reviews.author: Lucyale

reviews.author: sandra a

reviews.author: Ananthan N

reviews.author: SummrGirl!
reviews.title: Affordable AI option with some downside
reviews.text: Great food options.  Beach is nice but cannot access after dark.  Pool also closes at dark which is a big deal.  Reason given was they didn't have enough lighting.  That's a pretty easy fix for a resort however.  No hot tubs and not enough seating at the pools.  Staff was wonderful.  Entertainment was average.  More family oriented entertainment and no adults only options.  The rock band entertainment was obnoxious.  It's inside the rotunda and you can hear it super loudly throughout the hotel and in your room.  It goes until almost midnight so if you or your children are trying to sleep the night this band is playing, forget it.  Really unacceptable.

reviews.author: jboatman
reviews.title: Service was excellent!
reviews.text: I would vacation here with family. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Beautiful beach!! The pool is great.

reviews.title: Service in hotel paradisus

We were treated barbaric and the service was excellent, as well as tbn from Juan Manuel , both in Resto Malba of Paradisus Meliá. We are surprised with the Hunan quality received during our stay in Cancun.

reviews.author: Neil A
reviews.title: Great steakhouse.

reviews.author: Ulises M
reviews.title: Excellent!!
reviews.text: We had a great time, excellent everything about hotel. Food, rooms, swimming pool, beach and special all staff. The service is excellent and also the space for minors is a good alternative. We felt very comfortable, we hope to return

reviews.author: Tim S
reviews.title: Melia Paradisus Hotel in Cancun
reviews.text: Martin was our waiter at breakfast in Malva restaurant. Martin provided excellent service and always very friendly. The food was great and so many choices. My wife and I had a fantastic experience every day. The hospitality was wonderful every day. We would recommend the Meliá Paradisus is a great vacation spot for everyone.

reviews.author: Cruiser37281346139
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Experience 10/10 very comfortable beds and staff are very good especially Coffee shop pearl excellent service will definitely go again. Thank you perlita cared to attend us and look for what we wanted even if I didn't have it in cafeteria

reviews.author: Alina F
reviews.title: Excellent !!!
reviews.text: Jesus has been our waiter and he has been absolutely fantastic! His recommendations for food and drinks were spot on! Thank you LemonFish and thank you Jesus! Excellent sushi and excellent drinks!!We highly recommend the good and service!!

reviews.author: Carmel A
reviews.title: Absolutely Beautiful!!!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun exceeded my expectations! I've travelled extensively to many AI resorts, and this was one of my favorites. After reading some poor reviews, I was slightly concerned, but there was nothing to worry about! I will preface this review by mentioning that we upgraded to the Reserve, Adult's Only section and I would highly recommend this. 

The resort itself is gorgeous with high ceilings, running water, greenery and relaxing smells wafting through the air. Upon arriving, we were ushered off to a private check-in where we were encouraged to begin enjoying a cocktail and charcuterie snacks in the atrium while waiting. What a feeling of indulgence after the flight and transfer! Check-in was quick and seamless, after which our personal concierge (Mario) booked our restaurant reservations, bali beds and sunset cruise (included for Reserve guests) for the week. Mario would also provide daily updates on WhatsApp to remind us what was scheduled.

Our room was a Sunset view in building 5 - Reserve section. I know some reviews mentioned outdated and/or poor rooms, but ours was lovely. It was comfortable, well equipped and the shower had fantastic water pressure with hot water on demand! One note, when staying on the sunset side, some previous reviews complained about hearing bass thumping all through the night from a nightclub across the street. We could hear this if we happened to wake up and listened for it, but it did not cause us issues at all. In all honesty, the air conditioning in our room was louder. If you are somebody that needs total silence when you sleep, I'd recommend bringing earplugs. 

The next thing I will mention is the food, which was wonderful! We consider ourselves "foodies" and thought the presentation and taste was outstanding. Not every dish was our favorite, but that can happen anywhere, and I did my research before coming to ask others what their favorite appetizers, entree's and desserts were. Each restaurant was distinctive ,uniquely decorated, and very elegant. We belong to a dinner club, and often mentioned that what we were presented with was "dinner club worthy" Lol. We dined at Lemon Fish, Sante, Sal Steak Cave (also included for Reserve guests), Capella, Augamarina and Cielo. All were good, but Lemon Fish, Sante, Sal's and Cielo were my favorite in terms of food. Sante and Agamarina also got high marks for being outside with outstanding views. The menu is available via a QR code when you sit down, although you can get view full listing of menus on the Melia app to plan before hand. Most menu items are included, and the ones that are "extra charge" are clearly noted. I saw complaints about this as well, but virtually every resort offers upgrades for those that wish and the food/drink that was included was fabulous in my opinion. I will mention that we only ate in the main buffet once (dinner on the first night), and thought it was pretty average. Had we eaten there all week, this might be a different review. Each morning, we had breakfast and lunch in the reserve's atrium or Sante (the outdoor restaurant for reserve guests). The menus were varied and the breakfasts were absolutely delicious - extra bacon and mimosa's each morning - no problem! 

In fact, nothing seemed to be a problem at Paradisus. The staff in the reserve section was awesome, providing attentive restaurant and poolside service. Every expression of gratitude was met with "It's my pleasure". They were always smiling and gracious. I would like to highlight Louis and Lorena in the atrium, Cesar, Valeria and Fernardo at Sante and Victor and David, the pool concierges. Each one of them was delightful and made sure we were comfortable and satisfied. When staying in the reserve section, our concierge was able to reserve a poolside bali bed twice during the week. For the other days, you can put your name on a waiting list the day before you'd like it. We were lucky and were given beds for the entire week. Not only did Victor and David try to get us beds side by side with the other couple we traveled with, but they'd set us up each day and make sure we were comfortable. No sooner would you lay down, when one of the Sante servers mentioned above would come to see if they could bring a drink. The staff was really amazing. 

There was varied evening entertainment, but it seemed mostly geared to families, and my one recommendation would be to have a lounge with bands or singers that focuses on more laid back, adult entertainment. I've really enjoyed this at other resorts and it was the one thing I did miss a bit. There's nothing like a fabulous dinner followed by a nightcap with music.

The beautiful pool was heated and and the ocean/sand was absolutely stunning. This leads me to my only drawback of the vacation which was the weather. It was cloudy/rainy and very windy for most days we were there, which prevented us from enjoying the beach as much as I would have liked. Although this was disappointing, it certainly wasn't the resort's fault, and the staff really tried their best to make up for it by asking if their was anything they could bring to make us more comfortable. Food and drinks galore!!

I realize that had we not stayed in the Reserve section, we might have a different view of the rooms and resort itself. I understand that Paradisus Cancun will be closing for a year in June to complete renovations and upgrades. However, when they open again, I'd really love to go back!

reviews.author: Roving59163272490
reviews.title: Birthday
reviews.text: We went there for my grand daughter’s birthday and we had a great service by   Jesus Angelica and yajaira at Lemin Fish restaurant they were so accommodating with decorations and birthday wishes thank you all we enjoyed our stay and certainly we recommend this hotel

reviews.author: Rebecca W
reviews.title: Wonderful resort!
reviews.text: This is a Wonderful resort especially for people with mobility issues!  I felt like the Queen Bee because all I had to do was call the front desk and a wheelchair and attendant took me anywhere on the property. Also room service was quick and delicious!

reviews.author: Ana G
reviews.title: yhi spa
reviews.text: Highly recommended the spa of the hotel paradisus Cancun. Prices are expensive but worth the experience, there are various body treatments, facials, massages and manicures and pedicures. My treatment was Hamasaki which includes an exfoliation, pedal reflexology massage and wrap with Shea butter, the therapist Leonor made the experience unbeatable.

reviews.author: Maria G
reviews.title: The journey of my dreams
reviews.text: Excellent Service from Sante Restaurant and Attention given by Gemma, Joshua and Jacob. Excellent hotel its facilities, loved too much, I am interested in coming back next year to remodel the hotel.thanks so much paradisus for the experience

reviews.author: Blanca R
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text:
Being members of the Melia Paradisus club we knew we had to make our reservation in advance, but one day we decided to make a break in the cold we have in New Hampshire, and we made our reservation at the last minute. Ivette Sanchez & Veronica Jimenez (amazing service) helped us make it possible and also gave us incredible attention while at the hotel , a nice welcome letter upon arrival with nice details typical of Mexico,
Our very spacious room with everything we needed and everything working perfectly, coffee every day and in the minibar all kinds of soft drinks, beers and water, and the most amazing thing was an incredible view of the sea.The areas in general clean and in good condition, The attention of the workers is excellent and friendly , all willing to give you the best of Mexico “hospitality”, both the people in the pool (Iramh) on the beach (Francisco) restaurants (William, Adriana , devyson, giovanni, Ramiro) gym (Uriel) , Bellman (Raul, Abraham, kemil, Eduardo)Animation .
I will definitely return very soon and recommend them with my friends and family with the assurance that their vacation will be as amazing as mine 🤩 .

reviews.author: Vacation27732927033
reviews.title: amazing!!
reviews.text: The hotel was so accommodating and the staff was excellent. Veronica, Ivette, and Jenny were awesome. Our rooms were amazing, the food was great, and the beach was so clean, but the color of the water doesn't even look real. Couldn't have had a better time, recommend to all.

reviews.author: Schesmila annie T
reviews.title: Not a good experience at all
reviews.text: I spent a week in the hotel with a group of 25 executives. Overall, our stay was disappointing. Many of my group had to request room changes due to problems with the AC, a leaking room size, etc. I came in with my family (3) and was assigned to a king-size bed. I had to switch rooms on my second day without being advised that it would be a noisy area. It was six nights of bad sleep. Even though my dedicated manager (Gerardo) was great at accommodating all my requests, the hotel could have better services. The AC and power in the meeting room went off twice. The F&B were very poor. The quality of pastries and desserts was terrible. Overall, the food was okay, but the all-inclusive package did not offer a good variety of dishes. For my group dinners, I had three main course choices. The only fish offered was sea bass. It was challenging to have avocados for breakfast or guacamole with meals. This shouldn't be an issue in Mexico. For breakfast, there was no freshly squeezed orange juice. That is the least any hotel can offer. The hotel was old, falling into pieces. Unfortunately, the weather wasn't good that week, so the hotel should come up with indoor activities and announce them. Loud music should not pass 10 pm. It disrespects the families and people working, even though it's a vacation resort.

reviews.author: mauricio k
reviews.title: Avoid this place. Must have reservations. Concierge service is terrible. Pools are freezing cold
reviews.text:
Worst place to stay in cancun. Having come to cancun for 20 years and staying at every level of hotel, all inclusive or a la carte, and this is by far the worst experience. All restaurants, except the crappy buffet, are reservation only. Which means, you have an early dinner, look for a cool place to grab a bite at 10 that is completely empty, NOPE they can't seat you. Mind you, they close at 11. There isn't a soul inside, there is nowhere else to go because the 4 other restaurants say the same thing. You can't eat anywhere without a reservation, hard stop.  Our check in happened at 5 first day, the "concierge" closes at 5, they're the only person who can book you anywhere. So your SOL, you're literally going to go home without getting seated at a restaurant.
Room service isn't bad, takes 90 minutes at least
Bars all close at 2300. Room service can't take you drinks after 2300

Ordered drinks at the bar, they swished some tap water in the cup after someone else had used, no soap, no washing. Great way to catch something unexpected and very disappointing.

This place really is terrible
Poorly organized, poorly run. The app doesn't work
The beach isn't swimmable.
The pools aren't heated. They're un-swimmable unless you enjoy 65 degrees water
You can't eat without a reservation.
The concierge that you pay for is a joke. Only available "9-4". Waste of $$
The rooms are run down. This place is shutting down in june allegedly, and rightly so. Hopefully they don't open back up because this really is a terrible use of your money. 0/5. Awful experience
The ONLY saving grace is a handful of the staff, the majority are honestly terrible. Joan was awesome to helping us get a table, armando at the luggage check in was excellent, but the one who really saved us this trip was Gaudencio. He made the experience bearable. His counterpart Francisco en la playa was also excellent. These are the people who make the hotel and made it bearable. If you can't cancel your reservation and you're stuck at this place, find these people and tip them because they will treat you excellently

reviews.author: Marcelo S
reviews.title: Perfect days!
reviews.text:
The hotel is very good, with several restaurants, great location, spectacular service, perfect leisure areas and with the sea with blue water in front of the hotel.
The concierge Enrique was very attentive, was always available to help and make the stay even more special. He helped from the arrival at the hotel to the check-out.

reviews.author: DIANA G
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun, beautiful hotel!!!
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Cynthia A

reviews.text:

CINTHIA is a great waitress and was very attentive to us. The food was also very good. Get the tomato soup, octopus, prawns and the pavlova :)

reviews.author: Greg B
reviews.title: Meh. No more trips to Melia properties.
reviews.text: The resort is old. Their policies are overly strict and their care for client experience is poor. Other than our conceirge, Miguel, who was THE MAN... reviews.author: Ilazi A
reviews.title: Best experience in Cancun
reviews.text: Such a great hotel with great beach club. Great beds with the best views. Clear white sand and really sky blue water. The service was top especially Carlos!! We did not manage to pass off our payment as eating and drinking completely while getting special food. Next time definitely again !!!

reviews.author: Alex M
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Great family experience at Paradisus Cancun. Family concierge made the vacation easy to navigate will small children. Our concierge Mario was very helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: Rodrigo S
reviews.title: Unforgettable
reviews.text:
Wonderful hotel, excellent service, all friendly and helpful staff. The pools are great and the restaurant options allow almost a week without repeating meals. For those who can, the Family Concierge service offers an even higher level of comfort and convenience. We were treated with great affection by Daniel.
I'd definitely come back.

reviews.author: Gord M
reviews.title: Family vacation January 2025
reviews.text:
Our experience at the Paradisus Cancun was very good. The hotel is fairly large but easy to navigate and situated right on the beach. The food at most restaurants was good and the service was generally excellent. 

We did the family concierge and it was a worthwhile addition for our family. Our concierge Enrique was excellent - friendly, helpful and provided good suggestions for our stay. The boat trip was a highlight. 

Pros: location, beach access, family concierge, beautiful lobby
Cons: hotel is a bit dated in places (cosmetic only).

reviews.author: Janet Z
reviews.title: Great food at Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Ernesto at the Lemon Fish is an amazing server! 10/10 Ernesto had great recommendations. Desert was awesome. 
Highly recommend you try out the Lemon Fish at the Paradisus Cancun and when you come here you have to ask for Ernesto. I would definitely come back and eat here.

reviews.author: Erick S
reviews.title: Food in the restaurant Malva
reviews.text:
Tonight we were excellently served by Lilliana in the Malva restaurant of the Paradisus Cancun hotel 
Very good tasting food and wide variety of dishes, desserts and international food. 
Very cozy place and are always attentive to the service

reviews.author: Minor A
reviews.title: Work dinner.
reviews.text: Thank you very much for this great service that makes you feel at home. Liliana (Rest Malva) helped us with everything in our dinner moment, very professional and friendly. Excellent food looking forward to returning soon. Thank you and recommended 100%.

reviews.author: Jen D
reviews.title: AMAZING RESORT
reviews.text:
I have so much to say about this fabulous resort!  I have never done a review on a resort but I read so many comments before I booked (including the really bad ones taken with a grain of salt) and there were a couple very detailed ones that I really appreciated, so I am going to try to do the same.
I have been on approximately 20 all inclusive  vacations, all over the caribbean; I'm a beach girl, in my 50's, who loves to lay by the beach all day (under a hut), swim in the ocean, have good alcoholic drinks, eat good food and relax. I'm not particularly fussy about decor but of course like things clean.  I'll start there.

My stay at THE RESERVE:

Our concierge was Tony.  Such a great guy!  He was so personable and always right there!  My friend didn't know how to use the WhatsApp but he downloaded it for him and showed him how to use it, a couple times, all with a smile!  He was right there every time we had a question.  We messed up our safe and couldn't get in, so call Tony!  It was really nice to have a go to! It is totally worth the small extra fee to stay at The Reserve (adults only).

CLEANLINESS: This whole resort was spotless, I did not see one speck of dirt anywhere. In the room, in a restaurant, not even in the beach bathrooms. The staff work SO SO hard.  Every morning when I went out to get my hut (more on that below), they were cleaning all the windows top to bottom, every single day and there was never any sand coming into the hotel from the beach! 

COFFEE SHOP/BEACH: Next step after waking, I went down at 7am every day to the coffee bar. Out of this world coffee and pastries.  I order a cappuccino (or two) and grabbed a couple mini muffins and marble bread to go to beach to get my chair/hut (palapa).  1 minute walk to towel hut, where you did not need to trade in your used towels or wait for someone to hand over one towel.  They were all ready and still warm! for you to just grab.  I made the quick walk to the beach to get situated for 7:30 sunrise.  I would definitely suggest get your spot 7ish if you really spend all your day at the beach; but people do come and go all day so there is usually 1 or 2 free at all times.  The bathroom is 10 steps up and clean and all the same good soap as in your room.  10 steps up from that is the bar on the left, with THE BEST GUYS! SUPERB drinks and the best happy personalities. Again, everyone here is so so nice.  To the right is Sante, a great restaurant.  The breakfast menu seems limited (doesn't mention eggs, bacon..etc) but you can order it and it's really good.  Great pancakes too.  I also went here most days for lunch because I didn't want to leave the beach long and it was quick service and delish burgers.
and DAISY the pool cat!  They take very very good care of her, she's a beautiful sweet girl and she loves to snuggle all the guests in the bali beds around the pool. ( I snuggled her in the morning on my way down to the beach)
The water was sooo nice and clean, big waves, no seawood, a few rocks on the way in, nothing that hurts or cuts your feet.  There were a couple days where it was really rough getting in, ie, people loosing tops or bottoms lol, but once you get in, it's fine.  All about timing!

FOOD:  All the food is good everywhere.  I come from a state where the food is off the charts delicious so I'm a little bias but there wasn't anything I ever said I didn't like and I ate plenty!  

ROOM: The bed was SOOO COMFORTABLE.  THE SHEETS were exceptional.  I don't generally get in bed and say aaghh.  BUT I did here! The room was fully stocked every day with plenty of towels, face clothes, water, clean glasses. The shower was amazing.  The soap, lotion, shampoo and conditioner they have smells sooo good and felt so very clean. (All in dispensers)

NIGHTLIFE: I don't have much to say because being on the beach all day, I was tired after dinner and ready for a night cap and bed.  It does all seem to be in building 3, the main building.  SIDE NOTE:  Going from Building 5 (The Reserve) to other buildings is very confusing inside BUT if you do it from the outside, it's easy and takes a minute.  I learned the hard way walking in circles!

This resort is beautiful and lovely! I will definitely go back.  I would go back next year if they weren't closing for renovations (I believe May 31, 2025 to June 1, 2026) and I hardly ever go to the same place twice but it was that nice. It was safe, all the guests I talked to were so nice, the staff, .  I asked what they were doing because the hotel is gorgeous, it's an update to ' the guts' plumbing, etc.

reviews.author: Tristan H
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: We just stayed 5 days here and it was absolutely beautiful. We upgraded to the reserve side on check in and couldn’t have been happier. We got assigned Enrique as our concierge. He went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of. Only downside we found is there is not a lot of activities or nightlife for adults on the resort.

reviews.author: riley g
reviews.title: We <3 Miguel!!
reviews.text: Oh my goodness, words cannot even express how much we have enjoyed our time here. We are so glad we upgraded to the Reserve and with the Reserve area we got to meet Miguel!! Miguel has made us feel like royalty as we’ve been lounging by the adults only pool and making sure our drinks stay full, offering recommendations, bringing us food poolside! He has been so attentive and we have made sure to sit in his section every day when he isn’t working at Sante. Mucho gracias Miguel!!

reviews.author: APoyot9
reviews.title: Alex and Elle
reviews.text:
Abraham, Gabi and karina in the Ginger bar was 10/10!!!! The best of the best and the best cocktails in Mexico. Wonderful!!

Abraham, Gabi and Karina from the Ginger bar were 10/10!! The best of the best and the best cocktails in Mexico. They were great!!

reviews.author: Rachael M
reviews.title: A great week at Paradisus!
reviews.text:
Just wrapped up a week at Paradisus Cancun, and it was one of our favourite resorts. We stayed in an Oceanview Junior Suite in the Reserve Section and the staff are truly what made this week special! 

All the pool side staff we encountered (Oscar, Jose, Daniel and Gabby) were fantastic and provided great service. Luiz at the bar was a favourite as well. Always bringing the positive vibes even on the overcast and rainy days. 

Our Concierge, Manuel, was available everyday and was able to ensure we got reservations at any restaurant we wanted to try. He helped us book the Bali Beds and hydromassage as well. 

We travelled for a milestone birthday and all the staff played a big part in making it a great day, they went above and beyond to make it feel special and it was very much appreciated :)

Food was also great - Sante for breakfast and lunch was a favourite, as well as Lemon Fish and Agua Marina for dinner. 

Thank you for a great week!

reviews.author: TGabor1123
reviews.title: Welcome Home!
reviews.text:
Our Melia family welcomed us home and took exceptional care of us during our entire stay. We've visited Paradisus Cancun numerous times over the past 10 years, and it's so wonderful to see familiar faces. 
Martin in the buffet greeted us with a "welcome home" table sign as soon as we arrived. What a wonderful way to start our vacation! Thank you, Martin, for your great service over the years.
Our dining experience in Lemon Fish was amazing! We chose to celebrate New Years Eve here, and it didn't disappoint. Jorge our waiter, and Borris the manager, made it a night to remember! Great food, great service, and great memories! 
Lucas at Cielo Mexican restaurant provided such amazing service, that we chose to dine here a few times during our stay. He was great with menu options and kept our Cadillac Margaritas coming! 
Flor at pool side greeted us with a big smile and asked about our family! She's the best! Thank you, Flor, for taking such good care of our family the last 10 years. 
Elisco, Carlos, and Yoni, at the swim up bar remembered what we liked and kept our drinks flowing! Thank you all for such great service!
Our concierge Jaun Carlos (JC) helped with all our request, questions, and reservations.  He was always accessible whenever we needed anything. Thank you, JC, for taking such good care of us.

Leaving was bittersweet, knowing that Paradisus Cancun is scheduled to close for remodeling late this summer. We can't wait to return as soon as it reopens! Until then we have our memories and pictures to reflect on! See you soon Melia Family!

reviews.author: Odyssey60722531799
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text:
In restaurant Santé excellent service from the waiter Bernardo. 
Loved the menu in restaurant and pool, recommend fish tacos. Clean and good condition facilities in restaurant, beach and pool. 
This is my third visit to the Paradisus Cancun hotel in Reserve. I recommend it.

reviews.author: Alyssa G
reviews.title: Yummy food and great service
reviews.text: It’s our First night here and we went to the blue agave restraunt and we had  Pablo as a server who was fantastic! His service was quick and helpful! Food was great ! Ordered tacos,chips and guacamole and margaritas! 🫶🏼🤙🏼 can’t wait to come back here again!

reviews.author: Brett C
reviews.title: Flora Restaurant
reviews.text:
Flora Restaurant at Paradisus Cancun exceeded all our expectations! From the moment we walked in, the experience was nothing short of fantastic. Fanny went above and beyond to assist us with a mix-up in our reservations, ensuring everything was arranged perfectly. Her professionalism and kindness truly set the tone for the evening.  

Marco provided exceptional service throughout our meal, always attentive and friendly, making us feel like VIPs.  

The food was outstanding—each dish was a delight. The salmon was perfectly cooked and flavorful, the chicken was tender and well-seasoned, and the poke bowl was fresh and vibrant. We couldn’t get enough! To top it all off, the dessert was an absolute treat.  

The restaurant's beautiful seating and ambiance added to the overall experience, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. If you're in Cancun, Flora Restaurant is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Helen0927
reviews.title: Amazing experience at Flora in Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
The service at Flora is amazing .
Our waitress was Cynthia and she was so sweet and always with a smile. So hardworking and eagle to please us. 
She made our experience at Flora so special and so unforgettable. 
She’s definitely a keeper. 
Thank you Cynthia.

reviews.author: ymayford
reviews.title: [PARADISUS CANCUN NO THANKS] The horror of our lives is no respect for the client.
reviews.text:
With no respect for the customer, it was the worst experience we have ever experienced in a Melia or Paradisus.  
We stayed at this hotel in May 2016 the experience was sensational and we were looking forward to repeating (pure Luxus) Wow there was nothing closer to perfection food service quality maximum!!

 In 2016 they had themed meals that DIED!  Ta you just looked up and there was a waiter next to you that died! Dirty tables you had to wait hours to be served and put a horrible drink on.

There was not a smile at the Reception as we are used to in each Hotel Melia everyone was very premiered or did not want to work very much which we miss very much because Mexicans are very nice normally, only the guys at the door and some trunks had a smile and were looking for a way to help.

The facilities of the Hotel and the beach beautiful but very poor service and poor rooms Quality Price nothing to see not recommended.

CACUN SI

reviews.author: Riley G
reviews.title: Gracias Cynthia!!
reviews.text: Cynthia was a pure joy on the entertainment team. She has truly added to our experience with her enthusiasm and kindness during our activities. Mucho gracias Cynthia!! we have experienced her authentic joy during many activities and she has truly added to our trip:)

reviews.author: Rob S
reviews.title: We Would Return
reviews.text:
I am writing after spending a week in the resort staying on the LaPerla side. It is January 2025, and the resort seems quiet. We had no problems getting a sun lounger on day 1 at 11:00am. It is noon now and there are still chairs available. Most poolside are taken with a few exceptions. This is the main pool and the live DJ starts at noon every day. If you don't care for loud (ish) music stay behind the DJ booth.

The resort is well maintained but is starting to show a little wear. Paint is peeling in some parts of the hallways and in the rooms (we had two) but nothing to discourage a traveller.

The staff have been exceptionally friendly. This includes check in, bar staff and servers. The majority of staff gave a quick Ola' as we walked by them. They were always tidying up the chair and pillows.

We reserved ala carte restaurants for five nights trying a different one every night. The food quality was a strong 8/10 in the adults only restaurants. Lemon Fish and Tokimeku were a very strong 9/10. The restaurants on the family side were less than average. The food was flavourful for the most part but luke warm at best. Not a one off was luke warm.....all meals (7) we tried. Blue Agave and Ceilo were Mexican restaurants. They were average at best. I would have expected more being in Mexico. Flora restaurant was 9/10.The poolside restaurants (Fahrenheit and Celsius) again were 8/10. The buffet on the adult only side was 7/10. The buffet on the Family side was a 6/10 due to some of the items not being very warm.

The evening entertainment was great. One night at Kanna (outside beach restaurant) it was  Mexican night. Live entertainment and 10 different food stations. They were even making fresh tacos over a wood fire. The entertainment was traditional Mexican dancers and music. On the adults only side there was an event every night. Traditional live music, dancers,  casino night etc.....
There is a sports bar/night club. We went in for a short time on two different nights. Mostly an over 35 crowd. It had some dance music and classic rock. They played The Macarena and YMCA so use your imagination.

We headed out to 5th Avenue one day and the taxi service from the hotel was great. They have fixed rates to popular destinations. It was $330 Pesos to the start of 5th Ave. The driver Carlos gave us his WhatsApp info so we could message him when we were ready to head back.
We booked a snorkeling excursion from the hotel. The lady (Bernice) was very informative giving us information over and above what I expected.
The tour was through Aquaworld. We would not book it again as the snorkeling was only 15 minutes and you were herded like sheep. They wanted to get you into the tourist part of Isla Mujeres as fast as possible. The beach club they took you to was a 2 star at best. Terrible food and watered down drinks.

The beach is large with beautiful powdered sand. There was very little seaweed and what was there was raked daily. There is staff to take any drink orders you may have. We walked from the hotel both ways on the beach for over a kilometer and felt very safe. They are public, with families everywhere.

The bar staff were great at making drinks. The M bar made fantastic martinis with around 8 choices. I ordered a few Old Fashioned’s and Whiskey Sours at different bars and they were great. Although  they did make one wrong but that can happen anywhere. The liquor selection was excellent with all of the standards.

We would return. Yes

reviews.author: Jorge S.
reviews.title: 2025 New Year Stay The Reserve Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Service and food were good.

Only thing that was very below expectation was the New Year party:
Party was in the convention center downstair instead of any open air space at the pool area or any other open area in a non cloud and non rain night (events team should have more then one scenario planned).
I tried to get a champagne glass before midnight for toast with my family and the waiter tried to give me it in a plastic cup instead a properly champagne glass (he mentioned that the champagne glass was only for the paid dinner guests. This was a very bad answer/training for an all inclusive resort, even that I had The Reserve bracelet).
To become even worst, there was no band, only DJ, and after midnight, from 12:15 am until 12:45 am, only local Spanish music was playing in a party that supposed to attend international guests. Very bad music selection! At this time, 12:45 am, the party had less than 30% of the guests, everybody left.
Also there wasn’t any fireworks to see at the hotel, some people got out side of the hotel to see some neighborhood fireworks, very bad!

I’ve been at The Reserve Paradisus Cancun 3 times before and this last time, was my first New Year stay try, but for New Year uroose, The Reserve Palma Real Punta Cana team event organization/party are much better!

Hope you guys can talk with each other to exchange ideas!

Regards.

reviews.author: mauriciodayz

reviews.text: Great hotel overall, beautiful view, clean amenities and proper beach installations, good food and lots of choices. Family friendly even tho it lacks some kids zones. reviews.author: Frank D
reviews.title: Reserve experience recommended
reviews.text:
We stayed in this hotel in 2018 and it was exceptional….we were very well looked after by the staff and the food at each of the seven restaurants was excellent. Even the buffet had a different theme each night, eg Seagood night featured the sort of crab claws you’d see on “the greatest catch” on the discovery channel. The cocktails were all freshly made and were amazing. 
We also upgraded to the “royal” experience and had a concierge who took care of restaurant bookings and ensured we made the most of our time.
We hesitated to return due the danger of us remembering it being better than it was.
Unfortunately, it has changed. The only thing that remains is that our concierge Enrique was excellent. He ensured we had restaurant bookings each night and ensured we always knew what was available at the hotel. 
He made up for the way the hotel has changed over the 6 years since we were last there. The buffet, was the same each night…or very similar. Gone are the crab legs and fresh tuna. The steak restaurant, produced a steak similar to what TGI Fridays would produce, and the food produced around the pool….two days out of the six we were served hot fries. The other 4 times they varied from lukewarm to cold…actual cold. Tbf they always then got fresh ones, but it was poor that happened two times out of three. There are “upgrade” options at the restaurants…eg upgrade to a ribeye not a sirloin steak. The upgrade prices are ridiculous..I think it was an 80 dollar upgrade for the steak. Eg you’d be better off leaving the hotel and eating elsewhere. 
The best food, was strangely the avocado and poached egg toast in the reserve lounge. It says something when breakfast is the best option. Lorena in the lounge ensured we were very well looked after. Enrique, our concierge went out of his way to look after us, and made up for the other shortcomings. Similarly the gentleman in the reserved lounge bar was very helpful ensuring our glasses were always filled. 
In summary , the staff, made up for the drastic change at the hotel.

reviews.author: Diana P
reviews.title: An excellent resort experience.
reviews.text: I can’t say enough how beautiful this resort is. Beach is terrific and the ambiance of the building is stunning. Beds are comfy, showers are great. The food at Flora is stellar and the hostess Fanny was attentive and checked on us. Fanny was the best, most professional server. Was here with four girlfriends on a ‘decade trip- 50 and 60! Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: sunnileo
reviews.title: Perfect Paradisus
reviews.text:
We love Paradisus! We want to thank everyone that made our stay so wonderful. The beach is beautiful, the service exceptional, the hotel accommodations are great, and the food is amazing! 

The moment we arrived we were greeted by Raul who made us feel so welcome! We then met our concierge Enrique who went over and beyond to make our stay memorable! Each day he checked in with us, shared activities, and surprised us with unforgettable experiences. 

Lastly, Miguel at Sante bar was so wonderful he even bid us farewell with beautiful cocktails at the beach. We are so grateful for all the friends we met and hope to see Paradisus soon again!

The Reserve. Adults only.

reviews.author: Katie M
reviews.title: Fun family trip
reviews.text: Thanks to ALL the staff here at Paradisus.  Special thank you to Gerardo and Michel at the buffet for taking such good care of us. Irina at the pool, and ALL the pool bartenders were so attentative and do a super job! Our room was missed on the housekeeping rounds for the last 3 days of our stay. The hotel beds are super comfy!

reviews.author: Alicia R
reviews.title: TOP NOTCH TREATMENT!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus hotel gets my highest recommendation. A wonderful all-inclusive resort.
The real draw of this establishment is the service and staff. From the moment you walk into the lobby and check in, every single staff member is so friendly, attentive, helpful, and professional. They constantly go out of their way to make sure guests are having a great time.

Our room was very spacious with a large balcony overlooking the pool and ocean, always welcoming the sunrise with the warm rays of the sun and the lovely sound of the ocean waves. Absolutely relaxing from the early hours of the day.

Like the rooms, the common areas and restaurants are spotless, well maintained, and with good service at all times.

To start, our concierge Enrique was exceptional. Always attentive and responding instantly to all our concerns. Thanks to Enrique we were able to take advantage of all the amenities of the hotel.

The food is diverse, healthy and very tasty. I wish I could name every single person of all the restaurants, all of them have amazing staff. To highlight, Rafael at Malva.

The spa facilities are truly exceptional. It is a complete experience that we thoroughly enjoyed and if you wish you can spend half a day relaxing there. Don't miss the guided hydrotherapy. The water circuit consists of a sauna, steam bath and massage with water jets. A space for relaxation, health and inner peace. All people at spa are kind and friendly.

The housekeeping staff does a fabulous job. Every night we found sweets and fruit with chocolate.

Upon my return home, I realized that I forgot my favorite winter jacket in the room. I immediately contacted our concierge Enrique and he confirmed that the jacket was found by the hotel's cleaning staff and was delivered to the lost and found office. One more reason to praise the quality and honesty of the hotel staff.

Later, they put me in touch with customer guest service and it was with Rommel that I was able to arrange for my jacket to be sent to the USA. Rommel was very helpful, he answered my texts instantly and it was thanks to his kind service and diligence that I was able to recover my jacket. Thank you Rommel! You are very cordial and professional.

The Paradisus Hotel in Cancun is highly recommended for those looking to relax and return home feeling energized. 

Service, kindness and honesty are values ​​that guests will always appreciate.

reviews.author: Daniela V
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: We loved the experience at Paradisus! Very friendly people. We had a Butler Daniel Maya and he was very attentive with us at all times, giving us daily information of the activities, reserving the restaurants for dinners, and attentive to all our requirements in general. Excellent and very personalized attention!

reviews.author: madison skraly
reviews.title: Amazing Dinner at Sal
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I had the most amazing experience here. Our last night we had dinner at Sal and it was absolutely incredible. The food was… delicious. Our waiter Roger made great recommendations and was super attentive. He made our dining experience really special. 10/10.

reviews.author: Christine S

reviews.text: Cielo has amazing food, and Moises was so great! We loved chatting with him about Mexican traditions!! And he made fabulous recommendations!!  We had the shrimp and enchiladas for starters; pulled pork and slow roasted beef for dinner; and churros and sugar coated flour chips with a bonus flan for dessert!

reviews.text: We visited Flora for the first time and it was amazing. The service was exceptional (Marco, Tere, Fanny) and the food was so good! (José). We ordered the flora salad, tomato soup, salmon main course and Moroccan meatballs. Can’t forget the sorbet and Pavlova for dessert.  Don’t skip this restaurant when visiting the Paradisus. Thank you Diego for your recommendation!  Loved it.

reviews.text: Valeria is the best!! As is Farideh. Great resort great service - food is so so but service and atmosphere make up for it. Great community and great music. Highly recommend the reserve as it’s more luxurious and mellow in comparison. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Flyer708303
reviews.title: Great experience but needs some improvements
reviews.text:
I loved the atmosphere of the hotel—it’s beautiful, with lots of plants, spacious areas, and stunning lighting at night. The coffee made by Alejandro was fantastic, and he was so kind and welcoming. The food at Malta Buffet was excellent, with a wide variety to choose from, and the grilled tilapia at Aquamarina Restaurant was delicious. The staff there were polite, and the view was amazing. A special thanks to Miss Noemi Cardeña for her helpfulness!

The only downside was the challenge of getting a sun chair by the pool. You have to reserve one very early in the morning, which felt stressful and not ideal for a relaxing vacation. There weren’t enough chairs for the number of guests, leading to some frustration. Additionally, getting fresh towels by the pool after 3 PM was difficult.

reviews.title: Fourth time is a charm

The resort will need some updating as we found the AC a little temperamental and saw a few places where water was wining the war against glass or concrete. Still one of my favourite resorts and one of the few I think the upgrade is worth it.

reviews.author: Fernando P
reviews.title: Excellent place

Excellent hotel, with a beautiful setting with plants everywhere, and impeccable service.
Our concierge Manuel solved absolutely everything.
The restaurants are varied, and the cafeteria is excellent.
Bartenders are geniuses.

reviews.author: fireman49
reviews.title: Paradis Cancun January 2025
reviews.text: Victor and David at the reserve adult pool were outstanding. They took the time and helped us out every day. this resort should look at these two fine men as an inspiration to what Customer Service should be like on a daily experience. During our stay at times, it feels like we were harassed to give a review right after dinner. It would be better if we gave a review at the end of our stay, but it seemed like it was more on the servers to pressure the guest during their dinner hours to give a review of their service. However, during our stay David and Victor never I repeat never indulge in the privacy of our stay. Victor and David always check on how we were doing and if we needed anything and if we did they were on it promptly. Again our stay was pleasurable and our stay was made even more enjoyable due to Victor and Davis, exceptional and professional quality of service.

reviews.author: Rogério
reviews.title: Continues good, but with many reservations
reviews.text:
We stayed in the same hotel two years ago and we are now back in 2025 and much of this review has comparables. 
The hotel remains stunning. Very green and an excellent astral. A very good vibe. 

A very good thing about this hotel - it has a heated pool. I only saw that on competitor hyatt ziva. 

The Wi-Fi was great during the whole stay.

However, it is clear that the quality has fallen. Since this hotel is always one of the most expensive in Cancun, 
Let's make a few observations:

We stayed in the fourth category Family concierge, facing the sea (a category of the most expensive), but pasmem, does not have the concierge service Ehehe. I chose for that and am surprised at checkin that there is no concierge. That's just the name of the category. Concierge is only for the category The reserve (which do not accept children). Ever thought of that? The hotel gives the name to a “concierge” category that does not have a concierge service kkkk. But the room of this category is very good - spacious and Nespresso coffee capsule. Really great room.

Although this category gives you access to a private check-in, I didn't like the impatient care of the attendant. He did not explain what advantages we would have in this category. The most famous complaint - and I've seen there are already several here - is that you simply don't get chairs or mattresses on the beach. They are very few and it is obvious that this stimulates the prisoner to wake up early and already leave booking. Cedinho no longer has anything and no one releases. Marking with towels stays all day long. I didn't see the hotel fighting it.
I think the idea is to sell their stores at very high prices. Someone's serving you on the beach, just with a lot of slice. 
If you go to any hotel with this problem, be empathic; think of the others too; come out and let go... think of it!!

The hotel has an excellent Nespresso cafeteria! There's cookies, sweet and salty. Very helpful. It's great!! It's open all the time. 

The Italian restaurant Capela unfortunately changed place and was allocated in an area where it used to be for hamburgers and snacks. The exchange left the restaurant without coziness and decoration. There's no pizza. The entrances and dishes are bad and with products that lose to the general Malva buffet. 

The Mexican restaurant Cielo has entrances with tacos/nachos and serves cheese quesadillas and fried potatoes on request; I liked it. However, the main black rests to filling for nachos. Some bastards who don't like it. 

The general buffet Malva is very good, but comparing two years ago, dropped quality in products, but continues very good. Breakfast is always the best of resorts for me. The coffee here is excellent. Highlight to the waitress Ramiro (we adore him) and Liliana Sanches from the egg and omelette station. They were great 

Desserts are bad - they are summed up to some graceless cookies and ice cream. However, this happens in almost all resorts. 

The famous Lemon Fish restaurant unfortunately has only beauty. To our taste, everything is bad. Long service and miss the opportunity to transform the place - q is beautiful - in the best point of any resort. Actually, to taste Brazilian, I think nothing is good. It's a judgment. The restaurant could very well have a sushi snack season. There's no Yaksoba, chess chicken, sweet pork. None of that. It's all quite different (little and bad)

The meat restaurant Sal, only paying or if you are in the Reserve category. Negative point. 

The Caribbean and Mediterranean restaurants I did not even go, but I watched the dishes. More of the same and almost everything is in the general buffet. The assembly on the plate q is different. 

The fish restaurant did not even go this year pq we already hated two years when we met. Better pick fish and seafood at the main buffet.

The beach in front of the hotel is very busy and with some stones and shells. It may bother, but nothing that you go a little to the right or left will solve. The sea remains wonderful. 

The Academy became small and outdated
For so many people. There was no linen and alcohol for cleaning. She's got good bicycles and trays, but she's pissing on the appliances. 

In short, come if the price is good for you. Risking paying a little further, expecting something much higher, can be disappointing. For me, two years ago the trip was another (better).

reviews.author: Louise
reviews.title: Paradise-Us
reviews.text:
We returned from a 10 night stay back in December and were a group of 4 British adults (2 x couples). After reading reviews we booked to stay in The Reserve and were very glad we did as it was a less populated, more relaxing area. 

The rooms were nice and we both had amazing sea views. If you looked closely you could see that some things needed a little spruce, but overall the rooms had everything we needed and were very clean (cleaned everyday). As we were part of the reserve, if there was anything we ever needed (including minibar top ups) we would just WhatsApp our amazing concierge - Jose! 

Talking of Jose, as soon as we met him we felt at ease walking around the hotel (before that we were a bit lost as the place is so big)! Jose helped us make all of our dinner reservations whilst also booking us on other things like the Sunset Cruise - one thing you definitely can’t miss if you get the opportunity to go on it - and it’s free! 

Our days were mostly spent around the pool and although we wandered out of the reserve we preferred to ‘set up camp’ in the adults only section. Although quieter, on Saturdays they would have a DJ round by the pool along with other extras like a floating aperol bar. The staff during the day couldn’t be more attentive and always remembered what you liked! The only thing for us which was a bit inconvenient was that most of our stay (7 days out of 10) the beach toilets were closed, so your only option was to go back into the reception area of the hotel. 

The restaurants do get booked up quickly so we would recommend booking as many as you can when you first get there to secure good timeslots that suit you. The only time we ate at the buffet was during one lunch and although there was a lot of options, as 4 adults, we preferred eating at the many restaurants on offer! Lemon Fish and Sal’s were the two we visited more than once. 

The evening entertainment was good, although very much intended for the children. We found ourselves watching a few of them and then wandering over to Ginger Bar. We had many a good night there, thanks to Gaby and her team who filled us with endless shots! We really did enjoy ourselves there, but as it was the only bar open until close, we did find it a bit like deja vu after the first few nights! Due to this, we spent a couple of nights out of the hotel - one night at Coco Bongo and another night just in the club strip. We got Uber’s there and back which were well priced and we felt very safe. 

Overall, we loved our 10 nights away and would come back again or go to another Melia hotel in Mexico as this reached our expectations. Thank you again to all of the hardworking staff!

Room: I had a nice ocean view room in the main building. All comfortable. Cleaning service mostly come in the afternoon. Beach: Wonderful sandy beach but the ocean had a lot of waves during the time I was there but I still managed to enjoy it. They say March or April are the best time to come. Food: There is the main buffet for breakfast, lunch or dinner and then there are various à la carte restaurants for dinner. The food is high quality and tasty. Would definitely go back!,

reviews.author: juan carlos p
reviews.title: Very good experience with some details to improve
reviews.text:
Overall an excellent hotel, we felt satisfied and would probably return.  

From my experience I first tell the positive:  Very clean hotel, very well maintained, beautiful beach and well maintained. you could tell that the hotels next door had rocks on their beaches and Paradisus did not.  The friendliness of the staff is unbeatable.  The food is good, but if you eat in restaurants with reservation.   The beds very comfortable and the constant availability of towels in the pools and beach is appreciated.

Things to improve: definitely drinks and cocktails.  Of all the bars only the bar of Lemon Fish restaurant was noteworthy, the rest very bad.  Bland drinks.  Even with the ingredients, the bar tender couldn't prepare the drinks.  I tasted margaritas, mesaitas, Cuban mojito, pina coladas and none was well made.   Natural juices and natural beverages without flavor.  Buffet restaurant food somewhat cold and there was no variety overnight.   Another house that can improve is that you need a hot tub with hot water. there were in the unheated pools and they were always with cold water.  

The room we got was on the first level.  A horrible view for the place.  It had a mini jacuzzi on the terrace but didn't feel like using it.  It was dirty with hair remnants, and also overlooking white walls. It's never used for that.  In the bathroom we always lacked towels and they take a long time to leave them.  

Overall the experience is positive, but with few adjustments the hotel could have been perfect.

reviews.author: Katie T
reviews.title: Great resort, family friendly, excellent staff, beautiful beaches.
reviews.text: We took our grandparents here for vacation, so 2 elderly and 2 in our 20's. The staff were incredible, so happy to help and please you. They went out of their way to assist us with our grandpas wheelchair, serving us, and guiding us. The beach access could have been a little more handicap accessible but otherwise the resort was very accessible for a wheelchair. I'd like to mention a few of the staff, during our check in at the front desk Enrique went above and beyond to ensure we had rooms next to our grandparents (one of which is physically disabled & has Alzheimer's). At the buffet Malva, we had several servers provide excellent service during breakfast lunch and dinner, so thank you to our servers Martin, Fernando, Joni, Mariana, Candelario, and Enrique. The beach was beautiful and white, no trash or seaweed, didn't have to wake up incredibly early to get a beach cabana. Room service the food was pretty cold but our rooms were nice, had a great view of the sunrise and of the shows that were hosted at the pool. Other hotels allow you to check out a wheelchair and keep it during your stay, and the hotel was fully booked while we were here but they wanted to have a worker drive the wheelchair to your destination then they took the wheelchair back. Grandma missed a step (totally her own fault) but after that they allowed us to keep the wheelchair during our stay which was great. Would recommend if you need a wheelchair full time to bring your own. They had an umbrella for us to use when we had a reservation at the outside restaurant, as our grandparents are very slow walkers and would've been sopping wet by the time we got there. You can order food and drinks on the beach and have them delivered, the beach was NEVER crowded or unenjoyable. Didn't see any marine/wildlife but sometimes that's a good thing! It's a fairly quiet hotel, not too many activities in the evening but we thoroughly enjoyed this resort and the staff were always incredibly incredibly helpful and kind.

reviews.text:
We were atended by Ivonn and Alberto at restaurant Malva in the dinner . They were very friendly and received us very well in our first day in the hotel ! Thanks for both for the good reception and good Service.
Buffet with good variety of salads and very well presented in the Buffet .

reviews.author: Jean F
reviews.title: Malva Cenas Experience
reviews.text: Phenomenal service by our waitress Ivonn and waiter Alberto. My wife and I were impressed by the attention to detail and efforts made towards making our experience top tier! I would highly recommend dining at Malva Cenas! Overall a 10/10 experience. Food was also exceptional. There is no way that you will leave this dining experience with an empty stomach.

reviews.author: Sabine P
reviews.title: Wonderful stay at the Reserve
reviews.text:
My husband and I just spent 5 nights at Paradisus Cancun in early January. We stayed in the Reserve section of the resort which is for adults only and includes its own adults-only pool, poolside restaurant and bar, as well as an indoor lounge area where one can have breakfast, lunch as well as snacks and drinks all day long.  
The Reserve also comes with a dedicated concierge that handles restaurants reservations and Bali bed reservations as well as specific requests you may have.  Our concierge Rossana was great.  She booked our preferred restaurants and Bali beds on day one.  She checked in regularly with us during our stay to see if we needed anything. 
The adults-only pool area is generally quiet (no rowdy groups while we were there, but it was also a quiet time of the year, right after New Year’s, so maybe we were just lucky). They do have music playing (not all day long) which can sometimes be overbearing if your Bali bed or lounge chair is close to the speaker.  
The resort itself is very well maintained.  Our room and all common areas were super clean at all times of the day.  We dined at several of the resort restaurants and I found Flora to be the best.  We were not too impressed with Lemon Fish which is supposed to be a sushi place, but only offers a very limited sushi menu (additional sushi options come with a surcharge). In any case it’s great to have the variety when it comes to dining options!  
I found the resort staff to be super nice, professional and efficient.  You are always greeted with a smile, whether it be at the pool, the bars, the shop, etc… They do care about the wellbeing of the customers.  This was our second time at Paradisus Cancun and we would gladly go back.

reviews.author: Oliver S
reviews.title: The cafes were very good
reviews.text: Mrs. Pearl of the Cafeteria was very kind. He always made sure to give us the best possible service, the coffee was very delicious and the desserts were delicious.  In addition Luis was our waiter at LemonFish and provided excellent service. He is a very attentive and friendly boy. They should hire more people like them who make us feel welcome.

reviews.author: Vacation24927328694
reviews.title: Incredible! Want to visit again!
reviews.text: The resort was very welcoming and everyone was very friendly. The staff was very helpful especially our concierge Enrique, who provided us with activity and food information daily throughout our stay. We loved the service and the restaurants at the resort had delicious food. The beach was right there and we could walk to and from the beach and the pool whenever, which made the experience that much more enjoyable. We loved it so much we want to do a trip there again!

reviews.author: SuzanneFexa
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, AMAZING service!
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay at Paradisus. We decided to upgrade our stay on the second day to the Reserve adults only side as we were super interested in the perks. 

Our room on both sides was nice, the room in tower 3 could use some love in terms of some new paint here and there but that didn’t phase us. Our room on the reserve side was stunning. We had no issues with AC or water in either. The beds and pillows were very comfortable as well. 

The food for the most part is really good. We found some things were not executed well but the service was always amazing and it’s pretty common you might order something that doesn’t suit your palate. If that’s the case, try something else! Lemon Fish was by far our favourite but we also loved Sal, Cielo and Sante. The only one we really didn’t like was Flora. (The Pool menu on the reserve side is much nicer in my opinion. Classic Mexican tacos, quesadillas, ceviche and aguachiles) 

The only reason I did not give 5 stars is because the room service menu is quite limited (more so for late night) and the quality at times was very poor for a 5 star resort. There is no swim up bar on the reserve side but they do make you for it with excellent service around the pools. There is also no music on the reserve side so the atmosphere is very quiet. We enjoy more pool entertainment or at least some music in the background. With the reserve upgrade you do have the option to go to the other side and use the other pool with a swim up bar and more lively music and or entertainment however! 

The regular pool is not heated so on a colder day it feels really cold but it is nice on those really hot days. The reserve side pool IS heated which I loved. 

There is nothing open past 11 if you meet friends and want to have a little night cap. Usually we’re in bed early to enjoy a full day of sun but it is nice to have options. (This may be a bonus to some as it gets very quiet) 

The staff at this hotel were so accommodating. They work so hard and I didn’t feel like it was soon closing. Honestly, some of the best service I have ever received on a resort and I usually go to 3-4 a year. I wish I remembered all of the names of the staff that stood out to us. But 3 I fondly remember are Yamil and Cesar, they are waiters around the pool and at the Sante restaurant. Nestor was also a HUGE highlight of our trip. He made the reserve pool side more fun for about an hour every day teaching dance/water aerobics. He is incredibly talented and very sweet. 

I’m a little shocked they are closing entirely for a year as the resort is already so beautiful and magical. The beach is PRESTINE and they even do food and drink service down there as well. 

I would honestly recommend this resort to anyone who is open minded that some areas/rooms may look a little outdated but in my opinion, that added character to the resort and it didn’t affect my trip at all. 

Every resort is different and that’s a part of the fun. I wouldn’t compare this resort to other luxurious 5 stars we have visited as it’s meant to be a different experience. 

This experience was amazing for us and I would definitely go back.

reviews.author: Makenzie C
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: My cousin and I went with our elderly grandparents who are hard of hearing and have difficulty getting around. The resort was fairly accessible, with ramps and elevators most places except for down to the beach. The staff was fantastic, very nice and always so helpful! Especially Martin, Fernando, and Jony at Malva, Enrique at check in, and Couoh the beach waiter.

reviews.author: Aisha F
reviews.title: Subpar holiday vacation
reviews.text:
Very disappointing stay. I booked this resort based on the good reviews and was completely surprised on day one of our stay. We arrived on Christmas Day and couldn’t get a reservation for dinner.  I had called them weeks earlier to reserve dinner, but they told me that I had to do it upon arrival and that I wouldn’t have any issues. Well our whole family had to wait 3 hours to be seated at any of the restaurants, which was way past our kids bedtimes. 

There is very little customer service and it takes an atrocious amount of time to make dinner reservations at all the hotel restaurants. Food is subpar, the only decent food we had was during the day when we had to pay $250 for a daybed which came with a nice seafood lunch. 

The beach chairs are hard to come by, you have to race out at 6 or 7a to get a decent spot. And then our chairs were stolen by the time we got to them. I’m sorry, but this is not an idea of a relaxing vacation when you have to fight for chairs. 

The hotel is also old and run down. As I was taking a shower, the entire left side of the shower ceiling collapsed on me, which was absolutely disgusting. It took them two hours to come fix it, which they simply put some plaster on the ceiling. I went to guest service to let them know how unacceptable it is for the ceiling plaster to come off like that and there should be some compensation, such as a food/beverage credit, and he looked at me and responded with “the only thing we can do is send you a gift” and never even apologized to me. Not sure what the “gift” was because it never showed up. Absolute worst customer service and highly recommend to NOT stay here.

reviews.author: Alex N
reviews.title: Highly disappointing stay. The reviews on this resort are not honest!
reviews.text:
Where do I begin, I don’t know how this hotel has a 4.5 star Rating.

1. The room was missing a drain in the tub and had no water pressure for the shower handle. I called and asked for it to be fixed and scheduled a time for next day at 10am. No One ever came. 

2. We noticed the place has very little customer service. No one is excited or even has any desire to help you with anything.

3. The restaurants offer horrible attitude towards customers.  The only restaurant we went to that had exceptional service was SAL and thats because its not part of the all inclusive. Highly overpriced for what it is. You would be better off going to Harry’s or something out of the resort. It would be cheaper and better.

4. The Buffet has very little customer service. Very common to wait half hour for a cappuccino or basic request. 

5. The place is older and ran down. Not very upkept. The shower head was wobbling and paint was falling apart in many places all throughout the whole place. 

6. If you want to sleep, pyramid 3 is not the place. All night you can hear the music and party as if you’re next to it.

reviews.author: María del mar A
reviews.title: EXCELLENT SERVICE
reviews.text: Excellent attention from the staff in general but I emphasize on CONCIERGE Assigned DANIEL MAYA very professional diligent We look forward to the remodeling of the facilities to return next years thank you very much family MELIA is our second trip and to the same place

reviews.author: Gabriela Acosta W
reviews.title: Professionalism
reviews.text: I want to express my thanks to the staff at PARADISUS CLUB MELIÁ CANCÚN, led by Sra VERÓNICA, since they received us they made us feel like family, they were very attentive to everything necessary to enjoy our stay, they performed with a lot of professionalism and of course always Sra Verónica de club Meliá Paradisus Cancún we watch her work tirelessly together with her entire team.

reviews.author: Vicky C
reviews.title: Disappointments above disappointments, clearly not a 5 star
reviews.text:
Horrible experience all over the line! One of the worst trips of our lives. 

We had booked a suite overlooking the lagoon. As soon as we arrived in the hallway overlooking our room, this section of the hotel looked abandoned/neglected, but we paid no more attention than that... 

first night we didn’t sleep from midnight to 4am-5am, as there is a bar across the street and the noise was intense. Our bed trembled so much the bass was strong. We asked for a change of room the next morning around 6:30, but as the hotel was “full” it was impossible to change rooms at the moment. We were told to come back the next morning to confirm the change of room request. 2nd night, same thing... as requested, we were at the front desk to confirm our request for change of room and we were asked to come back around 4am to make the change, because obviously the room was not cleaned. 

Around 4am, we were at the appointment given that morning and curiously, our request had not worked. They couldn't give us a room. 

We have repeatedly asked to speak to the supervisor, because for us, the primary purpose of a hotel is to sleep, which we did not manage to do the first nights. NEVER did he want us to see it, but he eventually granted our request for a change of room. 

So we made the change, without being at the end of our problems, the given room did not have air conditioning! We immediately returned to the front desk to ask to speak to the supervisor, David. He finally found a temporary solution, a change of room for one night, a little less near the bar in question, but a better room would be given to us afterwards. We didn’t sleep well again, but David promised us a new room... we were hoping for an upgrade for inconvenience, but no!

In short, after 4 rooms we managed to sleep almost normally. The beds are so uncomfortable that my husband had to sleep with our son to manage to have some semblance of comfort. 

None of the 4 rooms we had were renovated and in the last the mini fridge did not work. We asked twice to have it repaired, but it was not done. 

Cleaning service to the rooms was going way too late and we ran out of towels. I had to call twice to get some and it took 2 hours before I got some when I mentioned waiting for them after that for our showers.

On the food side, nothing exceptional either. You have to pay to have some semblance of a proper meal. The portions are tiny. Not a filet mignon or lobster without having to pay on top of the exorbitant price already paid for the stay. You have to book dinners in the restaurant while they are still empty! He seems to be understaffed as well. The service is very long.

Our concierge Pablo seemed more interested in selling us hotel upgrades than serving us. It was tiring. Hotel very focused on upgrades and extras for a fee. I’ve never seen it! Even to have a special request put to the dj of the pool it is necessary to pay! Not to mention the twelve thousand times someone from the hotel came to us to sell us photo or activity packages. Seriously, it would be easy to get out with an extra bill of $3 to $4,000 more than the “basic” package.

On the clean side, it was ordinary too. Glasses of alcohol from the day before on the beach not always collected, and drops of urine on the floor in all rooms. Floors clearly not washed regularly. 

On the plus side, the pool bar gang: Didier, Jorge, Flore and Edwardo managed to make us forget momentarily this disappointing trip.

Moreover, at the Pascual lunch and his team: Manuel, Rafael and Ariadna offered us impeccable service every morning offering us one of the best places to eat.

I would not recommend this hotel to people who want the luxury of a 5-star hotel and expect everything to be truly included. Very disappointed. Second and last time in a Melia.

reviews.author: Kristina
reviews.title: My favourite hotel!

reviews.author: Quinn R
reviews.title: Experience
reviews.text: This trip was an extraordinary, one of a kind experience.  Everything we needed was immediately taken care of. Antonio was extremely helpful. Would absolutely recommend him to be a concierge for another group of people traveling to Cancun.

reviews.author: Louise S
reviews.title: AWFUL start, slightly redeemed by amazing staff helping to remedy stressful start.
reviews.text:
I wanted to believe all the positive reviews on here before I arrived at the Paradisus in the hope that they won over the negative ones;  and the holiday i'd booked for 15 of us (aged 12-81) a year ago would be as wonderful as it looked.  BUT those negative reviews, sadly won out.  I had sent many, many emails in advance (right up until 2 days before arrival), reassuring and checking our accomodation plans were in place having noted previous guests issues. All to no avail. We arrived with no room for my 81 year old father (despite it being confirmed and showing these emails to the reception staff) and all our rooms were scattered despite several emails requesting them next to eachother due to children etc. The room of doom (AKA reception) could not have been more unhelpful if they tried - throughout our trip. The rooms were tired, water pipes leaking everywhere - my father fell and gashed his head as a result having already complained about the water on the floor outside his room;  and generally we felt like we were staying at Fawlty Towers. The ONLY redeeming factor was the brilliant Alejandra Vilches who looked after us when we found her on day one begging for some help to get our rooms sorted and restaurants booked.  I was so stressed, dissapointed and underwhelmed that Melia has been so utterly blind in accepting their customer services and reception teams do not commmunicate and therefore they have disgruntled guests the minute they walk through the door. 

Alejandra was an angel from start to finish in ensuring the remainder of our stay after a stressful first 48hrs was calm and helped us daily fix, sort and upgrade to ensure we could make the best of the situation. Did we make the most of it, and find laughter and joy in the ridiculously stressful situation?  absolutely - thank god for family.... . But would I return, NO.  Would i visit another Melia hotel - probably not. Shame, as we had the BEST xmas 2023 at the Gran Canaria hotel which prompted us to book in Mexico in the first instance.

reviews.author: Lindsey C
reviews.title: Paradisus during Christmas/New Year
reviews.text: This was our fourth trip as a family to Paradisus Cancun and we met a lot of lovely people. We do the Reserve, which is well worth the money. The food has really improved, especially at Cielo, Cappella and Sal (get the picanha). They now include a steak/lobster dinner to Reserve guests at Sante, which was delicious, though I thought they kinda kept it quiet. I told everyone LOL. They also offer an excursion to Reserve guests. I saw before that is was a cenote trip but ours was a sunset lagoon cruise. I almost skipped it, but my (adult) kids wanted to do it. It was actually really fun. The resort is overrun with children during the holidays, so if that's not your thing you need to book the Reserve. Our room was nice but needed plumbing maintenance. Oh, important note. The Reserve rooms have glass doors around the shower that look out so you can see the sea. There is a curtain you can pull but it is sheer. Our kids were sharing a room, so this was a problem. They ended up hanging a sheet from the rod. Seems like an easy fix to put a more private curtain. The pools are great, but the main pool is not heated. The Reserve pool was heated. Mixed bag there because when it was cloudy the heat was great but it did get too hot at times, hard for the resort to win that one so really not a complaint. One thing we were very sad about was that Kanna beach bar closed at 6. We used to meet people at the pool and then meet after dinner at Kanna for a drink. Disappointing because it is a lovely area. The staff was great as usual, especially the pool cabana guys Victor and David (shout out to Nicole, we missed her). Julio at the Reserve bar is an absolute gem. Nestor did a great job with poolside entertainment. Housekeeping was great. I don't know the woman's name who keeps the Reserve bathroom by the pool clean but man she does a great job. Not an easy task. Lalo was our concierge and he was great with all our requests. I do have to say that pool/dining service was very slow, but I think that has to do with staffing. The resort is shutting down in May for a major renovation so I'm sure they are having problems hiring. I hope the resort does well by the people who make their resort shine and that someone takes Daisy the cat during the renovation. I love her.

reviews.author: Gimena B
reviews.title: Meliá paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: The stay was wonderful at the Meliá paradisus Cancun.  Captain Guillermo’s attention at the buffet – as well as the rest of the staff at that restaurant and the ceviche restaurant – was sensational. We had an unforgettable end of the year. As always, thank you.

reviews.author: Alessandra S
reviews.title: Good hotel

My criticism is only in relation to the number of chairs and sunshine in the pools, which are insufficient for all guests, being that several seats are reserved only for extra payment, policy which I do not agree because ya is an expensive and good category hotel.

reviews.author: jstifel

They provide us super qualified service level, hope everyone can imitate so good practices. It has been a really amazing time in the hotel, Merci!

reviews.author: Vacation230202
reviews.title: will we go back? absolutely not!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is a very nice resort with very poor customer service: we felt like they were very short staffed. Every time we asked for room service (mostly asking for milk for my one year old daughter) things were very flaky; sometimes they would forget or it would take them hours to bring what we asked. The food quality was poor generally speaking: the service was also not reliable at all; we asked for food for my daughter once and it took them 65 minutes to bring it. Not recommending at all. 

We had someone through the family concierge helping us who was very nice. Helped us with a room switch (we stayed 10 days and asked for a room switch on day 1 and we finally got it on day 7). He was very helpful for dinner reservation.

reviews.title: Expected Better From an expensive 5-star Resort
reviews.text:
Many, many problems with the room some of which were never resolved.  Am a handicapped guest and my repeated requests for a shower chair were ignored.  As a result, I fell 2 times.  No hot water at times, inability to open balcony door due to repairs being needed etc. etc.  Numerous requests to speak to the Reserve General Manager, Alicia, were denied saying she is in a meeting or too busy. Guess we will go back to RIU where attention to guest issues is a priority.
