reviews.author: 737maxwellm
reviews.title: Luxury hotel but bad experience
reviews.text:
We booked a 7-night stay over Christmas at Paradisus Cancún, a Meliá hotel. It’s hard to describe how disappointed we were. We booked a “Premium Suite Lagoon View” room which was pricey – and we booked it more than 8 months early. What we got was a first-floor room in the timeshare section with a view of the hallway doors that lead to the pool area. It wasn’t even on the correct side of the building. The bedroom flooded when it rained, the kitchen fan made a noise so loud it couldn’t be used, and the bathroom sink drained slowly.

The reservation desk just said that room types aren’t guaranteed and that no other rooms were available. We even offered to have our room downgraded. We asked for a manager and were taken to guest services instead. They offered to give us access to the spa for a day – not spa services, just access to the spa (sauna, etc.).  

This was the beginning of a very discouraging stay at Paradisus Cancun. We had the all-inclusive package but found out that in order to have dinner at any of the included restaurants, you had to book them between 10AM and 4PM, a time when most people are on excursions. And the reservation desk usually had a very long line. So, we were forced to eat our first 2 dinners at the buffet, which is mediocre at best.

We finally were at the hotel 1 day between 10-4 & were able to make dinner reservations for the rest of the stay.  We found Sante, Aqua Marina, and Flora to be excellent restaurants.  However, the house white wine included in the price wasn’t drinkable and the red was very low-end. We had Christmas dinner at Capella, and this was worse than the buffet. The food looked like it had been warmed over from days before. Thankfully the live Christmas show that was blasting into the restaurant got rained out halfway through dinner and our group could finally talk.

The other 3 rooms booked for family members were better – the only complaint was lack of hot water. Several times it was tepid and one time it was cold.

We did enjoy the grounds, the pools and the beach and the staff was pleasant. The hotel has great potential. If you have a decent room with a view, you will likely have a better experience than we did.

One other note: for tipping, take lots of smaller bills in pesos with you as we couldn’t get change anywhere at the hotel.

reviews.author: ChaineBlais
reviews.title: Does not match a 4 1/2 at all
reviews.text: Really disappointed, we had paid more to have more, but had much less. The room was not clean and did not match the photos published, among others, the shower in the bath which is painted white, a single chair on the terrace, dirt on the switches and the table. Quieter pool accessible only in the morning and at the beginning of pm, we were expelled from this pool 5 days a week around 2 / 3 pm to prepare private evening parties. Towels lying around in piles on the floor for the first two days, it came back after but the first impression was ruined. Not enough chairs and umbrellas around the pools, people steal umbrellas from each other. Vomited in the pool, 3 employees came to see but did not do anything to pick up, same for supplies outages during the week, they see but do not repair. Main pool broke but although it reopened, the water level remained lower than the filter ducts. Several evenings with private party outside not giving access to the outdoor area and also to one of the restaurants. Beef braised served with a piece containing 100% fat. We wanted to attend the Transat meeting but the representative did not make the planned meeting, we knew it when we were paying attention to the place agreed with another couple, he contacted us only by text.

reviews.author: Juani M
reviews.title: INCREDIBLE AND RELAXING EXPERIENCE!! ⭐️
reviews.text:
Stunning place!! We were lucky enough to go to the Melià Club Sector and as always we were fascinated! The human service they have is the friendliest I have ever seen! Everyone is very willing to answer any questions, super friendly! We took my grandmother (83 years old) and they were very attentive to her the entire time in case she needed personalized attention. The rooms are super spacious and comfortable with a very functional distribution and unique views of nature!!
The bar and buffet service is exquisite, always with freshly prepared dishes and everything delicious!!
Very clean pools, fun activities and impressive care of the flora and fauna.
Without a doubt a place I would return to if I wanted to rest!!
I was only a little bothered by the change in policies with the club members, where things that were taken for granted now have to be paid for... but that has to do with the Chain, not with the Hotel, which is impressive.

reviews.author: Kirthi T
reviews.title: Stay review
reviews.text: Manager Rommel Cruz helped us lot get to the room we wanted and arranged a surprise for our daughter birthday. He went above and beyond in service. Initially we didn't like the room and they made us switch to the room we wanted and everyday they did a follow-up call.

reviews.author: Stu B
reviews.title: 5 days of pure bliss
reviews.text:
We have no criticisms at all for our 5 night stay at Paradisus Cancun. Things that stuck out to us was every single employee we encountered from our Personal Concierge, Diego to the bar staff, the waiters/waitresses to the cleaning staff- all had the most genuine warmth to them. Everyone was so happy, and smiled big smiles. They laughed and joked with us, and we could tell they were so happy. This energy is contagious  and it was above and beyond. The service was quick, we never felt neglected-ever. The rooms were sparkling clean. We loved having two bathrooms in different sections of the room. The pillows were comfortable. The food was great and the drinks were so delicious. The one thing we’d love to see would be a swim up bar at the adult pool and more chairs at the reserve pool. It could be hard to find a spot. The thing that made the trip an unforgettable experience and one that will have us coming back is Diego. He felt like such a good friend who jumped at the opportunity to help us. He was in constant contact but never overbearing. He made us reservations and helped us with a room switch. Every time we ran into him he asked us how everything was. Professional, kind, warm and charming. He helped us make our anniversary special with a gift and personally delivered it to our door.  I felt like every employee we encountered had the same spirit that Diego had, we were just so lucky to have him on hand whenever we had a question. Diego is an absolute star, and we would return just because of your incredible employees. 
The adult pool was so calm and relaxing, and the private section of the beach was perfect. Don’t hesitate to book here. It’s cheaper than some of the competitors and is far more relaxing if that’s what you are looking for. 5 stars! Thank you for such an incredible experience. 
-Kara and Stu

reviews.author: Eric D
reviews.title: Palicidad Cancun/Kahana bar
reviews.text: Everyone has been kind and attentive. Especially the ones at Khana bar. Carlos, David, Carolina and Roberto were especially helpful at the bar, as well as with the food. The beachside lounges were clean and well served. The views from this area were beautiful.

reviews.author: Karine T
reviews.title: Hotel infested with cockroaches
reviews.text: Cockroaches in my room and in the lobby which is surrounded by restaurants. Buffet food in the evening very passable, same quality as Cuba. Very dirty swimming pools. Lack of chairs at the pool and beach, you have to pay $250 per day for all beach or pool beds that are empty. Flight delayed. Lost suitcase. The photos of the rooms on the sites do not correspond at all to those on site. Very old and everything broken (door handles, balcony door etc.. Very outdated hotel which does not deserve its 5 stars. The only positive points are: the staff on site come to see us every 5 minutes for drinks, the beach is superb, very beautiful lobby, good coffee and the evening entertainment is good.

reviews.author: Jen G
reviews.title: Great veggie food and Great Waiter Melvin
reviews.text: This was one of our best meals at the paradisus. My husband is a vegetarian and eating hasn’t been super simple (which we anticipated) so we loved the veggie menu at cielo.   We had a great waiter named Melvin who gave good recommendations that did not disappoint!

reviews.author: Gwenn M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun has become a 2 star hotel in one years time!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun has gone down hill so fast in the past year, I would now give it a 2 star rating and that is being very generous. They have all these people pushing the “Circle” membership,(timeshare) it’s a joke, they are just looking for money. The electrical sockets are falling out of the walls, the AC works intermittently, shower leaks, and so on. They are now holding big convention groups and weddings. These events take the resort over, you can’t get into the restaurants on the property that are part of the “all inclusive package” that you pay for. No one lets you know when you book your vacation that these events will be going on while you are trying to enjoy your vacation. STAY AWAY from this property if you are looking for a pleasant vacation.

reviews.author: Janette G
reviews.title: Celebrating engagement!
reviews.text: Super recommended for couples! We are celebrating our engagement, and Dania at the Ginger bar served us with great pleasure. Activities for many ages and at all times. Very good service and atmosphere! We will return very soon!!!!!

reviews.author: Sanda24
reviews.title: Wouldn't stay here again
reviews.text:
I'll start with a pros and cons list:

Pros:
Comfortable bed and pillow
Fairly good food and very good service at buffet and beach
Liked having the room key as part of our all-inclusive bracelet
Liked that we did not need towel cards
Good water pressure in shower and good hairdryer
Most of the drinks were made well (not diluted)
Plenty of outlets in room

Cons:
Narrow drop-off beach
Loungers on beach and in room were not adjustable. Could not lay down flat or sit in a  more upright position to read.
No coffee-maker or clock in the room
Steps everywhere, even in the room. A 4" step in to the bathroom, into the shower and
   into the toilet stall.  Constantly tripping
Air conditioner condensation constantly dripping on the floor in middle of room
Patio door ridiculously heavy and hard to open
No clothesline in shower area for hanging wet swimwear
Not enough shade by pool area

General Comments:
This was a lovely property but too many negatives for us to return.  We've stayed at other all-inclusives that cost less money that worked better for us.  
One of my favorite things is sitting out on the balcony with my morning coffee while still in my PJs.  It defeats the experience to have to get dressed and go and get a coffee to bring back to the room.  I don't want to have to get dressed for room service either plus I want my coffee now.  
The fact that the loungers on the balcony and on the beach did not change position was totally unacceptable.  We've been to many properties over the years and have never experienced that.
The food was fairly good but no better than many places we've stayed for less money.

reviews.author: Navigator53670784910

reviews.author: Brandon L
reviews.title: Dated, but excellent service compensates
reviews.text:
As a family of three with a 5 year old, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Paradisus. In all honesty, I was somewhat worried about the concerns mentioned in various reviews regarding long wait times for restaurants, overall cleanliness, etc., but it turned out to be a non-issue. Here are some breakdowns:

1. Kidsdom: The staff were fantastic from day 1. My son has been to the Kids Club at Royal Uno last year, and he had a great time there as well. But he loved the various activities throughout the day from 10 AM to 10 PM every single day! They do arts and crafts, games, little racing competitions, and movie nights. There are 1 hour breaks at 1 and 6 PM, but compared to Royal Uno which ran from 9 AM to 4 PM, this schedule worked out really well for us. My son loved every single one of the staff here (shout out to Bruno, Ivon, Rubi, Yamileth, Itrel, Ivana, Sheila, Xiomara, Monse 👏🏼)

2. Food: It’s true they no longer take reservations and it’s “first come first served”, but there was simply no problem whatsoever. The most we had to wait was at the Japanese restaurant (Lemon Fish) for maybe 10 minutes, if that. Lots of great options at the Malva, and food was all generally excellent in all restaurants (loved Agua Marina).

3. Massage: we were offered a free massage on day 1 in exchange for a meeting with staff at the Circle, which is a special membership program by Melia. In exchange for the time, they offered 1 massage certificate, but during our visit, there was a special program where Visa Infinite, and equivalent Amex, and one other credit card company “sponsored” one additional massage certificate. So we got a chance to get a couple’s massage. The one hour massage was preceded by an hour’s use of the sauna, the steam room, rain shower, and a special pool with waterfall features. We were treated by Leonor and Williams and they were thorough and professional. It felt amazing and I would have paid for the treatments.

4. Service/hospitality: Everyone we interacted with was pleasant and tried their best to accommodate various requests where they could. There was just a small complaint on our very first day at around 4 PM at the Blue Agave with seemingly disorganized and slow service which was attributed to the switching of shifts between staff. But overall excellent throughout the rest of our stay.

5. Facilities: We learned during out conversation at the Circle that this was one of the first hotels built in the Hotel Zone of Cancun around 1988. So, the building does show signs of wear and tear. The gym is particularly showing most need for some update. The rooms could also use some update, but not a huge issue. With that said, it seems they have done a good job of maintaining the property, so props to that.

All in all, we certainly enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Cancún with some minor downsides due to the age of the facilities. I would definitely recommend it to families with kids, and I wouldn’t worry about the first-come, first-served style of dining as some reviews stated.

reviews.author: mariana f
reviews.title: EXCELLENT EXPERIENCE
reviews.text:
Facilities: excellent, spacious and clean. A beautiful lobby. A dream pool, well maintained. The rooms are comfortable, but they do not have a single painting, decoration, or anything that makes them special. The high ceiling is very large for what the bedroom has.
Service: good disposition 24 hours a day. Keep in mind that waiters work with tips, they will not treat you badly if you do not give them, but they expect that money to be able to add to their (meager) salary.
Animation group: I estimate they don't have them because I've never seen them. No activities were organized on the beach. At night there were some shows, I only attended one magic show. And two nights of the ones I had, there was nothing.
Food: good variety, seafood, fish, chicken, meat, fruits, some delicious juices, smoothies (I detail this because before staying at this hotel I spent a few days at Paradisus Los Cayos - Santa Maria and the food service was very poor) . Variety of drinks.

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: The Paradisus Team is Excellent
reviews.text:
We chose The Reserve at Paradisus Cancun for a winter escape based on numerous Tripadvisor reviews.  We were looking for an easy going, relaxed experience, and had a wonderful time.

Two key factors made the difference: the Paradisus staff and the beauty of the resort.  

The resort itself is wonderful.  The open atriums offer a sense of space and calm, the pool area is exceptional and the beach is clean, clear and never crowded.  The Reserve section, adults only, was at the far end of the resort, away from the family pools and busier main atrium, and always felt like a retreat.  

Even more important was the consistent level of service we experienced throughout the resort.  Diego Torres, our Reserve Concierge, was friendly, relaxed and classy, and reached out to us every day to make sure we were enjoying our stay and answer any questions we had.  Nicole and Miguel at poolside were most excellent, and they were organized in implementing the Bali Bed waiting list - we were able to use the Bali Beds for the two days included with a Reserve booking, and three additional days.  Gabi made a great impression at Sante, the Reserve restaurant, where we had breakfast and lunch each day.  The restaurant wait staff was uniformly excellent, in particular Montserrat at Flora, who helped us make our dining experience there our favourite of the vacation.  I am an early riser, so I was up before many of the guests, and saw a huge team working cheerfully throughout the resort to keep it clean and polished for the guests, indoors and out.

While we have absolutely no issue recommending Paradisus, the rooms furnishings could be updated, although the bed was comfortable and the shower was excellent.  Also, people considering Paradisus should remember that it is a big resort, and attracts many different kinds of vacationers.  There were a certain number of people partying hard, big families with lots of exuberant kids and groups enjoying themselves (loudly) at reunions of family and friends.  But it was largely not a problem for us; it is a big resort, and we would just find a quieter section to meet our needs.

A special mention for our waiter Alberto at Malva who went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable! Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Olivia B
reviews.title: We enjoyed
reviews.text: Really enjoyed our stay. Family of 4 2 adults two children 3 and 7. Stayed 5 nights in oceanview suite room 4004. Our room was quiet one night there was a singer outside but done t 10 so that was fine with us as we went to bed at this time. We were happy with our room only issue was the 2 day they didnt stock our mini bar I had let our concierge person and she had them stock it the following day my advice if its not stocked by 3pm phone 0 in the room and request it i had done that 2x as I wanted to make sure it was stocked. Room service you can get 2x without a fee we only got it the first night as we arrived late we ordered as soon as we got there as we read in reviews it takes about an hr that is about what it took food menu. Our kids loved the buffet we only did 3 restaurants as our kids wanted the buffet we went to flora and blue agave  food was good at all of them. Pool area was great you can order from the waiter who goes around good me u wings hotdogs nachos fries burgers, they have a spit of tacos from 12 until 3 they are so good theres pizza beside it and icecream my kids mostly ate there. Coffee shop its very good as well we stopped and got our son milk from there each night and both kids banana bread their fave.The beach is beautiful it was wavy while we were there from talking to people who met who were returning guests its not usually like that, ginger bar is nice and kanna beach bar. Kids loved smoothies at kanna bar and swim up they have strawberry and mango, they have some top shelf liquor smirnoff absolute vodka Kahlua they have coors light I likes their beer better exp sol. I felt it was all great service the concierge is new to us the person u get if u have issues of questions u just text. It was very helpful we had jenny she was amazing. The kids club was great with kids I read alot of mixed reviews so 5 and under 10am 1245 drop off and 7pm to 945pm 5 and up is the same but they also do 3 activities throughout day you can drop the older ones off at or stay in watching distance for younger ones of with them. I would tip the kids club I dont think they get many as i gave a tip they were very thankful. It was nice to have a break we used the service 3x for our younger son my daughter wanted to go everyday one day my son didnt want to stay they phoned me right away they use the whats up app to contact via phone. Friday night they have local food vendors come and crafters we enjoyed it alot they had local entertainment this night as well. They also had entertainment by the ginger bar on 2 nights. They offer a free photo session u can chose 1 digital copy our kids loved it had a blast was about 30 mins additional copies are 20. We didnt have time to do excursions but theres alot of ones offered. We would deff return.

reviews.author: Matias F
reviews.title: Disappointing Week.
reviews.text: Disappointing to have an experienced a complex and room with broken AC. Not much was done to remedy the situation. In fact they didn’t seem to care. Don’t expect much from the entertainment staff. Buffet variety was lacking. A la carte restaurants were ok.

reviews.author: Blaine H
reviews.title: Wonderful !
reviews.text:
A beautiful resort and lovely vacation, enriched by the special attention provided by our concierge, Diego Torres! Diego made us feel immediately  welcome and well oriented with his guided tour and daily checkins at breakfast. If we requested any assistance he looked after it swiftly. The Reserve experience was definitely worth it for us. The Reserve area was calm and restful- just what we were looking for.
Clean room, nice view from the balcony( get the oceanview!), and good unobtrusive housekeeping and turn down services   Lovely pool, great beach access and we enjoyed Sante and their cheerful hardworking staff daily.  We were able to get a Bali Bed for 5 days of our stay. A beautiful spa and excellent restaurants enhanced our stay, with particular mention to the service we received at Flora by our server Montserrat. The Reserve area definitely helped provide a more peaceful experience than we would have experienced in the larger general areas which always seemed louder, lively and energized, which some people clearly seek out.

reviews.author: Shaya T
reviews.title: Paradisus Vacation
reviews.text:

The entire resort smells amazing and feels like a spa oasis
10/10 would recommend a visit to this resort!

reviews.author: Susan D
reviews.title: Lovely family vacation!!! Would def return this resort again!
reviews.text:
Loved this resort. Amazing service and staff!  Everyone was always smiling and willing to help. We went with a few small children so we ate at the buffet a lot, good variety everyday! Was happy that you can just walk into any a la carts, makes dining a lot easier for kids.

The only con I would say is that there is no separate space for the nightly entertainment, we were on the floor above the lobby bar and every night it was so loud. If you have small children, I’d recommend a room in the further building.

reviews.author: Clarissa
reviews.title: Great service and beautiful hotel
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel inside and out. Clean, comfy room. Beautiful beach right outside with plenty of lounge chairs. Our waiter Martin at the buffet was the best, absolutely adored him! The bell boys, room service, waiters, coffee bar guy, really everyone at the hotel was amazing.

reviews.author: Amanda C
reviews.title: Our favorite resort!
reviews.text: My family has been coming back to this resort for years now. It is always fun and relaxing to come here. All the staff are so friendly and accommodating. Alejandro at the Nespresso bar always greets us with a bright smile and he makes the best coffee! We also always book appointments at the YHI spa because we love the special access to the sauna, steam room, and cold plunge. Anna and Angeles are just amazing at giving massages. It’s always great when we come here and we will keep coming back. Not to mention this resort is very family friendly, providing activities for the little ones all day everyday! We highly recommend staying at Paradisus!

reviews.author: Virginia H
reviews.title: My experience was wonderful
reviews.text: Martin, Fernando and Gerardo are the best!! They made my breakfast spectacular!! They made me and my friends feel at home. The entire hotel has different environments that make you have a unique and unforgettable experience. I definitely felt in paradise. The air you breathe and the energy of this place is magical.

reviews.text:
This was our second time visiting this hotel with our family. We love visiting new places but the facilities and staff are so wonderful that we decided to return and did not regret it. The hotel has recent renovations and is just so beautiful, spacious and clean. 
I could talk about many aspects of this hotel, but I think the buffet staff deserve recognition. They really go above and beyond to make you feel special. They helped us with an issue on 2 separate occasions and even gave us a touching, beautiful send off. My kids were so sad to leave them. Diego, Toni, Gaudencio, Manuel and Malva were wonderful and they really added a personal touch to meal times.  We would not hesitate to return to this hotel if we visit Cancun again.

reviews.title: Summit Trektel at Melia Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Excellent attention from the waiters Ignacio, Ricardo and Alfredo. Good facilities, very rich and varied food, tremendous breakfast! They have to improve the service on the beach by the bar a little. The rest excellent. The beach is beautiful but a little dangerous. Good entertainment proposals, live music every night.

reviews.author: AB5901
reviews.title: Kanna night bar is the best
reviews.text: Karina and Abraham from Kanna Noche are the best hosts at the hotel, every night with a smile serving the best and the best drinks always different cocktails I hope to return soon, Thank you for everything See you soon☺️🙂

reviews.author: Roberto B
reviews.title: Highly recommended!
reviews.text: Excellent attention!! Super attentive Abraham, very kind! The delicious drinks! Plus the visit to the incredible sea! The warmth of the place adds a lot to the experience at night in Cancun. Plus Karina is super attentive! The best experience with the people of Trektel

reviews.author: Luis A
reviews.title: Good hotel, needs to improve service
reviews.text:
Terrible service upon arrival (no bellboy attends, waiters are inflexible in accommodating large groups at tables together), however the kids club and the staff that takes care of the children is excellent, they really allow parents to have the peace of mind that their children are safe and having fun.

The quality of food and drinks is good, the beach is very good too, balconies unsafe for children.

reviews.author: Txevoxxz
reviews.title: Definitely recommend
reviews.text: Amazing hotel, with truly the best staff in all my travels. We have been here several times and will definitely return again. The options are great, if you are coming without kids do The Reserve you won’t regret it

reviews.author: KatieB76
reviews.title: Mostly “All Inclusive”
reviews.text: We booked through Chase using our points. We chose this place because it was advertised as “all inclusive”, but there were so many things that were not actually included. Certain drinks, restaurants, etc. Even room service had an upcharge. I am not sure if this is typical, but we were both surprised and a little miffed, having just left a different all-inclusive resort. That said, the staff was absolutely wonderful. Everyone made us feel welcome, and did their best to accommodate us. Special thanks to Otneil for his warmth and enthusiasm, and Gerardo in the international buffet for bringing kindness and coffee to the breakfast table!

reviews.author: karim c
reviews.title: Excellent service kanna night
reviews.text: Excellent experience at the Pardisus hotel, the staff at this hotel are very attentive, empathetic and very reliable, especially Karina and Richi from the Lana Night bar, always willing to serve and give the best advice at the bar, a nice experience that we would repeat again in couple in this nice hotel

reviews.author: Jose Avellaneda
reviews.title: Good hotel but not 5 stars
reviews.text:
An average hotel for the hotel zone that has all inclusive, but not to be considered 5 stars, which is how they sell it.

Bad things:

- The hotel is already old, it needs maintenance in many places. There are leaks in each of the pyramids, so it is normal to see flooding in the hallways.
The furniture in the rooms is old. In our case, the couch in our room was old, it smelled of cigarettes and dirt, and the TV had black lines on the screen, despite being relatively new. The bathroom had a leak from the toilet faucet and the only thing they did was put on a jargon throughout my stay, but it didn't cause any major problems. The air conditioning makes a lot of noise, as does the mini bar, which can be annoying for people who have trouble falling asleep.

- The hotel bathrooms are old, lousy, dirty, nothing like other types of bathrooms in 5-star hotels.

- The Lebanese beds that the hotel has in the beach and pool area are too many and take up most of the space that could exist for lounge chairs for common use. The use of the beds is 250usd per day (I think it includes a bottle of champagne and lobster), additional to the cost per night and all inclusive. During the 5 days I was there, if 2 or 3 beds were occupied it was a lot.

- The service in certain restaurants was terrible. Lemon Fish, my food took 1 hour and the restaurant had few tables. Waiters with no desire to work there. Also at the Blue Agave restaurant, very bad service and they practically want a tip for everything they bring you.

- I suppose this is general and not in the hotel, but if you are a foreigner the service is very good, if you are a local, try to wait unless you find polite staff who earn the extra tip.

Good things:

The bartenders Carlos and Eduardo from Alberca and Jorge from the second floor bar, incredible service, as well as the waiters at the Malva Food Bazaar restaurant and the Capella restaurant. But without a doubt, the best restaurant was Agua Marina, the salmon and the excellent stone broth! First class food and service.

Incredible attention from the people at the Nespresso bar.

The beach is clean and tidy unlike hotels attached to the hotel zone. Lifeguard attention at all times.

The food is generally good and the alcohol is of medium-high quality.

reviews.author: Sussy E
reviews.title: Blue Agave Restaurant Excellent
reviews.text: The Hotel in general is very good but I want to make special mention of the Blue Agave Restaurant, the best, the exquisite breakfast is delicious, the attention of Luis, Osvaldo and Paola is the best. 1000% recommended

reviews.author: Santiago C
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Excellent experience, very nice hotel and very good service. Wide variety of restaurants, the most recommended are Lemon Fish and Cielo where we were very well served by Moises.
Excellent food and Bernardo's attention at breakfast in the buffet.

reviews.author: Amber M
reviews.title: Great experience all around!
reviews.text:
This resort was incredible!! Lots to do during the day and loads of activities for families, adults and kids! The food at the Malva buffet was delicious!!! And Alberto gave us some of the best service I’ve ever experienced! He was so attentive and remembered us and our orders. He truly made us feel like family!! 

We would come back again just to see Alberto!

reviews.author: Musicjaime
reviews.title: Average facility. Good food, excellent breakfast servers.
reviews.text:
I was at the Paradisus last week for a work conference and decided to extend my visit by a day to relax end escape New England winter. I had stayed there last year for the same conference as well, and also extended. The hotel has good and average aspects to it in my opinion. I never wrote last year but meant to so I’ll make my one gripe from that now. I spent 2 nights in the “adults only” Reserve and there were kids running around and screaming constantly in the atrium area like it was their playground. I asked reception about it and they did nothing. At least if they made an exception to allow them with their parents they should have controlled the noise for the benefit of those of us who paid extra for a quieter experience. This year I did not bother with the reserve. The Sante restaurant was good, I thought Sel was average. 
This year I was very specific that I wanted a room with two beds when I made the reservation. I was told that that was noted in the reservation. When I arrived, the “gentleman” who checked me in was not friendly or helpful and when I was specific about the two beds he said the room that had been reserved for me had a king bed and if I wanted a second there was a pullout couch. I pulled up my reservation confirmation to show him the two beds and he didn’t care. The rooms are definitely outdated. Mine smelled musty, the floor was dirty (needed to be polished) and while there was a balcony (I only paid for lagoon view) there was no furniture on it. I wanted to dry my bathing suit a bit with the hair dryer before leaving and it didn’t work. In the gym, the equipment is sparse for a hotel of that size. There were free weights, maybe 5 treadmills and 3 elliptical machines. I tried one elliptical and it didn’t work. I tried another and it worked but only for 10 minute intervals, after which it needed to be reprogrammed. To me, all this combined equals average, not a 5 star “luxury” resort. I don’t need 5 stars personally, but when it is billed as 5 stars and priced as such, I expected more.
I ate in the Mexican, the taco (Blue Agave) and the breakfast restaurants, plus group lunches and dinners for the conference. The restaurants were good overall. The highlight for me was the two servers who took care of the outside space for the breakfast restaurant (definitely sit here and not inside…it is far more pleasant with good music and great views). Manuel and Anatola (I may have gotten this name slightly wrong) were both excellent, remembered me and my colleague every day as well as what we like for beverages and laughed and joked with us easily. We had fun with them and service was excellent, which made breakfast a great start to the day.
I’ll go back again next year if the conference is there again and will likely extend my stay by a day or two again, but have a realistic perspective of what to expect, and not. Maybe two beds next year…

reviews.author: jonlap123
reviews.title: Great stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: It was an amazing stay from start to finish. The resort is located only about 15 minutes from the airport, the beach is unbelievable and the rooms are very comfortable. The service we received from the whole team was top notch. Armando, Candelario, Ignacio, Flor, Juan and Baltazar are a few that we were in contact with every day and they were all wonderful. We are already planning our next trip!

reviews.author: Morenoab1
reviews.title: 5 star service would  recommend it every day
reviews.text: Highly recommend the resort! We had the most amazing vacation, all the management and staff went above and beyond. Made leaving at the end extremely hard. 15 out of 10 experience.  This is the way vacationing is meant to be. Will absolutely be back.

reviews.author: matt willigman
reviews.title: Decent Cancun vacation
reviews.text:
Just got back from a 6 day stay.  Please be patient as I have a lot to share.

Check in for us was not smooth.  We made a few requests when we booked that were completely ignored.  We were told they could not accommodate what was asked for at this time.  After an hour and a half of going around and around, amazingly they were able to meet our requests.  Whole check in thing is kind of a joke.

That being said the room was nice.  Big enough for myself, my wife, and two teenagers.  The weather was beautiful so we weren't in it much but had a great ocean front view.  Maid service was great.  Room was well cleaned daily.  Fridge and snack bar always refilled.

We were in building three, which was very well maintained.  Almost all the restaurants are in this building, and it has a 24 hour coffee/snack bar.  The main pool and a smaller pool are also located at building three.  

The grounds are well groomed, and the beach is huge and beautiful.  The pools were not my favorite.  They were not heated.  The water was also below the skimmer line so water was not circulating in the main pool.  Also, pool chair saving starts very early, and unfortunately, many "reserved" chairs sat empty all day.  I just started moving people's things after a couple of hours.  Service at the pools was pretty good.

Food was hit or miss.  The taqueria and Mexican restaurant were great.  The buffet and Italian restaurant were ok.  The seafood restaurant was below average.  The service and food at the Asian restaurant were bad.

We booked through Costco, and arranged our transfers through their provider: BD Experience.  I do not recommend them.  They wanted to pick us up 3.5 hours before our return flight when were were 20 minutes from the airport.

Overall, it's not a 5 star resort, but it was a good escape in the winter.

reviews.author: Bill D
reviews.title: Melia Paradisus Cancun Sante Restaurant
reviews.text: If you are staying at the Melia Paradisus Cancun make sure to visit Sante Mediterranean restaurant.  The food and service were exceptional.  Manager Roberto, Chef Gerando made it all happen.  Hostess Monseriat(sp) welcomed was warm and pleasant.  Servers Amulto and Nathanael were attentive and caring.  Thank you for two lovely dinners.

reviews.author: Nathalia
reviews.title: Perfect first family holiday to Mexico
reviews.text: We had an unforgettable first long haul family holiday to Mexico with our 1 and 3 year old thanks to Paradisus Cancun. We were exhausted after the 10 hour flight but the hotel lobby is just stunning when you arrive. The atrium and dramatic hanging plants are so beautiful, the hotel smells lovely and it’s a gorgeous atmosphere. We loved our ocean view room and I loved showing my children the beautiful sunrises and sunsets from our balcony every day. Well-stocked minibar and the restaurants were brilliant, especially Malva for everyday ease with the kids (thank you so much to the staff) and Lemon Fish for sushi, cocktails and ambience. We loved the kids pool with the activities, especially the jet ski and bubbly pool party!  Also the quesadillas and frozen cocktails from the pool bar were top notch. And of course the proximity to the beach with the gorgeous white sands and turquoise waters was fantastic. We made special family memories that we will treasure. Special thanks to Keren who babysat for us while we had a parents only dinner - a rare treat for us and it was lovely to have someone so pleasant and friendly to trust. Thanks for a wonderful holiday to escape the cold and rainy UK in January!

reviews.author: PWL909
reviews.title: Opulence and joy to be experienced at Paradisus
reviews.text:
One of the largest hotels I've ever stayed at - and an incredible experience to go with it.

My main tip is: make it happen. If you want something, ask for it - politely, of course. The staff we experienced were excellent. Raul our bellboy made us feel very special on our entrance, which is something we'll always remember.

Likewise, early mornings will benefit you: 1) the sunrise is utterly stunning as you leave the main lobby towards the pool and beach. 2) you'll have a full selection of coffees at the Nespresso bar (this can run low by 11-ish: Americans love their coffee!) 3) you'll need to be up early to secure a sun-bed.

The sun-bed thing can annoy people. Yes, it'd be nice to be able to sleep in late and stroll down to find the perfect spot at your leisure. Sadly, that isn't the case. I knew this before I came, so it provided the perfect motivation to be up for 7am to find our spot. The alternative is to complain about it and have a miserable day.

The swim-up pool bar is the place to be. Julio is an expert veteran cocktail maker. I sat there for hours, watching him make things I'd never heard of, and asking him to make me one. This never gets old.

The food is fine - not spectacular, although I did adore breakfast. Again - getting here before 9am is recommended, as there is a rush for it later on. The nightlife was a slight letdown for me. I'm not expecting Ibiza, but a bit of live music wouldn't go amiss. But this is a minor gripe.

The ocean is utterly stunning. Wandering down to the beach for a dip in the warm, wild waves, then heading up for a swim and a kip was a truly ideal way to spend my days.

reviews.author: zahraswad92
reviews.title: Vacation in Cancun
reviews.text: Ian zamodio is excellent ! He helped us a lot and was super nice, always chrcked if we needed any drinks or food, ask for him he is one of the best. We were at pyramid 3 and he works at the aqua marina.                        Zahra

reviews.author: GrandTour54076959312

reviews.text:
Beautiful resorts 
Was here for a wedding 
Everything was fantastic 
Would definitely come back 
Abraham took care of all our requests, we were in excellent hands. 
Spa was beautiful and helped us recover from the partying. 
Full service and very kind servers.

reviews.author: Rebeca B
reviews.title: Wedding time!
reviews.text: The hotel was amazing! We came for a wedding and the experience was beyond what expected. I did want to mention the excellent service Abraham provided. He was attentive and helpful throughout the entire trip! I will definitely come again if I receive this treatment!

reviews.author: Joao Victor C
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: The best hotel I've ever stayed in in my life! It's so worth it!! Beautiful landscape, delicious drinks, lots of food on offer. Get the sea view room, it's just perfect! There are activities for adults and children. The waiter Antilano Manuel was very friendly and attentive!

reviews.author: Jillian M
reviews.title: SAL is the best experience
reviews.text: Leo and Daniel at SAL were amazing!!! Best service we got all weekend. Very happy to have come!!!! If you come here you must visit Leo and Daniel!! Extra plus they are very gluten free friendly and have amazing drinks. Great smiles too (: great job

reviews.author: Shelli H
reviews.title: Cancun girls dinner
reviews.text: Really incredible dinner and service with Leo and Daniel. They made sure we were treated like VIPs and made sure every drink and dish was served to the nth standard. We would definitely come back here to see them again.  Xoxoxoxox Chicago girlies

reviews.author: Destination561035
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: Leonardo and Daniel were AMAZING. They were super intentional. They made our experience very enjoyable. They food was incredible. Not a bad dish on the menu. They were very accommodating and pleasant with service. Incredible place!!

reviews.author: Elizabeth R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun the best hotel in the Riviera Maya
reviews.text:
Always a guaranteed experience at Paradisus Cancun! We love. We visited the “Flora” restaurant, it was excellent!!! The dishes are healthy, exact portions and delicious! In the end they gave us a bon voyage cake, since we were leaving the next day.
Excellent service and attention. We will definitely return

reviews.author: Enrique G
reviews.title: It used to be a very good place.
reviews.text:
Congratulations to Stelian my concierge and the pool/beach restaurant team at The Reserve including Gaby, Valeria and the boys in black. Yes, much of the staff does everything they can to ensure you have a very good experience. Here are some of the points why I would seriously consider returning to this hotel that I have been visiting for several years:
ROOM: On the wall at the head of the bed there is an LED strip which is a good detail. However, in my room they didn't turn off completely so during the night you had light in your face. Despite having reported it repeatedly, maintenance did nothing during the entire stay. Quite uncomfortable. Likewise, a report was made of a problem in the shower which was mediocrely repaired.
RESTAURANTS: For specialty restaurants, someone had the idea of eliminating the reservation system. Now, one must sign up at the time of consumption, to which the response is to return within an hour and a half!!! This is not ideal, is it? In the case of “Cielito Lindo” the hostess's comment was that, despite there being tables available, she only had one waiter and one cook so she could not assign tables.
RECEPTION: Being 2:50 pm they tell me to go eat and return later since the hotel's policy is to deliver the rooms at 3:00 pm. Really? I waited right there until three o'clock struck. At that time I had the comment that “there is no certainty that the room is clean” and that there is no communication with the corresponding area. Indeed, Housekeeping did not answer the phone.
ROOM SERVICE: I called to request more Nespresso capsules (there are four in the room), I received the response that this was my daily allocation and that they would not take them to me, which they did. I mention that in four days I only consumed: two light cokes, some peanuts, a package of Oreos and yes, a lot of coffee. It seems that there is a new definition about ALL INCLUSIVE.
EVENTS: I attended a talk in its main room. Food was served at the end of it. The dishes could be said to be “minimalist” not to mention scarce, and if something other than water was required, one had to leave the room to get the desired drink.

CONCLUSION: In this location what was paid was well worth it. This time it wasn't. The reason for my visit was an event of an institution. I did not pay the event fee but registered normally paying the “full” rate at The Reserve so there is no pretext that I had a reduced rate. Anyway, I received comments from the executives of the organizing institution that we will most likely not return next year, with good reason and it is a shame. When I commented here that I would not return to Melia Nuevo Vallarta five years ago, of course I fulfilled it!!!

reviews.author: Fabiola B.
reviews.title: Would never go on my own means.
reviews.text:
Went to a conference the 2nd week of January. The food, drinks and ambience is ok. The last day I was there, flees bit me all night. Left early and couldn’t report. Room 3120 so you can disinfect it. Last year tennis shoes were stolen from my room without any help. Would never go on my own means. There are better hotels in that zone.
.

reviews.author: Don C
reviews.title: Spa zen!
reviews.text: The spa at Paradisus, Cancun is phenomenal! Claudia and Gemma are masters of their craft. They provided stellar professional massage services to my wife and I and we truly appreciate their thoughtfulness and care. We had the hot stone and deep tissue massages with no regrets. We will return in the future.

reviews.author: AshL
reviews.title: Never Again - READ before you book!
reviews.text:
We’ve been to 20 resorts that rank in the same category, and this is by far the worst. We’ve never had issues with food illness until now. Will write the pros and cons:

PROS
-Caesar and Oscar on the Reserve and a few of the other servers were great 
-Bed was comfortable 
-Adequate Towels 
-beautiful ocean and sand 
-interesting building and beautifully done inside with the water features and plants 
-decent sized fitness center and equipment 

CONS
- good chance of food poisoning and don’t expect an apology of if you do get sick. Do expect a hefty bill from the resort doctor ($700USD)  if medical attention is required. 
- Restaurants are busy and you can’t make reservations even when staying in the reserve and paying a premium for a better experience. 
- Buffet food is always cold and a lot of what is served for food  in the restaurants is not edible. Such a shame and a waste to see so many plates dumped because it’s not edible. The reserve restaurant has beef items that can’t even be chewed through just gristle and poor quality meat (tacos, skewers etc.) and the fish is not fresh and very fishy. Mexican restaurant is the worst we’ve ever had and even the staff said “don’t eat there.”  The Italian had some ok options. The steak restaurant was better but most good items are an up-charge and some very unsettled stomachs after the meal. 
- We felt forced to eat off the resort for our remaining meals and that cost definitely added up. There are some amazing restaurants across the street and within walking distance. 
- The AIR CONDITIONING barely works in the room, especially in the morning. Im guessing this is due to the poor construction and single pane windows that have no insulation to keep the cool air in. The vents are gross and dirty. You can’t enjoy the ocean view from your room without having extreme heat issues. So the blackout curtains need to be fully shut for the temperature to be tolerable. Such a shame when you pay a premium for the ocean view. 
- Pool is constantly dirty and has a yellow oily film on top on sections. It doesn’t filter properly because the water level is too low for it to reach. The staff kept blaming it on sunscreen but that pool was not that busy at all and should not be the excuse. Pools with 100+ people in it never have that same problem. 
- outdated rooms and not deeply cleaned (dirty stained curtains, dust etc.) see photos. 
- Certain staff have attitude when matters are brought to their attention (Cecilia and some room service staff). She basically told our group to leave if we didn’t like it and had food poisoning. Very unprofessional. 
- Coffee can take more than an hour to get delivered. First morning it took 1.5 hrs 
- Room service is cold and meals are rarely prepared properly. The fries were not even cooked and raw. Breakfast is cold but probably has the most flavour. 
- Nespresso in the room only has two flavours - the darkest possible espresso and decaf. Most days we were only stocked with decaf and when we asked for more creamer it was a wild goose chase every time. 
- Spoke to several couples that had been here a few years back and their experience now doesn’t even compare. They said EVERYTHING has gone downhill. 
- 
EVERYTHING TAKES SO LONG and you are literally chasing staff down to try and get anything done that you’ve paid for. The “all inclusive” is actually up to you to fight for. Nothing is easy. You feel like you are just a number here due to the size of the resort. Paying more to be in the reserve doesn’t give you the perks that you were promised. Our concerns were mentioned to several management staff and nothing was ever done. Promises to speak with us and resolve but we were never followed up with. All that says to me is everything we brought up was something they hear regularly and there is no desire to fix any of the issues. If you are ok with a 2 star experience, then book here.

reviews.author: Denis L
reviews.title: lemon fish
reviews.text: Best service I've ever had at lemon fish, with friendly staff and super attentive to customers. In addition to being super attentive and attentive to our table, he was cheerful, helpful and quick to serve. Kind to children and explains all the dishes clearly.

reviews.author: coloradobean
reviews.title: Will be coming back!
reviews.text:
Overall we had a positive time staying here. There were a lot of pros but definitely some cons as well.

We absolutely loved eating at Cielo. The food was top tier and every waiter we had was amazing. We went multiple times!
Sante was pretty good. The waiters were nice and the food was yummy!
The Italian restaurant was also very good!
We actually did not enjoy Lemon Fish at all, even though it was the most recommended. The food was just okay, and the service wasn’t great. We didn’t get the food we ordered and ended up just leaving and getting room service.
Room service was super awesome though! A good variety of food and wonderful service too!

Our room was okay. We had made reservations for a lagoon view room, but ended up with a room facing more rooms. It ended up being a good spot though, more quiet. But I definitely wished we had some sort of water view.
The room style was nice, contemporary. But there were a couple downsides. The door to the deck was pretty stuck and super heavy, so I could never open it. There were also big dark chunks of dirt and dust clumped together in all the nooks and more hidden areas in the room. We ignored them, but it was kind of gross..looks like certain parts hadn’t been cleaned in years. Some of the paint was chipping off and furniture had dents and a lot of blemishes on tiles etc. 

The reserve as a whole was amazing. I would recommend that to anyone. It’s in building 5, so a lot more secluded and quiet from the rest of the resort. The interior was beautiful. We got breakfast most days at their little eating area. Service was spotty, sometimes we had a server immediately, and sometimes we waited 30 minutes before going up to someone and asking if we could get some food.
The take and go finger foods there were amazing. Like we couldn’t get enough! 

I was a little disappointed in some aspects. I had planned on surprising my husband with a private dinner on the beach. But was told, after already planning everything for it, that the resort would no longer allow it. Every restaurant we went to asked if we were celebrating something, and I would say yes, our anniversary. But nothing ever came out of it. Saw plenty of people getting birthday celebrations at the restaurants, and even the pool. So I just stopped saying that we were celebrating something. 

The cabana options were amazing! And the reserve pool was perfect, being separate from the other pools. 

Overall most people who worked there were super nice. Make sure to tip everyone, they all work so hard! We will definitely be coming back again sometime in the future!
Big shout out to Emmanuel and Galdino with the reserve for helping us out so much and being so friendly! As well as the ladies who worked at the reserve front desk!

reviews.author: Trip29352858196
reviews.title: Excellent Service!
reviews.text: We had an outstanding experience with everyone who work at Paradisus Cancun resort especially Rommel Cruz at Guest Service! His kindness and willingness to go above and beyond for me and my husband truly enhanced our visit. Exceptional service that made our stay memorable.

reviews.author: TinLove
reviews.title: Christmas at Paradisus with young kids
reviews.text:
For anyone interested in staying here over the festive period in future, or going as a family with young kids, or if you want honest foodie recommendations - get ready to read on...

CHRISTMAS: they had a couple of events for guests including a nochebuena buffet dinner on Dec 24th with entertainment (singers, musician, DJ performances). For families on Christmas Day, Mexican Santa and the kid's club team arranged to give out locally-crafted gifts to children by age, which is a lovely touch. Santa made an appearance almost every evening leading up to Christmas. The Grinch was also going around the resort, scaring everyone. There was another evening event for families on Christmas Day, which didn't seem well promoted as we only found out about it while waiting for a table for a restaurant at dinner. As well as a buffet, there was an elote food stand, crepe stand, face painting, tote painting for grown-ups and lots of funfair games to win prizes. There were circus performers and dancers for entertainment, which was a special way to celebrate Christmas. 

Tip: ask at the guest concierge desks to find out what events are on.

YOUNG CHILDREN: They have the Kidsdom club which runs from 10am-1pm, 2-5pm and 7-10pm. The staff are all friendly and it was never busy for the toddler group, but for the 5 years and above group, there were more children. The space is clean and we were allowed to go in and explore with our youngest who spent some time in the softplay area (she refused to go back without us). The older group spent time by the pool in the afternoon slot followed by outdoor festive craft activities. Our eldest enjoyed pottery-making and moulded a little Christmas tree, she painted characters on canvases and more. 

Tip: ask all the questions, the Kidsdom staff are well informed and professional. 

FOOD: the food at Paradisus across all the restaurants was very hit and miss, as expected for an all-inclusive resort. The service and quality really varies depending on where you go. We tried most options...
Cielo (4/5) - great tasting Mexican food, colouring in sheets for kids and kids meal options, warm and welcoming staff, good service.
Malva Food Bar (2.5/5) -  average food but lots to choose from, one of three places serving breakfast, busy queues for omelette counter, friendly staff, I recommend the delicious green juice and mochaccino. As we were still jetlagged and on UK time, we got there after 7am so it wasn't busy. It gets busier after 8:30am. Desserts were terrible and lacked flavour, which was disappointing as someone with a sweet tooth.
Agua Marina (5/5) - best restaurant there in our opinion in terms of food quality and service. We recommend the ceviches and all their seafood dishes tasted fresh and great! We went for dinner on our second night and back again for our last dinner where they had a singer and band. We also had lunch there on our last day.
Blue Agave (1/5) - extremely slow service, the chef was running late for the breakfast opening so we were waiting for our food for 45+ mins, food was very salty but glad we got to try Mexican coffee.
Lemon Fish (3/5) - food was actually delicious when we eventually got it but the wait was ridiculous! We got there as soon as it opened at 6pm to put our room number down on the waiting list for 7pm. We didn't get seated till after 8pm as they seemed understaffed and there were lots of frustrated crowds/groups waiting around (not great when you have hungry and tired little ones!) Don't think most guests realise it's also open for breakfast at 8am and would just head to Malva Food bar by default. Smaller scale of the breakfast buffet, lots of fruit flies on the fresh fruit table because the restaurant is surrounded by plants. Great atmosphere and felt nice to be sat down look around the atrium in the daytime.
Cappella (4/5) - again, we got there as soon as it opened to avoid the long dinner queues. Pasta dishes were decent, but portions were quite tiny.

Tip: grab an easy lunch by the pool/beach and order from the waiters. Definitely get the burger and fries - that beef patty is so good! The pizza's from Mascalzone were delicious too, and we loved the ice cream/gelato counter (especially the orange and dulce de leche flavours). We drank mango margharitas everyday in the sun and also enjoyed coffees (with caramel/marshmallow syrup) from the Nespresso counter.

About the resort overall - everything felt quite outdated including our lagoon junior suite and the gym. Our sink was always clogged and had slow drainage, but they sent someone up to sort it out. Room service food was so so. The front desk always ring and do a courtesy call after any requests to check all is ok, which is a nice touch but not when you have a napping toddler (turn down phone ring volume). Half of the lifts were out of order for a couple of days which means waiting and skipping lift calls. The resort staff are lovely, hard-working, and cheeful, we had regular chats with Shera who made us feel so welcome during our stay! The kiddie pool doesn't have much to offer so bring your own pool toys, and reserve your sunbeds early in the morning before breakfast with provided towels/non valuables. If you buy essentials from the resort shops, expect to pay a lot more than the RRP. 

We had a really amazing stay as a family creating beautiful memories, and the flaws didn't matter in the end but we would probably stay elsewhere if we ever travel to Cancun again.

reviews.author: Agustin
reviews.title: Dream vacations
reviews.text: I stayed with my family for 10 nights and had an incredible experience. The service and infrastructure of the hotel is excellent, I would return without a doubt. I want to highlight the kindness and professionalism of Javier on the beach, Alejandro at the cafe, Richer at the buffet and José, always attentive and willing to help.

reviews.author: Anyela A
reviews.title: The best beer
reviews.text: The birria is exquisite, with its tender and juicy meat, impregnated with intense flavors. A culinary experience that delights the senses. Birria, a feast of authentic flavors, fuses the softness of the meat with balanced spiciness and aromas that transport you to Mexican culinary tradition. A delight that captivates from the first bite.

reviews.author: Axel C
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Very well served by Moises Morales, avocato served on volcanic stone, warm tortillas, very good starters, fish of the day well baked in excellent aluminum foil and fried platanos desserts with condensed milk and tasty white wine.

reviews.author: Dylana M
reviews.title: Another Amazing Visit!
reviews.text:
We had the best time at Paradisus Cancun, I highly recommend the resort. The location is good, the service is stellar, beaches were beautiful, the food is fantastic, the activities are fun, and the adult pool is heated! The Reserve upgrade is recommended, it is a great value with everything that is included- the adults-only pool, 2 Bali bed reservations, Sante (the catch of the day is my favorite!), the extra bar/snack area, Sal steak restaurant and of course the fabulous concierges! 

Shout-outs to our concierges, George took the absolute best care of us on-site and Emmanuel made dreams come true even before we arrived! Victor and Juriel with the pool and activities were always helpful. And Oscar and Javier our main servers at the pool could not have been better- they kept the water bucket filled for us even before we asked!

The activities here are among my favorite- Fiesta night, Silent Disco and Boho Chic experience in the evening were all fantastic, and I love the daily cultural activities/art projects in the afternoon, the Hand Made girls are awesome! The late night activities were fun too (Karaoke, DJ and Glow It Up) and it was nice to have something to do later in the evening. 

Many thanks to every single staff member, everyone we encountered was so nice and helpful! This was our second time at Paradisus Cancun and we will be back!

reviews.author: Tomas Bergonsi
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Children loved the recreation, they made teddy bears, Mario's stroller, games in the pool and on the beach were always well attended, wonderful hotel, excellent restaurants, especially Italian and fish. we had a great time here

reviews.author: Freddie T
reviews.title: Paradisus Hotel
reviews.text:
Overall, what made our experience great was the staff and service. Specially, Hector Lagunas’s in the pool area. He was very accommodating and truly made our vacation great!

Now, the not so good, our rooms! Air conditioner was very noisy and didn’t work properly. We would constantly have to turn it off and on throughout the day and night. Refrigerator was so loud we just ended up turning it off after we called a couple of times to get it switched and no one ever came. Also, there was a strong odor coming from the bathroom.

reviews.author: tamhn2024
reviews.title: Poor staff training & management
reviews.text:
One of the worst customer service for a 5 star hotel. Check in front desk was rude & unprofessional. Staffs at blue agave just hanging around and talking while we brought it to their attention twice that we’d like to order. Waiter at Aqua Marina was nice but definitely couldn’t not handle a big party. He became rude & mean until we slipped him some cash so we can just get the dinner over with. This is my 4 times in Cancun & stayed at different 4/5 stars resort.  Paradisus is definitely a disappointment. Standards are low here. Rooms were dirty & missing things like hair dryer, iron, remote, towels. It baffles me that this is even a 5 star resorts if not for the beautiful lobby & location. 
Also they need to have more lounge chairs on the beach bc we didn’t even come on a busy weekend or anything. Most of the resort guests were laying on the sand bc there are not enough chairs

reviews.author: cipriano e
reviews.title: This massage we had at the end of our vacation was very relaxing and a good way to de-stress
reviews.text: Gemma and Guadalupe gave us a very good massage experience, attentive and very relaxing. Very friendly from beginning to end, in 41 years I had not had a massage but after this good experience I will do it again

reviews.author: Camila abril B
reviews.title: Excellent experience!
reviews.text:
Everything spectacular! I would definitely go back but the best thing is the food. I have been to many Meliá's and none have the level of food of this one: varied, healthy, elaborate food and high-class themed restaurants. Even the wine and drinks are very good, my favorites are from the bartenders at the central pool, Julio and Cesar I think were their names, they are GREAT.
At breakfast we were served by Ivonn, Ramiro, Jony and Bernardo who undoubtedly made an effort to make our stay unforgettable!
The only criticism is linked to the spa and the hotel's music. I have gone to other Meliá's such as the Palma Real in the Dominican Republic that without having the reservation service they let you use the hydrotherapy, in this case it was not like that, which lowers the level of a notable hotel. As for the music, it is something that I always criticize at the Meliá, if you come to a hotel in the Caribbean you want LATIN music, otherwise you would go to a hotel in the United States if you want to listen to their music and on the other hand it would be nice if in the There is also music on the beach. Those would be my only two criticisms but we will always return to Meliá! We love!

reviews.author: Bethany M
reviews.title: Everything was perfection
reviews.text: Couldn’t not have had a more perfect experience. The ambiance, the staff, the cleanliness, the options! I will definitely be staying at the reserve again! My only complain was that the adult pool is so hot. Almost like a bathtub so it’s not refreshing. The party pool is not heated and there is a smaller unheated pool in the reserve area we spent more time in bc of the heat. Also, we never heard from our consierge even tho the front desk triple checked our WhatsApp multiple times. Nicole and gabby at the pool assisted us impeccably in any information and other guests we met. A few more food options between 4-6 would be beneficial. Almost everything is closed and a lot of people eat dinner between 4-6, not late at night

reviews.author: Sasha B
reviews.title: The best hotel in Cancun!!
reviews.text:
The hotel is spectacular, the attention is wonderful, I would definitely repeat!! A super relaxing atmosphere, the incredible beach, wow colors!!

As for the food, everything was delicious, but if you really want to eat DIVINE, have breakfast, lunch and dinner at “Sante” it is in the pool area, with an incredible view of the sea, really of all the restaurants in the hotel, this It was my favorite, and my husband's. The food fascinated me, the service and attention “excellent” I want to thank Natanael, Arnulfo, Alex, Monserrat, Roberto, Cesar, and chef Gerardo for giving us the best of each of you, all those days, we had a I have a very nice memory of being very well served, it is the best restaurant in the hotel, we ate there almost every day.

I loved those days in Cancun, I went to celebrate my birthday, I didn't know anything, it was a total surprise, and our concierge Jose prepared a super cute detail for us in the room, if I have the opportunity to repeat this beautiful destination, I would go with eyes closed to Paradisus again😍

reviews.author: Robert L
reviews.title: Delicious and friendly
reviews.text: Aqua Marina restaurant is absolutely delicious.  I ordered the pork with egg noodles,  my wife had the sea bass. We also ate shrimp appetizers.  Food is very fresh and tasty.  Meals and appetizers came out within 15 mins of each other. What made the experience even better is the staff: manager Roberto, chef Gerado, hostess Monse, waiter Axel and Natanael.  Thank you for your your top notch service!!!! I highly recommend this restaurant!

reviews.author: SKY L
reviews.title: Gladino is the best, this is what 5 star hotel is all about
reviews.text: First impression bad, the check in staff did not explained our room clearly. But then Gladino, our concierge came, he corrected the front desk, and ensure our stay is amazing through out the stay. If you are coming to paradisus Cancun, make sure you get a reserve room, the experience is just worth it!

reviews.author: Travel31736
reviews.title: Check out the spa at this resort! Ask for Anna & Liliana, you will not be disappointed!
reviews.text: This is our 2nd trip in the last 18 months. I have been suffering from a shoulder injury many years ago. Last time we visited, the hotel had a commercial running on our tv advertising the spa. The next day we booked a Balinese massage for 2 and I’m so glad we did! Worth every dollar! It was so incredible that we booked 2 more massages that week with our therapists Anna and Liliana. This time we came to the resort for 10 days and booked 4 massages! I highly recommend Anna and Liliana. BEST MASSAGES EVER! They create an environment with wonderful energy to know and recommend treatments for maximum recovery! Better than a trip to the doctor. It was so good that this was the purpose of our trip to Cancún from Arizona!

reviews.author: Nieves
reviews.title: Mezcal Tasting!
reviews.text: Great stay, wonderful location. Did a mezcal tasting with Jorge - fun time. Only two mezcals were offered, wish there would’ve been more, but had a good time all the same. Thank you Jorge, Betty, and Nurby!

reviews.author: dpeff
reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: After visiting 6 years ago we were anxious to come back to the wonderful experience we had before. We loved the many choices of restaurants and good food. That has all been taken away. everything changed. we booked 5 rooms on 5 diff floors after asking to be together and promised to make note of it  Air conditioning broke in 3 rooms. sink and shower clogged in 2 rooms. Had wash clothes for only 3 nights out of 8. Pool staff were friendly and helpful We ended up eating outside resort most of the time after paying for all inclusive. very expensive and very disappointed. Found out on 3rd day we had an excursion included after spending $$ on the same type of outing. Staff is not helpful. Breakfast waiters were good. Rooms are very dated. Only people from the Reserve seem to have a good experiance

reviews.author: Roving40331349646
reviews.title: Was great and unforgettable ! Definitely made me fall in love with Cancun.
reviews.text:
Great views from lagoon and getting all inclusive really helped. The centre hall is just an amazing view especially at night time , they always have events going on during the day at the pool and inside such as acrobat shows / disco / yoga sessions.
Malva food bazar has amazing food and I always went there for breakfast and lunch! Shout out to the team especially Atilano, Armando and Ariadna! Great Customer experience

reviews.author: Isabella S
reviews.title: We hope to return
reviews.text: We were as a couple for a week at Paradisus Cancun and the experience was incredible. We recommend The Reserve for a quieter and more exclusive space and experience. The food in all the restaurants is delicious, the staff is excellent, very friendly. I highlight Julio's attention and warmth in the area of The Reserve, very attentive, friendly and helpful. I also highly recommend the relaxing massage at the Yhi Spa with Frida, 10/10, a delight!!!

reviews.author: Adventure324086
reviews.title: Don’t book save your money!
reviews.text:
As a 5* hotel you would expect the rooms to be in tip top condition and clean but in our 10 day stay we moved 4 times! The hotel and lobby itself is really nice and looks 5* and the restaurants were really good with lots of the selection however the rooms were just not to standard at all! 

For the money we paid this was a massive let down, each room we changed had a new issue…bathroom dirty/mouldy and outdated, AC is too loud you can’t sleep, a weird smell coming through, noisy, in our last room you can hear construction work near by and a club across the road. We wasn’t able to leave as we unfortunately booked it as non-refundable otherwise I would be the first one out of here! I do not recommend this place!! 

The staff and the beach were what made the holiday. The staff did deal with us nicely and were very accommodating. And the beach was just beautiful. But I wish we did not stay here and maybe considered an air bnb. 

Also if they try get you to join a presentation it is a way of you to sign up to 30 years membership packages I.e timeshare

reviews.author: tania m
reviews.title: birthday time
reviews.text: Truly excellent service, all the staff in general are very friendly and pleasant, they make you feel confident and comfortable. One of my favorite places is the “Blue Agave” restaurant, which treats you in the best way. I have to mention Esmeralda, Iran and Juan. for the ele te service they provide.

reviews.author: Mauri Nayeli M
reviews.title: Blue Agave
reviews.text:
The blue agave restaurant is delicious, in addition to the excellent service received by Captain Esmeralda, Hostess Iran and the super waiter Juan who was super attentive to our stay.
Upon arriving at the restaurant the service and attention was spectacular.

reviews.author: K L
reviews.title: Very good 😊
reviews.text: Excellent staff and food!!!! Tere , Fanny, Anabel and Chef Ruben Arturo are AMAZING.  This is a new type of restaurant for my husband and I but we’re so delighted with everything that we ate.  I highly recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: 972maggie
reviews.title: I would suggest not doing the upgrade.
reviews.text: We booked reserve adult only to find out there really isn’t enough perks to even bother on this property and the front desk manager was absolutely no help. As a matter of fact she told me I could leave but couldn’t have any of my money back on day 2 of a 14 day stay

reviews.author: Rodrigo M
reviews.title: Gaby the best😘🥰
reviews.text: The best experience we have had on my vacation. We met gaby and abraham at the ginger bar. They are very friendly and very attentive. We had an incredible time thanks to these guys. Thanks for everything. We hope to return for more experiences😘🥰😍

reviews.author: Micaela A
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Excellent service from Atilano Armando and Ariadna, waiters from Malva and very good food. And Axel's predisposition for animation is very good. Lemon fish's service is very bad, there is a lot of waiting. Very good service at Nescafé and very delicious cakes.

reviews.author: Love d
reviews.title: Unforgettable happy seamless experience
reviews.text: Great service crew especially the restaurants: Lemon Fish (Daniel) and Malva (Carlos). The rooms are clean and the bed is comfortable. I like the ocean view it is really worth the price. We love the activities and Derya our hostess was very much accommodating of our requests. Overall our family will definitely be back

reviews.author: Margarita M
reviews.title: SATISFIED AND ATTENTION😍😍
reviews.text: Excellent attention from everyone. At the Ginger bar we met Gaby, Christian and Abraham. They were the kindest people, happy, attentive and above all, always with a smile and great pleasure in serving us. They made our vacation unforgettable. 😊☺️🥰

reviews.author: Iliana G
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun excellent option! 😍
reviews.text:
Beautiful experience at paradisus Cancun! Excellent service at the pool, especially Didi, Baltazar, Rodrigo, Eduardo and Flor, always very attentive and friendly. We hope to return soon 😀
Rocha Family

reviews.author: Yex W
reviews.title: AMERICANS BEWARE
reviews.text:
Understaffed, poor maintenance, facilities falling apart (bathrooms by the lobby were always dirty/broken), furniture in room damaged/dated, stucco on balcony falling apart, food at the buffet was not marked (have food allergies), service was poor because you are understaffed and overbooked. Several employees were rude, and it was obvious that they were overworked. I slipped and almost fell on the wet floor and several other people did too, it was raining inside the pyramid area, and nobody cleaned it up, I had to ask someone to clean it. I went by the same area later and it was wet again, not fixed. Floors are extremely slippery if you are wet or are coming from the pool/beach area, watch out! Suggest adding rugs or anti-slippery stripes.
Hostess always ask for your allergies, but the food is not labeled. I asked a couple employees if a dish had gluten and they did not know. A lot of them did not understand me. Unable to try most of the restaurants as they were always full, the waiting time was 45 – 60 mins. The food at the buffet seems to be the same, lots of kids running around alone touching dishes.  Restaurants do not have AC (if they do, units need to be updated!), if you like to eat at 83 – 87 degrees this is your hotel. 
My main complaint is the lack of bottled water, when you ask for it, employees act like you are asking for champaign. Only water in a tiny cup and you must wait for it.  By the time it arrives it’s already warm. If you ask servers to fill your own water bottle (ex; we brought our own tumblers) with ice and water, they act surprised and some of them will just flat out be rude and leave unless you show them a big tip. 
This hotel is owned by Melia, which is a Spanish company.  They cater to Europeans, not Americans thus the lack of bottled water, clean bathrooms, updated rooms, friendly servers. I did not see too many Americans in the hotel over the holidays, most of the guests were Asian and/or European; I guess they like being dehydrated. 
Paid for Nikte as per their website is for the most demanding families and was highly disappointed, it’s not worth it.  No separate check-in, lines were long, there were only 3 employees, and they were very slow. Nikte rooms are dated, reminded me of my grandma’s wicker white furniture form the 90s. The stucco on the balcony is falling apart, and some of the balconies need repair as they have exposed screws/steel bars. The only perk of Nikte is the ocean view. 
The Beach is the best part of this hotel, beautiful location, lots of cabanas with chairs, clean and safe. No vendors harassing you to purchase souvenirs. The shower (not the bathroom) is amazing, very powerful and up-to-updated. 
 I really had high expectations for this hotel but was disappointed.

reviews.author: Amit W
reviews.title: Amazing experience at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Amazing experience for my first time in Cancun. The beach is well maintained and cleaned regularly, nice white sand and turquoise blue waters. Our ocean view suite was great and had an amazing view. The concierge is very professional, shout out to Rommel who helped me set up with the car rental and other tour questions. Great vibe at the beach as well as the pool.
