Lots of fun activities scheduled by the hotel on every day basis. Food at the Malva buffet is good. The sea food at the Agua Marina is delicious and the view at this restaurant is great. Walk up pool bar is amazing.
Towels at the beach and pool are free to use.. There is free service at the beach and pool huts for food and drinks. Unlimited drinks makes it very enjoyable.
The rooms can use a little upgrade as far as interior goes. But the view compensates for the room. We had booked a Luxury Junior suite ocean view.
 The evening shows are great entertainment   must watch. I would schedule dinners well in advance around these shows since you shouldn't miss them. The schedule for evening shows is given on QR codes when you check in.
I wish we had booked a full week. Totally worth it. Booked via Westjet vacations. Westjet has free pickup and drop off from airport in Cancun

reviews.author: jgonzalez2024
reviews.title: The hotel has deteriorated, becoming a member of the Meliá company should make the difference noticeable because in my case it was not
reviews.text: The hotel a year ago was one thing and today it is another, you find a staff that is not very pleasant and helpful, to everything they say No it can be done! I feel that what was promised was not fulfilled when I became a Meliá member, there is total dissatisfaction on the part of the staff because the hotel is nice but it no longer has the type of disposition of the people who work there as we perceived on the previous trip

reviews.author: maggiegomezsa
reviews.title: Lives up to its name
reviews.text: The service staff has a friendly and cordial treatment, they are always willing to help. They make you feel at home. The food is delicious and the drinks very varied. Despite the hotel being very large, you can always find a table in the restaurants and a place on the beach. The sea views are unbeatable and the beach with authentic Cancun sand is very pleasant.

reviews.author: Gabriela Roxana A
reviews.title: First and last time we choose Meliá
reviews.text: It is not a 5 star hotel at all, the service is really of average quality - average. We went to celebrate New Year's and got food poisoning from the hotel, we lost a whole day because we were in bed and we couldn't celebrate either. Lines for everything, reheated food, in special restaurants they take a long time to serve you. Old problem installed in the hotel with the lounge chairs, to go to the pool or the sea there is never room since some lively tourists go early to reserve and leave the towels sunbathing all day and leave those who want to enjoy without a place, and The hotel staff does nothing about it. We left with a very bad experience at the Paradisus Cancún hotel, the first and last time we chose Meliá because of this experience... we are from Argentina and we work a lot all year round to be able to go on vacation at the end of the year and take this bad experience away from us. makes me decide not to return to this hotel again or choose the chain again.

reviews.author: Lynn C
reviews.title: Beautiful place that really pays attention to all the details.
reviews.text: The people who work there are among the friendliest and nicest I have ever encountered in a hotel. The food (all inclusive) was extremely varied and really good. The maintenance of the property was top notch. The whole ambiance was great. It’s more geared to families but there are all kinds of guests from many different countries. The pool was the largest I’ve ever been in.

reviews.author: Hemi T
reviews.title: Best experience ever!
reviews.text: We had the best trip ever at paradisus Cancun. Everyone from front desk staff, assistant like Jenny, and waiters at the restaurants especially Ernesto and his manager Boris are the most friendly and kind people we have ever met. The service at the hotel and the foods at the restaurants are top rated, even better than other USA hotel and restaurants. People here are very hard working, honest, friendly and very welcome, especially Ernesto and Jenny. Thank you so much! We definitely will come back here again next year!!! Woa, it's actually a paradise.

reviews.author: Natalie B
reviews.title: Christian and Dania happy and helpful!
reviews.text: We loved the ginger bar, we went most evenings to play pool and have a drink before dinner.  Shout out to Christian and Dania who were amazing, always so happy and helpful, they made amazing espresso martinis too!!

reviews.author: bainter42
reviews.title: Check out Blue Agave and ask for Ulises!
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived at the restaurant, we were greeted by a very nice hostess. Within a few minutes, our waiter, Ulises greeted us for drinks. He recommended a mezcalita and sangria. I normally don’t drink mezcal, but the drink was so good that I enjoyed a second one. Our tacos were perfect and delicious! Then for dessert we had a rumchata, made by Ulises as a treat for us. Thank you to Ulises and staff, one of our favorite times at the resort!

reviews.author: ChrisChap0405
reviews.title: NYE travel
reviews.text: My husband and I go to a New Mexico all Inclusive resort every year. We are easy, just want good food, service and entertainment, we participate in everything! The first two days we were there, the 31st and 1st, it was not what we expected, long lines, service was terrible. I felt bad for the staff there, it SEEMED like it was not the usual staff and they were so understaffed. Wait times for food drinks and service was unreal. Starting on the second, it was as an entirely new resort. The service was amazing, the staff were on it and hustling and wait times were way down it was SO MUCH BETTER! So would definitely recommend this resort, just not during a holiday!

reviews.author: malalkarimi
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Paradisus was wonderful. We loved everything about it. All the staff were nice. The staff at Melva and the  coffee shop on the ground floor were amazing. The beach and the pools were beautiful. The kids did not want to leave paradisus. Will definitely visit again. One little suggestion, it would be best if green tea is available for breakfast.

reviews.author: Gabriela F
reviews.title: Very good service
reviews.text: The Santé restaurant is delicious, they treat you excellently and very personalized, the waiter Natanael Arnulfo and Roberto are super good people, we leave with a very nice experience of the entire hotel, the restaurants and the view of the super blue beach

reviews.author: Miriam C
reviews.title: Kidsdom and food
reviews.text: I loved that they have a kidsclub for children, my daughter is almost two years old and I felt comfortable leaving her with the children's team and being able to go to the sea or the pools. The food is of excellent quality and variety, what I didn't like is that you have to wait in line to get into the most popular restaurants.

reviews.author: Ève L
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
This was my 2nd visit to and hotel. I went there 6 years ago with my boyfriend and we returned this year with our 2 children.
I love this place. The beach is perfect, the staff very attentive and courteous and the cleanliness is there. There are also several restaurants (in addition to the buffet) and several small shops on site. There is also a kids' club and several activities. I recommend this place.

reviews.author: Road39287916253
reviews.title: The best experience
reviews.text: Everything is incredible from the moment you arrive until the moment you leave, the facilities are beautiful, they have a variety of restaurants and activities for the whole family and most importantly, the staff is super friendly and they make you feel very comfortable, in general a great experience I would definitely recommend

reviews.author: Angelica J
reviews.title: Pleasant and delicious experience. Thanks to Gladys
reviews.text: Pleasant experience. Good attention and friendly treatment from Miss Gladys. Foods with good flavor and the ideal temperature. I had a Castilian pumpkin soup and it was delicious. Along with the beet salad.

reviews.author: M D
reviews.title: Highly Recommend Staying at the Reserve
reviews.text: We had a great time with a large group as the staff was all very kind and accommodating. Highly recommend staying at the Reserve section of the hotel for a relaxing vacation. Special thank you to Stelian for taking care of all of us and making our experience extra special!

reviews.author: Sandra4Adam
reviews.title: Great family time
reviews.text: Amazing family vacation. Food was just ok but the hotel is very pretty. Carlos at the poolbar is a great bartender always friendly and makes amazing mojitos. The property is stunning. The coffee bar has fantastic coffee and snacks. The sports bar is a fun bar too catch football and then at 10pm turns into a dance club.

reviews.author: Mike K
reviews.title: A Nice experience for us!
reviews.text:
We had a very nice time at the Paradisus, arriving on Christmas Day through New Year.   The resort is beautiful with a huge middle atrium and their Japanese restaurant in the middle adding a very cool effect.  

Traveling around the holidays is always interesting and this was no exception.  The resort was crowded, leading to long lines for many restaurants at almost any time of the day.  But the food was great everywhere we ate.  

The beach was beautiful and the multiple pools were refreshing as well.  The bars kept the drinks flowing and the pool staff was always available and helpful bringing food and drinks to wherever you were on the beach or the pool deck.  

The resort is being remodeled so I'm sure the rooms will be freshened up a bit but we slept well every night, which is a rarity on vacation.  The room had a fully stocked refrigerator with beer and pop and water, which was replenished every day, well, I'll say the first 3-4 days but then the person wouldn't come for a day or two or three for some reason.  Also, the cleaning service was spotty.  Many days they didn't come at all until we called and even that took a long time for them to come up.  I'd say those were my only issues with the room but fairly big ones.  BUT we didn't come for our rooms, did we?  We came for the beach and beautiful blue waters! 

The resort had entertainment throughout the day and activities for adults and kids to do, which was nice.  One day we paid to rent a pool cabana and that was very very nice.  

We did a day trip to Chichen Itza through the company in the resort and it was great.  The 3-hour bus ride home after a long day was hard but well worth it.  We also did three of the AquaSport offerings.  They have 2 kiosks set up selling things to do.  If you do three, you seem to get a big discount.  The day at Isla Mujeres was great. We also jumped on a red bus for $1 each and took our teenagers to Senor Frogs so they could experience that (I was a little nervous).  Very toned down, family fun, and great food.  They'll rip you off with the drinks but I guess that is expected.  I think the kids really enjoyed taking the bus, which comes every few minutes.  The stop is at the street.

One funny aside is that the staff doesn't speak very good English so it was a running joke that even when you think they know what you are saying, they usually don't!  So yes, I had a cheeseburger that ended up as  a grilled cheese on a bun, and double check they know what Virgin means for non-alcoholic drinks!!  

That being said, the staff was great.  Our favorite area of the resort was the swing bar called Kanna which was above the beach with great views of the water.  Karina, our waitress at Kanna in the evenings, was especially good.

I look forward to coming back when it's renovated and maybe we'll come back another time of year to avoid some of the crowds :-)

Thanks Paradisus!

reviews.author: micheledN254OR
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text:
Never a disappointment.
The resort has changed some things since the previous trip. No reservations now for dinner.
I actually like that because you go when you’re ready. Not rushed to go back to the room to get ready for the reserved time.
The Italian restaurant has been moved to a bigger area. It’s absolutely wonderful. Think we ate Italian food 4 of the 7 nights. The food was amazing. Rolando was a fantastic server, attentive, great sense of humor.
Ivan one of the servers was excellent and very kind.
Malva for breakfast is great, can get a little crowded especially if there is a convention at the resort but the staff work extremely hard and very fast to get everyone seated.
You. Ant go wrong with any of the staff but Armando, Ramiro and Pascual are top notch. They remembered all of drinks that we  preferred every morning without having to request them.
On the way to the pool/beach there was a mimosa being served nice extra touch after breakfast.
The pool is where we spent 99% of our time and the staff are INCREDIBLE. They are some of the hardest, fun, kind, workers at the Paradisus. They served food and drinks with smiles & laughs all day everyday. Sergio Cano, Baltazar, Victor, Eduardo and Josue in my opinion are a fantastic team and the reason the pool is such a success. 
Elliot is a gem. He was able to locate all of our floats that had blown away by the wind.
We did have 1.5 days of clouds and some rain but the pool staff  made it enjoyable.

I think they are making changes to some of the rooms, they did remove the jacuzzis from the balconies and I’m happy. They were an eye sore and not used.  They should be add a few lounge chairs, tall chairs and tables to make the balcony more useable space.

Silent disco is a MUST. The shows at night are well performed and enjoyable.

The resort is great but the staff is the reason why I can’t wait to go back in 2024 to see them all again.

reviews.author: Sarahit Fernández
reviews.title: Excellent end of the year
reviews.text:
Excellent stay, choosing Reserve area was the best thing we could do because the experience was extraordinary in every way.
Very good food and drinks, we loved Santé, Sal and Aquamarina. We appreciate the attention of Natanael, Moisés, the entire team at the pool area and the pyramid 5 bar, as well as Roger who served us extremely well at Sal, it was a great dinner.
We thank Alan, our concierge, who took care of us and pampered us a lot.
Thank you for the experience and attention, we enjoyed it very much.
Only the desserts left me a little owed, but nothing serious.

reviews.author: db
reviews.title: Cancún heaven!
reviews.text:
We had a great family stay.  The hotel is a little dated but still has its wow factor. My daughter loved the kids club and all the activities throughout the day. The a la cart restaurant was good and a great Choice over the week especially the Italian and Japanese. Good choice of alcoholic brands for a all inclusive. We upgraded to a Nikte room and our personal Consierge (Diego) was on hand for everything from bookings to leaving little gifts in room for our daughter daily. 
I found the reception a little pushy with paying for everything upfront which stopped me from using vouchers I had at the end of check out what I wasn’t happy about. But that was the only negative about our stay.

reviews.author: Beth C
reviews.title: Best Vacation Experience
reviews.text:
From start to finish, this was a fantastic experience! 
Our reservations included ground transportation to and from the airport. This went fairly smoothly and our drivers both directions were friendly and their driving did not scare us. I believe our drivers were Sebastian and Luis.
When we arrived at the resort we were greeted and directed to our check-in area. We booked The Reserve, which is for adults only. That seated us for check-in and immediately offered us a drink of our choice! 2 Margaritas por favor! They gave us wristbands that were room keys and color coded to show what service your reservation includes. They directed us on how to get to elevator and room. They said our concierge Abel would be in touch in 30 min or less. Abel was there right away asking what we wanted to do while there. He made our hut reservations for us and dinner reservations at Sal for my birthday. Abel touched base with us every day except his day off. He made sure we knew who to contact when he was away. 
Nicole was fantastic to work with at the pool hut and so was Victor. Miguel was the server for the huts and he was so nice. He just seemed to know when to come around to get us something. 
We ate at Sante multiple times as well as Blue Agave, Cielo, Sal and Malva. We also had room service one night. Guacamole was fantastic the 3 places I had it from! There was also a place (like a Starbucks on steroids) where we could get coffee, adult beverages, bottled water, juices, sandwiches, and made to order items that rotated daily.
We had a 1 hour Hydro Therapy session included in our reservation so we both went. I would do it again.
The staff does a good job of keeping everything clean and everyone was friendly and helpful.
We will go back sometime!

reviews.author: Carlos M
reviews.title: Terrible service from hotel staff
reviews.text:
The attention of the hotel employees is awful. At the buffet I had to ask twice for a spoon and none of the waiters brought it, and it was like that in all the meals. On the Ginger Bar the lady Nurvi refused to serve me the wine in glass even when I asked her to do so, she served it in plastic cups, and when I tried to get her name she refused to give it to me. There is a bad attitude towards the guests.
I tried to enter the Italian restaurant and the waitlist was 2 hours, and there were empty tables in the restaurant so I asked why they are not allowing peoplet to enter, and the answer was that they dont have capacity to serve all tables. So I went to the buffet and they had pizza in there, so I tried to grab some, but they told me that I cant take the pizza because they were intended for the Italian restaurant only (the one I couldn't enter before), that the pizza for the buffet was already over and they were not cooking anymore for the buffet. So I asked to the manager why I couldnt get pizza, and his answer was that if he give pizza to me then he will need to give pizza to everyone because everybody wanted pizza.
Sunbeds are never available in the pool area, and you need to wake up at 6 a.m. if you want to get one. 
So in summary, everybody has a bad attitude towards the hotel guests.

reviews.author: JATZIRY GUADALU... Z
reviews.title: it was very good,
reviews.text: The hotel and the attention from the employees is very good, but since it was my birthday we ordered a cake in which we found a hair, the room service is very slow, the waiters Teresa, Fernando and Atilano were very efficient in their service. job.

reviews.author: Jasmine A
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The breakfast was amazing. Atilano and Teresa were very friendly and helpful during breakfast at Malva at Paradisus Cancun. The resort was very nice. The beach and pool was great. The staff was extremely friendly and welcoming to my family.

reviews.author: SdlT
reviews.title: PURE CHAOS
reviews.text: We had three Reserve Oceanview rooms over New Year's. The rooms were acceptable but the balcony is useless because the minute you sit down, the wall blocks your view of the beach entirely. Everything about this resort was pure CHAOS.  There are too many people and too few staff.  The hotel knows exactly how many people they have booked and there is no excuse for the understaffing and long waits for everything.  As a previous reviewer mentioned, there are lines for everything, long waits for food, lack of available reservations, lack of chairs, 3-hour wait for room service, etc.  The buffet is a nightmare and, on one night, they ran out of the main course at 9pm (this from a Spanish hotel chain).  On New Year’s Eve, they had the same fixed menu in all of the restaurants with only two entrée choices--duck and short rib.  It is nonsensical for a hotel that highlights their variety of restaurants to serve the exact same menu in all of them on the same evening with only two entrée choices.  The food choices, the lines, and the poor quality of the food made this trip miserable.  The chaotic, crowded environment is the farthest thing from relaxing or fun. And to top it all off, the staff was often rude and dismissive (when they weren’t soliciting tips).  This is not a top-tier hotel.

reviews.author: wnmansour
reviews.title: Would not recommend
reviews.text: Really bad experience, we stay in Mexico for New year every year. This was the worst hotel we've stayed at in the last 10 years. We stayed at a melia 11 years ago and we had the same bad experience. I am very disappointed it how the staff treated the guests

reviews.author: Resort32235310361
reviews.title: Congratulations....
reviews.text:
All very nice!!!!! Clean, spacious and beautiful facilities...
The food is very varied and delicious...
The sea view of the best images...
The staff is very friendly.... Above all Atilano, Fernando Gómez and Teresa, their attention is 10/10, thank you.

reviews.author: Stay02370132622
reviews.title: A luxury hotel that leaves much to be desired
reviews.text: Many people lying on the floor because there are not enough beds for the guests, if you want a Bali bed they charge you USD 265, crazy, very bad attention for guests who are not reserved. a shame

reviews.author: Adama G
reviews.title: high class holidays at a low price
reviews.text: was a very high class place to visit with familia and having a large one we required a good service which they delivered, i wouldnt stay any where else when visiting cancun again, for us safety and comfort whilst with the family is key and boy did they deliver

reviews.author: Nick G
reviews.title: Amazing Service, Beautiful View, Good food
reviews.text: Abraham and Luis were the highlight of our trip!!!!  We upgraded to the Reserve midway through our stay. It was definitely worth it. It was much quieter. Once we moved to the Reserve (adults only) Victor was amazing! He helped us with cabanas, and helped me charge my kindle countless times. He was so friendly. It would’ve have been as good of a trip without the staff  They all absolutely helped make our stay. Louis at the Capella restaurant was also amazing! He was absolutely amazing. We had a long wait time for our food, and he invited us to come back, and ordered us an extra cannoli when he saw how quickly we ate it! The Reserve was much quieter, and allowed you to appreciate the scenery more. The restaurant in the Reserve also served the BEST food (better than Sal’s Steak cave.) With the best service. Everything about our stay was wonderful. The drinks are also better in the Reserve (maybe thanks to our favorite bartenders!) But overall, we loved our stay here, and would be happy to visit again. I also had the pleasure of doing off-resort activities like Scuba Diving, and it was all perfectly safe, well-managed! A perfect, 5-star stay.♥️

reviews.author: Sharonbee3
reviews.title: Resort of Contradictions, how a resort with an incredible beach can fail so bad.
reviews.text:
My family traveled to Paradisus Cancun December 28-January 2nd.   We experienced a contradiction of experiences.   We had two Nitke Oceanview rooms, the rooms were nice with large balconies.   Having a concierge didn't anything to the trip, since there is no ability to make reservations other than booking a spa appointment there was no benefit.    I would not return to this resort unless they fixed their restaurant issues.    Here are the highs and lows of our trip.

The Good…  
•	The Beach is beautiful, crystal-clear blue water, amazing white sand, extremely clean.   Only improvement I would make is to replace beach chairs with ones that could be adjusted to different angles.
•	Resort is beautiful and the plants and lights in the main pyramid is lovely.
•	Beach service for drinks and food was great.   
•	Rooms were nice, beds comfortable, nice bathrooms.
•	The Gingers Sports bar Gabrielle is amazing, she makes every night special.
•	Kanna Bar - loved having an evening cocktail overlooking the ocean.  Shout out to bartender, Anna.
•	Spa was great and treatments and water therapy was very good.
•	We had a late flight and was able to book hospitality suite for an hour to shower which was great.

The Bad….
•	Lines, lines and more lines.   Nothing spoils a vacation more than stressing about how and when to eat or get a seat.    The Nespresso Coffee Bar is the only place to grab a coffee.   There is ONE person working the counter and there was never a time there wasn’t a line.  For a resort with 650+ rooms having only one person working the coffee bar is ridiculous!  Getting a coffee or tea took 20+ mins and the hot water button for tea only filled the cup around 40% so teas were tiny.  We started ordering multiple teas to get one cup of tea.   There needs to be a self-serve station to grab a plain coffee or tea and leave the specialty coffees to the bar or it needs to be staffed for the demand.
•	We got up at 6:45AM to get a seat at the beach.  By 7:00 AM almost all chairs by pool and beach are gone.
•	Food is bad, nowhere near a 5 star resort.  We were expecting at a minimum Blue Agave to be great, it started nice with good Guacamole and Chips, but the Tacos were bland, lacked any toppings and were so mild.   We asked if they had a hot sauce as the hot sauce, they served tasted of tomato sauce and it was hard to tell the difference between the different meats.    We thought even if all other restaurants were average a Mexican resort should be able to make a taco!
•	Check In – we arrived excited and happy to arrive and the people checking us in were miserable.   There was no wait, and we were happy to be there and when we asked a question we were chastised and told to be quiet that they were working and to wait.   It was harsh.
•	Lunch - there are limited options and lines for everything.  Like the coffee station there is a pool pizza place that is opened in the afternoon, and it is staffed by ONE person, she does everything from taking orders to cooking, plating every individual pizza.   The lines get long and with lines so long I saw people ordering up to 10 pizzas in one order.    
•	Restaurants have empty tables, but you are told there is an hour wait because restaurants can’t cook for all the tables at the same time.  With limited hours for each meal it is confounding why they are not staffed for the number of guests.
•	Buffet - be prepared to get up early or wait in a huge line.  I have never seen a resort where the buffet has a huge line to get a table.   The buffet is so poorly organized, it is spread out over a number of areas and people are bumping into each other, the food is cold and at breakfast like the coffee and pizza example one person is making the omelets and when she runs out of items, she needs to stop to chop ham or veggies (why isn’t someone prepping for the cook?).   It is crazy how one person is assigned to the busiest tasks.
•	Table at Capella are constantly sticky and dirty, not sure if they are ever cleaned.
•	Resort is Loud - even at 6:30 AM there is music blaring and due to the pyramid shape and how sound travels it gets loud at all hours of the day and night.
•	Customer Service lacking - we had one person in the family get sick and was in bed for 36 hours.  We went to the buffet to get some bread and light items and were told we were not allowed to take anything out of the buffet (we ignored them).     I asked if they could get me a yogurt and I was told they were busy and to wait.   We never got it, they really didn’t care which unfortunately was a common occurrence.   

The beach is normally at the top of our list of items we seek when going on a sun vacation, but the negatives of this resort outweigh any benefits and I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Alejandrita85
reviews.title: One of the best Christmases
reviews.text:
We went to spend Christmas and New Year's with my parents and the only word I can think of to describe it is PHENOMENAL. We stayed in THE RESERVE area and from the moment we arrived the treatment was exceptional. They assigned us to a concierge GEORGE, he made all our days perfect, from preparing an anniversary surprise for my parents to being 24/7 aware of everything we might need, such as reservations for the Bali Beds to the SAL restaurant, which is exquisite. He was in all the details he made everything work Perfect

To continue with the heroes of this vacation without a doubt were the entire SANTE team and the guys at the pool bar!

I couldn't forget their names anymore: Oscar, César, Miguel, Axel, Nathauel, Arnulfo, Moisés, Javier, Lorena, Valeria, Gabi, Luis and Alejandro

Thanks to all of them our food was served to us and they always tried to give us the best Recommendation with a sincere and friendly smile. You can tell they love their job!
The rest of the hotel, the staff was also very professional in all the restaurants, they treated us very well, the food was delicious and varied!

This year I found many more activities than before and we LOVED THEM!!!!

Sound healing, silent yoga with headphones with woow music, cocoa ceremony, as for the art part: hand painted hats, candle workshop, incense burners, Huichol art, macramé, painted alebrijes and hand painted bags They added value to the all-inclusive experience! Some great souvenirs to take with you as a keepsake and an experience to share with your family!

 We have nothing but words of gratitude to all these people who made us have an INOLVIDAE stay and spent one of the best Christmases as a family in unity, joy and gratitude.

Congratulations for continuing to be so excellent!
Many thanks for everything

reviews.author: Silvia P
reviews.title: Instead of Heaven...hell
reviews.text: As regular users of Melia facilities, we would never have expected to pay so much and receive so little... the all-inclusive formula should be banned, at least for some hotel categories. In March we stayed at the Me London Melia, which is a marvel and a true 5 star... nothing to compare with!!!

reviews.author: Fabián M
reviews.title: A disaster of attention
reviews.text:
The price is very high for the quality of service received. The insistence on taking a presentation to be a "Circle member" is uncomfortable, it doesn't let you enjoy your vacation in peace. And as for the stay, the rooms are old, with outlets that do not work, the Wi-Fi has a weak signal. In the online rate it is not true that all fees and taxes are included. Upon arrival at the hotel you have to pay another tax. The rooms in pyramid 3 are noisy late at night and early in the morning.
Restaurants are not available to all guests.

reviews.author: Lizeth R
reviews.title: I'm not coming back
reviews.text:
I'm here and I don't love it anymore, we came on the same dates last year and everything was much better, they removed the
Option to make reservations at restaurants and there is no way to find a place to dine, therefore room service is very late, and at 8/9 in the morning they decide to play loud music in the lobby and you can hear all the rooms if you want to sleep late the music wakes you up or if you want to watch tv there is no way, the staff is very nice but I have not been able to go to dinner at the restaurants the lines are 1:30 long you get desperate and opt for other options like the buffet, which is the only thing they offer you faster and it's not worth it, you pay a lot to have options and they don't give them to you

reviews.author: Susana A
reviews.title: THE WORST!! DO NOT WASTE YOUR VACATION TIME/MONEY!! PLEASE READ ENTIRELY BEFORE GOING AND VIEW MY PICS
reviews.text: I’ve been to Mexico 3 other times and this was my fourth time (second time in Cancun). Paradisius Cancún hotel was the absolute worst resort I stayed! For all the money we paid for this “all inclusive” this is the first time that we were charged if we wanted to eat at certain restaurants or have certain dishes. The food was TERRIBLE !! I’ve NEVER experienced anything more horrible. Room service was disgusting, the consistency of the steak was that of a “meat” I’ve never had before. It was as if I threw it on the floor, it’d bounce back it was so rubbery. The ceviche was nauseating because it looked and tasted like rotten fish guts.  The only food at the entire resort that was doable/eatable was their French fries and chicken nuggets. NONE of the food served was hot (even at the buffet). There was ONE restaurant that was good, which was the Lemon Fish, but good luck getting in there. The wait to that place is crazy but understandable since that’s the only place with decent food (still not served hot). Now for the rooms…I couldn’t wait to actually leave because they were so gross, dirty, and rusted !!!! I’ll let the video I post speak for itself on that aspect. The room had ONE outlet and one in the bathroom, that’s it! The outside and lobby of the resort is stunning though ! I wish they would upkeep the rooms as they do their lobby areas. The service was great (as they want a good tip so of course they were nice) some were genuinely nice but others forced it. The spa was great! The drinks all tasted watered down like crazy!! The mudslides were ok though. Mixed drinks and ALL THEIR JUICES tasted like 4:1 mix where 4 parts were water and 1 part possibly juice. DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY GOING HERE. I wish I had this review before booking. At check out, they tried to make me pay twice for a cake I paid for when it was charged to my room. I explained that and they tried to make me pay again or else  couldn’t check out. They called the manager because I told them if I see a double charge I will have my bank cancel one so they tried to force me to sign a paper that states I approve these transactions which I obviously refused to do and began recording because it was getting out of hand. To top it all off, one of their souvenir shops charge my brother US$120 for one dolphin stuffy which he gave them cash for and when he did not receive change, he asked them what is the conversion and they told him it’s 120 USD and not in pesos so he asked them to give him his money back right then and there and they refused and said he has to buy things up to that value if he did not want that one dolphin stuffy. Scammers! Again, I’ve stayed at other resorts and this was the worst! If this was my first experience in Mexico, I never would have come back, so I’m glad that this is only one out of the four places that I’ve been to that has been terrible.

reviews.author: 3Ring
reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text:
Wow - what an incredible disappointment. We came to this hotel (The Reserve - adults only) after 6 days at the Zilara Riviera Maya and the difference was night/day. The Reserve is the adults-only section of the hotel and we thought we might be able to stay largely in that area. Unfortunately, it seems the Reserve is an afterthought and an attempt to attract adults to the property. There are no dedicated adult bars and there is one outside restaurant with a limited menu. There are several other bars throughout the property, but there were always children present until closing. At the main lobby bar, they set up a DJ and had a toddler show in the bar.
At check-in we were assigned a personal concierge. She gave us her WhatsApp for any of our needs and told us she would let us know when our rooms were ready. Throughout the day we sent several messages to her asking about our rooms and trying to get restaurant reservations. She never responded. Finally, after 5pm, I went to the check-in desk and was told our rooms had been ready for hours. They simply failed to inform us despite our repeated inquiries.
Many of the staff were lovely, but a surprising number were rude and surly. Wait times for service were very long. Room service was frequently 2-3 wait. The buffet (the only option available to us one night as our concierge was not available to make reservations) ran out of many food items long before closing time. Food quality was unimpressive generally (and especially at Agua Marina). The rooms were adequate but small and dated.
This was very much a cruise ship free for all experience more than a luxury adult getaway.l

reviews.author: Cléa C
reviews.title: A fake 5 star
reviews.text:
Very cold staff, not at all welcoming, not even a thank you goodbye at check out, simply not worthy of a 5 star resort as they claim.

Restaurant 1h30 wait while 5 restaurants in the complex
Do not change the placemats between two customers: pieces of fresh guacamole on my uncleaned set??

Breakfast 20min to be seated and 25min wait for eggs which are poorly cooked
Old room, smells of paint, shower curtains and bathtub too old, 2 towels for 3 people, no bathrobes or slippers

Too many rooms for the deckchair or catering capacity: some find themselves lying in the sand paying €500 a night, this is unacceptable
Correct but does not deserve a 5 star nor its price is theft

The French flee if you like good gastronomy

reviews.author: Annie C
reviews.title: Disappointed, to flee
reviews.text: Extremely disappointed unlike the Melia Zanzibar, old-fashioned rooms, 1h30 wait for dinners, the queue even at breakfast. At check out not even asking if we were satisfied with the stay, barely a goodbye, total indifference. Does not deserve a 5 star, avoid!!!!!

reviews.author: Navigate01309587737
reviews.title: Terrible attendance
reviews.text: We had to eat on the floor this afternoon. No dining chairs. We sat where we were and ate next to the pool. In the middle of the path of passersby. Hotel with queues for everything. For breakfast, lunch, dinner. We had to complain to the staff about the meal that my son couldn't get at all since he has some dietary restrictions. You only had to complain a lot if you could get anything at this hotel. I don't recommend it and I won't go back. 5 stars only on the facade. Very beautiful hotel but service is terrible. It seems like they don't care much about the guest. In fact, just now I was served a dessert and the waiter told me to take the one that was dirty on the plate. My little son picked up the dessert spoon and threw it into the plate. The waiter didn't even offer another spoon. In fact, he offered it after he saw me looking at the dessert for 10 minutes. Anyway. It's not worth stressing about staying here at this hotel.

reviews.author: HORACIO S
reviews.title: Malva Restaurant
reviews.text:
Excellent service from Atilano, Fernando and Teresa at the Malva restaurant. And they made us feel at home. We will come back.
The food was very good and the variety was also excellent at both lunch and dinner.

reviews.author: Gelacio J
reviews.title: Nice hotel, average-bad service
reviews.text:
Nice hotel, average-bad service

Since before arrival we were battling. Transportation to and from the airport was included in our reservation.
However, when we spoke before arrival to schedule it, they never recorded our data and agreed to send us a form by email. Which they sent until the last day.
Because they asked us for the information on the last day, the airport-hotel transfer was no longer confirmed and we were waiting for it at the airport, without success. We prefer to pay for private transportation.

Arriving at the hotel, they gave us our room until approximately 5 p.m.

Concierge service in Nikte area is very different from other hotels. Only one person writes to you on WhatsApp, but there is no desk with whom you can contact.

We did not notice any difference in Nikte service vs. regular one.

To schedule return transportation also an odyssey. Approximately 10 emails sent, since the reception couldn't schedule it for us there
Same.

I think there are better options in the area. Unless there are major changes to the service, I would not return

reviews.author: velina2809
reviews.title: Not worth the all inclusive pass since food options are not great
reviews.text: Not worth the all inclusive pass since food options are not great   We ended up preferring to eat outside.  Room service was kind and great with requests. The vibe of the hotel checks but there was a lot of confusion on how to book restuarents and know what events are there for the day.

reviews.author: Alison D
reviews.title: Front desk - exceptional service from Lorena
reviews.text: Our family arrived after midnight as a hot mess with an overtired toddler and small child only to realize that we left our passports in the cab!! Lorena at the front desk was SO helpful and managed to track down the cab. We had our passports back within an hour. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Pablo Cesar C
reviews.title: Paradisus is not worth it
reviews.text: I bought at The Reserve but the truth is that it was of no use (except to go to the Sal Restaurant), I was there for 4 days but I could never find a chair for the beach because it was always full, you couldn't reserve a chair, only some lounge chairs but for the lounge chair I They asked for a modest $250 for the day. This hotel has a day pass option and the students are the ones who have all the beach chairs full, they should not have that pass option because the guests are the ones affected (we pay much more and we can't enjoy anything), the first night I It played in a terrible room because the bathroom made a noise like a train whistle, that noise all night and that's why I couldn't fall asleep, then on the second night, there was a strong wind and the balcony was the one that whistled, the The facilities are old with leaks in almost the entire building, I remember that even the Lemon Fish restaurant had a leak above it. Anyway, I didn't like this hotel.

reviews.author: elizabeth h
reviews.title: Must upgrade to Reserve!
reviews.text:
This is my second time staying at the Paradisus in the Reserve section (adults only). I decided to return after spending a heavenly honeymoon here back in Feb 2014. 10 years later and the hotel and reserve experience was better than ever. The highlights include:

1) coming in December was the best decision as the weather is mild and the hotel is beautifully decorated for the Winter holidays.
2) the beach was crystal blue everyday and the sand was free of sarghum. The view from our oceanfront suite was stunning.
3) the reserve perks were worth the extra expense, but especially the concierge service which either improved significantly in the past 10 years or we just got the best Concierge, Diego Torres!!! He gave us the best advice for daily dining, spa, and other experiences. He would surprise us with treats everyday, come check on us by the pool consistently and would even walk us down to dinner. I would definitely trust him in terms of ideal times for dining and spa reservations. He may be the best part of the trip and we can’t wait to request him in the near future. 
4) the spa was great and I recommend getting a massage!!
5) the new steakhouse (another reserve perk) that replaced the Michelin star Enzo was really good and a must try!
6) the rooms were great and service staff in general were all very responsive and friendly.
Some challenges that I hope get addressed before we return:

1) the reservation system that existed 10 years ago was replaced by walk ins only (except for the steakhouse) and basically if you don’t wait in a line at 5pm (doors open at 5:30) you risk not only getting seated when they open but then get placed on a list that can leave you waiting for hours before having dinner. This meant we ate the same food (the seafood restaurant in tower 1) two nights in a row in a resort with 10 restaurants! The poolside menu is also pretty limited and late night dining is also limited to room service. Overall, this system could use some improvement to make what was otherwise a perfect vacation.
2) you need to reserve your pool chairs before 9am everyday or risk having nowhere to put your belongings for pool days. If you maxed out on your two daybed reservations per room per stay, good luck with getting a daybed. We were lucky that for a 4 day, 5 night trip with 4 ppl and 2 rooms we were able to book one bed for everyday of our stay. Honestly the weather was so mild we didn’t really use them like we would have if it was much warmer. 

Overall, we not only plan on returning next year, we will be staying in the reserve section and requesting Diego Torres again!!

reviews.author: Nomad799421
reviews.title: Felt Pampared
reviews.text: My vacation at the Paradisus in Cancun was absolutely wonderful.  A special mention for Liliana, Amulfo, and Guillermo from la Malva PM as they absolutely did everything to accommodate our special request. Their attention to making sure we were taken care of was amazing.  My wife and I felt pampered. Can't wait to come back later this year.

reviews.author: Wendy P
reviews.title: Best service!
reviews.text: Had the most amazing time with a group of girlfriends. The staff was more than hospitable and went out of their way to make sure we were having a god time! Thank you so much to Sergio Cano, Balta, Didier, Elliott, Victor Cahuich, AB, and Martin! Lovely gentleman and an all around perfect vacation experience ❤️

reviews.author: R G
reviews.title: Extremely Horrible Room Experience.
reviews.text:
1) I spent about $5600 for me and my daughters to book 1 Bedroom Suite Deluxe Ocean View in The Reserve category directly from the Melia site.  At the time of booking and a couple of weeks before arriving I confirmed the booking and made sure they will be providing 2 beds.  Reservation also confirmed it

2) On arrival on 12/21, they first charged my credit card within 5 minutes of arrival and then said the room I booked is not available but there is another room with 2 beds. I checked the room and there is no ocean view from the balcony.  It faces another building of same hotel.  I went back to check-in area and all they said we are sorry and they will move me next day

3) Next day they moved me to the room and it only had 1 King bed and they said they will send an extra bed as we are 3.  In Spite of asking three 3 times no one came

4) I had to sleep on the tiny couch in the living room.  Now you tell me after spending about $5600 for 5 nights and sleeping on the couch.

5) During check I complained and they did not do anything

6) After arriving back ,  I emailed and only thing they say " we are sorry for the inconvenience

I would not recommend this Hotel to anyone as they dont provide the room what they promised and they would charge within minutes of arrival and then you are stuck with that hotel.

reviews.author: Angelia G
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text: There are so many positives about our trip! The wait staff is absolutely phenomenal and go above and beyond every single day. The morning breakfast crew of Gerardo, Armando, Martin and Manuel were amazing and made breakfast fun every single day. By the pool Balta and C are the best and never had our drinks empty. Lemon fish was our favorite restaurant. You can make reservations up to 3 days in advance! The taco shop is fantastic as well!

reviews.author: nathaliemcfadden
reviews.title: Amazing hotel!
reviews.text: All around amazing stay. This was our first time staying at this hotel and it was truly one-of-a-kind. Loved the atmosphere of luscious foliages inside & out, clean, friendly staff. Would definitely go back!

reviews.author: joni51
reviews.title: Spectacular vacation! Cant wait to go back!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun

This resort was spectacular.  Our room was the Reserve Ocean View suite.  Upon arrival we were directed to the Reserve area, which was in building 5.  The Reserve check in was absolutely stunning.  The  relaxing music, the subtle smells of vanilla and lavender, the pools of running water, the hanging vines, the lanterns, all just a sensory delight.  

Check in took just a few minutes and we were escorted to our room by our concierge Jose.  Jose made our dinner reservations for the week and said if we needed anything to let him know. Our room was just mere feet from the all day charcuterie board and bar.  Julio made the perfect drinks.   In the morning, there was a variety of fruits and breakfast snacks along with a coffee bar, juices and morning beverages, yes you could get a Mimosa or Bloody Mary.  In the afternoon, this area has drinks alcoholic and non-alcoholic as well as meats, cheeses, warm snacks and desserts. 

Room
Our room was perfect for us.  Upon entering, the bathroom was on the left.  The bathroom had a single sink with hand soap and lotion, as well as a few other boxed amenities, which we never opened. To the left of the sink was the water closet, to the right of the sink was what can only be described as a shower room.  The shower room included the large soaking tub and the rainfall shower. The shower had excellent water pressure, one of the best showers we have experienced at any resort.  The shower room was all glass, separated by a somewhat sheer curtain, perfect for the ocean views and sunlight, but not perfect for privacy.  The shower included Biology shampoo, condition and shower gel. To the right across from the bathroom was the closet that included a safe, ironing board and umbrella.  The closet had a light that doubled as a night light to the bathroom when the room was dark. 

The room had a king sized bed that was a bit hard on my back, but a mattress topper was added, and it was very helpful.  The room had a sitting area near the balcony as well as a table with 2 chairs.  It was sparsely decorated, but comfortable.  The morning sunrise with ocean views was incredible beyond words. 

Restaurants
When staying in the Reserve area you have access to Sante.  This is where we ate upon arrival.  Sante turned out to be our favorite place for breakfast and lunch.  The food was fantastic and had the perfect ocean views. The staff at Sante was very attentive and made sure we didn’t need a thing.  Sante is located right by the adult-only reserve pool.  

The restaurants we’re beautiful.  They all had a different decor that was reflective of the menu and style of cuisine.  There were many options that could accommodate a variety of tastes.  That said, while the service and menu options were always excellent, the execution of the meal itself was somewhat anticlimactic given the beauty and attention that surrounded you.  The food wasn’t bad, but it just seemed to be less elevated than all the other sensory queues. 

When staying in the Reserve area, you had a one time access to Sal’s Steak house (this restaurant is an extra charge if not staying in the reserve).  Like Sante, Sal’s was excellent, the quality and creativity of the food were elevated compared to the other restaurants.  We also had the opportunity to dine at Ceilo, Aqua Marina, Lemon Fish and Cappella. There were 2 mornings we opted for Malva, the breakfast buffet. However, once we discovered Sante had breakfast, we never went back to the buffet.  Sante was just superior.

One “must”, is the Kanna Beach Club (food at this location is an extra charge). Upon entering there is a small bar with swings and multiple seating areas. We discovered this small, out of the way spot while exploring the resort after dinner on a warm evening.  The location is nestled into the side of the hotel facing the shore with about a 10 to 15 foot drop to the sand.  It’s almost like a deck built on the side of a cliff overlooking the ocean.  The surroundings are very casual, we sat on a couch near a coffee table facing the ocean.  That in itself was great, but the way the location as designed meant that there was very little light from the adjacent facilities, meaning the view of the stars was absolutely breathtaking.  They seemed so close, and we just sat listening to the waves and marveling at the heavens.  Words fail to describe the experience.  

Off Resort Dinner
One of the great things about Mexico, and Cancun in particular, are all the off-resort options for excursions, dining and shopping.  We always felt completely secure and didn’t feel the need to take any extra precautions beyond what we would normally do with a trip downtown in our home town.  During this vacation we decided to explore dining options outside of the hotel.  Our concierge helped us decide which options fit our taste and even made reservations for us at two nearby eateries, The Crab House and RosaNegra. Both of these were only a short walk from the resort so we didn’t need transportation.  

The Crab House was very good, specializing in seafood fare that went well beyond what you might normally expect in the US.  It’s a bit pricey, but worth the extra money to dine on high quality ingredients while watching the sunset over the lagoon.  

Our second dining experience was really one of exploration and surprise.  We arrived at RosaNegra and were escorted through a very busy restaurant by an army of young, chic attendants.  Sitting at our table, we found it difficult to talk due to the surrounding noise.  Some may like that kind of bustling environment, but we prefer something a little more subdued and less busy.  For us, this just wasn’t the place, so we politely told our waiter that we were going to go find something a little less energetic. The next thing we knew, the manager arrived at our table, explaining that there were other dining options that would be a better fit just a short walk from where we were.  She offered to take us.  We were off!  Instead of walking us back out of the restaurant, she escorted us to a boardwalk on the bay that led to an Italian restaurant called Parole.  Apparently there are five different venues all connected and owned by the same company.  Shocked at the beautifully lit paradise in the distance, we were completely intrigued by what lay ahead.  We were warmly greeted and found a great table overlooking the lagoon.  The menu was huge and included some really creative Italian favorites as well as some really nice wine options.  I could go on about this experience but it was just what we were looking for.  In short, the Wagu meatball is huge and excellent as were all the courses we enjoyed. Additionally, Parole had some fantastic entertainment that included an electric violinist and a painter.  Yes, a painter (I won’t spoil the surprise.) I would highly recommend either of these as a great addition to the on-resort amenities.

Evening Entertainment
To be honest after dinner most evenings, we loved looking at the stars from the seating area at the Kanna Beach club.  We did spend one evening at the Ginger bar. It had a band that played 80s music and were very good.  However after long days in the sun, we were tired and ready to sleep by 2300.  

Spa
One afternoon we spent at the spa. Left our phones in the room safe, (Believe it or not, lol).  Upon arrival to the spa my husband and I were each escorted to the male/female dressing areas.  Once undressed, we were given a robe and taken to the hydrotherapy area. Each dressing area had access to a steam room and dry sauna.  After about 10 minutes, we were brought to a cool water shower area with a variety of water jets. We were lead to the hydrotherapy pool.  It’s a cool water pool with various jets and sprays to relax your muscles.  It was wonderful.  Once you completed your time in the pool, you were offered water or green tea and had a few minutes to lounge on a couch before moving to the massage area.  On our way to the massage area, we were escorted back through the dressing room and out into a public hallway area in our robes.  This was a bit unnerving and did take away from the newly induced relaxation.  

The massage, for me, was a bit disappointing.  The face pillows were very firm and I ended up with a headache by the time the massage completed.  I was also disappointed because the therapist asked what area to focus on, which for me was neck, scalp and shoulders. Unfortunately, the therapist failed to really attend to those spots, spending most of the time on my legs and back.  My husband also felt the face pillow was firm, but he managed to find a comfortable spot.  His massage was focused on the lower back, and seemed better than mine.  Overall it was a disappointing experience for me.  Marching through a common hallway, pressed into a concrete face pillow and misaligned massage left it difficult to find a benefit from the therapy.

Pool
The adult reserve pool was nothing short of perfect.  It was heated and always seemed just the right temperature.  Surrounding the pool were Bali beds, complete with additional loungers for those times you wanted extra sun.  Reserve guests are guaranteed a Bali bed for 2 days of your stay.  Additional Bali bed access is granted via requesting placement on a waiting list. You may or may not get one depending on availability.  We were lucky enough to have one every day of our stay.  Go to the towel hut to coordinate Bali bed access.  Jennifer and Nicole managed that amenity and were excellent, handling our requests and setting up our pool side oasis. 

Food and drink service is also available right from the bed. Valeria and Oscar were our pool-side concierges and they brought us drinks and food throughout out the day.  They made sure we had an ice bucket filled with bottled water and seemed to effortlessly insure that anything you might need was already at your disposal.  The food came from Sante so it was always excellent. One day we asked for a Bali bed over looking the ocean, this was not ideal as it was windy and a bit cold. The next day we chose to go back to our pool view Bali bed.  The pool was perfect for floating on a raft and getting some sun. 

Special thanks to Nicole, Jennifer, Valeria and Oscar, they made sure we were comfortable, well fed and well hydrated! 

Beach
Standing in surf up to my waist, i could see my feet resting on the white sand.  The water was clear and magnificent.  The waves were active and a bit rough for some, but I found it wonderful - an almost spiritual experience of the power, majesty and beauty of nature.  The sand between the resort and edge of the water was not very long and the drop off to the ocean was steep.  The sand was clean and soft, except for the occasional tuft of seaweed.

Our daily routine included getting up and going to the coffee bar just outside of our room.  We would have our coffee and watch the sunrise from our balcony.  Then we would get dressed in our swim suits/coverup and go the Sante for a leisurely breakfast.  After that we would make our way to the towel hut to talk with Jennifer or Nicole and find our Bali bed.  We would alternate laying on a lounge chair for sun, swimming and then laying in our hut reading or napping.  We also took random walks to the beach through out the day.  Oscar and Valeria also made sure we didn’t skip any meals.  We would return to our room in the afternoon, stopping at the Reserve charcuterie and bar before getting ready for dinner.  After dinner we typically found our way out to Kanna beach club for drinks and stargazing.

Overall this was resort speculator, from the sunrise views from our room, the food at Sante and the very attentive staff/concierge at the pool.  Reserve is a must!

reviews.author: Jorge R
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Honestly, I read lots of good reviews on this place along with Rafael’s service. I’ve had some incredible sushi made by Japanese sushi chefs before. The sushi was overrated at this place. The rice reminded me of grocery store sushi in the US. Something  very common in Mexican Sushi. Also, I grew up eating Mexican ceviche in Baja. I always thought that Mexican ceviche was the best until I ate Peruvian ceviche in Lima. Hands down, Peruvian ceviche is the best. The Peruvian ceviche in lemon fish is second rate, I’m sorry to say and the popcorn? Yes I said popcorn in the dish was a major head scratcher. Finally: the Lomo saltado (Peru’s signature dish), though very tasty at this restaurant, it was not Lomo Saltado. Can’t be lomo saltado if it doesn’t have potato’s, white rice and grilled onion. Lemon fish should not name that dish Lomo Saltado. Name it something else, because it is good but it is NOT Lomo Saltado. From all the reviews I read, I’ll tell you that Lemon Fish is overrated but Rafael’s service and attention to detail is not! Great server!

reviews.author: Tatiana R
reviews.title: Wonderful time!!! Rafael de Lemonfish is the best!!
reviews.text: We had the best vacation here. The staff was amazing and the food was good, even the buffet. Will be back again! Kids enjoyed the escape room on a rainy day. Our favorite food was the Italian restaurant but lemonfish was also yummy. Come say hi to Rafael!

reviews.author: finley1101
reviews.title: Cecilia was the best!!!
reviews.text: Cecilia was amazing!!! Catered to all our needs! Love all her suggestions! Would go back anytime. She anticipated all our needs and made us the best cocktails. She showed us alternate ways and made our stay amazing. She made our visit so great and I hope I meet her I. The future.

reviews.author: Parul A
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Very good experience to be in the pool party with the girls. They girls are so amazing, nice vibes. Dancing with the kids and with the adults, they are very nice. They are the best staff in the hotel, thanks to Itzel, Ivon, Brenda and the amazing DJ Aviles, thank you so much guys.

reviews.author: Katina M
reviews.title: You have to come to Paradisus!
reviews.text: It’s a stunning place .Out concierge Violeta was amazing,caring and sweet.Joel ,our waiter at the pool made our time there memorable and so was Martin at the breakfast buffet.Nicole at the pool was also amazing and made our honeymoon just so much better!Rosanna,guest survive manager,took care of us when we were in need and that’s everything when you’re in a foreigner country.I highly recommend you visit this resort .It’s Paradisus on earth!

reviews.author: Jennifer K
reviews.title: Great trip!
reviews.text: This was our second trip as a family to a Paradisus resort (went to Playa Del Carmen last year), and it was wonderful! The property is beautiful and right on the ocean. Restaurants were all delicious, and they were very accommodating for my kids even without kids menus per se. Our concierge (Margarita) set up all our dinner reservations and spa appointments and was super helpful. Our favorite part of the Paradisus resorts though are the awesome kids club activities! Our kids have an amazing time everyday, which allows mom & dad to have some fun. Every staff member was wonderful with our kids, especially Gustavo, Cristela (?) and Ivon :) We are also so appreciative of the on-call physician that came to our room at 2am to evaluate our sons breathing problems (turned out to be croup) and got him an ambulance to the hospital. We were so thankful!!! We love Paradisus and will continue to go yearly. For our kids (age 5 and 7) I have a slight preference for Playa del Carmen because of kids water park, but Cancun was fabulous too!

reviews.author: kmutafchieva883
reviews.title: You should come here!
reviews.text: It was our second time here.Honeymooners but didn’t receive much fuss about it .Resort is stunning service Top.Joel at the pool restaurant,Nicole at the pool,Martin at lunchbox and Rosanna from management made this trip so so special!!!However for your excursions DO NOT use Otium!They cost me a peace of my toe !

reviews.author: Paul C
reviews.title: Malva Food Bazar at Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: My wife and I ate here every morning to start our day. There was plenty of food offerings from fresh fruit, breads, charcuterie, desserts and toppings, to tamal, omelets, pancakes, sausage, bacon, and plenty of authentic local dishes. Something for everyone! It's buffet style so some items lose freshness under the heat lamps after a while. What gives this review it's Excelente rating were the servers, particularly Gerardo y Martin and the rest of their group.  We sat wherever they were knowing how well they took care of us. From fresh jugo verde to Mexican coffee with a twist, great conversation and service.  Sometimes they would find us before we found them!  Gerardo, Martin, and Malva really made our days at Paradisus delicious and delightful. Thank you! ❤️

reviews.author: Laura T
reviews.title: Best trip ever! George is the BEST
reviews.text: George made our trip last February amazing! He went above and beyond and catered to our every need. Our mini fridge was fully stocked with only our favorite drinks each day. He got our reservations with ease and even escorted us personally to our dinners each night. He arranged all of our private transportation. I recently reached out to plan our next trip in the next few weeks and he is already making my trip wonderful and I haven't even arrived in Cancun yet. FIVE MILLION STARS! The flowers, champagne, rose petals, and chocolate covered strawberries were really the icing on the cake. GEORGE will change your life.

reviews.author: nikki h
reviews.title: Loved Ms Laura!!!
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort/fantastic beach front!!!  Amazing choices at buffet! Staff super helpful & hospitable!!
Ms Laura at the heated pool bar was phenomenal!! So friendly & helpful…we loved her & soooo accommodating!!  Will 100% Return to this resort!

reviews.author: Michaël C
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text:
Ignacio Atilano is a server at the buffet of the Paradisus Cancun, and he is an excellent addition to the team. He is always awake and attentive, making sure that guests have everything they need and that their dining experience is enjoyable. He is polite and friendly, making guests feel welcomed and valued.

One of the things that stood out to me about Ignacio was his ability to anticipate guests' needs. He was always one step ahead, making sure that guests had enough drinks, refilling plates and ensuring that the buffet was well-stocked. He also had a great sense of humor and was able to lighten up the atmosphere with his jokes and friendly banter.

Ignacio's attention to detail was also impressive. He made sure that the buffet was clean and organized, and that the food was presented in an attractive way. He also made sure that the tables were clean and set up in a timely manner, ensuring that guests never had to wait long for a table.

Overall, Ignacio Atilano is a great server and a valuable member of the Paradisus Cancun team. He goes above and beyond to make guests feel comfortable and well taken care of, and his efforts do not go unnoticed. I highly recommend Ignacio as a server for anyone looking for a memorable dining experience.

In addition, it was a pleasure to see how he was always willing to help and very knowledgeable about the menu, he was able to recommend dishes and explain how they were prepared, which made the experience even more enjoyable. He is a true professional and I will definitely look for him the next time I visit the Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Chamene C
reviews.title: Best dinner
reviews.text: Rafael from Lemon Fish was the best! He was able to provide us with the best dinner experience during my dinner with friends. He was able to explain the best meal options based on what we each preferred within our group.

reviews.author: Jillmarie S
reviews.title: Raphael Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Great service! Excellent food. Very clean.  Fresh sushi and tacos. Everythingon menu was delicious. Greatselection. Chocolate cake was AMAZING.  Would definitely eat here again.  Raphael was great. Drinks were also amazing!

reviews.author: Candice E
reviews.title: Sergio is amazing
reviews.text: Sergio Cano  the waiter needs a raise he is amazing. I love all of the service and it was excellent. The drinks were always on time and prompt. I stayed one week here and never had to go without a drink. We had a wonderful time. Pay this man more. We will come back again

reviews.author: Rozon M
reviews.title: Rafael at lemon fish restaurant, Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: Perfect place perfect service with Rafael at the Lemon Fish. I’f you like to feel important and special is the place to be. Thanks I was alone today and I was treat like a Queen. I recommande this hotel and this restaurant 100%

reviews.author: Sightseer41580511215
reviews.title: Far from paradise
reviews.text:
Went for a music festival (Sunsoaked), and can tell you this resort fell short on every expectation. Paid over $3500 for 4 days, food was terrible. Upgraded to "The Reserve" 
 and into a suite after they moved me from the the Fiesta Americana, where i had booked a room with a pool in it. Weren't able to enjoy the real perks as most things need a reservation. The steakhouse (need a reservation and only open while the event was going on). Breakfast was more European style, and not really my thing. Drinks were very much watered down, unless you started tipping heavy (i know, that's the expectation) but for a trip where i spent close to $5k to enjoy, nothing was magical about this resort and i would recommend going anywhere else but the Melia hotels. Staff and location are the 2 thigs i can say were amazing every step of the way. Spend your money at one of the branded hotels, and don't fall for the all-inclusive tag. Suite was large, but i was by myself in the room and really only wanted the pool in my room that i originally reserved. No sorry. No ask to move. Just moved to the reserve and told it was better. I can imagine it was not.

reviews.author: Vivi M
reviews.title: Lovely staying at Paradius Cancun
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stayin at  Paradisius cancun. They made everything an experience,  food, music, activities and kids activities plus the amazing beach and amenities. 
My daughter really enjoyed participating in the kids activities, painting, pool parties and so many others. A special thank you for the lovely instructors who craft all the kiddo activities Ivon, Ruby,Brenda and Cristal.

reviews.author: Adventurer514906
reviews.title: Lovely visit at Mélia Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The staff was very accommodating and friendly. The resort has a lot of comfortable space by the pool and the restaurants are varied in their offerings. I had a lovely room. Raúl my concierge tried to be helpful with everything. The staff at Malva was very good to me every morning from the Fernandas, greeting me, to Janeth, Atilano and Ignacio who helped serve me everyone was kind. Also, the staff at Lemonfish was very professional and quick with their service. I thank everyone especially those that I forgot to mention.

reviews.author: Howard E
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun. Great Staff, Wonderful Destination
reviews.text: A wonderful destination, beautiful facilities, and especially a great ,helpful ,and friendly staff. Everyone was extremely pleasant but we want to acknowledge our 2 favorite staff members. Moises by the pool could not be more pleasant. He was always funny and attentive. Our special thanks and sincere gratitude go to our concierge Galdino. After we checked out and were at airport security my wife realized she had left her jacket with her car keys at the hotel. We jumped in a cab back to the Paradisus and contacted Galdino. He was not working that day. He did contact the hotel staff and had my wife’s coat and keys waiting for us . We did make our flight thanks to Galdino. Thanks again.

reviews.author: Gicet G
reviews.title: Great service!!
reviews.text: The staff was amazing! The service we received was outstanding. In particular the breakfast crew (especially Martin). The pool waitress Ada was always checking in and never missed a beat. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Mel
reviews.title: Don’t bring babies here
reviews.text:
Horrible experience with baby. Loud live music in the lobby almost every night until 11pm. The room is shaking with it. Called the concierge but nothing was done. 
They should not have advertised it as family friendly hotel.

If you like party, this might be for you.

reviews.author: TomL911
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant: Excellente!
reviews.text: Outstanding meal and service at the Lemon Fish restaurant. Very nice atmosphere. Terrific assortment of sushi. Raphael was an amazing server…friendly and attentive for our group of  seven. Highly recommend this standout restaurant at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Luana S
reviews.title: Rafael Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael was actually the best. Not only did he give us the best food recommendations but also the energy level was spectacular. He was was excited to be here for us & get our travels started. The food was absolutely incredible & amazing

reviews.author: itsmartinelli
reviews.title: You MUST dine with Rafael at Lemon Fish!
reviews.text: Lemon Fish and its staff (Rafael specifically) made our night so special! The food was outstanding and such a meaningful way to end our time in Cancun. Our team was able to relax after a three day conference and experience some of the best food that Paradisus Cancun has to offer. Don’t miss this!

reviews.author: Ronald K
reviews.title: Amazing Food and Service at Lemonfish
reviews.text: Everything from end to end was incredible. I can't believe the best sushi in Mexico is at an all inclusive. Rafael treated my group and I like we were foreign dignitaries or corporate executives or movie stars. Would recommend this resturant to anyone who wants a world class experience at the Paridisus.

reviews.author: RU4Rhyl
reviews.title: Older hotel with amazing workers!
reviews.text: Overall great experience the facilities were well maintained but you can tell it is a bit old, this did not bother us. we had amazing service from 2 very beautiful souls in Aldhair and Teresa from the Malvar buffet in the mornings during our stay, they accommodated our 1 year old making a mess everyday with smiles and amazing patience, good work Paradisus!

reviews.author: Austin C
reviews.title: Excellent service and atmosphere! From the minute you walk into the resort it’s nothing but hospitality and niceness!!!!
reviews.text: Fabulous service from everyone at all meals, events, room service, security… literally everyone! There’s a few people I’d like to give some recognition to during our week stay. Shout out to Atilano, Janet, Rodrigo and Francisco for taking amazing care of us!

reviews.author: Kassi B
reviews.title: Rafael Lemon Fish
reviews.text: We loved our dinner tonight. Rafael was the BEST! What a wonderful dinner it was!!! We had veggie sushi rolls and the best margaritas! Easy to east here on a vegan diet!  Yum yum yum. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lark D
reviews.title: Paradisius Cancun
reviews.text: We had the best stay! 10/10 service. Manuel Martinez, Atilano, and Richard from the coffee bar were so wonderful! Best service from them! I will be coming back again and again! This place is amazing and the staff is unmatched.

reviews.author: Steve S
reviews.title: Cielo Lindo
reviews.text: We ate at Cielo Lindo restaurant at the Paridisus Cancun at recommendation from the waiter at the Blue Agave, Filiberto. He was also our server at this restaurant. He provided great service and recommendations for food. The manager, William and the Chef, David and Hostess Karen were all very pleasant and accommodating.

reviews.author: Marla G
reviews.title: Paradisus Pick Another Resort
reviews.text:
PLEASE READ ...I'm not really sure where to begin. When I originally booked the resort I opted for the junior suite. I discovered that because I did not upgrade to the "Reserve" that we would not have access to certain areas of the Resort including the swim up bar. To me, the swim up bar and the Adult Only area was what I wanted. In addition there were restaurants that we would also not be able to eat at. So I paid the extra money and upgraded. I'm not really sure it was worth it though. By the way. I was surprised to see that this multi million dollar resort only has five restaurants? The resort advertises 4 pools. This is totally misleading as one of the four are a private swimming area attached to the rooms and then a tiny one next to the adult only pool. We never did find the fourth one unless you consider the hydro spa pool a fourth one. 

The cabanas- you have to reserve these 24 hours in advance and most of the time people don't show up. The beach chairs, people will come down at 6 am throw their stuff on the chairs but you won't see them until 1pm in the afternoon. See picture below . 

When we arrived to the resort they took us to this special guest service area for the upgraded Reserve guests. Once we were checked in, I was told by mistake I needed to pay a balance of $3,000 plus dollars. What???? I bought the trip through Southwest Vacations and it was paid for in full way before I arrived. Once that was straightened out, we got our bracelets on and headed to our rooms. The room we got was really nice. No complaints as we got a room off the main level with a swimming area outside off the deck. I was told this was an upgrade from the reserve we paid for which kind of scares me that the extra money we paid for would have probably gotten us a view of a brick wall. The swim up bar which is an amenity you pay for as a Reserve guest still allows kids at the swim up bar. We were told that the adult pool was this private great thing and it ended up being this tiny swimming hole while the awesome pool area where the swim bar is has kids swimming all around it. See my photo. 

We were assigned a concierge which was really of no help. All reservations for the restaurants were late (9:00 at night). We would walk up to the restaurant earlier and typically they accommodated us at an earlier time than our reservation. Our concierge didn't really explain anything to us. We had no clue about any of the entertainment going on until after it was over. We had to figure things out on our own and by the time we did it was too late.  

Taxi vs Uber if you want to go down to to Cabo or San Jose take an Uber! It's half the cost. An Uber was $10 to $12 vs  a taxi being $35.00. The taxi was a recommendation from our concierge. So there you go. Ubers cannot go the airport though so get a shuttle service. 

The excursions in the hotel are too expensive. Go see Amanda at Cabo Blue. It's 65.00 a person. They are awesome! They feed you, drinks, snorkeling, etc. 

The Reserve upgrade was also supposed to include an aromatherapy every night when they turn down your bed. This was not explained to me when I checked in. Some of the housekeeping staff had no clue and I got this service one night out of 6. I asked for food delivered at the pool. One waiter said no another said yes. Lol 
You have to reserve the cabana 24 hours in advance. Half the cabanas weren't even being utilized but they still wouldn't let you have them. So they stayed unoccupied all day. Most of the staff was helpful, friendly, and very accommodating with the exception of guest services and the front desk. I don't like the fact that you have to tip everywhere and everybody. You can easily go through several hundred dollars. I think the resort should take care of this. 

It's a beautiful resort and view of the beach is nice but I think it's overpriced. The food is ok but not the greatest. The wine is blah. I have had way better wine. I would choose a different resort with more restaurant options. We still had a good time an learned what to do differently next time. We hope you will learn from this as well

reviews.author: loretta
reviews.title: good stay
reviews.text:
