WE HAD A CERY PLEASANT STAY.  the staff for the most part was great.  The only set back was the drinks. SUPER SWEET, watered down and cheap alcohol.    we ended up making our own cocktails in our room!  The pool was really nice and the hotel was extremely x
clean!

reviews.author: TAS1013
reviews.title: We love Paradisus Cancún!!
reviews.text: Everyone is so kind and helpful. Liliana Garcia and Martin Kü went out of their way to make our last night very special. Alfredo at breakfast, Honororio in the taco place, Richer and Alexandro at the coffee bar and Irene at the pool…we just can’t say enough good things!! Thank you! The people make Pardisus spectacular!!!

reviews.author: AdamLucie B
reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus for our 10 year anniversary and it was amazing! We upgraded to the Reserve and Violeta was our concierge. She was so helpful in showing us the resort and making dinner reservations. Any time we had a question Violeta was able to help us. Everything was very clean. All employees we encountered were very friendly, helpful, and attentive. We also had fun at many of the activities and events that were held by the resort during our stay. We loved our visit!

reviews.author: Adam B
reviews.title: Amazing Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: Awesome experience! Personal concierge was a nice touch. Super attentive staff and beautiful property! Upgrade to The Reserve if looking for a little more R&R. Food was REALLY good as well. Beach area was nice with plenty of amenities.

reviews.author: shogun17
reviews.title: A wonderful all-inclusive resort
reviews.text: My family of 15 spend Christmas week at the Paradisus Cancun.  It was a wonderful experience in all aspects.  We had booked The Reserve which provides an ocean-view room, a concierge to work with and other amenities.  For our family, the additional expense was totally worth it.  But even without booking The Reserve, this all-inclusive resort is a wonderful place to stay.  The restaurants are very good to excellent, the coffee bar that is open all day is great, the pools are beautiful, the Bali beds which can be reserved are special and there are activities all day - and every evening there is something special.  I would definitely stay here again

reviews.author: Jansee G
reviews.title: Cancun Wedding Trip 2023
reviews.text: Had an amazing time at Paradisus Resort Cancun!! The hotel was amazing, food was amazing, and especially the service was amazing! Can’t wait to come back for the amazing views and activities! Armando Arturo Fernando was the best waiter!! He helped us every day we were here and provided the best service. Ask for him when you’re here!

reviews.author: Jen G
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemonfish
reviews.text: Rafael from the Japanese Restaurant is the super helpful. This is what I call "service marketing"at it's best. When we have questions about which to order, he shows us photos. If we want to change a side dish, he does his best never to deny all our request. He also speaks great english which is great for non Spanish speaking ppl like us.

reviews.author: Ashley G
reviews.title: service and food is phenomenal! very happy that we came here definitely big fans of service and ambiance!
reviews.text: rafael was amazing!!! great recommendations and service - ceviche was great, also loved chocolate cake and some other ice cream dessert was also really good. all in all happy we came - great ambiance and service

reviews.author: Jackie S
reviews.title: Wonderful resort
reviews.text: This was our second time staying at this all inclusive resort. Me & my husband noticed the attention to detail as this is by far one of the cleanest resorts I have stayed at. The entire staff is so friendly and helpful. Plenty of amenities pools, restaurants exc. Deyra helped us reserve reservations and checked in on us to ensure we had a wonderful time. Safe area we walked down to Harry’s restaurant down the main road (def recommend) and we went to the nearby mall by taxi. Also took a excursion via Amstar during the week. I absolutely recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.author: johnlstone
reviews.title: Excellent visit to Cancun
reviews.text: Our butler Galdi was once again outstanding!  Galdi and his team always make us feel like family.  We look forward to our next visit! The pool staff, especially Jennifer, treated us very well. The friendliness is refreshing!

reviews.author: masonhartwig
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The whole stay was so beautiful and relaxing, was never hungry or thirsty once for my whole week that I was here. For breakfast at the Malva restaurant Gerardo, Eddie, and Martin provided excellent service every time I saw them they were always helpful.

reviews.author: xelso
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancún
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancún is an amazing resort. Sure it’s past it’s prime and needs a bit of a refurbishment in the bedrooms and common areas, but the place is amazing, it’s like you’re walking into Edens garden. The experience since you walk in until you experience your first dawn is extremely satisfying. The staff are the best, nicest people, which makes your experience all the better. Our breakfasts were blessed with the amazing service of Atilomo Manuel and Ignácio, our morning drinks brought by the super friendly Balta. Overall the staff was the nicest ever and our concierge Aitza did an amazing job and supporting us in our experience.

reviews.author: Victoria M
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus 🌴🌊
reviews.text:
Just an absolutely amazing experience! Everything about Paradisus was great - from the food, security, rooms - absolutely 5 starts. 

The best part, and if I could give more than 5 stars, I would, were the staff. They really focused on creating a human connecting with you and it’s very obvious that we were viewed as actual people and not just a number. 

Special shout out and thanks to Atilono, Manuel Martinez, Ignácio and Atza!

reviews.author: Juan
reviews.title: Almost Paradise
reviews.text:
The plan for this family trip was to stay at the resort the majority of the time and just relax.  Prior to booking i did research on many resorts in the Zona Hotelera but ended up going with Paradisus because they appeared to be family friendly and the sand and water looked great from pictures.

I'm happy to report that Paradisus did not disappoint. From the first moment we stepped into the lobby it appeared we had transported to paradise.  The resort is huge and at the same time the staff makes you feel like you're the only one there.  The view of the sand and ocean is breathtaking and the photos do not do it justice.  The resort had a few different pools. The swim up bar was very nice and the bartenders were great, in particular Evaristo and Jean Carlos.

The restaurant reservation system is a bit annoying but many resorts do it. Luckily we had Veronica that helped with our reservations!  I highly recommend Lemon Fish, Cielo and Aguamarina.  If you go to Cielo, you have to try the elote with rajas dish. That was by far the best thing i ate the entire time there.  Heck, even the buffet was good. One of the big complaints about resorts are the quality of the food especially when buffets are involved but at Paradisus the food was excellent.

The drinks were great too.  Although not premium alcohol (you have to pay extra for that) the alcohol being used was pretty good stuff for an all-inclusive resort.  I highly recommend the Mezcalita and Tamarindo Mezcalita.  You have to go to Ginger Bar and order a drink there.  The cocktails look much nicer, taste better and they play music at night.

Walking around the lobby we had employees greeting us and making us feel at home.  The servers were all very attentive and polite.  There is a Nespresso place on Floor zero and they make very good coffee there.  The barista that was there was the most polite and friendly person of all the employees i met at Paradisus.  I wish I remembered his name so i could give him a shout-out.

So was the resort perfect? No it wasn't. For starters, it was sometimes hard to find a lounge chair anywhere in the resort despite there being so many.  On two different days i spent quite a bit of time searching for an open chair.  It didn't help that people would 'reserve' them by just placing a towel on them and coming back after a very long time.  Luckily the onsite security team did help clear out chairs that appeared to have been abandoned.

Because of the size of the pool area, it was hard to get a server's attention to order drinks.  It appeared that the servers were more attentive to the individuals in the cabanas which is an extra fee to reserve for the day.

Overall i highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for a more upscale all-inclusive experience.  If you are looking for something smaller and personal, this place isn't for you.  Again, the resort seems to pay more attention to individuals that pay extra (cabanas, 'premium' mezcal and tequila at Blue Agave) which can be off-putting considering this is not a cheap resort to begin with.  Having said all of that, I can see myself coming back to this resort in the future and maybe next time I'll splurge for the Reserve package to see how different the experience is.  As the name implies, Paradisus is pretty close to Paradise but not quite there.

reviews.author: Jason B
reviews.title: Alfredo waiter @ Malva
reviews.text: These guys are like extended family!  We come every year and one of our favs is Alfredo. We call him “The Birdman” because of all the spot-on accurate bird sounds he can make.  Service is absolutely impeccable (no bird pun intended) so ask for him and treat him right!  Love the work ethic and hospitality he and his surrounding staff ALWAYS deliver to my family and I.  Can’t wait to see them again in June2023!

reviews.author: Stephanie B.
reviews.title: Thanks for a great New Years, Paradisus.
reviews.text: I want to start this review off by saying that we enjoyed our stay very much at Paradisus. We went for New Years, and the hotel had a nice New Years party in their convention center. Outside in the front of the hotel, we were able to see fireworks, so that was nice. This resort is big, so it never felt too crowded. We traveled with our 1.5 year old, but if we would have brought our 10 year old I could see him getting bored pretty easily as the resort doesn't have any slides or designated kids pool area other than a 2ft pool with no other attraction to it. The pool chairs get claimed pretty quickly, so I would recommend grabbing some and leaving a personal item on them, or else people will take them even if there's a towel left. One negative was that the main pool was ICE cold, and the baby pool was as well. The pool closer to the reserve area was nice and warm, though, so we spent more time in that pool. However, our favorite bartender, Balta (super kind and made great drinks), was located at the main pool bar. If you are parents traveling with kids with no babysitter, the reserve, in my opinion, is a waste of money since you can not bring kids into the reserve area. The pool nor the exclusive restaurant to allow children, therefore making it pretty useless to us. If you can make reservations prior to your arrival for dinner, that's your best bet. Otherwise, definitely make them the first day you arrive. Every morning, we would eat at the buffet, sitting outside was much nicer than inside because you get a nice breeze, our favorite waiter was Martin, who was always so kind to us and our baby. He always made sure we got everything we needed, and we appreciated all of his efforts.  During our stay, we had professional pictures taken by 'Outdoors Photo'. Diego, our photographer, was kind and patient and took beautiful pictures, Oscar kindly setup our appointment & who we purchased the photos with. It is also worth noting the resort has two Aquaworld stands on the property to make reservations for excursions and the facility is directly across the street from Paradisus, they offer everything from catamaran trips to isla mujeres, jetskiing, parasailing and more. We went to Isla Mujeres for the day trip and it was beautiful and a lot of fun! All in all, the food was pretty good for an all-inclusive, the lunch food like burgers,  chicken tenders were good. Lunchbox was probably our favorite meal. We didn't get to eat at all the different restaurants, though, so we could have definitely missed out somewhere. The coffee bar was good, too. They serve Nespresso products. The Oceanview room was beautiful and was cleaned every day. The view was definitely worth the money. The beach was absolutely stunning, however theres no ramp for easy access to it, but that's not a big deal. The inside of the resort was also gorgeous and always smelled good.  All in all, my husband and I agreed we would definitely come back to this resort if we go back to cancun again, we had a great time!

reviews.author: chastity h
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
The service was exceptional from Alejandro at Nes Presso,  He was also friendly, kind and always smiling. I definitely recommend this resort, it was very clean, beautiful and we have already booked our next trip at this resort. 
I can’t wait to visit again!!!!

reviews.author: Ryan J
reviews.title: The lunch box
reviews.text: The Lunch Box has really great food.  The Lunch Box also have really great service. Jose, who works at the Lunch Box did a great job!   We really liked the burgers at the Lunch Box.  We are looking forward to our return to the Lunch Box.

reviews.author: Abhishek D
reviews.title: Amazing.
reviews.text:
Woow! From the location, to the hotel decor to the interiors. Wooow!
Special thanks and mention of our concierge Mr.Hugo.Hernandez. He made our stay so memorable. Our servers and waiters were amazing. Jorge Miguel at the lemon fish restaurant was amazing. Definitely re defining hospitality here.

reviews.author: Mr.WorldWide
reviews.title: Raphael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Raphael and his professionalism allowed me to enjoy this dining experience. The food was excellent and the service complimented the evening very nicely. The sex on the beach was delicious. Overall, the atmosphere was great. There was a live band playing in the lobby which flooded the restaurant. Maybe a little too noisy at times but the meal was undeniably excellent.

reviews.author: ryan_dajia
reviews.title: Paradisus Stay
reviews.text: We stayed in an ocean front Jr suite on the Reserve side and our stay was fantastic. We appreciated the more adult vibe and personalized service with staying on the Reserve side. Levi provided excellent concierge service and communication each day. We experienced most of the restaurants and the food and drinks did not disappoint.

reviews.author: suzyQ_3636
reviews.title: Great Vacation! Phenomenal Service at the Reserve!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a perfect mother daughter trip. We love this hotel!!! We had a beautiful and comfortable oceanfront room in the adults only Reserve with stunning views and an amazing rain shower. The beach is spotless and seaweed free, pools are beautiful, and food/drinks are plentiful and tasty. 

What sets this hotel it apart is the friendly and phenomenal service at the Reserve!!! We felt so pampered and well taken care of. Jennifer at the pool was amazing. She made our vacation perfect by giving us a quiet Bali bed with a gorgeous view (because we said we like to read peacefully) Valeria always had a big smile and attentively kept our cups filled with delicious frosty drinks all day. Cece at check in warmly welcomed us and ensured the requests we made in advance were all satisfied. The entire hardworking crew at Sante ensured that our breakfasts and lunches were perfect - They even went out if their way to find almond milk for my daughters. We also enjoyed great massages at the spa and would highly recommend 

A huge thank you to the wonderful staff!!! We couldn’t have had a better vacation and will definitely return!

reviews.author: Meredith M
reviews.title: High-end resort, very well managed
reviews.text: Wonderful resort. We went as a family (2 small kids, grandparents) and they accommodated everyone. I would definitely recommend staying in the Reserve, which is accompanied by a personal concierge. I typically am not the ‘all inclusive’ type; I much prefer boutique hotels or AirBnbs and a lot of local adventure. But for this trip, we just wanted to relax and really, do nothing but de-stress. The pools were wonderful, the rooms nice, the beach incredible, and for the most part, great food. And the kids camp! My kids LOVED it, they kept begging us to be at the camp instead of with our family! I would absolutely return to Paradisus. Thank you.

reviews.author: Jenny T
reviews.title: The Lunch Box
reviews.text:
Excellent experience at the Lunch Box. Jose was the absolute best. Greatest server! Give him a raise!

Food was excellent. People made the experience. Ten out of ten. View of the ocean was gorgeous. Love it.

reviews.author: maggie
reviews.title: The Lunch Box
reviews.text: Jose was one of the nicest waiters I’ve ever had. He was super friendly and always made sure we had a great experience at the restaurant. He never failed to put a smile on anyone’s face. I would recommend the restaurant to everyone.

reviews.author: Laura F
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
The place is lovely.  So romantic for a couples night out.  Though there are 3 tables per cube, we were the only ones in our cube.  That made it even more personal.  
Rafael was super nice! He shared some pictures of items from the menu so we knew what to expect.  Very attentive server. 
The food was great! We had pork belly ramen, mixed nigiri, and mixed sushi. 
Highly recommend both the food and Rafael.

reviews.author: Road658655
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Super recommend Paradisus Cancun! The staff is so friendly and they always willing to help! Amazing food, drinks, dessert! The hotel is very nice and cozy! The hotel views are flawless! We loved! Definitely will come back soon!

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.title: Vacation time
reviews.text: Hotel location is amazing, teams for check in and check out did very good job for welcoming and taking care. Guest services were helpful but there is no coordination between them and different teams. Restaurant reservation were not done in same time that booked initially , price lists for extra activities that was sent on mail was not updated.

reviews.author: N M
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: We had a blast with good vibes , the service was on point. People were very nice and friendly. Especially Gaudencio, Joni Manuel, they made us feel like our home. We would definitely recommend this place. Can’t wait to go back in paradise (Paradisus) :)

reviews.author: Marcela R
reviews.title: A family vacation heaven!
reviews.text: This is our third time coming back to Paradissus. We love it! Please bring your family here! The first time we came as a couple and the following  two times we came as a family including my mother in law. We can’t say enough things about the service! On multiple days we’ve been served by Baltazar and Sergio at the poolside. I don’t think my husband ever had an empty beer in his hand lol they both were 100% exceptionally awesome! They once again out exceeded our expectations! It’s really nice to keep coming back to a resort where they remember you and your children. Furthermore we also spent some time at the cabanas by the ocean! The servers were also extremely courteous and catered to my mother in law’s every and any need with a smile and extreme kindness. Finally, a shoutout to our main man Rene! We met him our first time as a server and he is now being promoted which is really nice to see good workers being rewarded and acknowledged . See you next year Paradissus!

reviews.author: Lis C
reviews.title: December 2022 holiday in Cancun
reviews.text: Overall over paid and underwhelmed. This resort is not luxury, hotel is 3 stars, beach is small and dirty. We were in Melia in Punta Cana, that hotel is much better. Rooms at this hotel is dirty and not consistent with amenities as we have 3 rooms and they were all different, one has no bathrobes, etc.

reviews.author: Karen&Mike
reviews.title: Christmas and New Year at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We found it very difficult to receive information in advance despite emailing months ahead so I hope to give you some insight into the festivities.   

We arrived  early evening and were so impressed with the Christmas decorations in the atrium - the lobby looked absolutely stunning !   However,    We were not directed to the Reserve check in area when we arrived and waited with others till I asked if we were in the right place - then we were taken to the reserve check in.  We were not offered a welcome drink and had to ask for water.    We had reserved 3 rooms in the Reserve with different requirements. As others have said, we requested 2 baby cribs, and king size beds in all rooms.   None of the rooms had correct requests  and we had to wait for cribs ( not good with 2 tired babies)  and we had to wait till the next day to get the right rooms.  We had 2 babies of 31/2 and 2, where did they think they were going to sleep ?  There was also option of sofa bed which would suit 2 young children, which we were not offered but discovered in one of the rooms!  We were in pyramid 3 which was quiet and near to everything unlike other pyramids, which were all connected but quite a long walk to pyramid 3 where shops restaurants and nespresso bar were located.   Although the reserve check in,pyramid 5 had its own beautiful bar, it did not do cocktails and was very quiet and remote.   Our pyramid (3) felt refurbed, luxurious and modern. 
 
 I don’t like upgrading and consider everyone should get same service and facilities, but glad I did,  there were 10 of us and wanted everything to go as smoothly as possible.  There was no problem with tables of 10 at all meal times.   You get a personal concierge who does try and keep everyone happy, booking restaurants and dealing with any other requests.   The room was comfortable although chairs broken and light switches uneccessarily complicated. You don’t automatically get turn down in the evening unless you request it,  via concierge, which is not acceptable for a 5 star hotel.  The cabanas poolside and on beach are only for Reserve and prime spots ( front beach view)  are only  for Melia time share.  Certain foods, restaurants, room service are included in Reserve and I do feel that you are treated differently if not on reserve package.     You cannot get a kettle ( for tea, although you can request hot water from room service (1/2 hr wait) trying to use the nespresso machine just for hot water, drove me nuts!   If you like English T, bring your own, it’s like goldust ! 

Christmas Day  Boxing Day - we had awful weather but staff made huge effort, there was Santa at 11 with huge queues for presents  at a beautifully decorated grotto ( nice presents if you wanted to Queue!  ) Decorations were fabulous, and all staff wearing Xmas flashing lights hats!   Menus were standard in all the restaurants and there may have been Xmas dinner in the Buffett but we didn’t go there.  Lovely Xmas atmosphere.  There may have been more going on around the pools if weather had been better.   NYE - there was a grand party in the convention centre that all guests could attend .  Lavishly done but disappointingly no fireworks at hotel, although if you went on the beach you could see fireworks along the coast.   Some restaurants had special menus as well as standard menus.     My main criticism was food was never hot ( could be because 10 of us) we had 2 vegans who were very happy  but had to ask if dishes could be made a certain way instead of being given options.   Very rarely did you actually get what was described on the menu and found this very disappointing,  it’s all about expectations, for example- char grilled baby gem with garlic aioli - was half a cold iceberg with cheese sauce - this was in the speciality steak restaurant, but happened in other restaurants too -we spoke to managers who always blamed the chefs !  PLEASE translate your menus properly so guests are not disappointed with what they get and have to send things back, what a waste of food!,.  My husbands pet hate is tipping - we would normally tip at the end of holiday for good service from certain staff, but every meal the waiters run over as you leave asking was everything ok , expecting tips.  More usual for US guests who must pay less for the overall holiday than Uk guests. 

 Despite our grandaughter having to go to hospital due to a virus - one of the hotel managers, Roseanne , accompanied them to the hospital and stayed there with my son and daughter in law for 9 hours and returned with them getting antibiotics from a pharmacy, full marks for that service 👍)   We had a fabulous family holiday, with everyone thinking of returning next year! 

Entertainment every night was superb  with lots of little surprises, although for some,  a bit early ( it usually started at 7.30 ) but can’t please everyone and all ages. 

Try and sit at same table in the Buffett if you go, that way the waiters get to know what you like ,  Armando at the Buffett breakfast always made sure he got me my English breakfast tea and saved my day !

reviews.author: Cyndi W
reviews.title: I was forced to stay here.
reviews.text: Stayed here with family for a wedding. I would not have chosen it myself, and would not return. Attention to detail was severely lacking in general and the need to make reservations for every single thing at the property made me extremely anxious — this was supposed to be a vacation, but I felt like I ended up being as over-scheduled as I am at work! We were unable to get reservations at any of the hotel restaurants in groups larger than two people, despite the restaurants looking mostly empty. And there was a bizarre lack of silverware at the restaurants. No silverware was provided at all at Blue Agave, and my dessert at Lemon Fish was served with a bamboo spoon. When I asked for a regular spoon, I was given a tiny espresso spoon for my dessert. Our room was fine but it was a nightly disco light show due to a phone light that would not stop blinking and a smoke detector over the bed that blinked brightly green every two seconds. The steam room at the spa was broken and unavailable, and while I was relaxing in the sauna I got called a “rude b*tch” by two snotty teenagers simply because I asked them twice to close the sauna door that they left open. Why are there even teenagers in a spa?? The reserve pool area was nice, but no one explained to us how to make cabana reservations, and poolside service was hit or miss (best service we received was from Moises at the pool - he had great cocktail recommendations!). This hotel is basically a land-based cruise ship; it’s the Olive Garden of the hotel industry. If that’s your jam, then I would actually recommend it. If not, then don’t stay here unless you are forced to because a family member is getting married.

reviews.author: Tamara D
reviews.title: Yesenia, gabby and laura. They were our best waitress
reviews.text: Thanks for everybody. This was our very good vacations. We meet three girls an the beach very good services, they are very attentive and very friendly. We hope to came here again. This hotel is like a paradise.

reviews.author: AdrienneGawlowski
reviews.title: Bali Bed Experience at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Gabby and Yesina by the beach treated us like royalty. They were so attentive to our group of 11 people. We rented the member’s cabanas and they brought us cold fresh passion fruit margaritas and beers. We also ordered from the kitchen - get the fish tacos. The whole experience was wonderful.

reviews.author: Edik S
reviews.title: Special thank you to Rosanna Zannino from Los Angeles!!!
reviews.text:
My family and friends spent total of 5 amazing days at the fabulous hotel and to say we are satisfied is to say nothing. We are beyond thankful to our guest manager host Rosanna Zannino for the above and beyond customer service. Rosanna’s expertise  helped us to get the most of our vacation, we are so thankful for her help. Thank you for your professionalism! 
Edik Sahakyan & Susanna Mkrtchyan (3451)
Sahak Sahakyan & Raya Baghdasaryan (3548)

reviews.author: Monica V
reviews.title: Carlos at Cielo
reviews.text: Carlos at Cielo was amazing. We ate here for my husbands 40th. He served us and suggested the best food. Even made my husbands bday special and requested that the singer sing to him. He was on it with every request we made.

reviews.author: Samah H
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!!!!
reviews.text: Had the best experience at this resort. We were a family of 8. Everything was perfect from the staff to the food to the views. It’s such a beautiful resort. You will not regret staying here. My family had so much fun thanks to the staff. We also got upgraded to the Reserve. Phenomenal service! Will definitely be back. I usually travel 3x/year to Cancun, this resort was definitely among the top.

reviews.author: Ikenna I
reviews.title: Vibez
reviews.text: I was here back in August and had an amazing time. We between all the different activities they had in and out of the water and all the food choices my friends and I had a blast. In fact it was so fun we had to do it again and the vibez were on point once again!

reviews.author: Stevie Jo
reviews.title: Best service!!
reviews.text: Everyone is so friendly and helpful! Joni, Atilano, Wendy, they are the best and very fun! The lost and found was very helpful to find some shoes that we thought were stolen. The food is very delicious and the views are incredible!

reviews.author: ReneeW
reviews.title: 2nd trip to Paradisus is paradise!
reviews.text: Excellent service and lovely well maintained resort. Food is really good. Not all restaurants were open but there was enough variety to enjoy many different options. Beach is beautiful and private. Guest services is amazing and will work hard to make special requests a reality. Thank you to Luis and Daniella!

reviews.author: Rachel M Pruitt
reviews.title: Amazing dinner for two!!!
reviews.text:
Ian y Melvin we’re amazing hosts. They were attentive and delivered everything we asked. The drinks were amazing (Don Juan paired with dessert - don’t miss it!)

We got a sampler of appetizers to start, followed by the octopus and then the lamb tacos with beans and then one of each dessert - tres leches (best I’ve ever had), churro with chocolate ice cream, and a chocolate cake!! 

A 5 star experience with perfect service (not intrusive but always available) and food to delight!!! Don’t miss Cielo when you come to cancun!!!

reviews.author: JLYNNWI
reviews.title: Relaxing Stay - Great STAFF!
reviews.text: First time in Cancun, but not our first stay at Paradisus.  Property was expected for Melia brand - clean and maintained, although a little older.  Location was perfect.  Easy walk to Aquaworld, a pharmacy, shopping center and a few seafood restaurants.   Enjoyed the food and the staff immensely!  Lemon Fish - new, but amazing food. Staff were helpful to us to make selections we would enjoy. Capella (Italian) dishes were all delicious.  CIELO(authentic Mexican) - was by far our favorite!! Staff so helpful going through dish by dish with explantion of ingredients and origin of the dish.  Our waiter was the BEST. (sorry we can't remember his name).   Malva food bazaar (breakfast/lunch) never disappointed.  Gaudeucio, Edy and Reynaldo were there every day and were always smiling and so helpful.  Blue Agave - is a must try, as is the food truck.  Beach/Pool staff - took care of anything we needed every day.  Thanks Flora and Jorge - great drinks.  Also a huge shout out to Pavel from Club Melia - made our vacation stay wonderful!  So glad we overlooked the negative reviews.  And no - it was not perfect, but what vacation is? All the staff were so welcoming, friendly and helpful.  They were clearly doing their best to accommodate guests for any inconveniences due to the pandemic.  We will definitely be going back.

reviews.author: Siri R
reviews.title: FUN Relaxing Stay
reviews.text:
Came to Paradissus for Business trip ended up coming with my wife a few days early.  

While lounging by the pool met a fun group of people played some awesome games beach volleyball and pool volleyball.  

 Agustin AKA “Tequila Guy” was so much fun and hilarious.  He  kept the games going, recruited people and made our stay fun, relaxing and enjoyable.  

Thanks Paradissus and Agustin “Tequila Guy” for the great memories 👏

reviews.author: Lynn P
reviews.title: Staff is excellent
reviews.text: This was our second time visiting Melia Paradisus Cancun and it was just as amazing as the first time. Pascual and Alejandro (Alex) from Malva Good Bazaar , Sofonia from Ginger Bar, Sergio from the main poolside are our favorites!! The resort amenities are clean and kept up really well.  The food is amazing! Definitely quickly becoming one of our favorite resorts!!

reviews.author: Christina L
reviews.title: Eric
reviews.text: Orlando Bello and Eddie Catsin made us feel extremely welcom and gave us exceptional service. The coco Loco were amazing, beers were nice and cold, great live guitar.  As well the food was very good. We will come back for another visit.

reviews.author: Tim W
reviews.title: Best Al Pastor Tacos ever
reviews.text: Thank you Lazaro Anibal David Javier for the amazing food. Had the Al Pastor tacos at Blueagave taco bar at Paradisus Luxury Resort. Had lunch with my wife and best friends Jeremy and Stacy Foresee. We will eat there again.

reviews.author: Autumn S
reviews.title: Absolutely Breathtaking
reviews.text: The Paradisus is a gorgeous property! The staff does an amazing job keeping things clean and covid friendly. Food was outstanding!!! We did not have one bad meal. All staff were friendly and eager to help you. The beach is perfect. The water is clean, warm, and seaweed free. Gaudeucio, Edy, and Reynaldo at the Malva are prime examples of how amazing the staff are here. They were always friendly, attentive, and excited to help make your stay fun! We can not think of a single complaint about our time here.

reviews.author: Anthony S
reviews.title: We will be back!
reviews.text: Great people! Great time! Axcel was one of the many excellent people that made our trip wonderful. They could not be any nicer to us. My wife has food allergies. They asked, listened and prepared meals without hesitation for her. Once there we asked about upgrading our room. Got a gorgeous newly renovated room . Well worth the money. Made our stay that much nicer. Highly recommend this place if not for the abundance of food & alcohol but for the workers that really makes the difference between a  good and a great time.

reviews.author: Samantha U
reviews.title: Best Employees Ever
reviews.text: Saul and Janeth were so fun and they made our trip so memorable. We played volleyball and made bracelets and it was so much fun. 10/10 recommend going to the paradisus and meeting these great employees !! thank you so much

reviews.author: Destination701828
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: We loved our stay at Paradisus- the staff was so friendly and helpful. We enjoyed the delicious food and ocean views. The staff treated us like family and we cannot wait to see them again next visit. Each morning we would go down to the Nespresso breakfast bar and get our coffees and a donut for my son- our barista, Alejandro Diaz always greeted us with a smile and made my son feel so special. Then we would head to Malva for breakfast and our severs were so incredible- Gaudeucia, Gerardo and Reynaldo were so on top of things and made each experience so enjoyable. They would come up and call my son by name and make him laugh. I highly recommend  staying here. We will be back sooN

reviews.author: Taylor L
reviews.title: Lunchbox
reviews.text: THE BEST FOOD!!! Mouth watering shrimp and tuna!!! Angel is accommodating and tells you all his favorites! I would def recommend this place when staying at Paradisus, I honestly might stop back before I leave

reviews.author: Kelly B
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCUN BUFFET
reviews.text: We loved the experience we received every morning at the buffet! Gaudeucio was very personable and made the trip memorable. Him and his team Reynaldo and Gerardo always made sure we had mimosas and we didn't even have to ask for them. I would highly recommend coming to this resort and having the experience we had.

reviews.author: Sara
reviews.title: girls getaway
reviews.text:
Booking Room: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
booking the hotel was simple, We got a Reserve room with 2 queens. 

Booking Transfer: ⭐⭐⭐
getting a confirmation got hotel transfer was AWFUL! Otium was sending me GIBBERISH responses and FRIDA from reservations had to intervene and get confirmations from them for me. 

Airport Arrival Transfer: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had the option, of shared or private private transfers....Private was #$35 one way for 2ppl. The Otium Agent was waiting for me right outside the terminal next to Margaritaville Bar, with a sign that had my name in it  

Resort Location: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had not visited  the Cancun Hotel Zone for a decade! Somehow I forgot how Beautiful the water is there!! it took 20 min to arrive at the resort from the airport!  

LAYOUT OF THE RESORT:⭐⭐⭐⭐
Oftentimes, the adults only area is secluded and that means it's further to get to the restaurants etc. furthermore, the resort is very linear, spanning 5 buildings. As beautiful as it is,  I wish it was laid out differently.  

Check in at the Reserve: ⭐⭐⭐⭐
Upon arrival, i was escorted form MAIN lobby to the hallway that connects the bldg 4 to 5 (where reserve check in is). The representative left me in the hallway, which is strange, Why not all the way? The check in agent Luis was very quiet, not unfriendly but definitely not the person you get a warm welcome from. Also, I was not offered a welcome drink or anything. I was pointed to the reserve lounge bar/food. I found out in a few minutes that it was actually closed however the friendly ppl there accommodated me anyhow.  Through out our stay anytime we needed to go the checkin desk, we found the staff there to be dry and not lively. They probably need new staff that welcome guests with drinks, and the usual island excitement!

Room: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
clean, comfortable beds, great towels, however no beach bag like other guests had. We had small ants in our room at one point and it seemed to be taken care of after i let my butler Juan know.

Quality of the Food:⭐⭐⭐⭐
i felt like no matter what restaurant we dined at, the food was always with a Mexican flare. Don't get me wrong, it was very good, but not the same when u are expecting it to NOT be Mexican (I have been to MX resorts that offer international cuisine and I'm comparing to that and the only reason i took 1 star from them)

Quality of the drinks:⭐⭐⭐
I was disappointed to find that the selection of tequilas and even the reserve offered liquors were such low quality. I assumed that by doing reserve category we wud definitely have better choices. Another thing i was surprised by was that they didn't make their skinny margaritas with Agave. I had our butler Juan go buy a bottle from a store!

Activities Staff:⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
these guys were always trying to get everyone involved and IMO coming up with activities that suited the current mood of the guests! Axcel ad Jennifer are AMAZING!!

Reserve Pool/Beach staff:⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
these guys go above and beyond to do everything they can to make your food, drinks the way you ask. Even to the point of bringing the bartender to you and making sure the communication is clear. Oscar, Valeria and Moises THANK YOU!!! ALSO huge thank you to the bartender Orlando for keeping us liquored up the way we wanted to the best of his abilities!!!

Pool Towels/setup:⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
these guys have a great work ethic, and always with a smile! Thanks Lucas and Maximillian 

Butler Service:⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Juan took care of every reservation and issue we had!  great communicator.

Would I recommend this resort-absolutely!!

reviews.author: Thomas G
reviews.title: Loved the activities director
reviews.text: Saul, the activities director made our days at the resort so much fun. He was quite an athlete but also made everyone feel welcome and included. We love this place and hope to come back soon. I hope Saul is here when we come back!

reviews.author: Kwilks79 .
reviews.title: The best service in Cancun
reviews.text: It was my twin and I birthday trip we went to Paradisus Cancun. Best birthday trip ever!! The staff was excellent especially Armando who threw us a party , Orlando , DIDI, Atilano. They made our stay awesome. Ivette she is the best she set up our excursions and made sure we had great time!! Gracias Paradisus Cancun staff!!

reviews.author: Tim C
reviews.title: Wonderful week celebrating our 40th Anniversary
reviews.text: So very impressed with our accommodations, helpful, polite staff, cleanliness, great food, etc.. We were upgraded to an ocean view with a jetted tub on our balcony, with a wonderful view. Although the unit was cozy, it provided everything we needed, a stocked mini-bar, and daily maid service. The staff was great!, especially Edier, Gaudencio, & Alejandro in Restaurant Malva, Deniss Gonzalez manager of on-site restaurants, Axcel in activities, Gabriel for helping us book our excursions, the violinist in restaurant Capella for a special anniversary serenade, and countless other staff unknown in name, but so considerate in service. Sadly, we did have one unfortunate incident. Upon check-in, Raul introduced himself as our concierge, promising to arrange dinner reservations, (to his credit he did set up our first two dinners), excursions, “anything we needed”. When we mentioned we weren’t interested in a presentation/tour - we never heard from him again - he did not respond to our texted  inquiries. We felt jilted, and felt his behavior as unprofessional. So, we just made the best of it, making our own arrangements. We had an awesome time.

reviews.author: Loren
reviews.title: Good Resort!
reviews.text:
I travelled to this resort before the covid pandemic.

Stayed at the reserve part of the hotel and it was fantastic! The perks you get from the reserve upgrade was huge for me since the adult only pool area was much quieter and less busy. This resort had a lot of family guests and getting a seat near the pool or beach seemed like a hard task in the general area.

Also I found the food to be subpar at this resort. I only enjoyed the food at the reserve restaurant because of the grilled shrimp dish they offered.

The interior of the resort is not really my cup of tea but it's definitely not boring! Room itself was clean and in good condition and that's what really mattered to me.

Our Butler (can't remember his name.. maybe Rafael?) was friendly and kind. Helped with our reservations and was helpful when someone from my group didn't feel well.

Another con beside the food is, by the pool area you can only reserve the beach beds maximum of 2 days (or 3) out of 7 days trip. I wish they had more beach beds available for guests. It looks like there is enough space in the area.

The beach was beautiful! Had a tiny bit of seaweed. It wasn't enough to ruin the beach experience at all! It didn't require a tractor to clean throughout the day. Nice and quiet adult only beach area.

Would I come back? Yes! Personally I stayed in multiple Paradisus properties and found their management/staff excellent in customer service.

reviews.author: Kirk Osterdyk
reviews.title: Knowledgeable, great attitude.  He is a great server
reviews.text: Ian was professional,  courteous,  friendly. Explained everything on the menu in detail. It was a great experience our last night in Cancun. He would make an exceptional part of your team.  Also think that his goals were expressed professionally, we were greatful  he asked for our opinion.

reviews.author: Jared M
reviews.title: It is a blast!
reviews.text: If you come to Paradisus Cancun, you have to play water polo with Axcel! We enjoyed going on the slip and slide and the bar on the first floor, called Ginger. Overall great experience on an amazing beach with lots of activities to do on the resort!

reviews.author: Brock Z
reviews.title: AXCEL IS THE MAN !
reviews.text: If you are on this resort, look for axcel. His is a great humble man who likes to have lots of fun and will show you all sorts of fun things to do. He showed us all kids of wonderful restaurants. The end.

reviews.author: Houston C
reviews.title: Friend Trip
reviews.text:
Great service all around. Perfect experience.
Oscar at the pool was fantastic. Was alway on top of providing drinks and food in a timely manner.
Juan the concierge helped us in many ways make our trip perfect.

reviews.author: Nomad769648
reviews.title: Best group visit!
reviews.text: We had the most incredible trip with our group of friends! The facility was gorgeous and food delicious! Maximilliano helped us get the best Bali beds at the reserve pool. Oscar, Moses, and Yaxmil were incredible waiters at the reserve pool throughout our trip and were the most accommodating! Juan did a great job as our group concierge. Overall this was a fantastic experience and our only complaint was that we couldn’t stay longer! Cannot wait to come back!

reviews.author: DVC-David
reviews.title: Almost 5 stars
reviews.text:
This resort is gorgeous, to say the least. It is grandeur in every aspect, rivaling any top end luxury hotel worldwide. The staff is abundant and the service is excellent, providing a clean and polished environment. The reserve pool was nicely heated to welcoming 86f and the servers were by every few minutes, with big smiles on their faces. 

Our personal assistant, Juan, was on top of everything. Even on his days off, he would check, arrange and follow up on tasks through WhatsApp. Thanks, Juan.

Now for the nit picking. We booked a room in the reserve, however, on arrival we were directed to the regular check in desk, despite reiterating several times to the door people that we were in the reserve. First impressions are key and after standing in line for 15 or so minutes, the welcoming greeter finally listened to what we were saying. I had to show him a copy of my reservation to prove that I was in fact booked into the Reserve Governor Suite. So off we went for a long walk to a different area of the resort to get checked in.

The room was beyond my expectations boasting three balconys each facing the ocean. I could go on and on about the beauty of this room but the following prevents me from doing so: The tower we were in is an A frame or pyramid configuration so the rooms all surround the lobby below. Great for looking down (we were on the eighth floor) but any noise in the lobby carries upwards to all the rooms. And just our luck… the lobby open bar (Ginger) happened to host a DJ that pounded music until 2:30 am our first night. 

We brought this to the attention of Juan the next day who tried his best to negotiate a room move with the front desk manager but the manager was pretty adamant that the only room he had that would be quiet for us (same category or better) was the presidential suite and that would cost us and additional $1300.00 per night but it would include a bottle of champagne. We could downgrade also but there would be no refund.

We stayed where we were and although we could hear the music every night, it was definitely toned down to a more acceptable level. If not for this particular incident, I would have rated this stay a definite 5 stars.

Would I stay there again? Without a doubt. I recommend this resort. But be forewarned, if you seek a quiet room, you do not want to be in tower 3.

reviews.author: Cecilia
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: The food was really good throughout the hotel but the friendly service made it all the more pleasant, especially Gerardo, Teresa, Candelario y Fernando at the Malva! Thank you for taking care of us so well!

reviews.author: Cristian
reviews.title: Reserve is the only way!
reviews.text:
I’ve been to this resort many consecutive years and this was the first time trying out the adults only “Reserve” side previously known as “Royal Service”. For the higher price, you easily get the value back in wider food options, better food and alcohol options/quality and a more private feel (be sure to request Pyramid  5) and many other added perks. Also they have a DJ and either a sax or guitar weekends at the reserve pool which is a super cool vibe. 

Some notable staff that really will elevate your experience are Alexis (manager in reserve who completely went above and beyond to ensure a great vacation), Jose (concierge), Lucas & Max (reserve pool), Diego, Ruben, Valeria, Moises, Miguel,Oscar, Joel (Sante), Alex (sante chef), David (YHI), and pretty much anyone you interact with. Everyone truly cares about your experience and I have yet to find another resort with such well rounded, friendly and conscientious staff! 

My only critique is that the lounge pool and hot tub near Sante should and HAVE to be heated. Please.

reviews.author: MGM001
reviews.title: Fantastic Experience with Exceptional Service
reviews.text: We’ve stayed at some other Cancun (Resort Zone) hotels and this was by far our favorite! The staff are amazing! We did the reserve experience and would absolutely recommend for anyone coming here. Juan, our concierge, was very helpful and attentive. He helped ensure we had dinner reservations every night, knew what was happening at the hotel and would check in on us throughout the day. The reserve pool staff, particularly Oscar, Maximilian and Miguel, were also very helpful with supplying us with food, drinks and Bali bed reservations each day. We can’t wait to come back again!

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.title: Service broke all impression
reviews.text:
So, if u are thinking that after long flight, u can get a special treatment at that hotel, then u are wrong :) 
I will tell u our experience with booking one of the best room at reserve of Meliá Cancun paradisus.

For sure, u can forget about welcome drinks, about normal check in/check out. 

Girl who supposed to show us where is reception of reserve, left us at the middle of the way and said : okay so u should go there , after turned, after go down , after bla bla bla… hotel is quite big, so obviously we got lost very easy, and waste lots of time to find reception. 

When we got the room, we asked to change it,because it was noisy, and they change it very fast, but welcome fruits and vine they forget to give us back from 1st room 😅👍🏼

When I ask at reception of reserve to change money (only 100$) , they said to me that I can make it only at main reception. 

Main reception said to me, we don’t have local money, go to shop if u need it urgent. 
Very good answer for 5* hotel, because that’s really what I “wanted” to do after long flight 😅

( for your understanding  during 3 days, I could not change 100$ in local money) 

About pool, they have a special system of booking sunbeds :) It’s okay, but, be ready 😅 that u can book bed which u really want 3 or even 4 days before but never get it :) u will ask why? 
Because they will give it to people who pay them more tips, and after when u will freak out how that happened, they will say, oh oh don’t know. 

( as reality they just have 2 notebooks, one main and other kind of line, so control that they make reservation in main, or u will be waiting 3 days as us, and as result never get it and stay with very sad mood…)

Check out:
😂 that’s really amazing experience, will never forget it… 
Check out at reserve reception was fast and good, they give u a card, which u have to give to a bellboy guy to bring your luggage. 
So I came at entrance of hotel, and were not bellboys, so I came to reception in front, began to ask guy, to whom I should give that card, and if he can help me with taxi 
AND 😅 when I even didn’t finish my phrase , that guy , without any word/ apologize or what ever, just turned back and run away  from me to other couple at the street…
Other people at reception was staying and speaking between themselves, nobody really care about u, what u should do, where is bellboys, who can ask a taxi)) 

Service of that reception(of main building), without jokes is the worst ever in my live…. 
We left hotel with completely broken mood

Hotel by itself is really good, u go in with impression WOW, rooms at reserve are good, views amazing. Activities r funny, I never seen like that before. Restaurants r good too, they r really trying to make a hight lever service, and to be honest they r quite good in that. But all that good impression of hotel broken with completely not professional reception team… I don’t have even a word to describe their work. 
+ that situation at the pool was very sad too!

In general hotel is really cool,I love it and I would like to put a 5*, but all that bad experience I had with reception and pool team, don’t allow me to make it. 

Hotel I recommend but you need to be very patient to staying there  😁👌🏼

reviews.author: Teri L
reviews.title: Waiter Eian
reviews.text: Eian was a very attentive waiter. He explained everything and brought us foodies extras like grasshoppers and habanero sauce. Eian is very polite and courteous. We met him at the mexican restaurant (Cielo)at the Paradisus Resort in Cancun.

reviews.author: Josh Z
reviews.title: Axcel is awesome
reviews.text: Perfect service, very funny, and very friendly everywhere we have good attention, we love the steak house, this is our second time here and we still love it, axcel is a good magician and good person we loved him and the activities staff.

reviews.author: JEF
reviews.title: Huge complex with ok food.
reviews.text:
The hotel is nice.  The food is basically the same in all restaurants. Power was out from 9:30am to 7:30pm Sunday.  No elevators working.  We were on the 7th floor.  
This was all inclusive but  some wines were an extra charge.  Be careful if you have fish allergies in the Lemon Tree.

reviews.author: Rayven K
reviews.title: Bachelorette Success!
reviews.text:
I am not the type to write reviews but I had to for the experience we had. This resort was beyond beautiful and clean. Staff was exceptional, our favorite was Victor Rodriquez, he took care of us twice at the cabanas and he made sure we had a great time. There was always someone around if you needed help. I even lost my work laptop and they found it for me a day later lol.

COVID testing is fast and inside the resort.

Buffet food was good, the themed restaurant foods were okay. But the service was exceptional. I would come back just for that.

reviews.author: Kelsey E
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun is a truly beautiful resort.  Excellent five star service!! Friendly staff.  Great food.  Fernando at the Malva restaurant made sure our family was well taken care of with his personal attention to us.

reviews.author: Emily E
reviews.title: The staff makes the experience one to remember.
reviews.text: I cannot speak highly enough about the staff. Every meal we were greeted with warmth, kindness, and unbelievable service. They make you feel like nothing less than family. Fernando is so sweet and was the best! We will miss the team when we leave

reviews.author: Julia S
reviews.title: Paradisus stay
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed at Paradisus over winter break in the reserve. Our personal concierge Aaron was wonderful and very accommodating throughout the entire experience sending us the daily activities, booking our restaurants for us, and reserving a cabana for us at the pool every day. He was quick and professional to answer our questions if we needed help. Food was subpar, a lot of the restaurants had small portions and not a lot of food on the menus. The room we stayed in in the reserve was fantastic except for how dry the air was, some nights you couldn’t breathe properly. All of the staff was very friendly special shout-out to Hugo manager of the lemon fish restaraunt and some of the guys at the Malva restaraunt who treated us very well. As well, I happened to leave some personal belongings behind on our trip a few days ago that were pretty valuable because we were in a rush to leave. We have tried to reach out the the hotel by calling them messaging them on several different platforms and nobody seems to care or want to help me get my personal belongings back.

reviews.author: Melynda D
reviews.title: Wedding by Romance by Paradisus Cancun Resort
reviews.text: I can't express how happy we are about the service Tania provided on our wedding day at the resort! She was their at any given moment ready to ensure our day was exceptional! Tania was extremely personable, professional in her position!

reviews.author: John and Christiana
reviews.title: Moises from Guest Services
reviews.text:
Moises was wonderful helping us with our room and navigating the system.

We had some issues with our room and overall service, and we were upgraded. Moises took great care, in particular  de-escalating the situation.

A+++ service

reviews.author: luisabelle2022
reviews.title: There are better resorts for the money
reviews.text: We traveled in a group. Three of the seven rooms had electrical power issues. When using iron, blow dryer or computer, the circuit breaker trips. We were told to use the bathroom outlet for equipment needing more power. Unacceptable. Also they have very loud music playin until late hours of the nigt in the center of the guest rooms. Anyone wishing to sleep before midnight will find this noise intrusive. We neede ear plugs every night and still were able to hear the music. There basically is no resource personel to attend to any needs that arise after hours...those hours are befor 9am -5pm. Any issues have to wait for business hours. The food is substandard compared to other resorts we have been to. The buffet area is a joke. There is no selection whatsoever and the food quality is mediocre. The specialty restaurants were disapointing as well. The resort itself is asthetically beautiful. Beach is very nice, pools are nice. But the discrepencies seemed to keep adding up and overall we would not return to this resort.

reviews.author: frederickbrn
reviews.title: Love The Resort but Groups Department is horrible.
reviews.text:
My wife and I love the Paradisus. So much so that we recently took over 50 people from our church travel club with us. After 30 years of organizing groups I have never seen a worse experience than working with the groups department here. My family and I initially had 34 rooms in 4 reservations. I asked to combine them and make one group. They said sure and that’s when the bottom fell out. From a lack of communication, canceling several of my rooms, wrong room assignments and several other issues it was horrible. This went on for months. After speaking to them, my wife and I actually flew there and stayed a week to get everything organized in person. We were 4 days into the week before anyone would meet with us. The meeting took place with me sitting on a couch near the reservations desk and lasted all of 20 mins. From there it got worse. I ended up communicating through email with 7 different people who obviously were not communicating with each other. The head of reservations actually called me at 10pm one night so rude and obnoxious that my wife was extremely upset with the way she was talking to me over their mistakes. It was their mistakes and I have the emails to prove it. 

The Good: Thanks to Jose Garcia who finally stepped in and got everything together. He was a pleasure to work with. Everyone loved the resort and had a blast. Check in was good and organized. Only 2 issues with 55 people so not bad. Staff was very attentive and excellent. Facilities and properties were very clean. Food and drinks were excellent. Nightly entertainment was just ok. I hate that we had this experience because we really love the property. Already planning to take 100 to Cancún next year. We will find a different property.

reviews.author: Mike M
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: From the moment we stepped into the resort we had great service.  Our concierge Aaron Ruiz was amazing!!  He gave us the grand tour from the opulent atriums which looked like hanging gardens to the restaurants and pools.  He even got us a cabana to lounge in facing the ocean.  Aaron checked in with us every morning to see if we needed anything.  He sent us a link to the daily activities, map of the resort, and list of all the restaurants.  The hotel and rooms were clean and comfortable.  We had our own balcony with a beautiful ocean view.  The food was amazing at all the restaurants, didn't have a bad meal anywhere.  Safety of all guests was a priority as you had to wear plastic gloves at the buffet to select the food and masks were mandatory whenever you were inside.

reviews.author: miafarah
reviews.title: Worst Management/ Good entertainment
reviews.text:
We had been planning this trip for almost two years so we were really excited to spend our anniversary for the first time in an all inclusive with our kids. We couldn’t wait to have good sleep and good fun!
The first thing we noticed when we entered the hotel was that you couldn’t feel the AC.
When they took us to our room we noticed that the AC had a noise and its wasn’t cool but we assumed the Ac had been off since it was an unoccupied room.
We were desperate to get unto the pool the kids were ecstatic. After an hour I went to the room only to find the AC had not cooled one single bit. I had to go to the front desk and complained. The manager Fabiola was such a sweet heart. She went to my room and surprisingly enough she was an HONEST person and told me the AC had been having some trouble that day.
and she at least acknowledged how hot the room really was!
I told them the least they could do was change me to another room that didnt have an AC with noise and that actually cooled.Fabiola changed us to another room. After a few hours my kids found out that some of their toys had been left in the first room and I called Fabiola and she found them and brought them to us! Fabiola you are amazing and deserve to be promoted. After months of my stay I still remember you!
After the whole day at the pool we went back to the room only to find the room had not cooled either!!! again the AC situation was not gonna be resolved. We called maintenance they gave us all sorts of explanations.
Our concierge Alan, was nice but not trained enough to really make our stay amazing. A couple reservations were not made properly that when we went to the restaurant they didn’t have us on the list. 
On the second day of sleeping in the worst bed with the worst pillows and all of us slept with underwear mainly because of the heat, Alan told us to speak with his supervisor. OMGoodness what a waste of time that was. Her name is Maricela also known as Malu. She convinced us of going on this meeting with some people that after a while I understood were trying to get us to become business partners with Melia and invest with them. What a joke!!! Two hours of them trying to sell me this, shoving me this idea down my throat when they cannot even provide me with a good nights sleep that I already paid for. An AC that should be working in any hotel and comfortable beds!! I was so aggravated!!! Two hours lost in this!!
I have to say that the only thing that would make us come again to this Hotel (which is highly unlikely) its their entertainment and their staff. If there is a reason I love Mexico is because of the people. Especially front of the house. 
Special mention to the Kids club staff: Axcel and Nicole! Our stay was romantic because they took care of our kids! They deserve a promotion!!! Also celeste and Jenny played with our kids!
Esteban from Fuego was super knowledgeable and very polite!
Alfredo de Capella went above and beyond saying to our requests (everything is possible) thank you for going above and beyond!
Victor from Mole simply super sweet and amazing!
 and the best of the best Atilano!!! what a server!!! simply made you feel so cared and important. Thank you Atilano for simply treating us like royalty!
A message for management especially Malu: You knew our complaints and did NOTHING then had the nerve to ask us if we had received a certain “amenity” left for us in our room. No amenity was ever given despite our continued discomfort  of our sleeping situation! If you wanted for us to receive an amenity you would have delivered it yourself. This is an all inclusive, bringing us a bottle of wine with some fruits from the buffet wouldnt have hurt the budget but wouldve gone a long way at least for us on your part.
Instead you saw in us a big money sign to maybe enroll us as partners? wow. May this be a learning experience for you. Seat with Atilano and let him teach you how to really connect with a guest, but trust me you could learn a lot from him.

Overall, I think that despite the old state that the hotel is in and the AC and sleeping situation, the entertainment in this hotel is TOP notch! Especially the kids club!! Thank you All!!!!

reviews.author: Ashanti
reviews.title: Liliana @ Yhi Spa
reviews.text:
Liliana is amazing! I got the relaxation massage and she was so great I had to come back the next day! 
Highly recommend her to get out those knots and kinks . She was also very kind. Thank you Liliana!

reviews.author: Mitchell B
reviews.title: Mr Mitchell Bryk
reviews.text: The waitstaff went above and beyond with every meal. Building personal relationships means the world when traveling. 100/10 experience, Pascual Y Alfredo thank you so much for your outstanding hospitality!

reviews.author: Cameron Z
reviews.title: Didier is the best!
reviews.text: We came to Paradisus for a trip with my employer - but we will be back soon! I never expected it to be so good. The staff (especially Didi!) were all so professional and kind. They really made the trip as great as it was. Cheers!

reviews.author: Peiliang
reviews.title: Amazing RESEVE service from Sante
reviews.text: Just got back last night for 6 days trip. The hotel was beautiful!! Mostly, Valeria from Sante made our breakfast wonderful… she knew exactly what we wanted for exact time. Our daughter was traveling with us. Valeria knew my daughter came for breakfast later, she would watch for her and get exactly what me daughter wanted! Also shout out to Ruben and Cesar from Sante… they knew our drinks. Perfect! Lucas in the adult pool were attentive. We will be back!

reviews.author: Артём Б
reviews.title: Best service
reviews.text: We were traveling from north California for our new years vacation,  so we were expecting best quality of service which we received. Thanks to servers team they were treating us like kings and created very family friendly environment.

reviews.author: squee-zbear
reviews.title: Construction at 2am?? Unbelievable...
reviews.text: We are on our first of 5 nights at the Paradisus Cancun and already regretting staying here. Loud construction started at midnight. It is now almost 230am. After I complained at least 3 times, and then personally walked down to the front desk, they temporarily stopped working at 145am.  Then at 2am, they are back at work hammering away, running power saws as they build cabanas. WTF are we supposed to do when the property management clearly doesn't care about their guests? We just want to sleep. That is the lowest expectation of a hotel and they are failing.

reviews.author: Janiceraneross
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: After a long flight and chaotic airport experience we were greeted with a refreshing beverage and clean beautiful room.    We did not read the fine print requiring a reservation to eat at the “fine restaurants but showed up hungry at Lemon Fish.   After much pleading we got a seating       Rafael our waiter was superb.   He detailed the menu and made excellent suggestions on the food and drinks.      In addition Rafael gave us traveling tips on the resort, pesos and nightlife at the resort.    Lemon Fish was a 5+ and Rafael will see us again before we leave

reviews.author: Joyce S
reviews.title: Fun in cancun
reviews.text:
Juan was very friendly
He wa
s alot of fun and very pleasant.

Axcel was alot of fun and made our trip extra special  he shared information with us and always spoke whenever he saw us .made us feel at home

reviews.author: Michael D
reviews.title: The Reserve is a must!
reviews.text:
Great experience! Juan in the Reserve was great! Highly recommend staying in The Reserve section. Juan booked our dinner reservations, got snacks and was there for any of our requests. The spa was great. Pool is huge and quiet. Food is great! The Italian restaurant was our favorite. We did not book any excursions but we could have as they offered them several times. Beach is kind of small, but still beautiful.

Staying in The Reserve we got a comply Bali Bed everday!

reviews.author: Lynn M
reviews.title: Pampered at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We loved Juan and Aldo!  Memo keeps everyone hopping.  Service was excellent.  We ate at the Lunch Box a few times for dinner and still stopped on other nights for drinks.

The Salmon Ceviche was delicious.   Try the shrimp and seafood Chube, beef tips and sea bass.  

The experience added to us being pampered for our vacay.

reviews.author: Tobias B
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text:
Best Restaurant in the hotel!
Test all but this was the best!
 
Nice view!

Profesional personal!
Absolut friendly with perfect cocktail!

The meat has a Great quality and the food is very nice!

We will came back

reviews.author: MJMarte88
reviews.title: The best staff I’ve ever encountered. Thank you!
reviews.text:
My stay  at Paradisus Cancún was beyond excellent. Everything from the food to the bedding was spectacular. Although everything was great what really was memorable and exceeded my expectations was the staff… WOW! My family and I had a misunderstanding with some tickets we bought through a third party (not the hotel) and the hotels manager Rosanna helped me every step of the way with everything. She truly saved my trip. Rosanna also helped me reserve dinners and the cabana for my daughters bday.. what an amazing hospitality she offered us. Aside from that the staff was just on point, friendly and very professional at all times.  Thank you so much and thank you also to Daniel, Wen, Fabiola and Luis.. i hope to see them there again! 

I want to  point out that the hotel is doing a great job keeping the hotel guest entertained despite us being in a pandemic which has been hard to find. 
The only thing I would change is the depth of the pool because I’m a non swimmer lol other than that I’ll be returning soon!

reviews.author: Mike R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Exceeds Expectations
reviews.text: The resort is the largest most beautiful one I have been at and I have been to many resorts including Phuket and Bali. The food at the buffet was top notch quality and there were countless options. The service is really what made our stay special. The staff working in the main buffet provided the best service and were truly genuine. Altilano and Joni treated us like family during our stay and I can confidently say they were among the best waiters I have experienced in my life. We also had a great time with the exceptional waiters Ignacio during breakfast and Samuel for dinner. We will definitely be staying at this resort again.

reviews.author: douglasalt13
reviews.title: The outstanding start to 2022!
reviews.text: Diego's staff at the Reserve was absolutely wonderful. we will return to this Paradisus Cancun because of his staff especially:Julio, Moises, Ruben, Joel, Javier, Luis, Maria, Valeria, Miguel, Yamil, Cesar, Eligio, Oscar, Josue, Lucas & Maximiliano!! These outstanding employees made us feel, welcome, relaxed, special and appreciated! Room view was nice but a bit small. Hotel location, beach access & amenities were very good. The "Reserve" is well worth the money. The restaurants were very good Cielo(Moises was excellent), Cappella, Malva & Lime Tree great receptions, serves and staff!

reviews.author: Amanda R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The staff is so amazing and helpful here, but, especially Daniel Mis and Rosana in Guest Services. Daniel was kind, caring, sympathetic and extremely helpful. Even on his day off, he made sure to help and address any concerns or questions we had. He truly  goes above and beyond to deliver amazing service. Highly recommend this hotel for your stay as they will make sure you are happy and comfortable at all times!

reviews.author: Amal R
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: All the hotel staff at Paradisus were so nice, helpful and welcoming. Daniel Mis and Rosanna were especially helpful! Daniel took time out of his day to help us multiple times and even helped on his day off! Would recommend this hotel to everyone!

reviews.author: Gwenn M
reviews.title: FANTASTIC HOTEL in CANCUN
reviews.text:
We have been coming to this hotel for 30 years. The service has been outstanding every single trip. From the check in staff, Reyna to the concierge, Jose and Janick, Raul who is at the front door always welcoming us back, the special event service Guendolyn, housekeeping staff, all the servers, Marten, Raul, Atilano, Joni, Luis, Gaudenceo, Randi. The outside staff, Laura, Acencion, Letica, Elliot, Jesus, Axcel, and all the others that I forgot their names. 
To others who have left bad reviews, NOTHING is ever perfect, have there been small bumps in the road during during the 30 years, yes! We have had few nothing that has ever stopped us from coming back, we have brought our 4 children here and now we bring our grandchildren. We consider this our home away from home. Please visit, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: arcruz
reviews.title: A solid 9/10!
reviews.text:
My husband and I arrived to the hotel before the rest of our group. The drive from the airport to the hotel was about 20 minutes. When we arrived to the hotel, security asked us for our reservation information. Fortunately, they did not make it a big deal that our friend — the reservation holder — was not with us. During check-in, we were shown to the exclusive “The Reserve” check-in area in Tower 5. Although the check-in took about 30-45 minutes, the staff was patient and offered us beverages while we waited. Again, although the reservation holder wasn’t present, this did not cause any issues or delays. 

To summarize our overall stay from 31 Dec 2021 - 6 Jan 2022 in the exclusive “Reserve” 

PROS:
- Our room key was a bracelet we had to wear that made it so easy not to worry about being locked out
- COVID protocols in place at the resort such as face masks worn by all staff, hand sanitizers throughout the building, and gloves for the buffet areas
-our own personal concierge, Aaron, that really made our experience so much better with his patience and quick responses to our questions and concerns
- the view inside and outside of the resort— just beautiful
- the quality of customer service from concierge, to housekeeping, room service, mini bar attendant, bar and restaurant staff
- everything was within a few minutes of walking— restaurant, pool, beach, etc. 
-The room had AC that worked really well! 
-The SPA was a great experience

CONS
- limited selection on beer (I.e. no corona or modelo)
- it was noticeable that the resort wanted to cater to different people with their food options, but at times this caused the food to be bland or not as enjoyable. 
-limited resort activities for adults
- The QR Codes used by the hotel for SPA menu, Restaurant menu, Room Service menu, etc, did not work for me or my husband. That was frustrating
-Sometimes it was hard to get ahold of someone at the front desk for help— especially during hours when our concierge was not on site

Overall, the experience at Paradisus was great! 9/10

reviews.author: Lola
reviews.title: Memorable Xmas  and New Year Experience
reviews.text:
We have been to this facility a couple of times. It remains a Grandiose environment that is very tranquil for relaxing and enough activities to make a good vacation. 
Worth mentioning is the professionalism and warm spiritedness of the staff members. Notably at the Guest services. Shout out to Rosanna and Pascual. Also Max and Lucas at the Reserve pool. All in all it was a pleasant experience that is worth repeating.

reviews.author: Sophia F
reviews.title: Great service and fun times!
reviews.text: Servicio Espectacular!!! Bernardo, Orlando and every single server we had were amazing! Don't think twice to visit Paradisus Cancun! Food was delicious everywhere we ate and rooms were comfy. More than anything - amazing service.

reviews.author: katowilks7
reviews.title: Christmas Vacation 🎄
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of staying at the Paradisus Dec 18-25; my husband 4 sons and myself. This resort is beautiful and expansive! It took us a few days to get our bearings because it is so large. The grounds are immaculate, pools are clean, and the beach is incredible. The restaurants were decent, better than most all-inclusives. Cielo was my personal favorite. Thank you Jose for the wonderful menu recommendations and service.  Special shouts to Abel, our concierge, for setting up dinner reservations and answering any and all questions we had regarding the resort and area. Patricia provided top notch service at the beach. Ada was great also. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Only wished they had more Christmas activities and entertainment for kids.

reviews.author: Sanja M
reviews.title: Excelent 5 star dinner!
reviews.text:
We are having a holiday at the hotel Paradisus. The restaurant The Lunch Box made our stay incredible with his dinner. The food products were fresh and the plate was garnished till perfection. Thank you Chef Ricardo for leting us to indulging this moment!

BEST COMPLIMENTS from 

Fam. Steinauer from Switzerland

reviews.author: Esmat B
reviews.title: Memorable Holiday
reviews.text: My family and I had an amazing time during our stay at Paradisus Cancun. The resort in itself was absolutely stunning, but what really made our stay memorable was the incredible staff, in particular Rosanna at guest services. Thank you for being such incredible hosts - will definitely be returning soon!

reviews.author: Raf
reviews.title: Amazing Experience at Paradisus
reviews.text: This was an amazing stay at Paradisus, Rosanna was excellent and went above and beyond to ensure we enjoyed our stay. I highly recommend this resort for families and couples. It’s a luxurious getaway. We stayed for 2 weeks and enjoyed our Christmas and New Years

reviews.author: maria s
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text:
Resort was beautiful, very clean. 
Room was beautiful with great view. 
The Buffet was outrageously delicious.. everyday breakfast lunch and dinner they was such a great assortment of food fresh warm.  Such a great variety of food.. 
The bar khana was a nice touch. The view of the ocean was breath taking.. the service was great.. Katrina and Manuel were great.. pleasant.
