Ginger bar where all the entertainment was held was nice.. again the bartenders were awesome!!! Wendy was amazing…. She is definitely a huge + at that bar… quick, pleasant, such a sweetheart…

Things that would have been nice to have was some Latin music, Mexican singers.

reviews.author: Dave C
reviews.title: Thank You Daniel and Luis
reviews.text: I would like to say a quick thank you to Daniel and Luis in guest services who took great care of our family while in Cancun. We had a great trip as a family over the holiday break. These two gentlemen went out of their way to make us comfortable and addressed our needs. We look forward  going back soon. Thanks again Daniel and Luis!

reviews.author: Bond1959
reviews.title: First Christmas In Cancun 2021
reviews.text:
Melia Paradisus Cancun stands out from the long line up of luxury Hotel's with its impressive elevated reception with surrounding views of Cancun over the lagoon.
 
From the moment we arrived in reception we were impressed with the sheer scale of the 8 storey central atrium, which provided a fabulous stage to 10 wonderful opera singers on Christmas Eve.

Our trip was in the height of covid so it was comforting to see the effort that went in by all staff to demonstrate their commitment to hygiene and all were masked at all times during our stay.
While we could not fault any of the courteous staff working here that we had the pleasure of meeting, we are especially grateful to some exceptional staff members  who we had a number a lot of engagement with and deserve a special mention.

Firstly, we were blessed to have DjORDjE as our private butler, which is one of the perks of upgrading to the Reserve suites. He looked after all of our needs in an exceptionally professional manner, it felt like we had his attention as though we were his sole clients!

His colleague CECI in reservations was also of great assistance in sorting out an issue with our booking when we arrived.

An amazing massage from GEMMA in the spa, took away the stress of the long flight !

We dined twice in the newly opened 'LEMON FISH' with its impressive bar and as elaborated on in a previous review, the Cocktails made by JORGE in a masterfully manner at our table were simply world class, while the manager HUGO went to some trouble to squeeze us in on a very busy night, for our second visit and then topped it all by organising room service to bring sushi to our son who had seen a bit too much sun!

Neither can we neglect to mention RAFAEL and MIGUEL who arranged a tasting menu when we were unsure of what to order ! it was so delicious we ordered it again on the second night.

Similar can be said for OMAR in Capella restaurant who again produced his suggested tasting menu, much to the kids delight !

Every morning RICHER and ORLANDO at the new Nespresso Bar were always smiling and friendly.  

FLOR, GABY and ADA, at the poolside, were so attentive to our family of 7 they kept us refreshed all day.  Have to also mention ORLANDO at the pool bar and VICTOR who made sure we had our preferred sun beds.

Thank you to all the staff at the Melia Paradisus Cancun for making our first family Christmas in Mexico so special.

The Agar family look forward to coming back next Christmas !!!!

reviews.author: Liam C
reviews.title: The best experience
reviews.text: This hotel is awesome. Specially Fabiola; Angela and Wen Wagner. They assistme and now I know what I want to do in Tulum!! Thanks girls!!! The food is delicious. All the staff is very happy. Definitely I will come back here!!!

reviews.author: Zehra Q
reviews.title: Spend your money elsewhere - you're welcome.
reviews.text:
If you can stay somewhere, please do yourself a favor and do it. Save your $ for a resort where you feel welcome instead of trapped. For one, this is an outdated resort- but I could look past that. Before I begin on what made me hate my experience I would like to highlight 1) our concierge was attentive 2) the YHI spa was excellent- Lilian (my spa tech) was probably the only highlight 3) the room was very clean
Now on to the problems.
1) The shampoo/conditioners are in refillable bottles. I felt both were watered down or just downright awful quality. My entire family's hair was feeling damaged after each shower.
2) We paid extra for "The Reserve" experience. Now we've stayed at other hotels/resorts before and when you pay this extra fee- you are PAMPERED! Not here. Once we entered the resort, instead of walking us to the special "reserve" side, someone at the front gave us half sleepy instructions on how to find our way to the special side. Nothing special once we made it there either, three men behind the check in counter- all look distracted, bored and just want to get people away. Which brings me to my third point
3) The staff! this was by far the most drained out, bored and unfriendly staff in general. I heard other guests talk about this too. They have a "you're on your own buddy" attitude. Not room service- that was always on time and on point but at other resorts, the staff feels like family by the time you leave- they make you feel so welcome. The staff can really make or break the environment. At Paradisus, they break the environment. They will be standing starting at walls but don't smile and look very unhappy. The gentleman who serves ice cream was rolling his eyes at kids. Also, at this "kid-friendly" resort they were usually out of the whopping 4 flavors they offered with terribly generic tasting toppings
4) I have never gone to a 5 star Resort to find NOTHING in the room upon arrival. At our other resort, the staff left cute dessert on our dresser daily. Here, not even on the first day did we receive anything special
5) our mini bar and snacks were not stocked after the first day- you had to keep calling for basic things like water
6) This is not a hotel problem but it does matter if you're going there to "relax" but the beach space for the # of guests this hotel has to host is a joke. The beach is a crammed 0.5 mile spread ....its the location, its squeezed next to other resorts. It didn't matter what time you went, it was so packed there was hardly space to sit. The Cabana cost was $200 per day - and if you didn't get that you are pretty screwed with not many seating options
7) For" entertainment" they have music blasting until midnight in the middle of the hotel lobby. We didn't see any beautiful performances or variety. Just different singers each night. 
8) They only have two pools- one for adults one for family. 
9) You will be pushed to attend an onsite meeting - probably to sell timeshare, but we just avoided it at all costs

There's a lot that made this trip a regret- which is not something I say lightly. But it was a lot of money spent on an incredibly underwhelming trip. We have stayed at another resort and EVERY SINGLE thing from the people, to the pools, the variety of entertainment to the service....impeccable! I never write reviews but wanted to save time (and money) for anyone I can.

reviews.author: Victoria G
reviews.title: Wonderful Staff
reviews.text: The staff is just excellent! Dider, Raul, gaudencio and Alejandro treated me like royalty everytime I asked them for anything! Hard working staff! This hotel/experience was worth every single bit of the money. I will be returning very soon!!!

reviews.author: Bhargav K
reviews.title: My visit to paradesis Cancun was very pleasant
reviews.text: Front desk wen wrangler was very helpful in booking restaurant reservation. She called us almost everyday to make sure we got a speciality restaurant. Thanks to her for making stay pleasant. I can say paradesis is hospitality at its best

reviews.author: Alyxis
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text:
This was my first visit to Cancun, so I may have rose colored glasses, but this was an amazing trip! Everyone in the hotel was very accommodating. The only complaint I do have is that we were assigned a concierge that never saw us. 

I have to thank Ada for being such an angel to us on the trip. I was visiting with my infant toddler, and she was so sweet to him. She recognized us at the concert event they hosted for New Year's, and made sure we were taken care of.  On our final day she made our last poolside visit a great one. Asuncion was also exemplary at making sure we had everything we could possibly want. 

All the kudos to Victor -The pool Concierge for helping my mother in law with reserving the palapas. Victor really went above beyond to accommodate our family. Elliot was also very key in ensuring we got a beach view palapa for later in our stay as well.

In the buffet the wait staff is very attentive and no request is too grand or small. Martin served me my drink of choice for the entirety of the trip (passionfruit margarita) and Hector also helped us. Hector also recognized us while visiting Isla mujeres and really helped us navigate the market. Our neon green stroller may have tipped him off.

Lastly, Raul, the bellman is my biggest thank you. I visited the spa, and my counterpart decided to go shopping. The alcohol flows, and Raul made sure he had a taxi that would take care to get him back.  

Anyway, I just wanted to thank the folks that really helped us. This place overall is awesome. You probably just suck if you could visit here and manage to find something to cry about. It's gorgeous.

reviews.author: Vlamir G
reviews.title: For the price charged, the services and quality should be much better.
reviews.text: The resort has a reasonable area but during the period we were staying (07/12 to 21/12) many areas were full, especially at the Malva restaurant, where breakfast was served. As we stayed at the Reserve, we could opt for exclusive restaurants and services. In terms of food, nothing special. Little variety and quality is not always pleasant.

reviews.author: vbpod
reviews.title: Christmas at the Reserve
reviews.text:
We chose the Reserve at Paradisus Cancun for our extended family Christmas vacation. We have planned this for 6 months and reserved specific room types for the 5 families and dinner reservations for our party of 15. We had paid the full amount in advance with specifics on who was staying in each room and the specific bed configuration needed. All of this was verified and confirmed months in advance. 

After a long day of travel we were taken to the “reserve check in”. This turned out to be the worst experience ever.  We got absolutely no assistance from Alejandro. We were informed the specific rooms were not available. They only had kings even though we specifically asked for several double beds for our young adults. His solution was that one could sleep on the flimsy sofa bed. He also wanted to charge us extra for one teenager who we had already paid extra for. I tried to show him the email from Melia verifying all of this. At this point he started getting visibly angry with us.  He informed me that he cannot honor what Melia reservations had confirmed. It’s mind boggling to pay $20,000 in advance and be told that he cannot confirm this. 

The restaurants were hit or miss. Once again, reservations that we made through Melia months ago could not be verified and new ones had to be made through our concierge.  The buffet dinner at Malva was lousy. Avoid Sal (rude waiter and hidden charges). Lemon Fish and Enzo are nice. Sante was great for breakfast and lunch. 

The pools are warm and clean. The rooms in the reserve and clean and beds are comfortable. Most of the pool and housekeeping staff are helpful and work hard. The Covid testing was slow but luckily we were all negative. 

Read the other reviews, this check in service is either a sham to upcharge you or evidence that they are truly incompetent at customer service. It’s a shame because the rest of your stay is bitter after this check in service.

reviews.author: annemichelemcmahon
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, pools, great food, fantástico everything
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, pools, great food, fantástico everything. From the friendly servers to the incredible views, to the picture perfect beach and great pool temperatures, Paradisus is truly paradise. The servers on the beach for the cabanas couldn’t have been more attentive or nicer. Also, Karina at the outdoor tiki bar, Kanna was especially awesome as bartender extraordinaire!

reviews.author: Kyle F
reviews.title: Greatest vacation ever
reviews.text: I went here on my honeymoon with my bride Kevin. We spent most of our time in the lobby bar where Wendy The pretty waitress with the scorpion tattoo took better care of us then a mother with her first born child.

reviews.author: Charissa T
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text:
The hotel is gorgeous, but the best part of this hotel is the staff. Axcel was great at helping us do activities, and made them fun. Wendy was great and so nice and kind.
Ada was also amazing and knew our drink orders by the end, and they were so kind. As always, Orlando was nice and remembered us from the last time! Omar and the restaurant Capella were fantastic. This hotel is absolutely gorgeous, and the staff is always great. They were very accommodating to our large family and made sure that we had the best time (and we did thanks to them).

reviews.author: sandraerika2004
reviews.title: Not recommended, Not sure what going on.
reviews.text: The staff really needs to get it together. People were not friendly. Refrigerators were not stocked, nor did the front desk answer the phone many times that we called to try to get a reservation we will try for hours. We seem to eat at the Buffet because we could not get into anywhere. The spa me the experience horrible for us. The staff member was very sick with a horrible cough. Also the day before our departure we had trouble obtaining our Covid test. They forgot to send us my husbands test. The hotel staff gave us a run around and sent us back-and-forth from different sections of the hotel. No one seem to wanna help us. We were very patient and very nice. Until I had enough and then one member was annoyed that they kept sending us from section to section and he called his manager and they help us connect with the clinic. We sent emails to clinic before they closed and after letting them know we didn’t receive our test. We were nervous because we had an early flight.

reviews.author: marci w
reviews.title: Thank you Joel, Diego, Moises, Lucas and Max!
reviews.text:
Kudos to all of the staff at Paradisus  Cancun. They are hardworking, always willing to assist and very personable.  A special thank you to Lucas and Max for all of their attention to our family and all the guest by the pool. Thank you to Joel, Moises and Diego at Sante and for their service  by the pool.
The staff is gracious and enthusiastic to assist all guest!

reviews.author: Fulltimenomads
reviews.title: What a remarkable staff!
reviews.text:
This place is absolutely incredible. The amenities, the service the food, all of it was fantastic. 
We splurged and did the reserve level, which I can't recommend enough. The service throughout the resort was top notch. It wasn't uncommon for staff to see us in other parts of the resort and remember us. I couldn't believe how genuinely pleased almost everyone seemed to have us there. Really, genuine smiles and a desire to help us with what we needed. Each staff member seemed to have been hand picked for their desire to provide exceptional service. And they have corporate culture of service of the heart and they put their hand over their heart when they speak to you. Orlando, Oscar, Jorge, all of them, amazing. The rooms were comfortable. The food was great, especially at the Yellowfish. The bali beds were fantastic, so were the drinks and food that never seemed to stop. They were GREAT about enforcing facemasks as well. When we went to get our covid tests (Provided by the hotel before travel!) there were a dozen staff members there being tested. Clearly they take it very seriously. 

The ONE downside, was anytime we had to deal with the desk. From a major screw up at 11 o'clock when we arrived to more drama at checkout, that part was a pain, but if you can get past that first impression, the rest of it is paradise!
My entire life would be complete if I could just figure out where to buy the SCENT that is used around the resort!  We are already planning our next trip there!

reviews.author: Ivantheroadwarrior
reviews.title: Positive attitude & excellent communication
reviews.text:
Rosanna Zannino made our family even better with her fab communication skills and positive attitude. 
When traveling with 12 family members, there’s always a place for someone who listens, understands, and responds.
Rosanna was awesome! 

Thank you Rosanna!

reviews.author: Shelby Richardson
reviews.title: WONDERFUL SERVICE
reviews.text: We came to Fuego for breakfast and enjoyed our visit so much that we came back for lunch the same day. Both meals we were taken care of by Atilano, Eddie, David, and Arnulfo and they were spectacular. I wish we found them sooner as we probably would’ve come here for every meal. Thank you for the best service and your kind gestures. We will be back!

reviews.author: Aman V
reviews.title: Great experience overall!
reviews.text:
I came here with my fiancé for our anniversary and we had a great time! Beautiful and spacious resort. And the beach was very clean! The only issue was that our room key kept malfunctioning, but they fixed the problem and provided exceptional service to make up for it. 

Some shoutouts! Christian and Ismael really helped us out and were able to get us upgraded. Fernanda helped us get cabanas by the pool, b/c the pool chairs would fill up quickly. The activities were also a lot of fun (especially the bag painting!).

Thanks to the great staff for making our experience enjoyable!

- Aman V

reviews.author: fsangalli2021
reviews.title: Perfect vacation
reviews.text: 6 fantastic days, we had zero problems. The hotel was very clean and very well organized. Check in was fast. The beach was nice and clean: service was perfect. Food was of a very high quality with a perfect service: I suggest Enso for lunch: just in front of the ocean

reviews.author: Carmen barbella
reviews.title: Reserve review
reviews.text: Ok were to start, my wife and i spend 1/21/21 to the 28th  in the Reserve side room 5612 luxury jr siute oceanview but it was oceanfront 🍹,i go to Cancun every year and try different resorts first time at paradisus,the staff in the Reserve was hands down the best service my wife and i ever had anywhere and I've stayed at other high end resorts, galdino are butler(i dont like using the word butler) are friend helped us with everything,I cant say enough about him what a great person ,every person that works in the Reserve was amazing are pool guy,waiters and bar tenders worked on giving us  everything we needed or wanted, room was updated , clean, water was hot and air condition cold. Food was on point in all restaurants,i will returning in April, i want to thank all the staff for there endless hard work .

reviews.author: joselynvasquezp
reviews.title: Amazing Cancun experience at Paradisus
reviews.text: Wonderful experience from everyone Antonio, Alex, Sergio from the bar as well as Ivonne and Didier from the pool area. Servers Pascual and Victor were also amazing loved the experience and my stay here.

reviews.author: Jill S
reviews.title: Awesome vacation!,,,
reviews.text: We enjoyed every moment of our vacation. The staff in all areas of the resort was super friendly and attentive to our every needs.  It was very relaxing and beautiful. We will definitely be staying again!

reviews.author: DMH
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text:
This was our third time at Paradisus. The staff go above and beyond to ensure your safety and comfort during the pandemic. The staff are wearing masks 24/7, inside and outside. Guests must wear masks while walking around inside and in certain outdoor areas. Temperature is taken at restaurants and sanitizer is provided throughout. Buffet is only open for breakfast and it is no longer self serve, there are attendants at each station. The grounds are throughly cleaned, the pool area is clean, the beach is gorgeous - highly recommend this hotel if you are a beach goer and like white sand and beautiful blue water.

All of the restaurants are open but require reservations for dinner which was the only part that annoyed me - it was impossible to get a reservation almost anywhere unless it was at 6 pm or 10 pm without putting up a fight. The system is a bit flawed because I couldn’t find anything on my first day for even my last days but I put up a bit of a fight (sorry!!) and we managed well. The restaurants are all very accommodating with dietary restrictions if you can’t find something on the menu which was extremely helpful. All menus are QR code. 

Rooms were cleaned everyday and sanitized. Nespresso bar is back to its original spot near mole, still my favorite part of the resort. Tons of activities happening poolside for adults and for kids, music at the pool and great drinks service but no swim up bar. 

Special thanks and shout out to: Guadencio and Victor at Malva for breakfast. Moises at Mole. Didier (Didi) and Rene at the pool, the two guys who manned the Nespresso bar during our week (21-27) who’s names I didn’t get unfortunately. Ingrid and the outdoor photo team. Daniel and the others at Bana. The most important one - Nicole and Celeste at the kids club for making my girls feel so comfortable and happy throughout our stay. They never like going to kids club but naturally gravitated to the ladies who were so friendly and sweet and I can’t thank them enough for making this trip memorable for them and easy for me.

The only iffy part was the circle by Meliá thing which they spring on you as soon as you check in and they say isn’t a time share but it really is just a fancier way of them calling it a time share. Juan was honestly so nice and not pushy about it at all which I appreciate and wish him much success.

Overall great time, would definitely return and highly recommend.

reviews.author: yvonnelawson550
reviews.title: Best Resort I've Ever Been To!
reviews.text: Celebrated my boyfriends 30th birthday and this was the most fun, amazing experience ever.  We couldn't have asked for a better staff, restaurant choices and service.  This is a 5 star resort!  Staff is accommodating, helpful and overall incredibly generous.  Not once did I feel unsafe due to covid.

reviews.author: BoardingPass646008
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun was a great place to stay. They made sure to keep the resort very sanitary and definitely had increased amount of cleaning for COVID (including all shared spaces, such as beach chairs). We were able to get the rapid antigen test at the resort before we flew back to the US. The test was administered by Farmacias del Ahorro in one of the hotel rooms. The medical staff were professional and the results were emailed to us within 30 minutes. Victor at Fuego restaurant was super hospitable and kind and made our experience unforgettable! His service was excellent, thank you!

reviews.author: Rox
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: What an INCREDIBLE vacation at The Melia Vacation Club inside The Paradisus Cancun! We would have to say that not only the most beautiful beach ever but the employees, servers made our stay phenomenal! First of all Jose, our butler, was always asking if we needed something, always going above and beyond making our stay as pleasurable as possible with such a sweet, kind, gracious  spirit and ALWAYS a huge smile! Also Betsy, Ruby and the other Jose at the front desk always greeted us by name and more than willing to help us with any arrangements or basically anything we needed while we were there. We actually extended our stay three times so the extra help arranging that with our network by Betsy was VERY much appreciated making sure we never had to change rooms! We also want to give a shout out to the entertainment guys Augustine and Saul! They were EXCELLENT at engaging with the guests always going around the pool making sure everyone knew what the next activity was going to be! They also learned our names...literally calling out whenever or wherever they saw us! That made us feel so welcome and like family! LOVED all their energy and constant enthusiasm! We’ve been going to this resort for over 12 years and have made suggestions over and over that they have activities around the pool and this visit was THE BEST EVER!!! Thank you Augustine and Saul!! Also, really need to mention Ricardo at the latte bar. He was just the best!! He’d greet me every morning with his great big smile asking me what our plans were for the day and ALWAYS have my two cappuccinos ready for me as soon as he saw me walk up!! I looked forward to this every morning! Such a wonderful start to each day!! We are Club members and purchased our plan before mandatory all-inclusive so we are optional as we can’t eat or drink that much! With that being said the pool servers didn’t need to really pay any attention to us but they did anyway! Latissia, Laura, Francisco and many others would give us water occasionally and always saying “Hi” as they walked by asking if we needed anything!! Last but not least was Elliot (the pool towel guy) was such a sweetheart. He knew exactly the location we liked to be every day (as we were there for 2 mo) willing to put our towels out for us. He was so so friendly and fun to talk with...and again...such a beautiful smile making us feel so welcome EVERY single day! We look forward to our stay here every year and really don’t want to go anywhere else! Thank you to”The Paradisus Cancun!”

reviews.author: kahgallas
reviews.title: AMAZING STAFF!! apart from Jorge (circle)
reviews.text:
THE GREAT:

OUTDOORS PHOTO BY INGRID DIAZ PHOTOGRAPHER was AMAZING! we have never done a photoshoot before and we loved it - she had great ideas for poses, was very skilled in capturing the moment and editing the photos. we were going to get only 2 pictures (pay 20 dollars for one and get one free), but we could not resist and got 10 - they were all amazing! (very hard to narrow down to 20 from the 63 she took in 30min)

HOTEL ACTIVITIES: my partner loved beach volleyball, the yoga looked amazing (will get back to the reason why I could not join soon), the wine tasting with IRAN (super knowledgeable and fun!) was fantastic (and we were the only 2 people in the tasting - was supposed to be a 30min thing and he stayed with us for an hour! <3 
The cocktail making activity was, once again, private - only my partner and I benefited from it. GEOVANI was very good at it and taught us many options of cocktails for different situations. In both this activities Iran and Geovani counted with the help from SAUL, an amazing helper and a lot of fun to be around.
CRISTIAN, our official waiter at Fuego, was SO good! he anticipated our needs , made sure the plates I had were all gluten free (even if it needed adaptations) and was very helpful.

Location wise this hotel is good - specially because you have everything there and never have to leave (specially in covid times!).

the rooms were very good, the balcony in the lagoon side is perfect for sunset views, but if you can get the ocean view, with the sunrise, even better.

the waiters in the pool area were always with a positive attitude and serving us really well, they were stars!

Ismael, in the front desk, managed to get us a last minute spot at Vento for dinner.

In general, the staff of the hotel were one of the highlights - they made us feel welcome, happy, cared for. 

There was one REALLY BAD experience with Staff though. When we left breakfast, Maria Fernanda caught us with a "certificate for 3 free nights" offer, that was supposed to take 5min and took ONE HOUR of our last morning in Cancun, overlapping with Yoga I wanted to do, only to have Jorge trying to convince us to buy a membership that does not really benefit us or matches our needs/style of traveling. Besides takin ONE HOUR talking, he was EXTREMELY RUDE to us once we said no (very friendly until that point, but after no he became an a$$).
So if anyone offers you something from Circle - RUN FOR THE HILLS! They are only nice to you if they think you will leave $12+k with them before you leave.

The NOT SO GREAT:

The music in the pool was loud and annoying (to me, come people like it).

Although the breakfast was AMAZING and the service at Fuego was great in all meals there, the food in general in the hotel is .. okay. We had a fantastic mushroom cream at Vento, but the rest of the meal was okay. 
The snacks by the pool are very US-like, not my favourite. 
Everything tasted at least alright - and we did not feel hungry at all, but besides the mushroom cream and breakfast, no meal we had was worth repeating/mentioning/raging about. Maybe our expectation was too high after seeing the reviews here?

The alcohol was of average quality, apart from the amazing drinks Geovani made for us and the good wines Iran gave us in the tasting.

All inclusive is quantity>quality, so nothing really surprising, right?

I would totally recommend staying at this hotel - the lobby alone is already a great place to visit! haha and the beach is amazing, the pool area is nice, and the staff makes it heaven on earth. the staff and the ocean are what make this place to be this good! so a BIG THANK YOU  for ALL STAFF in the resort (except Jorge...)

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.title: Attitude of gratitude
reviews.text: The staff at Paradisus were amazing! From the very first greeting at the door (Sergio?) to our good-byes, the staff was so grateful to see us. The resort was at about 30% capacity. After 7 months of nothing, they could not do enough for us. Every guest wore masks indoors and took them off once we went outside to enjoy the sunshine! The staff wear masks at all times, even outside. I have to list as many people as I can remember because they MADE us take a vacation. They would not let us put our dirty dishes away at Sunset Grill or throw away cups, etc. It was so enjoyable to chat with the staff and talk about culture and life. They are wonderful people. The staff (and more that we’ve forgotten) are Ale, Betsy, Jenniffer, Felipe, Francisco, Laura, Christhian, Eddie, Orlando, Alejandro, Tête-à-tête and Manuel. Again, thank you SO much for making us feel safe and welcome in Cancun.

reviews.author: Mariia V
reviews.title: Great! Especially Reserve Bali Bed
reviews.text:
Thank you for great stay at your hotel! That was amazing! Nice seafood & meat, good cocktails.... The only problem- they refill your minibar (even with water) only when you ask them. That’s not comfortable at all.... 
Special thanks to Cornelio & Maximiliano from Bali Bed - they were responsive, always asking what else do we need & made our vacations unforgettable!!! Really advise staying at Reserve

reviews.author: Johan M
reviews.title: Great stay overall
reviews.text: First time in this resort and from the start Diana was great upon check in, and so was the rest of the staff, DIDIER at the pool was phenomenal, from What ever my family or me needed he could make it happen, already looking to book our next trip to come back to this wonderful place thank you !

reviews.author: JoeRoe26
reviews.title: A+ from check-in to check-out
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Paradisus for 5 days/4 nights. Absolutely no complaints.  The staff were friendly and accommodating well-beyond what we expected and definitely were what made our stay here memorable and so relaxing.  We couldnt have asked for better service. 

Special shout-out to Rene and Dedier, waiters by the pool, who were so hospitable and friendly as were their bartenders/assistants, Sergio and Antonio. They kept the drinks flowing constantly, consistently checked to see if we needed anything and even offered to bring us fresh towels throughout the day.  

Martin, Alfredo and Orlando were the most gracious and hospitable servers we had the pleasure of meeting at the various restaurants during this trip; they couldnt do enough to make sure we were satisfied.  

From service to food and beverage to the room to the beauty of the property and cleanliness/Covid protocols in place, the property was first class all the way but the staff are what make a hotel special and this is certainly the case at the Paradisus. 

I was quite especially impressed with the precautions the hotel and staff were taking with regards to Covid...taking them more seriously than a lot of people in the US!! Just one example: even though utensils were wrapped and sealed in paper bags, they never once touched it; instead, placing it on the table using tongs. 

Will definitely be making a return to this hotel in the future.

reviews.author: WAYNE K
reviews.title: Another return to the Paradisus
reviews.text:
I feel that the hotel has done an excellent job working thru the COVID mess. Felt extremely comfortable with precautions and cleanliness.
The big change which I did not like is the addition of children staying in the Reserve area.  Kids running around the atrium area and screaming at the beach are not conducive o my relaxation.  Also would like to see the atrium bar open a bit later to allow for an after dinner beverage before retiring.
As far as the staff, it was great to see many familiar faces, but, understandable that some staff were lost due tu COVID consequences and the hotel closures.  I don't want to overlook anyone...which I surely will, but:
Melina in the new check -in area  is super efficient and a pleasure to deal with.
Daniel, Josue, Valeria, Cesar, Javier and all the Reserve service staff anr the best.
Edgar and Giovanni in Bana Bar are very entertaining..as well as good Spanish instructors.\
Galdino, the mayordomo supremo can handle everything for you.

reviews.author: Sightseer624179
reviews.title: Paradisus during Covid-19
reviews.text: After my family contracted Covid-19 before Christmas, we really needed a vacation.  Cancun was a destination we had not visited yet.  With the new furnished covid-19 antibodies we decided to make it an international trip.  The Paradisus Cancun was recommended by a friend of mine.  I am glad she recommended it.  The experience was definitely above and beyond any resorts we have visited in the past. The hotel staff and facilities are great.  The relaxing bali beds, he butler services to help with restaurant reservations and the catering to a vegetarian diet.  Covid-19 safety is enforced.  Hand sanitizing stations are at the entrance of every door.  They are also located at every outdoor facility.  I am glad the property is taking things serious.   Highly recommend a visit.

reviews.author: Cassiaguinha
reviews.title: Best service!!
reviews.text: Cristian was our waiter for every meal at Fuego and he was THE BEST! Anteccipated our every need, was kind and made sure everything I had was gluten free, asking the chef to adapt plates and so on. The service in the whole hotel was amazing and people were all very kind, nice and very helpful. Never too busy to stop and help us with whatever we needed.

reviews.author: Katy K
reviews.title: Want to have a blast!?
reviews.text: This was the best vacation I've ever been to! Food was great especially with Alfredo, Victor, Julio, Eddie who were serving us, they are the funniest people ever and made us feel so comfortable. There are many fun activities too! If you love working out or making cool crafts Tannya, Saul, Adrianna, Agustine, Eddy, Karina, Veronika, and Danial lead the classes throughout the day and make it extremely fun.  We would try to attend as much as possible and have learned so much from them. In the evenings, shows and parties are hosted. Every day there's always something new and different to see. Noe, Eddy, Rafael brought the nights to life with their music. They're seriously the best DJ's and created really cool remixes. You can even request a song to be played!  Also, there's a small coffee cafe that we went to once a day, and Oscar the barista would make us really good drinks and would give yummy treats to take along with.

reviews.author: Natalie Gurnik
reviews.title: The Best Place on Earth!!!
reviews.text:
This hotel is filled with the most awesome, lovely and funny people! The food here was absolutely delicious in all the restaurants. I was served by the best waiters there are: Alfredo, Julio, Eddie, and Victor to name just a few! The Nespresso coffee was also made and served by only the best: Oscar!

The fitness activities in this hotel are seriously something else! There is boot camp, aqua fitness, stretching, and many others. Karina led an awesome jumping fitness class while Augustine, Adrianna, Tannya and Saul led the others. Veronica also led the most amazing yoga class ever! I highly recommend going to at least one or all of the fitness classes!! 

Besides fitness, there was a ton of other creative and fun activities! Tannya led a graffiti class, a selfie tour, and dream catcher crafting class to name a few! She is the absolute best!! The pictures do the talking :D

The DJs here are also something else. DJ Eddy, Rafael and Noe had me dancing my shoes off the whole time! Hahaha!

Overall, this was the best experience I could've asked for with the best people ever!! My only regret is not throwing my passport into the ocean to stay for longer :D

reviews.author: Mustapha Tiba
reviews.title: Nespresso king
reviews.text: Ricardo is the Nicest barista at the resort. He makes great lattes & offers exceptional service. He’s also so nice and cares to make you the perfect cup of coffee. The Nespresso bar was my favorite part of the resort.

reviews.author: christieb617
reviews.title: Great Cancun vacation at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: My family and I had a great stay at Paradisus Cancun. We were there for five days and during the entire stay we were treated like kings and queens. We especially enjoyed Rodolfo who was our private butler and took care of our every need. He even made a video of himself performing a happy birthday celebration song for my son‘s 22nd birthday. He also arranged for a cake to be served at dinner. My son felt special, and the personal touch was definitely appreciated.  We stayed in the reserve section of the hotel which I would highly recommend. The Reserve comes with a private butler, restaurant and access to perfectly placed bali beds.  The food is absolutely delicious. I should also give a shout out to Ingrid. She is a photographer at the hotel. The experience with her was efficient and easy and she took some great photos. The staff is very aware of the Covid pandemic. Masks were always worn and liberal cleaning was always observed. We will definitely return for another visit!

reviews.author: Teresa L
reviews.title: Paridisus Cancun trip
reviews.text: Our trip was spectacular! The views are amazing and the staff really takes care of you. Our butler, Rodolfo was amazing and he really made sure to make our stay as easy and pleasurable as possible! Love this place and I recommend asking for Rodolfo to assist you in your stay!!

reviews.author: sabrina12092021
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: I had a great time here. The rooms were really nice. I feel like their should be more activities to do at night. The drinks are very water down. The food was just okay. The best restaurant was Enzo and that was only opened one night. Breakfast was great and that’s about it. I am not sure if Reserve was worth it because the butler wasn’t that helpful. The nightlife could be better. The bars and clubs should close later and the room service should include alcoholic drinks. This property is too big to not have golf carts. Especially when it rains and you have to go to your dinner reservations. The hotel should have golf carts for the butlers and staff to take guests to their rooms or to restaurants. It’s a very beautiful resort.

reviews.author: KARINA HERNANDEZ
reviews.title: The Best
reviews.text: Rodolfo was our Butler throughout the week and he was absolutely the best! He made our trip even BETTER! We couldn’t have asked for anyone better! Not only did he make sure we were taken care of but he made sure our dinner was scheduled and out needs were met, Gracias Rodolfo por toda su atención!!

reviews.author: anaismz2021
reviews.title: Best experience ever
reviews.text: The entire staff made our visit very special. Luis and Sergio at the pool bar were great, they were so funny and entertaining. Also Ignacio and Pascual were extremely attentive every morning for breakfast, for lunch and even dinner. They truly made us feel so welcomed. We would definitely go back next year maybe even in the summer.

reviews.author: fletcherdaniel
reviews.title: Melia Cancun Stay
reviews.text: The staff was very attentive and extremely polite. Overall I had a great experience there. If it wasn't for COVID I believe the nightlife would have been better. Regardless, I was able to enjoy it. Yvet coordinated my day trip to Xcaret and was extremely helpful. Soni one of the employees there was extremely nice as well, anything I needed she was on it right away. Def recommend this hotel. The one thing I recommend is contacting the hotel Doc. for the covid test make sure you call them 2 days prior at the least for the test. They will come up to the room and test you there at your convenience.

reviews.author: WineBRExpert
reviews.title: Remarkable dinner
reviews.text: A great surprise when dining at Bana at Paradisus by Meliá. The excellent meal carefully prepared by Chef Antonio and perfectly delivered by Rafael was a lifetime milestone. The constant care in the service and the high quality of the dishes is worth of a Michelin star.

reviews.author: Ed M
reviews.title: We had a wonderful stay at Pardisus!
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this magical place, the decor was absolutely beautiful, it felt like we were staying inside of a jungle. 

The entire resort went above and beyond to sanitize and keep everything clean due to the pandemic. We felt safe and healthy the entire time. 

The food itself was amazing, we just wish we could’ve stayed a little bit longer to try out all of the delicious food. 

The entire staff and our wonderful butler, Rodolfo, gave us incredible service. He paid close attention to our needs, was super delightful to talk to and helped schedule reservations for every day of our stay. He even gave us a special dinner surprise for our honeymoon!

We’ll definitely come visit again in the future!

Jane & Ed

reviews.author: Chellie K
reviews.title: Rodolfo our host
reviews.text: I highly recommend Rodolfo from Paradisus as your host! He was fun and very helpful! He tended to all our needs and answered all of our questions! (No matter how silly 😂) He made a point to text us every day, even on his day off!! He would also finding us daily to visit in person! ❤️

reviews.author: Kat G
reviews.title: Amazing resort!
reviews.text: We came to the Paradisus Cancun to celebrate my birthday first week of January and it was amazing! The resort was very clean and followed all the safety protocols to make us feel safe. The staff was amazing, especially Rodolfo our Butler in the Reserve section of the Resort. Rodolfo was very attentive to us and all of our needs. He was very knowledgeable about activities to do around the Resort, he made our dinner reservations every night and checked on us often. We loved this resort so much we will definitely be back again and you can most certainly be sure we are requesting Rodolfo again! Thank you Paradisus Cancun for making my birthday such a memorable one! See you all again soon!!

reviews.author: podsnel
reviews.title: Beautiful Dinner at Mole!
reviews.text: Such a beautiful staff, loved our server Melvin, and Iran was so courteous! Delicious meal, and our dessert was over the top! My son actually ordered two entrees, and his mixed grill was his favorite I think. Also enjoyed my cosmo. We are really enjoying our stay at Paradisus in Cancun-

reviews.author: Melissa_L729
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: We were a group of 4 friends who took a last minute trip for a long weekend to Cancun.  The Paradisus Meliá was more than we could have asked for.  The food was delicious, the service impeccable and the activities were so much fun (water balloon toss and dance parties with Augustin - a must!) We loved the location, the beach and drinks - all were such welcome escape from reality for one long weekend.  We can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: T From Southeast US
reviews.title: Amazing week in Paradi(se)us!!
reviews.text:
Two couples had a great time. Staff were all COVID conscious and we felt as safe as possible during the stay. 

The staff were amazing. Service was fantastic. Sergio- bartender and Francisco-pool side service, were amazing along with Luis and all the staff at the main pool. The restaurants had good food. We especially enjoyed Mole.  

Alexandra, our butler, and Soni, another staff member we met made our days bright everyday with fun ideas and assistance with anything we needed.

Try it out. The world needs a break...take yours. 

T&B S&T

reviews.author: Julie N
reviews.title: Bana Restaurant
reviews.text: The service by Rafael was excellent, we has dinner there twice during our vacation, great meals both times!  The setting is amazing and the sushi was great. Being all inclusive, it was fun to try new dishes as well.

reviews.author: Sean M
reviews.title: Best resort in the galaxy!!!
reviews.text:
Service was excellent! Staff is genuinely kind and puts forth maximum effort to accommodate any needs. Victor, Julio, and the chef at Fuego (Christian) are magnificent human beings. As well as Francisco at the pool and Jorge at Ibana.
We will return without question!

reviews.author: Lontina F
reviews.title: The best vacations
reviews.text: I love it !!!! Thank for everything !!!! ❤️😘😊.... and love dj eddy and Saul from activity this is amazing hotel for visit I enjoy everything here thanks for the attention and I recommend this hotel come here it’s great

reviews.author: Wanderer04278322889
reviews.title: Mixed experience
reviews.text: Our room had black mold when we checked in, but they did allow us to change rooms after we mentioned this to the front desk. We were here celebrating our 5 year anniversary and they did nothing to make this special/memorable even though we made a note in the reservation prior to arriving. They advertise how there are multiple bars in the resort, but due to covid/construction, in the evening there is only one bar open until 11pm. After 11pm there is no alcohol service. Room service food IS NOT worth it, otherwise the different restaurants were all very good. The concierge is very pushy with the sales pitch in the beginning and will continue to ask you to sign up for an information session throughout your stay every time they see you which is annoying. The activities they had were fun but I wish there was a wider variety instead of repeating the same thing every day.

reviews.author: Kim K
reviews.title: A much needed break from the world...
reviews.text:
We were here one week. First and foremost, I was very impressed with all of the protocols the hotel had in place for preventing transmission of Covid. I felt very safe all of the time. The food was delicious and there were many options. Loved the nespresso coffee bar which was open in the mornings and in the afternoons. Agustín was a great activity coordinator and we enjoyed the tequila tasting. We enjoyed sitting in Gaudencio’s section of the restaurant during the breakfast buffet and for lunch. He was super attentive and a joy to chat with.

I hope to return soon :)

reviews.author: Orestes Armando C
reviews.title: To be Repeated
reviews.text: My names is Orestes Calderon all I can say the staff at paradisus was outstanding the service, they make you feel like home. The food was awesome I loved the restaurant vento and Fuego. The guys at the buffet were the best and also the staff by the pool and the sunset grill. Special mention to Marina The Concierge from day one all she did was be our guide and treat us me and my fiancee like family. This Hotel is highly recomendable. They are also doing some remodelings and the beach is spectacular. All I have is good comments for paradisus during my stay and I will be back soon. The only minor detail is that there is no jacuzzi but other than that this Melia is top. Also mention Fabiola the receptionist and Felipe and the guys that work at the Nespresso. Thank you guys I'm a  Happy costumer I will visit the one in punta cana and the one in Playa del Carmen but I loved my stay at the cancun resort thanks.

reviews.author: Nam N
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Bana Restaurant
reviews.text: We eat here a few times a day cause we love sushi. Rafael is our server and he is the best there! The sushi is fantastic, they have every kind of sushi including ramen and miso soups. Fried rice and noodles as well

reviews.author: Carrie P
reviews.title: Beautiful First Class Resort
reviews.text: Very clean.  We enjoyed the nightly shows and the daily activities.  The restaurants were number one and the wait staff was superb!  The pool and beach area were beautiful. We would love to return to this property.

reviews.author: Rhys E
reviews.title: Must stay
reviews.text: The resort is amazing, perfectly located across from the aqua marine. The hotel staff were amazing and so accommodating in every facet. Very professional and diligent during covid - will bring in a coivd testing doctor if required (like Canada). Highly recommend, you spend already 7-9 days here!

reviews.author: Lui D
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text: Such a beautiful resort with even greater staff. They’re are so many activities to do for adults and kids, they are all interesting and fun. The staff there are so caring to the guests some people to look out for are Augustine, Sam (Bartender) and Francisco. These guys were all so amazing to us the entire stay. I love this place, I will definitely come again and recommend it to anyone’s first time visiting Cancun.

reviews.author: Murray H
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text: We'll be back. Had a really good time with our stay here. 5 Stars to all the great staff. Rene at poolside bar. Raphael at Bana. Ati Alfredo and Orlando each day at breakfast all were fantastic hosts. Jamal at Enso thanks for watching out for my allergies.

reviews.author: Luis Franco
reviews.title: A must-stay resort in Cancún
reviews.text: Amazing resort, delicious food, staff is very friendly, the beach and hotel grounds were clean. Thank you for your hospitality, you really made my stay memorable I’ll definitely will come back soon!!!

reviews.author: Ricardo L
reviews.title: Best service we have ever had! Cleaner & Safer than your own home
reviews.text:
My wife and I had doubts about travelling...but then we gave our heads a shake and chose to improve our mental health and get some vitamin D.  Best decision ever! Despite now requiring a PCR test before returning to Canada we put our faith in knowing that Mexico has a great health system and is as effective and efficient as any modern country.... We had never stayed at the Paradisus but decided to be close to the airport and close to Cancun in case we needed to access certain services. 
Right from the start we knew we were in good hands...All staff were wearing masks, our luggage got sprayed and disenfected and every local we encountered was extremely happy to have us visit their country.  We upgraded to the Reserve package and let me tell you....way better than expected. The room was sealed with a paper across the door meaning it had been cleaned and no one had entered,  every coffee cup, glass, cuttlery was wrapped and sealed....even the remote was in a plastic bag and labeled disenfected!  We had a concierge assigned to us and he was amazing. Djordje was our guy and he took care of everything for us...he booked our Bali beds, booked our restaurants, checked in on us everyday, he even gave us his whatsapp so we could stay in contact throughout our stay!  He gave us info regarding options for covid testing, he told us how no one except 1 housekeeper is ever allowed in our room. He was a 10 out of 10 and is one of the main reasons we will definitely return to the Paradisus! If your seeing this Djordje..your customer service, your professionalism, your awareness and anticipation of our needs...you will go far my friend.  Ok now the resort was not very busy but it was lively enough. It made me so happy to see kids and families playing on the beach and enjoying life. Although every single staff wore masks religiously, the guests could enjoy space to be mask free when needed.  The restaurants were all outstanding and even the buffet which is not really a buffet as they serve your plate when you see something you like,  was great.  The staff were so thankful and so attentive...Milton & Rigoberto at Enso were outstanding!  At he palapa and pool...Oscar, Cesar, Reuben, Jenny, Joel...Samuel & Josue at the Cocos bar. I have never remembered so many names before, but I also never had service like this before! Well done and I hope Management rewards these people.  We opted to have a doctor arrange our test and it was not cheap, but we got results in 24 hours. You can also book in advance before you leave Canada at a local lab for 130 us a person.  Dont beleive the hype....Mexico is welcoming, safe and exactly what you need to boost your immune system!

reviews.author: Sheena A
reviews.title: Simply Paradise!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is a piece of heaven! From the moment we arrived, the staff were incredibly welcoming. Even before we visited, I worked with Ismael in guest services to ensure there would be vegan options for my husband and I. Ismael then greeted us after arrival to help us make all of our dinner reservations. We were also given a special dessert and bottle of champagne for our graduation celebration. 

If you are looking for vegetarian options, there are plenty! Vegan options are less common, but you can make the buffet work and your concierge can help make arrangements at the different restaurants. And dont't hesitate to ask your waiters to ask you to make something that isn't specifically listed on the menu as long as the ingredients are on the menu somewhere.

My daughter injured her foot on the beach and all of the staff were so kind in ensuring she had everything she needed to make her trip enjoyable. Crutches, first aid, wheel chair, etc.

We also had a blast hanging out with the staff, Eddy and Augustin. They became our good friends while we were here!

There are lots of activities for families and adults and the views are beautiful. Rooms are clean and everything I expected. In addition, the building is beautiful and covered in amazing live greenery.

Some notes of caution: the Bali beds on the beach are more than $100 USD per day, but we felt the service made it worth it with drink and food delivery all day. Just a bit surprised at the price.

Tipping seems to get you better service, but I don't believe this to be uncommon.

Finally, if you want friends to visit you at the resort, they have to buy a day pass which is also about $100. There was no option to just visit and buy your own drinks.

Overall, Paradisus Cancun feels like my new home in Mexico!

reviews.author: Morine P.
reviews.title: Paradise on Earth
reviews.text:
This was our first time here as a family and oh boy were we super impressed with this place! 

Transportation to and from the airport we used “Otium” which is located at the resort. We were welcomed by some cold passion fruit drinks so delicious!! 

1. We are a family of 7 with younger kids (9-11) so my review is going to be on the non reserve 🙂. Our room was the lagoon view, (we got two rooms next to each other). The rooms are very spacious and clean and the view on the lagoon side was actually pretty breathtaking:), sunset and fireworks at night was a bonus 🙂 . Rooms were  cleaned everyday. A big shout out to the cleaning team, they do an amazing job. 
You do not need to upgrade to an ocean view especially if 90% of the time you will be outdoors like we were. 

2. The food service was amazing oh my!! All the restaurants were open and the service is over the top, we had Alex, Martin, Alejandro most of the time for breakfast, they are amazing!! (I miss tequila in my coffee every morning 😊) not forgetting Orlando from “Nespresso” we loved stopping by there for Mini treats. 

3. Kidzone was open for kids ages 5 and up and shout out to Tannya and Nicole and other staff. They had fun things for our kids to do, they had programs from 10am to 5pm with a lunch break. So awesome would highly recommend especially if you need a little break to enjoy yourselves. 

4. We got to do adult activities as well; volleyball in the pool, some water exercises, and also wine tasting.
We were talked into doing the “talk” of the Meliá Circle, they will push this on you(once you do it, they leave you alone :)We decided to give it a shot but ended up not getting it it we got  a discount to use it on anything we want, so we did “Xplor” it is a theme park in Playa Del Carmen, for the whole day. It was AMAZING; zip lining, river swim, Jeep rides through the caves, hammock zip lining, I mean everything was included, we had a total blast, I would highly recommend this, you sacrifice a whole day because the bus picks you up around 7 in the morning and you don’t get back until 6:30 ish at night, but so worth it. (Everything is included in the amount even food and drinks). 

5. Services are all over the place, there is always someone checking in if you need anything.

6. We used the app to do dinner reservations or called ahead of time. Some nights we did room service. ( if you are a big group, highly recommend booking earlier, especially with COVID, the maxim they can seat at a table is 6) 

7. Yhi Spa: sooooo relaxing, Danielle made me so relaxed, did this the morning before our flight back and so glad I did 😊. 

8. Outdoor photos did our family photoshoot and they are at the resort as well. Amazing photos from them. They even sent us a family album that got delivered to our home :). 

In general we had a super amazing time and planning on going back over and over again. My husband and I will do the Reserve if we go by ourselves but as a family I don’t see the need of it.  

What a great find this place was true Paradise on earth and already looking forward to our next adventure here!

reviews.author: Sebastian C
reviews.title: Great stay and great service
reviews.text: Stayed at “The Reserve” portion of the hotel and have a great time. Views where incredible from the ocean side view, food was solid, and we always had a drink in our hands. The staff was very friendly and we had a great butler named Rodolfo who went out of his way to make the experience better. Would love to visit and stay here again!

reviews.author: Kennidie A
reviews.title: Family trip 2021
reviews.text: Eddy and Agustin were the most fun outgoing people! Every night was so much fun with them! They knew how to keep the party going and make sure everyone was having a good time. Everyone is so happy and willing to help. This is the best vacation I have ever been on and the service was phenomenal!

reviews.author: Shaelynn Wright
reviews.title: Family trip 2021
reviews.text: The hotel was amazing. The staff is amazing. Eddy, Augustin, and ismael were all super nice and helpful. I would definitely come back to this resort. My friend broke her ankle while we were there and they were all so helpful and nice!

reviews.author: Melanie
reviews.title: The best vacation at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Our family (4 couples) stayed at the Paradisus Cancun in January 2021. We booked The Reserve Ocean View rooms. They took our temperature upon arrival and made sure we saw the hand sanitizing stations throughout the resort. W be e felt very safe during our entire stay. We were greeted with drinks and check-in was very smooth and quick. We met our concierge- Rodolfo- who is the absolute best. My husband and I read a few reviews before our trip, and every review mentioned Rodolfo by name and had so many wonderful things to say about him. So of course we were thrilled when he introduced himself as our concierge. He checked on us every day and made all of our dinner reservations for us. He also made sure our mini bar in each of our rooms were stocked with our favorite things. 
The resort practiced social distancing and guests were encouraged to wear masks while walking through the hotel. There were not many people there and some days it felt like we had the pool all to ourselves. 
All of the meals we had were fabulous! Every restaurant was delicious and offered amazing food and service. Rodolfo arranged a special surprise for my in-laws for their 50th birthdays and recorded a birthday song for them. We played this video of Rodolfo playing the guitar while the restaurant brought out a special dessert and champagne during our last dinner! It was so special and amazing. I can’t thank them enough for making that such a memorable surprise for them! 
Avenue bar was also fun in the evenings. They had some great and entertaining shows there. Karina waited on us every night and by the second day, knew all of our drink requests by heart! She took very good care of us as well! 
All in all, especially during COVID, we had an amazing vacation. This is the second time my husband and I have stayed at this resort and it will definitely not be our last. We love it here! 
Thank you again to Rodolfo! I feel like we gained another family member. He made our trip even better! We all highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Ariel M
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!!!
reviews.text: I loved this resort! I was impressed from my initial entrance until my departure. The resorts signature welcome drink is a must have. Our concierge Galdino, was personable, warm, and always available to help. He went above and beyond! The resort is impressive in size and beauty. The calming ponds, waterfalls, and foliage were delightful. The food was delicious in every single one of the many restaurant choices available. Vento was my favorite! All of the staff were friendly. Most notably, we received stellar service from Miguel & Jenny at La Palapa; and Orlando at Fuego. They became friends that I look forward to seeing when I return. I was very concerned about vacationing during the pandemic. However, the resort made every precaution to sanitize and keep us all safe. The many choices for places on the beach, by the poolside and in the resort to have fun and relax make me look forward to visiting again and again!!!

reviews.author: Sean Murphy
reviews.title: 10/10 Amazing vacation!!!
reviews.text: It was my family’s first trip to Cancun and Paradisus was absolutely amazing! The service was top notch. DJ Eddy had the dance floor going on silent disco night. Also Augustin showed us how to salsa so we wouldn’t look lost on the dance floor. We loved it and we definitely plan to come back.

reviews.author: Pádraig Ó
reviews.title: Holiday in Cancun
reviews.text: Food, concierge service, wait service, all outstanding. Augustin very friendly and knowledgeable. David also.  Pool, beach, what more can you ask?  We'll be back.  My son found the place and AAA wrapped it up the package.

reviews.author: Nomad285557
reviews.title: Winter Getaway In Cancun
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay! Hot tub on the deck was super. The activities were guided by Agustín. I really wasn’t going to do the activities but I saw others making colorful jute tote bags and I came late and wanted to make one and they let me. Then Agustino gave us dance lessons. Also an informative tequila tasting.
Our waiters were so helpful, I don’t remember their names.

reviews.author: Mayda M
reviews.title: Birthday Vacation at Paradisus-Cancun
reviews.text:
Loved the resort inside and out. 
Blue skys and beautiful ocean view from our room in the 4th floor.  It was breathtaking! The inside of the Hotel was stunning beautiful. Lots of life plants and fish ponds. The check in, went smoothly with the help of Melina and Sandra who greeated us with kindness.  The foods was good in some of their restaurants but the buffet was my favorite. Lots to choose from and everything was delicious and fresh. The servers were all kind and on point with their face masks and very cautious when serving. 
The room temperature was not the best as  it was set it at 73F.  We were dying of hotness in December...lol. we did adressed the issue to the Hotel Manager Christian who tried to acomodate us although it was really not much they can do about it.  They tried to get the A/C to work best but it just wasn't working.  He upgraded our room and amenidades. He even made it special for me on my Birthday. He wanted to make sure we were well taking care of for the inconvenience. Everything  else was close to perfection so we put that incident aside and enjoyed every single day of our staying.
The ocen was cold but the days were sunny and beautiful. The pools were very cold but we were able to get in on our last two days.  Drinks were ok but could been better. I will defenetly visit Paradisus in the future again!

reviews.author: 758toniac
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text:
Our family vacation at the Paradisus was absolutely fantastic. It is a gorgeous Resort with beautiful grounds and restaurants. Everything was very clean and we felt very safe with all Covid Rules in forced. The service and the staff was outstanding from the bartenders, waiters, housekeeping and I can not say enough about our concierge, Rodolfo! He took such good care of all 8 of us. He made sure all our needs and wishes were met. We will definitely be going back and can not wait for our next visit! 

The Cannon Family

reviews.author: nagendra sharma
reviews.title: Family recreation
reviews.text: Very good beach. Very good hotel. Friendly staff and services. But the ‘all inclusive’ is quite deceptive. Many or the best facilities are exclusively for those who pay extra. This is deception. The website shows all the facilities are available in all inclusive, but once you are there, You are barred to use some prime facilities ie Bar, Restaurants and huts along pool and beach. Quite frustrating and humiliating.

reviews.author: Ella
reviews.title: Honest Review
reviews.text:
This is a straight up honest review of what I think of this place. And I’m going to make this short and sweet. 

Service and hospitality: 8/10 
The desk area when you check in is brutal, takes way too long to check in or if you have to change your room keys or something. Mar in the front is super sweet she’s amazing. Loved her. But check in It’s honestly really annoying. The servers and waiters are AMAZING!!! 

Rooms: 9/10
we were upgraded to the luxury ocean room view and it was nice, very clean and well kept. The beds are so so regarding comfort. But not so bad. There’s a safe box, washrooms are nice and spacious and clean. 

Beach and pool: 10/10
spectacular!!! The beach is amazing, very well kept. People are always cleaning the beach and pools so it’s nice. No seaweed in the water. Water is clear and beautiful. 

Food: 2/10 
I hate to say it but the food garbage. It honestly ruins the whole experience.

reviews.author: mexy p
reviews.title: Superbe service and experience!
reviews.text: We spent the night of the 31st of December 2020 to state the New Year, and we had a blast! From check in to check out everything was great. We stayed in a beautiful spacious suite in the Reserve section. It was literally ocean front and with many amenities. The Reserve area is adults only, and entitled us to have a private check in and Butler assigned. The Paradisus in Cancun is a gorgeous resort, and it has recently been remodeled: restaurants and some furniture have changed and are now even more luxurious. The Reserve section is great: quiet and full of extra services like a private internal space with all day long buffet, private pool and access to the beach with bali beds and private restaurants, besides the great ones inside the hotel. Our concierge was Cristhian and he took great care of us, always checking on us by whatsapp and in person, despite being the busiest time of the year. We had a romantic delicious dinner at the Italian restaurant, great menu and service by Jimmy, who speaks many languages and has a good sense of humor. The chief of maintenance, Mr Juan Carlos Arenas helped us having the best experience all over our staying. New Years party by the pool and the beach was fantastic! And on the next day we had our meals at La Palapa and Malva, both delicious and with great service. Melina at the private Reserve lounge helped us having a late check out and was super helpful the whole time. We enjoyed a lot pool and private beach beds, with snacks and open bar. The staff is incredible, and we highly recommend a vacation at Paradisus Cancún by Meliá: exclusive brand, great accomodations, food and service. We just want to go back soon!!

reviews.author: Symara B
reviews.title: Vacations in paradisus
reviews.text: Shows is very wasome, specially Mr. Agustin, and Karina with the jumping fitness, the hotel is very wonderfull... the food and the entertainment is very nice, my favorite restaurant in Vento, Mr. Iran is very polite and attention guy.., I love everything

reviews.author: CBH487
reviews.title: Great Experience Pre/Post New Years
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Reserve section of Paradisus Cancun (12/30/2020 – 1/4/2021); building 5, suite 5710 (7th-top floor, oceanfront, sunrise view, end unit next to the Marriott – PRICELESS view/sounds of the Caribbean Sea). Our overall experience was incredibly good.  Very relaxing vacation.  We were also assigned the TripAdvisor Celeb – Rodolfo.  He is professional, responsive, attentive and results driven, every time we required his services.  Please note, we typically have a personal concierge, at all our all-inclusive vacations; so, we did not experience anything above-and-beyond the concierge experience.  However, this level of service is always good to have to fill in the blanks for hit/miss and enjoying the extra perks: worry-free or last-minute dinner reservations, quiet sections, The Reserve only snack and bar section, Bali-beds, hiccups with the App, etc.

The ENTIRE staff that we encountered were attentive, friendly, courteous, respectful and professional.  We did not expect a negative experience with any of the staff -- it is just their culture.

Enjoyed:
1.	Vento, Mole and Bana restaurants (tasty food and good number of selections)
2.	Most restaurants except Enso are near each other, building 3 (easy to find)
3.	Room service, prompt, and options were good for: breakfast, lunch, and/or dinner (we ate ALL our breakfasts in our room – to avoid as much public contact).  
4.	Our breakfast on the LAST day was not the best. You are on vacation so remain open-minded as you will not get your orders correct and/or inconsistent.  Room service coffee orders were not the same, taste and strength any of our 5 mornings, but still good.
5.	The Melia App is a Lifesaver – you can find all services in the App, scroll through it, and become acclimated.  You can make your own reservations through the app as well as get all the info on the daily activities schedule and happenings on the property.
6.	Check the App before you leave the check-in desk and if not working let the person who checks you in figure it out for you.  Or, close out the App and log back in (don't complain about it not working).  We had absolutely NO issues with the App and it was extremely helpful.  We relied mostly on the App so that our concierge, Rodolfo, can focus on more important tasks/issues (he has many other guests assigned to him).   Thank you, Rodolfo.
7.	Apple water and the lamb (wrapped in some sort of white wrap) at Blue Agave were the best things "I" had from the menu.  The chicken taco was edible but bland (even with all the fixings)
8.	Lobster tails at Malva’s was the “save” from the Fuego fiasco of a menu.  However, not sure if the universe set it that way or how often lobster tails are available for dinner at Malva’s.
9.	French toast was delicious for room service and LaPalapa – (comparable and better than a cinnamon bun from Panera Bread).  My first time having French toast.  My husband eats it all the time and said it was the best French toast ever.
10.	Bali beds, any areas, were a plus; calling out Aaron on empty Bali beds and locations and saying ‘not’ available when they remain empty an entire day (possibly work on schedule/time management)
11.	Excellent cleaning service: Fresh, clean sheets, large towels (not plush), robes, and slippers 
12.	Casual attire dining was a relief for NOT having my husband wear long pants in hot/humid weather A++

Not So Much:
1.	We did not enjoy Fuego, Enso, nor Blue Agave restaurants – (please note:  we will never all like, want or enjoy the same types of food/things) - menu choices were limited, unappealing, horrible, and/or bland for the most part.
2.	If you are into shots from the bars, then you are good
3.	To the bartenders’ defense, they do not have a lot to work with and/or they are not in the ‘know’ or creative in mixed drinks.  Do not even think about ordering: Blueberry Lemon Drop, Long Island Iced Tea, Vodka Collins, Bombay Breeze, Dark and Stormy, etc.  (Easy Fix Suggestion: management provides drink recipes to their bartenders).  Their focus is on mojitos and mudslides (we do not all drink the same drinks).  Either the Grey Goose is watered down or its local vodka in those pretentious bottles.
4.	Great raspberry cosmos, passion fruit drinks and strawberry daiquiris.  Note: I have a low tolerance for hard liquor so after 3 grey goose raspberry cosmos, I should be floored – NOPE, I had 5 and felt no buzz (except for the 1st one)/able to walk straight.  Just sayin’!  I’m not a drinker.
5.	Some of the photos posted are misleading (i.e. lobster plates on the beach services are $50 or 100,000 awards points - it is NOT inclusive, etc.)  

We did not attend any large gatherings/events, indoors or outdoors – less exposure, the better.

We did not see any difference in service whether we tipped or not; however, we tipped as staff are risking their lives to accommodate guests.

We would return here, mainly due to the views, ambiance, relaxation, Caribbean Sea with priceless sounds, Bali-beds and knowing what restaurants to avoid and how to better maneuver our stay.  Love the cute keepsake bracelets.  The grounds, internal décor: plants and fishes are therapeutic.  Thank you so very much to every staff member for a lovely, much needed, holiday break.

reviews.author: Mara
reviews.title: Amazing experience and vacation
reviews.text: Welcoming atmosphere and people. Saul and eddy are great employees. Enjoyed Spanish and dancing lessons. Amazing massage, interactive activities, quality service, thankful to meet amazing people. Quality and happy employees.

reviews.author: Kelly L
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
I just got home from Paradisus Cancun and if I didn't have to work for a living I would be back tomorrow. We stayed at The Reserve, which was well worth it for the use of the Balibeds, the adults only restaurant for breakfast and lunch, the snacks and cocktails on the ground floor of our pyramid, and of course, our Butler. Our Butler was Violeta, who was so kind and so helpful. She made reservations for us every night (which was necessary- we saw many people get turned away) and made herself available to answer all of our questions and take care of all of our needs. 
The staff diligently followed Covid 19 protocols. Everything was very clean and very safe. There was also an app that made things run smoothly.

reviews.author: Dreahawk
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!
reviews.text: I stayed for one week along with my best friend. This was literally the best vacation ever, there are so many different restaurants to choose from, all the food was absolutely delicious. I also had a massage at the spa it was the best massage I’ve ever had in my life!. The resort staff was excellent especially Galdino! I was hesitant about traveling during Covid, but the resort staff was constantly cleaning and spraying elevator buttons and the staircase handles. It was great to see that being done. I had a fabulous time and I cannot wait to go back!

reviews.author: samrozo
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: We visit this resort during Christmas 2020. The resort is Beautiful and well kept by friendly staff. The food for the most part is great, with the exception of Enso's, the Mexican style restaurant. Don't waist your calories going there. The oriental style restaurant is the best!

reviews.author: Olga G
reviews.title: Great  Restaurant Staff
reviews.text:
Overall the place is very pretty and well maintained. What really made my stay were the people working there. From the moment Julian checked me in, I felt very welcome.
Gaudencio was extremely nice and attentive during breakfast and lunch! He was very helpful and took the time to find out if there was anything I needed.  It just felt very natural and genuine, not forced because it is his job! I also loved the staff working at the spa. David did my massage and he was very professional and actually listened to what I wanted. I really enjoyed my visit to the spa. 
Overall the staff were very nice, polite and professional. There was something real and they made my stay very pleasant.

reviews.author: Maria B
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: Our experience was wonderful at Enzo! We had incredible service from Raphael, Louis, and Nicholas. They were all great servers. The food was wonderful. Appetizers and main courses were delicious. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Matt Morales
reviews.title: December 2020 trip
reviews.text: This was our second time visiting the Meliá Paradisus and we haven’t been dissapointed. We stayed in the reserve again and our butler Rodolfo handled everything we asked for and more. He was available 24/7 and organized our plans before we even asked. Anyone who gets to work with him is lucky. We also had Aaron at the pool arrange Bali beds every day, catering to our specific locations. Everyone was welcoming and helpful. The covid precautions were evident as all staff wore maks and the hotel was at 30%. We always felt safe on our stay. Everything remained open despite the reduced capacity it felt. I would recommend visiting for anyone on the fence.

reviews.author: taylorhodges
reviews.title: Christmas Trip
reviews.text: Great stay and the staff were awesome during the Christmas break - espcially Christmas Day!  Miguel in the resturant and beach area was fantastic.  He was very attentive and friendly throughout our stay

reviews.author: Cole
reviews.title: Mehhhh - Wouldn’t recommend or go back
reviews.text:
Resort overall is beautiful with amazing ocean views and clean beaches. We stayed at the grand reserve ocean view, the best part of the room being the ocean view & huge porcelain bathtub. The beds were VERY VERY uncomfortable and we got bit by some kind of bugs. The room’s mini bar was not automatically stocked daily and we had to call. Room service food was gross & barely edible.
