The overall resort food was mediocre at best, the highlight being the breakfast buffets. The dinners were not very good at all. Bana did however have good sushi. The house alcohol was watered down, the wines were not good, I recommend sticking to beer as your safest bet.

Rodolfo our butler was amazing & provided us with above & beyond service!!! Service on the beach under the Palapa’s was fantastic as well! 

The YHI spa was also great! I recommend Gemma, as she gave the most relaxing message! Take into consideration that no place on the property has a hot tub, not even the spa which is supposed to.... The water is Luke warm at best. 

Overall for the price of this all inclusive I would recommend just staying at a regular resort and venturing out to other restaurants to eat. We ate at Crabhouse and Fred’s seafood both were fantastic and across the street. We stayed at a Meliá in Dominican Republic and felt that the rooms were cleaner and comfier and that the food there overall was MUCH better than the Paradisus. This was a bit of a let down for us. Would not go back.

reviews.author: Olivia OH
reviews.title: Perfect vacation
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed here for Christmas and the new year. Our butler Rodolfo made our stay absolutely perfect. He did everything we needed and was always available when we needed him. He treated us like family. He went above and beyond to make sure our stay was care free and enjoyable. I would definitely recommend Rodolfo to anyone looking to stay here at the reserve. Rodolfo and ALL the staff at Paradisus were the friendliest and most hard working staff I’ve ever had at a resort. I will definitely be coming back here in the future.

reviews.author: auroradorothy
reviews.title: Amazing Customer Service
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve - definitely worth the difference in price especially if you want to be in the Adults Only side AND have a butler. Our butler was Rodolfo and he was extremely accommodating and responsive to our requests! I highly recommend requesting Rodolfo for anyone staying at the Reserve - you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Aiden
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text: Phenomenal time at Paradisus Cancun, biggest highlights were food at Mole and especially the service from Rodolfo and the rest of the staff. Highly recommend! Great pool and beach options, the Reserve is worth checking out for the additional access, privacy, and amenities.

reviews.author: Shawn D
reviews.title: Excellent Resort and Staff
reviews.text:
We stayed here from Dec. 23-27. Everything was excellent. We stayed in the reserve area and were treated like royalty from check in to check out. Being an all inclusive I was looking forward to the food being ok to bad but there was always something that was very good to eat everyday at every meal. The staff especially Martin, who was our waiter most mornings and afternoons was superb. After the first day, he knew our drink order and that we needed a high chair as we travelled with our 2 year old. 

The resort was immaculate and the staff was always wear masks and adhering to social distancing. The resort is a bit older and you can tell that in some parts but it’s very well maintained. I assume to saltwater has a lot to do with it. We had an issue with our AC not working/leaking but it was fixed very quickly. Our personal butler, Rodolfo made our dinner reservations each night. He even made us one at a restaurant called Harry’s which was down the street from the resort. I highly recommend it. Lastly, this place makes the best margaritas I’ve ever had! Everything was five stars and we are already planning a return trip!

reviews.author: Rob S
reviews.title: Great all inclusive resort. Great price
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I visited the paradisus resort in December 2020 over Christmas holidays. The resort in the accommodations are top-notch. The rooms are very comfortable with great amenities like big giant bathtubs and plenty of room to relax. We stayed in the Reserve, which is adult only and was a great break from our busy schedule at home with kids. Our Butler Rodolfo was fantastic. I would definitely ask for him again. Each of us had two massages during our trip and we liked the spa. Liliana was a great masseuse. The only thing that could have been better is the food. We liked the food enough, but there were certainly a few meals that were just mediocre. The staff was super friendly and helpful and always willing to accommodate us. And for an all-inclusive resort, they don't skimp on the alcohol.

reviews.author: Melynda C
reviews.title: 14 Night Stay - Family Vacation
reviews.text: Stayed at Paradises Cancun for a 14 night stay on this great property. The hotel was exceptionally clean, taking safe measures due to Covid. The staff was very friendly and Rene & Manual was outstanding serving us around the main pool area. Anny & Liliana provided us very relaxing professional spa services which I would highly recommend. We stayed in tower 3 with a lovely Ocean View on the 7 floor. We will certainly enjoy another vacation on this property!

reviews.author: Marissa N
reviews.title: Meliá Paradisus
reviews.text: Great hotel !!! Victor, Julio and Janeth were the best team at buffet and restaurant!!! Always attentive, great service and always gave us everything we needed !!! Really made our stay exceptional!!!! Great hotel!!!! You will enjoy it !!!

reviews.author: Christine F
reviews.title: Luxury Dive Vacation
reviews.text:
Royal Service certainly describes the pampering we've received here in our Royal Service Junior Suite Lagoon View.

They have thought of everything.  From a beach bag to use during your stay to sunscreen and bronzing oils poolside.  Even a free transfer to and from the airport  which was seamless. 

Each guest is assigned a butler that schedules all of your reservations,  answers all questions and is ready to serve whenever you need them. 

The Bali Beds, reserved by your butler are available for lounging pool and oceanside and are included for Royal service.  Amazing waitstaff ensure you always have a drink in hand and food to eat whenever your heart desires.  Luxury retreat at its finest!

Aquaworld Staff is onsite to schedule dives,  and all trips leave from their shop across the street from Paridisus. We brought our own gear,  so carrying it up and down the stairs was the only part that gave us a workout. 

The Aquaworld dive staff washed all our gear with fresh water,  so all we had to do was put it on the balcony to dry out before the trek home.

While this may not be your typical dive resort,  it sure fit the bill for us this trip.  Reviews of our dives have been posted at Aquaworld.

Bring cash for tips... while not expected,  many deserve it.  You'll want to tip them ❤

reviews.author: JF, Toronto
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: The Paradisus was one of the best experiences I have had in Mexico. Having stayed at other chains in Playa del Carmen, Puerto Plata, Cozumel and Cabo, the biggest difference was the staff. They were professional, pleasant and attentive. I would especially like to give a shout out to Christian Lovera who served us in the buffet and to Salvador who served us at Coco’s. The rooms were clean and the house-keeping on time and regular. Always fresh towels and a clean room after a day at the beach or by the pool. I would also note that the air conditioning was consistent and once we set the desired temperature, the house keeping staff did not re-adjust it higher (a practice we have often experienced). The food was very good. The buffet provided a wide selection including meat, fish, pasta, multiple salad choices, fresh fruit and various bread and desserts. Unfortunately, the Market Grill (the steak restaurant) was closed for restoration while we were there so we decided to eat out one night at Fred’s across the street. We had some problems with our room safe and our door locks but the hotel staff was on the job within minutes to fix the issues. There were a couple of things that could have been improved. The entre portions at Mole were so small we went to the buffet afterwards. The Japanese restaurant (Bana) had good food but the service could have been better. It took almost an hour to get our entre. One final thing; in the evening the hotel burns scented candles. I am sure they do this to try to create a nicer ambience but  one needs to like that sort of thing. It mainly just gave me a headache. Over all, it was a great week. The pool was excellent, There were always chairs available. The beach is very clean and the Paradisus has done a good job of creating a space on the beach where the merchants don’t bother you too much. I would go back to this resort in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Ashley Jordan
reviews.title: Amazing experience at the Paradisus
reviews.text: My husband and I recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for a week mid January and had a wonderful time. The food was incredible, the newly renovated room was superb, the spa was fantastic, and the pools were great. The evening entertainment was enjoyable at the resort and the night market on Thursday evening was really, really great. We had initially booked just a standard experience there but were persuaded to upgrade our check in and it made all the difference. With the Royal service we were granted a much better room upgrade, a personal butler, a la carte reservations 7 full nights instead of the typical 2, access to La Palapa pool side restaurant, access to the Royal pool side, and full access to the spa water therapies section with included the sauna, steam room, sauna, etc. Everyone was super sweet and we really, really enjoyed ourselves

reviews.author: Yuri K
reviews.title: Vacation with 6 adults and 3 babies - AMAZING
reviews.text: When traveling with 3 children under the age of 2.5 years old, relaxation and full enjoyment are not always terms that come to mind, unless you stay at Paradisus Cancun. The staff, facilities, and activities were incredibly well suited for 3 families traveling together with small children. All the restaurants catered to our kid's needs and were ready with high chairs, food options, etc. Enso stood out the most from the restaurants (attributable fully to Jose, the waiter). He saw we had kids, made selections for them and us so we do not have to worry about looking through a menu and took incredible care of us. We were so happy with his service we returned again to him on our last night. The pools were very nice, as well, and well suited for families with children of all ages. There was plenty of seating area and the waiters in the pool area were incredible. Here I will highlight Sofonia who took amazing care of us bringing us drinks daily and remembering our orders everyday. All-in-all I would highly recommend this hotel for families with children of all ages! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Joey Batchelor
reviews.title: Couples 4 Day Weekend- sewage leak at Royal Service Pool area awful smell
reviews.text: Booked Royal Service with 3 couples.  Concierge and Butler service was very good (Alex).  Rooms were nice and clean.  Food in onsite restaurants was ok, buffet food was high quality and very good. We paid extra for Royal Service which have us access to private pool and beach area.  Last 2 days of trip couldn’t even go to our private pool because of major sewage leak and horrible smell.  Kind of ruined our trip since the private pool area was our reason for paying extra.  Very disappointed with this matter.

reviews.author: Fatima Taha
reviews.title: Wonderful Trip w/staff that treat you like Family!!
reviews.text:
My recent family vacation at Paradisus was amazing! I cant begin to say enough  about the staff here. We met so many AMAZING staff members that truly made us feel like family! Our personal Butler for the week, Jaime was one of a kind. Went above and beyond to ensure our trip was relaxing and enjoyable, thank you SO much Jaime!!
The other staff members I MUST thank from Malva/Fuego are Capitan Aaron Oropeza, Alejandro- you were my daughters favorite! I'm sure you preparing a special Pink Panther drink for her helped ;-) , Armando and Gaudencio- you were all TRULY SPECTACULAR!! My family and I thank you from the bottom of our hearts for helping make this an unforgettable trip!!  You know an employee is doing an exceptional job when young children brag about them, which my children did many times!

I almost forgot, I feel bad that I cant remember his name, but the very nice gentleman at the Espresso shop was also great. He knew my drink order before I even told him, and it was always tasty!! 

None of us wanted to leave at the end of our trip  We miss you all already and look forward to future visits at Paradisus, mainly because of the awesome and personal service we received from each and every one of you! Mucho gracias for all that you did for us!! :-)

The resort itself is very beautiful, especially for being one of the older hotels in the Paradisus chain. The view from our ocean front balcony was breath taking! The beach itself is one of the cleaniest beaches I've seen in Mexico- no seaweed or rocks. Aside from the waves being a bit stronger than I would I have liked for my younger children, the resort has a very large, white sandy beach with beautiful blue water!

The pool areas are kept clean with shallow pools for young children and deeper for older children and adults. I believe the deepest was maybe 6ft. The staff in the pool area are very attentive. 

As for the food, the buffet at Malva was probably our favorite for all meals of the day because it had something for eveyone in my family. The salmon burger at Fuego was also very tasty!

Overall, this trip was great, and I would definitely return in the future!

reviews.author: Ishaan C
reviews.title: What a beautiful property
reviews.text:
OMG! What a beautiful place with Blue Water and inside the hotel cleanliness,Amazing Smell with fresh Flowers, well kept, We were amazed with the special service near by pool by SERGIO and DAVID and our Cabanas were so beautiful, we will definitely come back again and I will give 10Stars if I had option.

Thanks Guys.

reviews.author: Mon W
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time at Paradisus Cancun. The staff treated us like family and always made sure my kids and my husband and I were taken care of. We had no issues with reservations or bali beds. The family concierge took care of everything - Rodolfo and Violeta went above and beyond for us! Also, Elliot the pool manager was wonderful! We will def be back. Our Family Suite was beautiful - the pics online don't do it justice!

reviews.author: Lisa W
reviews.title: Nespresso
reviews.text: Orlando Bello at the Nespresso coffee shop was wonderful!  Very cheerful and helpful every morning!  Delicious drinks every time with a smile.  Great way to start each day of my week vacation!  Thank you!

reviews.author: blamacias
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: This was our second trip to Paradisus. We used the royal service. Our Butler this time, Alex, was absolutely wonderful. Love him! The food was a little less than last time but still better than other all inclusives we've stayed at. Planning our 3rd trip for our daughters college graduation present.

reviews.author: mikegS2957PH
reviews.title: who is rating this place?????
reviews.text:
we were at the jw.marriott wanted to extend our vacation but they were booked.  we booked the paradisus based on the ratings.  walked down the beach to see what we had  booked and began to hear a horrible bass thumping.  it was the 5 star paradisus playing 120 decible boggie bass thumping music and the tattooed residents enjoying it all.  went back to the jw for the last night in fear of the next three days.  checked in around noon and instantly smelled strong mildew and i started wheezing.  the checkin gal was, on the surface, very helpful but i knew what was coming.....timeshare pitch.  i yelled at her in loud enough to be heard over the thumping music NOOOOOOO!!!  asked the bellman if the place flooded and he said the place was full of sand and water last hurricane.  unfortunately the place was not gutted.  took us to the room in tower 5 i thing and it smelled.  we figured we could deal with it at least we got free meals................................called the restaurants and all booked for the 3 days we were there ,but there was always the burger bar and taco salad bar. yum.   looked online and the jw marriott had some cancellations we left and never went back spent $1099 for 3 nights of zeroness.  
moral of the story...UNLESS YOU HAVE VERY LOW STANDARDS,ARE LESS THAN 30, AND HAVE NEVER BEEN TO A GOOD HOTEL,  DO NOT BOOK THIS HOTEL!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Andoriyu J
reviews.title: New Years Holiday at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
My partner and I have stayed at Paradisus twice before the most recent one during New Years week in 2019.  I would just to add that the hotel management just knows how to do it right every time.  It comes down to the staff, their training and attentiveness.  From the time you walk in and drop off your bags,  they have hosts to take you to you your room.  We stayed in room service and we checked in from there.  I really liked the check in process.  They go through everything with you and provide with the all the activites, maps, and wifi-- all the essentials that guest ask.  
This review is really a Thank You and shout out of all the staff that make my trip there just simply amazing.  What was really great that they remembered me and were actually happy to see us again.  
So I would personally would like recognize the followiing staff members:
1.  My Butler Kenia-- super sweet and keeps in in loop throught texting
2.  Valeria- from the Royal Service and LaPalapa
3.  Antonio-Royal Service
4.  Eddie- Royal Service
5.  Lazaro- Royal Service
6.  Victor-Royal Service
7.  Julio- Royal Service
8.  Gemma- massage therapist
9.  Sofia-  massage therapist
10.  Edgar- Spa attendant Yhi

All of these people make some of the best attitudes  and service dedication that I have come across.   There are more actually but I have did not have a change to take their name.  But thank-you for the memories and the things to do for guest at Melia Cancun

reviews.author: Gray52
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach. Downhill Fast From There
reviews.text:
Let me preface this review by saying this was our 7th different all-inclusive (6 in Cancun/Playa del Carmen, 1 in Punta Cana). This our first trip without the entire family. People giving this place 5-star reviews apparently don't stay at many high end resorts. This place is in no way worthy of 5-stars. 
THE GOOD: 
The beach is the best we've ever been. The resort is extremely wide, and the water was stunningly turquoise blue. We got lucky, as there was no seaweed at all during our stay. Unfortunately, that's where "the good" ends. Ladies beware... there are 4 toilets total on the entire beach, two at each end of the main area. None of them are well maintained. 
THE BAD:
Food - The food was, without question, the worst of any resort we've ever been. Their best restaurant was on par with most of the bad we've had at other resorts. Nothing seemed cooked fresh. Everything is cooked into large lots and stored in open areas, and is cold by the time it's served. When it reaches your table/buffet, nothing was hot, or even warm. When we checked in, the staff touted how the buffet was all new and the food was improved. The wife and i were starving, so we headed there to check it out. We were shocked at the limited selections to choose from, and the lack of cooked-to-order selections. Most food items were empty every time we ate the buffet (mostly breakfast), so we stood around expecting a replacement. Nope. So i asked. Out came food. COLD EGGS, COLD BEEF, COLD CHICKEN. It was ridiculous. The next three nights we tried a la carte. It tasted like they pulled the food off the buffet, put it onto a plate, and served it up. Nothing was hot like you'd expect from an a la carte. Most people go to a higher end all-inclusive for good food. This is not one of those resorts.
BALI BEDS are $160/day. That's right, $160/day! and the bed itself is hard as a rock. DO NOT reserve one on the beach. There's a large double stack of speakers at each end of the bali bed setup, and the DJ plays music all.day.long. and it's LOUD. Think Metallica concert loud. Not an exaggeration. POOLSIDE SEATING -  There just isn't even close to enough seating around the pools. There's not even close to enough poolside seating for this resort. We were told the resort was at 80% capacity, and there were people sitting all over the concrete and in the grass areas... and that was at 11am in the morning! There is very limited shade umbrellas for the chairs, and no small tables to hold your drinks. I felt so badly for people arriving each day at noon, not finding a single chair just to put their stuff. Im not sure, but i'm thinking this is on purpose, to get people to rent their $160/day bali beds. POOL BAR had 1 bartender each day we were there. There'd be 20 people at the swim-up area and 1 bartender, so waiting for a drink was excruciating. Drinks were stiff, however, so there's that.
ROOMS - The rooms are TINY. It was just my wife and I and we barely fit. They are extremely clean, however (might have been the $5/day we left housekeeping). DO NOT stay in the main tower. It is loud. Music blared up from the all-night bands/DJ's well into 1-2:00am. We were awoken many times... kinda like a frat party. lol. Overall, there are so many other places that cost about the same that are much better. Moon Palace, Hilton Play del Carmen, and even Paradisus Play del Carmen come to mind. Save the frustration and book elsewhere.

reviews.author: Curlies
reviews.title: Relaxing in royal service
reviews.text:
We had a brilliant relaxing holiday in royal service. It's the sixth visit to the hotel. A high level summary: our luxury sea view room was comfortable, relaxing massage is spa was great, the majority of staff - excellent, coctails - delicious, beach and good size pool - clean and with stunning views, service - very good. A special mention goes to Cesar serving at La Palapa and pool area - Cesar exceeds 'customer expectations' offering excellent service which we noticed it on a number of occassions. La Palapa is our favourite spot for breakfast (and lunch unless we eat in bali bed) - staff and service are always excellent in this beach front restaurant. The hotel grounds are clean. During our stay there were maintanance work in piramid 5 grounds (incl. work in a few bali beds). Slightly disappointing to hear about closure of Tempo. Menu in other hotel restaurants changed since our visit last summer - Fuego used to be our favourite restaurant but that is no longer the case after changes to menu - unless you like ceviche etc. Par 3 golf course is a  nice addition - bring plenty balls - if you miss the green its hard to find them in a thick grass. Moreover there are a few 18 holes courses worth a visit within a short driving distance. I miss relaxing in bali bed after Morning golf. Our buttler took care of the requests. All you have to do is relax in paradise. 
Over the years we noticed cost cutting trend in Paradisus  - small things but noticeable to returning visitors - eg. no sweet snacks in room bar, no chocolates left on bed by turn down service, less amenities in room (toiletiers), royal service lobby bar seemed to have less selection of alcohol, no goodbye gift from hotel, no surprise sparkling wine in room from the buttler.... again, these are small things and would not stop us coming back. Improvement is needed to pre arrival communication - we got in touch by email months in advance without response (chased multiple times which finally resulted in response from hotel). This shouldnt be the case in 5 star hotel an
If you look for adult only relaxing holiday (without loud dance party music at a pool) choose Paradisus.

reviews.author: DMH
reviews.title: One week stay
reviews.text:
Just came back from a one week stay at Paradisus. This was our second time there, the first being in 2016. I would really rate the resort 3.5 but since I can’t do half’s I would say it’s closer to a 4 than a 3. It did not meet the same standard as our first time there but was overall good. 

The grounds are large and super clean. Check in was smooth and our room was ready when we got there however they really need to relax with the time share push. The second we checked in we were given a whole schpeal about the time share breakfast and then were called three times about it to the room. We were firm and said no the first time which should have been enough. I won’t name the rep because it’s just his job and he was really nice but my goodness. 
 
The hotel is very pretty and all the restaurants are updated/new (and open), with fun perks like the Nespresso bar and Gelato station. The rooms are dated (we were building 4) and are showing signs of wear but are still nice enough and clean. The beds are soo uncomfortable, even my kids complained. Mini fridge is fully stocked with water, juice and sodas that are refilled every day and come with your all inclusive package. We had beach view with balcony and it was really pretty however we faced the area where the outdoor shows and activities are, and our second to last night there was a private event with a super annoying, off key, insanely loud live band till 11pm. They give exactly the amount of towels to person in room ratio which is frustrating and their body wash is a bad and super drying (bring your own). 

The pools always had enough seating however there is little to no entertainment, no music and besides the pool where the buffet is, the water is ice cold, even on the warmest day. They give you towel cards that if you don’t return at check out, it’s $40 a card. I remember there being a lot more action around the pools last time. Drinks are hit or miss, sometimes strong sometimes watered down. The beach is super clean, no seaweed, clear blue water and white sand. Really beautiful. 

The food is okay. There are very little vegetarian and vegan options which was an issue for us. We had options but not many and very repetitive. I do want to mention Andres at the outdoor seating in the buffet for breakfast and lunch - such a nice guy and great server, made our meals great. Mole and blue agave are 99% meat. For every one veggie dish there were 4 meat dishes. Bana is sushi and was very good, Vento is ‘Mediterranean’ and if you know what that is supposed to taste like...skip it. Enso is Thai and was eh. 

My biggest issue was the BS about reservations for the restaurants. We came during off season, the hotel was MAYBE at 35% capacity. Every time I tried to make a reservation, two days in advance as they say is necessary, the same day or even the night before - all the restaurants were booked at all hours imaginable. We did manage to get two reservations for the seven days we were there, and a third for the last day after a lot of arguing. It’s ridiculous that a hotel boasting so many restaurants can’t accommodate their guests. The supervisor I spoke to basically called me a liar when I told him that when we were at Enso it was half empty for the hour and a half we were sitting there. The wait staff, servers, pool staff etc are all so great but the higher ups like check in and customer service really lack the people skills. Majority of the restaurants were empty between 8-10 pm which further proves my point about the ridiculousness of the reservations. 

There is very very very little nightly entertainment and almost nothing for kids to do besides the kids club and the cute ceramic painting by the kids pool. There’s no playground or any sort of splash pad or really any water things for the kids. Last time we were there they had a playground that has been removed which is a shame. Cocos beach club has a cute bar and they offer hookah for like $35 which gives you three coals and a Bali bed for an hour and a half. I’m not sure what the serves name was but she was a woman, there every night during our stay, and was so nice and helpful.

Big shout out to Giovanna Diaz who was the photographer for our fam photo shoot. My girls absolutely loved her and our pictures came out so great. 

The incense is also really over powering and there is no air conditioning in the ‘common’ areas. I did like the hotel and we enjoyed our stay (aside from the time share harassment and restaurant unavailability) and would return if the price was fair, but without the kids.

reviews.author: Samer O
reviews.title: Amazing place, service is awesome, clean facility coming back soon
reviews.text: This is our second visit and we will probably go for a third, this place's service is amazing, We booked the family concierge package and it worth every penny of it. You get the VIP treatment with that, we had two staff assigned to us (Gloria and Brenda) and they helped us with every little detail, from booking a restaurant to making sure I get my decaf espresso replenished every day to make sure the minibar is stocked appropriately and help my little girls walk around the hotel to and from their rooms. My kids loved it to the point they did not want to leave. Although the food can take and upgrade on the meat side as we love steak and they don't have that with the all-inclusive plan, they did a wonderful job in giving us two dinners complimentary (wonderful experience).  I recommend the Paradisus all the way.

reviews.author: Tracy
reviews.title: Great Hotel for the whole family
reviews.text: Our family had a week long vacation at this resort and the food and atmosphere was great!  My kids enjoyed the variety of food they had at the buffet and the service was outstanding throughout the resort.  Be sure to visit Gustavio at the Coco bar, his drinks are amazing!!!!

reviews.author: JustynaB27
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
Great service ! Big thank you to Gloria and Brenda our butlers , all the servers that work at the hotel, beach and pool.
When it comes to the hotel I was not thrilled. Very limited choice of food, all restaurants are either spanish or asian, nothing to do for kids beside kids club, entertainment very poor.

reviews.author: Sungbin K
reviews.title: Excellent overall services and hotel conditions - ruined by a single instance of Circle by Melia Timeshare
reviews.text:
Some warning and/or advice: Do not be fooled into sitting to hear more about their hotel. Act like you've been there before and you're not at all interested in their Circle by Melia timeshare. No matter what they say, that's what they are trying to sell you. They won't once mention the word "Timeshare" as that must be part of their way to get people to sit and sign up. Instead, they'll sneakily offer a free 'perk' with no commitment, in exchange for some time to reserve and sit and listen to them. Again, it seems obvious, but even after multiple attempts at saying I'm not interested or that I even know what they're trying to do, they won't just stop. There must be a lot of pressure or incentive to get that first signature. Don't sign anything, don't take up their time, and I'm sure it will be fine. But I cannot recommend this hotel until they change this tactic in their management. It completely ruins the experience and I couldn't trust the rest of the staff for the remainder of the trip. I found that it's not true for the overall staff and experience as the rest of the staff was incredible. So it's only the front desk/first visit people they try to target.

I chose an ocean view family concierge experience and I don't regret it. Compared to the price difference of the lowest option to book this hotel and the concierge that comes with butler service, it really changed the whole experience for us. Each night they left a nice toy/trinket for our son and were in constant communication with us through Whatsapp. They automatically booked us reservations (we forgot about the 2nd night) to ensure us a spot. While they couldn't get us booked to a dinner that was already sold out, it did feel like they did their best to find another booking. Also, the family concierge room where you check in was a great place to get a free adult beverage, coffee, bottled water while running around the hotel.

When checking out, our flight was delayed so the front desk helped us get a taxi and it cost $27 US. This price actually beats the shuttle and as long as you have exact change (bring plenty of ones, fives, tens in US - they'll accept it), you're fine. I suggest converting a few dollars to pesos, but if you're staying at the resort, you don't need pesos at all. 

Again, this was an incredible hotel, but they're also responsible for the timeshare pitch and that's a ridiculous thing to pressure on us at the price we're paying to stay at this hotel.

reviews.author: SuzanneDube
reviews.title: the service was excellent, the employees were very welcoming and warm with the tourists
reviews.text: the service was excellent, the employees were very welcoming and warm with the tourists, the cleanliness of the hotel was excellent, the guides were very knowledgeable and interesting, the room was very clean, quality and professional services from all the employees

reviews.author: Peter F
reviews.title: First Time at Paradisus - Flying Solo!
reviews.text:
After a 2 week research/work trip to Cobá for University, I decided to spend an extra week in Cancún and take a relaxing vacation. This is my 5th time to Cancún, 4th time at a resort, but first time at Paradisus. I chose the hotel based on reviews from Trip Advisor, Google, and other websites. Let me say, it exceeded every expectation I had for it. Totally blew it out of the water. From the second you walk in here they make you feel like a VIP and treat you like royalty. And I didn’t even get the Royal Service (which I’ve heard is magnificent, by the way). Every aspect of this trip was splendid. The check-in was fantastic, the food was top-notch, the activities were out of this world, and there was so much to do around the resort!! They really like to pack it in here. I stayed for 8 days and seven nights and I’ll quickly review the benefits of the resort below.

Food: pretty sure I made it to all the restaurants except Fuego. All of them amazing. Make sure to call and get reservations ahead as they book up fast, Vento is Mediterranean style, Mole is upscale Mexican (was my favorite one), Enso is Asian Fusion (Peking Duck was scrumptious), Bana is Japanese/Sushi, and Malva is the all you can eat buffet. Honestly have not had better food at an all inclusive before.

Drinks: good and strong. The Bartenders are great. Not much else to say here! They’ll pretty much make you anything you want and have top shelf stuff at most, if not all, of the bars.

Room: very nice. I had the Junior Suite with an Ocean View. The cleaning staff was wonderful and tended to every need that I could ask for. The view was incredible. I stayed in Pyramid 1 Club Meliá, which was very nice when I wanted quiet and away from the hustle and bustle of the main pyramid. Not a negative, just a comment, but the rooms could use updating in the near future, but it looks like they are currently working on that as they have some minor construction projects happening. This did not affect the stay at all. The only issue I had was connecting to the WiFi when I first checked in, but they promptly fixed this within a few minutes of me calling reception, and I didn’t have problems the rest of my stay. Additionally, the fridge/minibar in my room stopped working later one evening, and maintenance staff was up to my room within the hour changing out the fridge for a new one. Bravo service, really.

Spa: GO TO THE SPA!! It is incredible. I believe it is included in the Royal Service Package (which I didn’t have), but I did receive a complimentary spa day package (massage included!) for attending one of the 90 minute Meliá sales presentations. Absolutely 100% worth it. I went to the sales presentation my first morning here, they were not pushy in the slightest, was unable to purchase the package they were offering (even though I wanted to as it was an enticing deal, but I am a college student on a budget), and received my spa day certificate afterwards. The Yhi Spa is incredible. The massage was EVERYTHING and David my masseuse had magic hands. Everything about the spa was amazing.

Entertainment: absolutely, utterly fantastic. They have schedules of entertainment in the lobby or available right on the Meliá app so you know what is happening throughout the day. I did so much while I was here! Went to spinning class, did a personal training session, went to the spa, water yoga, aquaerobics, Zumba, watched a Brazilian Capoeira performance, went to a silent disco party, went to a guacamole making class, learned how to make margaritas, and so much more!! They honestly have something for everyone here. And the gym facilities ‘Yhi Moves’ is top notch, especially for a gym at a hotel/resort.

Ambience/Facility: utterly breathtaking. Wow, wow, wow. I walked in and my mouth dropped. I honestly didn’t know what I walked into. This place is probably bigger than some small towns. There is so much here and it is spectacular both inside and out. The pictures you take of it don’t do it justice. The beach is sparkling white and there’s not a drop of seaweed. The pools are so clean and maintained. The vegetation inside and out is breathtaking. The atmosphere and aromas here are wonderful. Really an experience for all the senses. 

People: obviously, and finally, I couldn’t forget all of the amazing people I met! Traveling alone I was a little apprehensive, but knew I would make some new friends. I met some wonderful guests who became fast friends, but more importantly, the staff here is absolutely incredible. Every single person I have come in contact with is incredibly kind, sweet, helpful, respectful, friendly, and wants to tend to your every need. I have a few shoutouts in particular that I want to give. These people went above and beyond my already exceeded expectations and really made me feel extra special, and developed that stronger relationship/friendship with me as a guest. They are amazing and deserve awards/raises/promotions/vacations/etc.: Alan from activities, Augustin from the gym and activities, Ruth at Club Meliá reception, Norma at the Concierge desk, Julio from the gym, David a masseuse at Yhi Spa, Edgar from the gym and Yhi Spa, Laura one of the attendant’s at the main pool delivering drinks, and Jaime our bartender for the Margarita class. All of these people really made my experience here extra special.

I think that covers my stay here at Paradisus Cancún. I am terribly sad to be heading back to the freezing cold and snow filled Buffalo today, but that only means I’ll have to come back and visit again soon. I hope you find this review helpful!

reviews.author: Samantha Z
reviews.title: Disgusting, outdated, not Inclusive!
reviews.text:
Pool and hotel was dirty and in major need of renovations. Food was disgusting and meal service people didn’t wear gloves. In addition there was very little to eat for food allergic people. Kids club was not inclusive to my English speaking children and also dirty and not safe!! Whole
Place was gross!

reviews.author: vic2riad41
reviews.title: Food and Service was excellent!
reviews.text: This was a mother/daughter trip for my daughter before she went back to college, I chose this resort because of all of the reviews and we were not disappointed! Restaurants were excellent as well as the service, everyone made us feel very special esp at breakfast in the morning!! It was a fun resort but not too crazy and perfect for my daughter and I and we also went to the club a few times.. so much fun! We enjoyed the shows in the evening and we also left the resort for one day and took the local bus into town which runs every 10 minutes past the resort and went over to Isle Mujeres on the ferry, definitely worth it! It was a nice way to see the area, and we always felt safe! The only recommendation I would make it for the resort would be to add more lighting in the room, we stayed in the standard room but it was very dark and hard to get ready… Other than that I would highly recommend this resort and we definitely would come back!

reviews.author: yzdragon2012
reviews.title: Fun, relaxing
reviews.text: Everyone enjoyed the stays, the college kids and the senior parents! The beach was beautiful clean, the service was friendly and sufficient. The food was very well presented and very fresh! Love the icecream!

reviews.author: Meg C
reviews.title: Best Resort in Cancun!
reviews.text: Paradisus is by far the most beautiful and entertaining resort in Cancun! The staff go above and beyond to make the guests feel welcome and like friends. Alan, Agustin, and of course our favorite bartender Jimmy are our favorite guys! We come every year with a large group and I look forward to it more and more each time. Thank you for the wonderful stay, see you soon! 😊

reviews.author: Pete P
reviews.title: 20th anniversary
reviews.text:
Could not of had a better anniversary vacation in Cancun. Was so excited to find out that everything about the place was just as beautiful as it looked in the pictures online. The resort and the staff were amazing. Even gave us a gift of the Bali bed rental on our anniversary. 
Manuel, our waiter while we were at the Bali bed made us feel like a king and queen! Wonderful young man who loved his job. Hoping in 5 years when we go back for our 25th anniversary he is still there as a manager teaching others how to perform great service. 
The waiters at the blue aqave restaurant where we had breakfast every morning were spectacular! Cristian, Lovera, Fernando and Alfredo were so kind. Never had to ask or wait for anything. Always smiling and willing to serve my wife and I. 
Would totally recommend anyone to go there for a vacation! Want to go back this year but will have to wait.

reviews.author: Dorothy B
reviews.title: Stay at Paradisus Royal Service
reviews.text:
Check in.
Friendly...we had royal service so they offered us drinks and a seat and sent down a butler to check us in.  Nice experience. Galdino was our butler(very good at his job). Showed us around settled us in.

Rooms.  ROYAL SERVICE.  VERY nice modern, clean.  We had lagoon view (may I suggest it....fireworks nighty which was a nice surprise)
they provided nice touches for royal service.

Beach....royal service area... amazing, quite, chairs seem to always be available.  Bally beds they promise in the sale of royal service, not so much, you have to book (max 2 days in 7 day stay) there are not enough. People book for a day maybe spend 2 hrs in them. Leaving them empty for a day as all you need to do on your day of use is show up check your name, the bed is yours even if you dont end up using it. Anyways they need more Bally Beds in Royal service.

Construction...any repairs or construction was done with respect to customers.  They were working a lot on some main areas of the royal service area.

Hotel. BEAUTIFUL you can't even take it all in.  AMAZING.

Staff.  As usual the staff in Mexico will do anything to make your day. Bravo to them.
We had a few favorites.

Food.  I hear and see a lot of complaints about food.
We did not experience this.  Remember no one is cutting your tomatoes and cooking endless amounts of food for you at home.  The food was great.
Restaurants...we had one every night no issues. All of them were good.
We may have had a restuarant every night because we had a butler. We were blessed.

Overall royal service was it worth it.
Yes .....were there some let downs yes.  
But you make the vacation as good or as bad as you like.

reviews.author: 425hillary
reviews.title: Huge resort, beautiful beach
reviews.text:
We reserved a room in the royal service pyramid (#5, adults only)) as was the only place there was an ocean view room available. Nice room with comfortable king bed but view was obscured by a cement wall waist high, blocking the view when sitting in chairs provided. 
The Pros: friendly and helpful staff; bali beds around pool (but have to be reserved), large general "international" buffet (large variety of decent foods, fresh, fried, etc); very nice quiet common area with Japanese garden feel (Koi ponds, lots of trees) with all day and eve small buffet with fresh foods & alcoholic drinks; butler included (was helpful); champagne (not the best tasting) on last night in room with choc covered strawberries
The Cons: Need larger maps to find way around building (HUGE resort); simple arrows with directions on hallways to direct to common areas (very confusing to find way around buildings); an in-room listing of resort restaurants with hours of operation; some of resort areas were in need of repairs; TV stations channel listings in room. 
In general, spending 4 days by the pool/ocean, reading, swimming, walking beach (picking up 8 bags of garbage on 2 walks daily) was great!

reviews.author: Suzanna H
reviews.title: Overall Great Vacation (Family Concierge)
reviews.text:
I traveled to Paradisus Cancun for 1 week on January 11th 2020 with my husband and 5 month old daughter. We booked a junior suite ocean view room and the family concierge service with Alexa and Violeta as our butlers for the week.
- Family Concierge service : made the difference between a 4 star and a 5 star review. Alexa and Violeta went out of their way to make our stay as relaxing as possible. They booked all the restaurants and sun beds for us, had food sent to us when needed, they had a crib sent to our room within minutes of our arrival, they had our sink clogging issue resolved immediately, they were always available to answer all of our questions, they left little gifts for us and the baby every day. Family Concierge also has their own lobby so check in and check out was very fast and convenient for us. 
- Room : our room was clean, modern and spacious, our view of the ocean was beautiful, housekeeping passed twice a day, the bed was comfortable, the fridge was refilled daily
- Food : the food was NOT at a 5 star level (as we expected from previous reviews). The buffet (Malva) and the Sunset bar where you eat most of the time were just ok, the restaurant Fuego was really not good, the Blue Agave restaurant had good food, so did the Enso restaurant, the Bana restaurant had ok sushi, the room service was good (with Family Concierge room service is free), Lapalapa at the Royal Service section had good lunch (Family Concierge guests have access to the Royal Service section but you cannot bring kids), the seafood platter that came with the VIP Balibeds was amazing but it’s not included in the all inclusive package. If I were to judge the hotel just by its food I would give it a 3 star rating.
- Beach : there is no longer a seaweed problem!! The beach was beautiful : white sand and baby blue water, however it was very wavy the week we were there. There were always beach chairs available. 
- Drink service by the pool and beach : 5star service! Waiters pass by every 5 minutes to get you drinks all day
- Construction : there are comments about parts of the hotel being under construction and being loud.. we did not see nor hear any construction during our stay! 

Conclusion
- Best part of vacation : services (Family Concierge (thank you Violeta and Alexa), housekeeping, drink services by the pool and on the beach) 
- Worst part : the food was only mediocre

reviews.author: best321
reviews.title: The Best
reviews.text:
we have an outstanding experience in a beautiful resort - Cancun Mexico.
we have been part of the group of 14 people and everyone was enjoyed the stay and hopefully will be back soon in one or two years from now. thank you and all the best to Paradisus team!

reviews.author: rf999999
reviews.title: Mixed Feelings
reviews.text:
This is our second time at this location. First, it's a beautiful property. We did Royal Service both times and found it more than worth it.  The staff is amazing. The beach is perfect. The pool and cabanas are great.  The only negative, and it's a big one, is the food.  It's been about 5 years since we had been here but felt the food has gone so far downhill it's almost inedible.  With the exception of breakfast at La Palapa.  We ate at Vento, Bana, and the buffet for our short 4 day stay.  They were all terrible. Very basic, bland food. I'm really not sure how to describe it other than they found out how to maximize profit by cutting food down to the bare minimum. 
  The drinks were good, property is perfect but the food was so bad that we will be searching for new vacation spots.

reviews.author: matthew H
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text:
Food was impressive considering it is all inclusive. On par with Marriotts I have stayed at in Hawaii. Royal service staff is excellent. Our butler Alex was awesome and Rosana always went out of her way to make sure we were happy. Ask for Victor and Eddie by the pool, very attentive and great attitudes. Aaron by the pool always had us set up with towels and checked on us to make sure we were happy. Coco beach bar is great and Victor the bartender made that experience even better.

Planning on coming back with my wife in a few months.

reviews.author: Hannah C
reviews.title: I will NEVER go back to this place!!! Horrifying experience!
reviews.text:
I gave them the benefit of the doubt and reached out one on one to them but they want to brush it under the rug and tell me there's nothing they can do. 
I'll start with the positives!

Beach was wonderful, cleaning and room service was on point. I will say on a positive note that I have a horrible time sleeping away from home, BUT that bed was AMAZING. If I could have stayed in bed the whole time and go to the beach, I would have. Let me rephrase, I SHOULD HAVE just stayed in the room and in bed, it would have been safer.

Now for the negatives. DO NOT GO ALONE AS A WOMAN ANYWHERE!

The food unfortunately was terrible. It tasted like your average greasy and cheaply made hotel food. In order to get a good meal, I advise you to go off the resort.

Half the lights in the room worked. The outside latch to the balcony door was missing so it was hard to get back in. Not a big deal at all. The power outlet in the bathroom for a hair dryer was coming out of the wall and there was a spark at one time. Again, I can handle that.

What I can't handle is having two of their male staff members sexually harass me. I wanted to leave the second day.

Our second day, we started off at the swim up bar. I let my husband be with a few family members while I ventured to the beach with his cousin. When we came back to the pool area, my husband was being taken towards the resort inside and we were told, "One more outburst and he's going to either jail or the hospital to sober up." Oh no...yup, he got overly excited and got a wee bit drunk. We took full responsibility. We took him to the room and and he fell asleep. One family member stayed with him for an hour to krep an eye on him. His wristband was downgraded to a kids wristband and he didn't drink the rest of the stay, and the rest of the family didn't want to either. No biggie, we're old, we just want to enjoy time away from home.

While my husband was recovering from the pool party he had, I wanted to go dance. They have an awesome dance club for ages 18 and older called The Red Lounge. That place is AWESOME! I felt safe, I felt comfortable. For about a minute.

I requested a song to the DJ (Drop It Low by Ester Dean to be exact) and he smirked at me and said he would play it only if I danced on him. Wait, what!? No. So I went back to the dance floor and hung out with the kiddos. 

Fast forward to me being old and getting tired. I said my goodbyes and headed to my room. Let me just say, when on the last day, I didn't know where my room was. It was so confusing. I got lost. Rule of being in a place where you have no idea where anything is, do your research and study the heck out of it. PLEASE.

I couldn't find my way back and I asked a staff member to help me. He was more than happy to help and understanding until we got to the room. I thanked him as I opened the door and next then I knew he had grabbed me and shoved his tongue in my mouth and I pulled away, ran into the room a few feet and he tried following before I told him my husband was in the room and laying in bed. He apologized and took off.

After two mishaps in the matter of a few hours of each other, please explain to me why I'm suppose to feel comfortable going to any other staff members for what happened? 

Apparently, Paradisus can't do anything since I didn't bring it to their attention during our stay. I reached out a week ago. I heard nothing until tonight after I sent another message telling them I would take matters into my own hands if nothing was done and I had not heard anything within the next week and that I would be reporting them.

They brought up the issue with my husband at the bar which was resolved the second day at our stay. Completely resolved and signed that nothing would partake again the rest of our stay. 

I feel like instead of taking responsibility for their lack of attention and their lack of caring, they immediately pointed the finger at my husband. 

Looking forward to reporting the resort to a higher authority. Any feedback on who I can report this to would be

reviews.author: Janet S
reviews.title: Malva Restaurant at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Redesign is absolutely stunning! Martin & Luis will take amazing care of you for breakfast & lunch. Food choices are second to none....something for everyone.  Dinner was also a very enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: Sierra-Cadenas L
reviews.title: Excellent services
reviews.text: Everyone was super nice. Specially Ignacio Vazquez at the Malva Buffet. He always when above and beyond for us. The resort over all beautiful. I recommend for adult. The food delicious. The presentation of the food amazing

reviews.author: alinahaik
reviews.title: Amazing, Amazing, Amazing!
reviews.text: My friend and I went to Paradisus Cancun from January 5-12. Both of us haven't gone to an all inclusive for a long time, but that definitely will change after this trip! We booked this trip with no expectations, and let me tell you the bar is now set really high. From the service, hospitality, drinks, cleanliness and aesthetic there is nothing really to complain about. Make sure to take the time and go to all the restaurants the hotel has to offer. Special shoutout to the manager Gabi at Enso restaurant and Nicolas for kicking it up a notch and providing the most stellar service. The beach was stunning and clean and the pools always had something to offer. If you're by the pool area make sure to say hi to Victor, such a great dude always greeting with a smile and making sure your drink is cold! Within the week, we decided we wanted to venture out a bit, Christian at the concierge was the real deal! Always available to help us and answer any questions we may have. We were two girls and he was totally honest and told us where to go/what to do. We had to reach out to our airline a couple times and he with no hesitation made that happen! Finally, we inquired for a room upgrade, David, big shout out too you! He was so kind and literally made our already amazing trip SO much better! We were upgraded to an ocean front view that were newly renovated! Definitely, no questions asked will be returning to this hotel, I don't think we've both stopped talking about it!

reviews.author: Kristina H
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: AMAZING resort. My boyfriend and I were extremely pleased with all aspects of our stay. Always something going on at night, and the Avenue bar and red lounge were great to chill and end the night. Service was excellent- from bartenders, to lobby workers, to beach and restaurant waiters, to the activities guys ... everyone was awesome!! The food was just okay, but everything else made up for it. The room was nice, a beautiful view. The room did seem a bit warm/muggy at times, and the air could only go down to 65. I could only see this being a real bother in the humid summers, however. I have been to many resorts in Cancun and this was my first time at Paradisus. Definitely a great place and will definitely be returning!

reviews.author: Alex C
reviews.title: Paradisus Can Cun is awesome!!!
reviews.text:
Our family had an amazing week at Paradisus over Christmas. The resort is very clean and well kept. The sandy beach is outstanding and the crystal clear ocean water is wavy with many beautiful colours of blue. The pool areas and swim up bar are terrific. 
We want to recognize and say a big "THANKS!"  to a few of the many, many fantastic staff ;

Amayrani is an incredible hostess at the Malva buffet restaurant whose smile lights up the room….she is so friendly and attentive. She actually called me by name every morning and asked me how I was doing!
Jaime, Julio and Camaleil took VERY good care of us at the pool bar. These guys are a ton of fun and awesome bar tenders!
Ismael and Christoper at the front desk took care of golf, tennis and restaurant reservations efficiently. Most of all they assisted me in arranging a late check out for one of our rooms so that we could enjoy all of our last day as we had an evening departing flight. All of this support made our trip go much smoother!
Augustin and Julio (events coordinators at the pool area) are fantastic! They had soccer and volleyball games going on the beach and huge floaty fun in the pool. 
We really connected with Augustin and could feel his sincere friendliness. He even took the time to teach my daughter and I a couple of excellent tricks! Augustin is a very good human being and we miss him. My daughter is still talking about him.   Thanks to all and see you next time!

reviews.author: Elizabeth H
reviews.title: Fantastic family vacation
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time. We did get Family Concierge service, which was really helpful. I hadn’t known really what it would be like from reading reviews. Gloria and Brenda kept in communication with us via WhatsApp and in person to help us arrange things for the kids to do and to make our restaurant reservations. They left surprises every day in the room for the kids. 

The resort is beautiful. The beach is stunning—minimal seaweed, beautiful sand. The staff are friendly and helpful. Drinks are easy to obtain—we didn’t go to any of the fancier bars because kids were with us, but drinks in restaurants and at pool side were tasty.

A surprise to me was that my kids (9, 5) liked the kids club quite a bit, which they didn’t think they would. We were able to have them do kids’ activities for a couple of hours each day.

Overall, beautiful, fantastic, would love to return and would highly recommend.

reviews.author: swellsy2020
reviews.title: Wonderful people. Good food. Bad rooms.
reviews.text: The hotel has so much potential and offered better food and service than expected, however, the room and the lack of seating in the pool/ beach areas left much to be desired. We ended up having a great time by renting a Bali bed each day to guarantee a place to sit by the pool and spending as little time as possible in the room. The room needed to be renovated 10 years ago - we had 3 leaks, an uncomfortable bed and bathroom lighting so bad makeup application was impossible. It’s truly unfortunate that Melia has only focused on the common areas and restaurants because it would be a place I would want to return but for the room.

reviews.author: Chase T
reviews.title: The Best Resort in Cancun, INCREDIBLE
reviews.text:
I have been to Paradisus Cancun 4 times now. I have stayed in 10 resorts in Cancun including the RIU collection of resorts. NOTHING comes close to the experience at Paradisus Cancun. 

The staff and amenities are incredible. The food is delicious, including the buffet food. There are 8 restaurants, a dance club, 4 pools, private cabanas, a hydrotherapy and full service spa, a gym and nearly every room has a breathtaking view.

I should come back around to the staff. I have gone once a year and each time the staff remembers me by name even 12 months later! They great me when they see me and do everything they can to make sure I am having a good time. From custom cocktails to surprise deserts. Just to name a few of the best there... make sure to visit these staff members when you go:

Alfredo, Cristian, Marten, Andres/Andrew, Amayrani (all in the breakfast/lunch buffet)

Rode in the Royal Service section.

Paulina and Fiona in the front lobby... and more! 

Thank you to all of you for making my stays so memorable. I will be back!

reviews.author: toi b
reviews.title: NEW YEARS
reviews.text: Beautiful property, amazing beach. Royal service was not worth it. The buttler only took reservations for us and did nothing else. We were not able to get a reservation for new years at the restaurant that is crazy why book people in a resort for new years if you don't have the space. The hostess was very rude to us when we got to the restaurant and we saw 5 tables open and she said she has nothing available. The only restaurant that we really enjoyed was mole. I would not recommend this resort the paradisus in playa de carmen is better food and service.

reviews.author: Jojo
reviews.title: Awesome Services at Malva Restaurant
reviews.text: The services especially at the Malva Restaurant was exceptional, most especially the servers Edier and Armando, both were very friendly and helpful.  They sincerely want to make sure we are comfortable and at home, providing us excellent services.

reviews.author: Ali A
reviews.title: Great atmosphere
reviews.text:
The staff at the resort are amazing 
We especially want to thank Gaudero at Naos during our breakfasts, his tables became our go to spot every morning we were there!!! 
All of the restaurants were great (we went to all except one)
We had an exceptional time at Enso on one of our last dinners. Darwin, Jose and Yamil really went above and beyond to make our experience so memorable. 

We would definitely recommend this resort!! And hope to be back again one day!

reviews.author: John Kroha
reviews.title: Great getaway
reviews.text: Our one week stay was great.  The food at the main buffet was excellent with some variation every day.  getting reservations at the speciality restaurants was a pain, but  doable .  The hotel staff were friendly and very willing to please, as were all the waiters.  We will be coming back with our grandchildren next winter.

reviews.author: Katherine P
reviews.title: Bigger isn’t always better — but it’s still fun
reviews.text:
We just came back from Paradisus as a group of 12 family and friends to celebrate my husband’s 30th birthday. I generally try to read reviews and become familiar with “things to know” ahead of a trip. Knowing dinner reservations would be hard, I asked about booking ahead of time...we were told this wasn’t allowed (I get that). I also inquired about having our five rooms be considered to be in the same pyramid (we had separate bookings) but received no response or an attempt to see if that was possible. So, our party was spread across the five pyramids. 

In short, we struggled to get a dinner reservation for half of our stay. Guest services tried to help with dinner the second night when we were striking out and “booked” us for 9pm at Mole. We waited for this late dinner with an infant and toddler, only to have Mole tell us they didn’t have the reservation. It took some obnoxious insistence on our part — and luckily, some proof that we weren’t mistaken — for some accommodations to be made. The remaining nights we booked without issue at Enso and Ibiro. Luis at Ibiro was exceptional!

Check-in was kind of slow (which is tough when you’ve arrived and are trying to salvage some beach time at 2pm) and they couldn’t find one room’s second occupant on file — when she booked directly with the hotel as an add-on and made payment. When WE found her information and showed the emails and confirmations, they ended up putting two strangers in our group with a king bed which wasn’t great. Fortunately, they were able to switch rooms for the remaining three nights. But, their new room had construction nearby, beginning around 8am. :-/

We had another couple with two children have to switch rooms twice over a four night stay — the first time, quick ant-like bugs were crawling all over by their mini fridge and into their bags after that late dinner. The second time, water was leaking from their bathroom ceiling all over the floor. The second move they were upgraded to an ocean view.

These were annoying hiccups and I felt responsible since I found the place and asked people to celebrate with us. I honestly just think the hotel is so big, these issues are bound to happen to a portion with people’s stays. The remaining three rooms in our party didn’t have issues.

With that said, Christian from Guest Services pulled through and helped make the stay MUCH better the second half. ALSO, the hotel is really grand and stunning and food is above average for an all inclusive. The pool and beach are incredible. And, the beach cabanas are so fun! Even with these hiccups, there’s no way you can’t have an amazing time unless you’re a wet blanket. :-) Many guests from our party would return, and despite some of the mess-ups, I probably would, too. Some particularly friendly staff help make you feel at home.

I just wish I was back!

reviews.author: Katie C
reviews.title: Perfect family beach vacation!
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I took his two daughters to Cancun for the first time this year.  We decided on Paradisus because it looked like it included all the things we wanted to do: beach, eat a ton, ocean activities. We achieved everything and more! The hotel hooked it up with Aquaworld directly, directly across the street and we were able to snorkel 2x on an excellent reef, drive speedboats, surf, AND scuba dive. The food was excellent - the buffet was above and beyond our expectations, serving everything from crab legs, grilled salmon, and sushi to chicken fingers, pizza, and calzones. Not to mention the exorbitant amounts of homemade guacamole everywhere! We loved the dessert bar and gelato. The rooms were absolutely perfect (highly recommend an ocean view). The beach was totally clear of seaweed and the sun was always shining. We could not have asked for a better vacation or stay than what we experienced at Paradisus. Will absolutely come back if we decide to return to Cancun!

reviews.author: Woody451
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: Being in Royal Services made this vacation enjoyable.  Quiet and relaxing. Staff is exceptionally pleasant and helpful. Beautiful beach and pool area. Food and drinks always available and staff aim to please.

reviews.author: venusurendran
reviews.title: Great experience! Excellent beach, great food. Had a good time!
reviews.text:
We were taken care of the moment we arrived. We arrived early, at about 8:00 am.  Luggage was handled by the bell boys. We did the checkin formalities. We were allowed to use all the hotel services right away. Had our breakfast, went to the beach. Getting our room took some time. we finally got our room by 4:00 pm. 

Malva was our favorite place. Buffet style restaurant with plenty of options. The food is not as great as that of a cruise ship though.

reviews.author: EDWARD G
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Review
reviews.text: Let's start off by saying this place was amazing! Very good service especially when they know you are carrying US dollars. One thing that I did not like was that they called us at about 9am to tell us they had a gift for us. Scheme!! I should have seen that coming. It was a scheme to try and get us to sign into a Timeshare sort of deal. The guy was very persistent on trying to have us watch the presentation but I kept saying no. He kept throwing in offers but since I've been schemed before, I sworn to never believe this stuff any longer. Sure enough now I'm looking at their club melia reviews and I can see I did  the right thing. Another complaint I had was we had the all inclusive package but I did not know what it included and what restaurants it included. So prior to making a reservation I called the operator to ask if ENSO restaurant was included in the all inclusive package. They said Yes! Upon arrival I gave my reservation room number and they sat us down. As the waiter approaches us and are ready to order on one of  the plates he says that'll cost you $40USD per plate is that ok? I was like I made sure this dinner was covered with the all inclusive package, what the heck. He responded sorry sir it's not. So I ended up paying for it. I was not going to have my wife and daughter go through the humiliation of having to leave. Because of this minor experience I will never stay here again. I figured it cost me about $120 to never have to stay here again. There are many options to choose from anyways. They should just be honest with their customers. They would have had a loyal one with me.

reviews.author: Rachel Wade
reviews.title: Highlight of my trip: Francisco
reviews.text: I'm writing this review primarily to highlight Francisco, a staff member who works in the red lounge. He went above and beyond to be sure my best friend and I (both 21yo girls) were safe when we left the bar at night. He really looked out for us in a way that I personally never expected, and I've never felt safer in a club-type environment. I am so incredibly grateful to him and the rest of the staff for making this a vacation I will never forget, and creating memories I will always cherish.

reviews.author: Gonzachumpi
reviews.title: Excellent stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We were a party of 6, including 80 year old grandmother and 14 year old grand daughter.
The rooms are great, especially the one with ocean view.
Ocean is beautiful. We enjoyed the palapas with pleasant Enrique and Elliot. Played beach volleyball and soccer. Great experience with Karina at the Jumping Fit.
Excellent restaurants. We highly recommend Fuego, the peruvian restaurant, were we had superb service by waiter Christian.
Gracias!

reviews.author: Dania Salameh
reviews.title: Vento
reviews.text: I had a great experience at vento restaurant. Fernando Gonzalez was amazing and made our experience excellent.. he went above and beyond to make sure we get our food the way we want it. We returned twice to the restaurant and next time will go back for sure to see him

reviews.author: shiron53
reviews.title: Be sure to eat at Bana
reviews.text: Just returned from a 5 night stay at Paradiscus.  Many positives.  The resort is very clean and the staff are accommodating. Probably the most positive element of our visit.  The restaurants are all so so.  Not bad but not 5 star cuisine with one exception that being Bana the Japanese restaurant.  The atmosphere is very nice with the tables being nicely spaced.  Our waiter Edwardo was exceptional.  He offered suggestions which were spot on. He also went the extra mile with service.  I did notice while there that many guest did not leave a tip for these hard working employees. It was very sad to see all the effort made by staff to make sure guest were  given the best service they could give and for guest to not acknowledge the efforts they made.  This was my third trip to this resort mainly because of the beach and location. All in all a good experience

reviews.author: Tamila A
reviews.title: The best place in the earth
reviews.text:
My gratitude to this resort and staff cannot be described in words. I keep coming back to Paradisus and with every opportunity will come back again. I tried many other resorts and none of them like my Paradisus. Everything about this resort, the look, decorations, environment, food.. Love the way of new remodeled buffet.. Food is delicious, rooms are clean and modern, everywhere is so clean, beach is outstanding but the most important is staff.. I feel super special, they make me feel super special, a princess, a little girl.. I feel in paradise.. For so many years that I travel to this resort I build relationship with many folks and I love it.. I love that they recognize my family, they treat us so well and even better.. Our waiter Roberto, as soon as we are arriving I am searching for him.. ROBERTO you are simple the best worker and most important human... My entire family loves you. Atilano, Eddier at buffet made my son feel like he is only one in this planet is celebrating his birthday.. They serve us like we are most important people.. Love you guys.
Edgar Martinez the drinks you made for us are the most delicious I ever had in my life and from time to time I come back you always remember my special drink from Edgar..your gorgeous attitude and smile and your skills are outstanding.. Every resort should dream to have you work for them. Giovanni Avauz we will miss you of how nice and kind you were to our son while you were making his parents happy.. Say hi to your 3 sons. Maybe one day we can meet your family. Our room service folks, cleaning people, cheff - everyone, thank you so much for making this resort to be so great! Without you it will be so different.. All love from Aspen's family.

reviews.author: Laurent P
reviews.title: Bad timing ..many resturants were closed
reviews.text: It is unfortunate that we were not informed of renovations ( at least 2 if not 3 restos) . Rooms are noisy. There is about one inch space at the bottom of the door. At least, the beach was nice and the weather was perfect.

reviews.author: Arvind Upadhyay
reviews.title: Once word - Awesome
reviews.text:
Stayed in this all inclusive resort for 5 nights. On an average this will cost $250/person/day ($300/day for couple). 

Resort has private beach area which is well maintained. Staff are very friendly (most speak Spanish). 

A lot of fun activities and water sport options are also their.

reviews.author: Olga S
reviews.title: we had good time, but will not come back
reviews.text:
food is the main complaint. the same choice every day, no seafood, with the exception of steam fish and a few shrimps in salads.
very poor for 5-star hotel
almost no light in evening in common area buildings, very annoying in the restaurants. I can not eat, when not see my food. I used the flashlight from the cellphone. It not fun when you paid for 5 star.
But beach is beautiful!!!! Hotel is clean and service is amazing!

reviews.author: MichieDenice
reviews.title: First time to Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to Paradisus in Cancun and our room was in the Royal Service wing. With our package we were provided the use of butler and our butler was George.  George was fantastic, I cannot provide enough compliments to George for his outstanding service.
The hotel is very clean and well-manicured.  The entire staff was friendly and always looking to make your stay as pleasurable as possible. We experienced a different restaurant each night and they were all wonderful experiences.  I would highly recommend considering Paradisus when traveling to Cancun.

reviews.author: Sean C.
reviews.title: This was a great time!
reviews.text: Great hotel with a great pool, amazing beach cabanas, and a great price for all-inclusive. There are many restaurants, but I must say the sushi restaurant was my favorite! Spent 7 days here and it was well worth it. I went in June, which is very hot and the main area of the hotel does not have AC - it is an open and beautiful area. I would recommend this hotel to anyone looking to relax. There is no casino here, so if that is something you need, you can always walk down the street to one of the neighboring hotels.

reviews.author: Szhang286
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
An absolutely amazing resort! Our family of 4 traveled to Cancun for new years and we had a blast! The resort was huge with nightly performances, great choice of restaurants, huge selection at the buffet and 3 big pools. 
Definitely recommend getting the Royal Service which gives you a private pool (away from all kids, loud noise etc), a personal butler to make dinner/spa/bali bed reservations and free access to their sauna.
But overall, I think the best part of the hotel were the staff. All staff members went above and beyond to make sure you were having a great time!  
My family is already wishing to be back in Cancun and will definitely revisit Paradisus again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Roving501763
reviews.title: Needed Break
reviews.text: Pool attendents went above and beyond to make it wonderful.  The wait staff in the Buffet area were attentive and very pleassat, they need the same staff in all the restaurants.  The extra service we paid for, started out great but the second half they were no where to be found when needing to request something.  Again the pool staff and the entertainment was great.

reviews.author: Joanna J
reviews.title: It's a 3-star resort with the price tag of a 5-star
reviews.text: The overall experience was fine but definitely not worth the price tag. Everything is on the schedule. No coffee after 10 am, no coffee maker in the room. Kids and the baby clubs are ok, nothing special and sometimes understaffed. Restaurants are fully booked even if you try to make a reservation a day before. Pool space is limited. Long lines to the breakfast in the morning. No snacks in the room and you can't take any food from the restaurant to the room. There's a delivery charge for the room service. Room service doesn't include alcoholic drinks and is very limited. Activities and shows are just OK, nothing special. There's no schedule to know what is happening and when. Everything would be fine if it was for half of the price. I stayed at the less expensive resorts and got a LOT more in all areas.

reviews.author: T N
reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.text:
Pros
Nice clean rooms
Gorgeous lobby
Beautiful beach
Good service at pool
Decent food

Cons 
Dinner buffet was tiny, difficult to get good at peak times
Too many stairs
Not enough towels, they never had enough towels to trade in wet towels so stuck with soaking towel all day

reviews.author: BusyTravelWoman
reviews.title: Family Christmas Vacation
reviews.text: Group of 17 family members = memories of a lifetime.  Wonderful Experience.  Clean, fun pool and beach activities, no problems with pre-booked dinner reservations at 5 restaurants, good food, tasty drinks (not watered down) and helpful and pleasant staff.  The staff could no do enough for you.  We were concerned with some of the negative reviews but we did not have any issues.  Yes, the rooms could use some updating but they were clean and the lagoon view was beautiful.  Really - how much time do you spend in them.  Can't wait to return.

reviews.author: xmvacaflores
reviews.title: Not an Adult Only Hotel
reviews.text: I booked an Adult Only hotel and did not get that experience. Kids are able to access the adult pool area and bars around the resort. My fiancee and I tried to have a romantic dinner and all i could hear was loud music and kids yelling and crying. The Royal Service area and check in was not great.
