The food/snacks in the check in area did not look appetizing and the bar was just a long table with bottles and a bucket of ice. The man serving the drinks wasn't friendly. I had to wait for the butler to takes us to the room and have it double checked before we entered. A very long wait for no reason. In my hotel room the door that goes to the room next door is very thin and i could hear the conversations and TV from the other room. The walls are very thin. People on the 4th or 5th floor were playing loud music and i could hear the vibration and sound from my room on the second floor. You will find your chips in the mini bar to keep them nice and cold which i did not like. The resort looks nice and some workers try hard to please, but it isn't consistent. I really wanted to like the resort, but i didn't. I stayed at the Adult Only Paradisus in Dominican Republic and I had a better experience there. I won't be returning to this hotel.

reviews.author: Cancun travel
reviews.title: Paridisus cancun
reviews.text: We highly recommended staying at the paridisus cancun. It was clean, had plentiful food choices with beautiful beach and pool areas. Concierge suite ocean view with Gloria and Rodolfo as our butlers made are week outstanding. Rooms were large (master plus a living room with pull out and roll away) Location across the street from aqua world was great for our activities. (Jet ski, flyboard, flow rider and zip line tour plus cenote and 4 wheeler ATV) There were plenty of pool and kids club activities at the hotel as well. The only negative is the buffet for breakfast.  There is no full service breakfast option for families. You can do adults only full service breakfast or room service however. The buffet has great food and service but we hate buffets in general.  It was awesome to have Gloria and Rodolfo arrange our full service dinners and the various restaurants on site, much more relaxing. The coffee is delicious here fyi. Gloria and Rodolfo were available for any requests through out the trip. We will be back

reviews.author: Maria G
reviews.title: So relaxing
reviews.text: Missing the Paradisus Cancun.   It was so relaxing. Everyone asks me - where did you go?   The service was good but sometimes policies were confusing.  Coco Beach rental beds were expensive but worth every penny.  Blue Agave was the place for lunch - great custom made tacos and quesadillas served by friendly waiters. Malvada had a lovely high quality  buffet. We got a lagoon view because it reminds me of the Florida Keys.

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.title: Great Time!
reviews.text:
The resort was amazing! The beaches were beautiful, the room was always kept clean, and the food was very good. As far as entertainment, I would recommend leaving the resort at night to go to the party area 3 miles down as there's not a ton to do at night there; however, Paradisus did throw a great New Years Eve Party. I would recommend it for next year!
My 2 kids also had a great time at the Kids Club; they were never bored when I'd drop by and always wanted to stay longer, so thank you to the team there! They specifically mentioned Brenda as being "so much fun" and "super nice", so I wanted to shout her out on here.
Overall, I'd definitely recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Jeff C
reviews.title: Over priced, horrible customer service, poor food quality
reviews.text: There are too many great options in Cancun to waste your money on this hotel.  There service is two or three stars at best.  The food is two stars.  But the price is five stars.  Save your money and try another hotel.

reviews.author: Sharon
reviews.title: Amazing stay!!
reviews.text: We spend just two nights in Paradisus and we loved every moment of it! The staff were all extremely friendly, especially Ismael at the front desk and Erik the bartender. They went above and beyond to make sure we had a wonderful experience. The only thing is, the food is nothing more than mediocre. But guess we can't complain when it's unlimited!

reviews.author: Russell C
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text:
Spent a relaxing and fun New Year's holiday at Paradisus.

CON:  the only reason we would not give a full five stars is Melia's TIME SHARE HUSTLE.  Immediately after check in, we were approached by a nice lady for a "tour of the hotel".  After about 40 min of pleasant conversation and helpful hotel info, we were hard-sold into making a next day "breakfast appointment".  This meeting was supposed to talk to us about "memberships".  When we didn't show up the next morning, another lady somehow knew who we were, and followed us into the restaurant for more pressure.  After a firm rebuke, she left us alone.  We felt that was an awkward manipulation on Melia's part, during what was supposed to be a stress free vacation.  We know now to avoid the nicely dressed staff offering "welcome packages" or "free tours".  

PROs:  the staff is otherwise amazing.  

Bali beds are worth the money, especially on the beach. It was an exquisite experience laying on a bed all day being served champagne, margaritas and lunch platters.  Big shout out for David and Rene who worked very hard to make sure we were having a great time.  

The room, grounds, beach, etc are beautiful.  

We'd definitely go back to the Paradisus.  Hopefully soon.

reviews.author: Christopher K
reviews.title: Good resort experience - some kinks with family concierge
reviews.text:
My wife and two kids (14 and 11) recently spent 4 nights in a family concierge room. Overall, the resort was great. The drive from the airport was short and easy. The lobby is beautiful and check-in went well. The room was clean and nice, with a great view overlooking the pool and the beach.

The food at the buffet offered a lot of variety and was pretty good. The food at the restaurants was pretty good as well. Fuego (Peruvian) and Bana (sushi) were the best. Blue Agave was good too. We did not like Enso or Vento much.

The pools were clean and nice. The beach and water are awesome - crystal clear and a beautiful color. We've been all over the Caribbean and the beach and water at this resort in Cancun were up there with the best.

All of the staff at this hotel were professional and nice. We liked everyone. That said, some of the staff really stood out and were stellar. Ruben and Jaime at the pool bar are awesome. So happy, helpful, and fun to be around. Dania led a lot of activities and she does a great job. She also took kids across the street to surf on the FloRider. That activity was fun and she was great with the kids. Francesco and Manuel were both great waiters and so nice and helpful. We also loved Yoalli with Family Concierge. She was not our assigned butler but she was always helpful and super nice - she helped us a lot when we had some problems. Our problems were with the Family Concierge program. It just didn't go as planned and the communication just wasn't good enough. We often had questions about our reservations or the timing of things that never got answered. 

So, overall, we had a great experience, but we wouldn't do Family Concierge again. it just wasn't worth the extra money. We liked the room, the food, the pools, and the resort. We loved the staff and the beach.

reviews.author: mi h
reviews.title: relaxing and fun
reviews.text:
I’d like to start by saying the staff is amazing!
The three concierges really went above and beyond, especially Ismael. He always had a smile on his face and an attitude of helping a friend not a customer. He gave us a lot of ideas for how to spend our rainy days.

My Girlfriend and I stayed at Paradisus for a week vacation, even though it sadly rained most of the trip we enjoyed our stay. 
Our first impression was very warm and welcoming. The staff met us at the front door and took our bags up to the room as we checked in. They offered us drinks and food as we went through the check in process. The only down side to this process is they try to push the time share pitch on to you by offering you deals. Our 90min breakfast talk turned into 3hrs of the only real sun of the trip.
The main pyramid is beautiful and provides great sounds and a wonderful backdrop for pictures. The color pallet for the rooms are ugly but the room is very comfortable. Warning, if noise bothers you try to get a room in one of the other pyramids. The adults club plays loud music which could be heard quite well in all the rooms. The hotel has alternative entertainment when/if it rains, including a silent disco in the main pyramid.
We also had a couples massage at the spa, totally worth it. The massage was so good I fell asleep … and snored, subsequently my girlfriend massage wasn’t as peaceful (sorry).
 
We ate all our meals in the main buffet restaurant. Christian (Head Manager) and Angel (Head Chef) are the best. I have some dietary restrictions and they catered to them (please be patient as they have a lot of guests, I promise they didn’t forget about you. Besides having a lot of other guests and responsibilities, they are taking their time to make sure everything is correct so your allergies won’t kill you). They came to talk with me about my Dietary restrictions personally and checked up on not just whether the food was good, but how they could improve (it was perfect). They even gave me a new recipe for salmon. I can’t say enough good things about these two gentleman.  The wait staff was friendly as well and knew our names by the 5th day, which was super impressive. The bar tender knew what I liked to drink and if he wasn’t busy would start preparing it as I walked up.  

TLDR: The hotel is really nice, the staff is incredible, don’t do the time share pitch, do go to the massages and tip well they deserve it!

reviews.author: Shing
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text:
I booked the premium junior suite that included a full kitchen and whirlpool on the balcony. When we walked in there were no kitchen or whirlpool. I had to go back down and they informed me that they did not have a premium junior suite for us. I just wanted what I paid for but after another hour of trying to just check in, I gave up. A free upgrade or partial refund for a downgrade would've been nice. Over an hour waiting in the lobby was enough and after a long trip to get there, I didn't have the energy or patience to put up with it.  

Other than the frustrating check in, the experience was great. Staff always greeted us, were friendly, and even engaged with the children. The resort was clean and quiet. We went off season so it was awesome to have so much space in the pools.

reviews.author: Salvador C
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Excellent installations , location and management down to waiters . Starting  with Mr Martinez , Mr Ascencio , Sonyia , Mr Palesti , Iran , Mario , Alex, Daniel , Nachito , Christian , Sandra , to mention some . Not to forget the cooks ( Angel , Hector , and the others ,,,, ex relent team .
Will send everyone I know to Paradisus Cancun ! See you guys soon .

reviews.author: Thakniki
reviews.title: Top notch service and staff
reviews.text:
We spent a week with our two y.o twins and were sad to leave. Though a large resort, the layout and excellent staff make it feel intimate. We thoroughly enjoyed the food and appreciated the daily changes to the menu at Naos (easiest place to eat when traveling with lil one's). We sat in the same section so got to know our servers Vicente and Cristian (we recommend doing this as by the second day they know your family's routine including which juice your kids like for breakfast!). 
We also left behind our kids favorite stuffed animals at the resort but Paulina in guest services helped ship them back to us!
We can't wait for a return visit!

reviews.author: Bah
reviews.title: Great Disappointment
reviews.text:
My husband had food poisoning after eating sashimi at the hotel, our last day at the hotel was simply wasted because of that. When we reached the customer service they acted as nothing had to do with them and Margarida the manager was very rude. I contacted Melia corp which only provided another cliche response saying again that they had nothing to do with his intoxication. 
Funny thing is that on the next night, after we complained, the Japanese restaurant was closed. Now I wonder why? Obviously they will never assume the possibility of having contaminated fish on their restaurant, but if I were you would think twice before giving your money to this group. The hotel and accommodations are not impressive, lots of noise in the rooms, they put terrible incenses all over and some areas need renovation.

reviews.author: Liz M
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This resort is very clean and the staff are top notch.  Always willing to serve and have a smile on their face.  A huge disappointment was the fact that not all of the restaurants were open and the others had to have reservations.  Every time I would call they would say that they were all full,  but it was very obvious that there were tons of seats open.  We had to eat at the same place every night which was a disappointment.  The food and drinks were good.  If it rains you are out of luck unless you go out to the swim up bar.  All of the other bars are closed until 5:00.

reviews.author: Rick D
reviews.title: Cooking Classes (Ceviche, tacos and salsa)
reviews.text: Erika, Guadalupe, Saul & Julio were great in this class, not only was the food amazing, but I have now learned how to make it, it was an incredible experience and these guys are the best instructors. Don’t miss out on this great class if you’re at Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: rohitl68
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: Just go, don't worry. We will have no hesitation going back there again, It's a very relaxed place, absolutely wonderful staff, decent rooms, good entertainment and I liked the food too. Some drawbacks that are very minor - no play place outdoors for small kids (the indoor one isn't much) and occasionally the seaweed on the beach is off-putting

reviews.author: Danielle N
reviews.title: Great bartenders, event staff, and pool area, bad rooms
reviews.text:
The wait staff and bartenders were AMAZING. Always so willing to help and make the experience fun and relaxing. Antonio and Alan were the best bartenders there. They made us feel so at home. And Angel who coordinated the daily hotel events was very helpful and friendly. We loved the margarita class! The restaurants, lobby area, and pool area and beach were beautiful and very clean. The only thing I didn’t understand was how the hotel was basically and we could never get a towel. 

The rooms however were disgusting at best. Our smoke alarm was leaking “water” (we hoped), our door to the outside leaked and flooded our room during a storm, and the walls were leaking and had black spots everywhere....oh and the shower head was falling off. A few times we flushed the toilet and the entire room smelled like waste. We left the room gagging. We went to complain and didn’t even receive an apology or get an offer to switch rooms. The cleaning staff basically sprayed fabreeze in called it a day. Oh and they were terrible. No matter how much we complained we never got fresh towels, anything in our fridge...they basically just made the bed everyday. 

Basically...great waitstaff and events staff (5 stars) Front desk was fine the first night but then was pretty terrible and the rooms were gross. That’s what brought the rating down.

reviews.author: Orlando A
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Great for singles or family.. Great pools and beach areas..great restaurants..nite club...swim up bars..lounges...excelllent luxury ocean view rooms...great sundown deck bars..great staff..international cuisine ..excellent Wi-Fi connection throughout

reviews.author: Morgan G
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Resort
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paradisus this January. Was very impressed. Hotel was very accomadating service waa good. Buffet was ok, wide variety of food at buffet. I highly recommend making a reservation at the resturants for dinner. Vento was great, Fuego was amazing and The Market Grill was fantastic. I am Gluten free, I did not call ahead to discuss options, but they had plenty of food options and if I couldn’t find something the waiters took care of me. The weather was beutiful, even when it was a little cloudy. The beach was well kept and the views were beautiful. They offered beach volleyball and soccer. Saul the hotel entertainer was very helpful with suggestions of things to do at the hotel. Everynight they had a show at 8:30pm and they were all amazing was never disappointed. Would return and would recommend to friends.

reviews.author: Megan R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Resort
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Resort in Cancun was amazing! The room accommodations were very nice and clean. The food was delicious (especially the ice cream!). And the shows were very entertaining! Would definitely go again and recommend to a friend!
Saul Zarate is the best entertainer

reviews.author: Delaware123
reviews.title: Amazing!  Family Concierge is a must!
reviews.text:
This is our second year visiting this resort and both years we had Fernanda and Violeta as our butlers with family concierge, they are amazing!  Anything you needed they were right there to help out.  We traveled with our 3 year old son (who absolutely loved the kids club) and one on the way and they were both so gracious and attentive every day.  We had an amazing clean room with a beautiful view of the Caribbean every day, super relaxing!
Please remember to tip (they do not expect it) your butlers, room maids, kids club employees, and restaurant servers, they work incredibly hard to make your vacation perfect and deserve recognition!  
Feel free to ask me any questions about this wonderful resort, we can't wait to visit again next year!

reviews.author: Vilibr
reviews.title: True paradise
reviews.text: This is our favorite resort in Cancun, what a beautiful, well maintained place. It's an older hotel, but rooms are quite nice, not super modern, but very clean and restocked daily. We had a family concierge the second time we visited - Sandra was very caring, nice and stayed on top of our reservations and activities. We'd like to come back soon for another restful vacation. Kids club was great, too. We had a wonderful time and are looking forward to more vacations at Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Alicia C
reviews.title: TOTAL DISAPPOINTMENT
reviews.text:
I don’t even know where to start with this review, I usually do not write many reviews but I will this time because I don’t want customers to be fooled and be sold something that’s not worth what they are paying for. 

For starters this is supposed to be a five stars hotel, apart from the waiters good customer service I don’t know where else this fits in the category. 

Starting with the check in, the receptionist named Yuli was the slowest receptionist I have ever encountered! It took about an hour to get us checked in, and at the time of our check in (3pm) 3 of our 4 rooms were not ready. We also had to come back to get our keys and where inside the room by 4pm. 

When I booked this hotel it caught my attention because of the “many different restaurants this hotel has” but don’t be fooled, we were not able to eat in any of these restaurants because they were always “full.” We even tried booking two nights in advance and still had no luck. Some of their restaurants were closed, and I saw that their restaurants do not hold the capacity for the amount of guests they have in this hotel. We had to eat at the buffet Naos every night and the food wasn’t even good, not many varieties either. I would give it 2/5. 

Unlucky for us the weekend I spent here rained everyday none stop, on the last day my room and my friends room were flooded due to the rain, I called reception and they told me I wasn’t the only one, that every other room in the side of the hotel we were in were having the same problem, but if they know this why don’t they fix this? 

Also a lot of the common areas had water on the floor and water dripping from their roofs. The rooms are old and not very clean. They charge you $5 if you want room service and alcohol bottles are not included in your room. 

The receptionists were not very helpful at all. For any inconvenience I had to call a couple times before they helped me do anything. 

Overall for the price of this hotel I do not recommend this hotel. DONT BE FOOLED!!! I have been to other resorts in Cancun and this is such a disappointment.

reviews.author: ginamkk
reviews.title: Royal Service at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at Paradisus Royal Service Ocean View. The resort was absolutely stunning! Our view was gorgeous and our room was immaculate! We were celebrating my 30th birthday and when we arrived we checked in at a private Royal Service area with complimentary champagne. We were escorted straight to our room and it was decorated with balloons, streamers and a bottle of champagne and chocolate covered strawberries! Such a thoughtful touch!

Alex was our butler and he was amazing! He took care of absolutely everything for us from dinner reservations to Bali Beds and checked in on us in person at least once a day. He was always there for us when we needed him and even took care of us on his day off. He even decorated my room with streamers, cake and champagne while we were out at dinner! Our trip wouldn’t have been the same without him! He made everything absolutely perfect! So so grateful that he was our butler. If you are visiting Paradisus requesting Alex is a must!!

When it comes to Royal Service, this is the pinnacle! We were waited on hand and foot our entire trip. From the moment we arrived, the service we received was impeccable. Every single person we encountered went out of their way to take the best care of us and made our experience indescribable. Everywhere we went, I was sang happy birthday to and it made my trip so special!

La Palapa restaurant at Royal Service was delicious! Fuego is also a must! These were our favorite restaurants.

Royal Service is definitely worth it!

We truly felt like Royalty this entire trip and we cannot wait to be back!! Thank you for the incredible and unforgettable experience!

reviews.author: Alexandra
reviews.title: Good hotel but there were some minuses.
reviews.text:
We arrived at the hotel on January 10, they offered us a complimentary drink at check-in, we had an Ocean view room which was comfortable for 2 people. Starting from the first day they were pushing us to join Club Melia, to a point where it became awkward and annoying. Club Melia staff did not recognize when we told them we were not interested and held us up for 20 minutes. They kept offering their services every day. The most terrible was when they called in our room after lunch when we were sleeping!!!

Next day we were woken up with the sounds of a loud hammer. When we called the front-desk they promised to help but did not seem courteous and the problem persisted. They apologized but attempted to sell a Club Melia membership. The next morning the banging continued. We spoke to a manager who offered to move us to another room. We ended up staying as they finished renovations.

After a couple of days, a huge group of people arrived at the hotel. There was some kind of conference. Due to this, we felt uncomfortable because the hotel became overcrowded. They were noisy, rude and took up the buffet and many restaurants. During the night the disco was dangerously overcrowded, they were drunk, pushing and they only played Latin music the whole night, however, the DJ promised to mix music with international but he did not and most of the other guests left the disco.

If you live in the third pyramid you will most likely hear noise from the disco and music from the shows. 

The food was above average. Some soups had too much salt and at times there was a lack of meat variety. We liked the Naos buffet, which had the most choice of food. The Mole restaurant, Ibana and market grill are our favorites. Snack bar on the beach has a delicious grilled chicken sandwich. Be careful cause sometimes they close some restaurants for dinner, please make sure at the reception. 

The beach was clean. There were some waves on the beach be careful if you are a bad swimmer. You have to pay extra $180 per day to rent a bed on the beach or on the pool. It was not fair to people who already paid a premium price for the hotel. It did not feel like all inclusive. There were passing by merchants at the beach who kept offering trips, cigars, coconuts without juice and even illegal drugs every minute, this really upset my husband who just wanted to relax from work. Even Club Melia representatives approached us every hour. Every time you go to pick up a towel for the beach, the towel issuers would try to sell us an excursion. There was no place to hide from being harassed. The pool did not have a working jacuzzi but they have a swim up bar. My husband felt like he was missing something important =) 

There was not a lot of sports activities, no basketball court, no billiard table, no ping pong table. The shows took place in a small location at the bar area. It was always packed as it is not of an appropriate size for such a large hotel.

For all these things I would give the hotel 3 stars. 
 
But 5 stars are going to people who`ve made our vacation special.

Morning and lunch waiters at the Naos, Fuego and Market Grill location:
1. Ricardo. He was extremely attentive, friendly, courteous and went the extra step to make us feel happy and at home. We were very sad that we couldn`t say goodbye to him=(
2. Andres. Really is talented at customer satisfaction, his manners were like in a high-level restaurant, he was very pleasant and genuine. 
3. Martin and Eduard were very friendly and always asked what we want. 

Hostess at the same location:
Jennifer and Amayrani - were always smiling and thanks to them for their hospitality. 

Waiters at evening Market Grill location:
1. Rafael. He knows how to talk to people, he always had amazing stories and was very friendly. And also he knows the Russian language which was a pleasant surprise. 
2. Alberto. He was very professional and pleasant. He brought the skewers very fast.

Naos evening location:
Jaime. He would help with everything we asked. We couldn`t wish for a better waiter. He was extremely nice to us. 

Beach waiters:
1. Mujuel. He would always ask us what we want to drink and brought us the drink fast.
2. Victor. Was very pleasant and would help us with things such as moving beach lounge chairs for us. And always asked us if he could help us with anything. 

And Oscar who is offering photography was great. He always had funny stories and he is very intelligent.

Desserts were amazing especially the Catalan cream=)

The cleaning maids did a great job.

And of course, we really like architecture, gardens. Everything was beautiful and well kept. We also like Mexico and Mexican people who are very friendly in general.

reviews.author: Rigotto
reviews.title: Need some SERIOUS renovation!
reviews.text:
Looks like this was a great hotel in the past.  It is falling in pieces. Everywhere you walk inside the hotel, there are white towels covering the floor due to infiltration. 
The rooms maybe are clean but you cannot guarantee as everything is a shipwreck, old and not working. 
The food is poorly prepared. 

The attention is the teams is good although at reception it looks like they treat you badly to create a disappointment and then you finally see some good service from the others. 

I guess there might be several other places in Cancun to stay that would provide a better experience. 

Have to admit again that the crew at hotel restaurants and bar are well trained and carefully. It is just the place that needs some SERIOUS renovation.

reviews.author: Mandii09
reviews.title: A beautiful place for a getaway
reviews.text:
The first thing I noticed when arriving st Paradissus, was the amazing smell of essential oils and lush greenery, almost everywhere. The staff here were all very attentive and friendly, and the hotel itself was very well kept, including the washrooms on the beach. Despite the size of this resort, it didnt feel crowded.  The morning barista at the Nespresso bar, Orlando, was excellent - always smiling and great with the guests. 

✅ if you want a plated dinner, reservations can only be made 1-2 days in advance. All were good, but Mole was my favourite ( traditional Mexican). 

💡 those wonderful Bali Beds (palapas) are $100 per day if your not staying as a “royal service” guest. 

✅ The food at the resort is good, but I think taking a day to go off the resort and eat at one of the local places in hotel zone is definitely worth it! My favourite place was Taco y Tequilla at La Isla mall

💡 Taxi to the main shopping area ( near Plaza Fiesta) should be 160 pesos from Paradissus.  No meters - so always agree on the price before getting in the car. 

🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽

reviews.author: Inspire22401539093
reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text: Highly recommend!!Leynor and the entire staff were absolutely amazing!! Exceeded all expectations!!! We will definitely make it a priority to go again. If you are thinking of going you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Amanda W
reviews.title: Good value & Service
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is a clean, spacious, and unique all inclusive resort overall. Once I have arrived, I was greeted by a bell boy. However, the check in process took longer than expected. There was a line with three people at the desk. I purchased the ocean view room, this room was bigger than I have prepared for it to be. There were two double beds, a bathroom with a separate section with a toilet and an elongated bidet. House maid cleaned my room twice, if not once a day. The lobby was nicely decorated with a nature theme, such as vines over the walls. Several ponds with fish, flowers and plants were also planted inside of the hotel. There are a total of 9 restaurants but some you need to pay extra. The beach was clean and right outside of the resort. Another con was that I stayed in tower 3 which is the main tower with live music every night that doesn't end until after midnight. If you have kids or if you sleep before midnight, it would be noisy. Other than that I had a great experience at this resort.

reviews.author: Africa forever
reviews.title: good stay, bad restaurants service
reviews.text:
The hotel is clean and not very crowded, you can hangout at the lobby and there are multiple lounges and places where you can chill.
Unfortunately, very bad service from all the girls at the restaurants reception.
Here is a story that happened multiple times:
I have a reservation at 20:00. So i come with the family at 19h30, the restaurant is empty, about 30%-50% max.
The girl looks at us and says you have to wait until 20:00 so ill let you in.
I totally get the part where you have to be on time, but sorry, if your restaurant is empty, you don’t leave your clients waiting in the rain for no purpose...the girl looks at us and says no ! You have to wait until 20:00 lol...

There is also a big lack of animation, if you are unlucky to get rainy days, well you are gonna be bored.

The hotel deserves a 3 stars, ill give 1 though just to show how much the bad service at the restaurants affected the whole experience.

reviews.author: Antonio V
reviews.title: Would not stay at the Paradisus/Melia resorts again
reviews.text:
We arrived on Sunday, January 20th 2019 to check into our oceanfront king bedroom only for the front desk to tell me that they don't have an oceanfront kind bedroom available until the following day. So we were inconvenienced to start our 4-day vacation by telling me they would have us in the two bedroom (cramped because of two beds in one room) the first night. 

They told us that we would need to change rooms by 12 pm the next day. That means we are not on our time but theirs, wake up early and pack and we could not go on our excursion the following day because I did not want to leave our valuables with the bell boys (has our passports, jewelry, and DSLR Canon 70D Camera). That evening my Fiance and I were washing up and getting ready for bed. The bathroom sink did not drain so it filled and filled until it overflowed. I took pictures to document.
The next day we waited in the room until they came to pick up our luggage at 12 pm. We held onto our valuables until 3pm the next day until they could check us into the next room. This made us miss most of the day outside and the great weather (the weather was stormy and pretty awful the rest of the trip). 

Went to Paradisus Punta Cana in 2018 and it was so amazing so we thought it would be great going to the Paradisus Cancun. I am deeply unimpressed with the customer service we received.I thought we would continue going to Melia owned resorts but I will start looking elsewhere now.

reviews.author: Kellyqtz
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text: Went to Cancun for few days to relax and tan. The staff here are super friendly and helpful. Guadalupe and Alex make our check in and check out process super pleasant and also suggested us to upgrade to royal service (you will not regret upgrading). I would highly recommend this resort due to great staff and lots restaurants to choose from. Definitely will come back.

reviews.author: donahoe05
reviews.title: girls trip
reviews.text: th.e sfatt was great! the Service was great!I did not like the constant push for spa services everyday, the pool was nice and bars had everything you could want. The food was good, no complaints.the facility is so beautiful but lots of stairs, up and down, hard to find elevators at times, ok for us, but if you had difficulty with stairs would be frustrating.I would go back here, great for romantic get away, family and girls trip.

reviews.author: Kerri H
reviews.title: Girls birthday trip
reviews.text: Had a great time at this hotel. The entertainment staff was great. Two of the employees Julio and Rodrigo were the best. Always checking on us and making sure we were having fun. Also the bartender Manuel made us the best drinks. Had a fabulous time !

reviews.author: Kennybrooke
reviews.title: Birthday for Melissa
reviews.text: Paridisus Cancun is a beautiful resort!  The food is delicious and abundant!  The staff was all very courteous and helpful. Lucia, Julio,Rodrigo and Alan justvtp name a few! Can't wait to spend next January here again!!!

reviews.author: Stephani B
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation!
reviews.text: Loved the resort; however the staff truly made the difference in this amazing trip. The shows, food and accommodations were good, but again, the staff really made the difference. Rodrigo, Julio and Lucia made sure we had everything we needed at all time and went the extra mile every day to make sure we were having the time of our lives! I highly recommend this resort!!!!!!

reviews.author: Melissa R
reviews.title: Vacacion 2019
reviews.text: We had a great time thanks to Julio, Rodrigo and Lucia! They were so much fun and made Mezcal and wine lex so fun. They kept us on track as to where activities were and at what time. Manuel, Samuel and Alan were amazing bartenders

reviews.author: Tamara A
reviews.title: Fun trip
reviews.text: Everything was great.  So much fun.  New friends and awesome workers.  Bartender Alan from the red latern bar and Manuel at the blue aguava bar and Julio the fun got.  Had fun at mezcal tasting and casino night.

reviews.author: Guide519808
reviews.title: Girls birthday trip for melissa
reviews.text: Rodrigo, Immanuel,juilio,lucia and Alan made this trip wonderful!! Great hospitality. Made  us feel very welcomed. Wine and mezcal tasting was wonderful. Special shots were brought to us numerous times by juilio

reviews.author: Ktrd5
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text: We have been so thrilled with this trip! The staff has made it extra special! Marisa and Carlos our pool and room concierges (respectively) were so kind and helpful, Carlos at Ensō was the NICEST waiter, Karina, Timoteo, and Carrillo at Cocos bar were outstanding, Fransisco from the avenue bar is the sweetest! Seriously I cannot say enough how amazing they all have been! Absolutely made the trip for us.

reviews.author: kshackle1962
reviews.title: Had a great time at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We just stayed 10 days and we really enjoyed ourselves. The food was great and the service from all the staff was superb. We have been to other resorts in Mexico. Cuba, and the Dominican and this resort rates as high as any of them.

reviews.author: Raj F
reviews.title: Lovely resort, wonderful staff.
reviews.text:
Probably one of the better resorts in Cancun. We had the family concierge package which is great if you have kids. The rooms were a good size, and the whole complex was very clean and tidy. The only disappointments we had was that on the first day we were unable to get a reservation at any of the restaurants as they were fully booked and we had to wait a very long time to even get a table at the buffet. This is quite difficult when you have a hungry child with you. The other disappointing thing was that being vegetarian, you were limited on what and where you could dine. Even basics that we take for granted like pasta and pizza was a struggle as they just could not make it correctly. There was no consistency between chefs and restaurants. But the staff did their hardsest to try and accomodate your requests. If you were not happy with something, they would try and make something else for you.
The concierge manager and staff were totally amazing, Always smiling, always ready to help. Just being able to call upon them made the holiday worthwhile. They would arrange all our meals, track down our son who could be anywhere on the resort with all the various activities going on, sort out activity and restaurant reservations. 
The mexican and pan asian restaurants were really good. All the bars served quality drinks. There was something for everyone with the evening entertainment. The kids club had lots of activites for all age groups and the staff are really good with the kids. The activity guys were great and would comev round every day telling you what was on. Tequilla and wine tasting, cocktail making, pool parties, cooking classes are just a few of the activities during the week. Overall, the staff in this resort are, very helpful, genuine and friendly, and this makes all the difference.

reviews.author: Larry R
reviews.title: What a BLAST!
reviews.text: Love this place! Giovanni was our go to guy for pool services. If you had more like him you would be all set. Michael at the pool area made sure we were taken care of our whole trip. At the front Raul, Kemil and the gang always made us feel like we were coming back home. Thanks again for a GREAT time

reviews.author: John_51_Stones
reviews.title: Honeymoon!
reviews.text: This was a great experience! We spent 5 nights here for our honeymoon and it was beautiful. The beach was amazing and just a great location overall. The views of the blue Carribean Sea was spectacular. There was plenty of food/drink options which were very enjoyable and tasty. The quality of food was really good and there was a wide variety available. There were also a lot of activities to keep us busy when we wanted to be active and AquaWorld is also right across the street which is so convenient for all the watersports and snorkeling/scuba experiences - they were great too! The service all round was brilliant and everyone was very nice. Overall very satisfied and would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ariana
reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus Cancun on the Royal Service side. It was a wonderful trip. When I arrived to the resort they greeted my husband and I with our favorite drinks. We stayed in a 1 bedroom suite, lagoon view. When I got to our room there was balloons on the bed for my birthday. There was also cake and champagne waiting for me. Rode was our butler for the weekend and he was fantastic! Anything you needed, he was available to help. I will be sure to request him again when I come back to visit the resort. Some other great employees that I have to mention is Ceasar and Ramon who worked at La Palapa/Pool bar area. They went above and beyond to make sure you never went thirsty or hungry. Daniel, the Royal Service Restaurant Manager introduced himself and on several occasions came to check on us while we were lounging by the pool. The service was just amazing! Make sure you reserve Bali beds, you'll love them. I will be returning to this resort in the near future.

reviews.author: Omar A
reviews.title: Great Family Experience
reviews.text: Paradisus is a great place for family trip. We stayed in a FAMILY CONCIERGE SUITE OCEAN VIEW. Although the rooms are not big in square footage, they feel comfortable for a family of 4. The ocean view balcony is nice. The concierge service was extremely nice. Everyday they left little surprises for my son, Max. After a day of pool fun and exploring he was excited to get back to the room and find what was left for him. The concierge team was attentive and were always available to provide any service we needed. The kids zone inside the hotel is great for kids. Really give a family somewhere to take your kids aside from the beach and pool (Unless you're doing daily outside attractions). Food was also great! I recommend this place! We will definitely return.

reviews.author: Justine H
reviews.title: Best staff
reviews.text: My family and I had a great time at Paradisus Cancun. Amazing location, the beach is clean and the staff is incredible. Constantly being asked if we need anything to drink as we are relaxing by the beach or pool. The drinks are incredible with lots of variations. Additionally, there are activities every day run by great people including Julio and Saul. Always there to get you up and moving whether is it Zumba by the pool or beach volleyball. Would recommend for any type of vacation

reviews.author: Discover18191679178
reviews.title: The Avenue Bar - Bartenters
reviews.text: The bartenders at the Avenue bar were great with a talent to shake and make martinis.. Very talented bartenders and personally friendly and very attentive to our needs and the rest of the customers.5 Stars for Alan Tec & Jaime

reviews.author: Discover22483392988
reviews.title: Great resort, but shady practice charging additional fees...
reviews.text: The resort itself was great. The food was quite good as well (specially mentioning mole and fuego restaurants). The shows at night were great too and included circus theatrics. One thing to note is that the night time events and club are particularly loud and might disturb your sleep especially if you reside in the lower of the 8 levels in pyramid 3.The stay overall was great, but the hotel has a shady practice of charging an extra tax upon checkout. My all inclusive stay specifically mentioned that all service fees and taxes were prepaid, but the hotel wanted to double dip and forced me to pay an additional tax upon checkout, even though i didn't use any additional service.

reviews.author: monika_s_vancouver
reviews.title: Great hotel friendly staff
reviews.text:
Came to Cancun with a cpl friends for the weekend and decided to continue with the Melia chain hotel. We upgraded to Royal Service upon arrival and it was worth it. Beach cabanas and private beach and pool area was way quieter then the other side. 
 Guadalupe was great with our check in and was extremely accommodating! Oscar and Joel were the best by the pool they came over often to check up on us if we needed drinks or anything. Friendly staff all around, going to continue checking out more Melia hotels all around

reviews.author: Departure59627460987
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text: My family of five loved this resort!! Everyone was so friendly and the service was impeccable!! The resort has one if the best beaches and ocean fronts we have been to!! Very clean and well kept! Lots of restaurant options!! My family loved The Paradisus!!

reviews.author: Oscar Hernandez Sr
reviews.title: Favorite Cancun Resort
reviews.text:
To begin we love the experiences we have here... I regret not writing this before, but now I want to express that all of the persons that we have dealt with are always so kind and interested in what we need or want. They always make eye contact with my family and me and show genuine concern and interest. I would like to point out the concierge young woman, Bianca that always is there when needed. Also, the housekeeping Manager Isabel, she was a dream .... along with all the other ladies. Everyone is very attentive. 
Noas buffet I can street enough Martin, Armando, Victor, Pablo, there were two other guys I cannot recall their names, but in June I will ask. We are returning again in June with the family. Thank you again for all that is done to make our trip so enjoyable. One more person Oscar the bartender at the reception desk, most helpful!  
Thank you!

reviews.author: George S
reviews.title: Excellent staff and service
reviews.text:
We just got back from our vacation in paradise. We had three couples in our group, my sister-in-law, her husband and my wife's cousin and her husband. Things started off a little rocky with the check in. When I made the reservations, I requested three rooms close together with king size beds. I was told that it was only a "request". They didn't have the three rooms with king size beds on the same floor or close together. After going around with the check in staff and getting nowhere, I finally got to speak with a manager "Guadalupe". She did her best to get our rooms close together. So we ended up with two rooms on one floor and one room directly below it. At least we had king size beds. 
The best thing at this resort is the staff and service. We wanted to recognize the staff that made our stay the vacation in paradise we enjoyed. We already mentioned Guadalupe at the check-in desk. Our first friend (amigo) was Martin Arzeta - he is a breakfast and lunch waiter at Market grill and Naos. Our next friend was Christian - a waiter at Fuego. There was Angel at the Blue Agave. Out by the pool was Sergio who was our waiter when we rented one of the pool cabanas. And our favorite pool waitress and friend (amiga) was Gabriela - she was always checking in on us to see what she could bring us to eat or drink. We would like the management to relay our appreciation to those individuals that made our vacation so memorable. 
We hope to see them next year when we bring our family to visit.
Thanks, George

reviews.author: citizenMelissa
reviews.title: Royal Service is the only way to go
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I just returned from a week at Paradisus Cancun. It was excellent...all because of the service at Royal Service, beach amenities & aesthetic, and room. 

If you are looking to spend your money on good, authentic food, this is not the place. The food would have made this place 5 Stars. Blue Agave, Naos Buffet, Market grill, Bana were mediocre. Even less then mediocre. It’s so disappointing when they can’t even get Mexican food right! Thank god for Royal Service because I would have been extremely upset eating at only these restaurants for all of my meals. 

La Palapa (Royal Service exclusive) was excellent. From the breakfast, to the lunch, to the beach snacks (where you are waited on even on the beach!!) was worth paying the money for this service. Valeria, Jorge, And Victor we’re absolute gems. My cup/glass was never not filled and my plate was never empty unless requested. They all called me and boyfriend by our names towards the end of the trip. Something simple as that goes a long way! 

I planned a Romantic Dinner on the gazebo for my boyfriend’s birthday for an extra charge. It was absolutely perfect. The food (I had tuna tartar, mushroom soup, salad, filet Mignon, lobster, fresh coconut ice cream, cake, strawberries) was fresh and well prepared. Moises, our waiter, was the perfect waiter for the occasion. He was funny & personable, attended to us, and made sure our night was just perfect. Very much recommended if you are staying for a special occasion! 

Contrary to popular belief, the drinks were not watered down !! — @ Royal service. They make frozen drinks fresh filled with flavor and alcohol. I got a few drinks at the pool on the other side and they were watered down so I Knew I picked the right option. 

The overall service was exceptional. The staff was very responsive via e-mail even prior to arriving. They made reservations, sent me a preference sheet, booked outside golf tee times, and coordinating the private dinner for me. Upon arrival, Mario and Melina were genuinely kind and helpful. Djordge was our butler who literally treated us like we were royalty by checking on us (via text) daily... even on his day off! He was not overbearing in any way, but simply wanted to make sure we were cared for and fully relaxed the entire time by taking care of the small details. Upon arrival, we received champagne and a cake in our room. While we were at dinner On my boyfriends birthday, they decorated my rooms with balloons and had champagne ready upon arrival from dinner. 

Wow, wow, WOW! Thank you Royal Service at Paradisus!!

reviews.author: 5899nena
reviews.title: Amazing !
reviews.text: This all inclusive hotel is simply amazing. Everybody is so pleasant, always with a smile and always asking if you need something or if they can help you or guide you. The facilities are beautiful, you feel your are in direct contact with nature, so much vegetation, but at the same time it’s so modern. The restaurants are great, all of them have a beautiful ambiance, they are all very appealing and they all have great food.  Everything that you need you will find in the hotel and there are so many activities that you will be active all day long. The beach is so nice but a little rough though so you need to be careful, although there is a lifesaver most of the time. They have shows at night which are very entertaining for thw entire family.

reviews.author: Cara
reviews.title: Customer Service from Management is Lacking
reviews.text:
We choose this time and location due to the desire to travel with friends who are owners.  Our reservation was for a King room on the ocean side.  When we checked in there weren't any king rooms available.  After seeing a few options we opted to keep our room and have the beds put together.  The first two nights were wonderful.  On the 3rd day a group of 600 conference attendees arrived.  During lunch the entire group came into the buffet at the same time and took over the restaurant.  They removed plates from tables that were occupied in order to be able to be seated.  Granted this wasn't their problem as the hotel and the conference planner should have had the fore-site to accommodate the attendees while avoiding interruption for the hotel guests.  The conference attendees were rude and pushed hotel guests out of the way in order to get their food first.  we decided to let this go and move on.  However that evening, the Red Lounge which stays open until 2:00 AM stepped it up a notch to entertain the attendees.  As mentioned before we had no issues the first two nights despite being in building 3 which is where the clubs are located.  The first night that the attendees were present the DJ turned it up and the attendees were so disruptive that we complained.  The manager on duty, Alejandro chose to do nothing despite the fact that the concierge admitted that they were trying to get the music turned down and the security guard said it was out of control.  Alejandro was rude and dismissive to us as we are females  The following morning we were moved to an "owner" building and given bracelets which allowed us to go to the adults only portion of the resort.  The front desk admitted the situation was handled poorly.  This would have been great but our travel companions/owners did not have the same privileges so we did not partake in the benefits (with the exception of being moved to a more quiet building.  
Thinking that all the inconvenience was behind us we went about our way meeting other guests/owners and enjoying the resort.  One challenge is tipping all the wait staff and we were running out of pesos.  I had previously gone to the concierge and converted dollars to pesos.  Knowing that the staff appreciate american dollars I went to concierge and attempted to break $20.00 bills into smaller amounts to tip the staff.  I was informed that I needed to check with the bellhop or bar staff.  the bellhop didn't have enough so I asked  front desk to again convert dollars to pesos.  I was informed by Guadalupe that  i would need to go downstairs in order to do so.  Mind you we had already done it at the desk as had our friends.  In my frustration I returned to Bana where we were eating dinner and the manager noticing my frustration immediately was able to get me smaller american dollars.  The next day I went to the front desk and brought the situation to their attention.  The day manager was out ill so they said they would take it up with her the next day and let me know what the plan was.  Today (Friday) we went to the front desk and after several go rounds with Margarita were informed that because we signed off for an upgrade on the noise level that nothing more would be done.  We were also informed that they were having trouble with the front desk staff and that the general manager was addressing it.  Neither the manager nor the general manager contacted us nor have they made any efforts to address the situation.  I was a previous owner at ME Cabo and can tell you that I would not recommend the resort to anyone until the management and front desk staff get their stuff in order and figure out that customer service means putting the customer first.  
Before any nay sayers respond, this is my 7th stay at a Melia resort, I paid full price, and have confirmed with the owners we are traveling with as well as the ones we have met that this is not appropriate.

reviews.author: Junnie
reviews.title: Celebration birthday !
reviews.text: Friends recommend this hotel they say the service everything is so good but  was 2yrs to go we coming to Celebration birthday 5day 4ninght  ! Last time my friend get free upgrade but not for us 😂😂. So we pay extra to upgrade the room if you ask me any  special  For the birthday they only will  decorate little thing in the room !  food service is ok not bad! Service some  are good same are so so next time not coming back this hotel !

reviews.author: Johncasablan
reviews.title: WOW!!!! Best Service Ever!!!
reviews.text: All I can say is Wow!!! I am an avid traveler and I work in hospitality in Miami Florida and I was very impressed about the level of service at Paradisus Cancun.. visited for 3 days for my mom’s birthday and everything was exceptional. From the upgrade to Royal Service to the cuisine and not to mention the service! Special thanks to Maria our butler for the incredible touch in the room for my mom and aunt’s birthday. Also to Arron at royal service, Cristian Lovera and Eddier at Naos restaurant for the incredible service, they really made us feel as part of the family. Definitely recommend this resort!! We will be back very soon! Thanks guys for making our stay unforgettable!!!

reviews.author: riiiiichh
reviews.title: #WhereYouWantToBe RELAXED
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun consistently continues to provide the best service. Friends and myself go there every 6 months or so for a quick getaway from the NYC grind. Staff always delivering stellar service. Alejandro at the hotel entrance to safely handle our luggage. Andres serving us morning "Tequila" during breakfast at the Market Grille. Luis and Flor taking care of us poolside all day from the moment the bar opens, all the way to last call at the end of the day. They made sure that we never had to leave that lounger for anything. The new updated rooms give a bright "Miami-esque" vibe to the former look which was a delight. If you don't book Royal Service, upgrade to the Gold band if you can to get access to Royal Service amenities. Access to YHI Spa and La Palapa alone make it worth the $$ .

reviews.author: mlomrantz
reviews.title: THIRD TIMES A CHARM!
reviews.text:
Having just returned Monday night from another FABULOUS vacation to Paradisus I must say thank you again.  They say “Third times a charm” and it sure was.  

The secret to a great resort is the staff and the “ambassadors” that represent you.  I must say everyone we encountered – one was nicer than the next.  Our waiter Pascual welcomed us back with open arms and waited on us hand and foot in Naos.  Special “shout outs” to the following who also made our trip so memorable: I made sure that I told Edgar the food and beverage manager what delights his staff was!
Edwin – Bana;Jorge – Market Grill ;Luis – Vento;Ivan –Fuego;Rafael – Enso
Also in Naos was Guadencia, Ataliano, Orlando and Arturo – all wonderful and so kind and friendly. Please share with all of them how we enjoyed their service and friendship.And the bartenders in Avenue and the beach beverage person Hugo!

The weather was perfect except Monday morning which brought rain as we were leaving.  The cleanliness of the resort was so evident with everyone wiping and cleaning all day long everywhere you turned.  We had no problem getting chairs on the beach and for the most part the crowd was respectful of one another.  To say a good time had by all is an underestimation.  You exceeded our expectations YET AGAIN.

We hope to return again next year and bring our family with us again to enjoy what we truly believe is “PARADISE”!

I thank you again for running such a great resort for all to enjoy.  I had been in Lisbon the week before for New Year’s with a group and am off to Colombia on Feb.1  I needed to just sit back relax and the only thing I needed to worry about was what ingredients were going in my omelet that morning and where I would be dining that night.  You made it so easy to relax and not have to think about anything. I have already come back and told some of my work colleagues yet again – you must go to Paradisus Cancun.

I appreciate you letting ramble on and on but had to tell you what a great vacation it was.

Until we see you again, my warmest regards,
Merle Lomrantz
Room 3608

reviews.author: Quest35569044650
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: The only bad thing was that I couldn’t do late check out and it was not enough chairs on the beach, but the overall experience was great . Good was great service was great location is great . We rented a cabana in cocos beach a great experience

reviews.author: Leila R
reviews.title: Fun time
reviews.text: Lots of activities by the pool and during the night. Rodrigo, Saul, Julio were amazing and I did wax art by the pool.great time during this vacation. The service here is very great and would recommend canacun to anyone.

reviews.author: REBECCA C
reviews.title: Felicidades al equipo de animación y shows
reviews.text: Omg it was awesome and Saul and Julio was the best entertainer and took care of us all! We received an upgrade to royal service which was so appreciated. Thank you so much for all the accommodations! THANKS!!!!!!

reviews.author: bcad0072016
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones and Chicago girls
reviews.text:
Wonderful time Saul and Julio was so much fun and made us feel comfortable ❤️🏝
And paradisus cancun was the best, the drinks, entertainment and accommodations! We ate at the various restaurants and got a free upgrade! I loved it here and will recommend others. Thank you Paradisus!

reviews.author: selenazy
reviews.title: Great service and Staff
reviews.text: It was our second time family vacation to Cancun. We had a great time there. The beach is really amazing, food and service are good. The room on our first day there were at first floor. Even though it's an ocean view room, but hardly see the view. So we decided to change our room and upgrade to Family Concierge room, then we have Lily and Gloria to assist us. Big thanks for them. The room is definitely with better view, brighter and kids friendly. After upgrading we have access to the family concierge lounge. Lily and Gloria always sent us the activities needed to be booked in the morning, and asked if we needed to book any. They always asked us which restaurant we wanted to book for the dinners. They gave my daughter a surprise gift everyday!  On the day we didn't go to any park, they also helped us to book balibed beside the pool. Whatever we need, and whenever we need it, we just need to msg them thru whats app. With their service, we feel the upgrade worth every penny. Great memories there. Thanks everyone in the hotel!

reviews.author: Alexandra S
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text: I had a very good experience with my family in this resort. The beach, the view, the shows, activities and the staff are fantastic. Rodrigo and Sarah were amazing, very nice and friendly guys, they gave us so much to do like activities at the beach and in the pool

reviews.author: netman4
reviews.title: Overall!
reviews.text: The rooms were great! The view was breath-taking! the restaurants were so-so. The steaks were tough at the Steak House. The Italian was very good. The buffets were plentiful. The wait staff were all very attentive and pleasant.

reviews.author: Isaip317
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: It was our first family trip out to Cancun and it could not have been any better. Service and hotel were amazing. Food was delicious and family Concierge is great to have for families with young kids. We took our baby and the experience couldn’t have been better. Sandra and Gloria took great care of us. Most frequent visited restaurant was Naos which is open all day. Great service! We met a waiter Edwin who took great care of us on multiple occasions. Including a private dinner on one of the nights during our stay. Great memories! Would definitely go back!

reviews.author: lbabchuk
reviews.title: Paridisus Cancun
reviews.text: Very good service! There are very fun activities that the workers provide for you. Constant volleyball games, zumba, and excersizes that keep you moving and having a great time! The workers that helped out most and went above and beyond were Rodrigo, Lucia, Angel, Adriana, and Saul. The waitor that always tended to our needs even when we were needy was Darwin. He worked at the Brazilian restaraunt and the Asian restaraunt. Excellent time here!

reviews.author: Penny R
reviews.title: Great Hotel with exceptional staff
reviews.text:
We chose this resort for our family vacation of 2019 after our experience last year and we were not disappointed.

Building Five was quieter than Building one and we enjoyed being on a higher level. We like to have the slider open to listen to the ocean, but if it's a busy/noisy night, the slider can be closed. The house cleaning staff was attentive and our refrigerators were always full. The hotel is beautiful, grounds are immaculately maintained, and each staff member is friendly and welcoming.

The variety of restaurants is perfect. The restaurants that require reservations (such as Fuego, Market Grill, Mole) can be made  48 hours in advance by calling the front desk at seven AM. I made calling at seven a priority and we were never disappointed  in the choice of times for our family of five. If you do not make reservations, you will be frustrated as they do fill up quickly. The restaurants that do not require reservations (such as Naos and Ensos) are great alternatives, especially Ensos as it is open air and is located on the ocean. Naos has a large  variety for breakfast, however the other locations for breakfast are quieter and offer a good variety of options as well. The pool side lunch location offered more choices this year. We enjoyed the seafood cocktails and wraps and the boys enjoyed the burgers/fries/pizza. My sons definetly missed the crepes this year...but were nearly as pleased with the ice cream/gelato.

We stayed at a busy time, so we did have to reserve our chairs at the pool or beach by setting our towels/items on them early in the day. The gym has many options for aerobics and strength training, and is very clean. We arranged jet skis and parasailing with the staff at the pool. It was easy, and actually, slightly less expensive, than if you pay directly on the beach or at Aqua world. My middle son golfed several times on the property and enjoyed the experience. 

Staff makes this hotel a five star experience. Each person passes you with a greeting (hand over their hearts was most endearing!) and they all work so hard. Of course, there are those that stand out amongst their peers.

David Dominguez Osorio was exceptional and made our experience unforgettable. He is attentive, friendly, personable and has such a strong work ethic! We watched him carry two (very full!) trays at a time while working at the beach. His pool side service is timely and personable. He always has a smile, hug, high five or hand shake  for the guests that he serves. He really makes an effort to know the guests...greeting them often with their names. Our experience would not have been the same without him and when we consider future family vacations, David's service/personality will make it difficult to not choose Paradisus Melia!

We met Angel Lugo during one of our dinners and were so impressed with his service that we made reservations two days later at Fuego (his normal restaurant)  and asked if he could be our server. He is also very  attentive and personable. We trusted him to choose our entire dining experience at Fuego and we were all beyond pleased with his selections! He certainly gives his all to his service and made our experience at Paradisus memorable.

Sergio, at the pool, was also very attentive and sweet. He also goes out of his way to make his guests comfortable and happy.

Upon reading other reviews, there are suggestions that you receive "better service" if you tip. I did not find this to be the case, at all! We always tip, but do so at the conclusion of our meals. Our service was always exceptional, whether at breakfast, lunch or dinner and was clearly not dependent upon the tip we left as we were leaving the table.

We did purchase a bottle of wine with dinner (as a treat for ourselves beyond the house wine) and we found this process very simple. The servers do make sure that you realize it is an additional charge,  so it is not a surprise at the end of your stay. The margaritas and champagne/mimosas and frozen drinks (including those 'sin alcohol' for the boys) were very enjoyable.

The resort is very sensitive to food allergies! While making reservations, you are ALWAYS asked if there are any food allergies. Our friends were going to join us this year, however their son has a peanut allergy, and were hesitant as we were not aware of their policies. This is a positive addition to their policies!

The front desk seems to be understaffed, causing a little frustration on vacation.

We had some difficulty with the door in one of our rooms (the lock had to be fixed/replaced three times) but the front desk staff were extremely responsive.

reviews.author: Balkan99
reviews.title: (4.5) Great Hotel, could be overpriced.
reviews.text:
Great hotel by it’s architecture and design with great location, I believe it was build about 30 years ago, over very large size of land and is very well kept all around.
Lobby area and interior are amazing, as the outdoors, pools and beach.
Service in the restaurants could be disappointing at times unless you show that you are a tipper.
Most disappointing for us, was the food and drinks quality. If you are vegetarian or wine enthusiast you may have some challenging times.
In few occasions the waiters were saying “NO” on our wine requests and they were trying to upsell us wines, despite the fact  they have few different choices unless you tip them.
Pizza was never offered  at the buffet restaurant, which is very desirable for kids as fries were not available every day.
I’m a consistent tipper, but would like to tip after the service is received not before to bribe for better one after paying $$$$$ for the whole trip.
The Entertainment area for the night shows is small and shows were about the same every night, there was only one night with  life music out of seven nights and  also there was almost no evening  entertainment for the kids.
Housekeeping service was great, but may be for the fact that tips were given, few times during our stay.
We didn't use the special restaurants, because of the limited menus there with vegetarian and kid choices, we preferred to dine in outdoor all of the time, that's why we used the International buffet. and The Market Grill, but was noisy and not very relaxing with service been rushed especially with servers cleaning the tables and pulling out our plates before we finished with our meals.
Over all it is a great place for vacation.

 
Here is a ranking by my own opinion and experience in different areas.

Hotel facility and condition - 5
Grounds, outdoor areas, pools and beach - 5
Security - 5
Restaurants service including tip - 5
Housekeeping service - 5
Rooms privacy and noise - 5, except when the AC kicks on.
Balcony and views - 5
Bathroom and shower - 5
Room and bed comfort - 4
Food and Drinks quality and choices - 4
Entertainment - 4
Check in process, elevators efficiency - 4
Restaurants service without tip - 4
Kids friendly - 3
Beach service - 3
Life Music - 1

We had a great time at this resort and definitely will go back, if the price is right for us.

reviews.author: Brett
reviews.title: The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly
reviews.text: Just got back from a 6 night stay at this resort. I’ll start with the good. I think the staff and Hotel cleanliness are good. The restaurants are better than other all inclusive’s I’ve gone to. I was in an updated room and that was nice as well. The Bad was the buffet and the lack of a coffee type place available all day. For the Buffet, it’s was eh. Not impressed. I’ve been to multiple RIU resorts that have a far larger buffet selection. There is a Nespresso station for a handful of drink options. However, they were out of ingredients when I asked for one of the items. I went to that Nespresso bar at various times during a day and it was closed. The hours aren’t posted from what I could tell. I think the hotel needs something along the lines of a Starbucks (definitely doesn’t need to be Starbucks) that is available all day for the guests. Something like this would provide a variety. I think the guests would like it because, the times the Nespresso was open, there was a line. The ugly consists of 3 items. First, our room was on the 6th floor in the main pyramid (bldg 3). However, we were not told there is a disco that opens at 10pm every night in that bldg. That disco is on 1st floor yet sounded like it was in our room! If you plan to go to bed prior to 1am then I suggest being in a different building. The staff should notify guests being placed in that building about the disco and give an option to be moved. Second, I went to get lounge chairs outside at beach and pool during day and almost all were taken. Yet, there are countless cabana’s surrounding the perimeter with all but one being empty. I was told the cost to rent one was over $100. Didn’t seem right to have so many of these open yet almost all lounges taken. The last item was the lack of alcohol in room. In most other all inclusive’s that I’ve been in there is stocked alcohol in the room. Here, there were 3 different Mexican beers and that was it. No rum, tequila, wine, etc. In short, I paid more for this resort and had higher expectations as such. I think I’ll try another resort next time.

reviews.author: Maryb
reviews.title: Great staff!
reviews.text: Rodrigo,angel, Lucia, July, Adriana, kept us entertained with always something to do. We played volleyball/ danced to Zumba/ did acuafit. We had a great vacation and thanks to them we always had something to do. The food is also very good and the servers were so kind and on top of their job. Darwin was our server and he was very sweet and went out of his way.

reviews.author: Olga K
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: Awesome service. Entertainers are great, we played volleyball/games every day and there were shows/activities by the pool. Rodrigo, Angel, Saul, and Lucia and Adriana were very nice and friendly! The waiters are so sweet, we loved Darwin! Hotel was clean and lots of variety for restaurants. Great stay, would come back.

reviews.author: Nadia K
reviews.title: Best entertainers!!
reviews.text: Today is my last day here! I’m so sad to leave!! Rodrigo, Angel, Lucia & Saul were so great at keeping us entertained!! I had such a great time by the pool and with beach volleyball!! They will be missed!!! Can’t wait to come back!!

reviews.author: Journey27813006360
reviews.title: Hire new chefs and focus on taste, quality, authenticity, and delight
reviews.text: There are excellent ingredients in Mexico so please use it to your advantage.  Hire people who can teach rest of your cook team how to make tasteful meals.  The Asian restaurants seriously lacking flavors and authenticity.  It's really a waste of ingredients.

reviews.author: Miguel B
reviews.title: expected more for the price
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel before several times. We like the property design , amenities. However customer service has declined over the years. We changed rooms 3 times. We travel with our son , and my husband requested a queen bed with a sofa. We were given a two bed room. Then the third room had the handle of shower room broken , we left and no-one show up to fix it. Many of the furniture through the hotel was broken. Employees did not pay attention to our request. My room was sent to the laundry by mistake , called reception to find out about it and they did not get back to me until the day I was leaving and because I went personally to the front desk. several times we asked for something and the waitress said they did not have it. If you tip them they will go find it!!! It should be the other way around. If they provide a good service then you tip. It was OK , but we expected more for the price and 5 diamond category that this hotel has. Really disappointed this time.

reviews.author: Anne Lee
reviews.title: Really enjoyed
reviews.text: I truly enjoyed this hotel. Lobby is beautiful. The room are definitely are maintained clean. Beautiful pools & beach. Only thing I would say it was so confusing getting to my room. The hotel is a maze.

reviews.author: Lexi P
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Paradisus is a great place to stay, there are many activities and shows that they offer. Saul, Julio, and Rodrigo were great with getting everyone to enjoy the activities and created a fun, energetic environment.

reviews.author: Bella mendoza
reviews.title: Fun in the sun- truly paradise
reviews.text: Our family stay at paradisus was excellent. We were able to reconnect as a family with beautiful views and entertainment. Saul, rodrigo, and angel were amazing entertainers and played volleyball and other games with our kids. David went above and beyond for our family- great service.

reviews.author: Anthony B
reviews.title: Beautiful beach and pool
reviews.text: Awesome service and beautiful pool and beach, would return. Saul, Julio, and rodrigo are great. Great entertainment and shows. Also people at the kids zone Adriana, Sara, Lucia, Arne y Ricardo, entertainment team is the best, the best waiter David and Luis at the pool area

reviews.author: Victoria P
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Great family vacation! Second time here and Saul, Julio, and Rodrigo helped make it so much fun! They encouraged different activities each day and made them fun. Also, my family and I noticed that the shows and the entertainment were a lot better this year compared to last year when we visited January of 2018.

reviews.author: samrinahassan
reviews.title: Wonderful all inclusive Resort
reviews.text: Had a near perfect vacation. Were greeted immediately on arrival and ushered to be checked in at the private family concierge area without any wait/hassle. Very impressed by the staff. The staff really makes you feel special. Upgrading to the family conceirge was TOTALLY worth it.  We had 2 personal butlers assigned to us Sandra and Gloria, both of them were amazing. They created a WhatsApp group right on our arrival, and kept informing us of daily resort activities, booked our bali-beds/cabanas , stocked back our mini bar and made restaurant reservations. They checked on us frequently making sure we got what we needed. The baby club was great with very loving professional staff that took care of out 18 month old. Halina and Sara at the baby club were very good and We felt very comfortable leaving our lil one with them. Lots of fun for the kids. Resort is huge, and you would expect it to not be that clean or have that beach resort type typical smell, but no -the resort was extremely clean and they used really innumerable pleasant smelling diffusers/candles at every possible corner that gave a very nice smell. We also used the hydrotherapy with steam and Sauna at the spa and got our selves pampered by getting bali-moon couples massage that was for about 2 and a half hours. It was a great deep massage session and the masseuses Gemma and Anna were very professional and good at their work.

reviews.author: RR40
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort!
reviews.text: Second trip to Paradisus and was as good as the first! Stayed in family concierge and traveled with my 11 and 18 year olds. Were greeted immediately and checked in at the private family area. Rodolfo and Alexander were our butlers and did a outstanding job! They made our dinner reservations, answered all questions, reserved cabanas and checked on us constantly to see how we were and if we needed anything. I mentioned on short notice it was my sons Bday and they decorated the room and sent up a cake! The food at the sit downs was excellent and they have one of the better buffets I have seen. Drink service is fast and top shelf liquor was used. They have a beautiful beach area with life guards out front. Every night they had entertainment also. The facility is clean and we had maid service twice a day. Room service was sent up in 30 min every time we ordered. This is one of the better all inclusive resorts  we have been to and I plan to return.

reviews.author: Arik1970
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: Incredible place. Superb hotel. Comfortable beds, quiet at night, great food, and nice pool area. Lots of fun for the kids. Everything was perfect. Great service by Violeta and Fernanda our family concierge staff. Will be back soon....

reviews.author: Laura S
reviews.title: Not bad for 2 days at Christmas
reviews.text:
Grateful there was rooms available so close to Christmas. The main lobby and all the inside of the hotel was beautifully decorated for Christmas Check in was easy for us. Color coded wristlets for those who could drink and those under age is smart. Not to thrilled with the sales ppl who talked with us about joining thier clubs.
