We were their for 2 days and didn't want to spend 90 minutes in a presentation to get a day cabana and food. Plus who know how long Tilley were ready. They were a little pushy with it which we were not a fan of. Wifi in the buildings was great but once you stepped outside at the pool or 10 steps outside at the beach, it's not the greatest. There are a couple restaurants that require dinner reservations and with Christmas Eve and Christmas Day, they filled up very fast but were able to get an early dinner res at the Market Grill. Very limited buffet menu for a place that required reservations but went back and forth to the non res buffet next door and made the best of it. The breakfast morning views around 8am ish were beautiful while eating. They were just so breathtaking <3 taco place was my favorite! No horchata but that's ok lol housekeeping doesn't do a great job keeping the mini bar/fridges restocked. 
Not a bad experience since we were at the beach most of the time. Not sure if we will be back though...

reviews.author: StephTheGray
reviews.title: Royal Service and the pool conscierge, Degnar are the BEST!
reviews.text:
Here for my husband's annual sales meeting, staying 6 nights.

Arrival was a rough start.  Our flight arrived early, so we were on site trying to check in at 11:30am.  What else are you gonna do?  Fully-clothed, luggage, been up since 3:50am... but alas, our room was not ready yet.  We waited.  And waited.  And waited.  Colleagues were being placed in their rooms... not us.  Finally at 4:30pm, my husband blew a gasket and was speaking with Roberto, one of the front managers, and he took care of things right away.  We upgraded to Royal Service for $100 extra per night, ocean view, room 5608 and it was the best thing we could've done.

Once on site we found the Royal Service to be quiet, no kids, and nearly unpopulated.  Every day you have to reserve a Bali Bed if you want one (awesome, canopied beds around the pool and beach.  Degnar ALWAYS was kind, courteous and professional.  He always tried to accommodate whatever needs I had.  I hope the hotel will consider giving that man a raise.  He arrives every day at 5:00am and works hard to create a clean, inviting space for guests, including me.  Thanks, Degnar!

*The gym is excellent, I used the elliptical machine, treadmill and free weights.
*Room service is excellent.
*La Palapa (Royal Service exclusive restaurant) is excellent.
*Beach service food and drinks are excellent.  Be SURE TO TRY THE SPRING ROLLS.  
*Surf is beautiful aqua blue and is very, very rough with RED FLAGS always up.  There are only a couple of yellow flags further downs the beach in sections wheret it's a little safer to swim.
*Lots of easily accessible bathrooms.
*Waitstaff speak pretty good English and they helped me with my fledgling Spanish.
*Nespresso machine in my room... YES!
*Nicely stocked room refrigerator (chips, M&Ms, beer, water, juice, etc).
*Weather in January is incredibly wonderful, not nearly as hot as Punta Cana this same time of year.
*You get your own personal assistant while you're here (Royal Service only).  We didn't use him much, but others seem to use theirs a lot.
*Clean, clean, clean!!! (at least in our RS area)
*Plenty of well-located beach chairs.
*Aqua - World is across the street inland and it's fun and free to go watch people in the surf machine.  Or you can pay and try it!
*Tipping is optional.

I'm going to visit the Myan Pyramids tomorrow (Chitzan-Itza)... $89 for a Royal Service guest.  It's an all-day (7-7pm) excursion, I will update when it's over.

So... come here.  But DO get the Royal Service.  You won't regret it.  It's crowded and noisy in the other sections.  Building FIVE is great.

reviews.author: Felisha C
reviews.title: Amazing resort and Perfect wedding venue
reviews.text: We love this resort! The food and service are amazing! We hosted our wedding there in April. It was the most gorgeous wedding ceremony at the gazebo. The entire Romance department is wonderful. Marlena is the best! She was our wedding coordinator and made sure that every aspect of our wedding was perfect. Each of our 30+ guests loved this resort just as much as we did. I highly recommend the Royal Service. Our butler, Jesiel, was great! Getting dinner reservations is much easier through Royal Service, and you have access to a private pool and private beach area, which helps you avoid some of the crowds. I cannot recommend this resort enough. It is the perfect wedding venue, and a great vacation spot!

reviews.author: bsushi
reviews.title: Go for the Royal Service!
reviews.text: Royal service really upped our experience at Paradisus Cancun and Alex the butler assigned to us made us feel incredibly welcome and relaxed. With Excellent food, attentive drink service and a gorgeous property, this is truly a top notch all-inclusive experience.

reviews.author: papasmith2
reviews.title: love this place
reviews.text: the main building was a little humid but the theme behind the hotel to match  the ruins it all makes cense the rooms are great. we had a newly remodeled room .the service was fanon Amal the people were great and very friendly.

reviews.author: Lexie S
reviews.title: Amazing resort and workout experience
reviews.text: We loved our workout instructor! We had an excellent experience at the resort! The highlights were the different workout classes offered in the morning and afternoon. (6 pack, boot camp, etc.)  Saul Zarate, the instructor, was amazing. I went to all his classes because he was just such a great instructor and my form for many workouts improved. The resort had shows each night, amazing restaurants, an Incredible staff, and a beautiful beach. 10/10 recommend this resort to all.

reviews.author: Katie S
reviews.title: Amazing workout
reviews.text: Saul zarate  is the best workout instructor ever! Fun time. We did boot camp and 6 pack and they were both so fun, the gym was great and the shows were great too. Awesome food, great beach all around fun time.

reviews.author: Michele
reviews.title: Amazing vacation
reviews.text: A great place to stay. the staff washers always so helpful, friendly and courteous. The hotel was simply gorgeous with a relaxing atmosphere and close to transportation, shopping and many tourist attractions.

reviews.author: Go56885646918
reviews.title: The best stay in Cancun
reviews.text: Seriously such a beautiful resort! Everything from the food, the rooms, the service, and the beach was great. Also the royal service upgrade is soooo worth it and at a reasonable price for such a beautiful resort!

reviews.author: Mikori1961
reviews.title: Family Trip
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort, clean, modern and inviting, the pool area and the cabana service is outstanding. Night time dance club was very entertaining.  The staff were very accommodating ready to help in anyway possible.

reviews.author: Vivababe
reviews.title: Stolen shoes from luggage stored after check out
reviews.text:
We stayed here in November and needless to say we ended up arriving home missing 1 pair of my husband brand new sport shoes...we did not check bags and after our check out this is what went down:we had our shuttle scheduled at 3.15pm and we went to the bell desk at 2.45pm and we were kinda told to take the shuttle loaded at the entrance not knowing why they are pushing us to leave...but clearly the shoes dis-appeared at this time the bellman should have just asked us if we can give him these shoes...we would have just gifted him these...anyway I hope the resort gets to the bottom of this issue asap
Otherwise the entertainment non existing so I have to share that days and evenings are boring not much happening here...
The food is excellent at the Buffet thou! 5 star for the buffet for sure! 
Sam and Flor at the beach bar are awesome, friendly and professional!

reviews.author: Golan N
reviews.title: GN
reviews.text:
Our stay was fantastic from the moment we arrived. We were taken to a private check in area where we were introduced to Rodolfo and his counter part Alexander. From that moment the trip was smooth sailing. They took care of everything from dinner reservations, planning etc. They took the thinking out of the vacation and made it a great week. Elliott the pool concierge was amazing. He helped and made the pool experience enjoyable and stress free: Victor and Sergio at the pool and beach made each day in the sun relaxing with whatever you needed.
I would highly recommmend this resort if you want a group of people that can make your vacation and enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: mmillerme
reviews.title: Great Experience and Service
reviews.text: The service we experienced was outstanding. Wait staff and servers in restaurants were skilled, personable and engaging. The pools were beautiful, plenty of activities, live music and performers on site. We had a great family time, perfect for everyone in our group.

reviews.author: Alejandro P
reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.text: Worst check-in experience, they gave us a room used by someone else, it took almost an hour because they try to sell you lot's of overpriced stuff. We also had an issue with our reservation and hotel staff didn't helped us at all.

reviews.author: LindaVegas1955
reviews.title: Paradisus is paradise!
reviews.text: My daughters and I spent Christmas week at the Paradisus Cancun. We were greeted by friendly staff and the resort is spotless.  Plenty of activities are available.  Their travel desk, provided by Otium, was very helpful and booked our excursions. We will be back!

reviews.author: Vacation02946444889
reviews.title: Great hotel and good location
reviews.text: Great place and good food, my son fell when getting out of the shower due to the high bath tub but other than that, we had a great experience at the resort. The staff and food is great. I would recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Camper112336
reviews.title: Healthcare
reviews.text: I will recommend this place to anyone who is traveling to Cancun because of extraordinary and excellent customer service. I am looking forward to visit the sister resorts in different countries since I like traveling.

reviews.author: Jeffnpa
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: We took a week in August 2018 for a couples only vacation. We stayed on the Royal service side of the resort. We arrived using USA transfers and highly recommend using them. Once we arrived they took our luggage and we were met at the door by staff who took us to check in. Once they identified us as royal service they took us to the Royal service check in. we were met with a drink and welcomed with a overview of the resort. Our room was not ready however our butler met us and took us to La Palapa restaurant for lunch. While we were eating he got us a day bed to relax by the pool. At 3pm he texted us to let  us know the room was ready and he took us to the room. It was a great beautiful room with a sitting are, two bathrooms and large balcony. The resort is wonderful, we are a very busy couple and did not want to be involved in activities, So we went to the pool everyday and read, slept, relaxed, swim. The restaurants are plenty and just ask your butler to make reservations and he/she will. there was never a bad meal or experience every night was different but great. I recommend Mole, Market Grill Bana (sushi).    .

reviews.author: Cliff Jones
reviews.title: Excellent Service and Value
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun was by far one of the best vacation experiences I've ever had.  I'm 29 years old and have traveled all over the world and stayed in luxurious hotels with my family growing up.  Paradisus Cancun had excellent service from the moment we arrived, and the exceptional service continued when they called after we were settled in to make sure our room was as we expected and to offer to meet additional requests.  The room service was excellent, the food was excellent, especially for an all-inclusive resort with a lot of guests, there was wonderful live music, excellent nespresso, gelato, and crepe shops, nice stores and gift shops, and the location is safe and convenient.  The beach was clean, beach service excellent, and the staff was very accommodating.  Overall, for a 4 star all-inclusive resort, the value far exceeded the low price we paid to stay there.

reviews.author: Adel S
reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.text: Overall a great experience at this wonderful resort. The staff was super friendly and accommodating. There was a ton of stuff to do. The food was great, alot of different restaurants to choose from. The rooms were spacious and up kept twice daily. Minibar was filled whenever needed. Overall great resort.

reviews.author: Michael F
reviews.title: Relaxing stay and helpful staff
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Christmas week with our two teenage sons.  It was our first-ever experience with an all-inclusive resort.  We were pleasantly surprised and truly enjoyed the experience.  The rooms we had were quite nice and the staff was always accommodating. For example, when we asked the concierge about restaurants to accommodate vegetarian needs, she called the head chef to meet us. He asked what we could eat and made certain that there was a note in our profile that special meals would be prepared if necessary.  (Be certain to book your dinner reservations as the restaurants fill up fast.)  The restaurant staff were all pleasant and attentive, and food was quite good.

We would no doubt return for another visit. We came home relaxed, tan and happy. What more can we ask?

reviews.author: Tour46454543197
reviews.title: Good Hotel
reviews.text: Good Food, Good location, clean rooms, Good customer service. Quick response. Slow check-in process. Pool is awesome. Beach access, They could have the restaurants open till 12.00. They close at 11.00PM

reviews.author: Rob Bravo
reviews.title: Untrained Unprofessional staff. Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text:
We stayed there from December 22-26. Group of 9 with 4 adults 5 kids. Booked via Melia. Got the upgraded family concierge rooms. With this you get a butler who is supposed to help you out through out the stay. The reason I am giving 2 stars is for unprofessional service and limited food choices. First for the unprofessional service.

The day we got their we informed the butler we would be celebrating a birthday for my son and requested the cake on 24. She said it was all taken care of . On Dec 24 I reminded her 4 times to make sure the cake was available after dinner. At the time of dinner the hostess refused to seat us telling us that the butler did not reserve the table for 9 of us , she only reserved space for 6. After 30 minutes of explaining she said" She will oblige us with a table" . Once the dinner was done, we asked for the cake. There was no cake, the butler forgot to put the order. While trying to the hostess to figure out what happened , She told us to leave the table asap and waled out of the room because we were wasting her time and she had other guests waiting to be seated on that table. We walked out and asked for the manager. A guy showed up after 1 hour at family concierge and said all he could do was send the cake to room now ( this is around 10 pm). We agreed to get the cake. At 12 midnight there was no cake in sight. We called again and the cake arrived at 1 am when every one except 2 of the adults were fast asleep.
Next day after complaining, we realized the staff is unapologetic and offered us massage for 4 adults for all the troubles the staff had caused. Which we accepted.

Now for the food: Choice for vegetarian foods was extremely limited. After we ordered food most of the time half of the food would not arrive because the server forgot the order. All in all I would never go back to this hotel.

reviews.author: Charles C
reviews.title: The Service Is What Makes This Hotel
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paradisus 12/21/18 - 12/28/2018 with my two teenage kids.  I would say for the price this hotel is a little above average if you factor in the quality of the food, problems regarding making dinner reservations at the hotel restaurants that are actually popular because the food is decent. However, if the Paradisus did not have such hardworking dedicated staff - this place would be a 1 star.  My family had breakfast on the outdoor patio at their NAOS Restaurant every morning. The reason we went there was because of the wait staff provided us with not only amazing service (they had our preferred drinks ready every morning), they were friendly, professional and no request from us was too much. I would especially like to thank the following wait staff from NAOS who in my opinion MADE our stay at the Paradisus great: Cristian Lovera, Jose Chan, Thomas Bello and Arturo Be. Paradisus is extremely lucky to have the people working for the resort and should make every effort to make sure they stay. Again, if it were not for our Breakfast experience at NAOS - I would have rated the property a 1 star.

reviews.author: Passenger45339050364
reviews.title: Sub-par all-inclusive experience
reviews.text: Half the restaurants were reservation only. So for a 3-day stay you only get to experience those restaurants once. If theres a big party then your time will get pushed. Elevators took forever so everyone took the stairs the entire time.Alcoholic beverages were watered down. We tried different and they were all the same. Directions were poor so we got lost a few times. There are no clear signs and nothing seems to be connected.Check-in experience was bad. For a trip that was pre-paid, the need to bring the same credit card was an inconvenience. So I had to charge the entire stay to another cc since I didn't bring the one I paid with. Had I left all my cc at home I wouldve been out of luck.The gym was pretty good. I enjoyed the beach! Very clean. However, the beach chairs didnt recline all the way.The rooms were nice and comfortable.

reviews.author: 3Miracles
reviews.title: Great family trip!
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful. The beach was beautiful.  The service was fantastic.  My husband and I loved the resort.  Especially when staff takes the time to remember your names.  We especially loved Cristian and Pasquale at the buffet every morning and afternoon.  They were always so pleasant and our 9 month old son loved them!  Thank you for everything. We will be back :)

reviews.author: Kristy V
reviews.title: Beautiful ocean-not great service
reviews.text: This resort was BEAUTIFUL. The only food worth raving about was the Steakhouse..nothing else was very good and I'm not a picky eater. The hotel is very clean inside and out.The workers do not treat you well if you are not a "royal" member. My mom got her Nike flip flops stolen and they were very rude to her and did nothing about it. Very disappointing. The techno music on the beach was AWFUL. But the water is so pretty that it makes up for everything. Excellent resort/not so great service or food.

reviews.author: 69karlar
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text:
We went to the paradisus to celebrate my birthday with some of my closest friends and I have to say everyone in this hotel created the best vacation ever. From the moment we got to the hotel everyone was very professional you can see this people are there to help you with anything you need. Kudos to Moises, Ricardo in the restaurant palapa he was always so happy and very professional with all of us. Our butler Daniel was 
always there for everything we need. I want to say thank you to the Royal service in the hotel the upgrade to the presidential suit was amazing this was unexpected and unforgettable. My friends and I were looking to spend time together and with this upgrade you guys let it happen! Thank you for this amazing experience and we can’t wait to be back again to this dreaming place!

reviews.author: cancunregular911
reviews.title: Another Fantastic Stay
reviews.text:
We just finished a birthday trip Jan. 20-27, 2018 and what an awesome stay. We loved the remodeled rooms in Royal Service and the newly resurfaced pool area.

I highly recommend Rode as your butler. I switched to Paradisus Royal Service because of him.  I could write a book on everything he did for us, from unpacking to packing clothes, ironing. making reservations at all the restaurants, and the champagne, and balloons for my birthday.

 All the staff at the pool Omar and Carlos. and at la palapa. Valeria, Victor, Ricardo, Jose, Octavio, Moises, Josue. Thank you so much for making everyday spectacular. 

We stayed in a 1 bedroom suite ocean view room 5116. The location made easy access to lobby of Royal Service, pool, beach, and a fantastic view. 

Loved the Royal Service bar area with the water features and lights at night. I would recommend the addition of a hot appetizer at night. Jorge was awesome with coffee in the morning. 

Special thank to F&B manager Daniel and Chef Eduardo for the special breakfast and lunch that you arranged. Loved the grilled lamb chops, steak, shrimp, and salmon.

If you are the vacationer that likes the privacy and relaxation and want to be pampered, Royal Service is the way to go.

Mr Lazaro, Laura, and Melinda, thank you for making guest service a breeze. We look forward to seeing you all again Feb. 2019!

reviews.author: Leyanis A
reviews.title: Awesome Stay!! Great experience!!
reviews.text: My friend and I went to the hotel for the weekend. The property is beautiful, rooms are great, and very important they are clean and confortable. The hotel has many restaurants , but we went to Restaurant Naos in the first floor which is a buffet. It has many options and I surely recommend it. Awesome service and a big shout out to Cristian Lovera and Gaudencio!!! They are the best, they make the stay so much better and fun. They make sure you have a great stay. Keep up the awesome service! I would definitely recommend the hotel.

reviews.author: Clarisel
reviews.title: Will be returning!
reviews.text: I fell in love the moment I walked in. Angel at the check in area made everything so easy for us. Every single employee was so attentive and made our stay so relaxing. My husband and I have visited Paradisus Punta Cana and I can say Cancun beats them by a whole lot. This location is absolutely beautiful. I did not want to leave. The only down side was the weather. January is their winter. Low 70’s for three days straight and no sun. Other than that everything was absolutely perfect. We stayed in the royal service part of the resort, which is adults only. Our room was a junior suite and it was spectacular. Everything was amazing. Can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Travelbuggy2019
reviews.title: 10 Stars for the Paradisus Cancun!!!
reviews.text:
We were there from Jan. 20- 25th. It was fabulous.

Pool: I upgraded to Royal Service just to have the adults-only section of the pool and at this time of year it was totally worth it. The pool is heated and huge. It was so comfortable I didn't want to get out. Plenty of cabana beds and your own private restaurant, La Palapa. The servers were so attentive. I asked for some fruit and they brought me a beautiful platter that I ate while lounging in the cabana bed. I felt like royalty. But I think if if you're looking for more activity and don't mind a colder pool, the main pool was definitely the center of the action. They had a swim-up bar, music, games, and even some performances. 

Royal Service: So this is what you get: Adults-only heated pool, poolside restaurant, upgraded room, your own section of the hotel with a beautiful lobby, buffet (delicious fruit, appetizers, pastries, meat, desserts, coffee, bar), and a butler! I also liked that you just walked downstairs out the door and there was the pool and the beach. 

Food: If you're a foodie, you'll love all the restaurants. My husband is a big meat-eater and loved Market Grill. But mostly we ate at the buffet. It was amazing! So many choices. I love fruits and vegetables and they were endless. They had everything you could ever want. There was a grill with chicken, beef, pork, red and white tuna, different kinds of fish, wonderful salad bar, smoked salmon, it went on and on. 

Beach: So beautiful, powder-soft sand, aqua water.

Entertainment: It was pretty good, some better than others. The best was a show by the pool that had a variety of acts:a beautiful couple dancing, break dancers, a juggler, traditional Mexican dancers, and drummers with colored lights. Other shows had some very good singers. It was nice to have something to do at night after dinner. 

Service: Impeccable. Everyone smiled, said hello, bent over backwards to serve you. Thank you especially to our wonderful butler Alain, Joel in Royal Service, Miguel S. at Naos PM. and everyone by the pool whose names I can't remember. On this note, please remember to bring cash for tips- they work hard and deserve them.

reviews.author: tariks2018
reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: Good experience but not the best good place for family rooms needs updates also sales associates needs to use less pressure when they trying to sell activities also needs more activities for kids other than that it’s good place overall

reviews.author: Janna D
reviews.title: Great cancun experience
reviews.text:
My family and I went to the Paradisus cancun for a week in December 2017. My husband, our two babies and myself had a wonderful time. The food was good, the hotel is very clean and the service was fantastic.

Upon our arrival, we were given a briefing about the hotel and how it works, where the restaurants are, the pools etc. The grounds are beautiful, however it might be time for some TLC.

We are beach people, so we only went to the "kid's" pool a few times. It was a shallow pool, something like a pataugeoire, but not necessarily "kid" ish. There are amenities for kids though, but they are mostly indoors, which, seeing as we are going to cancun to enjoy the outdoors, seemed...disappointing.

I really must commend the staff. We had an accident while at the resort, something that sounds very trivial, but created a very stressful l situation. Our 2 year had dislocated his elbow. We did our best to keep calm, but the front desk as well as the on-site doctor were fantastic. The ambulance came and the paramedics could not have been more helpful.

This is a really great spot in cancun. It is quite a way outside of cancun's night life, but if you are traveling with little ones like us, it's not like you are going to coco bongo at night anyway....right...

The only complaint I have is that there is no easy access to the beach if you have a stroller. My fellow stroller-sporting mamas were going up and down the stairs carrying the strollers. Some would just give up and leave the stroller at the top of the stairs (harder to do if baby has finally fallen asleep). Just something to consider.

reviews.author: sarahbB5787XI
reviews.title: Paradissus use to be good
reviews.text: Paradissus use to be good , very dissapointed , they need mahor uodate , renovations and service was very slow and not motivated.... pool was damaged all arround missing bullnose , lots of broken chair on the beach , no service on the beach

reviews.author: MARIA R
reviews.title: Dont miss this gem in Cancun!
reviews.text: Amazing food, super friendly personnel, great photographer to catch for unforgettable moments and dynamic music to dance! The beach is well kept and clean, the vary of food was amazing and the options for restaurants was superb. Even if you only stay with the buffet, is more than enough... you also have the option of having organic juices (veggies/fruits)

reviews.author: missyx0xx
reviews.title: best hotel!
reviews.text: this was my first time staying at paradisus and I LOVED it! I stayed at La Perla royal service and everyone over there are so nice and go out of your way to make sure you are enjoying your stay. I really loved my butler neftali! I you decide to stay here make sure to ask for him he's the best!

reviews.author: 762joelt
reviews.title: 4 times and will go back for sure!!
reviews.text:
We went at Paradisus Cancun the first time in 2014, one time in 2016 and 2 times in 2017
We were with Family Concierge and it's because of them that we went back. 
Our family concierge butler were Alvaro in 2014 and 2016 and Fernanda both times in 2017 - both of them were amazing!!! Each day, they were looking after us to make sure we were well taking care of.  They were also talking to our daughter in Spanish - she learn it at school since kindergarten (now she is 12) and is very  good!  
Also, we need to mention Gavdencio at Naos restaurant and Asuncion the waitress at the pool, their service was exceptional.    
All of them remembered us year after year!!! Can't wait to go back!!!

reviews.author: dbearch
reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.text:
Just returned from holiday at the Paradisus Hotel. 
When you walk into the hotel it’s very impressive and smells beautiful. We were in Pyramid One which to be fair was a very tired room but very clean and the best bed ever!
Bathroom was a little small but again very clean. We had a sea view room which was lovely.
All inclusive deal was excellent, food everywhere was very good and great variation. The bars are all very good with premium quality drinks. The staff in the restaurants and bars were brilliant. The waiter service on the beach was also very good.

We had a couple of minor issues in our room but they were resolved very quickly

The only thing that let this hotel down was the very poor service at check in. Staff were not friendly or welcoming, very little information given, a map of the resort would have been helpful.

However that’s the only negative comment I have. I would return!

reviews.author: Esme S
reviews.title: New Year’s Family Getaway
reviews.text:
My family of eight vacationed at the Paradisus Cancun during the New Year holiday for ten days. We are Club Melia members, this was our second trip to the Paradisus Cancun and it did not disappoint again. The food, service, grounds, pool and beach areas were all very good. 

A special thanks to our butler, Bryant, who was AMAZING! He went above and beyond to cater to everyone’s needs, especially our two children ages 1 1/2 and 5. His attention to detail and dedicated service was outstanding. A special mention to Edgar at the Enso breakfast buffet and Jorge at the Club Melia pool and beach. They both also provided excellent service and were very efficient. 

We’d definitely return to the Paradisus Cancun again.

reviews.author: Markell B
reviews.title: Parents time out
reviews.text: We just returned from a 5 day stay at the paradisus. It was very clean, food was greatvstaff was friendly!!! We upgraded to the royal service. We did get some awesome perks but we felt it wasn't worth  the extra charge. Of you want to eat anywhere but the blue agave and the buffet get reservations asap. We loved the market grill. Beautiful beach right out the door. Bars near by so you always could find a waiter for bottled water or whatever refreshment you needed. A little tipping went a long way. A dollar here and there kept the drinks flowing.

reviews.author: Bruce H
reviews.title: Great hotel, even better value
reviews.text:
We were swept away from the moment we entered the atrium, which really does live up to its "Paradisus" name. The aroma alone was enough to make us want to prolong our stay. I never got over that heavenly smell every time we left our room. Our room was very clean and well-maintained, not remarkable beyond that (we got a lower-category, lagoon view room). But the resort amenities are what make this worthwhile.

Food: outstanding. The buffet is excellent and the a la carte dinners were all great food and memorable experiences. Most of our dinners had live music accompaniment by excellent local musicians. Some reviewers have complained that they couldn't get reservations but we went at an off time I guess (MLK weekend) because there was never an issue.

Pool: nice pool with good services for lounging around. Frequent dance classes and ad hoc entertainment to keep you smiling. A little baffled as to why the whole pool is about 5 1/2 feet deep which makes it hard to just hang around if you're under 6 feet tall.

Beach: Plenty of loungers with occasional servers coming by. Also vendors but not overly pesado.

Classes: my wife went to a bunch of these and said they were mostly worthwhile. The yoga in particular was excellent.

Of course there are higher-level resorts in Cancun. But for the money paid, it would be hard to beat the value at the 5-star level. Will definitely come back to the Paradisus.

reviews.author: daphna262
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.text: The grounds at Paradisus are gorgeous, and very well maintained. The staff is exceptionally nice and helpful. The all-inclusive experience was great - and for this quality, I found a better deal here than anywhere else in Cancun ($216/night for two people). FYI: This is less of a party scene than some other hotels in Cancun, so it would be better for low-key couples looking for a relaxing getaway or families. The beach is beautiful with turquoise water, and very clean. The food at the buffet wasn't my favorite in the whole world, but from what I understand, as is the case with all-inclusives where tons of food is made in bulk all day long. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking to take it easy in Cancun.

reviews.author: Stacey A
reviews.title: Awesome trip
reviews.text: Booked this trip last minute, my husband and I brought our 21 year old daughter.  Absolutely awesome experience on every level for all of us.  We bought the Royal Service which was really worth the spend.  We loved the restaurants, high level of service, butler and high level to detail.  The resort itself is extremely beautiful, the beach is gorgeous, the pool was hot and the top shelf alcohol flowing....we met great people, and thought it exceeded every expectation.  We've been to all inclusives before, but this one is perfect for groups, families and fun seeking people.  Go!!!  The best all inclusive you can imagine (again - we did get the Royal Service (may not be needed for families with small kids). Great, service oriented staff who were lovely and eager to make our vacation perfect, it was!

reviews.author: Elocin
reviews.title: Lovely hotel, a few major drawbacks...
reviews.text:
The hotel and grounds are beautiful, the staff is helpful, and the all-inclusive package is the way to go.  We enjoyed the drink selections and the staff frequently checked in at the beach and pool to take our orders.  The staff were very friendly and accomodating.

 I recommend staying in pyramid 2 if you can, it is the main building and much more vibrant than pyramid 1 where we stayed.    Avoid a first floor room as well- the patio is easily scaled and I'm not convinced that the door locks would prevent a theft.  Apparently we had a "lagoon view"  bur on the first flooe or view was only a parling lot.   Further, we had people from upper balconies throwing cigarettes off of theirs and they often ended up on ours.  

We had two junior suites and they were quite spacious and clean overall.

We ate at two restaurants, Fuego and The Market Grill.   We found the food to be just o.k.  The breakfast spread at the buffet was great, however, and was my favorite meal there- plenty of selection, mimosa and bloody Mary station, a wide variety of breads, omelet station, and much more.   The fruit was delicious.   

The gelato stand and the Nespresso stand on the main floor were great and we really enjoyed them.  

Where this hotel fell short is in lighting, humidity and, well, sewage treatment.    To be clear, we were there for a very short time (48 hours) so we didn't bother bringing it to the attention of the management.   We also didn't spend much time in our room since the weather was so beautiful so it didn't affect our overall trip very much.

The room size was great, but one of our two rooms had an old couch that was impossible to sit in because it had no support.   We came to find out it was because the mattress in this sofa bed was missing entirely.    Miraculously a new couch appeared on day two, but it was odd.   We also didn't have a coffee table in that room, whereas our second room next door was much better maintained. 

The lighting (in both rooms) was a problem.   After sundown it was nearly impossible to see clearly- there were approximately 11 light switches throughout the room and bathroom, each linked to a tiny recessed light.    Even with all switches in the "on" position the room and bathroom were dim.    There is no way to properly apply makeup after dark and you have to walk around switching off each light before getting to sleep.

The humidity in our rooms was odd considering that we were able to control our air conditioning.    However, each night we got into a damp bed.   This never went away and was pretty uncomfortable, (though the mattresses themselves were quite comfortable).  No setting on the A.C. unit successfully rid us of the humidity, and we tried repeatedly.    I suspect it may be an issue with the ground floor rooms.  

Possibly the most concerning was waking up one morning to the overpowering scent of sulfur and sewage.   There was no leak or sewer backup, but the smell was overwhelming.    It suggests some type of sewer issue but we never figured it out. We were checking out that same day and simply told 'thanks for letting us know'.
   
Overall, the hotel was lovely but our rooms left something to be desired.   For such a short stay it didn't matter much, but if I was planning to stay any longer i would certainly have requested to speak with the Management.  I might come back...  but would insist on a room on a higher floor.

reviews.author: Michael H
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: We had a super duper uper good time. I recommend to upgrade to the Royal Service. With this, your personal butler makes all your reservations, arranges for cabanas, and just tends to your every need. You are also in a separate wing of the resort, with adult only heated pool, with a portion of beach separated from the noisy kids, and with butler service. I will let you in on a secret, the upgrade price is negotiable, but if you get the price too low, some of the services are not offered. Our room was newly remodeled, and absolutely beautiful. We loved the selection of restaurants, our favorite was the little bistro by the beach La Palapa. We ate breakfast there almost every morning. We took one day trip, and quickly learned to stay on base. Nothing bad happened, it is just not as nice outside the resort, and we were on vacation to relax. We would definitely go back if the opportunity arrises, it was a magical place.

reviews.author: maqz99
reviews.title: Great stay - Terrible Follow-Up Service
reviews.text:
Stayed at Royal Service Paradisus Cancun from late December to early January to celebrate the new year with my girlfriend. Everything was great, except for leaving my coat and gloves. Called the hotel in which they stated they still had them and I needed to pay for a label to return my items to me. This is all fine however they never responded back to me after 5 attempts via email with no follow-up. 

Would never stay here again after this.

reviews.author: Xglasgo
reviews.title: Cultural Care
reviews.text: Great Hotel and great location.  Especially the Illy coffee shop close to the Reception area. In particular Milka and Florencia who were very welcoming and a pleasure to be around.  The coffee in particular was great !

reviews.author: Lesley_ann_blood
reviews.title: Last night luxury
reviews.text:
We have been in Cancun for 13 nights and decided to treat ourselves to a night all inclusive before our flight home. 
Hotel is gorgeous and manicured beautifully.Rooms we had were lovely too
Check in is a nightmare- we were moved from 3 lines before we finally got to check in and were asked to come back for our room on key @ 3pm check in time which we were happy to do when we went back only one room was ready we had to wait  a further two hours for the other one - slightly annoying as a request to extend our room 3 hours was denied which would have removed the annoyance of waiting the two hours in the beginning.
Drinks, food and service were great at all times and I would highly recommend a visit to the hotel. We are going to use the brand in the UK to compare and hope that we are impressed again

reviews.author: Tom G
reviews.title: Grand Melia--- Paradsus Cancun
reviews.text: Cannot find a better place to vacation -- our stay at the Paradisus is always a five star experience. The staff and facility never cease to amaze us. The weather is usually very good also. I realize there have been travel alerts for Mexico in the recent months but we never saw any disturbances at all. we actually ate off premises every night just because we like to experience the local restaurants.

reviews.author: VWCalgary
reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text:
I was at the resort for 5 days for my Noevir (Japanese Skincare Company) 2018 Convention. It was a very beautiful resort. The entrance was grand, the inside was beautiful, everything layout perfectly. The outdoor areas was beautiful too, with a few swimming pools all setup with umbrellas, tables, chairs and cabanas. On the beach within the hotels, umbrellas and chairs are setup so we can enjoy our time in the beach.

The rooms were nice and clean, but some areas needed refinishing. I booked 2 days in a room with the lagoon view, which is a little cheaper and 3 nights with our Convention price to an ocean view room. The ocean view room has magnificent ocean view, I enjoyed watching the sun rises everyday.

The service was good at the restaurants, and we enjoyed the a Market Grill, Feugo and Bana the most.

The only disappointment was we did have some hiccups when checking in. The first 2 nights we booked through Booking.com, but somehow the hotel did not get our reservations (2 groups which were booked at the same time). We had to call Booking.com and it still took the resort on each occasion at least 4 hours to correct. Especially Kelvin, the resort reservation clerk, he wasn't very honest, he kept telling us different stories even though Booking.com had already fixed the problem, with him speaking Spanish to his colleagues, we knew he was lying. Finally we had to speak to the Manager.

reviews.author: Alicia T
reviews.title: Could Careless About Their Customers
reviews.text: I received the worst customer service possible from this hotel. My flight leaving JFK was canceled and had to be rescheduled for another time due to weather conditions. As soon as I knew I would not be able to fly to Cancun, I contacted the hotel to explain the situation. I was told to contact them via email, which I did immediately. I also made sure to provide proof from the airline, that my flight was canceled. When I did not receive a response back from the hotel regarding canceling, or re-scheduling my booking, I called them the next day. Once again, they directed me to an email address that I should send my inquiry to. I went back and forth with hotel staff regarding re-scheduling my booking, and they came back with the solution for me to pay $800+ to book at a later date (mind you they already charged my credit card $432 for my booking). This did not seem fair or reasonable, so I also inquired about canceling my reservation, to which they flat out said no. My last email to them, asking them if there were any other options that they were willing to work out with me, has gone unanswered. This hotel claims to be 5 star, but it can barely provide proper customer service to be given any stars. Such as disappointment, as I was actually looking forward to staying here. Now I will never go near it, and I will tell anyone I know to stay away.

reviews.author: kelseyd844
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text:
Every thing was better than expected 
Food was good 
Beds were amazing 
Everything was timely manner
Staff was amazing
Location was nice 
Overall hotel was beautiful and clean 
Activities were well planned and fun
Would definitely recommend

reviews.author: leenhanoh
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
We had great time and would definitely return. The service was incredible. Location is great close to airport. The customer service was excellent.
We love the food, presentation well-trained friendly staffs.

reviews.author: firstsystems
reviews.title: Cancun Paradise
reviews.text:
Beautiful property with vast beachfront and plenty of room.
Great employees including, Tomateo, Sergio, Jaime, Sonia, Claudia, Super Mario and Eduardo.  Food was good but could have been better, drinks were flowing and the Royal Experience was well worth it.  Pools were very nice.  Property was clean.

reviews.author: Terra Y
reviews.title: My wife's 60th birthday Trip.
reviews.text: Golf course was nothing but pitch and putt 9 hole.Each hole average 100 ~110 yard. All you need is pitching wedge and putter. They rent golf club with bag at $25. and each ball charge few bucks. So you decide bring your own golf club and balls.No score card. No starter. Several missing hole number sign. Very confusing to play next hole because of missing sign but beautiful scene around course. Food was great but hair dryer was still former guest's long hair inside comb when I was checked in.   There were only two electric wall outlet and consent was loose so  I have to make sure my plug keep in contact with plug. TV picture was NOT HD. Picture quality was terrible. No channel provide clear picture. Electric switch so confuse It took me little bit times to figure it out. The Italian food staff  Alejandro gave us excellent service. I want to give him 6 star. Good food and great beach and michael jacksons show was unforgetable.

reviews.author: kkausal
reviews.title: Stay at this Incredible Hotel-- Trust Me
reviews.text: I wanted to give my mom a nice Christmas present, so I decided to plan this trip for her. She is very picky about hotels, cleanliness, and food, so it's always scary to plan things for her. We arrived at the hotel and the person at the reception, Angel, already made us feel so welcome! He was hilarious and the check-in was so quick. After that we headed down to the pool/bar. I can't stress enough how nice the workers are in this place. Honestly, I think we were just constantly smiling at how sweet they were. They would recommend drinks and serve them so quickly, no matter how many people were waiting at the bar. Now the food- that was my biggest concern. I've eaten at hotel buffets before, and they were not very good. But this food? I was SHOCKED. IT WAS SO GOOD. My mom and I were both amazed at how tasty it was, and how sweet the waiters were, bringing us beer and water and anything else we wanted. We also visited Enso- which was a fantastic experience. We don't even like Asian food, but that food was great. The dish my mom ordered there did not come with noodles, but Eduardo was happy to tweak the menu for her and let the chef know. "We'll make it special for you" is what he said and it definitely put a smile on her face. We also dined at Vento, which was so cool. We ordered about 3 small dishes each, which we didn't think would fill us up, but we couldn't even order dessert with how full we were. The hotel was impeccably clean and always smelled so good. Other amazing parts were the gelato bar and the Nespresso bar. What really made our visit stand out was one of the waiters in the buffet- Edwin. We really could not stop talking about how sweet Edwin was to us. For breakfast, he offered us mimosas and talked to us about Chicago (where we're from). He made us laugh non-stop, and as if that wasn't enough, on our last day we were getting ready to check out, and he came up to the checkout and handed us a small piece of cake (best cake I've ever eaten) that said 'Thanks for Visiting.' My mom and I could not even believe it. Thank you to the entire staff of Paradisus for making this such an amazing stay. We can't even think of one bad thing about this hotel. If anyone is wondering whether to stay here- let me tell you that it's absolutely perfect. Beautiful beach, wonderful food, and an incredible staff. We can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Curlies
reviews.title: Royal Service guests
reviews.text:
We have been to Mexico a number of times and decided to return to the Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun following a great experience/stay from last year (this is my second review of the hotel on Tripadvisor).
It was nice to get off taxi, drop off the bags, get arrival drink at Royal Service check in and finally relax after a long trip. As soon as we entered the hotel I felt everything was taken care of. We could truly relax! Beautiful beach, choice of restaurants with nice food, being a Royal Service guest, daily re-stocked in room mini bar, bali beds - make your stay even better.
I loved breakfast and lunch at La Palapa (my favourite place) - the view is amazing and food was good (desserts were basic but it was not an issue as could always have a cake or ice cream in the Piramid)! One of the great servers Cesar helped us on the last day to organise our lunch/orders at La Palapa prior to our transfer to airport. 
Another place we liked, Market Grill - also great servers (during the last visit it was Alfredo and Manuel - both excellent and attentive) and nice food. meat and vegetables offered vary from day to day. a famous "red/green button" disappeared - apparently this is a result of changes coming up to this restaurant. We have also noticed that the restaurant has less tables than before. Less availability - is this to 'encourage' guests to eat in buffet? still unsure how dinner reservation process works - we tried to move our booking by 30 min one night and it was impossible (despite of many tables being unoccupied).
Fuego was also among our favourites restaurants too. Again nice food and servers. Delicious warm rolls as a starter, duck soup, salmon with sesame seeds, coconut creme bruele...mmmmmm. Dont forget about Tempo too - it is a great dinning experience and I would recommend it (our tasting menu was included in the package). 
Nespresso (former illy) and gelato bar had tasty coffee and ice cream.
Pool service/concierage was great - always happy to assist. He remembered our names during the whole stay. Victor was a fabulous pool waiter! 
Royal service lobby bar was good to have a drink and a snack in the evening - would be great if coctails (Paradisus has a tasty bbc, mud slide or strawberry daiquiri) were served there too. Breakfast at Royal Service lobby was not the best - we tried it once and never came back - can not beat La Palapa with a beautiful view.
Slightly disappointed with a butler - we requested the same butler as the last year. The butler has not been proactive this time round - eg. no surprises were left in the room (last year we received bottles of champagne, decorated strawberries, roses etc). just a minimum service this time.not what I was hoping for being a returning customer.
Overall Royal Service section feels so much more relaxing than the rest of the hotel area.The rooms in piramid 5 have been renovated - glass wall (with a curtain) separates bathroom and bedroom. Mini bar has been stocked daily.  Pillow menu which used to be in the room disappeared and when we wanted  to request aromatic pillow we had to either ask a butler or concierage (leaving the note at a door handle was more convenient).
coffee machine in our room was broken - the hotel inspected and replaced it soon after we reported it.
Tequila gift we received from the Hotel was a nice gesture. 
Would still consider Paradisus Cancun as our hotel for the next vacation.

reviews.author: chlolo50
reviews.title: Family stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
It's our second stay at Paradisus Cancun I was with my family and 2 grand sons 2years and 14months.
it's really a 5 stars, rooms are large and well equiped all is always cleaned.
The staff is efficient and  very kind specially with the children.
for the last day we have a surprise: a chocolate cake with this registration: have a nice trip! we were really affected by this.
Special think and thanks  for Mariza welcome desk Naos restaurant and Mr Gaudenou, Ignacio, ,Alfedo waiters in the same restaurant.
We recommend this hotel for a stay in Cancun.
Laugie family

It's our second stay at 

paradisus

reviews.title: Stay at beach resort in Cancun
reviews.text:
Great beach and pool areas. Excelente food and service.
Confortable rooms but noise comes from main lobby reaching even 8th floor.
Good activities ran by a friendly team: salsa, merengue and zumba. Plus volley and soccer.
Classes such: wine tasting, cooking ceviche a disappointment but there is room for improvement.

reviews.author: Coleman P
reviews.title: AMAZING Resort!!!
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about this place! Definitely worth the upgrade to the Royal service. I just spent a week here with friends and this is for sure the best resort I have ever stayed at. The property was beautiful, the food was wonderful, and the staff was INCREDIBLE! Daniel was our butler and he was there to help with anything and everything. He booked us cabanas by the pool for every day and always made sure we were happy with everything. BIG shout out to Moses and Orlando at the pool! These guys were on top of things. They went out of their way to make sure we were happy and enjoying our time. All of the restaurants were great - I especially liked Blue Agave for their authentic tacos. The drinks were were wonderful as well! We go to Cancun every year, but this was our first time at Paradisus and we will definitely be returning. Thanks so much for all you guys do at this resort! It was an amazing vacation.

reviews.author: OK_Traveling2014
reviews.title: Poor hotel
reviews.text:
Exceedingly poor hotel for the money.

I booked a lagoon view suite only to have a view of a wall. The light switches are cracked and broken, there is only one working power point, the floor is dirty, the safe in the room was locked when I arrived, etc. 

Additionally, the staff couldn’t seem to care less about issues. When I went to check in, they insisted my company had not paid for the room despite my having a confirmation number. They said they would take an imprint of my credit card but wouldn’t charge it until we could sort it out in the morning. They of course charged it immediately.

Additionally, when I went back with the booking confirmation form showing the credit card imprint from the travel agent, they insisted on seeing the bank statement to confirm the payment had gone through. 

My EA emailed them 4 times without response, and I have been to reception 6 times now without resolution.

reviews.author: Penny R
reviews.title: COMPLETELY SATISFIED
reviews.text:
We come to Cancun every year and stay at various resorts. We stayed here (prior to children almost 20 years ago) only because our "first' choice was not available while booking the trip. How grateful we are!!!

The food and variety of restaurants was amazing! The  restaurants at Paradisus exceeded our expectations. The food was amazing and the service spectacular and personal. We have three boys (and I have a husband who is an amazing cook) and we still can not name our "favorite" restaurant because they were all so great! All you have to do is call at 7 am on the day prior to dinner to reserve the restaurant. They were all so amazing! .The buffets are also  great for breakfast...and if you want a quick lunch.

Our Pool waiters were Sofonia Cabrera  David Dominguez Osorio and, Manuel...and they were AWESOME. We suffered the tragic/sudden death of my husbands brother prior to our trip and felt it necessary to share with them as we were not ourselves.  They were so attentive with buckets of water;/beer and constant service...it was amazing!!! We are so very grateful for their attention! They were personal and we appreciate their hugs. Their service was over the top and their professionalism unprecedented  MUChAS  GRACIAS!!!!!

We also loved Omar Garcia who we met at lunch at the seafood restaurant on the beach, but typically works at NAOS (the buffet). We were SO thrilled with his service and attention, His talents are clear when one on one with families and made us feel very special. At NAOS, I can imagine that the experience is Very different with the buffet style/Etc. I think Omar's talents are with personal customer service.

Edgar seemed to be in training...but his smile when he saw guests??? SO VERY genuine. You need to promote him right away to another position beyond food service. He defines awesome customer service. ALWAYS with a smile and positive attitude!

Our boys played golf and loved it...you do have to register for T times and there are golf clubs for rent. The central store handles it. Pack some golf balls...as the balls are probably overpriced but  the golf is really inexpensive1

There is a coffee place and an ice
cream/crepe stand. My boys visited the crepe/ice cream stand multiple times throughout the day!

We were there in high season, and it NEVER felt crowded. The pools are amazing and the beach is large and beautiful. There are dancing lessons and volley ball at the beach when interested. Staff makes EVERYTHING fun!!!\

Ultimately, the resort was clean, well staffed and managed well..even during the "busy" season. 

Staff was not only friendly but  was soon to become your friend.

If someone negatively reviews paradisus, they have their own (negative/never happy) issues.
This place was over the top amazing111

reviews.author: RotemRY
reviews.title: Great experience !!
reviews.text: Amazing experience!! We had a great time with the Zumba morning lessons, great shows at night (Elvis and Tenors), good restaurants (Vento, Mole, Blue Agave) and overall amazing service without being overwhelming! A repeat for sure! Need to keep a good look at cleaning around corridors, but great experience!

reviews.author: Kady S
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation!
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun before Christmas and had an amazing vacation. We were upgraded to the Royal Service, which was amazing as it was our first vacation together since we had our son. Our room was beautiful and very clean. We found the food at the hotel was very good, the pool temperature was perfect and the beach is absolutely gorgeous. The staff were extremely friendly, service was quick and we had no trouble finding chairs at the pool or the beach. The restaurant on the beach was a wonderful place to have a nice, quiet breakfast in the morning. The restaurants were a bit difficult to get reservations at, but we managed to try a few of them and enjoyed the buffet when we did eat there. The only thing we would have liked to see was more nightlife for adults, but we realize there are also other hotels and places to go to in Cancun for this.

We really enjoyed ourselves and it was the perfect first 'child-free' vacation for us. We would certainly go back.

reviews.author: Kihwan Hong
reviews.title: so so
reviews.text:
if your room arrange  first floor of piramid 3, don’t use and request other room. Because the smell of room is barbecue from the kitchen.
Especially room numner is 3125~26. The front desk staffs were not friendly.

reviews.author: Мариель Х
reviews.title: One of the best hotels I’ve been to!
reviews.text:
Well, EVERYTHING here is AMAZING!
Selection of restaurants is awesome. We loved the food, delicious! 
Bana, Enso and Fuego - our favorite!
Great international buffet with thematic drinks every night.
The entertainment during the day was also great. We loved starting the day in a sports class and then visit some master classes (guacamole, ceviche, sushi) and some sport activities. Special thanks to our lovely friend Andrea. You’re beautiful, girl! We will miss you.
Special thanks to the greatest fitness coach in my life - Martin. Guys you have to try his sessions! It’s mind blowing and fat burning. Muchísimas gracias Martin! Nos vemos! 
That’s amazing to have an adults only area where we can relax and have our calm relaxing space.
The Royal Service is GREAT.
All the stuff is so friendly and ready to give you everything you want. 
Thanks to Violetta and Fernanda, our family concierges. You made our visit a pure pleasure.
This hotel is an unbelievable oasis and we’re definitely coming back.

reviews.author: Douglas W
reviews.title: My Favorite Cancun Hotel...
reviews.text: I have visited Cancun on a semi regular basis over the past 25 years and continue to return as it is the third MOST VISITED VACATION place in the public's choice. The hotel is my favorite here because of the great quality that makes it a 5 star resort. With 7 or 8 restaurant choices in the hotel there is no need to go elsewhere. The service is fantastic and there are plenty of attractions for the kids including the KID'S Club for the smaller children. The Beach area is pristine and the HUGE pool area is the center of activity for all. I have already planned for my return next year!

reviews.author: Eric M
reviews.title: A place I’ll love to visit again
reviews.text: It is a very beautiful hotel. Beautiful design and nicely decorated. The rooms are average size with a good size balcony. What I love about this hotel is it is perfectly facing the ocean. The view on the balcony is amazing! Pools are nice and clean. Bars and activities beside the pools are fun and relaxing. Kids zone and Babis zone are very convenient for people with children. Staffs are very friendly. Nice housekeeping. Didn’t get chance to try all restaurants, but seafood options were kind of limited. Don’t know if it’s because of the season. Overall, i absolutely love the hotel and will definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Marie C
reviews.title: Fantastic Trip!
reviews.text:
We just got back from Paradisus Cancun and had a wonderful time! 

Christian from Naos provided outstanding service, as well as Sonia and Ameli from the Market Grill.

The staff works very hard to maintain the beautiful resort, and tips are greatly appreciated! 

Thoroughly enjoyed the Gelato (Cheesecake flavour is delicious) and Coffee bar (would be awesome if they could extends their hours to include the early morning). 

We did use the kids club and overall the staff was very kind and friendly - our kids had a great time! Would recommend a regular thorough cleaning of club (especially the floor mats), as well as ensuring that it is adequately stocked with water and snacks for the children. 

We look forward to returning next year!

reviews.author: Edwin
reviews.title: Great comeback!!!
reviews.text:
So from day one we were exited for our first trip to Cancun and for our honeymoon. Had really high expectations since we paid extra money to stay here because of the food instead of a cheaper place to just party. First two days we were not impressed and the trip seemed to be a loss but then we met chef Eduardo at the Market grill and made our last 3 nights unforgettable. He and chef Ezekiel made us some dishes that you can’t find on any menu at this resort and they were all amazing!!!! Chef Eduardo would look for us every time we came down to eat and he would have a little conversation with us. Then on our last night chef Ezekiel mad us a great dinner and desert. Great guys to have at this resort. 

The wait staff as well was terrific! Guillermo Lopez, Sonia and Andres Contreras at Naos and Luis in Bana took very good care of us. Never had an empty glass. Perfect service! We will be definitely coming back to the resort with our family. Hopefully by this summer we will make it again. I promise you will want to come back as we do. You really get treated like family here.

reviews.author: letsgonow123
reviews.title: 3rd time and here Still a 5 Star Review
reviews.text: This was my 3rd time at Paradisus Cancun and every time, it is perfect. The first time I was here was with my husband, second trip was for my wedding, with family and friends and this was a girlfriends trip over New Years. Whatever the kind of trip, it doesn't matter, the staff at this resort are amazing. Everyone works to make sure you have what you need. I have stayed at other resorts in Cancun and throughout the Caribbean and I would choose Paradisus over them all. I have always had a Royal Service room, but others I have stayed here with have had a regular room and they are just as nice. Royal Service is adults only, and adds in some additional services and the La Palapa restaurant. It also adds in the service of a Butler, and this time we had Rossana, who was so wonderful!!! <3 There are a few restaurants that you need to book reservations at. This time, we ate at Mole and our waiter, Christian, took very good care of us. The food and whole dining experience was amazing! Our days were spent relaxing in the sun at the Royal Service pool and Jose made sure we had what we needed from towels, our Bali bed and he checked in regularly. Joel was one of the waiters from La Palpa and also came by often, we never we lacking. The staff made sure that our days there were spent relaxing and enjoying the time we had wth each other, I really cannot say enough about them. We ate breakfast either at La Palapa or the main buffet. the Buffet has great choices and the quality of food is good for all meals. You cannot go wrong at this resort!

reviews.author: angi15
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus!
reviews.text:
This was our 5th trip at Paradisus Cancun at the Royal Service. Once again we had the chance to have Galdino as our butler, he's the best!  They upgraded us to a suite with a living room and 2 balconies. 
The service of the staff at the Royal Service is exceptionnal. We would like to thank Valeria, Cesar, Eddie, Orlando, Jorge.... and Omar and Carlos at the pool.
We love this place for the beautiful beach and the quiet spot.
See you soon!

reviews.author: anon6987
reviews.title: Do Not Trust Melia
reviews.text: We booked a family vacation, made the prepaid reservation which was a little less expensive.  When In received the confirmation, the amount was 20% higher than the rate I booked from the website and much higher than even the rate which could be cancelled.  Called customer service, they would not let me cancel since it was prepaid but told me the steps to contact billing and get it corrected.  Two weeks later they refused the change and I was stuck with airline tickets and this fraudulent charge.  Thought it was best to discuss live at the hotel with the backup customer service had asked me to provide.  Instead, I was told that my family and I could not leave the property until we paid the higher rate.  Be wary of this company and this hotel, dishonest.  I will never stay with Melia again.

reviews.author: Amneris P
reviews.title: Magnificent Experience
reviews.text: We are a family of 4. With children ages 6 & 8.  We stayed in a family concierge room and everything was amazing.  The service provided by our butler Alejandro was top notch! He took care of our restaurant reservations and activities throughout our stay.  We have been to Cancun area a couple times , but our first stay at Paradisus Cancun beats them all.  We felt very comfortable leaving the children at the kids club to do activities.  The restaurants always welcomed us and the wait staff is also great.  At Fuego: Sonia, Grecia and Luis made my birthday extra special!  We Loved Paradisus!  Going to Paradisus Punta Cana later this year and hope it is just as magnificent!

reviews.author: nicdertay
reviews.title: Family Concierge
reviews.text: We booked a Family Concierge 1 bedroom Suite with our 11 month old daughter. Let me say that we have stayed at many resorts throughout the Caribbean including 3 other Paridisus’s and the service here was the best we have ever had.  Our “butlers” Josue and Alexander were amazing and went above and beyond our expectations.  They truly made sure everything was looked after for us.  They brought our little girl several little gifts including toys, colouring books, food to feed the fish, cookies and milk in the evenings and even some candy ( which of course I ate as she is not at the “gummy bear” stage in her diet yet).  The family Concierge amenities for kids include a back pack with a sand bucket toy set, t shirt, slippers, and a children’s toiletries set.  For Mom and Dad we received wine and cheese plates, Champagne and chocolate covered Strawberries and other treats.  The suite even had bathrobes for us and a little wee one for our daughter.  There were tons of other amenities included that we didn’t take advantage of due to our daughters young age but there is a kids club, baby club, daycare and children’s entertainment everyday to name a few. The restaurants were all quite good as well and excellent service in all of them. We had a great time in Cancún at this resort.  If you are looking for a place to go with your kids then I highly recommend the Family Concierge service at the Paradisus Cancún and if you are lucky you will have Josue and Alexander as your butlers.

reviews.author: Experience321430
reviews.title: FANTASTIC service but WORST food
reviews.text:
I don’t normally write reviews but I can’t help it this time! I really don’t understand who wrote those great reviews! We are a family of four with two college-age kids. Yes, we know what good food is but we also know what is totally pre-made-then-frozen-then-microwave food is. The so-called passion fruit refresher coffee has sour milk flakes floating on top, the sushi was ceviche-thin served at “room-temperature”, the Asian flare was nothing but a joke, the buffet looks and tastes like those 6.99 all-you-can-eat at a joint off the freeway, the Spanish tapas was made with frozen octopus then reheat, so come on, they can’t even make Mexican food right! The only thing they did right was the fresh fruits; yes, they are real and fresh. Oh, also the fresh grilled lobster on pineapple, yes, that’s real non-previously frozen lobster. So the food is a “half star”.

The staff on the other hand was fantastic. The place is decent, and the beach is beautiful. If it’s not because of the service and the nice staff, I would give it “one star”. 

I have absolutely no idea who would write those high flying reviews on its food except the management!

reviews.author: teachinkidz
reviews.title: Absolute Paradise!
reviews.text:
What can I say about Paradisus except absolute paradise!!!  Upon arrival, we checked in at the Club Melia side since we were travelling as RCI guests.   They even had candy for my kids which allowed
us to focus on the check in instead
Of entertaining them...especially after a long day of travel!  The check in was quick, and out bags were dropped off to our rooms quickly.  

The lobby greenery and the overall ambiance of the hotel is simply stunning!  I felt like I was in.a rainforest.

Food was amazing both at the buffet and a la carte.  We loved the Market Grill and Fuego especially!!!   The omelet and smoothie stations at the buffet restaurant are definitely worth the wait.  If you don’t see something you want, just ask...the waiter overheard my daughter wanting pasta with butter and he immediately jumped out and said he would get it for her....that is service and it made her day!  We also really loved the poolside grill, where we often ate our lunch which had options of wood oven pizza and chicken wings!   Poolside drinks were always available...shout out goes to Manuel our wonderful server!!!  

We went to the nightly shows each night.  The Michael Jackson one and the Cirque de Soleil type show were great!!!  There is not a lot of space, so be there early!!

My kids really enjoyed the kids club activities!!!  Ceramics, cupcake decorating and wax hands were a hit!!  The also likes cooling down by playing video games before dinner.   Some of the special activities require registration...so check which activities need preregistration so your kids are not let down!

The pools and beach are breathtaking!!!!  Lots of loungers are available.  You can also choose to rent a cabana for the day!  The pool is on the deeper side except in the kids section, so bring a floatie which are much cheaper at home than in the Mexico tourist area.   Remember your thermal mugs so you can stay hydrated when walking down the beach!

The customer service and care of the workers truly stands out at this resort.   My husband got injured and needed to have surgery.  The manager at Club Melia, Ivette Sánchez, personally drove me and my children to the hospital as she could see the worry on my face about leaving the resort on my own.  She also called and checked in daily to check on my husband and my children and myself.  Ivette also arranged for my husband to be picked up at the hospital to be brought back to the resort.  Georgy, our butler was amazing at checking in on us and looking after any need we had!  On St. Patrick’s Day, I was surprised there were not any festivities and I mentioned it to Georgy....when We got back to our room, there were green balloons, green cake and a kids toy!!!  This level of customer service is not seen at many resorts...I have not experienced it anywhere!   Most people think the being injured on vacation would make you not want to return to the area or resort due to the memories...the customer service and amazing amenities made us rebook for our next vacation of which I  am counting down the days!!!  This resort truly is as Paradise as it gets!!!!

Many work colleagues have repeatedly asked the name of the resort after I describe it, and tell them about the amazing customer service!  A few are looking in to booking there for their next vacation!

reviews.author: evelynf1004
reviews.title: Best choice in Cancun!
reviews.text:
This was our second time at Paradisus Cancun, and we'd go back again tomorrow if we could! The facility, staff, restaurants... everything was perfect.
My family - with ages ranging from teenagers to seniors - was there to spend quality time and celebrate my dad's 85th birthday, we could not have picked a better place! 
We're forever thankful to the team, who took such great care of every little detail of our stay. Friendly, kind, dear people.

reviews.author: Jerry B
reviews.title: Great Time
reviews.text: Was there in early December and the weather was perfect, this was my first trip to another country and it was amazing, staff were amazing, all very polite and willing to help, please tip these people they deserve every dollar. The hotel was well taken care of and beautiful. The door lock to my room stopped working and they were up and had it replaced so fast I didn't miss a thing. Food was great and there was always something to eat at any given time. The drinks were good and did the job. I would attend again in a heartbeat, wasn't sure if I'd like traveling but now I can't wait to return to this amazing place.

reviews.author: VMannJ
reviews.title: Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: My wife and I traveled in July of 2015.  We left our kids at home, and we enjoyed the Royal upgrade package - in the section of the resort for couples only (no kids!).  The private cabanas were awesome.  The balcony view from our room was incredible.  Everything about this trip was great!

reviews.author: Lilia S
reviews.title: Grimes old Rooms with cockroaches!
reviews.text:
AVOID THIS HOTEL!  

I’m just going to leave these photos for you to enjoy and judge for your self - would you pay $$$ to stay at a place like this?

reviews.author: S9693JOadrianc
reviews.title: Fake cigars at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Did not appreciate being sold and promoted fake cigars. Best for you not to sell them at all. This will hurt your reputation. If your hotel is dishonest about its cigar products what else are you not honest about

reviews.author: Leandra H
reviews.title: A dream vacation!
reviews.text:
This is my first time in Cancun and honestly it’s been the best trip I have ever taken. This resort takes very good care of you. The place is beautiful, clean and the staff are extremely friendly that made us upset leaving them behind. I would highly recommend eating breakfast at Bana is the restaurant in the middle of the resort. Edier made are stay unforgettable so did Antonio and all the other members from that restaurant. During your stay they learn what you like and don’t like so they made our breakfast experience very heartwarming and personalized. I loved the experience in Paradisus. Everything was easy, room service, to the bar tenders and we felt super welcomed. I don’t know if I would ever be able to go anywhere else. Paradisus will definitely see me back again soon! 

-Leandra and Lina

reviews.author: ikandi
reviews.title: Can't wait to return despite the food
reviews.text:
We stayed here Jan 4-9, 2018.  Fabulous!!  The family concierge is worth every penny.  Fernanda was our butler, she took care of all of our needs and wants.  Treats and toys were left for kids and adults daily.  

The restaurants were as follows
Naos: not great selection or taste
Blue Agave: great menu, terrible execution
Market grill: great
Enso: super great
Fuego: amazing food and service
Sunset grill: great snack option

The babies club was so awesome, my kids didn't want to leave.   The ladies in there are really good with kids.

The overall service at this resort is outstanding.  My only complaint is about the food, but we will be going  back next year, so I hope they take suggestions and improve.

reviews.author: Mexico626
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation
reviews.text: We traveled during the week of 8/28/17 to 9/1/17. We had a wonderful time. The Family Concierge service was wonderful. They go out of their way to help with everything. The pool is large but so deep that you can't just hang out and enjoy the pool without crowding at the stairs and/or pool bar.  Thank you to Alan, Roberto and Jesus from the Avenue Bar, you guys were great. Alex our Family Concierge, you are the best.

reviews.author: d91804
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: We just got back from a week at the gorgeous Paradisus Cancun (1/1 - 1/8). We absolutely loved it. We went with our daughter and son ages 16 and 13. We had two ocean front rooms on the fifth floor in the main pyramid. The view was stunning. I spent weeks researching where we would go and I selected the Paradisus based on thousands of reviews. We've travelled pretty extensively (many cruises, previous trips to Cancun/Riviera Maya, visited most of the Caribbean islands, Cabo, Hawaii, Bahamas, Bermuda, Bora Bora) and we absolutely loved the Paradisus. The service was great. Everyone we met was genuinely happy to help. A special aknowledgement to Miguel at the main pool -- we never had to wait for a drink and he would often just bring us a fresh one without us having to ask. He was so nice and so humble. Sergio at the beach. He was always there bringing a fresh drink or adding ice to our bucket of beer/water. Mario the manager of Vento was outstanding. He prepared a special off-the-menu paella for us the second time we dined there. It was loaded with seafood and an outstanding meal. Leo our server at Vento was excellent. Everyone was so friendly and really went above and beyond. If we ever needed anything all we had to do was ask and they would go get it even if they had to go to a different part of the resort.
