We were very impressed with the service, the cleanliness of the hotel (they were always cleaning and it always smelled nice), the quality of the food (we ate at every restaurant including the tasting menu at Tempo which was an experience), and the overall friendliness and genuineness of all the staff. Honestly we're pretty picky but we abosultely loved our week at the Paradisus and can't wait to go back!! Here are a couple other thoughts for those of you who are doing what I did and are spending many hours online reading reviews :). The food was great. Like I said my wife and I did the tasting menu at Tempo. It wasn't cheap, about $200 a piece, but it was a great experience and worth it. For the included restaurants our favorite was Vento (great tapas options) and wonderful service. Our next favorite was Market Grill (Brazillian steakhouse style). We also loved Blue Agave for tacos at lunch. Javier was our server just about every day and he was so friendly and really made us feel welcome. The buffet (and we're not buffet people) was really good. So many choices. We loved the ceviche, fresh fruit, the hundreds of food options, and the kids loved all the desserts. The rooms were very comfortable and quiet. We slept great! We didn't do the Royal Service because the kids weren't old enough. But honestly I didn't feel slighted at all. I'm sure it's nice but it's not like you felt like you were missing out an anything. Even if we went without the kids I don't think we'd pay the extra for the Royal Service--I don't think you need it. Overall this resort was fantastic. If you're spending weeks online reading reviews about Cancun all inclusives, and your head is starting to spin, do yourself a favor and just book your trip at the Paradisus--you'll love it!!

reviews.author: jmblackburn
reviews.title: Lovely Resort...Needs a Few Tweaks for Families
reviews.text:
First of all, we are a family of five with three kids, ages 13, 4, and 2. We do much research everywhere we go to assure that the properties are a match for our variety of ages, and the size of our family....So this review is written based on the actual resort vs. our expectations from information provided on hotel website and reviews.

Start with the positives: The resort is beautiful. It is clean, modern, and the rooms are comfortable. The beach is gorgeous - Clean, white sand, perfect water, nice cabanas and chairs. We loved the barista and gelato stand. The entire feel of the main inner pyramid is beautiful, with the vines, the coy ponds, the bridges, the lights and candles at night. The food is good, but not great. We mostly at the Naos buffet for the convenience of our kids and the variety was very good. We at also at Blue Agave, Enso, and Vento. They were pretty good. 

Two great employees: *Sophie, who booked our AquaWorld experience, was very knowledgable and helpful. *Our server Asuncion by the pool is Wonder Woman. She ran our drinks and never lost her sprint and smile.

It was extremely important to us to have connecting rooms (Not just side by side rooms with entrances in the hallway). Our kids nap at varying times, we go to bed at different times, etc. I called the hotel directly numerous times before our arrival and was repeatedly told that they couldn't guarantee connecting rooms. The day before our arrival, I was then told that there weren't any connecting rooms, as in, the hotel doesn't even have any. I spent much time on the phone that day explaining that we wouldn't have booked there if we knew that. Miraculously, they then told me that out of over 800+ rooms in the hotel, there are 6 connecting rooms. We stayed for 5 nights and they could not give one to us the first night. So the solution was that we stayed in side by side rooms the first night, moved the next day (had to be out by noon, had no room until 3pm - not the best situation with young kids), and had lovely connecting rooms for the rest of the stay.

Since we didn't have a room for those few hours, and honestly weren't sure if it would take even longer, we rented a lovely cabana on the beach at Coco's. It came with a delicious platter of lobster, shrimp, and crab, and a bottle of champagne....but it is extra to rent there. Unfortunately kids were not able to nap there because we were very close to very loud music.

One other big downside to the resort is the COLD pools. The outdoor temps are lower this time of year and cool at night. They only heat the one main pool in front of the Market Grill and it gets quite crowded. The resort has so many beautiful pools that stretch the span of the whole resort...and they were virtually empty because they are so cold. I tried to warm up and get used to them and couldn't. My kids couldn't even get used to the temps. And just to be clear, this included the kids' pool. NOT heated. No hot tubs either.

Paradisus Cancun is overall a nice resort, but I don't think we would go back with kids. There are too many resorts on the peninsula to choose from that cater to families.

reviews.author: Karen Laos
reviews.title: Would go back (but be mindful - rate was $500 cheaper two days after I purchased online)
reviews.text:
Overall, we had a fantastic experience. It says a LOT that I would go back as I usually like to try new places every time I travel. Best part was the layout of the resort outside (wide open area) and the friendliness of the staff. Bummer part was the rate being $500 cheaper two days after I purchased on the Melia website and I didn't take a screen shot so couldn't prove it! Lesson learned. Wish the resort had offered some type of good will gesture, but I didn't expect it.

Pros: 
* Royal Service was the way to go! We were well taken care of and it felt like a different, more peaceful world when you went from the main area to the Royal Service area. Dinner reservations were made by our butler so we never had to worry about where we would eat each night. We also got champagne in our room and one day our bed was decorated with rose petals. The Royal Service area also had snacks all day long and live music most nights, too!
* Beach and pool layout - plenty of chairs and space at any hour
* Food was available anytime anywhere!  Even if the buffet isn't open you can get room or pool service!
* Room was beautiful and modern - incredible shower head, too. The lower your floor the bigger your room. Because it's a pyramid the rooms gets smaller as you get higher. Our room was 5218 and was on the second floor. I normally like a high floor, but this was just perfect.
* Very service oriented overall - everyone is so friendly
* The work out classes at the gym taught by Martin were incredible
* The whole interior was gorgeous, filled with plants and beautiful smells - particularly the Royal Service area

Cons
* Bali bed system is confusing - our butler secured one for us two days in a row which was awesome, and we were on the wait list twice, but no one let us know how that works. You have to go to the pool desk at Noon to see if you're able to get one. Jose at the pool twice said "we were looking for you" but he or our butler couldn't easily called or texted us. They aren't proactive, so you have to be.
*Both jacuzzis in the Royal Service area didn't work all week

People who gave exceptional service:

Melina - Royal Service check-in (she was so attentive and tried hard to help us get our money back from Cancun shuttles who never showed up when we arrived at the airport (by calling them several times).
Kathia (so sweet, friendly and just lovely) and Consuelo (asked if I could get Tres Leches to go and she did it within 5 minutes!) at Mole 
Omar - server at Naos (made a funny joke that we won't forget his name - Brad. Brad Pitt!).
Gemma and Jenny L . - massage therapists - possibly the BEST massages we've ever had.
Carlos (Charley) - Spa Manager
Martin - work out classes at the gym

reviews.author: Bobby L
reviews.title: Complete Luxury
reviews.text: Everything about this place is awesome. Restaurants were some of the best we ever ate at in all the resorts we've stayed at. Resort was beautiful and spotless. Service was A+ in every area. The family section was perfect for kids of all ages. The adults only section was really payed back and relaxing. The spa was A+. Would highly recommend for families or couples looking to relax and enjoy some quiet time.

reviews.author: brenth171
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, beautiful beach, but if going for food DON'T
reviews.text:
We got a pretty good deal for this resort and I like to choose for food, I want to eat well. I looked at alot of reviews and felt for sure I was in good hands. Sorry to disappoint, but no, the food was average at best. There is the Sunset grill by the pool which was pretty good during the day for the same thing every day, which is fine, but the buffet was not that great. If you like fish you may do ok, the restaurants have alot of fish, but from speaking to others who were visiting too, it wasn't just us. We went to Grand Bahia in Punta Cana the year before, that was fantastic food, this not so much. Market Grill was ok, that's all I will say about that.
Coffee place open from 11-5, that was great for a cappucino, ice cream bar was good too.
Kids zone, my 6 year old had a fantastic time, never wanted to leave, he was always in good hands, they took them to eat and were open from 9-9 which is good, we didn't use that long, but used enough that he loved it.
the beach is beautiful.
I had a tough time with the room cleaners, they have 2-3 different ones coming to the room, one for the mini fridge, one to clean and one at night to put a chocolate on your bed. I really wanted the girl that cleans the room to get the tip, i'm just not sure she did cause the money was gone and the fridge was restocked (we really didn't use the fridge that much so there wasn't much to do with the fridge) so that was a bit upsetting cause i wanted to make sure the right person got the tip. hopefully they all share.
Everything else was great, just the food, I wish I could say it was good, but I can't, very disappointing that side of it.

reviews.author: Dean J
reviews.title: Cancun
reviews.text: The staff were fantastic, family concierge Gloria and Maria could not have been more helpful 24/7, the service around the pool and beach areas the best Luis Cortes, Leticia & Christian were brilliant, once you got to know the restaurants food top draw, one of the best Christmases spent with the family, nine of us went we were looked after like Lords,once again i would like to thank all the staff as they know us, the Johnston family.

reviews.author: elar9
reviews.title: Ripped off
reviews.text:
My number one issue was that my mom came down with a bad cold, she went to the hotel  doctor, which we've have has to do in the past, the bill was $600! They had told her it would be apx. $140 for the consultation and medication and ended up gouging her at the end! 
Aside from that terrible experience,  the food was just not good at all! & you have to call every morning for dinner reservations. So annoying! The drinks at the beach and pool are horrible! The juices are disgusting. Ended just drinking water the whole time with an occasional beer. Loud blaring music ever morning by 9am. But the view and beach are incredibly beautiful

reviews.author: 宏彥 黃
reviews.title: Great view and comfortable environment
reviews.text: The hotel offers great view, comfortable environment including multiple restaurants, clean hotel room, amazing beach, and bar/lounge to relax. Food are above average except meat category which is more of pro quantity than quality, where you can see much left over of meats. Front desk is less helpful and attentive in terms of the efficiency in check-in process, lack of hotel facilities info, and activities around hotel/Cancun. Clerks/Waiters in the hotel however, are very attentive and show great hospitality. One note is that some restaurants are not in All Inclusive package.

reviews.author: holli0424
reviews.title: BEST VACATION EVER!!!!!!
reviews.text: Day 2 of 7day vacation and just have to leave review now!!!!!  Absolutely perfect!!! Service and atmosphere is amazing, resort is beautiful, best food, and treated like royalty! I wish I could give more stars so I could give them 1 million!!! If you stay anywhere else you are nuts!!!!! This Resort should be 10 stars!!!! And we are only on day 2!!!!! Thank you Paradisus you rock!!!!!

reviews.author: Hatsoff2u3
reviews.title: Beyond anything I could ask for
reviews.text: Me and my husband decided to take a relaxing trip to Mexico to get away working all the hurricanes this year. We found an amazing deal at this 4 diamond hotel. We arrived in Cancun and it was hectic grabbing taxis, so my tip is to set it up before you get there. But when we arrived at the hotel, the bellmen took our luggage and escorted us to check-in. Now, at the front desk they asked us if we wanted to upgrade. I thought my husband would say no, but we splurged, and damn, was it worth it. After that, we were whisked away to our private check-in on the other side of the hotel.  Where they greeted us with drinks. (my personal favorite). Now with the upgrade, we got a private butler, a private pool, private side of the beach, a private restaurant, and spa treatments, for only an extra 500? We were treated like royalty. Our amazing butler, Rosa, made reservations every night to eat at any of the 10 amazing restaurants. We ate at the buffet once and was extremely underwhelmed. But the other restaurants were beyond great. They made us special drinks, and small appetizers, they all went beyond the call to make things special. We ate at all the restaurants and the private one was my all time favorite, we ate lunch and breakfast there and the food was melt in the mouth good. Highly recommend the gyros and the grasshopper guac. The staff by the pool and the beach was.. i cant find a better word than perfect. They remembered us every morning by name, and by my special drink (extra tequila) hahaha, Jorge, served us every morning, he was funny and attentive. They brought us buckets of beer by the beach, and mixed drinks, we never had an empty drink the whole time. The other side of the hotel was also, great, they have a swim up bar and a club type atmosphere by the beach, if you are looking to party that is where you go. Our butler on countless times put rose petals on our bed that gave us the right amount romance. The spa was great, i ended up getting a small cold while i was there, and the spa helped me sweat it out with the complementary services. I Just a tip, don't go to Xcaret, unless you like crowded theme parks, didn't know that's what it was till we got there, also, i think the hype for senior frogs is totally worth a look. All I can say, if you are looking to pamper yourself without the large price tag, this is it.. Thank you again to our butler are Jorge, It was beyond everything i wanted.

reviews.author: gibson4475
reviews.title: A Trip to Die For!
reviews.text:
This hotel is beautiful and is very well kept. The staff is very gracious and everyone greets you with a smile. They are there to accommodate your every need and they make you feel as if you are very special to them. The food at all of their restaurants is wonderful. The buffet has so many things to choose from that you would never get bored if you ate there the whole week and didn't try any of the other restaurants in the complex.
The pool was beautiful and sparking clean and the beach area was fabulous. The bar staff also was available and asking if you would like a drink and the drinks were well made. The nighttime entertainment wasn't too bad and they had something different every evening. 
I highly recommend this hotel and have only good things to say about it.
I will definitely be returning!

reviews.author: P_1015
reviews.title: Badly managed, poor facilities and terrible food.
reviews.text:
This is a massive hotel but the amenities and facilities don’t match up to the number of people it hosts. We were hoping for a relaxed stay but we found ourselves constantly fighting for space - at the breakfast buffet where there were no seats available to accommodate even half the population of the hotel, same story for other restaurant reservations and even in the swimming pools and pool beds which are woefully insufficient for the number of people in the hotel. 

The restaurant reservation system is very badly managed - bookings have to be made over a day in advance, else you’ll pay an all-inclusive price and end up eating the buffet daily. We had to literally fight for a dinner table because the entire restaurant was empty and yet the concierge kept insisting that all tables are reserved. The tables stayed empty for most of our stay. The reservation system is a complete mess. We asked for some drinks to the room and were told that to drink, you have to go to the bar. Very stressful and not the least bit relaxing if one has to fight for food in an all-inclusive resort. When we finally did get a reservation, the things we wanted to order on the menu were not available or had sold out, and the rest of the food was terrible.  We left our meal and walked out halfway through it. 

We were trying to have a relaxed nap but a concert in the lobby made that impossible too - very loud music and extremely noisy so we couldn’t sleep during the day either. Room cleaning was average and on one of the days, there were no fresh towels in the room. 

You have to pretty much pay extra for everything - cabanas at the beach/pool, late check out etc. Again, all-inclusive in name only. While requesting a late check out, we were told that the charge would be $10 per person. What they didn’t tell us was that this was an hourly rate and then hit us with a $40 bill for two hours. Absolutely ridiculous. 

It’s better to stay in a bed and breakfast because that’s what this hotel is. 
We have been to several all-inclusive places, and this has been the worst experience for us so far - noisy, crowded, poor amenities, bad food and badly managed. Wonder what all-inclusive means If you can’t even get a table for dinner at restaurants that are empty anyway or space in the pools. 

At every point during our stay, we felt that we were being fleeced. We felt very unwelcome and we certainly will not be coming back. 

Totally avoid!

reviews.author: Yolanda D
reviews.title: Worse hotel ever!! A motel looks cleaner!
reviews.text: So first of all I am mexican and I’ve been in Cancun plenty of times so you can trust my advice when it comes to hotels, so I did my reservation 2 months ago and asked for 1 bed! I got here and they give me a room with 2 beds and asked Arturo Prieto who was the one to inform me that they cannot guarantee rooms with 1 bed or 2 beds that they only give you whatever is available (so whats the point of doing a reservation with so many information!).. I paid around 600 dls per night since I had an ocean view and I did not pay that amount of money for “whatever they have available at the moment” then he tells me that maybe they can change my room the next day but he tells me that I have to go to the reception and confirm! Seriously??!! So I ask him if I have to sign something! And he said no you just need to confirm it here... So what he means is that he just wants me to spend my time and go downstairs and remind them to do their job!! Ok and thats not it.. here are some pictures of the room.. I think a motel looks cleaner!! Good thing I’m only staying 3 days! I’m seriously grossed out! I think the westin is a little bit more expensive but so much cleaner and prettier and smaller than this huge cruise hotel!

reviews.author: fibombonato
reviews.title: Paradisus is true
reviews.text: We know the Paradisus Cancun in December 2017. A unique and unforgettable experience. Our two sons were delighted. The structure of the Resort is beautiful and spotless. The service is excellent, the quality of food with its numerous restaurants exceeded our expectations. Hygiene in all spaces is unquestionable. We highlight the work of Gloria and Maria from the space "family concierge" that attended us with competence and attention and filled us with pampering, this service is fantastic for those who go with children. We intend to return soon. Our only suggestion is to expand the activities with the children on the beach. What a lovely sea.

reviews.author: Amy C
reviews.title: So far so great
reviews.text: We checked in yesterday with our three year old and upgraded to the family concierge.  Totally worth it.  Great butlers help with everything and this resort is beautiful.  Not a lot of smoking thank goodness.  Great drinks and great food.  Top shelf liquor.  Tons to do for kids.  We have done Hyatt Ziva three times but we might be converts... loving it here !

reviews.author: duaa22
reviews.title: family vacation
reviews.text:
Amazing service in the room, in the buffet, around the pool and in the beach area.  Breathtaking scenery. Comfortable Rooms. Beautiful white sand and perfect water temperature for swimming. Variety of food in the Buffet. The highlight of the trip was the amazing and fun Zumba every morning next to the pool coached by Daniel. It was a great and fun way to start the day. (Thank you Daniel). 
As a friendly note, pool activities and night activities can be improved. Teen age guests need to be entertained until mid night at least. thank you

reviews.author: sophiewilson06
reviews.title: Overall an excellent resort
reviews.text: We were looking for a last minuet New Years getaway and Paradisus was perfect! The resort is very clean, friendly staff, and the beach is amazing. As soon as we arrived we were greeted by a friendly staff who made us feel very welcome and comfortable. Our room faced the "lagoon" and had a nice terrace. The highlight of the trip for us was the beach, and we spent most of our time there. Sergio was the waiter on the beach that provided drinks and always made sure we were taken care of. There are several different food options from a full buffet with everything you can imagine that serves breakfast lunch and dinner. There is also a more casual pool buffet with chicken fingers, french fries and burgers. For dinner there are several restaurant options but you need to make reservations as soon as you arrive, the food is only okay, not great. At one of the restaurants Enso we were the only people there for a 6:30 reservation. At night there are shows and entertainment as well as a few other bars. We were not looking for nightlife so were fine with the low key atmosphere.  Overall, our experience at the resort was great and they had everything we were looking for.

reviews.author: Avideh S
reviews.title: Charged us TWICE for 7 nights stay and did not give our money back!!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for 7 nights through Christmas and New Years this year (2017), we were content and comfortable for the most part expect for the mediocre food and TERRIBLE service we received at the front desk on our last day during checkout!! The front desk staff charged our credit card twice for our stay and has yet to reimburse us the money!!
We had originally pre-paid a few weeks earlier for the full amount via Melia Reservations. At checkout on our last day, they claimed that no payment has been made and they demanded us to pay again and would not let us leave the hotel until we do so! We kept telling them that we had already made the full payments a few weeks prior and showed them the email confirmation, but they kept saying no payment was processed and they do not have it on record. They demanded that we must pay (AGAIN) until we could leave the hotel. At this point, we were running late for our flight as they kept us at the checkout desk for over 40 minutes going back and forth. We finally gave them our credit card to process the payment thinking that maybe they were telling the truth and we had to leave or we would miss our flight.
After we were on our way and checked our credit card transactions, we saw that they DID infact charge us TWICE! We then phoned the hotel back within 10 minutes of leaving, asking for a refund and they kept saying to send an email to the supervisor, or that they didn’t understand English, or kept making excuses to not reimburse us our money. We emailed the reservations and have YET to hear back from them so we were forced to call our credit card company to have them get involved!! We still HAVE NOT gotten our money back!! Be very careful when you are paying as they will make you pay twice and when you do ask for a refund for THEIR mistake, they are unresponsive!!!

reviews.author: Kamal G
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Good resort, awesome location on the beach. Nice swimming pools and lovely restaurant right on the beach. Good value for money. Would definitely stay there again. The water is blue  and the sand is white here. Staff is very friendly.

reviews.author: PETER W
reviews.title: Real Paradise
reviews.text: We go to Paradisus Cancun for Christmas vacation with ours two boys, 12 and 14. This resort is a real paradise with breathtaking garden inside main pyramid and Japanese restaurant inside this garden. Concierge family service is a pamper service all you need is WhatsApp and every request is a minute away, fast and professional service and crew very friendly and helpful, thank you Josue and Alexander. Our room, ocean view, sparkling clean, twice a day room service with mini bar restock and well equipped, surprised us ones with champagne and strawberries on chocolate and ones wine with cheese and catering, and not to forget a gift which was aged Tequila in fashion made carafe by Paradisus . Many restaurants to choose from and main buffet offering huge number of food variety always everyone can find their favorite menu. Everything always freshly cooked in professional way and tasty. Waiters fast and very friendly. Many sunshades by the pool and on the beach and only sunshade beds are for rent only which is confusing because belong to Coco Club and are extra cost. Bars are widely spread along pool so no matter where, you are close. Sack bar by the pool always has food ready to eat and hot. Variety of boutiques at the property makes shopping easy. Christmas decorations beautiful with big Christmas Tree right in the middle of the garden, lights are everywhere even lighten garlands hanging from the roof down makes awesome effect at night. On Christmas Day Santa arrives at noon with many gifts for kids so every child got something, follow up a snowing effects right in the garden makes a taste of winter for Christmas atmosphere. Overall this was very good choice for a family vacation at the 5 star resort which stands up at any occasion very well managed.

reviews.author: Afshin N
reviews.title: Excellent Staff, Food, but no Entertainment
reviews.text:
No Pool Table, Ping Pong. Day and Night Entertainment was very poor. 
The rooms are not fully high Tech. There is not USB Output to charge the phones or ...
The rooms are not big enough.
Excellent Staff.

reviews.author: adam_petr
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text:
We stayed there for just three days so I cant (unfortunately) review all of the resort restaurants :).. 
+ services
+ clean & comfortable rooms
+ views from your appartment (also a lagoon view is nice)
+ lot of possibilities to do (you are nect to Cancun)
+ well equiped gym
+ kids friendly
+ one of the bars in the lobby is opened from 11pm to 4am (with live DJ)
- noise from AC
- noise from main lobby
- lower quality of food (we werent in the restaurant where one of the michelins chiefs cook)

Recommendation: 
I am going to return! :)

reviews.author: Bhaskar C
reviews.title: Great Hotel and Service
reviews.text: Overall great place. We got a sea facing room. The mini bar was filled regularly. Daily breakfast was great. They allowed us to access the facility even after check out till our transfer to airport in the evening.

reviews.author: W2047CXsusand
reviews.title: Wonderful Holiday Experience.
reviews.text: Lovely hotel and staff.  Family concierge is a must for helpfulness and reservations. The beach beds were incredible. Rooms large and spectacular views and private patios. Bathrooms need an update but overall excellent!

reviews.author: Brenda B
reviews.title: Nice hotel but double check your reservations
reviews.text: I stayed from January 25 to 29. Location of the hotel is great, is a little far from tours like Xcaret, Xplore, Chichén Itzá, but is close from malls and  located in the hotel zone. Just in front is water world or something like that, where you can do a lot of water activities. The food is good but you have to make reservations in advance on most of the restaurants. Staff is amazing, very friendly and helpful. The only problem is that I made my reservations in an lake view and two beds because we are a family of four and when we arrived there was no lake view and only one bed and there was dirty plates in the room!!! I tried to talk with Eduardo (the person that gave us the room) and he wasn't helpful at all. He moved us to another room again with one bed and there was a strange odor. I tried to talk with him again and he didn't even answer anymore. Another person told us very rude that they can't change us until next day, that they only can provide us another bed, that actually never happened. So be careful when you make your reservations. But we had a great time after all.

reviews.author: Cortney D
reviews.title: Amazing trip! Great family resort
reviews.text: We traveled with a 3 year old and 4 year old and this resort was perfect! Awesome kid pool and activities the food was delicious and a huge variety with the buffet for the kids. We would give the kids buffet food for dinner and then drop them off at the baby club and Alma and Adriana were awesome with them! It was wonderful because then I would be able to go and have a nice relaxing evening with my husband! The beach was right out the front door easily accessible for the kids. Already planning to come back next year!

reviews.author: deandgeorge
reviews.title: quick cancun escape
reviews.text: just returned January 2017 from this hotel. the reception staff was awesome and check in and check out was wonderful. fast and easy.... our room was on the sixth floor with a beach view......very clean and and beautiful........the hotel was filled with green plants and flowers......it is very clean and the staff always greets the guests.......the down side to this place is the fact that is is a join in club and they try very hard to sell you.....i had no idea it was a do you wanna buy in hotel........also i want to let everyone know that the smell of the spray and incense they burn is so overwhelming it almost chokes you....i have allergies and it really irritated them......the beach is nice and the staff works hard to make your time a pleasant one....if you can tolerate smells and dont mind being bugged to buy in it is well worth the all inclusive price. manuel at the bana bar was out of this world.....

reviews.author: jf19572017
reviews.title: Great vacation with excellent staff!
reviews.text: The property has everything you need for a great holiday. Staff are amazing! We enjoyed Zumba by the pool with Hugo and Suzanna, workouts in the gym with Freddy and drinks by the pool with Veronica. Best gym we have seen at a resort - cardio, weights and a spin room as well. The evening shows were great and again staff were there to assist. Thanks for everything.

reviews.author: Lilianabv
reviews.title: i had high expectations..
reviews.text:
building, decoration is nice but little old. room with ocean view has a bathtub and nice view but again decoration is old fashioned... the most important thing here was the food.. I did not like it at all.. and if you want to pay all included is not only for quantity ... we tried 3 restaurants and were simply tasteless. 

I wont recommended it because for that price you can get much better.

reviews.author: Natalia G
reviews.title: The Best family vacation!
reviews.text: Location is between laguna and see. The view is amazing from both sides. The staff is the nicest staff we have ever seen. There are 8 restaurants and you have a dinner in different restaurant every day. The hotel interior is amazing. A lot of green plants, fountains, fish in a small pools inside of the hotel. The food is delicious. Cleaning is 3 times a day! Everything is perfect!  But it is not suitable for people with allergy to smells. There is an intensive flower smell by the evenings.

reviews.author: Wanda K
reviews.title: The worst EVER
reviews.text: Really, its the worst hotel I've ever been. The immediate response for all the employees was "NO" . It was really annoying. We ask for jam and they tell us its only for breakfast. We asked for a table for 6 and they told us NO . They had the worst attitude . It is really the worst experience ever . The employees have no training . They want to charge extra for everything and it's all inclusive !! Please , take my advice and go to Secreta The Vine or Hard Rock . Depending on your type of trip . It's a bit expensive but trust me , it's worthwhile.

reviews.author: Carol M
reviews.title: Just amazing!
reviews.text:
Clean, safe, over the top service...special call out to Jorge, letcia, and Jose for making us feel so cared for. Beaches amazing! Just one of the nicest vacations. Chefs cooked the fish we caught at Mole and did an amazing job! Pool is great, plenty of space. Morning yogurt and fruit from the market was made with love by Jose!

Tips- use the hotel recommendations for taxi service to and from the airport. Pay attention to the activities- don't miss any, they are great. Coffee in the room not as good as the morning coffee available in the ground floor of building 3 and building 1. Bring a float for the pool or buy one in the Market shop. Reserve a pool or beach bed early!
Restaurant were good but we also walked to the captains cove, crab shack and wanted to go to Fred's but ran out of time. Do the parasail right on the beach and get your pictures the same day or they won't be available. Bring cash to the beach, there were folks who walked by and gently offered their goods. Some great jewelry buys ......definitely bring a sweater for breezy nights. Catch amazing sunrise from your ocean front or the beach.

You can't go wrong visiting this incredible place!!! Love my Mexico and the wonderful people who make it special!!!!

We will be back again!!!!!

reviews.author: Rudy B
reviews.title: Royal Service- Amazing
reviews.text: It was my first time in Mexico and the Royal Service at Paradisus made it an unbelievable one. The luxurious lagoon view and service was amazing. Geraldo, the butler, was unbelievable. He had items sent to us based on each activity planned during our stay, as well as dinner reservations planned in advance. Carlos was also very helpful and friendly even though he wasn't our butler. Paradisus was unforgettable.

reviews.author: humpty1
reviews.title: Excellent Staff
reviews.text: We visited this hotel and were pleasantly surprised.The beach is beautiful with a stunning blue water.The hotel has numerous restaurants with Enso, Mole and Fuego standing out.Avoid Nacos as the food is rarely hot and fresh.This hotel is aimed at American audience with few Europeans.They tend to takeover the hotel at weekends with stag and hen parties.The staff are amazing with Efrain from Mole,Nathaniel from Enso standing out.

reviews.author: Kara Z
reviews.title: Very Enjoyable!
reviews.text: We were cared for on every aspect of our stay. The people here and off resort are great. The food on resort is one of the best I've had. Highly recommended. Would definitely come back again. There is great entertainment and opportunity to go off resort for excursions.

reviews.author: Ryan Z
reviews.title: La Palapa Staff and Royal Service Pool Staff Made Our Vacation!
reviews.text: We cannot begin to express our gratitude to the staff of La Palapa and the Royal Service Pool staff, they made our vacation unforgettable. Yes, the pool was great, the beach was amazing, the room was freshly remodeled, and royal service was 100% worth it, however it was the people that made this vacation a perfect one. Muchos gracias Cesar, Moses, Omar, Eduardo, Octavio, Carlos, Edier, Hector, Javier, and Ernesto, you all are absolutely amazing! We know we forgot a few names here, thank you ALL for your hard work and dedication to guest satisfaction. We cannot wait to come back and spend another vacation with this wonderful crew. They are so friendly, helpful, service oriented, humble, and hard working. Research no further, book the Royal Service and go down and visit La Palapa staff and the Royal Service Pool staff. I've never been treated better anywhere else, and I travel very frequently. PERFECTO!

reviews.author: Lorna F
reviews.title: Fab Christmas at Paradisus Cancun - Royal Service!
reviews.text:
We opted to spend Christmas in Cancun this year and escape the cold Canadian winter! It was our third all-inclusive trip to Cancun, my favorite Caribbean destination!

Resort: beautiful buildings, looks larger than it really is, but not really a long walk to anywhere. Clean and majestic! Decorated for Christmas, loved the strings of lights hanging down with the vines from the main tower! NOT a big fan of the incense they having burning everywhere (likely to mask the smells associated with the humidity of the Caribbean). I have allergies to strong scents and asthma so this was bothersome for me.

Room: No complaints here, a beautiful ocean front room in tower 5, Royal Service section, quiet, very clean and comfortable. Everything we needed was there or brought to us promptly by our lovely butler, Caesar.

Royal Service: Could not imagine NOT having Royal Service for our next vacation, so spoiled now! Complete pampering all day long, nothing was ever too much for our butler Caesar to do for us, absolutely wonderful. Sandra, guest services manager, also checked in with us regularly (along with our butler) and was very accommodating with any request we had.

Pool: Clean and refreshing. Loved the Bali beds and full service that goes with it!!

Beach: It was my 3rd trip to Cancun and the beach is always 'red flagged', so enter the ocean with caution! Beautiful beach and loved the full service there as well!

Food: Excellent meals at Fuego and Bana, our favorite restaurants at this resort. we also enjoyed lunch at the restaurant near the pool in the Royal service section. The main buffet had great selection and could always find something we liked. But a part from that, I wasn’t overly impressed with any other restaurant. On two previous trips to Cancun, we stayed next door at the Fiesta Americana Condesa and the food there (in all restaurants) was far, far better than what I experienced at the 
Paradisus. This was our only disappointment at the Paradisus.

We would definitely consider returning to the Paradisus Cancun. It was more costly than any other All-inclusive vacation that we have done (this was our 9-10th AI trip) but well worth it indeed.

reviews.author: Teresa V
reviews.title: Carlos Valencia
reviews.text:
Carlos was wonderful to are entire group my husband had his Birthday and the two Carlos brought him a cake it was wonderful 
He always was happy and attentive , we have had a wonderful trip the hotel is very clean and has a lot of restaurants to choose from

reviews.author: emon2017
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: It was amazing experience. All stuff in the hotel are excellent . The check -inn process  take long time but the person who help us to check in he was very nice. Our room was not ready so he pointed us having lunch in Naos and come back after 30 min. The room was nice and clean, we had lagoon view room which is fine. If you get room on upper level you will see  nice view of lagoon. The buffet restaurant Naos was good , you have lot of option there. We had dinner in Enso and Mole. Enso is not good at all, you have to wait long time to get ur food and its not taste at all. Mole was the best place to eat . The server Juan was excellent in Mole restaurant. The Cococs bar is great place to have drink. The bar attender give good service and make good drink. Overall is a nice place to stay , I will come back for sure. I forget the name who check us inn but he was excellent . Anthony in Naos and Juan in Mole deserve award , they are the best.

reviews.author: Joshua S
reviews.title: Great for family vacation!
reviews.text: From the moment we got to Paradisus we were made to feel like everything would be taken care of. The staff really goes out of their way to make your stay care free and relaxing. Our family concierge was wonderful and provided quite little extras for our kids each day, from little fun toys, to extra fish food for the koi pond. Even the kids little robes made them feel special. The breakfast buffet was great every day and the Market Grill was our favorite for lunch. Dinners were spread out among four different places with Vento (Tapas) the best of the bunch. The Bana sushi spot was a nice setting but the sushi was so so. Blue Agave was great for lunch as well.

reviews.author: Carmen C
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: The food, the service and the room are amazing.   We took clients there and from the moment we arrived the service and the room were amazing.  The room with access to the pool are the best ones.  Make reservation for the Sushi hotel.

reviews.author: Sandy M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Jan 25, 2017
reviews.text: Great location with ease of access to many activities and downtown.  Beautiful well maintained resort with great restaurants!  Staff are amazing and work hard to ensure you enjoy your stay.  The manager at Mole restaurant offered to make me my favourite - tortilla soup that was not on their menu - that is service!

reviews.author: Liz F
reviews.title: Honeymoon disappointment we can never get back
reviews.text:
Terrible food except for breakfast buffet. Good service but was always wanting tips (spent $300 in tips for 4 days) and felt like that wasn't enough.Their was NO honeymoon 
experience which was promisedto us. Check in not greated by a drink, had to switch rooms due to construction of next hotel . Then pushed 2 beds together to form a king.  No apology.  
good.

reviews.author: Kathleen K
reviews.title: Beautiful property in need of concierge service overhaul
reviews.text:
My family (consisting of two adults and 1 young son) visited this property during the late fall; we booked a one-bedroom oceanview suite with Family Concierge. Because we were clearly visiting in the off-season, we encountered a lot of grounds upkeep taking place. While we appreciated all the work being done, we did not appreciate the terrible paint fumes (without fans/venting) in our pyramid and family lounge.The guest elevator was out of order for several days, forcing our family to use a staff elevator/corridor that was incredibly unsafe for our young son.

Resort rooms were clean and well-kept, and we loved the little amenities like the Nespresso, mini bar, and extensive room service menu. Bathrooms are in need of updating, but were sufficient for our needs. We really liked the kids' amenities and small treats for our son through FC. 

The Family Concierge pool was perfect and quiet for our family-- but the outdoor playground was rusted and rather unsafe. We rented a cabana one day, and we'd highly suggest renting one if you want the ease of finding and keeping a pool spot for the day. Other pools were more "lively"-- but we received excellent bar service even at the FC pool.

Restaurants were surprisingly good, even with an energetic toddler in tow. We were never made to feel unwelcome-- highchairs and alternative menus were plentiful if we needed. Kudos to the server at Bana who even brought my son a chocolate milk "cocktail" so he wouldnt feel left out while we enjoyed a cocktail.  The buffet was okay, but I'd suggest making reservations for the table-service restaurants; early reservations didn't seem too hard to come by. We also LOVED Blue Agave, and no reservations needed.

Our biggest concern was the level of service provided by Family Concierge. Aside from direct requests like dinner reservations and treats provided nightly, there was inconsistent follow-through by our assigned butler. Some requests went unanswered, other times I had to personally sit in the FC lounge and wait to ask someone in person. Unfortunately, we ended up almost missing our flight home because our luggage was locked in our resort room-- our butler told us he had arranged to have it brought down by bell services, and there was a lot of finger pointing back and forth.

Given our troubles, I contacted the General Manager of Paradisus Cancun and received a prompt response, apology and an offer to come back for a complimentary stay. Unfortunately, since his original response, I have been unable to receive any response from him regarding how to book this stay. I am still waiting to hear back and will provide an update if possible.

Would I return? Absolutely-- the general waitstaff, housekeeping, and bar/pool staff were fantastic-- but I'm not sold on the upcharge for concierge level services.

reviews.author: Paula V
reviews.title: EXCELLENT
reviews.text: Excellent destination, we have come here many times and this past September we had an amazing time thanks to all the staff but special thanks to Karina at the reception. Our friends from the beach bar David and Manuel! Super warm people, the best service, the private beach Cavanas totally recommended to have a relaxing time, enjoy your time away from the crowd. Not to mentioned the DJ Manuel also great music.  We are so happy and can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Eric B
reviews.title: Great place, great people
reviews.text:
This place is the best vacation spot I have been to. The service and people are amongst the friendliest, nicest anywhere. You have to sit by the beach and have Laura and Sergio serve you drinks all day while playing volleyball or just watching the ocean. Look for Ernesto on the Beach as well. Him and his fellow friends at Volleyball etc.. are very fun and nice!
Also find Pasqual at the Market grill. 
Food is awesome and location on the beach is great.

reviews.author: Inesa T
reviews.title: Overbooked, understaffed, poor service
reviews.text:
We have been to this hotel before and where very satisfied, however not this time.  

We talked up the hotel so much that we had 3 other couples join us.  Well what a mistake that was.  Hotel was overbooked, staff could not handle all the guests.  

Check in line was out the door.  Waited for 1 hr to get checked in.  No offer of water or drinks while we waited.   

Tried to make dinner at restaurant since we only came for 3 days - well that was out the door.  Everything was booked first night, 2nd night Brazilian was closed, 3 Rd night was only 9pm open.  Mind you we went by the restaurants and they had lot of open tables.  

Buffet constantly had empty plates of food.  Requested Food and it took 3 more requests and 30 min.  Dinner at the restaurant you had to ask for more food and if desert was coming.  It seemed like we where requesting too much. 

Overall horrible experience.

reviews.author: regorzz
reviews.title: Service was so bad we wanted to come home.
reviews.text:
We stayed here for my wife's 50th birthday and i though with the luxury room and royal service we would have the time of our lives.  I was mistaken about that tho.We  were in the hotel for over a hour and had to beg for some water(no cold cloth or refreshing drink on arrival). Our room was just a regular room and not the luxury room we booked. When we talked to someone about the situation they moved us to a new room up one floor(good joke on us the had a party on the top floor that did not stop until  4 30 am.)
Called the front desk 10 times about the noise but was finally told that the convention payed more than us and to suck it up for the night.
That was the last straw for my wife and she asked if we could just go home.
Made me so mad that this trip for my wife's birthday turned into a big problem(how do you recover from a lost night of sleep)  made the last 3 days not much fun.

reviews.author: Patrick K
reviews.title: Really lovely booze filled Trip!
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I (late 20's early 30's) enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus hotel.

Shortly after booking our trip, we were contacted by Otium Transfers for airport services.

At the airport, just outside there was a gentleman waiting for us with a sign. This was perfect. In just a matter of minutes we were off in an SUV headed to hotel (for departure they were 2 minutes early for pickup. Super smooth).

Upon arrival at the hotel we were ushered to the Check-in area. This was basically the only poor experience on our trip. Luckily, I had read reviews regarding check-in lines before so was mentally prepared for it. Even though there were only about 5 groups in front of us it took a solid 20 minutes to get up to the counter. Once at counter it took another 10 minutes for the gentleman to process our passports and paperwork. This is with us being prepaid and there wasn't even a talk of up selling. Just straight up time of the guy typing into computer.

There were some groups taking over 20 minutes to check-in too.

What is quite strange is how there were over 6 staff members standing around with iPads. It would be great for this staff to be moved to be checking in guests. Build temporary computer stands if you have to.

If that is too big of a stretch, how about setting up a beer or booze cart and give people welcome drinks to take the edge off?

As we left, the line had quadrupled in size. I felt bad for guests just getting there.

Other than that the hotel is quite lovely. Staff is amazing. Incredible customer service. Room was good, lovely balcony, decent mini bar with beer stocked, tons of bottle of water too. I had read a review about issues regarding the "all-inclusive" deal. For us, the only thing we saw people being charged for was select wine. Otherwise everything is good to go. In regards to quality of drinks Belvedere vodka by poolside and kettle one and Grey Goose at the inside bars. There is constant opportunity for booze basically everywhere. At the pool we found a quite corner with a server taking our drink order constantly. 

In regards to food, make sure you make a reservation for the restaurants (we did this upon arrival to our room). We were handed a sheet at check-in with tons of information about the food, wifi etc which was great.

Overall the buffet was a bit hit and miss, but the restaurants were good.

This place was a great vale.

Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Corneel K
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text:
Second time we stayed at this brilliant hotel. Love the pool and the beach. The food is very good for an all inclusive hotel too and service is all round excellent. 

The only thing they should improve is the capacity of the checkin desks, queues can be rather long in the high season and personally I am not a fan of the shows in the night club. 

The sea side rooms/suites with jacuzzi on the balcony are great and it is relatively straightforward to find a spot at the pool where there is no entertainment.

reviews.author: STraveller22
reviews.title: Worst experience ever - do not stay
reviews.text: I truly just joined TripAdvisor so I could warn everyone about staying here. The staff are inefficient, unhelpful, and rude. The rooms are terrible, food mediocre, and beach full of hustlers. Don't go.

reviews.author: Jeffrey P
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Great experience. Beach was fantastic, pool was great, service was great, room was exactly what we needed. We did Royal Services which I felt was worth it, never felt crowded in any way being slightly separated.  Rosanna was a great butler as well as the rest of the staff whose name I cannot remember. Food was above average, would recommend Mole, Fuego, Market Grill, and Naos.  Vento was not very good but I didn't expect the food to be stellar so it worked out. Would definitely recommend staying here. They made great drinks as well and were willing to go above and beyond.  La Palapa had good food as well that they bring directly to the beach. Jorge at the beach was a great waiter so was the staff at the Royal Service bar

reviews.author: Caroline P
reviews.title: Stunning Beach and Pool
reviews.text:
We had a great experience at the Paradisus. The Royal Service package allowed us to use the adults-only pool and beach areas which were large, beautiful, and not crowded at all. The bali beds around the pool were also a plus. Being there in January, the weather was warm and sunny but extremely windy. We had great service at the pool from Jorge as well as from our butler Rossana. The Royal Service area of the hotel also provided snacks throughout the day such as fruits, cheeses, and desserts which was really convenient.

The food was above average for an all-inclusive, but there were a few dishes at the Vento tapas restaurant that we did not enjoy and the food at the breakfast buffet was always cold (the omelette bar was the exception). Blue Agave, Fuego, and Mole were all restaurants that we enjoyed.

The ocean-view rooms were great with large patios and stunning views. Very clean and modern rooms. Overall a great experience and value for the price.

reviews.author: ann g
reviews.title: Family Time away
reviews.text:
Just got back last week from a week stay.
Went with a package on sunwing with my parents and my 10 year old. We came from Toronto and spend the extra money for upgrade seats Its even for the  it for the separate line check in
when we arrived at the hotel we were greeted  and had a quick check in and explain  the hotel. The hotel is big but spread out so feels not as busy. 
The room as really nice 4110  no real view close to the lobby nit far enough away. pretty quite except for noisy guests. My view was  only of the other part of my hotel  not great but i didn't really care as I am  never in the room but my parents moved rooms to a higher level and another tower for a better view.

We ate at most of the restaurants and the buffet was my favourite. because was something for everyone. Breakfast is good just after 7 days at in same room gets bit repetitive. The tapas restaurant was good for dinner. Skip the Japanese is not worth going. They say you need to book reservations which we did but was a bit of pain so we tried walking up which was fine as well
The pool is very big and spread out bit deep for kids .  I could stand up and I am 5'5 but was up to my neck.
lots of people gather there and there is a swim up bar. Even with the pool being big some guest took that to mean they can play pool football across the pool and this was grown men who did not care about anyone elses safety. I saw 2 people get hit then I got hit in the chest sitting on the ledge. They were jerks did not even say sorry and went on to say " accidents happen" I went to complain to someone at the pool and the person I spoke to said he told them a few times and they did not stop. Well they need a course of action call security. I was more upset that what if a kid got hit or someone really got hurt. 
I later told the front desk about me getting hit and they said they would speak to the  manager at their meeting. They have all these rule signs up they need to make one about throwing footballs across the pool.

We spent the whole trip on the beach in our rented cabana at COCO beach club. Best money spent. service was amazing and everyone so nice. was great to not rush for chairs and have food and drink served.
I did find that everyday people would just come and park themselves in a cabana and think they lucked out and got one with out knowing they had to pay. The staff was very on it and asked them to rent it or move on. Yet so simple to just put a sign that says they are rentals and to speak to someone. Everyplace  I go to does that.  Staff at COCOS are amazing... David is our guy but loved them all and they made the trip great.
Water there is amazing shallow but wavy and could be dangerous if you go in the wrong area. The life guards are also amazing and keep everyone safe and was very aware of all the swimmers  they are the real hero's. Saw few people had to be saved cause of  rip current but if you follow the rules its safe.

Rooms are nice  good size clean and well stocked
everyone there was great.
Sometimes the buffet for lunch would not be ready till 1230 which was a pain.
Location : its close to a lot of stuff. 2 good malls to visit after the beach. Lots of beach to walk on.
close to the airport

reviews.author: MirelisMM
reviews.title: Royal Service to the max!!
reviews.text:
We went to the Paradisus Cancun for my birthday last December and it was an amazing experience. We stayed at the Royal service section of the hotel and they truly deliver!!
Everybody from the hotel staff was extremely attentive and we received a personalized attention, they learnt what we like to eat and would bring it to the beds by the pool. 
The guys from the Palapa cafe by the pool are amazing.
They even had a surprise for me in the room the night of my birthday.
We will definitely come back soon!!

reviews.author: markfk2017
reviews.title: Paradisus Melia Royal Service
reviews.text: The resort is huge, so many options for restaurants. We checked in at the royal service and upgraded our room to a suite with two bathrooms and a living room. Which was definitely the way to go. The staff was awesome, always around and helping you out with whatever you needed. Our butler susana was awesome, she helped us out with all of our reservations for dinner and tips about where to eat or what to do. We ate at blue agave the first night, which was ok, typical Mexican quesadillas and tacos. The next night was vento, it was the Mediterranean place, the food was not very good, our server was great though. The food was overcooked and for seafood that was hard to eat. The market grill was our next night, and by far the best food we had the entire time we were there. Mole was great too. Fuego had good food but our service there was slow. And definitely try Bana if you like sushi, or even if you don't! We ate breakfast and lunch at la Palapa in the royal service and every meal was excellent. Try the omelettes and the French toast! We would definitely go back and stay in the royal service section again.

reviews.author: Allie T
reviews.title: Great waitstaff, item was stolen out of our bag while hotel was in possession of them.
reviews.text: The hotel was clean and the wait staff in the restaurants were amazing. The individuals at the from desk were very rude and not helpful. Our flight got cancelled and we had to spend an extra night, the hotel was not at all helpful in helping up book another room. They made us go online to book it and then check in again. While we were doing this, our bags were with the bellmen because we were expecting a shuttle. When we the bags were brought up to our room we were missing our Nintendo DS, it had been replaced with a little girls hair clip. The front desk was not helpful in this matter and when I contact the hotel once we got home I was told there was nothing they could do. I was shocked that something like this would happen at a resort of this size. I would not go back.

reviews.author: Jacques G
reviews.title: Nice week at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We had a nice week, nice weather, nice staff, very nice hotel. The food at the buffet is always cold and very repetitive but the A la carte restaurants were good. It was our first time in Cancun, we might go back to Paradisus, we would recommand it for sure.

reviews.author: George T
reviews.title: Great Winter Escape
reviews.text: This was our second experience with Paradisus with our first experience in Punta Cana last year.  Once again they exceeded expectation and made us need or want for nothing. As in Punta Cana we upgraded to Royal Serice which allowed us an adult only stay with an oversized pool and several restaurants, it also afforded us a private butler Antonio who handled restaurant reservations, upgraded scented down pillows and Bali Huts both on the beach and pool side.  What made me fall in love with these two resorts besides Royal Service are the countless lanterns and aromatherapy throughout the public spaces making the evening strolls romantic and peaceful. Our only regret was they are going through a update and experienced some of the "aged" interiors and exterior areas that made for a untasteful experience. Ripped or tattered bar stools and lounge seating and restaurant seating with little or no cushion left. I requested a pillow for many of the restaurants which they accommodated for me with no questions asked. We will certainly try Paradisus again - perhaps in Playa de Carma (?) where several guest during our stay said was also beautiful and more boutique style. Regardless this hotel group knows customer service and knows what the customer wants and will go above and beyond to ensure you enjoy your stay and after all isn't that what "vacation" all about?

reviews.author: partystore
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: The beaches need to be clean of all plastic bottle caps and dead seaweed. The sales people were awesome to deal with and the waiters were very nice to substitute some foods if it wasn't to your liking.

reviews.author: cloverChapelHill
reviews.title: Did not convert us to "resort people"
reviews.text:
Disclaimer: We are not resort people, but now that we have a kid, we decided to give it a try. This experience did not convert us. But I have tried to write this review to be useful to resort goers. 

Service: High variance. The folks at the Family Concierge were amazing. Friendly and always ready to help. They did a bunch of cool stuff for our three-year old. The wait staff was a hit and miss. Some were cheerful and helpful (Martin in the buffet area, our waiter at Mole and Bana restaurants), others behaved as if we were an inconvenience to them and were quite resistant to our (reasonable) requests (remarkably bad service at Vento restaurant).

Food: Mediocre at best. Admittedly we are foodies and while we did not expect to be blown away, we expected something better. We tried all of the restaurants except for the Market Grill and Blue Agave. Mole was good. Fuego was ok. Enso and Vento were not good. It is remarkable that at a resort where we were paying $700/night for three adults, there were only TWO kinds of wine (yes, you guessed it: red or white) and they were both BAD. 

Rooms: We stayed at a Family Concierge Suite Lagoon View. The room was spacious (separate bedroom with a door, a living area and two full bathrooms) and clean. There were a few signs of age (the blinds in the bathroom), but it did not bother us. Overall, great value.

Pool, Beach, etc.: The pool area is quite nice, but it was a tad cool during our visit and we did not go in the pool. The beach area is beautiful too, but the ocean was extremely rocky. The gym was absolutely great.

Guests: Perhaps because we have typically stated at boutique hotels or bed & breakfast type of places, we are used to our fellow travelers displaying some minimal level of friendliness and respect. Not here. Most of the guests were rude. Put food in abundance in front of people and observe how our primitive side comes out. 

Overall: We are unlikely to do another resort trip in the near future. If we do, we may choose another Meliora location, and, if we do that, we will make sure to get Family Concierge. That was totally worth it.

reviews.author: Keri A.
reviews.title: Medical Travel Trip Made EXCELLENT by Paradisus & Staff
reviews.text:
On January 6, 2017, I traveled to Cancun Mexico with my daughter and my mother to get my daughter stem cell treatment at the Hospital Galenia.  

Part of the travel package I purchased included a stay at the all inclusive Paradisus with Royal Service.  I chose this package because I had my hands full coordinating my daughter's treatment, her wheelchair and assisting my mom who required help with a cane due to her knee replacement surgery.

From the moment we arrived at the Paradisus, I knew I made the right choice (so many hotels to choose from in Cancun).  The staff immediately welcomed us and assisted me with my daughter and helped my mother.  Instead of a normal "stand up, wait in line and check in", they ushered us to a comfortable sitting area, offered us drinks, then finalized the check in process while we were comfortably sitting (so nice after a long drawn out travel trip there).

Once we arrived to our room, we were introduced to our butler for our 10 day stay named Rode.  To describe Rode and his exceptional service in a few words is very difficult to do.  He was AMAZING!  He helped with tasks that I could not even think of.  He was so incredibly friendly, funny and somehow, in that big resort, always where we needed him.  The resort also gave us a cell phone to call Rode directly, even when we were at the hospital, if we needed anything.  

After my daughter's hospital infusion days, we would come back to our impeccably clean room (somehow done earlier than normal on hospital days so my daughter could come back and rest).  Reservations for dinner were automatically handled so we did not have to worry with that.  Assisting my daughter and my mother every time we left our room, was done quickly and courteously.  

I even came down unexpectedly with a bad sinus infection during our stay.  Concerned I could get my daughter sick, I needed to get on antibiotics fast.  Rode helped me coordinate meeting with a pharmacist across the street (like an urgent care center), they assessed me and prescribed medicine.  Rode was with me every step because I was unsure of the medical protocol there (insurance?  appointment?).

Rode gifted us with the gift of relaxation.  We did not have to be in charge of anything... and with my daughter being sick for 6 years now, that has been a long time for all of us.  He also made sure a Bali Bed was available outside when my daughter felt up to going outside.  (Moses was one of our waiters outside.  He was phenomenal too!)  Every staff member we came across went out of there way to assist us.  

During one of my attempts to find out way around the resort on my own, I quickly realized we were lost.  Without missing a beat, a new to us staff member, Hugo, saw that we looked lost and offered his assistance.  We were clear on the wrong side of the resort and he did not hesitate to bring us all the way to the other side of the resort where we needed to be.  

We came to find out that Hugo was being trained by our awesome butler, Rode to be a butler too.  I can not express how terrific Hugo will be as a butler too!  Several times from that moment we needed help and he jumped in with a friendly smile and treating us like we were the only guests in the place.  (Rode has that gift as well... treating us like we were the only guests there) 

Rode, Hugo, Moses and the rest of the staff treated our simple selves as VIPs.

This trip to get my daughter stem cell treatment was a long dream and prayer in the making.  Rode being assigned to us was like us receiving our own angel - so helpful and kind.  The rest of the staff too!  Answered prayers!

As far as food - we were very impressed by the variety and quality of the food.  Our top favorite places to eat there was La Palapa (Royal Service Restaurant on the beach).  Staff was phenomenal and food delicious!  You must try their fruit ice cream!  So good!  We also loved the Market Grill!  During the evening, it is similar to Fogo de Chao restaurants here in Texas.

Resort Cleanliness - I have never witnessed staff working constantly on cleaning until we stayed here.  Some of the hardest workers with friendly "holas" everywhere you went.    

My daughter will be having to come back approximately one time per year for further medical treatments.  We will not even consider staying at another hotel while we are there.  Paradisus spoiled this illness-weary family and made us relax and feel special.  

A simple thank you will never be enough and we look forward to coming back.  

Rode and Hugo - thank you both for going above and beyond your tasks.  It is obvious you both have joy and pride for your work.  We appreciate everything you did for us!!

A note on the Royal Service - This was part of a package we purchased and it was worth every penny.  I know our trip was wonderful because of all the help we received through Royal Service.  The staff overall will make your time there great, regardless of Royal Service, but if you want a trip filled with complete relaxation and the extra perks of Royal Service (like the Royal Service only pool area and Bali Beds), then consider getting the Royal Service too.

reviews.author: Ali M
reviews.title: Relaxing Retreat
reviews.text: My husband and I spent a week here with five other couples.  Paradisus Cancun is a wonderful place to relax and enjoy the beauty of the Caribbean Sea.  The poolside cabanas are very comfortable and the staff is friendly and attentive.  We ate at several of the on site restaurants and enjoyed the food.  Our favorites were the Brazilian steakhouse and Enso.  There is also plenty to do in Cancun and the bus runs right by the front of the resort.  Directly across the street is AquaWorld where we rented speed boats for a jungle tour and took an expedition to Isla Mujeres.  I hope to go back soon!

reviews.author: Vilibr
reviews.title: Real paradise
reviews.text:
The hotel was great and staff was very friendly. We didn't know what to expect, but were impressed the moment we walked in. All the live plants inside the hotel make it look like a tropical paradise. It took us some time to figure out how to get to the room and restaurants, it is so big that you have to remember which way you go. We ate at the buffet mainly, because we didn't want to bother to make reservations for dinner. The food at the buffet was delicious and they always had new things to try. My favorite drink was the Sangria, they made it with lime juice I think. There was a zumba class on the pool deck every morning at 10, the dj and instructor were also very friendly and nice! Swim up bar was also convenient, but the pool closed early at 7pm. The ocean was just amazing, its color looks like it was photoshopped. 
The rooms were decent, considering the fact that this is a 30 yr old hotel. The room smelled like cigarette smoke, but they didn't do anything about it. It smelled the whole 4 days we were there no matter how long we left the terrace door open. 
I must say at the end we weren't ready to go back home.
P.S. Don't take the time share presentation unless you really want to buy. We did it for the free 3night/4day certificate they gave us, but it turned out there was a fee to activate it and also the all inclusive package we had to buy in addition was at a very high price (higher than what it would cost to buy the whole vacation at bookit.com).

reviews.author: BulaBula1
reviews.title: Horrible experience, would never return.
reviews.text:
I stayed here with my family in December. 
By the end of the trip, my husband was in bed 2 days with stomach cramps from the buffet, and I came down with a horrible cold, which I'm sure had something to do with the odd smell in our room, and the chemicals being used to cover up these smells.
On the plus side, I will say many of the workers meant well. And the staff at Coco's Beach, and throughout the beach, were attentive. Their beachfront was nice, and the view from our rooms were nice.  Finally, Mole restaurant staff made us feel special, and put out a lovely spread for us.

Here are a few of the problems I experienced:
1. Checking in took over an hour, and was a complete frenzy. Totally ill-equipped to handle the people checking in. They wound up giving out free shots of tequila to the crowds waiting in a huddle. 

2. Our room was in the central tower On night one, we wanted to go to sleep early, and their evening entertainment was BLARING from below. So so loud, shockingly loud. Our rooms were directly below 4th rate nightly entertainment. They were truly horrible performances. A D-rated Michael Jackson show dancing to Thriller is not what I'm looking for when I go to a resort in Mexico, and being 3 floors above the stage really sucked! After night one, we just made sure we were out of our rooms between 8-10 pm at night.

3. The food was truly horrible. Really sub-par. I didn't know you could make inedible guacamole and salsa, but now I know you can. My husband and I were excited to go to the airport to eat airport food when we left. Look at some of the reviewers food photos.

4. And the service--at Enso in particular--was some of the worst I've ever experienced. Really clueless--like they pulled someone off janitorial duty and had them start waiting on tables. All of the male waiters wore hair nets at the buffet at Naos....odd.

5. The perfume scent they spray throughout the hotel and elevators was so cloying. I read about this on Trip Advisor before I stayed here, but just shrugged it off, I've smelled scents at hotels before. This one was gag-inducing.

6. Room smell & how management handles issues at this property.
There was a smell in the entryway of my room that smelled like a mix between nail polish remover and rubbing alcohol and I don't know what harsh smell you could include in the mix. I don't know what it was. At first, I thought it was chemicals that the maids were spraying in the room. My brother in law thought it was a spray they were putting in to cover up mildew in the a/c unit? On day 4 of our stay I asked the maids about it. They speak zero English and came back with a spray bottle of the scent that they spray in the elevators and sprayed in throughout my room. Day 5 they bring maintenance in who decide it’s a problem with the a/c and puts something in the filter. Day 6 the smell is still there, I wake up at 4 am with the smell so strong, I open the patio door all the way--in the meantime there's no screen--and take a sleeping pill to fall back asleep. At 9 am I go down to the front desk and ask them to send someone up to my room to check on the odor. I stay down at the beach the whole day. At 3 pm come back up to my room, and the stench is still there. No note, no message, nothing. Only when I called the wholesaler that I booked this trip through, was real attention given to this situation.

The manager Mario called my room. I tell Mario the situation, and he asks me about the smell--I told him, come up to my room. He says no, there's a chain of command, first housekeeping, then maintenance, and only after that does it become his issue. WHAT? I told him I already followed his chain of command. I couldn't believe he was saying this. Then a crowd of people come to my room; the 2 maintenance guys and 4 housekeepers. Spraying, dusting, mopping, spraying more. And then and only then will Mario come to my room. He says he doesn't smell anything so what's the problem? I tell him one of the problems I had is that I'd asked at 9 am to have someone check on my room. I come up at 3 and there is no message, nothing. He says they don't follow up with guests. They ask their staff to check on issues, but they don't then follow up with the guests. HUH?!?! He offers to have me move rooms, we were checking out the next day. OR offers a free $100 massage....FORGET IT.

Never again.

reviews.author: preethi j
reviews.title: love this hotel!
reviews.text:
I booked a stay at this hotel after staying at the Paradisus Punta so I knew a little what to expect.  I loved this hotel.  It is beautiful and the rooms are nice. Everyone who works here is so nice and accommodating.   Check in was  a breeze- however it was not busy when we arrived.  Compared to the paradisus in Punta Cana, while this hotel is large it is not spread out and it is easy to get around.  The food for the most part was good.  Market grill and Blue agave were excellent.  The breakfast buffet has everything you could ever want. The Sushi at Bana was ok.  Ive had better- ive had worse. The buffet seemed to be good if you got there right when they opened.  IF you got there later, the food didn’t seem fresh.  Also a lot of the time the food would not be hot on the buffets- but if you eat at the other restaurants this is avoidable.   We had no problems making restaurant reservations.  We went to a guest relations counter and she made them for us on the spot (a big contrast from Paradisus punta cana where you are given the run around for days).  We checked out right at check out time and only had to wait about 5 minutes. 

We were here MLK weekend and never had any problems getting chairs at the beach.  The beach is clean and beautiful.  The water is rough.   Not a lot of people swimming but I don’t like a boring calm beach so these conditions were perfect for me. 

My main criticism is they are always trying to sell something.  Which is fine but sometimes we were being lied to.  I asked the water sports desk where I could get boogie boards.  I believe it is an aquaworld desk but I am not 100% sure.  Aquaworld is across the street from the hotel.  He told me he didn’t have them and tried to sell me other excursions. When I told him that I wanted to buy a boogie board he told me that I would have to ride the bus half an hour away to get one.  Not only does the hotel gift shop sell them- aquaworld across the street sells them.  You can get them at any pharmacy within minutes of the hotel.   So in order to sell me something I didn’t want, he just lied.   When we asked guest relations for something, they tried to set us up for a timeshare type presentation.  Every time I went to get a towel at the pool they tried to sell me an excursion.  I get that they are doing their job but at a certain point it gets old, and the water sports desk blatantly lying to me put me off. 

All in all, I would return. This is a really nice place to stay for the value.

reviews.author: Carlin H
reviews.title: Lovely experience
reviews.text: This was my first time doing an all-inclusive resort vacation and it was a great first experience. My biggest takeaway is how great the all-around staff was. They always had a smile on their face and treated us with the warm hearted hellos. The activity coordinators and staff members were great and made for a great experience. Ernesto, Antonio, and Hugo were great at interacting with the guests and making any activity of the day fun and memorable. I would go back to this hotel just for the staff! Awesome people.

reviews.author: Wade R
reviews.title: Best Trip Ever!
reviews.text: We felt like royalty from the moment we checked in. The beach and pool are beautiful and the food is delicious! Take advantage of the free classes too. We will definitely be back next year. Shout out to Oscar for being so welcoming!

reviews.author: Joanna C
reviews.title: Best trip to Mexico!
reviews.text:
We spent one week in a true Paradise...of course the beach and the warm ocean and views make it incredibly beautiful, but the people, the staff are the ones that made our vacation even better than expected!
