Be kind and tip a little - that goes a long way for the hard work they put into it ...but as one of the staff told us - your experience is what matters most to them, and they hope you tell all your friends (which we do!) and their hotel stays top choice with tourists, and they keep working and supporting their families.
Thanks Diego, Orlando, Abraham, Sophonia, Geraldo, Fernando (Il Cantante :)  all the reception staff, buffet staff, and really everyone there! 
Beach - beautiful and sandy and not crowded, lots of chairs available, beach service is great and prompt. The vendors that come by only during morning hours are nice and not at all pushy! There are stairs to get to the beach ...not a lot and even my arthritic mom was fine!
Dining / food - exquisite - 90% we loved, one restaurant was not our favourite ...but the buffet was always great, good variety, seafood choices every day! The food was always tasty! No problem to make reservations for the a la carte restaurants  - just call in the morning the day before and usually we got in anywhere we wanted.
Clean everywhere- YES! The beach bathrooms had cloth towels! And someone was in there cleaning and refreshing everything every hour or so.
Drinks - the best we had at an all inclusive ...great variety and great service.

reviews.author: Jan2468
reviews.title: Great Vacation at the Paradisus!
reviews.text: We had a great vacation in Cancun and stayed at the Paradisus. The all inclusive package provided an excellent variety of food and restaurants. One of the restaurants closed for maintenance for 2 days and unfortunately we weren't able to dine there. But all other restaurants and their wait staff were great! The resort staff were friendly and work very hard to assist you and keep the hotel and facilities in great condition. The YHI spa is very nice and has a large jacuzzi type pool. However, I would skip the massage-not professional quality. The resort is great for singles, couples or families. I would highly recommend staying there.

reviews.author: nsantini2017
reviews.title: Lovely, would definitley go again!
reviews.text: First of all the rooms were great, very big and clean. The cleaning staff was super nice and always greeted us. Check in was quick, and so was check out. Ferndando from Naos was very friendly and was running around helping everyone! Sergio from Blue Agave was fantastic. So helpful! The resort overall was beautiful, looked like a small forest inside. Everything was always extremely clean. The beach was also beautiful. A little windy and rainy when we first arrived, but beautiful weather the rest of the trip. The waves were very strong, so we couldn't go far into the water. Food was also great! Especially the diverse amount of restaurants. The shows at the avenue bar were incredible. The crowd sucked though, but the performers were amazing! The one problem we did have was with NEXUS TOURS and our representative ANNA. She was terrible. She lied to us, took our money, and was never back again at the hotel even though she said she would be there all week. She was late to our meeting. Then she sold us a trip to Xcaret for $400 and told us to bring money for snacks and towels and that is it because everything else was included. This was a lie, because once we got there, we could not do half the activities because of the additional fees. We only brought some cash for snacks and left our credit card back at the resort because she said everything is already paid for. STAY AWAY FROM NEXUS TOURS. Anna also sold us another trip on the same day and told us we need to take a bus to the AcquaMarina. We double checked with reception downstairs and they told us that it is right across the street in front of our hotel and that no bus is needed. Once again, Anna gave us false information. She also said we get free tequila and coffee tasting which never happened. She did not know how to do her job. VERY DISAPPOINTED with her service. But overall, the trip to Paradisus Cancun was amazing, other than Anna's horrible assistance.

reviews.author: Magnús O
reviews.title: Reservation hell in paradise
reviews.text: I was at this resort for a conference and as a conference center this was a good location.  I had one day off at the end of the conference and was looking forward to experiencing something else than the buffet.  There are several restaurants where a reservation is needed.  For some strange reason though those restaurants are half empty all the time and they are not willing to let anyone in without a reservation.  A total turnoff since the restaurants are booked out two days in advance.  Another disappointment was that I reserved a beach hut.  The morning was cloudy so I decided to clean up some work before noon and when I showed up at 1 pm by reserved hut had been assigned to someone else.  Apparently the fine print says that one has to arrive before 11.  There like with the restaurants the occupancy was about 30% on average.  So all in all keep your expectations low, unless your are extremely organised and strategic "booker" this resort is not for your.

reviews.author: suzi j
reviews.title: Can't wait to go again 😍
reviews.text: The hotel is gorgeous and has an amazing view and clean beach. The service was amazing and everyone there is extremely nice. The daily program was great and the kids activities were phenomenal, my kids were entertained the whole time. The food was very good and they had a large variety!! I will definitely go again , we had a great time

reviews.author: JANET R
reviews.title: Used to be The Melia Grand
reviews.text:
Arrived the week of Jan,08,2017
Huge property! Beautiful gardens and indoor decor. Excellent beach, you can walk for miles, fairly rough ocean, always a surf.
If you have any mobility issues this is NOT the hotel for you!,stairs everywhere! If you smoke, this is not the hotel for you! 
We stayed Royal Service,upgraded to waterfront but I think the Lagoon side would have been just fine and $350.00 U.S. Cheaper. Susanne our butler was excellent! 
The buffet had an amazing selection and our server Fernando was outstanding!
Carlos the pool consiger was very quick to assist in anything we could possibly need!
I gave the Resort a 3 due to varying service! , consistency of food and difficulty for me getting from one place to another. The Royal Service restaurant Lapalapa was more like a pool side bar, and we never got anyone to help us take our order or even say Welcome. I did hear other people say the staff was all over them!
Love the Paradisus Properties this will be our 9 visit, however I probably will not return to this particular property.

reviews.author: aangelo1975
reviews.title: Greatest vacation ever
reviews.text: First of if anyone is thinking of going there do so the resort is beautiful the staff is super pleasant and very attentive to our needs I never been treated that good ,we did have royal service which in my opinion was worth every penny. The food was great quality and huge selection even breakfast had so much to choice from .the beach was great plenty of room lots of reclining chairs tiki bed both by the pool and on the beach free by the pool with royal service but 100 a day charge for Bali beds on the beach. Room freshly renowned it the royal service part the rest of the resort is also very clean.Lots of bars to choose from and good night life .To close out this review  is will say that I definitely be back soon to paradius and highly recommend to try sincerely Angelo. P.s thank you very much to Erik our Butler and every one else that made our stay there so memorable.

reviews.author: Jessica W
reviews.title: Great Visit
reviews.text:
Visited here with a friend for 10 nights in a junior lagoon view room. We had a lot of fun. Check out was fine. There was a little line but no big deal. Room was not ready so went to eat and hang out until it was. 

Room was plenty big. We weren't in it much so that really didn't matter to us. 

Beach was a little rough so we hung out at the pool most of the time. Had great service at the beach bar. 

Probably would not go back just because I would prefer to do an adult only resort next time. It is perfect if you have kids or are looking for cheaper options not adult only.

reviews.author: cathiew2017
reviews.title: Bliss
reviews.text: Lovely service. Beautiful hotel. The botanical theme and decoration of the hotel was absolutely gorgeous. Food was fantastic and offered about 8 different restaurants, every one of them delicious. The hotel even smelled wonderful. My kids loved the all inclusive food and drink. The wide variety of food could not be beaten. I was sceptical about the buffet being any good but even that offered a plethora of deliciousness. The beach was beautiful and water was pristine.  I can't wait for our return trip.

reviews.author: Sandi M
reviews.title: Best Service Ever - Part 1
reviews.text: We just returned from the Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun.  We had a party of 12 (6 rooms) and we just loved it!  Rode was our butler.  He was extremely attentive, always was accessible and had an infectious smile.  Our whole group just loved him.  The great service did not stop there.  The pool and beach service was amazing!  Carlos and Daniel took care of our cabanas and ensured we had chairs, towels and buckets of bottled water every day. At our first breakfast as a group, Victor brought us a bottle of champagne for mimosas.  That started the drinks flowing: excellent Bob Marley cocktails, Mango Daiquiris and more champagne!  Everywhere we turned was either Jorge, Alejandro, or Edier.  In addition to them, Rode popped over to the pool at least twice a day.  In the Royal Service area, we had drinks before dinner.  My son had asked for some special whisky to make shots.  Moises didn't have it and offered something else.  10 minutes later Moises who ran to the other side of the hotel, came back with the right whisky.  Service was just excellent.  I have read hundreds of reviews as I booked this hotel without knowing much about it and I was nervous.  Many reviews complained about the service.  I can only assume, perhaps they didn't tip well.  This is how these people make money and they are the hardest workers I have ever seen.  Even Nury, who did our turndown service was wonderful, always giving me a handful of chocolate.  I looked forward to seeing her.  She was always smiling.  Jorge ran up and down the beach like it was turf.  He was back and forth so quick, we barely finished our drinks.  Understand I had 10 adults between 19 and 32.  We drank all day and we never had to look for a server.   We just loved everyone!  I truly hope I didn't miss anyone, because everyone server, attendant, etc.  was amazing.  We loved this place and would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Stremma
reviews.title: Better than Some ... But Certainly Not the Best
reviews.text:
Arrived in the late afternoon.  Check in was quick and easy.  Got a junior suite.  The room was clean and comfortable.  The only really bad thing about the room was the living room sofa.  The cushion that you sit upon was so worn that we had to stuff other cushions under it so that our butts wouldn't sink down to the floor.  Other than that problem, the room was pretty good.  The mini bar fridge didn't keep things very cold, but ice was delivered promptly once we called for it.

I rec'd frequent calls from staff trying to sell me activities or offer me welcome gifts followed by attempts to arrange time share presentations.  That was annoying.  I wish I could have figured out a way to prevent that.

FOOD:

Breakfast dining options are limited to room service or buffet (unless you select the Royal Service - I didn't).  The buffet has plenty of food, and it all looks great.  Unfortunately, all the food is the same temperature.  The cold food isn't cold and the hot food isn't hot.  It's all just luke warm.  The only exception is the made to order omelet.  That comes out hot.

We ate lunch at the buffet one day.  We were one of the first people there (starts at 12:30 pm) and even though the food was just freshly prepared (at least in theory), it was still just warm.  Disappointing.

Dinner was a different story.  We tried five or six different restaurants and quite enjoyed the food and the service.  Bana is exceptional.  It was our favorite.  Skip Market Grille for dinner.  Enso and Vento were good too though the portions are small so be prepared to order two or even three times as much food as you would normally expect to order.

POOLS:

Inconsiderate guests race out early and place towels and other items under palapas and on lounge chairs to reserve them for the day.  There are resort signs limiting absences to less than 30 minutes, but the staff refuses to enforce the rule.  We frequently saw chairs without guests for periods in excess of 90 minutes.  I'm an early bird, so it didn't affect me much, but it was sad to see guests looking for a place to sit when many of the chairs were occupied by nothing more than a towel and a paperback well beyond noon.

The service was pretty good.  Just a skeleton crew between 10:00 am and 11:00 am.  They had their "regulars" (timeshare people that come year after year) and spent an inordinate amount of time visiting with them before offering service to others.  Once 11:00 am rolls around, there seems to be more service staff and food and beverages flow.

I could have done without the loud music around the pool, and maybe a little better service, but on the whole, I'd give them a 7 out of 10.

reviews.author: jenn4dex
reviews.title: Should have been better for the price and rating.
reviews.text: Pool was horrible, way too deep and the chairs were old and didn't work.  You could only sit in one position.  Small children hanging around the bar. For the price I would have thought you could wade in the pool as it was too hot to sit on your one way chair.   Food was average.  Breakfast buffet was cold, but it did have a lot of options.  My room was not very clean and had to ask to have the sheets changed after 4 days.    Entertainment was excellent and beach was nice and clean.

reviews.author: webbsyght
reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: We have been there three times and this was the worst and will not come back. The lobby staff were rude and pushy about making sure you were escorted every where before you checked in so you could not explore the hotel in peace.

reviews.author: justing342
reviews.title: Overall excellent vacation at Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text: The dining at Paradisus was excellent. We've done one previous all inclusive vacation, and Paradisus' dining was decisively superior to the previous experience, both in quality/tastiness and variety of restaurants. The location of the resort is spot on - right at the center of Cancun's "Hotel Strip," with beautify white sand. The resort's beach also seemed on the larger side compared to those of neighboring and similarly priced resorts. Pools were also nice. Room were generally quite nice - modern and comfortable furnishings and decor, and housekeeping did a nice job. One complaint: mattresses were a bit too soft and thus not the most comfortable. The room phone also smelled. However, the resort's architecture and interior decore of the public areas was impressive and unique. Staff was very friendly and attentive. All in all, it was a great stay - would recommend to family and friends!

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
The staff were very helpful and so friendly. Not one complaint about them! The only issue we had was with the food on the buffet, it was never hot.  Any time we went to eat the food was cold.  It tasted great and there was always a variety to choose from but it just wasn't quite warm. The dishes got a little repetitive through the week but it all tasted good. The omlettes in the morning were fantastic and hot because they were made to order. The WiFi works everywhere! Even on the beach when we tried it. The room was clean and quite spacious. We had a lagoon view which was just fine with us, we could watch the sunset every night. The ocean side 
Had the most beautiful beach I have ever been on and the water was warm. The pools were clean, the service was fantastic and the mojitos were delicious!!  We have already made a decision to return next January.

reviews.author: Olga T
reviews.title: Cancun Paradisus
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun has improved greatly since 5 years ago when we first visited. They have great food, amazing kids zone, baby club, multiple bars and restaurants. Very friendly and helpful staff. We wil be definitely coming back!

reviews.author: Tracy
reviews.title: Mostly good with a few exceptions
reviews.text: Property and beach are beautiful, great location, staff is friendly and accommodating, Pool and beach service really amazingly attentive. Nice, nice people. Market Grill and Cocos very nice... Few things to know...do not sit near DJ stand by pool. The music is so loud you can't hear the people next to you even if your waaaayyyy down at other end of pool. Also, female singer so bad she Ruined!!! Hotel California for me forever, Band is good, she was screaming. Yikes. One other bummer is the whole reservation thing. They are real hardos about turning you away if you don't have a rservation...even if the place is empty. It's bad. Watched this poor couple sit at buffet while tables in restaurant sat open during our whole meal. Silly. Cocos is cute but way too small and crowded...Need more outdoor bars. And lastly, the incense they burn is nauseating. Too bad because the lobby is gorgeous and welcoming...it just smells really bad. We've been many times so know what to avoid, Tempo, overrated, but will go back to Paradisis because location and staff are great.

reviews.author: csp24
reviews.title: Look Elsewhere
reviews.text:
After travelling around USA and Mexico from Australia, it is obvious people in this part of the world are easily pleased. There is no way some of the rooms in this resort would warrant such a high Trip Advisor rating, so I will assume it comes down the restaurants, alcohol and location. 

Our stay at Paradisus was unique in the fact it started off terribly and ended positively. We were re accommodated due to construction taking place at ME Cancun Resort. Upon checking in to Paradisus, we were given a terrible room with two twin beds (we are a couple). The room was dated and even had light fixtures falling off the walls. We paid nearly $1000 USD for three nights so we really expected more, and were often mistaken/dismissed for being part of a large tour group which we were not. The cleaners came to push the two beds together and overlap the sheets, resulting in a terrible nights sleep in addition to a pulsating white fire alarm light directly above the bed adding to our discomfort! 

After much deliberation back at reception, and persistence on our part, we were finally upgraded to a better room for our second and third nights. This new room was in the Royal Service tower and was a trillion times nicer. Perhaps recently renovated. 

The restaurants at Paradisus were very good, and service was great. However you are expected to wake up at 7am to book early, as two restaurants were completely booked out. When we were dining at these "fully booked" restaurants, we noticed a large number of empty tables, especially at Mole Restaurant. Ridiculous! 

My advice: take considerable note as to which room type you are booking, as there is a SIGNIFICANT difference.

reviews.author: Hadeed2014
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort, amazing food and service.  Would come again!
reviews.text:
My wife and I spent 4 days/3 nights in this all-inclusive resort, celebrating an anniversary and my wife's birthday.  This was our first time to Cancun.  The resort itself is nothing short of stunning....vines hanging from the ceiling make you feel like you're in the tropics, lush vegetation in the lobby, ocean view rooms, tons of restaurants, extremely friendly staff.

We had a fantastic experience.  From the moment we walked in we were greeted with friendly faces and genuine hospitality.  There's the obligatory "excursion up-sell" after check-in, but we declined.  Our room was very comfortable and had ample storage space, and a huge bathroom (my wife loved the shower).  Our views were fantastic and we slept with the sliding door open just to hear the ocean.  

There are a plethora of restaurants and we never had trouble getting a seating, despite the suggestion to call ahead for reservations.  Our favorite was a tapas restaurant (can't recall name), but it's in the middle of the hotel, so you can't miss it.  

The beaches has soft, fine, white sand with minimal debris.  Lounge chairs were ample and never hard to find.  The waves were very easy to play in, but there was an under-toe to be wary of some days.  

We never ventured off the resort because we had a very short stay.  Overall we were extremely happy with our stay, the food, and most importantly the waitstaff.  A special thanks to our butler/concierge Galdino who was such a friendly man, made our stay super relaxing, and went out of his way to help with us dinner reservations, and getting everything we needed to be relaxed.  Galdino, you're amazing...God Bless you!!

reviews.author: djf1231
reviews.title: Long Weekend Getaway
reviews.text: We had a great stay in Cancun. It is an easy 15 minutes from the airport. Upon arrival we decided to upgrade to Royal Service which we highly recommend if you are not traveling with children. It is worth every extra penny. Beautiful beach, good service, decent food for a great easy getaway.

reviews.author: ana K
reviews.title: Worst all inclusive. They charge everything
reviews.text: By far the worst experience in any all inclusive ive been in. The moment you check in they try to sell you a VIP status where you can have a "full" all inclusive experience. Everything we ordered wasnt included in the all inclusive meaning national drinks like beer and vodkas. Room service to bring thise drinks in the inclusive had extra charges. Want a lounge on the beach? Well you have to pay an extra $150usd for it a day. Towels were limited. Just awful. Dont waste your money on this place.

reviews.author: Kat65M
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed in the Adults only building. It was very quiet and nice. hardly ever saw the butler so that was kind of a drag.Never around when we were looking for him. Room was nice and clean. Food was delicious and staff was very friendly. Spa was lacking but good massage. Overall very beautiful place!

reviews.author: peruzzoalex
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I would like to special thanks to: Rossana, Moises, Kevin, Cesar,Edier, Omar, Adriano and sakniete. The support was amazing. Excelent beach service, restaurants. Recommend the Vento Restaurant and Mole

reviews.author: Joyful1
reviews.title: Fantastic post Christmas Family Vacation
reviews.text:
We spent a week at this lovely resort, renting three rooms (two one bedroom concierge level and one Family Junior suite, also concierge level).  All were on the 7th floor of the main building, each with a great ocean view.  The best of the three was 7301,  The nine of us, six adults and three children, spent most of our days at the large pool, comfortably settled in a "Bally Bed".  Our main servers, Jaime and Victor, were excellent.  The additional $100 a day was well worth the money, for instead of Champagne, we opted for lobster, grilled shrimp kabobs etc. served at whatever time we requested.  It was more than enough food for all of us for lunch, though the outdoor snack bar offered burgers etc. for those who elected not to enjoy the freshly cooked seafood.  
This is not an inexpensive selection over the holidays.  While all-inclusive it was still pricey.
The one bedroom units have two balconies.  Our junior suite had only one.  Rooms were spacious, had mini bars refreshed daily, and we were offered Rum, Wine or champagne on a daily basis.  Our butler, Gabriel, was helpful in making dinner reservations, answering questions, and even checking on us at the pool.  I would characterize his position more as a personal concierge, than "butler", which is their terminology.  
The grounds are meticulously kept.  Across the boulevard is a pharmacy that offers free medical consultations if needed, though I did notice a sign for a medical doctor in the hotel.  
English is widely spoken and understood, but it is helpful to use Spanish if you can do so.  
The buffet was exceptionally crowded at breakfast, but on day three we discovered that Blue Agave offered most of the same choices.  It was quieter, less crowded, and hence a much nicer atmosphere.
And last, but not least, be sure to catch the entertainment at the pool.  Some of it is exceptional, and guest participation is encouraged.

reviews.author: Texantraveladdict
reviews.title: Could be a 5 star with more attention to check in process
reviews.text:
We had a fabulous vacation at this property over the New Years property.  It was my wife and 2 kids, ages 8 and 6.  We had the cheapest room category lagoon view room in tower 3.  

Communication with the hotel pre visit was excellent by email.  We asked for a room with 2 beds and they honored the request.

No airport shuttle, but we used happy shuttle which was great, safe, and affordable.  

Here are some pros and cons about the property.

Pros:
1. Absolutely beautiful property both inside and outside.  We thought the best looking property from the outside in all of the cancun hotel zone. 
2. Rooms were very nice.  Marble floors, nice balcony.  Housekeeping excellent. 
3. Beach was amazing, but we expected this.  
4. Pools nice, just wish they were heated but it was still acceptable.
5. Nice yoga classes and fitness center.
6. Amazing food.  We are vegetarians, no eggs,  and they did there best to accommodate.  The restaurant staff were so excellent. Montezuma in the Naos buffet was especially amazing.  Daniel in Mole restaurant was also very nice and professional.  Only advice is book the restaurants promptly the day before.  Also realize that on the day of arrival, if you are arriving at a busy time, all the restaurants will be booked.  You can always go to the buffet which is excellent.  If though on your first night you would rather have a reservation, write to hotel before hand and they will help.  We found though you can always go up to the restaurant manager the same night and they will try to squeeze you in. 
7. Service at hotel was excellent.  in fact, I do not think the upgrade to family concierge is really necessary.  
8. Marina across the street is nice. 
9. Fast Wi fi!  You can even stream movies.
10. Concierge staff excellent and friendly 
11. Nice hospitality room if you have late check out, just need to book when you get there. 

Weaknesses:
1. Rooms are showing there age in some aspects.  Our ac worked slow even after we called maintenance serverl times.  They did offer new room, but we did not want to deal with that hastle.
2. Spa services are overpriced and not really that impressive per my wife.  She had a pedicure. This needs improvement at a 5 star resort.
3. Music is blasting all day in lobby and beach area.  I think many guests would like some peace and quiet.  Also the main tower, tower 3, is loud most of day from 7 am-11 PM.  If you are a light sleeper, ask for another tower . On the other hand, we did enjoy being so close to everything. 
4. Now to the worse part of the hotel, the check in process.  I checked in quickly, then asked the agent for an orientation on the property.  He said the welcome concierge would answer all my questions.  Well  all she wanted to do was have me sign up for a time share presentation.  She told me very little about the property. I did not know about wi fi passoword, restaurant process, tennis, water sports ect.  I had to figure out all on my own over the next few days. This is unacceptable at a 5 star property.  They should either present a brochure or train their welcome concierges to do a better job in orientation.  
5. Beach beautiful but rough waves while we were there.  If getting in water real important to you, this is not the best part of the hotel zone.  Consider bend of the 7 area which is more calm.  
6. No egg free desserts, not even ice cream,  hotel should try to accommodate more regarding this.  

In summary, lovely property that I would go back to. One major weakness is check in process which management should be able to fix right away.  It's quite upsetting to be told nothing about the hotel and instead pushed a time share presentation instead on check in!

reviews.author: Tara D
reviews.title: Butler service is the way to go
reviews.text: We opted for the butler service, which is in building 5, adults only.  I was phenomenal!  Our butler was Antonio and he was awesome.  Anything we needed he made it happen.  Dinner reservations, reserving pool cabanas, food, drinks, towels, you name it he got it.  Freddy was our personal trainer at the gym.  His workouts were great and we did one on the beach!  I highly recommend Freddy and Antonio when you visit.

reviews.author: Shelley G
reviews.title: Last minute decision to spend Christmas here
reviews.text:
After cancelling our reservation a week before departure at another hotel due to bad reviews, we spent our Christmas week here at Paradisus Cancun.  I will qualify this review by saying that we have stayed twice at Paradisus La Esmeralda (as recently as this Thanksgiving) and loved it both times.  We felt confident of a good vacation knowing the Paradisus brand is of high quality.  
We arrived Dec 23rd in the morning and were met with a long line for check in.  We joined the line for the Melia rewards club line as we are members and hoped this would make the wait shorter - it didn't!  The staff were doing their best but they really were overwhelmed.  My request for two rooms connecting or adjacent could not be met.  We were travelling with our teenage kids and the nearest they could get us was a few rooms apart.  I wasn't thrilled but there was nothing to be done.  In the end that wasn't a problem whatsoever and gave the kids a sense of freedom away from my watching eye, it has taught me not to be so protective, they're teens not babies. 
The hotel is an older Melia property that has converted into the Paradisus brand.  In our opinion the design was outdated and the rooms and common areas needed attention.  But the beach was the best we saw along the Cancun strip, so much wider than any other property.  the hotel is wide and low rather than the Cancun typical high rise, which is so much nicer.  
The food in the restaurants was just ok and usually cold.  We were so surprised because the highlight of the Playa del Carmen Paradisus is the food, the best we've experienced in any all inclusive.  That said the staff here were more friendly and really did seem to want you to have the best vacation.  Our waiter on our first lunch visit remembered all of our names and drinks orders and was the best guy ever.  Thank you Antonio in Market Grill, it was a pleasure to meet you.  
The entertainment team around the pool were great too.  They knew my daughter and husband by name and were such good fun to spend time with.  Not at all cheesy or fake as some of these teams can be.  Special mention to Antonio Sanchez Ramon, for making it fun and always having a smile on your face.  
We did a few trips arranged with the water sports team on site, you have to go just over the main road to the lagoon to actually do these sports and all were fun.  We also went to Xplor for the day, recomended.  
Thank you to the team at Paradisus for a good stay.  We did enjoy the valuable family time over Christmas but really do feel there are a number of improvements needed to make this hotel as good as the one in Playa del Carmen.

reviews.author: terristours
reviews.title: Fantastic personal service and great all inclusive
reviews.text: This hotel has amazing fresh food choices and great service. We are very happy we did all inclusive as the fish and meats were all delicious and special attention to allergies was possible. I must also say the evening shows were of high quality and good family entertainment. I would def return again to this lovely and clean facility.

reviews.author: BaseballDad17
reviews.title: Fantastic Getaway!
reviews.text: My wife and I spent 5 nights here for a business retreat last week. The room was beautiful and the service was excellent.      The food was good to excellent. Our friends payed for the Royal Service and we wished we had as well. The hotel is gorgeous and well kept.  I would definitely recommend this resort.

reviews.author: bcp1165
reviews.title: Overall - good - but with some areas for improvement.
reviews.text:
Overall, we enjoyed ourselves. The staff were lovely - so welcoming and kind. Location was great, etc.

We were in the Royal Service tower, so all reviews and comments are based on that.

Pros:
*Adults only pool was great. Ocean was gorgeous.
*Got a cabana (with a little patience) every day. Good for a white girl like me.
*Loved that I could turn in a book and get a new one. Found a book I LOVED that I have since shared with others.
*Breakfast buffet was great. Everything we needed and more.
*Snacks and evening service were also great.
*When they offered us four bottles of liquor, we assumed airplane sized bottled. They were real sized. We didn't open any of them, but it that floats your boat, you are all set!

CONS:
*The $1500 resort credit is a total con as it is really a coupon book. Many we couldn't use because a) we didn't have kids, b) it was already included in our package, c) it didn't fit with our plans. Others were $20 off a $200 purchase, etc. We mentally applied the $1500 against our booking total so it was very disappointing to have it not really help at all. We saved some on our spa packages, but that was it. If they had advertised it as a coupon book, I would have been happy.
*Lighting is really, really dim - in the common areas, in the room bathrooms (try!! to put on makeup). 
*The tapas restaurant (Vento) was AWFUL. Inedible. It was our first night so we were scared. Happily, other restaurants were great. Esp. La Palapa. Gazpacho was amazing.
*Make all reservations in advance. Tempo was nearly impossible to book (we got in and it was FABULOUS), Mole was great, etc. But you have to battle your way in, and this was with a "butler" in the Royal Service section.
*On a minor note, the calendar was wrong. I went for an abs workout class, and ended up with a Cross-Fit class. :-(

reviews.author: jdelmoral_mx
reviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL
reviews.text:
Even that the hotel could look "old", the installations are excellent.
Food and beverages are great.
People who works there, really care about the customer making yo forget everything else.
Only thing to improve is the quantity of sun chairs, and even they have a 30 mins policy, most of the people do not care and reserve with the towels so can take a while to find one.

reviews.author: chriswebb02
reviews.title: better when it was the gran melia
reviews.text: the lobby staff were too lazy to do their job of customer service because they were always socializing with each other, the property needs to be updated because the signs were faded and pealing off, big disappointment and will never come back

reviews.author: Genesis P
reviews.title: July Vacation
reviews.text:
stood at Paradisus Cancun back in July 2016.. it was completely amazing. the location of this hotel is perfect the beach looks like a postcard and you are like less than 5-10 minutes away from the strip. The food here was amazing Blue Agave was our favorite for afternoon lunch and late night soup. amazing amazing tacos and the service was always amazing. From the moment we got there the service was great. in my reservation i had two rooms booked. and because of that they upgraded us to ocean view cause those were the only rooms available close to each other. This was a great touch since it was me and my bf and our sisters so we wanted them close by. 

the pool area was great though again like the other Paradisus I've stayed at the pool is way to deep for you to even stand but its okay. and also barely any shade and even if you wake up at the crack of dawn they will remove anything you place on a chair if you are trying to save a seat. the service at the pool was always great and we actually rented a cabana one of the days it was so affordable $80.00 and you get a bottle of Moet. 

overall if you are looking to be in a great part of the beach in cancun and close to downtown i would highly recommend this resort. the service, the food, the rooms and the resort grounds were all great  

also if you are traveling into cancun and your hotel doesn't provide hotel transfers i would highly recommend USA Transfers, super affordable and its a private transfer with no stops at other properties..

reviews.author: Martin C
reviews.title: 8 out of 10
reviews.text: Hotel needs to better accommodate non conference guests. We had to move while laying on the beach for them to construct a stage for the convention. Overall we would definitely stay again just not during a conference next time.

reviews.author: Shant M
reviews.title: Amazing service and food
reviews.text: I was hesitant to book an all inclusive package when visiting Cancun, since quality is sacrificed. I am glad I did at Paradisus. The service here is beyond awesome and their food is amazing. Highly recommend this place

reviews.author: Denise H
reviews.title: Each visit just gets better
reviews.text:
We became Club Meliá members last year after staying at Playa. Which is a beautiful Resort. Other Resort clubs have tried to get us to invest into their programs many times. But none even come close to Melia. Last year we stayed at Melia Puerto Vallarta. Fantastic!! The most beautiful friendly warm fun Resort you will find in a smaller Resort.
Of course here you have Cancun. But all Resorts have Cancun. But what they don't have is the heart of Melia. From the time you leave the airport they will assure you are totally spoiled. They insist you let them see to your every need. My sons room had beautiful roses on the bed and strawberries, chocolate and champagne. We had red wine and a great summer tote bag.
My husband is dairy allergic. They made every effort to accommodate at every restaurant. Often with little surprise tastes arriving at the table.
We only needed to check in at our own Members area for anything. There was always wonderful personal help waiting. Most times they came to us with updates or restaurant information no matter where we were, they found us. Amazing!
The restaurants are varied and will please most anyone. But what we enjoyed the best is the wonderful service. The people who Melia have are truly the most kind and friendly you will find. 
They go above to give you a great experience. Not just a meal.
So if you go don't worry about the weather, who can control that. Yes you might see a bug or two, your in the tropics, Enjoy the wonderful Resort Melia has for a beautiful vacation.

reviews.author: A T
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation Destination
reviews.text: It was our first trip to Cancun. The resort is wonderful, all the restaurants are amazing (you will need to book dinner reservation in advance). We had a fantastic time, as a family. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Stephanie B
reviews.title: First time in Cancun
reviews.text: My husband actually set up this vacation, he did all the research and worked with our wonderful travel agent. We have stayed at the Melia Resorts in the past at different places and we liked them so much that we became rewards members. The Paradisus is part of the Melia Resorts. I have to say for a 4 star resort it was really wonderful! The resort itself was really nice and always very clean. We had 2 rooms both in the adults only section. We originally reserved the Jr. Suites and when we arrived they upgraded my husband and me to a 1 bedroom suite at no extra charge which was really nice! Each room came with butler service and I have to say we had the Best butler ever!! His name was Cesar and he went up and above on everything for us! If you do stay at this resort, I would recommend asking for him as your butler. He was such a nice young man and was on the ball with everything. He made sure we had everything we needed to make our stay enjoyable!! Thanks Cesar, you are the Best! I would definitely go back to this resort in the future 😃😃👍👍

reviews.author: kristasal
reviews.title: Great family trip with a large group with kids
reviews.text: Just had a great 6 day trip to Paradisus. The hotel is very clean and the service was good. About 10 minutes from downtown restaurants and bars, this is a 10 dollar taxi ride. Many great activities going on at the hotel throughout the day, including an evening show each night at 8:30. The kids loved going to the kids club. It was very simple but they still liked going there for some part of each day. The staff in the Kids Club was awesome! Buffet had a nice variety and different themes each day. Very little money was needed outside of giving tips. Beach was pretty but very rough at this time of the year. The wind created very rough waters but the kids loved it. I was a nervous wreck except the fact that the water was very shallow at points. The hard part about dining at the hotel was the number of restaurants that required reservations. On vacation it is hard to plan a meal time everyday. We did make a reservation one or two times but decided to just chance it when we were ready to eat and that didn't work out well for us. By default we ended up back at the buffet again. The only other inconvenience was the coffee shop didn't open until 10 each day. By then I am 3 hours past needing a cup of coffee. There was always coffee in the lobby and buffet if you are just looking for simple coffee. Lattes and other fancier coffees were only available through the coffee shop after 10. Off site we went on 2 excursions, Xel-Ha and The Mayan Ruins Chichen itza with stops for lunch in an older colonial pueblo and a swim in the cenotes. BOTH of these trips were totally worth it!!! We traveled with 4 boys 7, 8, 9, and 9 and they loved the bus ride and all the sites along the way. All in all a fantastic trip and would do it all over again just the same. Maybe outside of the main winter months to get the waves to not be so brutal but sure was nice to spend Christmas on a beautiful beach.

reviews.author: ANJSFK
reviews.title: Wish we had stayed here!
reviews.text: We visited my sister and her family who stay at Paradisus every year. We unfortunately were booked a few hotels down. The hotel is absolutely beautiful and the staff at Paradisus were amazing! We talked with people staying there who were both on the all inclusive package and those that were not. Both were getting terrific service. The waitress on the beach, Asunción was so friendly, attentive and hard working, she alone would make you want to stay there. My nephew nicknamed her "Numero Uno" for obvious reasons. We will definitely be staying there on our next trip!

reviews.author: James N
reviews.title: Great Building, Good Luck Getting Assistance...
reviews.text:
My wife and I are both teachers, and live in the NYC are. I'll generalize and say that we probably have very high expectations of things as a result, but in NO way do we go looking for the problems. Anything I discuss are things that fell upon us. I'll start by saying this, we had a GREAT vacation all things considered. But this property misses the mark.

We visited this hotel after two previous stays at Melia properties: Melia Tropical and Paradisus (both in Punta Cana). Both were great experiences and if you look at my review of Paradisus Punta Cana, loved it. So I was looking to love this place too. We stayed here as Club Melia guests, so it had a concierge. Unlike other experiences, this concierge was minimally a service and more Club Melia sales reps that would do a few basic services for you on the side. 

Arrival: We arrived at the Club entrance, which looks deserted and unimpressive, and had nobody to greet or help with bags. We got into the Club check-in, and typically a drink or snack is offered. Not here. It's business. You're a guest and they are there to check you in. We booked an extra night for New Year's Eve and they couldn't find that reservation. She (Fabiola) defaulted to, just check with Carlos, our concierge (hardly). This is emblematic of this property, "I don't know" and refer you somewhere else. There is no sense of, "Hey, let me find that out". Basically, there is NO initiative taken by staff members. Carlos it turned out was gone when we arrived, off the next day, and I sought him out the third. If you're looking for true concierge service, either save the money or look elsewhere. You're not getting any luxury here. (An exciting tidbit, he accidentally forwarded us an email calling us annoying that was meant for an associate. The paper letter is on its way to the hotel GM regarding this!)

NOW... We had a nice time. Truly. Glad we went. 
Room(s):
We had a one bedroom club suite. Was nice. Room shapes can be bizarre, but attribute it to the unique and impressive architecture of the hotel. Stands out when compared to boxy places on the beach. When talking to people on the beach, yep, you're staying at the place that is the purple pyramids. The rooms were definitely clean although the first night, they had no idea they had to turn down the sofa bed for the now sleeping kids. Kudos to our concierge! When they made the bed, they only had one twin blanket which they awkwardly stretched sideways across over the sheet. Again, no "go-getter" mentality. Thankfully I speak Spanish and accommodated right away. 

Restaurants: 
We ate at the buffet (Naos) for breakfast. Our waiter at breakfast saved the vacation. This guys is AWESOME. If you go and sit outside, ask to sit in Gaudencio's section. He was SO great with everything. We weren't ALLOWED to cut our kids pancakes and such. Made it clear that were HIS guests. Above in beyond in everything. His asstistant Atilano was great too. He should be made a waiter soon and put alongside Gaudencio's section. Though they seem like a winning team now. 

We did have a reservation at a different restaurant each night. There is a nice variety. Really. I liked the Brazilian/Argentine steakhouse and Nedel, Jose, and Uriel were awesome. Great first night and unwinding after our check-in. Kudos to these guys for getting me to relax and have a great time. Vento was a second night and Leo was nice. Vento is a great atmosphere, but the food is eh. Better than Bana (Japanese) though. Enso had the best food, but the service was completely overwhelmed. Our waiter was a phantom... nowhere, but we met this guy Alonso who stepped in. I don't know if he was more of an assistant, or what, but he should be a waiter. He was on-point. 
SO: Market Grill, Enso (if their act is together), and Fuego are good. Vento and Bana cool atmosphere but the food is not so great.

Drinks were good. Wine was good (actually, really good for a house wine compared to other all-inclusives). We didn't need to order a bottle or anything. But bar choices and places to just hang out at night are lacking. Not many options. Didn't really affect us too much because after dinner, we'd have some tired kids and the most we could do with them was to hang on the bed/chairs on beach anyhow. It was a bit frustrating when they closed the only accessible bar in the lobby for New Year's Eve. 

Wifi was good throughout the hotel/pool/most of beach, and yes, it's free. 

Beach:
Ample beach chairs, although the prime spots are typically picked off early. Sadly, yes, I am one of those too (but if I don't, someone else will). Always towels and chairs around the beach. Pool was a bit more competitive. The servers were good, especially a woman with white glasses. Can't remember her name. Beach was clean, seaweed free (compared to Punta Cana) and lifeguards. The water was truly beautiful and this was by far the best water of any trip I've been on. Downside, all beaches are Federal property and anyone can walk by peddling items. I didn't see any problems, but I wouldn't leave any valuables. 

HOTEL Concierge: (Main lobby, not to be confused with Club Melia concierge)
I went to them to question about car rentals after the on-site place was sold out. Club Melia concierge couldn't be bothered. So the hotel concierge (Sandra?) was SO helpful in calling an offsite Hertz and arranging it. Was easy and great for a day trip over to Coba to see the ruins (totally recommend over Tulum).

Kids Club: 
I have to say that this was by far the most creative kids club with activities. My kids really did enjoy it, although if your kids are a bit older (like 10-12) they're a bit bored. With wifi, they'll need ipads and stuff for entertainment. Perhaps more of a teen club should be added. But overall, I was happy with the kids club here.

reviews.author: Designer78
reviews.title: ABSOLUTELY OUTSTANDING!!!!
reviews.text:
We just spent the Chrsitmas week in Royal Service and it was amazing!! Carlos our pool butler was so accommodating every day, Cesar our pool waiter was on it, Geraldo our royal service butler was great at getting all our reservations set up for the week!!! WE could not be happier with our 5th time to Cancun and 2nd stay at this hotel!! The bali beds are fantastic and there is palapalas on the beach.
 The new Royal Service restaurant has great food, I would say some of the best in the hotel . We love the Blue Iguana tacoshop, the Market Grill was good as well, the other restaurants are decent. It will be hard to top this vacation we just had!!!!

reviews.author: Shansee
reviews.title: The best all-inclusive I've been to!!
reviews.text:
The things I value most at all-inclusive: cleanliness, service, value, food & alcohol. We stayed on the lagoon side because we do not spend much time in the room. The view was still nice and we had a large balcony to dry our bathing suits and towels each day. 

Pros: 
-LOCATION: We walked out to the beach for the first time and found an AMAZING view. This part of the beach is THE BEST I have found in the hotel zone. White sand and crystal blue, non-rocky water. Also, It is located across from a water-sports facility on the lagoon which is convenient for excursions. 
-Facilities were all clean and room was taken care of each day. 
-Even without the royal service we had a cocktail waitress who was happy to bring drinks (including bottled water) to us. People at check-in were warm and welcoming. All servers in the restaurant were great and work very hard. The bartenders were fantastic! We chatted them up a bit and they offered to make specialty drinks and ensure we had a good time. 
-Which, I will mention- the alcohol selection is quite good (absolute, 1800, XX, etc)- to me this makes a big difference when drinking frequently. 
-The food was equivalent to the one 5 star all-inclusive I've been to. We were able to make reservations each night by calling down each day (yes, a bit of a hassle but this is how most places do it). We loved the reservation-only restaurants-- but honestly Blue Agave, the taco restaurant that does not require reservations, has the best food of all. We could have eaten there every day! 
-For the price, you really can't beat this hotel. There are plenty of more expensive resorts that may be better in certain aspects but I was very impressed for the price point. If you are considering spending less and going to a different place, i urge you to reconsider. I doubt you will be disappointed. I think the fact that the price keeps the young spring-break crowd away, which i appreciate :) but also is affordable for most. 
-One more, less important thing, They don't provide you the cheap plastic wrist bands, They give you quality bands that are super comfortable and the guys don't even notice they are there. 

Cons: 
-I don't care much for the variety shows that are put on at night, but people were disappointed with theirs. There is not much room for people to see, but again, I didn't care as much about this.
-There are occasional buckets and towels in the hallway for leaks. I have yet to be to a resort where this isn't the case. Not an issue for me. 

We are going back in a couple months, this time with friends and I cant wait!!

reviews.author: lori_drex
reviews.title: Don't plan on relaxing unless ou order a cabanca
reviews.text: Unless you pay for a cabana, plan on fetching everything on your own.  drinks, food, etc.  There is not relaxing and the hotel is hard to get around.  Steps everywhere. We go to Cancun a lot and will not be returning.  There is not bars on the inside of the hotel that open before 4:00 should it rain, unless you want to go to the buffet and order something.  There are ZERO family activities unless you pay for an upgrade.  the Kids Zone is nice, but there was no place for me and my kids to play inside when it rains or they were tired of the sun.  Also the pool options are 2 ft or 5 ft.  As a girl that is 5'6", that made it difficult to have 2 kids hanging on me and trying to walk on my tip toes.  And heaven forbid I might want to actually sip a drink in the pool, not happening.  Just don't plan on relaxing at this place.

reviews.author: RoshniPatel
reviews.title: Par Excellence as Expected - 2nd Visit
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at this resort for 2nd time and it was Par Excellence (as expected). The Royal Service is the way to go. Everything on my first visit's review applies again; All the staff on site are extremely accommodating and helpful. The restaurants, food, resort cleanliness, service, activities etc. is beyond expectations. 

The weather was wonderful and we also did a Romantic Private Dinner Under the Sky (in the Gazebo) one evening. All the serving Staff was excellent and went above and beyond to ensure a memorable experience. They even ensured to offer Indian food in dinner and played Indian romantic music in the background during the Private dinner. Thank you all.

If you are looking to get pampered, out of the world Royal treatment and an Exceptional Customer Service; without a second thought, this is the Resort you should stay at. Since our first visit in 2013; I have recommended this resort to many of my friends and all of them had a wonderful experience. We will surely visit again.

reviews.author: Elza M
reviews.title: Holliday
reviews.text: Wonderfull, This hotel is very excelente. The beach is perfect, the staffs are very good. The restaurantes are very good. The room in front of the sea with jacuzzi is a GOD. My Family and I love Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: cmamanuel
reviews.title: Bringing in the New Year 2017..Ally&mich
reviews.text: There's hardly words for the fantastic treatment and attention each and every employee at this hotel gives.  I wish I knew every individual name to thank them properly for their kind "hola's".  There are a couple waiters at Noas that deserve a special recognition " Antonio & Orlando" thanks so much for going above and beyond...you Rock! As for the activities there are several that made our stay an amazing one... Ernesto, Antonio, Hugo, Benjamin "benji" and Susan.  Thanks again for your nonstop attention and for making me and my daughter part of your family for the week! Happy New Years! You maked it great for us!

reviews.author: indirar2017
reviews.title: Cancun
reviews.text: It was a great hotel, really good food, good service, good drinks. Our room had some kind of a funny smell, i believe from chemicals. When I brought it up to the front desk, we were transferred to a different room. I have requested a bellman to help us move, but he has arrived an hour later after we have moved all our stuff ourselves. Other than that everything was great

reviews.author: jamietravels2017
reviews.title: Zero Customer Service
reviews.text:
Horrible experience checking in!!! Had to stand in a line over an hour for check in... no water even offered. Then was told I had to pay more money for my daughter, who is 13. Reservation was for 2 adults - not my fault!! He said my credit card wouldn't go through. Again, not my fault. I was treated as though I was trying to cheat them of something. After all of this, we had to wait in a second line to get our room key. Everyone in the long line was complaining about this. They had workers all over just standing around and one slow person doing more paperwork to provide a key! 45 minutes in this line and I was now being harassed about owing money, credit card not working and they were withholding my room key! She demanded that I call my bank, which I had already done. It was Christmas Eve. They were closed for the next 3 days. The nasty woman who was extremely rude took my card and called the number on the back, spoke to someone and then handed me the phone worth am attitude of "see, I told you I could get your bank to answer, you liar." She had called the stolen/lost card service. My card was not lost or stolen! She couldn't make my card work! 

We had been up since 4am, traveled 4.5 hours, stood in lines... we needed to get to a room! Did she expect me to hand over my daughter until I could reach someone at my bank?! 

I have never been treated with such blatant disrespect or experience such an inefficient check in system in any place throughout the world! No one seems to be in charge here.

There are good things at this hotel. Good food. Beautiful restaurants. But the service is ridiculously slow and the people don't remember things. I order 3 drinks and 1 comes. Never given enough towels. No water in the room. Fridge not filled. Smoke detector in hall outside our room going beep, beep beep... 3 times requested they put in a battery - a simple request. NEVER HAPPENED! On and on... 

But the absolute worst was how I was treated at check in. This place needs some serious customer service training! I will NEVER EVER return here or to any Melia operated hotel!

reviews.author: Lillianne G
reviews.title: Ups and Downs during our stay
reviews.text:
We arrived late at night and although I had requested late check in, were told that our room had been "given away" and we ended up in the lobby overlooking plants and listening to the employee's conversations while trying to sleep. The room's tub was so high from the floor that I had issues getting into it. 

We upgraded our room and were offered the Royal Service Wing. It took half the morning to do so and we ended up canceling our plans for the day and booked mani/pedi's instead. The ladies at the spa were very nice but by the second day of our stay my gel manicure peeled off. 

At the Royal wing, our butler Rossana was amazing and the details throughout our stay impeccable. However, we had a bad experience with one of the Royal Service employees who processed a currency change from dollars to pesos. We brought $140 and he told us that for $148 we would get 2400 pesos, so we owed him an extra $8. he told us not to worry about the $8 and gave us the 2400. Two mornings later we brought him $10 because we had no change. He took it. 

When at checkout we disputed the peeled manicure charges they pulled out an itemized charge sheet and we noticed that we were supposed to get 2600 pesos for $140 without the extra $10 we had given him to complete the $148 he said would complete 2400 pesos. To add to the lie, he had given us a form to sign that had my husband's name and no other information of the transaction and he said it was for the hotel to know who they did a transaction with. My husband signed it. When we requested to know why he gave us wrong information he pulled the form out and he had added that he had given us 2600 pesos, which was not true. 

So, be very careful when you make your currency changes. This employee ended up with 200 pesos and $10 dollars that belonged to us. Ask to see transaction details in writing before signing. The only contact from the hotel was his supervisor saying they would take measurements and apologizing and asking us to stay again, not to offer a refund of the amounts that were taken for us. 

A lots of positives but also lot of negatives.

reviews.author: kkoster
reviews.title: Gorgeous Ultra-Lux, Miami-Trendy-Style Hotel in Cancun!
reviews.text:
My family and I usually do Christmas at an all-inclusive somewhere warm, so I have been to a half-dozen all-inclusive resorts, and Paradisus is really in it's own class in terms of comfort, decor, & style...it really reminds me of a 5-star, trendy hotel in Miami...with the lovely perk of all the drinks being included (rather than $16 US/beverage). 

The attention to decorative detail is really stunning, from showers with a rain shower-head & curtain-covered glass wall to the bedroom (leaving this for honey-mooners & couples), zen garden in the tower surrounding the spa, floor-to-ceiling curtains separating a mod room from a terraced balcony with lawn chairs, so all the rooms get sun. purple mood lighting (Purple is Paradisus' color, and the pens write in purple, the pyramid towers are purple at night, the towels are purple...it's lovely) from below the cabanas on the beach, which is especially wide & lovely to lounge on or walk along. Great, long sculptured pools that are fun to explore... I just LOVE this place!

We wound up in tower 5, which I believe has been recently renovated, so the really gorgeous modern rooms may not be resort-wide (in other words, request tower 5 or a renovated tower, if you can!).

There are 9 restaurants, multiple bars including a really chic bar with cabanas and a just as stylish after-hours club with great DJ  music for dancing. Lots of variety, and more healthy options than a typical 4-5-star all-inclusive. 

I also typically don't love staying all-inclusive in my own travel because most resorts are so isolated, but the Paradisus is right across the street from an Oxxo, 7-eleven, and Ahorro (major mexican pharmacy chain) as well as other restaurants and shops, which make me feel less stranded (albeit in paradise).

I really can't say enough good things about this place, and I am so so sad to be leaving in 2 days! 

The only negatives are--the hotel isn't set up for the typical all-inclusive evening shows, so they are pretty crowded at night (but if this isn't your thing, no worries; and it's more than worth staying here & paying 30 to catch a show in Cancun, which is really accessible). Also, if you are really drawn to sprawling, outdoor, more Carribean-decor-typical resort-style, this probably also isn't your place. One other minor tip -- the cocktails & beverages are MARVELOUS[!], but on the digitalized program, it mentions that some of the bars have some specialty cocktails [asian-inspired, fused with green tea/etc.; or tropical-themed], and when you ask, the resort doesn't actually have this. So *do* bring this back, even if it's only one specialty asian or carribean-themed cocktail/day! That would be so awesome!!

reviews.author: baylor_travel
reviews.title: Amazing Christmas family trip
reviews.text:
Thank you Paradisus Cancun for making our family Christmas memorable and amazing. First and foremost, I want to say I'm not associated with any travel agencies or companies. I felt compelled to write a review because I used reviews to help me decide where to spend Christmas this year. 

Overall:  The Paradisus is a great place for families, couples, or just a place to relax by yourself. The property had a very zen like atmosphere making it a very stress free environment. Although this resort is a kid friendly resort, it still has a grownup feel. I would recommend staying at the Paradisus. 

Family concierge: My family decided to upgrade to the FC which I thought was great. We had Fernada, who helped us with all of our needs. Such as but not limited to reserving our cabanas(which you can reserve for the whole week or each morning), restaurant reservations, breakfast, packing lunch for our tour, etc. She also kept us up to date as when she would be out (taking a day off, etc). She had such a great energy. She even babysat my daughter so my husband and I could go to Tempo.  With the FC, I think the experience is very dependent on who you get. I recommend upgrading to family concierge. 

Beach: the beaches at Paradisus are clean and well maintained. My husband and I walked 5 resorts in each direction and we both concluded that the Paradisus by far is the best. The sand is soft. My toddler had no problem walking on the sand with no shoes. (The sand is cool to the touch on a 80 degree day). The waves are a bit intense. The flag is red almost year round. We brought our infant life jacket for our toddler to be on the safe side. Be smart and be careful. If you want calmer waters you want to be on the upper 7 of cancun but you won't get the aqua blue waters. 
We reserved the Cabanas on the beach -cocos beach. Alejandro was Fantastic. We requested him every day we were out there. He works hard and has such great energy. So positive :)

Room:  the room was an oceanfront suite. We had no serious problems with the room. Very comfortable. With the Family Concierge upgrade we got to pick out special pillows 

Restaurants: the restaurants at Paradisus are yummy. The food is great. The buffet (naos) is fantastic. On our last day we had Orlando for breakfast. He was by far the best server. We didn't have to wait for water or coffee. He was on it. My least favorite was enso.  Too salty. But I liked the Chinese chips. My husband and I tried Tempo. We did the tasting menu with the wine pairing. The food was good. The wine pairing I felt could use a little variety. The wines only came from Romania and Napa. Our last night, the resort did dinner by the pool. It was spectacular. It was a clear night and it was so romantic even having a toddler beside you.

reviews.author: TGabor1123
reviews.title: Great 8 Day Vacation!
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Nov 27 - Dec 3 and had a wonderful time. Our Butler Jorge is the best! He took care of our every need, including dinner and spa resevations, Bali Beds, and a special surprise for our Anniversary. Thank you Jorge!
Reymundo at the Toji bar is a "mixologist artist". The drinks are amazing and the presentation is unbelievable. He is very personable and we looked forward to visiting him to watch his "passion in action" every night.
Jiovanni at the swim up bar took great care of us during the day. It was nice to swim up to the bar and Jiovanni was already making our favorite drinks.
The Bali Beds are so relaxing and the service is great. We loved relaxing and napping in our pool side Bali Bed.
We chose to eat at a different restaurant each night and they were all very good. I would recommend eating at Tempo although it costs extra. The tasting menu was unlike anything we had ever experienced.
This was our 2nd visit to this resort in less than 8 months and we can't wait to go back. 
Thank you Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: treslechee_
reviews.title: Restaurant Bana/Rodizio
reviews.text:
Bana: 

One of the Best parts of my trip. 
The vibe and ambiance of the restaurant was spectacular. 
Darwin was our waiter and he was phenomenal. He suggested the best dishes to taste. He had such a great personality and had us feeling like queens. I'm not a big fan of sushi but let me tell you after tasting the dishes suggested I wanted MORE. They sang happy birthday and made it super special. Thank you Darwin for making our experience one to remember. 

Rodizio Restaurant: 

One word AMAZING from the deliciously grilled meats to the side dishes all the way to the chimi sauce. Truly amazing! I would choose them over and over again!

reviews.author: Tricia L
reviews.title: Excellent accommodations & service!
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I just returned from a week at the Paradisus Cancun. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The most positive aspects were the staff, the pool / beach layout, the spacious rooms and the location of the hotel. My reasoning for rating it at 4 stars is bc I didn't really care for the food... It tasted mass produced which is understandable but didn't make it any more enjoyable. 

Overall, we had a fantastic, relaxing trip and I would not hesitate to recommend this hotel to others.

reviews.author: 6JDS16
reviews.title: Cancun Jan 2016
reviews.text:
We can't say enough about how much we enjoyed our stay. Weather was windy and cloudy at times but we enjoyed the beach and swimming every day. Hotel is one of the cleanest we have ever stayed  and the staff could not be any friendlier. Great for relaxing, plenty of lounges and huts on the beach. Evening shows were nice with the family. 

Only negative was a squeaky pullout bed and on Friday night they were doing maintenance and turned off all electricity in the hotel at midnight, there was no emergency lighting that I could see from our room. Disappointed that our last night was cut short, would seem better to schedule maintenance after people are sleeping.  Overall great experience though, would go back again!

reviews.author: Wendy B
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise!
reviews.text:
My family stayed here the first week of January and it was amazing. From the time we checked in until we checked out, everything was excellent. 

The waiters, Martin Sanchez and Yhoni Gonzalez Torres in the Nao's restaurant were extremely attentive and the service was excellent. All of the restaurants on the property had excellent food with great service. 

I would definitely recommend this resort. The only thing I found annoying was their entertainment at night was held in a lounge which did not have enough seating for the guests and some guests had to sit on the floor.

reviews.author: Daniella S
reviews.title: Absolutley gorgeous
reviews.text: We had such an amazing time here. The food was amazing although 2 of the restaurants were not available on our stay. The people very helpful. Great location and so much to do in the area!!! Will go back!

reviews.author: kaush1030
reviews.title: Lovely resort
reviews.text: Its a lovely resort with a very maintained staff and dinning is fabulous and ornaldo he is best.its so memorable days we celebrated our anniversary they arranged romantic dinner for us its so lovely.And the most great is food of this resort and clean pool and nice beach.

reviews.author: Jim R
reviews.title: Opulent!
reviews.text: Paradisus is like a high end Vegas hotel (minus the gambling) on a wonderful white sand beach.  They have everything you need under their roof.  The staff takes service to a whole new level.  Rosanna, Jorge, Alberthe, everyone provided us with a premium experience.  The amenities were top notch.  Drinks were excellent!  Food was good to very good, but not great.  Yes, I would definitely return!

reviews.author: Tinana12345
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text:
Just so you know, we have stayed at many All Inclusives all over the Carribean and Mexico. Dominican Republic 15 times, Cuba 3 times, Jamaica 3 times, Antigua, St. Lucia and Cancun/Playa Del Carmen 12 times.

Paradisus is an excellent chain. Stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Dec 29-Jan 3 2016.

Pros
Excellent Service-  the waitors, waitresses and everyone else at this resort was very helpful and this was the best part of the hotel.
Great Food
Rooms are kept clean and have excellent views
Beach is great at certain areas, rough in other areas, our kids are now 10 and 9 and we found an area where they could go jump the waves. If you are looking for a calm beach, this is not the place for you.

Cons
The one thing I did not like about this hotel is that we could not find any  tanning beds by the beach or pool after 8. We would wake up early and all the beds were covered with towels however we waited half an hour and if no one showed up and there were no personal belongings on the tanning beds, we took over. Many people did the same as beds were reserved for others who weren't even up. 
There were bali beds that they charged $170 US on the beach which included champage and lobster....I found that to be ridiculous as I could get champagne at any bar. I could stay at another resort for $170.  
There were a lot of upset guests, the hotel chain should realise that people pay a  lot of money to stay here and should not be charging for extra for certain areas. In my opinion take away those bali beds and add more palapas and more rows so that guests don't have to sit on the sand or on the grass by the pool.

-Another suggestion would be to have the pools heated in the winter time. It was quiet cold certain days in the pool.

We have stayed at the Paradisus Esmeralda two times prior and will be going there in July again. In my opinion Paradisus Esmeralda is a far better hotel and is only 40 mins away from the Cancun airport. The beach is calmer, never had to pay for tanning beds. They also have the same excellent service and have heated pools which are great in the winter time.

reviews.author: Adriaan V
reviews.title: restaurants
reviews.text: The buffet restaurant was fantastic. Staff very friendly accommodating including Orlando and Kawij.Besides the buffet restaurant there are 6 to 7 other restaurants on the premises, two of which we really enjoyed, the Mexican and the Argetinian beef.

reviews.author: shiron53
reviews.title: pros and cons for experienced  travelers
reviews.text: A nice enough place but if you have stayed at some of the other all inclusives in the area , this property lacks something.  Having said that, I felt satisfied with overall experience and would return if the rates were acceptable.  Not wonderful but  was overall satisfied with the property.  Pros, staff in bars and resturants excellent  Cons Front desk check in and check out  staff.  Not satisfactory, slow and indifferent

reviews.author: Patty I
reviews.title: Girls week!
reviews.text:
We spent an all inclusive week here. There are 4 buildings in this resort. It is a large resort with beautiful beaches and large pools! You can view the ocean from one side of hotel and lagoon from other side.. Beautiful! Sunrise viewed on ocean side/sunset on lagoon side! The beaches have fine sand and big waves for body surfing! Lots of lounges to lay on ( beach & pool side). The staff is very friendly- can not do enough for you to make your stay wonderful! 
All restaurants (except one) housed inside building 3. The meals were exceptional - representing different ethnic foods ( Persian, Chinese/Japanese, Asian, Mexican, asian Fusion - 7) then an American Buffet too! 
They had a 1/2 hour show each evening that was good but had no special stage so they were performed in a bar/lounge (not a lot of room or seats).
The building at night was dark inside and outside. Needed to use flashlight on my phone to see menus ... And where we were walking... Romantic low lights and incents lit in evening...
Activities scheduled around one area of pool and on the beach were engaging and fun! There is a swim up bar too! 
The main building (#3) was a very busy building. Our room was on third floor - the air conditioning buffered the sounds from the activities going on in building...
The Spa was hard to find - over priced, small but excellent facials and massages experienced!

reviews.author: Yendi F
reviews.title: A Tropical Paradisus
reviews.text:
Lovely resort with many dining options!  Very pleasant staff and well maintained areas. Our concierge Luis Herrera was excellent- he helped with transportation, arranging birthday celebrations and recommended activities based on our needs. 

The wifi service is poor though.

reviews.author: Summer G
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: My husband, myself and our two daughters age 8 months and 3 years recently stayed at paradisus for a week. We had an excellent time. The service was great and the food was pretty good compared to other places we've stayed. The staff at the kids club are really nice and my daughter was asking to go there every day. The night shows were entertaining, and our older daughter loved the kids disco. The star of our stay was Gaudencio at the naos buffet. He was so friendly and kind to us and especially our children. Our youngest just loved him and we couldn't have asked for better service. We'll definitely be going back.

reviews.author: Margarita Z
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!  Wish we could stay longer!
reviews.text:
I seriously would not be able to find one wrong thing about this resort, even if I tried.  And I am very picky.. This was by far the best all inclusive stay!  Beautiful hotel, which always smells great, and always clean.  Beach is so clean and water is just beautiful.  The food is amazing.  I read a review below, complaining there is no Mexican food.  Not true, they have an amazing authentic Mexican restaurant that was super delicious. We made reservations to a different restaurant every night, and didn't even get through them all.  All of them were great!  The food is delicious, fresh and beautifully made!  Entertainment was awesome: special thanks to Fernando, "Chacho" and Freddy, who work so hard to keep guests entertained, and they do it so well!  The shows were awesome as well.
Special thanks to our favorite barista, (beating myself up for not remembering his name now) for always welcoming up with warmest greetings and making us laugh.
Our favorite waiter at the buffet, Orlando, always made us feel so welcomed. Sergio and George, the waiters at the beach - cannot say enough good things about these guys.  They work all day long to bring drinks/etc, and they always do it so quickly and with a smile on their face. Maria - the beautiful little lady who cleaned our room, I just wanted to take her home with me, the sweetest lady ever!  I wish I could mention everyone's name in this review, but I will just say, GO HERE!  Everyday these folks will make you feel like royalty.  Definitely coming back to this resort!

reviews.author: terryconroy
reviews.title: Hotel Review
reviews.text:
We were very happy with our stay at the Paradisus Hotel in Cancun. The hotel was clean, the staff was very friendly and took care of our every request. From the time we checked in to the time we left always helpful with a big smile on their faces. Te pools were nice and the beach was beautiful.
We tried most of the resteraunt and they were all very good, our favorite was the new Mexican one that was like a taco bar, small simple food but all tasty fresh and a great staff to take care of you.

We also ate many meals at the buffet that was very good and again everyone that worked there were fantastic, from the young lady's that sat you to all the waiters that provided that great service. Names like Marco, Jesus, and all the rest spoiled us morning, noon and night!

reviews.author: ssdmw
reviews.title: paradisus cancun is no 5 star resort
reviews.text:
I am rapidly coming to the conclusion that the people who write glowing reviews of mediocre resorts like Paradisus Cancun are either from Iowa or the whole Tripadvisor thing is a massive fraud perpetrated by hotels posting one bogus review after the next. 

I am staying in the exclusive part, the "Royal Service" .  Keeps the riff raff out, they put a little bracelet on you to signify your status and it has its own separated space of beach. 

Food here is not good.  Plentiful yes, good, no.
