In arrival they told us dinner reservations must be made 24 hours in advance. So if they do not tell you that beforehand, what are you supposed to do on your day of arrival?  I believe it is a ploy to send you to the buffet restaurant. 
when we told them that was not okay, they found an opening for us in the Asian fusion restaurant. when we arrived there at 830 it was almost completely empty. amazing 

There is a real challenge communicating with some of the waiters. Their English is pretty poor. They serve things you did not order. Then they work frantically to fix things. Would be a lot easier if they understood English more if they are the primary interface. Did not have this communication issue at the Excellence resort. 

Hot Tub may have worked 20 years ago.  Snow water is ice cold. When asked about it they said they were aware it was not working. No evidence they are even thinking of repairing it. 

Rooms are good. Service is good   The private butler is solid. 

Place needs a facelift. Also needs better management.

reviews.author: Mahawa S
reviews.title: Best Resort in Cancun
reviews.text: I had a great experience staying at Paradisus Cancun. It is a beautiful, high-quality resort with an incredible staff. First off, our room was a Junior suite which was a good size for two people and everything inside was in good shape. Housekeeping is very responsive and mini-fridge is stocked daily. Every room has a hot tub outside on balcony. Also, the location of the resort was great. It's on the southern half of the boulevard where all the hotels are, farther away from the nightlife in the north. I liked this because it was more quiet and peaceful. However, it is still a quick and cheap bus ride (<1 U.S. dollar/person for bus) to the north part where you can go shopping and go to clubs. Paradisus Cancun is also across the street from the water sporting place AquaWorld, which is convenient if you sign up for any of those activities. The food at the buffet and at the restaurants inside the resort was phenomenal. There's a lot of variety and I think it's the best food I've ever had. The drinks are very good and there are some special tequila shots they make too. The people who work at Paradisus Cancun made my experience truly memorable. These were the friendliest people I've ever met and are genuinely so. They got to know us a bit throughout our stay and even joked around with us a bit too (completely within a professional capacity though). Some of them even learned our names and greeted us namely. It is evident that they care about their guests and that they like talking to people. Paradisus Cancun is a truly exceptional place which I highly recommend and would definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: Houssam G
reviews.title: Very good service (waiters Alberto and Orlando )
reviews.text: I would like to thank the establishment for all my days in there , specially Alberto and Orlando (the waiters market grill)they are really kind and nice (best waiters ever ) I left the royal service only to be served by them ,in overall the hotel is really good offers plenty of services (spa beauty diving jet ski ....) I highly recommend this hotel

reviews.author: jackie a
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
I have stayed at 5 resorts in cancun and this one was the best! I believe all the resorts were fun and i had a great time at all of them. This one though was the best, very luxurious and large.

Food was amazing, so many different restaurants. Bali beds were fun to rent, you had to purchase a bottle first 100$ up. But they catered to you all day while you were at your bali bed and had a private menu for you and the food from the menu was the BOMB! 

Especially loved the sushi restaurant!

reviews.author: brickhockey
reviews.title: Simply Spectacular!!
reviews.text: Spent 4 days at this wonderful resort.  Everything was top notch.  Beautifully set on the best part of the beach.  Only downside was restaurants use this sharing type of service, and I was sharing food from the same bowl with people I just met so that was a bit awkward.  Sometimes there wasn't enough food brought out either.  The Grille however was a very good Brazilian type restaurant where this did not occur.  I suggest the buffet and the Brazilian Grille, but forget the other specialty restaurants except for Bana which I did not visit but looked great.

reviews.author: Kelly H
reviews.title: Very Clean Resort
reviews.text: The resort was very clean and beautiful. I wish they had checked the room a bit better before putting us in as some time was spent getting the safe to work, getting another chair on the porch, having the baday fix as it leaked all night one night.  Our friends that were with us also had troubles with a leak in their room that had to be fixed and led to them eventually having to move rooms as it was leaking on their bed still.  The staff was mixed, some excellent, some rude or uncaring but Kavil (I think that is how you spell it)and Rcs Naus were very nice.  The one gave excellent service at meal times and was so kind and upbeat.  Despite the room troubles we would go there again.  Food was good and plentiful but we did have troubles trying to get reservations to any of the other restaurants on the resort so ate at the buffet a lot.  Reservation system for restaurants was very frustrating. Had to make reservations the morning of the day you wanted to go and every time we woke at 7am (first time allow to call) they were already booked!  Frustrating!

reviews.author: Stylist1983
reviews.title: Outstanding Customer Service
reviews.text:
My husband and I went for our honeymoon, our first trip to this resort.  When you pull up to the resort, you are greeted by the staff with smiles and welcomes.  It was the warmest welcome I've ever gotten at a resort or hotel.  We were staying as Club Melia members and were not sure of how check in worked, which did not make for the smoothest check-in.  We were pointed in a few different directions before we actually ended up in the right place, then still had to wait 20 minutes before someone was able to start our check in.  Overall, this took almost an hour, which is far too long for check in. 
We then went to our room to meet the bell boy with our bags.  We had a studio style room with a kitchenette,  couch and very decent size balcony with 2 chairs, table and large jacuzzi.  The room is nice, but could definitely use upgrading.  The bathroom is small-a squeeze for 2 people to get ready together.  The toilet is in a separate area with a sliding door, and also has a bidet.  While this may sound fancy, it's actually a negative as the bidet is only 6" from your knees if you're sitting on the toilet.  Not what you want to stare at.  The shower was also disappointing.  It is a tub with shower curtain, and the tub floor was lumpy, as though it had been set on an uneven pile of something.  
The beds are very firm and the pillows are practically useless as they flatten out completely as soon as you lay your head on them.  I would definitely pack my own pillow in the future.  
There is also a lack of electrical outlets in the room.  While this may sound silly, we all use electronics these days, so having 2 outlets within reach isn't practical.  
With the amount of money they charge for the rooms, we just expected more.  Nothing a little updating couldn't fix.
Our first stop was at the large pool with the swim-up bar.  The pools are very clean-they are actually scrubbed clean every morning.  The chairs on the other hand are not comfortable.  There are 2 positions- laying down flat or laying back 3/4 of the down- no postiion setting to actually sit up.  All of the lounge chairs on the beach and at the pools are like this.  Everyone who first comes in tries to sit them up and actually comments that they can't believe you can't sit up.  There is also a lack of chairs for the number of people that are at the resort.  If you are not an 8am kinda person, plan on trying to find a spot in the grass or laying your towel in the sand.  
A

reviews.author: yaroslav2016
reviews.title: Nice resort!
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed staying at this resort! Staff is very friendly. 
Every time when I go here I visit Yhi Spa. Receptionist Cecilia is very friendly and she is always open to help.
Manager Omar at the Yhi Spa was very helpful. He is a very nice person.
Massage therapist Veronika is the BEST massage therapist ever!!!!

I recommend this resort!!!

reviews.author: H1234E
reviews.title: Excellent Resort & Wonderful Staff
reviews.text:
This review is long overdue. My significant other and I were here first week of December 2015 & I want to make sure I give credit to staff whose names I still remember. To say this is the place to be would be an understatement! We were in the Royal Service part of the resort. It is exclusively for adults and has a private beach and pool area. The resort has so many different activities to take part in. It has nightly fun entertainment and open bars. Many different restaurants that are part of the all inclusive package & the food is delicious! 

They truly treat you like royalty. We did not have to lift a finger to do anything. Our butler, Rode, whom I recommend for anyone going was always a phone call away. He would make sure our dinner reservations were always made ahead of time and make sure we were happy during our stay. Even if he had the day off, he would answer our call (if we needed him) and get us what we needed. He is a friendly person, who you can tell cares about the guests.

So, a plus of the Royal Service are the bali beds around the pool! Rodrigue who is in charge of the bali bed reservations was always accommodating. He always had a smile on his face. The waiters (Jorge, Caesar, & Eddie) who served us while we were lounging from La Palapa restaurant, were energetic and constantly willing to serve no matter what time of the day. They were as happy to serve at the end of the day as they were in the beginning. They would often come around and ask if we wanted drinks or snacks and bring bottles of water without being asked. They were always so kind and friendly & always smiling.

For couples with no children I recommend Royal Service because the staff truly treats you like royalty. The resort itself is spectacular, but the fact that the staff is so kind and friendly and cares about the guests made it even more worth it to stay here. We will definitely go back!

P.S. Lazaro keep up the good work! Royal Service was everything we hoped for!

reviews.author: landsold
reviews.title: Wonderful Physical Plant, Just needs A Few Tweaks....
reviews.text: Just returned from my fourth trip to a Cancun area all inclusive resort and the comparisons are fresh in my mind, so I'd like to take a moment to share with my fellow TA readers. First of all, this is one of the largest, most complete resorts in Cancun. The curb appeal is fabulous, as this nod to the Mayan ruins will take your breath away when you first approach it if you're staying here, and make you jealous if you aren't. Your transport will turn in at the marina, where all manner of water sports are a short stroll away.Then you'll notice a beautiful, manicured executive golf course representing the front lawn. Next, you'll arrive at the main entrance, and before you can bring yourself to approach the front desk, you'll find yourself drawn, open mouthed, to a cavernous lobby dripping in live ivy that leads to a magnificent tropical garden ground floor level with fountains, Koi ponds, and an Asian inspired restaurant that blends into the foliage. Keep walking through the lobby and out the back door and you'll find a beautiful beach as wide and long as any in Cancun. Multiple swimming pools also wind along the back of the building with the standard swim up bar and outdoor eatery. Check in was a breeze, the standard hotel rooms were beautiful, clean, and roomy, and every room has a nice large balcony. Physically, this is the largest, nicest and most complete property I have stayed at in Cancun. Everything you will need to have a fabulous time in Cancun is on site. For me, however, the only things holding this back from being a five star resort is the service culture and the food in some of the specialty restaurants. The five star competitors in Cancun greet you with chilled towels, champagne, and a rose for the ladies, and check in is done at a private table. Here the standard greeting and check in procedure is fine and efficient, but not special. As for the food, the buffet is adequate, nothing special. We only had one lunch and one breakfast there, and while the fresh cooked steak was good for lunch, the breakfast omelet stations were crowded. My tip for breakfast is to order through room service. Our omelets were delivered hot and within a half hour at the time we ordered, and we didn't have to wait for a table, and then wait in line. The specialty restaurants were my only mild disappointment with our stay. The Market Grille is a must. This Brazilian inspired steak house was our favorite for dinner as well as lunch. While the variety of meats and preparation is not the best I've experienced at these types of restaurants, our group of 20 thoroughly enjoyed the meal. At all of the specialty restaurants that we tried, there are no menus. Other than the steak house, all of the menu items, from appetizers to deserts, are served "tapas" style, with small plates that are put between two opposing diners and are intended to share. These small plates came out fast and furious at the Mediterranean restaurant as well as the Asian restaurant, and weren't always distributed evenly. We were left to wonder if we got to try everything, and some of the dishes were just plain awful. My last visits to Cancun had me convinced that the Mexican chefs are the best in the world, but, of all the places I have stayed in Cancun, I would rate the food here as the poorest. I want to make it clear that the food is not bad, and I would not rule out another stay here because of it, but the way that multiple tastes are thrown at you in rapid succession, and then all of a sudden they're serving desert, well, it just didn't work for us and the large group we were with. So, if they add a little more fan fare when you arrive, and a better, more personal style of serving in the specialty restaurants, than this would get the fifth star from this author.

reviews.author: Georgienyc14
reviews.title: The staff is wonderful
reviews.text:
We are a family of four (two young kids 4 & 7).  We upgraded to Family Concierge.  Fernanda took care of us.  She was simply amazing.  She went above and beyond the call of duty and took care of us.  She made us feel special.

Overall the staff at this hotel are very hard working and friendly.  There are some great restaurants  - Fuego and Mole were our favorites.  If you go during peak holiday season, it will be difficult booking dinner reservations so plan ahead.  
The rooms can use some improvement and upgrades.  We stayed in tower 3.  The pools are spectacular and the children's pool is huge.  Overall , I would recommend this to families.  It was a great vacation

reviews.author: carrie2play
reviews.title: Not my jam
reviews.text:
I will preface this review with sharing that all-inclusive resorts aren't my thing. My standards are VERY high if I were to find myself needing to be at one, think One & Only is almost all I could stomach but not sure my bank account would appreciate that! I was at the Paradisus for a large work event, which absolutely needed to be at an all-inclusive resort, which I understand for efficiencies and ease of use so to speak with so many people - so that's my context.

All that said, I will start with the good news. Folks that work here couldn't be more gracious and sweet. Customer service is EXCELLENT.  There is no dig or knock on them!

Now, for the bad news. I'll start with one of the most important things for me, food. I could write a whole review on that in and of itself. There was no Mexican food to be found (a few sad tacos and some guacamole at time scattered around the resort buffet options) for the majority of the day's meals. I love Mexican food, so this was disappointing. There are a few nice restaurants for dinner, but otherwise, you're doing the all-inclusive thing, meaning lots of pre-made greasy food for unhealthy American tourists - fries, hamburgers, random buffet things, you get the picture. I love food, and when it's not good, it doesn't make for a great trip. 

Unfortunately the accommodations weren't all that either. I was in the 'regular' part of the resort, not the fancier part so take that into account. My room was huge, which is nice for spreading out and feeling spacious, but the lights weren't easy to use and were annoying (I like dimmable lighting). The light outside the patio door could not be turned off, so there was no leaving the doors open for fresh air and the sunrise all because of a glaring fluorescent light right above the sliding glass doors. Bathroom lighting was also terrible (all downlights) which don't work well for putting on makeup or really seeing your skin or face (probably more important for most women).  There is a fire alarm right above the beds that flashes a bright lights sporadically throughout the night - not sure how anyone can stand this?

The shower took 10+ minutes running to get hot. No joke - it really did. I took cold showers until one day I figured this out somehow, but I'm a conservationist, so this is just not acceptable. 

Every chair and table or desk in the room wobbled.

There was no patio furniture for sitting outside. Really?  I'm in Cancun, I'd like to sit on my patio.

The doors on the TV / entertainment system furniture were falling off the hinges. 

I could hear people loudly walking down the hall at night b/c the floors are so hard and the sound just goes right under the doors.  I was woken up multiple times by folks coming back to their rooms after being at the bars or clubs.

All in all, as I said, not my thing, but even if it was, this wouldn't be where I would return to spend my money or my time.

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Royal service adults only ocean view room worth every penny.
reviews.text: Royal service is the way to go! Adults only section with special perks. The pool, royal service only la palapa outside restaurant and bar service were amazing! Excellent, excellent service from Moises, Valeria, Daniel, Edier, Alberth and Victor. You guys were the best!!!!

reviews.author: Peter M
reviews.title: Another great stay
reviews.text: Again, we had a great time at the hotel, even though the weather wasn't the greatest.  It didn't matter because everyone takes great care of you, and there are enough things to do when it's cloudy or raining.  We stayed in the royal service area, and everyone provided exceptional service; from Lazaro, the manager, to Sandra (Sandra brought our family special presents, which was over and above what was expected) and Juan Carlos, the Asst. Managers; all our butler friends, including Galdino (congrats on having a baby girl while we were there), Juan, Sergio; all the food and beverage staff in the royal service buffet area, great cappucinos; all the servers by the pool, including Octavio, Victor, Valeria,and other names I can't remember; and special mention to the pool attendants, Daniel, Omar, and Rodrigo, who also took care of us way beyond expectations.  We count all these people as friends, and look forward to seeing them again soon.

reviews.author: Gonzalez_Grande
reviews.title: Hidden paradise. Consistently perfect each time we visit.
reviews.text: This was our fourth time at Melia Paradisus Cancun. Each time has been consistently "Perfect" So good that we have already booked again for February 2016. This is couples therapy for my wife and we have such a great time together that we will be there twice a year from here on. From the second you arrive you are treated like royalty. A bottle of champagne is always waiting for us. As you walk the property you are acknowledged by all the staff with a head bow and hand to their heart gesture. They are continuously there to please you in any way that they can. Every restaurant is top notch. All inclusive at it's best with top shelf liquors. The royal service is always beyond our expectations and well worth the extra money. The spa there is also a very special treat. My wife and I had couples massage and the hydrotherapy session was incredible. This resort is right in the center of everything. Boat rentals and snorkel tours just a rocks throw away. This is my second review for this location. I want to start by thanking the manager Mr. Lazaro Asencio. He is an asset to the Melia organization and always goes out of his way to make sure our stay is perfect. The whole staff at Paradisus did a great job but it is important that we point out some of the staff that truly made it extra special for us. Let me start with our Royal Service private butler Juan. Juan was there anytime we needed anything. He even took the time to hand write us a letter when we were leaving. A very special touch! We also had great conversations with Daniel at poolside by our ocean front Bali Bed. He told informed us on Mexican history and was a really pleasant young man. There were a few more waiters that were excellent I must apologize as I forgot to write down their names. There was Carlos, Javier, Cesar, Ignaciao and Ricardo but one that really stood out was our pool side waiter Moises. It was pouring heavy rain and Moises stayed all day running back and forth to bring us food and drinks in our Bali Bed cabana. He was an amazingly hard worker who worked all day in the rain to please us. We will be returning again next month for our 20 year anniversary and can't wait to see all the special staff there. They always make us feel special and at home. Five star food and five star service has always been provided. All the staff at Melia Paradisus Cancun should be awarded for their hard work especially the ones that provide Royal service. Thank you for memorable experiences and see you soon.

reviews.author: Camtender
reviews.title: Foruth Time of Staying Here, Love More Each Time
reviews.text: I always find the Paradisus Hotel to be one of the best hotels, if not the best, we ever stayed in. Staff is awesome friendly and they always goes the extra mile to make your stay as pleasant as possible. My first pick every time to Cancun.

reviews.author: Millie C
reviews.title: Baby club
reviews.text: The baby club is excellent!!! Our little boy loved it, we stayed at the hotel for 2 weeks and he was in there most days playing we stayed there with him or we left him there with alma and Adriana who was both so lovely and so happy to have my little boy. We didn't have to worry, being in the hotel we were only a phone call away and if he was ready to leave they would just call us where ever we told them we was going to be. P.s alma and Adriana would love them to be a nanny for my child how lovely they was. Millie and Baye x

reviews.author: kr2016788
reviews.title: Jan 2016
reviews.text: I traveled with friends from my medical school. We had an amazing time. I wish I had stayed longer. The facilities were very clean and the staff was very friendly. I stayed on the Royal side and I am glad that I did (it was quiet). The food was actually very good for an all inclusive (and I have stayed at a few). . .in fact the best I have seen (and we were a group of 12). We plan on making this a yearly trip at this point to the same hotel. We did not leave the hotel at all and pretty much ate, drank, relaxed. My only issue (which was individual) was my butler. . . he was nice, but I didn't see him much. My friends had a little more contact with their butler. I was traveling alone, so I was pretty low maintenance, but would have preferred to at least see him once or twice (or have a note from him reminding me he existed). I still loved my stay. I consider myself kind of a hotel snob and only like staying in nice rooms, but my overall trip was amazing from start to finish. Other names I remember as being super were Leticia (she checked me in), Sergio (one of my friend's butlers). Great stay, amazing location, and fabulous hotel. Get the Royal!

reviews.author: debbie s
reviews.title: somewhat disappointed
reviews.text: Thought it would be a good value - kids club awful, used for 1 hour, restaurants not great - buffet is best food but if you don't like buffets you are disappointed. Massage at spa was GREAT - pool and ocean amazing - Martin Sanchez in main restaurant was so service oriented and on it....he was awesome!

reviews.author: Brenda T
reviews.title: Javier and Vinilli Marcus
reviews.text: Our room service attendants were superb here. Could ask for better service. Amazing experience the waitstaff in Market Grill buffet breakfast.  Marcus was the best waiter we have had ever. He always had a smile on his face every morning. We couldn't wait to eat breakfast to be greeted by Marcus smile. There are so many more.  It has been our pleasure to be here. The service was superb.  I wasn't allowed to carry my plate from the buffet. Marcus had my plate for me. Great guy!!! We will miss seeing him.

reviews.author: Jillian A
reviews.title: Paradisus is amazing!!
reviews.text: All we can say is, we love this place! We stayed in the Royal service, and everything was perfect! The food, the atmosphere, and most of all the people made our stay absolutely wonderful. To be specific, Juan Carlos and Javier by the pool made everyday bright. And Gustavo, the waiter by the pool, and Cesar, our butler, were terrific! And then there was the incomparable Rodrigo, our friend's butler, who made us laugh all the time! We miss him, and Paradisus, so very much, will be back soon!

reviews.author: sarahetta05
reviews.title: Nice relaxing family vacation
reviews.text:
The service at Naos restaurant, especially by Kauil, was great.

Nice resort, pretty beach, good location. Not a lot of variety for food. Not a lot for little kids to do on the resort but the people at the resort are very kid friendly. There is a show each night, but not much else to do in the evening.

reviews.author: lori_holthaus
reviews.title: Panoramic Sensations
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Cancun and it was the most amazing experience. We were treated to only the best they had to offer; from check in to check out.  The resort faculties are beautiful from street to sand. The sounds, aroma and attention to detail were exquisite!  Can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Stephanie S
reviews.title: Cancun 2016
reviews.text:
This resort is excellent.  The weather was windy but warm for the most part.  The staff was excellent And it is one of the most clean resorts I have ever been to....  The food is great!  The kids clubs was absolutely fantastic.  My 7 year old loved to go and the activities are great.  Staff to acknowledge are both Luciana and Marisol who were fantastic to my son... Thanks to you both!!!!  We and Oakley will miss you.. The adult activities were great... Beach volleyball.... But no tennis....one court that does not see any maintenance or play.... But we enjoyed the other activities.  We would come
Back..... For sure.😊

reviews.author: 123Beenthere
reviews.title: Great property, great service, so-so food
reviews.text: We loved the resort and the pool area.  Didn't go in the ocean because it was rough but you can expect that in January.  Royal Service gave an adult only experience without children which we appreciated.  The dinners in the hotel restaurants were very average.  One of us has trouble walking and this is not a handicap friendly facility.  Requires lots of walking, poor signage and few elevators.  Do not come here if you can't handle lots of steps.

reviews.author: Anon0623
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
This hotel is absolutely amazing. First off, the staff was exceptional and always went the extra mile to accommodate our needs. Check-in was easy and we were welcomed by Raphael. Our waiter, Martin Sanchez was the greatest! He referred to us by name and had my green juice ready for me every morning, without me even asking. The bartenders and pool staff were fantastic, especially Oscar & Hector (pool area), & Alipio & Pilan (Toji bar). We did not have great weather, it rained most of the week, but there were plenty of activities for people of all ages (volleyball, magic show, bingo, trivia, zumba, aerobics, wine & tequila tastings and a mixology class. The activities staff (Freddy, Rodgrigo, Chacho & Fernando) were great at getting everyone involved and again always referred to us by name. 

The food: I had no complaints about the food at all (I am an extremely picky eater). I thought that the restaurants had something for everyone and were accommodating to modifications I requested. Mole was my favorite meal (get the taco appetizer and Tequila Shrimp). Bana had awesome sushi and dumplings.  Market Grill is great for meat lovers; I only ate the chicken and sides but they were delicious. Enzo had fantastic appetizers and be sure to try their 'Welcome Drink'. Fuego was good, but not my favorite, however my family loved their steak dish. The buffet (Naos) had a good breakfast and lunch, but we did not eat their for dinner. I especially loved the smoothie station and fresh juices. Make sure you check out Andres at the Nespresso bar, he makes the best Maple macchiato. We tried out Blue Agave our first night, which was pretty good but unfortunately they were closed for the rest of the week for construction. (We stayed Jan 9-16).

The Room (Pyramid 1) : We had a junior suite with lagoon view and our parents had the same room but oceanfront (the view was AMAZING). The rooms appeared to be renovated and were spotless. Housekeeping always kept our rooms in top condition and we were fully supplied with fresh towels and shower products daily. The mini bar was restocked daily and our beds were turned down at night. 

The Pool/Beach: The beach was great. Yes, there was seaweed, but it's natural and does not interfere with your enjoyment at all. The pool bar was the best and the servers were always checking to see if we needed anything. We did not have an issue at all with getting chairs on the pool or beach. Most days we were up and out by 8 am to maximize sun time, but even by 930 there were still spots available. 

Overall we had a great time at Paradisus. I strongly advise to disregard the negative comments on this site, as we did not experience anything that was less than excellent. The grounds are well maintained and there are constantly workers cleaning throughout the hotel. While it is not expected, we did tip many of the workers daily as they provided optimal service. Everyone was so friendly and wanted to make sure we had everything we needed to have a relaxing week away. You should definitely book your stay at this hotel, you will not regret it.

Ps. There is a cat and kitten that hangout by the pool, they are so friendly. We provided them with water (bottled) and some snacks - they need to eat too

reviews.author: EUROPEU
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
In a point of view of architecture , views , loacation and atmosphere the Paradisus deserves a high note.
The problem is that a hotel it's not only walls, ceilings,furniture an. swimmingpools.
The quality of service of the human side is perhaps so important or more than the nonhuman conditions, and in this area Paradisus is very bad.
Service in bars and restaurants  are very bad , slow and without any kindness.
A glass seems to be any unknown thing.
If we order a beer or water comes the bottle but never the glass.. This is a 5 stars  hotel?
The concierge service is a complete joke.
Our concierge apparently knew nothing and didn't give some useful orientations.
Our concierge even , told us, that in Xcaret thare was no dolphins!!!
I think that she wished to sell not onli Xcaret but also Xe La.
As I have been 4 times in Cancun i Knew that her information werw wrong and I went by my own where I wanted.
But remain the question : Concierge for what? 
Also de food it's not compatible with a 5 stars hotel.

reviews.author: EJS35
reviews.title: Lovely property with excellent staff!
reviews.text:
We upgraded to Royal Service Oceanview for about $70 per night above the cost of a regular lagoon view room. We felt it was well worth it for the view as well as the RS amenities. Specifically, the separate adults only atmosphere, separate pool with Bali beds, Royal Service La Palapa restaurant for breakfast and lunch, quick check in and extra assistance with restaurant reservations.

The strongest attribute of this property is the staff-everyone was extremely pleasant and eager to please. I would happily stay here again.
Beds and linens were very good, generous bath sheets and nice pool towels. Room is nice enough with seating area and two chairs and table on the balcony. Unfortunately due to the architecture-the balcony has a concrete wall as opposed to a railing so you cannot see through it. But still nice to sit outside and listen to the waves.
Wifi was free and had no issues anywhere in the building-a little slower at pool but that is to be expected.
 In RS you are guaranteed 2 days in a Bali bed and wait list on the remainder of the days. BUT-you must check-in at the towel hut by 11 AM or you can lose your bed.
Food--again I would pay extra for RS. The outdoor restaurant for Royal Service only was lovely and served really good food. Full breakfasts, great lunch menu and snack menu for items you could order to be delivered poolside. 
We also ate twice at Tempo, at our expense, as it is not included. Highly recommend this if you like fine dining. Super value at $50USD for a 11 course tasting menu that is world class. Also had dinner one night at Bana for sushi which was good also. One night at the only regular restaurant that was outdoors--Thai food that was just okay. There was a very nice breakfast buffet indoors at the RS also that had anything you might like-fruit, yogurts, pastries, bacon, sausage, French toast, chocolate fondue, potatoes, charcuterie and cheese,eggs and also champagne!
I would like to also make note that I appreciated  that the menus included vegetarian, gluten free and healthy eating options at all venues. For example-you could order fruit kebabs and rare seared tuna at the pool for a snack. 
Overall the food was excellent for an all-inclusive with relatively sophisticated choices such as a foie gras Kobe burger at La Palapa. Not just bar food!
I rate only four stars based primarily on some facility issues. The hot tub was non-functional at the Royal Services pool. Compared with other properties we have visited---the interior lobby space is rather dated and dark. Did not impact my enjoyment but it could definitely use a face lift to brighten it up. Bathrooms were smaller than what I would label 5 star. One sink, very little shelf/counter space and really a one person bathroom as far as getting ready. Not bad-just not 5 star and certainly workable.
Balcony chairs could recline but still not a chaise lounge.
And as someone else observed--they need to put felt or nylon feet on the chairs in the rooms. The noise was unholy and the people above us were active until 5 AM pulling chairs around.
Overall a lovely property and a solid 4 stars and excellent value.

reviews.author: Emily S
reviews.title: Paradisus January 2016
reviews.text: A very good hotel. Food was good, staff were very kind. Service was not always very efficient.  Royal service allowed a butler and daily minibar restocking.  Our Butler was very kind, but it's ago while to receive any requested items. The aromatherapy throughout the hotel was nice. The Royal service lounge was great, which had  snacks and drinks throughout the day, without the need for a sitdown service.

reviews.author: Donald M
reviews.title: Noteworthy staff!
reviews.text: Martin Sanchez is a very friendly server at the Market Grill!  We also had a fantastic meal at Vento (tapas restaurant).  We missed Blue Agave (closed for construction). Special thanks as always to Lizeth Escudero who makes sure our group was well taken care of!  We loved our room and the attention to detail.

reviews.author: Sam G
reviews.title: 8th time in Cancun - Paradisus is the charm!
reviews.text:
My wife and I have traveled to Cancun 8 times and have stayed at a different all inclusive resort each time. 

The Paradisus has been the best by far. We traveled under the My Time Select package. Melissa our concierge was terrific. She walked us through our VIP check-in process and she also arranged a 2:00 PM check out time at no additional charge.

The food was amazing. The following staff at Naos Restaurant went above and beyond in their attention to detail and dedication to service:

Guillermo - El Capitan
Gaudencio, Ricardo, Orlando, Arturo, Marcos, Eder, Kauil, Martin Arzeta, Martin Sanchez, and Vincente Guerrero

At Ensos Restaurant:

Daniel - El Capitan
Hugo, and Rodrigo

At the pool:

Sergio and Ulisys

The Hotel is very spacious with plenty of restaurants and bars. The room was comfortable and very clean. The mini bar was restocked daily. The beach front is expansive and there are large pool areas to satify either the swim up bar people or other pool areas to cater to families with children or those who want to relax and read a book quietly.

All in all a terriffic experience. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: LeslieofNY
reviews.title: This was best vacation we've ever had. A little slice of heaven.
reviews.text:
I have so much I want to say and almost all is great. We can’t afford to vacation very often so it's really important to me that everything be, well, wonderful. After reading tons of reviews on Travel Advisor, I picked the Paradisus for our first trip to Cancun. I was so happy I did. We had an amazing trip. The resort is beautiful and lush. The beach is amazing and the pools are spectacular. Our lagoon-view  junior suite as spacious and comfy. The service everywhere on the property was great. 

That said, two gentlemen made our vacation truly special.... MOISES, one of the servers at the Royal Service area pool/beach. This man is so WONDERFUL. It's funny when you realize that one person, just one, can make or break a vacation. Lots of the employees did a nice job attending to us, but Moises was the superstar. He took the time to get to know what made us happy  and then he made it his business to make sure it was done. From our favorite drinks and snacks to making sure we had sunscreen and cold water, Moises took care of our every need. And the amazing part, he was only "assigned" to us for one day of our stay. Through out your visit your area is covered by one or two servers. It's their job to look after you and see that you get what you request. Moises went the extra mile. After one day as our server, he kept tabs on us making sure that we were happy. I don't have anyone else (except my hubby) who takes care of me but on this vacation I truly did. I could go on and on. Suffice it to say that he's amazing and he should be a trainer! If everyone who works in this place spent time watching, learning and emanating they way he approaches his work, there would be a waiting list for reservations. (BTW, I’m heartbroken that I didn’t have my picture taken with him!) 

I also want to tell you about Daniel, the manager at Enzo. On our final evening, we went to Enzo and met Daniel. It was rather late and the restaurant was rather empty so we started to talk. From the moment he introduced himself to the moment until he bid us goodbye (after showing us the best was to walk back to our room), we were treated like we were family visiting his home. He made us feel so special and that takes talent. He’s new to the Paradisus family and Enzo is a new restaurant at the resort. It wasn’t best meal of our stay but it was easily the best dining experience.

And finally, I want to give a shout out to one of the hardest working people we met, Cesar, a young waiter at the Naos buffet. Despite the impatient, demanding and sometimes downright rude guests and a rather cranky manager who seemed to feel like he wasn't clearing the tables fast enough, he kept a big smile on his face, never complained and worked to do his best while giving attention to each guest. This guy needs to be put in a place where he can train with someone like Moises because Cesar is going to be real asset to the Paradisus family.

One of the things I was unclear on but now have a real opinion on: Do tip your servers everywhere. The make a very small salary and a few dollars is a big deal to these folks. I'm not rich but giving the people who took care of us a few dollars each day made us feel good and each person was very appreciative. I also feel like it did get us slightly better service although at no point was anything expected or requested. Do take singles, fives (and tens and twenties if you feel like they are earned) with you. It is tough to get change although the waiters by the pool and the bellmen always were always willing to make change.

Our best meal, hands down, was at Mole. It was so good I wished that I could take my leftovers home and I probably over-ate a bit knowing I couldn’t. For lunch, we had the best food at the Pool area restaurant or off of the pool side/beach front “snack” menu. 

complaints?

On our last day, the ATM broke and since we were short on cash, sort of desperate. The front desk sent us to an ATM at the foot of the driveway on the street since the hotel's ATM wouldn't be serviced until the next day and we had to leave early. This was horrible. The ATM was very, very expensive to use and the bank added a hefty surcharge for providing us with dollars. Do NOT use this ATM. Honestly, I think the hotel should have cashed a check for us. In the end, the ATM was working before we left although I don't know what the fees would have been like. Do yourself a favor and save your small bills for a couple of weeks before you go and you'll avoid any problems.

Do let people know when you have a problem or a compliment. Managers need to know what works and what doesn't and they genuinely care. We had a disastrous first dinner at Vento and someone really should have tried to set things right. I encouraged my husband to splurge and order an off the menu steak and it was terrible. In the end, I paid extra for a ridiculously overpriced meal. I’m not sure why they didn’t and we were too upset to insist on speaking with the manager.

Suggestions?

It would have been great if there was a way to give some feedback or comments to the chefs at each restaurant. We are foodies (our son is a chef with a restaurant in NYC) and I think they need to hear what people think about their food.

Royal Service: Let guests know when the live music is happening in the evening. We managed to catch it a few times but would have planned to go and chill if we’d had a schedule. Send folks home with something that has the Paradisus logo on it as a gift. I was guilty but I took my slippers.  (Who else was going to wear them?) I’d love to have a set to highball glasses or one of the signature beach towels. In the end, I probably should have bought one but since it a sort of free advertising, why not sell them at $20 instead of $50? I’m guessing that this sort of thing doesn’t matter to folks who have the luxury of vacationing often but we don’t.

Butlers: Try to get to know the guests. I feel like our butler took one look at us and assumed that we were boring. I read a lot of great things about the Royal Service and we didn’t really experience anything that was memorable or special. Our loss was his as well since we are actually very appreciative and generous. The young men and women who made our morning coffee and poured our sodas were more attentive. Ditto the maids who left us a little message each morning and always stocked our mini bar with the things we liked.

Hints?
Royal Service is the way to go! We were so happy with all the perks and had the use of all the facilities. 
If you want to swim in the ocean, it's calmer in the morning.

Skip the buffet unless you go early when everything is fresh then try and find a “quiet” corner that’s away from the hustle and bustle to enjoy your food.

Ask for a Mango Lily at the bar if you like fruity cocktails!

reviews.author: karenmZ9931XR
reviews.title: Awesome Royal Service Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed in Royal Service. The staff there, especially our Butler, Rode, always went above and beyond our expectation. Roberto, the pool concierge always helped up find a beautiful palapas bed for the day and made sure we had anything we needed. The wait staff around the pool and at La Palapas were always very friendly and perceptive and ready for a good laugh. I could not have asked for a better vacation!

reviews.author: Thomas F
reviews.title: Amazing Property with Excellent Sercice
reviews.text: My family of 5 chose to stay at the Paradisus for five days in early January. We upgraded both our rooms to the Royal Service suit which was the best decision we've made. We had an amazing butler named Cesar, who was there to assist us with all of our needs. Amazing views from the rooms which are a great size. The royal service offers it's own dedicated tower and pool area. Definitely recommend upgrading. We have always chosen to stay with Paradisus resorts and this property exceeded our expectations. Big shout out to Cesar for making our stay extremely enjoyable.

reviews.author: Elena F
reviews.title: AWESOME RESORT
reviews.text: I've been to Cancun twice and didn't think I would go again but had to go again for the third time to attend a friend's wedding.  After staying at this top notch al inclusive resort, I would go again and choose to stay here again.  The service was over the top.  Everyone was no nice and friendly.  They go out of their way to serve you and the food was very good!

reviews.author: Hjremlinger
reviews.title: Royal Service a PLUS!!
reviews.text:
Second time we stayed in Royal Service accommodations at the Paradisus Cancun resort and would definitely do it again.  I especially want to thank Sandra who has been such a dream to have as our contact at the concierge desk from the pint of check in to now.  

Interesting to have a butler but not really sure of it value, then again I'm self sufficient and can press my own shirts and make my own reservations. I guess for some guests it is a plus.  

But all of the other perks are well worth it, and just to name a few, Bali Bed for three days, private pool, adult only accommodations, free tennis, free golf, private check in and check out......... And much more.  

Recommend the extra cost of your looking to relax in comfort.

reviews.author: Jeff L
reviews.title: Amazing vacation
reviews.text:
My wife and I took our toddler with us on vacation this past December.  This was our first time in Cancun and staying at this resort brand.   Our comparison is the iberostar which we have stayed in the Caribbean.  Both all inclusive with the only difference was having our toddler.  

The hotel was beautiful.  Large and expansive. Many restaurants to choose from and lots of clean white beaches.  The restaurants where you reserve a table were spectacular.  I am sure there are a lot of good things to do in the area as the hotel is right in the strip, but we stayed in so we could get plenty of beach and pool time.  

There were a lot more positives that I would consider coming back to the hotel.  A few things on the down side. 

The first two days at the hotel we had to avoid certain parts as they would hound us to go to their welcome breakfast and would give us money.  Basically it is a sales pitch and not what we wanted on vacation.  

Our concierge was kind of useless.  

There are three types of places to sit at the pool.  You can rent a cabana for 50.  They look amazing but we did not do that.  You can get a free palapa which is a shaded area for two chairs or just find random chairs or a piece of grass.  Papayas according to the sign could not be reserved and articles left more than thirty minutes without their owner would be removed.   People would put their beach towels out around 6-7 am and then come back around 1 when they were ready to sit by pool.  That left many hours without a nice place to sit if you did not wake olio early.  We just moved other people's things and let the cards fall.  But his was a negative as we would go to the pool from 9-1 until the toddler napped so this was a bit of a drag.  

Also the baby pool was not impressive.  They really need a splash pad.

reviews.author: Paige D
reviews.title: Amazing Place with Amazing Service and Amazing Food!
reviews.text: We stayed in the royal Service and it is a must! Our butler Fernando was absolutely amazing amazing and made our trip romantic and fun. The other staff was amazing to, from Latice at the main desk to Rodrigo at the pool and Rodrigo in the Royal Service as well. They were attentive and helped us have the most wonderful trip. The food was awesome as well. La Palapa was dynamite as well as Fuego and the sushi place. The drinks were amazing. I cannot say enough positive things about the place. It was beautiful and one of the best resorts I have stayed at. I definitely recommend Royal Service, it was magical and a great experience. Definitely will either come back to Cancun and stay at Paradisus or go to another Paradisus resort from the service we received! Fernando again was the best butler ever! A great, great guy!

reviews.author: Dsaulnier
reviews.title: Most gracious service
reviews.text:
We have been going to Sol Melia- Paradisus hotels for over 14 years.  We bought a time share and have enjoyed the great staff, cleanliness and professional management. My husband and I, as well as the 1000's of other guests love one particular server- Asuncion.  She has worked at the hotel for over 25 years.  She is most loved by all of the timeshare holder, new and past customers. She is a warm loving person who remembers not only your name, favorite foods and drink.
We, as do everyone at Paradisus Cancun love Asuncion.  I would love to have her as my employee but am so thrilled that she has become a friend to our family.

reviews.author: DavidB39653
reviews.title: Great Thanksgiving Vacation
reviews.text: Booked the Paradisus through Bookit.com for our first 10 day Thanksgiving vacation. Stayed on the adult side (Royal Service) with with my sister in law and her husband and friends from Arizona. Everything from start to finish was great. Our Butler Galdino was fabulous. He was there for our every beckon call. Have been at other resorts with Butler service but none as good as the Paradisus. Love the fact that they offer a free cell phone to you so you can call your own Butler for anything you need. Read the reviews before our trip that the Royal service was not worth the money but I strongly disagree. Worth every penny. The private pool and beach were awesome and Daniel who runs the cabanas pool side and on the beach was great. Some of the best people there were the wait staff both pool side and beach side. A big shout out to Jorge, Moses and Eddie for all the fabulous service. Never once had to wait for a cold drink or even lunch that they would gladly run and get for you.. Even better they would split their time inside at the adult bar and buffet in the Royal service lobby and outside at the pool and beach. I think the only drawback was that the swim up bar was not at the adult pool but on the family side of the resort. But the great staff made up for it. Samantha and all the other staff in the Royal service lobby were also there for all our needs and I didn't want to forget them. The room was beautiful with a gorgeous view of the beach and a huge balcony. Always cold drinks and liquor in the room.The free wi-fi in the room also would work at the beach and all through out the resort. Couldn't have been happier with the resort and all the staff. Would definitely go back and would recommend this resort to everyone.

reviews.author: N3417BUcarolineb
reviews.title: Outstanding Experience
reviews.text: The Royal Service was exemplary.  The Bali beds were amazing and the service there couldn't have been better.  The Royal Service lounge was lovely, as well.  The servers must get top notch training as our needs were met even before we knew what we wanted ourselves.  I strongly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Sandy H
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: We traveled with our three teens and mother n law.  We were extremely impressed with the entire resort.  There were so many choices to compare this one to, and we are so glad we picked Paradisus!  The food was awesome at the different restaurants, our butler was so sweet and thoughtful, the beach and pools were amazing.  We bought a sports package to jet ski, parasail etc. & that was worth the money!  The whole experience has us talking about when we can return!!  Loved it!!

reviews.author: Scott F
reviews.title: Great Vacation!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: I will say this place never lets us down.  I forgot to write a review so this is a little late.  Everything is great about this place.  We did not stay in Royal service this time.  We traveled with some friends and they loved it.  The only issue we had was my buddies phone was stolen by house keeping.  He left it out  so it was kind of his fault and this can happen anywhere.    If you stay in Royal Service ask for Juan to be your butler.  He is the best!  My wife and I are going again Feb 2016 and we are staying in Royal Service this time.  Paradisus if you are reading this can you please have Juan contact us?

reviews.author: coryw71
reviews.title: Butler made our trip!
reviews.text: Antonio is a fantastic butler and gave me the best service I've had anywhere in the world. He made my girlfriend and I feel like royalty! Anything I asked of him he made it happen and I never felt like I was a burden. Amazing service!

reviews.author: Sarah B
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: The staff is always amazing- pleasure to talk to and always looking for ways to better serve their guests! We have stayed here for the past two years and the service is always the same- perfect! The resort is beautiful and clean and for such a big resort it is also so peaceful!

reviews.author: Dena V
reviews.title: The best experience ever !!!
reviews.text: My husband and I have stayed at this Resort 5 times ! We stay at the royals and we didn't have a care in the world , they pampered us anyway they can .. The Food was amazing and quality was superb!! The staff knows us by name and recognized us which made us feel like we were home !! Can't wait to return!!

reviews.author: Teresa P - Vancouver Canada
reviews.title: Excellent experience;  great location
reviews.text:
My partner had a timeshare with Melia Cabo but due to the  hurricane in 2014 and the hotel was not ready so we were able to stay at Paradisus Melia Cancun for 2 weeks in December 2015
Absolutely wonderful hotel, we had a beautiful oceanview room, it is located right on the main hotel  strip, easy to go around, the buses arrive every 2 minutes,  easy to go to  Playa del Carmen or Cozumel.
Only took us 15 minutes to the big Supermarket by bus
Highly recommend this hotel

reviews.author: Bruce B
reviews.title: Very nice hotel, with spacious, well-kept suites and excellent staff and restaurants
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful hotel with an amazing atrium at its core, well-kept suites and excellent staff. The beach was fantastic, but the surprise bonus (unexpected for an all-inclusive) was the selection of great restaurants. The open-air Enso offered up amazing Asian fusion cuisine (thank you, Edgar). Another restaurant, Mole, introduced us to some interesting and very tasty variations on traditional Mexican cuisine (thank you, Leonardo). And the Mediterranean tapas restaurant, Vento, provided us with a wonderful meal on the final night of our stay (thank you, Benito, Gerardo, Katia & Jose).

reviews.author: Tx-foodee
reviews.title: Great place, outstanding service!
reviews.text: Second time there with family. Good food variety and quality, great pools and incredible beach with top shelf drinks across the hotel. Only downside is show area is not a theater but they do a good job managing that. Conveniently located between the airport and downtown Cancun, 20 minute ride each way. We've booked March 2016 to renew our vows with family at Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Janet H
reviews.title: Rest La Palapa
reviews.text:
We loved the beach side dining at La Palapa.  Our servers, Edier Cab along with Octavio and Jorge were awesome.  Chef Angel Almeida and Humb
erto do a great job!  
You have to be in Royal Service to dine here but we luckily were in Royal Service.

reviews.author: CoryM1111
reviews.title: CoCo Bar
reviews.text: This is a great way to spend a day and relax like a king.  This is extra money but is worth every dollar for the privacy and the service you receive while on the beach bed.  Sam Whinchester was our server the two times we utilized this extra feature and he was fantastic every time.  I can honestly say that my girlfriend and I decided to go back because of the service Sam gave us.  I look forward to going back for the service and relaxation that this club offers.  Just a FYI if you do go here you should tip just because you pay extra money doesn't mean that the wait staff is taken care of, its just like it would be in America.

reviews.author: HelloKL
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text:
We stayed the first weekend of January. I think the hotel was in a slower occupancy period because I didn't experience any of the issues listed in other reviews. I had originally wanted Royal Service but found we didn't need it at all in terms of restaurant reservations, beach reservations, etc. The property is huge and beautiful but it can be easy to get lost in the towers, especially at night when the lights are very dim... Pay attention where you walk! I almost wrenched my ankle several times falling off the path.They definitely need more signs throughout the towers.
For dining- Email ahead to set up dinner reservations for the first night and then you'll need to call every morning to set up reservations for the next evening. Market Grill is unlimited Argentinian barbecue; Fuego was ok. The daily buffet Naos is good, I actually even preferred the buffet food over some of the restaurants... If you're a big foodie you're going to think it's mediocre in the restaurants. If you're not a foodie, you'll think it's great.
Overall the wait staff in all restaurants, and on the beach, were impeccable in their service and so friendly. Even though everything is inclusive, I would bring $50 peso notes to tip all of the wait staff (roughly $3 USD) since they're just so nice and bend over backwards for you. I only spent about $30-40 on tips for four nights. 
I just wish the same could be said for the front office staff. The front desk agent and Concierge were both shy and quiet and did not offer information even when asked pointed questions. For instance, we asked the Concierge about clubs and she said "just go down to the city and there's a lot of clubs." We asked her if there was a cover fee and which one was best and she said "yes they charge a fee. Any are good." And did not offer the prices or names.  I would try speaking to the Expedia concierge instead. 

Airport tips- Set up taxi ahead of time. There's no point in paying for super shuttle taxi. The line is much longer for single taxis and they will try to double up passengers on you anyway. We waited in line for 20 minutes for a $102 round trip to the resort and they wound up loading another family with us. We didn't mind but we may as well have paid $50 less for the shared shuttle anyway.

reviews.author: lovetravelling87
reviews.title: Good, but not what we expected!
reviews.text:
My husband and i traveled there last week (Jan 2-9). 
We have been to Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana before and fell totally in love with the place! To treat ourselves this year, we decided to try Paradisus Cancun. 

Beach is very great, but as you may know, there are a LOT of waves in Cancun so it may be dangerous and 99% of time, there is the red flag...Not a nice place to swim, but nice clear water and sand...

Good points: Nice looking hotel in general. Very nice lobby with fallings leaves. Large suites covered in marble. The bathroom could be a bit more updated (as it is in Palma Real) but beside of that, it was ok. Nice large pool!

Bad points: In Palma Real we had an included wine list at every 'à la carte' restaurant. At this one, it's only house wine: Cabernet for Red and Chardonnay for White. For a 5* hotel, you definitely need to have more choices. We found some Red Wine Merlot at the bars during the dat, whice we liked. When we arrived at the restaurant at night, they didn't have any. I asked at Vento to try having us some!!! He wan't convince but finally his manager found us one! 

Room service: We order somme room service one morning. The lady made me repear my order 3 times, just to make sure she got it right. Unfortunately, it arrived all wrong!!! So after waiting 40 minutes for this, we got the wrong order and decided to go to the buffet, very disappointing!!!

Restaurants: Bana (asian/sushi) is amazing! It's located in the middle of the hotel, between the falling leaves. Very lovely. We had an amazing waiter and food was great. You REALLY need to try it. Besides that, the Market Grill (Brazilian) was good. 
Vento (tapas) was pretty much disappointing, we didn't like what we ordered! Enso is another Asian place which is on the top of the pool. Nice location, but not so good food. Nothing compared to Bana! Mole (Mexican) was not very good either :( No Mexican ambiance at all. My appetizer was ok, but that's it! There is a Taco Place which is nice, no reservations needed. Open at around 4pm, so you go there for dinner or a late afternoon snack. Finally the buffet was good in general, but always the same exact thing....:(

The service overall was ok, but there is a significant lack of communication in general. For example, we got a late check out per guest services. They called us at 2:30pm wondering what we were doing in the room...Euh?! Told them we had a late check out confirmed at 4pm...They said it would cost money!!! Ohhh no, told them it was already agreed with guest services. Seriously, need to have an organised team!!!

**Room tip: If you are willing to go there still, treat yourself with an oceanview. Totally worth it! Try not to be too close from Avenue Bar (where the shows are) because it's very noisy! It's a high pyramid, so the noise travels a lot!!! Also, is you want to go to the show, they are OK, but need to be there at 8pm (starts at 8:30pm) because there are only a couple of seats. They don't take place in a theater as stated above. It's in a bar!!! Kind of weird and only very few spots...

So, in general, for the price we paid (A LOT!) we were kind of disappointed. It's more a 4* hotel / service / food than a 5*, but at a 5* rate! The only thing that is 5* in there is the hotel in general and probably the fact that you have unlimited restaurants reservations. 

I may go back to Paradisus Palma Real, but certainely would never go back to this one for the price. If you are looking for a nice 5* resort in Cancun, i would strongly suggest checking the Secret The Vine (2 minutes from there) or treat yourself and go to Le Blanc or Live Aqua or Excellence, etc.

reviews.author: azick1987
reviews.title: Overall very good.
reviews.text:
I just got back from a 6 night stay at Paradisus cancun with my parents.  We stayed from Jan 7-13th.  Overall we had a great experience.  The hotel didn't seem too crowded which was nice--wasn't too hard to find chairs by the beach and/or pool in the morning.  We also had no problem getting reservations at the restaurants.  The food at the restaurants was okay--nothing spectacular--but whats to be expected at an all inclusive resort.  The service at the restaurants was excellent.  Our server, Pablo, at the market grill took care of us during breakfast and lunch for our entire stay.  I cannot say enough nice words about Pablo!  I would go back just to see him!!  

We did dine at Tempo, the only restaurant that is not included in the all-inclusive package.  It was very good, but was not amazing.  Yet again, the service was excellent but the food is not what I was expecting from a 7 michelin star chef.  It was still a nice experience and I am glad we went.  

We ventured off the resort once for dinner at Puerto Madero (recommended by our friend Pablo!) and it was excellent.  I highly recommend this restaurant!

The entertainment by the pool was always wonderful!  One day it rained and the entertainment team (Rodrigo, Chacho, Fernando, and the rest of the staff) kept us busy doing indoor activities.  It definitely made the trip fun!  My mom and I looked forward to zumba every morning!

The resort is beautiful and we had a wonderful relaxing vacation.  I would recommend this resort and would certainly come back!

reviews.author: Akemi I
reviews.title: So-So
reviews.text:
My mom and I stayed here for one week and we have to say we have mixed feelings. When we checked in, there was no special greeting. We then got in line and waited 15 minutes. The check in employees seemed tired and to our surprise, we were not upgraded to the room we booked.  They said to come back the following night to check for availability but when we did, they said the upgraded room features would be the same. The next day, we didn't get a detailed orientation to the hotel but it was clear that a lady who kindly explained a few things about the hotel was more interested in selling a timeshare. In regards to the room itself, it was clean. However, we had to remind the staff to bring towels, washcloths, and toiletries. Plus, they didn't clean/restock the rooms until late in the afternoon. The food was alright. We ate at the buffet most of the time and we can't deny that the food was varied and fresh. The servers were always kind and very attentive! It would be nice if the coffee station near the restaurants would open earlier. The entertainment was fun but there was never enough room for the guests to enjoy the shows. Most of the crowd had to stand up. Be careful what you lean on because one night, during a show, a pillar meant for decorative purposes fell on another guest's head and nearly hit a few other folks as well. We didn't see the staff rush to check on those guests which was worrisome. On a side note, the dancers and singers were fantastic!
The pools are nice but one of them was too deep for us. The beach was gorgeous and the accessibility was one of our favorite parts of the whole stay. However, there should be more beach chairs. 
About half way through our stay, it was time for our scheduled massage that we booked during the 2nd day. It was a wonderful 50 minute massage. The staff also let us know that we had access to various hydrotherapy areas. My mom wished she could have stayed longer than the 1 hour time limit. 
Bottom line, we are not sure if we would come back to stay at this hotel.

reviews.author: Anuta K
reviews.title: Just loved it
reviews.text: The service at that resort I just can't explain. People at the restaurants and buffet is awesome. We had a servers Christian, Hugo and Oscar. These 3 guys really work their butt off to serve their customers. Coming to our table every 5 mins and asking if everyone is doing good. They even remember our drinks. We were so satisfied with their service. Definitely is coming back. We were treated like royalty. Never had anything like it at any other resort, and we do travel a lot.

reviews.author: Gabriella C
reviews.title: VACATION HERE!!
reviews.text:
My sister and I decided to book a trip with Paradisus for the first time. The trip to the resort from the airport was pleasant.  As we entered the resort, I was astonished by how beautiful it looked. Two years ago we stayed at a different resort in Cancun and I must say Paradisus topped the last one. I had an issue with the check in process due to the fact that the lines for the front desk were very unorganized. It took almost 30 minutes just to check in just because there was no distinction if there were one, two, or three lines. Other than that, we were happy with the room we were given. From past experiences, this was a very large room with a king size bed. The room contained two balconies, but only one had lounge chairs on it. A plus to this resort is that the Wi-Fi is free and you are able to access it throughout the resort. Although, it lagged at times, I was still able to check social media sites and send and receive messages. 

I was impressed with the room service. Every day they came and always refilled the mini bar with beer, sodas, chips, cookies, and lots of water. The restaurants within the resort were all very unique and had delicious food. Reservations were easy to make and you can call a day in advance. I have read other reviews where visitors complained about this but I had no issues. I loved the Brazilian restaurant (Market Grill) they had. Overall, the service at each restaurant was great. 

The worst part of each day was trying to find a lounge chair near the main pool where all the activities would be held or announced. If you do not get to the pool by 11 a.m. all the lounge chairs by the main pool would be taken. People place towels on the lounge chairs and leave for several hours without coming back. The entertainment staff was fantastic, friendly, and enjoyable to be around.  There are many activities planned throughout the day that you shouldn't miss out on. You can do Zumba, salsa, aerobic exercises, volleyball, soccer and lots more.  I participated in the aqua aerobics several times throughout my stay and I must say Hugo, Jessica, Fernando and Chacho did a wonderful job getting everyone up and moving. Each day they did different things so it never got repetitive. I also enjoyed participating in the volleyball games with the entertainment staff. 

Every night there would be a different show and I enjoyed watching each one. Each night there was a different host and they all did a wonderful job! Try to get there a bit early so you can have a seat! The resort has a lounge which stays open until 2 a.m. for drinks and dancing. If you are in the main pyramid of the resort, you can hear the music from your room but I had no issue going to sleep with the noise. Another great perk at this resort is that if you get hungry, they have a late night snack bar that is open util 5 a.m. 
Unfortunately, on our last day it was raining but the entertainment staff (Jessica, Fernando, Chaco, Rodrigo & Hugo) still kept everyone on the resort busy and entertained inside. They had an Xbox set up, along with board games. Although it wasn’t nice out, we still had a really great time. If it wasn’t for these awesome people mentioned, my experience at this resort wouldn’t have been as great. 

Overall, we had a really great experience and all staff on the resort was very respectful and would go out of their way to satisfy any of your needs. So thank you for a really fun and great time, Paradisus!

reviews.author: SQUIDXIXMa_
reviews.title: Just got back.
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here from Jan 4th to the 11th. We enjoyed our stay and had excellent service through out the 8 days we were there. Every day Javier at the Royal Service pool section would make sure our cabana was set up and constantly asked if we were in need on anything. We also loved Martin Sanchez from Naos and Market Grill restaurants. We looked for him everyday to make sure we could sit in his section. The resort is a little dated and we preferred Paradisus La Perla in Playa Del Carmen. The beach in Cancun is much better though. Thought the food and drink were good but no great. Not sure if we will back unless we get a really good deal.

reviews.author: mvillasana
reviews.title: Excelente Soooo cool, we loved it, really. The service is excellent and the restaurants and bar and the beach; everythin
reviews.text: Soooo cool, we loved it, really. The service is excellent and the restaurants and bar and the beach; everything is very very nice. We would like to thank specially the waiter Victor from the pool bar, he's very polite and works very hard. Thanks a lot for everything and we really hope we can go back and stay there again. Cancun is never enough.

reviews.author: Ezequiel M
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text:
The Paradisus strikes right at the entrance, imposing building with an entrance hall that lets anyone surprised. Those hanging plants on the balconies that fall in cascade form in the middle of the hotel, in a Japanese restaurant ... Sensational! 
It has more than 10 restaurants, all with great food. However, I strongly recommend that you take the dinner in the Vento, the Fuego and Enzo are the best! They are, respectively, Mediterranean cuisine, Peruvian and Asian. 
The rooms are clean and spacious, the bathroom has shower and bathtub, the bed is very comfortable and the are a huge balcony. 
There are two pools with good depth, one has a bar with great drinks with great brands like Ciroc, Black Label, Dos Equis, etc. 
The structure of the beach is very good, comes with sun loungers and umbrellas in addition, there is a bar near the beach so you do not have work to leave the beach to order a drink. 
Ultimately, the Paradisus Hotel is an outstanding, excellent room with a breathtaking view of the beach or lagoon - All rooms you can see the sea or the lagoon, there are no exceptions!. The structure is great, the staff are in large numbers and are very kind. 
This is one hotel you do not want to leave because you feel was not taken all that it offers !!

reviews.author: Canoe1943
reviews.title: A Wonderful Short Vacation
reviews.text:
We only had four days of rest, relaxation, and cuisine, but all in all it was most enjoyable.
The hotel is immaculately clean and well maintained. The meals were excellent. Your choice of several restaurants, buffets, bbqs, and poolside bars. The staff is very courteous and helpful. Most speak much better English than speak Spanish.
The beaches, as in most of Cancun, are beautiful.

reviews.author: Juliet0304
reviews.title: Pre-Christmas getaway
reviews.text:
We have been going to this hotel for 15 years.  This originally was the Gran Melia Cancun.   Since it became an all inclusive things have gradually changed.  The most disappointing thing about the Paradisus Cancun to us is that they have forgotten Christmas.  No Christmas decorations at all.  They did have poinsettias out, but even they were removed the week before Christmas.  We heard this was at the request of a large group (that rented 650 rooms) that was coming in.  The employees don't even understand it. Please bring back Christmas! 

Every other hotel in Cancun and off site restaurants all had Christmas decorations up.  Its too bad, because the hotel is gorgeous.   Since we were basically spending our Christmas in Cancun we missed the happiness of Christmas.   We would have no objection to other religions being celebrated too, but Christmas without decorations is just another beach vacation. 

The best thing about the Paradisus was the staff.   We love Manuelito and Jose in the Vacation Club who attended to our every need. We also had wonderful service each day in Naos Restaurant from Kaoil.  Kaoil looked forward to serving us each day and gave us superior service.

reviews.author: BlackIrish11
reviews.title: Royal vacation!
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from a 3 night trip here. We chose the upgraded Royal package. We had a Royal vacation! Phenomenal time! Too many great things to list. Would only recommend this resort though, if you upgrade to Royal package. There are so many incentives....you just get spoiled. Would also caution families that other than the beach, this is not a young kid friendly place. Lots of steps, deep pools. We left kids at home. Special commendation to our royal butler, Sergio. 

Only two criticisms:  there was no visible security on the beach. The beach peddlers were non stop. And they had no qualms with bothering us sleeping or not. Some shady characters among them peddling some illegal stuff to vacationers looking for contraband. I'm not talking cigars...

Other criticism was the smokers. Luckily, we had a breeze every day, but the breeze just spread the smoke. The smokers had no regard for anyone else. Its a shame, because so many of us were not smokers! Should be smoke free resort - indoors/outdoors! 

Still, a tremendous vacation. Will be back!

reviews.author: Laura L
reviews.title: New Years in Cancun
reviews.text: Resort was beautiful and people were extremely friendly. Service in the restaurants was a little slow but servers were very pleasant. We stayed in the luxury resort suites which is only way to go in my opinion. We had the most amazing butler, Rodrigo. He was absolutely incredible and would be our main reason to come back to this particular resort in all honesty. He was helpful, funny, and very pleasant. Made us feel like we were the only people he was taking care of even though I knew he was quite busy. I think my husband hated leaving him, lol.  What a great asset to this resort he was.

reviews.author: christina w
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: We decided to escape from the cold weather and booked our party of 8 into Paradisus Hotel through our Club Melia.  This was a fantastic holiday for the whole group ages varying from 7- 55 we had a ball.  It was all inclusive and it meant literally that everything was included even the mini bar in the room. The staff were outstanding!!!! Especially Hector from the poolside bar.  the only reason I didn't give it a 5 was because the area in which the children's entertainment at night was held was restricted viewing unless you were on the first few seated areas we did have small children with us that did want to be involved but couldn't always see whats going on  ..... other than that we will be booking again next winter xx

reviews.author: Megan H
reviews.title: Great staff, poorly managed
reviews.text:
I have mixed feelings about my time here. To start, the check in process was long and difficult. They did not have a room available that met our reservation so we were put in a room with one bed and an "ocean view" the view was a sliver of the ocean and the top of one of the nearby buildings. No apologies were made and no offers for an upgrade due to the lack of rooms. The next day we returned to the office to check on available rooms with double beds. Only after we asked how they would make it right by us did they offer any upgrade. This included giving us gold wristbands that gave us access to royal service areas. The staff was unapologetic that we had spent nearly half of our first day of vacation standing in line trying to fix their mistake. 

The food here was amazing. The daily buffet has great options, the food is kept fresh throughout the day. In the buffet there were several meals where we had no service, which meant we could not order drinks or water. This seemed due to poor staffing levels as I watched one waiter and one busser care for large sections of the seating. We ate at Bento and Fuego for dinners.
