Bento was outstanding, even for those that do not enjoy sushi. The bartenders and wait staff were all excellent, friendly and made for a great dining experience. I want to especially mention Martin Sanchez in Naos restaurant, he was an amazing waiter who made our last meal at the resort a special experience. The Bellman Raul was also phenomenal in the service he gave. 

In our final room the view was perfect, everything you want on a vacation by the ocean. The minibar was disappointing. Two beers, several sodas and a bag of chips. No water was provided until we called room service. Housekeeping skipped our room the first day due to the do not disturb sign falling to the ground when we left the room. That was understandable, but not ideal. The next day we went on an excursion (Loma Bonita- very fun day). After leaving the room at 7:30am and returning at 2:30pm housekeeping still had not been to the room. We left the room again and returned at 4pm, the room had been cleaned and towels replaced but the shampoos had not been replenished. 

Each night we stopped by avenue bar to watch the show. Each night was unique, the dancers and singers were very talented and we had a great time. It is worth fitting them into your night. 

Overall, if your main priority is great food this property is a good option. The service staff in all areas are outstanding, they are just clearly mismanaged. The priority of this property does not seem to be in creating a seamless vacation experience for customers. I felt like a customer not a guest. If you are looking for an all inclusive service with an emphasis on hospitality I would suggest looking elsewhere.

reviews.author: Guestfromthecold
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 4 days in Jan. 2016.  Overall, our stay was great.  As I read the other reviews that are negative, I wonder if they were staying the same hotel.  The staff was always working improving and cleaning the facility.  Our room was clean and roomy with a great view of the ocean. The staff was helpful and always did whatever they could to accommodate any request that we had. One staff member that stood out.to us was a lady that worked serving drinks on the beach.  I can't recall her name, I think it started with an A, when we were there she worked the area right below Enso.  She was pleasant and unobtrusive always delivering drinks quickly. I was at the beach for several hours each day and observed that when she wasn't busy she wasn't standing around, instead she was picking up trash along the beach and making her area nice.  If I was an employer I would want 100 of her she is amazing she just quietly goes about doing her job.
The food had great variety and was tasty.  We played golf at the course, it was a lot of fun, the clubs they have there to rent are nothing fancy, but that was not an issue for us as it made it more fun.  There were no green fees;  but bring your own golf balls they do charge $4 apiece for used balls.

Overall, it would be difficulty to come up with any complaints about this resort. Great atmosphere and very clean and relaxing. I think the only negative thing we experienced was navigating the facility for the first day or two was not easy.  There is not a lot of signage and the sometimes confusing.  For example, finding the spa/gym was a trick at first. But we totally enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Andre D
reviews.title: Melia Club at the Paradisus Cancun Rocks!
reviews.text:
My wife and I, at the last minute, decided to go to Cancun to celebrate our anniversary. Through BookVIP, I was offered 4 nights all-inclusive at the Paradisus Cancun for an amazing price. The catch was that my wife and I had to watch a 45-minute presentation at the hotel on the benefits of becoming a Melia Vacation Club member. I agreed to attend the presentation so I could get the great deal. So, here's what I experienced...
1. The hotel accommodations were outstanding. Loved, loved loved the Paradisus, the food, the entertainment, the staff, the beach, the friendliness, the accommodations, everything! The Paradisus served the best food we ever experienced at an all-inclusive.
2. The Melia Vacation Club presentation my wife and I had to attend to get this great deal was the most professional and informative presentation we ever experienced. We met with Marvin who first took us to breakfast and shared some details about Melia Vacation Club. Then  we went to a meeting room where the presentation continued. For the entire duration of this presentation, the focus was on meeting our needs and establishing if it would be a good fit for us. We finished the presentation with the manager, Deon Alberts, who was amazing, professional, respectful and who also graciously accepted that at this time it wasn't for us. The only reason why we said no is because we just bought a sailboat so the timing wasn't right. However, we were so impressed with the Melia brand and Deon Alberts, I fully expect to become a proud Melia Club Vacation member within the next 2 years from now. Thank you Deon for explaining the value of becoming a Melia member so well, understanding our needs and respecting our decision with professionalism and grace. You have earned our future business.

reviews.author: Nick M
reviews.title: Beautiful Ocean View
reviews.text:
Very nice resort, wonderful ocean view, loved seeing it from several of the restaurants, the pools, etc. 

Friendly staff, the service was just not as good as the Playa del Carmen location. We waited 20 minutes to be served at one of the restaurants during lunch time, we finally had to go elsewhere.

reviews.author: mjharrison555
reviews.title: Paradisus BEST all inclusive I've ever stayed at!
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning building, amazing service and has the best kept beech in all of cancun. There's no comparing the other hotels to sheer beauty and grandness of Paradisius. More than satisfied with the service

reviews.author: Heidi S
reviews.title: Excellent Resort, but wish the variety of food changed more often
reviews.text: We loved staying at this resort.  Very beautiful and friendly staff.  The only thing we would want changed is that the only restaurant which doesn't require reservations would have a different variety of food daily.  Instead, it's almost the exact same every day.  The food was good, just got tired of the same thing as we most days didn't make reservations elsewhere.

reviews.author: Rspryor
reviews.title: Paradisus - Nice All-Inclusive - Royal Service Tower is a MUST!
reviews.text:
(NOTE: We actually Stayed in May, 2014. Options for posting wouldn't allow me to go back that far.) Large, sprawling resort. Tons of restaurant choices, all were quite good. Nice bar/lounge areas. We were 2 couples traveling together, so we booked in the Royal Service, all adult, tower. I encourage anyone traveling without children to choose this option. There was always a variety of snacks available in the common area, as well as a full, self-service bar. Also, the pool adjacent to this tower is separated from the all age pool area, so it tends to be more relaxing. Take care of the guys working out the the pool hut area, and they will make sure that is there are bali beds available, you will get one. We had 2 bali beds, side by side, for most of our stay, and we loved our view of the pool and the beach. We even rented hookahs a couple of days, and they brought them to our bali beds. Pretty cool! 

Overall, a great stay for the $. Not a 5 star, but worth what you are paying, based on other resorts in the area.

reviews.author: Mark D
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort - Not so friendly Staff
reviews.text: My Wife and I decided on this place because it looked unique. It certainly was once we walked through the doors. Draped with Greenery, it looks like you're stepping into a tropical rain forest of sorts. The live entertainment is fun and the dining is elegant. The Beach is obviously beautiful, but only average compared to the surrounding areas. They also close the beach at night fall which was extremely annoying. Our room was clean and very updated with a balcony viewing the Beach. My only complaint was Guest Services. We dealt with very sassy attendants and they were extremely nosy. They asked why we were getting back to the Hotel so late after a night out in Downtown Cancun. They also stopped me and tried to charge me extra for bringing a guest back to our room. I felt like I was being interrogated. I guess the good thing about that was we felt overly secure there. I wouldn't recommend purchasing trips from them either. You can find way better deals traveling to Chichen, Tulum and Xplor if you stroll downtown and find someone selling day trips. If you do stay here, make sure you are all inclusive, because it is expensive if your not. I also wouldn't recommend this place if you're planning on traveling and exploring the area a lot. We went to Playa del Carmen, Tulum, Cozumel, Chichen Itza and Xplor which rendered our elegant hotel room pointless in the end. If you go for a resort experience, this place is as good as any. Just beware of the Customer Secret Service Agents.

reviews.author: katiesim99
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I can't honestly say we would come back. I read many reviews on trip advisor before selecting our hotel accommodations. With rave reviews from friends about the food and service coupled with the positive words of trip advisor recommendations we booked at the Paradisus Cancun. 

Things happen that are beyond the control of the person behind the desk giving you the news. But how they handle it is important. To start things off we waited in a long and slow checkout line. Unlike other resorts no drink is offered upon arrival. We had requested two doubles beds and were given a king. Our "ocean" view was a small sliver of the ocean and the roof top of some facilities. The next day we were told to let them know before 11am if we wanted to switch rooms. We did. They said come back in one hour. We returned, waited in the Long check out line again and were told in another 30 minutes our room would be ready. Watching the clock tick on our sunny day as we sat in the hotel lobby we finally were given our room. We questioned what they were doing to make amends of the situation and they upgraded us to royal service. This meant we could enjoy some of the bars and dinners exclusive to Royal service. The view in our new room is gorgeous. 

Then we went to our first breakfast. Everyone had raved about the staff. We didn't have a single server address our table. (Which means you can't request bottle water). 

Off to enjoy the day. Lasted that night we went to make reservations for dinner and were put on hold for ten minutes. The only way to make reservations is over the phone. One nice thing is you can only book dinners two days in advance. This prevents people there for a week from filling all the spots. 

Lastly, I went to grab my glasses from the room and they wouldn't work. We went down to the lobby and explained it's a battery issue in the door and could someone call maintenance, the concierge said the only person who could do that was the main check in desk. Really? You mean to tell me I need to wait in the line where the average check in takes 15 minutes all to ask you to call maintenance because nobody else can.  I'm not faulting them for the door not working---but how you handle the issue is important. They sent a service person and 30 minutes later they arrived. I just wanted to meet my friends for breakfast....not wait for service. 

All in all, the service staff tends to be good. Bartenders try to take care of you. Although, the bars all close staggered from 10-12 until all that's left is the club. If drinking past 12 and not being in the club is what you are looking for your options are limited. Dinners are good and food is tasty. Even the Mexican that does not require a reservation was excellent. 

I can't recommend this hotel. Not because there were issues (that's life and travel) but because of how they didn't handle the issues. Of the three other hotels I've stayed at in Mexico, and one other in Cancun. I'd go back to the Iberostar in a heart beat. I actually looked at canceling day two and leaving. To spend all this time and money and feel like you can't get your issues resolved. I'd give up the good food for being able to enjoy my vacation from somewhere other than the hotel lobby standing in line.

reviews.author: HunnyBunny2014
reviews.title: Not what I expected
reviews.text:
Will go back to Cancun but will stay elsewhere.
Hotel dated, needs maintenance. Had a really really crap check-in experience which is too long to write about, Virgin refunded me 10% to apologize.
Staff ok in general. Most came across rude and obviously wanting tips!
I take my hat off to Samuel on the beach, he was friendly and assertive.
We opted for the extra cost of the beds on the beach everyday which we were made aware that it was rare for people to do. We went all inclusive but still spent a lot on extras and would expect to be treated nicely (not special treatment)
We didn't like any of the restaurants there - wasn't anything like I was expecting. So we went out and ate elsewhere most nights which was extra cost - not really what you expect for an all inclusive holiday.
Also the GM had friends staying so all the staff had to rally around them and make sure they were fed, watered, got their favourite bed first etc etc VERY POOR
Also lots of group large bookings which were disruptive. Wi-fi is not good.
Room was ok - my friend paid extra for a junior suite - and there was NO difference between my standard room and hers! housekeeping didn't top up fridge or cleaning products daily. One day my friend didn't even have towels!
Will be returning to Cancun but staying elsewhere.
I'm not a moaner, we did not let this ruin our holiday, still had a great time.

reviews.author: jessie_shields
reviews.title: Fantastic getaway!
reviews.text: This is an absolutely fantastic resort. There are SO many delicious options for dinner, the pools are lovely, and the beach is great. The rooms are extremely spacious, and every single one has a balcony. The gym and spa are fantastic - lots of new equipment. It is well worth the cost. Everything is so clean, and the hotel staff is extremely accommodating and gracious. This past trip was my third time and the resort just keeps getting better and better.

reviews.author: Carol K
reviews.title: Family Christmas Trip
reviews.text:
Trip with our kids and friends the day after Christmas. We had decided at the last minute to upgrade to the family concierge level.  I am not really sure it was worth it. Our butler, Ramon, although very nice and helpful when we asked, we expected and wanted more. We asked for chairs to be brought down to the beach,to put next to the beds we rented for 3 days, that took more than 2 hours,We actually carried them down ourselves the other 2 days, we ordered room service for breakfast and it never came, when our rooms were cleaned daily we daily had to call for towels which were forgotten or the mini bar was not restocked. The restaurants were great, food delicious,( except for Venzo- newly opened and they have yet to work out the kinks) the staff at the Bana especially Gaudacio was excellent, he always greeted us and he was warm, friendly and kind. Sammy our waiter on the beach worked his tail off and always had a smile on his face. 
The beach was beautiful,clean and heavy surf, so much fun.
Our rooms were clean,a little dated, we would have liked to sit out on our balcony which overlooked the lagoon but there was no furniture .
The weather was awesome, 85 degrees, sunny with some clouds, and always a breeze.
Wifi very spotty.
The staff at the pool bar and Coco's were great.
The biggest problem was at check out. We were told by our travel agent who spoke with the staff at the hotel that out upgrade cost would be 100.00$ per room per day and with coupons for our more than 4 night stay the overall cost would be 340.00$ We were charged twice that and they "forgot" to give us a big book of coupons with money off renting the beds, wine, activities, spa use etc. Our check out turned into a disaster and we were late getting to our prearranged travel to the airport which included another family who almost missed their flight as a result. We so enjoyed our time away with friends and family but the ending certainly changed our feelings about the vacation. When you pay the money to upgrade we should not have to beg for beach chairs, towels and services .

reviews.author: dionnew2016
reviews.title: Would definetyly recommend and go again.
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel.  Very large.  Royal Service was the way to go!  Everyone very friendly and always wanting to help.  Pool was a different kind of shape so you didn't feel as if anyone was watching you.  Pool area was full of Bali Beds and lounges and service was never ending.   Ocean View from room on 5th floor  was amazing, private large balcony and wonderful breeze.

reviews.author: christy f
reviews.title: Awesome place!
reviews.text:
Easy access to/from Cancun Intern Airport.  Very friendly staff.  entertainment by the pool everyday was fun.  Rodrigo and his crew were very inviting. loved all the games.
something different everyday!  they remember your name!  Restaurants were excellent.

reviews.author: Alex F
reviews.title: Friendly People & Fun Environment
reviews.text: Just returned back from a fantastic experience at Paradisus in Cancun. The staff there were phenomenal throughout the entire stay. The guys down in the Naos restaurant, specifically, Marco, were on the ball and provided outstanding service. There was plenty to do during the day especially down by the activity pool. Rodrigo and his gang go the extra mile to create a fun atmosphere. Wouldn't stay anywhere else.

reviews.author: Mariya0000
reviews.title: Excellent service and very well maintained facility
reviews.text:
This was the second time we stayed at Paradisus. The first time we came there as a couple with my husband and stayed in the adult only area. It was absolutely perfect! Next time we came back with our 1-year old daughter and stayed in the Family Concierge part of the hotel. Alvaro was our butler and quickly became our friend. Our daughter got sick one of the days and he took such a great care of us, bringing her presents to cheer her up and giving us recommendations on the best (at reasonable price) medical facilities nearby. It's been a few weeks since we came back and she still refers to him when she sees the doll he brought her.
By far, our favorite restaurant was Fuego. The quality of the food and service was like going to a fancy restaurant in the US, where we would've paid a few hundred dollars for the same dinner. All other restaurants were delicious as well. They also just opened up an Indian restaurant and that was way beyond our expectations as well in both, the food and service.
Martin (Sanever?) and Jaime were serving our family in the morning and lunch sometimes and always made sure that our family was comfortable with our (at time misbehaving) little daughter. If we ever needed anything, they were always extremely helpful and polite and got us what we needed.
Hands down, this hotel has the best service we've ever received anywhere! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: peterbV3322HZ
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Everything was incredible. From the beautiful of the beach to the wonderful architecture of the hotel. I truly had a marvelous time. The staff did exceptionally well to attend to my every need and the food was quite exquisite. I will absolutely recommend this to all my friends and family for a future vacation spot.

reviews.author: Vicky A
reviews.title: OUR 2016 NEW YEAR’S STAY AT PARADISUS (CLUB MELIA): A FIVE STAR ALL-INCLUSIVE RESORT IN CANCUN, MEXICO
reviews.text:
This was a Heavenly New Year’s vacation for my husband and myself. It was his birthday on January 1st, and we stayed at Paradisus Cancun Resort from January 1st to January 5th, 2016. Our room was exactly as described…a beautiful ‘Lagoon View’ Junior Suite with its own Balcony and Jacuzzi, as well as free minibar (that was stocked daily) and free WIFI. 

The all-inclusive resort itself was so breathtaking with fantastic service…we were pampered all the way. We had unlimited exotic food and drinks every day of our 5 day vacation, starting with seafood such as lobsters, salmon; crabs etc. on our very first day (which was New Year’s Day) at the buffet restaurant called Naos. Paradisus Cancun also has amazing restaurants, such as ‘The Market Grill’ where you have unlimited types of meat and poultry brought to you (with various salads & vegetables) at regular intervals until you’re completely filled – pretty much like ‘Fogo De Chao’ in the U.S. 

We had a particular server by the name ‘Martin Sanchez‘, at the Naos buffet restaurant during our last two days at the resort. This gentleman took very good care of my husband and myself (as he simultaneously did the same for guests he served around us). He made us ‘feel at home’ so much so that he left such an indelible mark on us. We’re actually looking forward to going back to Paradisus Cancun in future, and being served by this guy. He was absolutely phenomenal! Not only is he a pleasant, good- spirited guy who obviously loves people, and enjoys his job – but he also went ‘over and above’ in his delivery of outstanding service to us and other guests. The world will certainly be a better place if everyone was like ‘Martin Sanchez’! I sincerely hope Paradisus keeps this guy and even promote him, as he definitely represents them well and deserves to be in a higher position where he can shine more for the organization.

The beach too was fantastic – very clean environment with clear turquoise blue water! Besides that, it was very peaceful; unlike some beaches in some parts of the Caribbean where hawkers consistently bug you at the beachside to buy hats, jewelry or whatever product they’re selling. The other amazing thing that struck me about this all-inclusive resort was that in spite of the large size and human traffic, the entire property (especially the various guest restrooms at different locations) was kept impeccably clean with nice fragrance at all times. 

My husband and I had such an awesome experience, and thoroughly enjoyed every minute of our vacation at this Cancun resort. We would definitely stay at Paradisus (Club Melia) again, and again. Thanks a million Paradisus group! We can’t say enough about your extravagant resort with immaculate décor all around - even in the guest rooms. The exotic, serene, sophisticated, botanical garden ambience in all your atriums was very warm and welcoming too!!!

reviews.author: Germain M
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text:
We were there in December 2015. We were in the royal service, if you can pay this I definitely would recommend it to you. We stayed 5 nights. The room was nice and they restocked everything just every day. We enjoyed the beach and the pool everyday. The service of the waiters was tremendous. The best waiter was Cesar and Jorge, they should be employee of the year.
The hotel has a very good location near shopping malls and night life just some minutes away. If you are in Cancun you should do some tours and visit the bars and discos. 
What we liked the most of Paradisus was the service!

reviews.author: tntdns
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: Right in the center of everything.  Nice Beach and beautiful warm pool.  Friendly staff and great view.   The staff took excellent care of my family.  I have one special needs child and everyone made sure he was well taken care of everyday.

reviews.author: douglaspauln
reviews.title: Fun getaway with tons of perks
reviews.text: We picked the Paradisus because of the different options of dining for a whole week. There are so many activities that are available in this area.  We went sport fishing twice, parasailing, snorkeling, kayaking and spent a lot time in the ocean, on the beach and being treated with professionalism and respect.  The employees should all be commended for their over the top assistance!!!

reviews.author: haemi07
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text:
6 adults and three children under age of 4 came here to celebrate our FILs 60th bday...as hosts of this trip I was so excited to introduce Paradisus to my in law family only to find thatbour request for King beds (so the kids can sleep with us) were not met. We all got twin size beds. Activity paper were no where to be found and we learned that someone was to give us a tour to tell us some of the guidelines but nobody offered us that so we missed the time to make the dinner reservation at one of the restaurants. So there goes there first impression. 

Food is ok thus far but I've had better resort food elsewhere however the people all working here are very friendly. So I would assume this is more of management's wrong. First trip with my 9mos baby so wished the kiddie pool was warmer (too cold that my baby cried) and I was also shivering in coldness pf the water...

reviews.author: anorouzi
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Dec 2015
reviews.text: We have stayed in this hotel in 2012 and this recent experience was a reconfirmation of our earlier decision to chose this hotel and in particular Royal Service. Nice setting with excellent service and staff. Well recommended for all traveler who would like to stay in a hotel in Cancun with excellent service and profecional staff.

reviews.author: Rohan kuller
reviews.title: Its Great.
reviews.text:
Me and my parents went on a ten night stay at this hotel. We arrived on the 26th December and departed on the 5th of January. 

This hotel was an amazing from the moment we arrived. The overall buildings are amazing looking and are very grand. As soon as we got in we quickly checked in and decided an upgrade. It was a great price and now we had a suite. I slept in the living room and my parents slept in the main bedroom. We quickly got changed and went straight to the dinner buffet. It was a great selection of food and drinks and it was all to the highest quality.

After a great sleep we went to Breakfast which also had a great selection. We went to the pool and the beach. The main pool always had entertainment so u could never get bored. The beach was stunning and the waves were rough (which I like). 

Amazing everything. I loved it. Its for anyone.

reviews.author: John B
reviews.title: JUst got back from this great resort !
reviews.text: We were greeted promptly upon our arrival and brought to guest services. Our rooms were not what we expected but this was quickly corrected. Our Butler Rodi was great and checked on us constantly. He took care of our dinner reservations every day. We were disappointed with our restaurant the last night and walked out. When we told Sandra of our experience she took action and got us another reservation promptly Great job Sandra !! I would highly recommend this resort. Great food and service !!

reviews.author: senoralberto
reviews.title: Second time is a charm
reviews.text:
This is our second visit to this great property.  2 adults, 2 kids (8 and 5).  Xmas-New Years.

The hotel.  Beautiful atriums that are well-kept.   

The Beach:  Right in front (or back) of the hotel.  Wide beach, well kept, beautiful ocean.

The pool.  Great options for kids, young adults and adults only.  

The food.  Many interesting restaurants with very good food.  Also a well stocked buffet nightly and for breakfast.  We did lunch at the Sunset Grille at the pool.  

The entertainment.  Great nightly shows.  Violin player at Enso was amazing (outside asian restaurant).  

The room.  We had adjoining rooms.  Both were very nice with great private balconies.  We stayed in Building 1 where you could hear a pin drop.  

The staff.  I saved the best for last.  Incredibly nice and helpful staff.  This is what keeps us coming back.  This includes housekeeping, waiters, "butlers", pool staff.  A special shout out to Maria De Los 
Reyes Nieto E., Family Concierge Manager, for making our return trip so special and memorable.

reviews.author: jem799
reviews.title: First impressions are key
reviews.text: Extremely clean and beautiful establishment.  Would highly recommend this resort to friends and family. Staff was very kind and knowledgable. Food and bar was phenomenal. I Look forward to a future visit!

reviews.author: Elena J
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our time spent at Paradisus Cancun. We stayed here for 7 nights and had the Royal Service as it was our honeymoon. We had our own butler (Fernando) who was amazing and so very helpful. He did all our restaurant bookings for dinner (as you need to make a reservation for the nicer ones because they book out quickly) and he also restocked our minibar fridge every day. We were given a mobile phone at check in (which was amazing once again btw. I have never actually been served alcohol while completing check in paperwork and relaxing in lounge chairs :] ). Fernando was always checking in on us and ensured we had everything we needed. He booked beach chairs and bali beds for the Royal pool (it is seperate to the normal one). He organised roses and champagne on arrival and on our last night of our honeymoon. Staff were all nice and helpful! Eddie and Rodrigez at the Royal Pool were so helpful, constantly bringing us drinks, food or anything we'd ask. Best restaurant would have to be Bana! We were there on our last night and they truly made our experience the best we have ever had. We stayed there for almost 3 hours! Erik our waiter was honestly the best. He chose all the food for us, constantly surprising us with great food/drinks. He finished it off with a surprise cake that had a "happy honeymoon" message. So very sweet! 

The only downfall for us was that the night life of Paradisus isn't the best. As we are still in our 20's, we enjoy to go out to nightclubs and dance till the morning hours of the day, unfortunately this hotel only has one bar and since the crowd is a little bit older, it's usually empty. That was the only negative for us but if you are looking for relaxation and a quiet holiday, it is the place to be. Oh and Coco Beach Bar was also really good. You have to pay about $160 US (on top of your all included service) to get a bali bed but they bring you unlimited alcohol and a massive seafood platter with lobster and we thought it was worth it. They have a great dj that plays chilled out music all day while you tan and drink cocktails (definitely recommend this).

reviews.author: Vijit W
reviews.title: Huge Place
reviews.text:
Huge resort. Nicely kept. Beach wasn't that good. Lots of sea weed and the water goes deep within a few feet from the beach. Pools were good. There were guests bringing food into the pool and some were eating it standing in the water and washing off the grease on their fingers in the water. There were security people around but they either did not care or was scared to point that out. 
It looked like the management was a bit confused sometimes. There are two pools and all of a sudden, they would close off one pool to the regular guests so that their exclusive club members could use it. There were only two couples in that section the whole day and lot of kids and parents were very disappointed as the other pool was deep and kids could not use it.
Good entertainment in the evenings but after 9.00 pm, the place is dead. There is a disco place which is a joke. Some guests go out to the night clubs etc in the City but there is nothing for people who want to remain in the hotel. Shopping is close. You can take the public transport. 
Most of the staff were friendly. Food was good and a lot of variety. Did not like the Japanese restaurant much.

reviews.author: Deb A
reviews.title: Great Resort overall, but a few hiccups
reviews.text:
When we first arrived and walked into the lobby, I was very relieved and happy how nice it was!  Overall, we loved ur stay and would go back, but just a few things you should know and the issues we had.

At check in, they did not give us an activity schedule, so I missed yoga and other actitivites until I finally figured it out from the spa employee who handed me the schedule. 

They should also tell you that if your cell phone is near your room card key, it will no longer work.  I made many trips to the front desk to get more keys until after 5 days someone at the front desk told me why it was happening.

The tall, bald guy at the concierge desk is very rude, unhelpful and basically just stands there.  

The shows in the lounge are GREAT and the whole family would attend every night, but one night after the show they had a band and the music was blasting and they did not shut it down until after 11pm, but it was impossible to sleep through it.  The next night it was New Years eve and the music blasted until 2am.  I complained on both nights, but they could not do anything about it.

Getting a beachside cabana was a HUGE challenge until I decided to just set the alarm every day for 6:30 am to guarantee a good spot.  

Getting a dinner resey can also be very CHALLENGING!  The buffet was very good, not fine dining, but soooooo much to choose from and the waitstaff was GREAT!  

Aside from that, we really did LOVE our stay and the resort overall had plenty to for all of us (2 adults and 12 and 10 yr old who were able to roam freely without worry).  can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Tigranuhi M
reviews.title: great water
reviews.text:
big sandy beach.  Ocean water was PERFECT temperature.  Couldn't get enough of swimming in the ocean.
BEST SHOWER I have ever had in a hotel room. 
Food was very good as well. 
Service workers were for the most part very friendly and very helpful.

reviews.author: Clare F
reviews.title: Excellent location,Beautiful beach but most of all, FANTASTIC Customer service.
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus for 10 nights in December.
We didn't opt for the Royal Package and let me tell you that this didn't hinder our stay at all. 
The hotel itself is set out much like a Botanical Garden, which is very pleasant. 
In the evening candles light the walkways and incense burns and gives off a lovely aroma. 
We were booked into a Junior Lagoon Suite on the first floor. It had kitchen facilities & a bedroom that could be separated from the kitchen and dining area by double doors. It was very nice, but when booking in our reception host asked us if we would like to change rooms - to a higher floor, which we accepted.
The room was on the 5th floor of Block 3. The room didn't have the kitchen facilities or dining table and chairs but it was allot better for us in the fact it had more privacy for the outdoor hot tub. I wouldn't have felt comfortable sitting in the hot tub on the first floor where people can see you.
A point to note, our safe & hot tub were not working when we arrived into our 2nd room, with one visit to reception we had 3 people working on them within 5 minutes of notifying the hotel. They were fixed immediately and reception rang me to confirm this. Talk about efficient.
On the 2nd evening we were brought a bottle of Champagne to the room as a courtesy of the hotel (as we were honeymooners), what a nice touch.
The restaurants are all very nice. To be honest we spent most of our time at the Buffett as the selection of food was excellent. Meat,Fish, Fresh vegetables and salad were in abundance along with the most beautiful desserts I've ever seen at an all inclusive hotel. I don't eat dessert but I was tempted on 3 occasions and they were stunning.
The Buffett had theme nights were upon arrival they would have a Champagne Bar set up for drinks on arrival or a Tequila table. I was very impressed at the level of service in the Buffett.
I would like to mention by name, Guerillmo,Martin,Cesar and Pablo. There were a few others to which I have not noted their names. As it was our honeymoon, Cesar brought us a special dessert and Pablo brought the Champagne. The service of the staff members were second to none and I honestly believe that the standard was exceptional. I have worked in the food and be erase industry in the UK for many years, and they could really teach our staff a number of things.
We ate in Vento which is a Tapas bar, definitely worth trying, our server was Juan & Antonio and again they went out of the way to help us pick our food and to help us enjoy our evening.
We tried the Bana Restaurant which is Asian Fusion. It was a beautiful setting, pleasant food, presented so well. Our server was Jose and he was outstanding, he was so busy yet took the time to help us again with the wine and food selection.
CocoBar at the beach served soft drinks and alcohol throughout our stay and we were pleased with the service from Carlos, Gerardo & Alleandro.
The restaurant that is is situated at the pool overlooking the beach was closed when we were there. It had a beautify, setting and it would have been love,y to be able to try it, but again this didn't hinder our trip as there was plenty of places to eat.
The beach beds were busy for the first two days of our trip but after that, it seemed easy enough to get one.
The beach was clean and the staff come round offering refreshments constantly so you don't have to get up. 
There is a little beach hut beside the pool offering Burgers, Hot Dogs, Wraps, Nachos,Crisps and Fries if you don't want to go indoors. We tried this a few times and it was very good.
At night time, the maids offer a turndown service, they clean the room, offer fresh towels and tidy again. I especially liked this service because on our last evening, they even left small desserts at our bedside, instead of a mint, again it was a lovely touch and made us feel very special.
The Paradisus have a fab timetable of activities throughout the day and at night, gym activities in the morning, pool activities Mid morning, Life enhancing activites mid afternoon such as Sushi Making or Cocktail Making, please excuse my ignorance when it comes to the timetable for children, as I noticed it was extensive but as we don't have any children I ignored this. Finally in the evening, 'It is Showtime'. 7:30pm kicks of with a Kiddies disco, this was fund to watch and then 8pm a different show every evening.
Michael Jackson Show,Broadway Show, Mecican Night and Popstars to name but a few. 
The callibre of the dancers was excellent and the show was very entertaining. My favourite was the PopStars Night, as it was done in the style of X Factor, 3 judges were picked to adjudicate and the crowd was involved in judging also, using applause.
One thing I would mention is where the show takes place, it is very hard to see from particular areas, which meant that you were always trying to rush to get a good seat and then people would come in and stand in front of you, the staff were fab on occasion asking people to move around  so everyone could see, but it was nearly an impossibility. I would suggest taking a look at this, as people did get very frustrated.
I tried the Spa Facilities - having my nails done whilst here by Veronica. She was excellent.
Just across the road is the Aqua Park, it offers Paddle Boats and Kayaking free of charge for Paradisus residents. it also offers Jet Skis, Speed Boats and a Twister Style Boat for adrenaline junkies.
We opted for a Jungle Tour. You go out for 2 hours. It was recommended that we could on the 9am tour as this is when we would see most of the fish.
We had a guide and we headed out in our own speedboat. There were 4 boats including the guide.
We drove for about 30 mins in the Lagoon (bear in mind, we had been told there were Crocodile in the Lagoon, therefore I was petrified) my mind was out at ease by our guide Mimet, as he said they stay in 2 areas of the Lagoon and as the Lagoon was huge, it put my mind at ease. We were brought to a place to snorkel. Wow within minutes, a huge stingray was coming straight for me. I seen 2. The coral was amazing and we were swimming through shoals of fish. Wow, if you do anything, do the jungle tour.
We got to drive back, a little faster this time as we were more confident in the speedboat and let's just say our guide was brilliant and it was allot of fun.
We had beautiful weather for a full 8-10 days. Crazy as it was because the weather for the 3 months prior to our arrival had been stormy. It ranged between 25-30 degrees.
The last 2 days were stormy but still warm. It was a nice welcome change and you could still take a walk in your shorts as there was heat in the air.
If you didn't want to go out, the in house entertainment was great. at the avenue bar, there was giant beds to lie on and comfy chairs, and with wi-if everywhere you could catch up on the news back home or just chill out with a book.
We were offered Salsa Dance lessons, but as we lack in the rhythm department, we politely declined. We did enjoy watching the others doing it though. We took part in the Casino Games and it was nice and it helped us meet some other tourists at the hotel.
What can I say, would I stay at the Paradisus again, YES. Are the staff the best I've ever encountered, Yes. Everyone and I mean everyone says hello.
Please ignore any bad reviews on TripAdvisor, go and make this this the trip of a lifetime. We travelled from Northern Ireland and I'm already trying to work out when we can go back.

reviews.author: deborahsD7739KB
reviews.title: Beautiful property - wonderful staff - excellent location
reviews.text: We paid for the Royal Service, which was an excellent decision. This service entitles you to an exclusive section of the property with a section of the beach and pool only for royal service guests. There is a wonderful area to have breakfast, tea time, and cocktails daily. It was private and only for the Royal Service guests. There are no children allowed and many amenities offered such as a butler. This service was great because we had a special butler named Fernando Gonzales who was attentive and checked with us frequently to ensure our stay was memorable. Fernando could be reached by cell phone as the hotel provides it. There is no charge for the cell just a deposit if you lose or damage it. Fernando was so helpful he even came to our room one night when I called him to send a doctor to our room when my husband wasn't feeling well.  He stayed until the doctor was done and even came by the next day to check on my husband to bring liquids to keep him hydrated. Fernando reserved all our reservations for dinner, made suggestions on tours, researched one when we could not confirm the departure location, called and printed the necessary documents for us. Fernando asked us what we liked and stocked the refrigerator with them.  Being a hard working professional, this was such a luxury! If you can, I highly recommend adding Royal Service to your vacation. The opportunity to have a butler, especially one like Fernando will make your vacation memorable!

reviews.author: Cara D
reviews.title: Amazing Holiday Getaway!!
reviews.text: Our family of eight just returned back in the U.S. last night after eight wonderful nights at the Paradisus!!  The check-in process was very easy.  We arrived at 11:00 a.m. and were able to check into our rooms early.  Our luggage was delivered quickly to our rooms and we were in our bathing suits and down on the beach before noon!!  All of the staff were very kind and courteous.  We have to give a special shout out to Miguel, our beach waiter.  He is the BEST and met our every need!!  He always kept our bucket full of beer, water and ice and brought us anything we asked for.  The Paradisus is lucky to have such an awesome and dedicated employee!!  All of the restaurants are AMAZING!!  The staff give excellent recommendations and encourage you to try new dishes.  All restaurant staff were wonderful!!  We really enjoyed trying all of the many different cuisines.  Bana was one of our favorite restaurants.  I do not like sushi...I love it now thanks to Darwin Miguel!!  He suggested  several items on the menu for us to try in a sampler.  The food was wonderful!!  We also enjoyed breakfast at the Bana and the wonderful staff which greeted us like old friends each morning.  Each restaurant has its own cuisine and every one is really good!!  We didn't get to try Mole as it is small and unable to accommodate our party of eight.  You do need to set your alarm for 7:00 a.m. and call to make reservations for the next evening then run down to the pool or beach to throw towels/ beach bags on your chairs to reserve them.  Do not wait until after breakfast or you will not have a lounge chair.  The resort is very large and guest must walk long distances.  That was alright for our family but, might be difficult for elderly persons.  The resort is undergoing renovations so it can be a little noisy at times.  The beach is breathtaking!!  It has a sand volleyball court and soccer area.  Lots of fun for several in our family.  We wish there was a way for the Resort to keep the annoying peddlers from walking up and down the beach trying to sell us cigars, hats, sunglasses, jewelry, excursions, etc.  They start at 8:00 a.m. and do not go away until dark.  It is very difficult to relax on the beach with this constant annoyance and interruption.  Also, we were surprised at the amount of trash which had washed up on the beach and no one form the resort picked it up for days.  We were very surprised that such a beautiful resort would allow trash to pile up on their beach.  The wi-if is very spotty and in need of an upgrade.  Beware of someone from Club Melia (time share) trying to trick you into thinking they are with the concierge.  They will tell you that they have a special map of the resort for you.  We managed to escape the trickery and didn't have to go on the tour.  Other than just the few above mentioned annoyances, we will definitely come back to the Paradisus!  We love this resort and it's amazing staff!!

reviews.author: stevenap2000
reviews.title: Nice place but some obvious problems
reviews.text:
It's a beautiful place and we enjoyed our stay, but a few problems that are a real drag on your vacation.
1.  People are grabbing towels at 8 o clock in the morning by the bushel and have laid claim to every available chair by the pool by 9am.  I am sure this is a problem at many of these kinds of resorts, but this was ridiculous.  If you weren't up at the crack of dawn forget about relaxing poolside.  What makes it worse here is that you can ask for as many towels as you want, and some people were asking for 6 or 8, and there is no attempt to even verify room number.  People leave wet towels all day on chair and there is no attempt made by management to monitor who is really using chairs.
2.  No one makes clear to you that of the 8 or 9 restaurants on site you need to make reservations for all of the nicer ones.  If you call the same day you will likely hear that there is zero availability.  Ridiculous.  Every place has the same breakfast.  The Blue Agave taco place is limited men but good.  Would have liked to have tried a few of the other places but never got into them.  The generic buffet lunch and dinner places have a nice selection of food.  Basically like a cruise ship spread.
3.  The help are all very nice.  I didn't like the fact that the towels are given out at the pool by representatives of Aqua World across the street and I couldn't walk past one of them without being harangued about what my plans were for the day.
4.  Aqua World, walking distance right across the street, is a real benefit.  We did a few activities there and all were fun and not unreasonably priced.
5.  We didn't do the family concierge thing, which may have made things easier.  Frankly I don't want someone trailing me around for four days.  But I sort of suspect that if you don't do it no one is going out of their way to explain to you how the place works.

reviews.author: Senthil S
reviews.title: Good hotel
reviews.text:
Overall experience was good. Now to the details. We have booked multiple rooms and requested ahead of time to have the rooms together. We arrived at the day before the check in time and stood in a line for about 30 minutes to get checked in. The check in place is rather small for such a big hotel and very crowded and chaotic. We were given rooms together that we were happy about. But they told us to come back to get the keys as the rooms are not ready, which is fair. We grabbed lunch at Naos and lunch was ok. There were many items but the taste at Naos wasn't that great. We went back to get the keys, but were asked to come through the regular check in line, which is absurd. Another 30 minutes and chaos to just get the key. 

The facility itself is good, a lot of places to sit and hang out, they have a coffee place that is open 10-6pm. The rooms were decent, we had ocean view rooms that required a couple of maintenance calls on one but nothing major. The balconies were the  highlight, they are really private and no one else can see your balcony. We stayed in 3355 & 3356. 

We had to reserve the beach chairs for the stay by going early (around 8am), the pool chairs were never available. The best part was the swim up bar. Very nice! A lot of bars drinks everywhere, variety of cocktails. The staff were friendly and went out of the way at times to meet our needs. The beach itself, the sea was rough during our stay, but there are a lot of sea weeds. It didn't bother us much. 

Restaurants. Overall, Naos had variety but not great tasting. Bana was our favorite, Fuego, Mole and vento came second, Blue agave was after that. The worst was a new restaurant called Enso (?), we couldn't even eat that food, it was that bad. Market Grill was decent even for lunch, for two days we ordered from Market grill, as Naos was bad.

Pyramid 3 was very noisy, the Red lounge had thumping music till 2 AM. But there were other activities through out the evening, if you want quiet, this is not the best pyramid for you. 

Overall it was a good stay. This was our first cancun trip so cannot compare with the quality else where.

reviews.author: Teresa S
reviews.title: Amazing Pre-Holiday Getaway
reviews.text: Myself and a friend had an amazing experience when we stayed at the Paradisus Cancun.  The hotel is absolutely gorgeous and only a short ride away from the airport.  The staff was very welcoming and friendly and went above and beyond to provide great service during our stay.  All-inclusive is definitely the way to go when you stay at the Paradisus because you're never without a drink in your hand or food in your belly.  I especially enjoyed our ocean view balcony that also had views of the beautiful swimming pool and the pool side activities.  I also want to say THANK YOU again to the amazing staff that worked at Naos restaurant for the breakfast and lunch times, especially Jaime!  He was an absolutely amazing server and always went above and beyond to make myself and my friend have an enjoyable eating experience.  The other staff members; Pablo, Eder, and Martin were also great and deserve thanks and praise as well.  Their combined teamwork made for a great dining experience.  I also want to praise room service because when you're hungry at 1AM they were definite savors and the menu selection was good too.  I also appreciated the fact that there was an Expedia rep onsite at the hotel that assisted with the booking of off-property activities.  The rep was very helpful and gave an honest opinion which was appreciated.  Overall, I recommend a stay at the Paradisus to anyone that's looking for a great hotel, with fabulous amenities, good food, top-shelf drinks, and an amazing cater-to-you staff.  When I go back to Cancun, I'm booking my stay at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: candynaumann
reviews.title: Paradise at PARADISUS
reviews.text:
Great!   We loved the Royal Services.   Rodrigo was a GREAT BUTLER!!!!
Also, Moses at the Royal Service Pool was GREAT!!!    Very responsible, very attentive and very personable.
Would love to have taken them home!
Thanks

reviews.author: Mike L
reviews.title: Brilliant Cancun Christmas
reviews.text:
After a challenging travel day (16hrs) to Cancun we arrived at the Paradisus on Christmas Eve.  Our family of six (four daughters) walked into the hotel exhausted and hungry and were immediately dazzled by the atrium!  Check in was quick and the front desk made sure we had rooms close to each other.   We went straight to the buffet (Naos)!  We were quickly seated overlooking the pool and ocean.  The long day was forgotten and we knew we had arrived!  ....not to forget a couple of delicious marguerite's and great service.  The next morning we headed down as a family for breakfast at Naos and that is were we met Martin Sanchez!  The highlight of our trip was seeing Martin  every morning for our family breakfast.  I can't say enough about this man as he is not only a excellent employee but a great person who made such a difference for our family.  We all miss his morning smile!!
The rest of the week was outstanding with great poolside service from Laura and Flora!  Rodrigo Velazquez and his team (especially Fernando) who headed up the activities poolside were brilliant in getting us involved in some of the events occurring during the days.  He made such a point of talking to us and making sure we were enjoying our stay!  Upon finding out it was my wife's birthday he went out of his way to make it special!!  My daughters loved spending time with Rodrigo and it was his efforts that made such a difference for our trip!  
We stayed in the main building (3) and were thrilled with the convenience.  Everything is right outside your door.  The resort is kept so clean and well staffed.  Restaurant's are all fun with many available options.  Go into the trip knowing that someone will need to get up early (7am) to reserve pool or beach chairs and make the next nights dinner reservation and everything else will go smoothly.  Overall this resort exceeded our expectations with recognition to all the staff who really made our trip special.

reviews.author: bwonderingg
reviews.title: 2nd time and a bit disappointing
reviews.text:
This was our second time at the resort and our first time to go at Christmas. 
A caveat - all Melia's have a timeshare/ownership section so you may be approached to buy into the resort. 

First the good:
 
-The hotel did an excellent job for the Christmas season with Santa arriving by helicopter, a Santa visit for the children. They made it snow! And Santa gave out excellent presents. We were really impressed. 

-The food is excellent. We actually liked going to the buffet instead of the restaurants. 

Not so good:
-Xmas is a busy time to go so the pool area filled up in the morning early and you could not find a lounge chair anywhere by 11 am. 

-People who come to these resorts should know that tipping is not included so please tip. The staff work so hard especially the restaurant staff. But there are some exceptional staff who go to know us- learned our names and provided better service than others. We tipped extra but always tipped. 20 pesos per person and at dinner if we were at a restaurant we tipped 50 pesos. The breakfast egg makers work the hardest! Long line ups for eggs and no one ever tips them. Sad. 

- Kids Zone - our 7 year old loved it for the most part but I often found him doing "nothing" while at least 5-6 staff sat around talking - the kids were just sitting. They had finished their craft activity in about 15 minutes so I guess that meant it was time to socialize among the staff. This was the second most disappointing part of our trip. My son accidentally ran into the girls one room washroom and when he came out was yelled at by the staff member. My son said he then hid and did not play for awhile. He felt bad but I was angry that staff did not need to yell at a child for using the wrong washroom! It was our last day and when I went to pick him up the staff were so nice and gave us a backpack and hat! I was a bit suspicious so asked my son how is day was etc etc and that was when I found out what happened. The staff seem bored and not really interested in the children. Unlike the first time we went when our son was 5 years old and staff at that time were amazing. Night and day this time. 

-Entertainment. This was the most disappointing part of our trip. There was twice a mini disco for the children but not run well at all compared to other Melia's we have stayed at. Again it was the same theme- it was not about the children but something they had to do before the main show. It was sad to see. They did not seem to have fun with the children and the children danced in the back while the staff danced at the front. Adult entertainment was boring with lip syncing and dancing to modern american music. One night was Mexican and that is always good to see. 

Overall we had an ok time. Not sure we would go back again unless they changed their entertainment. I am looking forward to going back to Melia PVR just for their fantastic professional entertainment both for adults and children.

reviews.author: Tom_Andy
reviews.title: Just amazing
reviews.text: We had a ocean view royal service room and were treated like royalty. Our personal butler Gerry took great care of us. He made sure restaurants were booked for the evenings were booked and checked on us daily to make sure that everything was to our satisfaction. Special mentioning also to the pool waiters Rafael, Alfredo and Moises. The pool concierges Omar and Daniel also made sure we had a comfortable Bali bed. The whole experience was amazing. Never have we felt more spoilt by a hotel and its staff. Check-in was smooth and painless. The glass of champagne made it a joyful experience. We will be back next year

reviews.author: Elio L
reviews.title: Mixed emotions- hot and cold
reviews.text:
I will say that despite my review, the staff and facilities were good. I spent 7 days as part of my Melia membership at this resort over Christmas week. The restaurant options were good and I specifically want to call out Jose (concierge), Jorge (Bali beds), and the Blue Agave staff (Grissel, Alejandro, and Emanuel). These guys took great care of us during our stay and made great conversation as there was a huge lack of planning from management during that week. The facility, for the years it has, was not bad and to be fair it was good. Internet sucked and was slow. Food was good at any restaurant option we chose.

Now the good stuff. I am a Melia member. We booked our trip for many months in advanced. We take one long vacation a year and Melia messed it up as I booked the Playa del Carmen resort and apparently it was sold out. We settled for Cancun as it was booked. As we arrived we were told about a US company totally booked the facility. The dining options were limited, there was no entertainment during most evenings. One of the nights the company had a concert beach side which you can hear in your room and after it was done, the crew diassembled the stage and made noise all night. No entertainment and no sleep, great. The managers, directors and who ever is in charge have no respect for long term paying members and just showed no lack of loyalty for members who have paid a lot of money for a lifetime membership. This was our first time use of the membership and Paradisus Cancun made it a bad experience. 

My experience was bad, we made it the best we could as we were there already and invested our money. Outside of this incident, The facilities were good and all around great.

reviews.author: rasa f
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Royal Service section and could not be happier. The workers there are unbelievable, Valeria Gallardo went above and beyond to make sure we were happy. So did Octavio, who was a pure joy to have around. Rafita and many others at La Palapa made every morning unforgettable. The only thing was the Lagoon view room was quite small and not much privacy when you go to the bathroom. However, we cannot wait to come back (booked to go this April) and this time we got an ocean view room at the Royal Service tower. Hoping for a wonderful experience once again! Btw, food was pretty good, but the workers there made a true difference and made us want to come back. Will write a review again after the upcoming trip!

reviews.author: michael m
reviews.title: Christmas in Cancun
reviews.text:
We spent a week over Christmas trading the snow and cold for fun and sun of Cancun.  
We had 2 rooms in bldg 5 Royal Service (which we strongly recommend paying up for especially for adults only).   
We ate at 5 different restaurants and found some of the restaurant food quality was just average that said, we found that Enzo (just opened had great food and amazing service from Edgar and Ernesto)
Also dinner at LaPalapa was also excellent (it's rating was made top notch by the service from 3 amazing people that worked as a team --- Moises, Victor and Alejandro - wow!!!)
The Bali beds are a must - Rodrigo will help you plan your beds for the week- great guy and nice to know it is set for the week.
The service around the pool/Bali beds was 5 star! (Once again ask for Moises or Victor- they go above and beyond Moises went so far as to run to the market grill for specialty pizzas as the LaPalapa pizza oven was down -- I'd hire him - great attitude, work ethic pride in service).   Paradisus is lucky to have him!     
We have stayed at the Paradisus Punta Cana and found service quality at both excellent - nice to see consistency like that. 
Finally the room 5412 (1 bedroom suite picture attached) was excellent along with jr luxury suite 5415 (we were upgraded without asking which only added to the trip) rooms were clean, with nice treats left in the room as a bonus.  
Great trip, great family time at Paradisus Cancun !

reviews.author: MnJSmith
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus !
reviews.text: We hadn't taken a trip in over 8 years so we decided to do an all inclusive. We have no children and wanted a luxurious place. When we got there we heard another couple taking about the Royal service upgrade so we decided to do it as well.  The best choice ever!!!! Our butler Fernando was wonderful, Rafael at the pool side was never without water or drinks, the Bali beds and the pool side service Javier, Rodriguez ,Daniel and Roberto were awesome! We had a bed daily on waiting lists! Dinner at La Palapa , Fuego were our favorites but Enzo's was awful. The spa... Incredible!! We plan to go back for sure!!!

reviews.author: LindseyandMike
reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text:
I cannot read one more of these positive reviews from December without calling it out.

I booked a 10-day vacation for six for my parents' 50th wedding anniversary A YEAR IN ADVANCE. I did a ton of research and decided this was a good resort for us because it's family friendly. We get there after traveling all day, we're given a bottle of water and a "WE'RE SORRY WE'RE OVERBOOKED." Come to find out now that there is some company that pretty much takes over the place in December and has for THE PAST THREE YEARS.

CAN YOU SAY BOOKING SCAM? They might as well have sent me an email saying they have a million dollars waiting for me in Nigeria as long as I will give them my PIN number.

So what do they do? They send me and my husband (40s), my two young teens and my 70-something parents to ME and put us in rooms without balconies or bathtubs (two things I was specifically looking for) on the first floor over the nightclub. :|  ALL THE ROOMS AT ME HAVE EARPLUGS ON THE NIGHTSTANDS IF THAT TELLS YOU ANYTHING. And I do mean ALL.

Paradisus KNEW they were overbooking and did it anyway. This was a very expensive trip. So we were shipped to ME for five days and then back to Paradisus. (FYI we met people who spent their whole bait-and-switch trip at ME, which I'm guessing they couldn't fill, thus the overbooking by Paradisus.)

Let me tell you about ME. Drunk kids everywhere. Mexico's drinking age is 18 :(  These rooms had condoms, sex toys and lube as part of the mini bar. Techno music until 3 a.m. Upcharges everywhere, including $5 for room service. That's where they sent us. (Food was terrible too. OMG they sent us into a ballroom for some half-baked buffet on the first night.)

The best thing I can say about ME is that my husband and I met some nice people there, many of whom had the same experience as us. I blame the management and not the staff as well. The property is fairly small where as Paradisus is almost overwhelming in its size. I'm sure if you are 18 that ME would be a dream, although MANY people were complaining about how many small children were there because it's billed as adult (another bait and switch).

Best thing about Paradisus? A lot actually. Once we got there we liked it. Lots of activities for the kids and the food was great. Rodrigo and the other activities folks made it a lot of fun for my kids and I kept hearing "I wish we had been here the whole time." They did upgrade us to royal service, but because we have older kids we didn't really need it. Our butler Rosanna did a great job trying to "fix" things as best she could. Drink service is kinda slow because the property is so huge and they don't have enough wait staff, but our main server Asuncion did a great job that we appreciated.

I can't recommend the Paradisus as they lie and you won't get what you paid for. As far as ME, no freaking way. If you want an adult trip without drunken teens, go to Live Aqua. My husband and I went there on a different trip and had a wonderful time. Still can't report on the family vacation front and will never be able to redo my folks' 50th anniversary. Very disappointed and feel ripped off.

reviews.author: fallingdollar
reviews.title: Impressive and Beautiful!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a wonderful 5 night stay at Paradisus Cancun. What a beautiful property! Everything was wonderful -- the fascinating and elegant décor, the great restaurants, the lovely pool and, of course, the gorgeous beach. This was our first trip to Cancun and we did a bit of research before booking for an all-inclusive property. We were extremely happy with our choice. 

Our room was a Junior Ocean view "suite" in the main pyramid. The view was expansive and incredible. We were able to leave the sliders open a bit and sleep to the sound of the ocean each nite which was heavenly!. The lanai was very large, but there was only one lounger (?). That was a bit strange as bothof us wanted to sit out there and enjoy the view. The suite isn't really a suite, it's one room with a couch and coffee table area. However, it was large and very comfortable. The bathroom was very nice with a large rainfall shower and Thierry Mugler toiletries. The hotel provides plenty of water in the room, which was appreciated. As previous reviewers have mentioned, you can hear the music from the lobby in the room (we were on the 5th floor), but it didn't bother me and I am sensitive about noise. It was otherwise quiet and we slept very well every night.

The soaring lobby is stunning...like a gorgeous botanical greenhouse by day and theatrically lit at night. There is musical entertainment and shows each night. We caught the Mexican folklore show and the Broadway show, both of which were great. The Red Lounge Club was also fun for dancing late into the night. And Coco's beach bar was fun for lounging on the big white circular beds while overlooking the ocean.

The pools were large and uncrowded, especially the larger pool which was a bit cooler than the smaller one, but still enjoyable. I mostly had it all to myself, perhaps because of the temperature which was fine after the first several minutes. There are 3-4 jetted alcoves in the main pool which seem like they used to be hot tub areas, but are now just regular pool temperature. It would have been nice to have them still function as hot tubs... not sure why they don't anymore. There were no other hot tubs to use in the main area, though there was one for "Royal Service" guests in the adult only area. We were also told the pool at the Yhi Spa was not a hot tub either so we didn't try that. We opted not to upgrade to Royal Service (for an extra $500) but still felt royally treated by the attentive pool service and friendly staff.

The beach is beautiful and there were plenty of beach chairs, though they did fill up. There are also lots of beach beds which rent for $50/day. That seemed a bit much and it was slightly annoying not to be able to use any of the 20+ beds that dotted the beach and pool area without a paid reservation. The music is pumping at the beach giving the resort an overall lively feel. We walked by some neighboring resorts and they seemed more subdued by comparison. If the music gets too much, you can walk to the far ends of the resort for a quieter scene. The music was 12-6 on most days.

The buffet was delicious and varied, and the restaurants were great. We tried Fuego, Bano and Mole and enjoyed each one.

It was hard to leave such a beautiful and relaxing place. Paradisus lived up to it's name and we would definitely return.

reviews.author: Maureen B
reviews.title: Enjoyed!
reviews.text:
I was a little nervous after some reviews, especially about check in. We loved it! Check in happened with no wait. We were told 30 minutes for our room, but they brought us piña coladas and lemonades for the kids while they told us all the details on the resort and restaurants. We then walked to avenue bar to check out the views and have a glass of wine. 30 minutes went by and our room was ready. We requested main tower bc we have 2 small children (1 and 3) and wanted to minimize walking. We did have to change bc of noise to the hall room connecting main tower to tower 2, but mgmt was VERY understanding and got us a new room. Prob best to start out in a quiet room if you plan to go to bed early. 
Reserving beach chairs was easy bc we were up early. Breakfast was awesome. So much to choose from. There is even a juice bar! Fresh juices blended right on the spot. The lady that makes them is the SWEETEST woman with the best smile. 
The beach is beautiful. The waves were calm and got rougher through our stay. We had a lot of fun in the ocean.  ZUMBA CLASS WAS AWESOME! Karla and the guys that run this are too much fun! I had never done Zumba, but I love to dance. After 3 lessons I felt like a pro, and it helped burn off my piña coladas!
I loved the beach bar, the sushi restaurant and fuego! 
The shows were great! Yes, you have to get there a little early, but it's a bar! Relax and have a drink! ;)
The only hiccup we noticed was there were 500 pma sales reps there during our stay. This definitely changed the vibe of the hotel. It was kind if weird to pay full price for a fabulous vacation, but be surrounded by 500 people on a free trip. They were a little loud, and the beach Olympics mc was super obnoxious, but the staff did an awesome job of taking care of us and making us feel special anyways.

reviews.author: indymacthedog
reviews.title: Never left the property; They had it all
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus in Cancun in January.  We go to Cancun every January to get away from the cold. With our multiple trips, we do not take any excursions. So, this was the perfect spot for us.  We were met graciously at the entrance, and escorted to check-in.  There were great food options.  Outdoor seating if desired at two.  Room service 24/7, and the mini bar included.  Just remember to make your dinner reservations.  We saw some turned away from restaurants that did not make theirs.  The room was clean, and the housekeepers excellent.  We needed extra towels, and they were delivered quickly.  And, then a call from the office to be sure we were satisfied with the delivery.  We had a king size bed that was very comfortable.  The balcony was small, but did have an ocean view.  We asked for a chair for the balcony, and it was delivered within minutes upon check in.  The beach was kept clean.  Yes, there was loud music at times, but you are at a resort.  Believe me, we are part of the "older folks" that another reviewer wrote, but the music was not offensive, and was not constant.  We had a wonderful, relaxing vacation. Highly recommend, and hopefully will return next year.

reviews.author: Marc C
reviews.title: Bring a torch¡
reviews.text:
A mixture of the great, the strange and the dark at this hotel.  We stayed over Xmas & new year and I loved the Royal Service during the day, but at night things get strange.  Like the superb pool\beach side bar stops serving at 6pm.  So no evening drinks outside unless you are eating.  There is a self service bar area inside, but this closes at 10 pm.  So no after dinner drinks unless you go to the the only other bar and stand whilst being deafened by the music.
There are lots of great restaurants at the hotel, but you will need a torch to read the menus at many of them and to see the food.  You will also be very lucky if the food arrives even slightly warm. Which a shame as the food is very good, especially at the tapas restaurant (eat inside for great service and to avoid the noisy waterfall) or the sushi restaurant (use your torch to avoid falling into the Koy carp pond)!
And finally don't expect a gala dinner at Xmas and the hotel wanted 200 USD per person for a gala dinner on new years eve!  Not what I expected after spending nearly £3000 on my holiday.

reviews.author: Mary M
reviews.title: Great location .. Minor issues need correction
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus by Melia in Cancun in January and, for the most part, thoroughly enjoyed the resort.  There are lots of choices for dining and all the staff members were terrific.  The beach was right there.  However, for older folks, the constant, loud and unrelenting music from speakers at the beach and pool were inescapable.  It would have been nice to relax in peace and quiet, but that was not possible with the constant blare from speakers all over the place.  The rooms are good sized and comfortable but daily maid service was iffy.  We had to call for service very late in the afternoon on 2-3 occasions during our one week stay.  The balcony on our ocean front room was nice but we asked for a change of chairs and never got it.  We stayed on fifth floor and the ice machine was not working.  We reported that issue on our second day at the resort, and again on our third day and again on our fourth day.  When we left on our seventh day, the ice machine had not yet been repaired.  Lighting in the room was strange as well and hard to figure out what switch went to what light.  Other than the minor issues mentioned above, it was wonderful to be away from the cold winter weather and to a place of warmth and sunshine and friendly people.

reviews.author: crystalline242
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: We came to cancun for the renown service.  This is our 4th time in Mexico and have stayed in Riveria Maya and Cancun before. First let me say they call the junior suites but they are regular rooms. When we tried to upgrade and pay they said they had no more ocean view room suites. Meanwhile the hotel was so empty it could count on our hands the number of people walking around. We asked for a crib to be in the room but there was no crib and even hours later after we ate I had to call again. Then I called for some hot water for the babies bottle and it took an hour and and a half to deliver hot water. I just wanted to warm up my baby's bottle and there is no microwave in room. Nervous about the rest of our stay here. I am quite disappointed so far especially with the service.

reviews.author: Richard W
reviews.title: Nearly Perfect
reviews.text:
Great Hotel, Beautiful Beach, Great Service, Good Food! The only minus to the week's stay was the poor quality of the WIFI which kept dropping out. Particular thanks to Asuncion, Marisol, Luis, and Enrique at the Pool Bar for their incredible service.

Thank you,REW

reviews.author: Jessica p
reviews.title: Our MOST Amazing vacation by far!
reviews.text: Our first family vacation with small children(7 and 3 years). We were enticed by the "kids stay free" deal that Paradisus hotel in Cancun had at the time. Once we arrived-I LOVED that the airport was close to the hotel. Being a parent and traveling with young children - they can get a little fussy and difficult to control in a 5 hour flight and then again for a long trip all the way to the hotel, which in this case was only 15 minutes away. That was the first relief. Once we arrived to the hotel, as we entered, we were greeted by a lovely odor in the air. It was the smell of candles and fresh flowers. So relaxing after the travels from LA to Cancun with kids. The process to receive our room key and getting our luggage to our room was seamless. We headed to the room, my kids LOVED the mini fridge, which was stocked with sodas, juices and snacks. We headed to dinner by the pool side - amazing cuts of meat and wine (if you're a meat lover). Perfect way to end our first night was with an amazing dinner and amazing desserts. We stayed 5 nights. We were able to visit Chichen Itza and Xcaret. My kids loved both - definitely an adventure in getting there. If traveling with small kids, take something to distract them during the bus ride. Books, small enough toys that you can pack back up when its time to indulge in the history and adventures of your destination. I think over all my favorite part of the day was breakfast. Everyday, regardless of what our day had in store for us, the amazing staff at the Naos Breakfast Buffet - were ready to take care of our needs to make our bus on time. We never felt rushed. Many thanks to Ignacio Vasquez, David Contreras and Oscar Gamboa for making us feel part of the family and helping us make our mornings so stress free and enjoyable. Our experience was over all AMAZING! So many things to comment on...the food, the nightly shows, the beach, cabanas, drinks, support staff and the smiles they wear so untiringly - AMAZING! When we returned home, we contemplated whether we should try a new destination for our yearly family trip. I'm happy to report that we recently booked our vacation for November 2015 for Paradisus in Cancun - this time for 7 days. I'm so excited and although we still have several months until we can enjoy our trip - the anticipation will make it that much more fun when we are finally there to indulge...Can November get here any faster?

reviews.author: daed1524
reviews.title: Rooms close to the entrance
reviews.text: Better avoid accomodation in the rooms (Lagoon view) close to the main entrance (2-5 floor in the middle).  If you nonetheless do prepare to 24h noise and diesel aroma from the buses  and cars which arrive all the time.

reviews.author: ORTHON
reviews.title: Perfect luxury
reviews.text:
I just read the review "Almost perfect".... I would totally agree with this, if it were not for the fact that we fortunately stayed in the Royal side of the property.  This meant, among other things, that we had a huge pool dedicated to adults only, and none of the shenanigans going on at the "other" pool applied to us, thank goodness.  We walked by the "other" pool on the way to a restaurant one day, and there was indeed blaring music and various shaped bodies cavorted around in what I suppose was a Zumba class.
