The following day we stayed on our side to eat lunch, ordering it from the comfort of our bali beds.  That's what I mean by perfect luxury.  In other words, upgrade to the Royal if you can.  Our butler, Galdino, was a hard-working sweetie-pie, and our check-in agent, Leticia was charming and funny.  I hope both of them have a bright future.

All the staff we encountered, for that matter, were fabulous.

reviews.author: Patrick G
reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.text: Imagine a gorgeous hotel on the best stretch of beach..great employees perfect sunshine..and then.. these geniuses turn up a sound system on the beach that would rival any rock concert...they play a heavy bass Latin rhythm that can be annoying 150 meters from the source..I am one who enjoys loud music.. this is truly deafening..the beach beds are not occupied due to this monstrosity..management seem oblivious to the fact that this music drowns out conversation and even the loud roar of the surf FIX IT.

reviews.author: Racheli N
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel!!!!!
reviews.text: We very much enjoyed our stay at Paradisus!!!! A beautiful relaxing hotel where you have everything to make you feel the best! Thank you Dalila from club vacational for helping us make our stay the best! Dfntly a hotel you must  visit!! Service is Super!!

reviews.author: Bubbly_jo
reviews.title: Immaculate service!!!
reviews.text: I truly enjoyed my stay at this resort. I stayed on the royal service side of the resort and the best thing about this resort is the immaculate service that I recieved. My butler Sergio and my waiter at the Bali beds Francisco Terrazas were extremely sweet and attentive and took the time to learn my name as well as my boyfriends. The restaurants are awesome! Mole and Vento are my two favorite restaurants there. The hotel in itself is truly a Paradise....each floor on the royal service side has a different scent on each floor...smells AMAZING...the royal service is 100% worth the extra money. I've been to many places around the world and I wanted to see Cancun but I had no intention of going back but after this experience I definitely plan to return to this resort!!!!!!

reviews.author: itrippin
reviews.title: Cancun year end trip.
reviews.text:
A few words about this resort. Rooms are not as nice as some of the other hotels we have stayed in in Cancun. The beds are very comfortable and the grounds are beautiful and well taken care of. 
The pools are clean and big. The main pool with the bar was a little cold but the other pools were heated, which was nice. Food was just ok, it was hard to get anything that was hot. You have to make reservations a day in advance for most.

We were in tower 3, which is where the lobby is, and it was a bit noisy at night. One big problem was i needed to get on the internet for just a few minutes each day and it was nearly impossible. Called the front desk but no help there either. Also got some weird virus on my MAC BOOK which i thought was hard to do. 

If you like golf don't play the par 3 in front of hotel, not worth it even if its free. We rented clubs to play but they didn't have golf balls, go figure. Luckily a friend traveling with us had 4.

I will say the staff at the hotel are great. Friendly and will help with anything.

Overall would probably not stay here on our next trip.

reviews.author: whatmeow
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text:
Overall the place is gorgeous and felt really tropical.  We stayed in the adults section and had the Royal Service, which was ok.  We enjoyed the snack/drink area set up for us often, which was good because the fridge restocking was hit/miss and after the first day no beer arrived again.  I got sick two mornings from the breakfast buffett,  all I had was some melon and coffee....we ate dinner at Blue Avage twice, everything was great there.

The bed was super comfortable.  We didn't spend as much time on the balcony as I would have hoped for, the only chairs available were lounge back chairs, and the concrete beam blocked a good portion of the view.

I would not stay here again as there are many other resorts to check out and enjoy rather than come back here and be underwhelmed.

reviews.author: Megan S
reviews.title: Overall very pleased, but a couple areas for improvement
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently returned from 4 nights at Paradissus.  After staying one night at the Park Royal Cancun, which was well below expectation, we were so pleased with our stay at the Paradissus, which exceeded expectations.  To be fair, we stayed under their Royal Service plan, so I can't comment on how the experience fares for guests under the standard plan.

We had an ocean view second floor room and it had a very nice ocean view as promised.  I had requested a king size bed but they gave us two doubles.  I complained and they offered to push the two beds together so that was a nice compromise.  The balcony furniture was broke in that the chair backs would not stay upright and no one seemed able to figure out how to fix it, which was a little annoying, but we didn't spend much time on the balcony anyway.  Otherwise the room was quite nice and spacious, including the bathroom.  The bathroom had a bidet which my husband though was wonderful.

The Royal Service plan was well worth it in our opinion.  We were looking for a relaxing time hanging out on the beach and by the pool and that is what we got.  Royal service guests stay in an adults only tower, have their own quiet pool (albeit the pool is a bit warm) and own part of the beach.  You are guaranteed two full day reservations for a bali bed either by the pool or by the ocean as part of the royal service, which I thought was great.  There seemed to be some confusion each day finding our bali bed reservation since there was a guest with a similar last name and they inadvertently gave our reserved  bed to them, which was annoying.  We were also asked to relocate from our bed one day because another guest was throwing a fit and wanted our bed since someone had took theirs.  Annoying again, but there were other open beds so we obliged the request to relocate.  There is waiter service to the bali beds to bring you drinks or food from the royal service restaurant located oceanfront.  Royal service also has its own lounge area which gives you access to a variety of alcohol and food throughout the day until roughly 11 p.m.  Nice variety of white wines, liquor, appetizers, etc.  You are also given the choice of a bottle of one of 3 kinds of alcohol for your room but you have to ask your "butler" for this.  My husband chose a bottle of rum.  I asked for a bottle of wine and diet cokes to be in our room and the "butler" was on top of it.  Otherwise the mini bar fridge has standard fare:  a few beers, cokes and water.

I've stayed at 4 other all inclusive resorts and the Paradissus by far had the best food quality and selection.  There were 9 restaurants or so and I think we made it to all but 2.  The room service was also decent.  My minor complaints about the food service were the hour and a half wait for food we had at Vento and the room service breakfast we pre-ordered the night before that came 25 minutes early, even before our wake up call.

I would say the staff was tremendously pleasant and helpful, although I did feel obliged to tip quite a bit more than I have at previous AI hotels, but I wasn't upset by this because the venue was quite well kept and I was overall very pleased.  It was very easy to book an outside excursion at the hotel.  We went to Chichen Itza which is a LONG day but is the type of cultural destination it seemed we should see at least once in a lifetime.  The bus picked us up at 7:45 a.m. and we did not get back til 9 pm.  Be sure to bring snacks.  We had been told the trip would include breakfast, which it did not. The lunch provided was not very good.  The trip included a stop at a cenote for swimming and an old church, plus some extra time for shopping and such. 

So, the resort cons.  
1)  They put on very entertaining shows as nightly entertainment but the venue they hold them in is pitifully small.  You need to get there 30-45 minutes early to make sure you get a seat.  I really enjoy watching these types of shows as there are limited other forms of entertainment in the evening so this was probably my biggest complaint.  They do have a nightclub on site that is open late but my husband and I are not nightclubbing people so I can't comment how that is.  Still I would highly recommend going.  We saw the Michael Jackson and Circus shows and they were both really impressive. 
2)  The golf course.  The holes are not numbered and despite asking a number of people we could not get a clear answer on where the first hole started, so we wandered around aimlessly looking for it.  We paid $30 each to rent golf clubs, which is not really a full set, only some very old and mismatched drivers and putters.  There are no pull carts and no rental carts so you have to carry clubs.  I am a regular golfer and have never carried clubs.  In the heat, wandering around lost trying to find the first hole, this was an exhausting endeavor.  We only ended up playing 5 holes as the mid-day sun got the best of us. 
3) Lack of A/C.  This is probably the Minnesotan in me but I found the restaurants and some of the common areas to be too warm.
4)  Spa prices.  My husband and I were really looking forward to getting massages however they cost something insane to me like $140/hr.

Overall I would say the pros outweighed the cons and would definitely return!

reviews.author: Bobo1123
reviews.title: awesome stay!
reviews.text:
my wife and I had a wonderful stay at this place.  
Service is good comparing to other Caribbean reports I stayed before. 
Beach is long and wide comparing to other reports on the Cancun hotel zone.  I don't like the waves which made swimming almost impossible but my wife liked it. 
Room is large and well maintained. 
Food is good. we liked the Mexican restaurant mole.
Nighttime entertainment  is bad so other than eating there is not very you can do in the resort at night time.

reviews.author: roberttI522DG
reviews.title: Excellente Vacaciones en Cancun!
reviews.text:
A very special thank you to Abraham, Luis, Carlos and Raphael making our experience this past week exceptional!  

The pool bar was outstanding with first class service and always smiling Raphael happy to serve or make your day!  It was my birthday Tuesday and the breakfast, lunch and dinner staff all prepared birthday cake and sang in Spanish and English!  A great experience for me, my finance' and guests all around.  People were taking pictures and everyone gave a huge ovation for the performance.  Also Raphael made sure my drink was overflowing on my bday at the pool.  Great tequila and cerveza mi gordo!

Night life was great too, and when it was time for bed we had peace and quiet in our room.  Abraham always was happy to see us and gave us a 5 star lunch on our last day, our last meal with specialty margaritas and birthday cake again! 

 I'm glad we worked out in their health spa everyday and I played soccer and volleyball with their beach staff who were also amazing.  Great athletes and always patient, including everyone in the games.  

The last day we purchased a beach bed.  Well worth it!!! Great service and fun!!!

Thank you so much!  We will be back!

reviews.author: Roving21755
reviews.title: Great place, fantastic food, and terrific service in Paradise!
reviews.text:
We decided on the all-inclusive package this year as it is an option for Club Melia owners and were pleasantly surprised at the quality and service in all 7 venues!

The buffet option offers everything one could wish for and is available for brunch, lunch, and dinner. Amazing food!

The other restaurants offered gourmet plates with no limits and the included cocktails and wines were above average.
Wine aficionados will most-likely prefer to upgrade to something from their global wine list.

The poolside service we received under our reserved Palapa-style cabana which is only $10 per day if a club member ( if you are in a timeshare unit)was excellent and Ulises was amazing! We never waited long for a cocktail or food and he was friendly with a great sense of humor and memory of our preferences. 

All the staff is terrific and aims to please but a few stood out as going above and beyond: Axel in Blue Agave, Irving in Mole, and Victor in Vento. They went out of their way to find what we liked if not on the menu.

The rooms are spacious as are the balconies(very private). The bathrooms offer bidets and spacious countertop. The refrigerator and freezer is good size in the studio units and the coffee provided for the coffee makers was actually drinkable.

The only fly in the tequila was a corporate beach Olympic event that included too many loudspeakers and an overly enthusiastic and Tecate-soaked emcee. He yelled into his microphone for four hours alternating with spurts of raucous music in between. Thinking that won't be happening again...many guests complained.

It is an excellent value and wonderful way to experience the beach life in Cancun!

reviews.author: judycote1414
reviews.title: Best service ever!
reviews.text: My husband and I have stayed at numerous all-inclusive resorts and the Paradisus Cancun is at the top of our list for service as well as food quality.  We were Royal Service customers and if you can afford this upgrade, definitely take advantage of it.  The attentiveness of the staff is amazing!  When at the pool, I don't think there was 10 minutes between staff circulating to ask if we needed anything.  Our butler was wonderful as well, making sure we had the desired dinner reservations at the time we wanted.  And let me tell you about the food.  Although everyone likes the theme restaurants, I cannot tell you how good the food was at the buffet restaurant!  Service was excellent there as well.  We enjoyed our best all-inclusive experience at the Paradisus Cancun and will definitely return there for our next all-inclusive vacation!

reviews.author: Mark J
reviews.title: Great getaway
reviews.text:
We've just returned after a wonderful 6 days at the Paradisus Cancun resort.  We were skeptical of all inclusive resorts but this was a great experience.  

Pros:  The service is terrific.  They will go out of their way to get you whatever you need.  The pool and beach area are beautiful.  The waitresses are everywhere and Erick and Reymondo do a fantastic job at the pool bar.  For an all inclusive resort the food quality exceeded my expectations.   

Cons:   Pressure to listen to a sales pitch for club melia which is some sort of vacation club.  We refused and it was no problem.  The pool side food buffet was terrible but nothing a quick trip to the market grill restaurant buffet couldn't take care of.

reviews.author: NYvacationer82
reviews.title: Honest opinion of the good and not so good.
reviews.text: I am writing this review as I sit here in my hotel room on the 5th floor overlooking the lagoon. Ocean view rooms are probably nicer but you still have a nice view on the lagoon side as long as you are on the 4th floor or above. First impressions are breathtaking. The immense open lobby area in the main building is impressive and beautiful. Upon arrival (tired after a full day of travel) I was told that the only available room was in the basement with a view of a parking garage. And it had a king bed when I had requested a double. It was hard for me to believe I had the very last room in a hotel of this size so I pressed on for 20 minutes getting nowhere. Aggrevated and tired we relunctantly went to the basement, unpacked and settled in only to receive a call that a 5th floor room had miraculously become available. So we moved. I must say the basement room was double the the size so dont expect a large room on higher floors. Everyone raves about Royal Service but I really dont see the need. They serve top shelf liquor at all bars and there are bars everywhere. There are two things that you must do. Get up early and put your towels on a towels on your chairs at the pool if you want a good location. If not you will still get a chair but it will be far down away from the swimup bar. The beach chairs are even more scarse and really require that you get early. I was down by 8am every morning and never had a problem. The other must do is call the restaurant reservation line each morning to make reservations for the next two nights max.  Breakfast day 3 I took a table by the buffet restaurant which is much better than any buffet I have been in at other all inclusives. I left my sunglasses on the table and went inside for 5 minutes. When I got back the table had been cleared and my sunglasses were gone. All of the waitstaff, managers, etc..were not helpful. Hotel security wrote up some report. The hotel manager offered me 10 percent discount at the gift shop which amounted to a 2 dollar discount off their overpriced sunglasses. The hotel's attitude toward me during this event was unfortunate since I had really started to enjoy myself. The night time entertainment is terrible as others have rightly stated. If you get there late you cannot see the show. Only about twenty or thirty people can really see it. Also the show is a dance troup that just changes costumes and dance routines. Thats all it is every night. If you try to maneuver your way into a spot, you will be told to move by multiple people so its not even worth trying. As I said earlier, Naos - the buffet - is very good. The poolside lunch is mediocre and could use a grill. Its basically hotdogs burgers and nachos served buffet style. Bana is the sushi restaurant located in the lobby. The food and ambiance were both very good. Although wine drinkers beware the included wine is bad and the prices for decent bottle are high. Mole is the mexican restaurant - food was good and I would recommend. Blue Agave is a taco place only open after 4pm so no lunch here which I think they should consider. No reservations required and the tacos are okay. We ate late afternoon snack here if dinner reservations were late. La perla was a huge let down. It is an open air restaurant near the beach. One would think the ambiance and food would be good but it turns out that it is a buffet and the waiter service is also not that great. You will not be missing much if you skip this one. Vento - a tapas restaurant-  is pretty good but service is very very slow and they limit the number if tapas you can order even though each tapa is about two bites of food. Fuego is a civeche spot. We have reservations tonight so I cannot comment yet, and we have not been to Market Grill for dinner since we have some vegetarians and Market Grill is a Brazilian meat place for dinner. During the day it is the outdoor seating part of the Naos buffet. They have a lunch menu with pizza and pastas. Overall the restaurants and bars are pretty good for an all inclusive. Maid service and turndown service were both good although I did leave each a 10 dollar tip at the beginning so not sure how much that helped.

reviews.author: Amaia M
reviews.title: Amazonic Mayan Paradise!
reviews.text:
I was taken aback, like other guests, by the amazon-like jungle decor from the inside of this gigantic five-pyramid complex. I was there with my colleague celebrating the publication of my book, but also we were there to work --to write. Both of us had deadlines pending so we decided to go to Cancun and work there. I had never been to the Paradisus before, and honestly, it was a matter of chance that I selected this hotel. I wanted to stay in Playa del Carmen, which is in the Riviera Maya but we decided last-minute and I didn't have a long time to select the vacation package. I decided to do an all-inclusive because I have done it before in Cancun and it's very comfortable no to have to think about finances when you're there (other than tips which I always leave, especially for the women who work behind the scenes but I'll get to that...). When we arrived we were upgraded to Royal Service after I told the front desk attendant that we were there to celebrate my publication. Let me just say WOW! Royal Service is amazing. First of all there are no children allowed and, no offense to people who chose to reproduce, that was very welcoming to me. No screaming, no running, no weird stuff in the pool, etc. That in and of itself was paradise. I concur with one of the reviews that though they told us the place was full, I hardly ever saw people in the pool or at the beach. This is due to the fact that they have five pyramids that are humongous so people are totally spread. I know that in the general area it was difficult for people to get a nice cabana by the pool whereas at the Royal Service, Bernardo and Arturo? who kept our reservations and we got a great place by the pool. The food was fabulous though after six days it starts to get boring... I really enjoyed the variety of restaurants although we were unable to go to two of them since they were always full. 
I appreciated the service at this hotel and the professionalism that all workers at this place have. They always say hello and give you the Paradisus ‘hello’ which is taking their right hand and placing in in their hearts (weird but it brings pride to workers because instead of them being invisible, guests acknowledge their presence and I liked that). So let's talk about labor: this hotel needs to be more balanced in terms of gender equity and workloads. On the one hand the waiters were always running around in all of the restaurants and the women in the buffets as well. Whereas the 'butlers' or others like the cabana boys in the Royal Service who spent most of their time chatting with each other and making reservations. Don't get me wrong they do work but the workload is definitely not balanced at all. The men waiters, bell-boys, valets, etc. make all the tips because they're all in front face-to-face with patrons whereas the women are in the background making your rooms, cooking, doing dishes, etc. This means all the tips go to the men and I find that horrible! That's why I'm giving this hotel only 'average' because they need to take care of their female employees way better than what they are doing now. Anytime I needed change for a $20 for tips guess who always had ones for change? the bell boys. So please when you go to the Paradisus be conscious of the women behind the scenes and TIP THEM! yes let me reiterate that TIP THEM! more than the cabana boys who make reservations, more than the guy who carries a couple of bags for like ten seconds, and take care of the smoothie woman at the breakfast buffet, or the woman preparing your eggs, and most importantly tip the women who make your room everyday! They have different shifts, so leave a TIP by the bathroom sink so they know it's for them or leave a note or something... be appreciative of the people who are working long hours for not a lot of money so that you may enjoy this amazing paradise. 
Having said all that yes, I recommend this hotel but I strongly advise the owners to re-structure their personnel so that women may be better compensated. They should have a tip pool and at the end of the day divide it among all of the workers. Just a thought.

reviews.author: John W
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: I had a sudden change in my schedule and booked the Paradisus Cancun on Monday and left on Saturday.  The resort is a short ride from the airport.  The resort is well designed, most of the restaurants are adjacent to each other and there is a good selection of cuisines.  We tried them all.  The Bana restaurant in the center of core is a must and the Brazilian restaurant was well done with a good selection of meats.  We stayed on the beach all day and there were servers coming around all day taking drink orders.  I had not been to Cancun in a number of  years and on my last visit the beach was very narrow.  This is not the case now and my girlfriend was favorably impressed.  In fact she asked why we had not gone to Cancun before this.  We have been to Riviera Maya four times, Cabo once, and she was very happy with the beach and the Paradisus.  The bottom line is we would go back.

reviews.author: Metalmulisha88
reviews.title: Paradise and royalty in your hands
reviews.text: Let me tell you something,  I don't do reviews often or really like to. I can't begin to explain how amazing this place truly is. Obviously we got the royal service and glad and so happy we did. When they say the word royal they truly mean it. Everything including your own private tower, they set you up with a butler for the whole time you are there. They also give you a cellphone to call him whenever you need something.  Also, they give you they same guy the whole time. Everything including top shelf lounge is included,  24-7 room service included and mini bar that you can customize for free! Now for the restaurants, we tried Bana, market grill, vento, the buffet and blue agave. I was very happy with the food except for the buffet and blue agave, they were very bad. The food is not even mediocre, other than that Bana hands down the best sushi and fresh seafood. For the names of people who stood out from the rest! Héctor,  he was so attentive and always there for us. Fernando, Salvador , Carlos and Alberth. The worse part of this place is leaving it. Please tip well, a few dollars here and there take u far away!

reviews.author: WT Goldman
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text:
I think it's worth paying the few extra dollars for the Royal Service upgrade. I was treated like VIP the moment I walked in the hotel. They have excellent quality food and premium liquor, including unlimited champagne, in the Royal Service lobby. I can honestly say I ate too much during my stay. 
My butler, I forgot his name, was extremely helpful and friendly. He had all my reservations ready, all I had to do was show up at the restaurants of my choice. 
There's no way I'll stay anywhere else when I return to Cancun.

reviews.author: TeddyRuxpinGR
reviews.title: Excellent relaxing vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from Jan. 10-17, 2015. What a great place! We had a wonderful time during our stay. Here is my review of the hotel:

Pros:
1. The facility itself. As soon as you walk into the resort to check in, you enter an enormous pyramid and it almost feels like you've entered a luxurious jungle. There is green vegetation everywhere and it smells amazing. The hotel isn't brand new but it's very well maintained. Our room was more than adequate and featured a great Jacuzzi on the balcony!
2. The food. I've been to a couple of other all-inclusive resorts and this one had the best food and the most options in terms of restaurants. I was impressed by the variety of food that they offer, from Brazilian style (truly a meat festival!!) to sushi, to Mexican. I enjoyed every meal I had all week.
3. The SERVICE! The resort was pretty full during the week that we were there and yet it rarely seemed crowded. It was simple to make reservations for the restaurants (call the day before) and the staff did an exceptional job all around. A few staff members were amazing, including Manuel at Bana (he is soo nice and even had small gifts for us on our second trip to Bana). Erick and Enrique were hilarious and did a great job keeping us "hydrated" at the pool bar. "chacarone!". Luis worked his butt off making sure we always had drinks while we sat in our lounge chairs around the pools.
4. The location. The Paradisus is located right in the heart of the hotel zone and this made it easy to get to from the airport. It was also extremely simple to take the bus which runs right in front of the hotel into town to begin our excursion to Isla Mujeres.

Cons:
Sales Presentation: When we arrived we were given all of the hotel information and then were offered a discount on excursions if we agreed to a 90-minute presentation the following day to become a member of the Melia Vacation Club. We agreed, and the presentation was moving right along until it came down to the "hard sell" portion. We had to become fairly insistent that we were not interested before they let us go. If I had to do it again, I'd skip the presentation and enjoy the 2 hours that I spent there. Overall this didn't really bother me as I knew what to expect, but it can be frustrating when you have already said that you aren't interested and they keep pushing. Like I said, not a big deal overall.

Pro Tip!! We had stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana before and chose to upgrade to Royal Service there. In Punta Cana, the Royal Service really seemed important in order to get the extra free restaurant options and access to the Royal Service pool. I asked how much it would be to upgrade to Royal Service this time and it would have been an extra $100 per night ($700 total). We decided not to do it and were never upset about this decision. There are plenty of restaurants to choose from and there was always open lounge chairs at the pool. In my opinion, the extra $700 for Royal Service would not have been worth it.

We had a fantastic vacation at the Paradisus and would highly recommend it to others. The staff works very hard to take care of you and the facility and beach are exceptional.

reviews.author: Jennifer K
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Fantastic resort, we had a fab suite, beautiful views, our own private butler, gorgeous food and drinks, the list goes on... We were so spoilt and the location of the hotel was ideal for a honeymoon. Staff were always so helpful and polite and the resort itself is just amazing. I would highly recommend this resort for a holiday or honeymoon. If it is a special occasion it's worth the money to upgrade to the exclusive pyramid as the food and drinks are better plus u get your own butler which is a real treat.

reviews.author: Dan M
reviews.title: Luxury
reviews.text: Rough start,  they tried putting us in the time share tower, but once we complained they immediately switch us and let us up grade to Royal Service for a discount. Well worth it. The staff is very friendly and we'll trained.  Love everything about it.

reviews.author: eluvittar
reviews.title: One of the best resorts on the strip!
reviews.text:
We went there in May 2012 (our 1st of the multiple Mexico trips) and loved it.

Pros:
1. All inclusive is awesome. Good breakfast and food. Great drinks too.
2. Great interior decor of the hotel.
3. Bus stop right outside the hotel.
4. Good swim up bars, plenty of lounge chairs outside on the beach and they have beach service too and i think it was very good service.
5. Ocean facing rooms have a great view.
6. beach is fantasic for swimming. You may have some benign sea-weed, but the waves and all are great.

Cons:
1. They do this practice of promising a room and not giving it the 1st day. After you complain, you will get a room you want the next day. They did that with multiple guests.
2. the restaurant booking inside the hotel (included in all inclusive) could go out really fast. I once went in empty restaurant with no booking and they didnt let me sit and said its fully reserved! I was like , but "its empty". After some insistence and saying its our anniversary, i was served. Boy, tasty mexican food with FANTASTIC service.
3. Its expensive. It used to be called Gran melia and was cheaper. Then when it has become Paradissus, its pricier now :) 

I would still recommend this place, especially if you do all inclusive!

reviews.author: drvlaan
reviews.title: Disappointment Around Every Corner
reviews.text:
The first of many disappointments started when we were overbooked at our original resort, Paradisus Playa del Carmen, and relocated to the Cancun Paradisus resort.

Check In: Front desk staff was less than helpful with compensating us for our problems with relocating, as we had to travel a round trip from Cancun Airport to Playa del Carmen (50 minutes) and back to Cancun with a 14 month old. And then on top of everything, we were overcharged by $4,000 and took all week to get answers for a refund...again taking up ALOT of our time. 

Accommodations: Basic room/furnishings as you would expect to see in a Holiday Inn. 'Stocked' minibar includes canned beer/soda/water and junk food snacks. Room service was exceptionally slow, even for simple orders of yogurt and soy mild for our toddler. There was no furniture on the balcony and when asked at the front desk, they responded, "we ran out". So yes, we had a wonderful balcony all week that we could not make use of. Housekeeping: no turn down service, towels were not replaced, 3 washcloths for a one bedroom unit with 3 adults & a toddler, and rooms not left clean. The pull out couch into a bed had a mattress as thin as a sleeping bag. We ended up getting a roll away bed and adding the couch cushion on top of it...still terribly uncomfortable for the week. Highly disappointed with the 1-bedroom unit, not worth the extra money as you get no 'extras'. Would have been better off, and cheaper, with a basic/studio room with 2 beds. The 'personal concierge' service was a ridiculous waste of time. 

Restaurants: All food choices were far from 'kid friendly'. No food choices/menu for children. We asked for chicken strips & fries most nights, which came 45 minutes later. Yes, 45 minutes for a few chicken strips and french fries. Restaurant food was par, but the meal was ruined once we had to wait 45 minutes for our child's food. Drinks were usually pretty good. Buffets were terrible and repetitive.

Beach/pool: The one and only enjoyable part of the stay was the beach/pool. Although, there was limited areas of pool space for a toddler (no splash pad or wadding pool), we made due. 

Free Wi-Fi was available, but with limited accessibility. It only worked in the rooms and restaurants and lost service once you stepped outside the resort walls (no service at the pools/beach). 

Unfortunately the staff has to work at such a disappointing resort, as they were friendly and attentive. Not sure how this resort has received the accreditations is has. As being an RCI member, it is far below their standards. We could not be paid enough to return to this resort. We will not be returning or recommending it to anyone.

reviews.author: thelovemovement
reviews.title: Loved Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text:
After an 11 hour flight, I was extremely anxious about turning up at a resort which looks a lot better on trip advisor than it does in real life. As I entered the building I was overwhelmed by the 'zen' atmosphere and it looked better than the photos by a mile. Our room was on the 7th floor in block 3 (as requested via e-mail) with a beautiful ocean view. (The beach is absolutely divine!) The room itself was clean, stylish and immediately felt like home. It was cleaned daily, we had our nightly turndown service and our minibar was restocked daily with soft drinks, beers, oreos and crisps.

The food was absolutely fantastic, we loved all the variety of the a la cartes and buffet - I have to admit I put a few pounds on. The cocktails were great, and the service by the pool was really fantastic. There were points where I would turn around to a new drink without even realising the staff had been to collect my empty glass. The overall work ethic of the staff is like nothing I've ever seen before. The level of customer service and general care for customers was far beyond my expectations. I found Luis in the buffet (morning shift) and Erick at the pool bar were exceptional! 

The vibe was very relaxed, it was not a party hotel but there was still scope to have fun there. However I certainly wouldn't have chosen Paradisus for partying, I would have gone to Oasis or Hard Rock. I came with the intention to relax and would certainly come back for more :)

reviews.author: JennO
reviews.title: Great Place, Great People, Great Weather, Great Beach
reviews.text:
I am a Meeting Planner and coordinate many Sales Meetings and Executive meetings throughout the year and the meeting I most recently planned at Paradisus Cancun from Jan 12 - 15, 2015 was by far the best location and meeting in my many years of doing this. 
The resort is absolutely beautiful and spotlessly clean. As a meeting planner I was very impressed with the level of service we (I) received since it was an all-inclusive resort. 
Our group was given a private check in area which made group arrivals quick and easy. We were also all handed a delicious drink upon entering which was much appreciated after a long travel day. All the rooms in my room block were clean, well decorated and well stocked. Those of us that had an ocean view couldn't have been happier. 
Lorena Gonzalez was my Conference Sales Manager and she was beyond amazing. Everytime I needed her she was right there, very friendly, helpful and knowlegeable. I wish every CSM was as great as she is. Large meeting groups can be picky and hard to deal with pleasing and she did such a wonderful job of accomodating my group. She really helped make my life much easier on-site as well as making me look like super star to my group. 
The A/V company that Paradisus uses (JSAV) was also top-notch. All equipment was provided and for a reasonable cost and was also in good working condition. They also had someone outside the meeting space for the entire 3 days of our meeting so if there had been a problem (and there wasn't) they were there to help immediately. I was impressed by this. 
There are many different food options on the property that were all good so there was no reason for people to leave the property if they didn't want to. There were also ample bars inside and outside so people could find a social place to hang out. 
The beach is simply amazing with plenty of lounge chairs, umbrellas and even a bunch of covered canopy ceach beds. The beach also had volley ball, soccer, etc... which we as a group took advantage of during some free time. 
All the staff I encountered was incredibly friendly and ready to serve you. My drink was never empty and if I was seen sitting outside the meeting room by a Paradisus employee I was greeted with a smile and warm Hola and offered a drink, food or dessert. 
I visited the AMAZING YHI spa for a massage and for that hour I was in heaven. The spa facilities are very impressive and the services were incredible. 
Overall - our experience as a business group of people from all over the US we loved our stay at Paradisus. I personally can not wait to get back there for vacation and hope I can have our meeting there again next year. I highly reccommend this resort to all meeting planners!!

reviews.author: Ali D
reviews.title: Another Great Stay at Pardisus
reviews.text: This was our second time back to the resort and we were pleased once again. The last time we stayed here we were on the adults only side. And this time we stayed in the larger side. We had a lagoon view (not ocean) and we were very pleased with it. Our room had a really large and nice balcony but it didn't have any furniture with was a little odd. The pool had plenty of seating and the experience was awesome. We loved Laura, one of the pool attendants. She was on it! The swim up bar team was good and the pool activities provide some good entertainment when if you do not participate. We aren't big all inclusive people however this property is one of the best. The food is really good and we found the quality is higher than others. I highly recommend this property and we look forward to returning.

reviews.author: InfininitusEquitas
reviews.title: Great, not perfect.
reviews.text:
Overall Paradisus Cancun is a good spot to spend a vacation.  You won't regret going there.

I opted for the Royal Service upgrade, and that was definitely worth it.  You have access to a separate tower, separate pool area with plentiful cabanas, and a separate beach front restaurant.  Not to mention better liquor in the base of the tower anytime you want it.  I also had a bottle of vodka delivered to my room, and any drink arrived generally within 20 minutes or less.

My private concierge was completely useless - never really around, and gave bad advice regarding tours, but the staff member that were present were always helpful.

I do suggest bringing lots of singles to tip, you will get noticeably better service.

The room itself is pretty standard fare for a resort, clean, lots of marble, medium sized bathtub.

Another perk of the royal service is you get to use the spa areas as much as you want.  The facilities were nice, but showing their age.  That said, on a rainy day it helps to still be able to get into water and relax after a hard night of partying.

With one notable exception - the mexican restaurant - the other restaurants on premises were pretty good, although service was slow.  Food was not of the highest quality, but perfectly in line with medium price restaurants.

The breakfast/lunch buffet were nice, but didn't have a very wide variety.  They also seemed to constantly run out of the more popular specialty dishes.

The dinner buffet was also acceptable, but nothing to rave about.  With the exception of the new years dinner, I really was expecting more.  On the plus side they were open up to 2am, which is nice for when you want a post drinking snack, coming back from the clubs.

In terms of location, it will take you a good 10-15 minutes by bus or cab to reach the club strip, which is fine. The bus coming back can be an excruciatingly long ride though.

While they advertise having two clubs on premises, based on my new years experience there is really not much going on at the hotel itself at night.

Assuming you don't have bad luck with the weather, it's definitely a nice place to stay.

reviews.author: Jess S
reviews.title: Last Minute January Vacation
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled to Paradisus last week (1/11-11/16). We had a great time. The hotel was very clean and the staff was very nice. 

Pros: 
Very Clean! (Rooms, Beach, Pool, Bathrooms)

The pools are very large and clean. The pool swim up bar was amazing and the bar tenders were the best! (Eric and Enrique treated us like royalty the entire trip)

The food selections were wonderful. We tried all of the restaurants but our favorites were the sushi restaurant, the buffet and Blue Agave. (Note: you do not need to make a reservation at Blue Agave or the buffet. All of the other restaurants require a reservation)

The Beach was very nice, the water was crystal clear and it was very clean. I only saw about one or two vendors on the beach which was nice.

I liked the fact that the non-motorized water sports were included. We did kayaking twice and paddle boarding once. The open up at 9am and we were there both days at that time to start the day!

Cons:
The hotel did advertise pool side activities. While they did have them some days other days they did not. It would have been nice to have some music while relaxing poolside. 

The show each evening was pretty good however it was located in a bad spot with very limited seating. If you didn’t get there at least an hour early you would be standing for the show.

The staff did try to sell us off resort excursions everywhere we went. We did decide to go on a snorkeling half day trip. This excursion was sold to us by Amstar. I would give the trip 3 stars. We did have fun but the coral was not very colorful and there were few fish to be scene. They also advertised a full buffet and bar. We got a piece of fruit, a piece of pastry and a beer out of some 40oz bottle. Overall a so/so trip.

Overall we had a great time!

reviews.author: ihatejjredick
reviews.title: Good......depending what you're looking for
reviews.text:
My buddy and I are in our early 30's and were looking for a fun spot to visit for a quick four day vacation. We stayed at Paradisus 1/16-1/19.

Pros:
- plenty of food options (note: room service for food included with all-inclusive)
- friendly staff
- buffet is good and available for all three meals for a quick meal
- great beach and pool bar
- very affordable
- very clean rooms

Cons:
- Very dated look and feel (included a 90 minute lip syncing Michael Jackson musical routine)
- Tons of amenities but you must seek them out constantly
- zero nightlife
- food is hit or miss
- Only four beers in fridge per day and they will charge if you want more

Overall I liked Paradisus but I wouldn't stay there again. Not because it is a bad place but because I'd rather see a different Cancun resort and see if I like it more.

Paradisus appeared to be perfect for older couples and families. Anyone looking for a party atmosphere or an ideal honeymoon spot will be disappointed.

If you want a relaxing, affordable vacation spot in Cancun you can do alot worse than Paradisus.

reviews.author: Alexander S
reviews.title: Great Time On New Years
reviews.text:
I stayed here were there a couple of friends this past years. But the hotel six months in advance and get a great deal.

When I came in for check-in I was suggested to upgrade to Royal Service, a different part of the hotel with an all inclusive package for drinks and food.

I had a personal lounge with the personal butler and a personal Full bar. My weeklong stay was amazing, I had no worries I had time to relax from the world. Cancun was full of tourists I had a great time will come again.

reviews.author: Lucky_V8
reviews.title: Happy new year
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of staying here from 27th December for 11 nights. My wife and family (aged 21, 18, 18) all thoroughly enjoyed the Paradisus and would especially recommend Royal Service. Special thanks to Cesar, Francisco and Omar for the service received.

reviews.author: SaraJ314
reviews.title: Great winter getaway!
reviews.text:
Me, my husband and our 6 year old stayed her Jan 13-18th. Weather was mid 80's only rained one morning. 
Beach-Always clean!!! Soft white sands and clear aqua blue water. Yes the waves are intense...but my 6 year old loved standing at the shore and letting the little waves crash against her. I loved the waves myself (even if I didn't make it out too far)
Room-We stayed in Pyramid 3, floor 6, Lagoon View. We did take a look at the ocean view first but it wasn't worth the extra $60 a day. The lagoon view was beautiful...overlooking the golf course and front of the property. YES pyramid 3 is LOUD at night. However, we were so busy all day that by 930 p.m. we were typically all knocked out. The nightly shows ended between 9 & 9:30 and I honestly never heard much noise after it was over.
Staff- The people who serve you here are literally the heart & soul of this place. No, I didn't stay in Royal Service yet we were STILL treated like royalty (I'm sure it helped that we were always tipping though) Almost every staff I encountered spoke good English. Really appreciated that!
Food- The buffet always had something good. Market grill, try the beef & chicken. Vento..PLEASE get the tenderloin medallion..incredible! Blue agave, great tacos! Mole, this one fell a little flat for me..nothing on the menu looked appetizing and what I ordered was just average at best. The room service hamburger was sooo delicious! Also, I couldn't drink as I am pregnant, but they were always more than happy to make these delicious non alcoholic mango daiquiri's for me and my daughter.
Time Share- Yes, we listened to the time share...that they tried to present as a membership program...sure, if membership program and paying $84,000 cash to pre-pay the next 50 years worth of vacations are the same thing..then okay. Whatever you are into. Xavier is the first salesman we met with, when he couldn't get us to close the deal he called in another closer...who both then began to get sassy and irritated with us.The second closer even made a comment that it is typical for "northerners" to be tight with their money.. hahaha.
Overall, great stay...comfortable rooms. Seeing as we have a small child, we were either at the beach or the kid's pool with is joined with the other pools and has some great loungers in the pool and good seating around the pool which is great for mom & dad. 
This resort I think is best for families with young children and couples looking for a quiet getaway.
And please please tip!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Kamyar K
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text:
We stayed there from January 2 to the 7th. The hotel is very beautiful and the staff are very friendly . 
We had couple of issues when we got there, 1) when we got there they only had a double bed rooms left even though we had asked for king bed .
2) the rooms are very small 3) when we opened the sofa bed the mattress was very dirty and had blood stain on it and the whole sofa was so dirty that it actually had spider web on in the corners . My wife took couple of wipes and tried to clean it but it was very dirty . At this point I was so mad and I asked for a manager to come to our room . Alex came to our room and saw what's going on, he brought a roll away bed and clean sheets . 
The location of the hotel is fantastic , the beaches are beautiful and u don't see many vendors bothering u , the food is very good for an all inclusive hotel . The Buffett is open most of the time and the food is fresh .
Overall I had a very good experience with this hotel and I would stay there again .

reviews.author: D F
reviews.title: Excellent service and food - nothing special for Club Melia members
reviews.text:
We had an 8-day vacation with our college-age kids. The food and service were very good, especially at the Royal Service pool area and La Palapa restaurant. Francisco Terrazas was a standout with his great attitude and conscientious service. We would also like to recognize Roger, Alfonso, Valeria and Arturo for their strong service levels. We also enjoyed the Naos buffet (thanks, Cesar) and the wonderful sushi restaurant (gracias to servers, Cesar and F.). Our overall rating is based on the hard work and strong efforts of the servers and chefs. 
The major negatives had to do with the inconsistent service and information for Club Melia members. This was our first time booking as members and we certainly hope that future vacations are much smoother. We were provided a concierge who offered us no additional service. When we requested a better understanding of the Club Melia services and processes, we were taken on a 1 1/2 hour tour which ended in them trying to sell us ADDITIONAL options rather than addressing our current needs. The manager, Victor, actually walked away without a word once he realized that we were not going to buy. Very disappointing lack of customer focus, especially since we just purchased our vacation club membership last year. So far, it has been confusing with difficulty obtaining consistent information and follow-up.

reviews.author: Walker14
reviews.title: Don’t get fooled by the Paradisus corporate name as the hotel standards are very different from one to another.
reviews.text:
Having been last year at the Paradisus Playa del Carmen, Mexico, for a couple of weeks we decided this year to try the Paradisus in Cancun. After all it is the same hotel brand name so we expected the same quality of installations, services and food. The results were the extreme opposite, from the check-in time to the check-out. The hotel mainly catered to people between 20 to 40 years of age while we were there, mostly South Americans (Brazilian, Argentinian and Colombian), few Americans and Mexicans and fewer Canadians and Russians. All in all, a nice mixture of cultures. 
The following are the great and poor observations:
The great
We were in Mexico.
We got the superb service from the Mexican workers and with a smile.
The poor
At check-in we were told that it makes no difference whether you’re at the hotel 1 day or 2 weeks. Once the room has been assigned to you, if you don’t like it that’s too bad. That response is contrary to what happened at Paradisus Playa del Carmen (or any other hotel when you go for that length of time) where we were given a great room for the two weeks. At this time we were told that the hotel had very strict rules and that the other Paradisus might have more relaxed rules.
The hotel is divided in 5 sections with section 3 being the largest (about 200 rooms). If you’re assigned to this building be prepared to be discomfort from about 7 PM to 3 AM. Most of the restaurants, disco, bars and nightly performances are in the middle of this hollow building. The music is very loud as so are the guests shouting on the corridors. I am providing a tip picture on how to insulate the door from the noise generated during the mentioned times.
The hotel building is very large taking most of the property ground. The recreational areas are very limited perhaps less than 150 ft wide between the building and beach. This area has two large pools and a bar leaving very small room for chairs and walk ways.
There are many stairs to go to the pool or beach that I would not recommend for younger children or older adults.
The beach is perfect for a picture as it is beautiful. The problem is that a red flag is up every day due to ocean roughness along with a very strong undertow. Few people go on the water. The life guards had a big job rescuing guests while we were there.
Cabanas (or palapas as called there) are very few for such a huge hotel, about 60 of them for a hotel with over 1700 guess. What that means is that either you get up at 7 AM to reserve one or you will be on the sun all day. Due to the shortage of shade, it prompted other guests to occupy unattended cabanas creating tension in paradise.
Food quality at the restaurants was nothing to brag about, just ok, as it was with the buffet. The buffet area was also very small and crowded. During our first 4 days the quality of the food was far superior than the remaining days. Perhaps it was due to the extra money we had to pay in comparison to the following weeks in January. Drinks quality was excellent.
Room cleaning was done after 4 PM for our area and we thought it was too late since we were at the beach from 7 AM. Half the time the cleaning would not be done as we were already back in the room by 4 PM and we did not feel to go out for another 45 minutes. A request to have the room done earlier was not in their cards. 
Music at the pool and beach was “head banger” type that kept going for hours. Between the poor music and some cigar smokers it made the outdoor time quite unpleasant.
Restaurant reservations, was a challenge. We were told at check-in to go to the service desk on a daily basis or to phone call to reserve the restaurant time for the next day. The problem is that most of the time the service rep would not be at the desk and no notice was provided. If you tried to call the number provided, many times nobody would answer.
An annoying thing is that the hotel management did not really care whether you were happy during your stay or not, since we got numerous calls during our two weeks trying to sell us their Club Melia timeshare vacations. It seems that if we e.g. (join Club Melia) and spend more money with them the problems we were having would go away immediately.
Conclusion. It seems that the Melia group of hotels, have major issues when branding their hotels names. If I would’ve known that the Paradisus Cancun was going to be so different than from the Playa del Carmen, I would have never reserved it. I also think that logistically the Melia group has major problems that need resolved to better care for their guests.
If you feel like an evening stroll there is nothing in the vicinity. You may take the bus R1 or R2 and go to Plaza La Isla or Plaza Caracol, both have nice ambiance either during the day or late evening. Bus is 10.5 pesos or $1 US.
My special thanks to Sofonia for his great service and conversation, making our staying more enjoyable.
I rated this hotel a 1 due to the misleading corporate name Paradisus that does not keep consistent standards and I feel I wasted a lot of money for little enjoyment, otherwise I would have rated it a 3.

reviews.author: Kim E
reviews.title: Great All Inclusive Family Vacation with a couple of things to be aware of
reviews.text:
My wife and I spent 6 days at Paradisus Cancun with our three grown children ages 23,21 and 18.  Although we did not sign up for Royal Service, minimum age 18, when we originally booked the trip, it was offered to us at check in and we're thrilled we took advantage of it;  for the additional cost it was a great value.  Royal Service has its own building, private pool, beach and a couple of great outdoor restaurants for breakfast and lunch. It's only a 3 minute walk to the main building, Tower 3.  Tower 3 houses all restaurants, clubs and entertainment...if you stay in that tower be prepared for some late night noise. We met a family that put towels around their door to try and block the sound.
Royal Service includes a "butler" who is with you all week; basically a concierge for roughly 6 families at a time. Our butler, Rodrigo, was really great; he handled dinner reservations and helped us plan our week which eliminated much of that "where do we go tonight" stress...hint for dinner reservations make them in advance, the most popular places fill up quickly. Vento and Bana were our favorites, my boys all loved Market Grill (I'm a vegetarian and they very nicely offered to make me a polenta dish!). The food was really good all over the resort, a nice surprise for an all inclusive.
At the pool Bernardo and Arturo who run the beach/pool area for Royal Service were super, especially given the challenges of a holiday week. The resort was full and to say there was a shortage of lounge chairs, is putting it mildly.  One thing that appealed to us about Royal Service, was that I wouldn't have to get out there by 7am and save chairs, but if you didn't claim chairs by 8am, it would be tough to find them, that was a bummer.  Why Paradisus does not keep extra lounge chairs in storage for the busy weeks is a mystery to me.
Additionally, the pool servers Francisco and Rogilio were great and Samuel, the pool bartender was the best. 
The only other negative, which is specific only to the holiday, was the New Years Eve party.  The charge was $235 per person and it was not worth it.  The venue was small, the food was okay, the dancers were good, however, we saw them perform every other night of the week in the main building for free!  The music was awful, there was a soloist during cocktails and she was fun, but the rest of the night was bad, my kids couldn't wait to get out of there. We stayed at the Moon Palace 2 years ago and their New Years Eve Party blew this one out of the water.
The issues with lounge chairs, a couple screw ups with dinner reservations and the New Years Eve disappointment are the only reasons we didn't rate this as "excellent".
The food, friendly staff, cleanliness, beach and the weather we had that week were "excellent"! We would go back.

reviews.author: camp708
reviews.title: Nothing Special
reviews.text: Visited Paradisus for a 3 day business meeting with the all-inclusive package. Nice facility, but not new. In fact, while I was out at meetings, they actually did some painting in my room which resulted in a very toxic smell, strong enough to require me to change rooms. I travel a lot, never had a hotel touch-up paint in the room I occupied. Overall, the food was just OK with the seafood being the highlight. The beef steak I had at La Perla was a very thin cut and therefore not tender. The Japanese restaurant sushi was tasteless. The hotel was relatively empty yet it was not easy getting in the restaurants included in the all-inclusive deal because of the small seating capacity. The buffet did have a wide variety, but again, only the seafood stood out, while the rest was very average. The highlight was the staff - very friendly, spoke English well, and always greeted you with a smile. Paradisus is nothing special, but nothing real negative either other than the untimely painting of my room.

reviews.author: HeatherRaeOchoa
reviews.title: Good Times! Awesome People! Great Service!
reviews.text:
Overall everything was great. For an even better expirence tip, does not have to be extremly large amounts but $1 to $5 US depending on service. 

Resturant Advice:
Buffet as some say does seem cold at times.  It may be some fault of the resort but I always felt the warmth as I plated it but there are so many options by the time you get back to your seat it takes away from the temp! Also it is always a little breezy which may also cool your food. Alot of options,okay taste. 

Outside Evening Barbeque: Good food, alot of options no reservations needed, romantic setting and senery. 

La Perla Mid day Buffet- All Seafood.  Was not horrible, but all the options were very similar. 

Outside Lunch time Pool Side Self serve- Great option to be able to just go up and enjoy at your own pace or us as a snack. Chicken wings! Hambugers! Nachos. 

Mole Dinner Restuarunt- Reservations needed. Awesome food, awesome tempature, Awesome service. Higly recomended. Traditional Mexican Cusine. 

Fuego and Vento Dinner- Both need reservations, not bad but nothing to brag about. 

Bana Dinner- Reservations needed. Sushi. The taste of everything was good, but the tempature for sushi seemed a little too cold. I am sure they are try to be safe rather than sorry. Good service. 

Market Grill for dinner- Very good! Brazilan style! Great service! The stake and lamb is awesome! We went twice if you like rare meat make sure you get a center piece the outsides are no bueno!

Bars!!!!! 
They are all good, just depends on your style or mood. 

The Avenue- Nice relaxing, sit down enjoy your drink, the entertainment and the trail mix and mixed nuts! Good service!

Pool side they take care of you very well (remember your tip). 
Inside is The Avenue- relax sit down great trail mix and mixed nuts. 

The Red Lounge- club style,  good music, super fun times! 

Bana- Okay, we used it to get drinks while watching the shows at the avenue. 

Coco's- The best ever! Before dinner drinks, after dinner dirnks, pre beach walk, after beach walk! The guys there have a wonderfull sense of humor and keep the atmoshphere super lively! Got to give it to them! All around! My favoritest (if that is a word) memories/moments from our vavction started here! Thank you oh so much for the best most speacialized service from my buddies Miguel, Carols and the ever so handsome Antonio Gonzalez!  Thank you for making my vacation the best ever! I wish you the best for you and your wonedrful familes! You guys work hard and desrve the best!

reviews.author: Enrique K
reviews.title: Thank you Keyla Madrid Guzmán
reviews.text:
I want to thank Keyla because thanks to her advice I was able to enjoy this hotel with my wife during our stay.  Keyla paid attention to our tastes and needs and her suggestions were successful.  We spent a great time at Paradisus Cancun, an excellent experience. Keyla's advice as a Concierge was a key to this.
We want to congratulate the hotel staff in general and all the chefs in particular. Food is excellent quality there.
Bar tenders were excellent too.

reviews.author: Ela W
reviews.title: Your buck will take you far...
reviews.text:
Quite frankly I didn't  know what to expect of an all inclusive resort, but it was a great and pleasant surprise. 
Your hard earned money will take you far here. The place has all you need, from restaurants, entertainment, night club to shopping. 
I loved the fact that you can get brand high quality spirits (at least tequila). 
Why in my opinion they are not a 5 stars hotel: 
The place can use some remodeling and need some TLC in certain common areas. 
We went there to celebrate my birthday and told the maître, but didn't get a cupcake for it

reviews.author: MauriceKl
reviews.title: We were thrilled
reviews.text:
After spending 4 previous Cancun vacations in the Moon Palace we were hoping for the best, but prepared to be slightly disappointed. Needless to say, we were not.  The location was wonderful, and the food and beverages were outstanding.

The staff of Paradisus was exceptionally friendly, however we would still like to highlight a few who absolutely shone:

Bruno the concierge always took the time with his helpful suggestion and big smile.

Our favorite restaurant was Bana, with its world class Sushi.  Between the beautiful hostess Jessica, waiter Fabricio, food and beverage manager Mario, and super talented Enrique at the bar, we kept coming back.

The only downer on the trip was that all good things must end, and after 7 days which flew by, we had to go back home.

We can't wait to go back.

Maurice & Renee K.

reviews.author: Vakeyab
reviews.title: The resort is gorgeous, but rooms need to be updated.
reviews.text: This resort is beyond beautiful inside. Unlike any other layout I've ever seen before. One thing I would do are updates in the room. We had a suite that included a kitchen. What's the purpose of the kitchen with no pots, pans, or silverware. Also the wait room when u called and needed things took way to long.

reviews.author: Steve N
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text: From check in to check out .. Service was top notch.. Food was excellent.. Only problem was finding things for our butler to do..  LOL  The cabanas by the pool were a lot of fun as well..We will be back in the near future

reviews.author: David W
reviews.title: Amazing trip.
reviews.text: We have been coming here for about 4 years for a company trip with spouses.  Not a formal trip...just fun.  Everyone here is always very friendly and accommodating.  Endless activities for all ages.  Kids welcome.  Never a complaint.  Always feel safe and secure

reviews.author: MikeP267TT
reviews.title: Great choice for an all-inclusive get-away. Watch for the sales pitch after check-in.
reviews.text:
Pros: Attentive and courteous staff. Clean rooms and public areas all well-maintained. Large hotel (lots of rooms) with awesome pool with a swim up bar. Great beach location. Buffet selection is excellent. 

Cons: New guests arriving are being offered a chance to pre-pay their future vacations at a discounted price through the use of points at all Melia resorts and hotels worldwide by being a CLUB MELIA member (tip: it is going to be a 2 hour sales pitch presentation that will eat up almost half of your day inside instead of being at the beach) which doesn't work for us in our personal situation and had to say NO many times. However, vacation investors (they don't like to call it a "time share" but the concept is the same) and large families might see some benefit. Another con: lack of night life within walking distance.

reviews.author: Tennisgirl14
reviews.title: Exceptional!!!
reviews.text:
My fiancée and I  just came back yesterday from Cancun and stay at this resort and we absolutely LOVE it!!!! We thought the weather was going to be bad but it ended up to be gorgeous so don't believe on the weather.com because weather keep changing. 
The resort was huge and beautiful. There was a lot of walking from one pyramid to another but we did not mind at all. The room was nice and clean with an ocean view and a Jacuzzi tub. They changed sheet every day which I like the most and turn downs leave a chocolate on my bed side at night. 
 We used  YHI SPA for steam showers and Jacuzzi pool for relaxing. The work out facility was great with stretching room and spin class room. The thing I love the most was the chlorophyll Water that you can drink after the work out.
The food was fabulous, we ate at The Mole et Taco and The Market Grill, great buffet selection. The breakfast juices was  AWESOME!!! Fresh and Healthy. (especially the green juice)
The beach was clean and breathe taking and the waves were so much fun.  We did not stay in the pool but it was beautiful. 
The staff were all friendly, helpful and always smiling. We feel like at home!
The 30 minute show every night was a must see. They were all good and talented people and we love the variety of shows. 
The bartenders were all attentive and making sure we were taken care off. We are not big drinkers but their mix drinks were so delicious. WIfi was not bad at all but then again we did not came here to work.
We came here to relax and enjoy the beach and were impressed with the wonderful services we received from all the staff ( housekeeping, grounds, servers, front desk, concierge, bartenders etc... you name it) I work for the Waldorf Astoria Hotels and I know what good service is.
We were thinking of coming in May!!! And we can't wait.

reviews.author: Peter W
reviews.title: Someone shoot the DJ
reviews.text: Apart from the music which had the same boring boring beat from sunrise to sunset, and i like everything from Emimen to Elvis would be a big factor in not returning to this hotel.The staff where always helpful and friendly and in particular Edgar Mesevo who severed breakfast to us on several occasions in the Naos rest. Let me know if the Dj pops is socks.

reviews.author: Linda1079
reviews.title: Sooooo.....Sad! Today is our last day!
reviews.text:
This is our third stay at this wonderful resort in  two years. If your traveling with all adults the Royal Service section is definitely worth the extra cost. It is a seperatate wing of the hotel which is adults only. The atmosphere is spa like. Could not be more relaxing. Perfect for a couple who do not share the love of the sun. I can lounge in the shaded bed at the pool while my husband bakes in the sun next to me. Many different restaurants to choose from. The best breakfast buffet. 
This resort is not new but maintained to the 10's.
We thought this year we would try a new resort and booked a 7 night stay at Dreams Sands Cancun. We stayed 1 night. The resort is old and advertises itself as new. The resort is very very poorly managed.

reviews.author: avb2k
reviews.title: How disappointing for that amount of money
reviews.text:
This is my first review of a hotel in my life. I have been to many many hotels and never felt I needed to add to the reviews that already existed until now.

First the positive, the food is decent in this hotel and the location, pool and beach are pleasant and the inside is well done.

Now to the part which made me want to write a review: We had booked an 8 day stay at their family concierge service for over 5000$ for the three of us (my wife and our 2 yr old son)
I had asked for an early check in at 2 pm instead of 3 pm before we arrived so we could freshen up and take care of the needs of the two year old.

We got ushered into the family concierge area which I thought was a nice start but I was wrong. Of course early check in was not available. The whole check in procedure took over 45 minutes with crying kids in the background and total disorganization from the check in staff. After traveling for 8 hours with a child it would have been nice if our stuff would have been ready and check in would have been fast. My inlaws that had booked a regular room checked in within 10 minutes. They also paid 1000$ for their stay. 
After waiting until 4 our room was finally available and we were taken by a lady called Fernanda to our room in pyramid 3. I asked her if there would be any noise since the room was above the main bar especially having our child in mind and she said, there was never a complaint about noise. So I trusted her.
At 8 o clock at night just when our little one went off to sleep it was like a night club in our room. The music was so loud it was almost damaging to our ears. Needless to say I asked the next day to be moved and they could only accommodate us the following day.
We were moved to pyramid 1, which was very quiet. The room was ok but there was a wet puddle on the floor from the AC which was dangerous on the tiles for slipping. Other issues we had was that the minibar was never refilled nor the coffees etc. We had to call for it almost every day.
At the family concierge area we booked a bali bed for 50$ per day which was dirty when we arrived and it took the gentleman an hour to make those beds in the morning. We encountered drunk party people with beers in their hands in the morning in the kids area, couples on lounge chairs without kids smoking. There was no one that told them off our asked them to go to a different section of the hotel/pool
Our inlaws did everything that we did but paid 1000$ less. I must say that our child did receive during the stay a coloring book, 5 cookies and a marionette when we left. But is that really worth 1000$? I think the family concierge thing is a scam as we could have had the same benefits minus the cookies etc for 1000$ less. If you have a kids program you should maybe have the kids needs at heart by giving quieter rooms, more attention, faster check in, no smoking area?

At check out we got overcharged 150$ which was due to the exchange rate eventhough our booking was confirmed in dollars. The lady Maria at the concierge kept saying she would sort it out but blamed the overcharge on our bank and to date we have not heard from her.

I think the hotel is good if you get a decent rate but for the rate we paid we can have a lot better especially with kids in mind

reviews.author: Nance08
reviews.title: Cancun Getaway At Paradisus
reviews.text: Escaping the grey skies of Nashville, my husband and I headed to an all-inclusive 5 night vacation in pretty Cancun. We were contemplating St. Lucia or St. Thomas, but, for the money, this proved to be an incredible getaway.  The last time I was in Mexico I got food poison from room service so I was a little hesitant.  We tried all the restaurants with the exception of Tempo, which cost extra.  All the food was good quality particularly Bana, Fuego, Mole - which we loved.  If you want a little quiet past 10 pm, choose any building but 3.  We stayed on the 5th floor of building 1 - perfect ocean view!  The staff were very attentive - a departure from my previous Mexico experiences.  In fact, the swim-up bartenders had on adorable TripAdvisor shirts.  From check-in to room maids to people just walking around.....everybody was on board with being a good host or employee.  LOVED it. The facilities were beautiful. The ocean perfect. We were going to rent a $100 bed on the beach. We thought we needed a little more shade and a little less loud music but a fun option if you like that sort of thing! I also had a 80 minute deep tissue massage - fabulous!!!  This hotel earned my 5 stars and we would like to visit again! PS- the wifi did go in and out....but overall, we were able to get it at the beach and pool and were pleasantly surprised.

reviews.author: murdog
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text:
My sister and I came here for 3 nights.  We have been to Cancun many times, and have stayed at a handful of different places.  The service was good, and the hotel staff was friendly.  When we entered the hotel, we were led to a check in room as we passed by a large desk that looked as if it should be the check in area.  After waiting for around 20 minutes we were finally helped.  We got all checked in and went up to the room.  It was small.  We looked through the refrige area, looking for drinks.  Everywhere else that we have stayed has had top shelf alcohol in the rooms.  The bell hop came up with our luggage and said there was no alcohol in the rooms and that we would have to go downstairs to the bar.  
The accommodations were just ok.  The room never really cooled off.  The majority of the hotel was always very humid.  
The food was good at all of the restaurants that we went to.
We mainly went to Cancun just to relax by the pool and beach.  I must say that our favorite person in the whole place was Laura at the poolside bar.  She was very friendly and always kept our drinks filled- if we wanted them.  
When we travel together, my sister and I like to talk to other people, and maybe hang out with new friends for the duration of a trip.  There was really no one here our age (40's), with similar interests. 
We didn't find a lot of night life either.
Another con of this hotel is that they don't take US Dollars.  I found that very strange, and annoying.  Everywhere we have stayed is happy to take US.  I needed something from the gift shop and came in from the pool, wanting to just charge it to my room.  They said that I didn't have a credit card on file.  I know I presented it to them at check in.   I had to go all the way up to the room to get my credit card.
The check out process seemed to be odd too.  My sister had an earlier flight than I, so she left before me.  She had to get a check out card so that she could leave the hotel, although I was checking out a few hours later.  
After I had checked out, I was talking to the cab driver.  He said that there are some hotels that are marketed to Mexico City and other areas around Mexico.  Being from the US, I had no idea about this.  We won't stay here again.  I will stick with the Palace Resorts!!

reviews.author: CanCharlie
reviews.title: Recommended, see tips
reviews.text:
Our 4th trip to Mexico, this is the best resort we've stayed.  Travelled with 2 adults and 2 children (2 and 5).  Dec 11-19th, 2014.  
Fantastic food, we expect mediocre food in Mexico resorts...not this place.  Their food was amazing.  Those who complain about food from this resort are clearly complainers who didn’t try everything.  Service was always friendly, always.  Felt safe and secure at all times in the entire resort (we had two small children).  We aren’t the ‘drop the kids off’ type of parents so we didn’t try the kids club, although we did visit the centre to play, they enjoyed it.  Many beach chairs/huts available (more than most hotels on the strip).  Sand is incredible in Cancun compared to Mayan (for those who have only been to 1 or the other).  A few things to point out though:  Pools are not kid friendly.  The main pool is too deep, too deep for adults even (over 5.5 feet throughout with no shallow end!!)  No real kid’s pool.  The main pool was extremely cold, I am from Canada and I thought it was too cold!!  During our stay we only saw a few people in the main pool the entire time we were there due to the depth and cold.  The smaller pool in front of the restaurant is warmer, but also not kid friendly.  Our room had no view, not even of the lagoon unless you went out on the balcony (we didn’t mind too much as we were never in our room during daylight).  Stay in a tower close to the main building, otherwise you have a really long walk to the restaurants/beach.  Close to the airport (no 2 hour bus ride like Mayan).  Room service was easy and quick.  Did I mention the food was a surprise and fantastic?  Rooms were clean and very nice (although they had a lot of fruit flies in the bathroom, seen this in lots of places though).  They provided us a baby crib in a moments notice.  Great selection of food/beer/water/juice in the free mini bar.  Free wi-fi, always worked for us with no issues.
If you are looking for a true kids resort (waterslides, toys, pools, etc.) then this might not be it, but our kids enjoyed it.  If you are looking for a resort that is tops in service, food, beach and safety - we highly recommend it.      
We will wait until our children are older, but this resort is a must return at some point.  Highly recommend it.  Let me know if you have specific questions before your trip.

reviews.author: leINDIA
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Cancun
reviews.text: This hotel is the reason I keep coming back to Cancun. The staff, food, and ambiance is great.
