reviews.author: PeglegofSurrey
reviews.title: Hotel is mainly disabled accessible apart from the pool so most enjoyable
reviews.text:
As the hotel caters for families in the other part of their complex who come over in the evenings for the restaurants/shows, the whole area was totally accessible and my husband hired a mobility scooter for 10 days that really made a difference to how he could get around. We went for the Royal Service and would recommend it most heartedly.  The La Palapa restaurant has a step up but they have a ramp for wheelchair users. The Capitain, Pablo, keeps a watchful eye on everything going on to ensure it is smooth running including waiting at tables when busy.  He always has a beaming welcoming smile. Lizbet at reception ensured we always had a table close to the plinths so that my husband could get himself up from the table more easily when finished and would always give us a helping hand over the step The waiters were also very helpful and made a point of remembering what we usually had for breakfast. We took a taxi on a couple of occasions and the main reception ensured that it was large enough to accommodate the scooter. The pool staff were extremely good with Alfredo very proud of his badge of honour as being so helpful and the cocktail staff made up some very interesting cocktails to your choice of drinks. Ximenta at Pool Resources does a splendid job ensuring that all is running smoothly around the pool and gave us help on quite a few occasions putting the towels on the Bali Beds that we had to use when available because of the extra equipment we needed, including a spare water leg.  However there were a lot of people getting up very early to nab the Bali beds and one couple also reserved a Bali plus a day bed by the pool as well every day.  They were constant chain smokers so the fumes coming over were a source of irritation to non-smokers and she also smoked constantly at the pool bar.  Perhaps there should be a separate smoking area. . 
The pool has a major drawback as there is no rail going down into the pool and the steps down are all the same colour so you cannot see where they finish to the next step and quite a few people complained that it was a bit scary, particularly as the steps were a bit on the slippery side.  Luckily a lot of guests came to our rescue on the occasions when we went for a swim. Although we had a swim-up room, we found the water quite cold as it is connected to the main La Perla pool so it was not worth the extra money and also is was more interesting to be around the Royal heated pool talking to people.  The room was very well appointed with plenty of towels and toiletries but the possible drawback for English people is that it only has a coffee filter machine and no tea making facilities.  You would have to ring for room service to get a pot of tea.
We tried most of the restaurants and people's choice of food varies but we found the waiter service at La Palapa and the food there to our liking as well as the ambience compared with the cold air/conditioning and noisiness of some of the other restaurants and also preferred not to have children around as we tend to eat early and children are allowed to be around until 9pm.

reviews.author: DerekRomo
reviews.title: Our home away from home
reviews.text:
We have just booked our fourth stay at the Paradisus and I could go on for hours about why this is our home away from home.  After our first trip we tried other resorts.  Each of them failed to live up to the standards set by the amazing team at Paradisus Cancun.

This January 2015 we will spend our 5th wedding anniversary in the Mexican resort that has the best beds, most delicious food and superlative service.  We are especially looking forward to seeing Margolis at the beach and pool-- she is an excelent example of the personal connection that the team here makes to deliver an amazing experience.

Look at all the sites, check out all the other resorts.  Book here.  That is all.

reviews.author: nora d
reviews.title: Tired rooms, not enough sun lounges, great buffet.
reviews.text:
Stayed in pyramid one, the rooms are very tired and the A/C is so loud. The lobby area is stunning, the beach is also great. 
The only problem is trying to gets sun lounger, the ones they do have on the beach are falling apart. There are Bali beds,$50 a day, loads around the pools weren't being used but people were sat on towels on the ground. Unacceptable. I have never had this problem at a hotel.
Naos buffet was great, fabulous selection and very fresh.
The kids club was fantastic, the staff were very patient with my 2 children and they had a great time.
I would love to return but don't fancy sitting on a sandy towel on the beach everyday.

reviews.author: johnwA2308IY
reviews.title: ZEN
reviews.text:
The hotel atmosphere was very quiet and smelled good. Zen is the word that comes to my mind that this hotel brings.To me, this hotel seemed very spa oriented with a touch of Asia. If you are looking for a hotel with a big night life, this is not it. Also, I can't imagine ever bringing kids to this hotel. To be fair, we did stay in the adult only Royal section. I wouldn't come here without having the Royal Service either. 
The food was OK. Not horrible but nothing I would brag about. The pool is lovely, but one thing to know, bring your own suntan lotion. Even though it is provided at the pool with the Royal Service, they prefer you stand there at the towel hut to put it on then leave it. It's very expensive in the gift shop and not to be found when shopping. The pool cabanas were lovely. You are able to reserve one twice at the pool but on the beach they are first come - never a problem getting a covered spot in the Royal only section. I don't know what it would be like if it were busier. We were there the first week of Dec. 2014.
Everyone in the hotel was very nice (except maybe 1 guy at the towel hut) but otherwise everyone seemed genuinely please to have us there. Our butler had a very kind soul. You could just tell. His name was Layner.
Overall, we had a very relaxing time. Maybe too quiet for us, but I know that's just what many would want.

reviews.author: Familyfun21
reviews.title: Excellent Stay at Paradisus, Cancun
reviews.text:
My family of five plus extended family (15 in total) stayed for Christmas week and we had a great time.  The staff is really outstanding and go out of their way to make you feel comfortable.  In particular, Tony Rocha at Naos restaurant was so accommodating and generous of his time and attention.  We have stayed at many places over the years and he is one of the best!
The resort itself is beautiful and clean.  We had a lagoon view room and it was just right for us.  The pools and swim up bar are nice and we learned about half way through that the one in front of Market Grille is heated at certain times of the day.  I highly recommend Fuego restaurant for fine dining.  Vento was also excellent and Market Grille for the Brazilian style meats is also very good.
Weather was nice but quite windy each day, but that made for some good body surfing conditions.  The beach was clean and so close.  We did scuba diving one day and set it up through AquaWorld right on site.  Book it through JJ....he is the best and took extra time to help teach my kids who were doing it for the first time.  He is very patient and knowledgeable.  Other than scuba, we really didn't leave the resort.  We also played beach volleyball and soccer and made use of the tennis court which could use a little maintenance.  There aren't a ton of other activities, so I think any longer than a week would have been too long for us.
The evening shows were excellent and professional.  There was good variety with a different theme each night, however the seating arrangement for the shows is terrible.  When the resort is full, if you don't get there early you will never see the performers.
Overall I would recommend Paradisus, Cancun.  It's a big resort like many at Cancun, so as long as you aren't expecting something small and quaint, it's a great place.

reviews.author: Czielin
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: This was my first time in Mexico and it was just wonderful! We went for a week in December before Christmas (my boyfriend and I) and it just felt like complete luxury! We paid the extra for the Royal Service and it was well worth it. We were worried because we wanted to go to an adults-only resort but decided on this one. We barely ran into any kids this whole time. The place is HUGE and we spent the first few days getting lost. :) It was very fun to try different restaurants every night. Our personal butler was amazing, he took care of all of our reservations and things we wanted to do outside the restort! HERVIK is the #1!!! He took such great care of us, "Lopez cousins"! Really loved the Market Grill restaurant and Fuego which we had on our last night- what a great time-- our server Ivan was the best we had all week!! The pools were great and the ocean view was awesome. Hervik recommended a deep sea fishing excursion for us as well as snorkeling and they both highly exceeded our expectations, we caught some awesome giant fish and had an amazingly long day snorkeling! Our side with the Royal Service had open bar and our own adult pool. The whole place smelled amazing too from the moment you walk in you are greeted with such warmth! Not too far from the airport either. Thank you for the best vacation i've had in years!!!

reviews.author: Robyn C
reviews.title: So Great I'm going back.
reviews.text:
I am super late but better late than never!! I traveled to Cancun, Mexico back in July of 2014 for my 30th birthday with one friend.  This was a ladies trip!! It was very last minute so we decided to stay at Paradisus because it was a great deal at the time and it had pretty decent reviews.  Once we arrived, we were upgraded to Royal Service, which is located in the 5th tower (pyramid) because they were booked solid. Beware, because they will attempt to sell you royal service and when you decline they have no other choice but to put you in the Royal Service tower because there are no other available rooms.  However, I would totally pay for Royal Service next time because there is no other way to stay at this resort unless it is a family vacation.  We were told we "were not" Royal Service because we did not pay the extra fee.  However, once in that tower (and you receive your all inclusive arm band) you are Royal Service.  

First, the pictures on the website and most of the traveler photos listed on this site do this resort absolutely no justice.  It is simply beautiful and breathtaking.  It always smells great and is very clean.  Some say the smell in the common areas is a bit overwhelming but I enjoyed the fresh scent everyday.  Royal Service is secluded from the other parts of the resort and has a private pool, private pool bar w/ great servers, private dining, and many other private amenities.  However, those are the ones we used the most.  

You have to be sure to build a relationship with one of the servers and tip well and you will be treated awesome.  However, we were treated awesome well before we ever tipped our server.  He is soooo awesome and I pray that he is still there when we return this year.  His name is Ephraim (I hope I spelled that right)  He is simply amazing!! He treated us well, he always made sure we had something to drink or eat, he was very attentive, he made great suggestions, and he always seemed happy to see us.  We layed out by the pool and beach at least once a day during our stay and he was working the entire time.  We loved him so much that we were a bit excessive in our tipping but he definitely deserved it.  He kept us very happy.  Although, I feel that the resort was awesome he made our experience much better.

We have traveled the carribean and stayed at many different all-inclusive resorts.  However, we had never stayed at a resort at the capacity of Paradisus.  We were excited to learn that 9 out of the 10 restaurants were included in the all inclusive amenities and there was always something going on to keep us entertained and our belly's full.  The restaurants were absolutely amazing but you must make a reservation in order to dine there.  We were able to enjoy 3 out of the 10.  I believe the only one that is not included in the all-inclusive amenities is Tempo, which looked absolutely amazing.  We were told it is not included and the executive chef is award-winning chef Martin Berasategui so it was well worth it.  While we were there the resort hosted a BBQ and the food was absolutely amazing.  If we wanted music and a party we could head over to one of the other pools and there was always a ton of people and a lot of action going on.  However, if we wanted some quiet we could make our way back to the Royal Service pool.  This is a kid-friendly resort.  However, you would never know because it is sooo large and there is a lot for kids to do.  

There was so much to do in the resort that we only left the resort twice to go downtown to enjoy the nightlife and jetskiing over at aquaworld.  There are 10 restaurants, a number of bars, and a swanky bar/lounge called the red lounge which stays open until 1am.  

We were satisfied and this was money well spent.  We will definitely be going back to Paradisus again this year with more people to join in on our experience.  And yes, we will be paying extra for the complete Royal Service experience.

reviews.author: Peter G
reviews.title: Amazing - First Class
reviews.text: Paradisus was amazing.  First the staff was tremendous.  They were all very friendly, helpful and smiled the entire time making sure if we needed anything they got it for us.  It was very clean both in the room and all the common areas of the resort.  They have several different restaurants that you can choose from and the food was excellent.   They have 3 pools.  One of them has a swim up bar.  Outside grounds are well maintained and clean.  The beach is beautiful and they have outside beds that can be used along with plenty of beach chairs.  Beach and water is beautiful.  I can't wait to go back!!!

reviews.author: weatherman2003
reviews.title: Wonderful and Relaxing
reviews.text:
Stayed here back in February 2014 and was very pleased with my choice.  The ride from the airport was not very long at all and the check-in process was very quick and painless.  We were off to our room and onto the beach within a 1/2 hour tops.  

The room was great and exactly what were were expecting.  If you can, upgrade to the ocean view rooms.  One of the most relaxing things I did every day was to wake up and watch the sun come up on our balcony overlooking the ocean with coffee.  Best way to start the day!  

The lobby is amazing and all of the pics you see with the plants, trees, vines, coy pond, etc don't do it justice!  It's beautiful and really makes this hotel great and unique.  We upgraded to the Royal Concierge service - HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!  This meant that we had a room in one of the towers on the side, away from the main tower which got more foot-traffic and was a bit noisier.  We were so happy we upgraded to the concierge service.  Our butler was amazing and gave us everything we needed.  Every morning we had a bed reserved in the private pool section (only guests with concierge service can stay there).  We had priority dinner reservations made everyday. 

We really enjoyed Bana Restaurant as we're seafood/sushi lovers.  But Mole was delicious as well.  The food here was really good, and the breakfast/lunch options at the buffet were perfect and always seemed fresh.  Lunch at the Market Grill was always pleasant and right on the water, couldn't ask for anything more on a beach vacation.  With the royal service we also had access to a private bar and snack area every day, anytime we wanted.  Aside from the top shelf liquors that we could poor ourselves, we could enjoy a variety of snacks (meats, cheeses, etc).  It was perfect for when you didn't want to load up on a full lunch after a few days of doing that.  

Would absolutely stay here again on another visit to Cancun.

reviews.author: Mido
reviews.title: Very nice hotel
reviews.text: I highly recommend this hotel, the pool area is very good , the beach side was not that good as the ocean was bit dangerous (march) and was raining sometimes, the room is nice and the decor of the hotel is very nice, they also have live singer during the night . u  have a bus in front of the resort that can take u to the restaurants and market area and coco bongo which is handy, also thebes thing about the room is the balcony, its so private that noone can see you ( in a pyramid architect )  highly recommended for couples - visited march 2012

reviews.author: Rampr
reviews.title: Average to poor experience
reviews.text: Resort was clean. Not kid friendly. No kid activities except for a large pool. No entertainment in the evening. Food is vegetarian unfriendly and insensitive. The restaurants made an effort at serving vegetarian food but they had very little concept. Resort is old and rooms need a lot of reoairs. They say they have free wifi but it does not work in the rooms

reviews.author: Tina M
reviews.title: Good hotel!
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice.  Decent food and drinks.  The staff was very friendly.  We loved the bar in the center of the hotel in between the first floor and floor zero.  The bartenders were awesome!  Ask for the jellyfish shot!

reviews.author: Evan L
reviews.title: Exceeded my expectations
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun was an overall amazing vacation experience that I would recommend to anyone, especially couples (as I went with my girlfriend) as the hotel is more adult themed with it's high end restaurants and zen decor. I would definitely recommend paying the extra fee for All Inclusive "Royal Service" as it truly is a grand treatment with private check in, a whole adults only wing of the hotel with a massive private lounge area and self serve bar/snack station. We stayed in a beachfront Jr. Suite and the room was spacious, clean, comfortable ad had stunning views of the Caribbean Sea steps away from our balcony. Royal Service also has it's own adults only pool area with cabanas. Each room in Royal service comes with Butler service and we had Sergio who was great. He took care of reservations for all our dinners, beachside cabana, activities etc..
Overall the food was really good and we enjoyed all the meals, and especially liked the tapas spot "Vento". As a New Yorker I'm pretty picky about food quality and I have to say I was impressed with the level of quality and service. All the employees were fantastic..Sergio, Leyner, Lazaro, and all the female staff that helped us out as well. 
We also rented a car across the street at Payless for $50.00 USD and took a day trip to the Tlum Mayan ruins, snorkeled the Mesoamerican Coral Reef, and swam in the Dos Ojos Cenote, all of which were must see things to do and well worth the 1.5 hour drive.

reviews.author: lisakaj88
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: We went to the Paradisus Cancun for a friends birthday and had a wonderful time.  Antonio G., Octavio and Jose were very good to us and helped with all our needs.  We were greeted the moment we stepped out of the van from the airport.  Everyone was very friendly and always greeted us with smiles.  The pool is beautiful and the staff were always coming to ask us if we wanted anything to drink or eat.  The food and drinks were very good. Our ocean view room was just beautiful. It was so nice opening up the glass door in the morning to hear the ocean and feel the breeze.  Royal service is the way to go at this resort.  Our group is planning to return there next year as we really enjoyed ourselves.

reviews.author: lynzc
reviews.title: Just what was needed!
reviews.text:
Having returned from 2 weeks at the Paradisus in Mexico, we are now looking forward to returning! Everything wad fantastic and having experienced the Royal Service we were never asking for anything. The staff could not do enough for you and were friendly while being professional. We perhaps expected more from the room, based on previous hotels but to be fair, The room was comfortable and had what you needed. It was spacious and had nice furnishings. One thing could be to maybe put 2 chairs on the balcony rather than 1 Sun lounger.
The food was if a consistent standard which was very good and there was something for everyone. On a par with this was the service. Jose our butler was wonderful, especially considering he hadn't been there that long. Victor on our reception in the Royal Service was also friendly and helpful. Then there were David and Alexander, the boys who attended to the Royal Service Bali beds in the pool area. You couldn't ask for a nicer group of people to look after you.
We would definitely recommend and return.

reviews.author: Rocky49009
reviews.title: All Inclusive what a way to go
reviews.text:
Our trip was sooo relaxing. It was great to not have to worry about carrying around cash or credit cards at our stay. (Although, we did take extra for tips, even if it was included. Cuz its just the way we roll.) 
Shopped one day, did 2 excursions. Booked with Etienne, the friendly good looking Frenchman. We did the Tulum Jungle Maya and Israel was our funny informative guide. These two gentleman were 5 star in themselves. 
The other trip was right down the street from our hotel we drove speed boats out to the coral reef, Alex was our guide, he was quite the funny informative man also. 
Shopping is another story some of the store owners are very pushy but hey guess that's how they make there living. Probably will not go back to do that again.

The accommodations were 5 star. We would of did the spa thing but thought it was over price, even if they offered a special everyday. But of course I really have no idea what the going rate is for spa service these days.  Juanito was our go to dude for butler service, was a very interesting informative guy, if there is a return will most likely ask for him :)
David at the pool was awesome, even the one day of bad weather, he had a smile on his face and got our Bali bed ready, we put him in charge of getting the weather to straighten out, it didn't quite happen but he did put up a awesome rainbow out our 5th floor room facing the beautiful blue ocean. 
The whole staff was so accommodating, always a smile, and hey can I help you. 
Please if you get the chance book here and do it all inclusive. All eating places were good except the steak place the cuts of meat there aren't quite up to par, but the salad bar made up for it.
All places are casual dress except for one. If you plan to take your family they have separate place in the hotel for you. And it looks like the kids do have fun. There are a lot of activities for all ages during the day to do, along with exercises. Oh and you can't beat the weather. 
Enjoy

reviews.author: lkbNorthDakota
reviews.title: Love this place!
reviews.text: We recently stayed here from January 13-22. It was our 7th time at this motel, the first since it changed to Paradisus. We had a fantastic time! We stayed in the Royal Service tower, which we loved. We were greeted at check in by Marisol, from the vacation club. Even though she knew we weren't interested in joining the club, she was always so friendly when she would see us. Hector, our butler, was always so nice, and helpful with our questions. When we told him my zipper on my suitcase had ripped, he went to our room and hand-sewed it himself...very impressive! We were extremely happy with how nice all the staff were,but the service at the pool area was EXCEPTIONAL! Every morning David would greet us, and prepare our Bali bed. He always made a point of saying goodbye to us when we left each afternoon. We appreciated his kindness. Rogelio, our waiter, was SOOOOOO Awesome! He would bring us drinks before we even ordered them. And he always had a smile on his face! Octavio was also a nice waiter that we had. We saw Asuncion on our last day there. We remembered her from our previous years there, and she always took great care of us. The food at the pool grill was the best we had in the whole motel. A special thank you to their chef-Axel. The drinks were good, but could have used more alcohol in them. I really appreciated the free WIFI in our rooms, and even on the beach. We love this place so much, and will never stay anywhere else in Cancun.

reviews.author: aagoncillo
reviews.title: Excellent through and through
reviews.text: Paradisus, in regards to the hotel was remarkable.  From the first moment you stepped into the hotel it felt like you just sat down on the lap of luxury.  The rooms were fabulous (get the ocean view if possible), the service was top notch (shout out to Isaias at Naos and Simon at the pool bar) and the food at the various restaurants were superb.  My gf and I were very happy with our stay and it proved to be exactly what we were looking for to escape the cold wraths of NYC.  Don't think, just book!

reviews.author: Michael U
reviews.title: Unless receiving tips, staff is horrible
reviews.text: If you go to this hotel, just be aware that unless the staff is in a position to receive tips (waitor, bar tender, etc), you will probably receive the worst service ever.  It took us over an hour to check in...there were only about 5 other families there.

reviews.author: Linda1321
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: Just returned from a great vacation at Paradisus.  Initially I was a little hesitant about staying at an "all inclusive" but this place was beyond our expectations.  The only thing that we didn't like was that if you don't reserve a chair with an umbrella by 8am you're not getting one.  Had to get up early every morning and put towels on chairs to reserve them, which you are not supposed to do. Miguel Quinones serves drinks on the beach and in the pool area.  His service was outstanding.  He went above and beyond to make sure we always had whatever we needed.  The room was clean and fully stocked daily.  Would love to come back.

reviews.author: customerconcern
reviews.title: Definitely Want to Return
reviews.text:
Located on the southern part of the hotel zone, Paradisus Cancun is a great resort with good food, wonderful modern decor/ambiance and excellent customer service, especially Mr. F. Boutouba, Mr. R. Flores Koh, Sergio - concierge, Gerardo (Jerry) and Melvin @ Market Grill, Valeria and David @ Naos, Roberto @ Blue Agave, Angel @ Mole, Martin @Fuego, Gal – guest services and Marisol – beach service.  Paradisus Cancun is lucky to have these dedicated and wonderful staff, one of the best customer service experiences we have encountered.  

FOOD 
It was a luxury to have 9 restaurants for dinner to choose from (8 of the 9 restaurants are included in the all-inclusive package), all opened from 6PM-11PM.  We liked that the restaurants stayed open later than other resorts that usually close at 9PM or so.  Only the buffet (Naos) and Blue Agave do not require reservations and the other a la carte restaurants do require reservations, which is a simple phone call from your room the day before you want to dine.  Reservation desk is conveniently open from 7AM-11PM to take reservation phone calls.  You can choose what time you want to dine, instead of fixed times and no need to stand in line early morning like some other resorts to make reservations.
1)  Mole – Mexican contemporary cuisine, gotta try the sea bass w/ the Veracruz sauce 
2) Bana – Asian fusion sushi bar
3) La Perla – steakhouse, try the rib eye steak
4) Fuego – Latin fusion from Peru & Chile, try the corn soup, coffee soup dessert, home-made butter is extremely delicious 
5) Vento – Mediterranean Tapas (appetizers) 
6) Market Grill – Brazilian and Argentinian Grill for dinner, also open from lunch
7) Blue Agrave – simple menu of yummy tacos, tortillas, quesadillas, soups, chips and guacamole and salsa
8) Naos – buffet with rotating options daily for breakfast, lunch and dinner so you don’t get bored eating the same buffet foods, there was always something new and interesting to eat, our favorite was meats/seafood being grilled right in front of you. 
9) Tempo – upscale cuisine, $90/person (not part of the all-inclusive package)

BEACH
Since the resort/hotel is spread out horizontally over 5 pyramid buildings, there is a lot of beach front real estate.  There are plenty of loungers in the sun and for palapas, guest would need to come early.  The beach service was prompt and friendly.  There were no rocks, barely any seaweed in the beach.  Just like all the hotels on the southern location of the hotel zone, the currents can be rough and wavy.  We loved that no towel cards were necessary and you can replace your towels as much as you wanted.  We didn’t use the swimming pools so we can’t comment, but we did see a lively swim up bar.

ROOMS/POOLS
We were in the main pyramid #3 (non-royal service) where all the restaurants, lounges, bars, shops, spa/gym, etc… were located.  Check-in was a breeze.  No pressure or long sells pitch for timeshare.  The room decor was nice (just like the pictures) w/ hot coffee maker, great quality extra long bath towels, good sized private balcony and the most comfortable bed ever (slept so well).  Room cleaning was 2x/day including an evening turn down service.  24-hours room service was prompt .  Some other reviewers mentioned loud music playing late night, but we didn’t encounter this problem.  One night, we did hear some music and luckily the AC tuned it out so we barely heard the music.  Another common question is if you should upgrade to Royal Service or not, we never tried the Royal Service so we can’t compare.  However, we did not feel we missed out by not upgrading to Royal Service and were extremely pleased with our experiences.

ENTERTAINMENT/GYM
Nightly entertainment was on the floor of the Avenue Bar starting at 8:30PM.  We watched the 70s show, circus show (our favorite) and Michael Jackson show, all were very entertaining and enjoyable.   As for the gym, located next to the spa, had a decent variety of Life Fitness machines,  flat screen TVs and satisfactory work out music.

LOCATION
Public bus right in front of hotel for 9.5 pesos or 1 USD one-way, across from Aqua World, and approx. 15-20 mins. from the airport.

INTERNET
Free Wi-Fi, good Wi-Fi signal in lobby, average Wi-Fi signal to room, okay Wi-Fi signal at beach.  We were told that the hotel is in the process of upgrading and improving their Wi-Fi strength.  

We vacation in the Cancun area often and have tried several hotels in the area.   Thank you again for your superior customer service.  We definitely want to come back this marvelous hotel and tell everyone we know you will be happy here.

reviews.author: Jeff R
reviews.title: One Special Server Makes this Resort a Favorite
reviews.text: We return to this resort almost every year.  It has what we are looking for in a warm place.  One worth mentioning is a drinks server in the pool area named Asuncion.  She has been there for 22 years and truly understands how to make guests feel special.  Asuncion is gracious and friendly,,,always there when you need her, yet not pushy or intrusive.  Especially when contrasted with the guys trying to sell you cigars, hats and shells down on the beach, Asuncion is a breath of fresh air up by the pool.  She makes the visit worthwhile.

reviews.author: retiredtech551
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: We have a timeshare with Club Melia and we purchased at this resort 10 years ago.  We did not take all inclusive this trip, we know from past experience the food & service is superb. The Caribean view is second to none. We arrived on the 6th of January at midnight and our room had a not so great view of the parking lot on the lagoon side, our wonderful Club Melia hostess (Nancy) rectified the situation and we moved to a beautiful 1 bedroom suite on the 3rd floor facing the Caribean. The hotel & Club Melia staff are wonderful and many I recognize from 10 years ago, reflects well on the hotel & management. There were many children at the resort, wish there had been an adult only pool and bar areas during the early evening other than Club Rouge.  There are several Scotiabanks & ATMs throughout Cancun, one by La Isla shopping centre (Hotel strip) - best exchange rate possible CDN to Pesos, use the ATM. Plaza La Fiesta shopping outlets have decent prices and there is no haggling therefore no pressure. Mercado 28 is a great place to shop & eat, alot of pressure sales here. The bus system is excellent and runs 24 hours a day (9.5 pesos-approx 85 cents CDN).  The bus drivers are very helpful, make sure you have a few extra pesos to tip the entertainers that board the bus from time to time - this is something new since our last trip to Cancun in 2011. Walmart is a great place to shop, liquor/wine/beer prices are very cheap here (eg: less than CDN$10 for a bottle of Captain Morgan's Spice Rum or a decent bottle of Tequila).

reviews.author: Rogier B
reviews.title: Good Price/Quality Hotel.... Rooms are little bit dated and leaky
reviews.text:
Location: 5
Cleanliness: 4
Bathroom: 3
Amenities: 4
Room Space: 4
Bed and Matrass : 4
Staff: 4

TIP: Book directly at the hotel website: much cheaper than any other hotel website.

We stayed here at the one bedroom suite with familiy concierge. The extra familiy concierge is really worth the extra bucks: personalized check in, bali bed, beach chairs and the extra service and attention. We loved the beach area which is very broad, clean (staff cleans out all the seaweed in the morning) and the beach umbrellas and chairs are excellent. There is drink service at the beach (more attention at the Familiy Concierge and Royal Service areas). PArt of the Familiy Concierge is some beach accesiories for the kids which our 18 month old used all day long. We liked the restaurants and bars of this hotel and also the overall layout. 

Minor points: When it rains it really leaks everywhere in the room and hotel. Our bathroom had a unpleasant smell the whole week; we asked for cleaning staff to do something about it but was only partly succesfull. When staying in Building 3; you can really hear the noise from the night entertainment in your room and there were construction noises from midnight till 2 am on one of th nights we stayed there even though we complained at the reception about it.

All in all; loved this hotel but did not love the room itself. Because we booked through the hotel website we got a very good deal so price quality was OK. Do not know if I would stay in the same hotel again; would probably look for something different next time.

reviews.author: Aljassar
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The best hotel in cancun the service is great i like this hotel and come again and location is very near for the mall my advice if you come cancun stay this hotal because what you need the hotal make for you

reviews.author: RonNCarol
reviews.title: Totally Enjoyed our Stay
reviews.text:
Visited there Dec 14 through Dec 21 '13 and had a very nice time. Hotel is clean. Restaurants are very good. Service was excellent. What made it exceptional was the service Marco Rojos, Josue and Ivan gave us at the restaurants. They couldn't do enough for us.
Got caught up in a "Power" convention held there later on in the week, which turned the beach into what looked like spring break but we were able to remove ourselves from the crowd effectively. We would stay there again.

reviews.author: Beth T
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise
reviews.text: :Hotel is absolutely beautiful.  The restaurants Vento and Mole were excellent.  Bar staff at pool. beach and avenue bar were great.  Waiters in all restaurants were wonderful    I wish they would stop selling themselves everywhere

reviews.author: Pete B
reviews.title: Favorite place in Cancun
reviews.text:
We vacation in the Cancun area 2-3 times a year and have tried several hotels in the area.  We have just returned from a vacation at the Melia Paradisus and it was exceptional.   This is our 4th time at this property, the 1st since Melia converted it from the Gran Melia to the Melia Paradisus.  While we liked the Gran Melia the property has only gotten better.

Several investments have been made since we were last there (2yrs ago) restaurants added, better entertainment, and significant facility updates. The food is above average as compared to other places we have stayed in the area.  ***NOTE: we ate at and loved the tasting menu at TEMPO please not that this restaurant is not part of the all-inclusive experience;  we knew that but it was a shock to the table next to us.  That said if you are a foodie it is a must do and if you are not there are many other great dinning choices.

If you do not have kids the "Royal Service" is a must do taking great service to a new level!  From an intimate place for breakfast, snacks and cocktails... to the private reception area no detail is left out.   WAY above any other service we have experienced in the area.

reviews.author: Ray2039
reviews.title: GREAT PLACE
reviews.text:
Can not go wrong at this hotel.  Great atmosphere food, and service.
Bar service around the pool was fantastic. Servers---Asuncion and Laura were incredible.  Got us what ever we needed and quickly.  Will go back

reviews.author: Julie L
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: Hotel facilities are just great! The food is also beyond expectations.  I enjoyed my vacation there and would definitely recommend it to my friends and family! The only thing is the efficiency and accuracy of check-in service: they gave me the wrong key to the wrong room with other guests still in it..

reviews.author: Dconner7
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text:
Family of 2 adults and 2 kids (9 and 5) and we had a great time. Beach was very nice, pools we great. Room was nice. Highly recommend the family package as we had a personal "assistant" helping with anything we needed and went the extra mile. Food was fantastic but at the specialty restaurants, our kids did not have a lot to chose from so we would go to the buffet afterwards for them. The buffet was one of the best I have been to in Mexico (we have been to 15 different all-inclusive places in Mexico). 

I was happy that they had DosXX on tap. Bartenders at the pool were OK, it seemed they were too busy to smile. Everyone else at the resort (employees) were always smiling and asking if they could be of assistance. 

I would highly recommend this resort. We have stayed at Melia's in Cabo and PV but this place... nice.

reviews.author: thegarageguy
reviews.title: Great beach, great food, great service, mediocre rooms
reviews.text:
I'll review my stay from the vantage point of a typical day, starting with check-in.

CHECK-IN: Welcoming from the time you pull up in the front of the hotel. Nice aroma in lobby, great decor.  Almost feels like you walk in from outside into a greenhouse.  We were there for a special occasion but they did not receive my e-mails, or at least the front desk didn't know anything about it.  We were offered upgrades for a fee, but after you pay over $350/night + airfare, I think if they have nicer rooms available (which they did), they should give you the best rooms available. What does it hurt?  We did not go Royal Service, though I would have done so for a more reasonable upgrade fee.  We were offered the timeshare breakfast, but we made it clear that we did not want to do it and that was the end of that.

Rooms: Biggest disappointment of our trip.  I'd put the rooms on par with a 2-star hotel in the states.  I've had nicer rooms at the Holiday Inn Express.  I saw a few of the upgraded rooms that were much nicer but again, if you're going to be a four-five-star hotel, ALL of your rooms need to be nice.  I shouldn't have to upgrade to get a decent room at these prices.  Room was small. Comfortable bed, tiny bathrooms.  It would not have been such a big deal if it didn't rain for 3 days of our stay.

FOOD:  First of all, if you have gluten issues, you won't do much better than this place.  Food at buffets is usually marked, menus say what is gluten free, you have plenty of choices and they are quality choices. At each restaurant it felt like we had at least 2 waiters and the food was hot, prompt, and although it took us an hour or more to eat at each place, we never felt like we had much of a wait between courses. Mole was some of the best Mexican we have had and it's not just the traditional pollo, chips, guac, beans, etc.  Service at Mole was fantastic.  Loved it and the personalities, manager, everything.  The tapas place was our second favorite, I'd recommend three cold tapas and three hot ones.  It will be plenty of food.  Ate there twice as well.  Blue Agave is more of the traditional mexican fare, but it was great and always fresh. La Bana was good sushi, great service, great atmosphere but they should offer more than just sushi.  Fuego was our least favorite but it was still very good.  Service was excellent in each place.  You never lacked for a refill and attitude was never a problem.  They really make you feel like they enjoy serving you.  (TIPS NOTE: Tips are part of the all-inclusive and It seemed like most people didn't tip, but we generally left $5 just because the service was so good.) Lunch at the Market Grill was good, not great.  La Perla food was similar to Market Grill.

As for the buffet, great variety, different each day, but PLEASE do something to keep the food HOT. I cannot for the life of me understand why so many Mexican buffets in four-star resorts cannot keep their food hot when your typical Golden Corral can pull this off with no problem here in the United States.

POOL/BEACH.  Service pretty good.  As noted early, water seemed a little cold. Beach is FANTASTIC.  Get there EARLY for a cabana on the beach -- like 8am early.  I'd say the hotel was at 60% capacity and all the cabanas were gone by 9am on every sunny day.  Almost no one was swimming in the pool for very long -- too cold.

ENTERTAINMENT: Good, usually family friendly, but it was difficult finding a place to sit and enjoy the show.  80% of the people watching have to stand up the entire time.

GYM/EXERCISE: We are into fitness and while the gym is well-equipped, it feels like you are in the basement.  YOU NEED A GYM WITH SOME NATURAL LIGHT.  IT'S A DEPRESSING PLACE TO WORKOUT.  Also, my wife wanted to do ZUMBA each day, and though it was scheduled, the staff rarely showed up to lead it.  Do some pool exercise or something.  This place is good if you're not an active person.  We are not into shows or partying, but we do like to have a good time in activities and this place just isn't much on that.

OVERALL: This place would be an easy 5/5 if it weren't for the mediocre rooms.  If you don't need a fancy room, this is the place for you.

reviews.author: ww3354
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
We have stayed at this hotel 6 times since 2004 and every year it gets better. The food at the buffet is above average for breakfast and lunch. There is something for everyone. This year a nice addition was a juice bar at the breakfast buffet. We sat in the outdoor section (Market Place) for breakfast and lunch, and after our first morning, Jose Luis Cano Balam remembered what we drank and would meet us on our way back from the buffet to carry our plates (not that I needed that, but what a thoughtful touch). He was very attentive, polite and professional. We also had the pleasure of being served by Carlos Lopez with the same great service. The Mexican restaurant, Mole, was superb and the Margaritas at the entire resort were fabulous. 

We used to love Tempo, but that is no longer part of the all inclusive. For and additional $90 you get a 5 course dinner with wine pairings - we heard it was very good but didn't dine there ourselves. There is also 24 hour room service and a section of the buffet is open with extended hours for snacks - which is a nice touch. The lobby still takes my breath away with all the hanging vines. The resort is kept immaculate and our room, although a little dated was very clean, spacious and well appointed.

reviews.author: Zachary C
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Excellent place. I had a blast. The service was remarkable. My only complaint is that the place had a little bit of a mold/mildew smell in the main hotel and my room. In my room there were actually a few black mold spores on a picture hanging in the room. This is an easy fix. Overall great place!

reviews.author: EMC11715
reviews.title: Great hotel in Cancun
reviews.text:
My family and I just got back from a 6 day vacation at Paradisus and we loved every second of it. The decor and feel of the hotel was very modern and luxurious. 

In terms of food, we went to one of the steakhouses (not my favorite, but it was OK), Vento (delicious tapas that actually really fill you up - my favorite restaurant), Blue Agave (our waiter let us try basically every type of taco and quesadilla on the menu- delish!), Fuego (also really delicious), and Mole (great Mexican food that isn't just tacos and quesadillas). The buffet in the morning and afternoon was awesome. Excellent omelettes for breakfast along with assorted breads, fruits, meats, etc. Lunch had a different theme everyday which made it exciting to come down and see what kinds of food they were offering. Oscar was our server pretty much everyday at the buffet. Great service and very friendly. I came with someone in a wheelchair and he always helped us find the best table for us. Basically, the food here is awesome.

The rooms were smaller than in some of the other hotels I've stayed in the area, but still great. We had a lagoon view which faces the front of the building. Our AC was broken one night and they had it fixed right after we called. We were located very centrally in Pyramid 3. I'd definitely recommend trying to get a room in that pyramid if you can. 

The pool was definitely on the cold side, but in that kind of heat it isn't all that bad. The beach was on the warmer side and absolutely gorgeous. Laura was our favorite pool server. She gave us exceptional service and always found us by the pool. Definitely find her if you're out there. I think we had Hector and Enrique as servers when we were down by the beach. Again, great service. Everyone at the hotel did a great job service wise and made us feel at home there.

I would definitely recommend this hotel to visitors. It's a short cab ride to downtown where all the shopping and nightlife is and a beautiful place to spend a few days away from home.

reviews.author: Marlene L
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text:
My husband, 17 year old son and I thoroughly enjoyed our vacation over the holidays at the Paradisus Cancun.  We thought the one bedroom unit we stayed in was attractive and comfortable.  The hotel's design in striking and the interior atria are beautiful.

The best part of our stay was the service.  From the moment we arrived until we left everyone on the staff was friendly and solicitous.  We were especially impressed one morning: Every lounge chair around the pool and on the beach was occupied yet the staff hustled to pull out additional chaise lounges from storage to make sure everyone was comfortable.

The food is tasty and plentiful.  Try to get to a different restaurant each night. They've got  different cuisines so there's variety. You don't have to eat the same thing every night.

Not only can we recommend the Paradisus we will seriously consider going back.

reviews.author: Christopher R
reviews.title: Winter Vacation
reviews.text: Stayed for a week in early January. The hotel is only a 15 minute ride from the airport so it is a very convenient location. The arrival section of the Cancun airport was quite messy and disorganized but we got through fairly quickly. The departure section of the airport is very large with lots of shopping and eating options. We booked with Air Canada Vacations. Our shuttle to the hotel was easy to find and very organized. The hotel welcomed us very quickly and check-in was easy. The staff were very friendly. The hotel is quite large. It's like being in a mall. Which was fortunate because it rained most of the time we were there so we were stick inside a lot. There is a bar/lounge area with big lounge chairs so a lot of people hung out there. The food was good. Breakfast was OK, the lunch buffet was good. There is a table service restaurant for lunch if you get tired of the buffet. There are five table service restaurants for dinner if you don't want to do the buffet. There is a very upscale restaurant that is not included in the all-inclusive deal. We did not eat there however we did the wine tasting lesson which was very good. It was very easy to book a table in the all-inclusive restaurants. The dinners were pretty good and they had a variety of options. The room was OK. It was a little tired. The rain was leaking into our room a bit from the patio door so they had to put towels on the floor. Apparently they are not used to that much rain. We had some ants in the room. The bed was comfortable. The pool area was nice and the beach area was very nice. It was fairly easy to get a pool lounge chair. The hotel in general was clean. There are a lot of staff attending to the hotel. I would recommend going to this hotel. They are a little pushy on the time share but we just ignored those discussions with them. We probably won't go back for a while because we'd like to try some other options on the Cancun strip.

reviews.author: Shanna P
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived we were treated very well, the staff members are at all times friendly and helpful. We had a few problems with the room but they were promptly dealt with in a professional manner. Sergio from the concierge was incredibly helpful as was Javier from reception, we always felt well looked after. The rooms were a good size with comfortable beds and a regularly stocked mini bar, the cleaning staff did a great job of keeping it spotless. The plants and running water in the atrium certainly make for a great atmosphere inside the hotel, it feels very natural and open. The dining was top notch, the Naos buffet always had great food, the selection was a little limited at time but it kept us trying different things. Our favourite restaurants were Bana and Vento, excellent sushi and European style tapas. The pool area was really nice, the main pool itself was vast so there was plenty of space and it was deeper than the other resorts we've been to which was a welcome change. The beach area was typical Cancun, well kept sand stretching for miles either side and the waves were quite choppy for the duration of our stay. Overall we thoroughly enjoyed our stay despite the mediocre weather we experienced, it's a well kept resort that prides itself in keeping it's customers well fed and happy.

reviews.author: Anna G
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Wonderful stay. Amazing staff. Great time. Royal service is a must. Hector is excellent! Very clean. All restaurants were delicious! Mole, Mexican restaurant was my fav! Buffet was great! Variety and presentation!

reviews.author: Marisa2788
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: All the staff were extremely friendly and fun to talk to. In particular, Josie, Angel, Rodrigo, Fabian, and Nestor,- all activity directors, Simon- the bar tender at the swim up bar, Fabricio- a waiter at Bana the sushi restaurant, and Angel- a waiter at the Mexican restaurant. I had a wonderful 3 days!! I wish I could have stayed longer!

reviews.author: KevinHart
reviews.title: Caring, Dedicated and Friendly Staff
reviews.text: My wife and I visited this resort in mid November and this was the second time staying here in 6 months. As you enter you are greeted by very friendly staff, pleasant atmosphere, nice aroma of in-scents and a gorgeous view of the ocean. Upon entry, it is evident that the vast grounds of the hotel are extremely clean and well maintained. My wife and I stayed on the Royal side of the hotel and there the staff are VERY helpful and take care of ANYTHING you need.The staff was very pleasant and treated us like we were King and Queen. At the pool, David ensured that a bali bed was always reserved for us. Rogelio and Octavio both went out of their way to keep our drinks full and served us great food right by the pool. The food is incredibly good and the menu is constantly updated (the menu changed from our last visit) which allows for a variety of foods. In addition, the menu by the pool allows for plenty of different choices and is slightly upscale. The food at ALL the restaurants was fresh, tasty and served with finesse. Carlos, the personal wine connoisseur, always has a great selection of wines and follows you from restaurant to restaurant. A must try is the Tempo restaurant ranked #1 in all of Cancun. This restaurant is upscale from food prepared by the finest chef to the white glove service. Lastly, another person who had a great impact on the success of this vacation was the operations manager of the hotel. Mr. Fred Boutouba is a wonderful and caring man who will go to great lengths to ensure your ultimate comfort and happiness. He took care of my wife and I personally when it came down to reservations, our happiness with the restaurants, the comfort of our rooms and many more aspects of our vacation. Mr. Boutouba is dedicated to his clients and will guarantee to do his best to turn your stay into a relaxing and memorable vacation. The success of this hotel is definitely the service from all the dedicated staff members and the lovely ambiance they create. Go to this hotel you will not regret it.

reviews.author: TonyDM
reviews.title: Best Hotel we have visited
reviews.text:
The hotel is lovely, staff are lovely, food is lovely. If you are just a couple, go for the royal service - pyramid 5, private pools, cabanas, no children etc, massive private part of the beach. So many lovely restaurants and even the buffet food in the day was excellent - the steaks were gorgeous!

Extra special thanks goes to Sergio - our butler in pyramid 5 and the Cabana booking staff esp David and waiting staff in the royal service pool area - those guys work all day in the scorching heat to make your day perfect!

All of the staff there are lovely, we had one slight room issue at one point, we mentioned it to staff and had a team in the room within minutes sorting it out.

reviews.author: Ly T
reviews.title: BAD WEATHER GREAT SERVICES
reviews.text: We love our butler Hector and our pool server, Javier Salsazar.  We have bad weather but their services make up for it.  The shows was entertaining.  The staffs work very hard, we did not have to wait for anything.  It was worth it to get Royal services.  The only thing that I wish the hotel have better internet connection.

reviews.author: Phil1200
reviews.title: Great Place to be
reviews.text:
I had a nice suite 1 bedroom , 1 living room , 1 bath room with view on the lagoon, 1 wc and 2 balconies (1 with jacuzzi)...

Just disappointed that I was there for business and could not really take advantage on it .. :(

But this will be a place I would go back to make holidays for sure...

reviews.author: Guatemala32139
reviews.title: Mixed emotions on our 47th anniversary. suite 3318
reviews.text: First day was bad the check in not good at all it was a total disappointmen the person that was to take care of us ( Alfonso ) had us about one hour trying to sell us anything and everything that came to his mind it was absurd, we were tired and wanted to rest the next day he came to ask us again if we wanted to do as he wanted and finally i had to tell him to get lost.                  The hotel is nice and the rest of the people were ok especially a lady at the restaurant Nao her name is Sandra she was great we really liked all her attentions she manifested towars us.         Warning to the traveler be aware of this individuals who want to take you and sell you everything they can.      Riley's

reviews.author: Mo A
reviews.title: Great Entertainment, Great Food, Great Vacation
reviews.text: This is my second time to Paradisus and I’m happy to say that I would never go to any other resort in Cancun besides this one.  I visited the resort with a group of friends and we all had an excellent time.  We ate delicious foods for every meal of every day and enjoyed fantastic activities on a daily basis.  The entertainment crew at Paradisus are second to none.  Each day they provide fun activities for guests to participate in.  One member of the crew, Diego went out of his way to ensure that the guests enjoyed their stay at the hotel by organizing fun filled activities such as sushi making classes, dance classes, volley ball games, etc.  With the weather not cooperating as much as we would of liked, Diego and team still did an outstanding job by ensuring the guests had the option to partake in fun filled indoor activities.  The room service crew also does an outstanding job by ensuring our rooms are kept tidy each and every day.  I truly enjoy staying at the Paradisus and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Cancun.

reviews.author: Erin W
reviews.title: Great service... If you're tipping...
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at this hotel while on a family vacation with his family. We were really excited to stay here as he'd stayed here on a previous stay (before it was the Paradisus). And loved it. It started bad and at the end we could only say that the facilities were nice but the customer service was horrible, except for the pool waiters and others working for tips. They were wonderful and very helpful. 

So, what went wrong? We arrived to the hotel around 7pm, well past what we thought would be the check in rush since check in begins at 3:00. We were greeted at the door and led into the lobby and then left to wait in a line that did not move for 1 hour! During this time the front desk staff had maybe 10-12 family groups waiting. They had 3 people working and the line did not move during that entire time. Thanks to people's kids running around and exploring, we found a cabinet with complimentary beverages, which you would think the greeter would have pointed out, given the line. After 30 minutes we asked a staff member if there were any other people who could be called to assist and got no response. Finally, after an hour the manager showed up and things started moving. We thought maybe it was just us but my in laws, who arrived hours before us, were greeted with a 2 hour check in time. 

I've done a few all inclusive stays but this was the most frustrating when it came to restaurant reservations. They stated they had a 1 day max for advance reservations but we repeatedly showed up at 6am and we're told all the restaurants for the next day were already booked. Turns out, if you're in the Melia club you get priority for reservations. We were so frustrated we ended up going off property to the Marriott next door where we called the day before and got a table for 12 at the Japanese restaurant at a normal time, not 10pm. 

The food at the buffet was good for a buffet. A couple days it was frustrating as the more traditional lunch items weren't an option, e.g. sandwiches, Mexican lunch fare (tacos, tostadas, et al). We found the lunch option the last day, but you had to be seated in its area to order from that menu, even though they were seating buffet eaters on that patio taking up all of the seats. 

Another top notch customer service example was when we booked the golf round at the par 3 course. We talked with the rep in the store who said it would cost $22 US per person, including clubs, balls, and fees. So we set a tee time for 9. When we went the next morning to check in, the fee had magically increased to $33/person! We asked and he said that's what it always cost. When we asked if he had lied to is yesterday we got no response. Then when we got to the golf course we were left to our own devices and pointed toward a tee that wasn't there. 

The poor service added a dark mark to what was otherwise an enjoyable trip, I'll spare you the check out drama, but just revisit the check in, it was equally as horrible.  So if you plan to have no interaction with the hotel staff not working for tips, stay here. Otherwise I'd recommend any other hotel.

reviews.author: Pam K
reviews.title: Lots of good, but disappointing at the same time.
reviews.text: Overall this resort is very nice.  We signed up for the royal service which has been somewhat of a disappointment.  It seems very important which butler you are assigned.  My suggestion is ask for Sergio.  He is very friendly and checks on his guests regularly, even when they are out at the pool.  Everyone seems vey happy with him.  We haven't been as fortunate.  We have been forgotten or skipped.  We have received turn down service 2 of our 6 nights.  As its the butler who should be making sure all goes well, we have given up.  We ask for service he agrees and then forgets.  We have two nights left and will make the best of them.  The pool area for the royal service is lovely.  David has been wonderful setting us up with our Bali bed, towels and chairs every morning. The wait staff at the pool makes sure you have a drink or meal before you even realize you need one.  A special thank you to Brenda for teaching us how to make the perfect guacamole and Carlos for educating us on wine.

reviews.author: 224Cheri
reviews.title: Girls Birthday Week in Cancun
reviews.text: Thanks to Carolos Lopez and Edgar Mesrios - morning servers at Naos Restaurant. Excellent service and great representatives of the property. Even though it rained for most of the trip, the hotel was of great quality and made the grey skies much more tolerable.

reviews.author: s1rscub
reviews.title: Good and Bad
reviews.text: Nice location, nice beach, nice hotel overall. Fortunately the buffet restaurant offers a great variety of options and good food because in order to dine in one of the other restaurants (6), you need to make a reservation a few days in advance apparently - that was an area of disappointment since we stayed only a couple of nights and managed to dine in one restaurant only, which was an average experience (good food but lengthy service). Beach and swimming pool are great but we had a hard time finding some beach chairs and umbrella - which we needed because we have a 2 year old. There is wifi in common areas but not in all rooms - another area of frustration.

reviews.author: Wassim B
reviews.title: Thank god for the entertainment team
reviews.text: This resort is awesome! The staff is very friendly and the resort is beautiful. During my 6 nights at this resort it rained 5 of those days. Luckily for us, this resort has very cool activities. I was able to attend a zumba class every morning. In the afternoon there was always a different activity. One day i attended  a sushi making class, another a mixology class (where i improved my adult beverage making skills!!). Another cool activity we did was at the Yhi Spa, we were taught how to give massages! I strongly recommend upon arrival, all guests ask to speak with Diego (he works for the activities team), and make sure you attend some of these activities. I plan on returning to Paradisus in the summer, great place!

reviews.author: ParadisusCancun2013
reviews.title: The hotel was amazing and had excellent service.
reviews.text: Our recent vacation to cancun was made amazing by many things in this hotel. There where many activities held for kids all day and night. Kids where able to be occupied 24 hours a day. Our family and friends who joined us on this vacation especially would like to thank the guest experience. Our kids made great friends and had an amazing time with many of the workers. They became very close with fabian agustin and miss him very much. We hope to come back next year to such an amazing hotel and friends.

reviews.author: Tom A
reviews.title: Paradisus Vacation
reviews.text: The facility is one of most beautiful that I have visited, rooms are very nice, clean and well kept, most of time. All service people we dealt with below management level were some of the best and friendliest help you ask for. Guest services and management level personnel was a different story.  We were misled from check-in to leaving by guest services management level people. Example, not enough chairs at pool side and no one there to assist guests, many conflicts between guests over chairs.Second example, we were told at check-in that only one restaurant required advance reservations, wrong, all but one did. We did not misunderstand, had the lady repeat it several times. We will not return to this resort until they get it together on a management level. They also have a real nice par three golf course, but we were told no loaner clubs we could rent. We were not the only ones feeling this way about the management.

reviews.author: Ray L
reviews.title: One of the Finest Resorts I've Ever Visited
reviews.text: Extravagant is the appropriate word to describe the Paradisus.  From the sights and sounds (the resort is all about 'the 5 senses'), to the excellent staff and the food (I highly recommend Tempo), you won't be disappointed if you visit the Paradisus on your next stay in Cancun.

reviews.author: Samantha W
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: I stayed here on a vacation provided by my boyfriend's company, and it was great. The staff is extremely friendly and willing to help with any need. The buffet that was provided didn't serve the hottest food, but that was a small con in comparison to the great aspects of this hotel.

reviews.author: Daph B
reviews.title: Ok, but never again!
reviews.text: We had a family of 8 stay here over the holidays. I will start with the fact that I travel to the Cancun area at least twice a year, so I have a clear understanding of almost every all-inclusive resort there. For starters, the check in/out process is absolute chaos! There is not near enough staff to accommodate the number of people coming in or out of this resort. It took an hour just to get room keys, & even longer to check out. This was during the week days, not even the weekend.The double rooms have tiny beds, & no sofa at all for seating. Nowhere did I ever read this place requires 24 hr advance reservations at ALL of the al-a-carte restaurants, none of which are great. Even when I made reservations, our large party was given a "limited" menu. It is nearly impossible to get a chair anywhere on the beach or at the pool if you are not out there before 10am claiming your spot. There is only one buffet that is a feeding frenzy with kids hands in everything, & people running all over the place grabbing food or waiting in a line to get food. Considering we spent (over $16k), I expected a little better treatment & service. Even the "nightly" shows are impossible to get a seat at since they are in a very small bar area with virtually no seating. The  excursion planning was a disaster as well when our ride arriving 2+ hours before the scheduled time, dragging us out of bed with no food or anything prior to leaving. No credits or consolation offered, just "sorry about the misunderstanding". I will not be returning to this property again based on the lack of service, accommodations & impersonal treatment.

reviews.author: Duncan G
reviews.title: Mixed bag at Cancun All Inclusive
reviews.text:
First the good news. The Mexican people at this resort and in all of Cancun were uniformly nice. All of the hotel staff were fantastic and made our stay all the more enjoyable. The location is great, less than 20 minutes from the airport. The beach is beautiful with great sand and clean warm water. The hotel pools are nice although the water was cold when we were there. There were no hot tubs that we saw but we had a hot tub on our deck outside of our room.

 The food was ok. One restaurant, La Perla, was very good. The buffet was just average, with limited selections and so-so quality. The pool grill was not good. Pre-cooked burgers, undercooked hot dogs, and nachos with melted cheese were the choices. 

The nightly entertainment was very good. 4 of our 6 nights we really enjoyed the music and dancing shows in the Avenue Bar. 

The hotel itself was very large and in need of a toal renovation. Chipping paint was every where. Broken fixtures in the room. When we were there it rained and there were so many leaks it felt like we were on a cruise ship. The check in staff ,while friendly, were incredibly slow. The housekeeping was spotty. We asked multiple times for more towels or the mini-bar to be replenished. They always resoponede quickly but we had to call. 

The gym is old and small and very difficult to find. The spa was good and a well deserved shout out should go to my massage therapist Yarelli who gave a fantastic deep tissue massage. 

Overall I would give the entire experience a C+/B-. Its hard to critize the freindly people and the beautiful beach but the other issues dragged down our rating.

reviews.author: jetsetter82_11
reviews.title: DECENT for the price but never again
reviews.text:
- same ol' food, majority buffet
- minimal selection
- watered down liquor
- amazing beach front
- decent pool 
- no music
- very lame energy
- nice wait staff but no service at the pool unless we stood @ bar
- great scenery in hotel but we were 22 ppl and they had us spread out between the entire hotel
- def recommend coco bongo nightclub
- they also have cabana section w hookah to the left of the pool, def worth checking out

reviews.author: Kris4221
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation, excellent staff!
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I had great time at the Paradisus.  The hotel was very clean, many restaurants and bars, beach and pool area were beautiful, staff was excellent! Special acknowledgment to Miguel, who worked as beach service-bringing us refills and cold waters without ever needing to flag him down. He even found us beach chairs on days we got down to the beach late. I also want to recognize the bartenders at Avenue Bar, where my boyfriend and I spent every night.  Bartenders ENRIQUE and ISRAEL were outstanding!! Before our first drink was gone, another one was already being made for us.  Every night I would ask for a fruity drink and they would make me a different kind every time-the best I've ever had! Whenever we walked in we felt as if we were VIP because of how friendly and attentive they treated us. They really made our stay unforgettable!

reviews.author: darjosh
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun- Poor beach service and customer service
reviews.text: First thing - Bad Beach service - ran out of towels by 9 am on more than one day. Restaurants, - La perla has a good steak but the Mexican food at Mole was not good. I have been to mexico before and have had a great authentic mexican meal and this was by far no comparison. I am of the belief if you say something, honour it. We asked for an upgraded room to have an ocean view and were willing to pay for it, however, it was not available for the day that we arrived. We said that was okay, however, they called us to come get our key for the new room the next, it was not what we requested. They wasted our time for more than 1.5 hours when we could have been outside enjoying the great weather. The employee we dealt with (Adrian) who also worked with us the day before about getting the upgrade now was saying the original one was not available and was trying to tell us to switch to another room (and this room he told us the day before was not good because there was no view). I wouldn't feel comfortable recommending this resort to my family or friends, so, I would say there are probably better options for the price in Cancun.

reviews.author: Joan S
reviews.title: Happy honeymoon vacation!!
reviews.text:
We loved the place! Very big, good food, friendly people, very helpful.
The only thing was we were there December 7th-12th 2013 and they were doing some renovating which was very noisy at times.
The two bartenders at the Toji Bar were great!
Treated us so good and were friendly and helpful with drink selections. They are Simon Gonzalez and Jose Velez. They took good care of us several nites we were there. The bartenders at the pool bar were very nice too. WE would definitely recommend this hotel and their staff!

reviews.author: Andrew G
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: Had a great time at Paradisus. The staff was really great. Their guest services people weren't the best, need a better working knowledge of the English language. Otherwise, the food, hotel, beach, and everyone else working their was great. Special acknowledgements to the staff at Tempo (Samel, Fares, and the Chef's Felipe & Ismael). Also, Moyses at the Spa was incredible.

reviews.author: Kevin B
reviews.title: Should have stayed at moon palace
reviews.text:
Where do I begin?? When we arrived, we were greeted and taken to family concierge. After waiting for almost three hours, we finally had our rooms...the wrong rooms. The first room we were taken to was occupied and when they opened the door, there was a man laying on the bed. The second room was dirty and the third room was not even close to the room we had booked, not to mention that the pyramid shape of the hotel made your room a weird shape and space was hard to come by. 

The room service was so slow that by the time the food got to your room, it was cold. How did they know I like to eat cold eggs for breakfast? They didn't have the best food selection at any of the restaurants, I mean, if you like to eat the same thing for a week straight, this hotel is for you. Variety is obviously not a word that they know.

The staff overall sucked. If you had a question or problem & needed to address it, they would look at you like you were insane. It was a "do it yourself" attitude the staff had. The girls in the kids zone rarely interacted with the kids and when they did it was to yell at the kids. That's just what I want, someone yelling at my kids on their vacation because they want to have fun. If you don't like your job, quit!! Housekeeping was awful!! We left for the beach early one morning, a few hours later we headed back to our room. The beds were made nicely, the room had been picked up, but...there were no fresh towels in the room & after a day at the beach, you need clean dry towels. I will say that the female housekeepers did a better job than the guys!!

I could go on forever as to why you should spend your money elsewhere, but I won't. I will say that Karla in family concierge was a true blessing. She is one amazing lady and that hotel does not deserve her!! Love you Karla! Thank you for everything!!

reviews.author: DianeVin
reviews.title: Truly Paradise (12/25/13-12/30/13)
reviews.text:
Perfect resort!!! I highly recommend if you are looking for a truly relaxing place without the partying atmosphere. I took my 75 year old father from Italy and he still can't stop raving about our trip. The property is spotless, both inside and out, and the pools are tremendous and the food is top notch. The fish (sea bass and octapus were my favorite) and meat selection are great and the desserts are to die for!!  Great place for health conscious travelers, not the resort for pizza or fried foods. Attentive and accommodating staff and the beach is just perfect. The property is large so it never felt too congested but I feel it's more of a resort for adults, singles or couples, but possibly boring for children...although their pools are beautiful and if your children can entertain themselves they would have a blast! 
Great location....great staff....excellent fresh, light and healthy array of food and plenty, plenty of it!!!
We can't wait to return!! A special thank you to our waiter in the restaurant buffet Nao, ENRIQUE ZAVALA, who always went above and beyond to make our breakfasts and lunches extra special!

reviews.author: Charm916
reviews.title: Very lovely place but there are a few cons...
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus with our two kids 7 & 11yrs from 12/27-1/2 and had a great time. We got 1 bedroom Family concierge and it has a nice perks.  You're assigned a butler and ours (Hervik) was exceptional. Whatever we needed he would try his best to accommodate us.  He's super friendly and genuinely cares about his guests. Here are my pros & cons

Pros: 
-Beautiful atrium! All common areas throughout hotel have nice decor with contemporary feel. 
-Gorgeous views from the hotel and restaurants. Nice aroma with candles & incense throughout.
-Good service & staff works really hard
-Food is delicious!! Most of restaurants were great except Blue Agave which was so-so. Naos had excellent buffet selections every day.  The restaurants also are beautifully decorated and some have gorgeous views of ocean. 
-Wide open beach with nice soft sand
-if you upgrade, Family concierge lounge always have snacks and a small game room for kids or play games. They make you feel extra special.
-Avenue Bar is open area for families to lounge and hang out with cool beds and variety of seating. Shout out to Libertad (our server for nightly events) she was super nice and fun. 
-We LOVED the 8.30p nightly entertainment at Avenue Bar. The dancers were amazing. On couple of the days there is a group of 6 dancers who are outstanding! Don't know name but it's 3 men and 3 ladies.  Don't miss them! Michael Jackson show was just okay but still entertaining. 
-Most of staff are truly hardworking and accommodating.  Please tip them even if it's a dollar.  They all work SO hard for little money. Servers by Family Concierge pool (near tower 1) need to walk back/forth to tower 3 in the hot sun to get drinks and food.  When I do that walk just once in mid-day sun I was suffering. 
- Bali beds by pool are great if you can get one. Family concierge guests assigned only 1 per stay but you can rent one if you want more days. A family of 5 or even more can fit into one of these huge beds. Sooo relaxing. 
-Resort is big enough that it doesn't feel crowded around pool and beach areas
-We had a lagoon view which is still nice to see water.  
- Although I didn't use the spa, I did a quick tour and it looks fabulous. It looks amazing inside.  Take a tour and you will not want to leave.  They also have a separate kids spa! It's so adorable! Family concierge guests entitled to a free water spa ritual.  I didn't get a chance to use but you shouldn't miss it like I did. 
-Free WI-FI is very reliable both inside and out by pools & beaches.
-There's a great gift shop on level 1 owned by a nice man who has sign "cheaper than flea market" and his prices are truly good.  He has some great items for souvenirs. 
-We generally don't like mega resorts but we didn't feel it was super crowded due to size of resort and how it's spread out. For example I walked by Hard Rock hotel nearby and their beach area was super packed and everyone was squeezed into their space. Hard Rock has less land but a very tall building. 

Cons
-Tower 1 rooms are dated and needs some updating. The rooms do not match the beautiful common areas of this hotel.  When we entered our room we felt like it was a different hotel. We had1 bedrm which has separate sofa bed in living room with a powder room and master bath. Great space for family of 4+ but felt the room was stale and old.
