The curtains in bathroom have mildew, stains, and obviously dirty.  Mildew around shower area & windows. The bedroom didn't have a bathtub but shower only.  We met another family in tower 2 and they said room was dated also. Not sure which rooms are updated in this hotel...maybe Royal service (adult only). 
- Many times they ran out of towels by family concierge pool. It can be very frustrating when you need one.  
- Difficult to get chairs around pool & beach unless you're up at crack of dawn to stake some out. So annoying.
-It's always risky to vacation during busy peak holiday time as it's inevitable there will be hiccups.  Hotel was fully booked but it should be prepared to handle the increase in occupancy with extra towels, pool & beach chairs, etc.  Paradisus...what about renting extra chairs during peak season?!
-Although ambiance is nice, it's relatively dark inside common areas of resort. I found myself straining to see many things.
-The place is very leaky when it rains

General
- if you tend to get chilly in hotel lobbies, etc you don't have to worry about this one.  It's typically warm & humid in common areas and restaurants. No additional sweater needed!  I like it that way since I'm always cold but some may find it uncomfortable.

Overall I would definitely recommend this beautiful resort but not sure I would go back unless the rooms are updated.

reviews.author: Ivan F.
reviews.title: Hotel Facilities + / Room and Beach Services -
reviews.text:
Your first impression on Paradisus Cancun will be amazing: it looks beautiful, fancy and huge. And it is.
The hotel facilities are amazing and the staff very helpful and friendly.
The rooms are nice, with comfortable beds, nice shower and an amazing ocean view. By the way, the beach in front of the hotel is great!

The restaurants are good and I was able make reservations to all of them. Don't expect a menu with a lot of options though - in general there aren't many options in the menu.

Despite these great qualities I probably wouldn't return to this hotel for two special reasons:

- The room service was slow and weak: in one of  my days at the hotel I had to ask 3 times to have my room made -  and it just happened in the end of the day. In another day there were only 2 towels in our bathroom, and we were 3 people there (!!!)

- The beach service was AWFUL! You have to ask 3 times for a drink and wait around half hour to have it. There was only ONE waitress/waiter for an entire session of the beach. If you are at Club Meliá building or in another "premium" building (they call them pyramids 5 and 1) you will have special attention, otherwise you will wait a lot. Another negative point: there are 2 main pools for "regular" customers and one of them (in front of Grill restaurante) doesn't have a single bar, which makes the other overcrowded. Premium users also have their own pools and bars.

Paradisus Cancun overall is a great hotel, but I think it is possible to find better options in Cancun if you look for better room and beach services. I will do it next time.

***

Sua primeira impressão no Paradisus Cancun será incrível: o hotel parece bonito, luxuoso e bem grande. E realmente é.
A estrutura do hotel é ótima e a equipe muito cordial, atenciosa e pronta para ajudar.
Os quartos são ótimos, com camas confortáveis, bom chuveiro e uma linda vista para o oceano. Aliás, a praia em frente ao hotel é ótima!

Os restaurantes são bons e consegui fazer reservas para todos eles. No entanto, não espere  menus com muitas opções.

Apesar dessas ótimas qualidades, eu provavelmente não retornaria a esse hotel por duas razões especiais:

- O serviço de quarto foi fraco e lento: em um dos dias da minha estadia eu tive que pedir 3 vezes para que arrumassem meu quarto - e isso só aconteceu no final do dia. Em outro dia haviam apenas 2 toalhas no nosso banheiro, e estávamos em 3 pessoas no quarto (!!!).

-  O serviço de praia foi PÉSSIMO! Você tem que pedir 3 vezes por uma bebida e esperar por volta de meia hora até que ela chegue. Havia apenas UM garçom/garçonete para uma sessão inteira da praia. Se você está no Club Meliá ou em outra sessão "premium" do hotel (eles chamam de pirâmides 5 e 1), você terá uma atenção especial, caso contrário terá que esperar muito. Outro ponto negativo: existem duas piscinas principais para "hóspedes comuns" e uma delas (em frente ao restaurante Grill) não tem nenhum bar, o que faz com que a outra esteja lotada e tumultuada o tempo todo. Hóspedes "premium" também tem suas próprias piscinas e bares.

Paradisus Cancun no geral é um ótimo hotel, mas acho que é possível encontrar melhores opções em Cancun caso você busque bons serviços de quarto e praia. É o que farei da próxima vez.

reviews.author: eelacina
reviews.title: Excellent resort but one concern
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus for one week starting 07-th December 2013. It was really an amazing place and I would definitely recommend this resort to any family with kids. 

AMAZING evening entertainment, among the best I’ve seen at any resort.  Especially noteworthy was the Flamenco dancer and her musical accompaniment.  I was truly in tears after watching this beautiful girl performing Flamenco dances.  I would go back to this resort just to see her dance again.  The other entertainment venues were also very good.  I especially enjoyed the acrobats, I felt they were as good as the acrobats in Cirque du Soleil.

I really liked this resort for wonderful people, the very good entertainment, the food and service.  There was one girl working at the lobby by the name of LLUVIA and in my opinion she was exceptional. I approached her many times with different questions and each time she answered with smile on her face. I also talked to the Operations Manager Fred Boutouba, he was very professional and willing to help any time and any way.

Thank you guys for such a great experience at your Hotel. You definitely have made a difference.

The only concern I had with my stay was with the pool-side bar.  I had a talk with the service desk because I was concerned that children ( 6 or 7 years old) were sitting at the swim up bar and being served by the bartender with non-alcoholic beverages alongside adults being served alcohol. The representative said that this was OK and that the parents are responsible to take care of their children. 

A few days later I am sitting at the poolside bar with my friend and on the opposite side were two young girls about 8 years old. The bar was not busy on the pool side so the bartender wasn’t paying much attention (in fact he wasn’t behind the bar for a few minutes).  There was an unfinished Pina Colada sitting on the bar that was about three quarter full. The girls became  interested and as I watched the first girl took a sip and made a face at the taste of alcohol, then both girls took another sip of the drink. 

It did not look like they were enjoying it but just being curious. I assumed the parents were watching because I would never leave my child unattended at an adult bar. I am not comfortable with underage children being served at the same bar that serves adults, even if they are given non-alcoholic beverages.  The chances of a child getting access to alcohol are too high, and having young children around intoxicated adults is not safe.  I have been to many resorts and normally children are kept separated from areas serving alcohol, especially for poolside bars.  I hope the Paradisus will review their policy and  encourage parents to keep their children in the designated family areas.

reviews.author: Gerry
reviews.title: Awesome!!
reviews.text: Spent New Years Eve with wife and some friends, place is amazing, atrium, restaurants, beach, service, etc. You get the whole Cancun experience. Very well trained Staff, attentive and always ready to anticipate your needs.

reviews.author: Mimi_Renee
reviews.title: Hotel feel
reviews.text: When we arrived on December 28, we were very impressed with the inside design and look of the space and restaurants.  One negative is they have this strong scent everywhere, it actually makes us feel nauseous.  The restaurant service is amazing, 5 star for sure.  The restaurant buffet is always the same.  We liked most of the restaurants but nothing great. The beach in front of the hotel is amazing, there is a sandbar and it's safe.  Our daughter did not like the kids club.  We can't even leave our child there and go for a walk on the beach, we can't leave the premises, we have to check on her every 45 minutes, so we decided to not put her in the kids club.  The pool is alright, too deep for fun play.  We can never find chairs at the beach or pool.  The rooms are not 5 stars, typical Mexican décor, orange, dark wood furniture.  We are content but we will not return.

reviews.author: Kelly S
reviews.title: Very pleasant and beautiful!
reviews.text:
I stayed with my family in the Club Melia side, as my family has a time share with this hotel. The hotel is enormous and very beautifully designed. There are staff constantly cleaning and always look like they are rushing around, keeping busy. But not too busy to stop, smile and say good morning.
I shared an ocean view suite with my sibling, so one of us had to sleep on the pull out sofa. This part is my only complaint. It was not comfortable. The upper half is very hard and the split down the center where it folds out is prominent, the bottom half is soft. 
However, when we asked the staff to bring us extra blankets and sheets for the bed to be made, they were very quick in getting it set up and doing their best to make it useable.
The bed in the room was very comfortable, no issues there.
The rooms are also huge, so we didnt feel as though we were crowding each other.
We opted for the all inclusive upgrade, so we didnt need to use the kitchen facilities in the room, had we decided to use them, rest assured it is fully stocked.
There are seven restaurants in the hotel to choose from, all but one are available for making dinner reservations. HIGHLY recommend going to eat at the tapas restaurant (Vento?), Mole is quite a romantic setting and great food. Blue Agave had the best service. Our waiter was so much fun and very attentive. 
In the buffet restaurant, look for Martin, he is a standout waiter, very friendly! When we weren't sitting in his section, he would come by and say hello and check in on us. 
The Market restaurant had belly dancers the night we were eating, what fools we were for not bringing our camera! They were great! 
The servers on the beach were also very hard working, trudging through the sand with trays of drinks and trays of food.
The grounds are spotless and so beautiful to look at and walk around. There are many wonderful aromas coming from everywhere, between the ocean breeze and the jasmine scents used in the main areas, you could stroll through the hallways and still feel relaxed.
 In spite of having a ton of business conventions appearing every day we were there, it still seemed like a quiet resort.
I also booked a relaxation massage in the Yhi Spa. I must admit, I didnt really enjoy the pre massage pools, sauna and steam room, I didnt relax much in them, I found the pool a little bit spooky at night and a little bit too cold, but perhaps that is just me. I also would suggest that the supplies in the spa shower be checked more frequently, as some of the bottles of products were completely empty. 
My masseuse Daniella, gave me the most phenomenal massage! If you are looking to unwind and completely lose yourself in the treatment, then this is your girl!
The beach is spectacular and the hotel certainly covers a lot of ground to find yourself a seat near the water. I would return to this hotel.

reviews.author: AlisToro
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful, the pools were gorgeous and the restaurants were diverse!  The location was perfect and the beach was amazing!  This was not my first time to Cancun, however this was my favorite experience.  The all inclusive package didn't get boring as most do because they have different restaurants you can eat at, you need to make reservations, but that's ok.  I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Famillesabord
reviews.title: A family vacation at its best
reviews.text: This resort is a very good solution for family vacation with everything for everyone under the same roof. No need to go outside the resort if you don't feel like it. 12 restaurants where you eat so well, you forget you are in Mexico. Some restaurants like Tempo offers better than the best restaurants in NYC or Montreal. A family concierge service where professionnal butlers and concierges take care of you all week long. The children had a kid's club, a Game Room, a Kid's zone and entertainment on the pool and beach everyday. All inclusive, you get a lot more for your money than you expect. The rooms are perfect for children and parents with family suite with two rooms, two tv and balcony.Very safe place. The parents can enjoy night life with babysitters availables anytime. A nice Spa is also a nice solution while the kids are having a blast with their friends at kid's club. A place to go!

reviews.author: ChefPostman
reviews.title: A Hotel in the midst of Change
reviews.text:
This property is just being re-branded this month (January 2013) as we are here for 2 weeks...so a new Executive Chef from Panama via Germany, the Executive Corporate Chef is here for at least a couple of months....it is all changing for the better...and it was pretty good to start with.

Lots of eating options, most of which are ordinary, but getting better...take the TEMPO dinner.  Probably one of the finest meals we have ever enjoyed.  Period.  Chef Felipe and his staff presented a menu by Martine Berasategui from Spain and this is one of the finest restaurants in the world!  I have just returned from 3 weeks working in China and I work in the food business and I can easily say that TEMPO was a dining extravaganza!

Tonight, January 29th, we enjoyed a Peruvian dinner at Fuego which was very good.  It was surprising actually as we had not been greatly impressed with some of their signature eateries.

So, try TEMPO for an amazing dining experience, Feugo for a pretty good dinner and The Market Grill for those meat protein guys as this is a very good Brazilian-style eatery.

Daytime pool grill offers great burgers, quesidillas and guacamole!
All of the servers are excellent!

reviews.author: Manish J
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
This was the best vacation we had. The service was top notch. We booked Family concierge room and it was worth every penny. Our butlers Karla and Isaac were very helpful and attended to all our requests. We want to extend special thanks to Karla for making our anniversary a memorable one.
I would highly recomment this resort.
Con - Breakfast and lunch Buffet tends to get repetitive. Especially for vegeterians, choices become limited. Still, our butler worked with chef to get variety of food during dinners.

reviews.author: Larry
reviews.title: Nice, reasonable prices and large buffets
reviews.text: We stayed a week here and the place was very nice and clean - but didn't have the attention to details like the Marriott Casa Magna in Cancun.  The food was good and they had buffets daily.  The beach was incredible with crystal clear water and the walking distance to the center of Cancun was about 40 minutes - but they had a bus that you could take that runs up and down the strip 24 hours.  The service was good - we had a problem with the safe and they rectified the issue.  The hotel was booked solid and we did the tourist time share deal - where you spend an hour and get a free meal while they try to sell your a timeshare.   For 90 minutes of time we got 2 bottles of tequila, a  blanket, hat and 50 dollars.   All in all it was OK, but nothing real fancy as compared with other hotels.

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
We booked this vacation through a travel agent after only seeing a few pictures online and thought "why not, looks pretty good."  It looks even better than all of the pictures that we had seen.  Amazing views!  The view from the balcony was so fantastic that it ended up being where I proposed to fiancé and she said "Yes!"  We kept saying to ourselves that it didn't even feel real to look out over the water when the sun was rising every morning.

ROOM:  We had an Ocean View Jr Suite with a King bed that could have fit 5 people on it.  Very comfortable and relaxing and even with our room next to the Red Lounge it was quiet and we had no problems sleeping  The room was very clean and tidy.  The rain shower was awesome.  Altogether it was a lot more than we ever thought we could get or afford.  

CHECK-IN:  The check in went smoothly and we were led right to our room after a short pitch from a Time Share group-We just said we we not interested and they left us alone, no questions asked.  

FOOD:  Every restaurant was AMAZING but one in particular was Fuego!  We were able to eat at every one (except for Tempo because that was an extra charge) and we chose Fuego to go back to and eat again.  The Beef Tenderloin and Chicken with Squash and potatoes were probably the best meals we had the whole trip.  The service at all of the restaurants were great  but again Fuego had the best service that we had received.  All in all, if we had to rank the restaurants (not including NAOS or TEMPO) it would be 1) Fuego, 2) Blue Agave Tequilleria, 3) Mole, 4) Bana, 5) Vento.
BARS/POOL/BEACH:  We loved the sitting areas in the Avenue Bar and were able to watch a few storms roll in over the ocean with a drink in hand.  The swim up bar was fantastic and the staff was always around to take a food or drink order.  It was great to be able to order food and in 15 min be able to eat without having to leave our pool chair.  Plenty of beach shade and bungalows around if the sun was getting too hot.  Night life and shows were very entertaining.  

CONS:  -Sometimes we had some troubles getting really steaming hot water in the shower.  If we ran the water for a long time we could eventually get it hot but it felt counterproductive to the Water Saving model that the hotel was promoting.  Some days were fine but some days were rather lukewarm at best.
  -As a younger couple, we mainly wanted to enjoy a more adult resort and there were quite a few kids that were around the bar areas of the pool and that was a little annoying.  There was a family specific area but it didn't seem as if the family's stayed in that area during the day.  Not a real big problem though.
-We had a few colder days with some drizzles and rain and the one thing that we would have loved to have been able to do was sit in a hot tub or Jacuzzi with the rain falling down with a drink in our hands.  I understand that during the summer months and on those hot days it wouldn't get used much but on those days I think that would have been a great option to have. 

Stayed Jan 20th through 26th

reviews.author: Jesús G
reviews.title: DISAPPOINTING EXPERIENCE
reviews.text:
I have been to Cancun several times  and still thinking is the most amazing and beautiful place to enjoy a family vacation or a second honey moon.  HOWEVER my friends, please do not stay in this hotel. I stayed here from January the 4th to the 9th 2013, traveling together with a group of  five other Mexican  families from Monterrey Mexico and Austin Texas. 

I have to tell you that I have had the beautiful experience of staying before in other Paradissus hotels in Punta Cana Republica Doninicana  and in Playa del Carmen Mexico, and the comparison is like from heaven to hell.

Since our arrival, the check in process was a night mare. After several hours, I did receive my room at 6:30 pm at night, after several mistakes regarding my reservation and room assignment,  Finally I got a room full of old furniture and terrible physical exterior conditions. 

I asked to have an interview with the Manager, and he kindly visit my room and confirm the terrible conditions the room presented. He offered his apologies and told me that they were doing their best.  I gave him a lecture regarding Business Strategy and explained him the risks of offering a promise that can not fulfilled.  I guess, I was speaking in the dessert because I received the offer of another room in worst conditions that the original one.

My friends. Do not get confuse regarding the beauty of Cancun, as well the nice beach and gardens this hotel has. I can speak very well in behave of the people that gave us service. Waiters. Lifesavers  and other workers  were warm and kind. However they can not compensate through their effort, structural problems this hotel has. Specialty food is 3rd class quality (Brazilian food is a joke and breakfasts are ok), the rooms and exteriors are old, and the MANGERS need to be trained urgently. 

By the way, careful with your children and  do not leave them unattended. Sometimes the sea is rough.

Please, if you have doubts regarding visiting Can Cun, I strongly encourage you to do it.
PLEASE FIND ANOTHER OPTION FOR YOUR STAY

Regards

reviews.author: Lynzeelulu
reviews.title: "One of the best in Cancun"
reviews.text: I have been to Cancun a few times now.  This was my second time staying at the hotel.  We stayed from Jan 17th through 24th. It is an amazing resort! Check-in has never been a problem for us-I know there are time share people there-but we have always just stated we want to go straight to our room.  Rooms: Beautiful. We had a little kitchen area with coffee maker, toaster, blender and a fridge that was restocked daily with soda, beer and water.  There is also a jacuzzi tub on the patio. Food: Delicious! We did Fuego (recommend the beef tenderloin), Mole and Venga.  Did buffet and rooms service the rest of the time.  Bars: There is an indoor one that opens at 11 everyday, a night club, a pool bar and a beach bar.  We had amazing service at all.  The have staff that runs all over the beach passing out drinks and food.  Pool: 3 beautiful and large pools. Beach: Best by far! I went jogging up the beach for an hour and the Paradisus has the best.  There are a large number of little table/huts for shade when needed.  Most places didn't have any shade.  Entertainment: every night at 8pm there is a show in the common area.  Very fun place for singles, couples and families! Take the bus for 80cents to downtown.  Super easy!

reviews.author: Philip K
reviews.title: Beyond Expectations
reviews.text: Just returned from a six day stay at the Paradisus Cancun and what a GREAT stay it was! From the moment my friend and I stepped on the property we were treated so special. Check-in was a breeze. There was a minor incident with the "time share" folks but we just declined them promptly and they left us alone. We got to our room, a deluxe jr. ocean view suite. It was beautiful. Very well kept and spacious for two people. And when they say "OCEAN VIEW", WOW do they mean it!  The view from our balcony was STUNNING! And the beach at the resort has to be experienced to believe it. Absolutely BEAUTIFUL!     The food was great at any of the restaurants we tried. The reservation process can be a bit of a hassle but whenever we couldn't get a reservation, we'd just go to one of the several that don't require one. The entertainment there is also first rate. There was a different floor show every night we were there and the main lounge and RED lounge were very fun and entertaining. Which brings me to Rogerio, one of the bartenders in the main lounge. He is top notch at what he does. We  stopped at that bar every night and he was always so friendly, funny, and warm. And he always made sure we were well taken care of. Baltizar at NAOS restaurant is also a standout. We ate at NAOS for our very first meal and he made us feel very welcome and relaxed. One of the few things I could complain about is the WIFI. It can be inconsistant and spotty, depending on where you are at the resort. But overall, my stay at Paradisus Cancun was amazing. I really didn't want to leave when it was time to go. I highly recommend it to all and I will definitely go back for more!

reviews.author: louise c
reviews.title: Never Again!
reviews.text: Don't waste your money,one of the worst hotels I've stayed in.  This hotel is not about customer service, It's about selling tours and buying Time share.Took over 3 hrs. to check in,food at buffet is based on how many people are in the hotel. We were told there would be shows everynight but only 1 show in 1 wk. There was an employee in our room while we were sleeping. Only bar open during the day was outside at the pool.Our travel agent told us the travel agency bought into My Time therefore we were entitled to certain anemities,we went to our travel representative and they knew nothing about it and told us no. I found the staff to be cold and indifferent.  The do not have a clue and the hotel travel representative should know what is going on for his guests that he is suppose to be representing.

reviews.author: Amore G
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: I'm actually still here we depart  tomorrow.  The experience is amazing. My fiancé brought me here for my 21st bday. Love it. Hotel set up is great , very clean, service is A1; they have entertaining shows every night, everything dies down by 11pm so the sleep quality is great. The location is great as well; a 10 minute drive from all the party downtown. The rooms are nice. The spa is great - high prices though. And the breakfast is good-Lunch and dinner food is good as well. I can past on fuego - wasn't too interested in that .but yes I WILL def come back. PS there party atmosphere is Awesome!!!! Crazy dance music, contests, and great ppl and tourist that makes the party CRAZY!!! They will def see this face again!!!

reviews.author: Virgep
reviews.title: Outstanding!!
reviews.text: 4 of my friends and I stayed in building 5 which included the royal service. Check in was a problem because they couldnt find one of the rooms reservations. After that, however, it was wonderful. the staff was incredibly helpful and nice. The restaurants were great and we had an outstanding time at the Red Lounge. The beach was clean, rooms were clean, and would definitely go back!! Beautiful resort!1

reviews.author: cpavilag
reviews.title: DO NOT waste your money on this hotel
reviews.text: This hotel was a nightmare from the very begining, took almost 30 min to check in 2 rooms with nobody else but us at the reception. The quality of the food was very poor, not to mention uncooked rise and very limited options for dinner.  Nobody told us where our rooms where located at a different tower therefore it was impossible to locate our rooms. Now after a whole week since we stayed there I haven´t received my bill, I have been calling eveyday for this situation but yet I have not had any answer. Trust me this is a very bad option for accomodation in cancun, the price if extreamly high for what you are getting, I will strongly recommend other hotels.

reviews.author: John J
reviews.title: Remarkable Experience!
reviews.text:
I'd stayed for 7 days at the Paradisus Cancun. At the beginning, I was kind of worried for some reviews I found around from other users, but, then we arrived to the hotel and my whole perception was renewed. Since my last visit to the hotel I can say that there has been a completely renovation of the hotel. They were still making some progress at the lobby, but the good disposition of the staff, makes you feel as welcome as home. 
Entering the room, it was clean and quiet (couldn't hear a noise). The bathroom is also spacious and very clean. The bed was one thing that if I could take it home, I would have done. Hard in the right places and comfortable....
Very rich and tasty international cuisine, you could spend an entire week just tasting each one of the speciality restaurants at the hotel, particularly I love mediterranean food, and I found the best around at Tempo. My tacos with mole also were fantastic at the mexican restaurant!!! With each dinner I became more spoiled.
Regarding to the Yhi Spa... Big WOW!!! The last time I did experience such comfortable full body massage was during my last trip to Tokyo, I must say that it's a full five sense experience, I definitively recommend it!!
Negative experiences: Well, there were some rainy days... but what could I say? I did spend it at the Spa.
My expectations were low; my experience was among the best: Congratulations from the heart!

reviews.author: Christina M
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Resort in Cancun was a wonderful experience form the moment we pulled up to the hotel. Everyone from the Concierges, the Entertainment Staff, the Waiters and Housekeepers kept a wonderful happy vibe the whole time we were there. Everyone made us feel so welcomed and kept us informed about all the activities that were going on through out our stay. We loved the entertainment at the Avenue bar each night as well as the Salsa lessons! Great stay, great memories and great friends, we will be back soon!

reviews.author: Jimboslice
reviews.title: Cant wait to go back...Everything was great!
reviews.text: Just returned yesterday from a 5 night getaway and it was so much fun.  I had stayed here a while back when it was Gran Melia and liked it a lot.  As a paradisus, I loved it all over again.  The lobby is gorgeous with the greenery, the rooms are nice, food was great (didnt have a single bad meal...we loved vento, fuego, and Bana), The service and staff were so nice and accommodating, we could go on and on.  Mauricio with the Entertainment and Activity staff does a great job with his team in making sure the shows and music are always fun and exciting (each ngiht at 8pm at Avenue bar there is a show.  One night was an amazing breakdancing show, another night they had the celebrity look-a-like performers from Coco Bongos come so we saw Michael Jackson, Beyonce, and LMFAO) and the activities during the day keep you entertained and busy if you choose to participate.  They aren't pushy in making you do anything you don't want too.   During the day, we did everything from beach volleyball and soccer with Diego,Jose, and Javier (they are with the entertainment staff and are awesome people) to Salsa dancing classes and sushi making classes.  The bars staff was great too.  Alexander in the pool bar is a great guy and does a good job!  Our room was really nice, Ocean View deluxe room, with a nice big balcony.  It was a great vacation and we cant wait to go back!

reviews.author: Hali1986
reviews.title: Awesome!!!!!
reviews.text: Such great value! Rooms are nice, stunning waterfall shower :) all inclusive was a treat, no complaints about the food or service. All you can drink at pool bar was so much fun, made friends by the pool  - even had a photo shoot on the beach - i can't wait to go back!!

reviews.author: Glenn V
reviews.title: What you see is not what you get
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. All kinds of activities are available, but they lack service and quality. A lot of things look and are run down. Hotel needs a structural upgrade at the rooms. Same things from a decade ago when we were amazed by the hotel. Service is deplorable. Nice view and impressive hotel, but that's were it stops.

reviews.author: Am-Ray1
reviews.title: Splendid!
reviews.text: I've stayed at this resort numerous times in the past couple years (used to be called the Gran Melia).  Every stay is wonderful. The staff is super, rooms are always up-kept and in immaculate shape and is nice and quiet all the time.  The food in the restaurants is wonderful also.

reviews.author: Lisa R
reviews.title: Wonderful week in Paradise
reviews.text:
We spent a wonderful week at the "new" Paradisus Cancun. We have stayed previously at the following current and former Paradisus resorts: Playa del Carmen (La Perla), Palma Real, Punta Cana (3x) , Playa Conchal (2x) and Riviera Cancun. We have also stayed at Dreams, Secrets and Iberostar resorts among others. Paradisus remains our favourite all inclusive resort chain. 

We want luxury, gourmet food, great service and a fabulous beach and pool. The past few visits, including this one, we stayed in Royal Service so the comments apply to the RS rooms and pool/beach area in addition to the shared restaurants and facilities.

The resort, RS room and grounds:

This resort was upgraded to a Paradisus resort in November 2012 from a Gran Melia. We stayed there over New Years for 7 days. We did not see any construction and all restaurants were fully operational. Our room was nice, a good size and satisfied our needs. We were disappointed that although we had an ocean view room the hedge in front of our balcony blocked most of our view when sitting down. Unfortunately we were not able to change rooms. Also, we are big coffee lovers and really enjoy having coffee on the balcony but the coffee maker was old and unappealing. At Paradisus Playa del Carmen the RS rooms had Nespresso machines. We loved that. The room service menu was mostly pizza and snack foods and a continental breakfast. As a result, we did not order any room service. (Room Service is included in RS). 

We spent most of our time in our Bali Bed either at the pool or on the beach. We loved the Bali Beds. They were free of charge for RS guests, had gorgeous views, were incredibly comfortable and had both drink and food service all day long. The beds require a reservation and you are guaranteed a bed for two days. Although the resort  was full but we never had a problem reserving or getting a bed. Juan and Sergio worked hard to keep everyone happy.  We managed to get a fabulous bed each and every day. Thanks guys! The best beds were along the beach. We had a bed there our last two days and they were the best two days all week, although we loved the beds around the pool as well. Each bed comes with a chaise and a chair so you can also get some sun! We did notice that some people would reserve a bed and not show up. When this happened the bed was released at noon so someone else could have it. This is an excellent and fair idea. 

The resort is beautiful with multiple pools and a wide beach area. The RS area never felt crowded. It was very clean. They even scrub the pool decking with a rotary power washer at night!   The beach is also clean and wide with palapa tables. Drink service was frequent. Some resorts offer a drink of the day. That would have been a great extra touch. 

The resort appears huge and a bit confusing at first but was not at all. It took us less then 2 minutes to walk from our building (5) to the towering open main lobby (building 3) where most of the restaurants are clustered together among lush palms. flowers and hanging vines.  . 

The restaurants:

The poolside RS restaurant at lunch (La Palapa) was excellent  with wonderful food, beautifully presented and a gorgeous view of the ocean. The only suggestion would be to add a few more vegetarian options - especially a veggie burger! The guacamole was great everyday. Good variety of premium beverages with no additional charges.

We ate breakfast most days at the RS lounge which was "continental" but still served warm options including eggs. Great fruit selection and we loved the Nespresso. This beautiful area is in the centre of the RS pyramid (building 5) with vines hanging from the ceiling and koi swimming under our feet. The lounge also serves snacks, sushi and cocktails in the evening. The main buffet menu (Naos) for breakfast was typical of any resort but does have a lovely outdoor seating area. 

We did try lunch at the main buffet. Neither of us eat meat (but will eat fish and seafood). One day we had an amazing lunch with tons of fresh prawns, calamari and other seafood. It was fabulous but unfortunately when we went back other days the buffet was primarily meat so we returned to La Palapa. 

Our best meal was  an incredible 7 course, white glove meal at Tempo. Tempo has a fixed menu and a surcharge of $45 per person. It was so worth it. The restaurant quickly replaced the one meat course (veal)  with fish at our request. Portions were small, delicious, unique and beautifully presented.  This  amazing meal was the best we have had at an all inclusive and right up there with some of the best meals we have had anywhere. We travel a lot and have eaten in a lot of Michelin top rated restaurants. There is an additional charge for premium wine. You can also choose wine pairings with your meal at a fixed cost. Our only suggestions was that they turn the lighting down a bit in the evening .The room was a little bright for an evening dinner. Although the dress code for the whole resort is resort casual, we recommend dressing up for this place. It is a special place.. 

We went to Mole on New Years. We were not aware there was a standard fixed price menu in the resort that night. The food was good but we wanted Mexican! So we were disappointed that our concierge or butler did not inform us.

Bana is the Asian restaurant located in the middle of the main lobby pyramid (building 3). It is a beautiful restaurant built into lush gardens. Most of the restaurants are in building 3, right in the middle. The lobby/main building is gorgeous inside. The sushi was good, not inventive but very fresh. Curries were good as well. 

We also went to Fuego (Latin Fusion) and Vento (Tapas). Both were very nice and had good food. Again, we would love another veg option or two. Overall we enjoyed all the a la carte restaurants we went to except La Perla. It was a lovely location (open air, building one, you could see the ocean) but the service was incredibly slow and the food was only average. We did not linger.

Royal Service:

We loved the RS area and facilities. Both check in and check out were fast and efficient. Everyone is very friendly. However in RS you are assigned a butler when you arrive. You are supposed to get a cell phone to call him/her (we did not) and he is supposed to take care of your restaurant restaurants, Bali bed reservations, provide a pillow menu, assistance with check out, luggage, among other services. Our butler delivered our luggage but otherwise we did not hear from our butler all week and did not even know where to find him. At Playa del Carmen our butler was amazing and checked in on us daily to make sure we had everything we needed. Here we ended up doing most things ourselves. The concierge service was also disappointing as our restaurant reservations were often inaccurate or we had to go to the concierge multiple times to confirm whether we had a reservation at all. By the end of the trip we made our own reservations. So, in terms of RS service when it comes to the concierge and butler, this resort is not yet up to Paradisus standards. I am sure they will get there but they are not there yet.

Overall, this is a lovely resort with great potential. The RS service is not yet at the level of resorts like Paradisus La Perla in Playa del Carmen  where we stayed a year ago.  One thing that became a bit annoying was the presence of small children in the Royal Service area. We love children but RS is supposed to be 18 years and over, which is why we stay there. We mentioned this to staff but only once did we see anyone do anything about it . We also noticed non RS guests using the area reserved for  RS guests. RS guests have distinctive wristbands but no one monitored the situation.  RS guests do pay a premium for the extra service and it should be respected. Better signage, especially at the beach entrance would help solve this problem. We hope the concerns  noted in our review will be addressed so we can recommend this resort with enthusiasm to our friends, many of whom have become fans of Paradisus based on our recommendations.

reviews.author: Thode851
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text:
Every thing was just as one would expect 
Wonderfull place top staff and amazing food. 
Absolutly nothing to complain about. 
Special thanks to the lifeguards and the waiter Symfoni that helped a lady I meet, up to her room and called a very efficient doctor to treat her in just 5-6 min. 
Amazing place I'll be back

reviews.author: Julianne D
reviews.title: Terrific 10th Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus last year when it was still under Gran Melia but really had a fantastic time.  We chose not to do all inclusive and instead elected to eat breakfast in the room and eat the other meals out.  The room was nicely appointed and had a large balcony to eat our breakfast on.  It claimed an "ocean view" which it did, but you had to go to the edge of the balcony and peer to the left -- otherwise you were really just looking at other people's balconies the next pyramid over.  It was a bit of a walk to get anywhere inside the complex for us (being in the vacation club pyramid) but that was okay with us -- a little more exercise.  The gym was small but usable.  The spa was very nice and clean.  We both got a massage but wish we'd tried the fish on your feet treatment.  Drinks flow freely around the pool but we found it a bit more difficult to get served on the beach unless you were up beneath the blowy tent things to the left of the property looking at the beach.  The beach is stunning and clean.  Since we like to get out and about and off hotel grounds, the location of this resort, so far down the Cancun strip was a little far away from things to make a trip out convenient.  However, directly across the street is a recreation "store" that we used to do a mangrove tour.  This was great fun -- a little two person boat that you drive in a line (but nicely spread out so it's not quite like a "baby" tour) with other folks through a mangrove and out to a reef to snorkle.  Really fun.  There is a bus stop at the end of a long drive out of the hotel grounds which we took in to Cancun City several times during our stay.  We would certainly stay here again.  It was SO huge it was a bit impersonal, but the niceness of the place convinced us that we'd come back.

reviews.author: Toni L
reviews.title: Great stay! Wonderful staff!
reviews.text: We stayed in an ocean view junior suite in pyramid 5 which is royal service. Our room was nice and cleaned daily. Our butler Daniel made sure everything was taken care of. Our dining reservations were handled by the royal service desk without a hitch. We stayed when it wasn't that busy so I think they were even more attentive! The staff went out of there way. The Bali beds are free in royal service area and $25 by the regular pool. Juan by the pool set us up everyday. one day they brought us a bottle of wine by the beach. I found every person that worked at the Paradisus to be above and beyond nice. We tip well....and in return got unbelievable service.  If you are looking to party then the main pool is the place to be....if you are looking for quiet, romantic...no kids...than the private royal service pool is the way to go! Food is typical Mexican , nothing really was spectacular ...but I was always full and Karina Reyes who services the royal service area always made sure I had drinks before bed.....she has 2 kids age 2 and 4 and says...they are like a category 5 hurricane! She made my stay extra special!

reviews.author: AGEDA V
reviews.title: Great Christmas Get Away
reviews.text: My husband and I traveled from December 19 through the 25, 2012.  We stayed at Paradisus recommended by my sister from NY.  I have to say, if you go to Cancun and stay here, you must do the all inclusive package.  The buffet food was great!  the bbq by the pool was great and eventhough tips are included, always tip if you want to get extra attention/service. If you want to go to the other restaurants at Paradisus, make your reservations when you first check in.  Most of the reservations I learned are pretty much booked by the "Club Melia" representatives to lure more members for their time share.  If you have any problems with the hotel, insist in talking to managers they will work out your problem right away.  The hotel is beautiful but stay away from building 1, it is very old as well as the rooms.  We had a situation and it was solved by the management department.  Thank you Director of Experience Fred Boutoba and concierge named Daniel, (from Guatemala) for all of your help.  All the employees are very well manered and cordial. We can't wait to come back to Paradisus this coming Christmas.

reviews.author: JACK2011
reviews.title: WOW a must in Cancun!
reviews.text: We went in the last years in many 5* in Riviera Maya and this is the top one,we were in royal service section, full services and attention. Surprisingly no Mexican music around, only lounge style music in background, personally I prefer to feel to be in Mexico with at least some Mexican music... If you like walking on the beach you can do it for hours from this hotel (bring some water!) You can take a bus in front of the hotel (R1) for 15 pesos (about $1) to go downtown (15 min) or shopping (5 min.).Only small complain the(free)wireless internet speed was slow, don't know if this was because of the room location. Hint: Choose Royal service for the private pool with Bali bed! Have fun!

reviews.author: Toni L
reviews.title: Great stay, great staff
reviews.text: We are still here....sitting on the beach in the Royal service area....We read that royal servicev was the way to go, so we paid the extra money....in return our check in was a breeze, we had a private butler who made our reservations for dinner, arranged our taxi home and gave us a bottle of champagne, tequila and absolute....the Bali beds are free with royal service....the royal service pool is quiet and the service was excellent. Daniel our butler and Karina the barmaid in the royal service area made our stay extra special....Karina went out of her way every day to bring me drinks! The food was typical for Mexican all inclusive...don't waste the money on tempo...excellent service but it is a sampling menu....u have no choices....and honestly I feel bad even mentioning it because the staff went above and beyond.... Victor made us an awesome cappuccino every morning in the buffet. royal service has it's own place for breakfast, tea and snacks....again Karina every night made us drinks and brought out small things to snack on. Lizabeth in Royal service checked us in and made our dinner reservations....everyone was very very polite.  We tip well. And in return got excellent service !  Some people don't tip....I know it's not mandatory to tip....but get a hundred in singles and tip....you will be surprised at the way these people appreciate it!   We are planning a trip back!

reviews.author: AnB_4ever
reviews.title: Great Hotel and Location
reviews.text: We had a great stay here during December 2012 for a family members wedding.  The hotel and staff were excellent!  The buffet restaurant was good..albeit a bit expensive.  The Taco bar wasn't the most authentic, but was ok...had a great Mariachi band come by.

reviews.author: L0uise1960
reviews.title: Enjoyed a wonderful week!
reviews.text:
We are in the Melia Vacation Club and spent a great week at the hotel. The construction is done and the hotel is renewed. Great service! Our room was tended to daily and minibar filled. Favorite waiters were Victor in the La Perla and the Market Grill and Antonio in the Bana. Victor is an eager server and is always smiling! He went out of his way to make sure we had guacamole, drinks and excellent, personal service at breakfast and lunch! He needs a promotion! Antonio was very personable and made great recommendations for menu items while making us feel special on our last evening!

Tips.....ask waiters for what you need if not on the menu. Take the city bus to the Kukulcan Mall or Isla Mall on the strip for about 80 cents. About a mile to walk if preferred. Nice aquarium at the La Isla mall but see if you can get discount tickets at the Paradisus first. We paid ten dollars vs. 14 at the aquarium. 

Small problem...no ABC, NBC or CBS channels on the TV. Told us the cable company had an order to repair but it never happened. We don't watch much TV but wanted news and a few favorite shows. Only Fox and HBO available.

Overal, the transfer to Paradisus has been smooth. Great memories for us!

reviews.author: Steve T
reviews.title: Saved My Life!
reviews.text: While swimming in the ocean on a beautiful day last December I got caught in a riptide and floundered off shore, exhausted.  If not for the assistance of Angel, the Lifeguard at the hotel, I think that I would have drowned.  He is typical of the exemplary employees there.  Thank you,again.

reviews.author: TillyAlberta_
reviews.title: Great time in Cancun!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus from Christmas Day to New Years Day and our trip was amazing! From the restaurants and bars to the poolside we had outstanding service. We got to know Tonatiuh from the "Toji Bar" and he was superb! He was very personable, funny and interactive and made our vacation much more enjoyable. We also got to know Alberto from the "Taco" restaurant and he was so much fun! He was very humorous, professional and he went above and beyond.The resort recently changed names and everything was newly renovated by the time we arrived. The resort truly is beautiful! We had two rooms booked, one for us and one for our teenage children.When we checked in they had us in separate buildings, which was not convenient at all. They weren't able to switch rooms that day but the next morning we were able to get a room right next door. The front desk staff was very accommodating. We paid for the ocean view side and it was gorgeous. We had a view of the pool area, the beach and of course the ocean. I would definitely recommend booking on this side of the resort. We stayed on the 3rd floor and had a great view.  The a-la-cart restaurants that we dined at were very nice, although we were unclear as to the rules for booking until later in the week. The buffet was very large and we never grew tired of the food. There was enough variety that you didn't have to eat the same thing twice. At the pool, they served tacos, hotdogs and hamburgers. This was very convenient and the service was great! We loved the pool although it was a bit cool and we really enjoyed the swim up bar.  The beach was beautiful! Even though the red flags were up we did enjoy some "body surfing" but you do have to be careful of the undertow. We did a day excursion to "Xplore" which was a lot of fun. They had ATV's, swimming and rafting in the stalactites and stalagmites and zip lining. It was a full day and worth the money. Our children also went para sailing and loved it. You can book this on the beach or in the hotel. We also took advantage of the photo session and ended up with some beautiful family photos. You can book this in "The Market" downstairs. The only negative thing I would say about this resort was that aside from the bars, there wasn't much for nightly entertainment. I definitely recommend this resort, whether you are a couple on a getaway or a family on vacation!

reviews.author: Randy A
reviews.title: Missed Opportunity
reviews.text:
This is simply one of the most beautiful hotels in cancun with one of the best
beaches I've ever seen.  Even the rooms are nice and the hotel atrium is almost
breathtaking.  But it seems everything is so complicated at this hotel that if you
want anything out of the norm, you better dedicate an hour or two to trying to 
work it out.  For instance, I had to make three phone calls and wait three hours
to get a rollaway bed for my son, we had to make three maitenance calls for 
things not working in our room.  And trying to reserve a cabana out by the pool
took walking to three different locations in the hotel, only to be told there were none to reserve, when the one we sat by all day went unused.  I realize it is a 
big hotel but there is a little dysfunctionality going on in management.

reviews.author: CL0111
reviews.title: Nice beach side hotel
reviews.text:
Stayed here back in November 2012 when it was the Gran Melia Cancun.  Was here for a conference so I didn't get to enjoy all the amenities.  
Ride from airport to hotel took about 20 minutes.
Check in was reasonably quick, make sure they give you the bracelet thing so you can enjoy the all inclusive stuff.  When eating at the fancier restaurants in the basement, make sure to ask if it's included or if you have to pay extra.
Room was facing the road, but I could see the beach and ocean from the balcony.  The rooms on the other side of the hall were facing the beach and ocean as well, just closer.
Went to the buffet in the basement and it had a decent variety of food.  There's a carving station with a soft taco made to order station in the back corner.
The air conditioning in the room was great, but in the public areas like the lobby and hallways, it was humid.  Be sure to go outside (to the back) and enjoy the beach - I only got to walk it since there was no free time with the conference though.

reviews.author: moejoe_13
reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.text:
We traveled to this hotel on Dec 29, 2012 to Jan 5, 2012 with two small children.  This was our first time staying in Cancun as we usually always stay in the Mayan Riviera.  I was a little frustrated with the check in process as we were directed to the time share people, to show us to our room and tell us about the resort.  They wanted to spend time telling us about things but I was short with them that I was not interested, we had two small children and we wanted to get to our room. I did not realize that they were time share people until later on in the week.  Don't be fooled!  Right after you check in you will be directed to them to be taken to your room.

The hotel lobby is beautiful! We had an oceanview room which was very nice with a great view of the pool and ocean.  You have to get up early to reserve a chair by the pool or beach or else you will be left with nothing.  There are cabana beds available which always say that they are reserved but we manged to use one for a few days and nobody said anything to us.  I like the BBQ by the pool, you can get burgers, hotdogs, fries, and nachos.  Ask for your burger well done if you don't like it pink.  The service was extraordinary by the pool, Christian was amazing!

The beach was beautiful, however I was very disappointed with not being able to really swim in the ocean.  It was rough and there was red flags every day.  Tons of Mexicans selling things on the beach, which I like.

Food was good.  I didn't find the buffet all that impressive.  I liked the option of eating outside overlooking the ocean for breakfast and dinners.  The Tapas a lacarte was not too impressive.  We ate at the Market Grill a lacarte twice because we enjoyed the first time so much.  After the second time, we got sick.  Not sure if it was the food.  Our kids were able to dish up at the buffet and we could eat the at the restaurant!

Overall, beautiful place! I would not be scared of it.  Stay away from the time share people! Lounges are beautiful and the lobby is very unique.  I wouldn't hesitate to go back and I have very high standards.

reviews.author: Anthony S
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation!
reviews.text:
The beach was gorgeous. The food was excellent. But the service was outstanding. Our private butler in the private concierge, Karla, made our trip extra special by going above and beyond. The two young ladies, Fernanda and Viridiana, that worked in the concierge area, couldn't have been any more helpful. The experience director, Fred, was helpful on many occasions and a great addition to that hotel. Not much for the teenagers to do at night other than the shows, which were fun, but my kids seemed bored at night. Overall, this hotel is a winner!

-Tony S. (N.Y.)

reviews.author: Barabbas_10
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text:
We stayed in this hotel New year 2012 and it was still Gran Melia. The hotel is fantastic, the lobby,the service,the people, just Perfect. The room size is massive with big terrace with views over the sea. It has 2 or 3 very big pools and then access to the beach. They used to have service also on the beach I am not sure how it is now when the changed to Paradisus. The food is not that good but for me was not big issue...because almost every night we were eating outside. The spa looks very nice. The hotel grounds are beautiful and the lobby is Wow..The hotel by my standards has one of the beach area of all of hotels in the hotel zone. There is a bus stop just in front of the hotel and buses are every 5-10 minutes to get to shopping or in down town Cancun for party. 
Overall fantastic hotel(beach,views and service) in excellent location.

reviews.author: moran b
reviews.title: simply execellent!!!
reviews.text: we arrived to cancun for only one night and we were looking for the best hotel at the area. at the reception a very nice guy was helping us and heard that we are on our honeymoon so he offered us to get the "red level" service- v.i.p floor. it was the best desicion we've made!!!!! everything was so perfect and defintilly worth every peso!!

reviews.author: manuel p
reviews.title: A battery charger
reviews.text:
The buildings arquitecture are a statement in itself, pyramids with balconies looking to the sea,  disposed in a way so you can´t see any neighbour and nobody can´t see you, perfect to enjoy your privacy reading a book. 

The pool has a Balinese beds area only for adults, where you can also relax and enjoy your drinks looking to the sea. So you can travel with friends with kids and also enjoy silence.

Worth to mention the great Spa with a great Hydrotherapy circuit, and the world class chef Martin Berasategui restaurant inside the hotel, with an 8 steps menu.

Personnel very kind and efficient, everybody says hello with a smile and hand in the heart.

Congratulations, I will come back.

reviews.author: Miguelhigareda
reviews.title: Superb!
reviews.text: We stay at the hotel and also celebrated Michelle & Scott weeding: 70 people attended, all comments were geat, either about the beauty of the hotel, the service and attention, food, pool, spa,  great attention.  Congratulations!

reviews.author: Jackie L
reviews.title: Relaxing, Fun, delicious, Friendly and Ocean Paradise
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful, inside and out. The Lobby transported you to an organic spirit. The 3 daily buffets served a tremendous amount of food with many choices. We really enjoyed the poolside food service and the outdoor BBQ. Burgers were the BEST I have ever eaten! The high end restaurants were fantastic and romantic. Food was delicious and the service was nothing short of 6 star quality. The beach and pool areas were clean and well maintained.the staff was always very friendly,attentive and helpful. The hotel was under construction when we arrived. Unfortunately our tour operator did not inform us of this. I had asked to speak with the Manager who was very accommodating by upgrading us to a lovely ocean view room where we woke up to a stunning sunrise every morning to start our day in paradise. I am in the hospitality and development industry, therefor I can appreciate the betterment of the hotel for future enjoyment. It is impossible to upgrade a hotel and be shut down simultaneously. The loss of revenue would enable the progress and conversion of the hotel. Now how happy would travelers be if that were to happen? They wouldn't be. In mine and my sisters opinion it did not interfere with our relaxation. Construction time frames were respectful of daily events and guests. A special mention to the Site/project manager he was an extreme gentleman and took special care of everyone he encountered. Hats off to him and his team! I have been sharing my positive experience with everyone I know and referring them to Paradisus (Formerly Gran Melia). I know from our direct experience with this wonderful hotel that they would not be disappointed and I personally look forward to returning in the future!

reviews.author: MotorCityDude
reviews.title: Enjoyed my stay pretty decent hotel
reviews.text: My wife and I decided at the last minute to take an Xmas break vacation so our options were limited. From the airport we were told by the taxi driver that it was no longer called the Melia anymore but on the website it still goes by that name so it's kinda Deceptive. Once we arrived our room wasn't ready which is really the norm these days unless u get lucky so that was no biggie.. We were all-inclusive so we went to eat at the buffet and it was pretty good, the variety of meats and cheeses were decent along with the sides but the desserts weren't really were they should be but overall it's was ok.. We ate there a lot because we could walk right in and be seated. We also ate at the Mexican restaurant my wife didnt care for it but I thought it was ok on the outside its a restaurant called the grill where most of the food was cooked right on the spot, burgers,dogs and pasta with a nice salad bar . We didnt managed to eat at the higher end restaurant because that's not 100% inclusive which is strange but whatever our Excursions kept us busy.. The pool and beach were great we laid on the beach for hours and never hit the pool. The nightlife is pretty cool if your into it if not get a room farther away from the center.. The rooms were so-so the 1st thing I notice entering the rooms were the doors there kinda flimsy and they don't seem Sturdy at all. Once inside it was pretty cool, nice little couch for seating and cocktail table even though there was a chipped Glass on top so potential to cut yourself the bed was cool and the view was a garden view. Headed to the bathroom you have to step up to enter it so if u forget it leaving out you might twist your ankle especially at night with the lights off.. I couldnt understand how the knobs worked on the shower kinda confusing but its a waterfall faucet so it's pretty cool but the plaster around it needs to be sanded and repainted. Overall I had a pretty good experience at the Melia oops I mean Paradius Cancun I've never had all inclusive so being my 1st time I wasnt sure what to expect... But you always remember your 1st!!!!

reviews.author: Mjb249
reviews.title: Good stay with some great aspects as well as some shortcomings
reviews.text:
Hotel is certainly one of the nicer hotels in the area and one of the better known. It was previously the grand melia and people still know it by that name.

Pros: 

1) Great facility grounds with an amazing lobby area. Has four? pyramids with most all rooms having full or partial ocean views.
2) nice pool and pool bar
3) great performances at the lobby bar area
4) lots of dining options

Cons:
1) service was very hit or miss. We were here for 8 days and visited every restaurant. Of these restaurants 5 had servers who could care less about what we ordered and providing any level of service. Granted they generally don't get tipped much on average (given the large portion of European tourists who are not accustomed to it) it was disheartening to see such apathetic people. 

One MAJOR exception was Alberto Cortes who was our server on 2 nights at Mole restaurant. Alberto was phenomenal. His English was the best we had heard at the resort and he never disappointed with food or drink recommendations. Coming from New York with restaurants that that've phenomenal service, Alberto was a welcome difference from most others at the resort.

2) towel service requires a card! Ridiculous
3) restaurants require a full reservation. Not that big a deal but inconvenient if you forget to make one.
4) golf course could be nicer

All in all a good place for both singles looking to hang out as well as families with children (lots of scheduled activities). Will head back.

reviews.author: Marcela C
reviews.title: Do NOT stay here!
reviews.text:
What a terrible experience! Upon our arrival, after 2 hours to check-in and a very tired baby, we are informed that the promotion we booked with EXPEDIA was actually a little booklet with some louzy coupons. The reason we booked this hotel was because we would get a $200 dollar hotel credit, that we thought we could use to buy food, go to the spa, etc.

After that, the hostess kindly take us to our rooms and tell us that the first morning breakfast was free. We happily get to the NAOS restaurant the following morning and look like complete idiots when informed that there was no free breakfast, but a charge of 35 dollars per person for a crappy buffet.

We came with our daughter who wakes up early, so we were always the first ones to get to the pool in the morning. Let me tell you that there were no chairs available to use, they were all marked with towels/books/sun lotion. We found out that there was a "mafia" of people who pretended to be guests, who actually worked at the hotel for tips to get you a chair. Ridiculous! These people will do anything to get your money!

I felt unsave the whole time. Now reading some of the reviews I consider my family lucky because we didn't get robbed.

The hotel is beautiful, it looks like a 5 star hotel but has a 1 star service. The food SUCKS. Service the worst I have ever experienced. I had to ask for shampoo, soap, new towels EVERY SINGLE DAY.

The bathroom smelled like sewage and I had to call several times to get someone in maintenance to take a look. The guy arrives at the room with some scented bleach and tried to cover the problem.

I would NOT recommend this hotel to my worst enemy!!!!!

reviews.author: DCTransient
reviews.title: Lovely Year End Break
reviews.text:
My stay involved myself, wife, 18 year old daughter and her friend, in 2 rooms. It was all inclusive with Royal Service. First of all if, you are any kind of sophisticated traveller and can afford it, Royal is the way to go, but they do not allow children under 18 so there is that requirement which is part of the benefit if you are so inclined. We were in building 5 ( lagoon view) which is the Royal building with its own concierge. The staff were extremely friendly, efficient and attentive. As with any hospitality situation in Mexico it goes a long way if you can or at least try to speak even high school spanish. These are very warm people after all and they appreciate the effort you make to treat them with respect.

I have read many negative reviews here and it appears that the renovations made to pretty much all the restaurants as part of the changeover to Paradisus was the problem. Since our stay began 12/27 for 7 nights fortunately most of the heavy work was done. There was no noise, very few workers and they were doing mostly finishing work. In that regard, I would strongly suggest to the hotel that ALL the restaurant windows, both interior and exterior, be cleaned thoroughly as they are appear to have not been done so since the renovations. A positive is that there are 5 restaurants that serve only a la carte, in that they do not offer buffets. This is in addition to Naos which is the all buffet restaurant for breakfast, lunch and dinner not associated with, but available to Royal guests. Over all the food is average to better than average depending on the restaurant. Tempo is definitely the top of the line and can compete in any US city for fine dinning. Presently it has a tasting menu with 7 courses. The maitre d informed us that in several weeks there will be a change to a full menu service. Reservations in all a la cart restaurants are recommended, even before arriving via email to the hotel, especially in peak weeks.

The Royal guests have their own private pool area with out door bar, restaurant and waiter service in the pool area and on the beach. This is in addition to an indoor lounge area that is open for a lighter breakfast and for  pre-dinner cocktails and snacks.

Now for a few areas that need improvement. The Naos buffet is nowhere near the quality to be expected for this hotel. Nothing looks terribly appetizing nor very creative in its layout. But if you looking for quantity and have kids, this can work for you.
The absence of a true "seafood" restaurant, given the location on the beach seems to be a minus. Strangely, there is a "meat carnival" known by many different names around the country where various meats such as beef, lamb, chicken, sausage, pork and turkey are brought out on skewers in a restaurant called "The Market Grill". For me, this just didn't seem to work in such a locale as this.

The gym is well below adequate. It is much too small for the size of the hotel. With only 2 treadmills, there is never enough equipment available. (On my last day 2 more were added)
We did not use the SPA but were given a tour and it seems to be top of the line in the services it offers.

Lastly, I would like to see a private, fine dinning restaurant for Royal Service. Personally, I am somewhat fussy about having young children nearby when dinning in a resort. The only way around this is to make late reservations at the Paradisus and that is not a guarantee.

So, to summarize, this was a great way to spend the year end holiday with the family. The beachfront in the Cancun hotel zone is among the best I have ever seen. The weather is very comfortable. There are many hotels in the zone and I am sure many are as good as or even better than Paradisus; there are probably some that are worse. That's the way it goes. Ultimately its what we make of it and how we deal with the occasional glitches that always seem to come up on vacation. The important thing is that we are usually with people we love.

reviews.author: Danny E
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text:
I was there with my wife and 2 kids for Christmas and New Year 2012. We stayed a total of 10 nights. We had an all-inclusive package. We only have great things to say about our stay. From the greeters at the door, to the waiter on the beach, everyone was very proffessional and very helpful. Our check-in process was seemless. Our rooms were always comfortable, tidy, and clean. The breakfast and lunch buffets were very good, althought at times, the variety of dishes suffered from the hotel being fully booked at this time of the year. The beach was fantastic as usual. We would have appreciated some heated pools for the kids in december, but I guess it is Cancun after all, and it's hot most of the year. The kids club was very entertaining to our children, and gave me and my wife quite a bit of alone relaxing time. I used the Spa facilities, including the warmed hydrotherapy pool, the sauna, and the vapor room. They were all excellent, and the staff was very attentive. 
The New Year party was excellent, they had a DJ from NYC, and he kept the night very alive. The dinner before the party was standard, but the wine was excellent. 
Overall we had a great time, and we were very impressed by the attentive staff that eventually came to know us by name. We would defenitelty go again.

reviews.author: Aimen
reviews.title: Horrible stay
reviews.text: We stayed here for 4 days in september. Its a horrible hotel, dirty and poor service. will not stay here again. The in hotel  restaurants are sub-par and too expensive for the quality. Find another hotel. There are much better deals for your money.

reviews.author: Lovetotravelygc
reviews.title: Disappointed in Cancun
reviews.text: We stayed here in a group of 17 (friends and family), and everyone was hugely disappointed.  We have all been to Mexico countless of times.  This hotel was supposedly renovated, but it shows no signs of same.  The place is horrible.  The rooms smell of mold. The buffets and food everywhere was mediocre.  Upon checking out we were prevented from physically leaving in the car because we hadn't received what they call an exit voucher from the checkout staff even though we had prepaid in full and had a credit card on file.  Upon trying to receive the voucher, they made countless mistakes delaying our hotel departure unreasonably.  All 17 of us have traveled extensively, and we were all shocked at the low standards and bureaucracy at this hotel.

reviews.author: JDNY23
reviews.title: Fast fall from Gran Melia standards
reviews.text: It pains me to write this, because I look forward to our annual trip to Cancun every winter and had even impressed hard to please in laws with a fabulous stay at the Gran Melia in the past. Prior to arrival, I was told in 4 separate emails that construction would be finished by the time we arrived on Dec 18th. That was not the case, and while the work was being done very quickly it still created a lot of noise, kicked up debris, and smelled like a mix of chemicals. Shortly after arrival, we ran into 2 different people who had been robbed which was very unsettling. Negative reviews that we had read on TripAdvisor before coming suddenly disappeared mid stay, all the way back until Dec 2011. Weird. On to drinks. Be careful with the margaritas. They use some sort of sour mix that got me sick after having 2 the first day of vacation. I'd recommend sticking with beer, pina coladas or trying tequila with soda water and fresh lime instead. Reservations at the restaurants were very difficult to get even with the help of a concierge. Make sure you have the reservation slip in writing. Don't bother with the sushi restaurant unless you enjoy blocks of rice with cream cheese cubes. On a positive note, the waiters at the restaurants were very good and attentive, which helped ease the frustration. Things came to a head when our group of 8 was at first turned away for our reservations at Tempo due to 2 of the gentlemen wearing jeans. Upon arrival, we were given a paper outlining the required resort casual attire for men as including jeans and had to go back to the room to get this piece of paper as proof. This issue could have been handled by management in a non-combative way. Once we got through that, dinner was very good and if you can get into Tempo, I'd highly recommend it. Fit for foodies. Checkout was a nightmare with long lines and miscommunication. Thankfully, we were heading to Playa del Carmen afterwards so real relaxation could begin. Every time it seemed like things were getting back on track something else bad would happen. The beautiful beach front and private balcony facing the ocean aren't enough to carry the rest of the baggage involved.

reviews.author: S N
reviews.title: Save yourself. Go elsewhere. March 2025.
reviews.text:
This hotel is a two star at most and not worth the money. There is an impressive level of incompetence and disregard for customer service.

We are currently staying at this hotel and would recommend families stay elsewhere. Despite the comments below, if you do choose to stay here I recommend paying extra for the family concierge to make a terrible experience slightly less terrible.

Stay elsewhere for the following reasons
1. Restaurant will suddenly run out of food (without warning or any alternatives) in the middle of the day.
2. Service is abhorrent. Difficult to find anyone to get water or any drink. Buffet will open but the speciality food stations (which have all the decent food) will stay closed for an extra 30-40 minutes.
3. There are salespeople located throughout the hotel who constantly that hassle you for upgrades and other additional paid services. It’s unfortunately not something you can escape as they are throughout the main floor and beach area.
4. Buffet food (after waiting in a lengthy line) is limited, repetitive, and sits out for hours. Several guests outside of our family and including our family were sick. Servers act annoyed when guests sit in their section. One had the audacity to tell us that the hostess shouldn’t have sat us in his section because he already had too many people (even though his section was clearly not full).

Save yourself the experience and go elsewhere.

reviews.author: emel5672025
reviews.title: Dream vacation.
reviews.text: Luxurious destination, clean and beautiful room, front beach view with large pools. Activities every day. Friendly and helpful staff members.

reviews.author: camila h
reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: the food is very good, the excellent personal service most are friendly. gin gin and ger bar all the staff very attentive, bar kanna slow service the bartender is a little rude does not want to attend you fast.but if in the pool area the bartenders and waiters attended me amazing, thanks for everything,

reviews.author: pablo a
reviews.title: paradisus cancun
reviews.text: I was with my partner 3 days in the hotel, the hotel is good, clean in all areas very clean, the sea view very incredible beautiful. in the pool area, all the very friendly staff attentive, in the KANA area. the very rude bartender. I ordered cocktail, it takes more than half an hour to give me the drinks. treats you unwillingly, I don't know if there is no manager or manager to check those details. or also does not care how they work your collaborators.

reviews.author: patelron50
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: Hotel is very good services very poor. Family concierge is a joke. There is nothing like family concierge. Lalo was my family concierge and he did not contact me for 1 day and he was off another day and rest of 3 days he did not help a bit to make my stay enjoyable. Nothing. Waste of money. Better go with standard ocean view room and save some money.

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.title: Kidsdom is the best
reviews.text:
Kidsdom is a five star experience ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ 
Lety, Carlotta, Yadira, and Yessenia run a tight ship, they are incredibly professional and experienced! Our son is 4 and he loved every minute at the service. His highlights of the trip for sure. Gracias!!!

reviews.author: Venture25512129686
reviews.title: Family vacation was amazing with the help of Rodolfo Medina.
reviews.text: Rodolfo was an amazing concierge, he went above and beyond for my family. Made our vacation the best!! Even on his days off he reached out to me to make sure we were taken care of. Genuine and kind hearted. And I can not forget Baltazar and Didier that took care of my family while poolside. They made our Cabana experience very special. Paradisus Cancun was amazing.

reviews.author: Caroline C
reviews.title: Fabulous fun with our family!
reviews.text:
Wonderful resort! Dedicated staff and excellent service from so many areas of the resort. Daniel (entertainment) and Didier (poolside service) were exceptional!  

List of amazing aspects:
-Room cleanliness and comfort (beds are so comfy and rooms are very spacious and well kept)
-room service is fantastic with lovely friendly staff 
-pool side service is wonderful fro select individuals (mediocre from others). Didier was absolutely consistently fantastic! 
-entertainment is run by a very dedicated group of staff. Daniel and his team were so full of energy and fun to be around (advice: take the salsa and meringue lessons! You won’t be disappointed. And the Mario Kart tournament was super entertaining. 
-food was great at most of the restaurants. Flora was mediocre in terms of quality and service but the rest were wonderful. 

Other:
-pool was very cold the first day but warmed up over the couple first days (likely cold after being topped up due to evaporation and refill). Pools are deep (with the exception of a very small kid pool that is to the very side of the resort) so bring floatie wings and pdfs for your kids!
