-pool chairs are reserved by 7am and very competitive to get due to the no limit towel system and ability to reserve a spot for the day. We did get up every day at six am and were able to get a spot (8am to as too late) but just an fyi. 

Would highly recommend. The dedicated staff are what raise this place to the next level!

reviews.author: Mitushi
reviews.title: Excellent! Highly recommend for families.
reviews.text: We took the Family Concierge junior suite and it was well worth the additional amount! Our Destination concierge, Christian, sat with me the first day after check in and made suggestions for reservations for all of the restaurants at the resort, which gives preferential access for reservations and to some restaurants. Our kids loved the kidsdom teachers and activities which gave us breaks throughout the day and kept the kids occupied.

reviews.author: Tibisay O
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text:
We stayed as a family for the spring break. We had the family concierge service with Carlos, who did an amazing job and made our time there wonderful and easy. Staff at the restaurants offered a great service as well, food was good at some restaurant but Flora and  Salt were the best for us. The hotel needs more love, but we heard they're gonna close very soon for remodeling. 
Overall, it was great and we had a wonderful time together. I'm curious to see what they will do after remodeling.

reviews.author: Daniel F
reviews.title: Awesome place and people
reviews.text:
Overall great experience. The customer service at any resort can make it more break it. They were phenomenal. Christian our Destination Concierge was super helpful, friendly and efficient. Help us book all our restaurants and offered valuable info for all
Daily activities. Everyone from support staff and management were very helpful. Food is really good. Buffet great, restos are great as well. Wife and daughter were very happy the whole time. Kudos to the whole team. The resort isn’t brand new, and there are signs of aging, however the upkeep is great. Like every other resort in Cancun the beach is wavy and not great. The only downside.

reviews.author: Emma C
reviews.title: Yummy foods, come here!!
reviews.text: I went with my friends and Carlos was the best server!! Food was 10/10, everything is delicious! I got the tacos which were really good and yummy and so did my friends!!! Carlos was incredibly nice the entire time, very great service all around!

reviews.author: Mia L
reviews.title: Carlos the server
reviews.text: Carlos gave us great service at lunch at the Mexican restaurant. He was extremely accommodating and very patient with all of us. Pleasant dining experience and made sure we had very quick and speedy service. He went out of his way to make sure we had everything we wanted. Never an empty drink.

reviews.author: abby b
reviews.title: Unforgettable
reviews.text: Loved it!!! The service was amazing, the quality of the food was amazing, and any questions we had were answered immediately. His smile never left, making this a friendly environment and an enjoyable meal. I would definitely come again and recommend to a friend.

reviews.author: Eliza V
reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.text: Very limited options for dinner. Long waits for food, drinks, coffee etc. Perhaps they were understaffed. Found several cockroaches in the room without any comment from the staff. I’ve stayed at several nicer resorts in Mexico. This is not worth the money. The nicest part of the resort is the pool and beach views.

reviews.author: Trip52104867500
reviews.title: Great stay at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We upgraded to the Reserve (Adults Only) since it there was a lot of children/families in the regular area. If you are not travelling with children, I HIGHLY recommend upgrading to the Reserve as it is a lot more relaxing and completely changed our experience 

Galdi was our personal concierge in the Reserve and always made sure we were taken care of and texted us everyday to check in and make sure we were having a good time. He is professional, timely, kind, and excellent!

Lizbeth was my masseuse at the Yhi spa and if you need a deep tissue massage, she's definitely the one to book. She is professional, sweet, and ensured my comfort throughout my service. 

There are many activities scheduled for every day if your're interested. We did a Margarita Class with Nestor, who was SO fun, and made sure everyone had a good time as well as actually teaching us how to properly make margs. 

There is access to the pools, the beach, and several open bars. Note well there are several restaurants at the resort, but you need to make reservations 1-2 days before. Galdi helped us schedule all the reservations. There is a buffet but the line is long (at the family section). We never faced lines at the open restaurant in the Reserve :)

reviews.author: alexismcbride26
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Such a beautiful resort! We loved the location. The beach views were immaculate. The staff were so kind and attentive. We loved the coffee counter!!! The food was delicious. We were able to try multiple restaurants but the Malva buffet was honestly one of our favorites! So many different options to choose from. We took advantage of the daily craft activities with our son and also enjoyed the night entertainment which was also great! We can’t wait to visit again!

reviews.author: weddingmoons
reviews.title: Great RESORT in Cancun
reviews.text: Beautiful resort.  Clean and inviting.  Great entertainment for adults and children.  The Steak Restaurant is SUPERB!!! The greenery all over the resort is spectacular. The service was really good and pleasant.  I would recommend this resort for young families as so many were there during my stay.

reviews.author: carol
reviews.title: A WONDERFUL HOLIDAY AT THE PERFECT RESORT
reviews.text:
We returned from 10 fabulous days in the Reserve part of the Melia Paradisus, Cancun on 20 March. 
We had a Suite with Ocean View (Rm 5123) which we thoroughly enjoyed although the planned closure from May for a total refurbishment is definitely due!
Our holiday was totally enhanced by the Melia Staff experience. The service, friendliness and professionalism was unbeatable. 
All the staff at the Melia Paradisus Cancun were excellent but there are some who deserve a special mention. Enrique was our personal concierge and it would have been impossible to have had anyone better.  Being British our cups of tea are essential (!) and Enrique located a kettle for us as well as fresh milk.  He also managed to obtain feather pillows from housekeeping which was a big help to me.  Enrique made all our restaurant bookings, not such an easy task as it sounds!  He did everything with a warm smile and such friendliness and professionalism. He even surprised us on our departure to say Goodbye, I have to say that we’ve missed him since we arrived home!
We were checked in and out at the Reserve Reception by Oscar.  He was also very helpful, professional and friendly and we wish him well as he leaves Melia, Cancun.
Breakfast in the Reserve area was lovely with excellent choices and quality.  Lorena served us almost every morning and she made our day!  Her efficiency, friendliness, professionalism and SMILE (!) impressed us so much! She also served us in Sante at lunchtime.
David at the Reserve Swimming Pool also deserves a special mention.  He was so helpful and friendly, checking everything was ok for us every day.  I miss seeing his many photographs of the beautiful wild life at the resort and beach.  
We enjoyed dinner at the Restaurant SAL on two occasions and were made very welcome by Daniel and our 2 fabulous waiters, Leo and Ignacio, who were so friendly, professional and efficient.
Everyone we met from Housekeeping was also very friendly and helpful. In fact we found all the Melia staff more than helpful, friendly and cheerful.  They are a credit to the Melia Group.
We hope to return in March 2026 to see the completed Hotel Refurbishment (and hopefully many of the same staff!) and look forward to an equally exceptional experience.

reviews.author: Mariano R
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Excellent hotel experience, everything very clean, tidy and very helpful staff. Special mention to Ishmael from the spa who treated us to 10. The location is great and the stay very comfortable, paradise views perfect for relaxing.

reviews.author: kenjsutton
reviews.title: AN EXCELLENT EXPERIENCE DELIVERED BY EXCEPTIONAL STAFF
reviews.text:
We spent 10 wonderful days in the Reserve Section at the Melia Paradisus between 10 & 20 March. Despite the planned refurbishment and closure scheduled for May this did not affect our enjoyment. We had a Suite with Ocean View which we found really good, despite the obvious need for an upgrade.
As with any hotel the experience relies mostly on the Staff and the service they provide. You can have the most luxurious hotel in the world but without great staff the experience can be poor.
The experience started before we arrived when I contacted Emmanuel. The Supervisor of the Personal Concierges, who was extremely helpful in answering all our pre-arrival questions.
All the staff at the Melia Paradisus Cancun are excellent but I would like mention some in particular.  First and foremost is Enrique, our personal concierge who was absolutely fantastic. Apart from his excellent Customer/Hospitality skills there was absolutely nothing he could have done more to make our stay more special; a true asset to Melia. 
Check-in and Check-out at the Reserve Reception were both done with Oscar who was very friendly and informative.
Breakfast in the Reserve inside bar/restaurant area was really relaxed and the service we received from Lorena each morning was excellent both in terms of friendliness and efficiency. In the evening Julio always ensured I had my favourite drink/nightcap
The staff at the Reserve Swimming Pool were very helpful. David was especially friendly and helpful and made all our days at the Pool very relaxing and enjoyable.
The 2 dinners we had at the Restaurant 'SAL'  were made really special by the Head Waiter Daniel and more especially our 2 waiters Leo and Ignacio who were both 100% Professional in their efficiency knowledge and friendliness.
We definitely plan to return in March 2026 when the Refurbishments have been completed and look forward to an equally exceptional experience.

reviews.author: anaraquel a
reviews.title: Hotel incrivel as an excellent structure
reviews.text: I was at the hotel in March 2025 and had a great experience. Very good service, very attentive.  Large apartment, very comfortable and very clean, surrounded by lots of attention. Variety of restaurants with delicious food. The structure is very good. All very beautiful. What a wonderful sea!  Great location. I loved staying at the hotel and spent beautiful days. I will definitely stay at the hotel again at the next opportunity and will always recommend it.

reviews.author: Antonio Edson Pereira
reviews.title: EXCELLENT EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, very well located and with excellent service, very good facilities, excellent restaurants and entertainment.  I stayed in pyramid 5 "The Reserve" and with a travel agent I will indicate to my clients.

reviews.author: Petra M
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Beautiful resort; wonderful staff and the food was amazing. Special mention to our waiters Martin, Alexandro and Richer at the coffee bar; these three went out of their way to make us feel welcome. The rooms were cleaned daily and mini bar stocked up to your liking. The special restaurants were very good; with the exception of the Italian, pasta dishes lacking a little flavour. Would definitely go back to this resort.

reviews.author: Aiie
reviews.title: We are rested, well fed and brown!!
reviews.text: I am currently having diner at Sante, the Reserve restaurant, no kids. We’ve been here for a week. Ocean front reserve suite. I could not be happier. My only criticism is the food. It can be great or it can be meh. Our concierge is fantastic. I am going home brown and well-rested.

reviews.author: Kara S
reviews.title: Great massage!
reviews.text: I've been to paradisus cancun many times and enjoy visiting the spa. I had an excellent massage with Teresita at YHI spa. It was so relaxing and she has great flow. The hydrotherapy was nice. I highly recommend visiting the spa during your trip.

reviews.author: baguilar2025
reviews.title: Excellent experience Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Good service and lovely facilities. I was at a technology conference and enjoyed my stay

reviews.author: Camper561108
reviews.title: Family Vacation to Cancun
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay but did notice the lack of staff due to the hotel closing in a couple months of our stay. I think it was obvious some staff had already left.  The food at night was just OK but we did love the tacos and other options by the pool.  Breakfast was good as well.  I do think it's time for a remodel although the hotel was still very nice.  We did have roaches in our room however in Mexicos climate this might be hard for them to control.  The entertainment was pretty bad.  If you book a restaurant for 7:30 the entertainment is over before your dinner is done.  I would prefer some later night shows and not so much geared towards little kids.  The rooms were nice and the staff they had was good as well.  The pool area and beach are very nice.  I think due to the hotel closing it did make service slow and limited.  The guys onsite from Aqua World were so nice.  We booked a private boat for 4 hours and it was well worth the cost.  It was great and the guy that booked us would say hello everyday and call me by name. I was quite impressed with him.  Thank you for a great trip and I hope to see the hotel after renovations.

reviews.author: VoyageurPositif
reviews.title: Wonderful Holidays!!!
reviews.text:
We spent a wonderful week in Paradise Cancun. I do not understand all the negative reviews about this hotel.

We had the Junior Suite Grand Ocean View ( Without reservation). 
Yes , we see some signs of wear of time (but represents a detail, unimportant, which did not affect our appreciation of the site. Whether it's the rooms or the open spaces, it's very clean.

On arrival, we were welcomed. Our bracelet is also our key. We were offered a drink. Our luggage was taken care of and brought to our room.

On the 3rd floor we had a breathtaking view. At our disposal a bar, snacks, dressing gowns, good hygiene products and clean and very comfortable bedding.

Throughout the hotel, there is a relaxing zen atmosphere. The interior gardens are beautiful.

The food is excellent at the buffet. Our favorite for reservations was Lemon Fish. Reservation of à la carte restaurants is simple. (10:00 to 16:00). We also enjoyed the pizzas cooked in an oven outside the pool. The small Nespresso cafe gives excellent service. Special thanks to Alfjandro/Ricardo for the extreme kindness.  Enjoying your coffee in front of the ocean is a pure moment of happiness in the morning.

For chairs and palapas, we were going to reserve a place at the beach around 6:30am.  The pool booked earlier and is very popular. We prefer the beach and we have never had a problem. In addition to your towel, you should also put personal things (e.g. magazine, book, caps, etc.) We brought personal effects in our suitcase specifically for this. If it is just the hotel towel, we have seen, almost every day, guests remove them and take the place. Accessibility to having beach towels is unlimited and uncontrolled. You can also ask an employee to find you a place. They know, when chairs with towels only, haven't been used for hours.

There is entertainment every evening from 8:00 to 9:30. Then it's quiet on the site. We were comfortable with the hours. We'd rather enjoy our day than go to bed in the early hours of the morning.

We have been informed that renovations will begin in June 2025. The site will be closed for one year. We will definitely come back to it, hoping to find the same qualities and atmosphere that we enjoyed so much. The only recommendation on our part would be to increase the number of bathrooms for the pool and beach.

The beach is beautiful, the color of the ocean is a delight for the eyes. There is a bar and food service at the pool and at the beach.

The staff is extremely kind, hardworking and friendly.

We would like to thank Paradisus Cancun for a wonderful week.

reviews.author: nonno97
reviews.title: Nice, family friendly, great staff and service
reviews.text:
The staff are very friendly and attentive! Gerardo and Ariadna provided wonderful service at the buffet. We always looked for them when we went to the restaurant.
My kids loved the kids club and made friends when they were there. They had wonderful time doing activities with the group! 
We enjoyed the pool, the food, the stay, and the sunshine!

reviews.author: Agustin S
reviews.title: Luxury stay
reviews.text:
We stayed with my partner 4 nights. The truth is that the hotel exceeded our expectations, from the time we arrived until the last day we were treated in the best way. 
Special mention for our concierge Enrique who took care of all our doubts and facilitated everything in our stay. 
Spectacular room, all top restaurants, excellent staff overall. 

Super recommended.

reviews.author: Victoria V
reviews.title: Recommendation of Hotel Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Excellent service and organization by the hotel.
The facilities very nice and comfortable.
We were pleased to meet Concierge Enrique who guided and accompanied us at all times making our stay more pleasant.

reviews.author: lherrera2025
reviews.title: HOTEL RATING
reviews.text: The facilities are nice to go to family, friends or work group. The restaurant experience was very good. Excellent food. There are some areas in the area near the assassin in Tower 3 that does not smell good, I do not know if there is any intake or reservoir of water that generates that smell. The rest of the stay was pleasant.

reviews.author: Jennie I
reviews.title: Christian should be at a 5+ Star resort!
reviews.text:
We had the absolute pleasure of having Christian as our concierge during our stay at Paradisus Cancun, and WOW—he truly went above and beyond to make us feel like royalty! From the moment we arrived, he took care of all our reservations, checked in with us daily via text, and made sure we were always in the loop with what was happening around the resort.
He even steamed our outfits for the wedding we were in, brought us surprise treats like champagne and chocolate-covered strawberries, and regularly stopped by to see if we needed anything. His professionalism, kindness, and attention to every little detail made us feel like we were staying with family.
We had never stayed at this resort before, but we’re so grateful for Christian he was a huge part of why our experience was so memorable. Honestly, he should be working at a 5+ star resort—he’s that exceptional! Even after the trip, we still keep in touch.
If you're reading this, Majestic Elegance—steal him!! 😄
Thank you again, Christian! You made our trip unforgettable.

reviews.author: jandaffnievizcarra
reviews.title: Paradisus Experience
reviews.text: Staff are all friendly and the service was great. The only problem was when you eat in the restaurant they buy time when serving your food that causes a slow service. Aside from that everything was great

reviews.author: Anna J
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Excellent location with a beautiful beach front position, bus stop on the main road and lots of taxis available if you fancy sightseeing.
Team members are attentive and friendly.
The check in process was rather long due to information from our booking not being transferred correctly- which in no way was the fault of the young lady checking us in at the level.
Would have been nice to be offered a chilled drink on our arrival! 
We had a sea view room which was gorgeous waking up to this and the over all size of the room was good but definitely needs some upgrades, with splatters of something on the walls, tatty furniture and fruit platter on the table that had obviously been sitting there for a while as the fruit had become dry.
Shower which does not drain properly and ends up all over the bathroom floor.
Definitely well worth upgrading to level as you have your own bar/lounge/breakfast area exclusively for the level guest only.
Use of the Bali bed and sun loungers, you need to book Bali beds through your concierge and then go on the waiting list.
The amount of these available is very limited, also a severe shortage of parasols.
A special thank you to Enrique our concierge, Lorena and Luis  for their attentive service during breakfast. Julio for his excellent bar and cocktail making skills. Jacob for looking after us by the adults only poolside and also looking after Daisy.

reviews.author: Andy N
reviews.title: Blue Agave
reviews.text: Antolino was a great server! Tacos were amazing especially the Langua! The restaurant was comfortable and clean. The Mojito and Margaritas were  great. We had one of each of the tacos to experience every flavor they had to offer. We will be here again!

reviews.author: anshumahajan82
reviews.title: Not worth what we paid for
reviews.text:
Long waitings for restaurants, bar staff was not friendly and liquor was not good. 
Many other resorts in same or better price. 
Will never go back to this one.

reviews.author: thexavierwesley
reviews.title: 10/10 All Around
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights all inclusive. Favorite parts include, but not limited to, the pool side bar, the buffet, and the nespresso corner, the kind workers, the beach, the pool, and more! Had an amazing time, and it was honestly a steal of a price for how much we did/had.

reviews.author: CHRISTOPHER N
reviews.title: Cancun Trip
reviews.text: Everything was amazing, our private concierge Christian took care of us and made sure we had everything we needed. Definitely relaxing and the food was amazing. We will highly recommend this to especially the adult reserve if you need that private time

reviews.author: anemitz2025
reviews.title: Great break for some sun and sand!
reviews.text: Great experience. Large pool areas, good beach (just the weather was windy so couldn't spend much time in the ocean). Our family's best concierge experience! Enrique helped us get the most out of our short stay!

reviews.author: Kim423232
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text:
The hotel did not meet the standards of a 4-star establishment. The rooms were unremarkable and lacked appeal. Despite paying extra for concierge service, there was no record of this upon arrival, requiring me to visit the check-in desk and provide proof of payment, which was both inconvenient and frustrating. Considering the cost of our stay, the experience felt significantly overpriced. Our concierge offered only average service, and by the time she reached out, our friends had already secured reservations through their own concierge. The kids' club was disappointing for our 10-year-old, as its activities were primarily designed for younger children, resulting in a lack of engagement for older kids. Moreover, our room was situated near the activity area, making it difficult to get to bed before 11 p.m. This was particularly problematic given we had a 7-year-old and a 10-year-old with morning plans, which negatively impacted our overall experience. When the concierge finally checked on us late Monday afternoon, she offered to look for an alternative room, but we declined as our departure was scheduled for Wednesday morning.
Ultimately, while the food and the excellent restaurant and cabana staff redeemed our stay, without their exceptional service, we would have rated this hotel 1 star. It was the dining experience and the professionalism of the waitstaff that truly saved our trip.

reviews.author: Jana R
reviews.title: Favorite for Cancun Girls Trip
reviews.text: My favorite part of visiting Paradisus Cancun is the staff! My friends & I have been coming for several years & have always had a great experience. Rodrigo takes care of us at the pool, Uriel kept us grooving, Abraham, Katrina & Javier are our besties for evening cocktails. Daniel hands down, entertainer of the year!! Above & beyond & we can’t wait to come back after renovations to see our friends again! Jose set the bar for concierge & Carlos has consistently taken care of us & we couldn’t be happier. Thank you for the memories & good times. ❤️ Adios, hasta la proxima.

reviews.author: Sebastian R
reviews.title: A bed cot and poor service
reviews.text: The service is bad, half the things are not included, the bar closes at 11 (there is nothing open after that time I never saw anything like that). We got hit. A cot for the third adult person that included the reservation. Everything is quite loose except the facilities which are beautiful.

reviews.author: Anna Z
reviews.title: Melia Paradisus has the best night life on resort!
reviews.text:
Abraham, Katrina and Javier at the Ginger Bar make the night!  The service, the specialty cocktails and personal care are top notch!

Daniel as MC makes the evening so enjoyable!
Uriel on the music keeps you dancing and shaking’!

Come back every year - can’t wait for Spring 2027!

reviews.author: Dorian M
reviews.title: Super service
reviews.text: Carlos and gladys in the ginger bar the best, I loved their service would come back for them were super friendly, the rooms and all the service the truth will be back soon and I always hope to find the guys from the bar very friendly:)

reviews.author: ADMKIDS
reviews.title: All inclusive!
reviews.text: We had a family of 4. Two adults and 2 kids, younger than 10. It was an amazing experience.  We look forward to doing this again. Kidszone was great for us to get some time to ourselves. For the family master suite, I know they are renovating, but it would be nice for them to have 2 beds in place of one king. When booking online, I called a couple weeks in advance as well as 2 days before the trip to confirm I had the double beds family suite. We got only the king family suite. The hotel said they only had 1 or 2 rooms of this nature. Besides this hiccup in our trip we had a wonderful time!

reviews.author: christianvicente2025
reviews.title: An unforgettable experience
reviews.text: A very good stay, good food, excellent service, diversity, and spacious environments. The days I was there, believe me I won't forget you in my life, my summary Excellent.

reviews.author: TESI G
reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.text:
Terrible value , overpriced. Food quality in all restaurants sub par. No recycling bins , no sanitizer stations at hotel for buffet /restaurants . 
Circle “member” area is dishonest and time share scam

reviews.author: Neil J
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Our second visit to Paradisus. On the whole, a very good hotel, but looking tired and dated. The hotel is closing for renovations soon. As usual, the staff make the hotel and special mentions must be made for our concierge Enrique, barman Julio (in the Level area) and Lorena at breakfast.

reviews.author: RAYMOND M
reviews.title: Our Infinitive Black Membership
reviews.text:
We have been enjoying the Black Circle Membership since 2019 and previously Club Meliá (which we joined in 2015). We have been in Punta Cana and Mexico for many years and  we have been enjoying those countries and our membership there so far. We were in La Perla adult’s only last year and in Paradisus Cancún this year and we enjoyed both Paradisus Hotels. However, how can a hotel give a full service to Infinitive Black Members and another hotel cannot give that Infinitive service?  
It has taking us some time to get used to the membership but we have a full understanding of the Circle Black Membership now. So what is given in hotels should be the same all over the world. 
We would like to thank the personnel in all restaurants (Paradisus Cancún) all bars, coffee Nespresso shop, Balibeds in The Reserve and in Club Meliá, for their professionalism,  outstanding work ethics, and kindness towards all the guests and Members. A big thanks to the staff in the Reserve Adults Only who gave their best all day long (Gabriella, Valeria, Diego…including kitchen staff).

reviews.author: Torimcnally
reviews.title: The best vacation ever thanks to our concierge
reviews.text: We just returned. Rodolfo Medina (our concierge) was phenomenal! Very attentive, always pleasant, caring & really skilled at his job when we needed help with things . Rodolfo is an amazing asset to Club Melia and is a true brand ambassador.

reviews.author: Matias M
reviews.title: Impeccable
reviews.text: Excellent from start to finish, the restaurants fine, the overall service very good, the cleanliness and comfort of the hotel spotless. I make special mention of Galdino who was very attentive to us at all times. Thank you so much for everything!!

reviews.author: Vitamin Sea
reviews.title: Amazing Experience – Can’t Wait to Return After Renovations!
reviews.text:
I just returned from an incredible trip to Cancun, and I have to say this resort is absolutely one of the best on the strip! The beach was stunning—pristine, crystal-clear water, and soft sand. It was definitely one of the best beaches I've experienced in Cancun.

A huge shoutout to Lalo, my concierge, who went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect during my stay. He was always ready and willing to help with anything I needed—thank you so much, Lalo!

I also want to thank David and Victor, who took such great care of us by the pool. They made our time in the cabanas extra special and comfortable. We had an amazing time relaxing under the sun with their excellent service! Bartenders at the Ginger Bar were top class thank you for the service!

I did learn that the resort will be closing in June for renovations, but I’m already excited to return in 2026 once everything is updated. I have no doubt it will be even better when it reopens! Highly recommend this place for a fantastic vacation.

reviews.author: Mama475
reviews.title: horrendous service in emergency situation
reviews.text:
I am going to preface this review by saying that I have been coming to the Cancun area for 40 years and have stayed at dozens of hotels in Mexico. I stayed at this resort’s sister property in Playa del Carmen which was wonderful.

February, 2025: Our first night here, my mother tripped on an ill-placed ledge going into the bathroom in our room. She broke her hand in two places, was severely bruised all over her body, and broke a crack in her knee. Medical care came to the room at midnight. We spent 6 hours the next day in the hospital and she will need surgery. She could not go in the water during our stay and was mostly confined to the room because she did not feel well enough to get around.

I am absolutely astonished by the hotel’s complete lack of care regarding this incident. We had to take our own cab to the hospital. I spoke to two managers and a dozen different people and no one addressed anything regarding this fall. We had an additional complaint from night one regarding the noise outside the room being blaring music until 10pm— we were told this would not be every night, which was flat-out untrue.

I was given an anonymous WhatsApp guest service phone number to text and all they did for us is make a dinner reservation. I asked multiple times over WhatsApp and email for a copy of the hotel’s incident report and they refused to give it to me— they handed me my own handwritten paragraph regarding the incident. There are so many small things that could have been done to make my mother’s stay more comfortable and…. nothing.

I would maybe just chalk it up to “Mexico” but when our friends who had the family concierge were upset about their son’s birthday cake being an hour late, they were sent two cakes and a bottle of champagne.

Honestly, this experience has completely turned me off from the entire Melia brand, whose marketing is terrific. This ruined our vacation as well as the week was about being a nursemaid to my mother rather than relaxing, and with no one else to help with my young son.

She has a bill from the hospital that will need to be addressed, but that the entire staff basically ignored that this happened on the property was astounding to me.

The kids club was terrific and the best aspect of our stay.

reviews.author: Cqfv1408
reviews.title: A team at the Top in a site that will close a few months for renovation
reviews.text: What a service!, cleaning staff, bars, restaurants, swimming pool, administrative service and especially the concierge Rodolfo, we received a service at the top despite a somewhat failed start. As announced in the title, the site is a little aging and will be renovated in the coming months. Some traffic signs would be welcome as the site is large and it is not easy to navigate.  Compared to Melià Punta Cana, the food is below although decent. large swimming pools and blue sea at the top. I highly recommend staying at this hotel as soon as the renovation is complete.

reviews.author: Юля К
reviews.title: Not the best experience
reviews.text: The hotel itself was outdated. The shower was covered in limescale with very low water pressure, and there was a ceiling leak in the toilet. We called for a handyman, but he did nothing and promised to return, though he never did. For a hotel that accommodates over 500 guests, they only provided about 200 sunbeds. If you didn’t wake up around 6AM, you were left without a sunbed or umbrella for the rest of the day. There was a balcony with one sunbed (room was Junior suit, so theoretically can stay 3 people) and bath tub which never ever been cleaned. Under the table I found some nest (even don't wanna know who lives there)

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.title: Highly Disappointed! Don't waste your time and money here, they don't value their guest!
reviews.text:
Our family trip was incredibly meaningful, marking multiple celebrations: my parents' 40th wedding anniversary, our 7th anniversary, and both my son's and my birthdays. It was extra special as our first family trip together ever. 

Upon arrival, our excitement dwindled when we were assigned our rooms. Despite our requests, nothing was accommodated or acknowledged. Romina at the front desk informed us that nothing could be changed due to a big group arriving the next day, making us feel like we didn’t matter. Not to mention, there was nothing special setup in our rooms for our special occasions like we've experienced at other resorts. This definitely set the tone for the rest of our trip as we litterally felt like we were getting the bottom of the barrel treatment.

Our initial rooms felt like a "hole in the wall" on the basement-like bottom floor—claustrophobic, and the balcony faced a wall. Displeased, I returned to the front desk. Thankfully, Enrique was helpful. He changed my parents’ room to a higher floor and provided us with a room with the king-size bed we prioritized, though still on the bottom floor.

Enrique promised room changes could occur in 3 days, as they would be available by the 15th. We accepted this and was asked to return in 20 mins for our room, only to encounter Romina again. She told us the earlier promise couldn’t be fulfilled due to the large group arriving the next day, displaying a very bad attitude unwilling to help and seeming intent to block Enrique's solution.

To prevent further distress, I accepted the situation with the new room, which faced only half a wall this time, resolving to not let these issues ruin our hard-earned trip.

At first glance, the room seemed acceptable, but as we settled in, it became clear how worn out everything was. Two lights were out, making the room very dim. The bathroom was filthy and appeared improperly cleaned; the tub looked like it needed replacing. This was the worst cleanliness I've encountered at an all-inclusive, and I've stayed at Grand Oasis before in my early 20s. Over our seven-day stay, the cleaning person showed up only two times, our fridge was never stocked, until we complained and even then it only got stocked on the last day, and no one came to collect the room service dishes even after we called. Midway through the trip, we discovered two mid-sized roaches in the room and later encountered many tiny baby roaches in the bathroom. 

The food was below average. Despite a wide array of options, the dishes didn't taste great and were often overly salty. The cooks looked over worked and unhappy at the buffet. The service varied there, as well. 

During our stay the large group Romina mentioned ended up being a corporate conference who were not being serviced privately resulting in huge lines everywhere and multiple nights of large private dinners by the main pool where the entertainment would typically be being blocked off and only accessible to the conference goers. Again, changing the atmosphere for people who are there on vacation. 

Anyhow, the entertainment was lackluster, though the entertainment team seemed to try their best with limited resources; unfortunately, it fell short for us.

The beach was the highlight, even during a windy week when the water was too rough for swimming until the second last day. The service from Eduardo at the beach club with the Kanna Bali beds was excellent, though not included, costing an additional $250 USD or available as a gift if you endure a sales pitch for Club Melia membership. I strongly advise against joining Club Melia. The brand lacks integrity and consistently fails to address issues promptly, missing multiple opportunities to make things right. why join a club when they can't do things right the first time? Second or third.. 

Activities for kids were well-managed by Nestor, who ran the workshops admirably and beach activities. 

The kiddie pool section was great for young children, with knee-high water, though it wasn't cleaned daily and seating was limited.

The nine-hole golf course, though appeared promising, was neglected, with broken bottles and rough greens. 

The main area in building 3 is dreamy with all the vines coming down, but that's where it ends.. everything else shows its age. The resort is closing in May for a year-long renovation, and it seems many staff have lost motivation or aren't performing at full potential during this time and it shows. 

Would we return? No, because our business didn’t feel valued at all on multiple occasions during our stay. I highly recommend saving your money, time, and energy by booking elsewhere.. somewhere where they actually cared about your experience.

reviews.author: Dcole1731
reviews.title: Amazing Trip
reviews.text: The staff was amazing.  Manuel was our Concierge and he was outstanding. Daniel at Sal's Steak House was the BEST of the BEST.  David and Victor at the Reserve Pool took care of everyone and treated everyone like Kings and Queens.  The pool bartenders and pool Waiters , Luis, Oscar understands how to treat their customers.  The team at the resort made sure everyone was enjoying their vacation and  feel special.   The staff really cares about the guests at the resort!

reviews.author: Connector38199575900
reviews.title: at Paradisus, we are treated like family.
reviews.text:
10/10 Adults-Only Resort Experience

My girlfriend and I just got back from a week-long stay in the adults-only reserve area, and it was an incredible experience. We had a couple of minor issues during the first couple of days, but once we met Enrique, our concierge, everything changed for the better. Enrique went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect for us, from celebrating our anniversary with special in-room desserts, booking restaurant reservations to getting Bali beds—he really turned our trip into something special.

One of the highlights was the catamaran cruise, which we hadn’t done during our stay last year. The live jazz musician on the boat made it such a unique and fun experience, and we were thrilled it was included in the reserve package. Overall, the resort was just as peaceful and beautiful as we remembered, with clean beaches, amazing pools, and great food everywhere we went.

I also want to give a special shout-out to the incredible staff that made our trip unforgettable: Cynthia for pool activities and Spanish lessons, Oscar, Miguel and Victor for serving us at the pool, David for organizing our cabana, and Valeria, Javier, Josue, and Miguel at Sante Restaurant who made breakfast a highlight of our mornings.

From the friendly bellboys to the front desk staff, everyone at the resort made sure we had an amazing time. We’ll definitely be back again, and we can’t wait to see the same friendly faces after the renovations!

reviews.author: christophernwihim
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Service was amazing, our private concierge Christian did a phenomenal job, looking forward to coming back again!

reviews.author: michaelk39812
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: We stayed for 6 nights in the reserve section in March of this year. Everything was amazing. From as soon as we got to the resort the staff took our bags and had them delivered to our room, we got brought over to the Reserve check in, which was a super quick and simple process, and got welcome drinks from the staff and this all took maybe 15 minutes from start to finish. We were then advised that we would have a concierge throughout our trip and our concierge was amazing! We arrived around 8:30pm and weren’t expecting to hear from our concierge until the next day but we received a message from our amazing concierge Christian. Christian made our vacation so easy and relaxing and was honestly one of the best parts of staying at the resort. He went out of his way to reach out to us every morning and sent us a list of the daily activities and restaurant hours. He also met with us first thing the day after we arrived to book all of our a la carte reservations. He also offered to book excursions and spa appointments, Bali beds, and anything else we might have needed. He also booked us the sunset cruise that was included in our room which was amazing! Christian went out of his way to check in on us and say hello anytime he saw us around the resort. He always had a smile and was willing to go above and beyond. His amazing service made it even harder to leave the resort because it felt like we were leaving a friend behind. He even messaged us after we had checked out just to check in and make sure we had arrived at the airport safe and sound. We had also asked him in for a bottle of wine in our room and he gave us chocolate strawberries with it as well which was so nice. The resort itself was beautiful. The service at the pool Bali beds was amazing as well as at the Beach club beds. Jose, a server at the Capella restaurant was also amazing and so friendly! We really enjoyed all aspects of our trip and would love to come back. We also loved seeing Daisy the cat around the resort and loved that she was well taken care of by the resort and had her own bed. Thank you Paradisus staff for making our trip so wonderful and thank you so much Christian for all you did for us. Paradisus Cancun is very lucky to have someone as great as Christian working here.

reviews.author: Christiane A
reviews.title: The beach was paradise
reviews.text:
The hotel was very beautiful and clean with one of the nicest beaches in Cancun.

The service was not too bad but a special shout out to Alejandro and Ricardo at the coffee bar that offer fast and friendly service.

The food was ok too, nothing too spectacular but you can always find something good to eat.

The shows were ok but the set-up near the pool was not optimal.

reviews.author: Karen H
reviews.title: Nice getaway
reviews.text:
This hotel is going to undergo a major renovation so I will not reflect on any physical problems.
The staff was very friendly but communication needs to be worked on.  There were benefits that came with my stay that I was never informed of and discovered on my own by accident.  Also, the restaurant reservation system needs an overhaul.  We found it extremely difficult to get into the restaurants we wanted.  If you do not eat seafood then your meal choices are limited.
As with any resort, loungers are not to be found after 7:00 AM.  As this is an ongoing problem everywhere I would not hold it against them.
The hotel entertainment seems to cater to children so if you are looking for an adult entertainment experience I would not recommend.
As I said before Paradisus is undergoing a renovation shortly and some of my issues may be addressed.  I would definitely try this hotel again after the renovation.

reviews.author: María P
reviews.title: Perfect experience
reviews.text: I was with my family enjoying for five days the incredible experience of Paradisus Cancun, staying in the Reserve sector. Added to the wonder of the Caribbean Sea and its white sands are the hotel facilities, with their five pyramids, which highlight the natural vegetation, water fountains and wooden constructions of restaurants and spa, which make one feel in the middle of nature even while inside the hotel. The rooms are spacious, impeccably clean and with all amenities. The variety of restaurants to choose from for lunch and dinner, each with different gastronomic proposals, is extraordinary. The same the buffet, which we were fortunate to have the exclusive Reserve sector, where we were served by Julio in a way that we will not forget, for his willingness and warmth. In addition, there are bars with all kinds of drinks and snacks, inside and outside the premises, and even with beach service. I want to highlight the hotel staff, who strive at all times to make the stay pleasant for guests, and especially our concierge, Mr. Galdino Chavez, who was watching that our stay was really of a higher standard: friendly, always impeccable and attentive to all the details to guide us, advise us different activities and make reservations in our name so that really everything was “all inclusive”. I recommend 100%.

reviews.author: Domenico L
reviews.title: Absolute Paradise at Paradisus!!
reviews.text:

Generally, the restaurants had the best food. The buffet was really hit and miss.

reviews.author: Angie H
reviews.title: Massage
reviews.text: My massage with Kaylee was amazing. I was very relaxed and the pressure was good. She was very kind and answered all my questions. Also listen to my concerns. I would highly recommend this was award for a massage. I can’t wait to come back with experience it again.

reviews.author: Mary Costanzo
reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text:
I recently returned from Paradisus Cancun, where I celebrated my birthday with a couples’ trip. We stayed for three days at this all-inclusive resort, and while the food and drinks were okay, the service truly made our stay exceptional.

Our concierge, Christian C, went above and beyond—he helped us book restaurant reservations and kept us updated on daily activities through WhatsApp. Another standout was Luis at the adults-only pool bar, whose outstanding service made our poolside experience even more enjoyable. reviews.title: Experience Hotel Paradisus
reviews.text:
The hotel very well and the attention of Christian, our advisor during the stay, was very good and warm. The service overall pretty well and the experience was satisfactory. We stayed in the Suite with sea views and the truth that very happy, also with the cleanliness.

The restaurants they have, they had to be booked in advance, it was almost full, but then you went and there were no people. Maybe because people booked and then went outside the hotel but that would have to be controlled differently.

reviews.author: Sofia M
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: We are partners of Meliá for 6 years usually travel every year to paradisus of Playa del Carmen, but we decided to give this hotel a try, generally the treatment was very good, Rodolfo our concierge always friendly and attentive in every detail... there was only one issue that displeased us, from the beginning we asked for adjacent rooms and we were assured that it would be, since we always traveled a large group of family and we are facilitated in many ways that type of rooms, all week they said they would try to accommodate us to what we had asked more never happened. On the side of family concierge there is not as much variety in terms of quality liquor as when you pass to reserve. The rooms are too old and smelled bad, the good thing is that it is about to be remodeled, we hope next year to come back and that you can really live the circle experience since as partners for that we pay a monthly fee. It has a beautiful view certainly and the location is great.

reviews.author: Michael L
reviews.title: Enrique made the stay!
reviews.text:
This is a wonderful resort. I really didn’t know what to expect, but this resort was top notch. The rooms were nice, amazing ocean views, the grounds were very well kept, the food was really good and the drinks were too! 

What made the trip next level though was the help and attention of our concierge, Enrique! You have to make reservations early in your stay to get dinner reservations at some of the popular restaurants. Enrique helped us secure multiple reservations for the large group we were with every night we wanted them. He also went above and beyond with our specific needs and advising us on areas to try out or things to do that made our trip unique and honestly so much fun. I HIGHLY recommend paying for the concierge package. It’s not much more and totally worth it to enhance your stay. And if you are lucky you’ll also be paired with Enrique! 😊

reviews.author: Ashleigh C
reviews.title: Kidsom
reviews.text:
Kidsdom was perfect for our 4 and 8 year old during our recent stay at Paradisis Playa. We utilized it in the morning for a few hours to allow the kids to have some time apart and with other kids, and loved that it was available in the evening for those adult only restaurant bookings. Lots of crafts, and different activities throughout the day. Staff were friendly, and remembered myself and my children throughout our stay. There was only one afternoon in which the younger group 1-4 was at maximum capacity (we had no intentions of taking the kids but they asked). If you require a spot, best to line up 10 to 15 minutes before Kidsdom opens for that shift. When the staff took the children out and about the resort, they were very attentive. They do not feed the children, but will offer water and they can take the waterbottles. Everything is very transparent and when there was an issue, they called us immediately (they could not find out registration form, but that is because we upgraded rooms on the second day). Yadira was so kind,  my youngest trusted her so much and showered her with hugs! All of the staff were great including Yessenya, Lety and Corbta. 

So nice to have this opportunity for our kids!

reviews.author: Tina C
reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text:
The hotel was fantastic but there were two particular issues.

 First was the reservation was pre paid in full on the Meliá app using PayPal (for security purposes) and at check in was told that it’s not valid and I would need to re-pay the full amount with a credit card and then wait 3-4 weeks for a refund. I found that insane and pushed back. After speaking to 3 people and escalating the matter, a supervisor allowed the pre paid reservation to be honored and refunded the second charge on my credit card.  
The second reason is that the pocket door in our junior suite was broken, forcing me and my children to use an open bathroom for the week. 
Outside of that, the hotel, service and food was amazing as was the family concierge. 
One word to those planning to go - get up no later than 6:30am to secure beach and pool chairs as they’re limited. Plus put something person on the chair as some people have no shame and would take it if only towels are on them.

reviews.author: Wanda V
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun reserve
reviews.text: Staff was amazing we loved our pool guy Oscar and our concierge Christian was so very helpful. Rooms could use some updating which is starting in June of this year. Ocean was beautiful on the white sandy beach infront of the resort.  Everyone was very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: giuliana g
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL HOTEL, RECOMMEND!
reviews.text:
With my partner we had a beautiful experience, since you arrive, they treat you like kings, they take care of everything, you do not have to lift 1 finger for anything. Almost all the resort staff were very friendly, there were some waiters who didn't like the deal very much, but it was the minority. I want to highlight the kindness that Rossana had, our concierge, was always on the lookout for us and resolved all the concerns, she was also in charge of making our reservations to restaurants and other activities, the truth that that made everything much easier for us. 
All the facilities were spectacular, from the pool area to the room, everything super clean and in order, you enter and there is a rich aroma throughout the hotel because they put humidifiers, a detail that I loved. 
Our room had sea view, very very beautiful. It was also super spacious, with all the comforts, the beautiful bathroom too, the shower was GOOD, we also had a nespresso machine and a minibar full of things that replaced you whenever you want. The only detail that would improve the room is that in the bathroom mirror sector, there was little lighting, which for me, who like to put on makeup, I found a little uncomfortable. 
As for the beach, the beach sector that the hotel has is very nice, it is wide enough to be comfortable on the sand, and at the date we went, it had no sargassum. The only thing that would improve is that the beach that is in the reserve area of the hotel (which is where we were), in my opinion would need some shaded tables, there are only some restrooms. 
As for the reserve, if you go only adults, I recommend it, in my opinion it is worth paying for, it gives you exclusivity in some things that are good. 
Finally, the food and drink, everything was excellent, the only detail was that in the restaurants, most of the times the portions were VERY small, that I did not like, and another thing that I did not like, was that the beer was always hot, and in the restaurants they do not give you the can of coke, they serve you in the glass and it was usually watery. 
Generally speaking I HIGHLY RECOMMEND, especially if you are going to be calm and relaxed, if you are looking for more atmosphere of partying and uncontrollable, this hotel is not for you, as it is quite quiet.

On our part we will stay there again on our next vacation in Mexico, we were fascinated

reviews.author: MichelleG1984
reviews.title: Great food but Rooms really let this resort down.
reviews.text:
Stayed as a family of 4, two littles 2 and 4. A great resort in terms of travel time from airport,  food and pool/beach area. However, Rooms are severely needing a refurb with mostly broken or chipped furniture, walls, doors etc. the lighting in the bathroom is non existent marble chipped and shower heads so old they are thick with limescale. Rooms are so dated that this is the sole reason we would not return. 

Some building work was going ahead around property while there and the staff even agreed that they hoped work on the rooms would commence soon. Fingers crossed. 

Other things to note are:
- pool and chairs. There are not enough umbrellas/ shade. This is critical especially around the shallow kids pool. 
The entire resort has huge Bali beds that are for members but they mostly remain empty as so over priced most ppl don’t use them. Waste of space. Bring down the price or just allow people to use them after a certain time. 
- the shallow kids pool was large and safe plus lots of seats around to be able to watch children from a few metres away. 

- food was good. Some restaurants got it spot on with the menus. Buffet for breakfast was also good. Lots of prepared fruit and fresh bakery. 
The Italian restaurant wasn’t the greatest  and it was sad to see people over ordering in the ala carte restaurants, so wasteful.

Overall a really good hotel but we wouldn’t recommend due to the room situation.

reviews.author: David A
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience at Melia Paradisus Cancun;  a poorly managed, frustrating experience.
reviews.text:
The resorts look impressive on pictures. Review: Disappointing Experience at Melia Paradisus Cancun

We recently stayed at the Melia Paradisus Cancun, expecting a luxurious experience based on its reputation and beautiful common areas. Unfortunately, while the resort itself appears well-maintained on the surface, the quality of service and room conditions left much to be desired.

From the start, our stay was filled with issues. We spent the first two nights in a room with no working air conditioning, making sleep nearly impossible in the humid Cancun weather. Despite multiple visits to reception, we were repeatedly told there was “nothing available,” with no real effort made to accommodate us. Even as Melia members, we were denied an upgrade, despite the clear need for one as a family of three squeezed into two full-sized beds for five nights.

Another major issue was the sewage smell that filled the air in the evenings, making it unpleasant to even sit outside and enjoy the resort. On top of that, the resort was severely understaffed—room service took over an hour, housekeeping had to be called twice just to clean our room after it was left untouched for two full days, and simple requests required waiting for approval from someone outside of reception or customer care. It felt like no one on site had the authority or willingness to resolve even basic issues.

The biggest disappointment was the lack of empathy from management. Despite our repeated complaints, they remained uninvolved and dismissive, offering no solutions or gestures to make up for the inconveniences. With the poor service, rundown rooms, and constant frustration, our stay was far from the relaxing and enjoyable vacation we had hoped for.

Would I return? Absolutely not. If you’re considering this resort, be warned—the beautiful exterior hides a poorly managed, frustrating experience.

reviews.author: Chrysti W
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCUN, I love you!
reviews.text:
This is a thorough, honest review, albeit long. My apologies...

WEDDING: Our daughter held her wedding at Paradisus Cancun, and it was amazing! The bridal coordinator, Fernanda, did an excellent job meeting with us before our arrival to ensure my daughter's vision for her special day came to life. She and her team were on hand for the welcome party Friday night, throughout the day Saturday while we were getting ready in the bridal suite, as well as the ceremony and reception. She took care of all the details so my daughter and I could be in the moment and enjoy her day! The vendors we hired through the resort were top-notch and did an excellent job with hair and makeup, DJ services, a violinist for the ceremony and a saxophone player who entertained the entire wedding party and guests. It was a magical day!

CONCIERGE: My husband and I stayed a week at the resort and enjoyed every second of it. Lalo was our concierge and was extremely organized, knowledgeable, and helpful. Right after checking in, he reached out to introduce himself and set a time to meet. Lalo scheduled all of our dinner reservations and informed us daily through WhatsApp of all the activities happening at the resort. He left a bottle of wine and chocolate-covered strawberries in our room as a gift for the parents of the bride and stopped by the pool multiple times to check on us!

LUGGAGE PORTERS: Nine of us arrived together and dropped the extra wedding baggage, several suitcases, and baby strollers with the porters as soon as we walked through the front door. The luggage was going to three different rooms all over the resort and those guys didn't disappoint. They delivered every bag to the correct room. 

RESERVE POOL: I cannot say enough about Victor and David at the Reserve Pool. We had a large group of family and friends who wanted Bali beds close together. They went out of their way to help make that happen so we could enjoy each others' company. 

OUTDOOR AREAS: The beaches were beautiful and the ocean was calm enough for our grandchildren to enjoy a swim. Even though the resort was completely sold out, it never felt overcrowded. The pools were well-maintained and beautiful.

SPA: Please take time to go to the HYI Spa when you are there. It has such a calm and relaxing atmosphere-I should've gone before the wedding instead of after! Cristina and Sergio did a wonderful job guiding us through the hydrotherapy experience. Ask for them when you schedule your appointment!

RECEPTION: The people at the Reserve reception area are experts! With such a large party, you are bound to have a hiccup or two. We did, but the errors were not on them. They went out of their way to help correct any issues and to make everyone's experience exceptional. 

CLEANLINESS: The cleaning staff does an excellent job in every area of the resort. The sweet lady who kept our room clean was outstanding and quite patient with all the extra wedding stuff that we stored in our room. 

FOOD: The best food we had was at our daughter's wedding reception. I know that doesn't help the average person but was a huge relief for me. The resort gave the bride and groom several options to choose from for each course of the meal and they were very cognizant of food allergies. They even offered to prepare pureed options for the babies that were attending.

Sal Steakhouse was our favorite dinner spot. They were busy, but our waiter did a phenomenal job! I loved the short ribs and Brussels sprouts. 
Cappella for dinner was very enjoyable. They served small Italian dishes so we had room to try several different ones!
Lemon Fish was good, but I thought the menu was limited. However, I am in the minority. It is their most popular restaurant. Our daughter and son-in-law like it so much they ate there three times! 
Sante serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and we ate there most often. It is near the Reserve pool and open-air but covered. Oscar was hilarious, and every employee provided fabulous service! 
Malva is a buffet and is a great spot for a crowd. It's easy to scoot into and grab some fruit, yogurt, or a salad. The wait staff is very attentive with drink orders and other needs. If you are looking for American food, the poolside menu and room service are your best bet. The food is good and consistent. 

NESPRESSO: The coffee bars were a huge hit with our crowd! There is one near Malva and one on the Reserve side. That one is a hidden gem! They have a Nespresso machine but are also a full-service bar with a refrigerated case that has small sweet and savory treats calling your name when you walk by. Dining there is having a light breakfast or lunch at a tranquil cafe in the middle of a rainforest. I wish I could remember the names of those who worked in that area. They were OUTSTANDING!

Overall, our experience was a 10/10 and we will definitely be back! Every employee we encountered was polite, helpful, and kind. We stayed in the adults-only area of the Reserve, but there were several in our party who stayed on the family side and had a blast. Being in the Reserve gave us the ability to enjoy every aspect of the resort. We had the freedom to visit family and friends with kids and then return to the Reserve when we wanted. The facilities were beautiful inside and out and they are doing a full remodel soon!
@thevalentinecollectivesc

reviews.author: T R
reviews.title: Stay Away! GOOD REVIEWS ARE FAKE
reviews.text:
We’ve been coming to Cancun for the last 10 years and this was hands down the worst resort. I’d rather get stuck in the airport. 

Transportation- They don’t provide transportation from the airport but recommend a company. The company canceled on us and told us to find our own way. Great start. 

Elevators- it would take us 10 minutes waiting for an elevator to get to our room

Very crowded- they oversold and there are people who have to lay on the grass and concrete near the pool because there aren’t enough beds for everyone. People put their towels out at 6am to claim beds. 

Upsell- every restaurant and bar try to upsell you on everything. Restaurants only have about 5 main course items on their menus to try to get you to buy stuff. 

Food- very below average. You have to make a reservation for every place even though it’s visibly empty. They won’t let you eat there unless you reserve it. Buffet food was a slight step up from eating garbage. 

Service- almost all the waiters were very slow and not friendly. We did like our waitress at the sports bar. She was a bright spot. 

The family concierge tried their best to make our stay better but there’s nothing they could do.

If you’re reading any of the good reviews about this place, they have to be fake. There’s no way anyone could enjoy this place.

reviews.author: Flo
reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text:
I never write negative reviews, but I feel compelled to share our experience at Paradisus Cancun to help other families who may be considering staying here. I’ve been to Mexico and Cancun specifically over a dozen times, so this is coming from experience!

Unfortunately, this resort was a huge disappointment. The food wasn’t great and most food options don’t open until 8 AM or 1 PM, which is impractical when traveling with a toddler. Service was shockingly bad—we constantly had to ask multiple times for simple requests before receiving anything. We got our high chair mid meal, begged for water, etc. 

The private family concierge check-in, which is supposed to be a perk, ended up being the slowest check-in and check-out process I’ve ever experienced. At one point, I asked a staff member for help with my parents’ day pass check-out, and she laughed in my face.

The entire resort is an upcharge—from dinner menu items (only 4-5 options are actually included, the rest cost extra) to poolside day beds, everything is an additional fee. Good luck finding a spot to sit unless you wake up at 5 am. We walked past several people laying on the grass because there are no chairs available. 

Drinks were bad, and the facility feels run down. Lines for everything were unbearably long, with overworked and unhelpful staff making the experience even more frustrating.

One night, we tried to go to dinner early when the restaurant was completely empty, but we were told it was full—even after explaining that we had a toddler and would be quick.

The only positive? We paid for a large suite, and I do like our room. But beyond that, I can’t recommend this resort to anyone, especially families. There are far better options in Cancun that actually deliver on the “luxury all-inclusive” promise. Save your money and go elsewhere.

reviews.author: Kevin M
reviews.title: Very enjoyable 10 day holiday!
reviews.text: We had a great time on our recent holiday at Paradisus Cancun, the majority of the staff are very friendly, helpful and welcoming. We would call out Julio as being exception, he works in The Reserve bar during the evening, his smile and welcome was something we had never experienced before and we really appreciated it, he really made our holiday. Our room was perfect, we had a great view, and plenty of space. The food on offer was ok, the restaurants are a bit hit and miss depending on what time you eat and which server you get. There is options to upgrade from the AI menu which is where you get the really nice options. We found the buffet to be one of our favourite places to eat. The Reserve pool area is lovely, having to get up really early to get a sun lounger was a bit annoying and the fact that people reserve sun beds and then don’t arrive until midday was frustrating, we think the towels should have been removed by staff to give someone else a chance to use them. The waiters that come around by the pool are great, so nice to have someone checking on you to see if you need a drink. The Sante restaurant is really nice at lunch time we really enjoyed having a relaxing lunch there. The sea is absolutely stunning! I’ve never seen such clear waters. All in all we had a wonderful time, just a few areas for improvement which will hopefully be addressed when the hotel closes for renovations.

Jacob and César swimming pool waiters always friendly and helpful, also can not fail to talk about the waitress José from the Restaurant Capella , very friendly and attentive serving us , we went to all the restaurants of the hotel , we just did not go to the Japanese Restaurant , the rest can say excellent with a wonderful food ! reviews.author: Jeff S
reviews.title: Lalo - our thanks!
reviews.text:
First of all - great thanks to our concierge Lalo - without whom we would be lost in this gigantic hotel, with no dime spared on its intricate architecture. It’s our more than 30th time in Mexico in as many years and this one is the best by design. Can’t wait to see what it will become after complete rehab:) 
Lalo organized all our day activities - we only had to wake up, and do it:) 
Presidential week was the busiest time and it showed. Not enough sitting space around pool; this is “reserve” section I’m talking about. Outdated gazebos are not bad ideas, but when it’s not enough for every guests - come on. Hope remodeling will bring it up to the class of hotel. People  don’t have to get up at 6am to “mark” their spots. More umbrellas - way more!
Food - the very cozy cafe in reserve dome was great. The long lines in buffet were terrible, and food  mediocre. Dinners were better - the interiors outstanding.
Entertainment - I would say one of the best we experienced. Professional troops are beating the “actors of stuff” in other hotels hands down. 
And lastly - there is tennis court. May I suggest to make 3 pickleball courts in its place instead? Like both neighboring Marriotts? Or struck a deal with them to allow guests visits, for a fee maybe? Who plays tennis now days🤣
We’ll - that’s my 5 cents, and I can bring a team of pickle friends with families if the last cent will be implemented:)
Thank you for reading - Jeff S., Chicago

reviews.author: Robin H
reviews.title: Great vacation at Club Melia Paradisus
reviews.text:
We, (my husband and I and a friend) stayed again at the Club Melia Paradisus in Cancun, from 2/8-2/15/2025.  It did not disappoint!  We had a wonderful time.  The resort is very clean, and our rooms, 1112 and 1114, were very comfortable.  Housekeeping kept us supplied with ample towels and our rooms were stocked daily with water and drinks.  This year, we had to make reservations for the specialty restaurants which we did not have to do in the past.  But, we were able to eat at the ones we wanted to without much problem.  The resort was much more crowded than in the past, which caused people to have to get up early to get chairs by the pool and beach.  I want to acknowledge some of our favorite waiters and bartenders, who always went above and beyond with awesome service:

Iran at Sante and Lemon Fish
Melvin at Capella
Sergio and Wilber at Agua Marina
Karina and Carlos at Ginger Sports bar
Jorge and Daniel at Lemon Fish
Pasquale and Roberto at Malva

All in all, it was a great vacation and hope to return again.

reviews.author: kellycrespi
reviews.title: Paradise with Restrictions
reviews.text:
Positive points: Wonderful beach. Hotel with impressive infrastructure. Courteous attention. Delicious food. 
Negatives: hotel with old structure especially in the rooms. We were informed that the hotel will be closed soon for renovations. 
Use of Balinese beds, beach chairs and the like are complex. You never know exactly where you can sit. 
As partners of the hotel we find the interior care to other resorts of the Meliã network that we already know.

reviews.author: Elizabeth T
reviews.title: Relaxing girls time
reviews.text:
This was such a wonderful trip. The resort itself is clean and very accommodating. You are welcomed with refreshment options during the check in process with friendly staff members. Keys to the rooms are actually bracelets which is very convenient for the week. 

We booked the all inclusive deal so we didn't have to worry about food at all. We weren't planning to leave the resort, so it was a great option. Buffet is available for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Then you have restaurant choices for dinner options that you make reservations for. I highly recommend Lemon Fish for dinner. Perfect size portions and delicious food. There's also a cafe that provides coffee drink options and pastry for snacks include a ham and cheese sandwich which was my favorite! Their carrot cake was amazing too! All inclusive comes with a stocked mini fridge of drink choices and some snack options.

This place is family friendly as well, if you are planning a trip with kids. There is a designated area for kids to play at the pool with more food and drink options poolside. This trip was worth every penny and I would love to come back with my husband and kids in the future.

reviews.author: Daniela d
reviews.title: Good.
reviews.text:
The food at the hotel is very good and the service of the staff too, although a little slow. The bars close 11pm, I get very early even if it is a more family-friendly hotel.

They need to do something to solve the problem of the beds, I saw people who left their towels, left 2 hours, came back was 30 minutes there, and left again and separated. They should say that this is not allowed from the moment of check-in. 

The buffet had very long lines for breakfast at all hours, although at dinner there was not much line after 7:30pm.

The beach of the hotel is nice but there is a part that has stones, for you to consider.

The rooms are pretty old already, so good that they will remodel already.

reviews.author: Nicole S
reviews.title: We love it
reviews.text:
If you are going to stay at the Paradisus Cancun, the reserve section of the hotel is the best place to go. The staff is fantastic and goes out of their way to make sure you have what you need. We look forward to eating breakfast at the outside restaurant overlooking the ocean each morning. I was only disappointed about the lack of a beach area in front of the reserve section. You can walk down to the other section, and they had more space, but it was hard to find a chair. If you are looking for a hotel that provides active nightlife, this isn't the hotel for you. 
Highlights: Heated Pool, Excellent Service, Great Food, Top shelf alcohol, and they have Coors light.

reviews.author: Aman M
reviews.title: Great vacation and beautiful property.
reviews.text: It was a great vacation, and the property was very beautiful. The only thing I missed was Indian cuisine. All the staff members were very helpful and polite. The concierge was very supportive; otherwise, we would have been lost without the direction signs on the property, especially with most staff and tourists speaking Spanish.

reviews.author: Sharon P
reviews.title: Paradise at Paridisus!
reviews.text: A beautiful resort that we have been to many times being club Meliá members for 20 years. In all this time we have to say that Rodolfo was the best concierge we ever had. Attentive, proactive and most importantly helped solved a few concerns our friends had about their room quickly and efficiently. Cornelio at the cabana bed rentals was also excellent! Thank you for an amazing vacation!!

reviews.author: Companion565349
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Overall the service and facilities are excellent. We were particularly impressed with housekeeping, our concierge Roldolpho and our bali bed provider Cornelio. The only problem was the maintenance of the building. Our friends room had a water leak that went on for days without action. Later they had a problem with cockroaches, perhaps due to the moisture in the room.

reviews.author: jordanelle16
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: We unfortunately experiences horrific food poisoning from Sante. Other meals eating here were just overall underwhelming and poorly constructed. Service took a very long time as well. Otherwise, had a great experience. Rooms were clean and comfortable. Bali beds were an awesome amenity, grounds and beach were well kept. Greenery and ambiance within the hotel was gorgeous!

reviews.author: Steven
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun hits the mark across the board.
reviews.text:
They cover all the bases.  Location is terrific.  Beach totally accessible. Multiple restaurants to choose from and all of them are very good. Plenty of pool area.
   Our concierge, Rodolfo Medina was all we could have asked for.  Made dinner reservations for each night, made sure we had a cabana each day, arranged the travel to and from the airport....all of it.  And had special treats arranged for my wifes birthday.  Very special guy.

reviews.author: JoAnnSteinbach
reviews.title: Carlos is the best concierge!
reviews.text: We received an upgrade to a 2 bedroom and it was fantastic! There was a small problem with the mini-bar service the first 2 days but Carlos handled it well and compensated us very well for the inconvenience. He is the best concierge we have had in 25+ years of vacations at the Paradisus!

reviews.author: Elizabeth K
reviews.title: Birthdays Celebration at Paradisus Camcun
reviews.text:
The experience was fabulous from beginning to end. The Hotel is immaculate and all were professional and personable making us feel welcomed.
Enrique went above and beyond guiding us every step of our vacation, a treasure.
Miguel assisted us at the Cabana, making ours days poolside heavenly.
Highly recommend all to vacation at Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Susan d
reviews.title: Once again Enrique was a pleasure
reviews.text: Enrique was our concierge and was so pleasant , helpful throughout the whole time we were there 4 days . He made all reservations and everything he explained was wonderful and went off beautifully. He is a very nice, caring,efficient young man . It was a pleasure to have him as our quide

reviews.author: Ziatenna
reviews.title: Sun sand pool food and Enrique!
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel - we could not have been more pleased and pampered. Fabulous pools and of course the beach and cancun water speak for themselves. The food choices are endless and quite good for an all-inclusive. Top  shelf liquor at your disposal and all of the staff were remarkable, so very kind and helpful (we kept getting lost as this property is immense) 
We especially want to acknowledge Enrique, our concierge server, who went to great lengths to ensure we had everything we could need or want to make this vacation as lovely as it was.
Special thanks to him for all his professional and personal touches. He is truly an asset to Paradisus Cancun!!

reviews.author: Carmen L
reviews.title: Best experience ever.
