reviews.text: The best experience was to have our own concierge Enrique. He made me feel like royalty and I’m booking again to the same place for the holidays. I loved everything . The cabanas, the food, the drinks, top of the line . The beds , the pillows and most of all all the extras touches.

reviews.author: Rob M
reviews.title: A great 2 weeks !
reviews.text: Our trip was excellent overall. Best beach in the area in terms of depth and walkability over the other resorts on the same beach. Dining was exellent and plenty of options at the buffet to suit many tastes. Evening entertainment could be better but a venue to have evening entertainment would be even better. Overall no issues with the resort or with the staff. Everyone was welcoming and pleasant. Thank You Paradisus !

reviews.author: cirekaz
reviews.title: Great spot
reviews.text:
Very enjoyable week food was especially great
Ivan our concierge was very helpful in navigating for us. The upgrade was well worth it to get the restaurant and the quiet pool area.   Whale watching paradise with many sightings very close to shore

reviews.author: Trail317413
reviews.title: Our favorite all-inclusive resort!
reviews.text: Our 2nd time here.While we had another resort last year, didn’t come close to food satisfaction and Paradesis has a heated pool on the adult side.They have different plans to accommodate families with children as well as other special touches.Both trips were obtained via Costco. A great value for all they offer as an all-inclusive resort.We recommend the Reserve adults only option for all they frills for an unforgettable and relaxing vacation. They are closing May 31,2025 for a year of renovation. We can’t wait to book in 2026-2027.

reviews.author: Carl Fiorica
reviews.title: Paradisus birthday trip
reviews.text: The staff at Paradisus was amazing. Everyone was very courteous and helpful. Our Club Melia personal concierge, Rodolfo Medina, was invaluable and helped us make the most of our stay.  He worked to setup dinner and trip reservations which made everything simple. He even responded and helped us out on his day off.  It was a great trip.

reviews.author: dmsparr
reviews.title: Our Honeymoon Getaway
reviews.text: My wife and I came for paradise and we sure got it! From the food, to the pools, to the drinks, it was utter relaxation and truly paradise. The staff made us feel welcomed and pampered. Enrique went above and beyond, he made it a magical experience for us! My only complaints were our last two days a large group Elevate came through and they were extremely rude guests. It screwed up our dining experience at Lemon Fish, which we had been very excited for and had reserved much more in advance than the other group. Luckily, the next day Sal made up for it. We also were not fond of the playa del Carmen trip. We were left at the tequila factory and otium did a poor job of making us feel safe/getting us back. It ruined an entire day and we preferred staying on resort as a result. The resort itself was phenomenal 10/10! The staff made this place shine!

reviews.author: alba e
reviews.title: wowwww
reviews.text: Such an amazing stay! The staff here is soooooooooo sweet and great and they really accommodate to every need you possibly have, the staff including jorge, flor, baltazar, dino ,yoni ,leo, didier, they are so great and go above and beyond for the experience and they are really lovely people. The food is also amazing ! They have a nespresso station which is so nice and the place is super clean and well taken care of. I love the swim up bar and the water activities were so affordable and a plus to the place

reviews.author: Compass11365839599
reviews.title: Paradise Experience
reviews.text: We had a wonderful week-long vacation in February at Paradisus Cancun in The Reserve (adults only). We loved the idea of being in the adult-only section with the ability to venture into the rest of the busy resort if we wanted to.  Our concierge Enrique was truly fabulous.  He was kind, quick and attentive. He sent us our list of available activities every morning and booked us in at all our restaurants of choice through the week. There seems to be a lack of restaurant space through the hotel and we were fortunate to get all we asked for. Our staff at Santa and at The reserve pool were excellent! I wish I could remember each persons name and we hope they all get credit. Our fav happy bar tender at the big bar beside Santa, our mother/daughter service team at the pool and Santa, Cesar was excellent as well. Enrique was always around either via messenger or would do his rounds on the group. We enjoyed the gym and loved the beach. When we wanted to head out on an excursion, Enrique suggested the best transportation. We highly recommend a day on Isla Mujeres.    The food, for the most part, was very good! Sometimes it was served less hot, but the quality was still great. We especially liked the small cafe for breakfast and snacks in The Reserve and their waitress and bartender were great. Night entertainment needs some improvement. We would have liked an interactive bingo/musical bingo, dance something or more organized adult event. The bars in the main pyramid were fine but not much happened in the evening.    Our room, contrary to some reviews, was great. Although we expected high quality, we didn't care about the "aged" feeling of the tile. It was clean, well kept and no bugs! The bed was pretty comfy. We had one day where we didn't get room service due to low staffing but that was quickly resolved and no big deal. We would absolutely come back to this resort when it reopens in 2026. We're looking forward to the facelift and another great vacation. (We hope they'll have many many pool and beach chairs!)  The beach at Paradisus can't be beat!  Thank you!

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.title: Fun trip
reviews.text: Hotel was beautiful and staff was great. Food was decent but nothing special. Bathroom had some mold in it probably from poor ventilation but had huge tub and shower. Hard time finding beach chairs on the busier days/weekend.

reviews.author: opd228
reviews.title: Second to none.
reviews.text: Clean. Friendly.  Fun. Relaxing.  Concierge was the beer and remembered our names and treated us as family.   Poolside service top notch

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: Fantastic Vacation at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We just spent a wonderful week at Paradisus Cancun.  Before arriving we knew the resort will soon be closing for renovations expected to take one year to complete.  However, the staff, and in particular our concierge Rodolfo, helped make the stay as comfortable as possible.  We were also happy to see Raul who was our concierge for 2 previous trips and has since been promoted into a management position.

In my opinion, hotel staff make all the difference in making a vacation wonderful.  Last week Rodolfo and Raul went above and beyond to make our vacation everything we wanted it to be.

We’re looking forward to returning to Paradisus Cancun in 2027 when the renovations are completed and hope to see our friends, Rodolfo and Raul again then.

reviews.author: Jennifer H
reviews.title: Excellent Meal at Flora
reviews.text: Our meal at Flora in Paradisus Cancun  was excellent!!  The service from Fanny was excellent!!  I highly recommend the pumpkin soup and the pear desser, but our whole meal was fantastic!!  We also enjoyed the fountains and ambiance!!  I would definitely come back!

reviews.author: NKBB
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text: Excellent service at Lemon Fish. Delicious food, tasty cocktails and brilliant service. Jesus, our server,  had brilliant recommendations for food. The slow cooked beef, short ribs and octopus were delicious. It is also a lovely venue for dinner.

reviews.author: Vivien K
reviews.title: Clean beach and amazing service
reviews.text:
We went with our 5 year old daughter and her friend (and their family) from school. And I wish we did this a long time ago! When your kids have good friends at an all inclusive, the adults really do end up having a better time! We had the family club ocean view master bedroom suite, which came with one room and a living room, plus 2 bathrooms. The hotel can use a reno but our room is very clean and comfortable regardless.  The ocean view accessible from the two giant balconies is amazing 

Our family concierge, Christian, went above and beyond to ensure we have everything we needed, he booked our dinners which was surprisingly something I didn’t know I could use! For the first 3 dinners Christian had to book tables for 10 ppl because our friends were there and he made sure everything was set up properly. He left little gifts for my daughter as surprises from time to time which my daughter still talks about it now. Thank you Christian

Lastly - the beaches… is amazing, I’ve been to many AI resorts Cancun + Playa Mujeres + punta Cana + Cuba + Jamaica, and I honestly think the beach at Paradisus is the smoothest and the most free from seaweeds.

reviews.author: Venture45290863307
reviews.title: Sisters Trip of a lifetime!!!! 💗👯‍♀️👯‍♀️
reviews.text:
I can hardly say was an experience my sisters and I had at Paradisus last week. This trip was a long time coming for us and we really had high expectations that it would be a wonderful luxury experience. When I tell you the caliber of care and intention that we received during our time at the resort soared past any of our expectations! 

I have to first thank our INCREDIBLE concierge Enrique for orchestrating every detail for us!!!! His calm vibe and diligent communication and personal check ins made our experience! Him helping us book palapas, making sure we had the right dinners on the right nights, our spa experience timing..I could literally go ON and ON. 

Next I want to be sure to thank our Reserve staff that really stood out and gave us exceptional service. Julio at the cafe bar, Oscar, Cynthia and the activities directors and of course Luis at the pool bar(!!!), David at the pool house, and all the cleaning and maintenance staff. We were truly touched by the love and kindness given so freely by the whole staff. 

In closing I want to make sure and thank the kitchen staffs and chefs who made (and cleaned up after!) all of our amazing meals the entire week. WOW! Definitely one of the most wonderful and inspiring buffet arrangements I’ve been at. The steakhouse gift at the end really put the cherry on top! 😭🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼 Also the late afternoon tea time snacks at Reserve were a photo shoot dream! 

Thank you again for an unforgettable week, my sisters and I truly made memories that will last a lifetime (but, we hope to be back sooner than later…..!) 😍😍😍⛱️ 

Getting to see your view of the ocean every day was such a huge blessing 🙏🏼 thank you !!

reviews.author: Julia D
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: We had the most wonderful and relaxing time here! We had everything we could have wanted and were able to fully relax enjoy. Our concierge Enrique was so attentive and helpful, we felt like princesses. He helped us with all of our reservations on the first day, advised us well on what we needed to know, and was so kind. The pools are amazing, the folks working there are hard working and polite, the drinks were so fun, the food was great. I would love to come back!

reviews.author: Beata M
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise for Us
reviews.text:
Stayed in the Reserve again and was treated royally. Still worth the extra expense, especially since the hotel was at 100%. The staff could not have been more helpful. There are fewer of them, and that makes their job more challenging. Special thanks to our concierge, Enrique, who worked hard to make us feel special.  There was a shortage of beach chairs due to the storm in January that washed away everything on that part of the beach and so extra thanks to the beach hut employees, David and Victor who did their best to find us chairs.  I do hope more are on order! The hotel is closing end of May for extensive renovations, and we did notice that some minor things in our room are not maintained. I will be interested in seeing the new version. Hopefully it will not lose "the magic" that makes the hotel unique. 
The buffet food is only three stars, - not the same variety as we used to see and trouble keeping the food warm. Variety being cut as food costs everywhere are increasing.  I'm sure that is true at all resorts, and not just in Mexico. All of our meals at the specialty restaurants were great. The chefs there are top notch. So that part gets 5 stars. Lack of staff means they are only able to serve at 50% capacity. 
Special gratitude to our agent Karol Chareza who always takes excellent care of us when we make our reservations. He finds us the best travel available.

reviews.author: Ali
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text:
Healthy, delicious and different food.
The spinach noodles are spectacular. The salmon and prawns are delicious.
Santos has attended to us. Very thankful. He explained everything to us in detail, recommended delicious dishes and was very attentive to the children. A pleasure.

reviews.author: meilute s
reviews.title: Strongly recommend it!
reviews.text: We visited Flora restaurant on a 4th day in Paradisius. We ordered starters, soup, mains and dessrts and the food in restaurant was Fatastic! Excellent team! Our waiter was Cruz. He was extremly helpfull with menu and coctails! Cant recommend enough!

reviews.author: Gabriel Malovays
reviews.title: Spectacular food, average service
reviews.text:
I tend to be very objective in my reviews because I think this platform is very useful for those of us who are frequent travelers.

The hotel has a privileged beach, the food is exquisite and of a very good culinary level, especially the Lemon Fish. I would like to make a special mention of the waiter Abraham, who offers an extraordinary service in addition to knowing magic tricks that he performs in case he sees small children. in your reservation.

Something that I definitely did not like was that the hotel does not have a reservation system in the restaurants as usually happens in hotels that have specialty restaurants, a situation that makes your stay not pleasant because it is very complicated that upon arrival at a specialty restaurant there is a table available to be able to enter your dinner, having to wait about an hour or ending up deciding to go to the buffet restaurant (where the food is also very delicious)

This situation of not being able to reserve your dinner time generates a lot of annoyance among guests, since unfortunately the table assignment staff is not trained to be able to handle it, creating a bad experience during your stay.

Another special mention that I think I should recognize is the service of the waiters, Martin from the Malva restaurant has a truly warm and extraordinary level of service, making your start to the day very enjoyable.

The staff is not fully trained to give you accurate information, the tennis court is open from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. and there is no one to give you the rackets and balls at 7:00 a.m. because the service staff guest arrives until 8:00 hrs. I asked at the reception and Rafael told me that the staff arrived until 9:00 with nothing that could be done, until I asked to speak with a supervisor, that was when they gave me the rackets and balls to use the tennis court.

Another situation that I observed where the staff was not trained, is that upon my arrival I asked the room concierge about a Teens Club where there were video games so that my children could play during my stay, they told me that there was no type of service. and that only with one type of membership could they provide us with a video game console in the room; Later my children discovered that there was an area where there were video games for guests.

Something that I loved about the hotel is that there is a cafeteria open 24 hours a day with Nespresso coffee and cakes and baguettes for guests. A highly valued service because the coffees and desserts are very delicious.

One point that, at least I didn't like, was that the people at the reception immediately look at your wrist to know what type of bracelet you have to answer any questions you have during your stay. That happened to me with Rafael, who gave me imprecise information. of the arrival time of the guest service area and who confirmed again that there was no video game area for children and that only guests with a Nicte membership could request a video game console in the room.

The level of maintenance of the hotel is not good, my room 3604 did not close the door properly and you had to pull it very hard to ensure that it did not stay open, in fact on one day of our stay after the cleaning service was done the room was left open.

In summary, I think that the hotel is a good resort but it has points that can be improved to make the guest's stay more pleasant.

reviews.author: jasonferro
reviews.title: Paradisus Resort
reviews.text:
Paradise at Paradisus!
Flor and Martin were amazing. They made me feel like family! The best all inclusive resort on Cancún! I will be going back as soon as I can! From the beaches to the pool  and amazing fresh food everything was always fantastic!

reviews.author: Jeannie R
reviews.title: Top-notch poolside service
reviews.text: Our poolside bar service was exceptional. The bartender Juan Manuel and server Rodrigo, went out of their way to make us feel welcome and valued. The drinks were delicious and they anticipated our every need. They made this trip into a first-class experience.

reviews.author: Paloma A
reviews.title: Excellent place and service
reviews.text: The hotel was fabulous, the food was very delicious and the staff was very friendly, everyone greets you and treats you with great kindness and respect, I especially recommend the service of the waiter Pedro Martinez, it was spectacular, if I come to this hotel again, thank you service offered by young Pedro Martinez, a great man and person.

reviews.author: Allie C
reviews.title: Excellent service, Excellent experience, Excellent atmosphere
reviews.text: Simply incredible! Diego, Moises, Arnulfo, axel, Joel, Miguel, Cesar, Yamil, Estephania, Galdino, Julio, and crew in the reserve are amazing!! So thoughtful, caring and kind! Truly have become family and make the experience so special. Highly recommended!!!!

reviews.author: Bertha S
reviews.title: Happy!!
reviews.text: Excellent!! Especially the dinner at the Flora Restaurant, Anabel served us wonderfully, she was very attentive and offered us recommendations for the dishes!! And the first class menu!!!!!!!! The menu was very varied and very good reviews of the wine.

reviews.author: AlwaysOnVacation520
reviews.title: Super honest review
reviews.text:
Will not go back cuz of the following :

1) rooms aren't clean, I found hairs on towels, contact lenses on the floor, cigarette butts in the balcony.  The overall room looks old. 

2) rave party outside the hotel that will wake u up from 1am-4am, my baby had nightmares  every night cuz of that.  We went to front desk to complaint, and lady says there's ntg they can do cuz the party it's outside the hotel.  We didn't have a single good night sleep since our arrival.

3) food, the buffet service was overall ok, some restaurants food can also be found in buffet, so by day 3-4 we were fed up with the same food that were just overlapping over and over again. 

4) Beach is nice, BUT always missing towels 

We had the worse experience ever and can't wait to leave mostly cuz of the lack of sleep.

reviews.author: Irina M
reviews.title: Felt well taken care of at this resort!
reviews.text:
Service has been amazing. Our concierge Stelian has made the world of a difference during our stay! Top notch service! Our group felt well taken care of. 
If someone were to ask me what I loved most about the resort, it’s the service!
The beach, the food, the Cabanas, the drinks, the layout of the resort, all was spectacular!
Highly recommend. 10/10

reviews.author: Tennisfan126
reviews.title: 10th Anniversary Wedding Celebration - Vow Renewal
reviews.text:
We have been to the Paradisus several times to celebrate either our anniversary or my birthday.  We decided to renew our vows for our 10th wedding anniversary at the Paradisus with a small group of close friends and family.  Abi was our wedding coordinator.  Our vow renewal celebration was amazing, even more beautiful than I imagined when I planned it.  Every detail was taken care of, and the evening was so much fun!

Abi provided me a list of all the Paradisus staff that made our 10th anniversary so perfect – a big thank you to all of you: 
Abi, Gloria, Mel and Fer – wedding team
Alberto – bartender
Aldrin – waiter 
Roberto – Captain of the Restaurant
Carlos, Alan, Alberto – set up of the wedding

So thankful to all the hotel staff for making this trip memorable, and to Abi for working in personal detail throughout (even getting the minister to include a surprise mention of our two puppies, Diesel and Chloe, into the vows – was such a cute surprise! Abi was very professional, and so sweet to work with, she put a lot of care into making sure that the event turned out exactly as planned, and I really appreciate all of her attention to detail – thank you Abi & the Paradisus team!!  The Paradisus will always have a special place in our hearts, and we look forward to coming back to celebrate future anniversaries.

reviews.author: Nancy K
reviews.title: Coffee and hot showers hard to get
reviews.text:
The hotel is visually beautiful.  I loved that it is not done in that dark neo-dungeon style that is so popular now. Instead, there are hanging plants and natural materials that make the environment very welcoming.

The staff is very friendly and helpful.  The food was also good, ranging from good to excellent.  However, they need to work on labeling foods for gluten and vegan.  The male waiters did not care about gluten, but the female wait staff were more in tune to the requirements of someone with celiac disease.  The hotel needs to really work on labelling the foods on the menu and in the buffet for gluten and vegan.

If your idea of a vacation is to relax with a cup of coffee or tea on your beautiful porch in the morning then don’t stay here.  There is no coffee maker in the room, and you have to go all the way down to the first floor and stand in a long line to get a cup of coffee.  The hotel should put big coffee urns and muffins on each floor, or coffee makers in each room.

If you like a hot shower before dinner, don’t stay here.  The shower at 5 pm was not even slightly warm.  It was cool.

There are 8 floors and 4 elevators in building 3 but most of the time one or two of the elevators were not working.  Someone pointed out the head maintenance person as he snuck by and I told him both of the elevators in one bank were stranded on two floors, but he did not care.  He just made a face, said they were busy, and hurried into the staff room.

There are not enough electrical outlets in the bedroom for charging and the one outlet that was not hidden looked spongy and improvised (room 3427).  It was difficult to get a charger to stay in it.

While we were there a ceiling panel at the entrance to the beach fell on a woman and she was bloody and appeared injured.

This hotel does not need to renovate the decor, that would be a waste of money.  But the infrastructure is badly in need of updating and the head maintenance guy might need to be replaced.

reviews.author: Andries E
reviews.title: Amazing experience!!
reviews.text: We loved staying at Paradisus. The service was impeccable and the staff very friendly. Our concierge Lalo (aka Eduardo) took care of our every need. The hotel was clean and the included 24 hour room service was really good. Would definitely recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Ronnette C
reviews.title: Terrible food horrible service outdated rooms this resort is supposed to be kid friendly  but it was not geared to kids
reviews.text: I DO NOT RECOMMEND. I overheard lots of families complaining All week long. The food was really bad even the breakfast limited options but the worst resort food i have run into thus far. We had to leave the resort to eat thats how bad it was. Also lots of non working restrooms throughout the resort. When we checked in they advertised several restaurants but only 4 were actually open on the resort the others we were told were open during certain hours we went and they never opened. A portion of the ceiling fell on a lady as we were making our way to breakfast my oldest daughter saw this and was traumatized she was walking on eggshells the rest of the trip. When we got back to our room that same day the ceiling was coming down so we called right away they told us 15-20 mins they came the next day. It was from the humidity in the room the ac in our room was broken they never offered us to change rooms or anything the day before checkout they came to fix it. The humidity in the room made our clothes damp. While we were attempting to eat in the buffet Wednesday night a cockroach was crawling on my chair we left and went to McDonalds for dinner. The pools were decent however they had limited seats for tons of ppl first come first serve but not enough seating to accommodate the amount of guest. We originally had a king size bed bedroom they switched us without explaining or asking if we wanted that. The room was terrible very outdated tiny bed leaning to one side. The tub/shower was very old and cracking and had been painted over. There was a leak inside the hallway 2 rooms down from mine which attracted water bugs to that area. The espresso counter was decent for the most part. Several kids activities were advertised but each time I attempted to take my daughter the activity was cancelled from some nonsense reason.  I will never visit a melia property again not even for free. Thankfully I travel a decent amount a year so I was about to go off the resort to safe locations with my kids to make the best of our stay. Please update the rooms and expand the restaurants to accommodate the amount of guests!!!!!

reviews.author: E C Life
reviews.title: Sante and Adults Reserve
reviews.text: We are currently staying on the adult reserve side of the resort... it's absolutely wonderful! It's much cooler than the main building and very quiet and convenient with it's own cafe and restaurant. We just had dinner at Sante and it felt like we had our own personal chef! Our servers Arnulfo and Nathaniel were amazing! Top service from both of them and they brought us lots of special drinks from the bar, which were above and beyond your basic cocktails! We truly felt like first class guests here. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Irene F
reviews.title: Kanna Night
reviews.text: Karina Christian from Kanna Night were exceptional providing amazing service during our stay. They have improved our experience at the hotel. We liked it a lot and we highly recommend it! The views are incredible and so is the place.

reviews.author: Nacho F
reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: The waiters at the Kannah restaurant at night, Karina and Christian, were exceptional, very friendly and very hospitable. It is obvious that they know absolutely all types of cocktails in the world and that is greatly appreciated. Perfect

reviews.author: Logan F
reviews.title: Kanna night the best service!!!!
reviews.text: Karina and christian from kanna night  very good made my trip would come back just for them. Cancun is a beautiful place loved the water and the incredible service. They knew our names from the first time we visited. Cancun exceeded our expectations and I would highly recommend this place. Make sure to ask them to make you a surprise drink. Absolutely amazing. Thank you Cancun for a trip of a lifetime.

reviews.author: Jason J
reviews.title: Kanna night the best service!!!
reviews.text: Karina and Christian from kanna night, so amazing great service, always so happy and friendly!! Made the tasty drinks you need in mexico! So good looking as well! Love you both! Had the best view from the cabanas and the ocean is so amazing! Love you guys, see you next time!

reviews.author: Noe
reviews.title: The best coffee by the sea
reviews.text: In the Nespreso Coffee sector, the best service with the genius of Alejandro. Always with a smile, charisma, good humor and at the same time efficiency to serve and he even knew my family's tastes. On the day of his rest, his absence was noted. Thank you so much Alex.

reviews.author: Abner C
reviews.title: Not the best place.
reviews.text: The place is nice but the pool crew next to the reserve is very disrespectful. I’m Latino and they only care to serve white Americans or white Spanish people. One of them even told me a sex joke to verify my sexual orientation and was a bad experience if you’re on vacation.

reviews.author: J W
reviews.title: Fantastic experience for 8 days
reviews.text: Our recent trip to the Paradisus resort was spectacular! The resort is well maintained and the service staff was awesome.  In particular,  the service from Gaudencio and Aldahir on the beach was truly special. Kudos to both for outstanding service and actually caring about the guests. In the morning breakfast buffet, Alfredo, Conclelario, and Albeita were really great servers and very helpful. And, at night in the Malva restaurant, we had Carlis, Francisco, and Ivonn as servers...and again I can't say enough praise for their service and professional attitudes towards guests. Lastly, we had an issue with our next trips registration in December. It took three visits to get the issue resolved, but Isaac Mendoza took the time and effort to handle the issue. Management should give this young man high praise for caring about the guests. All in all, this is an excellent resort with fantastic rooms facing the Caribbean sea and iutstanding service staff.  If you make a reservation,  please look up the staff I mentioned in this review...it will be worth your efforts!

reviews.title: Very, very old, run down and unorganized.
reviews.text: Rooms are very small and many, many things broken. They say they will take care of it but never did. We paid extra for the retreat but don’t fall for their verbiage. The only thing worth it is the adults only private pool. Our “Retreat Junior Suite” was just like any regular hotel room.Very old and rundown.

reviews.author: nedabayat
reviews.title: Make remarkable memories.
reviews.text:
First time at Paradisus Cancun, we enjoyed it a lot. The staff were supper nice and friendly, different activities everyday, food was so good, morning yoga on the beach was my favorite part of the stay.
Highly recommended for families with kids. If you don’t have children you can upgrade to Reserve adult only part for only $50/ night.

reviews.author: RajdeepandJohn A
reviews.title: Abraham the man!
reviews.text: Abraham at lemon fish is amazing!! He make’s cocktail like a boss and is so freaking kind. He loves what he does and is helpful when needing to select cocktails. His personality is perfect for Cancun life! Come visit Abraham when you’re in Cancun and you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: John G
reviews.title: Abraham best bartender
reviews.text: Abraham at the lemon fish was amazing! Great cocktails and very friendly. 5 stars, great drinks. Very quick service, fast and great food. He got the conversation going and continued to check in with us to see what we wanted to try and what we liked.

reviews.author: Anthony A
reviews.title: Recommend Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: This is my wife’s and I second trip to Paradisus Cancun and our visit was exceptional. Rooms were very clean and excellent hospitality. A shoot out to Karina at Kannanight for the over the top customer service, exceptional drink recommendations and a lovely personality to match her services to our group of 7. I would highly recommend the hotel, food and guest services.

reviews.author: Noah A
reviews.title: Amazing service at paradisus
reviews.text: Amazing service, food, drinks and all. The service was extraordinary for Karina from Kanna noche, she deserves a raise more then anyone else. Food was absolutely amazing. Drinks were quickly made and always delicious. Service was amazing and their English impeccable given it’s not their first language.

reviews.author: Kristy A
reviews.title: Awesome staff
reviews.text: Karina at Kanna night was the BEST!! Took care of us the entire trip and was super friendly!! Made our experience extra special! Food was really great and buffet changed daily! Little details like higher end toiletries and jumbo beach towels really made the trip perfect.

reviews.author: Ben U
reviews.title: Tequila!
reviews.text: Jorge, Gabriella, and Santi led a lovely tequila tasting at the Paradisus, providing the opportunity to taste a variety of tequilas while learning about the history, variety, and culture of Tequila! This was one of the highlights of our trip!

reviews.author: Garrett M
reviews.title: Excellent time! Wouldn’t have done it different
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I went for a get away vacation for our anniversary. We booked through costco not knowing what to expect, but overall it turned out spectacular. The rooms were as seen in the pictures, cleaned everyday. Pool was great with an epic pool bar. Some of the food spots were just okay, but the majority were amazing! We went to Flora on our anniversary and the service was excellent. From Fanny the hostess helping us get situated to Alex keeping the food and wine coming, them and their team killed it. Even gave us a special sparkler with our desert. All and all, great stay. I would say the only cons were that the showers were rarely hot and the buffet food could be a bit warmer. If you can live with that, highly recommend Paradisus!

reviews.author: Alicia Penaherrera
reviews.title: Kanna Nights
reviews.text:
The hotel Is nice and the food is good. The gym is a bit small but functional. I would recommend to go at odd times like 1pm. 

We were at the kanna night lounge all nights and Karina was DA Bomb! She predicts when we will need a refill, remembers what we are already drinking and is always smiling! One of the highlights of our trip!

reviews.author: mullentnt
reviews.title: Love this Resort!
reviews.text: We enjoyed every moment of our stay. Oscar, Cesar, Migel, Luis, Gaby, Alejandro, Valeria and our concierge George were all amazing. Beautiful resort, great location and impeccable service. We especially loved the Sante restaurant. A view doesn't get better than that!

reviews.author: Bailey S
reviews.title: Corrupt manipulative cheats
reviews.text:
So absolutely disappointed in staying here. Our first time to a family resort as we have only ever gone to adults only resorts and it was horrible. I was expecting the quality to be less compared to the 5 star adult only resorts were used to but this was by far the worst resort we’ve been too. I won’t even go into the hour long waits at reception to check in ( and then to re wait another few hours the next day to switch rooms to the one we actually paid for ) 
But all of those things were minor compared to the blatant discrimination that we experienced. To keep it short we rented a cabana by the pool , guy said 55$ US 
Bill comes in at 255$ US ..we maybe thought it was because they’re gave us lobster and champagne (which the guy said was included in our cabana) but I thought maybe it was miscommunication and of course we’ll pay for what we used. Come to find out ALL the other canbanas around us paid no more that 55 with everything included . I feel so manipulated and cheated . Everyone was so kind I’ve been going out of my way to tip generously and then to find out how our kindness was taken advantage of by the staff here left such a sour taste in my mouth. I’ve only ever stayed at high end resorts and have never experienced such cunning and disgusting service. I will never stay here nor do I recommend anyone with standards to stay here it’s just untrustworthy and corrupt . It’s day 2 of my stay and I’m utterly disappointed.

reviews.author: Leslie Z
reviews.title: The Kidsdome (kids club)
reviews.text:
The hotel is wonderful no matter where you look at it, and not to mention all its staff! They are all excellent! Excellent attention, treatment, everything is perfect. On this occasion our children accompanied us, and we had the opportunity for our daughter to spend a super pleasant time at The Kidsdome children's club. My daughter thoroughly enjoyed the activities they have daily at the hotel and we absolutely loved the treatment they had with my daughter, the ladies from the Kidsdome team Monse, Ivy, Rubí and Yami.
Thank you very much for all the love, care, attention and fun you have with the children.

reviews.author: Manuela M
reviews.title: Pleasant stay at the Melia paradisus hotel in Cancun, especially for the service that is attentive 24/7.
reviews.text: It has been a very pleasant stay, we have spent a few days very comfortable with the family. The service is attentive 24/7 and they help you with everything, the effort is noticeable. Recommended experience if you like all-inclusive hotels and not worry about anything once there. Special mention to Alejando at reception who treated us very well.

reviews.author: Diana Gabriela N
reviews.title: Service and attention. Wow!
reviews.text:
We had a great time!
The service is what makes the difference. We loved the service in the restaurant from Armando, Martin, Ronaldo and Richer.
Rodrigo from pools, wow!

Of course, it caused me a little discomfort regarding the Nikte service that I had previously used the reserven even with children and they lowered the quality a lot.

reviews.author: Mercedes R
reviews.title: Much more than vegan food
reviews.text:
Excellent food and
Best service from our waiter Alex. Super recommended! The very delicious tandoori chicken, the charcoal prawns and the noodles with picaña are very good. The duck tamale, tomato cream and olive octopus are also worth it. All delicious!

reviews.author: zookidsclubcuracao
reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text:
Lovely hotel with a fantastic view 
Friendly staff 
Delicious food / I will come back. Only one recommend ion is for the lemon fish restaurant to accept reservations. We have been told no reservation needed , but was difficult to get a table on my husband birthday. So went to another one. We heard  it was good restaurant that s why we wanted to go their

reviews.author: annjones324
reviews.title: Beachfront Bliss
reviews.text:
My friends and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun in March 2024. Everything about our stay exceeded our expectations. The interior of the resort is visually stunning and every area is clean and well kept. The food was delicious. We sampled most of the restaurants during our week stay and we were not disappointed once. It was convenient that reservations were not required, allowing for some spontaneity. The spa was well run and serene -make sure to arrive early for the saunas and hydrotherapy pools! 
At every turn the staff were inviting and hospitable. Some staff that went above and beyond to make our visit perfect - Flor and Balthazar at the poolside bar, José at Ceilo, Williams at the YHI Spa, Alberto at the Ginger Bar's mixology class, America in the gift shop. 
We can't wait to plan our return trip, and this time we plan to bring our families along for the fun!

reviews.author: rh0ikawa
reviews.title: Will be back…
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful resort, big rooms in the Club Melia side, amazing view, great food and beverage service. Great location, beautiful beaches and pools. Super polite staff, easy and quick check in and check out…

reviews.author: Ariela G
reviews.title: Breakfast staff
reviews.text: Alberto, Arturo, and Alfredo were amazing and very helpful! Their team made our first breakfast at Paradisus smooth. They cleared the tables of our unused dishes quickly and brought us juice whenever we asked. I would recommend eating here because of this great team.

reviews.author: akunzp
reviews.title: Excellent vacations!!!!
reviews.text: I went with family and friends and we had an incredible stay, hotel staff always attentive and willing to deliver great service! Great location and with services that facilitate and contribute to making the most of and getting to know the area as much as possible.

reviews.author: Jimena D
reviews.title: The best family vacation
reviews.text: Very good service, very good attention in the ginger bar from Gaby, she attended to us during our stay and we really had an incredible time with her. I recommend that you visit this hotel since you are going to have a great time, thank you for all your attention , we are delighted with this hotel 😎❤️

reviews.author: aapg2024
reviews.title: Staff was amazing
reviews.text: Everyone from the bell desk, check in, restaurants, beach front, and spa were absolutely amazing. The quality of food and drink was outstanding. The only con I have was that there was a smell in our room but other than the the room was clean and the view of the ocean was awesome!

reviews.author: Brooklyn F
reviews.title: L
reviews.text: Karina and christian from kanna night are the best bartenders here!!! Came back night after night just to hang out with them! Plz go see them when you are here, it’s the best. They give the best service possible. Truly amazing. Cannot wait to come back and see them!!!

reviews.author: Voyager771775
reviews.title: Lemon Fish restaurant
reviews.text: Amazing Service by Miguel!!! Above and Beyond in drinks and food! Delicious, a total must when at Paradisus Cancún! Boris the manager made sure it was not too long of a wait. We had a wonderful evening, atmosphere was next level. I recommend the tuna tacos and the nigiri.

reviews.author: XZZ L
reviews.title: Check-in is relatively slow.
reviews.text: Amazing place! Every place is clean and tidy, every person here is super friendly. My daughter also enjoyed the activity at “Kidsdom” a lot, the staff were so nice and responsive and you know your child can play safely and happily here. There are many activities for adults too!

reviews.author: Tim F
reviews.title: Excellent resort
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful. Although somewhat dated there were improvements being made. We loved the soft sandy beach. There was next to zero sargassum in March. The staff was always friendly and ready to help. We especially enjoyed our waiter in the buffet, Joni, with which we had great conversations, and always looked forward to seeing him there. The shows were mostly outside around the pool and there wasn’t always enough seating to accommodate the guests. We would love to come back again.

reviews.author: Rose M
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at Paradisus Cancun and had a blast!
We got to the resort and was greeted with open arms. They took our luggage until our room was ready. We headed over to the reserve side where we stayed. We checked in and had a drink just before we were attended to. Check in was easy and quick. At that time we were partnered with our concierge Fernanda. While waiting for our luggage to come to our room we went to Blue Agave for lunch, food was delicious. The reserve atrium is gorgeous and really spells out luxury. During our stay we ate at Cappellas, Sal, Blue Agave, Lemonfish, Agua Marina, Sante and Malva. The food was all fantastic especially Sal and our breakfasts at Sante. Did a quick lunch at Malva before we left to the airport, wasnt my faviurite, but I also in general dont like buffets. Around the pool the reserve was the place to be, the pool bar over on the other side was highly crowded! Oscar was amazing on the reserve side for his service. Rodrigo was super fun! Booking the reserve adults only was the right call. The entire property is beautiful but the reserve had that special touch that made it feel that much more luxurious. We loved the coffee bar that had snacks throughout the day. Unfortunately, our concierge was sick for 2 out of our 5 day stay so we didn't get to know her or really use her services to our best ability. But she did help us book dinners and get late check out. 
We also did the excursion that came with the booking. We were told it was terrible however, we thoroughly enjoyed it :)
Other reviews on here that talk about all the negatives are definitely nit picking. There was nothing that stood out that would deter me from returning. Was there some water leak in a few hallways with a pylon, yes. Did it make it terrible, no. 
All in all, I would recommend Paradisus to others and would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Maria S
reviews.title: The BEST restaurant of our stay!!!
reviews.text: A GREAT restaurant! Don't pay attention to the fact that it is a “vegan” restaurant. Exceptional food and even better service! Cinthia, Fanny and Alex especially!! Everything was so delicious that we returned 2 nights in a row (it would have been more but the trip came to an end). They treated us very lovingly every night and gave us a special dessert for our last night. It's a shame not to have tried Flora before! They have vegan things but it is not at all a “vegan restaurant”, there is everything!! The best restaurant in the entire hotel.

reviews.author: Sofía G
reviews.title: Flora Paradisus Restaurant Cancun
reviews.text: The Flora restaurant is wonderful, the hostess Fanny is very friendly, serving with a person, Alex and Cynthia are charming, always attentive when you run out of drink, offering you another one and making conversation. The food is very good, the tomato soup and the octopus are the best I have ever eaten, of all the restaurants at Paradisus Cancún it is the one we liked the most. In general, they are very detailed professionals, they even gave us some farewell candles on our last day. If I return to the Paradisus I would repeat without hesitation.

reviews.author: Prajakta M
reviews.title: Fun Stay
reviews.text:
Had an amazing holiday in paradisus Cancun!! Had lot of events/activities for entertainment which included yoga, aqua  aerobics, circus, magic show etc
They have special play room for toddlers as well where they have some fun activities and the room has lot of interesting toys 
The hotel staff mainly Mr Rommel Cruz, the guest manager in paradisus Cancun made such nice arrangements for my husbands birthday decor. Made it so very special for us we just loved the gesture from the hotel. Such amazing people out there
Thank you guys!!

reviews.author: Alfredo C
reviews.title: Nikte is not the Reserve for families
reviews.text:
We are a family that travels three or four times a year to Cancun, we had visited the Paradisus in Cancun three or four times in previous years, and the one in Playa del Carmen. likewise.

We have a bad impression now that we come as a family because before - at least in Playa del Carmen - we contracted the “Reserve” package, and now we could only contract the “Nikte” package, for coming as a family.

The big issue is that they sell the package as a “superior” package, and the truth is that it does not include anything additional, or superior that is worth it, being that the “reserve” does have premium liquor, for example, but that for Coming as a family, unfortunately, you have no scope, which is disappointing.

reviews.author: d n
reviews.title: Great stay minus the restaurant wait no reservation’s
reviews.text: Beautiful resort , there no dinner reservations so hard to get a table with large group. Food was good through out great pool tacos and pizzas. Best is the breakfast team at Malta Ivonn Condelario went above and beyond to make sure the kids got French fries and all there favorites .

reviews.author: J S
reviews.title: Average Experience
reviews.text:
I’ve stayed at both Paradisus Cancun and Cabo.  I do not think I’ll return to either as there are far superior resorts in both locations.  Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful property/location, but the resort is run down. My party received an “updated” luxury ocean view room and it was still fairly basic.  Sink in bathroom did not drain properly.  No coffee in room.  Check in process is a nightmare. Expect to wait at least one hour.  This is the first resort I’ve been to that does not give you a room until the exact check in time (3pm).  Others in our party did not receive their room until almost 4 pm.
If you have a room in the main pyramid (#3), be aware that it will be loud until appx 11 pm due to shows and music. This was not an issue for my party, but may be for others.  
Restaurants do not accept reservations.  If you want to eat any at of the restaurants you need to line up at 6 pm to put your name on the list.  For Lemon Fish, you’ll need to line up even earlier.  If you have a larger party (9 or more), expect a 2 hour wait for a table (or be told they cannot accommodate your party). We were only able to eat at Cielo and Capella.  Buffet food was hit and miss.  Often cold.  
Pool has minimal shade and chairs.  My party rented a cabana near the pool bar for $255 PER DAY (x 4 days).  Includes a bottle of champagne and seafood platter each day.  Jorge, our cabana waiter, was excellent.  Service elsewhere in the resort was average.

reviews.author: Reza A
reviews.title: Nice views, good food, lineups and poor service
reviews.text:
Our family of three, consisting of a couple and an eleven-year-old, from Toronto, Canada. We travel regularly to destinations in the sun. 

Our recent experience at Paradisus Cancún left us with mixed feelings. While the resort boasts a picturesque setting, we encountered numerous challenges during our stay, ranging from limited amenities to poor management decisions.

Check-in, Staff, and a Safety Incident:
The check-in process was slow and poor, lack of staff authority, requiring constant referral to higher management for even basic requests. Despite generally friendly interactions, the staff seemed not motivated to address guest needs promptly or even to listen and show a basic level of empathy, demonstrating a lack of understanding of the basics in the hospitality world. We did, however, witness a commendable response from management during a safety incident (hair dryer was so old that it caught fire while being used).  

Amenities and Swimming Pools:
Despite the resort's sprawling size, it fell short in providing essential amenities commensurate with its capacity. Access to necessities like towels and showers was often accompanied by long queues, with inadequate seating and umbrellas causing further inconvenience at both the pools and beach. All these easily manageable to address, however, no sign of any willingness to help and or even trying to improve. 

Night Entertainment and Dining:
Nightly entertainment offerings were underwhelming, lacking quality, adequate seating and a designated stage area. 

On the culinary front, while the food quality ranged from acceptable to good, the constant upselling of additional items excluded from all-inclusive and the exclusion of certain restaurants from the all-inclusive package left much to be desired.

Drinks and Rooms:
While the resort offered a decent selection of beverages, the frequent extra charges for certain items detracted from the all-inclusive experience. Any wine other than house wine, cava or Sake are all extra! Even Coconut juice is extra!!!

Room quality varied inconsistently, with multiple relocations necessary due to maintenance issues and inadequate bedding options. Air conditioning units are located in the ceiling of the rooms as individual units.  Very noisy and hardly able to control the temperature and humidity in the rooms.  

In conclusion, our experience at Paradisus Cancún left us dissatisfied with the overall value for money. The resort's shortcomings in amenities, service, and room quality overshadowed its scenic beauty. We have no intention of returning and would advise seeking alternative resorts in the area offering better value and more guest-focused management.

reviews.author: Leonel L
reviews.title: Excellent service and food
reviews.text: We have stayed at The Reserve and the service and food have been excellent, one of the best I have seen in hotels with the all-inclusive format, the quality of the food is perfect. The attention of the waiter Oscar, the Manager Diego and the bartender has been very professional. Thank you, we will surely return.

reviews.author: Jaysree_PS
reviews.title: Memorable Holiday thanks to the Paradisus Vibe!
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful holiday at Paradisus Cancun! I travelled with my spouse and 4 yo daughter! The beach is beautiful - minimal seaweed and significantly longer stretch compared to other resorts on the strip - I can vouch for this as we walked the strip! The waves were high making it more of a surfer’s beach. However once you pass the initial little bit of rocks, it soft sand underneath and you can swim and ride the waves easily during low tide. We really could not get enough of this beautiful beach!! They had volleyball at the beach every day at 11 am - this was popular and in high demand as many guests joined to play! 
Our guest concierge Atzi ensured our trip was impeccable. She guided us to get our catamaran tour booked to Isle des Mujeres and photoshoot done through the hotel. Initially our room was not upto the mark and she got us upgraded promptly making our experience so much better! 
We did attend the presentation/talk and it was a valuable product, however not for my family. There was zero harassment during the talk - the reps were very pleasant and respectful. 
The food is amazing and delicious at this Resort - Malva buffet is really wonderful - a variety of food/cuisine - pasta bar every night, teriyaki/stirfry bar, Brazilian style meat bar another night, yummy desserts, fruits - something for everyone! 
My absolute favourite a la carte experience was at Cielo - their Lamb Birria was heavenly!  The service from Melvin Jimenez and staff was impeccable - efficient and they were ready to accommodate us! Chef David Corrales came and out and spoke to guests in the restaurant- we had the opportunity to taste Mexican delicacies - insects  - cricket that were really delicious! 
We also went to Flora (we had octopus and Moroccan meat balls) and Agua Marina (catch of the day and shrimp tacos) and were quite pleased with the food. Capella was good as well however I later found that Malva and Mascarpone were able to replicate many aspects of the menu. Blue Agave was good - limited to tacos only but still quite delicious. Lemon pepper - Japanese Peruvian fusion was okay and overhyped in my opinion - ridiculous wait times - turned away three days and then finally on our 4th attempt we got in and I thought the food was average - enjoyed some sushi and salman katsu and chocolate cake. 
The people working at Paradisus are very nice, welcoming and warm hearted. Jorge at the main pool took care of us and made sure we had good drinks and lunch by the pool. My daughter enjoyed pizza every day for lunch from Mascarpone followed by ice cream right next to it. There is also a taco stand there and we enjoyed chicken, pork and beef tacos (alternated each day). We enjoyed aqua beats (water exercise) at the Main pool as well as a nice pool activity that involved climbing a pad and then going through obstacles and then down a slide and back into the pool - my daughter went on it 6 times in one day - great activity for adults and children! 
There was always good entertainment by the quiet pool during the evenings - across from the Fahrenheit bar. One night they had a dinner and dance show set up outside as well. There was also a churros stands. Another night there was a circus and acrobatics as well as a children’s game station through kidsdom.  
There is a coffee shop/stand where they serve nespressso 24/7 and usually have some pastries or  baked goods to pair with the coffees. 
The only reason for my 4 star rating is the Rooms accommodation - in need of major renovations and not at a 5 star standard. We originally booked lagoon view and were upgraded to ocean view. I heard and read great things about The Reserve(adults only) and Nichte rooms - both of which are recently renovated. If you’re considering booking Nichte or Reserve I would strongly recommend as then you will have the complete 5 star experience! 
Overall our vacation was truly memorable and we enjoyed the vibe of Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Suzy I
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Service needs work.
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Hotel and I have some thoughts. First off, the hotel itself is gorgeous. The grounds look amazing and the ocean view is really nice. But that's where most of the good stuff ends.

The main problem is that there aren't enough people working there for all the guests. It felt like they couldn't help us much because they were always busy or just not around.

For example, they say they have a pool concierge, but don't expect much. They won't set up your beach or pool chair. Finding a seat is all on you. This led to a lot of guests grabbing more chairs than they needed and no one from the hotel did anything about it. We even had to wake up super early to get chairs, but then other guests would just take them. And there weren't enough umbrellas, which was a big issue for some of us who needed shade. We tried talking to the staff about it, but didn't get much help. One staff member (Luis) even told us to just steal someone else's chair! Then, a manager Ignacio came and when the server was explaining to him what was going on - he rolled his eyes and told him to ignore us in Spanish and walked away. I was really surprised. This has never happened to me at any hotel before. 

Other guests had the same problem with chairs and not enough towels. Sometimes there was only one person taking orders by the pool, and they said they couldn't take our order.

Check-in was another headache. It took forever, and there were lots of people waiting behind us too.

Eating here was tough as well. You can't book tables at the restaurants, so we had to wait a long time to get a table for our group of 8. 

Some staff members were nice, but a lot of them didn't seem too happy to help or answer questions. It's a shame because the hotel is truly beautiful. But the service, or lack of it, really made our trip less enjoyable.

I don't like giving bad reviews, but I think if the hotel worked on these issues, staying here would be so much better.

reviews.author: Rob B
reviews.title: Great experience!!
reviews.text:
Our waiter Fransisco at the lemon fish restaurant was awesome!! He delivered an exceptional meal. Not only did he provide an unbelievably tasty meal but he also suggested items that he thought we would like. What a memorable experience!!
Mucho Gracias Fransisco, Paulina and Boris!!

reviews.author: Guadalupe H
reviews.title: Lemon Fish restaurant
reviews.text: For two days we stood in line, we could not enter the Lemon Fish restaurant, they should make reservations in the morning, the service was excellent by Jorge, the food was very delicious, Jorge's attention was excellent, the hotel is excellent, it has good restaurants, the attention everyone was nice

reviews.author: Sherpa28292340476
reviews.title: Mixed Bag.
reviews.text:
Clean, great location, amazing beach, food at the various restaurants was good. Wait staff super friendly and hospitable. Hotel is pretty cool, designed after a cenote. 

But. 

Asked a concierge a question and got totally roped into a really long "presentation" of the Melia Circle Membership, which, despite being told explicitly that 1) it would be less than an hour and 2) it would be no-pressure, it was over 2 hours long and seriously stressful high pressure sales pitch for their version of a timeshare, which they don't say is a time share, but is, as far as I can tell. Luckily we got away unscathed and didn't sign anything, but it was frustrating to say the least. Also felt very much like a scam, but I'll leave it there. 

Secondly, one late afternoon we called for housekeeping service, and for maintenance/management (?) to come to our room for a maintenance issue. We left the room for a couple of hours. When we returned, the safe (tucked away in the closet) was open, and over $300 had been stolen - from the safe. 

If it had not been for these two incredibly negative experiences, this would have been a 5-star review.

reviews.author: Dhiren D
reviews.title: Poor Stay - The Reserve at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We stayed here after staying at Parasidus Playa Del Carmen La Perla with royal service. We had a concierge here, but the team could not handle requests or communicate replies. 

We had difficulties in the room, such as missing a hair dryer, flooded bathroom, missing kettle, mugs, and coffee, snack, some of which were resolved after a few days of requesting. 

The resort was very busy and we had long queues for tables at restaurants, which had no option to book, With waits of up to an hour.  Long waits for room service order also with the longest being almost 2hrs

Given the price we paid for the Reserve, it didn't feel luxurious, and we often had to chase with the concierge that things like the Bali beds were booked, but when we went to use them, they weren't, and we hadn't been told anything. Would have been simpler to make our own bookings. 

Not a good experience. We have stayed at many Melia properties, but this is not up to the usual standard, and I'm not sure we will consider Melia properties in the future.

reviews.author: Jacob M L
reviews.title: It was amazing 10/10
reviews.text: All of the staff was amazing but the waiter Armando Martin at the food bazaar and Alejandro at the nespresso cafe were both amazing and a highlight of early mornings for Family. I love the way they would remember to say hi every time they saw us and be sure to be very accommodating for our nine month old

reviews.author: Maria F
reviews.title: Great! I highly recommend it!
reviews.text:
Great! I went alone and took The Reserve option and it was great!

STRENGTHS:
- The view of the sea is the most impressive thing for me, I loved it! And you can see it from anywhere in the outdoor area.
- The location of the hotel is good. (This region is much more beautiful than Playa del Carmen, for example and is not that far from the center and the airport)
- At The Reserve I stayed in a quieter and quieter area, both in the rooms and in the pool (there is a pool for adults only), with the option of reserving beds on the beach at no cost (if the hotel is very full, you need to book), They let you do late checkout free of charge. Everything was perfect!
- There are several restaurant options and different types of cuisine. There's no catch, everything is really included (except lobster and meat in a specific restaurant that they warn you about beforehand). The food and presentation of the dishes is far superior to other all-inclusives I've been to, including those from the same chain.
- Includes really cool activities like crafts, yoga, wine tasting, etc., for both adults and children (For those who are at The Reserve, everything is free)
- One night there was a really cool Aladdin musical performance around the pool. They always offer different night shows.
- The entire team is very helpful
- At The Reserve you have a concierge to help you and book everything you need via WhatsApp.

NOT SO POSITIVE POINTS:
- Even taking the The Reserve option, the restaurants are together with the others, there is no exclusive area for eating, except for a cafeteria. But you have advantages for booking restaurants and so on.
- At first the resort was empty and it was easy to dine, but closer to the end of the year celebrations there started to be huge queues and restaurants reaching their maximum capacity for that day.
- Unless you have small children, I don't recommend the trip to the Cenote with Yoga and Shamanic ceremony, which is free in this package. I found it disorganized and quite a waste of time (it's like a dark lake with a small zip line, Yoga was a mini foot stretch and the ceremony was a quick smoke). They sell it as something incredible, but it isn't. This region has real Shamanic activities, real Yoga and other Cenotes that are much more beautiful (crystal clear and blue water) than this one, so I didn't think it was worth wasting a morning there.
- Just one day I left a sign on the door to clean the room and no one came, I don't think they read it and thought it was "do not disturb". Only after I removed the sign, at the end of the day did they come in and clean it.

IMPORTANT to say: None of the negative points diminish how pleasant it was to be there, how well I was treated and I loved staying at this resort, so it's a place I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Taylor C
reviews.title: A Beautiful Stay to Remember
reviews.text: From arriving to end, our stay was wonderful!! Upon arriving at concierge, Rocio greeted us and showed us a wonderful time during our stay! I was there celebrating my birthday with my friend and Rocio decorated our room very beautifully. She was very thoughtful and attentive along with the rest of the staff. Would definitely return and definitely recommend this resort to others as well!!

reviews.author: Carolina Rodríguez
reviews.title: Malva Restaurant
reviews.text: Malva has a very good variety of food and the service is excellent!!! Everyone in general is very very friendly. We had a very good experience with Joni, Gerardo and Fernando, they are very helpful and gentle, always willing to serve and always with a smile.

reviews.author: arati d
reviews.title: Quick get away
reviews.text: Not what I expected.  The food was subpar and repetitive.  Long line up for the buffet.    Lemon Fish was the only good al carte. Amazing sushi. The rooms are clean but dated.  It was a beautiful resort with friendly people but that's all. Disappointed

reviews.author: Priscila D
reviews.title: Perfect Service and Wonderful Hotel
reviews.text:
Excellent infrastructure. The hotel is beautiful, combining luxury with nature. Good food. Excellent service from staff. Special mentions to:
Agua Marina Restaurant - Manager Martin and waiter Antônio.
Lemon Fish Restaurant - Manager and waiter Omar.
Flora Restaurant - Waiter Alex
Swimming pool - Garçom Baltazar
Tour services - Vitor.
And especially CONCIERGE ROSSANA and ALEJANDRO, their service was incredible to the point that we miss them. They became friends. We'll be back soon. I highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Alberto Luciano Tamburrino
reviews.title: SURPRISING - WONDERFUL HOTEL AND ABOVE AVERAGE SERVICE
reviews.text: Surprising. We had an idea that the structure of the hotel would be beautiful from the photos we had seen, but in person it is even more beautiful. The hotel seems alive, lots of nature, very well maintained. All the staff without exception were incredible. Some waiters deserve special mention. ALEX - FLORA. ANTÔNIO - AGUA MARINA. BALTAZAR - SWIMMING POOLS. OMAR - LEMON FISH. I definitely highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Luis Angel L
reviews.title: Fantastic service from AXEL SOLIS
reviews.text:
I am truly delighted with the service of AXEL SOLIS at the Sante restaurant. He supported us at all times and made our experiences more than pleasant.

His attention to detail stood out, attending to all our needs and he was always aware of what we wanted, looking for hotel resources.

He made our 4th anniversary perfect.

reviews.author: Raúl SN
reviews.title: Great experience at Paradisus Cancun.
reviews.text:
If I have to use 1 or 2 for words to define my overall stay, I would use "care" and "kindness." Paradisus Cancún maintains its high standard of service since it was Gran Melía (and is still part of the Melía group).

I was fortunate to be in "The Reserve" which is the Adults Only Pyramid (5) of the complex. The quality of the rooms and amenities are top-notch. I highlight the good attitude of the snack bar, where you can find unlimited Perrier water, drinks, sandwiches, Nespresso coffee, etc. (only applies to guests of The Reserve), however in pyramid 3 there is a Nespresso coffee station next to the restaurant from the buffet and is free for all guests.

The specialty restaurants are in the main pyramid (3) which is where you check-in and is the main lobby. What great quality of food, from the classic breakfast buffet to the specialty restaurants.

I visited 4 restaurants and all of them, taking into account that they are All Inclusive, exceeded my expectations. Cappella (Italian), Lemon-Fish (Cevices and Seafood), Flora (Dominican that left me speechless), Malva Food Bazaar (here I recommend only breakfast, although dinner is not bad, it is buffet style and much better to explore the other culinary delights).

My SPECIAL THANKS to ALEX and FANNY from Flora, Alex, you are a great guy and excellent waiter, who together with Fanny the hostess made us feel at home. What great quality of food and what a good proposal (that pumpkin cream has everything to be awarded a Michelin star).

Alfredo, José and the rest of Malva are always attentive to the service. I really admire their good attitude, always ready, always smiling. I emphasize that ALL THE STAFF throughout the hotel are friendly and good. We asked about the Pizza restaurant and a waiter took us to the foot of it (even though it was on the other side of the hotel). I applaud the warmth of the service even in high season, the young man in charge of the pastas and omelettes are equally good and always willing to help you or get what you need (for example there was no Bolognese but they made me a pasta that I compensated with other ingredients even outside of those they had at that time).

I will return to Paradissus soon to enjoy their food, service and facilities.

AREA OF OPPORTUNITY: Rest spaces at the pool and beach. It's not possible that at 7am everyone is busy (by busy I mean with books, magazines and suntan lotion on the chairs), even though there was NO ONE in the pool area. I saw people coming down from 6am leaving things, they return to sleep/have breakfast and then when you come down around 7-8am there are no more free spaces and you have two, either you wait for it to become free or you move the things (which I had to do because There was no one and I was there at 7:30 am and only two people in the pool and around 100 beds already with things on them). Please make sure each room has a reserved chair, otherwise it will be chaos.

reviews.author: Paradise56127319770
reviews.title: I never saw one like it
reviews.text: An impressive hotel, with very attentive staff, from the bellman to the resident manager Jose, to the entertainment girl who taught how to make dreamcatchers (Laila if I remember correctly), to the girls at the spa and above all our dear Lalo, who we could meet count at all times. If we have the opportunity we will repeat.

reviews.author: Sightseer600697
reviews.title: This place sucks, horrible place, do not stay here
reviews.text: Waste of money, horrible customer service, this place is claiming to be 5-star hotel, but the service and the experience is 3 stars. Plan on spending lot more money when you get in the place. Staff expect you to tip every place in order to give good service.

reviews.author: ejuarez2024
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: I found the place very cool, the waiters and bartender were very friendly, I was satisfied with their services. The mini bar was excellent, although more drinks were needed (for one who wants to follow it), in general, a very good place to enjoy the vacation.

reviews.author: Maria G
reviews.title: Excellent long weekend
reviews.text: Excellent service from all employees and excellent level of food and drinks. And special mention to the pool waiter Alberto, beach waiter Javier and pizza lady who served today, Tuesday 03/19. Thank you for everything and we hope to see you soon!

reviews.author: Juan Jose G
reviews.title: Everyone is in a hurry. Id like to have more attention from staff. Except Fernanda Ortega and the buffet captain. Great
reviews.text: Everyone is in a hurry. Seems to be all are mad and just want to leave. Except Fernanda Ortega and the buffet restaurant captain who are great people who pursuit in helping us and engaged to give us a great experience and a great time. My congrats to them.

reviews.author: Chyna B
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Sofonia is the man!!! He is such a pleasant bartender but talk to him for more than just your drink. He’s a family man and visits Disney with his familia. He has a beautiful family and he’ll make your experience amazing. Our second time at this resort and we’ll be back a third for sure. Can’t wait to return

reviews.author: Resurreccion R
reviews.title: lemon fish
reviews.text: Excellent service, food and atmosphere!! The best place!!! Jorge Ramírez is the best waiter in the entire resort. The experience was spectacular and Jorge guided us in the process of choosing the best. Congratulations to Chef Marcos and Boris Maciel for their excellent work!!!

reviews.author: Crystal O
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun was an amazing experience
reviews.text:
Rocio was absolutely amazing! She was so incredibly kind and made sure that we were well taken care of. She also set up the cutest birthday celebration for my friend.

The views are incredible and the dining experience is unmatched. Customer service was spectacular. Everyone regardless of if we knew them was so kind and friendly and always made sure we were well accommodated.

reviews.author: Amy K
reviews.title: Amazing!!! Highly recommend
reviews.text: Amazing!  Love this.  Girls getaway.  Fabulous service, food, accommodations, activities.  Did the adults only Reserve experience.  Separate pool, restaurant & bar, beach area.  So good!  Miguel at pool bar Reserve experience & Jose as the concierge are both 5stars+.  Fabulous!!

reviews.author: raulwarnholtz
reviews.title: Bad service, very old rooms and good food, but I would not return, there are better options in Cancun for this price
reviews.text:
The hotel has some remodeled areas, but the rooms feel very old, the only good thing about the room is that it had a jacuzzi.

The food is delicious, of good quality, and the attention of the staff at the Malva restaurant is quite good. I wish that quality of attention could permeate the rest of the hotel. Because the receptionists are not well trained, they do not know their processes or the services that the hotel has; And the worst thing is that they respond poorly and reluctantly.

I tried to use Room Service twice and I couldn't, the first time it took almost 2 hours and the food never arrived, maybe they forgot, but I had to wait and we had to go down to dinner and the second time their system didn't work and they couldn't take my order.

The rude bell boys, the Mascalzone restaurant staff too, in short, I had several incidents during my stay that left a bad taste in my mouth about this hotel, a shame because it was a good hotel and it went bad. For the price there are definitely many better options in Cancun.

reviews.author: Brittany W
reviews.title: The perfect girls' getaway!
reviews.text: What a gorgeous resort! Starting from the first day, service was impeccable. I stayed with friends in the adults-only Reserve section, which was worth the upgrade. The views from the beach and pool were stunning. We were able to secure cabanas easily as part of the Reserve upgrade. The rooms had plenty of space and were cleaned thoroughly every morning. The downstairs restaurant in the Reserve section was perfect for breakfast, snacks and coffee throughout the day. Hydrotherapy at the YHI spa was included with our package and it was so restorative after a day in the sun. Restaurant-wise, our favorites were Blue Agave and Agua Marina - just super fresh and delicious food! Our concierge Stef was amazing and everywhere we went the service was top-notch. Shoutouts specifically to Stef, Gabriella, Victor, Oscar, Cesar, Miguel and Luis! We had a fabulous girls' trip and wouldn't hesitate to recommend this resort.

reviews.author: ryanmonterowork
reviews.title: PARADISE IN CANCUN
reviews.text: Great hotel and great service. Everyone is nice! We were treated as vip and the service was personalized shoutout to Galdino our concierge who helped us with everything. Shoutout to Jose as well one of the hotel managers who helped and introduced us to paradissus cancun. This hotel is highly recommended!

reviews.author: gkoskinas75
reviews.title: Auful
reviews.text: Second and last time in Paradisus .first time was amazing this time not sure from where to start and finish. Most important room awful in pyramid 1. Receptionist in the front unwilling to help and unfriendly and bothered from my questions . I paid for upgraded room and they gave us the worst of the worst . So noisy small outdated room 1king while I requested 2 quenns because we re a family of 3. Never again

reviews.author: Linda F
reviews.title: WE ALL got a wonderful vacation together!  Great place!!!
reviews.text: 4 adults andTwin 10 month old girls!  This place was AWESOME!   Daniella suggested we wait for the perfect rooms - and WE are SO grateful!  1 bedroom - first floor!   Fernando and Carmendo really took SUCH good care of us every morning!   They were SO nice about cleaning up the high chairs!   AND they kept us in coffee, juice and smiles!!   Mucho Gracias!  the place is spotless, the warm pool delightful - the baby pool bouncing and every day is a Party!   Thank you to the cleaning staff who we rarely saw but we know they worked!  Thank you to the excellent waiters at every restaurant - fast when we had the babies - so attentive!  AND thank you to the chefs so that we all got a vacation!

reviews.author: Johanna R
reviews.title: BLUEAGAVE
reviews.text:
At the blueagave they treated us very well, Paola the girl was very attentive. Very nice and very sweet and very patient. He offered us good food and even dessert, in fact the jericalla dessert was very delicious.
Apart from that, the girl behaved very kindly with a lot of respect.

reviews.author: Kim B
reviews.title: The atmosphere was incredibly beautiful.  We enjoyed every moment at this resort.  Every staff person was helpful.
reviews.text: My experience was excellent!  Raphael at the front desk went out of his way to help us get rooms on a higher floor, and we were very very happy! We were so thankful he was able to do so.  Thank you Raphael!  The food was excellent and my favorite server was Joni!  Joni was attentive, relyable and very efficient with bringing us what we requested with a genuine smile!  Thank you Joni!

reviews.author: Joan I
reviews.title: Absolute disconnection
reviews.text:
Impressive hotel, with excellent views of the Caribbean Sea, themed restaurants and very professional attention from all the staff spread throughout the premises.
You can spend several hours discovering its different interior and exterior spaces.
The latter are also incredible, with different pools prepared for you to achieve absolute relaxation.
Its privileged location allows you direct access to the beautiful sand of the Caribbean Sea, allowing you to take long walks along its shore.

reviews.author: yemina p
reviews.title: Everything is beautiful, especially the sea.
reviews.text:
Very happy!! First with our help in kidsdom
*Xiomara
*Ivonne
*Bruno
*Monse
*Sheila
*Itzel
Divine everyone
