Then * Juan at the bar of the dark blue pool paid attention without expecting anything in return.
They are as friendly as * Lalo in charge of helping the family during the stay!
*Alejandro in the cafeteria!
The included visit to the cenote was spectacular 😍
Nothing more than thank you!

reviews.author: Dreamer00872834033
reviews.title: The best hotel, service, and attention
reviews.text:
It was very pleasant to return to this hotel, the Malba restaurant was one of my favorites, especially the good service from Ivonn and Bernardo.
And on the beach not to mention Gaudencio's super attention.
Definitely my best place to vacation, I will return for the 3rd time next year

reviews.author: Alaina T
reviews.title: Highly recommend staying at this resort
reviews.text: The workers were all so nice and amazing! Especially Alejandro and all the coffee bar workers! The food was great the pool was great. Everything was great. Recommend for anyone who is planning on taking a trip to Mexico. Melia hotels are the best!!

reviews.author: Darlene C
reviews.title: Exceptional Customer Service!
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancún exceeded my expectations. From the moment I stepped into the luxurious lobby, I was greeted with warm smiles and impeccable hospitality. A special thank you to Cesar, Moises, Diego, Esmeralda, Julio, Iran, Alejandro, and Joel De La Cruz for your exceptional service!!! You guys made me feel incredibly grateful and truly taken care of! Your genuine enthusiasm set the tone for an unforgettable experience!  The resort's stunning architecture and beautifully landscaped gardens created a tranquil and serene atmosphere.

reviews.author: K2Y2
reviews.title: Great time with the family! Food was varied and tasty! Our ocean view suite was perfect! l
reviews.text: Great time with the adult family! The gym, spin classes(Ariel) stretch(Santi) and yoga were a great way to start the day! Food was varied and good. Our favourite dinner  restaurants were Flora and Capella with manager Teresa, host Fanny, waiters Cruz & Alex & chef Ruben making it extra special! Our favorite lunch restaurants were Agua Marina, mexican Blue Agava! Fun poolside activities and awesome pool aquasize were entertaining. The performance stage and lighting needs to allow the audience to be more engaged with the talented entertainers. Overall an awesome experience!

reviews.author: Haley C
reviews.title: Best Churos Ever
reviews.text: The Churos were so good and amazing the best I had.Melts in mouth.I also have to give thanks for my sever Oscar he was a big help of decision making of the yummy food and drinks me and my family had.Also thanks to the chefs that cooked my meals.Thanks so much for having me.I rate 10/10

reviews.author: Jksully02
reviews.title: Amazing views! Great food and wonderful staff!
reviews.text: We took a group of 9 people for a Spring Break trip from ages 15-73. Everyone had a wonderful time and enjoyed our spacious rooms, on-site golf and pools. We only wish there were a few more activities to do like shuffleboard or pickle ball.

reviews.author: Gary S
reviews.title: Off to bad start
reviews.text: Check in process was disorganized and took too long. Assigned room was flooded. While waiting in reception area, overheard two other families with flooded rooms. Waiting for another room - taking over an hour. No upgrades offered. Won’t be returning here.

reviews.author: Abhijit K
reviews.title: Amazing resort.
reviews.text: Beautiful sea side resort. Went with our infant. Rooms were well maintained and with an amazing view. The food there is amazing, nothing to complaint about. Special thanks to Liliana Garcia, Alberto Lindres and Cheff Emilio, thanks for the wonderful service.

reviews.author: Sam D
reviews.title: 6 days in the Paradisus
reviews.text: Great service, all the staff at the hotel were lovely people and genuinely cared about the quality of our stay here, beautiful hotel however the room had some technical issues my fridge broke twice in the 6 days I was there this was more of an inconvenience than anything. The pools and surrounding beaches were amazing. The food was pretty good too.

reviews.author: Carlos B
reviews.title: Amazing experience thanks Bernardo Ramiro and Jenny
reviews.text: An unforgettable experience in this beautiful hotel, the service is of quality, everyone is treated as VIP it is incredible, I had the experience of meeting Bernardo and Ramiro, both of these guys gave me the best service to me and my wife ,  they treated us as if we were from the family thank you for the good moments and unforgettable memories we will miss you guys  I will will come back anyways  also thank you very much to my concierge Jenny always very attentive explaining to us all the wonderful that this hotel has I will definitely come back soon and paradisus is my unique and favorite hotel now

reviews.author: riggsk2
reviews.title: Excellent family friendly resort
reviews.text: This resort is a go-to for our family when visiting Cancun. The resort, staff and service is truly a 5 star. Rooms are well maintained as well as the staff being welcoming, friendly and always accommodating. Beach and pool areas are wonderful!1

reviews.author: Tammy M
reviews.title: March 2024
reviews.text: Balthazar and Jorge were fantastic at the pool. Food was great!! Beds were a little hard but other than that all was great!! Will be back! There was a hiccup at check in with internet but other than that it was fine. Staff is great here. Read past all the bad reviews.

reviews.author: Navigate370016
reviews.title: Excellent client service
reviews.text: This place has excellent customer service. All the waiters in all the restaurants were attentive and very helpful. Armando, Richer, Alfredo, Alex, Krystel, Román Cruz, Francisco, Antonio, etc. The location of the hotel is also excellent in a very convenient hotel zone. The only complaint, and it has nothing to do with the people who work there, is that the rooms are a little run down and need modernizing. But in general the facilities have everything without having to leave the hotel if you don't need it.

reviews.author: Julie201907
reviews.title: Awesome resort!
reviews.text: It’s been a great week in Paradisus! The beach is excellent! The resort is beautiful! Lots of activities if you want or relaxation if you prefer. Lots to discover. The waiters are all very professional and friendly. We really enjoyed talking with Joni at the buffet!

reviews.author: Case W
reviews.title: Didier is an excellent hardworking employee!
reviews.text: Didier was terrific!  He is kind, attentive and goes all out to ensure a great customer experience!  Thank you for having Didier keep us happy during our stay!  He is a gift to Paradisus resorts! He went out of his way to ensure we were taken care of in a “white glove” manner!

reviews.author: Evan N
reviews.title: Paradise Cancún Restaurants
reviews.text: Paradise Cancun was a great stay. I enjoyed the restaurants, especially the tacos at blue agave and the great service and food at Sante. Axel did a group job waiting on us and his fellow staff did as well. They gave us free shots and were all very entertaining

reviews.author: dnlmom
reviews.title: Love Paradisus Cancun except for the loud music!
reviews.text:
The grounds and lobbies are beautiful.  Guest services was very accommodating for our special requests.  Special mention goes to Nicole and Victor at Pyramid 5 pool, and to Josue, Elliott and Luis at Pyramid 3 pool.  They  were absolutely excellent and made us feel like special guests.  Food is very good although Cielo could use a few more options.  We were Nikte guests one week and Reserve guests for 2 weeks, staying in Pyramid 5 for one week and Pyramid 3 for 2 weeks.  I have to say, I will never stay in Pyramid 3 again as the music at the Ginger Bar was horribly loud and went on way too late.  This is not a minor complaint - it was so loud that it is enough to make us think about going somewhere else after being loyal customers for more than 8 years.  And Pyramid 5 needs more than one elevator as guests cannot be expected to walk up 7 floors when the only elevator there is broken (and that happened 3 times in our one week there). Other things that could easily be improved and would make our stay more pleasant - enforce the no smoking areas, and drastically reduce the noise level at Pyramid 3 in the afternoons.  It is so loud it hurts your ears!  On more than one day, we were driven away from our time at the pool because of the loudness of the music.
All in all though, we love Paradisus Cancun and hope that these few adjustments can be addressed prior to our next stay.

reviews.author: michaj42024
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: The location was great! The Beach was wonderful. We found the Staff were Plesant and helpful. The only complaint is the beach cabanas (rentals) sat empty most of the time. Discounted them mid day would be a great way to have more seats and increase  revenue.

reviews.author: Cristina b
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text:
It is a great hotel to spend unforgettable days resting.
Juan Manuel, pool bartender, the best!!!! The treatment and attention he puts into his work is wonderful.
I would repeat without a doubt!!

reviews.author: henar g
reviews.title: very good hotel
reviews.text:
Very good hotel, all the staff are lovely, always with a smile on their face, they help you with everything you need, charming.
The hotel is great, the food is all very delicious and a lot of variety.
The beach was fascinating, although we couldn't swim, but because the weather was very rough and the waves came in very strongly. Everything is great

reviews.author: Saumei L
reviews.title: If you are young, don't go (20s-30s)
reviews.text: Separate the hotel all inclusive adults only reserve experience. And the truth is that it did not have anything luxurious or 5 stars. The service at least from our concierge was terrible. The condition of the rooms was bad, waiting time more than 3 (check in time) for them to give us bad rooms. I do not recommend the SAL restaurant at all. TERRIBLE service and it took them 2 hours to serve us the food that was normal. In terms of drinks, they offer diluted cocktails, diluted shots and non-existent premium liquors. The position area was 90% older adults, and they didn't even play loud music. There was no nightlife in the hotel and the only karaoke/sports bar with a DJ closed early and the bar service was terrible.

reviews.author: María C
reviews.title: Beautiful stay
reviews.text:
We had a beautiful stay! The facilities are very comfortable, spacious. Pools with bar, varied restaurants
I especially highlight the attention of the staff, Francisco from the Malva restaurant was very attentive and helpful to us.
Elisabeth who gave us a meditation class, also super friendly and warm
The hotel is super good, pleasant and familiar, you can see the effort to provide good service. We will definitely return!

reviews.author: abfraselle
reviews.title: The Reserve
reviews.text:
Congratulations to Manager Fernando for his great work and Concierge Fernanda from The Reserve area for being so attentive during our stay. Professionalism, closeness, empathy, friendly and smiling at all times. Very decisive and anticipating the client's needs. They are in constant contact with the guest so that nothing is missing.
Congratulate the attention received at the Sante Restaurant by the managers: Esmeraldo and his Hostess Fernanda.
The waiters are very professional and at your service at all times. Thank you for your attention to Axel, Natanel, Oscar, but especially Valeria.
The restaurant offers a healthy, varied and very well presented gastronomic service.
Together with its employees and the views, they make the experience unique and unforgettable.
I recommend the Grand Ocean View Suite, to feel the maximum rest and pleasure of your vacation.
Balinese women have coolers and bottles of bottled water that are always cold. In addition, a snack service if desired.
For a special event, I recommend the Beach Club Kanna: again very friendly and attentive staff as well as very good music in the afternoon.
YHI Spa facilities in good condition and I tried one of the massages, highly recommended.
In short, it is an ideal place to disconnect from the routine and noise of the cities.
Thank you all and until next time.

reviews.author: kasolira4
reviews.title: The reserve section is not worth it
reviews.text: From the time of check-in, we were promised two double rooms, but were assigned a king and a double. Despite having a "personal concierge", he never responded to our messages. The quality of the rooms left a lot to be desired: one of them did not have a bathroom door and a curtain was torn. The food in general was unsatisfactory, especially at the Sal restaurant, where we waited 30 minutes for the complimentary bread and 2 hours for the meat, which arrived undercooked in every way (some were half-done and others very undercooked). We never received the "premium" alcohol that was supposed to be included, it wasn't even offered to us. Despite asking several times for them to refill the black nespresso pods (which contained caffeine), they never did. Also, on the second day, we had to ask for the room to be cleaned because it was already 5 pm and no one had done it

reviews.author: Kelsey W
reviews.title: Kanna night the best bar
reviews.text: Karina and Christian from kanna night are the best bartenders! So accommodating and attentive! Other staff is also very welcoming and willing to go above and beyond. Absolutely wonderful place to stay. Very clean and easy to communicate between staff members.

reviews.author: Meagan C
reviews.title: Shout out to Karina & Salvador at Kanna Bar (night)
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus at the end of February. It was our first trip to Mexico ever and overall it was a really great trip. We booked the junior suite lagoon view in the 4th building and the room was okay. Definitely not like the pictures when booking but it wasn’t awful. The food at this resort was amazing. Blue Agave, Lemon Fish and the coffee bar were our favourites! The Buffett also had a ton of fresh fruit and a wide selection of food. One of the employees Jenny was fantastic to deal with and so helpful. Additionally Juan Carlos was so fantastic and went above and beyond to help us navigate going off resort, taking public transit to the ferry and over to Isla Mujeres. He gave us some really good pointer that’s were extremely helpful. The frustrating part of the trip was not having any pool chairs to use by the pool. People go down at like 6 am and put towels on them and then most weren’t used all day so you just saw empty chairs with towels on them. There are also cabanas but you have to rent them to be able to use them. I want to give a HUGE shout out to Karina and Salvador from the Kanna Bar at night. We spent every evening there and by the end of the trip we were sad to have to say goodbye. Truly the most amazing humans and just really liven up the resort! If you like tasty drinks, let Karina or Salvador choose and make you something delicious! If you are staying at the resort, go to the Kanna bar at night! Not just the best company but a cozy place to sit and enjoy the view!

reviews.author: wicha46369
reviews.title: Thank you Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We recently visited the beautiful PARADISUS CANCUN for our 25th Wedding Anniversary and exceeded our expectations.  We were upgraded to The Reserve and we were pampered the whole stay.  Thank you to our personal Concierge George Topalovic and the staff at Sante:  Gerardo - the Chef, Montserrat - the Hostess and the waiters Natanael and Alex.  Also were luky to get Balinese beds at the Pool and the service of Oscar, Luis and César was superb!!!

reviews.author: Paige L
reviews.title: Thank you Cesar. Muchas gracias!
reviews.text: Cesar did an amazing job ! We loved our experience. The dining expwrience was anazing and he helped us with everything. Always making sure we had what we needed as far as food and drinks. I was able to practice my spanish. I am very grateful. Thank you!

reviews.author: Cristian V
reviews.title: Arturo, Enrique and Alberto
reviews.text: Enrique, Arturo and Alberto gave excellent service to me and my entire family. They were very attentive and made us feel very comfortable throughout our stay. I highly recommend the hotel and the Malva restaurant for its incredible variety on the menu.

reviews.author: Gloria S
reviews.title: Relax Time and Fun!
reviews.text:
I went with my son and there were many options for the children, both in the pool and in the kids room, he had a lot of fun, even though the hotel was always high in occupancy, there were places to be.
The beach was super nice and zero sargassum, very clean.
The service was excellent, Eduardo at the pool and his partner were very friendly and helpful.
The food was very delicious, the pizzas and the ice creams.
We saw a wedding during our stay and it was clear that the coordinators took care of every detail, the couple looked super happy.
definitely a place to return and enjoy with family or partner.

reviews.author: Danie m
reviews.title: 5 star food and service but 3 star rooms...
reviews.text: It seems I'm not the only person who has stayed at this hotel recently and whose first reaction was wow, so much potential but so sad that they let such a beautiful property deteriorate to this state. This review should actually have 2 parts: 1. Service and food and 2. Property and accommodations. The most impressive quality this hotel has is service. No matter which restaurant we ate, everyone was exquisitely thoughtful and professional. The food was equally great at any of the dining options (although Capella was my personal favorite!) Similarly, the service we experienced by the pool by everyone was quick, attentive and very thoughtful. A special thanks to Charly who was so patient with me on our first day which had a very rocky start and he was unfortunately there to bear the brunt of my frustrations. I would also like to highlight the exceptional service we received from Rosanna the Guest Service Manager that took care of us with white gloves and managed to completely turn around the horrendous first impressions and initial experience we faced the first 24h there. Rosanna was born to be  a leader in customer-service because she puts herself in other people's shoes, listens and genuinely takes on your issues as if they were her own. She followed up every day to ensure we were ok and this made all the difference because it was a ROUGH start to our vacation, to say the least. This brings me to point number 2 - Property and accommodations. My family and I had been to this hotel about 10 years ago and we were delighted to be going back because we found it to be a true 5 star 10 years ago. Upon arrival, we all realized how desperate this hotel is for renovations.... and not just touch ups! The first room we received was in the dungeon with dirty curtains, rusted faucets, mildew hanging out of the vents, a moldy smell everywhere and the list goes on... The second room was somewhat better still very tired looking with the same rusty faucets, a grimy bathtub with a grimy curtain etc and then the third room that was finally an "updated room" with fresh paint and a much better bathroom with a glass shower door was acceptable but still not 5 star quality. The furniture was simply painted so if things were broken before, they are still broken, like the drawers that kept collapsing and falling off the tracks each time we opened them. Lastly, pay attention to the sun chairs by the pool. Many have rusted bolts and screws sticking out. A pretty serious hazard this hotel should take care of immediately because the sun chairs are placed so close to each other anyone can easily scrape themselves on the rusted screws. Such a beautiful property with wonderful people working there and all-around delicious food available in any of the restaurants but wow, wow, wow, does this hotel ever need renovations from the inside out.

reviews.author: Alejandra T
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text:
We came with another couple for 6 days and 5 nights. Our trip started off a little bit rocky when we arrived to our room and saw that while it was decent, it certainly does not look like what is advertised on the website. We booked a junior suite with a lagoon view, upon entering we noticed that the cloth headboard above the bed had multiple dead flies smeared on it, the bathroom was not thoroughly cleaned, the AC turned off every ten minutes and would only restart if we turned it back on, and our lagoon view was non existent. We had large plantain palms covering our view and blocking the natural light from coming in as well as having no patio furniture on the balcony. I expressed our concerns to Raphael at reception where he apologized and offered to upgrade us the next night to an ocean view for a discounted rate. He was very attentive to our concerns and seemed genuine in his willingness to resolve our issue. He mentioned to me that someone would be in contact with us in the next days to resolve the issues we had encountered and to make it up to us. Unfortunately that never occurred and it seems like the hotels internal communications are a bit disorganized as no one could confirm that this incident had even occurred when I brought it to their attention. However our new room had a stunning view and a jet bath on the balcony which was a very pleasant surprise and definitely elevated our stay. 

The food was the highlight of our trip as I find it rare to find quality food at all inclusive resorts. I have been staying at Melia hotels for years and my expectations are always high, but nevertheless the food here does not disappoint. Our favorites were Cielo which offers delicious Mexican cuisine, Agua Marina that has delicious and fresh seafood, we ate both lunch and dinner here and I would even go back a third time. Lemon Fish was also great with a nice ambiance as well. We did not stay at the Reserve so we didn’t get to check out those restaurants, but we in no way felt like we missed out or that the other restaurants weren’t up to par. 

The pools are very clean and offer guests the ability to choose the environment best suited for their stay, we loved the adults only pool which was heated and a little more secluded from the other pools. Over in the main pool Rodrigo was amazing and extremely attentive since our first day there. He made time fly over at the wet bar and we definitely enjoyed our time with him. Down at the beach Gaudencio continuously went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of and that our drinks were never empty. 

Overall we really enjoyed our stay here and would come back in a couple of years if the rooms get a little bit of a facelift. This resort is great for both younger couples and families alike as everyone has the room and amenities to fit the needs of their trip. The staff here is attentive and friendly and stands out among other resorts in the area.

reviews.author: Vidyia R
reviews.title: La Reserve Experience
reviews.text: Second time back to Paradissus in a year. We did La Reseve this time and really enjoyed the peace and tranquility. Didn’t need to go far at all from our room to the pool which was heated on the windy days or the beautiful beach.  No seaweed in sight.   The restaurant in the reserve section was amazing for breakfast and lunch. They also served us at our Bali bed. Felt quite spoiled. The little coffee/snack/bar in the lobby was never busy and the staff were always helpful. Loved the Christmas decor and as always the place smells quite nice. Spa like throughout. Did dinner at all the restaurants.  Loved the steak house and the seafood. Planning on heading back again. Is La Reseve worth it?  I usually say the premium upgrades aren’t worth it but this time it’s a yes.

reviews.author: mandeepsinghdhiman
reviews.title: Amazing vacation place to be with family
reviews.text:
If you are planning a trip to cancun, you need to check this one as well. We stayed for 7 nights with kids and the experience was amazing.
Service and hotel location is amazing.
For kids, they have kidsdom and I m pretty sure your kid ll love it. The kids activities were super fun and amazing and keep kids busy and you can spend some quality time alone.

reviews.author: VeronicaMartinezKS
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation - Reserve area
reviews.text: We had a great stay at the Paradisus. We stayed at pyramid 5- Reserve Adults only. Our concierge Juan Garcia was very friendly and helpful! The waiters at Sante- Cesar and Moises are beyond phenomenal! The food and service at Sante were amazing! Diego Diaz the manager over at Sante always checked in on us to make sure everything was going great. The amenities at the Reserve are the best! I’m ready for my next trip!

reviews.author: josefr531
reviews.title: Great all-inclusive hotel in the hotel zone of Cancun
reviews.text:
Hotel:
All-inclusive hotel of the Melia group. 25 minutes from the airport, right on the long hotel zone. The public hotel zone buses (old, red buses) take you quickly to the shopping mall and also to the boat dock in Playa-Mujeres. We had booked "The Reserve" - a recommendation because, among other things, it has its own pool area for adults only and its own restaurant. There is also a concierge service. We had GALDINO as our concierge, who was very helpful and solution-oriented for us. Thank you for that.

Room:
The arrival was bumpy because we were assigned a room right next to the construction site of the neighboring hotel (Marriott). Thanks to Caldino, on the 2nd day we moved to the 6th floor of "The Reserve" building (5). Clean, large, bright, simple - but still spacious. The refrigerator is refilled almost daily, cleaning twice a day, large TV, great WiFi.
The patio door creaks very loudly in the wind - which was very unpleasant at night. There was always wind. 
Please note that the Marriott is still being renovated and all the rooms that are right next to it hear the construction noise (including the excavator peeing when it pushes back)
It should also be noted that there is always something going on in the evening - loud music until around 10 p.m. is basically the norm. 

Beach/Pools:
There was little congestion at the pool at "The Reserve", so the great Bali beds had to be reserved in good time. The other pools were always full - lots of North Americans with drinks in the pool and corresponding "background music" (but this is the same in many Cancun hotels). Victor and Nicol are responsible for the Bali beds, which can be reserved twice a week per The Reserve guest, but it can be reserved more often. The two do a perfect job, are always friendly and there are always enough towels.
Unfortunately, the beach was much narrower than the last time we stayed in 2020, a hurricane probably destroyed a lot of the beach width. Until the end of February there was hardly any seaweed, but then a lot of it started to swarm. Unfortunately, little or no beach cleaning is carried out. It's a shame, because seaweed makes every beach horrible. Due to the always very strong wind, the beach became even narrower in certain places at the beginning of March (see photos, on the beach part of The Reserve - where there was almost no beach left). Sunbed reservations are also available in Mexico....
The WiFi works at top speed in the entire hotel area (up to the beach).

Restaurants/bars:
Top! Perfect! Delicious! There is a large buffet restaurant (Malva) - varied and a huge selection. There are also themed restaurants such as fish, Italian, Mexican, taco, Japanese delicacies, Caribbean...
The number 1 is the SAL steak restaurant with huge steaks from all parts of the world.
Guests of The Reserve can visit the SAL once per stay at no extra charge (special card for this). In some hotel descriptions, this is stated too vaguely because many The Reserve guests assume that you can eat in the SAL every day. 
Guests of The Reserve have the SANTE restaurant exclusively for themselves for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The menus of the themed restaurants do not change. 
The service is excellent in all restaurants! Cleanliness, speed and extremely friendly - the short version for all employees. 
The fact that there are hardly any guests who wear long trousers - unfortunately has a somewhat negative aftertaste. But Americans and taste in clothing is a tricky thing. There are of course a lot of "peculiarities" in clothing in the Malva buffet restaurant. I do not need to describe any further that the all-in negative effect of excessive alcohol consumption becomes apparent by the afternoon at the latest.

reviews.author: Corey J
reviews.title: The best bar of the night
reviews.text: Karina and Christian from kanna night!!! This was the best night!!! Me and by husband had the best honeymoon. We enjoyed the food and the drinks. It was the best time. We would recommend the bar with the swings by the ocean with Karina and Christian. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: nick b
reviews.title: Kanna night the best bar☺️
reviews.text: Karina and Christian from kanna night!!! Great time, went with friends. They were great bartenders. They were happy and created a great vibe and comfortable atmosphere. They also let us on Aux to play music which was great. Thank you both of you

reviews.author: Carmen V
reviews.title: Amazing vacation - The Reserve area
reviews.text: Amazing stay from the start to the end, in every detail, all made possible by the amazing people who work here and who deliver an exquisite service for their customers. They are always ready to help, checking to make sure you have everything you need and never miss of anything. Was really impressed by their warmth and kindness. Big Thank You to our concierge Andres Vargas who made everything easy for us. We were lucky to have you assist us, with your lovely smile and personality. Loved the smooth check-in and check-out in the stunning atrium of Pyramid 5, the spotless room with the comfortable king bed and the perfect shower, the beautiful and relaxing pool area. Thank you Uriel for the aqua gym and the activities by the pool, your energy and your smile are contagious. Loved the Sante restaurant with the stunning views of the ocean and the good food. The variety of restaurants in this resort, all with delicious food, is outstanding. The beach is beautiful and the colour of the water is unbelievable! The whole resort is beautiful and well taken care of. Happy we chose this place for our vacation and hope to be back!

reviews.title: Kanna night the best bar!!!
reviews.text: Wonderful experience with Karina and Christian from kanna night . Excited to see them all tomorrow! The tiki bar is the best place to experience drinks near the water. Great music and great drinks to keep the night rolling. The most magnificent experience ever.

reviews.author: jblaurel
reviews.title: Unforgettable stay!
reviews.text: Our first time at Paradisus Cancun was absolutely unforgettable! From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel like VIPs. Special shout out to Jose, who went above and beyond to ensure our stay was perfect. Our concierge, Galdino, was also incredibly helpful and showed us genuine hospitality throughout our time there. The hotel itself is stunning, and the entire team made our experience truly wonderful. We're already planning our next trip back!

reviews.author: Polett Banda
reviews.title: Back and bad experience in Aguamarina
reviews.text:
It is notable that areas of opportunity have emerged, in service, taste of food that went from very good to simple and in some cases slightly tasteless. We are staying in tower 1 of Club Melia and the deterioration of the rooms is notable, without a doubt The areas need renovation, as well as updating the hotel and installing facilities for children.

Today, which is our second night of reservation (although we have been members for years and vacation frequently at the Paradisus) we had dinner at a restaurant called Aguamarina, with the specialty of seafood, although it would seem that they specialize more in neurotic waiters, where we were "served" by Miguel, who looked like a canteen waiter, always rushing around, rude, defiant, distracted and stupid, bringing what he wanted when he wanted it, and ensuring that every thing he forgot was our fault because we didn't ask for it, anyway. , the situation escalated along with the disappointment until the other waiter, named Wilber, who, it is worth mentioning, served us well, had to apologize for him, "asking for understanding because Miguel was a little rushed since he was acting strange that day." , in the words of good Wilber.

Of course, after the complaint escalated, the waiter Miguel began to talk to us and we asked to speak with Captain Rafael, who took a while to arrive, and was friendly but with a very lukewarm personality, he fixed the problem at his own expense. style, which I doubt is effective or at least functional given the terrible attention and management of his work team, judging by the little respect they show him, and a shame because the food he had tried up to that point was average to good, although nothing remarkable, but we no longer continued eating because the situation took away our appetite.

Not everything is bad, we ended up leaving almost without eating, because we honestly didn't feel comfortable eating there.

We went to another restaurant that is poorly promoted, called Flora, where we were surprised by the dishes, THE BEST THING WE HAVE EVER EATEN IN PARADISUS CANCUN, from the charcoal prawns, the olive octopus or something like that, tomato soup, delicious salads and exquisite desserts , and with a friendly, organized service and where you can see a totally controlled management from A to Z, it is a STRICT VISIT when someone comes to paradisus Cancún.

At this moment we are staying in the room and tomorrow we will definitely return to delight with the service and flavor of Flora, and with the fabulous attention of Tere the captain, who would be good if she could teach Rafael how to motivate his team, and the waitress who Their treatment made us remember why we decided to buy the membership many years ago, among so many delicacies we tried we forgot their name, but thanks to Tere and Ella for changing our bad experience at the Aguamarina restaurant.

reviews.author: Paige  W
reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text:
This is our second time at the Paradisus and certainly won’t be our last. The resort is beautiful, perfect location, great food, but most of all the service is outstanding. 

Axel, Gerardo, Monserrat, Natanael and the rest of the Sante team put together a special dinner to celebrate our engagement. Not only was the food delicious, but everything they did for us went above and beyond to make it a night we will never forget. Pictures don’t do it justice but I will add them anyways!

Daniela was our concierge and was excellent; we hope to have her again every time! She responds immediately and takes care of anything you may need and checks in daily to make sure everything is going well. 

Karina and the rest of the crew at the Kanna bar also deserve another special shoutout for the second year in a row. The atmosphere of the bar is amazing but the staff adds so much to the experience. They are awesome at what they do.

Julio at the Reserve bar is very nice too and can make any drink you want. These people all deserve a day off because they are always there! You can tell they love their jobs and truly care about the guests. Every encounter we had with any staff member was positive. I know I am forgetting some staff members by name, but they were truly all exceptional!

Last but not least, housekeeping is great and your room will be cleaned and restocked daily. They don’t miss anything. We can’t wait for our next visit!

reviews.author: Michelle H
reviews.title: We had an amazing time!
reviews.text:
We recently spent 6 days and 5 nights at the Paradisus Cancun. It was our second visit. We did The Reserve again, which I highly recommend. We were able to have a cabana for every day that we needed one. The pool is heated. We had access to Sal Steak House, which was delicious. We were able to have reservations to the restaurants, so we never had to wait. AND, we had an INCREDIBLE concierge - Violeta. 

Violeta is so kind, efficient, and wonderful. If we needed or wanted something, she made it happen that day. We never had to ask twice and she always went above and beyond. For example, I was having some allergy issues from the down pillows. I asked for one regular, non down pillow (like the one in the closet). She immediately found two and brought them to our room. I also shared a career milestone, that happened while there, and she had champagne and a beautiful plate of fruit and chocolate sent to our room. Thank you so so so much, Violeta. You are definitely the best concierge we've ever had.

reviews.author: reem s
reviews.title: A bad experience made right
reviews.text: Our trip started on a bad foot moving from room to room first upgrading to ocean view then because no view, then broken AC in total we had to move three times in 2 days and were frustrated. reviews.author: Greyce R
reviews.title: The Reserve exceeded all our expectations!
reviews.text:
Every moment at Paradisus Cancún felt like stepping into a dream. From the ride with our friendly Otium driver from the airport to our unforgettable days at the resort, enchantment seemed to follow us every step of the way.

We arrived at Paradisus around noon and were amazed by the fact we could begin enjoying the hotel's facilities while waiting for our room to be prepared. Our introduction to The Reserve was made all the more memorable by the warm welcome from Martin, whose kindness extended beyond a simple greeting as he guided us through the pool area and the Santé restaurant, setting the tone for our entire stay.

With the Reserve experience, we were assigned a concierge, but we couldn't imagine we would meet such a dedicated and friendly one: José. He further elevated our experience with his attentive service and complete tour around the hotel. José was in touch daily to update us with the hotel activities, booking the included experience to the cenote, and our dinner at Sal. 

At Paradisus, reservations for restaurants are no longer necessary, adding an extra layer of convenience to our stay as we can do things at our own pace!

After visiting all the hotel areas and the main pool, we concluded that the Reserve is the best choice to unwind and soak up the tranquil atmosphere as a vacation should be! While the common pool tends to get a bit crowded, with big families and loud music, the Reserve area was just the place to be, away from all the noise. 

We were also informed that at the Reserve we can book pool beds twice during our stay, but we could enjoy them almost daily by simply adding our names to the waiting list that works pretty well! 

These pool beds were where we spent most of our days, alternating between the pool and the ocean (what a tough life!). The service at the pool is also amazing, with staff checking often if you need another drink! There is a QR code by the pool bed where you can order food directly to where you are. There is also staff passing by offering popsicles and inviting for other fun activities!

The drinks served at all the bars were so well crafted! While Luis from the Reserve pool bar provided exceptional service during the day, it was Julio, from the Reserve inside bar, who ensured that each evening concluded with exclusive cocktails we never tried before! 

The culinary offerings at Paradisus were equally impressive, with breakfasts at the Reserve lounge being a highlight of our mornings. From perfectly prepared eggs benedict to salmon and avocado toast, each dish was a masterpiece and we felt like being fed by a chef! Even the grab-and-go options available during the whole day at this lounge were presented with such care and attention to detail that we could just eat with the eyes!

Among the restaurant options, Agua Marina stood out for its fresh seafood selection, while Santé impressed with its stunning views and lovely staff, especially Luis and César. 

Our room, with a breathtaking ocean view was another highlight! Thoughtful touches like sunscreen and repellent, along with a welcoming bottle of sparkling wine and macaroons, made us feel instantly at home. Watching the sunset from our balcony, glass in hand, was an experience we'll cherish forever!

By the end of each day, they set a nightly buffet by the main pool, featuring performances ranging from traditional Mexican dances to rock band! We also found a big show going on at the event hall with a lot of performances. And of course, the silent party (with people listening to different DJs on headphones) was fantastic! So fun!

As our time at Paradisus came to an end, we found ourselves wishing we could stay longer. We then were informed about another great surprise: you need to free the room by noon but that doesn't mean you need to leave the resort. We could stay till the end of the day enjoying all the facilities and José booked us a complimentary room just to take a shower and get changed before we departed. Details like that make all the difference!

What truly sets The Reserve apart is its exceptional staff. With their genuine warmth and hospitality, they ensured that every moment spent at Paradisus felt special. Their enthusiasm mirrored the joy they took in their work, leaving us feeling truly cherished throughout our stay.

The Reserve surpassed all our expectations with its impeccable service, amenities, and unforgettable experiences. We can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Kelly P
reviews.title: Great service, average thoughts on overall resort.
reviews.text: It’s a huge resort, took days to feel comfortable. Biggest disappointment was everything shutting down at 11pm every night. Room service was available but wait times were long. Activities were off time and just ok, if you weren’t there 15mins early you couldn’t get a spot. The Buffett was great, tons of options, Armando, Ignacio and Jonny made every visit incredible.

reviews.author: Blanca T
reviews.title: Total relaxation
reviews.text:
This resort is amazing. Our family has been coming here for years now. The rooms are clean. The service is great!  Can’t beat all inclusive. I like that you can stay at the Reserve section and totally relax or join the family on the family/children area as well. 
When people asks us for a hotel recommendation in Cancun, we say Paradisus. It’s paradise!

reviews.author: Anam
reviews.title: Liliana the magician !
reviews.text:
Walking into Paradisus YHI Spa, I was hoping for a break from the usual tension in my shoulders, but what I found was so much more, thanks to Liliana. She’s not just good at what she does; she’s a game changer. With an incredible knack for pinpointing the problem areas and this warm, welcoming vibe, she made the whole experience feel like catching up with an old friend - if your friend was also a wizard at easing away every bit of stress you walked in with.

Liliana’s hands work magic. She’s got this gentle yet effective way of making you forget the world outside. By the time I left, I felt lighter, like I’d shed a weight I didn’t know I was carrying. It’s clear she loves her job, and she’s brilliant at it.

Honestly, she’s the heart of Paradisus YHI Spa. I’m already looking forward to my next visit. Liliana, you rock!

reviews.author: LeRoy M
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text:
The atmosphere and the staff was amazing and made sure that we had a pleasant experience. The food was great and the pool experience was also great.

The SPA treatment was amazing and relaxing. My massuese Liliana was amazing and me feel totally relax and rejuvenated.

reviews.author: Ronda M
reviews.title: Excellent service at a beautiful resort!
reviews.text: As I sit at the airport sadly waiting for flight, I must give props to Paradisus for their wonderful service & beautiful resort! We hate we are having to leave! Frida & Lilliana (spa), Arilano, Cesar (Sante), Axel & Fernando (mgr) ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Cynthia D
reviews.title: Trouble in Paradisus
reviews.text:
Pros - Near Airport, ocean front
Cons- Sudden water shut-offs, ours lasted for 7 hrs in all of the 3 ocean front Nikté rooms we reserved on 2 out of our 4 night stay.  No water for flushing toilets, sinks, nor showers from 11am-6pm.  When water was restored to our rooms, our sinks did not drain.  Our room keys (bracelets) had to be reset several times.  On one occasion, the lock system needed a battery and we needed to go back and forth to the front desk for assistance.   Rooms are not maintained to the standard of a 4 star hotel, let alone a 5 star hotel.  Mini bar was never restocked during our 4 night stay.  Room service was not included in the all-inclusive prices.  At The Blue Avage Restaurant, our server did not get any of our orders right and refused to bring extra guacamole to our table.  Our flight was unexpectedly changed by American Airlines and had to check-out 1 day early.  We explained and showed evidence of the change to no avail.  We were charged for the extra night anyway.  We were also charged for the days we experienced the water shut-offs.  Not sure what recourse there is for when guests are left without water in their rooms.  Overall, our stay was not up to par with what we are accustomed to in a 5 star accommodation.

reviews.author: Jessica M
reviews.title: Best resort experience ever! We will be back.
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I absolutely loved our recent stay at Paradisus. This is my second time at a Melia resort and I will continue choosing Melia. I've been to a number of resorts in Mexico and this was by far the best one in all areas: food, room, view, beach, staff, location, ambience -- all exceptional.

We were in the Adults Reserve area and our lagoon view room was modern and beautiful. Housekeeping tidied up every day. The resort location, layout, and beach were gorgeous. Sand is soft and the water is clear. There was minimal amount of seaweed that was cleaned up daily and plenty of chairs to lay out on which is usually an issue at resorts from people taking them by 6-7am. I usually never use the pools but they kept them so clean that I ended up swimming in the pools 3 out of the 7 days we were there. The pools are kept at a perfect warm temperature. One of the reason I picked this resort is because of it's more quiet, slow paced nature. We are not party people and I loved that the pool areas were always quiet and calm. Perfect for naps and reading! Overall, the resort has a very relaxed vibe which was exactly what we were looking for.

We loved that Reserve guests could reserve cabanas at no extra cost. I've never seen so many cabanas available within a resort either so there was no shortage if you booked in advance. The common areas like the lobby and halls were always clean and smelled so good!! I've never seen so many plants inside a resort. It's like you're in a tropical jungle, so cool.

I was also incredibly impressed by the food quality. Usually by day 4-5 the food is repetitive and I'm sick of it but that was never the case here including the buffet! They put out new items every meal each day. The selection of fresh pasta, fruit, desserts were so good. We also loved the little canteen in the Reserve area where you can take desserts and pastries to-go! The Sal steak restaurant was absolutely delicious as well. It was included with our Reserve booking and we were thrilled to eat there. Blue Agave and Cielo (Mexican themed restaurants) were also among our favourites. Throughout all the restaurants, the meats were always so tender and juicy, never overcooked. I've honestly never experienced that before at any other resort.

Having been to numerous resorts, the staff here were also by far the BEST. Everyone greeted us walking by and the friends we made among the staff greatly contributed to our wonderful experience. In Malva, I want to especially recognize our dear friends Alfredo (no pasta!), Martin, Richer, Alberto, Enrique, and Gerardo. Everyone works hard at the resort but these men went above and beyond to serve us. Alfredo helped take every plate back to our seats and they all ensured our beverages and requests were filled quickly. They each took the time to get to know us while at our table and never rushed the service. Meanwhile I can see they are serving many many tables and working tirelessly cleaning and carrying dishes back to the kitchen. In the hours we spent at the buffet, these men never stopped working for a second! We always looked forward to being seated in their sections at Malva. They should be extremely proud of their exemplary service and I hope they are recognized for their consistent, hard working ethic. Dear Alfredo, Alberto, and friends, we hope to see you again very soon!!

We also want to recognize and thank Veronica (cleaner) and Moises (server). Both have also left a lasting impression from our trip. The first time we met Veronica was in an elevator where we just said hi in passing. Then a few days later, she took the time out of her schedule to come help us sweep sand off our cabana bed. It wasn't something that she needed to do but she happily helped us anyway. It was such a lovely gesture that showed the staff here truly care about their guests. I even noticed every morning there was staff raking the sand on the beach by the chairs so it looks nice when guests arrive. Again, something that is totally unnecessary but shows how Paradisus goes above and beyond. Galdino, our concierge, was attentive and took the time to find us within the resort to connect. He made sure to see us before our last day and we really appreciate all his help. Upgrading to Reserve is so worth it. For anyone not travelling with kids, we highly recommend it. The perks, extra 1:1 service, and restaurant access you get is phenomenal. 

Last but not least, we want to thank Raul (bellboy) at the front door. We met him on our last day waiting to get picked up and he left an incredible final impression that sealed our 10/10 stay. Our transport was late and he came over to check and update us many times. He took care of calling the transport and coordinating with security so we just sat and relaxed. We had a great chat with him to pass the time and truly look forward to seeing him again in the next few years before his well-deserved retirement. He is the best person you can have at the front of the house as the very first and last memory of the resort.

reviews.author: Macarena M
reviews.title: Flora Experience
reviews.text: My husband and I went to dinner on the last night of our visit at the Flora restaurant. Its exquisite menu, the presentation of the dishes invites you to try the entire menu. The attention from the moment we arrived was warm as if we were at home, familiar, spontaneous and helpful. I want to thank the entire team: Cruz, Alejandro, Fany, Teresita, Monste, Ana and Cinthia, thank you so much for making this trip such a special memory. 🙏🏻❤️

reviews.author: Keiashine
reviews.title: Best drinks best people best bar
reviews.text: The best bar in the resort. I recommend to visit the ginger. There you get the best drinks.The staff very friendly. Thank you gaby didi and Alberto. You made our best vacation…. Thanks everybody. We really love you😘😍🌴🌊🫶🏼. You won’t be disappointed. Great time.

reviews.author: Lori L
reviews.title: Great February Trip with Family and Friends!!!
reviews.text:
My friends and I just spent a week at Paradisus.  It was a wonderful time. The employees at the Reserve go out of their way for you. Our butler Galdino could not have been any better.  His attention to detail was amazing.  The two pool concierges Nicole and Victor always had our Bali beds ready for us.  The staff at the pool  (Moses, Joel and many more sorry I can’t think of everyone’s name, always was there getting us anything we wanted.  

Also, we can’t forget about Liliana at the Spa. Her massages are one of a kind.
  We all felt very spoiled while we were there.  All of us enjoyed our time so much we are headed back in May.    If you are thinking of visiting, go ,  you won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Cindy G
reviews.title: Galdino Rocks!
reviews.text: Galdino is the most amazing butler. He goes above and beyond every time we go. He makes sure our rooms, reservations and or activities are set. He communicates before we arrive and comes to see us every day to make sure we are happy. Could not ask for a better experience from him.

reviews.author: Daniel E
reviews.title: Bed bugs worst experience ever
reviews.text: Thank god my vacation has come to an end. I have been all over the world travelling and I have never had a worse experience both with staff and cleanliness in my life. Please see attached photos of my arms and hands after night one(bed bugs) I was itchy all week. The staff is absolutely horrible. The managers laugh and smirk at you the entire time you try and talk to them while lying through their teeth. Nicole at the adult only pool bar could be the rudest person I have ever met. Stay as far away from this place as possible u less you want to look like you had chicken pox all week.

reviews.author: Kenny E
reviews.title: Bed bugs and HORRIBLE Staff!
reviews.text:
Beware of this resort!  There are bed bugs in the rooms (see attached pictures) and the staff are amongst the rudest staff that I have ever seen.  I have been to many high end resorts and the staff at the Paradisus is by far the worst.  They try and upcharge you whenever they can and will call security on you if you try and talk to them.

There are only about 50 chairs next to the main pool at a resort with 2,000 rooms.  If you do not wake up at 5am to secure a chair then you will never get one.  The food is average at best and everything shuts down at 11pm.  There is no nightlife at this resort whatsoever and is the most boring place to be after dinner.  If you like going to bed at 8pm then this resort is perfect.

The pool concierge, Nicole, at the adults only section (the reserve) is one of the worst human beings alive.  She constantly screams at guests, has absolutely no respect and tries to get people kicked off the resort for no reason.  How she still has a job is a mystery in itself.  

The spa staff will get you in trouble if you use the change room to get changed in and will write a report on you if you get naked to change into your bathing suit.  

I would never go to this resort again even if I was paid to go there.  It is unorganized, under staffed and an absolute disaster.  I am a professional in my late thirties and I highly suggest you book another place in Cancun to stay at - take my word for it.

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: 14th Stay at Paradisus Cancun and It Won’t Be Our Last
reviews.text:
We’ve stayed at Paradisus Cancun at least once a year since 2011 when it was a Gran Melia.  It has certainly become our favorite place to spend a week of sunshine, beach and relaxation.  However, not every stay was wonderful and when we had a problem back in 2012 the Director of Operations, Ivette Sanchez, asked us to give them a chance to make it up to us and return.  We did and Ms. Sanchez made things right which is why we remain loyal guests.  We always enjoy seeing Ms. Sanchez during our visits and were happy to see her last week.

During this stay our concierge, Raul, also made our trip nicer.   He makes the extra effort to make our stay more pleasant.  This year he had chocolate covered strawberries and a bottle of sparkling wine sent to our room to help celebrate our wedding anniversary.  Raul was also our concierge last year and specifically requested him this year as we will next year. It’s employees like Raul who add a personal touch to our stay that make our stay nicer.   

My wife and I also enjoyed massages in the Spa.  Gemma was my masseuse who gave me a great deep tissue massage.  Yes, there were moments I’d thought she was killing me, but I wanted a deep tissue massage and that’s what I got.  I felt amazing when it was over.  

There are many places in Cancun to choose from but when you’re treated like an old friend it makes our decision to return an easy one.  We’re looking forward to returning next year.

reviews.author: Lecia
reviews.title: Beach Bliss
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time at Paradisus Cancun. The beach was absolutely perfect--no rocks, soft sand and easy to swim in the warm water. We even got to see baby turtles hatching on the beach!! We had a great experience at the cabanas. 

We also loved the restaurants and of course, the buffet. Gerardo Fernando Martin were all extremely helpful, bringing us everything we could possibly wish even before we could ask. Thank you for a great trip!

reviews.author: LESLIE STEFANIA M
reviews.title: Delighted with the Lemon Fish restaurant
reviews.text:
My favorite restaurant was Lemon Fish, the waiter Jorge was super friendly and warm.
He is a very nice person, I would definitely return. The chefs Marco and Antonio prepared us a delicious dinner and Boris the manager was always looking out for us.
I loved .

reviews.author: Rogelio U
reviews.title: A super special hotel
reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice, perfect to go with the family and have a great time.
The Lemon Fish restaurant is spectacular, the waiter Jorge makes you feel at home, super friendly, the food from chef Marcos and Antonio is delicious, and Boris the manager is super friendly.

reviews.author: Wendy U
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: Excellent option to go with little kids. The hotel has special amenities for children, and offers a personalized service. Rooms are comfortable. There are many food options (international / local / asian, grill, etc) and also a variety of activities to do with family. The hotel is all inclusive.

reviews.author: Maria L
reviews.title: The people who helped me were: Joni, Atilano and Alfredo. They are good people who took care of us.
reviews.text:
The service is really good and the people who served us were very kind and gentle.
The food was excellent and the completeness of the good service makes it a good place to have lunch with family, friends or partner. Totally recommended Malva restaurant

reviews.author: biki_ma
reviews.title: Take this cat to the vet!!!!!
reviews.text:
The resort cat Daisy is sick with upper respiratory infection and this was reported multiple times by me and different ppl to the front desk and supervisor Angelica but I doubt they will do anything about it. 
They use this cat as mascot of the resort but don’t care for her, they don’t feed her nor take her to the vet.
This morning she stopped eating completely, I hope she won’t die but she will if they don’t take her to the vet.
Heartless people, only running after $$$

reviews.author: Surbhi M
reviews.title: Highly recommended for families with young kids
reviews.text:
We had great time at the resort! The staff overall and at kidsdom especially was awesome. My kids had great time and we were very impressed with the activities arranged for kids to keep them engaged. 

There were variety of options to select for food. Facility was a little dated but kept clean overall.

reviews.author: ASISTENTE S
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Karina and Salvador from Kanna Noche, Excellent service, they looked after us all day very well, friendly, cordial, and offered us all the best of the hotel, thank you very much for everything we had a delicious time. The delicious sea and the perfect hotel......

reviews.author: track1track1
reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: Had a great time celebrating girlfriend’s birthday. Looking forward for next year!!! Beautiful arrangement of hotel and amenities thru-out. The staff makes the hotel feel even better. So many options to do that u don’t even make to leave.

reviews.author: daniel_tinco
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text:
A great hotel in Cancun.
We spent 7 incredible days.
Room 3315 with a beautiful view of the lagoon.
The hotel is very large, central pyramid plus three others on the sides.

The gastronomic offer is wide as is the number of bars.
I loved the Kanna, stunning ocean views and a nice place to start and end the day.

The cevicheria bar is also a pleasant place to have a drink in the evenings. Great attention from CARLOS. He deserves congratulations since it is clear that he enjoys his work.

The attention from ALL hotel employees is unbeatable. They are very cordial and always kind to any request. Whether in management (PAOLO, ROSSANA...Yenni! Thank you for your kindness), also in bars (Juan, ASUNCION, IRINA, Orlando, Manuel, Luis, Salvador, Mitchell, Timoteo, Rodrigo) everyone does a great job.
They do not make differences between nationalities, we are all equal and receive excellent care.

The Ice Cream Parlour, Pizzeria (Andrea!) and Taquería that the hotel has in the main pool area are also great. Very good quality!

Very good buffet with an excellent variety of options. Ismael and David, cooks deserve a 10!

Francisco, buffet waiter too!

------

The gym is open 24 hours a day, very complete to maintain an ideal workout. Spinning room, yoga and a large machine room.

------

Entertainment! The hotel offers an ideal team to have fun during your stay. Bryan, Santi and Ariel the Cuban are pleasant people.
I like to play volleyball and the truth is that there were some nice games.
There was an animation girl whose name I don't remember but I would also like you to congratulate her.

The inflatable in the main pool, volleyball, water polo games and basketball.

To end the day, a quality show. At the convention center we experienced a night of high-level live music. (Violinist, trumpeter and two singers and impressive team of dancers).

---------

We had to change hotels and we had such a good time that I ended up leaving at 5pm haha. We were sorry to leave

------

Wide beach area and a divine sea like the one Cancun is used to.

We will return without a doubt!!!

reviews.author: Infane J
reviews.title: A must Visit
reviews.text: Karina and Salvador from Kanna. I enjoyed the time we spent at the resort and the drinks and hospitality was top notch. I don’t write reviews often but when the customer service is good I feel I have to. I recommend this establishment any time you are in Cancun!!

reviews.author: Adventure50829910260
reviews.title: 5 Star Experience- Make this your next vacation spot!
reviews.text: We highly recommend this resort! Everyone was friendly and very accommodating. Everyday the waiters remembered us and knew our preference drinks. Rooms were beautiful and food was the best. Iran Mendoza was our personal concierge and she helped us, sent daily activities,  setup the restaurants that needed reservations,  etc. She was the best and made our experience even better! Thank you Iran!

reviews.author: dlauer2015
reviews.title: Great 3 night trip
reviews.text: I've stayed at several all inclusive resorts in Cancun over the years and this is by far the best. I have stayed at this particular one at least 3 times in the "reserve" adults only section. Quality of food and alcohol are very good. Staff are very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Rebecca D
reviews.title: Amazing time with Great Service
reviews.text:
We had an Amazing time at Paradisus! From the start with our concierge Jose, who is AWESOME, he was able to get all of the reservations we needed no problem and was always checking in on us which we appreciated. Abraham and the wonderful crew at Ginger are knowledgeable and attentive. Christian at Sante was so awesome and great personality, really enjoyed the service and conversation. The baristas at the nespresso bar, Alejandro and Fernando were awesome as well.
The food was great.  We did not have a bad meal.  
Loved having the bali beds for use and having servers, like Oscar, bring your drinks was an added bonus. Pool on adult side of the resort was heated to accommodate this time of year
Spa saunas on men side wasn't working the best in the spa per my husband. 
Relaxing and fun time with friends.  Would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Ashley M
reviews.title: Better than we dreamed!
reviews.text:
My husband and I had never been to Mexico or an all-inclusive before. We choose Paradisus on a recommendation from a friend who had stayed there and it did not disappoint! Everything during our stay exceeded expectations —the location, the atmosphere, the food, the staff, the activities! We enjoyed water fitness with Uriel —it was like a dance party in the pool! The pool is large and has plenty of places to lounge as well as a swim-up bar. There are also lots of relaxing spots on the beach by the beautiful turquoise water (the beach was very clean too)! 

Our favorite restaurants were Cielo and Agua Marina for dinner, Blue Agave for lunch, and Malva for breakfast! We also enjoyed gelato by the pool. Alejandro and Fernando were our favorite baristas at the Nepresso bar! They made amazing iced caramel marshmallow lattes! The staff at Paradisus definitely goes above and beyond to be friendly, fun, and kind! We could not be more grateful to them for making our trip truly one to remember. We are already dreaming about coming back!

reviews.author: Rayza Karely N
reviews.title: A really nice vacation with many new experiences that gave me and my family wonderful landscapes.
reviews.text:
We have been surprised with such good service, very friendly, welcoming, delicious food and the incredibly beautiful hotel.
Especially the warmth, kindness of your staff in general and Mr. Alberto Linares and Miss Liliana García, thank you very much

reviews.author: ctillerjr
reviews.title: Excellent and Friendly Service
reviews.text: My wife and I had a wonderful spa experience. Then we had dinner at the Lemon Fish on our last night, and I want to shout out the WONDERFUL service by Jorye. He made wonderful suggestions to my wife who loves to try different alcoholic beverages. The food was to die for so hats off to Chief Marcos. Finally I would like to say thank you to Boris Maciel the manager of the Lemon Fish. I wish I could take all these people back to the States with my wife and I 👍🏽👍🏽

reviews.author: wallymcmillan
reviews.title: Cancun 2024
reviews.text: This was a very nice resort, great location on the beach lots of beach to walk in both directions. The restaurants were nice, a few that were not included in our package which was a little disappointing and several items on the menus of the restaurants that we were allowed to visit that were extra costs which was also disappointing.

reviews.author: MrRaveon10
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: Location was outstanding. Access to the beach was really easy. Numerous bars on the facility allowed access to beverages easily.  Food was OK. The buffet had a huge selection. The meat choices were not that great and could use some attention.  but Dinner wait times for food were 1 hour 1/2 for many of the restaurants. Much too long. Facility was clean. Staff were attentive.

reviews.author: Kristen
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Had a great stay at Paradissus. Beautiful beach. Clean rooms. Comfy beds. Loved Karina and Salvador at the Kanna bar, best bartenders at the resort. Armando, Daniel and Ignacio always did an amazing job at the buffet. Very attentive, kind and funny. Remembered us everytime we came in. Food was great.

reviews.author: jenmoody627
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: Beautiful inside and out. Rooms were very nice. Beds were ok. Food at buffet was mediocre and usually cold. All the restaurants were very good. Lemon Fish was the best. Pools were huge. One too warm tho and one too cold. Hard to use swim up bar because water so cold. The resort has so many stairs that are difficult to avoid. That was tough on my somewhat recent knee surgery. Kids club activities could be advertised better. The kids foam pool party was a lot of fun. Night life for adults was fun. Gift shop prices were insanely high.

reviews.author: dan270960
reviews.title: HALF FIG HALF GRAPE
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus from February 18 to 27. Here are the negatives and positives
Negatives: When we arrived at our room, big disappointment...view of the lagoon and also of the parking lot...the balcony very small and no place to sit. And even sitting, view of the concrete from the balcony. No coffee available in the room.
-Positive: They worked hard to find us another room that was a little better with an ocean view but still with an unusable balcony.
-Chairs on the beach, impossible to lie down...mid-sitting position only...First time I've seen this in a resort...
-Positive: Very beautiful beach cleaned every day and very pleasant water for swimming.
-Negative: Not enough accessible restaurants and too long waiting time (up to 2 hours waiting some evenings). Why 2 Mexican restaurants?
-Positive: Very nice buffet in the morning and at lunchtime.
-Negative: Lobby bar, only one person serving drinks and not available every evening. The bartenders have a tough time but are long enough to be served.
Positive: The kindness of the people at the resort in general. The service at the Malva buffet: Alfredo, Martin and Gérardo were very nice and friendly. They made our stay very pleasant during our meals.
-Negative: Apart from the Malva (buffet) the only interesting "restaurant" for us is the Lemon Fish but the waiting time is too long.
-Positive: Congratulations to Angel for his patience and having to deal with people who were very irritated or intoxicated by the waiting time. A nice thought for Miguel too.
-Negative: Lighting too bright at the Capella
-Positive: The menu at Capella is very interesting and Jesus was very kind.
-Negative: Not being "preferred", no access to the healthy restaurant or the Steak for a fee.
In summary: The price paid is too high for this huge resort but the kindness of the people made our stay interesting.
Danny

reviews.author: Claudia P
reviews.title: Mejor tiempo en Cancún - Paradisus
reviews.text: Salvadore y Karina fueron los mejores bartenders. Lo pasamos super bien en el Paradisus Cancun.  Fabulous time due to the best service. Kanna Noche was amazing - we will definitely be here again. The drinks and shots were awesome and we made new friends.

reviews.author: ALBERTO C
reviews.title: The experience I had in this restaurant was pleasant, there is a great variety of food and it was very delicious, the service is good.
reviews.text:
What I liked is the kindness they show to all their clients.
I also liked that people who were asked a question put their hand over their heart. The food is very fresh, hygienic, and tasty. The facilities are clean.
Liliana Garcías and Alberto Linares are people with a vocation for service that very few people have.

reviews.author: Camper14515
reviews.title: Another excellent week on the Mexican Caribbean !
reviews.text: My wife and family have visited this property roughly 25 times.  We have never been disappointed with the property or hotel staff.  This year we were especially well taken care of at the Kanna Night bar by Karina and Salvatore, which made our evening cocktail hour an absolute delight.  These two were the best.

reviews.author: Traci H
reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.text: Traveled with a girlfriend for a week stay at the paradisus Cancun.  Food was delicious,  room overlooking ocean was great.  A little outdated but didn’t matter because it was clean and view from balcony was amazing of the ocean.  Service at the pool, restaurants and buffets was very good!  Loved everything about the paradisus!

reviews.author: Traveler W
reviews.title: Nice time
reviews.text: We had a very nice time this week, we have been coming here on and off over the years.  Very kind people took care of us. Some memorable people were Pascual, Johny and Ariadna at morning breakfast in Malva. Look for them! Very hardworking and attentive!!

reviews.author: Kim W
reviews.title: Good but not for couples!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve side. It was gorgeous. The pool was great!! The staff was great! The food was better than some resort food I’ve had. The downside of the resort is..even if staying at the adult side (The Reserve) all but 1 restaurant is on the family side and kids were running everywhere! Eating off the buffet with their fingers unsupervised etc. You can tell it’s an older resort that has been updated but it’s beautiful other than very thin walls (you can hear EVERYTHING I will not be back but truly only because of it being attached to a family area where I want adults only.

reviews.author: pflaumer1
reviews.title: Best service ever!
reviews.text: Reserve side was amazing. Resort was beautiful & smelled amazing (vanilla and lavender incense)!  Excellent service from Jennifer, pool concierge, and all the great guys poolside (Oscar & Moses are the best!).

reviews.author: James C
reviews.title: Excessive Charges for Added Children
reviews.text: It was meaningless even if they were charged an additional fee that was close to the room price for the additional child. I was very embarrassed by the charge for a different fee than before. I think next time I will have to look for other places and hotels.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Room smells like mold.  Ordinary restaurants.  Dirty Pool.  Good staff though.
reviews.text:
Room:  A/C didn't work at arrival so called service.  It took two visits to get it fixed.  Room smells like mold (I think the smell comes out of A/C), this explains why they sprayed very strong air freshener in the room which made my fell nausous when we arrived.   Bathroom  needs updating.  Sink was cracked and drained slowly.  The rain showing is a nice feature but not much water comes out of it.  We had to use the sprayer to speed things up.  Hair dryer is the same model seen in the 90's and barely working.  

Ordinary restaurants:  Appears all the restaurants we reserved have similar food compared to the main buffet.  Nothing special.  For example, during our Italian dinner, I asked what ice cream flavors for dessert, the waiter stated it's the same as the buffet ice cream.  Nothing speical about these restaurants so don't expect a lot. 

Pools:  Pool has nice design but was dirty.  We saw brown bubbly vomit-looking substance and garbage floating in water at muliple areas of the pool.  And at certain sections of the pool, you'll expeirence sewage smell coming out of the pipe exhaust.  

Staff:  Great staff in general.  Helpful when they can.  One of the plus at this hotel.

Entertainment:  Decent.  The silent disco was entertaining to watch.  Mayan dance show was good. 

Overall, for over $500/night I expected better, so I gave 2 stars for the value I perceived for this hotel.

reviews.author: Steve R
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful inside and outside. The staff attention to details is fantastic. Restaurant variety is superb. My wife and I enjoyed our stay to the max. We definitely recommend Meliá to our friends and family

reviews.author: Passport161562
reviews.title: The Best hotel and Best Service EVER!
reviews.text: We think of The Paradisus Hotel in Cancun as HOME.  The hotel is beautiful, the food is good and the service is EXCEPTIONAL.  We have returned to this hotel about 5 times and each time is better than the last. We always stay in The Reserve (Pyramid #8) and have CeCe for Butler.  SHE IS FABULOUS1  Jennifer and Nicole always takes great care of us at the Bali Bed.  Food service at the Bali Bed is fantastic.  Moises is the greatest!    Joel is great.  Diego, Javier, Reben and Atilanta are so great and helpful. A big shout out to the Poo Cleaner, who works so very hard to keep the pool so clean!  Also, David the Spa Guy was very helpful.  Hotels are as good as the service it provides.  This hotel is GREAT!

reviews.author: Violeta K
reviews.title: Bravo!!
reviews.text: Thank you so much to all PARADISUS Cancun teem !!! You made our vacation very special. Thanks to F&B Manager Ricardo Melia for taking care of us every minute every day. Very special thanks to Chef Carlos Caballrro!!! We traveling a lot, but here we did have one of the best food. A lot of different choices , fresh and very very testy food  with nicest representation . Thank again for your talent to make everyone happy. The best to all of you !- Violeta\Stanley, UAS/Europe

reviews.author: Jay B
reviews.title: Had a FANTASTIC trip!
reviews.text: We had a fantastic trip at Paradisus Cancun!  We stayed at the adults only "Reserve" so you get a few extra perks like better access to cabanas by the pool and some premium liquor options.  Food was very good all throughout the resort, we especially liked the Blue Agave taco bar, Cielo (mexican), Sal (steakhouse) and Capella (italian).  The buffet for breakfast and lunch was very good as well.  We also loved the service provided by the entire staff, everyone was so welcoming and nice.  We especially want to thank our concierge, Aaron, and Julio at the Reserve bar, you guys were incredible!!

reviews.author: Liz W
reviews.title: This old gal still delights with service
reviews.text:
This is our 3rd trip staying in the Reserve.  Food was a little better than last year. Rooms are showing their age but comfortable. The special sauce of this place is their service.  Their staff go above and beyond in a genuine, authentic way from the moment you arrive until the moment you leave.  Some specific staff to mention who made our vacation outstanding:

Reserve:  Djordge (George), our concierge.  I requested him in advance after working with him last year and he absolutely nailed it again.  Our arrival was effortless and every need was taken care of. We appreciate you!!

Reserve Pool:  Nicole, Jennifer, Joel, Javier, Moses, Cesar, Jamil, and shout out to Ruben who wasn’t technically our server but checked in on us every single day.  Also, shout out to Ruben the pool guy - the wind had him working but he did an amazing job!!

Reserve Lobby Bar:  Julio

Malva:  Armando, Candelario, Atilono, Alejondro, Janeth

Cielo:  Jose with the dimples 

Capella:  Jesus

Lemon Fish:  Carlos

reviews.author: yubao8888
reviews.title: Excellend service!
reviews.text: This is the third time we stayed in this hotel, always an excellent experience!  Very friendly staff.  Specifically, Ms. Veronica offered great help for us when needed throughout our stay in the hotel.   We'll for sure be back again!

reviews.author: ashleygilliam1
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but needs updates
reviews.text: We went for a best friends wedding. We stayed 4 nights, 3 days. overall, it was a really nice time. Though there were some things I noticed during my stay that needed some attention, all in all, I do recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Lorenzo C
reviews.title: An exceptional experience with service and hospitality awesome!
reviews.text:
Liz and Galdino from Paradisus Meliá Cancun very very helpful and excellent service and advice.
Thank you for all the reservations 
Will be sure to return soon!
Thank you 🙏
I recommend them! Very helpful

reviews.author: Vrodmama
reviews.title: Shady & building disrepair
reviews.text: Shady business practices if it doesn't benefit the resort or Concierge. Buffet food was room temp. Building elevators were broken and fire hazard. Bldg paint chipping, Roof leaks.
