Travel agent, Otium, was helpful to sign up but got rude when there was an issue and they didn't care after they took your money. Otium tour guides were great as well as the Cabana workers. The buffet waiters work hard and were pleasant. Japanese restaurant had poor service.  The lack of printed menu's was frustrating because you didn't know what you could order if you didn't have your phone with you.  Room was hot and bed linens were hot too. No USB charges in the rooms (rooms are dated), no smart tv's. Showers are old. Sink faucets leaked and drains were clogged. Nice marble, plants, water features, music throughout the facility. A few pleasant interactions with a few employees but the bad ones stood out. Lots and lots of stairs and difficult for disabled to get around within the hotel especially with the elevators not working. Had to take stairs to get to ramps to back of facility/beach area.

reviews.author: dincauwright
reviews.title: Average Resort!
reviews.text: The resort was nice but was not maintained very well. The first room we were placed in (5004) had exposed breaker boxes by the front door, was supposed to be an ocean view and all you could really see was the top of cabanas. Instead of fixing issues they masked them, like in the spare bathroom they just covered the outlets so there were none available. The 2nd room we were moved to 5412 was nicer and had way better views but was kissing missing a shower door in the spare bathroom so unless you wanted water everywhere you couldn’t use it and the air conditioning didn’t work very well and the room would get hot. Overall the food was okay, to be expected at an all inclusive.

reviews.author: dmart13
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing!
reviews.text: I never knew I could experience such a peaceful and outstanding experience like I did here! I honestly don’t want to book anywhere else and this was our first all inclusive resort! Everyone was so amazing especially our concierge Abel! He truly made our experience a 20/10! We will be returning!

reviews.author: pzabo2023
reviews.title: Employee service fantastic. Could use better info about hotel prior to arrival.
reviews.text: Bring smaller currency denominations for tips. Hotel services couldn't break a $50.  Luckily some of the wait staff could using their own tip money. I would have liked more information about the hotel and services prior to arrival. Ordering higher quality wine at a restaurant was a bit over the top. Wait staff was great and very helpful and friendly - best I have ever experienced.

reviews.author: Camper02190943033
reviews.title: Thank you.
reviews.text: Gustavo, the Reserve activities instructor, was fantastic y great with our children. We will come back again, just to experience that! Thanks again to everyone for a wonderful vacation!!! For some reason this thing is not registering that I have enough characters, so I’m going to continue to add characters until it allows me to post this post. Thank you very much again and I really appreciate the fact that voice text is available to fill the space. Thank you.

reviews.author: Chris P
reviews.title: Not good at all
reviews.text: We just got back today from a 5 night stay at this resort. We had 2 reserve rooms, master suite and junior suite. Not sure where the 4 and 5 star reviews stayed, but it could not have been this resort. From the start is was bad. We checked in at the Reserve, and to be honest, the representative was not very friendly. I will say, most of the staff were very friendly, hence the 1 star for them. Elevator in the reserve did not work, we had to walk up 6 flights of stairs to get to our rooms all week, it was horrible. Our Concierge was a no show, we met him once on day 2 and never saw him again. Now to the really bad part, the FOOD and drinks. The food was HORRIBLE at every restaurant. We ate at Sal's WOW it was bad. Steaks were raw, lobster tail was over cooked, then the next 1 was raw. Grilled ceasar was not grilled, it was soggy. The buffet was maybe the worst I have ever had. We had breakfast there a few times, and trust me, it was horrible. We looked in for dinner and Golden Coral looks better. Lemon Fish was okay. The reserve  restaurant was bad as well. Overall, every restaurant had a very limited menu and all the food was served cold or old. Night 4 we went across the street to Toro and had 1 of the best dinners in a while, Last night we visited their sister restaurant, Rosanegra, was also great. Overall the drinks were watered down. Some places honored the Reserve quality, some did not, very strange. Nothing really going on during the day besides the pool and beach. At night their was a dj  a few times for a few hours. Sport was was okay, but closed by midnight and stopped serving liquor at 11:30. Pool sticks were broken, missing tips, we were told that is the way it is. Buyer be ware this place is a money pit.

reviews.author: Meganne
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation!
reviews.text:
My friend and I had a wonderful time at this resort! We stayed in the Reserve, which was the best decision (includes premium liquor, access to two additional restaurants, private cabanas with poolside service, access to spa facilities). All facilities were clean and well-kept. Our room was quiet, cool, and comfortable. The other guests in the Reserve were respectful, and we never felt that the property was too crowded. 

Some meals were better than others. I’m vegetarian, and there were options for me at every restaurant. Some restaurants even made special dishes just for me. 

The beaches were gorgeous, and the weather was wonderful. We split our time evenly between the pool and beach. 

The service was overall very good, and the staff was friendly. Joel and Jennifer took great care of us by the Reserve pool. Giovanny and Uriel provided excellent entertainment and activities through our stay. 

Our biggest complaint was in regards to the Meliá app, which contained all the menus, schedules, etc. It was slow and difficult to navigate, but wifi access was good throughout the property.

reviews.author: Teri V
reviews.title: Warm and comfy
reviews.text: The employees were great. Josue at the Bali beds was kind, friendly and organized. He made sure my 88 year old mother was comfortable. The servers by the pool checked in frequently for beverage and food wants.

reviews.author: John L
reviews.title: Lunch at Agua Marina
reviews.text: Lunch at Agua Marina was excellent. Fresh fish in interesting preparations had us coming back day after day, skipping the usual burger and pizza options. Rafael and Antonio were attentive servers. Our glasses were never empty and they made us feel very comfortable.

reviews.author: Angel
reviews.title: Jurassic Park with Bad Service
reviews.text: We are in Cancun a lot and this has been the least pleasant experience although the most expensive.  The hotel design looks cool, my kids would hum the Jurassic park theme because it looked similar to the pyramid but the open space although cool looking left almost no air conditioning which wasn’t a huge deal except it carried over to the rooms.  We were unhappy with the room to start as it had no bath and we had paid for the privilege (I forget what they called it) level but were placed at the opposite end of the hotel to the privilege amenities (lounge, pool, etc.)  We also learned no kids were allowed at the privilege pool area so all those perks which were supposed to carry over for us to the main pool did not.   Our personal concierge was absentee and acted as if he was doing us a huge favor getting us a room in the area we paid for with air conditioning that worked (basically they added a unit by the window).  The kids club stuff delivered was broken and dirty.  I informed the concierge and he shrugged.  We tipped everyone who gave good service well..the restaurants were great and the service.  We had a lady at the pool who was also wonderful and the ice cream guy tolerated our kids multiple trips.  The concierge actually contacted us after to ask why we left him only $20 per day for the days he actually provided us any service.   We won’t be back.  So many other great hotels with much better service and kids clubs.

reviews.author: kdoonan
reviews.title: Risky Place to Stay - Better Options.
reviews.text:
There were so many things that didn’t go right, and a few that were good. 
The Cons. The facility itself is terribly difficult to navigate and the elevators did not work the entire week we were there. Twice, when it appeared to be fixed, we attempted using it and it was very stressful. The unit jerked back and forth, the doors opened and shut repeatedly and in one case it would not ride to the floor we requested, instead riding up and down. Guests were left with the option of climbing starts, we were on the 7th floor, or taking the service elevator in a closed off part of the resort which was gross, dingy, smelled and in a very unattractive area of the hotel. Towards the end of the week, the service elevator began acting badly.  During rainy days, there was significant leakage in the hallways. Staff was working had to clean it up but there was a lot and there were a lot of caution signs. Luckily, we had not issues in our room with water.  I went with a friend and we requested a room with two beds. We confirmed this request on four occasions and were told it would not be a problem. When we arrived, they only had a king.  The hair dryer in the room didn’t work. I requested a replacement multiple times along with more towels and nothing was ever sent (this happened several times over several days.). We were finally moved to a room with two beds, which was much more comfortable and it had a working hair dryer. 
The food was consistently mediocre.  Malva, the main restaurant was essentially and oversized cafeteria. If you attempted breakfast after 9AM the lines to get in were crazy long. If you don’t care a lot about food, you’ll do a okay. If you’re a foodie, you’ll be disappointed. 
The Pros. The rooms were clean and the beds were very comfortable. The staff servers at the the pool and restaurants were always excellent. The spa service was excellent.
Summary. We made the best of it and enjoyed our vacation, but I would suggest finding something else. There are some serious facility problems that would make getting our there a real challenge in an emergency. The rooms in good shape, but the building itself needs a lot of infrastructure repair, especially the elevators. The food was mediocre. The activities were meh. Personally, I think it’s over rated. It’s near impossible to navigate the 5 pyramids, and that along is a really big turnoff and danger in an emergency. I think for the money you could find something else.

reviews.author: Cindy
reviews.title: Cindy & Bob
reviews.text:
I returned from this hotel last week ,I went for my birthday with my husband and had a superb time.we stayed in the reserve , block 5 is reserve only, and the rooms are much more modern. Special mention to Julio the bar tender at the reserve bar .George our concierge was just the best and arranged for champagne,balloons,cake etc in my room when we returned from the pool for my birthday , thank you George really meant a lot. 
Staff are ALL superb and nothing was too much trouble.
Restaurants: in my opinion Sal was amazing the steaks are amazing shame you don’t get more than one visit per stay. The lunch Box has to be one of the best in an all inclusive, and trust me I’ve been to the Caribbean a lot, the lunch menu is amazing and the portions are super size, on an evening if there is entertainment outside the restaurant try and get a table pool side 👍 , Martin ,one of the waiters during the day was awesome and on an evening Natanael and Rafa where just the best, oh and the food on an evening is just as good as daytime.
Rooms: ours was modern and on the lagoon side which we didn’t mind , mini fridge had cans of pop Coke , Sprite , bottles of water and bottles of Heineken ,Tecate light . You also get snacks & drinks replenished daily as well, bag of nuts,2 packets of crisps and a bag of M&M’s.
There’s a pizza place that looked great but didn’t get the chance to try it.
Coffee Shop: Nespresso with marshmallow ummmm and the cookies we’ll say no more I ate far too many.
Sports Bar : Special mention Cecilia , Sofonia ,& Pedro who looked after us for the whole 2 weeks , thanks guys 😀
Would I recommend this hotel ,YES I would and I can’t wait to book and return again. 
The only criticism I have is the entertainment although they do provide it and we saw some superb acts ie Jersey boys , it’s not communicated very well and sometimes changes with out letting guests know.
What this hotel needs is a dedicated theatre where guests can go and of course have a notice board with a schedule of acts / times on.At the moment it’s either at the Ginger / lobby bar ( not a very big  area to accommodate all the guests) or at one of the pools.

reviews.author: reliableMontreal
reviews.title: Things to make it better
reviews.text:
Love the hotel. Nice people, big spaces. Here are some points for management to better the experience
1. The Reserve: The Reserve beach should be CLEARLY identified. It should be cleaned up every morning. No personnal music or stupid phones that we all hear ...go on the other side beach...it should state QUIET. Like at Le Blanc. More waiters and hashtrays.
2. To put little pads under furniture so it stops from making some much noise when you pull it.
3. Breakfast and lunch...why cant we just enter from the pool? Like before. Feel like a prisonner at lunch because cant eat outside? No. My vacation. ! There is a useless girl at the entry so slow it causes a line up to eat...really..at a buffet? No. 
4. For The Reserve guest there is a special breakfast and lunch restaurant. At breakfast please, faster with coffee....the run around but not efficient. 
5. Restaurants at night are not run well and not so good...lacks also ambiance. We go out to Cenacolo, Rosa Negra ect....really good and kept tight.

reviews.author: Tiffany B
reviews.title: BABYMOON PARADISE
reviews.text: The water and yoga instructor Gustavo was wonderful, very Energetic, and made the classes fun...I enjoyed my stay at the Paradisus, cacun resort...the food could be better but it was all inclusive so no complaints here....if your thinking about coming here...do it!!!!

reviews.author: Linda1079
reviews.title: Can’t wait to go back!
reviews.text: My husband and I are somewhere between 8-12 trips to this resort. We always stay at the Royal Service/Reserve Adults Only section. We both find the service and peacefulness is worth the extra money. If you stay in the Reserve Section you can still go over to the noisy, full of activity and kids side but they cant come to you. We go for R&R and just want to relax and be pampered.

reviews.author: Storyteller823365
reviews.title: A little above average hotel experience
reviews.text:
Overall the stay was good. We stayed in the reserve that was supposed to have a concierge that took care of anything you needed. The 1st day Andres made our restaurant reservations and sent them to us on the 2nd day. After that we never really heard from him again until I complained to a manager. So if that is the service you get by staying in the reserve, I would save my money and stay in one of the other towers. The food at Sal's steakhouse was the best food of the week and would highly recommend it. The food in the buffet was not very good at all and really limited on selection. The other restaurants were average at best. All of the servers at all of the bars, pools and restaurants were excellent and worked hard to make sure you had everything you needed. 
Overall a decent trip, but will not be going back.

reviews.author: Culture799712
reviews.title: Had a Good Time Many Changes Needed
reviews.text:
We stayed in the reserve 4 nights end of Feb. first part of March 2023. Went with my daughter.  
Pros: 
Beautiful resort inside and out.
Nice clean room with balcony.  
Nice restaurant overlooking the ocean for rserve guests only. Waiters were wonderful.
Clean beach area for reserve only.  Large palapas provide shade all day.  With drink and food service
Private pool with nice furniture, umbrellas and sunbeds.
No kids and private.
Snack/lunch area inside with deserts, breakfast/lunch food.  Nice variety.  Bar also, drinks and specialty coffee as well. 
Multiple restaurants.
Some entertainment.
Concierge service.
All staff were friendly and helpful.

Cons:
Lighting in the room was awful.  Couldn't find a spot to put on make-up no matter where I went in the room.
Weird shower set up.  Full glass window facing into the room.  It did have a curtain.  But you could see right through it.
On the beach the lounge chairs were very old.  None of them laid flat so you could not lay on your stomach.  Also, none were adjustable.  They did did not go far enough up for comfortable reading.  We saw others place rocks in the back hinges of the chairs which brought them further up.  That worked well for us.  But, not all chairs had that particular  configuration in the hinges so this couldn't be done with all of them.
The pool area had nice new loungers.  They need to replace the ones on the beach.

They did have several restaurants.  Reserve guests were to get priority seating.  But. that is not entirely true. They have 25 reservations per each restaurant each evening.  When those reservations are taken you do not have priority.  When we came in the concierge could only offer us reservations at 6:00/6:30pm or 9:00pm.  We were told they would take walk ins if there had been a cancellation.  We tried that the 1st night as he had no reservation available for us that first night.  That was not true.  We would walk in and were told they had no tables available although several tables were empty.  We later found out that they do not keep their restaurants to full capacity.  Finally we asked to talk to a manager Who was very apologetic and helped us right away.  He actually went to all the restaurants until he could find one to take us that first night.  He also was able to arrange the rest of the nights so we could have better seating times.  Not the concierge fault.  The concierge has limited seating available compared to the manager.
The food was good but not great.  The seafood restaurant was awful.

If you want one of the sunbeds by the pool you must reserve them right away the first day you come in or you won't get one the rest of your stay.  Guests would book them for their full stay and then not use them everyday.

I generally do not write reviews at all.  But, felt I needed to this time.  Would I stay there again? Probably not.  If they made these changes maybe. For sure would not pay extra for the reserve experience.  It's such a shame because the resort is beautiful.

reviews.author: Climber14099666879
reviews.title: Te amo Diego!
reviews.text: The property was beautiful, very large, and clean. The transfer from the airport is always filled with minor unnecessary delays and confusion but that is always the case. As for the resort, the best decision you can make is to upgrade to the Reserve and try to get the best concierge in the World - DIEGO!!!! He was amazing. He inquired about what we wanted to get accomplished during our trip and made all our wishes come true.

reviews.author: Melissa Q
reviews.title: A perfect getaway and celebration
reviews.text: Staff were very friendly, fun and helpful. Food was excellent and restaurant staff were great especially Alejandro, Libri, Emmanuel.  The restaurants were awesome especially Lemon Fish, A lot of fun activities to do in resort. Facilities and rooms were spacious, clean and well maintained. We were celebrating the birthdays of 2 people in our group and the staff made it very special by doing special greetings and surprising us with drinks and desserts 😀

reviews.author: Macie H
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful resort with some very amazing staff. Stayed 8 days with my family of 6 for the 2nd year in a row.  Jennifer helped us with our pool cabana for our entire stay.  She made sure activity staff came to do a few crafts with us and made sure we were with a waiter we requested which was either Joel or Moises.  Joel is one of the waiters at the Reserve Pool. He made sure every minute of our time there our needs were well taken care of.  He made us all feel special and welcomed everyday we had him. And even when we were unable to have him, he checked in to be sure we were happy and taken care of.  He remembered us from the previous year,  greeted us with a smile and always remember everything we ordered and at times added something a little special which we always enjoyed. He went way above any expectation we had.  Moises another waiter in the Reserve area is also amazing. He always made us laugh and made sure our pool time was enjoyable and unforgettable.  Maribel from activities was just so sweet. We made bracelets, and dream catchers with her while sitting by the pool.  She made it fun and relaxing. She also did some pool aerobics that were fun and engaging. These 4 staff are a large part of why we came back to this resort.  Thank to all of you for making our stay so enjoyable and we can’t wait to return and see you all again!

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Our 5th - and certainly not our last - time at Paradisus!
reviews.text:
We stayed in Paradisus for our 5th time, opting for the reserve for our 3rd time. This is indeed paradise and the maintenance and upkeep of the facility is impeccable. It's big, beautiful, and filled with people that work hard to make your trip the absolute best. The scenery and beach are gorgeous and a big part of why we keep coming back. 

Having been here before, we were delighted to see that some of our friends from before 2020 continue working here, including Cesar, Julio and Oscar. They're all so fun and friendly and will go out of their way to make your day! We also met Luis, Yamil, and Javier (my apologies if I'm forgetting anyone!) who were all amazing. Luis, Cesar and Julio are EVERYWHERE and work very hard, but with wonderful smiles on their faces the entire time. We couldn't be happier to see them and their enthusiasm and warmth is infectious. 

We also have the pleasure of having met Hugo who manages Lemon Fish. Again, one of the nicest and hardest working people at the resort. Lemon Fish is incredible. Make sure you visit and take time to enjoy the amazing food, atmosphere, wine, and service. There's nothing else like it. Splurge and buy a bottle or upgrade a meal if you can. You simply will not regret it. 

We also took advantage of the activities and dance troupe. We did yoga two days, aqua gym two days (much more fun than it sounds), and the 3:00 dance lessons EVERY day! What could be more fun that learning to dance in the amazing Mexican sun after a couple of tequilas with fun, friendly and amazingly skilled dancers. I know most people want to lay around all day and drink, but get up and dance! It's so fun!!! Jesus was the leader (and the others didn't have name tags but were amazing!), but the rest of the troupe was so fun and so encouraging, even though I could barely get through many of the routines. So glad I tried and am still working on my moves back in Pennsylvania! They're great dancers and just very beautiful people in so many ways. 

The only thing I may say has lagged is the concierge service. This used to be very involved and very helpful. We've seen this drop off dramatically in the last couple of years with the concierge checking in once a day instead of being available more often. Disappointing if you want dinner, Bali bed, or other requests.. you're left guessing. And, in fact, one of our dinner reservations was even screwed up (the manager of Sal saved the day, however!). This may have to do with the concierge to which you're assigned, but I'll say the last two weren't great. We had Violetta three years and she was phenomenal. Since then... eh, ok. 

In summary, we love this place. It was our home away from home and it's indescribable how amazing it is to see our friends every year and how devastating it is to leave each time. We not only feel like guests, yet as friends and as part of the family. We simply cannot wait to return.

reviews.author: Diana P
reviews.title: Horrible experience, stay away
reviews.text: Came for bday trip. Spent 4 hours in line to check in. 1st I was told the room was not ready. Then we were assigned a room overlooking industrial Ac that was very noisy. The manager refused to change the room. We asked to change a room and a new room magically appeared. The new room was moldy. The front-desk refused to issue a refund. Stay away, they lack basic customer svc skills and will ruin your vacation.

reviews.author: Bob T
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Cecilla and Pedro at the sports bar are amazing! So fun, kind, friendly and welcoming! The staff are fun! Food is good! But mainly the sports bar staff added to the greatness of our trip! So Nice! The service at the beach was also great! Pool bar was amazing service too! Top notch place to stay!

reviews.author: macie h
reviews.title: Joel waiter at the reserve pool
reviews.text: Joel is one of the most kind waiters in the reserve. Every day he went above and beyond our expectations to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. If I were to come back I would definitely request joel again. He’s the best. This trip was amazing thanks to joel. He was personable and professional all at the same time.

reviews.author: Nikki B
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience!
reviews.text:
My friend and I had a 9 day stay and were treated like queens.  Food was amazing, the room was comfortable, the activities were fun!  Lots of great areas to relax. Loved the decor and the relaxed boho vibe.  Shout out to Orlando, Jhony Jimenez, Manuel Delezma and Pascual Gavdencio Ivonn.  They made our morning breakfasts something special and memorable.   

Didi and Victor took special care of us everyday at the poolside.  I would definitely come back to stay!

reviews.author: H4969YVcherylp
reviews.title: Overall pretty good
reviews.text:
I am actually here now- party of nine …2 families -property is  very nice the regular rooms are pretty tight and small only one sink in the bathroom— You have to close one door to use another type of small… Service is very nice food is just OK …my main complaint is dinner reservations…when you have a party of nine it seems they can never fit you in anywhere except this place called the “lunchbox”  which is basically burgers outside -even my concierge could not get me better dinner reservations- my husband goes down every morning waits 45 minutes and still is told the same thing -“nothing available for a party of nine except for the lunch box OR a restaurant at 9 PM which means we miss the show and we don’t like to eat that  late… …that’s very disappointing… 
Bartenders at the sports lounge are so nice and great… They do need more bars and lounges not just sports bar and ginger for such a HUGE property

reviews.author: Wanderer68625947461
reviews.title: Beautiful and Great Service
reviews.text: The hotel is amazing, beautiful. A lot of great restaurants and options. Rooms need some work, shower leaked and patio door would get stuck. The bartender on the reserve side Julio - he is a gem, great bartender he made our day everyday with his friendliness and service. We did the reserve package, unfortunately we missed out on the reserve check-in maybe because we arrived late and we got the wrong room... the lady checking us in should of seen we booked reserve. Our concierge Diego we met the next morning he was amazing! such a nice guy and booked all our dinners for the week, and made my birthday week very special. I had wine and strawberries sent to the room, balloons in the room. The reserve side is very nice, quiet, good service they could use some music by the pool and make it a little more livelier as its adults only. the other side seems fun with the entertainment. I would suggest staying there - its a beautiful hotel and great location.

reviews.author: PD C
reviews.title: Beautiful in Paradise
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely beautiful. It is peaceful serene, private in your room. The beach is great, a little aggressive but we think it was because of the season. The pools are outstanding, and so are the amazing bartenders.

reviews.author: Inspire22305042542
reviews.title: Malva Buffet- Breakfast
reviews.text:
Food selection is excellent!  

Our 2 servers, Atilano and Manuel Martinez were a pleasure to meet.  They were so welcoming and fun to talk to.  We had met Atilano on previous trips and always looked forward to seeing how he and his family were doing.  We look forward to returning!

reviews.author: DEBORAH C
reviews.title: Was ok for price
reviews.text: The resort is nice and the beach was beautiful  . The buffet was ok for breakfast , The only specialty restaurant we liked was the Lemon fish went there 3 nights . Issues we observed there were not enough lounge chairs by pool and quite a few of the palapas on the beach didn't have lounge chairs . You need to get up at the crack of dawn to get a towel and reserve a lounge . The lobby bar is set up poorly they need to remove the bali beds and add more table and chairs . The resort was ok  for the price we paid . How ever we paid a reduced rate because we did an exchange on our time share . A friend of mine was looking to join us and the prices she was finding on line $2500 a week per person I feel was way out of line for what you get here

reviews.author: Jason L
reviews.title: Average/Below Average for the price… but with some positives.
reviews.text: The kids club was incredible, extremely friendly and engaging staff. They really went above and beyond with the kids (and it was free for the kids to attend). Cant say enough good things about the staff at the kids club, they were special. Other than that - standard amenities for a resort at this price range, nothing special. I considered the food to be below average though. However, the service was excellent, staff were all great, really attentive and nice.

reviews.author: Karyn H
reviews.title: Tequila tasting at Paradisus
reviews.text: We did tequila tasting with Gustavo at Paradisus . He was so knowledgeable about all the types of tequila and made the experience so fun . I highly recommend this for someone that wants to learn about different types of tequila and what to look for . The venue was perfect and so fun ! Highly recommend !!!!

reviews.author: Lisa B
reviews.title: Fabulous week at Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent last week at the Paradisus Cancun resort and LOVED it! We are longtime Melia vacation club members and this past week did not disappoint. Our concierge, Raul and another fabulous person there-Jose, provided incredible help and expertise during the week. 
I would wholeheartedly recommend this amazing resort in Cancun to anyone!!

reviews.author: Relax382594
reviews.title: 5-star and total WOW! When can we go back?!
reviews.text: All we can say is WOW. From the minute we stepped in the property we were impressed with every aspect of this trip - the gorgeous surroundings, the attentive and friendly staff, the delicious food, the awesome excursions, the gorgeous room with sunrise/ocean view … and so much more. Here’s what we’d recommend: Upgrade to Reserve - it was worth it!!! Get an ocean view!!! We watched the sunrise from our bed!! Meet with you concierge right away. He scheduled all our meals, got our palapas (cabana) reserved and checked in throughout our entire stay. It was my son’s 18th birthday and he even decorated the room himself so the balloons and desserts!!! Diego - you made our trip! Next - head to the aqua world stand and go see Julian!!! We signed up for three excursions - jungle Tour, Aqua twister and parasailing. Each was incredible and worth the extra cost. The twister was our favorite. We were the only ones on the boat and they even let my son drive since he has his boaters license. So. Much. Fun. We even sprung for the pictures that they took since they were so funny. Next head to the restaurants - they were all amazing. Don’t forget to make reservations on the first day. My son is a vegetarian and there were always options. They were so accommodating and always asked if there were food allergies or restrictions. The sing to my son every night - it never got old! Shout out to Caesar at Lemon Fish - you rock!  Order as much as you want. Explore every type of food since it’s all delicious!!!!! Next off to the pool - The Reserve Pool Manager Diego made the most positive experience. Jennifer was our palapa queen! The tram was always quick with food and drinks. Even brought us sunscreen when we started to fry in the Cancún sun. Don’t worry about seaweed here - they clean the beach each morning. So impressive. We also did yoga at 8:30 am - Veronica knew how to cater to all the levels - plus the view was incredible. And Maribel set us up and took amazing pictures of us while doing our yoga moves!! I’m 50 and my son is 18 and brought his friend. We all had a blast and enjoyed the shows, Silent Disco, DJ vibes with Angel, karaoke and more. We made so many friends. I’d highly recommend this Hotel but don’t forget to upgrade to reserve!!!

reviews.author: Blair C
reviews.title: When eating at the buffet, Martin KuCan and David where exceptional!
reviews.text: Great times! We stayed 7 nights and had a great time! Service was fantastic and food was terrific. The Italian was really good and the buffet had everything you could ask for! Premium liquor and cold beer are always plentiful!

reviews.author: Giselle C
reviews.title: Wonderful service
reviews.text: We love Paradisus. We have been coming here for almost 25 years and it never disappoints. They have top notch security, accommodating staff and great amenities. We love the swim up bar and ocean front property. The sand is so soft and water clear. We can’t wait to come back. Special thanks to Balta at the pool bar for such excellent service!

reviews.author: Janill E
reviews.title: Best experience!!!
reviews.text: We stayed in the reserve part which was the adults only part. The hotel and room was beautiful. The cleaning staff did a great job. The buffet and restaurants were all delicious. Our favorite was el Ceilo (Mexican cuisine). Jose (server) and David (chef) was very attentive. They recommended the dishes that were Amazing! Our dedicated Concierge George was extremely helpful. He took us directly to our rooms and explained all the features of the hotel. He also made all our reservations for the restaurant and cabana by the beach. The cabana attendant Jennifer was so friendly and nice. She was also able to get us a cabana overlooking the beach. The reserve area has a lounge with premium liquor and tasty snacks. Yami our server at the Cabana and at the Sante restaurant was extremely attentive and always with a smile on his face. He gave us great service. We had a great time and definitely will come back!

reviews.author: JamesRAttwood
reviews.title: Little piece of paradise
reviews.text:
This was my first time at an all inclusive and Paradisus set the bar extremely high.  Beautiful resort.  Clean, good food, friendly staff, and great amenities.  Shout out to Karina, Salvador, and Luis.  I always find reviews important in deciding on where to stay, so I'll provide the highlights of what made Paradisus so amazing:

1. The staff.  Everyone is friendly and helpful.  There were quite a few people who went over and above.  If you're looking for anything related to the poolside experience, look for Juan at the staff station.  He went over and above for us on a number of occasions.  Very good at his job.  He remembers your name, which may not seem like much, but it's the little details that make you feel welcome.  Karina who worked at the Kanna Bar is an exceptional waitress.  She'll remember your names and drink order.  Which kept us coming back.  Salvador who worked the Kanna Bar as a bartender was also amazing.  Very warm and friendly.  Always took the time to stop and chat with us.  These are the kind of people who help make an all inclusive experience something special and deserve special recognition from their employers.
2. The Facilities.  The resort is absolutely gorgeous.  Huge pools, lots of seating, upgrade options for private cabanas ($50 per day, which includes wait staff or $250 per day with champagne and upgraded sea food options).  We treated ourselves to the private cabana twice and it was worth every penny.  You'll find that the beach chairs at the poolside fill up fast and early!  We learned quickly that you had to be up around 7am in order to secure good chairs.  If you don't, then you'll wander the poolside and see that every chair has been taken up with people's stuff.  If you can't find poolside seating, then you can head down to the beach where there are a number of shaded spots as well.  
Everything is clean and well maintained.  The layout of the resort can be a little confusing at first, but take the time to explore and you'll have it memorized in no time.
3. The room.  We stayed in a Junior Suite with the ocean view.  It's a decent sized room with a nice bathroom and private balcony.  I'm glad that I upgraded to the ocean view because it's a stunning vista to wake up to.  It has a mini fridge that has four bottles of water, a couple cans of coke, sprite, diet coke, Dos Equis, and some other assorted beers.  The refilling of the mini fridge was a little hit and miss.  Some days it was refilled and others it wasn't.

reviews.author: Nelson D
reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: The concierge there are terrible lack of information about what activities was available and what was available for my three year old daughter to do I have stayed in serveral Meliá resorts this is by far the worst I doubt I come back to this resort

reviews.author: Jacquilee9
reviews.title: Wonderful Couples Trip
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived we were greeted with kindness and helpfulness. Our concierge was Violeta. She took care of everything for us for the entire week from dinner reservations and the spa to our pool cabanas. She truly made this trip so special for us with extra touches. We will definitely be back to The Reserve at Paradisus.

reviews.author: wrdfixer
reviews.title: Our Third Time Here
reviews.text:
We vacationed at the Paradisus Cancun twice before (pre pandemic),  and were delighted to have the chance to return and spend 2 full weeks.  We stayed in an oceanfront suite  at “The Level,”.  ( formerly known as The Reserve),. During all our visits, the service was excellent. The concierge service provided by Ruth and Violetta was great. They made our dinner reservations and successfully attended to anything we needed. The pool directors Nicole and Jennifer provided wonderful service by reserving the same cabana and lounge chairs for us for the duration of our stay. The poolside restaurant and beverage service provided by Cesar, Joel, Valeria and Oscar was top notch. We barely needed to ask for cold drinks or extra ice and both were readily available.
The best part of staying at this hotel is that all the restaurants are resort casual. Ladies can dine anywhere in nice shorts and a tee and gentlemen can dine anywhere in nice shorts and a collared shirt. No need for fancy  loathing which for us is preferable. There are choices for dining. Our two favorite restaurants were Lemonfish  where the cuisine is Asian fusion. Stop at the bar before dinner no matter where you’re dining and meet Randy, likely the best bartender in Cancun who is personable and highly skilled at his craft.   When we ate there, we were served by Daniel, a most attentive waiter who guided us through the menu with great suggestions. Our other favorite was the Italian restaurant Capella, where our waiter Javier impressed us with his “savior faire” and made us feel like we were dining in a 5 star Michelin restaurant. His knowledge of the menu and the quality of his service was impeccable. The chef Arturo is to be commended for a variety of selections that could please anyone. 
During our previous visits there was a Brazilian steak house and Mole(a Mexican restaurant), that were both terrific. They have been replaced by a steak restaurant San, and a Mexican restaurant Cilento.  San is at best mediocre and in our opinion the Mexican restaurant was awful. The buffet has some nice selections and the food was fresh and plentiful.We were disappointed that the original steakhouse was gone. The Aquamarina  restaurant was scenic serving mostly seafood and was also mediocre. In all the restaurants except the buffet, there were menu selections that incurred an extra charge. I found this a bit surprising because nowhere in the description of the resort was this mentioned. During our previous visits this was not the case. It would be interesting to know if this is true at other all inclusive resorts in Cancun. If you choose to come to here, tip generously and frequently. The staff is hard working. They deserve and appreciate when guests acknowledge their efforts. The weather was glorious and overall we have had a lovely experience here,

reviews.author: Christy C
reviews.title: Beach service from Alfredo alvaro
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing. Alfredo alvaro was the absolute best!!! I will come back just for him. He was very attentive and made it an experience for us. It was our first time in Cancun! 
David the bell boy was also very helpful.

reviews.author: Dcole1731
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: The week was amazing!  The staff was outstanding!  Elliot, Flor, Ada, Gus and all the activities coordinators went above and beyond!!  I would recommend to anyone.  The service was the BEST.  The team at Paradisus Cancun took care of everyone with extra TLC.

reviews.author: ig0rs72
reviews.title: Great place - Excellent Staff
reviews.text: Wonderful resort. Especially staff! We were on short vacation and Paradisus offered us all all we needed to enjoy our time off. In restaurants we visited food was very well prepared with appealing presentation and full of flavours. For both of us, Paradisus was a happy place. We certainly return and recommend for other travelers.

reviews.author: KB3313
reviews.title: Nice, but restaurants need to be more accessible
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun gets a 4/5 for me! I love the resort, scenery, and location. It is truly a beautiful resort. The staff is kind and extremely accommodating. Everything was as described. I truly have no complaints. Upon arrival, we were greeted and immediately taken to check-in. They were punctual and check-in took less than 15 minutes. The room was ready early so we were able to be taken straight up to our room.  What I will say is, the restaurants at this resort must become more accessible.  The first day we arrived, you needed a reservation to eat at all of the restaurants offered. We had just arrived and there is no way to set a reservation before arriving, so we were stuck eating the buffet food which In all honesty is not that good. Not only that but by the time we checked in all of the reservations for the next day were  gone as well. I didn’t want the buffet food so we went to a restaurant near the hotel. Wednesday was the only day we were able to get a reservation and we left on Thursday. To be able to book an all inclusive is a luxury, everything included should be accessible to customers and I definitely should not have to eat anywhere outside of the all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: OnAir34860268549
reviews.title: Love This Restaurant!
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite restuarants in the Paradisus.  Food is always great, atmosphere is fun and the staff (Jorge, hugo and Angel to name a few) was attentive/helpful.  Overall excellent experience.

reviews.author: Sandie T
reviews.title: Gone downhill
reviews.text:
I have come to the paradisus cancun since it was called the gran melia, about 8-10 trips here. This was the worst experience.

-There was a day my room wasn't cleaned and it was 5pm and I had to call and ask for towels at least so I could shower. 
-there was no concierge and I could never find anyone to help me with questions. I tried to go to the front desk several times and the line was so long that I'd wait for 15 minutes and just leave. Finally someone asked my father in law how the trip was going and he said not good and to contact me. That was the only way I could get any assistance for my questions. She tried to tell me someone named Victor was assigned to me, I never heard from Victor, don't even know who he is. If it is Tuesday afternoon and I don't know who my concierge or helper is, then that's a huge problem. 
-I couldn't get any reservations. It's ridiculous that I pay so much money and can't eat where I want to eat. This was a huge reason why the stay was so negative. I ended up having to walk up to places and beg for a reservation so we didn't eat at the buffet.
One day (3/7) I waited at the reservation desk starting at 840 (opens at 9am) in an attempt to be the first to get any dinner reservations and nobody showed up until 9:20. The line behind me was about 20 people. Everytime an employee walked by id ask where the people at the desk are and they'd pretend to text and then kind of walk away slowly and just not help at all. 
The buffet was closed on night (3/9) for dinner. Just a sign saying it was closed with no advanced notice. There were many people of course that couldn't make reservations anywhere so there was a huge line at the taco place (the only other place that doesn't require reservations) 
-my husband wanted to try the morning mediation at 830 on 3/9. He went up at 820 and was told it was full. The woman was not friendly and did not tell him if there was a sign up or how to try to get in the class next time. Again, we pay a lot of money and can't do anything we want.

The resort itself is gorgeous, stunning,  if food or activities or getting help of any kind isn't important to you, then this is your place!

reviews.author: mindstaterev
reviews.title: Great food, excellent service
reviews.text: Had an absolutely lovely dinner at Lemon Fish. The ceviche was fresh (green marinade terrific), sushi and negiri great, and picanha delicious. Best of all were Miguel and Jorge who made the experience fun and comfortable. Will come back for the food but also so say hello to the guys anytime.

reviews.author: Geoff D
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: We had a great 4 day, 3 night stay February 2023.  We did the Reserve package and our concierge George was excellent in making sure we had dinner reservations each night and that we got cabana access.  He went above and beyond to make sure to set up our room quite nicely as we were celebrating an anniversary as well.  The hotel is quite large and well kept, and the staff, drinks and food were all much better than the other 2 other all-inclusive resorts we have stayed at.  We are already to plan for the next time we come back!

reviews.author: Lillian W
reviews.title: Beautiful time at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Such a beautiful resort! Every single staff member was helpful and pleasant. The food good and plentiful. We enjoyed the flexibility of the buffet Malva and friendly service from Atilano, Janeth and Martin.

If you would like to try the other restaurants at dinner time be sure to reserve in advance.

reviews.author: BC_Explorer_MT
reviews.title: Great Stay - The Reserve is Worth the Upgrade!
reviews.text:
Just came back from a 6 night stay. When we arrived we asked about upgrading to the Reserve. They were full the first two nights but were able to accommodate us the last four nights. Definitely worth it! 

Started our stay in tower 1, which is a ways from the main lobby. If you want to be close to everything, ask for tower 3 or 4. First room was a bit older but clean and quiet. 

When we upgraded, we were put in a room that faced the street. There was a 24/7 nightclub across the street that had base going all night - avoid if you’re a light sleeper like me! Staff were able to accommodate a room change the next night and we moved to a much nicer (and quieter) room.

The Reserve is 100% worth it. Eliu made us all our dinner reservations and helped us book a cabana. The reception area with the snacks and top shelf bar was also great. 

Food overall was amazing. We had breakfast and lunch at Sante off of the Reserve pool which was great. Lemon Fish and Sal Steakhouse were our favourite meals. 

Loved the silent disco on Saturday night! We had so much fun. They had a band play on the pool deck on Monday which was also entertaining.

The service is definitely what makes this hotel a 5-star. The employees care about their guests and it shows. 

We will be back!

reviews.author: Daniel F
reviews.title: Poor service, poor food, OK facilities
reviews.text:
Firstly the positives: the staff are very friendly, the view from the pool overlooking the beach is nice, and the a la carte steak restaurant is very nice.

Sadly that is where the positives end, we had a number of issues during our stay which forced us to leave early, and the handling of our complaints both at the hotel and after the fact with Melia customer service were incredibly disappointing, in fact they refuse to even acknowledge that the service provided was poor. The negative points are as follows:

- the concierge himself was incredibly friendly and helpful, however, presumably due to expectations placed on them by hotel management, was incredibly pushy to attend a sales pitch for their private membership/timeshare program. Even after explaining we weren't interested we were still pushed multiple times per day, even being approached more than once when simply trying to relax by the pool

- the food quality in the buffet restaurant is poor. We have stayed at a number of other Melia resorts in Europe and the food quality here is substantially lower

- aggressive sales tactics for other services such as scuba diving/jet skis etc

- a number of leaking ceilings throughout the hotel and one particularly horrendous smell coming from a storage cupboard that we had to walk past every day to get to the restaurant

Certainly not value for money in the slightest, avoid at all costs.

reviews.author: Mariam H
reviews.title: An amazing birthday week
reviews.text:
We visited to celebrate my 30th birthday 🥳 Had an amazing, unforgettable time. Staff was really nice and hard-working, rooms were clean, we loved the pool area. 
The hotel has an amazing kids’ club Kidsdom that accommodates kids between 1-4 years old and 5-10 years old. My kids (7 and 2 years old) had the most wonderful and fun time there. Staff is absolutely great with kids, they entertain them and they have different activities every day. I would like to give special thanks to Itzel and Axcel at Kidsdom, they are awesome!! Always smiling and super energetic, very responsible and kind! My kids loved them and I felt safe leaving them in their care. Thank you guys ❤️

reviews.author: drcarter
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text:
Hotel was amazing, as were the people working there.  Steak house is great, Sante restuarant is great.  Upgrade when you get there to The Reserve portion of the hotel.  Our waiters Sofonia, Pedro and Daniel were the best at Bar Ginger.  Would stay here again.  Alberto at check in was fantastic, very helpful.

If i had to give a negative it would be the check in process, it took forever and do not use the Aquaworld for a booze cruise, not a great experience with them.

reviews.author: thegdr
reviews.title: Good all inclusive hotel
reviews.text: My overall experience was very good.  Only negatives were the concierge that didn't reply to me for days at a time and cabanas that were always booked.  I wish they would remove towels on chairs if left for 30 minutes. Getting up early to save chairs is a pain.  Lots of good restaurants / bars.  Very good service.  Room was nice and always clean.  Resort was very beautiful.

reviews.author: Navigate64013059965
reviews.title: Best bartenders at Paradisus
reviews.text: This review is strictly to give Salvatore and Katrina at the Kanna Beach Bar a  shout out! They were the kindest, nicest bartenders we met our entire trip. Salvatore remembered us and always knew what we wanted to order before we even ordered it. He even threw in fist bumps to greet us. They had fun even when the bar was packed full and always played great music. Their service was prompt and quick. I never had an empty drink for long. I would come back to the resort just to see Salvatore at the bar.

reviews.author: Christopher A
reviews.title: Resort activities HIGHLIGHT - Wine and Canvas (Tabs and Gustavo are the best)
reviews.text:
I am currently still staying at Paradisus but I had to jump on here and write a raving review about one of the many amazing resort activities available for guests. 

Yesterday three friends and I were able to enjoy the Wine and Canvas event led by GUSTAVO and TABS. The staff were incredibly hospitable, professional, attentive and friendly. 

What more could you want than painting on canvas while drinking wine and being served appetizers with a beautiful beach view? I loved the activity and the amazing service/help from TABS and GUSTAVO made it even better. There are so many other events available but the Wine and Canvas event was the most memorable and I hope they host more of these for guests to enjoy.

reviews.author: jmarion93
reviews.title: Only OK for the money
reviews.text: Since it was not the least expensive, we expected a more luxury experience.  Staff all very nice and accommodating.  Top shelf liquor included.  Was not able to book a specialty restaurant our entire trip.  All beach chairs reserved before 9am.  Bars and restaurant service seemed very slow.  It was a "nice" experience, but would try other options next time.

reviews.title: Amazing Stay!
reviews.text: I came with two friends and our stay was amazing. The entire resort is so nice, the food is amazing and the staff go above and beyond. Gustavo & Maribelle were so kind and helpful  leading activities which included beach volleyball, wine & paint, and silent disco! Definitely would come again, there are families, couples, singles and groups of friends- it seems to be a great place no matter what your vibe is!

reviews.author: Justin F
reviews.title: Incredible vacations
reviews.text: Gaby , Balthazar and cauich by the pool bar. These guys are incredible. They made our best vacations and I want to tell to their boss they are the best waitress. We hope to came Back and see them again. Thanks for everything

reviews.author: Kai L
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text:
During my stay at Paradisus , Cancún, I had an exceptional time ! From the ambiance, to how clean the resort was and how GOOD is smelled ! 

The customer service at Malva has to be my favorite ! Janeth and Atiliano?!!!! AMAZING !!! From the day my friend and I sat at the restaurant, we requested them as our servers each and everytime. The attentiveness and friendliness was unmatched !

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.title: Great atmosphere!
reviews.text: Great atmosphere. Friendly staff, food was pretty good! Fun activities, nice amenities. Clean facilities good amount of pools and seat options at pools and at the beach. I would recommend this option for families or people looking for a lively atmosphere. The reserve side was also worth the money

reviews.author: Travis W
reviews.title: Not worth it for the cost
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed for 4 nights. We had 2 rooms. The first room reeked of sewage and when the cleaning lady came in she knew right away. We watched her go right to the shower drain, spray a solution down it, and walk out. After a days long battle with the front desk we were able to get a new room. The food was sub par for an all inclusive. There is no kids pool, it's literally just a shallow pool tucked on the far end of the resort. The Kidsdom staff were extremely nice and helpful. The hospitality staff at the front desk was extremely sub par. No one would take accountability for anything and they all passed the buck on to other colleagues, making the guest wait longer and longer, hoping we'd just drop whatever the issue was and move on. 

The price we paid for the all inclusive aspect was not worth it. Our two best meals came at off site restaurants.

There are much better family friendly options with exceptional customer service up north in Playa Mujeres or further south than the hotel zone.

reviews.author: Chavely V.
reviews.title: Excellent!!
reviews.text: We booked for 4 days all inclusive in the Nikte suite. Our experience was excellent! The staff was always very professional and helpful. Our concierge, George (Djordje Topalovic), went above and beyond to make our stay a complete five star experience and we highly recommend him for future visits as he is very professional and truly wishes for his guests to have the best time. Also, when you go to tower 5 visit Julio as he makes the best maracuya margaritas and any other drink that you would like. Overall, we had an extremely positive experience and will definitely be going back.

reviews.author: Dee R
reviews.title: The reserve is worth it and you HAVE to visit Cecelia at Ginger Bar
reviews.text: 100% recommend the Reserve area to stay in if possible! Julio, the bartender in the reserve lounge, is a treasure and makes a mean espresso martini!! Our concierge Seline always had our backs and booked us the best reservations (Lemon Fish, Agua Verde and Santé were our faves) and had such a quick response time to help with any questions we had. And the shining star of the hotel was Cecelia, the mixologist in the Ginger Bar, who made such lovely and refreshing drinks (with and without alcohol) and the ambiance of the bar is so chill and a nice place to rest your feet and watch the waves.

reviews.author: twofirstnames
reviews.title: Good, and Could Be Great
reviews.text:
Overall, a wonderful vacation. Love the cenote-like interior courtyards, the views, and the people.

They changed policies about Reserve between our booking and arrival. This was not communicated to us at all. Reservation could not be viewed in their system. Got a room in the building farthest from where we reserved. Travelled with friends whose room had a water leak that was "fixed" but in the middle of the night room flooded and ceiling started flaking off. After this we all got moved to the correct building. Things were much better after the move.

Food ranged from decent to excellent. Especially like Capella (Italian) and Lemon Fish (sushi). Great margaritas everywhere. Table wines were okay. Lunch at Aqua Marina was delightful (but the men's restrooms stink--missing hardware in the urinal drains and no deodorizers.) Sal could use some improvement.

Not quite enough chairs at pool or beach but there is room for a few more. Bali beds are confusing. We (in Reserve) were told they were included but not told that some were extra charge ($250 and up). They all look the same. Those with extra charge should look different--be much nicer. Different color mattresses and roofs, and maybe decorations of the poles. Should also be roped off with velvet ropes or similar. But no matter where you were, the scenery is BEAUTIFUL.

Also appreciated how clean the windows were. They looked great every day. Things throughout the resort were generally in good repair and up to date. Used the gym every day. Equipment in fairly good condition. AC could be a couple degrees cooler.

Virtually everyone on the staff was wonderful, warm, and charming. Terrific. Especially liked the servers at Sante.

This was our first Melia experience. Liked it. Will certainly consider Melia in the future. Would love to come back to this resort but with kids not allowed in the Reserve experience, not sure we will.

reviews.author: Myiesha B
reviews.title: The most amazing birthday trip.
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of staying For a week in paradise, literally!!! Our concierge, Selene, did an amazing job making our time and my sister’s birthday special!!!!! The hotel was beautiful. The view was spectacular. Special shout out to Sal, steakhouse the best meal we had. All of the staff are super sweet and helpful. Worth it!

reviews.author: Agnes K
reviews.title: Absolutely best
reviews.text:
Gabby, Balta and Cauych by the pool were absolutely amazing ! This is our second time here … and the crew never disappointed ! Always smiling and ready to help ! 
Wish there were more people like this ! 
Definitely recommend this place ! Ask for Gabi and she will make your stay remarkable !

reviews.author: Steve K
reviews.title: Gustavo from Kidsdom was awesome with my kids
reviews.text:
This hotel is pretty cool, and we go all the time.  This time however, a cool guy by the name of Gustavo from the “Kidsdom” area shined as the best!  He made my kids feel so welcomed and was always fun to be around.  That said, he was also part of a pretty great team at the Kidsdom area.  
Our kids a little older now, and I’ve been coming to this resort for about 10 years and have seen the kids evolving to what I think is the best its ever been.  If you have kids and want them to have some independent time playing and doing some fun activities, I recommend Gustavo and the great team he’s part of at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Chip W
reviews.title: Amazing Spring Break 2023
reviews.text: Outstanding clean resort. Restaurant food was great, with amazing activities and fun night life. Our concierge, George, was invaluable. He was extremely friendly, and did an AMAZING job scheduling our reservations. We will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: 14th Stay at Paradisus Cancun - Always a Fun Experience
reviews.text:
This was our 14th stay at this resort and we will be returning next year.  The staff at Paradisus have always been professional and courteous whenever any kind of problem has arisen.  This year the A/C in our bedroom wasn’t working correctly when we arrived.  Someone was sent right after we called and the issue was resolved without delay.  

I would also give a shout-out to our Concierge, Raul.  Raul made us feel welcomed, made dinner reservations at local restaurants and was helpful navigating certain activities we partook in.  Raul certainly made the stay nicer.

Since timeshare owners have the choice of taking the all-inclusive option or not we always opt out because we enjoy dining at local restaurants around Cancun.  However, we had a nice lobster tail and seafood lunch at one of the day beds after participating in a presentation for their new vacation club, The Circle.  The Circle didn’t seem like a good option for us and we didn’t buy a membership Frankly, we didn’t care for the hard sell tactics of their sales manager, Ricardo.  That’s not the reason we didn’t join, but it didn’t make the experience pleasant either.  

This year it became apparent that Paradisus was making an extra effort to make their guests more comfortable.  It’s obvious that the entire area is getting back to normal after the year of the COVID lockdown.  Last year the staff was inexperienced and a bit confused.  This year they’re back to the professionalism we’ve always experienced from them before.  

The only thing I would like to see improved is the WiFi which was very spotty in our room. It certainly isn’t a big problem because we’re on vacation.  But I like reading the news and keeping up with sports.  The spotty WiFi made that frustrating at times.  

Still, we’re looking forward to returning next year.  Sitting on the beautiful beach under a palapa and soaking up the sun at Paradisus every year just makes our lives that much nicer.

reviews.author: Dana L
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael was awesome! Such great service and recommendations. The drinks were great and fast (and flowing!) the food was great too and probably best we had during our trip. Would highly recommend especially if Rafael is taking care of you!!

reviews.author: Kiersten B
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael was great! He educated us thoroughly on the menu. He made sure we knew exactly what we were ordering d and even showed us pictures of items we unsure. Additionally, he was super personable and gave excellent service!

reviews.author: ahsan a
reviews.title: Capela restaurant
reviews.text: Chef Arturo is really good. Very delicious food and Carlos from Capela restaurant  is very helpful and their food is 10/10. You should look for chef arturo and ask him to make any food you would like.

reviews.author: Dylan P
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text: Drinks were delicious, sushi was fresh and the service was amazing!  We were served by Miguel and Jorge, they were super quick and went above and beyond to make sure our dinner was great. Would eat here again!

reviews.author: Mary S
reviews.title: Quick Mon-Fri get away to escape the cold at home.
reviews.text:
Paradisus Pros/Cons

Pros
-Room key on the wrist/very easy
-Clean hotel
-Service/workers mostly nice/attentive
-Not much seaweed on the beach
-Big pools never felt crowded
-balcony with lounge chairs 
-canned beer instead of draft beer
-good beach/pool chairs
-quiet/easy to sleep 
-not a party hotel
-approx 25 min from the airport
-escape room was good. **extra charge

Cons
-Get pool towels have to go to a stand that is manned by the excursion guys. You get hit up to do an excursion every time you get a towel. 
-No butter/salt/pepper/spoons/salad dressing always have to ask
-Do not change out room towels each day and will take dirty ones but not always replace with new. 
-Lacking in the nightly entertainment department (depends on what you are looking for) 
-$250 for a cabana (includes lobster and other food) 
-Food was very average
-As with most hotels in Mexico very few electric plugs in the room
-Air conditioning kept shutting off at night
-didn’t sweep vacuum rooms when sand on the floor
-there wasn’t any daytime pool/beach activities (depends on what you are looking for) 
-not really air conditioned indoors except for your room.

reviews.author: dexter L
reviews.title: Didn't feel like a 5* resort at times for Reserve
reviews.text:
For Families I would avoid this place. A lot of the issues wouldn't necessarily exist if we were just a couple.

Staff was great, however we were given a normal room at first. There was no correction until we were told our wristbands were the wrong type by someone by the pool.

Rooms: Too loud, if you have kids or have trouble sleeping don't go here. We went to 3 rooms, 2 in pyramid 3 and both were really loud. One night the music didnt stop until 3am. The other night it was 1am.

I rated this 4*'s still because aside from noise the stay was mostly great. Having to move rooms 2 times is not a great experience, so it's closer to 3.5 * but the staff was great for me and the family.

Reserve: It includes a dinner at the steak house, but no kids are allowed so unless you have someone to watch the kids you won't be able to go. This is less of a restriction for older kids.

The reserve includes a lot of adults only features, but we used the bali beds which were great  by the kids pool which were usually empty. For the Turn down service for kids nobody knew what we were talking about. So don't expect milk and cookies because it was probably an older service.
Due to the english site having older information annoying to hear about no milk and cookies. I didn't care for the cookies but wanted the milk for my toddler.

George was our Concierge and was able to get us reservations every day after we checked in which was great.

Aquaworld is on there to try to sell you experiences and we did the submarine and jungle tour which was great. However the jungle tour is near the submarine so I would probably recommend a different snorkel location if you did the submarine.

The good. Endless drinks, before dinner 1 shot per drink, 2 at dinner onwards. Food at each restaurant was great. The Italian was the weakest of the bunch because the pizza wasn't that good. But it was still good. Cielo was the best for normal dining. Sal's was great. Don't skip on their mashed potatos.

Having worked at a breakfast buffet I was impressed by their offerings.

Health: Traveling and eating at buffets carry some risk since the tongs are shared between some foods. I had some stomach issues and so do one other person traveling with us. So bring pepto. Food safety seemed great so it could have just been too much alcohol.

reviews.author: matt d
reviews.title: Pretty solid all inclusive experience
reviews.text:
Great stay all around. The hotel is beautiful and a lot of fun. 

We had a private event with 30 people, and Jenn Aguilar did an AMAZING job planning it. We were in great hands from start to finish with her and the food was really solid. She deserves a bonus or raise for how much care she gave to us. 

We also had a ton of help from our concierge Galdi. He helped us make reservations and took great care of us. 

My advice for fellow travelers- the best food IMO is at Lemon Fish and Blue Agave. Make sure to try and go to both spots.

reviews.author: jacquesbens
reviews.title: Diner at Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
We had a great time ! Miguel Jorge was really helpful, kind and professional. Such a pleasure. Thanks a lot! I highly recommand the place and especially this waiter. Thanks to Miguel. 
For sure we will be back soon

reviews.author: CLA2023Chi
reviews.title: Pretty location and family friendly
reviews.text:
We traveled with our 14-year-old  daughter and stayed in a Junior Suite Ocean View (did not participate in Reserve Upgrade) over the President's Day Weekend.

Staff: Great experience at Paradisus.  The staff makes a huge impact on the travel experience and we found them to be happy, friendly, and willing to go out of their way to make us happy.   In particular, Didier and Yvonne at the pool were really nice and attentive. Galindo was our concierge and was extremely helpful in making reservations for dinner and ensuring our stay met our expectations. In particular, Galindo went out of his way to help us secure a backpack left behind after our departure and along with Cristhian in Guest Services worked with a local packing company to safely return my daughter's school-issued IPad back to the States!

Food: The food was good and offered multiple options. We always enjoyed the buffet at Malva the most and of the restaurants requiring reservations the Italian restaurant was outstanding. We read a lot about Lemon Fish however it wasn't our favorite but this is likely due to our food preferences (vegan) which limited what we could order.  Rafael our waiter was great and worked to accommodate us.  

Pools/Ocean: The pools and beach were lovely and not crowded. The ocean could get rough but we were able to spend time in it despite this. Seaweed is present but it is not a negative impact visually, walking or for swimming.  The water is beautiful!  We did make reservations for the covered beds which was a lifesaver for enjoying the outdoors in full sun all day.  Beds by the pool were free but you need a reservation, a bed facing the ocean on the pool deck included a charge.  If you go with getting lounge chairs make sure to claim them by 8:30 as that seemed to be when they would all be claimed, but again the staff will gladly help you find something. 

Hotel Activities: We traveled with my 14-year-old daughter and there wasn't much for her to do at the hotel from an entertainment perspective.  We looked for other kids her age but most were either much younger or much older. This may differ during different times of the year - we were there during President's Day Weekend.  

Rooms:  Be aware that if you stay in pyramid  3, you will be satisfied with the proximity to the hotel amenities but you will also experience the disco and nighttime performance noises from 9 to 11.  We were on the 3rd-floor ocean side and our room thumped from the noise and sleep was difficult on those nights we tried to turn in early.  The hotel was not fully booked and I wish that when we checked in the front desk would have considered this issue. Aside from the noise the room was nice and had been recently renovated. Air conditioning is strong by day but weak by night no matter what setting we put it on. Fortunately, it was cooler at night in February so not a huge issue. We had 2 double beds and a couch that looks like it pulls out. This was an Ocean View Junior Suite.

Excursions: We chose to do our own. We took the red busses from the front of the hotel which comes by at least every 5 minutes for about $1 a person each way. The bus drivers are happy to tell you when it's your stop.  We visited La Isla shopping center (upscale and fun for our teen) one afternoon. We also enjoyed some appetizers at a beautiful Japanese restaurant called Ryoshi at that same mall.  Our second excursion was again utilizing the red busses to get to the Playa Tortuga ferry to Isla Mujeres (about $60 RT). There we rented a golf cart ($65) for the day and used it to tour the island and then we rented a covered bed and ordered food and drinks (about $115 all-in) on the beach. Several clubs and beds were available and the water is stunning. Google Green Demon for location.  

Getting to and from the airport: We used Happy Shuttle and it was fine. The hotel is close to the airport but there is a ton of traffic due to construction and this can increase the wait time for the shuttle. 

Miscellaneous: The dress code is mostly casual. Even at Lemon Fish men were in golf shorts and a polo and women mostly in a sundress - all of us in flip flops. Consider bringing towel clips or bands to help claim your chair by the pool. Bring enough sunscreen to get through Day 1 and walk across the street to purchase sunscreen at the pharmacy or check a bag with some from the states. A typical-sized spray on (Neutrogena if I recall) water-safe sunblock is $41 USD at the hotel! They had cheaper ones in the $20s but we preferred the water safe for obvious reasons and a spray-on due to the sand. 

Overall, we would go back to this hotel primarily because of the staff, amenities, and location and we enjoyed the Hotel Zone area.

reviews.author: reenzyseason
reviews.title: If you can’t get the reserve, don’t go
reviews.text:
I booked through chase travels and didn’t see an option for the reserve. When we checked in, I asked if we could upgrade, but he said there were no reserve rooms available. He still got us a concierge, her name was Teresa. She walked us to our room but really wasn’t too helpful after that. She booked our spa for us and got us a “discounted rate”. 

The rates were always changing. One day it’s $350 for a couples massage, but it we participate in their “discount program” 45 min explanation, it’s $95. We opted out and said we’d rather pay full price than have someone shove a time share down our throats during our vacation. Then the next day for no reason at all, suddenly our massages would be $200 if we did them that day instead of Wednesday like we wanted. We took the seal and honestly the experience was only worth that much. Their spa is very cramped. You get a set ten min in the sauna and ten min in the steam room and then you take two very cold showers before you get in the hot tub…. Which is not very hot. The massages were fine. They provided robes but no slippers, you had to wear your own. 

Now the rest of the resort was horrible. Our room in pyramid one was the WORST looking motel room I’ve ever stayed at in the ten all inclusive resorts I’ve visited in my life. The restroom was small. I just can’t elaborate any more than to say DO NOT STAY IN PYRAMID one. 

The food in the entire resort was DISGUSTING. Almost inedible. We tried all diff types of food and from all diff restaurants. The buffet was very limited in options much less in vegetarian options. Smallest buffet I’ve seen at an all inclusive. We ate at agua marine the first day and couldn’t finish our food the fish was tasteless as was the steak. The lunch box was similar… the chicken sandwich said it came with pickles and ranch but it didn’t. Again the fish was very fishy, not flavorful. The nachos were gross with a cheese sauce that tasted more like butter than cheese. There’s certain restaurants that are reserve only that must be better. Or at least they can’t be worse. We left the resort to eat outside because of how bad it was. We tried to make reservations for our stay within an hour of arrival and most everythjnt was booked. What was left was only available at 5pm or 10pm. Again I think the reserve got preference. 

The pool was always too cold. The drinks were very watered down which was to be expected, and tasted way too sweet like artificial sweetener. 

The elevators are extremely small and almost always being used by staff to transport things as they don’t seem to have a service elevator so we can’t even get on the elevator to go in and out of our room due to that. We took stairs always. 

The only pro about this resort is it’s located on a bus stop so that’s easy. The beach is gorgeous. And that’s about it. 

I’ve been to praradisus Palma real in DR and I can’t believe this piece of ish place is related to that one. Two completely diff worlds.

reviews.author: samueldooman
reviews.title: Food Allergies not taken seriously
reviews.text:
The resort itself was great (awesome pool and drinks, great beach access) and I thought the spa and gym were great as well.

The reason I I'm rating this so badly is for the food services.  I have severe food allergies, and provided that information to every host/server for each restaurant we went to.  And almost every single restaurant put food in front of me that I obviously couldn't eat.  For example, sushi rolls with sesame after I told them I'm allergic to sesame.  

On our last night, we went to Sal (the fancy steak house) and I gave them my full allergy list: peanuts, soy, sesame, and tree nuts. not only did I get immediately served a dish with nuts in the sauce, but later on I actually ate something I was allergic to without knowing, and had to leave dinner early.  We still don't know what actually caused the reaction, so I had to spend 30 mins monitoring whether I would need to be hospitalized.  Not a relaxing last night!!

This was not a language barrier issue; our party had several people fluent in spanish, and this was an issue with every restaurant except for one.

Also, other members of our party with dietary restrictions (vegatarian, etc) had a rough time with some food options.

Basically if you can eat everything, you'll have a great time.  If you can't, be wary!

reviews.author: Alexander
reviews.title: Amazing Resort with amazing Service!
reviews.text:
We frequent this resort a few times a year and what keeps us wanting to go back is the amazing service that they consistently provide.
Ceci our concierge at the Reserve portion of the hotel is incredibly amazing and consistently goes over and beyond to ensure that our stays always exceed our expectations! We have developed a relationship with her and consider her family and that relationship was created as a result of her personable attention from the very first time we met her.
