Diego the restaurant manager at Santo and Moises our waiter continue to exceed our expectations on every visit!
Thank you all!

reviews.author: Lovelace W
reviews.title: Kids activities
reviews.text: Brenda and her crew were all so kind and attentive to our children. We couldn’t thank them enough! Your children are safe with them and enjoy their time! Each day they have different activities for kids

reviews.author: Shaun E
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text:
We were in Cancun for 8 days, staying at the paradisus. There are several very good restaurants, but our favorite was actually Lemon fish! I would not have expected to have the best sushi I’ve ever had, but, I did.

The garlic tuna rolls were my absolute favorite. 

What are final night and visited for a second time and Christian Sanchez give us the best service!  Overall, just wonderful!

reviews.author: Narciso r
reviews.title: Mesero
reviews.text: Alejandro Diaz was great! Everywhere he helped us he immediately recognized us and made us feel at home. His recommendations greatly helped our experience and we are grateful for his help! We hope to be lucky to see him again on our next trip.

reviews.author: Wayne R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Just returned 20 hours ago and wanted to share the experience.  The resort was wonderful.  We stayed for 5 nights and the staff couldn’t have been more helpful.  Our concierge, Valentina, made sure that we had everything that we needed and was even in touch on  her day off to make sure that our dinner reservations were scheduled and at the restaurants we preferred.  Sergio and Jennifer at the pool and beach cabanas made sure that we were comfortable had plenty of food and beverages throughout the day.  Valeria helped us at the pool cabana and that lady is a saint.  She went above and beyond.  Will definitely return!!

reviews.author: Becca H
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Martin and Samuel were exceptional! They always greeted us warmly every time we come in, they made us feel special and was always kind. They were attentive and fast on their feet with our needs. On our last day, they even set up a cute good bye sign with a dessert and champagne for us. We would come back next year just to see our friends at paradisus!

reviews.author: Luis C
reviews.title: BEST HOTEL
reviews.text:
They make you feel like home! Armando at the buffet restaurant managed to take care of myself and my family, very friendly, efficient and always with the smile (even thou he wears a mask) you can tell he is smiling. 

Overall, great place, great food, venue for my sisters wedding was top notch. 

Oh don't forget to try the Japanese restaurant 👌

reviews.author: Sami I
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text:
Paradisus is an awesome resort. Super clean rooms and awesome property. My kids 3 and 7 had a great time at the kids pool and with the kids club who spent 5 hours with the kids daily.

The Malva buffet inside Paradisus has great food options and an even better staff!

reviews.author: John Q
reviews.title: Awesome Hotel/Amazing Service
reviews.text: Everything about the experience was great the moment we get there, until the day we leave. Atilano, Gaudencio from the breakfast buffet and Jorge and Carlos from the Japanese Restaraunt gave us amazing service and treated us like family. Will definitely return. Thank you for hiring great staff like this, and thank you Management for the hotel experience. See you soon.

reviews.author: Donna
reviews.title: Joni Bello and Orlando were the best!
reviews.text: Joni Bello and Orlando were our servers at the buffet. They went up and out of their way to always make sure we had what we needed. They went out of their way to pay attention to the smallest of details like making my husbands coffee just as he liked it. Always with a smile on their faces and delighted to serve the guests of the resort.

reviews.author: Erika Toensing
reviews.title: Erika Toensing
reviews.text: Lemon Fish restaurant was absolutely delicious. The sushi was fresh and so full of flavor. Our waiter Cristian Sanchez was amazing and very nice. He had wonderful recommendations and was on point with every single one.

reviews.author: HappinessS
reviews.title: DISAPPOINTING CELEBRATION FOR MY 30TH
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for this hotel because of the reputation (being part of the Melia hotel chain) and it really disappointed me. 

I was there to spend my 30th birthday which I stated in my notes when booking. Upon check in no consideration was made, they made no efforts to make me feel like it was my birthday. Other hotels of this calibre have done a lot more when I’ve noted a celebration. 

However, this wasn’t the main problem, the main problem is I travelled with my partner and we were given two separate beds. I informed the hotel about this as soon as we were shown our room and was literally told "trust me, I promise we will get this sorted straight away". 

We had just come
off a 12 hour flight so went for dinner , and in this time they said they would have it sorted (i.e. we would be in a new room with one bed). When we spoke to the hotel after no update, we were then told it would be sorted the next day as the hotel was fully booked for that night.

The next day came and I was told that the hotel was fully booked, again. 

The day after that I was shown a room in a lower class (which the hotel admitted after) which had two beds AGAIN!! This was very upsetting as on this night, it meant we were late for our dinner reservation for the Mexican restaurant in the hotel. The hotel concierge was made aware and promised they would let them know at restaurant that we would be late because we had outstanding issues to resolve. However when we arrived at the to dine, the manager and staff had no recollection of this, and it was made quite clear that he was doing us a favour if he were to seat us. We were told the restaurant closed at 11pm but when we got there he said it closed at 10pm (we arrived at approx 9.30pm).  Reluctantly with a bit of back and forth we were seated.

The jacuzzi on the balcony was not clean and dated, so we didn’t even use it. 

Our shower drain was blocked and flooded the bathroom. 

There was also a strong sewage smell coming from the bathroom which made the room smell unpleasant. Concierge were told - they said they would provide maintenance - nothing was done. 

The taco restaurant where we ate for lunch didn’t treat our stomachs well the next day either.

Overall: 

The hotel in itself is very nice however the rooms aren’t anything special. The stay at this hotel really did put a downer on the trip, a sad way to spend a birthday.

reviews.author: SShah
reviews.title: Atilano
reviews.text: Great staff member and excellent waiter! Helped us with food options and special food requests since we are vegetarian. Good service. Very friendly. We ate meals a few times at Malva when he was our waiter.

reviews.author: HeatherJT1979
reviews.title: Overall good trip
reviews.text: The hotel was great, food was good. The Reserve section left a lot to be desired for our family.  We didn't have a great concierge, though. Missed a few dinner reservations, had to ask multiple times for a spa reservation, no cabanas waiting for us. Not really a big problem, but seeing the other butlers come to check on their families by the pool made us feel like we were missing out! The activities people, especially Axcel, were amazing. My kids had such a great time with his activities. And they are teens, so I didn't think it was going to happen! Great trip overall. Maybe not upgrade to the Reserve again, only because we had to make our own appointments and reservations anyway, and still tipped those people. But overall a great resort!

reviews.author: Muji A
reviews.title: Service was excellent.
reviews.text: The hotel was excellent.  The staff was absolutely delightful. Atilano attended to us at every breakfast at Malvo. He took time to understand our preferences and was attentive to our needs. 10/10. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: eniola o
reviews.title: Love Paradisus
reviews.text: Atilano took good care of us during our breakfasts..He’s a good host.always smiling and ready for us. The service was good and would love to come back again.  Would love to come again. Thanks to everyone

reviews.author: Rosanna O
reviews.title: 10 days in paradise
reviews.text:
What an amazing location. The resort and the service didn’t disappoint. From the welcome at reception to the service by the pools and numerous restaurants, we were very well looked after. The staff are friendly, helpful and very efficient. It looks like they take pride in their work.
The room with the stunning ocean view was kept immaculately clean every day and drinks and snacks stocked up too.
The choice of food in the various restaurants means there’s something for all tastes. Highly recommend the sushi in Lemon Fish and the quesadillas in Blueagave.The pizza and pasta wasn’t great in Capella but again service and ambiance was fab.

I didn’t explore the spa offering very much but did have one rejuvenating facial.
This is a picture perfect location and a memorable one to celebrate our postponed from 2020 30th wedding anniversary. I’d highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Tom O
reviews.title: Paradise is Paradisus
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel in a wonderful location .  Staff couldn’t be more helpful and accommodating. My last holiday in Mexico was 32 years ago and the friendliness of the people hasn’t changed.  The quality of food in an all inclusive setting was very impressive.  Plenty of choices to suit most.  Would thoroughly recommend.

reviews.author: Kristina M
reviews.title: Our favorite resort
reviews.text: This was our third time here and we absolutely loved it. They changed up so many things here for the better and it was a great experience! We had a birthday in the family so we arranged a little decor with Premium moments and it came out beautiful. Guandoline was so easy to work with and made everything look amazing. She’s the best for any dinners, dates, surprises or birthdays!

reviews.author: Mima S
reviews.title: Good service from the waitresses
reviews.text: Every time I visit Paradisus I am surprised by the service, but this time I liked Veronica and Liliana the best, always great service and very happy, congratulations for having these two girls. See you girls next year.

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.title: Loved Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text: We spent our spring break with five families, a total of 21 people. Everything about our trip was beautiful! Yesenia took extra special care of us on the beach all week. We all miss her already! Can't wait to return to Paradise!

reviews.author: Mark G
reviews.title: I found the best staff
reviews.text: Orlando with the coffee, aleja in blue agave, and Didier in lunch box. Really appreciated them. Not everyone was helpful but those 3 were incredible. The food was ok and the location was great. Make sure you bring cash to tip people to ensure fast service.

reviews.author: Michelle T
reviews.title: Just a regular chick
reviews.text: Atilano is so friendly. The entire staff of Paradisus are very respectful, welcoming and caring. Their hospitality is second to none. We will definitely be back. Gracias, Atilano! See you next year!!!

reviews.author: Rodolfo G
reviews.title: The return to Paradisus
reviews.text:
Our return to the Paradisus left me asking why we had not returned sooner. The Reserve area of the resort provided exactly what we needed; personalized attention to everything so all we had to do was enjoy the food, drinks, and pools. Galdino was our personal concierge who from day one met us and arranged our luggage be delivered to our room. He made all our restaurant reservations, ensured we enjoyed the pool with the use of a Bali bed on two occasions and made sure if there was anything we needed he was there to help. 

Ruben provided excellent service at the pool, Bali beds, Sante restaurant and even at the Reserve lounge area he just seemed to be everywhere and ready to serve.

The food was great at all the restaurants but my favorite for a quick bite and excellent tacos was Blue Agave. 

Room was perfectly cleaned each day and A/C was cold.

We are definitely not waiting another four years to return.

reviews.author: Martel M
reviews.title: Amazing Service!
reviews.text: Guendoline did an amazing job helping me pick out what to do for my girlfriend’s birthday. She was extremely thoughtful and provided great service. She definitely made our time at Paradisus Cancun special!

reviews.author: Rachel Hawn
reviews.title: Amazing Resort & Experience
reviews.text:
Amazing resort. All inclusive. Premium moments were amazing. 

Guendoline was awesome to work with when we set up premium moments in our room. 

Itzel in the spa gave the BEST massage that I have ever had. 

Our entire experience was amazing and we highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jovonnie M
reviews.title: Magical, Majestic, Wonderful Experience
reviews.text:
The service I received was great from the check in with Kemil who safe guarded my luggage from early arrival to my late departure.  Esmerelda who was able to find me a beautiful renovated room in the main building (3) on the fifth floor overlooking the ocean, the main pool, swim up bar etc.  

The room perfect clean, classy and exacting for my taste.  My room was located near 6 restaurants, the pool area, the bars and the beach. 

I loved the guest services. Angela was a sweetheart. She set us up on 2 golf excursions our favorite was the Cancun Country Club she arranged the transportation both ways. Got us a Tee times and we were on our way.

I cannot not mention the service at all the restaurants were all 1st class. From the buffet to exclusive beds at the pool side. This was my first experience at an all inclusive resort. I have been on many vacations in many parts of the world and loved just leaving tips for everyone I was in contact with. Everyone was kind with a smile.

reviews.author: Kristina G
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: Liliana in the Spa  was fantastic! She gave me a massage and was not only phenomenal...she was friendly and very knowledgeable! Highly recommend you visit her if you make it to the resort 👍 The facility was beautiful and clean also.........

reviews.author: Phylonalds A
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
Amazing resort, service is expectable.  Atzi, Orlando Bella, Victor & Evan outside pool cabana servers, and every staff member I encountered,  truly made my trip awesome.  I will be back real soon! 

The room size was great and the ocean view was beautiful.  I just wish the bushes weren’t so high on the balcony.

reviews.author: Juana R
reviews.title: Weeding Vows
reviews.text: Amazing humble service from the people atttending to the guest service. Special thanks to the buffet waiters and waitress.  Room service to Massage and  Spa service. This place is enchanted with the soul of the Cancun Essence. It is the spark of that makes this place magical. (It's workers) We hope they are well compensated. We look forward to visit Cancun again.

reviews.author: Kari W
reviews.title: Perfect Trip!!
reviews.text: Loved this resort! The people were all so nice and the entire resort was amazing! We had so much fun with Saul and Axcel playing beach volleyball and other activities! Will definitely return some day!

reviews.author: angela B
reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel in the Reserves area.  We had Violeta as our right hand all weekend.  She was prompt and went above and beyond to assist us even after check- out.  We had an unexplained charge and Violeta and Alberto were in communication with me nonstop to get it straightened out.  The service was superb, from checking in, to service by the pool, to housekeeping.  Would HIGHLY recommend anyone to stay here.

reviews.author: Traveler1
reviews.title: Great hotel, amazing stuff!
reviews.text: We were group of 3 friends, we booked 3 nights and extended 1 night more because we had so much fun! The massage is amazing and also the spa facilities, the food is good, mainly the special restaurants. And the most important thing is the stuff, they are all very kind and smile all the time. A special thanks for Rossana the manager how helped us a lot. Strong recommendation!

reviews.author: Anna Z
reviews.title: Buffet
reviews.text: I came here on spring break with a few of my friends and was astonished by the great service provided by Samuel S and Martin! They were constantly very attentive and kind to us the entire trip, making sure we were always accommodated! The food was great, and had many different options for whatever you’re in the mood for! There is a reason we kept returning

reviews.author: Ezik D
reviews.title: Vacation.
reviews.text: Samuel Sosa was sooo great at Malua inside Paradidus Cancun. We waited on us for lunch and dinner during our 5 night stay. He went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed for dinner.

reviews.author: Marnae L
reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Axcel was great playing volleyball with us. We played on the beach and in the pool. Then we also did pole dancing with Gina and Axcel. Pool food needs to up their game. Nothing even remotely healthy. Need better options. Beach service was good though

reviews.author: Arianna N
reviews.title: Yhi Spa
reviews.text: My mom and I got the Cocoon Body Treatment with Liliana and Daniela and it was the best massage experience we’ve ever had. They were incredibly kind, skilled, and professional. Absolutely loved every second of it! Liliana and Daniela made sure we were comfortable and relaxed, and we will definitely be coming back for another service with them. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Julia W
reviews.title: Beautiful place but service lacking, reserve rooms isn’t reserved.
reviews.text:
This resort has Beautiful grounds and very nice entertainment, but the staff I am not sure as I read all the service is excellent but my friend and I are not being treated like how I remember Cancun as. As soon as we arrived, we were escorted to pyramid 5, to check in with Reserve reception. As soon as we met with the receptionist he acknowledged we were there but we did not feel welcomed and he did not offer even water, I asked him can we please have something to drink because we just waited one  hour for our transfer from the airport, then he acknowledge that we can go to the lobby bar and get a drink and some snacks. Once we get back another person took over as it seems to has which shift, he was much nicer more from there and check us in pyramid 3which wasn’t even in the reserve section, so beware if you book the reserve does not mean you will be staying at reserve towers. We ended up in pyramid three with the spring breakers, the room is a standard room with no tub, and it just is on top floor and gives you access to reserve section.
We We’re told our concierge will contact us, no one has done that and we went down ourselves to make reservation for restaurants. We were told we can only eat in the buffet or the taco place as everywhere else is booked, and they manage to book a reservation the next day. 
I have been to cancun numerous times, I even have stayed in this place before when it was me Cancun, which I got very bad food poisoning. I just don’t see this place with standard five star hotel service, even if we stay at hotels in the area has warmer staff and better service. 
The food in the taco place and buffet is nothing special, buffet doesn’t have much selections, we try to go to the Japanese restaurant since it’s booked up for the rest of the trip, the lady at the front desk was very rude saying you can  wait till 730 reservation cancellation and just left us on the side, never came back and check on us. 8 comes, I go over there and ask her if there’s any cancellation because I see so many empty tables, she tells me these are for 8 o’clock reservation and you can wait another 30 minutes to see if there’s any cancellations. I’ve never experienced this kind of rudeness in Cancun, usually everyone is very accommodating and if they cannot get you in a restaurant they were suggest somewhere for you to eat. I am unsure if everyone is just having a bad day or We are being treated differently because we are a small minority group of 2.
I hope they can adjust how they work with the reserve rooms and clarify. I asked the staff is the rooms are the same they claim they are but I overheard the fifth tower has tubs and Jacuzzis. 
If you are willing to spend more money for a high standard resort this may not meet your standards.
And we have not met our concierge or anyone reached out to help us with anything.
 Everywhere you go seems like you’re bothering them.
Today will be day 2, and I really hope We can get better service.

reviews.author: Sarah H
reviews.title: Lemon fish review
reviews.text:
Alejandro camelo was an amazing server-
He took such good care of me and my wife on our vacation…
I hope when we return that we can see him once again.  Food was prepared perfectly and his attention to detail and our needs was completely on point.

reviews.author: Angela B
reviews.title: Believe the hype about the service
reviews.text:
First of all, ignore reviews for pretty much any resort in December and January. Ya'll remember what was going on then right? A little thing called omicron that decimated the service industry? Well, service is back in a big way at the Paradisus. 

I visited last week for spring break with my husband and our son for our first trip outside the U.S. since Covid started and it was exactly what we needed. It's a truly beautiful space, the food is pretty solid for an all-inclusive (definitely hit up Blue Agave for their tacos and margaritas) and we got impeccable service from every single employee we interacted with. Our son made several "freidns" among the staff and they truly treated us like family. It was wonderful. The location, beach, and facilities are also top notch. 

We didn't spring for the Reserve upgrade because honestly, we didn't plan to be in our room very much, so we were in one of the "older" rooms. Was it Four Seasons-esque? No, but it was also half the price per night and included all of our food and drinks so that gets a big old shrug from me. Don't let the complaints from people claiming that "it isn't really five-star" or that "it's not nice enough for the price" get to you. They need to calm down. The older rooms have more of an old school Mayan vibe with lots of dark wood but honestly that didn't bug us and we didn't have any issues.

Some quick hits:
Make sure you visit guest services to get your dinner reservations set as soon as you can so you don't have to worry about it and can eat where you want.

There is no paper for anything so if you want a map of the property, details about the facilities or the schedule of activities for the week you'll have to rely on the Melia app (which we couldn't get to work) or QR codes that are spread out throughout the property. Our biggest criticsm here is that we're used to visiting resorts where all of that info is readily available at check-in so without a working app we were pretty lost for our first few days given the size of the property. 

The resort provides on-site Covid testing and has converted a couple of rooms to testing spaces. They'll give you a QR code to scan when you check in to register for your test to return to the U.S. (if you need that). If you're leaving on a popular "exit" date (like a weekend) be prepared to wait in line, but from there it's very easy. You can choose an antigen test or PCR and even though they will tell you to expect a longer wait, we had the results of our three antigen tests emailed to me within an hour of testing so we were able to upload our documents for our flight the following day and go about our business without worrying about it. 

It seems like there's some sort of DJ situation every night at 9 in one of the bars so if you're traveling with young kids or want to go to bed early, request a room that's tucked away from all that. We got lucky and got a room that was away from the noise without asking, but it's something to consider. 

The Aquaworld excursions are worth it. You can book at the resort, it's right across the street and they have lots of fun things to choose from if you want to do more than lounge by the pool or visit the beach. We did a "jungle tour" with snorkeling that was fabulous.

All in all, we had a great stay and I'd happily recommend it.

reviews.author: Samantha P
reviews.title: Yhi Spa
reviews.text: First time at Paradisus Cancun and first time at Yhi Spa. I had a deep tissue massage and Leonor was AMAZING!!! Never have received a real deep tissue massage that was so comforting and relaxing. I definitely felt relief from the moment I walked out. 10/10 recommend. Her service was phenomenal.

reviews.author: Jade D
reviews.title: Restaurant Malava
reviews.text:
THEY ARE THE BEST!
Orlando bello, Armando, Cristel and Alexis & Martin and Gaudencio were SOOOOO amazing! BEST service, best food, best vibes all around. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a safe, enjoyable  and relaxing get away in paradise, Restaurant Malva is the place to be. I felt very taken care of and they made the stay so much more lovely with their helpful demeanor, friendly attitudes and hard work to make sure I had a good time. 10/10 would come back again :)

reviews.author: Paola M
reviews.title: best customer service ever
reviews.text:
Best resort ever, very safe and private resort . Beautiful facility, very clean and they strive on customer service . The service from beginning to end is impeccable and flawless. Quick to help and direct you,  great positive energy and vibe. They make you feel right at home from the moment you step in to the moment you leave. Most the employees have upbeat angelic  energy which set the vibe and compliment the amazing facility which results in an amazing getaway. They have sections in front of the beach that comes with bed like set up and they provide premium alcoholic beverages and serve you food all days while you rent the section, highly recommended Amenity. The resort is big and set up like a pyramid , makes for marvelous views while you walk through it. Pools are big and beautiful. buffet is premium food with authentic mexican dishes that are delicious. Many amazing restaurants inside the resort that we didn’t do bc we like variety at the buffet. Buffet was amazing and to get to experience all the wonderful restaurants would take days. We did 5days 4nights and it definitely wasn’t enough and would say 8days 7nights minimum and that wouldn’t be enough. recommend getting room with beach view, won’t regret it.This resort is a piece of heaven on earth. 

Will finish off the review with honorable employee mentions which my fiancé and me remembered all by memory no picture taken, just muscle memory due to the personable interaction they provided. Customer service at its best. Meliá needs to promote these employees and all companies across the world need to learn from these people. Resort is top of its class but would be nothing without these employees with their personable touch making you feel like royalty with their angelic like service making it feel like heaven on earth. 

*Honorable employee mentions:  
Edwardo/Oscar/Raul/Alberto/norma/rivera/Sergio/Alfredo/Ramiro Xsotel/Teresa/ruth/Orlando/Alfredo/Sergio/victor/ Alex / Antonio / joni/ fernanda/ sacedo/ Johnny *

I apologize if I missed a few names as this was muscle memory and not wrote down. Will definitely be booking our wedding here and would even consider buying a timeshare here and come more frequently. Very upscale part of Cancun with high end restaurants in front of the resort and high end stores like Louis Vuitton mins away. highly recommended resort that will leave you speechless and begging for more , will make you quickly forget about all the worries you left at your home city or town. a piece of heaven on earth. Royalty vibes with angelic like service provide for a Godly experience.  Thanks to all the employees who made this an amazing experience, resort would be nothing with you. God bless .

reviews.author: Barb Frank
reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: A gentlemen at Paradisus guest services was so helpful printing our COVID verification documentation. The stay was amazing. We'll be back for a third time. Loved every minute. So relaxing and spring break for grown ups

reviews.author: Sasha G
reviews.title: Best massage at spa
reviews.text: Booked a Sensorial Escape for 75 min at the spa with Liliana. It was a wonderful salt and sugar scrub. Then I showered off the scrub and she massaged front and back. My muscles were happy and my mind was calm. Liliana is gifted. The essential oils and hot wraps were lovely. A major moodlifter. Give yourself permission to indulge. Fabulous!

reviews.author: Bekki S
reviews.title: Best latte and EXCELLENT service!
reviews.text: Hotel Paradisus is an AMAZING place! Definitely paradise! I get my latte made at Cafe NESPRESSO by Alex who is wonderful at what he does. EXCELLENT service by Alex! My favorite Barista! I will return!

reviews.author: Jessie K
reviews.title: Wonderful experience.
reviews.text: We visit Paradisus Cancun often but this trip stood out to us. Everyone was super friendly and welcoming. Gaudencio at the Malva breakfast Buffett made us feel super important every single morning. He always greeted us with a smile and positive attitude. He truly made each morning wonderful. Teresita at the Malva buffet was also a bright spot on our trip. She was always excited to see us and welcomed us to the buffet. We spent most of our days by the beach. Lux was our wonderful server who kept food and drinks coming. Jose always had our Bali bed ready for us in the morning. Elliot was also amazing, always so positive and helpful. The staff really was incredible, it was a tough week with spring break but they always remained positive. Overall this trip was one of the best. Thank you Paradisus Cancun for celebrating our Birthdays with us!

reviews.author: Sam L
reviews.title: Thank you!
reviews.text: Cristian was the best! His service was excellent and we enjoyed our food very much. We got the beef marinated skewers, the tuna tacos, and the sushi rolls. All delicious and the ambiance was incredible. Thanks Christian!

reviews.author: LightPacker376631
reviews.title: Amazing Family Vaca
reviews.text:
First time out of the country in two years for family vacation!!! I couldn’t of asked for a better hotel and staff! Rosanna Zarrino (Guest service manager) and her coworker Fabiola, were so accommodating! We were met with open arms and fabulous customer service, and  smiles on their face while helping. Rosanna was so attentive and warm hearted, we definitely will be back!
Also loved our Butler Rafael!!😊
The resort was amazing the pictures were just like the website. We stayed in the Reserve, spend the money it’s worth every dime!

reviews.author: Haleigh A
reviews.title: Best spring break ever! -Thank you Orlando!!
reviews.text: Stayed here for spring break & had the best time ever! Everyone was accommodating & friendly. Especially our favorite bartender ORLANDO who made our vacation so memorable! He made our drinks so fast even though he was so busy and still had time to get to know us. Orlando if you’re reading this te amo mucho! Give this man a raise. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming I wish we could’ve stayed here foreverrrrr. Shoutout Augustin and Raul tambien. Thank you for the memories Paradisus!

reviews.author: Bev T
reviews.title: Fantastic service here!
reviews.text:
Atilano, Orlando Bello, Gaby at pool, the pool bartender!  Awesome service from all. So attentive! 
Had a great 3 days here with friends and colleagues. Recommend the Italian and seafood restaurants. Enjoy!

reviews.author: kboyd2016
reviews.title: Cancun 2022
reviews.text:
Lovely beach & great for walking/ ocean for swimming.  Resort- 5 pyramids connected through passageways. You can stay inside or walk outside to arrive at your destination ( spa, restaurant, hospitality suite). We stayed in the Reserve. It was worth the added expense (reservations for dinner, Bali beds, etc). The staff prefers you mask indoors. However, the staff indicated that it depends on your country of origin if you mask indoors. Our group of 6 masked indoors consistently. We all had covid within the last 90 days and have been vaccinated. Majority of people did not mask indoors as it was not enforced. Although to enter restaurants you were required to wear a mask until seated ( similar to Canadian protocols). We booked (upon arrival) our return antigen test for 430pm on our last day (Friday). We received 5/6 test results (NEG) promptly. No records were found for my 15 year old until 20 Thank you Moises, Jose, Maximus, Galdino & many more. Hardworking and very pleasant staff.We connected with our Reserve concierge through WhatsApp.  One of our rooms was in a party zone so they were moved to a different floor after banging and knocking on doors occurred after “quiet” hours.
Gym- this would be less than ideal for the amount of people at the resort. Not enough gear or free weights. . 
Beautiful resort. I would highly recommend a vacation to The Paradisus for family’s, couples, and groups. Please improve weight room.

reviews.author: C B
reviews.title: Great place and great staff!
reviews.text: This is our third time staying at this hotel and again we were really happy! This hotel is pretty and maintained to perfection. Check in was a breeze and our room was ready early. They had a large, taped notification across the door to seal it. The tape read that the room had been sanitized. Upon entry the room was clean and perfect. The staff is so amazing at this place. We have stayed at many other hotels in Cancun and we feel the staff here just seem genuine and want you to be happy. The newer Italian restaurant Capella's was really good. We enjoyed our seafood pasta dishes. We also had a great dinner a Lemon Fish. We stayed in the Reserve section, which used to be called Royal Service. Children are now allowed to stay in that section, which isn't great if you wanted adults only, but they are still not allowed in the adults only pool area. Now for our favorite people, at Ginger Bar one, we had the best time because the staff makes sure of it! Wendy! We love Wendy! Both nights we were there Wendy, Roque, Luis, Sofonia, and Alejandra made the nights fun. Great drinks, they always check on you to make sure you don't need anything at all and stop by to just spread their happy, fun energy. They even made a special birthday drink and song for my birthday. It was really sweet, they just did this on their own. Axcel who was the daytime activity guy was awesome too, he got people to have fun in the pool. The testing for covid prior to our departure was easy and quick, done in the hotel and we had results emailed to us within probably 2 hours. Paradisus give your staff a bonus because they really do make the place. I wish I could remember everyone's name because they are all amazing. Thanks for a good vacation.

reviews.author: sarah a
reviews.title: Delightful Staff
reviews.text:
A HUGE shout out to Wendy, Sofonia Rogue and Alejandro in the Ginger Bar! They took such amazing care of us each night! Superb service and incredibly kind! Can’t wait to see y’all again soon! 

A HUGE shout out to Alejandro Camelo for AMAZING service at dinner! Excellent service and very attentive!

A HUGE shoutout to Guillermo for amazing service at the buffet! Fast and friendly service!

Everyone at Paradisus is and was incredibly kind, friendly and helpful. We always go to Paradisus Cancun. We will return this summer to mark our 3rd time in just 9 months. I can’t say enough for this resort. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Jenny
reviews.title: Mother/Son Trip
reviews.text: The Paradisus is a beautiful resort with excellent ocean views. Our group had a wonderful stay! The service was excellent, we stayed in the reserve accommodations which kept us all in the same area-very helpful!  The ocean front rooms are the way to go! The staff did everything they could to make our vacation first class!  We loved our time there!  We enjoyed all of the pools, bars and restaurants.  The sushi was our favorite!

reviews.author: Sophia R
reviews.title: Lemonfish
reviews.text: Alejandro, Christian, and Hugo were the most amazing waiters ever. Best food in paradisus by far. Such a good experience and the restaurant is beautiful. Ate here two nights in a row and had the most amazing time.

reviews.author: Alayna Foley
reviews.title: Lemon fish visit
reviews.text: We love Christian and Alejandro. The best servers ever and we had the best time with them. They were so personable and kind and got us everything we needed. If you come to paridisus cancun you HAVE to come here. Even if you aren’t staying here you need to come

reviews.author: Lily M
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text:
My partner and I stayed at this resort for a week. We did just about everything offered from spa day to water fitness class and hat making (thanks Jennifer will not forget your pump up routine). I highly recommend the reserve upgrade for this, if you are not coming with little ones and want some relaxing time.  We also had a very friendly concierge, Ruth who checked us into our room and booked our restaurants throughout our stay. She checked in with us every day and helped us troubleshoot when we had problems with room service or questions about covid and checking out on our last day.  All the staff was so friendly and professional. Big shout out to Max and Lucas, the guys in charge of the Bali beds and all the servers (especially Oscar from Sante) who went above and beyond to meet our needs every time. And a few mixologists that made interesting and delicious special drinks just for us. Thank you Rogue (I'm not sure how to spell your name, sorry!) And Johnny, and Wendy.  Everyone was so nice and welcoming it was difficult to leave. Thank you for your hospitality. 

We will be returning!
Lily and Brett

reviews.author: Cheran W
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: Janick was an excellent concierge for us! He was very attentive and checked in to make sure everything was okay. He reserved our Bali beds and made beach days hassle free. He also made all of our food reservations. We had a little miscommunication (my fault) so we had to move some reservations around and he was happy to do so and made it work. He makes dreams a reality! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Marie Paola S
reviews.title: Great food, great service!!
reviews.text: Went to Lunch box for dinner. Our server Juan Solis was great, very patient with us. It was such a busy night that night, Juan was sweating his ass off because of how busy it was. He apologized for not being able to take our order on time. But he made up for it at the end. The food was also really good 10/10 recommend coming here for dinner.

reviews.author: Cole K
reviews.title: Saúl
reviews.text: He is a great guy! He’s great at volleyball and lead the st Patrick’s day party well. We will remember Saul forever because he made the trip absolutely amazing. Thank you all for a great trip and cancun is great

reviews.author: Koti L
reviews.title: Paradisus customer care specialists spent extra time and care to make our stay amazing!
reviews.text: There were two outstanding specialists that made my stay exceptional! Rosa Zannio and Fabiola Ramos, They work in guest services and they are both amazing.  I will be returning in September and hope to see these fabulous ladies again. I would and will recommend staying at  Paradisus to all my friends and family, Thank you ladies for making our stay amazing and helping us feel welcomed!

reviews.author: Pablo M
reviews.title: Family spring break vacation
reviews.text: This is our 4th time at Paradisus, and by far this has been amazing. The customer service has been wonderful 6 stars. TERESITA, ALEXIS, CRISTEL, RAUL AND GAUDENCIO took so much care of us each day. We are avid travelers and this has been the best experience ever. Also we can not forget Danya from poolside. She was so amazing.Thank you Paradisus!!!!

reviews.author: Brianny M
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I love Paradisus. I’ve visited 4 times, and will continue to come back. DD is an amazing server at Paradisus Cancun! He was extremely helpful, sweet, and friendly. I will definitely be asking for him every time I eat at the buffet!

reviews.author: Brent S
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
My wife and I have traveled to 50+ all-inclusive throughout the Caribbean and as we get older (mid 50's) we become a little more selective in our choices. We had extremely high hopes after reading several reviews but were immediately disappointed upon arrival. We were rushed through our checkin process. No welcome drink, little explanation of the property and amenities, no map or schedule of activities, and no explanation of what was added to the upgrade we had purchased for a luxury Junior suite ocean view. We had a beautiful ocean view room but nothing else in the room appeared to be a  luxury upgrade. Even when making dinner reservations the employee assisting us questioned why we didn't have our concierge doing it for us. We were unaware that we might actually have one but would think with the upgrade we would.  Our first day by the pool resembled a spring break "Rave party" , drunken 20 yr olds doing shots screaming and yelling. I overheard a few of them state that a resort a couple properties away had several of their rooms condemned that they were put up here, and it was evident. I get that it is Spring Break, but I expected much higher standards from this resort. I went to guest services that evening to express my concerns and was assured that I would be contacted the following day by management. That was two day's ago and I've heard from no one. Disappointing.

Don't get me wrong, the property is beautiful, most employees are extremely friendly and hard working. However, we found the food mediocre at best, total lack of entertainment, and a total lack of an exciting beach vacation vibe. There was not much activity day or night.  The main bar and sports bar were consistently crowded with young teens and college age students.  We couldn't even get to play a game of pool because young kids were playing pool at 10 pm.  What a shame because the Ginger Bar 2 would have been a nice place to end the evening.  We love the Kanna bar but again after day one it was filled with young adults and by mid week the bar was not even open.  

I still have three days remaining here and hope it gets better. At this point however, I can't say
 that I will be recommending this resort to friends and family, especially during spring break.

reviews.author: Cathy D
reviews.title: Excellent service!
reviews.text: We just completed our spring break stay with our seniors Although we had some hiccups with room assignments and reservations for dinner, I have to say the staff at the pool bar and at the restaurants were amazing!!!! Gaby and Angel were fantastic - so friendly and helpful and very attentive!! They deserve a raise!!!!! The server Orlando in the breakfast buffet had our table waiting for us every morning with our hot tea and coffee ready! Thank you Gaby - we hope to see you next year!!

reviews.author: Dan B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Service as Food
reviews.text:
Alejandro Camelo really looked after us. He was amazing,he suggested all the best menu items and kept the food and wine coming. 
We had all the sushi and Nigri abs were not disappointed. We also had the shark tacos which were very tasty. We finished off with the spiced pineapple dessert which was the cherry on top! 
Make sure to visit Alejandro at the Lemon Fish. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: rachelmcgraw
reviews.title: Definitely recommend!
reviews.text: My daughter and I had a wonderful trip to Paradisus Reserve, Cancun. The resort is so pretty and relaxing. The food was very fresh and healthy at all the restaurants that we went to. Our favorite meal was at the Italian restaurant, Capella, on our last night. The manager Carlos and our waiter, Luis, we’re terrific!

reviews.author: Daisy W
reviews.title: I Would Never Recommend Staying Here - Not a Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful hotel but don't judge a book by its cover. This is the worst all inclusive experience I have ever had hands down. From the bigger issues we had down to the small details that they do not seem to care about. For example, this is the first time I went to an all inclusive that did not serve welcome drinks when you arrived at the hotel. 

I called a week in advance to ensure our room was close to my mom and brothers so grandma could watch our 19 month old. When I checked in the concierge said they were close to one another but they actually put us in different towers that were super far away.  We went to my mom's room and it was one king bed even though I booked two twins on Expedia and also on our pre-check in form. My 69 year old mom and 44 year old brother do not want to have to share a bed. Then the bellman said my brother could just sleep on the pull out couch. I did not pay $2000 per person for a 5 star resort for my brother to sleep on a couch. So I had their room changed which was a 30 minute ordeal at front desk. They moved them to a room that was even further away from our room (10 mins walk 2 towers away). 

When we went to our room there was no power. Only the lights in the bathroom worked. We could not see anything since it was night time when we checked in. No  one came to fix it for well over an hour, so we went to front desk to change rooms. The first thing the very unfriendly hotel staff member asked is if we tried the light switches. How condescending and rude! Of course we did! It was another 30 minute ordeal for us to get a new room. 

Then we learned that pyramid 1 had only one elevator to access the top floor that we were on and it just stopped working for the rest of the day. So imagine hauling a 19 month old, a stroller, and all our luggage down from the top floor down 6 flights of stairs. At no point did anyone offer to move our luggage with all the room changes. Also while we were making multiple trips to move everything, our old room key stopped working before we got everything out. Another 20 mins at front desk getting our key re-activated. 

They give you water bottles in your room that are not twist off caps and our room had no bottle opener. Small details that are missed. I tried calling front desk to ask where the children's play room is that they advertise online. I couldn't get through after trying at least 10x. The "Kidsdom" is hidden in the basement of Pyramid 2. They are only open at odd hours and turn off the sign so it is very hard to find. We couldn't locate it till the 4th day of our trip. I was first told by staff it was in Pyramid 1 then someone said it was on the main floor. The staff did not even know where it was. 

DO NOT go by the Westjet Paradisus Cancun Photos of this hotel. It clearly has not been updated in a very long time and a ton of the venues and restaurants don't exist anymore and that site was honestly a huge reason I booked there. There is no Avenue Bar, Vento Restaurant, Red Lounge, Family Concierge Lounge, Fitness Centre, or Spin Studio. Covid is their excuse for everything but it was a packed resort. You could not even get a poolside chair at most times. You need to tell people if you are running at half ass service so they can choose not to book there or else discount the rates.  There was really only the Ginger Bar open which is an open club in the middle of the hotel that you can hear from your room in Pyramid 3. It has a very small lounge attached to it. There is literally NOTHING else to do. No other lounges or clubs or theaters or activity rooms. There was no entertainment at all besides Mexican singers and dancers we saw by the pool only one time in the 6 days we were there. Apparently a singer was in the Blue Agave restaurant once but we did not have reservations at that time to hear her. What kind of all inclusive has no entertainment?   We saw one person try to use the pool table in the Ginger Bar and the worker said he was not allowed to till 3pm. Poor kid was just bored because there is LITERALLY nothing else to do but sit by the pool. The Ginger Bar also ran out of tequila one night... in Mexico! Who runs out of tequila in Mexico ... land of tequila!? 

We booked reservations at Ceilos and they said they wouldn't seat us at our time because our entire party wasn't with us. My brother was just using the bathroom. I got in 20 mins after our reservation time as I watched them slowly cleaning our table. At Sal's Steakhouse, I asked for my steak rare and it was over done and chewy. Of course it's the restaurant that is not part of the all inclusive. So we paid $380 American for a meal that was totally not worth it. 

The only breakfast option is the one buffet and good luck trying to ever get bacon which would always run out. All of the food was really mediocre except for the oysters we got at Agua Marina which we also had to pay for. There is an oyster bar at the pool but they never ever served oysters there. 

We pre-booked our Covid test time slot in advance but it didn't matter. We had to still wait in a really long line up. Barely anyone in the line wore masks even though the family in front of us said they were redoing their test because their daughter had a positive result the day before. The 4 of us booked online in advance but they could not find my mother's registration form and took 20 mins to re-register her. Why did they have the other 3 reservations when they were all done together? 

I think all of these mishaps I could have dealt with better if the staff was just nice to us.  No one was apologetic or friendly with the exception of some waiters. Oh except the one who asked my mother if she was going to tip him. This was the most expensive resort I have ever booked at and there is absolutely no way it should be a 5 star hotel. The food is truly mediocre, bathrooms in the rooms are dark and grimy, no entertainment, and staff was rude. I would never recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.author: Julie C
reviews.title: A taste of paradise
reviews.text:
Beautiful area and wonderful ocean however it was an added extra touch to have such thoughtful and kind servers- Samuel Sosi and Martin.  

Regardless of what time I came down, Samuel Sosi and Martin  remembered me and my drink preferences and made sure to say hello even though I'm sure there are thousands of guests.  

I'm just going to suggest that their manager, Rafael, give them a paid vacation and a raise. ;) 

Mucho gracies!!!

reviews.author: Lance C
reviews.title: SAMUEL SOSA IS THE 💣
reviews.text:
My wife and I are extremely impressed with Samuel Sosa and his coworker Martin. Consider this a shout out to their capitan, Rafe, these men deserve a raise! Samuel remembered our drink preference even though we only dined in the buffet about once a day (my wife visited more often). They are the best pair at the Buffe Mallua!

Seriously. Give those gents a raise!

reviews.author: KAzzo25
reviews.title: The name speaks for itself!!
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun was absolutely amazing! Just got back from staying there for a week and wish we stayed longer/already miss it. From the staff to the food everything and everyone was outstanding! This was our first trip post covid and with a 1 year old and we felt so safe, very clean and kid friendly. All the restaurants on property were amazing, especially the Italian restaurant (ask for Xavier for your waiter) and Ciello Mexican (ask for Ian for your waiter)  and the buffet (ask for Antonio and Gaudencio for your waiters). My family and I will be coming back to Paradisus Cancun and bringing the rest of our family with us and making this place a yearly tradition.

reviews.author: Miguel A
reviews.title: Great trip!
reviews.text: We had a great stay at Paradisus, the staff was exceptional!  Javier and Joni severed us daily at breakfast and remembered our drink orders. The only thing lacking was a good lunch option. Besides that, our 3 and 5 year olds enjoyed their time at the beach and pool.

reviews.author: simon r
reviews.title: A little trip to Paradise
reviews.text:
Hotel is stunning and feels like a tropical paradise. Great views of the Carribean sea, lovely beach and clear water, if a little rough, but that adds to it's appeal.
Staff are fantastic, couldn't do enough, even when they didn't understand our accents! 

Overall a fantastic holiday experience. Best restaurants were Yellowfish (Japanese) and the buffet. Extra special mentions to Martin (Breakfast Room), Bar staff Wendy, Luis, Sofonia, Pool area Jennifer, Moises, Max and Lucas. Not forgetting the lovely Theresa our personal concierge.

Would love to return one day.

reviews.author: Fabiana M
reviews.title: Best service
reviews.text:
This is the 4th time I stay at Paradissus…what an amazing experience…concierge Juan was the best, making my friend’s bday so so special…from the moment we checked in, he made our stay the best…thank you Juan….
Diego and Maximilian at the pool were also very attentive. Thank you Paradissus for such an amazing stay…til next year

reviews.author: Katie E
reviews.title: Kudos to Alfredo and Ramiro at Malva!
reviews.text:
I cannot begin to describe how amazing this trip was - from beginning to end!  The views are amazing, and the staff is so friendly and full of humor.  The pool was kept remarkably clean, and the rest of the resort was immaculate as well.  While I spoke Spanish, most of my group did not, and they had no trouble communicating with the staff either.  

I need to call out the phenomenal service offered by some of the hard workers at Malva - Alfredo Arcos and Ramiro Pech.  We were a group of 6, and these two remarkable staff members helped us the first day.  We had breakfast in their section every morning after that, and they were so attentive, friendly, and honestly the best waiters I have ever had, anywhere.  I also have to call out Martin who works at Malva as well, but was helping in another restaurant when we met him.

reviews.author: Snoopy1k
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and a great beach!!!
reviews.text: We have been going to Mexico and the Caribbean for 20 yrs. We have been to Cancun 8 times. We upgraded to the reserve. This gives you your own pools cabanas and restaurant should you choose to use them. We did and it was great. As well as private check in and out. The resort is beautiful. Has a very nice beach. The food is good. They serve premium alcohol. The staff is great. Always there when you need them. There is 24hr room service. Your room has a fridge with lots of beer, pop, juice and water stocked daily. Plus room snacks. Not sure if it was COVID retaliated but the bars shut down at 11:00 pm. I would stay here again in a heart beat!!

reviews.author: Kelly B
reviews.title: 18 day stay at Paradisus Cancun was amazing!
reviews.text:
Feb 18th-Mar 8th, 2022

What can I say this place was amazing again. We've been coming since 1998 and this was the BEST stay yet! From the moment we checked in to the time we checked out such great people.  So many to mention. We were treated like royalty from Irina, Gaby and Dianna (pool area waitresses) daily. As far as waiters Carlos in Blue Agave and Alfredo and Antonio in the Malva buffett were a pleasure to see every tiem we went in there. Such very nice people and attentive to us. 

We had a ton of fun and felt like family with the activities team. Agustín, Axcel and Saul were AMAZING! Such great guys! Give them a raise bc they deserve it. They got so many people involved in the activities every day. Kept it fun all day long. Veronica and Miguel who were brought in to teach yoga were really good. I was included in the SUDA Experience and was so grateful they happened to be there one of the weeks we were. Such a great experience! I participated in all 4 sessions and my wife did 2 of them. 

We also had photos taken by the pros in the hotel and they turned out fantastic! Diego was recommended to us by a friend and he did not disappoint!  The pictures turned out great. To the point we referred some other friends of ours to use him, they did and their pictures also turned put amazing! I have to mention during our photo shoot a lifeguard (later identified as Julio Manain) HAD an real save! An adult male swimmer got caught in a rip current and was in distress. The lifeguard (whose name I later got) didn't hesitate, jumped in and rescued the guy. It was great to see and Im glad to know such qualified people work for the Paradisus Cancun! This lifeguard (Julio) deserves a life saving award!

The only hiccup we had the whole trip was our assigned "butler"/concierge named Pavel. On day one he was so impressive.  My wife put whatsapp on her phone at his recommendation (he even helped her set it up and made sure his number was in the phone) so we could stay in touch during our stay. The way he TALKED, my wife and I were like if this guy comes through we need to give him a huge tip. NOTE: We are low maintenance people and require very little. Well no worries about the tip because it only took a couple days to realize this guy is all show and no go. A couple miscommunications on his end at first and then just no responses as our trip continued. He promised a couple things (one was a Lobster dinner) a couple times and when it didn't show up we messaged him and got no response. Then we ran into him at the pool and he asked about it. We told him we never got it and he said he'd make it happen. Never did and no response to our text about it. We gave him so many chances to come through and he never did. When my wife went down to the vacation club to check out he didn't even acknowledge her and he was sitting next to the lady checking her out. Super disappointed about this and talked to a manager about it when we checked out. She was very apologetic. And wished we would've said something sooner and she would've switched our butlers. She shouldn't have had to do that! Can't figure out what the deal was. Maybe because we were there for 18 days and he just figured we'd be too much work? Don't know but as I mentioned we are super low maintenance. He was gonna do three things for us. The one he did was screwed up and he failed to do the other 2. It worked out fine because we handled everything ourselves. Side note...our friends had Juan Carlos as a butler and said he was amazing. So if you get Pavel pass on him and ask for Juan Carlos. 

Even though Pavel was a disappointment I still rate the Paradisus and all the other employees 5 st🌟r's! One customer service (not so)specialist who sucked isn't gonna tarnish the great work everyone else did! We'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Randy S
reviews.title: Those who served us this week at Paradisis Cancun were awesome!
reviews.text:
Atilano and Orlando were amazing servers in the buffet restaurant! They treated us like family!

Laura was an exceptional server it by the pool. She got to know us throughout the week and was so kind and attentive!

reviews.author: Jess
reviews.title: Kanna Beach Club!
reviews.text:
The staff at the Kanna Beach Club was amazing! First off you had a gentleman that bartended during the day. I didn’t get his name but he wore suspenders and has worked there for 21 years. He made incredible drinks! His fresh cucumber and jalapeño margarita was incredible!

The afternoon/night staff was so fun and friendly! Gotta give a shout out to Karina and Salvador! We were there for my good friends wedding. They made sure we had everything we needed from thw drinks, shots and can’t forget the hookah!

reviews.author: veronicavilla50
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Reserve and loved it! The waiter Cesar over at Sante was very attentive and funny! Max that handles the Bali bed reservations was very helpful and polite. Alexis is the Manager over the Reserve and he went above and beyond to make sure that the minor hiccup we had with our room accommodations were handled to our expectations.

The Kanna bar is a must...reserve a bali bed by the ocean! Victor Cauich was our waiter and he provides OUTSTANDING service- very attentive, thoughtful, and made my beach day extra special celebrating my 40th Birthday!

I recommend booking a massage by the Ocean- David provides great service and I had a very relaxing massage!

We love the Paradisus Cancun and plan to visit again soon!

reviews.author: Paradise320391
reviews.title: Book with caution!
reviews.text:
This hotel is beautiful, has great landscaping and well taken care of lobbying/atrium. However, that is were the compliments end. I found the front desk staff to be unfriendly and check-in to be very slow. Additionally, the hotel was overcrowded (inebriated college spring breakers), getting pool chairs and restaurant reservations were impossible. I was literally told by staff it was “impossible”. I was also haggled about sitting through a timeshare presentation, very odd.

Next, if you enjoy premium liquor or seasoned food this is not the hotel for you. The drinks were watered down and the bar was full of rail liquors.

Lastly, three tips, schedule covid test appointment, food reservation and excursions on first day of arrival, for your entire stay. Covid testing is only conducted from 9am-5pm, make sure to fit timeframe in plans.

reviews.author: Pamela
reviews.title: Message
reviews.text: Just had a massage at the spa. It is beautiful and the atmosphere is very relaxing. The entire staff there is very friendly and welcoming! My therapist was Leonord who did an excellent  job. I would highly recommend to request her. Thank you Leonord.

reviews.author: Allison P
reviews.title: Christian Sanchez
reviews.text: Christian is a very nice person and works very hard at his job! He served our family tonight and was amazing!! I ordered many drinks and the service was amazing because he brought our family whatever we needed.

reviews.author: Alwina K
reviews.title: Fabiola
reviews.text: We received a Great customer service! Fabiola is the best one, really appreciate her! She made a super beautiful surprise for the birthday of my kid! Super friendly and ready to help. Thank YOU Fabiola❤️

reviews.author: Gloria B
reviews.title: Wonder service at Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Christian Sanchez is the best server! What a wonderful and memorable dinner we had at Lemon Fish! Thank you so much for a great dinner! They made our anniversary feel super special. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was very cool. All around 10/10! We will be back!

reviews.author: Zach M
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: Extremely good food, in a beautiful location! Everyone at the resort is very friendly and accommodating. The food is all of good quality and tastes fantastic! Sushi is just what you need after a long day at the beach.

reviews.author: Dax Bordenaro
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Galdino our reserve concierge made our experience smooth and relaxing. We spent our nights at kanna beach club where Salvador and Korinna took care of us with the amazing service and even better drinks. And can’t forget about Angel at the poolside bar.

reviews.author: simonscornik
reviews.title: Great food, great service
reviews.text: Our waiter Alejandro made our night. Super kind and brought us plenty of samples of sushi and other dishes so that we could celebrate our amigos 22nd bday. Great restaurant and host wish we could have stayed and talked to Alejandro and Christian all night.

reviews.author: Larissa D
reviews.title: Beautiful restaurant
reviews.text: My husband and I came for our anniversary dinner we were very impressed! Restaurant is beautiful, loved the atmosphere & our waiter Christian was Great and so attentive. We tried a sushi platter everything was good

reviews.author: Brian I
reviews.title: Angela Alonso - Guest services
reviews.text:
Angela was a 🔟.  Thorough  and attentive. The quality of service from the entire staff was exceptional.

Golf reservations and entertainment off-site were fantastic. Great beachfront.

Beyond expectations.

Will be back.

reviews.author: Anandsubr
reviews.title: An awesome birthday get away!!!!
reviews.text:
Oh what a trip!!! The weather was perfect all the days, and the choice of resort could not have been better. Paradisus Cancun excelled in every way. The room was gorgeous, the staff were super humble, the arrangements spectacular, the property awesome and did I mention the staff?

Anthony helped us in checking in and made it a breeze. Rafa was our concierge and was always there to answer a question even in his day off. 

The day of wifeys birthday we had a beachside dinner and that was out of the world. The setup was amazing and Oscar took care of us all the time, attentive as ever.

Every morning saw us at Malva where Atilano and Orlando were always there to greet us with a smile and super attentive. 

Lucas at Bali huts made sure we had the best of the huts and sante servers took utmost care of us all day. 

At blue agave had the most amazing singer who sang a romantic song for us and we danced. 

Capella was our last dinner and Omar and Carlos made it special for us. 

Ana at yhi spa was the best. Wifey had a treatment everyday and Ana made sure she came back awe struck each day. 

Am sure I missed a lot more people who together made out stay one to remember. 

Sadly we have to go back but we will be back.

reviews.author: Abz M
reviews.title: Best place to be in Cancun for cool families
reviews.text:
Our family vacation has been simple the best. 

Let's start with the rooms. Beds are sooo comfortable. Showers are amazing and the rooms with a view are to die for. 

Sunrise beach views rooms

Sunset lagoon view room 

Food 
Each restaurant we went to was amazing. But the ones that stood out the most was the lunch box and Aguamarina. 

The guys serving us at Lunchbox was Orlando and Atilano.  They were so helpful with everything. 
Especially with the kids. 

Denisse at Aguamarina was so kind and helpful too. I think Denisse and my daughter are friends for life now 😁. 

Forget about any negative comments. 

This place is out of this world and would highly recommend. 

We're coming back next year 👍🏾

reviews.author: Olivia M
reviews.title: Perfect family holiday, 5* throughout
reviews.text:
Our final day at the Paradisus Cancun and we wish we never have to leave! We have visited from the UK for one week - the hotel is not far from the airport and it has been perfect in every way since we arrived. The food is outstanding, the rooms are modern and the hotel has a real luxury feel.
We can't wait to come back here, hopefully at Christmas! 
A special thanks to Atilano and Orlando Bello at the lunch box for always bringing us the best double espresso and warm milk for our babies bottles!  A big thank you too, to the amazing staff Juan Carlos, Denniss, Albert and everyone here. Best holiday ever we will miss you guys x

reviews.author: Sydney S
reviews.title: Loved Capella at Paradisus Cancun!!!!
reviews.text: Our time spent at Capella was one of our favorites the entire trip! Our waiter, Luis Ayala, made this experience such a lighthearted and enjoyable one that we will not forget! Will for sure be back, 10/10!

reviews.author: Geena L
reviews.title: Amazing views and great staff!
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I visited for my birthday. The food was great and the drinks were delicious. We stayed in a reserve room and it was well worth the extra money.

The beach access was amazing as well as the pool areas. There are a ton of bars

reviews.author: Drew R
reviews.title: Great service from Luis!
reviews.text: Restaurant Capella was a great food, with even better service! Our server Luis Ayala was the best! I asked him to surprise me for dinner and he gave the most perfectly cooked food and dessert! Luis was warm helpful and explained all of the food perfectly! Will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: C K
reviews.title: Fabulous experience
reviews.text: Paradisus was fantastic altogether. We had a wonderful dinner at Lemonfish, an intimate spot in the center of the lobby with outstanding and friendly service from Rafael. Looking forward to the next time!

reviews.author: Amy W
reviews.title: A wonderful family vacation
reviews.text:
Our family of 11 came to Paradisus for a long awaited family vacation, delayed due to Covid.  We had been planning, waiting and hoping for this vacation for 2 years and I can say that it was everything we could have hoped for!  To say the resort is beautiful doesn't begin to give it credit.  The lobbies, the pools, the restaurants are all extraordinarily well presented.  The activities for both kids and adults were varied, plentiful and fun.  Our age group spanned from 7 years old to 70 and there was something to please everyone.  Axcel was terrific at encouraging the younger adults to play beach volleyball, water polo, try the "silks". etc.  The children enjoyed making bracelets, learning magic tricks, making magic wands and potions.  We booked through the Reserve and so Josue and Elliott were most helpful in arranging chairs and Bally Beds for all of us.  Alexis was truly amazing in helping us work out issues with our rooms and housekeeping.  We wish him a very special thank you.  We booked resort photos through Oscar, a very kind and pleasant man.  The photos were taken by Diego and are absolutely amazing!  We were so excited with them!  Hugo, the restaurant manager, was very friendly and accomodating, and we enjoyed Wendy at the Sports Bar.   A speccial word of gratitude goes to Martin and his team at breakfast.  They quickly arranged a table for all 11 of us every morning, brought the boys fruit smoothies and entertained them with napkin animals and balancing tricks.  They made us feel so very special.

We enjoyed the beautiful large pool and the beach.  Only complaint would be that the music is much too loud at the pool in the afternoon  and we couldn't use the Reserve pool (much more quiet) because children are not allowed, even though they were also Reserve bookings.   Also, it would be nice if they enforced the non smoking policies at the pool. The boys loved going to the swim up bar for Mudslides!

The food at the various restaurants is delicious.  Our favorite was Lemon Fish. the setting in the lobby is so lovely,  but the other restaurants were also outstanding.  The coconut custard dessert  at Cielo was memorable!

The staff was the best and truly made our vacation amazing.  We will be back!

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: Best resort I’ve stayed at
reviews.text:
A group of 9 of us had an absolute blast at the Paradisus. By far the best resort I have ever stayed at. Rooms were great, hotel was very clean and the staff we’re always incredible all over the resort

Diana, the groups event planner, was fantastic at checking in to make sure all our reservations and everything went smoothly. Angela was also very helpful in booking our golf out front and making some last minute reservations 

Restaurants were all 10/10 from Blue Agave to Cielo to Lemon fish in the middle. Blue agave had some of the best tacos I’ve ever had. For our large group, each restaurant was able to do a really good spread . We unfortunately didn’t catch many of the servers names but each one was exceptional 

During the day the resort had a great pool bar ( shoutout to Orlando one of the bartenders), volley ball to play, golf at the front of the resort and tons of seats to post up at. At night they had several cool activities - an amazing live band in the bar upstairs, a silent disco one night and some great beach bars where you could rent a hookah in a large booth

Overall an amazing stay and by far the best resort I have stayed at .

reviews.author: Hanna G
reviews.title: Wonderful place & staff
reviews.text:
This hotel is beautiful, peaceful, serves great food, and is made exceptional by the incredibly friendly, kind staff. One server at the buffet whose name we caught was Atilano, but all the staff members at this hotel are truly exceptional at their jobs. We'll come back as soon as we can!

-Hanna and Meg from New York :)

reviews.author: Tanner M
reviews.title: Fernando Sandillan and Carlos  at Capella
reviews.text: Great service and exceptional personality. Very helpful and knowledgeable on items in menu. Fernando Sandillan was the best waiter! The mussels are to die for and if you don’t like them you will here…Come see him at Capalla! And Carlos the manager

reviews.author: Anastasia M
reviews.title: Beautiful vacation!
reviews.text: Paradisus is pure paradise! The staff, food and facilities are outstanding! Norma at check-in, Wen and Fabiola in Guest Services, all concierge staff, Alfredo, Joni and all breakfast staff, Salvador and Karina, Luis and all pool staff, all housekeeping staff and all lunch/dinner restaurant staff have been amazing. If I’m forgetting names, I’m sorry! There are so many staff members to mention by name, because all of the staff are professional, courteous, helpful, hard working and kind. I would absolutely come back to the Paradisus! All you have to do here is relax and enjoy!

reviews.author: Jon M
reviews.title: Great relaxing resort
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed Paradisus Cancun and the relaxing atmosphere.  The facility was modern, clean, and very attractive.  We ate at (7) different venues, organized by our extremely helpful concierge, Violetta, enjoyed them all especially Lemon Fish.  The staff in the buffet, Ignatio, Martin, and Arnulfo were both helpful and entertaining.  The service poolside, lead by Moses, enhanced our relaxed mood.  We would definitely recommend this all inclusive resort and plan to stay in the Reserve section again.

reviews.author: Juan A
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun.
reviews.text:
Best place ever the staff at Malva restaurant and all others were amazing Alfredo Alvaro,Alexis ozuna and Ramiro pech are outstanding. Very helpful and attentive, had my Indio beer ready and my girls mimosas on the spot. My Lil man drank ojs and coke. Food was great and very clean. Was buffet style  but change every day. Paradisus cancun takes care of you. Barrista at the Nespresso lounge was amazing with a Lil extra shot of coffee for that early Start to the pool. Hector over by the cabanas was on point. From bottle service to drinks never disappointed. 
Thank you Jackie's husband Sergio and Big Mikey union brother  for the bottles and cabanas. Great times from Paradisus cancun.

reviews.author: Tanisha M
reviews.title: Another amazing vacation
reviews.text: This is our second trip to Paradisus Cancun and we opted to upgrade to the Reserve - well worth it and we will do so every time!    The staff was so welcoming and cared for our every need.   Violeta was a great concierge - ensured our reservations and looked after us with grace and tact.  Lio at the spa gave me a relaxing massage and body treatment.  Carlos at Cielo restaurant made tasty recommendations and provided elevated dinner service.   Alex and Armando make a great team and keep us taken care of at the buffet - we always had an amazing view and they were so complementary and fun.  Maximillian looked out for us at the pool and Oscar and Moises at Sante took service to a whole nother level.  Charming, funny and perfect menu recommendations.   We cannot wait for our next trip.   Also - if you go to Aquaworld - Mars is the most patient and professional guide  for the snorkeling/jungle tour experience.  He was gracious and accommodating above and beyond expectations.

reviews.author: Deb S
reviews.title: Debbie S.
reviews.text: Oh Paradisus Cancun lived up to its name! Absolute paradise and some of the nicest people! From Antonio who checked us in and ensured we had an appointment for our massages, to our lovely concierge Violeta and our host at the poolside Maximilian who helped us reserve Bali beds and ensured our time by the pool and ocean was superb! Our waiters at all the restaurants and the buffet were so friendly, professional and attentive!! Armando and Alejandro at the Malva buffet, Carlos at Cielo, Alejandro at Lemon Fish, oh and Moises at the Reserve who helped us enjoy some fabulous surf and turf. Dame was my masseuse for the cocoon body treatment, her hands and touch were magic, the scrub was so refreshing and relaxing, my skin was super soft and smooth! Throughout every day, our room was cleaned spotless and every wish provided for by the cleaning and room service staff. Top notch! And I can’t say enough about Mars at Aquaworld! I had never been snorkeling in the sea, so he helped lead me around and keep me safe while holding onto a life preserver with my life jacket on! I got to see all the coral, fish and underwater statues up close and personal with his expert guidance! And the driver and boat staff for the parasailing were wonderful too! This was a vacation to remember, thank you to Paradisus and their supremo staff!

reviews.author: Dani P
reviews.title: Incredible!
reviews.text:
We literally don’t want to leave! We have had the best delayed honeymoon/first anniversary trip we could have ever asked for! Everyone on staff that we encountered was incredible! 

We were immediately met at the door by Victor, who was extremely personable and nice, and escorted to the private Check-in at the Reserve where we were met with drinks and food to begin our stay. Violeta, our personal concierge, met us in the lobby and escorted us to our beautiful room where she helped us make plans for our dinner reservations. She even had the next day off and still contacted us about our dinner and Bali bed reservations! She was incredible and let us know every morning that she was at the resort if we needed anything, and she occasionally met us at the pool just to make sure our stay was going well. 

The Bali beds were so amazing that we didn’t even want to leave them to go on excursions. Our waiters were constantly checking in with us to bring us food or drinks. Julio was so nice and was constantly running around to get things for everyone, and he remembered us the next day which was so cool! Max was always so helpful with setting up our Bali beds and making sure we had everything we needed to enjoy our time by the pool. Jennifer and Axcel on the activities staff were so fun! Jennifer helped us make lizard keychains and bracelets for our family back at home, and Axcel gave us a great water workout and helped us learn how to make incredible ceviche with a wonderful chef (unfortunately I can’t remember his name, but his ceviche was magnificent). We also had the best waiters! They were always so kind and attentive and helped us with choosing what foods/drinks we wanted to try - Miguel at lemon fish, Javier at Capella, Armando at Agua Marina, and Valeria at Sante are only a few of the many amazing servers that we encountered on this trip! The food was always so good! Also, the housekeeping staff - both of the rooms and the communal bathrooms around the resort - were so great! We rarely ever saw them but the bathrooms were always so pristine.
