We truly had the best time and are definitely recommending this stay to friends and family and will hopefully be able to come back soon ourselves!

reviews.author: Daniel K
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is Paradise!
reviews.text:
We stayed as a couple from Switzerland the first time at The Reserve adults only section of the Paradisus Cancun for 14 nights. Visiting Mexico for the first time, we didn`t know what to expect. But what we experienced at this beautiful resort was absolutelly awesome! 
A very clean, very well kept hotel with great, helpful and very friendly staff, very friendly and hard-working waiters and a personal assistent, a so called "buttler", who organized everything and was there for any wish we had!
We highly recomend this resort to anyone, who would like to experience a dream holiday! 
Many thanks to the manager Alexis, who let us stay for free until 7 pm in our room, since our flight was only at midnight. Also to our "buttler" Violeta, who took care of all the wishes we had and was always there for us, and to the waiters Oscar, Martin, Alexis, Orlando ant the rest of the waiters for the great service!
I will share my expeience with my cousin Sascha, the owner of Kompass Travel Switzerland. This resort, especially The Reserve section, fulfills the high quality standards of Swiss travelers!

reviews.author: Mayiyot
reviews.title: Employees is what makes Melia a home away from home!!
reviews.text: We are Club Melia members and we always come back to Melia anywhere we go ( Mexico, Punta Cana, Paris) we recently visited Paradisus Cancun for the 2nd time. We had a great time!! guys at the sports bar, Nurby (my favorite)!! Also, Pedro, Melissa and Mauro are awesome too!! They are always attentive with our needs.. Even the DJ Daniel is up to date with all new and popular music! The guys at the buffet (Martin and Arnulfo) are very nice and funny they have our spot reserved every morning.. Darwin and Antonio at the Enso restaurant are very polite and knowledgeable.. Ian at the Cello restaurant is amazing.. We had him pick our dinner and he did not disappoint.. our food (which aian picked for us) were all amazing. Very nice and cordial guy.. Hector at the beach cabana waited on us everytime he’s a very patient and quick with our orders.. We have a concierge, which was a little disappointing because she is not like the other concierges that we had in the past who would make anything possible for us when it comes to reserving dinner(not very accommodating). From the time we mer with her, she had work restrictions which we understand but everytime we ask her for something(dinner reservations)  theres always a conflict or not possible to get a specific time. So I ended up booking our own dinner the on our last night and it took me not even 2minutes. But thats ok she just missed out on a good tip. But nonetheless we had a fab time.

reviews.author: Mariela N
reviews.title: Memorable experiences!
reviews.text:
My family stayed at paradisus for the 8th or 9th time and the wonderful thing about this hotel is that it can always surprise us more. The staff is always very sweet and dedicated! I would like to highlight Rosanna GuestRelations manager, Miguel, hospitality manager, and Djordje, who was the family's butler for the second year. Excellent service with memorable experiences! Thank you all and heading to the tenth year of hosting with you. With all my best, 
Mariela Neubauer

reviews.author: Rong G
reviews.title: Excellent guest service in Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: Thank you so much Wen who helped me a lot as the personnel in guest service! When I have trouble or questions during my stay in Cancún, she always responded me as soon as she can! Thank you again, for this excellent experience!

reviews.author: Kema
reviews.title: Lemon Fish restaurant inside Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Excellent food! Alejandro Cob is an excellent server. His recommendations were exactly what I needed. What more can I say? Delicious food, drinks and great service! I visited every restaurant available at this resort. I have zero complaints. They were so kind to celebrate my birthday with me.

Photos by Fernanda at Outdoor Photos was an excellent experience. My photos are very professional and all of my family loved them. Please ask for Fernanda if you get photos!

reviews.author: Ilse R
reviews.title: Paradise!!
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of staying at The Reserve Paradisus with family members. To start what a beautiful resort! Our butler Violeta H. was absolutely amazing! She made sure we were taken care of the entire time. Violeta made sure to schedule our dinners, accommodations (next door to each other so no family members got lost) and answered ALL of our questions. The customer service was SUPERB! She really took the time to get to know us and to make sure we were taken care of. We also dubbed at the buffet DELICIOUS every day for breakfast where Martin was out waiter! He remembered our names and would greet us with a smile daily! Martin made us feel at home and made fresh juice for us if the kind we wanted was not available! WOW. We were blown away by the atmosphere and the wonderful experience. Max at the Reserve cabanas was very nice and he always made sure to show us the best options and made reserving a spot easy and stress free! Overall just a wonderful vacation surrounded by excellent service. The views, the service, look no further than Paradisus! Be sure and ask for Ms. Violeta as your butler! And book the Reserve! It’s the adults only section and HIGHLY WORTH IT! We will be going back soon! Ms. Violeta thank you for everything!!

reviews.author: Ahna P
reviews.title: The Reserve is worth it!
reviews.text: If you are traveling with no children, upgrading to the reserve is worth it.  Concierge services, adult pool, and great food!  Oscar is an amazing poolside server, who is very attentive.  The sunset cocktail class was also fun!  Also a shout out to Max who works hard to oversee all the Bali beds.

reviews.author: marymccabe
reviews.title: Fabulous!!
reviews.text:
Fabiola from customer services went above and beyond to help us!!
She was great!
Thank you Fabiola 
The food was top shelf. The hotel is spotless and housekeeping comes twice a day to clean your room. All the service is absolutely wonderful! They bend over backwards for you. 
We felt like royalty!

reviews.author: Mike W
reviews.title: Friends Trip
reviews.text: We had a friends trip the last week of February. For the most part everything was awesome. The rooms were kind of dark and our fridge was in the middle of the floor but they were very clean and spacious. The restaurants were very good and the food was delicious. Guadencio (he told us to call him Mr. G) was a great entertainer. Him and the other staff on the patio at the buffet never left our drinks empty. We also rented pool Cabanas for 2 days, which is definitely worth it. We had the absolute pleasure of having Victor Rodriguez assist us not only for our cabana days but also the 2 restaurants we ate at later those nights. All of the staff were wonderful and friendly.

reviews.author: CS041
reviews.title: Amazing experience at Paradisus Cancún... The Reserve is WOW!
reviews.text:
Where do I begin... This experience was nothing short of amazing!  I stayed in The Reserve pyramid in a one-bedroom ocean view suite with my family.  We were joined by friends and family; a group of 4 suites.  All received the same amazing service by our concierge, Aaron.  Violeta assisted us as well, and was equally awesome.

Everything was arranged from the start, from dinner reservations to reserved bali beds by the pool.  Daniel from the Guest Services team including, lead by Rossana, were there from the beginning and addressed all of our needs.

This property is an all-inclusive, and that means all-inclusive.  Liquors are top-shelf (request what you would like) and dining is 5-star.  The entertainment is unbelievable!  One night we went to the silent party, which had several DJ's and neon headphones.  What a blast!

The Kids Club was another highlight... Andrea, Axcel and Celeste were amazing.  Our children are 2 years old, and the Baby Club was closed, but they still played in the Kids Club.  Management:  Please open the Baby Club!  

Also, we used the babysitting services with Liliana, who also is an amazing aesthetician in their spa.

One evening we attended a special dinner at Sal Steak Cave.  What an experience!  The manager, Joel, assured an unforgettable experience.

My two cents:  Go for The Reserve... It's worth it!  The private check-in/check-out, concierge service, private bar, private restaurants, private pool, reserved bali beds... Wow!

This is definitely my top hotel in Cancún.  Thank you, Paradisus Cancún, for a wonderful trip!

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: Family vacation!
reviews.text:
My family of 4 (2 girls, both age 5) just came back from our vacation here in the end of February. We stayed in the one bedroom ocean view room. We were not in the reserve. We had a wonderful vacation, I would rate this resort around 3 1/2 stars. I’ll start with the positives, The resort itself is absolutely beautiful! The service and all the staff here were pleasant and kind. The activity staff who hosted activities in the pool  were all very good with the children. The breakfast buffet was very good, lunch was ok. The beach is beautiful. The pool staff will help you set up if you’re looking for a spot and the pool is crowded. COVID testing to return home was quick and easy!! The spa was amazing and they had a special at check in for $115 for a 50 minute massage!!! Also, on Sunday they had all these fun blowups in the main pool and an inflatable slip and slide in the pool. That was a lot of fun!!! We felt very safe at the resort and all the other places we visited while in Cancun!!

For negatives, the pool is not heated. I can see this not being an issue in the summer and warmer months, but when it’s an 85 degree day, it needs some heat, especially in the morning!!! It’s the only resort I’ve ever been to that you are completely alone in the pool at 9:30 am, because it’s freezing cold!! My kids were literally shivering in the pool!! 

One of the biggest negatives for me was the alcohol. It is without a doubt, watered down. I had like 900 bloody Mary’s and felt 100% sober. The only reason we were considering switching to reserve was for the better alcohol choices, I’d be pretty angry if we paid extra for this and got watered down alcohol. The only time I ever felt a buzz was for the dinners when we left the resort. 

The room was nice, however I was upset that we upgraded from lagoon view to ocean view because during the day we had to keep the shades closed because the AC was so weak and we were told to help keep the room somewhat cool, we’d need to keep the shades closed during the day. So there was literally no point in the upgrade. Luckily we weren’t in the room too much during the day, but most days we came back around 3 or 3:30, and the view we paid for would have been nice. I can’t imagine the temperature of this room in July. 

The food was ok. Nothing special. The first night we ate at Capella, the Italian restaurant. It was mediocre. We decided for the remaining nights to leave the resort for dinners. We went to Porfirio’s, Rosa Negra, Harry’s and Hacienda Sesal for the remaining nights, all were fantastic. So my recommendation is do not upgrade to reserve. Give yourself a real upgrade and leave the resort for dinners!!!

reviews.author: mermaid12
reviews.title: Pleased at Paradisus!
reviews.text: After multiple visits, we still enjoy this hotel! The pool and beach is amazing, the rooms are great… and the best part is the service provided by a hardworking, engaged staff.  The dining options were convenient and our favorite was the breakfast! With so many wonderful choices.

reviews.author: N K
reviews.title: Cancun 2022 - J&N
reviews.text:
Upgraded to reserve and loved the experience.
Julio and Max did a great job at the reserve pool.
Wendy was amazing in the ginger bar. 
Jennifer did a great job getting us excited and interested in the activities. 

We will definitely come back. Met some wonderful people.

reviews.author: Taylor A
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: I had to work every day from 8-4:30 but Rodrigo from Entertainment made sure that I knew every activity for the rest of the night and made sure I had a great time! Also, Saul, Mary, Nicole, Adriana & Jennifer made sure that I had everything I needed during my stay.

reviews.author: inna m
reviews.title: Amazing!!!!
reviews.text:
Came with my 2 kids and my friend with her son. I was not booked reserved and honestly felt no need for it.

We had an absolute amazing time. Everything was really great. The food and drinks were definitely above my expectations. So delicious!!!! The service everywhere from each restaurant, buffet, bartenders, beach servers ect.... was above and beyond. These people were so extremely pleasant and accommodating. Please please please tip them. They went unpaid without work for 6 months. No one offered this info to me. I asked.
Coffee here is so delicious, ask for bailys in yours.
Kids always had some sort of entertainment. 
I emailed ahead of time for reservations and I promptly received all of my requests fulfilled. 
Nothing negative to say. The room was small but extremely clean and i barely spend time there anyways. They even had a welcome pack in my room with masks, gloves and hand sanitizer.

reviews.author: Hadiyah B
reviews.title: Friendly staff exceptional service
reviews.text: My stay was great. My concierge Alberto was perfect and went above and beyond to make sure me and my family had everything from rides to reservations. Our server on the beach Sergio also was amazing. Beautiful location. Stay in the reserve for sure. The food is great for a resort. All the staff were friendly.

reviews.author: Zenette D
reviews.title: Wonderful week at Paradisus!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus the week of March 22nd and had a fabulous time. The rooms were beautiful and service was top notch. Our Butler Galdino was amazing and accommodating to our needs. Shoutout to Oscar at La Palapa who was also our waiter for our private beachside dinner. Yamil & Ruben were also amazing. Liliana at the YHI Spa also gave the best deep tissue massage I've ever had. Overall the experience was wonderful and we will be back soon. Pro Tip - pay the extra for the Reserve experience. It was well worth the price.

reviews.author: Alban F
reviews.title: Not so bad
reviews.text:
I was not disappointed but I was not impressed. For the price, the standard of the room was average, clean and comfortable but need renovation (at leat for the paid price). The food is good but not amazing. It is true there is a lot of variety and it is of quality, but not gourmet at all as I can see in other reviews.
The very plus is the staff, very service focused, especially in restaurant and customer service. Except the staff at the beach, very sales agressive (selling you scuba diving or motor bike) and even not polite.

reviews.author: Renato D
reviews.title: Bana sushi paradisus
reviews.text:
Bana restaurant was so good and Rafael and Guilherme  gave us a really nice service during our dinner.
Great experience, from the start to the desert. The restaurant was beautiful and good vibes around.

reviews.author: Storyteller826343
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: We had a great experience!  I want to specifically thank Oscar & Daniel at La Palapa; Max @ The Reserve Pool; Our Butler Rodolfo; Yamil & Ruben @ the Reserve Pool; Jorge our waiter at Bana; Thank you everyone!!!

reviews.author: Liz W
reviews.title: Excellent as usual
reviews.text:
Another great trip to Paradisus in the Reserve. Good food and amazing service which sets it apart from other places I’ve stayed. Special shout outs and thank yous for making our vacation so great:
Malva:  Armando, Vincente, Orlando, Ignacio
Bana:  Raphael, Christian 
Reserve Pool:  Daniel, Yamil, Oscar, Moises, Max
Vento:  Jesus

I stand behind the 5 stars because we had an amazing time but there were a few things off this trip. We were placed in building 3 instead of building 5 for the Reserve which was a disappointment; rooms weren’t as nice, patio was small etc.  Being in building 3 also meant that we got to listen to the 100 loud spring break kids all night. This was not the elevated, adult-centric experience I’ve come to expect (and paid for) from the Reserve. 

Also, I’ve had amazing butlers in the past and ours was terrible.  She gave my parents no tour, didn’t review our preference sheet or note any of my correspondence with Reserve concierge in advance, didn’t explain the resort offerings, nothing.  It was a bare minimum effort at best. 

Lastly, it was much better when it was Royal Service (sans kids).  Will I come back?  Absolutely. The service and reserve pool are top notch.

reviews.author: VIS
reviews.title: Cancún
reviews.text: Best place to stay and eat, good for kids and adults,  friendly staff ( Reception Ceci, Butler  Aaron, Pools  Cornelius, Victor, Restaurants Juan, Buffet  Orlando,Alfredo, Ignacio and more). We highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Daniel B
reviews.title: Best relaxing vacations ever
reviews.text:
To celebrate my wife and I were already vaccinated and to end the long quarantine we decided to fly to Cancun with the kids. We chose this hotel based on the reviews and their safety covid measures.  

We also followed the recommendation to upgrade to the RESERVE and it was the best!  Our personal Buttler was Rodolfo and he was amazing!  Always checking up on us making sure every day we had reservations to all the different restaurants and the bali beds in the pool.   

At the pool we had great service by Rene, Manuel and Victor.   They were super nice and attentive making sure we always had drinks and food.    At check in Miguel was super friendly and gave us very detailed options for the upgrade and Rubí showed us different room options taking us to each room so my picky wife could decide which one she liked better.

We usually never repeat vacation spots or hotels, but this one definetly will be a repeat exception.

reviews.author: Live your best life!
reviews.title: Go see Richer at the Nespresso bar!!
reviews.text: Do not miss out on Richer at the Nespresso bar!! He made every morning perfect- wouldn’t be able to get through the day without his friendly service, smile, and delicious coffee drinks! Thank you Richer!

reviews.author: Syeda T
reviews.title: So Amazing!
reviews.text: My friends and I came to Paradisus for a short 4 day trip. The hotel itself is gorgeous and looks truly like paradise. There are great day and night activities. The food is great, I recommend the Fuego restaurant. The restaurant manager, Guillermo, was super friendly and attentive. The hotel staff as a whole is wonderful, kind and incredibly respectful, especially Abel, Alejandro, and Luis! We loved our stay and hope to be back soon!

reviews.author: Asha
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The manager Sandra made our visit so amazing . She made sure we were so comfortable.  Also Malania who works for the reserve, she's amazing. These 2 ladies made our visit so amazing in every way. This place has the best views, the best food and entertainment. Amazing clean place

reviews.author: Trisha H
reviews.title: Beautiful place!!
reviews.text: The environment is beautiful and the service was fantastic. The food was the only missing link in our stay. We were thrilled with the beach and the friendliness of the staff. We were also a little shocked that there were children in the Reserve portion of our hotel.

reviews.author: Courtney R
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The resort was amazing and the wait staff was awesome. They were always there for anything and everything we needed. We had the reserve service and our concierge and butler were wonderful. Very helpful. Always had them with a text, even on their days off they would help.

reviews.author: Sami M
reviews.title: Really good service
reviews.text: This was a great place to stay at, came here with a family and we all had a great time. All the people here were really nice and caring and treated us like family. They all seemed happy to be here and very helpful. Martin, Orlando, Angel, Rafael, Luis, and many more that I can’t remember took really good care of us and treated us like family. Would recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: Amy F
reviews.title: Best service!!!!
reviews.text: Orlando Angel Rafael Martin all the ladies are soooo above and beyond for everything. The most amazing service! These workers deserve the best tips!  Bring cash for tipping everyone please! It’s the least we can do! So much personality we appreciate all of you. Thank you for making our stay amazing! (Family of 10)

reviews.author: Rigoberto L
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: We visited the Mexican restaurant at our last night at Paradisus Hotel.  The food was different however we were pleasantly surprised.  It showed true Mexican cuisine and tasted the different spices from the region.  The service was espectacular from the beginning.  Our waiter Noe was very helpful in guiding us to choose the right meal.  Gaby his captain made sure  we were well taken care of and brought us a wonderful treat when she found out it was the last night of our trip!!   Amazing service and amazing meal.

reviews.author: Ryan M
reviews.title: Honest review in depth-  the reserve - March 2021
reviews.text:
Upon arrival we were met by Raul who gathered our luggage and gave us a slip to get checked in. Check in process is rather long but they get you drinks while the paperwork is conducted. We stayed in the adults only upgrade section. The perks advertised online that I read about (Royal service) included daily spa admittance, butler service, special dining (palapa) , Bali beds, and special pools. While it is mostly still accurate, apparently Royal service is no longer a thing and it was changed to the reserve. Only difference that i noticed is that you no longer get an hour of spa time (hydrotherapy). The adult section was very quiet and due to the covid capacity restrictions it was probably at under 50% occupancy. There was no trouble finding loungers in the sun, or beach front loungers, I was even able to get a Bali bed with ocean views (there is only like 5 of them with ocean views so reserve in advance). The adult section also is the only area that has lounger beds in the pool. The pool bar is only on the regular side of the resort. Also they had music and inflatables for kids on the main pool area. The butler service was underwhelming. It’s also good to know that the reserve section has an top shelf bar in the lobby of building 5, I believe pre covid you got your own drinks, but now they have a worker there to fix you drinks.

Butler service- While our concierge was polite we didn’t really see her, most communication was through “WhatsApp”. The concierge is responsible for making dinner reservations for you, which she booked without asking us if we wanted to eat at those particular places. After explaining we don’t eat sushi it was corrected and we ate at places we chose. She did pull through and get us into a fully booked restaurant which was nice. I also felt bad for her bc her hours were weird (3-11) and she would message us while not at work. I would think, unless it was for a personal matter that she needed to work 3-11 that the resort would have a scheduled concierge on site for most of the morning hours. I spoke to other people staying at the resort who had similar issues with their concierge. While it isn’t a big deal or anything, the website and reviews I read about the upgraded service really embellish the butler service, so I was slightly disappointed in that aspect.  

Dining- we ate at mole, ensos, fuego, and vento. I believe tempo the five star extra resteraunt has been replaced with sals steakhouse. Mole was Mexican dining, ensos was international foods, fuego was a lot of seafood,  but a couple non seafood items, vento was Italian. Most foods In the actual resteraunts were very good. We tried the food at sunset grill, a takeout place next to the main pool. Do yourself a favor and skip that, we had the burger, hotdog and nachos all kind of gross. The main buffet attached to fuego served pretty good food with a big variety of selection of foods and deserts. My favorite place to eat is la palapa, which is only for people in the reserve. It is only open for breakfast and lunch. Food is amazing and we made sure to go every day for both. Get the French toast! 

Service: all the workers really try to make your time there special. They go above and beyond. The wait time by the pool for someone to come by and take your order was hit and miss. There were times you couldn’t finish a drink and others where you may have to go to the bar and get it yourself. It was fine though, I don’t think the average person would mind given the attention you typically receive. I would like to particularly shout out Abel from ensos, Julio from the buffet and Omar at vento for their  service. The other servers were just as good but I forgot their names. Max at the towel stand and Bali reservations also was very helpful at getting me the Bali bed I wanted.

My wife and I walked the beach and the other neighboring resorts at least from the beach did not look like they even compare to paradisus. The sheer size and amenities they offer are really top notch. While it is quite expensive it does pull through with the service and views. We stayed lagoon side, which is the side of sunsets. The room was nice, I saw reviews saying it needs updating, but I don’t think that’s really necessary. The view of the lagoon was decent but the Reserve building  is directly across from a gas station and a strip of resteraunts that’s all lit up at night which is basically your view but it beats looking at other resorts. It provides good privacy. 

Entertainment: aqua world is on site by the main pool to set up water excursions. I would look at their website for prices. They are located across the street from the resort. The main excursion desk is in the lobby. The resort entertainment seemed kind of lame but i don’t know what else they could do.. the entertainment mostly consists of dancing shows, such as solo acrobats/ break dancing which was not bad, the other I partially watched during dinner was a belly dancing show by the pool. I would suggest maybe a magician or aquatics show for the resort. The night club is under construction. They did silent discos and had a musician in the lobby area on some of the nights I was there. Building 3 is where the entertainment goes on. Building 5 (-adults only ) is very quiet and has aromas pumped into the main areas

Housekeeping: the housekeeper was the best I’ve ever seen. She folded all our clothes, organized everything for us, and even removed the hair from my wife’s hair brush. I’ve never heard of such care before this trip. I never got to meet her so I can’t give her a shout out but she was exceptional.

Dislikes: I did not like the high pressure sales tactics some of the employees attempted. Occasionally in the lobby and pool area people will try to get you to do a sit down about “too good to be true offers”. I did not go to the Melia app event, which sounded a lot like a timeshare program, even though they denied it being that. I was upset that a vendor at the pool show that was selling fake cohibas but with the vendor being approved to be on resort grounds I felt it gave the vendor more credibility that he was selling authentic merchandise. 

Pro tip: the photographers onsite told us people in the reserve section get 3 free photos with a free photo shoot with the opportunity to buy extras at $20 a piece. This was one of the things that sounded to good to be true but we gave it a shot, I waited for the catch once we sat down but they didn’t pressure us to buy anything but we bought an extra 2 photos and tipped them for their time since they didn’t try and scam us. They said they don’t advertise it, so double check that they are still doing that if you book an appointment. They do wonderful work.

I hope this review helps you make a educated decision. I read a lot of reviews prior to going and I tried to add in all the things I wondered about.

reviews.author: P20210320
reviews.title: Not a 5 ⭐️ experience
reviews.text: If this was a 4 star hotel then it would be decent experience, the property is very run down. Their best room is far below the standard. Duck taped walls, scratches everywhere, noisy hallway... Very positive experience was with all the staff around the hotel. Great people service - friendly, attentive, fast. Only issue is the building itself which is outdated.

reviews.author: missmikki1616
reviews.title: SAVE YOUR MONEY & GO SOMEWHERE ELSE!!!!
reviews.text: Rude staff! We paid a lot of money to not even be allowed to eat!!!!!! Room had issues! Check in took 2 hours at the least... Check in lady was sooo RUDE!!! You have to use the Melia App & it doesn't work!!!!! Every time we made dinner reservations we got a call saying were not allowed to go beacuse the "APP" has issues and they are overbooked!!! THIS IS NOT AN ALL INCLUSIVE RESORT!!!!

reviews.author: Jasmin E
reviews.title: Birthday Trip
reviews.text:
This was my first trip to this hotel and to Cancun. I stood at Paradisus because it was highly recommended. I must say that it was worth the stay. From the moment I arrive, Raul (baggage guy) was very welcoming and very attentive to all our 15 bags. When headed to reception area to check in to our rooms, Julian was great, very courteous and professional. 

Our stay was perfect. When we went to go eat at Fuego (Malva), hostess Amayrani accommodated all of us to sit together. She was very friendly and professional and treated us all with respect. Our waiters Gaudencio and Reynaldo were the best. Gaudencio always made sure we had a smile on our faces. His service as well as Reynaldo was on point, friendly, courteous, professional, and made sure that our cups were never empty. 

The beach waiters... Omg...were amazing! From Jorge, Manuel, Josue and Rene were very attentive and on point. They were all very respectful, amicable, courteous, professional and they made sure we were ok with our food and drinks. 

So we decided to do excursions so I went to see Jerry from Aqua World Activities. Jerry made sure to accommodate all of us on the excursions. I also dealt with David, Esteban and Samuel as we had a change of plan due to the Covid-19 testing prior to leaving. However, these guys did an exceptional job in accommodating us to our last excursion. They went above and beyond to make sure they made it happen. 

I must say that this was the BEST and AMAZING birthday vacation ever, despite losing my phone in the beach water. The Life Guards at the beach did help me search for my phone. They saw my distress and did what they can to help me. 

I highly recommend going and staying at Paradisus Hotel. I know that I do plan on going again just to have see and have fun with these wonderful people.

reviews.author: Allison L
reviews.title: Far exceeded our expectations...first trip since Covid last year!
reviews.text: Absolutely one of the best vacations ever. Kindest staff, impeccable grounds, stunning views, and service was was beyond amazing! The Reserve is a must! Our daughter went to the kids zone while we had a Bali Bed all day. Perfect!

reviews.author: Amanda M
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Paradisus is the ultimate all inclusive spot. We had a access to the best food and drinks the whole time. There were events everywhere we turned: tequila tasting, floaters, Disney shows, and pool parties. Agustin showed us the the best places To be and party - we had a great time. Every restaurant we went to had amazing food- mole served us bone marrow and bana had unlimited sushi... incredible place.

reviews.author: rach f
reviews.title: Relaxing in Cancun
reviews.text:
Resort is beautiful! Easy and quick ride from the airport.

Room: I had a deluxe ocean view (renovated) room and it was beautiful, very clean as well. Only complaint was the safe which first they didn't even give us keys for then twice stopped working but the staff was there quickly to fix, still annoying.

Restaurants: Hard to get reservations at some restaurants. Also,  be careful if you aren't in the "reserve area" with a private concierge area; multiple people will try to get you reservation which can be confusing and result in double bookings.  
Favorite was the Italian...amazing! We were only successful in getting reservations there one night, seemed like the preferred restaurant. Jimmy was our server and went above and beyond to make our experience the best. 

Bana was also great. The atmosphere was fun and the food was great!

Blue Agave, sat for 20 min without service past dropping off a water; got up and walked out. 

Beach- great, expect bigger waves. At the non reserve side of the resort there is a lifeguard stand but no lifeguard.  Service was excellent at the pool and down at the beach,

Additional activities are lacking but I assume that was due to covid.

reviews.author: Michelle U
reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text: Stayed at Paradisus (the reserve) for 7 nights and everything was excellent. Our butler Violeta was awesome and she stayed in touch every day of our stay making sure we were receiving the best quality of service. She was extremely helpful and attentive. We will definitely be back soon!

reviews.author: V M
reviews.title: Customer service done right
reviews.text: The meal was great, as we've grown accustomed to at Paradisus.  But what stood out tonight was the service provided by Pascual.  We asked for a spicy margarita.  He came back with what was a disappointing offering..not what we had in mind. Upon learning of our discontent, he went the extra mile, found some fresh Serrano peppers and got us a couple of amazing drinks. That little gesture made all the difference. Bravo, Pascual.  Excellent service

reviews.author: Fernanda G
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort - All inclusive
reviews.text:
Clean, safe, friendly staff, excellent service. The beach is beautiful the resort offered everything we needed on the 5 days we spent there as a family. Activities for our daughters ages 7 and 11, six different restaurant options, beach and pool service made our stay the most perfect and deserved spring break vacation! We absolutely loved Melia Paradisus and we are already planning when we'll be back.
Would like to mention Gaby at the Mole restaurant that gave us a lesson about Mexican gastronomy and it was amazing.

reviews.author: Cecilfamily2018
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: My family loved being here in Cancun. The water was beautiful and the service was amazing at our resort. Vicktor C was amazing and had impeccable service. He was kind and was on top of everything. The whole family loved him.

reviews.author: mmeyers477
reviews.title: Amazing Reserve experience
reviews.text:
Staying at the Reserve within Paradisus Cancun was absolutely the right choice. Having access to the Reserve-only restaurant and relaxing pool area was invaluable. 

The staff were incredibly attentive, especially our concierge assistant Violeta, and the whole resort was perfect. I will definitely be returning to Paradisus when I return to Cancun

reviews.author: K & K Smith
reviews.title: Anniversary trip 2021
reviews.text: We had a great time during our stay.  The best customer service as always! Our butler Violeta was awesome, she took care of all of our reservations. Ruben,  Moses and Val were awesome at the pool and Lapapla. Daniel was all over it! He was always asking us if we were doing good and if we needed anything.  Max took great care of us at the pool always checking on us and always friendly! The customer service is above and beyond! They all are so friendly and love what they do and it shows! David from YiSpa was amazing,  booked our massages and checked on us the next day to make sure we had a great massage! Intzel and Lorietta were awesome for both messages! We highly recommend the Reserve at Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Leslie B
reviews.title: Restaurant Mole!
reviews.text: Carlos and Melvin are wonderful!  Excellent service!   They did a great job with dinner and our service all evening. We enjoyed watching the special coffee be made and how nice they were all for our table.

reviews.author: rhansfor
reviews.title: Great Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: My wife and I have been back for a week, we had a great time we had a great butler Djordge who took care of all our reservations and was very accommodating to our needs. All restaurants were very good and our servers were so friendly and great. The resort itself was beautiful, room was so clean and the lady who cleaned out room was nice enough to make it personal instead of not having any idea who comes in your room, such a caring lady. We will definitely be back as we had a great memorable time. The only complaint was the cold pool in the reserve, but that is really searching for a negative. The staff here works so hard to make your experience great, we can't thank them enough for making our anniversary memorable.

reviews.author: Matt W
reviews.title: Expectations = REACHED
reviews.text:
I really don't even know where to start.. this place is unbelievable! After spending hours looking for hotels and reading so many different reviews, my girlfriend and I decided to stay at the Paradisus. And wow did we make a great choice! From the location, to the food, to the accommodations, to the all the staff and their top notch service.. I can go on and on. I really don't understand how this place isn't rated higher or praised more.. 

Location- Amazing. Right in the middle of the strip. Beach is very well kept with plenty of places to sit, lay, and relax.

Hotel- BEAUTIFUL. I still can't get over the lobby and just how well thought out the design of it all is. Gf and I walked through the place many times just for the fun of it. The ambience and the smells alone are so soothing... sounds weird but you'll understand what I mean once you get there!

Rooms- I can't speak for all the rooms but our room in particular was pretty freakin great.. One of the few rooms in the hotel that has 2 balconies, one in the main bedroom and one in THE BATHROOM! Beds were great and the balcony view even better. 

Food- SO MUCH to choose from... a bunch of different restaurants within the resort with so much variety. Seafood, Mexican, Asian, Italian, etc... every one of them had it's own flair and really felt like we were eating at higher end restaurants. It was wonderful.

Service- 100 out of 10. I dont think I walked past a single employee that didn't greet hello.. some of the nicest people you'll meet. As a reserve guest, we were fortunate enough to be treated even better by our wonderful personal butler, Rodolfo, who took great care of us throughout the week and made sure we didn't have to do a thing... 

The Reserve- We didn't choose to do the reserve until we checked in at the front desk but man was it worth the upgrade.. especially if this is a couples trip. From the complimentary room service, the premium bar access, the private pool area and restaurant, it was definitely worth the extra cash. The butler service alone was worth it! Rodolfo took care of all of our reservations to dinner and spa so we didn't have to worry about a thing.. thats what a true vacation is all about isn't it! Everyone else at the reserve lobby too was so helpful with any other questions we had, George in particular! Super cool dude. The fifth pyramid in the resort is also quite the place.. such a beautiful lobby. Breakfast at La Palapa was something to look forward to every day. The food and staff there were tremendous. Also, a HUGE shoutout to Max, the reserve pool manager. Very cool guy and was always on top of making sure our cabana reservation was in order!

Overall, I don't mean to hype this place too much, but I think it truly is well deserved. Far exceeded any expectations my girlfriend and I had coming into this. Was hoping to explore other spots in the future but we might have to come back here instead!

reviews.author: Amina S
reviews.title: Ms
reviews.text: Esteban was amazing! He made my experience at Bana so memorable. He even did something special for my birthday. 10/10 will definitely be coming back and requesting Esteban. We highly recommend coming!

reviews.author: Robert G
reviews.title: Reserve @ Paradisus Cacun During Covid
reviews.text:
Stayed @ the Reserve @ Paradisus Cancun in Mid-March 2021 during the Covid-19 restrictions. Covid-19 safety precautions are in place and strictly followed by hotel staff. This is the first time I have stayed @ the Reserve since it was promoted as Royal Services. First thing I noticed is that the private check in in Tower 5 had moved to the lobby entrance part of the hotel. The next thing I noticed is that Tower 5 which used to be for adults only now permits children. 
The high point is the Palapa restaurant were I ate all of my meals except dinner. Daniel and his team are top notch and ready to do anything to make your stay a pleasant one. Poll side service is top notch from waiters and the pool attendants.
The hotel and room was clean and well maintained. Cleaning service was excellent.Butler/concierge service was adequate but not as friendly as in the past.
Restaurants were I ate dinner get a mixed review. I give 5 stars to the "Palapa" restaurant. I give 4 stars to "Enso" "Vento" and "Bana" and 3 stars to "Fuego"

reviews.author: Veronica M
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text:
From the moment I walked into the hotel, the staff greeted me with welcoming and warm attitude. I was immediately introduced to Malu, Betsy and Ale, which were a pleasure to work with. For most of my trip, our Concierge  Ale took care of all of our needs and questions without fail, and without headache. Not only was her organization punctual but her attitude was always bright and helpful. All the staff from waiters to cleaning crew, to bus boys, and entertainment were all friendly and delightful to be around. If you choose to stay at the Paradisus Hotel in Cancun, be sure to ask for Ale(Congierge), Malu( Congierge), Besty( Registration), Eddin(Waiter), Jose( Waiter), Christian(Waiter) and Augustin( Entertainment).

On a different note, we did have some issues with the electricity in the room twice, but they sent someone right away on both occasions and fixed the issue right away. I also had issues with the freezing the safe(my fault) and someone immediately came to resolve the issue. We also had trouble with our room accommodations, please make sure you have it listed correctly on your confirmation BEFORE arrival, as this was difficult to undo...

Other than that, 

Thank you all for an unforgettable experience ❤

reviews.author: melanyleavitt
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!
reviews.text: This resort is top notch. The service was impeccable it was extremely clean and people were friendly. We stayed in the reserve and it was a wonderful experience. Our butler Djordje was always available and extremely accommodating. The only thing I believe we missed out on with some of the cool adult activities in the reserve. We were unaware of when those things were happening and on our last day saw couples making handmade bags. That would’ve been fun for my husband and I since it was our anniversary.

reviews.author: Inspire517563
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: My husband and I just returned from paradisus cancun and had the most amazing time!  Everything was perfect  from our butler Rodolfo to the staff at the adult pool, Max, Moses, Oscar, Miguel, Daniel, and Valerie at the restaurant.  Thank you for making our trip so very special. We will most definitely return! We miss our new friends there already. I would definitely recommend this beautiful resort.  The service was spectacular!

reviews.author: Russell S
reviews.title: paradise
reviews.text: The staff, pools, beach and great location make this the perfect all inclusive to visit.  Food was very good and had an abundance of choices.  The staff at the breakfast buffet were terrific...Shout out to Julian Ortega who helped us switch rooms. The first room was noisy and in front of the pool.  They moved us to a private room on the eighth floor.  The beach here is spectacular and they even have a heated pool. Also the entertainment was great.  Especially liked the rock n roll night with live music. Will go again!

reviews.author: Samantha P
reviews.title: Awesome Family Getaway
reviews.text: This was more amazing than expected and an awesome trip for our family of 7 adults! Their attention to COVID safety was exceptional, but we were still able to relax and forget about the difficulties of these times. The beach is the most beautiful we have seen, and the layout of the resort makes everything simple and convenient. The wait staff at the pool were exceptional. We spent most of our time at the pool and even chose to eat lunch there because we loved the food so much. Didier, Victor and Samuel were beyond attentive, and we were sad to say goodbye to the friendships we made with them and other guests at the pool during our stay. These waiters remembered everyone's names, everyone's favorite drinks, and delivered fast and in great spirits. They really made our trip. If we could have eaten dinner at the pool, we would have. Haha. The nightly entertainment at Ginger lounge was great too. The only complaint I could give was the quality of food and service at some of the dinner restaurants. But, I still give it 5 stars, since they are just getting back to being busy and making adjustments to servicing and satisfying a larger population. This place handled it great and it never felt crowded or unsafe. We would love to come back.

reviews.author: leirabanillo
reviews.title: Very relaxing and they spoiled us!
reviews.text: This place perfect in every way; luxurious, relaxing, food is amazing, the service is outstanding and cleanliness is definitely excellent . Our butler name is Rodolfo, he went above and beyond. And we have the nicest servers as well - Alejandro, David, Sergio, Augustine, Eddier, Rafael, Yvonne, Jesus, and Melina. Everyone is super nice and helpful! We can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: ncsun711
reviews.title: Love Paradisus!!
reviews.text: My daughter and I just got back from the best vacation ever! Paradisus in Cancun! This is our second visit and we loved every minute. Hightlight was Julian at the Front desk and his checkin process! He helped us get into our rooms quickly and upgraded us to the 5th floor for a stunning oceanfront experience. Everything about the trip was amazing! The food, The pool, The oceanfront views, the amazing staff :) . Cant wait to come back!!!

reviews.author: Elias H
reviews.title: Bana
reviews.text: Had an amazing dinner at Bana inside the Paradisus Cancun. Our waiter Rafael was amazing as always. The sushi was fresh and the beef noodles where the bomb. If you are staying here, I highly recommend you reserve a spot for dinner one night.

reviews.author: Discreettravels
reviews.title: Amazing amazing
reviews.text: The restaurant Vento is the best in the world. Hugo the manager and the chef is absolutely excellent.  Hugo went out of the way and has specific vegan dishes prepared. He is the sweetest guy ever. Then there is another eating place for the reserve section called le palapa.  The manager is absolutely amazing and chef Alex. The service is beyond excellent. To be honest not enough compliments for these two places Vento.and le palapa and the managers and chefs. There is a manager Sandra and she's so amazing.  She helped with all our needs in every way plus a lady called malania  who works in reserve section. She helped us so much. In all honesty felt our experience was great due to these people.

reviews.author: David N
reviews.title: Visually stunning resort.
reviews.text:
The first thing to say about this resort is it is immaculate. Visually stunning a true treat for the senses from the moment you arrive at the property. The water features, architecture, and common areas - I can't say enough about them. 

The ocean front rooms are fantastic offering their unique expansive balconies offering complete sun but total privacy from neighbors. 

Onsite COVID testing was a breeze and only required a phone call and results in about 20 minutes.

Staff and service always exceptional. 

My only disappointment with this resort was the caliber food available. To be clear I'm the guy totally happy with most chinese buffets but I also appreciate a steak at Charlie's. The lack luster food - not for lack of options - lead us to dining off the resort frequently.

Overall great property though and would absolutely return and recommend.

reviews.author: Malisha
reviews.title: Kichwen
reviews.text: My family and I love Paradisus Cancun. Our personal butler Aaron made our entire experience unforgettable. The facility was clean clean and the staff was very friendly and attentive. The concierge’s Max made sure we always had a what was needed. The pool bartenders are the best, always making sure they remembered our name. The best part was having the Covid test done on site. It took the stress of worrying about where you would have to go to get one. I highly recommend going to Paradisus Cancun not only is it a beautiful place but the staff are excellent.

reviews.author: Eriq Patinio
reviews.title: Mole Restaurant - a dining experience
reviews.text: This place is amazing!!! A must try if you are in Cancun. Mole restaurant offers Authentic gourmet Mexican cuisine!! Highly recommend the shrimp or sea bass dish. For dessert, YOU MUST TRY the coconut creme brûlée. Special thanks to Chef Yohary, Capitan Gabriela, Mesero Moises, and Nue Mendez for exceeding our expectations. I’ve been to many nice restaurants in Mexico and the United States, and this place is top 5 for sure.  Had such an amazing experience at Paradisus Cancun!! Will definitely be coming back

reviews.author: timryanarroyoarsenal
reviews.title: Great hotel, some bad staff members.
reviews.text: I dont want to put a review because I dont want to put a bad name in a great hotel due to some bad employees. The hotel was so great but there were isolated bad experiences due to not well trained employees.

reviews.author: Cito
reviews.title: What an amazing stay
reviews.text: Amazing trip! Amazing food and amazing service. Faris was amazing in connecting us to all the fine restaurants at the hotel. Don’t miss out on the excursions either. Book the restaurants reservations ahead!

reviews.author: kscraper
reviews.title: Vacation in Cancun at a beautiful place with a dark side
reviews.text:
Sucks big.  Management obtained access to my room safe without my knowledge.  
UNBELIEVABLE but true 
It’s real. 
Avoid this place, your personal positions are unsafe.  It’s rating reflects the service but ignores your personal privacy needs. 

Don’t go here if you’re personal privacy is important.

reviews.author: Raul O
reviews.title: Vacaciones 2021
reviews.text: Had an awesome time at Paradisus. The staff was amazing. Have to eat at Mole. We are there half the of the Jura of our stay. Can’t say enough good about it.  The food is amazing. The staff ,again, was great. W have come here twice and will definitely come back again. Of course return to Mole again.

reviews.author: Patrick G
reviews.title: Consistently Excellent
reviews.text: I have reviewed this hotel before and I am running out of superlatives. Lets start with the beach. The sand is so clean that you can't find any plastic or cigarette buts even if you tried ( and I did and I couldn't ) The beach servers are awesome. Asuncion and Leticia were so friendly and fun and might even take a picture or two if you ask nicely. The beach chairs and towels are plentiful and you can move your chair away from the crowd if you want to read quietly or play your music loudly. You will be treated like a KING. Be careful this hotel is addictive. I have been here at least twenty times.!

reviews.author: Doko
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun was a very nice resort. We like to thank our Butler Rodolfo for going above and beyond with his service. Also Manager Daniel Morales at the Reserve was very Professional and Accommodating and had a great staff, to many name to list. Superb Service..

reviews.author: Ashley O
reviews.title: Best Honeymoon we could have ever imagined.
reviews.text: This experience was top notch.  Shout outs to Ale who was our butler. She was amazing. And for David at the spa, Max in the reserve and all the staff in the entire place, too many to mention! Everyone was very nice and made our honeymoon extra special.  The resort is well maintained and very clean.  The food was delicious.  We upgraded to the “Reserve”  (no kids allowed) and it was worth every penny!  We went on a few excursions and most things are only 20 mins away, the location is perfect.  The waves on shore were rough, but if you waited until high tide came in you got plenty of swim time. The beaches are well maintained and had lots of seashells.    The pools are warm and the Bali beds are comfortable. We got a lobster and wine dinner on a Bali bed on the beach and it was such a great experience.   I would come back here over and over again.  Thank you Paradisus for everything.   We will be back!

reviews.author: Montgomery L
reviews.title: Great hotel and service was tremendous
reviews.text:
This was a great hotel for our stay. The restaurants were excellent, as well as the food and the bar. It was not crowded so beach chairs and pool chairs were readily available. Staff is super friendly and service was superb. The reason for the 4 instead of 5 is the app. The hotel requires the use of the app to book any reservation at the restaurants. Many users had problems with the app not working. It took 2 days before mine started working and even then the information provided was incomplete and/or inaccurate. For example, it showed the Blue Agave as open when it had been closed for 2 days and for the remainder of the week. Menus were NOT available via the app. You have to actually visit the restaurant and scan their QR Code to see the menu. This makes it difficult to decide what restaurant you might want to eat at. Reservations made via the app seemed to be impossible to change or cancel. Your Stay information did not show the reservations made. Very cumbersome.
  Cleanliness is A plus. You cannot touch any food at the morning buffet. Servers are there to dish it out. I saw tables being constantly wiped and seating has more than adequate spacing. They take the COVID scare very seriously.

reviews.author: Monica S
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed our stay here this week. I like the ambiance of the hotel. The beach is beautiful. They have very good food for lunch at the restaurants. I found the best dinner to be in the restaurant Mole. The drinks were very good also. I love the little gelato stand and coffee bar stand with the cute macaroons. The nightly entertainment seemed amateur and it is set up at such a far distance it is hard to see the performers. The gym is good but you have to make an appointment and they close 3pm so this was an inconvenience. I read in many of the reviews about an upgrade for the Reserve Club and an offer to join the Circle Vacation Club. We were never offered either of these during our stay. I would love to come back soon.

reviews.author: Lucas M
reviews.title: One of the best !!
reviews.text:
The resort is amazing!!!! Very beautiful, the room is enormous!!!!
The food, the staff , everything was perfect!!!

You can't miss the dinner at Vento restaurant !!

I recommend a lot the upgrade to "The reserve" !!! The place is beautiful, the Bali beds are amazing!!!

The butler Aaron takes care of everything for you,  it is really amazing!

reviews.author: Lena Y
reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text:
What a wonderful experience with Paradisus Cancun!

We came here to take some time off and recharge our batteries. It is not our first time at a Melia/Paradisus resort as we really love the brand and the quality they offer as well as their efforts in being a sustainable company.

The Hotel:
Cancun and the tourism/hotel area is a rather packed place however the resort is spacious and very well maintained. There is plenty of staff around keeping the place clean and nice! The building itself consists out of 5 pyramids with rooms. The main building hosts all the restaurants that you get to chose from and all guests services. 
Wifi coverage is very good. We had a nice room on the 6th floor and sea view. 

The Guests:
70% of the people are US visitors that only stay for a few days. The remains are a divers mix is Europeans, Russian, Latin Americans and very few Asian people. 
During our stay the hotel had an occupancy rate of around 50%.

The experience:
Overall we really enjoyed our stay. The food was really nice esp the authentic Mexican restaurant. The staff was super nice and was very proactive to refill drinks etc. we mostly had lunch and break at the Lapalapa restaurant as we liked the the food as well as the staff such as Miguel, Daniel, Ruben, Cesar or Max who took charge of the Balibeds. There were also very good activities offered such as Sports (we did yoga) or Art (we did the painting with Tannya and the team from handmade_cancun and really enjoyed it).

Things to improve:
There is really not much that could be done better. We loved our stay and look to come back ASAP!!!!

reviews.author: erica R
reviews.title: Great spot to visit
reviews.text: Loved our stay, food was good staff was friendly and the service was great. We did not try all the restaurants but mole and fuego were our favorite. My room had an ocean view and a nice patio. I was very happy with my trip

reviews.author: AKIS86
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I stayed @Paradisus with my friend for one week and it was amazing. Check in was nice and smooth, staff was friendly, food was delicious and we got free upgrade from a very nice manager Andria who went above and beyond to make sure our stay is most comfortable and memorable. Room was amazing! I will be recommending Paradisus to all my friends. Huge thanks to Andria and all the staff, it was great experience and we’ll be back for sure!

reviews.author: Chad R
reviews.title: Great location, food and beverage
reviews.text: Updated room with Ocean view! Great service, quality food and beverage with a Mediterranean flare. I originally had some issues upon check in however they were corrected and followed up on through out my stay by Julian Ortega. We will definitely be returning to this property.

reviews.author: emlydade23
reviews.title: Great food, awesome service
reviews.text: Came to this hotel for the first time, and loved it all the way. The restaurant Bana, is amazing. The food was delicious and the waiter Rafa gave us the best service. Every dish or drink he suggested was super good. Can’t wait to go back.

reviews.author: Edward E
reviews.title: Carlos was great, friendly service amazing food.
reviews.text:
Carlos was great, friendly service amazing food. This has become one of our favorite places in the resort.  

We had the soup, three meats and wine.  Yes will definitely be back a couple times this week alone.

reviews.author: PeteK54
reviews.title: OVER THE TOP VACATION !
reviews.text: We stayed a the Paradisus Cancun and upgraded to the Reserve.  We have never experienced the "over the top" service as we have at this hotel and we have been taking these tropical vacations for 25 years.  Everyone was kind and friendly.  Special appreciation to many but most importantly: Djordje our fabulous butler who took excellent care of us and Alberto at the "Reserve Check In" for getting us the best room in the hotel.  We also want to acknowledge the wait staff Armando, Hector and Edier at Malva Restaurant.  Daniel (Manager), Javier, Ruben and Oscar at La Palapa Restaurant.  Carlos Miquel at Bana and Jimmie at Vento.  Fabulous crew! We highly recommend this absolutely beautiful hotel!!!

reviews.author: Yamilet V
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: It was really nice and relaxing place! Low season because the pandemic but I enjoy it! Alfredo was amazing he took care of me every day! He remember how I like my coffee. Rent a car and go out to go around to have fun! Muy buen viaje y el lugar excelente, limpio y con todo lo necesario.

reviews.author: Sunshine260189
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: perfect service! we loved Alejandro, Julio and Pascual our serves! The breakfast was the best here, it was a massive buffet with everything you can ask for from Mexican specialities to continental breakfast.

reviews.author: Erick F
reviews.title: We had a great stay at Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun all inclusive gives you that all inclusive experience you want when visiting Mexico. The proximity to the history of the Mayan history, the experience of the Caribbean, and a swim up bar makes Paradisus Cancun unforgettable.

reviews.author: Compass236881
reviews.title: not great according to the web site
reviews.text: I stayed there for 7 days and could not wait untill this vacation would be over. The food in the buffet was excellent. There was poor entertaiment in the evening, In the evening was very boring and not fun  that at 9 pm we were in our room. There is nothing to do if your age is between 40 and 60. They have a night club which is very small and crowded and mainly designated to the young people. In the swimming pool was boring also. Water was super cold  Not too many activities were there either. I previously was staying in the different resorts and this one was the worse and not cheap. This is  my first time when I regret being there.

reviews.author: M_Akp
reviews.title: Unsanitary & Stingy
reviews.text:
If you are even considering booking here, for the sake of your vacation, please keep looking. I have traveled to Mexico every year for the past 5 years and this was by far my worst experience and it’s not even close.

I’ll preface this by saying I stayed at a Melia property in Cabo San Lucas, a 4 star, which was absolutely amazing so naturally I expected nothing less from their Cancun 5 star location. That proved to be a mistake.

This resort is dirty, has a poor smell, the rooms are poorly cleaned, you are nickel & dimed for everything the minute you get to the property, and their service is horrible.

Starting at the beginning — check-in. They are constantly trying to up-sell you for higher priced rooms, services, etc. They offered a “luxury” room for an extra charge of $260. I negotiated it down to $180. Fine.

Upon arriving to the room, I immediately notice a dingy, dirty looking rug in the seating area. Stained throw pillows on the bed, and stuck-on food on the spa brochure (shown)

I went downstairs and asked for a new room, hoping that had just been an isolated incident. They check me into a new room. 
Same thing — dirty rug, stained pillows and this time I even found a blonde hair in the bedsheets. I have black hair. 
Even more disgusting — I turned over the comforter and found a dried yellow liquid stain on the inside (pictured). 
I was absolutely horrified, especially with the serious concerns over coronavirus and the spread of germs. 

From then on, every minute I spent in the room was miserable, wondering what had actually been cleaned or replaced and what hadn’t. That is no way to spend a vacation you spent your hard earned money on. 

I expressed my concerns to their management and I was told that they “looked into their housecleaning processes and found nothing wrong”. 
They offered absolutely nothing to remedy the situation. 

In addition, the nickel & diming was pathetic for a so-called 5 star resort. Never have I been to an all-inclusive resort that charged for room service, especially since it’s the only food option after the restaurants and buffet close. They charge $5 per order and the best part — there’s a good chance your order will be wrong, as mine was all 3 times I ordered.

They also charge a whopping $200 per day to use their beach beds. You are forced to a purchase a “package” which includes a bottle of champagne. Tough luck if you don’t drink
I guess. 

Also, you will be turned away at their restaurants if you don’t make a reservation even if there’s barely anyone there. 
And to top it off, the food is extremely mediocre, except for the taco restaurant. 

In short, it seems at this place their goal is to make your vacation as difficult and expensive as possible. With emphasis on the latter. 

There are too many resorts in Cancun with way better value to waste a minute of your vacation or spend a penny of your hard-earned money here. 

But if strangers’ hair and unidentifiable stains in your bed, and poor food and service sounds like your dream vacay, then book away!

reviews.author: mic_sam
reviews.title: Amazing Amazing Amazing
reviews.text:
My wife and my 2 sons stayed at the Parasidus for 11 days. I'm a picky traveller and I have travelled extensively around the world. We stayed in a Family concierge suite in the main Pyramid. The property is impeccable and beyond clean.

Our Concierges were Violeta and Alexa. They are the most amazing individuals you could have. They did everything to please us ( organised a romantic diner on the beach for my wife and I, recommended restaurants, booked restaurants, catered to every little steps of our trip) I feel very thankful for their hospitality and Mr. Rodriguez is very lucky to have such staff within the premises.

All the staff in general have been amazing. The food was fantastic, lots of options for picky eaters and kids. 

The kids pool was perfect for us, we had a cabana most days and loved the depth of the pool for our younger child. Beach is spectacular

2 points, I'd like to mention to Mr. Rodrigues as feedback. #1 I was approached very rudely by one of the buffet hostess as we tried to bring some food back to our room. I feel like she could have simply talked to us about the policy at the hotel and perhaps provide more convenient container. I felt very embarrassed

#2 Coco bar staff were also quite rude. My wife and I were simply trying to have a drink one night and we got no service from anyone, yet they were helping younger people to get hammered. They should pay attention to everyone... Perhaps the quiet ones are the biggest tipper as well

Miss the Paradisus already

reviews.author: jaberayah
reviews.title: Great time with our two kids!
reviews.text:
Everything was exceptional.The rooms were clean, the beach was breath taking and the pools were nicely maintained. The food was great as well, some restaurant were better than others. All the staff seemed caring and very friendly.
Only recommendation the gym needed updating.
The baby club was excellent, MAY & NICOLE were amazing.

reviews.author: Christopher G
reviews.title: Do Not Stay Here...Physically Restrained from Leaving
reviews.text:
In January, we paid in full ($2,400) for 2 rooms for 4 nights at the Paradisus Cancún (March 17 -21) through Bookit.com. We decided to extend our trip for 1 more night (March 21-22), and booked that night through the Melia website. We arrived on March 17, and were not informed of any issues with payment for our stay. We stayed the night of March 17, and at multiple times that afternoon and the next day, the keys to our rooms were deactivated. No one said anything about any issue with payment when reactivating keys. Finally, in the afternoon of March 18, the keys were deactivated again. I went down to the front desk and had the key to my room reactivated—no one said anything about payment issues. Several minutes later, my wife went down to have the key to her room reactivated, and for the first time, the front desk stated that the stay reserved through Bookit had not been paid to the hotel, and that we would have to pay the $2400 again or leave the property. This obviously left a very bad impression upon us. Because we had paid for 1 night through the Melia website (not a part of the Bookit dispute), and only stayed at the property for 1 night, we decided to relocate to another resort. When trying to exit the property with our bags, the bellmen physically blocked our exit and stated that we would not be allowed to leave unless we went to the front desk. After arguing with the bellmen for several moments, I returned to the front desk. I informed the woman at the front desk (Alma), that we were leaving as requested. Stunningly, Alma informed me that if we wanted to leave we had to pay for another night at the hotel. I explained to her again that since we had already paid for 1 night through the Melia website, and only stayed for 1 night, we were even. She then had to go speak to management for approximately 30 minutes about my request to leave. Once she finally came back, she told me that management had agreed to let me leave, but that I would have to pay for a $78 bottle of wine from dinner the night before. This was a surprise, since this is supposed to be an all-inclusive resort and our waiter never mentioned any upcharge for the wine. After paying for the wine, the bellmen were kind enough to let us physically leave the property on foot. 

Melia knew of payment issues with Bookit well before our arrival and failed to inform us or other guests, instead letting their guests stay and then demanding payment in return for being allowed to leave. Absolute scam!

reviews.author: Alex S
reviews.title: Happiest Staff I have ever experienced!
reviews.text: I absolutely loved staying at Paradisus Cancun. The highlight of our trip was the staff here. We had a positive experience with every single person that we met, and their joy was contagious. We LOVED the bartenders at Avenue Bar, Edgar and Yeczee. They went out of their way to give us an incredible experience (and the best cocktails we have ever had!). Everything in the resort was well-maintained and clean. There was a nice variety of restaurants and daytime activities. I definitely recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Gorrell
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text:
We traveled with 2 other couples and we all really enjoyed this resort.
We had standard rooms and we never felt like we were missing out or limited by not upgrading to Royal Service.
We ate at all of the a la cartes and enjoyed them. The Mexican was our least favourite. We really liked how they suggested family style dining at the restaurants to allow you to try everything. The service was fantastic. Jimmy at Vento and Veronica at Bana stood out.
We did not go to the steakhouse. It seems odd to pay the same as someone visiting the restaurant when you’re at an all inclusive.
If you are sensitive to scents, then this might not be the resort for you. There are very strong scents used in many areas.
Everyone that works here is very friendly and each one will take the time to say hello or good morning.
The batteries in the key card thing on the door stopped working. The manager happened to be walking by and stayed there with us while it was getting fixed.
We would definitely return.

reviews.author: MATTHEW SCOLES
reviews.title: VP SALES AT KNIGHT WATCH
reviews.text:
We had our company trip here. The staff went out of there way to make us feel welcome. The resort itself was beautiful. The food and restaurants were aesthetically very classy. The rooms were very nice. The royal service butlers and maids were off the charts. Daniel and Rosanna were so accommodating.
Melia is a first class company. The wait staff for banquets

reviews.author: Victoria Hall
reviews.title: Favorite vacation
reviews.text: We’ve had such a great time in Cancún and have felt like we chosen the best resort. If you find yourself in Paradisus, you MUST visit Roger in the Enso. He will take such good care of you and ensure you have the best experience for dinner!

reviews.author: Thom M
reviews.title: 5th time staying here
reviews.text: I can't say enough about this property and its management My wife and I return year after year because of how awesome it is. They recently renovated many areas and it looks awesome. Some menus changed from last year as well. Staff is very attentive, polite and willing to serve. Property and grounds well maintained and very clean.

reviews.author: Barb Frank
reviews.title: Spectacular views
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with very catering staff. Wonderful Malva buffet all day. Had Alfredo as a waiter every day and he was wonderful. Leticia took care of us poolside. Could sit at the pool but look out at the Carribean so best of both worlds.

reviews.author: Lisa E
reviews.title: Beautiful complex
reviews.text: We enjoyed our time at the resort.  Pool area was nice.  We had to get there early to get a spot big enough for our group of six.  The buffet was fine.  David was one of our favorite servers at the buffet.  All of the servers were great. I wish i could remember all of their names. No complaints.

reviews.author: MesmerisedNot
reviews.title: Lovely resort, shame about the food
reviews.text:
What a lovely resort; beautifully clean with plenty of staff  to attend to your every need.  We spent a very relaxing 10 days at The Paradisus Cancun, lovely spacious room, great pool space and adjacent to a lovely sandy beach.  Plenty of sun-loungers available, although you will find holidaymakers wandering around at 06:00 to secure their favourite spot!  In addition to the main Buffet which serves breakfast / lunch / dinner, there are a few specialist restaurants which you need to book in advance; Japanese, Mexican, Asian, South American ...... special mention to all the wonderful staff who make this resort so special and, in particular;
 KARINA at the Coco Beach Bar, 
MARTIN and CARLOS at the buffet in the Fuego area 
DANIELA  at the YHI Spa

But, the downside for us which made this a standard 3/4* as opposed to a 5* is:

1. Terrible food!  The Buffet area is crowded but the food, whether it be breakfast/lunch/ dinner, is simply average and cold - not even warm.  
2. The food in the ‘specialist’ restaurants was also cold ... Japanese and Asian food was good but cold, but the Mexican and South American food  was awful!
3. The sun loungers are (where you spend the vast majority of your day) dated and uncomfortable. The majority are fixed in a semi upright position which means you cannot lie flat and are not conducive to a position for reading.  If you upgrade to the Bali Beds (for a fee) you will get fully flexible sun loungers!  My gripe is that after having paid a 5*star fee for your accommodation, you then have to pay extra for a better sun lounger.  Never experienced this before having stayed in Cancun resorts previously.

reviews.author: JohnLinCBD
reviews.title: Some thoughts to make your stay better!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Resort in the hotel zone in February. There are so many positive things we can say about our stay. All the staff were amazingly friendly and helpful. Particular thanks to Ismael at the concierge desk. He helped with so many requests like printing a business email, then scanning the signed document, and sending it back.  He arranged delivery of some items from the pharmacy. He was always ready to help! Management should be very proud of this employee.
We had several small requests and either housekeeping or maintenance personnel were immediate in their response.

We were on a Westjet all-inclusive vacation, so our brown wristband meant we did not have to spend a cent at the hotel.

The food was amazing in every restaurant. The buffets were overflowing with choices. For example, breakfasts had every kind of cooked egg available at the omelet station, massive amounts of fruit, wide selection of breads, meats, cheeses, cereals, salads, juices and much more. Lots of mimosas. Lunch and dinner buffets were similarly extensive.

We had no problem getting a reservation in a specialty restaurant every night. The trick is to call for a reservation shortly after noon each day and reserve for the next two nights.  The only items we saw an extra charge for were some high-end steaks and seafood. Room service was $5 extra and well worth it. 

Our room, #3458, had a great view and was recently renovated into a beautiful place to enjoy. We had plenty of 110 v electrical outlets for our devices. There was a big screen tv with lots of English language channels.  Our housekeeper, Luz, was amazing. I don’t know how we made such a mess each day, but she had everything perfect by evening.  We were told by other guests that building 3 was the best and to avoid building 1. Building 3 has reception and many restaurants. 

The mini-bar was fully stocked each day with the drinks we asked for. We had all the bottled water we wanted. Potato chips, Oreo cookies and other candies were well stocked.

The pools were huge and clean. The swim-up bar had a full selection, even non-alcoholic beer.  In fact, everywhere at the resort there was plenty of high-end alcohol served by bartenders who liked to suggest new drinks. 

The staff is paid very little by American standards, so we recommend frequent tipping of $3-5.

A few things that others should be aware of that bothered us but might not bother others. First, there was pounding music from about 11 am until late at night in building 3 night club.  The loud bass techno music that was everywhere. On Saturday and Sunday afternoons, there was an exception when there was a great band and singer on the beach that we enjoyed.   And it was a relief when on a few select mornings the music was quiet and relaxing.

Secondly, if you are going there as a couple for some romance and quiet, you should expect hundreds of small children everywhere. We had more than one meal ruined by screaming kids whose parents did nothing. It would be a great place if you have kids.

Thirdly, the heavy fragrances everywhere starting with the check-in area. We could barely breathe. I suspect they were trying to cover up the smell of mold. Huge sticks of incense burned throughout the building.  This was so overpowering. 

Fourth, like so many hotels, there were never enough loungers at the pool since selfish guests would put books on them and then not using the loungers all day. The hotel has signs posted forbidding this practice which are ignored. I wish they would enforce this rule! This is really frustrating!  The expensive Bali Beds take up so much space and they are rarely used.  Management, please consider reducing the price of the Bali Beds or remove them and replace with more free loungers.

Fifth, in these days of Coronavirus, I recommend the hotel provide gloves to buffet guest so that we are not touching tongs and spoons that hundreds of other people have touched, or have your staff serve each person everywhere. You do it at the omelet, ice cream and bar stations.

Finally, it was great to be in a resort where there were no drunks abusing the all-inclusive drinks. In ten days, we saw only two drunks.  But then, it is not really a Spring Break kind of place.
