A few other extra touches in our room:  There are enough drawers and a big enough closet for all your stuff, and luggage.   Cool lighting in the room and around the bed.   A bathroom big enough and with enough counter space for all your cosmetics.  And the most clever: the patio chairs have a space between the fabric and the chair frame, just enough space to hang a hanger with your wet swimwear.   Thank you for that!

Lastly, we had professional photos taken by Ingrid at Outdoor Photos.   Her desk is on the same level as reception.   She did an incredible job of capturing our happiness on the beach.   She is kind and sweet and made us feel comfortable.    Be sure to do this when you are there.   The price is affordable and you will love the photos.  Thank you for this fun and everlasting memory of our trip. 

Management should be complimented on their hiring decisions and the high level of professionalism of all on their team.

reviews.author: Scott082910
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Very nice place, clean rooms, quiet, nice beach, awesome staff......Martin, Alfonso, Karina and Luis looked after us all week....great people.  We enjoyed the food at the main buffet probably more than we did the restaurants.  The only complaint (and it was probably our own fault) was we booked online and thought that we were getting a king size bed and we ended up with 2 double beds.....like I said we may have hit a wrong button when booking.  We would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Ryan W
reviews.title: fantastic
reviews.text: we had a great vacation at Cancun Paradisus, they were very friendly and the food was great. we will surely return. we felt they were genuine and very attentive to any needs. we would highly recommend this resort to anyone who really wants the five star treatment

reviews.author: Caleigh H
reviews.title: Amazing resort!!
reviews.text: My friends and I went to paradisus for our spring break and had an amazing time. Julio, Saul and Augustin from the outdoor activities staff made sure we were entertained all day and had great things to do by the pool. Ricardo and Francisco from the restaurant and bar staff really took care of us. We would definitely come back another time!

reviews.author: Ves
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Disappointed with the resort. We had a cockroach in our room. No one bothered to check in to see how our stay was, bathroom by the beach was closed for 2 days due to plumbing issues.  They had a steak house there that was extra$$$, including alcoholic drinks and lounge beds on the beach were also extra.  Food was nothing spectacular and staff could have been friendlier.  I would definitely not come back.

reviews.author: Alex L
reviews.title: Overall Great Resort
reviews.text: We stayed for 7 days. We came right before the spring break rush which in our opinion was a great time to go as lines for Buffet and other areas weren't large. Quality of food was decent and the staff were quite attentive. Beach was very well maintained but it was very wavy in the ocean. We loved our experience. The various restaurants gave us nightly options to try different food. I would say overall the food was Good. the center/inside of the hotel is beautiful and they have a nice all day/night coffee/tea station that we enjoyed. They had activities and things going on nightly which were well put together. Drinks were good too even though we aren't big drinkers. We felt relaxed there but when the 'spring breakers' started to roll in about the 2nd week of March it got a little bit crowded.

reviews.author: Leah B
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text: We stayed here for 10 days and it was a stunning resort. The interior garden was beautiful! Service is excellent here. Andres from the main buffet worked so hard and provided top notch service. The beach chairs are slightly uncomfortable. It was hard to get chairs some days. The king bed and pillows were so comfortable. They have no hard liquor in the rooms but provide only beer, juice and a few pops. We did, however, dislike the separation of the royal service and regular service. Everything extra you had to pay for. It's almost felt like you were a peasant in some cases? It was odd. Other than that, we enjoyed the food and overall time here at Paradisus!

reviews.author: Natalie H
reviews.title: Definitely Not 5 Star
reviews.text:
This was my first trip to Mexico and first time at Meliá. In the past I’ve been to Riu, Bahia, and Sandals. This is my review in hopes that it helps someone make their decision to book or not to book.

Rooms
Some of the rooms are outdated and look nothing like the images posted...our first room had an smell in the bathroom and a view of the employee parking lot. I originally requested a room close to the ground level but we complained due to the smell and eventually were moved to a better room.

Food
The food at the buffet was almost never hot, either lukewarm or room temperature. The grill was the only source for a hot meal. There was a lack of variety even though they did rotate from day to day it seemed to repeat every 2 or 3 days. The poolside buffet offers burgers and fries, hotdogs and chips which wasn’t bad.

Service
The service at this hotel is impeccable! I rarely had to go to the bar for myself and the servers constantly check in; possibly the only downside to this was feeling obligated to tip all the time.

After visiting this hotel I don’t think I would return. I heard Paradisus has another location and was told it’s much better than the Cancún location. The common areas are beautiful but the outdated room and the food were a disappointment.

reviews.author: S Desai
reviews.title: Don’t stay if you like to sleep
reviews.text:
Very nice hotel with wonderful beach and water front. 
However they are continually making noise throughout the night, whether it’s music or moving heavy furniture, which makes it sound like elephants trumpeting at 4am. 
Even if they lacked the common sense to be quiet while people are trying to sleep, the doors to the rooms are clearly very cheap and have zero sound insulation. 
Something to consider if you like to rest on vacation

reviews.author: Davin W
reviews.title: 2nd time staying, we were dissapointed.
reviews.text: We first went in March 2018 and were so impressed with the service, amenities and attention to detail that we decided to come back March 2020. Sadly the resort seems to be suffering financially and started cutting corners, making the experience less impressive. The servers are  less attentive, often you have to get your own coffee and drinks after waiting over 20 mins to be served, they no longer offer the barista who would make cappuccinos or other drinks for you, the hot crepe station dissapeared, the room no longer gives you a welcome souvenir to remember your trip. Bottled water was eliminated and you have to settle for refilled cups which is harder to take to the beach with you. The kids club has 1 or maybe 2 staff trying to look after 10 or 12 kids, and often the parents have to stay with the kids due to limited supervision. The door lock mechanism  in our room broke,  locking us out, and the 5 mins we were told it would take for staff to come fix it turned into 40 mins. We needed a bed for my toddler as we'd booked a room for 3, and it took 2 days for them to bring up the extra cot. The fridge didn't work in the room. The buffet previously had themed nights, even one night was steak and lobster on the last trip. This time the buffet had the same items every night without variation, and the a la carte had  mostly buffet items, they were just brought to you instead. We kept having to exchange the beach towels because they would be given out stained. I realize these things may seem silly to some, and of course the beach was lovely. The only outstanding thing was the spa which had incredible service, I'm guessing maybe because its $215 for a massage so they want to ensure the customer is satisfied. I just wanted to point out some of our concerns because it was all the little things that made this resort stand out in our minds. The servers were so quick and efficient on the last trip, the food was amazing, and the resort seemed to go all out with the attention to detail. If this is your first time, you'll probably have a good time. But if you come back for a second time and anticipate it to be same, I think you'll be dissapointed. Unfortunately next year we will try a different resort.

reviews.author: Love_Gajjar
reviews.title: Extraordinary people, excellent service!!
reviews.text:
It was a great experience. Me and my wife enjoyed a lot. They have a very friendly and polite staff. Food quality was perfect, drinks were ok too. The only problem we experienced was there were no english language channels in tv, almost 95% were in Spanish. But overall we give 99/100..
Great job guys,
Thank you

reviews.author: svitlanapopovych67
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: I like everything in this hotel, will come back. Nice beach, tasty food and a lot of choices,great pool area, nice entertainment,every night different show. We have fun and few extra kilograms.good value for the price.

reviews.author: Mayan R
reviews.title: THIS PLACE IS A SCAM! DON'T STAY HERE!
reviews.text:
THIS PLACE IS A SCAM! DON'T STAY HERE!

SCAM #1 
When I first booked this hotel, I booked under the refundable rate which charges you upon arrival.  When I checked my bank account a couple of hours later I noticed I was charged in full. I reached out to the hotel to try and get this resolved because it was for a group of 15 of us and some people hadn't decided if they were coming yet. The response I repeatedly got from the hotel was that they can't tell what I clicked and since it is nonrefundable there is nothing they can do about it. At this point, I was already very upset and weary with the hotel.

SCAM #2 
A few weeks later, I got an email from the hotel that they didn't receive payment and that my reservation would be cancelled if I didn't wire them them money immediately. After a couple of weeks of back and forth with the parent company and their accounting department they were able to locate the money that I had already paid a month prior on their end. I was reassured that my reservation was in good standing and would be fine upon arrival at the hotel.

SCAM #3 
Fast forward to the trip. 15 girls from across the US arrive in Mexico. When members of my group arrived earlier than me, they were told that the reservation was not paid for and that since it was not under their name THEY HAD TO WAIT OUTSIDE ON THE CURB FOR 4 HOURS UNTIL I ARRIVED.  Once I arrived, I was told that the reservation was not paid for and that we would have to pay for 7K in full again or we could not stay. 

I explained to the manager of the front desk and his supervisor that I had paid and it had all been sorted out with the accounting department already back in January. I showed them printed out copies of the emails and my bank statements, I even called my bank and allowed them to speak to the hotel. Showing complete and total proof that I had paid. 

The hotel could not find the money within their own internal systems and could not show me any evidence that they didn't have it. The words I was repeatedly told was if you don't pay now, you cannot stay here. After 8 hours of arguing with no food or water or any accommodation for us  15 girls we came to a compromise that I would pay for the first night again while they sorted out the issue and refund me the money in the morning.  I asked for this confirmation in writing and was told that they couldn't give it to me in writing. I was weary to trust that this would actually happen, but 8 hours had gone by and we were in a foreign country with nowhere to go so I reluctantly agreed.

I'm not sure why as a customer with complete evidence backing up payment I was the one who needed to provide the payment while the hotel tries to find the money within their own system. As a large corporation, providing us a few rooms while they sort out THEIR OWN ISSUE would have been the more appropriate way to handle the situation.

Scam #4
When I showed up the next morning to sort out the rest, the men I was working on this with hid in the back room and told the guy at the front to let me know if I don't pay again we can't stay.

So we left to the hotel next door hoping that our bank can resolve the issue and get me money money back.

OTHER ISSUES WITH THE HOTEL
1. They ran out of clean drinking water
2. The bars all close at 11
3. All restaurants require a reservation to get seated, even if they are empty, You can't make a reservation until after checking in.
4. Personal belongings were stolen out of a girl's room
5. The hotel is now flagging our reviews for removal and responding to them saying this situation never happened to try and cover up their seriously gross misconduct

I HAVE NEVER EXPERIENCED SUCH POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE IN MY ENTIRE LIFE!  I spent the first 24 hours of my bachelorette party crying and stressing over a horrific situation.. DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND STAY FAR AWAY FROM HERE.

reviews.author: rusAleksG
reviews.title: Back to the paradise
reviews.text:
Here we go again! 
I’m back only after three months. It seems that I can’t stay away from this place. This time around it was not very good...it was great! If I would have an extra couple of days - it would’ve been perfect. I already pointed out in my last review that I love this place and people, but some things bear repeating.
My sweet Anna ( the affable masseuse) is still there. Oh...those hands! If I had a chance, I would book the whole day with her - 2 hours massage, 15-20 minutes break, then back on a table - that’s how much I like what she does and how she does it. After so many times with her, she already knows my preferences and when  to go easy on me. Anna, if you’re reading this, I have no words left for you to express my gratitude. You know everything...and then some.
Another word about bartenders. Giovani ( he was working at Avenue bar) and Randy ( Baha restaurant bar) are the only two guys I’m looking for when I go for a drink, even though they rotate on regular basis. Sorry, Edgar.  Lately, I found their job not only to be very professional but also very inspirational. Because of them I consider to take a bartender school. Don’t get me wrong, I love my job, but who knows, it might be my plan B for retirement: to work at some tiki-bar, serve nice drinks, make people happy. Guys, thank you for giving me a piece of your mind.
Last but not least, I try to tip everyone, even though I’m way too far from being rich or wealthy.  Yes, you might spend some extra cash on tips, but the staff does an exceptional job, and a lot of them even rely on it, especially in all inclusive resorts. I shared with a lot of people one of my rules in life - don’t be cheap for your pleasure. But, that’s just me.
Anyway, enjoy your stay. Share your experience with loved ones. It’s a great place to be.

reviews.author: Cailun G
reviews.title: The Worst Experience. Save Your Time & Money
reviews.text: Something is fishy about this resort and their ethics. Was here with a large group for an event and they claimed that we hadn't paid for our rooms, therefore we couldn't check in. Sometimes there's a mix-up in communications, which I can understand, but this was a complete and utter lack of morals and hospitality. We had full documentation from our bank that we did, in fact, pay for the rooms and all the front desk could tell us was that their bank had "lost the money". We waited 7+ hours trying to resolve this issue, but since this resort's bank is in Spain there "was nothing they could do". They insisted the only way to resolve was to pay in full again and they'd "try to find the money tomorrow". So, being that we were a large group from out of the country without a place to sleep, we paid for a single night. The next morning, the staff we were speaking with the day before wouldn't even speak directly with us to try and keep resolving. We ended up finding last minute rooms at the resort next door and it was 10000% more accommodating and our trip ended up being fantastic.

reviews.author: Amanda L
reviews.title: UNSAFE, UNFRIENDLY, THIEVES, OH AND THEY RAN OUT OF CLEAN WATER
reviews.text:
I'm an experienced international traveler and I WILL NEVER come back to this resort. We had booked a friend's bachelorette party there, paid in full and received a confirmation number straight from the hotel. Well when we got there the hotel staff tried telling us we did not pay and in order to stay we needed to repay. After ignoring our confirmation number and refusing to let us speak to a manager, we were forced to wait in the lobby for 7 hours. We even called our bank (Chase) and confirmed with them they had sent the money and had verification it was sent directly to the hotel. They still wanted us to repay. They also tried telling us that the manager was not available, so we asked to speak to someone in charge of online booking. They claimed that "office" was  in Spain and unreachable given the time difference. This place is a SCAM!!

As a group of women we did not feel comfortable leaving in the middle of the night to try and find another hotel and were forced to pay for only one night and leave in the morning. By the time we checked into our hotel we needed to find something to eat so we decided on going down to the late night restaurant. Before I left the room I wanted to ensure our valuables were locked up in the safe. I noticed the instructions on the safe were rubbed off so I called down to the front desk for instructions. They said they could not give them over the phone and would need to send someone up? They said a staff member would be up in ten minutes. Well, we waited and waited and no one showed up for over 45 min. I called down a second time, no answer. At this point, I decided I didn't want to leave the group of women waiting so I left the room and went down to dinner. After dinner we were taking group photos in the lobby and asked the front desk for water. Their answer... they RAN OUT!!!! The hotel would not be receiving clean water until the morning. I was in utter shock. NO WATER?!

Waterless, we returned to our rooms, and I noticed by RayBan sunglasses were missing. I remembered I set them on top of my iPad which I wanted to put in the safe, but couldn't. I was furious. Was this all another scam?? Had they sent someone up to our room while we were gone? All I knew was that they were in the room when I left and when I returned they were missing. The next morning I filed a report with security. Of course, no help there. The said they would check footage and "look around" for them, but lets be real... 

So after I filed the report, we needed to check-out. They claimed they needed to charge us each $8 dollars to remove our wristbands?? We asked to see where in the check-in documents that we signed did it show this fee. They said they don't. So we refused to pay them and said we would cut off the bands ourselves. Then they threatened to charge us each $150.  

We left that morning and went to the hotel next door (Fiesta Americana). WHAT A DIFFERENCE! For anyone considering Paradisus, save yourself the trouble, thirst and RayBans, and DON'T. Our weekend stay at Fiesta Americana was 1000% better and thankfully saved our trip.

reviews.author: Fred S
reviews.title: Wonderful visit, I would return
reviews.text:
We just spent 6 nights at Paradisus.  I booked based on other reviews on TripAdvisor, and was not disappointed.  We upgraded to Royal Service when we checked in, Javer was our butler.  Javer was very helpful, attentive and knowledgeable.  The hydro therapy spa is not to be missed.  It’s an included service and features sauna, steam, showers and a large pool with jet stations and waterfalls.  
We spoke with other Royal Service guests who weren’t told about the spa, and it would be a shame for anyone to miss that.  

The food was fine.  The buffet offered a diverse and appealing meal service for all three servings.  Caesar, Julio, Josue provided excellent service at La Palapa and the pool and beach.  Get the wings, we didn’t order then until the day before we left.  There are plenty of things to walk to and the marina isn’t far if you’re going to Isla Mujer.

reviews.author: Maddy
reviews.title: Like hell, only worse
reviews.text:
If you enjoy waiting in the lobby for 7+  hours for check in, then trying to be scammed out of thousands of dollars you already paid to get a room, then this is the place for you! There was some sort of problem on the hotels end and their system had a glitch. While they figure it out they, made us sit in the front of the hotel and wouldn't even give us access to basic items such as food/water. It was over 7 hours of us waiting for them to try to resolve the issue. Spoiler Alert: They never ended up figuring it out and we had to repay for the first night because they said the system would be back up and running the next day. It was not, so we were forced to leave the hotel after double paying and find a new location.

The staff was super rude and unhelpful, even after contacting their headquarters in Spain about the ordeal who said everything was ok, they still would not give us the time of day.

We did get the morning at the pool before being forced to leave and the drinks were watered down and the margaritas were bright blue for some reason??? 

The hotel next door was basically heaven on earth compared to this hell hole we came from. Overall, do NOT come here unless you enjoying spending your entire vacation in a humid hotel lobby arguing with people who won't even look you in the eye. On the bright side, we have some lovely vacation photos of us walking down the street of Cancun with all of our luggage!

reviews.author: aaronm
reviews.title: Beautiful property, great drinks, too party-oriented
reviews.text:
TL;DR: Very nice, upscale resort. Drinks were top notch, food was good, and service was excellent. Constant music/party vibe was grating, spa felt rushed.

My wife and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun in February for a mid-winter thaw. We waited too long to book, so this was pretty much the only resort in Cancun that fit our budget and amenities list. We arrived very late in the evening on our first day, and were immediately impressed with the lobby and reception. Everything inside the resort smells fresh and lush. At night the resort is lit with soft purple lights and looks awesome. Check in was very easy and a nice touch was the premium resort bracelets for the all-inclusive. (wood and cloth instead of paper) Our room was very clean and spacious, with a private balcony with a jetted tub. The lagoon view was mostly of a parking lot, but you could see the water easily.

We're foodies, so the food was an important part of our resort choice. Unfortunately we were a little disappointed overall, however the food itself is good, just not great. There's only one breakfast location, so make sure to get there early or be prepared to wait in line. Food is above average for a buffet though. Lunch time is similarly limited, with Blue Agave serving decent tacos or Malva with a lunch buffet (didn't try it). Fuego opens for lunch at 1pm, and has very good burgers. Definitely the best lunch option. For dinner we tried Vento, Enso, Mole, and Fuego. They are opening a new "paid only" restaurant named Sal that we did not try. Fuego and Vento were good, but nothing spectacular. Mole and Enso on the other hand were exceptional. The food was more flavorful and really well prepared. Note that portions at all restaurants was very small. The food was very instagram worthy, but we often were hungry after dinner. This is not a resort where you split a meal. Unless you have the stomach of a squirrel. Exceptions for those who are hungry were the meat platter at Mole and the burgers at Fuego. Service at all restaurants was excellent. Lastly, the drinks were great. Never got a watered down drink, and they even have 1800 Anejo available as part of the all inclusive. 

The activities at the resort were pretty good, but not amazing. The best by far was the sunset mixology. It's a different bartender on Mondays and Thursdays, so go twice. We got the best drinks from Giovanni, and it was a lot of fun. The tequila tasting was alright, same with the sushi making class. 

We booked a couple sessions at the spa, and while overall it was really nice there's a few areas they could improve. The preparation area is pretty nice, with clean locker rooms and sauna facilities. The hydrotherapy pool/waiting area was sort of outoors, and was looking a bit dated. It wasn't the most relaxing experience either, as people would be in the hottub talking. The massages themselves were excellent, very relaxing and enjoyable. We did the couples wrap treatment too which was awesome. Our only points of complaint were that the massage rooms were a degree too cold and the whole process felt rushed. As soon as we finished our massages we were handed survey forms to fill out. Once that was done, we were rushed back to our separate changing areas. It would be much better if they let you sit and relax for a while, maybe letting you sip some champagne or water. 

Lastly, the beach and pool area. The beach in Cancun is wonderful and super soft. The surf was high the whole time we were there so they didn't recommend swimming. They do have lifeguards though, which is nice. The pool area was very spacious and pretty. However, people would "reserve" pretty much every pool chair by about 8am. If you want to just wander out and read by the pool, that's not going to happen. The resort needs a better solution there. As a result, we ended up booking a covered Bali bed by the pool two days we were there. Excellent decision and totally worth the cost. You get a spacious bed to relax on, ours included a bottle of prosecco (it was ok), and a seafood platter. Boy is it a platter too! Two lobster tails, 3 kinds of ceviche, and chips and guac. One of the best things we ate at the resort! The poolside service was outstanding too, Didier was very attentive and ensured we always had drinks or food. Here is also where we had our biggest issue though, the music. Maybe this was just the wrong resort to come and relax, but they have a big sound system setup that constantly blasts dance music. Most of the time you couldn't hear the ocean over Justin Bieber or whatever US pop artist they were playing. There were speakers at the pool and facing towards the beach, ensuring you couldn't escape it. Similarly the Avenue bar in the resort was always playing dance music too. If that wasn't enough, the bass from the Red Lounge was often audible in the main resort area. The music wasn't enough to ruin the resort, but it definitely was annoying and is why we won't be coming back, despite how good everything else was overall.

reviews.author: d0nnellyfamily
reviews.title: Great Place to visit
reviews.text:
This place is awesome! We've been there multiple times and it's the only resort we've ever returned to. The food, drinks and staff are top notch. You won't be disappointed.
The rooms are starting to look outdated (although you're rarely in the rooms) and need to be renovated and there's not too much of a night life for adults (we have 2 kids). The rest is excellent.

reviews.author: Maria S
reviews.title: Family concierge was worth every penny!
reviews.text:
We were a family of 3, travelling with our 3 yo daughter. The resort was beautiful and clean, and the beach was nice! We had Rodolfo and Fernando as our Family concierge butlers and they were wonderful! Our vacation experience was so much better because of the family concierge service. We thoroughly enjoyed all the surprises they had for our little one and the Bali bed was relaxing. We loved that either Rodolfo and Fernando were always available by phone whenever we had a question. 

Overall, the resort was wonderful and family friendly. Only suggestion we would make would be to have more lounge chairs by the pool. Otherwise, everything else was great!

reviews.author: SH
reviews.title: Nice week at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
My wife and I recently spent a week (February 22-29) at the Paradisus Cancun.  We were somewhat wary of the resort due to reviews touting their Royal Service (which is an expensive add-on) and other reviews where people could not get dinner reservations.  We did not pay for Royal Service and frankly, it was the best money we didn’t spend!  The resort was very nice; we had zero problems making reservations and ate at each of the restaurants that were available to “non-royals”.  If we didn’t have a reservation, we just walked up and asked when we could be seated.  This may have been due to our only needing a table for two, but even when we called a day or so before, we got the restaurant and reservation time we wanted.  The first night after leaving Vento, we noticed people dancing in the Avenue bar with headphones on.  No music…just people dancing.  The headphones were lit red, green or blue.  It looked like an episode of Black Mirror.  So we walked over and it was a silent discothèque.  So we joined and danced for about an hour or so.  It was great fun and too bad it’s only on Saturday nights.  There were two DJs competing for the crowd to change their color which brought a different DJ selection.  Again, excellent idea!  Other than the usual towels reserving loungers early in the morning, everything else was fine.  Breakfast was great including mimosas.   We loved the tacos at Blue Agave.  Not sure why there were so many negative reviews of their tacos but we thought they were good, it was empty for lunch, and they make a great margarita.  As others have posted, the rooms could use an update but we had really nice weather and spent little time in the room other than sleeping!  The only thing we didn’t care for was the non-stop pounding techno music at the main pool and on the beach.  It was so loud on the beach that it drowned out the sound of the sea which in Cancun, is hard to do.  But the resort is large and there are at least two places we found where the music was barely audible.  So all in all we liked the resort, had a really nice time, and didn’t miss the Royal Service.

One last thing...not sure what the deal was with the falcon that the handler had on their arm every day!  Nobody approached for pictures etc.  Just this huge falcon sitting on it's handler's arm making the rounds by the pool.  I would think a bird less menacing would have been more appropriate for photos.

reviews.author: PMOM
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text:
The staff at this hotel are amazing. The lady who was our guide, Marina, was very helpful and always available. We were particularly served for lunch and dinner by Edier and Alejandro who were very nice, polite and helpful too.
One thing we were not happy about though was our room and its location. They placed us on a floor where there were some ongoing renovation and painting. It disrupted our two kids naps and we could also smell the paint from time to time. 
The thermostat was not functioning the first two nights till we asked them to come and fix it. 
The fridge was making a lot of noise which we again asked to be replaced. I am sure they could have offered us a better room specially since it is a huge hotel with many many rooms.

reviews.author: Nichole R
reviews.title: Great Hotel with Excellent Customer Service! I literally felt like a princess!
reviews.text: This was my second time at Paradisus and servers and staff were always there to ensure that they I am having a great time! I would like to commend certain staff loke Leticia from Coco's Beach Club, Martin, Gaude, Adelier from Malva who made my stay more memorable! Kudo's for your service!

reviews.author: Companion35303187906
reviews.title: Cancun Paradisus review
reviews.text: We became Melia rewards members while staying at this resort, so we were quite happy with the quality of the staff and the facility.  I want to especially mention Luis Herrera and Mabel Gomez who were especially helpful in making our stay a memorable one.  We were truly pampered and felt very special throughout our stay.  We had a communication problem, however, with Jaime Castro, our butler, as he did not communicate through email which was our only source of communication.  We urged him to be more accommodating and later learned that he was sending my husband instant messages through his Ipad which we had recently acquired and did not use while on the trip.  I also strongly encourage you to make your facility more user friendly for older people by installing more railings and making steps more visible.  We appreciate your efforts to be eco friendly by using glass water bottles in rooms and limiting the plastic outdoors to be reusable.  The grounds were kept well but could include more flowering plants.

reviews.author: mhyla237
reviews.title: Sending Love From El Gato
reviews.text: As someone who has never been to an all-inclusive resort before, I had no idea what to expect. Considering our rooms were cheap (this is coming from someone "thrifty"), I thought the website would be overselling the experience. I was absolutely wrong. From the moment you walk through the door, you are experiencing luxury of the highest order and greeted with the greatest smelling hotel imaginable. The staff greets you, gets you and drink, and gets you through the check-in experience in a beautiful environment. I did the Royal Service "adults only" package for those wondering. After check-in, the real fun begins. There are bars everywhere for drinks, charcuterie, and espresso. The staff will bring drinks and food to your cabana poolside. The restaurants were incredible and they will feed you as much as you want. The staff was incredibly happy and upbeat, no matter what drink I was on or if I was asking for yet more food. There are incredible views of the beach everywhere you go. There's even spa treatment to chase those pesky hangovers. I cannot emphasize enough how wonderful my stay was, and I plan on coming back very soon!

reviews.author: CH3
reviews.title: Superb resort and staff!!!
reviews.text: This is our third stay at Paradisus Cancun and once again: absolutely amazing!  The staff know how to cater to your every need and make your vacation truly memorable (and travelling with children easy and fun!) The hotel, beach and rooms are so clean and well maintained, the food at every restaurant is excellent and the service is just perfect! Thank you so much to Rodolfo and Gloria for their attention to our family (from the amazing balloon creation surprises for our kids to the birthday celebrations they arranged for one of our family members!) we are truly grateful for your care and the memories! Thank you also to wonderful waiters who made meals special such as Pablo, Luis and Ignacio and th  hostesses at Malva who were sweet and greeted us with their smiles! Muchos gracias Paradisus Cancun!!!

reviews.author: marie_helene_besner
reviews.title: Nice resort but can be improved
reviews.text: Really good service, but the food is bad. The room design is not optimal when you travel with your family. Really clean pool. Really noisy, especially in the restaurants. We tried the buffet and many others it was so noisy we were not able to heard a anything. Difficult to reserve even though the restaurants are empty. For the lunch, just 2 restaurant are open before 12, burgers or fast food!

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.title: Amazing hotel and wonderful staff!
reviews.text: Everything at Paradisus Melia Cancun was amazing! The hotel is spotless. The food was incredible. The service went above and beyond. A special thanks to Rodolfo and Gloria for taking such special care of our family and making sure we had everything we needed to make our trip unforgettable!!! They also made sure to celebrate a birthday with us and everyday they made it special for our grandkids! Also thanks to the waiters who brightened every meal we had especially Pablo, Luis and Ignacio! The hostesses at Malva were so nice!

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: Another Great Stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
This was our 11th stay at Paradisus Cancun and won’t be our last.  Each year we notice incremental improvements in various areas which indicates Club Meliá and Paradisus are always trying to improve the guest’s experience.  One improvement we noticed this year was that the beach area was roped off which prevented the countless number of people walking on the beach trying to sell things to tourists from walking through the palapas and annoying guests. It also gave a greater feel of exclusivity.  

Through the years we’ve always found the staff to be receptive to our requests and needs.  One staff member at Club Melia check-in, Karina, has seen us return through the years and always greats us as friends.  It’s easy to see why she’s been promoted to a management position which she certainly deserved.  However, it’s important to recognize that this is Mexico where people don’t typically rush they way they do in the U.S.  So, it’s important to be patient when dealing with hotel staff.  

We are looking forward to returning next year and having the same kind of great vacation that we’ve experienced at Paradisus Cancun since 2011.

reviews.author: Celine
reviews.title: Wedding anniversary
reviews.text: Had the most wonderful time at the paradisus adult only section. Our butler Kenia was perfect. She even gave us a champagne bottle to celebrate our 20th wedding anniversary. Room was spacious and luxurious. At the Palapas restaurant the manager Daniel is sooo nice. Definitely will come back . Thank you for your great hospitality

reviews.author: Jacob L
reviews.title: Nightly entertainment! Hotel/food okay, staff and service 10/10
reviews.text: We returned to this hotel for the second time in as many years. Our trip last year was cut short due to illness, and after much deliberation, Meliá (owners of Paradisus resorts) granted us the nights that we missed to use this year. This is our fourth vacation to a Paradisus resort, but the first two were at the property in Playa Del Carmen, which by all accounts I would rate slightly higher than this one though both are pretty awesome in different ways. We have had two very different experiences at the resort in Playa Del Carmen, with the first year being just fabulous and the second year being just OK. That is what prompted us to try the property in Cancun in the first place. The hotel is beautiful with hanging gardens and very well manicured, but it is dated. There are some remodeled portions and some that aren’t, and we only learned by chance the difference between the two when we visited last year. This year we were led it to one of the older rooms, and we immediately requested one of the remodeled versions, and they moved us without much fuss. The all-inclusive restaurants (with the exception of two) require reservations. That is no problem, except they sort of walk you through your meal step-by-step and it is a very prescribed experience. I don’t feel like the staff is tipped consistently, so at some of the restaurants the service was lackluster by comparison. That being said, the staff and service during this trip, from our concierge to the restaurants to the poolside waiters, was outstanding. We want to give a special shout out to a few in particular that helped to make this a very special vacation for our young family. At the pool, Sofonio was awesome. He took extra special care of us each day that we were there and was great with our kids. A piece of advice: I appreciated that the staff noticed on the first day that I left what must’ve been a generous tip. They were fantastic then but took it several steps further after we tipped them well. This seems to resonate throughout the property. Tip these workers people! It is probably the majority of their income. I handed $20 at the end of each pool day, after having been served many drinks, food, towel service, and general prompt attention. To me that’s a small price to pay for exceptional service, and it improved each day that we visited. Our family concierge butlers, Brenda and (especially) Gloria, were awesome. There was a special treat and surprise waiting in our room each afternoon for the kids, and they handled our reservations and really anything we needed, including poolside Bali bed reservations. That level of service is exclusive to Family Concierge and Royal Service (adults only). A quick note about upgrading to family Concierge: it is not quite the same upgrade in Cancun as it is in Playa Del Carmen for a few reasons. In Playa Del Carmen, which for the family friendly side is called Paradisus La Esmerelda, there is a separate family Concierge swimming pool which is the only pool that is heated on the property, and also a separate family concierge beach area for those kind of days. Cancun has the same private check-in and larger rooms for family concierge guests, but the rest of it is pretty much the same for everyone other than the fact that you can reserve daybeds and get unlimited towels. We found out during the trip from another family that had not paid for the upgrade that the hotel was being very strict with towels and chairs/day beds for them since they were not Family Concierge guests. Other than that, they get the same drinks the same food in the same pool as we did, for substantially less $$$. That’s fine and we would not have known the difference had we not already visited the property in Playa Del Carmen. All in all, we will probably not visit this property for the next several years but we intend to explore other Paradisus properties in Los Cabos and other parts of the Caribbean.

reviews.author: HEPAR4
reviews.title: Galdino was the face o the Meliá Hotel
reviews.text: Good ; relax , confortable . All crew had the best altitude , super clean , you do t need to go outside every thing  is In The hotel .  the only thing that wasn’t accurate  we were 2 couple and the guy of the check gave to us a different flor room , but wasn’t a big ideal .

reviews.author: Don W
reviews.title: Another great 10 days
reviews.text:
For our third year in a row and our 5th time at this resort, we had a great time. Giovani is an amazing bartender, who has remembered us over the years, Sevey is great, the two Luis at the main pool bar, Caude at Mava has been catering to us for years. Thanks to our concierge Jose, front desk Ismael and the folks in Circle, Victor, Sandy, Bianca and Adrian.

See you all next year for a family reunion.

reviews.author: Curtis R
reviews.title: Awesome resort!
reviews.text:
I'll start by saying that this resort is exceptionally nice, and every staff member we dealt with was awesome.  We especially appreciated Randy and Geovani in the bar.  What an awesome team those two are!  Having stayed in a few resorts over the years, this one sticks out as especially well managed, clean, and very nice. 

I really wanted to give this resort 5 stars, but I couldn't do it because the first and last impressions were quite bad.  Everything in between was great.  

Regarding the first impression, Melia's incentivization of trying to get people to sign up with their timeshare junk program has worked; the staff is extremely pushy to get you to commit to an hour of your time to hear some presentation.  Look, I already paid a bunch of money to stay at the resort.  Making me feel bad about not signing up for your time share is NOT appreciated.  I had the timeshare pushed at me every day of my stay... Every. Day.

Regarding the last impression, I waited in line for a full hour to check out.  This was not an optional check out mind you.  They literally have staff forcing you to get back into line to check out.  Every other hotel I've stayed at in the past couple years has this figured out, but for some reason, this hotel hasn't taken notes.  Look, you have my card on file; charge the incidentals and email me the bill.  My time and presence is not required.  

While I was more descriptive on the couple of bad notes, it is mainly so Melia might improve those two areas, because literally everything else was great.  The first and last impression was a glaring departure from an overall great stay and resort.

reviews.author: bruceharring
reviews.title: Another great experience
reviews.text: This is our 3rd time in 3 years, staying at the Paradisus Cancun.  We brought another couple with us this time and they were equally pleased and impressed.  The grounds are pristine, the rooms and facilities are clean and up to date.  The food in all of the restaurants is fantastic, and the service is outstanding.  We cannot say enough about the staff and how hard they work, while being incredibly pleasant, friendly, and helpful.

reviews.author: Chely31
reviews.title: Family vacation/Daughter's wedding
reviews.text: I had a great time during my stay.  We went for my daughter's wedding.  It was so beautiful.  The staff helped her in everything.  The food was ok but what made the experience better was our waiters at the Malva Buffet.  Ignacio 'Nacho" and Andres where awesome!!!! They are the best of the best!! I am so happy we met these 2 great guys.  They always made sure we had what we needed.  They made us laugh so much.  Thank you guys so much for everything.  Please people tip these waiters......waiters in general.  They all work very hard and deserve a tip.

reviews.author: Wonderwomen G
reviews.title: Amazing hospitality
reviews.text: The Malva Restaurant!!!!  our waiters were Andres Contreras y Ignacio Vazquez amazing service and so friendly and upbeat energy. They treated our family like royalty! We would only sit in their section because of all their amazing attention they would go above and beyond. They were funny and attentive to us. We only went their to eat throughout our stay just because of them. These guys are gems to this establishment And honestly I would go back again because if these two guys who made our stay delightful! Overall the resort is amazing with their hospitality all the employee’s are kind and always helpful. The baby club is amazing Andrea rocks with these kids! The housekeeping was amazing!

reviews.author: Pat K
reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time my wife and mother-in-law and we were joined by my daughter and son-in-law. One staff member was nicer than the next. They could not do enough for us. From the pool area to the restaurants to our room everything was perfect!

reviews.author: Sudsmeister
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun - February 2020
reviews.text:
The property is very grand and beautiful and has a huge stretch of prime Cancun beach.  We stayed at the Royal Service section and it was nice, but not as luxurious as we had experienced at other Melia/ME hotels. The best benefit of doing the Royal Service was the private pool and bali beds which were amazing. In addition, this was the only section that did not have children. 

Overall we were disappointed with the food at the hotel. The buffet was decent, but most of the food at the restaurants needs improvement, especially Enso. In addition, it would be nice if they had at least 1 (or more) adult-only dinner options.  

Overall, despite our disappointment with much of the food, it was a great trip.

reviews.author: Sandy
reviews.title: Hate the food
reviews.text:
First of all we have been here for almost a week and could not get reservations for a restaurant. 
The restaurant we did go to Enso was horrible. The food was cold and the food was not good.
The only good thing I can say is that we enjoyed the band “Radiance “ at coco club. Other than that there is zero entertainment in the day time. If you are awake at 11pm they have a night club. 
I will not be returning. One more thing!!!!!! Do not do the presentation good lord the two hrs sales pitch to join timeshare was brutal!!

reviews.author: Curious526886
reviews.title: Get ready for time share pitches!
reviews.text:
The hotel is nice. The location is nice. Unfortunately they tried over and over to sell us a time share package and it got frustrating. We were scooped up quickly by the well dressed concierge staff acting like we were VIP's only to find out they were just trying to sell us something we don't want. We never got told about the hotel and how everything works because of this. 

Overall this hotel could be 5 star, but the concierge people ruin it for everyone else if you don't want a time share. 

Hotel was spotless and the food was fantastic. All the staff was super friendly once your away from the check-in area. They do not respond to emails so don't try.

reviews.author: Filipa Costa
reviews.title: Absolutely A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!!
reviews.text:
Paradisus it’s unbelievably good!! The food and drink are top quality and so many different options that it’s mind blowing. The staff though is just absolutely amazing (and I cannot stress this enough!), people are naturally super nice and don’t wait for you to tip them to provide an excellent treatment. I would and will recommend this resort to everyone. The service room is another cherry on top of the cake, everytime we went out for the day (by the amazing huge pool or beautiful clean beach) we would come back to a perfect room. I didn’t feel, not even for one moment, that either us or our belongings weren’t safe, we even left our safe locker opened once or twice just as an example for you to understand how safe, happy and exceptional this all-inclusive resort is.
Some other resorts give you cheap horrible drinks as well as food or even amenities and in some places staff gets kind of annoyed when you keep asking for drinks or etc., here is everything top top quality. From the toilet paper to the service, staff goes around the pools and wherever you are really asking if you would like anything, from food to drinks, you can ask as many as you want and it’s guaranteed they will bring it over to you with the biggest smile no matter what.
Also, rooms are pretty big and very clean. Staff also keeps your mini fridge stocked up, so you don’t have to worry with grabbing either water or other drinks from the cafeteria. Every single day they will be replaced!
I really couldn’t be any happier with our choice of coming here.
Definitely 10/10 guys!! Hope I can help anyone looking for advice, as before we came here we’ve spent around 1month researching and looking up all the resorts and respective reviews and sometimes can be quite confusing.
So therefore, I’m telling you, if you choose Paradisus you won’t be disappointed!! Will definitely come back, hopefully soon!!

reviews.author: Teri B
reviews.title: Won't stay again...
reviews.text:
This was our 2nd time staying at Paradisus.  They are not the same.  Was given wrong room then moved and wound up on bottom floor overlooking parking lot.  Lost a night of vacation over room changes, finally gave up.
Food not anywhere as good as back in 2018.  Very disappointed.
Will stay elsewhere next February.

reviews.author: Winston R
reviews.title: Great Family Experience
reviews.text: We flew in from Chicago, first time in Cancun and first time at Melia. My wife and I with our two kids.  5 and 3.  We had an amazing time and will be back next year.  We booked Family Concierge on the Lagoon side.  We had two butlers who helped with everything.  Have to give a shout out to Brenda and Gloria.  We had Bali Beds all 5 days we were there.  They have a kids pool and a huge warm pool.  Food and drinks were great.  Staff were amazing.  All of the servers were hustling and working hard.  Please tip all of the hard working people.  There are plenty of vegetarian options as well.  They also have lactose free milk!  Evening entertainment was good also.  WIFI worked fine.  We used Amstar as a private shuttle to bring us back and forth to the hotel.  We stayed on the resort the entire time.  Kids napped in the Bali bed.  Great time, great food, great people, can't say enough.

reviews.author: donovanosborn
reviews.title: Cancun Get Away
reviews.text:
My wife and I just spent a week at the Paradisus Cancun Resort. This was our second time staying at a Paradisus Resort, and our first trip to Cancun. From the very beginning we felt right at home. We had booked an ocean view junior suit with a king bed. The room was always clean and well stocked. House keeping did a wonderful job of refilling the mini fridge daily with snacks and making sure there were clean linens in the bathroom. 

Our butler, Rosanna, was fantastic. She was very helpful and polite. She had made different dinner reservations for us every night, and also went ahead and made golf reservations for me at a nearby course. 

Moses, who works as a waiter at the royal service pool and also inside in the royal service dinning room went above and beyond with his service for not only my wife and I, but also for the other guests he was serving, Always greeting you with a good morning Mr. so and so. He often had my drink of choice ready and waiting for me as I sat down in the cabana. 

While at the pool, Aaron, who is in charge of the pool cabanas and towels, was very helpful. He greeted each person as if they were just as important as the next. Every day he made sure that my wife was satisfied with the location of the cabana and that we had enough towels and sun screen. If there was ever a problem we he worked on correcting the issue right away. 

We also went on one excursion while we were staying at the resort. We went on an all day trip to Chichen Itza, the Mayan temple. This was a long trip but very worth it. The entire day was spent learning about the different Mayan traditions and local wares. This is family friendly trip however since it takes about 12 hours, the younger kids may get bored. 

We are already planning our return trip for next year as we hope to make this a yearly tradition.

reviews.author: Agsss7
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: One of the best hotels I have ever stayed in. Super tasty food (large variety of restaurants), good service and nice staff. The beach is amazing and it is not far from the airport - perfect for a weekend getaway.

reviews.author: ELA 986
reviews.title: Staff was wonderful!
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus Cancun the last week in March with our family for spring break. We did the family concierge and it was definitely worth the upgrade. Jose and Violeta were our butlers and one of the best parts of our trip. Being able to communicate through the app was awesome. They helped us with everything and went above and beyond everyday. We were traveling with another family so it was so helpful to have them make our reservations for our large group. Jose even handmade special gifts for the children before we left. They are both truly wonderful people and we enjoyed getting to know them both. 

Michael at the pool was so helpful as well. He was a joy to talk to and we loved learning more about him each day. He even made balloon animals for the kids!  Lara, Leticia, Elliott, Salvador, Edgar and all the pool staff were great. They were always getting us what we needed before we knew we needed it. All the servers outside at the buffet for breakfast and lunch were great too. 

What we didn’t love:
The pool chairs were very uncomfortable. They did not adjust so there was only one level to sit. We rigged them with a magazine but I’d prefer for the chairs to be adjustable. 

There was not a sports bar or a place to watch the games. When we travel during March Madness and Cubs opening day we like to have a place to go. The guys ended up walking next door to the Marriott. 

Our room was ok. It only had one bathroom which is not ideal for 5 people in a suite but was my fault for not checking before I booked it. The room did not have any artwork which I thought was strange. It looked very plain but we cannot complain about the oceanfront view. Gorgeous!!

This was a nice hotel and the staff make it even nicer!  Thank you for a great trip!

reviews.author: Thornton Getaways
reviews.title: Family concierge or Royal Service is the only way to go
reviews.text: My wife and I had a great time with 2 - 17 year old teenage girls for spring break. 1st thing is Be patient at check in. You aren’t in America at the holiday inn express. Take a deep breath and practice smiling before you get there. If you check in at 3-5 pm, there will be a line. The beach staff maintain a very clean beach each morning and will attend to your every need if you rent one of the cushioned bali beds on the beach. You will also get an awesome arrangement of food and better service than the individual chairs on the beach or st least this was my experience. Make friends and bring some dollar bills, it goes a long way. If you dont rent a bali bed then obviously you need to get up early and grab your beach towels provided by the hotel and claim your chairs. The food is great at most of the restaurants as we only had one that was a not so great experience. The family concierge service is well worth the upgrade. Better set of rooms and location. We found great value with having any question we had about the resort, dinner reservations, best places to go off site, entertainment throughout the week on site,etc... A large all inclusive place like Paradisus can be overwhelming and sometimes you could feel lost but the concierge service truly makes it so easy. By the end of the week, you have some new friends and got the most out of your vacation.

reviews.author: Stay41124481828
reviews.title: Paradisus is a great place to stay in Cancun
reviews.text: Very positive on this Hotel...we had friends stay in another Hotel in Playa and many of them got food poisoning.  The Paradisus was great, especially the water activities !  Will definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Marvin Theodore
reviews.title: My home for unforgettable experiences
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun took the word paradise and turned into an experience to be remembered. 

I'll never forget the warm authentic greeting that I recieved right out my airport transportation. Then there is an entire rainforest jungle integrated into the facility that is the size of an entire shopping mall!

The view of the beach and the ocean are clearly seen from just about every window. The service is led by people that actually WANT to be there, a crucial factor that must not be ignored. 

The food quality, the waiters and the view while eating all combine to an unforgettable experience.

The area is clean and there's always technicians discreetly working proactively on the maintenance of the facility. 

Introverts will especially love the huge quiet area if ever in need of some introspective space to breath and just be. 

There are front desks everywhere to serve you and solve any issues with breathtaking decor at every angle.

reviews.author: Phil I
reviews.title: Royal Service At Paradisus = Amazing!
reviews.text:
Everything was just Perfect!

The Royal Service is worth EVERY penny. 
The Food and restaurant choices were excellent, Bali beds at the pool and beach, top shelf everything! Special treatment from the first minute. If going to Cancun, this is the only option.

We will be back!

reviews.author: Traveling family of 4
reviews.title: Wonderful Family Vacation
reviews.text:
We just returned from our trip at Paradisus Cancún. We traveled with our 2 young children (2 & 4). I was hesitant to book the family concierge but did so after reading reviews here. I am so glad I did!  The service provided by our butlers Lili and Gloria was top notch! My children were so pleased every day by little surprises in their room. We received champagne and chocolate covered strawberries two afternoons as well.  

We stayed in building 3 which was very convenient to all of the restaurants. We had a wonderful view of the ocean and the sunrise but I believe the resort view also had a nice view as it had a beautiful  sunset.  Our room was right about the main pool which had loud music in the afternoon but my kids thought this was fun!  We spent our days by the quieter kids pool, or the beach. 

Although we only visited it for a few hours the staff at the kids club was very friendly  and kind. My one son did not want to leave!  I also recommend doing the ceramic paintings by the kids pool- the gentleman inside the shop does a little “magic” to them after and They come out amazing. 

We went during a crowded week so chairs by the pool were hard to find during the morning. Elliot was always available to help us find a place and make sure we had everything that we needed.  I highly recommend renting a Balibed on the beach.  It is amazing!

The food was average but was what I expected from an all inclusive hotel of this size. As I mentioned we went during a very busy week. I felt like there could have been more servers in the buffet, as well as by the pool. But everyone who was there was extremely helpful and accommodating.  My overtired 4 year old insisted on chicken nuggets one night , and our server at the buffet had them prepared for him.  I highly recommend the market grill. It is the best restaurant of them all!! Enso has a beautiful location for a continental breakfast with omelets cooked to order.   Room service was fast, and complimentary.

The other perk of the family concierge is the private Lounge.  They had snacks , drinks, TV’s and books for the kids.  Also- the private check in and check out was amazing.  When we arrived there was a huge line to check in but we were escorted to the private area and were so pleased with the service.  

Overall- I would highly recommend this hotel especially to families traveling with young children.

reviews.author: Jim
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: I've been all over the Caribbean first time in Mexico and the first time at the paradisus I found it to be the best resort I've ever been at I was a little nervous going to Mexico the staff at this Resort are the friendliest I've ever seen the entertainment is top-notch the only complaint I could say is that the swimming pool it's too deep

reviews.author: Relax07549794924
reviews.title: Treated like royalty at Paradisus royal service.
reviews.text: From arrival to Paradisus to our departure every worker was attentive and friendly. The royal service has a great atmosphere that is both luxurious and intimate. The food is great at every restaurant and our favorite was la palapa; sitting next to the beach with good food and a cold drink, what more can you ask for! Our personal butler leyner was very helpful with all of our needs. Would definitely come back again!

reviews.author: Imran P
reviews.title: Family Trips
reviews.text: my first trip in Cancun realy memorable place. paradisus one of the best hotel in my all trips. i never see that hospitality any other resort . room nice and clean . i will visit paradises aging .  THANK YOU.

reviews.author: Tayla Park
reviews.title: Average at best
reviews.text:
Started off the trip a little rocky. Alejandro did our check in for us and it appared he had no idea what he was talking about. He gave us the option to upgrade to Royal Service for $70/day/person which we decided to do based on the perks. Although, he gave us info that wasn’t even correct, regarding location of La Palapa or the hours that they served. After upgrading we were then told that there were no king beds available for us and wouldn’t be until the next day (found this totally ridiculous, who doesn’t have any king beds?!) No compensation/ room upgrade was given after complaining but we were moved the next day, although this process wasn’t easy either, we personally had to move our bags from room to room. 

Room- Ocean view was beautiful nonetheless, I would not recommend staying in building 3. This building has the main bar/ restaurants in it which creates extreme noise at all hours of the night. The music at the bar was heard until 11pm some nights, not ideal if you’re wanting an early night! The room was also extremely small and there were ants in our room. 

Restaurants- Food overall was very poor. First night we ate at Bana, the sushi was nothing special and a little flavorless, second night we ate at Blue Agave, tacos were good but more of a lunch spot, third night we ate at Maket Grill which was by far the best meal we ate there, lastly we ate at Fuego, food was extremely average and service was the worst we have had yet. No asking how our food was, no refilling of drinks etc. 

Bar- The main bar is Avenue Bar, this bar was very dissapointing compared to other resorts we have stayed at. Service was not very good, they were not attentive when you needed a drink. The overall ambience was not very beach vacation like. I would suggest having more tables and chairs rather than lounging beds in a bar. 

Royal service- Worth the money but not $70/day. The service was definitely above average at the adults only pool, beach, and at La Palapa. The best food we experienced was there, everything was extremely tasty. It is a nice plus that you get to have the day beds included. 

Other cons- 
Charged $5 delivery fee for room service (ordered a sandwich and pasta included on the 24 hour room service menu, should not be a fee for this).

reviews.author: Wayne E
reviews.title: What a great place!
reviews.text:
I think the Royal Service is worth it. Hector our Butler was fantastic and the all around service at the cabanas was great. It’s worth the extra. A particular shout out to Oscar, Moises, Aaron, Jamie and all the staff out at the pool. This place is really good. They really do care about the customers and it shows.
Wayne and Heather

reviews.author: CharSkan1
reviews.title: Great Experience at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
My wife and I had a wonderful 4 days at Paradisus Cancun this past weekend.
Started out with a great check-in with Rosalia at the front desk.  Not only was she courteous, friendly and quick, she was able to get us an ocean view upgrade because of our anniversary.  Be sure to let the resort know prior that you are celebrating something.

When we entered our room on the 5th floor we were greeted with balloons, streamers, champagne and cake.  Nice touch.  The room is not huge, the bathroom was well laid out and the toiletries were stocked regularly (we will leave our toiletries at home next time).  The cleaners did forget to stock up water but a call down to reception and it was brought up promptly.

I have to agree with other reviewers, the resort needs more chairs by the pools and you certainly need to reserve them early.  We didn't have any issues as the pool crew of Michael, Yvonne and Elliot helped us get settled everyday.  They went out of their way to help, were hard working and always friendly.  I could see they had the same interactions with other guests.  Pool area had music and the entertainment staff were out everyday.
The servers by the pool, Laura, Flor and Jasmine did an excellent job of keeping us hydrated. 
One recommendation I have for the pool, it would be nice to have some sort of lift for guests with mobility problems.  

Got to admit we enjoyed the buffet, Naos more than we enjoyed the a la cartes.  Started with the friendly greetings from the hostess' Jenny and Teresa, the good food choices and the excellent service by our servers Edwin, Xavier, Alberto and Martin.  Any request we had they came through.  A little tip goes a long way.
The a la cartes we didn't fully enjoy.  They had some good food offerings but overall average.  Market Grill serves Brazillian style meats.  There was a lot but it seemed we were getting the leftovers on the skewers because of where we were seated but we did get some very tasty cuts.  One complaint from Vento, if you are advertising king scallops on the menu, don't bring me 10 small scallops the size of a small marble.

Ocean was spectacular.  Waves were great for jumping and the many different shades of blue take your breath away.  We even had a supermoon for a night.  No seaweed and the water is so clear.

We are trying to return to Paradisus Cancun this summer with the kids but it doesn't look promising as many weeks are booked up at the resort.  That tells you something.  We will keep on trying.

Enjoy.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Perfect All-Inclusive Vacation in March
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Paradisus as part of an all-inclusive package with a lagoon view room. First I'll say that the hotel is beautiful! Really well kept and clean everywhere. We had a lagoon facing suite and were offered an upgrade to an ocean view but this was not complimentary like others had in the past. Nonetheless the room was awesome! Big suite, lots of room, good air conditioning, and a good sized bathroom. Zero complaints about the room overall. It was spotless when we checked in.

The service was very professional from the front desk, to the cleaning staff, to the beach/pool staff and the bartenders. It just made the stay so much better to see people happy to be working where they are! The beachfront was large, clean, and if you went out early you would 100% get one of the free beach chairs out there. The main pool was the same - clean and lots of beach chair options (but these fill up quickly). For either the beach or the pool, if you put a towel on the chair it is "claimed" and you can leave and go to breakfast and come back to it whenever. We also rented the Bali bed by the pool for $135USD for a couple of days - it was awesome! You have a dedicated server to bring you drinks/food, it was very comfy with lots of space and shade, and you have the best view of the pool/ocean/both. Would highly recommend having one for at least one day!

Lots of restaurant options to choose from as well. We tried all of them and found the food at all to be delicious. Obviously we had our favourites but overall, not your typical resort food. All but one restaurant (the Naos buffet) are a la carte, which made the experience feel even more luxurious. 

Now for some specific shout-outs to certain staff that went above and beyond. Hugo (pool staff) was our server for both times we rented our Bali bed and was a regular presence on the pool deck regardless. He was exceptional and became a friend who would always stop and chat. He made our experience at Paradisus superb. Michael (pool concierge) was always a friendly face on the pool with an obsession to make sure you were taken care of in all ways possible. He made sure everyone was happy and even gave us a good deal on our Bali beds. And finally Giovanni (bartender) went above and beyond with his drink making. You could clearly see he loved his craft and was extremely creative in his drink creations. 

Overall I would say Paradisus is hard to beat for value, luxury, and overall service. You also have the option of upgrading to Royal Service (even MORE perks and luxury) which we didn't do. I would be hard pressed to find another resort that had more for the same price/experience. We will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Laurence_T
reviews.title: Great resort for families - super friendly staff!
reviews.text:
We've just spent a week at Paradisus Cancun during Spring Break.The resort was busy but I did not feel crowded at all. The restaurants were totally fine and the buffet gave quality options for our entire family.  The pool is really nice, arrive early in the morning though to book your chairs!

The big plus of this resort has to be the staff, super friendly and helpful, all! They were truly wonderful, all of them! The kids club was also fantastic, our 8 year old daughter spent lots of time there (Violetta is fantastic, with a ton of energy and keeping the kids busy all day long).

The only glitch happened during check in, we waited a long time and the gentleman did not seem super comfortable with the system. He made quite a few mistakes and after a long flight from Canada it was not great for all of us. 
The Melia App is great, you have access to all the activities - strongly recommend to download if you go to Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: seasoned travelers
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text: We have been to many different all inclusive resorts in Mexico and the Caribbean. This is by far the best resort. It started with our free upgrade to a ocean front room. Our view was amazing could not get enough of it. The resort is totally amazing, clean, the atrium in the middle is spectacular. Can't say enough about the staff. We loved Sergio and the staff at the bali beds on the beach. We were served lobster, had a band, and were waited on hand and foot. Also Salvador and staff at the Swim up bar were great...so much fun!! Last but not least our friend Orlando (Gru) at the Ibana bar in the Atrium. We had no trouble getting in for any reservations to eat in the evening. Not all of them require reservations. Beach was very beautiful and well kept. This is for sure a resort we will return to. Thanks Paradisus for a amazing trip!!!!!!

reviews.author: Teddy VanGalen
reviews.title: Couple Trip March
reviews.text:
We arrived to Paradisus and were originally booked for a lagoon view room but after speaking with friends who previously were here we upgraded to royal service. Upgrading was 100 % worth it.

 My girlfriend and I were given a butler, Rode who made everything as easy as possible and never had to worry about anything. He would book all restaurants, help with excursions and then will book Bali beds where you request. He has a ton of people to worry about himself but he will give each person the necessary attention. Rode was incredibly friendly, caring and helped us whenever we needed something to be done. I will request Rode when I come back to be our butler. Well done Paradisus. Royal service takes all the stress out of the stay and also made us not worry about a single thing. 

In regards to food, all the restaurants are incredible and all the staff throughout the day are incredibly nice and accommodating. You get to develop a friendship with the staff here and it seems they truly care about each and everyone who stays here. I will recommend anyone to come here, if you book royal service you will feel like royalty all week. I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: dnlmom
reviews.title: Disappointed in our return trip
reviews.text:
One of the things we were really looking forward to on our return trip to the Paradisus was early evening cocktails at the lobby bar.  Well, the bar never opened until 6:00 and they had removed all but 4 seats at the bar!  We like to go for drinks around 4:30 or 5:00, before dinner.  When we spoke to the bar manager, he gave us a long winded excuse about how it worked better for the hotel to open at 6:00 (but not for the customers).  He assured us that the bar would open the next evening at 5:30 and noted that the Avenue Bar was always open anyway (again with only 4 seats).  The next evening, the lobby bar did not open until 6:00, nor did the Avenue Bar!  So much for assurances by management.
Furthermore, when we arrived, we had been assigned rooms facing the lagoon, even though we very specifically asked for ocean front.  After 1 1/2 hours at registration, they arranged for ocean front rooms for us beginning the next day.  Registration lines were ridiculously long.
Rooms were made up late (not done by 3:30 PM), refrigerator was not regularly restocked.  There always seemed to be some kind of little problem.
Pool was way too loud in the afternoon!
We have stayed at many Melia hotels and at the Paradisus more than twice.  I will check around next time we come to Cancun to see what the other options are.

reviews.author: Stephanie R
reviews.title: Thank you staff!
reviews.text: Thank you Jose ( club Melia Butler) , Darwin ( enso waiter and Angel ( activity staff) awesome guys made my 19 th bday special!they are so hardworking and always have a smile on their face even when tired 😇

reviews.author: Rafielle
reviews.title: Entertainment
reviews.text: Angel from entertainment is awesome! Got an excellent workout in with his spin class and 6pack class! Angel is a great asset to the paradisus Cancun team! I hope to take his classes again when I return for a future vacation!

reviews.author: Amarjeet M
reviews.title: They Say Great employees and Staff Can hide your all deficiencies .
reviews.text: Great staff ,hard workers But management thumbsdown Small reception desk could not hold even office supply.Basement Ground floor rooms Noisy Couldn't sleep kept getting noise from adjoining restaurant

reviews.author: Lucy Moreno
reviews.title: My butler rode
reviews.text: From the moment that we stepped onto the property grounds we were treated with the best service. We had the royal service and it was definitely worth it. Part of royal service means that you get a personal butler and our butler was, Rode, and he was amazing! I celebrated my birthday while I was here and he went above and beyond to make it amazing! He blew up balloons, decorated my room, had a cake, and even a bottle of wine waiting for me. He checked in with us everyday and made sure that we had everything that we needed. He was super attentive and made us feel at home and safe. Rode, thank you so much for making this the best birthday and trip! I hope that we will get to have you again when we come back. I highly recommend this place and Rode! Thank you, thank you!

reviews.author: Breannagilbert
reviews.title: My butler rode
reviews.text: Rode has made our trip the most memorable time! He was very attentive, energetic and exceeded all expectations! We’ve been treated like royalty from beginning to end! I can’t wait to come back and visit, I will be requesting my very favorite, Rode!

reviews.author: Marlene S
reviews.title: couple in family resort
reviews.text: This hotel was our first Melia the food , staff and amenentities were great . top shelf liquor and white sand cleaned beaches were awesome. They have several restaurants but we found ourselves always at the buffet since the options wee so tasty.

reviews.author: Renee L
reviews.title: Pros & Cons - Good information to know before you book at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
You are only allowed 1,500 characters on a review so if you want to see my full and very helpful review go to the detail page for the reviewed location.

I would like to give a huge shout out to the hard working people here: Flor, Rene and Luis are three people that served us delicious drinks on the beach, these people are some of the hardest working people at the resort, walking up and down the stairs to bar to get our drinks all day, every day in the hot sun, walking through the sand, this is a lot of work. At night we always went to the only ONE outside bar they have Cocos Beach Club if your lucky you will have Salvadore & Carina there to take care of you, both of them are incredible hard workers and made our nights at the bar very enjoyable, it felt like we were hanging out with friends.

reviews.author: Climber07503179246
reviews.title: Bradly
reviews.text: This was our 8th trip to Cancun and our first at the Paradisus. They all have their good and bad points. About my only complaints would be a very limited buffet, not a lot for evening entertainment and very slow check in. The staff is probably the best I've been around and it's a nice resort.

reviews.author: happycouple1234
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun....
reviews.text:
