Great resort. Great food, the only downside is that it is hard to get bottled Water. The liquor was decent....no no name stuff here.  Room was a Junior Suite which was kinda small but functional. Resort was a decent size... mid size. 

Big shout out to Sarahi at the baby club.   I observed Sarahi working with my 4 year old  and supporting a lot of educational activities... pehnominal! SHE is an actual trained teacher working at the kids club. 

Overall this is q great place for families. Great food, and atmosphere.  Bottled water is kinda hard to find... but aside from that it's a great place.

reviews.author: millieq55
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus is a beautiful resort with so much going on we didn't feel the need to leave the resort at all! We had never been to Mexico and were leery of leaving the resort at all, but the Aqua Adventures business was affiliated with the resort and located right across the street, it was a legit business with so many cool options! Julio coordinated activities in the resort and took us kayaking in the lagoon and set up beach volleyball everyday, we had such a great time and kept active because of him! We decided not to do any of the excursions, but when we come back we absolutely will! We upgrade to Royal Service (SO worth it) and it really changed our whole experience at the Paradisus. The service by the Royal Service pool was unbelievable, Orlando made sure we were never without a drink or chips and guacamole! There was also excellent service on the beach, Orlando and other workers were always coming around giving buckets with waters and we constantly had our bucket filled with ice to keep everything cold! If you decide to upgrade and be Royal Service, ask for Alex as your butler... we did not have him but met a couple who did and he set up the kayaking for them and us! Our butler was Javier. We didn't see him much but he set up all of our dinners the first night which was nice. 

Timiteo and Giovanni at the Bar at Bana were the best bartenders in the resort!! They made us amazing drinks that I wish I could re-create!! Definitely make your way to this bar and ask them to make you something special!

reviews.author: DALLAS
reviews.title: GREAT RESORT !
reviews.text: Highly highly recommend this resort ! Very nice, and employee friendly. Good food, great daily and nightly events. Has huge pool and 7 restaurants. Ocean view rooms with balcony are great. Walking distance to jet skies and jungle tour - very close. Me and my girlfriend had a great time here will definitely come back !

reviews.author: Rick C
reviews.title: Romantic dinner for 2
reviews.text: We have been at Paradisus Cancun Royal Service for nearly a week now. The amenities are amazing, staff is very friendly, having an amazing time!! The shining moment was the romantic dinner for two that was set up for Myself and my Wife for our 1 year anniversary. Josue did a fantastic job setting everything up, the food was remarkable, he went out of his way to make the night very romantic. Thank you to Josue and also Leynerd for the amazing night. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!

reviews.author: Laurence B
reviews.title: Beautiful and relaxing, just a couple downsides
reviews.text:
Context : I stayed here with my boyfriend for 1 week. We go on vacation in Mexico twice a year , this was one of our favourite resort. We didn’t get the royal service so we didn’t have a butler or access to certain restaurants like some
Of these reviews talk about. Don’t expect a butler. 

Here’s the positive : 
- Absolutely loved the fresh scented towel upon our arrival. It was definitely needed after a long day of traveling. 
- Loved the service throughout our stay , employees are very accommodating and make an effort to learn your name and they actually remember it so that was a nice touch.
- The room is spacious and bed is comfortable 
- I loved using the Meliá app to reserve for dinner. Very simple and easy to use it’s great that I don’t have to physically go to each restaurant to reserve a day or two in advance. The app also shows all activities and shows and the times and location witch was great
- Blue agave ( tacos and quesadillas) is always open , and delicious witch is great if you get tired of the buffet
- The beach is gorgeous and water is beautiful and free of seaweed witch was a great addition for me 
- The personalized service of Francisco and Miguel at the beach was amazing ! I would come back just for them. Francisco learned what I liked to drink and had it ready at around the time I went down to the beach witch was amazing. Checked on us every 5-10 minutes to see if we needed anything. We loved it.  
- It is very simple and easy to make requests either by phone or using the app ( like more shampoo or more towels ) 
-The buffet has a lot of options and it’s different everyday witch is nice 
- Room service is very fast 
- You can have shisha for about 30$ by the pool witch we enjoyed at the end of the day
-The bar in the middle of the main area ( next to the Japanese restaurant ) has amazing cocktails and great service by Orlando. He made me discover amazing drinks. 
- The main building always smelled like a spa witch was amazing 
- The sunset bar ( only open on Monday for 5 a 7 ) , was great ! Delicious cocktails and view on the gorgeous sunset. I would
Of been there every day if it was open more than 1 day. 
- Aquaworld is right in front of the hotel , it has a great range of water activity and we loved that it was close and we didn’t have to take a longs shuttle like most excursions( scuba diving was a great experience, it was our first time , the instructor at our pool was great at teaching us and calming us before the actual activity ) We would of loved to see more life under water but we still got to see a huge turtle from very close and a sting ray. 
- There’s plenty of little nooks around the hotel if you want to be alone and have some peace and quiet witch is lovely. 

Negatives 
- Dinner options for food were very ordinary. The buffet is actually better than some of the restaurants. You can eat at Tiempo for 140$ American a head witch seems a bit much. I would
Of loved a middle ground 
- The coffee( nespresso) and the ice cream shop ( gelato) are only open from 8-10 and 3-5 , witch we didn’t appreciate since we woke up late on a couple of days and would
Of loved a nice cappuccino at 11 am or even noon
- They ran out of towels at the pools a couple
Of times and we were told to come back in 20 minutes witch wasn’t major but still noted.
- They didn’t really recruit or were god at organizing sporting events. We stayed at a lot of hotels were the staff motivates people and find players for volleyball for example( witch is supposed to be organized at 11 am and 3 pm ) but most days my boyfriend really wanted to play and there didn’t seem
To be any organizer there or anything happening. 
- It was definitely difficult to find room around the pool witch was always full and a bit noisy so we hung out more down at the beach. 
- Only huge down point for us : Check in was extremely and unnecessarily long. We got to the hotel at 11 am , we then waited in line 1 hour to check in ( at least they passed out plenty of food and drinks so that was really appreciated) , they said the room was only ready at 3 , witch is fine but they then asked to come back to get our room key and information at 3. In the Mean time we walked around the site to have a look around ( I would of loved to change out of my airport clothes but couldn’t since the room wasn’t ready ) , then we went back at 3 and my boyfriend waited another hour to actually get our keys and everything. I feel that 2 hours total of wait time just to check in is excessive in my experience but I’m aware that it’s spring break and it’s very busy so I wasn’t upset or anything just annoyed. 

Overall we had an amazing time , beautiful views , great dedicated service but the food was only ok. We would definitely come back and maybe check out royal service next time.

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.title: Go to Paradisus in Playa Del Carmen Instead.
reviews.text:
We (husband and I)  travelled with our baby 2 years old here. Had a great trip but here's our summary: 

ROOM: Decent, outdated but clean and spacious. Tub kept leaking but upon calling they did respond quickly to fix the problem. We had the family concierge room and it was great for families. No mini bar in room though.  Highly recommend ocean view rooms here...beautiful view. No tub on porch or jacuzzi..but you get that at Playa Del Carmen. The beds are the best at Playa Del Carmen....beds in Paradisus Cancun are ok. Pillows weren't great in Cancun either but in Playa we loved it. Microwave provided if requested for heating up baby bottle in Cancun. In Playa Del Carmen, it comes in room with a full kitchen for you in your suite. 

FOOD: Average- not great but not bad. Ice cream was great though!

SERVICE: Good, respond quickly to all your needs but you have to ask for everything...including for your in room snacks and drinks and coffee and water to be refilled. Could use more poolside servers as service wasn't great there. It didn't appear as if there was enough staff poolside. 

BEACH: Beautiful, no complaints here. 
 
POOL: Getting a pool chair seemed to be an issue around the kids side. More guests than available seats. Pool is shallow for kids but really deep on the adults side at around 5ft deep of water. 

Summary: We have travelled to many 5 star resorts in Cancun. For a 4.5 star facility, it seems to be lacking the service and amenities of the Playa Del Carmen sister resort. Our advice is to pay extra and go to Paradisus La Esmeralda in Playa Del Carmen- food, service, rooms, pool, amenities for children are way way better. We travelled to Playa Del Carmen Paradisus Las Esmeralda three months ago and we are at Paradisus Cancun right now and see a dramatic difference all aspects.

reviews.author: Mont88y
reviews.title: Fantastic - best hotel I’ve ever stayed at
reviews.text:
This hotel is hands down the best I’ve ever stayed in. Nothing was too much trouble for staff, the buffet restaurant was superb - good quality food and the a la cartes we’re out of this world! We paid extra to eat at the Michelin starred restaurant with wine flight and would recommend this, both the food and wines were outstanding and it’s basically half price to what you would pay in the uk.
We had a fantastic holiday here and would not hesitate to come back!

reviews.author: Mile High Traveler
reviews.title: Better Options in Cancun
reviews.text:
I have stayed at other Melia properties and the one in Plays is still in my opinion the best one we have stayed at in all our trips (18) to Mexico.  However this property fails in almost every way.

Rooms:  The rooms are much smaller then they seem in the pictures.  I mentioned this to the GM and he told "The hotel is a pyramid and they get smaller on the way up".  Doesn't make any sense to me, but OK.

Room Service:  I do not like waiting until 5:00PM to 6:00PM to have my room cleaned.  I mentioned this to the GM as well and his answer was "We are very busy property".  To me being busy is not excuse for poor service.  Also, they were very bad at stocking the mini bar.  Even knocked on my door two nights at 11:00PM to do so.  So unless you call down and ask for them to come clean your room it could be dinner time before they get to it.

Food:  Was just Ok.  Good selection but typical resort food.  Their other property I felt the food was outstanding.

Beach/Pools:  Beach is nice, service on the beach is good, however you have to get down there earlier to claim your spot.  People were laying towels out at 6:45 in the morning to claim their spots and not coming back until lunch time.  If you didn't claim a spot earlier they run out of chairs very quickly.  Pool is the same.  Also, not a lot of organized beach activities like other resorts have.

Other issues:  They burn an incense through out the hotel the is very strong and over baring and besides myself I heard numerous people complaining about it.

reviews.author: roman s
reviews.title: So so experience for the money
reviews.text:
Context: this is compared to a couple of RIUs and iberostar and we did NON pay the extra fee for the “club membership”. Restaurant and pool service is very slow, and food selection is mediocre compared to the other places and the most annoying thing was sneaky pitches about the club membership masked as a family consierge. 

I feel like the hotel is really optimized for the folks who have the membership, as there is way more cabanas (only for members) than regular shaded lounge chairs. If you want to pay for a cabana it’s $150 a day... or get the membership. I also suspect many of the 5 star reviews came from members, so I want to make sure I explained the difference.

reviews.author: Nomad673064
reviews.title: Spring Break
reviews.text:
Paradisus was everything we wanted and more!  Our family of four and my sisters family of 5 had a very memorable vacation.  We were with teenagers and they enjoyed it as much as us!  We had a Ocean View room, which was a bit tight for a family of four so we ordered a cot for my son to sleep on., which worked out ok.  Beds are full (not Queen) so pretty tight to share for adults.
  
The breakfast and lunch were very good, as was the Grill restaurant by the pool.  We ate there almost every day.  Dinner options were good but make sure you make reservations at least 1-2 days in advance.

We enjoyed the shows by the pool and the Lounge shows - nice option to have something to do after dinner. 

We wish there was a jacuzzi at the resort - that was one thing we missed.  It is also difficult to walk the beaches in this area of Cancun.  The beaches are very sloped making it hard to walk a mile or two (which we love to do in FL). Not a deal breaker on either end, but would have been nice for 
to have a jacuzzi to relax in at the end of the day.

If you are looking for an upscale resort with beautiful amenities, Paradisus is the place for you.  Teenagers were fine there too but I would not bring kids from 6-12 ... not much for them to do besides swim and eat as the Kids Club is geared towards little kids.

reviews.author: Zeinab H
reviews.title: Alexander and Violeta were Fabulous!! Stunning resort!
reviews.text: My family and I had such a fabulous time! The resort was sooo amazing clean and beautiful!! The food was absolutely amazing!!! Our family have 0 complaints about this resort. All the service staff were amazing. A special thank you to our butlers Alexander and Violeta!!! They were amazing and helped us with all our various needs and truly went above and beyond! Thank you Paradisus we will definitely be back again!!

reviews.author: Spencer
reviews.title: Royal service - worth it for the people
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for 6 days and the main difference maker was the people. Our butler, Alex, was exceptional and went above and beyond to make sure we had a perfect vacation. Royal service employee Jennifer was amazing and she should be a butler if she isn't already. We'll absolutely be back next year specifically for those two. If you come, ask for them by name. Thank me later

reviews.author: Rohan
reviews.title: Resort facilities are great, restaurants are great, service is great. Rooms need an upgrade.
reviews.text:
I would unequivocally recommend this resort to a friend. It is good for families, but that doesn't mean its bad for couples or younger audience. 

Pros - 
- Resort facilities are great.
- Large Pools.
- Enough chairs on the beach and around the pool.
- Daily buffet restaurant - Naos is pretty decent for breakfast lunch. 
- The tacos place - Blue Agave is good if you want something lighter. 
- Coco's beach bar has a nice vibe. Especially if you want to hang out here later at night. 
- Evening restaurants - Fuego, Market Grill, Vento are pretty good. Enso is alright.
- This busy resort has some nooks where you can just hang out in solitude. 
- They seem generous with drinks. 
- Service is amazing. Right from the time you land at their front door to the time you depart.
- Shout out to the amazing bell boys, receptionists, servers, bar tenders. No one ever says no  to any request. Amazing hospitality. 
- Activities in the evening are pretty good. 
- Liked the performers who performed near Avenue Bar, wish they would stay longer on certain nights. 

Cons - 
- The resort is big. Has 5 pyramids. So because of the layout of you are in pyramid 1 or 5, you may have to walk a bit to come to pyramid 3 which hosts most restaurants and bars. 
- Rooms need an upgrade. From the inside rooms look dated. Ours was an ocean view with jetted tub, but the actual room itself was pretty mediocre. 
- Wish they had mist sprays for the hotter areas. 
- At times we would have liked coffee. The only coffee bar in the resort would be closed most of the times.

reviews.author: Taforbes
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text:
This was a lovely property. The service
Was great  food was good in most places  many activities liquor flowed  people were great.  Would
Go back again. Weather was perfect. Excursions were so so  when they say all inclusive. It’s true

reviews.author: Jarrod D
reviews.title: 4th time @ Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Timeshare vendors need to lay off us guests when we express we are not interested in timeshare purchasing.. Check in wait times need improvement. Other than that had an okay stay here. Just certain staff members made it less enjoyable this trip.

reviews.author: czmarchy
reviews.title: Birthday Bash
reviews.text: I came back from a fantastic birthday trip to Paradisus Cancun, I went with a group of friends and we stayed in Royal Service. Every one was great-Hector, Melina, Moises, Cesar, Valeria, Oscar-just to name a few. It is a low key luxury experience in paradise. Love the Bali beds, the Cadillac margaritas, the nightly entertainment and the décor of the hotel. We all agreed that we need a yearly trip to Paradisus!

reviews.author: Trek25515349203
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: I’m going to write both positive and negative comments.                                        Positive: I would like to appreciate those guys that served us Orlando Bello( Nespresso) great coffee, great service, friendly personality as well as Rafael Chi,Ho , Christian. Thank you all for your great service.                                                                                               Negative: I will start from our room it had only 2 visible electrical outlets, one in the room, the other one in the bathroom. We found more behind the furniture but in order to use it we had to move our furniture. Speaking of furniture our 3drovers were not working properly I was afraid to drop on my foot while trying to open them. I was on vacation with my 76 years old aunt she had hard time going to the beach, because there wasn’t any handicap access or ramp. I don’t think this property is handicap friendly. It’s a problem for people with wheelchairs to access the beach.  Another thing that I didn’t like was that coffee shop and ice cream boutique were open twice a day from 8-10am and 3-5pm. Why is there limited time? I have stayed in other resorts non of them had limited time like this property. I hope my review will help otherwise.

reviews.author: lrs1963
reviews.title: An amazing place!!!
reviews.text:
My daughter and I got upgraded to the Royal Service.  We absolutely LOVED it!  I would suggest that you opt for the Royal Service if you can.  The best parts of the Royal Service were having food and drink service on the beach and pool, the private pool, and the private restaurant that overlooks the beach (La Palapa).  We loved the Bali Bed.  We reserved a Bali Bed for our last day.  There was no additional cost for the bali bed since we had the Royal Service.  You have to reserve a Bali Bed a day or two in advance at the Royal Service Pool. We ate our breakfast at La Palapa on 3 out of the 4 days we were there, and it was wonderful.  We also loved the room service which was free if you have the Royal Service.  
The grounds were beautiful and the people that work there are amazing.  The woman that checked us in on the first day asked me if we were happy on the second day.  Our answer was a huge YES!  
The only weak part, in our opinion, was the dinners.  We found that the food was prettty similar across all of the restaurants and the buffet.  We ended up eating at the Blue Agave (a taco and tequilla place for a quick bite) several times when our dinners just didn't satisfy us.  We tried the Tapas restaurant and the Market Grill.  They also have outdoor dinner buffets out by the pools, where the entertainment will be later on in the evening.  These outdoor buffets were good, similar to what is served in the buffet (Naos).  The evening entertainment was fun.  They had acrobats, dancers, and a retro night with a live band.  
Breakfast and lunch were great!  
I was glad not to see any college spring breakers at the resort!  The resort is quiet, lovely, and relaxing.  I would love to return with my husband!  
Thank you Paradisus!

reviews.author: Zachary L
reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text: The nightlife is great! Lots of shows going on at night and during the day there is lots of dancing and music. Staff is extremely helpful and friendly! Rodrigo (activities staff) helped us find yummy resteraunts.  Restaurante mole was great!

reviews.author: Gerald H
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: This resort is our favorite in Cancun. It has Good food, updated and stylish resort. All of plants and vegetation in the hallway and Atrium is a nice touch. The staff are very friendly and helpful. The beach is great also.

reviews.author: Roam26357778796
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Rude staff, empty trays at the buffet all day long, not enough umbrellas by the pool, pool chairs not adjustable, very weak drinks, very slow service by the pool, too many disruptive events by the pool, unexpected taxes at check out, not enough mexican food choices. The only good thing was the beach. Absolutely beautiful.

reviews.author: CanDan6462
reviews.title: Great Experience at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: This review is a little late, we returned early March from a week at the Paradisus.  This was our first time here.  The hotel is amazing and has many great restaurants to choose from.  Mid week we upgraded to Family Concierge - what a great experience!   It allowed us to have breakfast and lunch at La Palapa which has amazing food and Daniel took good care of us there.   Rodolfo our butler took amazing care of us and arranged anything we needed for us as did Elliot by the pool and Sofonia.  We had a beautiful seafood feast at our Cabana one day.  Special thank you to Jesus and Eduardo at the Pool Bar.  All of the staff are genuinely happy to do a good job and provide good service.  We will definitely be returning!  Great job everyone!

reviews.author: Chany R
reviews.title: Huge international resort - family friendly
reviews.text: We stayed March 7-14 with our 5 and 8 year olds.  Had a beautiful stay.  The weather was hot and windy - this meant we  spent most our time in the pools.  The service at this hotel is superior - you never need to ask twice and the staff are super friendly and helpful.  Our children LOVED the kids club - lots of activities through the full day.  The restaurants were excellent, esp Fuego (get the pan fried steak — best steak ever in Mexico — thanks to Christian for the suggestion!).  In all we had a wonderful trip.  The only downfall of this gorgeous resort is the ongoing g battle for beach chairs and umbrellas.  People do actually reserve them with towels/ personal effects before 7am to get the best pool/ beach locations- esp on the busy weekend.  Be forewarned and plan ahead.  Otherwise a beautiful and much needed family holiday.  Thank you Paradisus Cancun — you rose to the occasion! ❤️

reviews.author: Safari61614675389
reviews.title: Excellent place for family.
reviews.text: The place is clean and have special kiddie pool. Gloria and Rodolfo were very helpful. Food is good. The location is nice and safe. Many restaurants and variety of options for food and drinks. The family concierge option was great.

reviews.author: Meilyn Boutet
reviews.title: Spring Break at Paradisus
reviews.text: I attended with my friends for our spring break. As soon as we entered the hotel we felt welcomed. The staff was amazing and super friendly. The food was pretty good, better than I was expecting. I would 100% recommend the hotel to a friend.

reviews.author: Aaron Tagala
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun 2019
reviews.text: Amazing staff and awesome views! Be friends with Julio, Sergio, Ruben, Argenis, Perla, Angel, Jaime, and Rodrigo and they will make sure you have an awesome time! The sushi in the main lobby restaurant is great and the tacos at Blue Agave are delicioso!

reviews.author: annie0liver
reviews.title: MAS TEQUILA!!!!
reviews.text:
That was the best trip ever! I stayed there for my spring break trip and all of the employees went above and beyond.

Shoutout to the activities team for making this trip soooo much fun! (julio, rodrigo, y angel hasta leugo y muchas gracias!!! -Annie) I learned how to make ceviche and sushi, and i went wine tasting (lol) on the resort. I also went kayaking on the bay right off the resort. The pool party was a ton of fun and the silent disco was definitely a sight to see. Bored was not even an option during this trip because of all of the activities. 

The food was good, i definitely recommend ordering all of the appetizers because they never disappointed. The buffet (Naos) offered so many different foods, also shoutout to my waiter Martin for really making me and all of my friends feel so welcomed and special.

The service throughout the pool and the beach was awesome. All of the waiters made sure to ask us if we needed anything every time they passed us. Shoutout to Victor (the victor that works right next to the pool bar i believe his last name is rodriguez because sorry if i'm wrong!)

Speaking of the pool bar, shoutout to the bartenders Ruben, Sergio, and Perla for taking care of our demanding asses. All of the drinks were so yummy, they were always ready to hear what kind of shot was going to be ordered next. Sometimes we wold just turn around and see a line of shots waiting for us because they knew we were going to ask for more. 

Don't worry, if you like to workout the gym had at least 15 different machines, 4 or 5 treadmills, 4 ellipticals, and several other cardio machines. There was a good variety of free weights, a smith machine, and a set of cables. 

The room, the resort, the views were all spectacular. Honestly, cannot thank the staff enough for how hard working and caring they are. I would 100% go back to this resort without a doubt and will always recommend it.

reviews.author: Chase T
reviews.title: Service Beyond Measure!
reviews.text: Guillermo and Christian at Fuego are a duo to remember. Their attentiveness and service was above and beyond. So much so that we went to Fuego three times during our stay at Paradisus. We will certainly be back to the resort just to see them! Additionally, the man who showed us our room, Alex (or Antonio?) saw that we were not happy with the room and without being asked he called the front desk and got us a better room with a great view! It is this kind of attention to guests needs that is rare in today's world. Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: PeachTree
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
My Fiance and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun 7nights March 9-16 2019.
Had an absolute wonderful time! The staff was amazing, everone was very cheerful and happy to help with any need we had.
-Melvin @ Enso restaurant*****(THE BEST!!!)
-Carlos @ Enso restaurant
-Katina @ Avenue bar*****
-Michael pool concierge*****
-The two poolside women who serve drinks (dont remember there names😞)
Among the ultra friendly staff these few really stood out as above and boyond to us in making our stay great!

Other then staff...the food, cleanliness, entertainment, and layout was awsome, roomservice was incredible clean n fancy eceryday. Super pretty Resort.
Overall super great place and WILL 100% be going back!

If i had to find CONS about the place id say
-Shower took like 10min to heat up
-A/C never really got cold, tolerable but i like it cold at night(mexico i know, its hot get over it!)
-I wish there was a "specialty drink menu" at the bars so we could try new drinks
-Annoying and difficult to get bottles of water... had to basicaly room service order them to the room?

But not enough to keep us away.

GO TO THIS RESORT! Go to Enso and ask for Melvin!

reviews.author: Pauln5857
reviews.title: 2nd Year As Good as the 1st
reviews.text: We figured, When you find a resort that hits all the points on your checklist, why look elsewhere. Cancun beach itself is beautiful. The resort is large but has the feel of an intimate resort. You can get from room to beach in 5 minutes. Restaurants and bars are centrally located.   The food and service are second to none. They go out of their way to make certain every detail is thought of. My wife is fair skinned, so the thatched umbrellas (she refers to them as mushrooms) on the beach are a big plus. We’ve read so many reviews that talk about upgrading to royal service. As I’m sure royal service is spectacular, we didn’t upgrade either year and couldn’t imagine it being much better. So my recommendation is, if you’re budget conscious, you will be extremely pleased with the service and amenities. I wasn’t to extend a special mention to Francesco who tended to us on the beach and served us breakfast yesterday morning.

reviews.author: ValaKoza
reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text:
This was our 23rd trip to the Caribbean and 5th time to Mexico. we visited this resort in March 5-12. here is the good: the resort is very beautiful especially the lobby in the middle pyramid, it is like a garden with palms, trees and bushes and a pond with fish and a fountain and Japanese restaurant Bana which was great, we went there twice, food was so good, and the waiting time for food was about 10-15 min and service was excellent like in the other a la carte restaurants: oriental Enso and Mediterranean Vento, food in the buffet was great too, we never had any stomach issues. they also cook food beside the deep quit pool every lunch, check it out, seafood with rice was my favorite, the room was pretty decent and quiet, far away from the noisy bar, the washroom had bidet, service in Mexico is the best, they are eager to serve and please you, not like in some other Caribbean countries, the resort has 5 pyramids, the 5th one is for adults only, pools are very deep and they have shallow ones for kids as well, try out all restaurants, we went only to 3 of them which i regret.
here is the bad or not so good: the room did not have a room clock which i need, good i brought my own, but there was a coffer maker in the room which is useless for me,  the ocean was rough, high waves, floating devices are not allowed, we were using them but when a lifeguard saw us on them, he came and told us not to use them for our safety, not sure why, which was very  disappointing and we could not go in the ocean without them because of high waves, once a big wave knocked me over , i went under the water, got sand in my mouth, ears, etc and never went back in. we visited Beach Palace resort in November 2017  which is located 4 km from this one on the same stretch of the beach and the ocean was so quiet, no waves at all, so we were very disappointed that the ocean was rough this time in March, well, what can you do, you cannot foresee it, they do not have enough sun beds, umbrellas and palapas, the resort is huge, too many people, if you need a shade, you have to get up early and reserve the chairs, they do not have towel cards which is good for some people and bad for the other ones because you can take many towels and do not need to return them back to get cards, you are supposed to put them in special towel big brown containers beside the pools and the beach, but many people do not know that and when they are done with the beach or the pool, they go and leave towels on the beds and the other people who are looking for vacant sun beds cannot find them because there are towels on beds, so they think beds are taken and cannot find empty beds, this was very frustrating to me, as there was no order, and i have been to 23 resorts so far, they should have towel cards. Overall, the resort is fantastic but the ocean was rough, as for me i go to the Caribbean because of the ocean.

reviews.author: Johnny G
reviews.title: A Great Vacation, with a few Caveats
reviews.text:
Summary - Great pool, beautiful beach, helpful waiters, very nice hotel rooms. Poor quality food, aggressive and annoying sales people: be prepared for a stay in a comfortable and well appointed room and for a relaxing time at the pool and beach, but also be firm at managing and walking away from the sales pitches people will constantly be giving you and brace yourself for bland and poorly cooked food that should be considered unacceptable for a resort of this quality.

We stayed at the Paradisus for 5 nights, overall we had a good stay. We upgraded to an ocean view room for $50 extra per night and thought it was totally worth it. We declined an upgrade to Royal Service since we didn't think we would use it and didn't want to spend time in the quiet adults-only section of the pool. There are many pros and cons to our experience, here are the most important ones:

Pros:

- Hotel aesthetics and decor: the hotel is designed nicely for a massive resort hotel and the decor is pleasing. The garden and koi ponds in the atrium are a plus as are the amounts of natural sunlight in the hotel.

- Room comfort and quality: the room was updated, clean, had a great A/C, excellent bathroom, and an amazing view with a very private balcony. The bed was comfortable and the drinks/waters we took from the refrigerator were replaced daily. 

- Pool and Beach: the pool(s) are great. They were never too crowded, have a swim up bar that we can easily access, and are clean. There is a shortage of pool chairs, so get to the pool early if you can OR reserve a Bali bed. We chose to reserve a Bali bed each day and it's worth it to have some private space, waiter service, and guaranteed shade. Beware that they will try to get you to pay for bottle service, a seafood platter, and snacks for $175 for the day. You can opt for just the Bali bed and a bottle of Prosecco for $60. The beach in front of the resort was kept very clean and was raked daily. There were usually plenty of beach chairs available. 

- Hotel Staff: the wait staff were friendly, eager to help, and very attentive to our needs. Their responsiveness to our needs and requests made a big difference in our stay. The front desk staff was friendly but was slow during check in and wouldn't give us answers to question we had and continuously decided to defer us to "guest services" (aka, pushy sales people who did at times provide helpful information).  

Cons:

- Food: this is by far our biggest complaint. This resort is a culinary mess! The food was absolutely terrible and the blandest stuff on earth. It's like it was made for a person whose palate requires zero flavor, zero seasoning, and no spice. The Naos Restaurant buffet had a lot of poor quality selections that were obviously not fresh, had obviously been sitting out all day, and were from reused pieces of leftovers from prior meals or the prior day(s). It was a challenge to make a reservation at any of the specialty restaurants and it could only be done prior to 5pm on the same day by calling from your hotel room. While they claimed that they were nearly booked solid and they had only limited availability at many of the restaurants, we noticed that they were only about half full. A few that I'm going to call out:
- Restaurant Blue Agave: tacos were very average and somewhat flavorless, I've had better at countless places in the United States. 
-Restaurant Fuego: they claim to be a restaurant that has spicy Latin American cuisine, but each of our dishes was mild with no heat and little to no seasoning. 
- Restaurant Enso: almost none of their main dishes on the menu were what they claimed to be (for instance, spicy Pad Thai does not consist of Italian linguine noodles mixed with a few vegetables and peanuts in a flavorless brown broth). That wait staff was great here and picked out a super bottle of wine for us, so that made up for the horribly misleading/false menu.

- Aggressive and Annoying Sales People: everyone from the people handing out beach towels and info on extra activities, to the guest services concierge rep, to the front desk staff is focused on a hard upsell. They are persistent to the point where they are annoying and offensive. Be politely blunt and do not let the "guest services" rep badger you, walk away. Unless you are in the market for a timeshare/club membership, do not agree to sit through one of their presentations. We initially agreed to attend a breakfast to learn about a new property and then we found out it was a 2 hour long sales pitch so we backed out. We were persistently contacted and bothered and had to eventually feel like we were being rude for repeatedly saying no. It was definitely a negative part of our visit. 

Overall it was a pleasurable and worthwhile trip and we had a great time. I simply warn future Paradisus visitors to be blunt with the sales/service folks and not to engage in conversation with them.  Also, don't expect a culinary adventure. It's a place that's great for those who looking for a comfortable and relaxing beach visit.

reviews.author: Shannon C
reviews.title: Spring Break!
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience here! Rodrigo, Julio, and Angel kept us busy with fun activities while Sergio, Perla, Ruben, Michael, and Victor Rodriquez gave us drinks! We were always welcomed at meals with Martin as our waiter and couldn't have had a better spring break!

reviews.author: gevachristine25
reviews.title: Gevachristine
reviews.text: We had wonderful service from Guillermo, Asuncion, Micheal, Ivonne, Laura, Nacho, the morning coffee guy, Roberto.  They catered to us.  I am gluten free and they always made sure I had what I needed!  Will definitely be back because of the service!!  We are treated like family! 🤗

reviews.author: Anncole
reviews.title: Amazing week!
reviews.text: I was here for my spring break and it was amazing! All of the workers are so nice and attentive and go out of their way to make sure you’re having a good time. Julio and Rodrigo were especially friendly and so cool—try to find them for fun activities and a good time. If you go to the buffet, find Martin—he is so sweet will make sure you’re taken care of. Overall, I had an amazing time, and I felt like the workers really made the trip special.

reviews.author: Jason D
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Wonderful place to stay! We had such a great time, and recommend it highly to anyone traveling to Cancun. Very good food and service. We stayed in the Royal Service area, and we couldn't have been more pleased.

reviews.author: Stacie N
reviews.title: Very nice, would come back.
reviews.text: Only  setback was the delay getting registered at the front desk.  However, Roberto saved us and gave us a beautiful ocean view room.  Everything else was excellent, service, attitude, coco beach pricey but well worth it.  The seafood platter and champagne was awesome.  Fuego was delicious but make a reservation.  Loved it.

reviews.author: Sue C
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Had a great vacation at Paradisus.  Resort staff is helpful and very friendly. Two employees really were excellant.  They are Giovani Arauz and Timoteo Arcoz. The both work 
at the Toyi Bar. They were fun and make  excellent drinks. The family concereige service is well worth the extra you pay.

reviews.author: Bakergirl
reviews.title: Very nice resort but PLEASE BEWARE OF THE PERVERT AT  YHI SPA!!!!!!
reviews.text:
This is my second time coming to Paradisus Cancun, both times in Royal Service. The first time we came was November 2017 and our experience was so wonderful we had to come back. The staff is very friendly and accommodating throughout the resort. Aaron by the pool is very friendly and he makes sure you’re comfortable and you have what you need throughout the day. The Bali Beds are an amazing place to relax, take a nap or just read and just a few steps away from the beach. 

Now for Yhi Spa I was impressed the first stay in 2017 so of course I had to utilize again. The hydro therapy is wonderful to use when you’re just leaving the pool or beach to get that grid off but my stay was ruined on the first night. I used the hydro therapy and I went into the spa pool area to have water and a spa member asked if I would like to lay down with a cold cloth over my eyes, which I did. He then asked if I would like a massage which I said yes to and let’s just say he attempted to give more than a massage. He slid his fingers into the bottom of my bathing suit and touched me. I pushed his hands away and said no. It happened very fast and I was very disturbed not knowing how to react and when I sat up nobody was around not even him to get his name. I wasn’t able to go back to the spa nor will I visit here again. I don’t know who he was which made it extremely uncomfortable when the spa employees would walk around the pool trying to get people to come into the spa. I didn’t know him but he may have known who I was. Very disappointed with the spa service!! Very disgusting and disgusted!!! I kept thinking “ what if this was my 19 year old daughter!!!! Please beware of going to the spa!!!! It’s so sad how one rotten egg can ruin for everyone!

reviews.author: Ann M S
reviews.title: Royal service nice but not always best
reviews.text: We enjoyed our own pool area but disappointed there wasn't a pool bar at our end. We only had drink/food service when we had a bali bed reserved otherwise they ignored us and we were ready to tip big!  Enso was good- skip Mole- market grille like a knock of Fago de chao -large buffet ok- smoothies were good.

reviews.author: Expedition323847
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Great location. Decor was elegant and very well maintained. The staff was very attentive and always easily accessible. I wish the concierge who helped during checkin would have explained all that the resort had to offer because it is such a large property and you can miss out on some of the amenities.

reviews.author: Miriam
reviews.title: Be clear on what is included in the "all inclusive" before you commit and come prepared to spend an extra 30%
reviews.text:
Let’s start with the positives. 
1.	The hotel is very beautiful.
2.	The beach is nice and on the strip. 
3.	The service is for the most part attentive. 

The negatives.  
1.	The pressure to up-sell starts right at the door. The first question we were asked on reaching the hotel was whether we wanted to upgrade our room.  This continued throughout our stay. For an all-inclusive hotel, the included items come from a pretty short list. People want to get away form pressure sales on holiday, not have it pushed down their throats at every turn. 
2.	The room was neat and clean but the very second day of our stay the bathroom over ours leaked into our bathroom. There was water all over the floor and we had to call service late at night to fix it. 
3.	The instructions on the safe had worn down and we could not read it. It’s a $2 fix to print out new labels for the safe.
4.	The second day in our room, the card keys would not work. I thought it must have got de-magnetized and went downstairs to have it fixed. After much ado security let us in to our room. Two hours later we were again locked out. So, this time they changed the lock battery. Next morning, we tried to use the door, we were again locked out, so they changed the lock itself. It must have been a total of 2-3 hours wasted because the room locks don’t work, to say nothing of the inconvenience and irritation.  Irritation that was exacerbated by the fact that there is only one elevator for an entire wing of 8 floors, so it takes considerable time to go up and down to reception.
5.	There is a shortage of chairs by the pool. To get one of the “Tahiti beds” you have to pay extra – again this perk is “not included”. Since there are not enough chairs for the number of people requiring them, the only way to get one is to reach the pool area before 7 in the morning. 
6.	The food was unimaginative.  My daughter thought that Costco frozen entrees were quite comparable. We had a couple of dinners at the reservations only restaurants, for the most part it was the same food as the main restaurants but served in smaller and prettier plates. The wine served alongside was truly appalling.  Of course, it goes without saying that not all the restaurants are included in the all-inclusive price.
7.	The alcoholic drinks do not have alcohol in them. At least nothing that can be detected by anything short of a sensitive laboratory test.  As the cocktails were basically flavored sugar water, I asked for a glass of wine. That turned out to be a mistake. If you want a decent glass of wine, you have to – yes guess what - pay extra! Here’s an idea for management … LIMIT the number of alcoholic drinks served but actually serve decent ones instead?
8.	 My daughter ordered a snack at the taco restaurant. They bought half the order and forgot the other half. When she reminded them, they asked her if she still needed it!  
9.	The computer printers in the business center didn’t work. I couldn’t print out my boarding passes and there was no one to help.
10.	There were never any life guards on the beach though there is a life guard platform, I never saw anyone there. 
11. They provide you a bunch of coupons when you arrive which allows you to discount $10 off some extra service that is already three times the cost you would normally  expect to pay. And you can only use one coupon at a time.  More high pressure selling. 

My guess is that this hotel is either  managed by a sales guy rather than  a customer satisfaction guy, or that the sales team has a disproportionate say in the way that the hotel provides services.It leaves the customer stressed out.

reviews.author: rita_c85
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: This is the second time we go there, to meet with family. This time they gave us family concierge, because of that. Well, the place is amazing, for lack of a better word... White beach, endless swimming pools, the ocean is Crystal clear.... Now the family concierge offers a service where you can text them anytime on WhatsApp and they'll take care of your every need, inform you on shows and activities, and even bring little treats to your room, as champagne and chocolate covered strawberries. Everytime you open the curtains in your room, the view is astonishing. Village is clean, there are so many options for food you can't probably try them all in a week. They have a huge gym and a spa. I wish I could live there. Our Butler Rodolfo was the best, along with his colleague Gloria. They made sure we always had what we needed, gave us late check-out to match our flight which is so great, and took care of us. I wish I could live there! 😂

reviews.author: GarryP
reviews.title: March 6th - 10th 2019
reviews.text:
Overall OK but very slow check in and check out
Buffet average not very imaginative  but did enjoy the lunches at poolside
Great staff - very helpful and friendly
Clean rooms and clean pool areas
Cheap poolside chairs without ability to adjust
Loved Vento and Baha restaurants
Don't get sucked into the upgrade for Royal service - not really worth it
Lots of stairs to get to and from buildings and the beach
Not much daily information on daily events or activities

reviews.author: Kimberley Y
reviews.title: The Perfect All Inclusive
reviews.text:
My fourth visit to Paradisus Royal Service Cancun, one would think I'd grown tired of the same place,
but quite to the contrary.  The rooms are airy, beautiful views of ocean and property. The staff is courteous, all of our inquiries were answered promptly.  The food and beverage was very good.  Top shelf liquors and many restaurants to choose  for meals.

reviews.author: Jet17239223278
reviews.title: Ruined my travel
reviews.text:
Terrible concierge service
A rude employee
Screwed up my memories about Cancun
Giving me uncomfortable situations
Noise at disaster level from AC
The damp bed
I lost my voice for this hotel
As same with my comments for Check In

reviews.author: Marcie A
reviews.title: Fantastic trip
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at this property. The staff - especially Rodolfo and Leslie  - in the family concierge - went above and beyond to make our trip the best for our kids and a special anniversary celebration that we will remember forever. The beach was amazing and the nighttime shows were a hit for the kids. Thank you very much!

reviews.author: Tammy Dunnett
reviews.title: Royal Service!
reviews.text:
Wow! What a vacation. I have stayed at The Paradisus Cancun Resort on several occasions and each time I've been greeted like an old friend and made to feel welcome. I have stayed in Junior Suites, one bedrooms and the family room and each and every room has been clean, tidy, and contained everything you could require for a great vacation. 
Melina is very friendly and super efficient checking you in and insuring everything is sorted for a problem free stay. 
A BIG thank you to our Butler, Rhode for your kindness and generosity, you helped make our vacation unforgettable. 
Breakfast and lunch at La Palapa is excellent. Daniel is evidently very experienced in providing wonderful customer service. Daniel is one of the best parts of staying in Royal Service, he is thoughtful and caring to insure that you are enjoying your vacation. 
The poolside staff is very attentive, professional and friendly especially Moses, Joshue, Javier and Oscar. A sincere thank you for providing such a fantastic fun environment!

We look forward to our return in April 2019.

reviews.author: Lynn B
reviews.title: Terrific service
reviews.text: Great service!! Beautiful hotel. Loved the hard working waiters and butlers!! They genuinely wanted to please and were very polite! Everything was handled professionally in the Royal Service and would definitely come again.

reviews.author: Jackquito
reviews.title: Final Wedding Review - Unforgettable Wedding - Best Experience
reviews.text:
I have reviewed this property before therefore you can search within my profile if you want specific property information. I will be focusing on our wedding experience with Paradisus Cancun.

A little bit of background. Our wedding event was over the weekend of September 14th 2018. I know the review is late, but I was waiting to receive all the perks, services, and items purchased for our wedding event, and today we received the last item from the wedding package we booked.

As stated earlier, I have already reviewed the property, and also on the wedding package, so you can go back and read previous reviews. For this review I will be focusing only on the final delivered wedding event. I will start with the CONS, but believe me the PROS will be much better and it is worth to read them. The review is long but if you are planning your wedding in Cancun, this might help with getting some clarification on what to expect.

First off, the CONS:
-	Pricing: This was definitely on the higher end of the spectrum when we were looking for a hotel to host our wedding event. Do not expect to pay a $2,000US for a lavish wedding. Initially (like most people) we thought about the destination wedding due to the reduced costs when compared to the average wedding costs here in the US. However, if you want a detailed wedding it is going to cost you. Paradisus being on the higher end.
Well, that is the only CON we had. So if you made it this far, the PROS heavily outweigh the CONS.

Pros:
-	Exclusivity: Yes, you read right. This hotel offers an almost exclusive wedding event. Before deciding on this hotel, we visited AMresorts (Secrets & Dreams) & Royalton, and believe me when I tell you, your wedding day might be shared with another 3-5 wedding events happening at almost the same time. While at Paradisus Cancun, the maximum per day is two wedding events and both events would take place at opposite ends of the resort. For our wedding, we were the only wedding event that day and that really felt great because we had all the attention of the staff focused on our event and that made everybody feel special. When we received the explanation from the hotel about this, we began to understand why the higher price tag.
-	They Keep Their Promises & Contract: Paradisus Cancun has kept all the agreed upon prices, contracted services, and additional perks received (because we booked their top tier Taylor Made Package). Nothing was left out, and today we received our two night anniversary certificate and have already booked to return to celebrate our anniversary. Paradisus Cancun also kept their word with a room upgrade even though they were pretty full at the time. This again proves their commitment is high to customers and they understand that we are expecting nothing less. Planning a wedding is hectic and emotionally charged, but once we arrived at Paradisus our fears were put at ease.
-	Experienced Wedding Personnel: We had as our wedding coordinator Marlene Perez, and let me tell you she is the best. The patience and constant contact via email was the only reason why my wife kept her cool. Marlene was able to provide an answer to all our questions, she had ideas that we never thought of that improved our wedding event. Marlene was always with a smile, and kept us organized all the way through the event. We are so happy she was our coordinator, we recommend her to anyone who wants to have a detailed, well-coordinated wedding event.
-	Butler: We stayed at the Royal Service side and we had as our butler Galdino. Let me tell you, that this man is a life saver. He helped me coordinate my groomsmen and made sure everybody was there on time and ready for the photo-shoot. If you want someone who is attentive to all your needs, Galdino is the right man for you. Best of all he is honest, he will answer any questions you have, and if he does not know, he will find someone that may answer the question.
-	Staff in General: During our stay the staff in general was great. Almost everybody knew in the hotel we were the couple that was going to get married that weekend. Again, this to me means at some point supervisors and managers met with their team and told them to be aware of the wedding party. Everyone in our family had nothing but good things to say about the hotel and staff.
-	Accommodating to Guests Needs: Several of our guests had special needs (from babies to dietary needs). The hotel was able to accommodate all requests from our guests.
-	Unforgettable Experience: Though I left this one for last, it might be the most important reason why I gave this hotel a 5 star review. Every time my wife and I think about our wedding, our experience, and the entire run up to the wedding, we actually would not change a thing. After thinking for a while, we felt our experience is our own, not a cookie cutter experience, but our own and we know that others will not be able to copy. Not because it is impossible, but because the way Paradisus builds your wedding event is very personal and especially if you decide to go with their top tier package, it will be almost unique in many ways. Guys, the biggest test for any hotel is when you can ask your wife “Would you change something?” and she replies a straight answer by saying “NO”. That to me alone makes this hotel the best place to celebrate your wedding.

I tried to not make this review so long, but I know this might at least help anyone feel at ease of either booking, or continue with their wedding event. We will be back at Paradisus this upcoming September to celebrate our 1 year anniversary. We have avoided repeating all-inclusive hotels, yet Paradisus Cancun has been the only hotel we have returned year after year after year.

reviews.author: Cheryl B
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Resort Mar 2019
reviews.text:
Very nice price if booked through an on-line party. It seems like everyone that stayed at the hotel has to listen to the timeshare presentation which is no fun during your vacation. The food was under seasoned but they did have many options. The beach was beautiful and the pool was heated - all a bonus. My room began to smell of mildew by the second day. Also,  the check-in and Check-out process is extremely slow so be prepared to wait. 

Over all it is a GOOD 5-Star Cancun resort.

reviews.author: Al W
reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text:
Had a nice room in the main building along with our friends which was convenient as most restaurants are located there and central to the beach and beach bar. 
The beach itself is wide and sandy and we had no problem getting chairs. The ocean had large powerful waves which necessitated “red “ flags during our stay and I think this is an ongoing situation there. So due to the wave action on the sand when walking on the beach most times you are walking at at an angle as opposed to a flat surface. The beach staff came by on a regular basis to see if we required anything. 
Meals we ok but nothing special. There is one restaurant that serves Tacos as their specialty but they were not particularly good. 
Small issue with housekeeping as getting hand towels and facecloths was hit and miss but room was always nicely cleaned. 
Entire staff very friendly and offered a Tequila or a Bloody Ceasar  to start your day. Nice touch.

reviews.author: Danay R
reviews.title: Real paradise
reviews.text:
Hotel incredibly beautiful .
Staff is excellent everyone is nice and charm providing an excellent customer service .
Elizabeth ( housekeeper) did an excellent job every single day. Patricia and Sarahi at the kids zone are very nice and friendly with children and parents .
Spend the money in this hotel is a good choice don’t hesitate to do it!

reviews.author: Lily S
reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.text: Extremely disappointed! Starting off while checking in the front desk person named “ Juan “ was trying to give me a lot of trouble trying to charge me a lot of hidden fees that were not there when I paid in the moment because it was not something I wanted at the moment. After a concierge named Martha tried to sit us down with to give us the lay out. She talked us into going to a timeshare tour we agreed but after finding out the next day that it’s over a 90 minutes long and it was our last day and my husband birthday. We decided to not do the timeshare to enjoy our last day/birthday in Cancun. Concierge Martha confronted us and we told her that we didn’t want to do the timeshare and she completely disrespected myself and my husband on his birthday. I was completely in shock that the Concierge Martha was pressuring me and my husband and disrespecting us at the same time because we decided to not do it. Which was completely disrespectful that me and my husband did not deserve to get disrespected by anybody there to the fact that we were not asking to stay or rent a hotel room for free we paid over 1k for our hotel room. If you’re thinking about staying at Paradisus Cancun with an infant or toddler think about it twice and please use the pictures as reference. My child’s life was in danger while trying to sleep in a broken crib. The crib was extremely disgusting and nasty and dangerous. Crib was stained with bite marks, broken, unscrewed.  I’ve contacted the front desk person named “ Juan “ who checked me in to try to resolve this issue and it was not handled at all. Most of the people who work at Paradisus Cancun have really bad attitude they try to make it seem like they are better than you and you’re asking for food or drinks for free when you’ve paid for the service and everything else. Extremely disappointed!

reviews.author: Sightseer13539169219
reviews.title: Royal service is a MUST
reviews.text: Great property, great service. The only downside is no one tells you of all the perks you receive as a Royal Service guest. Some attendants can be pushy in attempts to sell you something, that was a bit annoying.

reviews.author: raoufm853
reviews.title: Great location!  Awesome Beach/Pool...Average food!
reviews.text: Overall, we enjoyed our time at Paradisus Cancun.  Resort is super close to the airport which is a plus!  The beach was beautiful and clean...pool was fun and never crowded.  The room was spacious and our ocean view room was awesome!  Only real downside to the resort is the food quality/variety.  Buffet repetitive and dull and the ingredient quality (meats especially) was somewhat subpar.  Same goes for the restaurant options.  Wish they up their good game...otherwise, it’s a great resort with a friendly and super attentive staff.  Special shout out to Sergio at the pool bar...he was awesome!

reviews.author: Patrick G
reviews.title: Always A great Hotel
reviews.text:
I have been visiting this hotel since the early nineties. the beauty of the architecture, the incomparable Atrium lobby, the immaculate beach and the beautiful pools make the Paradisus a true paradise on earth. The best thing and the reason I return is the service from beach waitresses Asuncion and Leticia. 
If heaven is not like The Paradisus Cancun I will be VERY disappointed.

reviews.author: Minh-Tri Do
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: Amazing service there. The place is in a great spot, right next to the beach and we had a lot of fun with the staff member Angel. The restaurants are great, there's a good variety of food and the waiters are very lively. the inside of the resort is absolutely stunning. there are a lot of fun activities to do every day and we did a lot of them with Angel. He was really nice and showed us a lot of fun things to do during the trip.

reviews.author: Dream58581414888
reviews.title: Great Resort.  Staff are friendly and attentive
reviews.text:
Resort has been around 30 years but maintained very well.   Great location and very nice beach that is groomed every day.   Pools are very nice and restaurant food quality is great with good variety.
Highly recommend!

reviews.author: rudipen
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text: Had an enjoyable relaxing stay. Enjoyed the food and the service was great. Staff was exceptional. Would recommend and would definitely stay again. Loved this resort as it is steps from the beach. Great views from several of the restaurants and bars. Loved all the restaurants we went to but loved Bana, Enso, and Mole the most.

reviews.author: tuhravel_10
reviews.title: Family and Friends All Inclusive Vacation
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun was an amazing experience.  I went with a group of friends, along with my 8 year old daughter.  The property itself is as beautiful as it gets in Cancun, and the staff are very nice.  My favorite part about this resort was that it was family friendly!  If you have kids, I recommend taking full advantage of kids zone!  They will have other kids to play with, and they bring them along to the pools, and do activities and shows with them!  Definitely worth the money, and the food was legit for an all inclusive establishment.  My family and I would definitely be back!

reviews.author: Domingo C
reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: This is a complete scam. They charge you at check in with 150 USD per person for a package for premium spirits of course if you want, but you are already pating for a 4 star hotel. The issue is that most premium spirits are already available and those that are not they never have them. Never pay for this package. A second package, for the modest charge of 300 USD per room/day you can stay in tower 5, a complete cementary, bore to death.

reviews.author: ricker1618
reviews.title: Awesome week in paradise
reviews.text: This hotel is 5 stars. Beautiful lobby and grounds, restaurants are all great food and great service. Lots of choices for alacart or just buffet. Pool is awesome overlooking beautiful beach. Entertainment every night is also pretty good. This Melia property has great service throughout, everyone is so acomadating.

reviews.author: Gurpreet Singh
reviews.title: Family vacation for 5 days
reviews.text:
Pros 
 
Family concierge Butler (Rodolfo) service was very good -5 star. He made all our special moments extra special . Kept us updated with all the events happening around . -BUTLER (RODOLFO)
-1-Brought so many surprises for our child and for us . 
-2-Made our wedding anniverary extra special by decorating our room in the evening 
-3-Even on his day off he made sure we have everything we need on time . 
-4-Brought balloons , toys , fish food for my 2 yrs old which kept him busy and happy all theoughtour our stay . 
-5-Very respectful , a good listener , very much accomodating butler.
-6-Kept us updated with all the upcoming events happening everyday . 

Services 
Room service and house keeping- 4 star 
BUTLER (RODOLFO)
-1- very respectful , a good listener and accomodating butler 
-2- he made our wedding anniversary extra special by decorating our room as a suprise with champagne and cake 
-3- even on his day off he made sure we have everything we need on time through his staff
-4- he brought toys , fish food , balloon for my 2 yrs and kept him busy and happy all throughout the stay.
-5- kept us updated with all the events happening around 
-6- made our reservations into all the restaurants 

Services:
Room service and house keeping 4 stars
Strawberry yogurt went out of stock during our stay and that was one of the few things that my 2 yrs eat but family concierge made sure that we receive and they managed to bring few more to us somehow . 

Blueagave restaurant - Nachos with those spicy dips is 5 star from my opinion . Tacos are okay . 

Cons 

Room

-3-Mini fridge was not filled when we checked in 
-4-The welcome fruit platter in our room - apple was rotten
-5-We had asked for a aromatice pillow service and turn down service on the last night of our trip but we never received any . 
 
Hotel 
-1-The floor number of lift was very very dim . You hardly can see which floor you are at until you look closely .
-2-One of the two lift of our side did not work for 4 full days . At times there used to be long wait for the lift. 
-3-The champagne glasses of our cabana at the beach were of very poor quality . They had cracks and plastic was all yellow . 
-4-Enso restaurant- watch out for head waiter of this restaurant . He was very rude to some customers including us . 
-5-Mole restaurant - table were wiggling. 
-6Food in almost all restaurant is below average . We are chicken lovers so could not find much options there but that might not be the case for meat lovers (maybe)

Outdoor photographer 

The photographer -Josh was good at clicking pictures but there MANAGER - Andreas was so rude to us while explaining the packages and she was also being pushy in selling us pictures . Being a manager she was not setting a good example there thus indirectly spoiling the repo of the hotel. She said to us that we have a "bad taste" in selecting pictures that we are rejecting some of the cutest moments but i want to ask them if each picture they are selling $25 (which is so expensive)than how can someone take 60 pictures that we clicked . She is no one to suggest and should leave upto a guests to decide . 

This leave a dissappointment on me of a hotel services .

reviews.author: Greg_DFM
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel!!
reviews.text:
We had an incredible time here. Although the check in process was extremely slow because there were only two people working, the hotel and staff as a whole made it up for that tedious time. 

The buffet surprised me with the quality of the food. Their restaurants for dinner were good, but they weren’t as good as I expected. 

The bartenders at the pool bar were incredibly quick and we never had to wait long for our drinks. They also have servers that come around collecting drinks orders often (more often if you give good tips) which is nice. 

It is a hassle to get the chairs and tables at the pool and beach. You’ll have to get up early to secure them. They tell you to look for the pool concierge but I promise that you’ll never find him. However, there are other employees that could assist you like they did to us. 

They also have activities during the day like sushi classes, dancing, yoga, wine tasting, etc. We thought it was a great way to spend the day and not get bored if you spend a lot of days in the hotel.

They have a Nespresso bar which is amazing. The coffee is really tasty but they only open for two hours in the morning and two in the afternoon, make sure you try it out. 

Amazing hotel, the beach is incredible, the food and drinks are too. You’ll not regret it!

reviews.author: Sarah L
reviews.title: You would love it
reviews.text:
Very good customer services. We were arrived at midnight and they had only one room left. We booked just the lagoon room, and it was a Lagos room as well but somehow I just found out the size of the room was a one bedroom! It is huge room. Huge washroom with a living+dining area then our bedroom, plus a outdoor massage bathtub!
We did not get charged for the extra due to they only have the room for us! 
And we had a room service for our dinner which we had no dinner on the flight. 
The days in cancun was awesome with sunshine only weather!
The regular hours for the front desk line up was awful! I hope they can have more then 5 ppl working at the time.
The only time drive me crazy was check out time. Feels like it takes me forever!
Food:
Many restaurants can choose and they’re all different styles!
I love the buffet at main building. Can get the food right away. And the Japanese restaurant was awesome. I also tried the special dinner at the poolside dinner! It was an Italian dinner. With the show after dinner. Missed the fireworks due to we had a trip the other day.
Swimming pool was really fun and really big. Pool bar and water yoga. It’s cool!
The chair are free to get. The customer service was really good! The towel area ran out the towels so I just asked someone and they just went to grab one for me. Really enjoyed my first trip in my dream place. 
I see some other bad reviews for the days I was stayed, I need to say, it was a full resort for my whole stays until I left.
They already tried their best for everything I believed! 
They also have kids indoor play area.
Thank you all

reviews.author: Maria V
reviews.title: Winter getaway
reviews.text: It was great to get away while missing 3 winter storms in NY. Upon arrival you are greeted with a drink and check in was smooth. The center of the hotel has a beautiful tropical feel. On your way to the beach you pass a Nespresso shop and gelato station. Once at the beach, it was so relaxing and service was spectacular. But beware of the currents and rough waves. I had to be pulled out of the water on my last day by the lifeguard Victor whom I’m so grateful to him for saving my life. I also want to mention that Paulina at the front desk did everything she could to make our stay wonderful. She knows how to take care of guests. She was pleasant, professional and helpful. We tried every restaurant on the premises and found Enzos to be our favorite. Ask for Melvin the waiter and Joseph the manager knows how to run the restaurant. Everyone working at the hotel is friendly and accommodating. Overall it was a beautiful, relaxing week and the service was impeccable.

reviews.author: Byu
reviews.title: Mr Yu
reviews.text: WiFi was extremely strong and fast. I don’t mind the plastic cups because it is more hygienic. The pool bar staff seems to give preferential treatment to certain guests. Reservations for the speciality restaurants were limited and hard to make. The restaurants were small and doesn’t seem to be able to accommodate the sheer amount of customers they have in the hotel. The food was good, we found the beef to be extremely tough and overcooked. The buffet has a huge variety and desserts were good. Everyone loved the coconut ice cream and always seemed to have a line. There is always food no matter what time it was. You can never go hungry. The staff members were extremely friendly and helpful. Nightly entertainment was great and fun to watch. The rooms were well kept.

reviews.author: Tennisgirl14
reviews.title: Beautiful Day in Paradise
reviews.text: I've been coming to this resort for the last 4 years and I've always love it. Staff were all very friendly and they go above and beyond everything. Rooms are clean. Food was good with a lot of selection. Spa was treatments were also great. Beach was beautiful.

reviews.author: Sonya M
reviews.title: Perfection!!!
reviews.text: We have been to Cancun many times. We have tried other resorts and keep coming back to Paradisus!! This trip, Guadalupe at the front desk was a dream. She was so helpful and kind and upgraded our room!!!! Montse was our concierge, and she was delightful. The service at Paradisus is always great. Food and drinks are fabulous. 2 years ago, we tried Live Aqua and was very disappointed by comparison. If you like great service, great food and great drinks, quiet comfortable rooms and a wonderful view, this is the place for you!!

reviews.author: jlao90
reviews.title: Romantic and Relaxing Getaway at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun was a perfect place for a quick getaway during the cold winter months. When we arrived, the resort offered us a discounted rate to upgrade to Royal Service. Royal Service provides you with additional and exclusive amenities including cabana rental access, the hotel section is adult only, a personal butler, premium access to lounges with premium alcoholic beverages, and more spacious and nicer suites.  

The resort provides you with 9 restaurants to choose from for all cuisine preferences, various pools for swimming, access to the beach and various retail shops throughout the hotel. The service is exceptional, with each room fully stocked with drinks, snacks and the opportunity to order room service any time of the day. We could not recommend this hotel more.

Our butler Javier was amazing. He made our stay that much more relaxing, enjoyable and he took really good care of our needs. He even organized a bottle of champagne, chocolate cake, and candles for the room to surprise my wife for her birthday. All of the restaurants exemplified excellent service throughout the site and all spoke English. Paradisus Cancun is a must stay destination!! We can not wait to go back one day.

reviews.author: 604frankg
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Very nice resort to stay at! Food was very good. We really enjoy the beach and how much area they have. Everyone is not on top of each other like other resorts. This was our second time staying here and we will visit again soon.

reviews.author: Passenger67534199148
reviews.title: Great time every year
reviews.text: Come for 3 weeks every year and have never been disappointed.  The wonderful people are so friendly and helpful.  Our concierge and butler surprised us with thoughtful gifts or services so often we really felt like VIPs all the time.

reviews.author: Linda1079
reviews.title: How can a place that so so so great keep getting better!
reviews.text: The Royal Service is such a wonderful experience my husband and I are afraid to go elsewhere for fear of disappointment. Sixth time staying and the rooms, service food and hotel in general is amazing. They are always on their game. I recommend this resort to anyone and everyone.

reviews.author: Inspire37519397662
reviews.title: All you need  for relax and enjoy !!!
reviews.text: Everything you need to have a very nice vacation, the facilities, excellent service beautiful ocean or lagoon view,  the food very delicious, location, activities by the pool and at night in the big atrium . Awesome stay!!!

reviews.author: cindy p
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Tempo is a restaurant you need to experience,prepare to have your mind & tastebuds blown. I'm sure all the hosts are amazing but hope for George. He knows what you want or need before you do. Claudia is amazing at what she does. She makes you feel like family. Can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Star0215
reviews.title: Best Experience Ever!
reviews.text: This is an amazing hotel with all the amenities you could imagine. Located at a beautiful area in Cancun and offering the best service ever. Beautiful decorations, designs and amazing food. The restaurants offer a big variety of food and there is always something available to please your appetite. This hotel even offers a Coffee bar and it's literally the best coffee.

reviews.author: Sightsee10811886021
reviews.title: Excellent place for all
reviews.text: My family and I just spent February break at the resort and we have not one complaint. The people were so nice, courteous and hardworking.  The facility was impeccable and extremely well maintained. We felt safe at all times.

reviews.author: ppd
reviews.title: My favorite resort
reviews.text: Paradisus is a beautiful resort inside and out.  Great food and accommodations, as a vacation club owner our 2 bedroom suite was beautiful.  All staff went out if their way to meet every request.  Take advantage of bali beds

reviews.author: coladakitty
reviews.title: Striking Cancun AI
reviews.text:
Our family of 5 enjoyed our brief, 3-night stay here in February.  The lobby is stunning, with hanging ivy, koi ponds and lovely atmosphere.  The pools are beautiful and there are plenty of beach palapas.  Food and drinks were all very good.  We especially enjoyed the less-crowded pool-side buffet restaurant for breakfast.

Our rooms were on the lagoon side and nicely outfitted, if not remarkable.  Both had terraces overlooking sunset.  I imagine those with ocean-front views are gorgeous as well but also louder, given that evening entertainment happens by the pool.

Staff was outstanding.  Waiters by the quieter pool came by often to see if we needed drinks regularly.  No one hangs about looking for tips, but tips are certainly appreciated.  

We had both paella and tacos by the pool that were delicious.

My main quibble was with dinner reservations, and this is why my review is 4 stars and not 5.  On our first day we called to make reservations for the next three nights, and we were unable to get tables at decent times.  We ended up settling on the tapas place (very good) at 6 pm and Fuego at 9:30.  Since both restaurants had plenty of open tables, this didn’t make much sense to us.  Further, we couldn’t get into the lobby restaurant, Bana, on our first night without a 2-hour wait, even though they don’t take reservations and there were tons of tables.  Reservations are not centralized, so they cannot tell you what is available — you have to ask about each restaurant.  Even if my preferred place isn’t open, I would have appreciated it if they had said “We can’t get you into Fuego until 9:30, but there is a table open at Mole at 7.”  Thankfully the buffet was quite good, but the reservation system really needs an overhaul.
