A bit more shade by the pool would also be welcome - there were plenty of loungers but not quite enough umbrellas or palapas, causing a bit of a towel game in the early mornings (get out there by 7:30 for best locations).  

Overall we all enjoyed our stay and would recommend the hotel to people going to Cancun.  The staff really makes this place special and I hope they are appreciated by management.  Sergio and Gabriela by the pool are top notch.

reviews.author: Paradise779516
reviews.title: couples trip
reviews.text: Pool and Beach were beautiful. the pool was huge with a bar centrally located. We rented a cabana on the beach and the service and food was perfect.  However of all, the margaritas were amazing....the food here is horrible.

reviews.author: Janice De Vlugt
reviews.title: From Sunrise to Sunset and under the Mayan moon
reviews.text:
My 4 kids and I (ages 27, 24, 18, 13) checked in late at night at the Paradisus, and from the moment we entered the subtle scent of incense, gorgeous fresh flowers and a solicitous, welcoming staff created a great initial impression which only built through our 8 days.  We didn't LOVE our initial rooms, they upgraded us to the central tower, 7th floor, which overlooked the beautiful lagoon and opened onto the view of the gorgeous centre pyramid zen garden.  The staff were friendly, anticipated our every need, and were so numerous and efficient we felt like VIPS.  The resort was constantly being cleaned and grounds were immaculate.  The nightly entertainment was okay, nothing too exciting, but we were there as a family so we enjoyed that.  
The hotel demographic was a really good blend, lots of young sun and funlovers, but also mature couples and families.  Not a party resort, but definitely sophisticated guests.  The onsite tour booking agents got us extremely great deals on all our excursions, and there was absolutely no timeshare sales pressure or solicitation.  The buffet was definitely a seafood lover's delight, and the other onsite restaurants were super!!  My kids loved the BANA sushi and the FUEGO tacos...  The beach is great, lots of it and always groomed and monitored by lifeguards.  I would rate our stay at PARADISUS a definite 10+ out of 10, and would go back in a heartbeart..  Our last moment before the airport shuttle? On the top terrace driveway area, watching the sunset, with bean bag chairs, loungers, and a very posh sunset bar set up, with amazing mixed cocktails served by the staff with flare and fun.   PARADISUS lived up to its name...

reviews.author: Resort10174596097
reviews.title: Excellent!!!
reviews.text: Everything was perfect.. food amazing!! Lapalapa restaurant had the best ice cream ever and burger delicious!! Will recommend 100 percent. Staff, food, and ambiance everything just perfect. Don’t have any complaints

reviews.author: WalterB11763
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: My wife and I had an awesome time at this resort. We utilized their Family Consierge Service wich made check in fast and easy. Our butler, Rodolfo did an amazing job; keeping us busy with activities and booking all of our dinners. For an all inclusive the food was good, with several restaurants all in close proximity to the main lobby. The beach and pool areas had a great atmosphere with shows almost eveey night. The rooms were clean and up to date with private oceanfront balconies. We will be coming back.

reviews.author: Erica N
reviews.title: Great getaway but not everything we hoped for!
reviews.text:
My husband and I came to the Paradisus for 4 nights / 5 days to celebrate his 40th birthday. Overall we had a fantastic time but there were some hiccups.
Upon check in, it was fast, it took us some time to find an appropriate room as there were many conferences coming in within our stay. They had also run out of coupon booklets and it took me many tries and almost 3 days to get a coupon booklet so I did not have a chance to use them, I ended up giving them to another couple. This was frustrating as if they knew how busy the hotel was and how many packages came with these coupons it should have been organized prior to the arrival. 
The app for the hotel was not working so it was difficult to find out what activities were taking place around the hotel. While the complex is beautiful and grounds are well kept, this I want to warn people is not a “happening” hotel. There were multiple pools so while my husband travel south often this was the first hotel we stayed at with all their pools being particularly quiet with the exemption of the pool party on one of the days, but even that was more for children than for adults. The hotel activities during the day were much more low key then we expected. We ended up doing the eco tour by kayak as Ricardo  had told me about it during the 8am spinning class at the gym. We went out with Angel Ramirez and he was fantastic. Him and Ricardo really made a difference in our trip throughout the 5 days. They were attentive and friendly along with the other 2 pool animators who were equally as good but I do not remember their names! That being said the pool animation was minimal, there was no real music playing, no pool games, very low key which was nice but also boring at times if you were spending the day at the pool. It would have been great if they had the pool with the swim up bar more of a happening place with fun things to do. While it is nice they have to go around quietly and invite people to play volleyball it also took away from the fun atmosphere they were all trying to create but seem to have limitations as to how they were allowed. The animation also got overshadowed by the dinner by the pool staff who had to set everything up early so some activities like Zumba and trampolines could not take place as there was no place to do the activities by the pool. I also participated in a cooking activity which was short and fun. Angel R. had us all laughing with the chef teaching the course. 
My husband and I used the gym facilities daily. The gym was great. My first day spinning Ricardo was fantastic (on Thursday the 28th of February) but then after that was a man who did not seem to know the basics of spinning. There were no intervals, tension, or even really sitting on a bike. He never arrived on time always strolling in a few minutes late and the classes seemed really short. One was over by 8:35 which lead me to having to do my own work out after, which is frustrating if I am waking up so early to attend. 
The food overall was great. For breakfast we always sat with Martin at the buffet outside. I have diet restrictions and he always had food made before I got there and ready. He was fantastic. Frank at the Enzo hotel was also amazing and they both took the extra time to make sure our food was to our liking. I liked that there was always options in terms of restaurants and did not all require a reservation. Reservations were seemingly easy to make and accommodating. Our best meal was at Mole and our waiter there helped my husband celebrate his birthday. He was FANTASTIC, by far the best waiter we had all trip. Loved the added touch of the mariachi coming to the tables. 
My husband celebrated a birthday while we were there. The front desk confirmed this upon check in. I spoke to the concierge on 3 different occasions to make sure my husbands birthday would be celebrated and even the morning of, had someone check the computer to ensure the request was made for that day. They told me to keep hi out of the room from 4-6pm so they could decorate and bring a piece of cake. Well… they forgot, then they explained that it was in the system for the following day at 9 am but we were checking out… eventually they sent something to the room but it was very frustrating. The other person whose birthday and were given the same instructions were also forgotten about, so if you are going to celebrate something, do not have high expectations! 
The nightly shows were not what we were used to. We are used to resorts with stages and real productions. While the shows were fine, if you missed one or two you would not be disappointed, they were basic but provided entertainment until the evening parties really started. Our favorite activity was the silent party, we had THE BEST time at the red lounge. Everyone wore ear phones and 3 dj’s played music so you could choose which song to listen to. I am unsure if it was more fun to watch or participate in but we had a great time, the club was fun as well on the Saturday night. 
What left a horrible taste in our mouth upon leaving is March 1st the government put in place a new tax. So we got a note under our doors explaining we would owe money upon check out for this new tax. The letter while written in English and Spanish were readable nobody seemed to understand them. Upon check out for our 3 days in March we were expected to pay $5 US to cover this new tax. This was not explained to ANYONE upon check in and while we were explained it was new from the government, it seemed like a trap. I fully understand that after spending that much money on vacation $5 is minimal to spend at the end but the principal of the resort to pass the cost over to the guests that checked in without knowledge of this new tax was pretty cheap on their end. This left guests who had a great time at the resort leaving frustrated and feeling like they were taken advantage of and over $5… for a hotel chain that is not cheap to begin with, it would have been a better PR move to cover the cost of the taxes for those who checked in prior to March 1 and who were not informed. Yes, this would have been an expense for the hotel but for someone like myself who travels often, even though I had a great time at the hotel, I would like think twice before staying as at a Paradisus or Melia hotel due to this business move which only cost me $5. 

Overall, my husband and I had a great time on our birthday getaway. The wait staff at the bars were attentive, food was great, beach was well kept, and if there were small changes to allowing more engaging activities at one of the pools and better evening shows this hotel would have been even more fantastic.

reviews.author: Happiness61312345974
reviews.title: Great butler experience
reviews.text: Rodolfo knocked it out of the park. Very professional and a pleasure to have on our side. He was right on top of everything we asked for, no matter what time of the day!!!  From fish food to a bottle of wine, he did it all. I can’t express how much we appreciated him as a person and also as a butler!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Amy K
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Great Stay!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for a night during our honeymoon in Mexico. The check in process was quick and easy and the interior of the hotel is absolutely beautiful with all of the shrubs and greenery. Our room had a great view, the bathroom was large and the AC worked wonderfully. The restaurants in the hotel were good as we had dinner at the Ipanema steakhouse and the food was great! I fell in love with the green juice offered at breakfast. The outside grounds were kept up very nice as we enjoyed laying out by the beach on the loungers during the evening. We would absolutely recommend this place and return on future trips to Mexico.

reviews.author: Anzhelika L
reviews.title: Great vacation!!!
reviews.text: Hey there!!! I will give 10 out of 10 for this gorgeous hotel, friendly stuff and excellent service. I was traveling with my daughter 18 month old, and the greatest host Rodolfo( family concierge) was assisting us every day during our vacation. He did a great job and made  come true every our wish and even more. Also, i’d like to thanks baby room personnel, especially Adriana and Sarahi for there care of our baby. My daughter enjoyed time spent there. Baby clubs rooms are spacious and clean, with a lot of toys and things to do.

reviews.author: Olga A
reviews.title: Probably the best vacation we had so far!
reviews.text:
We went to a hotel in Riviera Maya last year that left a very sour taste in our mouth, so I did a lot of research before booking this vacation. We decided that if we were going to spend a nice chunk of change, it better be one of the best resorts in Mexico. 

We were a family of 4 - 2 adults and 2 kids (6 and 3 yr old)

I prebooked a transportation company - e-transfers. It cost me $52 round trip. 

We arrived at the hotel and were greeted by a young woman who welcomed us, directed our luggage to the bell boys, and took us to the check in area. We arrived around 4pm, the check in area was empty, so it was relatively quick check in.
 
We decided to upgrade to the Family Concierge. We previously read that the service that comes along with it is superior, so we decided to do it. Honestly, it was a bit pricey - We paid $600 for the upgrade, however I think it was the best upgrade we have ever done.
The Family concierge provided us the following:
-2 butlers - Gloria and Alexander. BEST TEAM!
- We never had to worry about making reservations to any restaurant. We used Whatsapp to communicate with our butlers and they took care of it all.
-My kids received a welcome bags, which included toys for the beach, shampoos and personal items to use during our stay and keep afterwards.
- Kids received special treats on the beds almost every night - Cookie and chocolate milk, along with Mexican toys some evenings, or a bed full of balloons. 
-1 Cabana for 1 day of the week we stayed 
- Access to the SPA. We spent 1 hour each day in the spa.
-Access to adults only section and the Royal Service area. 
-Any question, concern or anything we may have needed during our week, our butlers were up and ready to take care of for us. 
-You also have an access to the family lounge which has top alcohol selections, various snacks throughout the day, pool table, some kids toys. 

I personally would probably do another concierge upgrade if I ever come back to this hotel.

Restaurants:

Every night we tried a different restaurant. We ate breakfast at the buffet. Lunch was mostly from the burger joint by the pools. I tried the buffet once, but since the kids pool was too far, we tended to grab a sandwich or something quick from the grill place by the bar. 

Dinner:

Vento Restaurant - it is a Mediterranean restaurant. It was okay. We were encourages to order 3 main dishes each. They come very small. Food is okay. As a person that knows Mediterranean cuisine very well, I wasn't blown away.  

Mole - Modern Mexican cuisine. It was good. I liked the modern approach on the Mexican cuisine. 

Bana Restaurant - Sushi restaurant. We heard such great reviews from other guests about this place. The appetizers were great, but I did not like the sushi at all. If we ever go back to the hotel, I would not reserve this restaurant. 

Market Grill - THE BEST RESTAURANT they have! This is a Brazilian Rodizio restaurant and the meat is just phenomenal! We ended up coming back to have our last dinner at this restaurant, because it was so good!

La PALAPA - This is for adults only. It is open for breakfast and lunch only. I went here solo, without my husband and had the Gazpacho and grilled Shrimp. Probably one of the best cooked meals I have had ever! The Shrimp was cooked with hot and sweet sauce, something out of this world! Highly recommend.

They have Gelatto ice cream place and coffee place, but they are open approx 4 hours during the day. The coffee place (Nesspresso machine) is open 8-10am, and then 3-5pm. Ice cream maybe an hour longer in the mid day.  

For those travelling with pickey eater kids, the dinner restaurants had many options that were side order for kids only. I did go to the buffet to grab food for the kids when we ate at the Market Grill. 

The entertainment shows were really really good. There were 2 shows that we did not enjoy - The Mexican night, was very boring for the kids (but they did put some game stands for them so that occupied their time), and the Afrobotics was not entertaining at all, we actually left it mid way.   

The pools are huge! There is an adults only pool, then a pool by the buffet (which I rarely saw people swim in it), a huge pool by the swim up bar, and has a long path into a kids pool. We spent most of our days in the kids area, but swam to the bar every few hours. It is a long swim, but the kids wanted to practice their swimming abilities. 

They sell floating items (huge ducks, mattresses etc), but every morning we found items in the kids area and just used those. Probably people who bought and then left to go home left these behind. 

The beach is very clean. However, the problem that Mexico has with the seaweeds is noticeable, because these things float out all day long. Just and FYI, I have developed an allergic reaction to the areas where those seaweeds touched my body, primarily my legs. After short research I learned that these seaweeds produce poison, so it looks like bites anywhere they touch. But it doesn't appear to be the same on all people. 

We used the Kids Zone everyday. My kids enjoyed the way they were treated and were excited to go in. They took big liking with this girl Sarah in the Kids Zone. She was amazing with them!

The service is above par! Everyone smiles and greets you all day long. They tend to you extremely well. The grounds of the hotel are impeccable. We had no complaints about this at all. And of course it helps if you tip them too.

My only negative feedback is that the room sizes are relatively small to hotels we stayed prior. Our room had 2 full size beds, I would have enjoyed 2 queen sized beds. The balcony was very big though. 

At a resort this level, I expected to have liquor in the rooms, maybe whiskey or tequilas. We only had 3-4 beer cans in the fridge, and 1 bag of chips for the kids. Would have liked a better variety, just in comparison to the level of this hotel. 

One more note, the bathrooms on the grounds seem to be a bit far from the pool, the restaurants. So if your kids need a bathroom, you better run fast :)  

Also, throughout the day they do not have major entertainment going on where they call you to exercise or do some games. The hotel considers itself a bit more sophisticated and does not want to bombard its guests with this. I think the kids would have loved to be involved in stuff like that. They had one pool party, where they brought a huge inflatable into the pool and kids slid in, with a DJ playing music. It was totally fun, I wish they did more of that. 

We also decided to listen to their timeshare presentation and were given few perks that made our stay even better than described above. 

We did not leave the hotel. So I can not comment on the outside of the resort, or any activities. Although, a family we met did Chichinitza and ended up paying $100 for the 3 of them which included the transportation in a super luxurious bus, entrance to the ruins, and lunch. 

Overall we have enjoyed ourselves tremendously and are so happy we chose this hotel.

reviews.author: Discover43398929631
reviews.title: couples birthday getaway
reviews.text:
Very nice resort. A must stay. Staff was amazing, esp Victor Hugo and Miguel at the main pool.
The food was okay but I am a picky eater. My husband was satisfied.
The room was beautiful and views were amazing.
Only complaint was check in and out. Too crowded and takes a long time.

reviews.author: pbug21
reviews.title: Amazing Week at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Amazing week in paradise, great facilities, relaxing environment, beautiful setting, great food and drink, and especially amazing staff. We stayed in Pyramid 5, Royal Service, definitely worth the upgrade for what we paid. Personal butler, Bali beds included, breakfast/lunch at La Palapa and especially the use of the RS lounge, the all-day snack and drink bar are some of the upgrade perks. Norma was our personal butler, providing exceptional and friendly service, staying in regular contact, in person and via Whatsapp, to make sure all our needs were met. She really looked after us, making our bookings, providing recommendations and going above and beyond to source any off site items we needed. The staff throughout the hotel made our stay amazing – special mention to all the Royal Service staff, in the lounge, at the pool, on the beach and at La Palapa – Jorge, Luis, Aaron, Victor, Ricardo, there are many more, all made sure we were well looked after. Staff are amazing elsewhere also, special mention to all at Naos and at the main pool bar.

reviews.author: Fernando
reviews.title: Disappointing.. definitely it's not the paradise....
reviews.text:
My Daughter was doing a fifteenth birthday, so my family decided to find an amazing resort in Cancun to host for somedays. We found good options in Cancun, and choose the worst, the Paradise Cancun.

It has been paid around a one hundred days before my check-in. So, since the payment, i'v receiving informations from the Hotel in my e-mail, like my reservation,  login to use the app hotel, always information saying  that everything about my reserve was ok.

But, for my surprise, when I arrived there, they asked the original credit card (that used a hundred day ago), and that moment I haven't. I was with other credit card. 

So, I tried to explain , the payment was ok, but they almost put me out. So, I paid again (twice) the reserve. Well, that time I understood that hotel just  think  about money.

I has been hosted in several hotels in the world, I never had such problem. I read again and again my  reservation and there is nothing saying about to bring the original credit card, NOTHING. If anyone want I can send it to prove (number 1804101125).

After this inconvenient, I realized others bad things about this Hotel. For example, the juice is not natural.. and very very bad. 

Coke is worse than Coke Machine... very bad also.

The food is very similar for all day... and the room is to simple for the price...

I'm writing this comment to help you, because there are other good options with better service and  price.

ah.. And about the first payment ???

I yet not received the refund... I hope not be necessary involve the authorizes to get it.

Att,
Fernando.

reviews.author: Marina L
reviews.title: Absolutely fabulous!!
reviews.text:
Just checked out after one week’s family vacation here and can’t wait to recommend this absolute gem of a place to everyone!! 
We’ve been to a good few 5* hotels in the Caribbean and this one beats them all. The design, atmosphere, quality food etc, is all you ‘d expect from hotel this standard, but there is something special that sets it apart by a long shot : it’s exceptional service and lovely people who provide it.

Everyone goes out of their way constantly to add more pleasure and satisfaction to your stay. Absolutely everyone, from cleaners to waiters to really all staff. None of it is “fake” and, unlike all other Caribbean hotels, they don’t loiter or wait for a tip. 

Our little one of 2,5 years that normally doesn’t like staying anywhere with anyone, loved the Baby club (1-4 y.o.) and our 7 y.o was impossible to fish out of the Kids Club (5-12y.o), they had so many fun activities every day (both open from 9-21h every day). Our particular thanks to all the team who looked after them - Ivonne, Sarai, Paula and each and every one else that was there!! 

It’s been our best holiday yet and we’ll definitely return here!!

reviews.author: Camino_Jim
reviews.title: Just average
reviews.text: While I have been to Playa del Carmen three times this was my first time going to Cancun.  I am not a typical all-inconclusive type of traveler. I expected gorgeous beach and 5-star dining.  The beach is gorgeous, but too few cabanas on the beach unless you pay extra.  Very average food all the way around.  The service is great.  I am not much of a drinker, so if your idea of a great vacation is free drinks once you get there, my review does not apply to you.  I was not impressed and would not do this place again.

reviews.author: Hjremlinger
reviews.title: Another wonderful and relaxing vacation
reviews.text:
This has been my +9 visit in the past 9 years and once again we could not have asked for a better week.  

It was magical starting at the time we stepped out of our shuttle and were recognized by the smiling face of Rahul (who remembered us from last years) to just minutes before we left saying good by to our Paradisus family, Marta and Moses. 

Paradisus hires the best people who are attentive, friendly and like family and this is why we continue to return.  I have to give a big thank you to Pablo at the concierge desk who was very instrumental in make our stay even better.  

Thank you to all of the staff but especially to Marta, Moses, Rahul and Pablo.  See you all again real soon.

reviews.author: Rockgirlca1
reviews.title: How do you run out of towels at a beach resort ?
reviews.text:
Gorgeous day in Cancun we have sun however been  waiting for over 1 hour ... it’s pretty bad when you come to a beach and they cannot accommodate their guests with the basics ie beach towels ! 

BRING YOUR OWN TOWEL (BYOT)

reviews.author: 2SunsetSailors
reviews.title: Guacamole Workshop
reviews.text:
What to do after a long luxurious breakfast and a morning basking by the pool?

A fun, informative and delicious Guacamole making class where you literally get to eat the fruits of your labor! 

Chef Diana & interpreter Angel Avel guided us effortlessly through the process of customizing guacamole to our own tastes. They took the time to offer additional ideas of ingredients we may like to create our own custom recipe once we return home. 

I highly recommend skipping (or delaying) your siesta to take this  short workshop hosted by knowledgeable and personable staff at Paradisus Cancun.

Angel Avel, interpreter & Diana, Chef

reviews.author: john l
reviews.title: Great beach and pool area
reviews.text: Above average all inclusive .Nice resort. Great service. Food average. The nightly entertainment needs improvement. Very nice beach and pool area. Great workout facility. Very large complex and has a area for children separate from adult pool.

reviews.author: Crystal F
reviews.title: Royal Service- Worth it!
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from our first visit.  The resort is beautiful both inside and out.  It is impeccably clean and the scent inside is intoxicating.  We loved it!  We walked for miles in both directions on the beach and felt very safe.  The waves were a bit rough, red flags were out most days, but the water is a beautiful shade of blue and perfect to gaze at from your personal palapa.  

We upgraded to Royal Service and felt that it was well worth the extra charge.  We were assigned a personal butler, Norma, who asked our preferences the first day and texted us the following days.  Every single staff member that we encountered was friendly and could not do enough to make us feel welcomed and pampered.  We had the very best service at the Royal Service pool.  The waiters there are incredible!

Our only recommendation for improvement was the food. We felt that it was low quality and bland in each restaurant.  There are a vast amount of choices, but none stood out to us.  We are not extremely picky eaters, nor are we foodies, and still we feel that this is an area that Paradisus could improve upon.

We have travelled to Cancun for five years in a row, in addition to many luxury resorts throughout the Caribbean.  We would would highly recommend this resort, but hope for improvement in the restaurants.

reviews.author: Imrankhan M
reviews.title: Rude front desk staff - horrible service
reviews.text: The electricity in our room was not working, after repeated complains and having to bath in darkness and feed our little baby in darkness - we were left to wait in the lobby with a hungry baby for an hour. The front desk staff Samuel and manager Luis were rude and told us it was ok, we just had to wait. This level of service is unacceptable in a motel, let alone a 350 $/nt hotel claiming to be five star luxury. Absolutely disgraceful and blood boiling - this hotel needs to be ashamed of themselves for starving a baby.

reviews.author: Quincy S
reviews.title: Beautiful Property / Poor Communication
reviews.text: Visited Cancun for a long weekend on a company trip. The property is beautiful. The staff is friendly and helpful. BUT....check in and check out are long and involved. Communication is poor as to exactly what services are included in the upgrades, how check out works, and group dinner reservations were difficult. There was no communication as to shows and activities going on at the property so we missed a lot of fun. BUT...the property is beautiful and the staff are friendly. Overall it was a wonderful, relaxing trip.

reviews.author: Robert L
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at Paradisus Cancun and we had a great service from Gaudencio from the Naos restaurant who recommended us a seafood plater including lobster for an extra 40$usd that was delicious. Gaudencio is an amazing waiter and you should meet him if you have the chance.

reviews.author: BabeRog
reviews.title: Mega resort, mega perks
reviews.text:
Yes I paid for the Royal Service and my experience may be slanted.  However this resort offered something for every type of traveler.  

Facilities beautiful and very clean.  I can even go as far to say, scenic indoor spaces.  Many entertainment options, classes - ceviche cooking class, tequila lessons, wine tasting - yoga, water aerobics, pool side bands, lounge acts (excellent) and night club.  So much to entertain!

Food was wonderful.  Tapas, Peruian, Brazilian, Mexican with high end twist, and everyday Mexican ( have to say that was the worst service restaurant with its no reservation policy) and buffet.  There was another internationally acclaimed restaurant that had a lofty price tag which I didn't visit.  If you felt really lazy you could order food at your personal palapa.  I had tuna skewers!  Delicious!  Room service available also.

Beach:  probably due to season and high winds, but ocean almost unusable.  I did walk it daily but waves very rough and current strong.  Chairs and shade plentiful.

Now for my personal experience with the Royal Service.  Alex was my butler.  He did absolutely everything for me.  He was friendly and efficient.  I would just text him and it was done.  I have traveled to Mexico many times and have always gone to scuba clubs or adult only.  The option here to have an adult only space was a good choice.  Alex made experienced, knowledgable recommendations when I asked about particular activities in and outside the resort.  Great experience.

reviews.author: Arthur M
reviews.title: last minute deal was too good to pass up!
reviews.text: Great all inclusive deal . we had been at a Paradisus at another location(Punta Cana ) and were very impressed with the brand.  This was a beautiful hotel with great landscaping of plants and vines inside where the restaurants were located.  Great service and good staff throughout. Problems we had were 1) Gluten free options were limited and difficult to feel comfortable with some offerings. 2) The music on the beach was the exact same nightclub upbeat rhythm for hours - I would have settled for anything else just to mix it up a bit - when I wrote down a list of about 10 different popular artist and gave to the DJ , he didn't even look at it and said he had to play his specific stuff ( which was ok for 10 , 20 , 30 minutes - but not for hours on end with no variation)

reviews.author: Melissa F
reviews.title: Great cabana experience
reviews.text: We loved Alejandro Gonzalez and Jorge Martinez. Excellent service, beautiful location and super quick service. These guys are amazing, helpful, nice and would get us anything we needed. The poolside cabanas are so lovely with a view of the beach and pool.

reviews.author: Judith P
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort!
reviews.text: My sister and I have been meeting here for 13 years and have come to know the many fantastic folks here who make our visits well above pleasant!  Thanks to Cristian and Edwin for the fantastic Champaign service at breakfast!  Thank you to Asuncion and Sophinia for the wonderful beach delights, and to Oscar for the most incredible dinner service (and more bottles of wine for our room).  This place is low key and just what I need every winter!

reviews.author: Freedom270648
reviews.title: Amazing family trip
reviews.text:
This is our second time being in Paradisus Cancun. We just wanted to express our gratitude toward Claudia (our Meliá club greeting manager , George (our butler), and the rest of the staffs (waiters, Andre and Christian) while we were staying at the resort. 

And again, our family had a wonderful time on our vacation. As matter of fact, it was one of our best vacations so far! Thank you for the wonderful food and extraordinary service that you provided us. You guys work so hard to make sure everything was perfect for us, from the dinner reservations to the pool cabanas, (Mariza works so hard as well). George visited us every day to ensure that we had the best time and answered any requests we had! He makes sure that we know who we can go to if we have any concerns on his days off. You really made our vacation a home away from home experience. You made it such an easy and enjoyable time for our family. 

We hope to come back and see you guys again soon and thanks again for making our vacation a memorable one!

reviews.author: Gregg H
reviews.title: Top notch Cancun destination
reviews.text: Excellent, well maintained property. Food is way above the usual all inclusive fare. Staff was over the top accommodating. Special thanks to Michael Lara for his help at pool and beach. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Gabriella (Gabb... Z
reviews.title: BEST TIME
reviews.text: Seriously Jesus, Didier, and Jaime made our whole trip! Rent a cabana and they will give you the best experience ever!! I will recommend this resort to anyone for the sole experience these guys give! Will come back for them. The hotel is awesome and everything service wise is A+ all around. From the outside bar bar to the inside bars everyone is so awesome. Front desk was amazing as well. Can’t say enough about the service.

reviews.author: Betsi Z
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: Honestly had the most amazing experience overall, but what really made it was the servers at the cabana. Not included in the all inclusive but highly worth I️t, mainly for the cabana boys!! Didier, Jaime, and Jesus were the most helpful and amazing people, they made our experience absolutely worth I️t. If nothing else then to say hi to these gentleman. Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Jackie P
reviews.title: Paradise 2018!
reviews.text: This is our 4th time to this hotel. We've come once a year in the early spring for the last 4 years. Our favorite part is Manuel and the Bali Beds at Coco's Bar. They provide fantastic service... always asking if you need more beer, water or cocktails. Plus the view of the blue ocean and white sand from the beach bed is hard to beat. This is the reason we come back. The hotel is also beautiful. I would say all the restaurants are good. We enjoyed Market Grill, Bana, Fuego and Blue Agave for dinners. All great and different. We went with two other couples and had the best time.

reviews.author: Annette Koscielniak
reviews.title: Amazing service by Chef
reviews.text: On our first day there Chef Eduardo Mukul greeted us at the entrance of Naos Restaurant, right away he was very pleasant and asked us how we liked the food. That night it was sea food and e made sure we got what we came for :) The food was amazing and his service was priceless. He was always there smiling and welcoming us when we walked it. Very caring and pleasant, he took the time out of his extremely busy schedule  to say always hello and serve the food himself right to our table! AMAZING SERVICE, will defiantly go back!

reviews.author: John G
reviews.title: Paradisus disappointment
reviews.text:
What a disappointing experience. First, we pull up to hotel and there eas absolutely no one to greet us or take luggage, but instead we get bombarded with people selling timeshare. 
Now it gets better......
We specifically paid full price for an upper floor suite and we get a standard room on ground floor. 
Things happen and I understand, but I don't appreciate being lied to.
After arguing with front desk they said they would give us what we paid for but they can't right now because they gave out room to someone else....and of course while I'm arguing here comes the timeshare people again. 
Dining staff lacking and very unattentive.
We visit Cancun every year and typically stay at Hard Rock but we thought it would be a good idea to mix it up this year, big mistake.
Nonetheless, we are still
 here and I will update as this worsens im sure.

reviews.author: Cranean
reviews.title: Great Spring Break Trip With Kids
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a great hotel for the entire family, look no further. This all inclusive hotel has it all, great food, perfect beach and amazing staff! Traveling with kids is always interesting, but they loved it! Sandra and Alexandra our butlers were great. It is well worth the extra to upgrade to family concierge. You are given priority for the restaurants, have access to the royal service at the adult only pool (if you can sneak away) and have your own lounge for private snacks and drinks. The hotel has lots of activities. My favorite were the sushi and mixology classes. We were also lucky to hear three tenor singers that were so good they bought tears to my eyes! Thanks Paradisus Cancún! Can’t wait for next time!

reviews.author: lulabobula
reviews.title: Truly Paradise
reviews.text: I had an incredible stay at the Paradisus Cancun last week. I found myself constantly amazed with the level of entertainment, ambiance, and service. If you are staying here I highly recommend doing the activities. Omar is amazing and went above and beyond to show me a good time.

reviews.author: Brooklynite_Abroad
reviews.title: Incremental improvement, not yet a true Paradisus
reviews.text:
The setting:  You are a 20-minute drive from the airport and a 10-minute walk some of the best lagoon facing restaurants in Cancun (Porfirio’s, Fred’s, Puerto Madero).  There is a convenience store and pharmacy right across the road from the entrance to the hotel.  The resort is a massive structure of five Mayan-esque pyramids.  The one in the center is the largest and functions as the main reception area for regular hotel guests.  The lobby entrance is impressive as this is the largest pyramid.  The massive open space is nicely accentuated by a plethora of pathos plants hanging off each floor.  There is a lounge/bar with an awesome view of the sea and many restaurants including the main buffet off this lobby.  If you are arriving in a taxi or a shuttle, the main entrance is where you will be dropped off.  If you rented a car and you can drop it off at the main entrance for the complimentary valet to park it.  If you are a Club Melia guest, you will be staying in the first, smaller pyramid, which has its own parking lot and entrance.  If you are arriving prior to 11pm, you can park here and access your room much easier, instead of parking in Pyramid three and walking through two pyramids to get there.  Pyramid five is the exclusive, adults-only, pyramid.  The spa is located on the ground level of pyramid four.  We are Club Melia members, so we parked directly in front of pyramid one and our check-in was smooth.  I was expecting to have to battle with reception staff to get a sea facing room (which is an incredible view), as we usually get lagoon facing rooms (with a view of the parking lot and the road, but with gorgeous sunset views), but we were assigned a studio with an amazing sea view, so I was pleasantly surprised/relieved.
The room:  Ours was a studio, with a decently sized bathroom, tiled with natural stone.  The bathroom had a tub with a rain shower head.  The tub drained slowly and the water pressure was weak in the shower.  The toilet and bidet were behind a sliding door.  The room had a stocked kitchen with a microwave and a range.  There was coffee maker with complimentary coffee but no milk or sugar.  There was also no tea.  There were water bottles and an empty fridge, as we didn’t opt for the all-inclusive package.  Housekeeping will not replenish your water unless you opt into the all-inclusive deal.  There is complimentary tea and coffee in the lobby area of the Club Melia Pyramid, but this gets taken away in the evening.  If you want to enjoy a cup of tea in the evening, in your room, make sure to grab some tea bags and cups during the day.  We had a king-size bed in the room and the bedding and mattress were comfortable.  There was a dining room table in the room as well as a small sofa.  The flat panel TV hung opposite the bed, but channels in English are limited; there wasn’t CNN for example.  The WiFi was free and worked great at night, but was sluggish to non-existent during the day when resort’s guests are simultaneously using it.  The air conditioner worked well in the room.  Our balcony had an amazing view of the sea and came equipped with a chair a sun lounger, as well as a large jetted-tub.  
The food:  We never opt for the all-inclusive as it’s a poor value if you are a couple without kids.  The restaurants in Cancun are excellent and a great dinner will never exceed $50-60/person.  We ended up eating breakfast at the resort’s buffet, which is not a terrible value at $23/person and is convenient.  For lunch, which drove out to a local taco stand, or took advantage of the small, free lunch buffet offered on Saturdays in the Club Melia Pyramid’s lobby.  I would only opt-in for the all-inclusive package if I were staying with kids, for convenience.
The pool/beach:  The resorts has large pools for regular guests, an exclusive Royal Service pool area with Bali beds, a pricey beach club area which no one was using, and a pool and beach area for Club Melia guests.  There were a lot of children in the main and the Club Melia pools, so prepared for the noise.  If you are Club Melia guest, you can reserve a Bali bed, either beachside or poolside.  These are ideal if you love the beach but not the intense sun.  You get your first day free and subsequent days are $10/person.  These Bali beds/cabanas are upholstered in a towel-like material with plenty of cushions.  There is a foot was at the entry to each poolside Bali bed.  The poolside Bali beds also have electrical outlets and USB ports for easy charging of your electronics.  There is drinks service offered frequently poolside and less frequently beachside.  If you prefer both the beach and the pool then opt for Bali beds 7-10, as these are closest to the stairs leading to the beach and farthest from the shrieking children in the pool.  The beach has soft white sand and the water is crystal-clear, but the wind is strong and so are the waves, at least during the month of March.  Lifeguards at the beach herd swimmers into a shallow sand bar area, which is handy for safeguarding swimmers but is annoying for the swimmers as this is a very shallow area.  The water temperature is refreshing and comfortable, but not too warm.
All in all, this property keeps improving but is still no match for true Paradisus-branded resorts like in Dominican Republic or Playa del Carmen.  It’s impossible to retrofit an older Gran Melia into a modern Paradisus.  The small improvements like electrical outlets in the poolside Bali beds are a step in the right direction.  Customer service in the Club Melia Pyramid could improve very much so.  First of all, when guests arrive, even late like us, and ask for some tea bags to make tea, these should be quickly brought to the room.  Instead, the reception staff who checked us in suggested we try for tea the next day or order room service at $5/cup.  If the resort supplies complimentary coffee beans in the room, they should also supply tea bags, sugar and milk.  There is no reason why complimentary water bottles are not replenished for Club Melia guests who don’t opt into the all-inclusive package.  The resort should redesign all-inclusive to bed and breakfast or breakfast and lunch only, allowing guests to leave the resort for great restaurants nearby.  We had a butler assigned to our room, Bryant, but he never even made an appearance during our long weekend stay.  I would stay here again only because it’s a good value if you have some options that are expiring.

reviews.author: dethredge
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever - Good Spring Break Destination on the Chiller Side
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is the best Resort for the reasonable price. Everything was completely clean and any question or problems were handled immediately. As a college student on spring break this resort was nicer than other resorts in the area and had plenty of younger people although it was not as much of a party scene although red lounge is bumpin. The staff was the best, shutout to Francisco and Rigoberto.

reviews.author: Richard M
reviews.title: Never left the resort, enjoyed relaxing low key 4 nights in first visit to Mex
reviews.text: Before we left i read all these reviews and comments cause i'm sort of an over-planner, I'll start with a few words about us because I think that helps people get more out of the review with context of who we are. My wife went to Paradisus Cancun for 20 yr anniversary getaway, break from our normal life. We are not frequent travelers, in fact this was the first time to Mex for both of us. on paper Paradisus met a  lot of our criteria and was economical and we went for it. We spent 1 night in normal Jr Suite Ocean View, then 3 nights upgraded to Royal Ocean View. Huge difference in the room. Very new, clean, bright, bathroom like a diff world from normal room. Ocean view is really cool and worthwhile. Go upper floor for better view. Overall the resort is over 25 years old and although well maintained and clean, there's no getting around the age. Our original room in building 1 had some updating but as an ex the sliding door to the bathroom was somewhat broken and didn't close well. Shows some age. A big pro is the ocean, the water is gorgeous, the beach itself is great, sandy not rocky. We typically spend our summer vacations on the FL panhandle so we're use to white sand beaches. it's not that white but it's great still. You snag an umbrella w/2 chairs on the beach, then get waited on all day with drinks. Great service. Food - we had fine experience with the restaurants. yes you have to have reservations, and with Royal Ser our bulter helped out, but i also did it myself and you just call in the morning, worked fine for us. Only got room service a couple of times, once it was pretty bad, i mean the french fries were bad, not sure how that could be but just telling like it is. Otherwise i was happy with the food overall. Throughout the stay staff was quite helpful. We sat thru a sales pitch for the vaca club, 90 mins w/breakfast, not too painful and worth it if you're getting something good in return. We had a Bali bed only 1 day but it was the bomb.com; so peaceful and relaxing. Other comments: the place is quite large and also has some funky smells; they try to minimize it with candles and incense. Might have been more noticeable since we were on first floor (bldg 5). Notice it seeping into our room a bit, so maybe an upper floor would be better. Some people complained about slow check in, but i thought that part was fine. Just expect them to offer a deal around Club Melia, you can so no or negotiate terms to attend it, and boom case closed. No one else brought that up during our stay. Overall staff very nice, friendly, helpful. Like i said we never left the resort so i can't comment on tours, excursions. Didn't watch nightly shows. For our purposes (seeking peace, quiet, time together as a couple) this worked for us. No college party scene while we were there. If we had stayed any longer than 4 nights i would have been ready for some sort of excursion or change of scenery. Since we're not big international travelers, i don't have a lot to compare it to, but for our needs, money, and location Paradisus worked out great.

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.title: Royal Service made our stay, otherwise our experience was mediorce
reviews.text: Royal Service was worth every penny.  Without it, the trip would not have been worth the time.  Rode was an excellent butler, and was responsive to every need.  Additionally, Eddie took excellent care of us while we were enjoying the bali beds by the pool.  The food was only okay in many instances.  Each restaurant has a limited number of dishes that are above average, and figuring them out is key to having a good time.  Tipping the staff is greatly appreciated and will drastically improve the level of service during your stay.  Make sure to take full advantage of the Bali beds, they are one of the most enjoyable aspects of this hotel.  To reiterate, Eddie was incredible.  We wished there were more activities included with the hotel.

reviews.author: JaredEsq
reviews.title: Nice family vacation
reviews.text:
Just returned from a week long vacation at the paradisus Cancun with my wife and 2 kids ( 2 and 1/2 and 6 months ). ‘Melia club package w concierge . Great place for a family vacation. However , I would not come here if not for a family vacation .

The hotel is nice , with a ton of staff working hard to keep the place looking nice and clean .  Definitely not a 5 star hotel in terms of the rooms , but 4 Star quality . We had a one bed room with connecting room w kitchen for the kids. 

The layout for a family is great since everything Is close together . The kids pool area is great and we rented a pool  Bali bed everyday facing the beach which made it much more enjoyable. 

The food was ok at best . Ordered room service breakfast most days which was good. Lunch by pool was very weak. Gross burgers , hot dogs .... good chicken wings and guacamole. But who wants to eat that everyday for lunch . 
You can also go to lunch buffet but I generally feel buffets are gross, and for the most part the buffet here was just ok food .

For dinner we at all of the restaurants and once at the buffet .
Enzo - good at best . Some things disgusting 
Bana- very bad .  sushi was barely edible. 
Fuego- not good . Certain things not edible 
Mole - good meal . Best of what we had during our stay
Buffet - Tuesday lobster night was good if you stick to the lobsters 
Vento- good/ok. Certain dishes good others just ok 
Blue agave - lunch twice - very good . Traditional Mexican food.
Worth mentioning, the Service at all go the restaurants was excellent . Every waiter was great . My comments relate to food only 

Overall we had a very nice time. He room was prefect for a family and the resort staff was excellent 

I would definitely come back but only for a family vacation

reviews.author: barbarasprague
reviews.title: Great Trip
reviews.text: Great hotel and experience.  The place is made all  the better by friendly, accommodating and outgoing team  Everything was done with a smile.   Alejandro, Andres and Pascal had us looking forward to breakfast and lunch everyday!   The rooms and property are very good.

reviews.author: Mr Onthego
reviews.title: Amazing again!!!
reviews.text:
Second time in two years.
Last year was business conference this year family vacation because I fell in Love with this place!!!!
Note I am anti Cancun because before I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Last year I always got sick and swore I would never go back!!!!
This year I booked a family vacation with a 1 bedroom suite for my daughter/ son in law and granddaughter as well as a studio suite for my wife and I.
I love this place !!!!!!
Even in the family / owners pyramid we are still within a five minute walk to the restaurants and beach.
We checked in late on a Wednesday so my daughter got an ocean front room and we had to wait until Saturday to get moved to one which was well worth the wait.
All restaurants are very good ( except Enzo’s ) which was pretty much all “Currie “ spiced and I’m not a big fan of.
The buffet was always great!!
Tuesday is seafood night with all you can eat lobster!
We had room service for breakfast twice which was good but the service at the buffet is the best!
Pasquale and Christian are the best waiters you could ask for !!!
They go above and beyond to make sure you have everything you need and then some. ( would you like Baileys in your coffee ??)
They are great !!!!
Then we go to our beach Hut ( Bali beds) 
Mariza the pool / ocean concierge is the BEST I have met in my 30+ years of traveling !!!!!!
She starts her day at 6:30am and “runs” to make sure your hut is ready for you when you get there.
We are early risers and usually show up at 8:00am and yes the hut was ready.
Even with her running she still takes the time to chat with you make sure all is perfect.
Then Laura our ocean front waitress shows up At ten am with a bucket of ice filled with bottled water and keeps it cold and filled with water and beer all day. She’s around every 15 minutes for any other drinks you want.
The only problem we encountered was the first 3 days we didn’t get turn down service and the refurbishing of our mini fridge was hit and miss...
Will we go back??????
Absolutely!!!!!!!!

The last day there Pasquale, Christian and Mariza all gave us a big hug and look forward to us coming back.........
We owe to them because their service was ( I’ll say it again)
Amazing!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: David J
reviews.title: Exceptional resort / exceptional people
reviews.text: I have never written a review of a resort - and I have stayed at many - but I feel the need to comment. This is, by far, the most exceptional place I have been to. From the moment we arrived the staff has been incredibly attentive (we have some serious food allergy issues - upon arrival the manager Mayte Dalila Angeles Guerrero was waiting for us to introduce us to the head chef and manager of restaurants - just to put our minds at ease. They did. The food (in addition to being safe for us) could not be more delicious. Grilled garlic octopus in hibiscus sauce? Tamale with chocolate and lychee ice cream? I could go on. The grounds are beautiful / lush, pool fun, the rooms comfortable and clean - but what makes this place so special are the people. I could not recommend Paradisus Cancun more highly. I plan to return.

reviews.author: Bridget D
reviews.title: Did not meet our expectations
reviews.text:
The first thing you notice when you walk in is the overwhelming scent of incense being burnt. If you are sensitive to scent or migraines are triggered my scent do not stay here. In parts of the building (older buildings) you can actually smell the mold and mildew they are trying to cover up. 

Were were initially put in the wrong room but had to walk about 15 minutes to the furthest building and up 5 flights of stairs before we figured it out. The room was DISGUSTING. I feel like everyone rejects that room or they put the drunk 18/19 y/o college kids in it. The couch was stained and so worn out, the air was filled with bleach and the balcony was over the parking lot which had construction and we couldn’t hear a thing. The mirror also had a red burn stain all over it so you couldn’t even see in it. They had 1 tiny elevator for this building and it wasn’t working, so we hiked it up 5 flights of stairs before realizing they put us in the wrong type of room. 

We were relocated to building #3, night and day!! The room looked like the pictures online, it was clean, didn’t smell, balcony was larger, and the bathroom mirror was clear. The staff did not heckel us for this so I give them credit for that, BUT I give them 1 Star for putting me in a room like the first one to begin with after spending $360/night. 

Our shower was never cleaned during the 2 night/ 3 day stay. I set up the shower head, etc., to test it and it was never touched. Pretty gross. Waters in fridge were never refilled and safe only worked on room key. The room also didn’t have an extra latch lock, this made my friend and I a little uneasy. 

FOOD: we did room service, pool side service, buffet and the taco restaurant. I would give it all 2 stars, not good at all. But they are feeding the masses. 

POOL/BEACH: The pools are huge and they have a lot of cabanas to rent. The lounge chairs are first come first serve. I watched the pool servers give away people’s chairs (mine included) when they stepped away for less then 10 minutes and left personal belongings on them. So unless you’ve parked your behind on the chair, it’s not safe. Beach views and beach front is a major plus for this hotel. If you’re a beach goer, this is a prime spot. 

SPA- ALERT!! We had a spa employee offer a private 20 minute massage out of the spa and asked us to keep it a secret. He was so creepy and made my friend and I so uncomfortable we immediately ended the conversation and did not schedule any spa services. He begged us many times not to tell anyone at the hotel, which we didn’t but we are writing it on here. 

Paradisus is a very large resort but it’s old and not well maintained all around. If you are paying for Royal or family concierge they may focus on you otherwise I would spend the extra $$$ and stay at the Marriott next time.

reviews.author: matthewnewnham
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic time on our holiday for 11 nights. We had the Junior Concierge Suite Room for me, my wife and our two young boys. 

Our concierge ladies were Fernanda and Violeta. They were both attentive, polite, and helped with our every need. I couldn't recommend them highly enough. 

I also must make a special mention of Alberto who worked around the pool areas looking after all the guests. He was so helpful and always had a smile on his face. Thank you!

This was our best family holiday and it really is like being in paradise!

reviews.author: 20Twenty
reviews.title: Beautiful All Inclusive Hotel Resort
reviews.text: It was my first time in Cancun, Mexico. This hotel made me view Cancun in a different way.  Our room was spacious with 2 lanais overlooking the harborside/marina, golf course side of the hotel.  Mini bar was fully stocked as well as the bathroom amenities.  Lots of eating options and drinks.  This hotel takes care of everything!  Staff at the restaurants and bars are so accommodating.  No issues with bad water, cleanliness and food here in our 5 days 4night stay.  The beach was spectacular and this hotel has a good stretch of sand and water, and if you choose the pool they have several of that too!  Awesome experience that will last a lifetime!

reviews.author: ddswong
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay at the Paradisus Cancun Mar16-23/2018
reviews.text:
I just returned from a one week stay with my family at the Paradisus Cancun and we are already looking to return to this wonderful hotel. We have stayed at this hotel 3 times when it was the Gran Melia, but this was our first stay in 10 years and we were happy to see that most of it had stayed the same. Here is a rundown of the highs and lows of this hotel:
1.We had a beautiful beach view room and we had family concierges Sandra and Alexander who did an impeccable job taking care of us. They both were incredible and are the main reasons why we are returning. They really went out of our way to keep us well taken care of and they went above and beyond. Bravo to the two of you.
2.Restaurants- we were rather disappointed with Tempo. We all thought " very little substance for the extra price". I had the tasting menu while my wife had the lobster and my daughter had the filet mignon. I would say that I enjoyed my meal the least, however the service was impeccable. We all agreed, the food was better before it became a Michelin rated establishment
Market Grill was our favourite restaurant and Angel and Rafael were the best waiters we have had at any restaurant. They are fantastic and both are very attentive . Benazir was an incredible hostess who does an impeccable job. Frank at Bana Japanese restaurant was also a wonderful waiter.
Mole(the Mexican restaurant) was also a bit of a letdown, but Fuego was fine.
3.Pool service by Joel and Jose as well as Cesar was impeccable. Hector at La Palapa was also top notch.

This group of employees really made our stay enjoyable and for me to remember each of their names is a testament to the top notch service that each one brings to their guest. Each of them should be commended. Both of my good friends were so impressed with the hotel  and staff that they both bought time share at this hotel and personally, I may do the same the next time I visit.

A+ service. Thank you so much and we will definitely see you again very soon

reviews.author: tonit0814
reviews.title: Beautiful Vacations - Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text:
The Hotel, beach and pools were very clean and beautiful. 
La Palapa restaurant the best restaurant in royal service area.
Market Grill restaurant a great place to dinner and very good service.
Family Concierge  one bedroom with ocean view suite was a very clean and comfortable room located in tower 3, floor 7, room 3712.
Family concierge service its a great great option... Fernanda and Violeta very kind and helpful and always determined to go the extra mile. They booked all of our restaurants and complimentary cabanas by the pool. They also left surprises for us and the kids every day!!!!! toys, snacks, wine tequila, champagne and canapes.
Thanks Fernanda, Violeta and Liliana from Family Concierge services,Jesus and all staff on Cocos pool area for make an awesome vacation for Mendiola's Family.
Excellent Hotel.

reviews.author: Colleen R
reviews.title: Love it!!!
reviews.text: Absolutely a great time. The food was wonderful and had fantastic service!!  Extra special thanks to Market Grill and Coco’s bar, Sergio knows how to take care of his guest. You will not be disappointed here.

reviews.author: Josh M
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort with Terrible Service
reviews.text:
I recently went with my family of 4 to the Paradisus Cancun. We stayed in a Family Concierge 1 Bedroom Suite for 6 days. For the last 3 years, we stayed at The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real in the DR (I'll refer to it as DR throughout). In the DR, we had such wonderful service, beautiful large clean bedrooms, amazing fresh fruit tropical drinks, the best butlers, and, well average food. We wanted to see if the Paradisus Cancun could give us some variety and still be as wonderful as the DR. 

We thought this hotel and facilities were absolutely beautiful with few exceptions. The lobby in building 3 is spectacular. Everything is clean and well maintained. I'll walk you through my overall experience and why the service was terrible.

**Check-In**
Upon arrival we had a very nice welcome and private check-in in the family concierge lounge.  The lounge is not as easily accessible from the pool as it was in the DR and also did not have any windows or a bartender making amazing drinks. This was nice benefit in the DR. In Cancun it was a nice facility with a self service bar (that we never used), and had some food throughout the day. It also had a nice area for children under 5. That area was too childish in design for my 7 and 10 year old. Check-In was quick and painless, they offered a bottle of vodka, rum, or tequila to take to our room and introduced us to our butler.

**The Room**
We had an ocean front one bedroom suite with one balcony off the living room and one very large balcony off the bedroom. The room was very clean. The one bedroom suite in the DR was more than TWICE the size. I asked that they bring in beds for my children and they converted the living room to a bedroom. The convertible couch was tiny and would never accommodate 2 children comfortably. With the beds in the living room there was no room for anything else. In the DR, with the beds in the living room, we still had a couch, large coffee table, small dining room table and wet bar. The DR had a massive walk-in closet, huge bathroom with 2 sinks, and a large walk in shower and separate soaking tub. The toilet in the DR was in a separate small room (WC) which was very convenient. In Cancun, there was a much smaller bathroom with only a tub and a single sink. The tub had a rain shower head which was very nice. This is a huge difference in living space when the price was very similar.  So over all, i'd say we were disappointed in comparison to the DR. I also wonder if we were not given the room type we should have had.

**Food**
The food in the Naos which is the buffet style service was good. Breakfast service was much better than the DR. In the DR the buffet style area was so huge and had so many options it did not have a cozy feel. If felt more like they were feeding the herd. In Cancun, it had a better feel, but it had fewer, but higher quality options. The rest of the restaurants were underwhelming with the exception of the peking duck at Enso which does not compare to NYC peking duck but was really good. The mexican food at Mole and Blue Agave was really good too. Bana was good as long as you don't expect NYC sushi. The pool food at Sunset Grill does not qualify as food. Remember the hockey puck hamburger from high school lunch and the cardboard pizza.  The pizza was better in the high school cafeteria. The only edible pool food was the amazing guacamole and probably the best chicken nuggets ever. Tempo which is an additional charge restaurant with Michelin stars was good. We had a few outstanding dishes at Tempo, but some were below average. They served us seared tuna that we ended up sending back because the texture and flavor was way off. The person playing the piano at Tempo was so incredibly talented and it made the whole night better.

**Drinks**
The drinks were a major disappointment in Cancun. In the DR, everything was made with fresh fruit and not the artificial corn syrup mixes as used in Cancun.  When they made a pina colada in the DR they put fresh pineapple in the blender. In the DR they also had the high quality blenders that did not leave big chunks of ice in the drinks. I love a good daiquiri or dirty banana and the bar tenders were not as skilled as in the DR. Also, in the DR, some of the bars and bar tenders were very kid friendly. My kids love ordering all of the same drinks without alcohol. In the DR they could easily get service at the bar. The bar tenders in Cancun paid more attention to the drunk people ordering tequila shots then my children (okay i was that drunk person a few times). I needed to help my kids order drinks a few times when they get such a kick out of doing it themselves.

**The Service**
This is where Paradisus Cancun fell very short. This may sound snobby to some, but the extra money I paid to have a butler was a total waste of money. I think they actually made my stay more stressful. The first day we arrived, we asked them to reserve dinner between 7 and 8 at every restaurant for our stay. Every day was a mistake or issue that I needed to spend time working out. They always had one excuse or another as to why mistakes were made. I needed to be very persistent on my vacation. This is an additional service that the hotel offers so you can relax. In the DR, they got the reservations right, they learned the food and drinks you liked and surprised you with things at the pool or beach like a plate of sushi or shrimp cocktail. 

In the DR, our butler had a cabana reserved for us each day with towels. In Cancun they charge you $130 USD for a cabana by the pool which included pool food service which was terrible. They don't let you take food from Naos back to your seat. There was no place to go for anything fresh unless you go inside. The cabana is a way to extort more money from people who are already paying a lot. I asked my butler if I can get tacos from Blue Agave to the pool and they said NO. It is a strange rule to have when the pool food is so bad.

Some of the waiters were very good, but a majority would give you a warm welcome, ask if there is anything at all they can get you, and then completely forget or never return.

This service was very disappointing. No one cared at the hotel to improve it. 

We still really enjoyed our vacation and spending time with family, but I will not be returning to Paradisus Cancun. Next year it will either be back in the DR or looking for a new experience.

reviews.author: Karen Ziezold
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: The service and attention to detail was outstanding. The food was amazing. Never bored as there are so many options of different cuisines and restaurants complete with unique decor.  When we were relaxing on the beach, the waiters always ready to take our drink orders and deliver it back to us without delay.

reviews.author: HappyNomad7
reviews.title: Old, tired and busy
reviews.text:
This was my last visit ever to an all-inclusive resorts. The price is insanely high and what you get is an old hotel, tired rooms and food & drinks so bad we ate nothing and went to eat at a restaurant outside the hotel. We had one drink during our visit--a Gin tonic--and it was mediocre. We wanted wine but the house wine is worth $3 cost a bottle (yes, a bottle, this is not a joke) and we just couldn't drink it.

When we left, the line up at the checkout counter was at least 30 people, and since it's an AI and we consumed nothing, I just left only to be stopped at the door because I didn't have permission to leave until the checkout counter gave me a stupid little paper so we had to walk back in and wait. And wait. I think by that point smoke was coming out of my ears.

Anyway what this all means is: if you've ever been to a real hotel (i.e. not a AI) and enjoyed it, you will not enjoy the Paradisus. It's just a different world where they charge you a fortune for third rate quality.

reviews.author: Thom M
reviews.title: The Best Cancun Has To Offer
reviews.text:
There are not enough words to explain how great this resort truly is. My wife and I along with another couple have been traveling to this resort for 3 years running now and we fully plan on doing so for years to come. There are many things that make this resort and more importantly the experience so good. From a facility standpoint the resort is clean and well maintained. We were excited this year to see some improvements that had happened from fresh paint to added shops. The rooms are all appointed and very comfortable. The views from the patios are also very nice with a planted raised bed and chairs to relax in the morning and evening. We spent most of our time (evenings) in the main pyramid which is beautiful, more so at night because they light the glass roof in a deep purple which sets an evening mood . 8 stories of tiered floors in a glass enclosed atrium make this space truly special. My favorite feature is the vines that grow down from each level, some of which are very long. The koi ponds and lush tropical plants all are very inviting. Shops and restaurants are well laid out and very comfortable. The beach area is always clean and well maintained. They also have several outdoor bars which make getting that cold drink very accessible. 
The food and drink selection for this resort are also a main reason we return time and time again. The variety of cuisine is so nice and the food VERY fresh. Whether you want to eat buffet style or a more intimate dinner setting the options are many. We can honestly say that we never had a bad meal while staying here and not even just an OK meal. Everything is awesome!  Our favorite places would be Blue Agave, Fuego and Bana. Each has its own unique setting and all have excellent food choices. Always fresh and always making you want more. There are many bar options to choose from depending on your mood and time of day. We spent most of our time at Coco’s which was great for sunning on the beach and really nice in the evening to sit out and enjoy the sounds of the ocean and the cool breeze. 
The staff however is truly what makes this place so incredibly awesome. From the time you arrive and until you leave you are treated very well and everyone is quick to be helpful should you need anything. I have stayed at other resorts similar to this and I can say confidently Paradisus has the best team I have ever seen. We have also noticed from year to year that many of the same people are still working there which leads me to believe the working environment is positive for the employees as well. This year we had a standout individual in the Naos restaurant by the name of Christian Lovera. This young man exemplifies what customer service truly is. Everyday we made it a point to have breakfast and lunch with him and everyday he went above and beyond anything I expected. Always quick to take care of a coffee that needed refilled or a plate that needed cleaned up. His hospitality and way of managing a table of guests was very similar to what I have seen in very high end restaurants. He truly works for the guest and makes their experience so much more pleasurable. 
All in all I would rate this resort at 5. I don’t know if there is much they could improve on because everything seems to be so well done. We are already planning our trip for next year!

reviews.author: Marty M
reviews.title: Dinner at Bana
reviews.text: This is our second visit to this resort. At Bana, The chef Bartolo, the waiter Jose and the manager made our dinner exquisite. The chef spoiled my wife and 12 year old daughter with special dishes and made our dinner a unique expierece. We repeated this restaurant in our 6 days visit. I would highly recommend this restaurant when you visit this resort.

reviews.author: noelchristin
reviews.title: Literally cried when we had to leave
reviews.text:
My husband is NOT one to leave the United States and it was difficult to convince him that we should give it a try at an all-inclusive in Mexico. By the time we had been at Paradisus for one day, he was already talking about coming back and bringing the kids!

This hotel is beautiful and there is such attention to detail. We loved the foliage throughout and the fresh and aromatic flowers in the lobby. We were there the first week of March and the weather was absolutely perfect. Not too hot where you can't enjoy yourself outside, but hot enough to swim without being chilly. We do not take luxurious trips often, so for us an ocean view room with standard service was just fine and not once did we feel like we were treated as less important guests. Every single staff member we encountered, from the front desk to the cleaning staff, went out of their way to ask if we needed anything and they were all incredibly friendly. The food was superb at every restaurant and even the buffet only had a few "misses" for us. The grounds, pools, beach, and water are breathtaking. We actually left the resort a few times and felt perfectly safe in the business district where we found little shops and fun things to see. We cannot wait to get back there and even found ourselves fantasizing about an alternate universe where we could find some way to live in Cancun!

reviews.author: Martin M
reviews.title: Experience at Bana
reviews.text: The chef Bartolo was super special with us. My wife is allergic to gluten and the chef treated her super well. Our 12 year old daughter also enjoyed the special rolls that the chef prepared for her. Jose was our waiter and he also made the experience unforgettable with his kindness and outstanding service. Overall it was an outstanding experience for the whole family. I would highly recommend this restaurant when you visit this resort.  We repeated this restaurant on our 6 days stay.

reviews.author: Nat H
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel. Loved It!
reviews.text:
Excellent Hotel. Great food at the buffet and most restaurants. Out of 6 restaurants the only one that we did not like was Enso - bad food and bad service. The rest were amazing.
We enjoyed the beach and the pool. Couple things that could be improved - there was a lot of seaweed on the beach, and instead of removing it, there was a tractor every morning pushing the seaweed back into the ocean to make the beach look clean. Also since this is a family friendly hotel we would expect to have quiet time at the beach, but there was really loud DJ music on the beach. I would prefer to just enjoy the sounds of the ocean and if someone wanted music they could enjoy it at the pool or have a portable speaker... Our waitress Asuncion at the beach was excellent.

This is the 2nd time we are staying at Paradisus (1st one was Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana). Would definitely recommend this hotel chain.

reviews.author: Dylan P
reviews.title: Our Stay With Royal Service Was Excellent!
reviews.text:
We spent six nights here in the middle of March. The vibe of the hotel was welcoming and pleasant. Every step of the grounds smelled excellent, thanks to well-placed aroma dispensers. Our Junior Suite Lagoon View Room was gorgeous; it was spacious, comfortable, and provided a cool respite from the sun in the afternoons. We spent a few nights exploring the reservation-required restaurants such as Enso and Bana, both of which were great. Our favorites were Blue Agave for its delicious quesadillas and tacos, and Naos for its eclectic buffet selection. While every restaurant provided excellent service, we particularly enjoyed our interactions with Martin, Andres, and Atilano in Naos.

Service pool and beachside was superb, with waiters coming by occasionally for drink orders, or just to drop off an ice bucket with several water bottles. Even in the height of spring break season, we were never disturbed by other guests, loud music, obnoxious kids, or any such annoyances. All the grounds were well-kept and modern, and access to the concierge and room service through the bedside phone was prompt and stress-free. We ordered from the 24-hour room service (which was complimentary) several times; ordering was easy, and our food arrived within 30 minutes. While not as high quality as what you might find in the restaurant, it was satisfactory for its convenience and ease.

Our only complaint is the brevity of our stay. We hope to be back, and we highly recommend the Paradisus for anyone looking for a calm, relaxing getaway.

reviews.author: Wyatt M
reviews.title: Beautiful but subpar
reviews.text: The Paradisus is beautiful but has some glaring problems. The service was fantastic, especially Francisco in the red lounge. He took care of our every need and was extremely friendly and funny. However our experience at the front desk was painfully difficult. The beach and pool were great and relaxing and the room was very nice but dirty and smelled like mildew. The food was mediocre and we had to skip multiple meals because the food looked so unappetizing.  Overall it was a good experience but for Melia/Paradisus this resort did not live up to our expectations.

reviews.author: fransvan0
reviews.title: Are you under 14 ?
reviews.text:
Location, infrastructure, architecture, design, room comfort = 10/10.
ICT (pre-check in, registration, customer monitoring, invoicing, check out) = complete chaos. How does this hard working amiable front office desk staff (there are 10 of them) manage to cope with this situation, day after day ?
