Must be paradise for the children, but for those over 14 you should pay 10 % extra and book Royal Service Exclusive in order to avoid the beehive.

reviews.author: Haley A
reviews.title: Superb!!
reviews.text: Went for six days and literally I have no complaints! The food is wayyy beyond expectations at an all inclusive. The drinks were well made and timely, and the staff cannot be raved about enough - they are so sweet, helpful, and hard working! The hotel itself is gorgeous, the grounds well kept, and the ocean is beautiful and clean. I would recommend royal service as it made the trip even more of a breeze! 5/5!

reviews.author: Sara D
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: This is our second time at Paradisus Cancun. Our son requested to come back after spring break last year. Kids club is great,  pool bar is great. Grounds are kept up. Avenue bar with Samuel, Benito, and Luis is exceptional.

reviews.author: JoefromNYCarea
reviews.title: Rode in Royal Service was excellent!
reviews.text: We just returned from an extended weekend, having stayed at the resort 6 times before, each time enjoying it more and more.  Rode was our concierge in Royal service this time, and he was so incredibly helpful, always being around and overly attentive to our needs.  Next time we visit, we look forward staying in Royal Service (it is worth the up-charge) and hopefully enjoying his presence again.

reviews.author: girlfromSC
reviews.title: Absolute Heaven
reviews.text:
Stayed here as part of a girls’ 30-something spring break in Royal Service suites and it’s been the most amazing experience. 
The hotel is flawless from the moment of arrival. We were whisked away by a butler to our special checkin area where we were met by Melina. We were given an overview of the Royal Service and since we were early and our rooms weren’t ready, asked if we’d like to go to a restaurant or the pool. Our butler, Hector, arrived and we got introduced. We exchanged numbers so we could contact him via WhatsApp if we couldn’t find him. 
We decided to go to the pool, which Hector showed us to and introduced us to Jose, our pool concierge. Day after day Jose ensured we had sun beds we liked and setup our towels for us. We were then greeted by Valeria, our Royal Service pool waitress for the day. She made sure we didn’t go hungry or thirsty. 
While we lounged by the gorgeous pool, Hector made sure our rooms were prepared. Our rooms were immaculate and mine was decorated in honour of my birthday with balloons and streamers, with cake and champagne waiting. It really makes you feel special. 
Overall the rooms are spacious, cool and comfortable. The bathrooms are perfect with high quality toiletries (including conditioner!). 
The Royal Service pool is fantastic and try to reserve your Bali beds early. The service at the pool is incomparable. Valeria, Moises, and Octavio all took the greatest care of us. Also, wander over to the semi-secret pool near the wedding gazebo with sun loungers in the shallow water. If you have an inflatable, take it to the main pool to be blown up. 
We enjoyed the pool area so much we didn’t make it to all the restaurants. We had breakfast and lunch at La Palapa each day. I will always remember the great service we received from Joel de Jesus at La Palapa; he made each meal memorable. Tip: if you ask nicely, your pool waiter might bring you something from the main menu to your sun lounger. 
Of the other restaurants, Blue Agave was memorable for its laid back atmosphere and delicious tacos. Market Grill was a great Rodizio experience. Bana had inventive and delicious sushi. Mole was the only letdown as it was too dark and the menu seemed limited. 
Room service is included and they’ll also oblige to some off-menu requests. The Royal Service lounge is also very well equipped with soft drinks, premium spirits, wine, beer, teas, coffees, and canapés bordering on mini-meals. 
The overall Royal Service experience is second to none. You’re constantly made to feel special and cared for as a guest. Saying goodbye to Hector was a moment and I had to give him a big hug.

reviews.author: flora767
reviews.title: Four Days in Paradise!
reviews.text:
We were a party of four, including two kids 4 and 7 years old. Right of the bat, I have to admit that their Explorer's Club is fantastic, with caring and competent ladies who really do love what they do.  Susie, Hana, Lucy, Lili, Rosi, Vale, Pao, and Lori: thank you for making our trip amazing by taking care of our children so well!  The only comment I would make in the area of improvements is that the relevant authorities should look into is some sort of restrictions/regulations around where the kids play just so not everyone has an access in.  In Punta Cana, their Explorer's Club allows only the children in the play area, no adults.  Being the neurotic mom that I am, I am totally for that kind of restriction.  
As far as the other amenities/services/ etc are concerned, we did have to ask to be moved from a noisy family room on on the first floor of pyramid one.  Guadalupe in reservations said she is the supervisor, but had very little control over her abilities and emotion, and consequently was of no help to us.  Myte had to step in and she definitely deserves a lot of praise around how she handled the whole situation and got us to on a quiet floor in pyramid 4.  Thank you Myte!  Rosa also deserves special mention because she made our room service breakfast order experience just fabulous!  Thank you Rosa:~)  Great resort if you are looking for just the resort experience, however, we did go downtown in a taxi, stopped at a flea market, and also went to the Maya museum.  The ferry lines were too long and slow to Isla Mujeres, so we had to abandon that plan especially because we had kids with us who were melting under the super hot sun.
Do check out the gelato cart!  Our family loved it, especially during hot days.  
We would definitely love to come back and visit again. Thank you:~)

reviews.author: Conny2785
reviews.title: Fantastic holidays
reviews.text:
We spent 9 days at Paradisus Cancun in March 2018 and had a really great stay. We booked Royal Service and a Junior Suite with ocean view and it was definitely worth it. The view and the spacious room were amazing - the bathroom had a large rain shower and a bathtub. Our Butler Daniel was very attentive and took good care of all the restaurant bookings etc., thanks a lot to him. 
The hotel is very clean and in a good condition with many nice looking details, even though it is a bit old. The beach area and pools were great. 
Paradisus Cancun offers a lot of entertainment - sports, dancing, sushi workshop, shows (I recommend the artistic show - amazing) etc. Every evening a different person/group were singing at the Royal Service Lounge. 
The food was delicious, especially the grilled shrimps at La Palapa :-) We liked the a-la carte restaurants Bana and Fuego very much, only the ladies at the entrance of the restaurants could be a bit more friendly. We asked for a table without a prior reservation, while the entrance lady referred us to the telephone right beside her with the statement that reservations for the next day are only to be made by phone - which we perceived as bit insolent. All in all the staff, above all the La Palapa staff, was remarkably friendly and helpful - being always aware of personal needs, even if you jammed your finger a waiter brought you some ice right away (thanks a lot for that) or if you asked for churros in the afternoon although they serve it only in the morning - the staff made it all possible. Special thanks to Abraham Franco, as management team, for making our holiday that great :-). We will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Companion761825
reviews.title: The most precious vacation!
reviews.text:
We stayed in Paradisus the end of February. It was a very special vacation for our anniversary and I was planning on  proposing to my girlfriend over this trip. That said, it was SUPER nerve wrecking trying to plan the trip especially since it was in another country nor was I familiar with the property. I reached out to LuZ and the guest service team who guided me to Concierge. Nayeli Arzate from the Concierge department really helped me out with all my needs and planning for this special vacation. I emailed over some options and after a very long email thread (thank you for your patience lol) they tailored out my needs. It was very nerve wrecking being all the communication I had prior to arrival. I was afraid someone might have slipped up and messed up the surprise but they didn’t. Everyone was very welcoming from the front desk, pool, and restaurant staff. We coordinated a special romantic dinner in the beautiful gazebo by the water. That’s where i got on one knee and popped the question- she said YES. The gazebo was lit up so beautifully with a long trail of rose petals leading to the dinner table. The servers where great as was the food. They made us feel like royalty! While having our dinner I had Nayeli coordinate to set up the room with a plethora of rose petals. When we returned to the room that was definitely the cherry on top! I’ve never seen so many rose petals in my life. She was super surprised! 

The rooms were clean and spacious. No matter what side of the building you choose, you will have a wonderful water view. All the restaurants we tried were delicious. Timoteo at the bar made us the BEST Mezcal Margaritas. The pool was huge! I believe Ivonne was the name of the team member who look after our seating arrangements everyday. She was a very pleasant person. The red lounge was a fun spot at night. We had couples massage at the spa which was excellent. I wish I remembered our therapists names to give them their credit. 

The entire stay was phenomenal! I highly recommend this hotel. We will definitely return. We are actually thinking about having our wedding there after such a great experience. Thank you to all that contributed and made this such a wonderful and memorable experience for us!

reviews.author: Annie M
reviews.title: Amazing Time
reviews.text: We had a girls trip here, and splurged on the butler service. Totally worth it!!! If you can request a butler, request Alain!  He is the best!  So accommodating, attentive and overall awesome.  We wanted to take him home :) The resort was beautiful and had amazing food.  Service was on point!

reviews.author: Eya
reviews.title: Very good resort
reviews.text:
We stayed for one week in March, 2018.  Originally placed in a junior suite in pyramid 1 that looked at pyramid 2, we looked at several rooms before changing to an ocean view room in pyramid 4.  Excellent room - modern.  Great view of the ocean.  Staff was friendly with room change.  
I thought the food was very good.  We ate at the restaurants 5 nights and the buffet 2 nights.  We ate at the Japanese restaurant Bana twice - excellent sushi and seared tuna.  Claudio is a warm and friendly waiter there.  
We did not use Bali beds because they were not included in our stay.  However, we got up early and reserved beach chairs under straw canopies by 7 am - there were usually a few free until 8:30 or 9AM.  
The water was very blue and comfortable for swimming.  Gym was great too.  Highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Yü Y
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: I went to Cancun with friends and we stayed at adult only area in Paradisus for 8 days. All I can say is that it is a great experience. I personally enjoyed the restaurant La Palapa very much. Not only has it the breathtaking views, but also it has tasty food. We are also lucky to have a dinner there once. Really great! Except that the personnel in the hotel is very kind and helpful. They also have some travel agencies in the hotel - either at the lobby or near the pool for water activities. It offers you many options. We also happened to get a personal touch with one of their members in the senior management team - Ebraham Franco. Very experienced management and always put their client first. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kelkhaz
reviews.title: An amazing place for families!  Incredible service!
reviews.text:
We just returned from the Paradisus and I wanted to provide lots of information that I was looking for when I was looking for places.  A little about my travel profile first: we are a family of four from Toronto with two 38 year old parents, a 7 year old and a 2 year old.  We are very well traveled and have stayed all over the world.  In general, we try and stay at 4 to 5 star places.  

FAMILY CONCIERGE
After hearing about this service from several coworkers, we decided to try it out and it was totally worth it.  Our butlers were Sandra and Alex and they were incredibly attentive.  They booked all of our restaurants, showed us around, booked complimentary cabanas by the pool, booked any activities we wanted and pretty much helped with whatever we needed.

They also left surprises for us and the kids every day: lovely toys, snacks, wine, tequila etc.  The cabanas and surprises were totally worth the surcharge we paid for the service and we would definitely do the family concierge again.  I hope we get Sandra and Alex again!

RESTAURANTS (including Food Allergies)

In general, we try and be healthy eaters and we were really happy with the variety and healthy options available in addition to the good (unhealthy) stuff (authentic Mexican, chicken wings, hot dogs, burgers etc.).  We've been to all inclusive in Cuba, Mexico, DR, Jamaica and this food was the best by a long shot.  My reviews below are obviously based on personal preference but I'm confident you will find food you love here.  I also wanted to call out how they handle food allergies.  Upon check in at the Royal Concierge desk, they wrote little allergy cards in Spanish for our kids and encouraged us to show them at the various restaurants.  Every single restaurant/chef/manager we encountered were incredibly accommodating and each ensured we were comfortable with what was being served.  

Naos: Buffet was really good with tons of choice and lots of fresh food.  In general, we try to be healthy eaters so were really happy with the fruit and veg options.  To be honest, we were getting sick of the buffet after 7 breakfasts though and were happy to have dinner reservations every night.  Service was really good.

Vento: This is a tapas restaurant and it was pretty good. Very nice ambiance.

Tempo:  This is the adults only restaurant by Martin Berasategui.  It was really really quite beautiful but we weren't quite prepared for what it was, didn't realize it was a tasting menu and would take a few hours.  My husband and I had just come back from a weekend trip to NYC and had a lot of amazing culinary experiences so we weren't really yearning for a place like Tempo.  It was no fault of the restaurant but wasn't for us on a family trip like this. We ended up rushing it and skipping the tasting menu and wine pairing.

Blue Agave: This place has authentic Mexican.  The tacos are incredible.  I will miss this restaurant the most.  It's the only place open 24 hours.  It's also open for breakfast and you can avoid the crowds at Naos by eating here for brekkie.   

Mole: This was my favorite restaurant.  Our kids have food allergies and these guys were the most accommodating and provided the best service.  The head chef (I'm sorry I don't have his  name) came to the table with the manager (Stephanie) and talked about what they'd make for the kids to make sure we were ok with it.  It was certainly a 5 star experience and we were really impressed with the service.  Our waiter was Rigoberto and our host was Claudia and their attention to our family and dinner were unparalleled.  The food was also really really good.  I wanted to eat everything on the menu.  The mole was a standout.

Market Grill: Alan and Rafael were our servers and they were really nice.  Again, they accommodated our kids' allergies by making some separate dishes and the meat was amazing.  Try the chicken!

Fuego: Try the seafood appetizer and the ceviche!

BEACH / POOL
Beach: Beautiful but lots of seaweed this time of year (March).  Waves were also a bit too big for our 2 year old but no rocks on the beach is a plus.  Was sometimes hard to find beach chairs so get out there early.  Sergio (our server) was really nice.

Pool: At the very end of the resort is a family pool.  Our 2 year old could walk around confidently with her floaties and it was a really big pool.  It was full of nice families and lots of other kids who kept our kids occupied :). The cabanas here arranged by our concierge team were very comfortable.  Nurbi ensured our ice bucket was always full and that the kids always had water.

KIDS' ACTIVITIES
The Kids Zone and Baby Zone services were the areas I was trying to research the most and couldn't figure it out ahead of time.  For families with kids, this service was unbelievable.  The Kids Zone was perfect for our 7 year old.  It had a great play structure, video games, movies etc.  It is also connected to the Baby Zone where our 2 year old played so her brother could go check on her.  We didn't really get to take advantage of this service as we spent a lot of time together on the water but many other parents we met were dropping off the kids and were very complimentary to the staff.  Halina and the rest of the staff were very kind to the kids and even called by name when they saw our kids around the resort.  The activities for the kids are awesome. Cookie making, cupcake decorating, keychain making etc.  There are activities for both kids and babies (0 to 4).  So to clarify, you can leave your kids there.  There were lots of other kids and parents in there playing with their own kids. When you sign them in, you just have to say where you'll be or if you have a concierge, they'll keep in contact with your concierge in case of emergency.  I will come to Paradisus again for this service alone.  Totally trustworthy.

Overall - an excellent stay.  We ended up paying a lot for this trip because it was March Break in Canada and were kind of annoyed when we heard what price last minute travelers we met at the resort paid for their trips so we'll probably try and look for a last minute option next time but will look forward to visiting again soon!  Thank to all of the Paradisus Cancun staff for an amazing family trip!

reviews.author: Alex M
reviews.title: Not worth it. Sneaky charges and rude reception staff ruined a very nice stay.
reviews.text: This would be a nice hotel, with decent infrastructure, beautiful beach and great restaurants, if it weren't for their sneaky charges. I had a three-day business conference scheduled at this hotel, so I decided to bring my family to stay the full week. The room was paid for during the three nights of the convention, so I contacted the hotel and asked for a family rate and was told $450 a night for the four extra nights. When I arrived they said it would be $600 a night, since the $450 was a single occupancy rate. I was slightly upset since I clearly mentioned three other family members, but I attributed it to miscommunication. Then at check-out I was overcharged again. They said that during the convention only my food was paid for, and I had to pay for the food for my three family members. I was again upset by the surprise charge but accepted and assumed the difference would be $150, same as the difference from single occupancy to quadruple occupancy. But they said no, the food charge during the convention is actually $300 per day! I asked why, since the food available to us was exactly the same during the convention and after. They said that was the agreement between the hotel and the convention organizers. I said that was unacceptable, I cannot be liable for an agreement between the hotel and the convention, and that someone should have told me that at check-in. They said "Sorry, but that's it. If you don't pay you cannot leave." I was furious, I have stayed at plenty of all-inclusive resorts and have never seen this type of sneaky, underhanded behavior. To make matters worse, I wrote Melia customer service, they said they would get back to me and never did. Not worth it, plenty of better options in the world.

reviews.author: Welove2travel2018
reviews.title: Great escape to Cancun
reviews.text: We had a wonderful seven day stay at this beautiful resort.  From the moment we arrived we received warm hospitality and attentive service.  Our room had a beautiful ocean view.  We found the food to be exceptionally good with a great variety to choose from.  The resort was kept spotless.  All the staff were great but a few stood out for us.  Chef Eduardo Mokul, Chef Guillermo Lopez and Noe Mendez in the buffet area treated us royally for the seven days ending with a special farewell dinner for us.  Receptionist Melissa Guzman and Alberto Sanchez, pool concierge, made for an exceptional stay.

reviews.author: Evann B
reviews.title: Trainer Martin in the Gym is THE BEST!
reviews.text:
Since we eat and drink a lot at Paradisus, we also try to hit the gym almost every day that we are here. This is our second time back, and we LOVE Martin, the personal trainer! He was a great instructor and really worked us hard, but still made it fun. He gets us moving at the right level for our fitness and a class with him would be super expensive in North America!
Can't wait to see him again!
Kari

reviews.author: roxannw688
reviews.title: Royal serv
reviews.text: A little mix up with the room. We made our reservations thru Jetblue for family service then realized we should use the Royal Service. We E-mailed and called to make the change and we were told we had to make the change in person. So when we got there they only had first level floors which all reviews advise against. FYI the first floor is  like basement level...You sit on your patio and see a cement wall....even when you're walk out of your room you are below ground and it is a much better feeling to be above.  Our butler Eduardo was able to get our room changed by the 2nd day and that made all the difference. Other than that the place is beautiful. The staff is very friendly and helpful.  Eduardo made out dinner reservations to the places we wanted to go, he got us the bali beds and really did everything he could to make our stay enjoyable and relaxing.

reviews.author: Jeannine83
reviews.title: Royal Service is the Best!
reviews.text:
This was our first stay at Paradisus Cancun, but we plan to return. Waking every morning to the oceanfront view was spectacular. 
The Royal Service section of the resort had a buffet in the lobby that featured a continental+ breakfast each day, then changed to snacks later (cheeses, fruit,etc all afternoon)- but always had an open bar! The staff were welcoming and friendly and did an amazing job providing excellent service. We spent most of our days at the beach or pool and the waiters there were great! Eddie was so nice- he truly pampered us. Orlando brought so much fun to our day (tequila shots!) and recommended the best meal I ate at La Palapa- grilled shrimp with Thai rice...Delicious! Jorge was our amigo on the final day of the trip, and he was great- insisted that anything we wanted, he would get-even going down to the Sunset Grill on the other end of the property to bring back a hot dog for my son. We enjoyed LaPalapa for breakfast and lunch. Julio remembered our drink preferences after our first visit. Jaime at Naos was so kind and welcoming. The circus show was great- long enough to be entertaining, short enough for the young kids in the crowd to stay interested. The food was good, the beach was beautiful- but what made this property truly special is the people!

reviews.author: Marie C
reviews.title: Great place! Excellent service
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic time.  I would recommend this place for couples as long as you use the Royal Service.  

Our personal concierge, Sergio was amazing.  He had booked our Bali beds before we even arrived, took care all of our dinner reservations and always checked in if there’s anything else we needed.  You never had to do anything for yourself. 

The servers in the restaurants and poolside were fantastic- Octavio, Ramon, Jorge, Carlos and Julio were always friendly and always took care of everything.  La Palapa was by far our favourite place to eat.  The food was great at all the restaurants we ate at.  We definitely did not have a terrible experience anywhere.

Only reason why I am not giving this place 5 stars was due to the fact that they try for you to attend a seminar for an hour and half about the company.  They do offer compensation for your time, but we were here to relax and not listen to a seminar.  Trying to refuse was quite difficult as they keep pushing to a point of rudeness at one point.

Overall, we had a great time and will probably return.  Hopefully, by then they wouldn’t be so pushy with the seminar.

reviews.author: Kristen M
reviews.title: A Perfect Vacation!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus March 3-10.  Our trip was fantastic!  We stayed with Club Melia (Time Share) and had a wonderful ocean view room in pyramid one.  The Club Melia staff treated us great.  Our concierge, Carlos, made sure we had dinner reservations made every night and was very helpful with everything we needed.  We booked a couples massage with Vero and Lulu and they were amazing!  My only complaint is that the Club Melia section of the pool and the area where their bali beds are, are near the kids pool.  It wasn't too bad, but would have been more relaxing if we weren't always near all the loud children.

reviews.author: Rich M
reviews.title: Never disappoints!!!
reviews.text: Went back to this resort for the third time in less than 2 years. Once again, incredible vacation with my wife and toddler daughter. Special recognition to Didier, the server by the kids pool.  He was awesome. Great and friendly service.  The team at the buffet restaurant (Naos), so kind and patient with our daughter's dietary needs.  Kudos to Alejandro, Jorge, Roberto and Vicente, to name a few.  Last but not least, all the girls/ladies at the baby and kids clubs.  They were phenomenal with the kids activities all around the resort. Food was great too.  Loved it! Only reason I don't give it a 5-star rating is because the rooms we had (2015 & 2016) are in need of renovation, especially the bathrooms.  Other than that, great vacation.

reviews.author: SonnyATX
reviews.title: Great spot for a family vacation
reviews.text:
Overall a wonderful family vacation.  We did the Family Concierge, where you get butlers to assist you with your stay.  Our butlers, Sandra and Alex, were great.  They helped with the kids, restaurant reservations, transfers, booking excursions, cabanas/bali beds, and everything else you need.  They do a great job, so much sure you tip them!

  - Food at the buffet, Bana, and Fuego was delicious.
  - Enzo was not very good.  Vento was okay.
  - Take advantage of the Bali Beds on the beach and by the kids pool if you have kids.
  - Room service was included, so that was very convenient.
  - Butlers surprised the kids everyday with some sort of goodies.
  - Kids loved the Kids Zone.  They have activities every hour.
  - The stretch of beach at Paradisus is probably one of the longest and nicest there.

We are already making plans to visit again.

reviews.author: RelaxedTraveler504
reviews.title: Great service, great facility, great vacation
reviews.text:
I just returned on Mar 13, and I traveled with my wife and another couple. 

--Arrival and Rooms--
From the start, the service was amazing. We were greeted like we were VIPs, offered a drink, and given a tour of the facility. Andrea was great with the introduction and was so pleasant to talk to! Our rooms were next to each other and met all of our requests (King beds, main pyramid, floor 1 - which is actually the 2nd level). I'd like to thank Patricia for all her help in meeting our requests prior to arrival - very reassuring to have prompt communication with the resort.  I loved the placement of our rooms as they were on the 2nd level (when looking to the pool), in the main pyramid so very convenient, had a balcony, AMAZING ocean view, and were reasonably quiet. Can't ask for more in my book. 
*The only con was that my room didn't have a sliding bathroom door, which I never complained about. We really didn't need it, but I noticed all other rooms had it.

--Pools and Bars--
I loved the large pool that winds around the main pyramid. It's very beautiful and there are usually plenty chairs. Alberto was our favorite at the pool, he was walking around to ensure everyone was okay and having a good time. We ended up talking with him quite a bit; he always had a huge smile and was ready to help. The swim-up bar was a huge hit, mainly due to the awesome bartenders and service we received there. We have to give a shout out to Randy, who was so helpful and kept us coming back. He actually found our friends straw she lost the first day and became her hero. He even knew when to (respectfully) cutoff the few spring breakers that got out of hand. Also, Carlos was a blast and made some great drinks!
**My only complaints are that the water level is a little high at almost 6 feet, and it wasn't heated. It's warm enough by mid-day, but chilly in the AM. And if you bring a float, you're good. 

--Eats--
The food at the resort was very good for my standards. Great spreads at breakfast with several options and omelette stations. Good service bringing quick mimosas. Lots of smiling faces. The taco bar was a great lunch option, but make sure to order multiple tacos (3+), they're small. But that allows you to try more! The pool snack bar was a hit as you don't always want to leave to eat, and they had solid/simple choices.  We ate at all the dinner restaurants except La Palapa and Tempo, because they weren't included for us. However, we liked all the others; we only ordered 1 dish we didn't like and we took a chance lol. Our favorites were Market Grill, Enso, and Fuego. David was a really good server at Market Grill, we went 2x it was so good. We never ordered room service, so no comment there. 
*Only complaint is the reservation system which can be annoying (call ahead each AM), but we never had a problem getting a table. 

--Ocean--
Beautiful ocean, nice sand, but the waves were quite big when we went. We were able to swim, but not very much. The seaweed wasn't bad, but wasn't clear either. Walking the beach and laying out on the beach were perfect, hot sun, white sand, super blue water, and a constant ocean breeze.

--Shows/Entertainment--
The shows were pretty good, some talented performers, but nothing that we "wouldn't miss for the world". The area to watch the shows was so small that only about 50-60 people could watch comfortably. The night club was ok, we went to a "silent party" with headphones that was interesting. The other night we wanted to dance ended up being a casino night, so no luck. The games and activities at the pool were entertaining enough, but the music was always going on and off and I couldn't figure out the schedule. This was only a minor concern.

Overall, this was a great resort and very nice vacation.  I'd recommend for anyone looking for a "grand" resort experience in Cancun.

reviews.author: Abe W
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Fantastic staff. The people that worked there really made the stay wonderful. Nicest staff I ever had anywhere in the world. The food was much better than any all inclusive I've ever been to. The rooms were a little old, needs a facelift

reviews.author: dylan817
reviews.title: 1 Week In Paradise
reviews.text:
This is an amazing hotel, full of luxury relaxation.

I want to tell you that the staff at this hotel is what makes the place so fantastic! Don't misunderstand me, this hotel is fantastic, but the staff is so amazing that you will remember them the most.

When we arrived honestly not everything went to plan, there were a couple of issues, this being at check-in where the systems were not talking to each other to show I had already paid and the room location and condition.

I did lodge the fact I was unsatisfied, and its the way the hotel manager Jair swiftly dealt with the matter in such a professional and personable manner that stuck out to me the most. Jair was so accommodating and understanding regarding the issues we had. In my eyes Jair you are an absolute legend & we owe you our gratitude. 

Veronica is a Royal Service manager, and I cannot tell you how much we appreciated all your help when we stayed with you, you made sure our trip was just what we wanted and helped find us the correct support when I was unwell. You have a very special place in our memories and we truly cannot wait to see you again.

Laura was our Royal Service Concierge and boy do we miss you!! Everyday we met with you it was lovely, always fantastic service, so happy and energetic! You really are a wonderful person! Nothing was too much, everything we needed / wanted taken care of, I really do not think we could of asked for more!! Truly exceptional customer service.

A few more shout outs, to Rafael at the Market Grill, this guy is amazing, knows how to keep his customers amazed and happy! Daniel on concierge also a great help, thank you!

I am sure we missed many people on here, but that is truly because the service is SO HIGH from all staff.

I would not hesitate to come back again, and fully intend to come back within 12 months.

Jair, Veronica & Laura we are sending you a package from Scotland shortly to express our gratitude.

Kindest Regards
Mr & Mrs Taylor

reviews.author: Audrey S
reviews.title: Amazing trip!
reviews.text: It was my first time trying out an all inclusive in Cancun, Mexico with my family. The reviews and comments really made our decision that much easier especially at Paradisus Cancun. I had the time of my life at this resort with my family. It was super family friendly and they even had an adult section where adults wouldn't feel left out. The amount of restaurants that were offered was amazing and to top it off it was all inclusive so we were able to get anything and everything that we wanted. There were nightly performances and constant daily activities. The staff were incredible and super friendly. They truly wanted to make you feel like you were at home and catered to your needs. It wasn't as if they had to but rather because they wanted to and enjoyed it in the process. I would book another trip to Paradisus Cancun in a heart beat. Thanks for a wonderful vacation!

reviews.author: lsternberger
reviews.title: Paradisius in Cancun is wonderful!!
reviews.text: My husband, and two close friends stayed in Paradisius last week.  Wow, what a treat.  First, let me say the staff are absolutely the best, truly first class.  Everyone was friendly and polite, from those who cleaned rooms, to the groundskeepers, to the wait staff, just wonderful.  I'd like to particularly mention Emanuel, our waiter at breakfast who was kind and caring beyond expectations.  He brought us drinks regularly, helped cart food from the buffet, and just was a charming young man.  In addition, Sergio Gonzalez and Laura, beach waiters, were also amazing.  Timely, caring, went way above the call of duty. Sergio even brought us a LARGE round of drinks when he knew the beach bar was closing.  Wow.  The rooms are very clean--we have ocean view, which I would highly recommend.  The pools were lovely, the swim-up bar fantastic, the gym completely adequate, and the food.  Oh my, all the restaurants we tried were excellent.  I particularly enjoyed the sushi bar, Blue Agave, Naos (buffet), and Mole.  However, I must say they were all quite good--and you have a wonderful selection of where/when you want to eat.  And I might mention the nacho bar on the beach was a nice touch!!  Enjoy this very special place!

reviews.author: BBMMOldBridge
reviews.title: We had the relaxing time we went for
reviews.text:
Sorry this is a very long review but I am very honest and  thorough in my Trip Advisor reviews! 

I booked the Paradisus because we went to the one in Punta Cana ( Palma Real) a few years ago and loved it!  Although this was a great resort, I liked the Punta Cana better. The restaurants were good but we don't eat seafood and that made it hard for us.  We ate at the Market Grille and Bana 2x and both were excellent.  We really loved all our meals at La Palapa (Royal Service only) and wished they offered dinner there because it was really the best food.  The resort itself is very beautiful but the lay out makes it very difficult to get around.  We were in the Royal Service which is the last building (5) and it took us most of our days there to figure out the best way to get to the main part of the hotel (Level 2 btw takes you there).  This was the first time we used the Royal Service which is adult only and we really loved it.  I would use it for now on to be honest.  Our butler Galdino., was very good, we are not high maintenance, so all we really had him do is make all our reservations and check on a few things for us.  Some people got more from their butler but we were fine with ours. 
 The room we had, Royal Service Luxury Lagoon Suite was beautiful (6th floor). The shower with tub enclosure was beautiful.  They really need some more shelving in there for your things but we made it work. The lighting in the bathroom was absolutely HORRIBLE!  I don't understand why they put low or less lighting in there?  People need to see to put makeup on, shave and get ready.  I had to use the hallway mirror every time. Very annoying.  The room needed more mirrors too, they only had the one in the bathroom and one in the hallway.  There was a vanity in the hallway that would have been great if they added a mirror and seat for getting ready, it was a waste of space. Lots of room for your clothes and to store your bags.  they also give you a beach bag to use which is very nice.  Our bed was ok, kind of  hard, my husband slept fine, I was eh.  The air worked great but there was no ceiling fan which I thought was odd.  Our couch had a broken leg and a few drawers were broken but Galdino had them fixed asap.  Balcony was beautiful and we watched the sun set almost every night.   
The Royal beach was great but if you don't get up early everyday (7am) to get a palapa and chairs your out of luck.  I'm an early riser so I didn't care.  I went down every morning and watched the sun come up. They really need to offer more beach seating.  The water was absolutely beautiful but rough, I didn't go in, my husband did.  We are not really "pool people" but with Royal Service (adult only pool) you get a Bali Bed for two days.  Definitely get it.  It was beautiful and they come a serve you there all day.  We did the beach then hung out in our bed a few hours in the afternoon.  One note about the pool area with Royal Service.  When you get your Bali bed, you get two lounge chairs as well. Again, I don't know what you would sit on if you didn't get a Bali bed? There were two per bed and that's all, no extra chairs available from what we saw. 

There are several restaurants there but like I said earlier. we don't eat fish so we had some trouble.  The buffet was good but I'd rather eat at a restaurant.  La Palapa (Royal Service only) was the BEST! Their breakfast ( get the French Toast, had it everyday!) and lunch were great.  Same menu everyday but enough to enjoy, You can order as much as you want.  We ordered eggs and french toast almost everyday.  Bana and Market Grill was our favs.  The outside buffet by the pool was very nice, we ate there one night.  They have a Gelato kiosk but its only open from 12-6, they need to extend that so after dinner you can go get some yummy dessert.  My husband liked Blue Agave (tacos and quesadillas), but I didn't care for it. Like I said, there are many other places but we couldn't find anything on the menus we liked but you probably will. We were extremely disappointed that there was not a Hibachi restaurant to eat, every all inclusive we've ever stayed at had one. 

We were talked into doing the "time share/point system" spiel.  We listened for an hour ( I set my alarm on my phone) and we received a couples massage for $50.  It was worth listening too ( and the massage was awesome) but we were not interested at this time. What bothered us most is that everyone we met was offered different incentives to listen. Several couples were offered a free couples massage, one got a $150 massage, a $50 credit on excursions and one more thing that I can't recall.  After, I listened. I spoke to a female supervisor (wish I got her name) about why this was the case, and she was very rude to me and said it depends on who offered you the appointment, what day you came in, and other BS excuses.  She should have made it right and gave it to me for free, but she didn't and I was quite annoyed. I told her I was putting this in my review and she didn't care.  I was even more annoyed and angry that she just pushed me off but she really didn't care.  So, if you are going to listen, negotiate what you want and stand your ground! 

The resort was quite beautiful.  It was clean but I felt that Punta Cana made sure all their areas were kept spotless.  As we walked to our room daily, there were always things on the carpet that were there for a few days. House keeping was great and helpful.  Tip them everyday, they work hard!  I used an English to Spanish app to write her what we needed daily ( towels, water, etc).  Make sure you use the water for your toothbrush daily, we didn't even run it under the sink water and we NEVER got sick!!
The nightlife here was not to my liking.  They had a show daily at 830 but since we ate dinner late every night we would miss it.  We saw an Elvis show that was pretty cheesy.. We heard the Michael Jackson show was good but we missed it  Other than that we really didn't have entrainment.  There was a girl who sang at Bana while we ate dinner and she was very good but it wasn't nightly.  After the show ends, there is no bar you can go to and hang and listen to live music, just recordings.  You have the club at 10pm that plays dance music and that's all. So, unless you like to just hang and drink, nightlife really stunk!  Not sure what they had for families with young kids, we weren't on that end.  Family section was in Building 1 on the other side.

Here is the list of employees that made our trip even better than it already was.
Felipee-Bellhop
Galdino- Butler
Melina- check in at Royal Service
La Palapa- Victor, Valeria, Octavio, 
Beach- Ramon and Octavio
Bali Bed- Cesar
Bana- Tania and DAVID (requested him the second time too) he was our best waiter EVER!!!
Market Grill- Ruben, Kathia and Tapia
Club Melia- Orlando 
These people went above and beyond to impress us!
Lastly, bring lots of 1's and 5's to tip these people who work hard every day to make your stay a good one!
All in all, we went to relax, which we did! I'm not sure we'll be back to the Cancun location but I love Paradisus resorts and will defiantly go back to Punta Cana Palma Real and also try the Playa del Carmen and Rivera Maya resorts in the future.
Thank you and I hope you get some good insight to this hotel.

reviews.author: LittleButterfly1987
reviews.title: Perfect Vacations
reviews.text: I just came back from a visit to Cancun and stayed in Paradisus. The location of the property was the best. I stayed on an ocean front and my friends had a lagoon view. They have the authentic Mexican food onsite and even the buffet restaurant was great. My favorite was the Asian. Service was top notch and the staff always had a smile.

reviews.author: Pete L
reviews.title: Relaxing vacation
reviews.text: Upgraded room offered a great view of beautiful azure waters and sunrises.  Don't miss the Togi bar and the excellent and friendly service you get from Evaristo and Alan Tec. Itl;s right next to the Bana Restaurant which has a breathtaking tenor performance on Monday nights.  Don't miss it.  There's nightly enterainment near the pools with a lot of variety. The Enzo restaurant was the only one that was disappointing .. but that was just our take on it.

reviews.author: Rachel J
reviews.title: Stay Away
reviews.text: The place is nice, not at all like the pictures makes it appear, but I wasn't expecting a palace. I could write a lot about the leaking water from the ceiling in our room, or the  lackluster quality of the room service food, or the fact that it was the least inclusive "all inclusive" resort I have stayed at,  but none of that is relevant because the maids will steal your money. The cash I brought was intended to be used for tips for the staff members who were doing their jobs, but was instead stolen by their greedy coworkers. Thankfully, I only brought about 80 dollars to be stolen, but I'm confident if I weren't a poor graduate student and had brought more money, they would have stolen much more. Stay away, folks.

reviews.author: joannslater
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: Hotel was beautiful -- we stayed in the tower which was convenient for every thing we wanted to do.  Everyone was so appreciative with the tip that we left.  Never felt pressured to do that -- they deserved it because of the excellent service.

reviews.author: wendyp9902
reviews.title: Paradisus is the best
reviews.text: This is the second Paradisus hotel we've stayed at and I can't say enough positive things!  Service is amazing, food is excellent.  Everyone is so helpful.  We did Royal Service last time because it was a large group and it was SO worth it.  This trip was just the 2 of us and we were fine without it.  If we went back we'd definitely look into getting the Royal Service again.

reviews.author: mackie w
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I spent my spring break at the Paradisus with 3 friends. We had an absolutely amazing time! The all inclusive is without a doubt worth it. We had three incredible meals a day and if you have even a few drinks a day, you will get your money worth on the all inclusive. The breakfast buffet was wonderful every morning and Blue Agave was our favorite for lunch. We ate at 6 different restaurants for our dinners and not a single one disappointed. The swim up bar made the trip for us. Randy, Nestor and the others made everyday fun! They make fun and new drinks and shots for everyone. Randy was exceptionally sweet and polite throughout our whole stay. He offers insight on different things to do and makes sure that everyone is taken care of and feels safe.

reviews.author: LindaandRandy
reviews.title: Outstanding in all ways!
reviews.text:
This is my first ever TripAdvisor review not because I don't travel; rather I want to ensure others are aware of the most friendly staff and incredible property.  We stayed for a week and enjoyed the following: 
Blue Agave - exceptional food and outstanding service. Hats of to Leonardo. You made the experience for us more than just the food. 
Pool - Laura, thank you for your friendly smile and outstanding service. 
Swim up pool - Carlos, Samuel, Giovanni - you made the afternoon so much fun.  We appreciate you. 
Ocean was perfect - no one can make this better -  natural waves and superior sand. 
The property was well maintained...in fact, EVERY DAY, someone was doing something to maintain this property! 
THANK YOU - see you next year.

reviews.author: Brock T
reviews.title: Best Choice of Resorts
reviews.text:
After watching months of YouTube videos on the choices of resorts in Cancun, Mexico, we  chose Paradisus Cancun Resort! This place is absolutely perfect, clean, and elegant. We stayed five days in Royal Service, the staff are very friendly, attentive, and willing to do anything to make your vacation perfect. While waiting in a short line upon check in, we were greeted and served a cocktail. The rooms are very breathtaking, bright, modern, clean and omg the shower was AMAZING. The restaurants , pools,  bars, and grounds are FIVE STARS. I must say after driving along the strip of resorts, the Paradisus Cancun resort has the best curbside Appel.  I strongly recommend this resort. 

   Our first night at the resort we ate at Blue Agave, which was so yummy, and we also ate breakfast there a few times. Martin was our waiter every time, he was very attentive, friendly, funny, and welcoming. 

    Sandra was our butler, she was welcoming, accommodating, friendly, funny, and easy to communicate with. 

                  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Mr_SammyBoy
reviews.title: Truly Paradise
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 8 days/7 nights, and we had an awesome time. It's truly a beautiful resort with awesome views and facilities. We had the family concierge package and Ocean facing room, and both combined made it a great experience. Our kids enjoyed the pools and Kid Zone as well as Baby Zone. I give it a 4/5 rating due to few concerns:
1 - The resort is pretty old, and hence, there is wear and tear in many places. Primarily, the AC in our room was very very noisy, and was disturbing our sleep. 
2 - Most of the servers were friendly, however, some of them seems more friendly/servicing others better, probably because they gave higher tips, although we believe we gave more than decent tips to everyone.
3 - Baby Zone staff seemed junior or unsure about the rules - our baby was 1 year old, and can't walk very well yet, one of the staff said baby needs to walk very well in order to be let into Baby Zone, while checking with another staff said it's ok and allowed our baby in. Same incident repeated next day as well. Anyway, what's the point of baby zone if they allow only babies who can walk.

reviews.author: Marsha G
reviews.title: Disappointment in Paradise
reviews.text: Been to Mexico every year for the past 5+ years for daughter's school break. First time at Paradisus.  The beach was beautiful, less windy than the Hyatt Ziva, however that is about it.  Room smelled like smoke and had no hot water.  Moved rooms, it was better, however, it was so loud, as was everyone else's (we had a group of 9 adults and children).  It was Spring Break Central including observing and assisting a twenty something girl pass out and vomit and choke....thank goodness we were traveling with a nurse..  Day 3 couldn't get in pool due to vomit.  We were spoiled at Hyatt with cleanliness, food and coffee bars.  The procedure to make dinner reservations was also a huge pain and of course our reservations were misplaced on night 3.  There were guests partying until dawn every day we were there, never been so loud and we got about 2 hours sleep each night.  NOT conducive to a family vacation.

reviews.author: 1LiviaC1
reviews.title: The staff is nothing short of incredible
reviews.text:
Where to start, the food was phenomenal! I'm surrounded by some of the best sushi places at home but I would say the sushi I ate at Paradisus was up there with the best sushi and sashimi I've ever eaten. The seafood and tacos were also awesome. The buffet was even pretty good in comparison to other all inclusives I have been to, plethara of options, clean and always stocked.

Above all else I CANNOT stress enough how sublime the staff was, specifically the staff at the pool bar. The majority of the hotel staff was much like other hotels, very helpful, and nice. However, both mine and the others I visited with, trips would not have been as amazing had we not been to the pool bar. Sounds cliche, I know, how could you not love the pool bar right? We had originally seen Randy at the avenue bar where he was equally as amazing, but the next day at the pool bar he remembered all of our names, the drinks we enjoyed and were able to offer suggestions based on the types of drinks we liked. Nestor, Juan and Andres were equally as amazing able to handle large groups of people, speak to everyone in both spanish and english. My friends and I like to have fun but we were looking to avoid the insane college spring break crowd, we were a little worried when an obnoxious group of 18-20 somethings but Randy was able to assess whether or not they could use another drink or if they needed a water. Shutting down any behaviors that were either not appropriate or impacting other guests. The pool bar staff gets a big 20 out of 10 from me and my friends!

reviews.author: angiejennifer
reviews.title: My first time in Mexico :)
reviews.text: A few days ago I visited for the first time Cancun, Mexico. I stayed at Paradisus Cancun, the gorgeous and Magical Paradisus Cancun!! I will never forget that experience. The Hotel is amazing, the staff is awesome, so nice and so attentive!! the center of the hotel simply magical. I felt in love with Paradisus Cancun, the layout, the Beach, the staff, everything. I ate too much, best tacos ever!!!! can´t wait to come back with my mom and daugther... :)

reviews.author: Gloria M
reviews.title: Yoli Annual Incentive Trip
reviews.text: This was our Second trip to the Paradisus Resort and the experience was very memorable, From the time that the shuttle picked us up at the airport to take us to the Resort until the time we left we were treated with the utmost respect and attention to detail by a super friendly and very knowledgeable staff. We were definitely impressed with the quality of the food and the quality of the entertainment. In addition we were treated to a very special Dinner cooked by Chef Eduardo Mukol,he was amazing with the presentation of our dinner and it was better than most 5 star restaurants that we have visited. The beach at the resort was beautiful and very clean and the waitstaff were extremely courteous and professional. We were so impressed that we also joined Club Melia so we can return more often.

reviews.author: AWineADay
reviews.title: We stayed at the Royal Service
reviews.text:
We preferred an Adults-Only environment and the Royal Service at paradisus Cancun met our expectations.

An entire pyramid in the resort is reserved for Royal Service guests, complete with private pools, restaurants and bars. Our butler is already waiting at the entrance to greet us when we arrived from the airport transfer. He escorted us past a Japanese-style Zen garden, part of the excellent spa, and through a private corridor to the Royal Service pyramid, which opens up into a soaring jungle environment. Instead of lining up at a counter to check-in, we could do it seated on a sofa in the Royal Service lounge, with a chilled orange blossom-scented towel and a fruity welcome cocktail.

Our room wasn't ready yet (we arrived at 10 am), but we were invited to enjoy ourselves by the pool, with our private Bali bed. This is the exclusive pool for Royal Service, and it feels quite peaceful. No running kids or drunken crowds. Food and drinks can be ordered and delivered to your bed. We ordered a beer each, and they bought us six, putting the extra ones in an ice bucket. 

The pool side food was made-to-order and quite delicious. The guacamole was fresh, the tuna skewers was cooked nicely, and the wings were very good -- I think I was eating them every day when I was there!

Our room was newly renovated, with a huge balcony overlooking the wedding gazebo and the sea. What a view, especially in the morning! No bath tub in my room but there is a very spacious glass-in shower, and we had MUGLER amenities. They smell very nice and the quality is nice.

Overall, the food is great at Paradisus Cancun. The lamb gyros and the hamnurger at La Palapas (Royal Service exclusive) was great, as is the Market Grill in the general side. I think I have tasted the best bass filet in my life there. The Mexican restaurant, the Mole, offers quite an authentic experience, with an exhaustive menu featuring dishes from different parts of Mexico. 

We also went to Tempo by Martin Berasategui, a Spanish chef with eight Michelin stars currently. The restaurant is not part of the all-inclusive plan, but if you are celebrating a special occasion, it is well worth the splurge if not just for the attentive service. I will try to write up a separate review later.

The spa was also special. It was like a vacation within my vacation. 

I made it a point to arrive an hour before my massage appointment to enjoy the full water ritual. The sauna and steam room begin the detoxification process. Next, you enter the spa pool, where jetstreams along the side relieve fatigue from your legs and lower back.
As you reach the end, lie down on the submerged chaise to enjoy a gentle bubble massage along your spine. Then, a cascading waterfall loosens the knots on your shoulders. The ritual ends with a barefoot walk through a pebble course. Yes, it was painful, but it’s meant to bring reflexological benefits.

After the massage, I headed to the Oriental Garden and sipped floral-infused water and snacked on berry skewers. The hibiscus water is especially nice. Then, it was zone-out time. The circular patterns in the Zen garden must have a hypnotic effect — almost a full hour had passed!

The resort offers a series of curated experiences called LEX. There are sushi workshops and tequila tastings. and I chose the ceviche class, which I thought was more relevant to a Mexican vacation. The chef did not speak English, but there is a translator who cheerfully guided us through the preparation process. Now I know that the secret to success is to use purple onions, not yellow, and lime, not lemon. Tried making basa fish ceviche after i returned using the recipe she shared, and it wasn't too bad!

reviews.author: Julie G
reviews.title: Fantastic week!
reviews.text: Just returned from a 1 week stay for a sisters’ getaway, we had an an amazing week! Starting at check in, which was fast and efficient, with the help of Marta (from guest services), who took the time to explain all the different services, the restaurants, how to go about making reservations (just pick up the phone, couldn’t be easier), and showing us the premises. We were treated warmly everywhere we went, and service was excellent. Special thanks to Miguel and Tania for their wonderful and friendly service at the beach, they always made sure our bucket of iced water was full, remembered our favorite drinks and kept them coming lol! You made our week all that more enjoyable :) Rooms were spacious and clean, and the grounds beautiful. Would definitely recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: BuffaloMike
reviews.title: Paradise found at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from 2/25 to 3/4. We had a wonderful relaxing time. We checked in and upgraded to royal service. 

Our room was ocean view suite and the balcony had a partial view of the ocean because we were on the 1st floor. It was the only room left so we took it. We were not disappointed because we didn't spend much time on the balcony and the view was fine. Next time I wouldn't wait to upgrade royal service at check-in. The view from the higher floors are better. The room was clean. The only downside was the balcony chairs are not adjustable and the beds are not the most comfortable. We had two double beds and we're a little squeezed. They should offer queen size if you can't get a king (which was not available).

We met our butler and he was very helpful in booking out reservations to dinner and the pool cabanas. He also was very helpful with any other needs. We communicated by cell phone so it was easy to get a hold of him whenever we needed help or had questions. All other staff at the resort were very friendly and helpful. Don't forget to tip because they work very hard and rely on tips for a living wage.

The food at resort was very good. We especially like the Market Garden. Naos is buffet style with many varied and good selections. I have food allergies (gluten and shellfish) and they accommodated us with no problems. This is the best resort we've every been to when dealing with these issues. I would highly recommend to anybody with gluten issues to stay here.

The pool area is clean and the water is heated in royal service area. There are cabanas all over the area and we stayed for free twice in cabanas. it was a great experience, very pampered. We felt like royalty.

I save the best for last, the beach. It's a beautiful clean beach. The sand is perfect. The water is beautiful. The waves are strong and there are riptides so you have to be careful. I like to body surf in the waves and you can do that here. Just be careful to pick spots that don't have rip tides. You can go on youtube and look at videos on how to spot rip tides. We had a cabana everyday but had to get up early to save it. I went down to beach by 7:30 and put towels on chairs and beach bag. The only downside are the beach chairs. They back of the chair don't adjust.

Overall, in spite of the minor issues, this is a great place to stay. I give it 5 stars.

reviews.author: letoriaoneal
reviews.title: Wedding Weekend
reviews.text: Our wedding weekend was absolutely amazing. Paradisus took great care of us from the time we entered until we left the resort. Our wedding coordinator Mariana went beyond the call of duty. Anything we asked for she took care and of it right away. She made the wedding experience /vacation outstanding for us . We can’t thank you enough Mariana. The in-house event planners are amazing. Thanks Vanessa. The DJ was awesome with getting our request in last minute. Thanks to our butler Rode- he told us to call him if anything is needed even when he was off duty. He even called to ensure we got our marriage certificate and some cash we left after leaving the resort. I told our coordinator she must never sleep or go home. She was there every step of the way. She should get recognition for her hard work. I will like to say thanks again. We will recommend this resort for anyone stay/ wedding etc.  You made our wedding weekend Perfect for us and our family.

reviews.author: OnAir759426
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: Our room was beautiful and immaculate. Extraordinary service from Jose at pool and Mr. G (Gerardo)! They made sure our stay was outstanding! I have stayed at hotel in the past but they have improved service with exceptional staff!! Great servers...Victor, Moses, Josue!

reviews.author: Laurie L
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: See review.  Wonderful hotel, fantastic people, Royal Service was great.  Food was great.  Lack of night time entertainment which may cause me not to return.  Also games or activities around the Royal would be nice around the Royal pool.  Thanks

reviews.author: Kimmie820
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text:
Recently returned from a trip to cancun. This hotel is a very nice place. The service was impeccable! I never had to ask for a drink when i was at the beach, they kept them coming. The rooms are nicely decorated, and clean! 
The only complaint i have is that they don’t keep the beach area very clean. Walking down to the beach, there was always garbage, that wasn’t picked up the entire time.  
The food is good, not the best. But hey, i didn’t go for the food anyway. Overall, this is a nice place to stay. Again, service was better than many places i have stayed! And i have been to cancun 30 times!

reviews.author: Chad R
reviews.title: Good Family Vacation
reviews.text: Let me start by saying don't believe any bad reviews. There are people that can never be pleased. Our trip from the airport was less than 20 minutes. Check in was 15 min and they had 5 people checking people in. After our check in Bianca was there to tell us about the resort and things to do. She was wonderful and informative. We asked for 2 rooms side by side and that is just what we got. Room 3609 and 3610 over looking the beach was amazing. Rooms were cleaned every day and beds turned down around 7 every night. Our phone rang in the room and it was someone asking what we wanted for dinner reservations during our stay. How easy is that, we got into every restaurant right on time. Food was good and service was great. Our trip was wonderful and can't say enough about the staff. Drinks were brought to me by the beach quicker than I could drink them. The staff at the beach brought a pail of waters on ice to my son and players playing volleyball without being asked. These are the things you remember, staff doing the extra things when they don't have to. Beach was great with no rocks in the water anywhere. If you are thinking about staying here do it without hesitation.

reviews.author: Shawn9632
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: My husband and I just returned home from a week in Cancun.  Grounds are beautiful, the staff is extremely attentive, there to help with anything you need.  I visited the spa two times and the massages were wonderful!!!  Gym is busy, but nice.  Royal service was great, our Butler Daniel was excellent!!  Can’t wait to return.

reviews.author: Diana W
reviews.title: Royal Service Wonderful!
reviews.text: I was at Paradisus for business and was fortunate enough to stay in the Royal Service area.  The rooms are very spacious and views to either the ocean or the bay.  I had a butler - Rode as well.  He went above and beyond, always there for every request and was outstanding!  Thank you Rode!! Dinners in each of the restuarnts were very good.  We had a dinner on the last night out on the golf course that was outstanding.

reviews.author: kasonsgreen
reviews.title: Luxury service in a beautiful resort
reviews.text:
The hotel experience was spectacular. The room we were in had a beautiful view of the ocean even though it was on a low floor. The middle of the hotel is full of real plant life making the vibe at the restaurants in the center of the hotel pretty awesome. Aesthetically, it's hard to top the way the inside of this hotel looks.

The outdoor pools were beautiful. Never too busy, extremely clean - and the service was second to none. My cup was never empty. 

The service overall was likewise incredible. Staff checking to see how your stay was and make sure you understood the different options in the hotel. Great room service & concierge service from the front desk.

The only thing average about the hotel was the food. The buffet (which is the only restaurant open for breakfast, lunch & dinner) was average. It had a lot of options and was better than a cruise buffet, but still just OK. There are probably 5 or 6 restaurants open at night with a reservation. Fuego was really good and I would recommend it. Enso on the other hand, was ptiful. It's "Cantanese" food and my girlfriend and I would have much rather had Panda Express that night. However, you don't necessarily go to an all-inclusive resort for the food experience, so it didn't ruin anything for us.

HIghly recommended if you can find a good deal!!

reviews.author: Kimberley Y
reviews.title: Wonderful all inclusive resort
reviews.text: It has been my great pleasure to stay at the Paradisus Cancun twice.  I found the service, accommodations, and facility to be exceptional. For this visit,  booked two ocean view , Royal Service Junior Suites, for myself and 4 friends.  I knew from my previous visit the suites were large enough to comfortably accommodate an extra bed for the 5th person.  However, upon our arrival we were graciously upgraded to the Presidential Suite.  The accommodations went for very wonderful to luxurious, every detail of our trip was orchestrated by our staff liaison, (butler) We found every staff member from housekeeping to waiters, pool people and poolside waiters and most of all our butler to be about the most hard working, efficient and gracious persons we had every dealt with in a resort setting. The food was very good and the drinks were very generously supplied.  I know that when I have the opportunity to return to Cancun , my stay will be a Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: Paola T
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: Since day one we were treated with the best service! Te place is beautiful and with breathtaking sunrise and sunsets on the beach. Thanks to Jhonathan the Club Melia consierge for helping us out in every step to our best adventure. And to Antonio Cruz for helping us with our bags! Hope we can return soon enough and continue to enjoy Mexico!

reviews.author: Stylist1983
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
This is my 3rd trip to the Paradisus.  As always, everyone was friendly, pool was clean and alcohol was flowing.  
Pros: Darwin at Bana, Samuel at the pool bar and Evaristo at Toji bar were fabulous.  Great customer service, speedy, personable and always had a smile.  We had massages at YHI with Brenda and Augustina, and they both did a great job.  Rodrigo is the friendliest concierge.  Luis at the pool is always on his A-game.  
Cons: the first day there we had lunch at the buffet, 3 different servers approached our table multiple times for drinks orders, we would order but not get our drinks.  This happened throughout the entire lunch which was really frustrating. We just traveled for hours, were excited to be there and dying of thirst but couldn’t get a drink for 15 minutes every time we ordered.  
We stayed in room 3125, above Vento.  Big mistake.  After 10pm all you hear is the constant clanking of silverware and dishes, along with many voices chatting.  Not very nice to try to fall asleep to.  
Market Grill was awful.  AWFUL.  We were ignored half of the time the skewers of meat came out and the drinks were beyond disgusting-they tasted like rubbing alcohol.  After sitting for 20 minutes with no food on our plates, we left and finished our dinner in the buffet- which by the way- was exactly the same food as they were serving at Market Grill, except I actually got to eat it!  
Blue Agave does not have good tacos.  This should be obvious by how empty the restaurant is most of the day.  Please, please put some love into your tacos!!!! 
It’s hard to give a bad review of this resort, as it is my favorite, but this was a disappointing stay compared to past stays.  The first time we stayed, every employee that passed you would place their hand over their heart and offer a greeting.  This time that happened once or twice.  The first stay, you were offered the house drink at each restaurant- this time we got it once at Bana (go Darwin!). The first time, all of the food was fabulous, this time not so much. 
The pool entertainment during the day is lacking.  Our first trip, Rodrigo lead the entertainment and you looked forward to the games, workouts and interaction. Now, you can barely tell there is entertainment there.  I actually forgot the guy was out there most days.  Also, the fact that the music is turned off after Zumba is just silly.  The minute it goes off, everyone at the pool complains that there is no music.  It’s far too quiet and boring with no music, people enjoy music.

reviews.author: Danny R
reviews.title: Stay away! Absolutely disgusting trust me!
reviews.text:
Where do I begin. We stayed at the paradisus playa del Carmen last yr and it was a truly amazing unlike this dump. I warn you this is nothing like that experience and I don’t understand why people give this place a 4 star rating. This place is sooo old and crusty. The start of the experience was supposed to be introductory but all they did was sell sell sell leaving us to try to find our room and the logistics of the hotel. 

The room: 

was above the market grille where all you heard was dishes clinging together all day long. Not the mention it was also above a night club in which all you heard was loud bass and people screaming until 3am. When we woke up the 1st day we realized they had given us blood stained sheets. After giving housekeeping a call they then brought us all new sheets with blood stained towels. (This is no joke) When we brought this up to a manager on staff she acted like it wasn’t a big deal and disregarded the fact that it was blood. 
Room service was unbelievable as they never would show up and when you call to ask about the order they would hang the phone up on you. After six phone calls it would finally come almost always wrong and missing something. The room is so dated you can tell it has seen its time. The electrical outlets/bathroom lights went out almost all the time along with our hot water (cold showers everyday)  The ac unit was so old it rattled all night. Although we actually didn’t mind the rattling as it took away a little from the night club action.

Food:
We were not able to get a reservation for dinner for the first two days because the place is so big. We ended up eating at the buffet the first day and from that point on we became deathly sick where it ruined our entire vacation. I have stayed at many all inclusive resorts in the past and I have to tell you I have never seen or tasted food anything like it in my life. 

For management you are some of the rudest people I ever seen and you could care less about your guest’s comfort. So please save your auto generated response as it is a lie. 

Please LISTEN and stay far away from this place!!! So many better places in Mexico. What a waste of a week of complete sickness. Can’t believe we paid for that nightmare. Literally felt like a ant in a ant farm and we tried to go home on day number 2 it was so bad. They shouldn’t even be allowed to carry the name “paradisus” as it is not even close to a Melia resort.

reviews.author: Veetz20
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel. Upgraded to adult section thanks to Angel. The rooms there are beautiful and modern. Definitely made our stay much better as we were celebrating our anniversary. Thanks again Angel. Pool and beach staff was much more attentive on the adult only side.
Jose, the adult pool concierge was very attentive and made sure we were happy each day. 
Nightlife was pretty good, drinks at the Avenue bar ( Enzo and his team made great drinks, some nights there were shows there too)  then dancing at the nightclub, some nights were busier than others but always had good dancing music.
Our favourite restaurants were the buffet, the Brazilian steakhouse, La palapa, Fuego
Large property so takes a day or two to navigate everything.
Not much activity in adult  pool so we hung out at the main pool one day to see some activities, but we were on the adult only side most days.
The beach was beautiful not too crowded with vendors and the lifeguard was very attentive.
Overall we had a wonderful stay.

reviews.author: 335tracyt
reviews.title: Horrible place to stay!
reviews.text: So many reasons why to pick a different place to stay!  Poor food quality, poor service... our room flooded from a blocked drain on the deck... poor clean up and did not offer anything for our inconvenience  Gourmet coffee bar not open until noon!  What!?  Wanted to exchange $100 for $20's.. We were told "no".  The language barrier was so bad that even when they could speak English you good not understand what they were saying.  Will NEVER go back and NEVER recommend!

reviews.author: AmberS4
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and great food
reviews.text: I went with my husband, toddler, and another couple and their toddler. The hotel property is beautiful. The staff is friendly and attentive. We ate in five restaurants including the buffet and the food was great. The variety was excellent. The kids' pool is the perfect size. The kids club was good for our kids, too. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: suza6032018
reviews.title: Wonderful relaxing time or whatever you want to make of the vs action. So many options.  Good quality food.  Nice staff.
reviews.text: Vicente led us to our breakfast table and had our nice ready each day. They called us by our names and gracious for a small tip. Angel makes great breakfast omelettes.  All restaurants were good. One restaurant is not part of all inclusive.  Wait. It should be. Crazy rule.   Beach and pools are great and will fit whatever mood you are looking for. Rooms spacious but could not get waterfront. Darn. Tried.   The shuttte service was great  clean large SUV. Right on time polite and helpful

reviews.author: thinktravelCA
reviews.title: All good except the dinner options
reviews.text: We had an oceanfront unit on a high floor and loved the view.  The property was very clean and well maintained.  The beach was excellent, and the water a nice temperature. The water has too much wave action and undertow to make for safe swimming in the winter months, but am told that the water is like glass come November.  The lifeguards seemed very attentive.  Last year we stayed at the Paradisus property in Playa del Carmen.  While it is newer and larger, I think this one is more attractive.  It is also nice to be closer to the airport.  We were impressed with this year's liquor selection.  But the food was not that great in the specialty restaurants.  Nor frankly was the service.  Both were definitely a let down.  We were able to eat at La Palapa, which is for Royal Service Guests, and enjoyed our breakfasts and lunches there.  But with the exception of the Rodizio experience at Market Grille, the buffet would have been more satisfactory for dinner.  And it wasn't just that the food was funky.  The service was very lacking.  The resort should really focus in on this as a nice dinner adds a lot to the experience.

reviews.author: born67
reviews.title: Stunning hotel
reviews.text:
What a beautiful hotel. The service from the greeting, , check-in, to all service staff was unbelievable. He staff made sure you had what you needed and if you didn't like it, they made it right. We did tip, but only when service was granted. 
We were given a ocean view room, right beside the "Rd room" if you are over 30, probably not the best idea. Lots of noise, as you share a wall and the techno music blasts from 10-2 am. We lasted 2 night and we were moved to another room at the other side of the hotel. So make sure you look at where you are. The disco is in the middle of the reort and we heard from other guests that it's a problem anywhere close to the disco. So BEWARE. 
The hotel is clean, service outstanding and the beach is fantastic. But please listen to the Lifeguards, they know what they are doing and when you don't listen, they half to come and save you. Which happened at least 3 times within the week. 
We were a group of 17, they made accommodations when going out for dinner at the reservation restaurants, they were "family style" which gives you a nice variety of all the foods. Lots of 
Great wine and quality spirits and mixes.

reviews.author: NHTraveler03301
reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised!
reviews.text:
I have to say:  I wasn't holding high expectations for this resort.  I don't know why.  The reviews were pretty good (which is why we ended up staying here).  Maybe because it was our first stay in Cancun, and the somewhat negative press it gets as a "party place."  Either way, we got a great deal on a family suite and decided to give it a try.

We had a great time!  

Although I was a little concerned when we first checked in and were starving.  We hit the buffet right away.  Granted, it was mid-afternoon and we were already exhausted.  But the food quality at that time was so-so.  Later that night, we ate at Enso, the asian fusion restaurant, and I knew:  this was going to be a good trip.  The food and service was excellent.  They even had great live music as well. 

Every night was this way for us as far as the restaurants.  All excellent.  Great food, great service.  Our favorite was Fuego.  Which we were a little concerned at first would be too spicy.  We didn't even notice.  Wonderful food there.
