The Paradisus also tried to entertain with various shows every night.  This was nice, as we were traveling with our daughter, and not looking to stay out late or party. (I don't think this place had much of a late night vibe anyway, as things got pretty quiet after 11pm) . They put on some good shows, and definitely tried hard to provide some quality entertainment.

Our family suite was the main reason we picked this hotel, and was great!  Big room, nice quality, incredible view (we picked ocean-front).  Our butler, Alexander, was wonderful.  He checked in on us every day, and if there was something we needed, he made sure it was taken care of.

We ran into only one problem, and that was the hot water.  One evening, and one morning, we didn't have any.  The problem was solved within a few hours, however.

So....I'm not sure why I wasn't expecting much from this resort, but they definitely exceeded my expectations, and I would definitely stay here again, especially if traveling with kids and need a second room.

thanks paradisus!

reviews.author: mac2jeter
reviews.title: WOW!!  This place is GREAT!
reviews.text: I was blown away by this place from the time we walked in the front doors.  All you need to do is take a walk or run on the beach in either direction and you will quickly see that this is the best and most beautiful resort in the area.  The food was fabulous and the staff is beyond amazing.  We were so fortunate to have stayed here and were taken care of in every sense of the word.  With that being said, we were also in the area that is reserved only for adults and those wearing a special band.  Make sure you get one of those...it is worth it.

reviews.author: renae l
reviews.title: Best place
reviews.text: Our experience at Paradisus Cancun was one we would never forget! Our family goes to Mexico every year for vacation and this place we had no complaints! The food was great although we had to make a reservation every morning the day before. But it was totally worth it. No waiting in line and getting seated right away was awesome. We were able to try every restaurant and we enjoyed every meal! We were able to get chairs on the beach everyday because people couldn't reserve their chairs all day with towels. So that was nice! The staff was so friendly and loyal. I didn't realize I had forgotten my necklace in my room until i was back in the US. I called the resort and they found my necklace on the floor and they were able to keep my necklace in a security safe until a family friend could pick it up months later. Housekeeping came to our room twice a day to tidy it up. Hands down the best resort we stayed at! Will definitely come back again!!

reviews.author: Liblou
reviews.title: Beach Cabana Rental @ Cocos!
reviews.text:
The hotel was lovely! Very lush and green inside! Staff was very attentive and willing to help. Our favorite part was the beach cabana rental at Cocos. Manuel was our server for two days and he was awesome. He kept the drinks coming, supplied us with ample amounts of water and ice all day! Alejandro was his backup and he was just as amazing. the beach cabana was an extra charge but that included champagne and a lovely lobster plate. Other food and drinks were included in the all inclusive part. 

Only downside was we ordered room service one night and it never showed up. and another night ordered extra pillows and they never showed up. Other than that, great experience!

reviews.author: DMS79
reviews.title: Mixed feelings
reviews.text:
We decided to go to Paradisus based on the many good ratings and unfortunately we did not have the greatest experience and we did purchase Royal service. 

Positives:

* Great views from ocean front rooms.
* Room was modern, clean and very comfortable.
* Beach was fantastic and the beach service was outstanding.
* Lots of restaurant options.
* Location is great and convent to stores and shopping.
* Hotel was very clean and appeared to be well staffed.
* Royal service pool was nice and quiet. 

Negatives:

* Found hard plastic/ceramic in our food at Enso which caused a cut. No one appeared to really care when we brought it to our servers attention.
* Two mornings the Royal service lounge did not have food in the hot breakfast area, and after waiting 30 min it was not refilled even though it was prior to 8 am.
* While in our Bali bed we were repeatedly asked if we were using our bed or chairs even though we were in them. When we got up to go to the bathroom the concierge would ask if we were leaving. They didn't ask those around us so we feel someone wanted our bed specifically. But as it was assigned to us we didn't appreciate feeling like we couldn't use it. It took me yelling at the concierge that I just got up to get my phone and to leave us alone as yes we were using our chairs to get him to stop. 
* Our butler was the worst part. He told us to contact him for certain things and when we did, he acted like it was a hassle and that in order to do things like get us a bottle or make a reservation was a "special" treat. We know that this is standard services that they're are supposed to do. He would also leave us gifts which were nice, but then message us to remind us how nice it was of him to leave us the treats. We paid for Royal service and it is included with the extra $$ so it was frustrating that we had to continually thank our butler for providing services that we paid for. 

Overall the trip was okay which is too bad as it was costly and we were not satisfied guests. 

I am glad we went and tried the resort out, though we will choose a different one next time due to the Bali bed and Butler issues.

reviews.author: 269greggc
reviews.title: Paradise in the Paradius
reviews.text: This property is very well kept. Resturant were good. We had royal service and the rooms were quite large. Our butler “Daniel” did a wonderful job taking care of us. Weather was beautiful, the adult pool was not over crowded in though the hotel was booked. Service is outstanding, definitely worth another visit.

reviews.author: 1kdf
reviews.title: Wonderful time
reviews.text:
My family stayed here last week. There were 9 of us including 1 teenager and 1 preteen. We spent the extra money and stayed on the family concierge level. That is well worth the extra money. Our two butlers gloria and maria were awesome. They take care of everything. They booked restaurants for us, took care of housekeeping needs and personally escorted us around the first day. The two kids also got a few free products like a tote bag and water gun.  Plus there is a family concierge area that includes beverages and snacks which is great when you arrive.  I highly recommend this service.

We booked the lagoon view rooms and they had a lovely view of the lagoon. It is across the road but a nice view anyway. 

We also decided to splurge and get an ocean cabana. Dont let the money dissuade you.  We got wonderful personal service from alejandro and jorge ( great guys).  The price does include a wonderful lobster and shrimp meal and a bottle of champagne.  A wonderful plus.   We had a cabana that comfortably holds 3 people laying down plus two beach loungers.

The restaurants were great. We tried two different ones and enjoyed both meals.  We also loved the buffet. 

Now the only problem was with my checkin. I am sure that the melia representative told me to bring my same credit card but i booked the trip 7 months prior and forgot. It is melias policy that if you dont present the same credit card even if you had prepaid they will bill you again. The great staff in the family concierge lounge helped me get a refund for the original amount so i wasnt charged double. So if you prepaid remember to bring the same credit card.

reviews.author: David A
reviews.title: Excellent experience!!
reviews.text:
All our vacation experience was great.. The best hotel that I've visited.
The chef Eduardo Mukul and all the personal into the hotel were really kindly,  respectful and happy.
The gardens and the facilities are espectacular.. Quality 1A

reviews.author: Monat9
reviews.title: Overall great resort...
reviews.text:
We stayed for the first time in playa Del Carmen.. we were coming from our first visit to Cancun.... 
It’s a great resort for families with few points to note -
Plus points 
1. The resort is amazing with great rooms (with private pools) is which is where we stayed... I definitely recommend these rooms !
2. Great restaurants, good food and service! We really liked mole and market place and naos had great buffet always ! 
3. They have small kids area where they hold activities / parties for kids... it’s great for kids and for you to go to an adults only dinner restaurant / party! 
Negatives 
1. If you don’t have personal pools then you could miss out as the public pools had just too many kids and were small.. so not much of options
2. I didn’t like the service on beach... for drinks etc... they could definitely improve on that... 

But overall it was a good experience!

reviews.author: Jamie M
reviews.title: WOW.... Couldn't have been ANY better !!
reviews.text:
Ok so, When I first found this hotel on red tag / sunwing. I saw plenty of mixed reviews, from the pictures it looked absolutely beautiful and most of the reviews were better than good, so my boyfriend and I booked a weeks vacation from February 23rd to march 2nd (yesterday we got back)  .  As we got to cancun and took the shuttle to different resorts to drop people off, we saw lots of hotels where we thought to ourselves ( wow, i hope this is NOT where we are staying) Mean while ,as we pulled up to our resort we were in "Awh". As soon as you pull up to Paradius Cancun you can tell how beautiful it is.  The hotel is so well kept, clean and so nice. The lobby and rooms are amazingly beautiful as is the whole entire resort. There are 2 huge pools and a lovely beach !!  The service at this place was 10/10. They come around the pool / beach all day asking if you need a drink and or any food to eat as you lay by the water and bake in the sun.  All of the restaurants were amazing as was the service. Even the buffets were very good.  The WI- FI is free and is through out the entire resort and is actually really good.  I would and will recommend  this hotel to ANY ONE looking to go to cancun !  MY boyfriend and I are so in love with this place and are planning to come back this october with another couple !

PICK THIS RESORT !!!!

I have been to Hawaii 13 times and have stayed at the four seasons resort ( non all inclusive) ( one of the most beautiful hotels in the world)  SO BELIEVE ME WHEN I SAY

this hotel is beautiful for an all inclusive !!!!

Thank you paradisus Cancun and all staff

we will be back

reviews.author: KenMurphey
reviews.title: Beautiful Inside and Out
reviews.text: Love this place if you like Cancun and want to be south of the main Hotel district. You can catch a bus at the entrance for about $.50 or 8 pesos to go just about anywhere north and to Cancun proper. Very nice beach and staff and pool.

reviews.author: filmguy2
reviews.title: Paradisus Feb 2018
reviews.text: Really liked this resort, the resort staff were awesome. They went above and beyond to make our visit a memorable one. The food was great, we dined mostly in the buffet restaurant as the selection was wide ranging and tasty. We only tried 2 of the restaurants, the Brazilian was our favorite. The only complaint I have about the resort is that the Nespresso bar is only open from 11 am to 6pm. It should be open at 7am as most people like to have good coffee in the am. The rooms were spacious beds were comfortable and the mini bar was well stocked with water snacks soft drinks juice and beer. The beach was awesome with turquoise water and white sand. Unfortunately the week we were there it was windy and the red flags were on display everyday. I would recommend this property to my friends and relatives.

reviews.author: REGINAC
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
I had a great time at Paradisus. It is a big complex as most of the hotels in the area. As you are entitled an 'all-inclusive' service and you may feel like enjoy everything they have for you, there is not much you feel like doing outside the hotel, I guess.You can always go to town or a mall. For that, lots of buses are available to take you there for 1 dollar. 
The restaurants at the hotel are excellent. Most of them require reservation for dinner, but the one that is always available, Naos, is a great place for a meal.
The only thing I think it should be clearer from the start is what is really NOT included. For instance, we had to pay extra for some wine and beer and we just learned that after they were served and opened. 
We saw some people feeling embarassed when they wanted to use the beds around the pool or on the beach and did not know they were extra charged as well. 
The staff is always very ready to do the best they can to make your stay unforgettable.

reviews.author: david p
reviews.title: Realistic Review - Currently NOT a 4, 4.5 or 5 Star Property
reviews.text:
Attempting to write a realistic review that your average traveler can relate to.  Nothing is worse than reading a review that starts off how your terrible your hotel was because your airline lost your luggage or your flight was late!  

This was our 15th trip to Cancun having stayed previously at Hyatt, Westin, Marriott, JW Marriott, Secrets and NOW properties.  The Paradisus has always looked attractive from the outside and has an outstanding beach location that we were familiar with being next to the Marriot, JW and Secrets.  You can't beat the beach.  Unfortunately the property currently does stand up to a 4, 4.5 or 5 star resort rating.  The rooms are very tired, worn and in need of major refurbishment.  The bathroom needed a major revamp and cleaning (not to mention it is pretty small).  The bed was pretty tired - every time you moved or even climbed in the whole bed and frame moved and bumped against the wall.  The drapes in the room were on their last leg as far as being able to pull them open or closed.  The overall feel of the room was drab and dreary - windows need cleaning, in need of some fresh paint and in general just freshening up. We walked through the main pyramid on several occasions and saw rooms with their doors propped open for cleaning.  What a difference - rooms APPEARED to be bright with fresh paint and new furniture.  HOWEVER, it was only in the main pyramid. 

The restaurants for the most part do not meet the standard of a 4 star hotel.  Exceptions are Blue Agave and Mole - both were excellent.  The main buffet had either a strong fish smell or strong oil/frying smell. You need to make reservations for dinner (Normal for most all inclusive resorts), but good luck as this was always a challenge.  You can make reservations up to 48 hours in advance.  We did that, each day adding a reservation for 2 days out.  Reservations would always be shown as "Pending" and never confirmed.  The day of we would have to call and inquire, be told 'no sorry' and by the end of the phone call told 'ok you are confirmed'.  Show up at the restaurant and run into the same - sorry we don't have your reservation - host calls someone, 10 min later they do have your reservation.

We did us the Spa for a massage and included hydrotherapy treatment.  The massage treatment was excellent and good quality.  The spa IS NOT.  Tired, worn, needs major refresh and not on a par with a 4 star hotel or resort. I would get a massage again, but just expect an overall poor spa experience compared to what it should be for the hotel.

Service - have to say service was outstanding.  In general the staff goes out of their way to be accommodating.  Both beach and pool area had attentive staff that were always checking on you, bringing water without even requesting etc.  You never had to look for someone to order a drink etc like some other all inclusive resorts.

All and all the hotel SHOULD be better than what it is.  Pictures and physical location make it look great.  Service is great.  However, behind the scenes it is a 30 year old hotel (true) that is need of major refurbishment and cleaning.  When you compare dollar for dollar you can find a true 4 or 4.5 start property for same price.

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.title: Never disappoints!
reviews.text: This was out third time at the Paradisus Royal Service. All I can say it gets better every time. Our butler, Daniel, exceeded our expectations. If you stay there , be sure to request him. He’ll do anything and everything possible to make your stay more pleasurable. Be sure to ask for Jose at the pool. He’s also very accommodating for your pool needs. All the restaurants are fantastic. We recommend Mole & The Market Grill . If you’re staying at the Royal Service, be sure to have breakfast or lunch at La Palapa .. sandwiched between the pool and the ocean.  We love this place so much we never feel the need to leave the resort. Enjoy!

reviews.author: eggz716
reviews.title: traveled solo to paradise!
reviews.text:
I had a great time on my solo trip to Paradisus Cancun! I'll break my review down into sections to make it easier. 

Transportation: I booked my whole vacation through Expedia, including my shuttle.  I used Super Shuttle.  I had a shared shuttle from the airport to the resort, they were punctual and courteous.  It was about $15.  No trouble finding them at the airport.  My tip would be to confirm your reservation with them 24hrs before you travel.  I booked my return shuttle to the airport at Paradisus Cancun.  They have an Expedia desk on the 2nd floor with Expedia staff members.  Apparently I had a return shared shuttle included in that $15. The pick up time was 4 hrs before my flight departure so I chose to upgrade to a private shuttle for another $20, this had a pick up time of 3 hours before my flight departure. I again confirmed the day before I was leaving.  I was picked up at the resort right on time, no issues getting to the airport. 

Check In/Check out: very easy and seamless.  I booked an ocean-view room.  Originally was given a room in pyramid 3 (main central building) on the first floor, i asked for a higher floor and took pyramid 4 on the 4th floor.  I do not regret it! I had a beautiful view and pyramid 4 is not that far! took me 5 minutes to get to any of the restaurants from leaving my room.

Room: Clean, well kept. I had 2 double beds even though I traveled solo.  The beds were a little firm for my taste but not a dealbreaker.  I know I had turndown service at least twice a day because I would notice my messy bed remade all the time :) Bathroom was clean and spacious, i loved the overhead rain shower! I also was able to adjust the temperature and fan to my liking.  The balcony was beautiful with 2 pool chairs and a stunning view of the beach and pool.    

Royal Service: I did not get Royal Service, but i do not think i missed much other than a royal service section of the pool.  For me I didn't think it was needed. 

Dining: For breakfast/lunch i ate at Naos the main buffet place.  Plenty of options to choose from.  For dinner you have a variety of restaurants.  I ate at Bana, Mole, and Vento.  My tip: make reservations the day BEFORE you want to go, call the front desk in the morning, they can start taking reservations at 7am the day before! I even made a reservation for my very first night by calling the day before i arrived.  I had didn't have any trouble getting the time I wanted, it also may be because it was just myself.  There were plenty of variety in the cuisine.  I enjoyed everything I ate. 

Pool: I didn't use the pool but there is a nice pool bar.  They also had shows around 8:30pm every night by the pool which was nice.

Beach: Turqoise blue waters and white sand beaches! There was not much seaweed either which was a plus.  You could go sort of far out into the ocean without it getting to deep.  I did rent a cabana on the beach for the day (10am-5pm).  There are different price levels of the cabana ranging from $130, $150, $180 for the day.  I did the $130, the only difference is how far you are from the water and whether you want lobster.  I was in the back row of cabanas and did not care for lobster so i picked the $130 one.  They serve you lunch from Coco's Beach Club, unlimited water, drinks, and a bottle of champagne :) I also got up early to reserve my beach chair, i think people start around 7am.  I reserved one around 8:30am without difficulty.  

Excursions: Aquaworld has a desk right by the beach/pool so you are welcome to explore.  I actually booked parasailing through the Expedia desk at the resort which they said was $8 cheaper.  Expedia booked it through Aquaworld too and gave me a ticket.  It was called "Sky Rider" so parasailing was done in a little couch-like boat rather than your feet dangling.  It was wonderful! The pick up was at the resort next door so just a 5-10 minute walk down the beach to their tent.  I was taken to the boat on a jet ski, parasailed for 15 minutes then taken back to the tent.  

Entertainment: They had a variety of shows, singers, bands every night either in the main atrium or by the pool.  I enjoyed a little bit each day. 

Overall I really enjoyed my time there! I would definitely return again!!

reviews.author: Martha C
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
What we loved: Our waiter at Naos, Ignacio Vasquez!  And Arturo at Naos.  And Raphael and Ruben at Market Grill.  All the wait staff were warm and friendly and helpful.  The food was very good.  Our favorite meal was at Market Grill -- beef, chicken and lamb right off the grill.  Blue Agave has excellent tacos and margaritas.  Which is good because we ate there almost every night.

The water is gorgeous.  The resort was impressive.  The beach was stunning.

What we didn't love:  It was impossible to get reservations at the restaurants.  They set up very specific hours when you can call.  And if you're on the all inclusive as we were, they block out 6:30 to 8:30 for paying guests (that's my guess because that's the answer I got every time I called to make a reservation).  Bummer.

We didn't love that someone was trying to sell us something everywhere we went.  

The entire resort was very loud and very crowded.  In order to get a free chair at the swimming pools or on the beach, you had to go and reserve them by 7am.  There were some wonderful "beds" with thatched roofs that we would have loved to use, but they were $125 a day!  More than most hotel rooms we've stayed at. 

We were "upgraded" to an ocean front room on the first floor that had almost no view and was right above the grill.  Noisy, smelly, loud and no view.  Other than that, it was okay.

Our room never got cool.  I get it.  It's hot and humid and the hotel is almost 30 years old.  Still.

There was very little connection to nature -- guess not what the area is known for.  Our bad.

Overall, we had a great time, but certainly not the best experience we've had.  And that includes the trip where we had Norovirus!  Ha!

reviews.author: dennisblair2
reviews.title: Restful weeks vacation
reviews.text: This was our first experience to travel to Cancun and the Paradisus came with high recommendations from friends. The Royal Service package was an excellent choice. Adult only, great food, Pleasant wait staff and our Butler Rosanna made our stay. Hats off to Julio, Valeria, Moses, Hector, Edwardo and Roberto for their attention to detail.

reviews.author: magk341
reviews.title: Nice hotel and beach
reviews.text:
It is a nice hotel, a great beach and overall I was pleased.
The room and beach were great. The bathroom was a bit rundown...there were cracks in the sink and bathtub and although it was clean it was disappointing...especially that it was the most expensive beach package I purchased and I've been 3 times only in Cancun before, plus in other Caribbean resorts.
From the airport we're picked up and asked to seat 2 persons on the front seat near the driver. Clearly that was a generous 1 seat, but not for 2.  The people from the back seats did not try to accommodate one of us either. The positive part - it was like 20 min drive. Clearly I was unimpressed...
The check-in - not impressed either. The porter did not help with the luggage and actually indicated the wrong desk. Then there were some ladies that pointed to the right desk. The guy was trying to convince me to upgrade the room but was not concerned at all if we can eat anything at 4 pm. He pretty much told me that the restaurant was closed. Then finally he gave me a piece of paper with all the restaurants and I could figure out the grill on the beach was open until 5 pm, so we could eat something.
The travel agency representative next day was as helpless as the check-in guy, he was interested only if we want to buy trips and for the rest of questions regarding the hotel he told me he does not advertise for the hotel.... 
So, from this point of view this is the worst experience I had for check-in and travel agency representative in my 8 visits in the Caribbean resorts.
But I ignored all this and actually the food and beach were great.

One other note: reservations to the restaurants are done 1 day prior and you better do it at 7 am (by phone) else you don't find seats anymore. I went just to the Market Grill restaurant - it was great, the food was excellent.

As a final note - drink is "controlled", meaning the waiter serves you and it can take a while. At least 2 times when I ordered a glass of wine they brought after 20 min and by that time I was done with eating. And I actually don't drink wine if I don't eat in the same time, so...

The weather was beautiful (except 1 day). The entertainment - I don't care too much for it - it was crowded close to the swimming pool - they do not have actually a dedicated inside area for it. There was a music band one day on the beach that sang many classic rock songs. That was nice.

As I said I pretty much ignored the negatives and enjoyed the positives. Most of the waiters/servers were quite nice.

reviews.author: karindillner
reviews.title: Paradise with our family
reviews.text:
First off, let me just say that Fernanda and Rudolfo with family concierge services and Homberto (or was it Alberto? GAH, I'm blanking!) with family concierge pool services made. our. vacation. If you have little ones, I would definitely suggest booking a suite with butler services. Never in my life have we felt so welcomed, looked after and just downright spoiled. The staff here is beyond--so warm, so thoughtful and just really want to make your vacation memorable. Our boys ADORED all the staff--maybe because it was of all the love and affection they received? :)
The few (super minor) hiccups were SUPER small (No turndown services for the boys a few nights, food the first night was just ok, but we attribute that to being super busy during high season, so not a huge deal. It wasn't bad, just not great.)
The grounds are gorgeous and the beach and views are breathtaking. If you can, definitely book a room with an ocean view. It won't disappoint. 
One tip--the pool does get pretty busy, so if you don't rent a cabana, go down early and snag a few lounge chairs. By afternoon, they're all pretty much gone during the high season.

reviews.author: cheryle w
reviews.title: Paradise and treated like royalty
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel experience. Upgraded to royal service and worth every penny! All the hotel staff spoiled us, felt welcome and pampered.  Room was spacious, clean and bed very comfortable. Spa service was awesome, one of the best massages I ever received! Gym had enough equipment and again, very clean. Royal service pool and beach area was beautiful, service top notch. Would mos def come again.

reviews.author: Darren T
reviews.title: Good but not great.
reviews.text: Spent two nights, three days there last weekend. It was good overall. The building and grounds are very nice. The staff was great. The food is ok, decent for breakfast and lunch, but if you are searching for a gourmet dinner consider some of the nearby options. Lots of truly great choices within walking distance. It's safe in that area so venture out! I would also note the main building is pretty noisy at night due to activities in the main atrium. It's loud until 2 am. Also, most of the rooms were not ready until 3 pm or later, so on your day of arrival pack your shorts and tees in your carry on. As you arrive, the bellmen will take your luggage away for storage and it's not a well organized process. Meaning, they separate you from your stuff pretty fast then scoot you into an enclosed "check in" lounge to do the paperwork and break the bad news that you won't have a room for while. My suggestion to the property is to do a smoother job asking guests when they arrive if they need anything quickly from their luggage before storing it. It's ok that rooms are not ready until later IF there is good communication and the ability to change. It was peak season and to be fair they do allow noon check outs on the other side of your vacation. A few tweaks and its a dandy place. Pack your patience for the arrival process!

reviews.author: aaronhK3148QF
reviews.title: Excellent Family Vaction!! :)
reviews.text: It was excellent on all fronts. Staff was amazing. Food was good and the beach and pool areas had somewhere for everyone..took two younger daughters during spring break and we had a great peaceful time and were able to avoid the partiers (I was young once as well) who had their own area. It is a big place and accommodate the guest well, very relaxing! :)

reviews.author: Kaiden1215
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation in Paradise
reviews.text: Paradisus was the ultimate relaxing vacation! Every year our group of friends take a vacation together to reconnect and just have a good time without the kids. We chose Paradisus because it was an adult only resort. We were very pleased and happy with the entire resort. The variety of food was descent and the pools/beach was perfect. It was never crowed and the people were truly friendly. We had an ocean view room which was large and clean! We couldn't have asked for better and will definitely return.

reviews.author: TheRosses2014
reviews.title: Poor Service, Quaility and Follow thru
reviews.text:
I've been reluctant to post a bad review, thinking someone from the hotel would be willing to make the issues I had while working with them right.  Apparently that is no the case.  I host retreats around the world for women entrepreneurs, and am always looking for great service and willing to pay extra for it.  I contracted with the Paradisus not once, but twice to bring my group there.  The first time I visited with my group there was some mix up with the contract and the hotel ended up charging me an extra $5,000 Dollars, so to make it right the next time I brought a group the credited me $2,500.  I reluctantly said yes, as the service I received was not great.  This last trip was the worst.  

As the host of the group you would expect the hotel to be interested in taking care of you, they did the opposite.  I paid for a larger room, with Family Concierge and needed to be near my group.  I was put in a smaller room with my toddler (which DID NOT work) and when I requested them to make it right was given an OLD room with a roach problem in 4 pyramids over (it was a hike to say the least).  See the photo.  Per our contract the hotel still

reviews.author: Curtis B
reviews.title: Great Spring Break Vacation!!
reviews.text: We were not sure what to expect but rolled the dice and came out pleasantly surprised. I read the few bad reviews that they were understaffed but not in our case. At times I thought there may have been two staff for every guest! The staff was wonderful and never did I get a NO or a Can't from them as some reviews stated. I actually got the opposite. They tried everything to help us. Not always successful but they tried. The Hotel was at 97% and never did I feel cramped. Make sure you book reservations for dinner the day before you want to go as they do fill up. The Naos Buffet was spectacular and always open as was the Blue Agave Mexican Grill. We searched everywhere for street tacos only to find the best at our Hotel!! We ate at Bana (excellent Sushi) and followed it with a trip to the Buffet for our son who doesn't like sushi. Food options were great - some were better than others. There is even a Hamburger and Pizza place next to the pool for the kids (and some adults!)! Market Grill was our favorite which is a Brazilian steakhouse. The beach was fantastic with cabanas and the wait staff kept the drinks full. They hustled! Yamil was terrific!!!!! Rented a Suburban and went to Xcaret for the day and felt like we lost a day at the resort. Not sure I would recommend Xcaret. Aquaworld is directly across the street from the resort to book all of your snorkeling/scuba/jungle tours/Isla Mujera trips. Doesn't get much easier! There is also a bus stop in front of the Hotel to take you into town where we went to Mercado 28 (Outdoor Market) for all the Gifts for my neighbors wife (as one store owner put it). Went to Carlos & Murphys one night for crazy fun and free tequila shots for my 14 year old (He liked it)! Great time and we look forward to next year!!

reviews.author: AdrIan T
reviews.title: Great time with a great crew
reviews.text:
Had an excellent week at the Paradisus Cancun.  Room was great, 4th floor, beautiful ocean view. The resort is large so you get lots of exercise walking around. Staff very friendly and helpful. Restaurant selection was large (6) quality of food was very good. 
Freddy, Hugo, Andrea and especially Earnesto were great!

reviews.author: MarkFromBuffalo
reviews.title: Don't pay extra for Concierge Service
reviews.text:
We loved our stay at Paradisus. The spot on the beach right next to the Royal Service beach was perfect away from the crowds and no one ever placed any loungers in front of us so we had a perfect view of the indescribable blue water all week.

Because of the severe lack of loungers on the beach in our section, all "reserved" by 8 am, some angry patrons were taking peoples' posessions off the lounger and stealing the lounger to use at another location.

One last thing, after reading the reviews prior to our trip I knew to contact the hotel and request our rooms in Building 3 above 5th floor and our rooms were perfect. Our friends arrived later and had paid extra for Concierge service which is a complete and utter scam, both groups got placed in Building 1 which is the oldest building for Melia timeshare people and next door construction banging day and night and they were the farthest from all the action. By calling very early for restaurant reservations for next day I always got what I wanted for 6 people in our group while they always got lousy times with their "concierge".

One last thing, people were desperate for loungers on the beach and were crashing the Royal section with impunity. No one was checking.

Rant over. I would definitely go back in a heartbeat though.

reviews.author: ashishpandita2017
reviews.title: Amazing Family Vacation!!!
reviews.text:
We're a bit late in posting this review, but better late than never :)

- Family of 4 ( 2 girls 5yrs and 9yrs)
- Booked Ocean view - Family Concierge service
- on arrival, the check-in was done at the nice Family Concierge facility... kids played pool while we did the check-in
- we were given a cell-phone to contact our Butler, Gloria.
- Gloria took care of everything from restaurant bookings to excursion planning etc.
- She would leave a local toy/ treats for the Girls everyday!!! They loved it!!!
- if you are a young family, don't think just go with Family Conceirge service. 
- Kids Zone was amazing, it would open at 9 and go till 8. Girls didn't even want to go back to the room  :). They would take them to the pool, feed them lunch/dinner and engage them in tons of activities. 
- Thanks to Kids Zone, we go some adult time everyday
- Restaurants are great... each is better than the other. The general buffet itself is quite good and full of variety 
- the drinks, while not top of top shelf, we're pretty decent. 
- we rented a car on two days to visit xCarat and Tulum/Xel-Ha. Driving there is pretty straight-forward the road is straight-line as well. 
- weather was amazing all 7 days
- everyday, near the pool they have some performances. 
- Also, every evening there is a performance/show at inside bar.
- Didn't have one dull moment
- Transit from/to the airport was smooth 
- Staff is extra helpful and polite... the quality of service is really good. 

You can't go wrong with this resort!!! 

We had an amazing time!!!

Gloria, thanks for all your assistance and service... it was simply amazing. The girls still talk about you ;)

Cheers!!!
Pandita Family

reviews.author: Thoms249
reviews.title: Great week in the Cancun sun
reviews.text: Had an excellent week at the Paradisus Cancun.  We are Club Melia members so we were in the Club Melia section.  Room was great, 5th floor, beautiful ocean view.  The resort is large so you get lots of exercise walking around.  Staff very friendly and helpful.  Restaurant selection was large (6) quality of food was very good. Concierge at Club Melia very helpful.  All in all an excellent week No complaints.

reviews.author: Jesus B
reviews.title: Very nice stay overall will return in the future
reviews.text: Very nice hotel! We  loved the Royal Services and its restaurant at the beach! Also love the main lobby atmosphere,  night shows, and bars!. There was a great idea to open the disco at 11:00 PM since we do not usually stay late so for us was perfect. Definitely we will be back in the future.

reviews.author: kahirs
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is a wonderful 5 star resort.
reviews.text: Resort is exceptional in every way. Impeccably clean, friendly staff, nice variety of restaurants with excellent food, premium drinks everywhere, and picture perfect location. Beautiful marble interior and the most exquisite lobby of any resort. Pools are large and clean and the beach volleyball was a blast. This is the 2nd time we have been there and already talking about booking another trip there. Highly recommend !!!!

reviews.author: Lauren B
reviews.title: An AVERAGE at best hotel.  Not a 4-5 star by any means!
reviews.text:
Our experience started off poorly.  We booked our reservations then 2 weeks later it went down $500 a room, they wouldn't credit us the difference or work with us. We repeatedly contacted them and were ignored us every time.  Don't bother trying to contact the hotel directly or Melia customer service. I called the hotel and asked to speak to a front desk manager and was told they "didn't have one".  I asked if this is the poor service that we can expect upon arrival, he responded with a "Yes".  

THIS IS NOT A 4 or 5 STAR HOTEL...DON'T BE FOOLED.  The $1500 resort credits are a complete joke.  

Let's start off with the hotel rooms:  we had 2 double/double rooms.  Beds are truly double sized beds, not queens, and were comfortable.  We asked for adjoining rooms since we were traveling with kids, did not get it. DO NOT use the pull out couch, absolutely disgusting!  The furniture is old, stained and beat up, doors to patio and bathroom were missing handles.  Caution with bathrooms - there's a step to enter, tub is at a higher level then the floor and the door to the toilet can't be opened or shut unless the door to the bathroom is closed.  You need to request daily to have your refrigerator refreshed.  The last day we were there the air conditioning was barely working.  Two days with no hot water for showers!

Restaurants:  If you don't make your reservations 24 hours in advance enjoy eating at 9:30-10pm or be subject to the buffet AGAIN.  Service is extremely slow as well.  We walked out of 2 of the restaurants because food was so bad at one and too slow at the other.  You cannot walk in the restaurants without a reservation either.  There was a buffet at the pool a few nights.  We thought it was for private events but turned out to be for hotel guests.  Overall the food was okay...some restaurants better than others, that's to be expected in our eyes.

Hotel:  TIRED!  Needs a major renovation.  ALL the lobby and lounge furniture is worn and torn.  The hanging plants cause a mildew/musty smell so they over compensate with overwhelming air freshener machines all over the hotel - migraine central.  

The staff was very nice and accommodating.  Make sure you find Oscar in the check in area...he'll take great care of you.  The pool and beach were very nice, location is nice, public transportation ($1) was a great way to get to the shopping areas.  There was entertainment at the pool but only on the weekend and the nightly entertainment in the lobby lounge was nicely done.  

We enjoyed our vacation, not because of the hotel but rather cause we made the best out of it.  Would not go back, would not recommend staying at this hotel and will never stay at a Melia property again.

reviews.author: Patrick G
reviews.title: consistently excellent
reviews.text: I have reviewed this hotel before.. and the hotel has not changed.. my room was very clean and very comfortable. The maid service was attentive to detail and thorough in cleaning the room. The pool is expansive and ultra clean. THE BEST THING ABOUT THE HOTEL IS THE SERVICE. Asuncion and Leticia and the rest of the beach service crew go out of their way to make the Paradisus your paradise in Mexico.The beach is huge and immaculate.. I was looking for any bit of garbage ( (while looking for shells) on the beach and couldn't find any. Once again the hotel plays EXTREMELY loud BOOM BOOM MUSIC. ( IT ANNOYS EVERYONE ) but the beach is so big you can and should get away from the NOISE. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kenneth A
reviews.title: Nice all inclusive
reviews.text: All in all we were very satisfied with our stay and the location is incredible. The room was nice but a bit too worn to warrant a 5 star rating.  The bathroom was designed by a homicidal architect as there are multiple elevations into the bathroom, tub and toilet area.  The bathroom door also clashes with the toilet door.  The main door to the bathroom should be a pocket door or equivalent.  The restaurants try to upsell on wine nightly.  Most peple figure it out on the first night.  The service was excellent and the included restaurants very good.  Save  your money on the restaurant Tempo.  It is good but they are charging Le Bernardin prices for what is basically a good upscale restaurant.  Before they closed I had the opportuinty to go to Le Bec Fin in Philadelphia and the prices were absolutely worth it.  Emrils in 1993 was worth every penny and the grill room in New Orleans always provides the finest value.  Tempo was just good: but not memorable.  Blue Agave, Vento, Bana, Fuego and Mole were all perfectly good and were included (except for the attempted upselling of wines).  The house wines were acceptable.  Mole in the mornings was a pleasant surprise and was not as busy as Naos which gets crowded in the mornings.

reviews.author: sheilarevel
reviews.title: One Week in Paradise
reviews.text:
My husband and I, along with another couple, had the pleasure of staying at Paradisus the first week of March.  We upgraded to the Royal Service and highly recommend.  Our Butler was Edwardo and he was very professional and worked hard to ensure all our needs were met.  Eddie C. & Carlos by Royal Service pool were wonderful.  All the staff worked very hard and seemed to be happy to serve us.  We really enjoyed the LaPalapa restaurant for Royal guests.  The Cobe Beef burgers were awesome.  Loved that they also offered a can American beer option at the Royal Service pool (Coors Lite).

Food - Market Grill was our favorite.  We also ate at Fuego, Vento & Tempo and thought it was very good.  We tried Blue Agave (tacos) and I will just say it was not for us but some seemed to like it.  

I would highly recommend this resort and would gladly return in the future.

reviews.author: kdandino
reviews.title: Best friend girls getaway!
reviews.text: Cindy and Laura by the pool were exceptional!!!! Treated us like royalty! I miss them already! Gabriel at the lounge bar was great as well! We never wanted to leave! Our room was a perfect ocean view and the food was great!

reviews.author: Lisa C
reviews.title: Far better places to stay for the price!
reviews.text: This is not the place to stay. Only upside was beach proximity and good drinks. Everything else was sad and tired. Entertainment was poor. Food was mediocre. Décoré and room cleanliness was poor. Had to call everyday about cleaning, towels, bar fridge, and toiletries. Room quality left a lot to be desired. Balcony tub never cleaned. No hottub in pool area. Nice pools but nothing spectacular. Spa service was good but facility was lacking- many things didn't work. I have been to Mexico several times. This was rated a 4.5. At its best I would give it a 3. That's being generous. Do your research far better out there for the money.

reviews.author: MTappert
reviews.title: 5 star Resort
reviews.text: We had a excellent stay at Paradisius Cancun. Family Concierge exceed our expectations. The restaurant were all good and especially Market and Ibana. Some Staff that really made our vacation are: Lesley, Gloria at FC Martin, Tahir, Alejandra, Kathia and Roberto in the restaurants.

reviews.author: BrianandTrish
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text:
If you want the best customer service and a relaxing vacation the Paradisus is the place to go. 
My husband and myself keep going back not just for the great food selections, the pristine beach, or the pool...it's all about the fine people that work so hard to make your vacation special.  

Royal Service is the best way to go(especially during Spring Break season).
The pool is heated in this section, the rooms recently remodeled to include a dream bathtub and rainfall shower head, Bali bed options, and Breakfast/Lunch area.  (My husband and 21 year old son say the French Toast is spectacular)

There are also no lines to wait in to check in for Royal Service as I have read in other reviews.  The best restaurant to go to is Market Grill, but be sure to stop by the buffet on the way out for the ice cream.  It's fantastic. 

Now, back to the reason we keep coming back to Paradisus.   We see the same familiar friends, the awesome staff, year after year.  If you want something off menu in Royal Service, they will do their best to find it.  Never does your drink get empty.  

My thanks to Galdino(our awesome butler every year), Daniel(was so happy to see you got promoted), Carlos(you rock my Bali bed friend) and Omar(thanks for taking care of us by the pool), Ceasar, Moises, Eddie, Rafeal our poolside waiters that hustle so hard, and Valeria with her smiling face who knows I like bananas.   Rode, my thanks to you too, hope you enjoyed your mini vacation.  I know I'm forgetting someone......

One year from now, we will be back to Paradisus as the customer service is the best.  If you truly want a resort that exceeds your expectations, Paradisus is for you. 

I also want to thank the Manager of the hotel, thanks Lazaro!!!   Room 5114 has a new name in my mind thanks to your comment.   

The Chappell's

reviews.author: Edna C
reviews.title: Overall this hotel is excellent.
reviews.text:
Room was spacious  with very private balcony. Out of 7 resaurants we  tried 6 and all were  top quality with staff who REALLY wanted to please.  They were knowledgeable  about the different menus and always  always asked if we had  allergies . 
The pools were always sparkly clean with pool boys working none stop vacuuming and  testing the pool.  The grounds were spotless  and the gardens full ,green and lush. Our beds were rather hard and we had to ask for  foamies which were happily given. My favourite  waitress at the pool  was Asuncion who helped me with my chair every day as I was unable to lie on the sun bed. She was attentive and fast and always had a smile.  Although I didn't travel with children I was told by those that did that an excellent kids programme was in place every day.   
.

reviews.author: Dawn E
reviews.title: Nigel and Dawn from London
reviews.text:
Our stay at this amazing hotel has been one of the best we have ever had. 
We enjoyed the Royal Service and the service we received was excellent. Our Butler Galdino was superb, quietly organizing our visits to the amazing restaurants and ensuring we had the use of a Bali bed! 
We enjoyed all of the restaurants but our favourite was the Grill Bar and the fabulous hostess Mirian! She was professional, efficient and made our meals at her restaurant more pleasurable. Our last meal particularly so with support from her staff Angel and Stephanie. 

The pool in the adult area was so warm, clean and plenty of room. 

The staff at the La Palapa Resturant made our lunchtimes enjoyable very attentive without being intrusive- especially Valerian she always remembered us and made us feel special- the young man working with her who made sure my husband had his special cup for his cuppacino! Excellent service. 
The location of the hotel is amazing with its own beach area and beds with shade. 
The virgin rep we had was excellent making sure we had all the information we needed on arrival and whilst enjoying our holiday - Kayley was a superstar. 
We loved our holiday and hope to come back again soon.

reviews.author: Mallory L
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
We decided to come here because we went to Paradisus Punta Cana last May and loved it. First let me say that we did the Royal Service (RS) upgrade and highly recommend it. You get a butler who takes care of your dinner reservations and helps with anything you could possibly need. Our butler was Hector and he was absolutely great. You also get a private restaurant called La palapa that has great breakfast and lunch options. You also get a huge pool for RS guests only. It was at 100% capacity when we were there and there might have only been up to 10-15 people in the pool at a time. Our favorite part about RS was that you are guaranteed to get a bed and 2 chairs by the pool reserved for you all day for at least 2 days of your stay. The beds are so comfy and provide full shade. You are required to check in and get your reserved bed by 11, I believe, or they will allow other guests to take your reservation, so we were able to get beds every single day of our stay. The days we didn't have a reservation we just went to the beach until 11:30 and then got a bed. There are several servers for the RS pool and beach area. With RS you get 24/7 room service and a completely stocked mini fridge of snacks and drinks. They refill it once a day. RS is also in its own part of the facility. It is extremely quiet and they have a large area to get snacks and drinks all day. We obviously highly recommend RS upgrade. 
     The beach was gorgeous. It was choppy, so we didn't swim very far out. It also got pretty windy a couple of days, but humidity was very low. We didn't break a sweat the entire time (we are also from Texas so we are use to heat). 
     The food was amazing. My favorite was Vento and the Market Grill. Although all restaurants were great. 
      We loved the night shows at Avenue bar. There were some live bands, circus type performers, and dancers on different nights. We didn't miss a single one. We aren't huge into night life, but we did stay at the red lounge one night for a little while and enjoyed ourselves! 
       Overall the service was outstanding. Everyone is friendly and helpful. We couldn't have had a more relaxing and stress free vacation.

reviews.author: Alvin B
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
This place is literally Paradise! One of the most beautiful resorts I have ever stayed at! My friends and I came here for spring break and we had an incredible time. The lobby is magnificent and as soon as you walk in, the fragrance the resort uses is amazing. I recommend purchasing the all-inclusive package it is definitely worth every penny or pesos! The place is designed to be relaxing and has a very Spa-like feel with koi fish and ponds and hanging gardens everywhere. All of the restaurants in the Resort were of 5 star quality along with great live music. Red Lounge and Avenue Bar were a great place to wind down with music and shows. The beach was breath taking and the pool was also amazing. One of the best perks is the great buffet style food and being able to sit by the pool or beach and even the cool swim up bar. 
      But what I want to commend this place for was the HIGH QUALITY LEVEL OF SERVICE!!! All of the employees there were so above and beyond than any other resort or hotel could offer. Every employee says Hi to you and always makes sure to ask if you need anything. They even respond with "it's my pleasure or it was my pleasure to help!" I have never heard of any other service at a hotel use those words. To hear that come from their staff, no words can describe it. From the waiters to room service or front desk, everybody was willing to help with a smile. There was a great sense of genuine humanity, care and dignity from all of the staff there. I am from NY, and out of all the places I have visited/stayed at through out USA there is nothing that even comes close to what I experienced here. 
     I want to give a great shout out to Parvi and Ame of the Outdoor Photography group for their extraordinary service and helpfulness. Parvi is a great photographer and did an amazing job taking my photos. I have never seen such great skills and it was worth every cent for such great quality photos. Ame was genuinely super helpful in helping me select the pictures and putting together the right package. I wish I could remember the names of every person who helped me and deserved a shoutout but then I would have to list every single staff at the resort. 
     Overall beautiful place, great food, excellent service and no doubt the best resort to stay at when thinking about vacationing in Cancun! I will definitely be coming back here for sure!!

reviews.author: Brooklynite_Abroad
reviews.title: This places is improving, but slowly
reviews.text:
The setting:  You are 20 minutes by car/shuttle from the airport.  This is a rebranded Gran Melia, now a Paradisus.  This, however, is not at all like a Paradisus you may have visited in the DR or even Playa del Carmen.  This is a spacious complex but one without the modernity of a Paradisus resort.  The main lobby is located in the middle pyramid, which is the third pyramid to be exact.  The lobby opens into an incredible, large space with hanging plants everywhere.  It’s calm and soothing to enter the hotel.  Complimentary parking valet will take your keys upon arrival.  Check-in is tastefully handled to the left of the lobby in a glass enclosed area, with plenty of seating.  Check-out can be done at the regular reception counter, to the right of the entrance.  If you are a Club Melia member, like I am, your lobby and check-in is done in Pyramid 1, which is similar to Pyramid 3, but smaller in scale.
The room:  Whatever you do, make sure you spring for a sea view room.  Cancun’s beach is incredibly beautiful, and the water is many shades of blue.  Having this view is definitely worth it.  Your alternative is the back view of the hotel, towards the inland lagoon.  Looking out at the parking lot and lawns, rather than the beach and sea is a drastically different experience.  Our first room was a master one-bedroom that faced the parking lot, room 1312.  It lacked a Jacuzzi on the balcony, and even a mirror above the vanity in the bathroom.  After some persistent and bitter complaining, and although we were initially told nothing was available, we were allowed to switch to a ground level master one-bedroom, with a sea view.  This Club Melia room had a living room and kitchen, with its own full bathroom and a balcony with a Jacuzzi.  The bedroom with a plush king size bed was its own room and also came with a full bathroom.  Both the living room and bedroom had large, flat screen TV and the Wi-Fi worked great.  The kitchen has an electric range and microwave, a small fridge, a coffee maker and basic utensils.  There was a safe in the closet off the kitchen.  The shower in the bathroom off the bedroom had good water pressure, but the rain shower head was attached to the wall and not hung from the ceiling, defeating the purpose of the rain shower.
The grounds:  This is a large property, with Club Melia area at one end (Pyramid 1), and Royal Service/adults only area at the opposite end (Pyramid 5), and three pyramids of regular all-inclusive rooms in between.  There is a large pool in front of Pyramids 1-4, and a separate smaller pool at the Royal Service area.  The Royal Service area has better service than any other part of the hotel, separate a la carte breakfast and lunch restaurant, and a child free pool/beach area.  Unfortunately, the beach cabanas (Bali beds) are limited at Royal Service.  Although free to RS guests, there are only four cabanas that face the sea, and many more that face the pool, but these are booked up in advance, and are only available for two days of one’s stay.  Chances are, once you arrive, you won’t be able to land a cabana until a few days into your stay.  There are plenty of loungers by the pool and beach, many under thatch umbrellas.  There is now an exclusive beach club, Coco’s, in the middle of the beach at this hotel.  For $50/day you can rent a cabana at Coco’s.  Lastly, is the Club Melia beach area, which has been much improved.  I was surprised that I could rent a sea facing cabana at the Club Melia beach or pool for only $10/day.  The main area and Club Melia pools are loud with children and occasional drunk adults.  The beach was wonderfully peaceful, but beware, March is the windy cooler time of year in Cancun, which means big waves and dangerous conditions for enjoying the sea.
The food:  As we were part of Club Melia, we had the option to add an all-inclusive plan for $100/person/day.  We didn’t take advantage of this because we were without kids and wanted to enjoy the excellent restaurants that Cancun offers for dinner.  The breakfast buffet here is $25/person/day, and the lunch buffet is similar.  There was a large selection of Mexican and continental options at breakfast.  Although, all the food looked great it did not taste as good as it looked.  The same can be said of lunch.  For dinner we headed out to eat.
All in all, this is a good hotel, though slightly dated, with a wonderful beachfront.  Stay here if you get a good rate.  If possible, avoid the all-inclusive and go out to dinner as outside restaurants exceed the quality of the hotel’s restaurants.  Do not skimp on a sea view room, as the beach and sea are strikingly beautiful.  Lastly, this is much below the quality of other Paradisus resorts.  It's not comparable to the Paradisus resorts in Playa del Carmen or in Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: ges757
reviews.title: A treasure in Cancun
reviews.text:
We have stayed at this facility for the past 6 years. We have never been disappointed in the service, room, view, bars and restaurants. The best part of the Paradisus is the staff. Everyone treats you as a very important person. From Hector at the pool and beach, to our new friend Jennifer who sat us for breakfast and lunch, a warm smile and good morning greeted us each day. Each employee should be commended on their hospitality. We enjoyed all the restaurants for dinner and had no problems getting reservations in the place of our choice. The only little eating issue was the taco place, too much like fast food, not really relaxing.
We did enjoy our spa experience done on the first day which helped us get into vacation mood quickly.
I write this on our last day here and am already looking forward to next years visit.
,

reviews.author: Sunil S
reviews.title: All in ⛱ Resort
reviews.text:
Excellent suites , food , location, service.
Beach access from the resort and place to rest are great.

Downtown is just 20 mins away.

Access to ferry for traveling to isla mujeres is just 30 mins away. This island offers great options to enjoy with family. 

Do not forget to checkout amazing ocean view from this island.

reviews.author: Fearless432512
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: On Our 4th trip to Mexico we stayed at the Paradisus  Cancun, our first night in our room was directly over the red lounge disco, booming music coming through the floor till 2 AM requested room change next night much better. Did not like the food we had 1 reservation for Supper and they did not seat us even though the whole place was almost empty  stay somewhere else paradisus not worth the price

reviews.author: fitorenovaj
reviews.title: UNREASONABLE !
reviews.text: I checked in March 13th, 2017 with 5 people total under one reservation. Two other cousins checked in the same time as I, however, they had their own separate reservation. The same night an incident took place which resulted into getting kicked out of the hotel....The next day, we all had to meet with two "managers" to discuss the situation. I, who was asleep and not part of the situation was kicked out for an unknown reason! Just because the guest who did something has the same last name as myself resulted in ALL OF US getting kicked out. When addressed the "managers", they were TEXTING their boss and when asked to directly speak to the boss, they would say 'he is not here". I am highly baffled by the customer service and the fact that the "managers" had NO REAL REASON as to why they are kicking out the reservation that had NOTHING to do with the incident out! They rather let their guest get kicked out with no back-up plan and only care about their money instead of citizens! Upon arrival, there was no papers to sign stating anything about hotel policy. To this day, I still have no idea as to why I and the guest under my reservation were kicked out since we were not the people who were part of the incident. Just because we have the same last name and are relatives to the person who got into a situation, they decided to kick us out as group which technically they cannot do. ONLY GOOD THING ABOUT THIS HOTEL is Ernesto and Gulliermo, without them, we would have been stranded. MAKE THEM THE MANAGERS and fire the other two no power, brainless men. The AMSTAR guys were beyond helpful and super kind enough to help us find a motel for the night and help us reserve rooms in a different hotel through CheapCaribbean. Rock on to them because without them, we would have literally been stranded in the street considering we did not bring enough money since we did not anticipate any issues. SAVE YOUR MONEY AND GO TO IBEROSTAR! GREAT HOTEL, SERVICE, AND STAFF ARE WAY MORE PROFESSIONAL. In addition, upon arrival, IBEROSTAR makes their guests sign a letter stating their policy so incase an incident does occur, you were informed. WAY TO GO IBEROSTAR!! P.S. I STILL NEED AN ANSWER AS TO WHY MY RESERVATION WAS KICKED OUT WHEN WE HAD NOTHING TO DO WITH THE INCIDENT THAT OCCURRED. HAVING THE SAME LAST NAME AND BEING RELATED TO THE OTHER PERSON SHOULD NOT HAVE AFFECTED EVERYONE!

reviews.author: debg631
reviews.title: A Vacation Destination worth taking.
reviews.text: This was our second year at the Paradisus. The first year there were nine adults. This year nineteen friends and family members joined in the fun.  The resort was so beautiful inside and out. We played golf every day and participated in all the poolside activities. The entire staff was always friendly and courteous. I'd like to mention a few individuals who stood out. Rodrigo ,the pool activity coordinator was phenomenal. He had so much enthusiasm and kept the crowd entertained. He deserves recognition along with Veronica the waitress at the pool. She always had a smile and made sure we had everything we needed. Two staff waiters Atilono and Reynaldo at the restaurant Naps stood out with their friendly demeanor and caring attitude. The housekeepers kept our rooms so neat and clean.  The staff was wonderful from the first to the last day. Hope to visit next year.

reviews.author: Love_to_travel_wm
reviews.title: Just arrived
reviews.text: Love it already. Walked into the Royal suites were greeted and given a drink waiting to check in smells wonderful here everyone's nice very clean the Lobby. Our butler is so awesome our room is great I can't wait to go explore I'm sure this will be the best vacation ever.

reviews.author: prem g
reviews.title: One of the best resorts in Cancun.
reviews.text: This is a large property that includes 5 buildings joined together. We stayed in Royal service section for adults. Excellent service at the poolside, beach and other areas. Restaurants were fine but food was not of New York standard as is the case with other resorts too. Room was a mini suite with ocean view and was well furnished. Staff including the manager of the Royal service were friendly and very helpful. This was one of the best stay we had in Cancun over the last few years.

reviews.author: spoiled2014
reviews.title: My favorite Hotel
reviews.text:
Though a bit "pricey" this hotel is my favorite place to travel too. We have been here four times over the years.
Beautiful suites, a huge pool, several top rated restaurants to choose from, and exceptional service all around, combine to make this Heaven on Earth for vacations.

reviews.author: fosterca26
reviews.title: Fabulous Family Vacation
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at the hotel. Our private butler Ana Velasco took care of all of our needs. Ana booked all dinner reservations for us during our 10 day stay. Ana was always available for us and made an effort to personally connect with us daily during our stay. Ana also took care of booking our transfer to the airport for our departure.

reviews.author: Diana C
reviews.title: Excellent Royal Service even without the Concierge!
reviews.text: Been to Paradisus  Playa del CArmen last year so we wanted to repeat the experience in a different location , again Royal Service because last time it was excellent , so we repeated it , we stayed for only two days and a half so we requested again concierge but this time we had to change the concierge when we arrive because he left us unattended for one hour and didn't appear at all , we had to look for him and request a change , the second one made appointments at restaurant at inconvenient times so we had to change each time ! Besides hat the royal service restaurant were excellent Bana and Mole   Incredible ! We love it !  It no concierge for us next time !

reviews.author: Leslie
reviews.title: Great time at Paradisus!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a week at the Paradisus Cancun and had a wonderful experience. We've enjoyed many 5 star properties in Mexico and Dominican over the years and this one was one of our favourites. We travelled with 4 adults and 3 teenage boys. Service was top notch here from check in to check out. We arrived early and 2 of the 3 rooms were ready so they gave us those rooms right away. We had ocean view rooms which I highly recommend. The rooms were a nice size and well maintained by the maid service. Rooms were cleaned in a timely manner each day, fresh sheets daily,  lots of towels and turn down service was a nice touch. The only negative were the really soft pillows. 
We spent every day at the beach and enjoyed the picturesque ocean and the fantastic service. Loved the no towel cards needed policy! 
The food throughout the hotel was outstanding, again so was the service in all restaurants. They asked if anyone had allergies every time; which was impressive having one member of our group with a dairy allergy. 
The gym was small and crowded at times but when machines were busy we did the crossfit class. The instructor  was fantastic. He made sure everyone was doing the exercise properly and gave us a good work out. Unfortunately we did not get his name but kudos to him; it is rare to find good technical instructors at all inclusive resorts. 
We enjoyed the night entertained which was nice to enjoy in a central part of the property. We also danced each night in the disco to top 40 songs. 
Once again, we couldn't say enough good things about the friendliness of the staff and a big thank you to those behind the scenes that had this hotel running like a well oiled machine. There were lots of people coming and going and they were able to keep up with the demand with simplicity.

reviews.author: judylp
reviews.title: Amazing family holiday
reviews.text: My husband, son and I enjoyed a week long stay at Paradisus Cancun.  The resort is pristine, the staff extremely friendly and helpful.  We especially enjoyed the Mole restaurant (authentic Mexican cuisine), Bana (Japanese restaurant) and Market Grille (BBQ meats).  The buffet was always plentiful with so much variety, beautifully presented and the food equally delicious.  The pool waiters were outstanding especially David and Manuel who catered to us and always delivered our preferred beverages with a smile.  The resort has well coordinated activities.  Our son loved the kids zone, spent many hours making new friends, enjoying the kids club facilities and play time.  I thoroughly enjoyed Zumba class with Andrea and Rodrigo who made this fitness hour so motivating and fun to partake in.  The evening shows were well done and entertaining.  If you want an awesome vacation at a reasonable price point for the entire family, I would highly recommend it.  Thank you Paradisus Cancun for showing my family an awesome time.  We take with us fond memories of a beautiful holiday and can't wait to return.  😊

reviews.author: Mist24
reviews.title: Please do not mistake this for a five stars hotel
reviews.text: Omg I am so sorry to say but this place sucks!!! We checked in today and it's just heart breaking. The rooms are tiny, the first upgrade to another tiny room is $120 per new night. The buffet has hardly any options, not even pasta station. All the restaurants are booked and when I called to book for tomorrow they are also booked and you can't book for the following day. There rule is book only one day in advance. So I have to wake up at 7 am tomorrow to book a restaurant for the day after tomorrow . I can't imagine that we have to stay here for a week !!!! Based on other reviews I was really looking forward to this Vecation but this is so bellow our expectations.

reviews.author: Adrien T
reviews.title: Paradisus Hotel Cancun
reviews.text: I had a fabulous trip to Paradisus Hotel in Cancun.   The food, the location, the room, the staff I give 10 out of 10.   My friend that I travel with is waiting for a knee replacement so we spent a great deal of time by the pool.   Asuncion was a primary waiter.   Asuncion couldn't do enough to make my friend comfortable due to limited mobility.    She brought ice for the knee and made sure we always had water or frothy libations at hand.   Laying in the sun is hard work.

reviews.author: chunter08
reviews.title: Amazing trip!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus March 13-17 and had an absolutely amazing time. At check in we were asked if we wanted to upgrade to Royal Service and we are so happy that we did. Being in Royal Service helped us miss the majority of the spring break crowd that was at the resort and we couldn't have asked for better service. From the private beach/pool to the private lounge, the service was outstanding. Ricardo took care of us while we were at our Bali bed and Alejandro took care of us each night in the royal lounge. Our butler Erik made our trip unforgettable. He made all of our dinner reservations the first night we arrived, made a reservation for my husband and I to have a couples massage in the spa and on our last night had rose petals and champagne in our room for a very romantic evening. The food at the resort was delicious. We never went to the buffet because Royal Service has its own restaurant for breakfast and lunch. Blue Agave, Vento, Market Grill and Mole were all incredible. My husband and I are already planning our next trip and can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Ryan C
reviews.title: Booking Beware!
reviews.text:
I haven't even had my stay and already having a terrible experience! I am extremely disappointed by the service provided by this organization! 

When trying to book on the Melia website for a 4 day vacation in Cancun in the coming weeks, the confirmation I received had incorrectly booked us for only 1 night on completely different dates. When I immediately consulted the phone service about this, I was able to book the correct dates over the phone, but was advised that I could only submit an email to try to claim for the faulty booking, which was a non-fundable ticket. I did this.

In over 2 weeks I have received no resolution to this issue despite multiple enquiries online and a highly uncooperative phone call. This is all leaving a very bad taste in my mouth and overall I am now dreading my visit to the hotel. 

I'm now looking to escalate this issue with Consumer Affairs. This is simply not fair or acceptable. Trying to change an incorrect booking (due technical issues on their website) from 1 night to the correct booking for 4 nights (a longer stay!) should be simple!!!

reviews.author: Jose R
reviews.title: Staying Here Now: Family Vacation
reviews.text:
Staying here while writing this review.  This hotel has more negative than positive attributes:

We arrived early Saturday morning for a 7 day stay & our son had 102 fever.  The staff made us wait for hours for a room.  They would not give us a room unless we paid $80-$250 more per night for an upgrade & could care less that our son was ill & needed to take medication & go to bed.  

Not enough shade in children's pool area.  People place towels in the few shaded spots by 7-8 in the morning & than the resort forces you to pay $50 daily for Bali beds if you don't want to roast in the sun.

Same situation in the beach area.  Also, no staff to help you with chairs on the beach unless you pay more for the Royal service.  Difficult to do with children & all the things you have to carry with you.  The only way you get any service as a family with small children is if you pay $200 a night extra for the Family Concierge package.  I already paid $4000 for this stay to begin with.  I expected better service & compassion since we have 4 year old twins with us.

We're not foodies but the food is just ok.  However, we're not picky & have never found anything we thought was great.  The variety is excellent though.  We're not drinkers so I can't comment about the alcoholic beverages.

The staff at restaurants & bars are excellent.  As a whole, workers throughout the resort are very pleasant.  

I have traveled the world & have never been segregated in a hotel based on what I spent to stay there.  If you go into the Royal Service or Family Concierge area by accident, you're asked to leave instantly.  My wife took my children to the nearest bathroom by the beach & was asked to walk to the other side of the resort because it was the Royal Service bathroom.  Try explaining that to 4 year olds when they need to go to the bathroom right away.

I would never come back to this resort.  However, we have 5 days left & will make the best of it.

reviews.author: Jo Marie B
reviews.title: fun place. beautiful.
reviews.text: don't expect a perfect experience.  the hotel was built in the late 80's, and is now experiencing maintenence issues...leaky pipes on the 3rd floor, outlets not working ( plugs worn out) towel bars loose, . .... the saving grace was the staff. they were friendly, kind, and wanted you to enjoy your stay. that made the over all experience really nice.

reviews.author: Roland T
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Paradisus Cancun over four nights in March 2017.  The hotel is esthetically beautiful and the staff so friendly and welcoming.  I came here for rest and relaxation and that is exactly what I got.  The wait staff at Naos Restaurant were terrific but one particular gentleman, Orlando, deserves special recognition.  This gentleman was always upbeat, energetic, and enthusiastic about his job.  He embodies the spirit of outstanding customer service and it was always a pleasure to see him.  What made Orlando special is that he would anticipate your needs.  He would fit right in at a high end restaurant anywhere in NYC.  He was playful with the children and friendly with every one of his customers.  If possible, ask for a table with Orlando and he will take really great care of you.

reviews.author: Ed2travel666
reviews.title: Coc!o Bar makes me loco
reviews.text: Quality and service for great PRICE! Grab a chair by the pool early let them do the rest. Please stop by the Coco Bar and see Christian and Katrina for a good time and  tell him Ed and Joni said Hello.

reviews.author: mfairy2016
reviews.title: Fun times at paradisus cancun!
reviews.text:
The property was beautiful and well maintained!
The service was wonderful. The pool staff, (Jorge set us up in a Bali bed on the beach each day) and the servers on the beach, hector and Veronica were attentive as well as victor and Carlos at the swim up bar. The restaurant staff at marketplace grill was great, we had great fun evening with Luis and Alfredo taking care of us. At Bana we enjoyed an amazing dinner as recommended by David. Fuego was also delicious with Ricardo and Aaron. The buffet didn't disappoint for breakfast and lunch, the waiters were all very attentive.

reviews.author: keight1365
reviews.title: Perfect Getaway!
reviews.text: I loved everything about this resort and Cancun.   Admittedly, I was not expecting to be overly impressed - my thoughts were that Cancun is a passe place to travel in Mexico if you're not in college.  I was wrong.  I guess there's a reason why Cancun was one of the first popular travel destinations in Mexico.  The location is great (close to the airport) and the beaches and water are spectacular.  There is a lot to see and do nearby for individuals with varied interests.  As far as the resort - Impressive!! The staff at a resort can make or break your experience and everyone at Paradisus is friendly, accommodating and professional.  I was particularly impressed by the qualify of service provided by our waitress at the beach, Asuncion.  Never did we have to wait for a fresh cold drink or replenishment of buckets of ice for our waters.  And all the drinks were well-made with top-shelf alcohol.  The food was delicious, too  As a group of ten we sampled three of the restaurants - The Mediterranean Tapas, Brazillian Bbq and Mexican (Mole Restaurant).  All were great but our experience at Mole was truly special.  Our party was fortunate to secure a private room - our Captain, Efrain, and waiter, Daniel, were both beyond accommodating; and the meal prepared by Chef Irving was mouth-watering.  The buffet was quite impressive too - my personal favorite was the fresh high-quality fish available at every meal  (salmon, Mahi Mahi, cevechi, etc) also the coconut ice cream was amazing. The people everywhere are friendly, engaging and hard-working and quite appreciative of any extra tipping you feel inclined to give.  Well-deserved to most in my opinion!

reviews.author: Lesly H
reviews.title: Great Group Vacation!
