reviews.text: We stayed here with a large group of friends and family (all adults). After a slow check-in, we had no complaints. Food, drinks, pool and beach were all amazing! The beach area is very close and made it easy to go back and forth to find friends. Everything was well maintained and clean and the service was excellent! The main pool with swim up bar is a little deep (I'm 5'5" and was on tip toe) but not a major issue. Our flights were canceled going home and the hotel worked with us to allow us to add an extra day with no notice. We would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Melissa S
reviews.title: I would've given it 10 stars!
reviews.text: My husband and I were extremely pleased with the Paradisus. The rooms were clean with all of the amenities, the beach was larger than our last resort, the hotel itself was beautiful, and the food was FANTASTIC! The Mediterranean restaurant was by far the best food we had. We rented a cabana on the beach for a day, and our waiters made us feel like we were royalty. The service was impeccable and we hope to go back again next year!

reviews.author: Paula E
reviews.title: Bravo to Bust
reviews.text:
I travel often and have plenty of experiences to measure this place against. It’s a nice place with a great beach and delicious food. Most of the staff was wonderful...except for a few unfortunate events. 

Night one of our stay was interrupted at 2 am by intoxicated college kids who got confused and came pounding on our door trying to get in thinking it was their room. The entry attempts happened several times. Then, there was fighting. I finally had to call security to diffuse the situation, but not before one of them threw up against our door (while staff members were there with them). The hotel floors are marble so it made a giant messy puddle against our door and entry. The staff could have cleaned it up at the time but left it until morning. My husband and I tried to leave for breakfast at 8:45 am and it was still there. We called front desk to resolve the issue and they said they would send up someone right away. DIDN’T HAPPEN! An hour and fifteen minutes later it was still not cleaned up. We couldn't jump over it so we were forced to step in it. Quite disgusting. I understand it was not their fault that it happened, but it was indeed their fault it was not cleaned up in timely manner. There was plenty of opportunity to do so. To make matters worse, when I went to the concierge to discuss it with them, the concierge manager quickly angered and said it was "out of their control that it happened" and that clean-up "was being handled". By this time it was 10:15 am. Too little too late in my opinion, with no sympathy nor apologies given whatsoever. We felt very unimportant as guests. 

Then, night two we were woken at midnight by a knock on our door from several staff members telling us our smoke alarm was going off. It wasn’t going off in our room so we were apprehensive to open the door to discuss. Through the door we told them things were fine in the room and they left. A strange way to handle a concern in my opinion. Why not call? It made us uneasy and caused night #2 of interrupted sleep. What started out to be a good experience turned into one that left us with some hard feelings. I would rather give my money to a place that values their guests feelings and takes better care of them. There are plenty of great choices out there.

reviews.author: Sylvia C
reviews.title: Could have been better
reviews.text:
Please note that this is an older hotel. My husband and I had our wedding at the amazing Paradisus in Playa Del Carmen last year and were expecting the same quality. The initial check in was a pain as we asked to switch rooms; the first room was right by the central building and we could hear people and music going on in the atrium. The second room was very old and didn't feel the same so we just accepted it and went on with our vacation. 

The quality of the food was mediocre, nothing special from any of the restaurants here. The drinks, pool-side and beach-side servers were great!  The pool was too cold to enjoy as we visited in early February. The beach was FABULOUS, a little cold but nothing you can't get used to .

During our visit, the waters were too choppy and the red flags were out. Unfortunately, someone drowned one of the days were relaxing on the beach; please take caution!

All in all, either stay at a different hotel in Cancun that has a better value in price and experience or visit the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen.

reviews.author: patience l
reviews.title: Great Spring Break for Family
reviews.text: Came as large party- 8 adults, 9 kids (ranging from 3 to 8). Had a great time~ we did upgrade for concierge, but to be honest- save your money. The best deal to be had were the daybeds by the kiddie pools ~by our third day, the staff knew us and made sure drinks never stopped flowing and kids always had chicken fingers/fries/juice. And i could sit and relax.

reviews.author: Q9690VIvictorr
reviews.title: Victor 2 Review
reviews.text: This was an excellent experience .. the staff was incredible.  We plan to go to the Cuba Melia  hote  next year.  The view, atmosphere, staff, was incredible.   I would recommend this hotel to anyone.  We celebrated my Mom's and Aunts Birthday there

reviews.author: sandhum
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: Checked into the Adults Only section of the resort, and thankful we did! The luxury and service unsurpassed. We were spoilt. We managed to secure the Bali Beds on two of the 4 days we were there which was brilliant and spent time relaxing and sipping cocktails all day at this all inclusive resort! Good variety of restaurants, although food was pretty much mass cooked so we were not expecting too much in quality! Otherwise great spot to stay, unwind, and chill!

reviews.author: Karen B
reviews.title: Lovely Place, Lots to Love but some of the processes are awful
reviews.text: We had a great experience for the most part however the initial check-in was beyond painful. We were upgraded for free to family concierge, and 40 minutes into our meeting with our personal concierge, we were getting the high pressure for the "presentation" (i.e. timeshare type of thing) - she was begging us to meet her for 90 minutes and wanted a credit card. We escaped her relentless attempt but we were pretty exhausted and unnerved from this - we weren't expecting this. They totally screwed up all kinds of dinner reservations - lost them and denied they existed even after we confirmed them. Ok, that was the negative. But the good outweighed the service issues. Nice restaurants, fun entertainment, beautiful beaches, amazing decor. Still not sure why the illy coffee bar is closed for most of the day, but we really loved everything. They need to work on their "people" but the place is great. FANTASTIC spinning classes in the gym - loved the personal trainers and the gym was very high end!

reviews.author: Adventurer563227
reviews.title: Awesome trip!
reviews.text: My husband and I came to Paradisus Cancun for a 7 day vacation. We absolutely loved it! The entertainment staff, Rodrigo, Andrea and Brenda were awesome! We loved all of the nightly shows and the activities around the pool. You can lay by the pool and relax or you can join in on the activities, you won't ever be bored at this resort! All of the staff were great! Thank you Rodrigo, Andrea and Brenda and all of the other staff for making our stay so enjoyable, we will be back!

reviews.author: Alberto G
reviews.title: Charge for extra service, as Royal service, and deliver worst service than a motel
reviews.text:
As soon as you get there they push to sell this special program, that basically does not add any benefit.

What you end up getting is rudeness from the staff, specially manager and people from the help desk staff.

When you ask for something there is no one able to help and redirect to somewhere else.

Once we called the help desk over the phone to check something and they end up transferring  over 5 times until they hangout.

Basically it is the worst service I have ever stayed, mostly for being and all inclusive. 
It advertised it has multiple restaurants. But there is no way to eat in them, they ask for reservation and when you call they tell you they are full, however they are empty.

In the end, we tried to speak with the general manager, who is always busy or does not care.

It was without a doubt the worst experience in Cancun.

In the pro side the installation are good, but not word a dime for the terrible service you received.

reviews.author: H8447DLjulies
reviews.title: Spring Break with a Large Group
reviews.text: I was part of a Spring Break group of 14 moms & their daughters plus extra friends who were Seniors in high school. The Paradisus was what we expected for the price and location of an all-inclusive hotel in Cancun. The hotel was clean, the rooms spacious with nice views, and the property was nicely maintained. However, the food was just mediocre, especially the buffet breakfast and lunch grill. There's little kid-friendly food besides bread or rolls, and no cheddar cheese anywhere so "nachos" were a plate of thick tortilla chips with a scoop of pico de gallo and guacamole on top. It was difficult finding a single chair or group of chairs after 8:00am at the pool or beach....unless you upgrade to the Royal Service Side. We were never able to secure large group dinner reservations before 8:30pm at any of the restaurants, despite calling each day at 7:00am as recommended by the hotel. The beach was picturesque, but service was slow and there were people peddling their wares all day long. The chairs at both the pool and beach were extremely uncomfortable, and there weren't enough chairs (although there was enough space) for peak times when the hotel was at capacity. The drinks were very good - and Christian was an outstanding waiter for our group of moms who would stay by the pool while the girls spent the day on the beach. I personally would choose a more upscale, non-all inclusive hotel if I travel to Cancun in the future.

reviews.author: rajesht531
reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text: Enjoyed every moment. Food is excellent quality. Bars were great. Everyone is very friendly. Staff is amazing. It was an amazing experience. Restraints were great, Naos and Vento. Although the two restaurants were not inched in all inclusive package, I think it will be great if they can add them to all inclusive. Will sure go again. Would benefit by adding more activities.

reviews.author: allison m
reviews.title: Paradisus Resort
reviews.text: Would suggest the all inclusive package to everyone! Our experience was amazing and we can't wait to go back for our anniversary and eventually with children. We had delicious food and drinks (all unlimited) and wouldn't want to go anywhere else for vacation.

reviews.author: DebBoo
reviews.title: This all-inclusive needs some help
reviews.text:
I am fortunate enough to have visited many resorts around the world, and I need to report that the pool and beach lounge chairs are the most uncomfortable I have ever experienced.  They are either completely broken or in terrible disrepair.  

Additionally, there are several meal options and restaurant choices on the property.  However, I found too many "fusion" choices for dinner. Why not have one serve Italian food?  There were nights I sat down for dinner and found nothing on the menu I could eat.  

The only exception was the phenomenal Tempo restaurant.  The service was impeccable, the food presentation was unique and the meals delicious! 

One more thing that concerned me was, as a handicapped woman, I found no ramps for beach access... only stairs.  This limited my use of the beach and swimming in the ocean.

Sitting around the pool was fine, except for inconsiderate guests blasting music from personal speakers.  The resort needs to address this by asking people to use personal headphones. I moved several times each day to avoid loud music. It certainly was not a peaceful experience!

reviews.author: Phil L
reviews.title: Great family vacation/awesome kids zone
reviews.text:
Overall, the resort had exceeded my own expectations in terms of quality of service and food. My comments resonant other positive comments made about this place in the previous posts, but one thing I do want to highlight is the baby club/kids zone, which was a life safer for my wife and I. My 2 year old son and 6 year old daughter wanted to be at the kids zone and baby club everyday complementing our visit to the pool/beach. 

The staff at the kids zone/baby club were very accommodating and showed nothing but kindness and care for my kids. The kids zone always had different activities planned each day such as crafts, pizza making day, sand castle competitions and other outdoor activities. For any busy parents who needs a bit of quiet time at the resort don't hesitate to use the kids zone/baby club!

reviews.author: Quantummottle
reviews.title: Excellent value. All-around good
reviews.text:
The location of the hotel was excellent. The beach, although rough when we were at the resort - it was spectacular. Although the hotel was full, it did not seem that crowded, given the vast. size of the hotel. The service was friendly and efficient 

One complaint I had was that the cocktails were really watered-down. I would avoid having cocktails and stick to pure liquor such as whiskey, wine or bourbon or sake if that is what u like. I did that and was pleased with that

I would go for blue agave, naos, the tapas place and avoid the Asian restaurant. The sushi restaurant location is the best especially late night. 

Overall, we stayed four nights there and enjoyed every moment of it. Make sure you have a oceanfront room as the view is amazing

reviews.author: Mark W
reviews.title: ***Best service ever!***
reviews.text: Short and sweet review... rooms were nice; typical hotel beds. (Lots of Spanish channels on tv lol) Mini frig stocked daily. Pools were not crowded, and felt like they were heated which was nice. Beach is pretty, but waves are very rough. Food was plentiful and everything we ate was wonderful. The #1 thing I can tell you about this hotel is the service.... everyone went above and beyond. Best service I have ever received at an all inclusive resort. Tips are not required, but we did because of the excellent service. Definitely 5 stars!

reviews.author: benjaminrB6632KX
reviews.title: Excellent Trip
reviews.text: We had a great time at Paradisus. The best part of the trip was our butler, Erik. We had the royal service and Erik assisted us the entire time. He made the trip so much better and he was there to assist us anyway we needed.

reviews.author: Audrey S
reviews.title: All inclusive are not just for drinkers!
reviews.text:
Hello travelers,
This was the first time my husband and I stayed at an all inclusive. We have always thought we would not get our money's worth since we are not big drinkers. We were wrong and are hooked. 
Let me first say we did stay on the Royal service side and did not share in the spring break experience going on the other side of the resort. My husband said he was thrilled I talked him into upgrading to royal service, ocean view. Much more our pace.
We did have some cons so let me outline both for you.

Pros: 
1. The rooms were beautiful as were the views. 
2. The beach is very nice, had no idea they would be so beautiful on that side of Cancun!
3. The palapas or cabanas were very comfortable and they really did make our trip exceptional. For management purposes, please acknowledge your pool staff member for us, Carlos as he really did go out of his way to make our trip special. And the pool was so clean and warm! I really appreciated the ability to get as many towels as you needed.
4. The food at the exclusive royal service Palapa Restaurant hit the mark every time! Their poolside menu was no less yummy! We had a hard time going anywhere else!
5. The royal service lounge was honestly my favorite place in the hotel. peaceful, beautiful and the drinks and snacks were such a pleasure. Here we did manage to have a couple of glasses of wine and Disorono! The entertainment in the lounge was wonderful.
6. My massage was perfection, the spa is quite is nice.
7. The restaurants were amazing! I'm not sure I understand the negative comments, maybe it was just a fluke and I'm sorry for it. Because our meals were exceptional. Our favorites were Enzo, Blue Agave, Vento and Market Grill (book earlier for Brazilian night, you get a better selection). Mole was our least favorite ( the thres leches was really good though) and we are not big sushi fans, but Bana is still a beautiful restaurant. 
The butlers make your reservation and we simply told Hector to surprise us. It was fun getting our note each day with which restaurant we would be dining at.
8. Most of the staff were very good. And check in for Royal service was a plus. We appreciated the arm bracelets opposed to those plastic cheap ones.
9. There are several other perks of royal service, but I don't want to spoil the surprises for you. Don't miss out on the pillow menu. ;) 

Cons:
1. I had only made one request when we arrived on Wednesday (I even called prior to arrival since we were staying at another resort in Cancun for 5 days prior to Paradisus.) I needed two day passes for guest for Friday, a Palapa by the pool and dinner reservation for Market grill that evening. I was given FIVE, yes five different prices for the day pass ( I understand this is not a common occurrence but come on!). After paying the highest quoted price of course ($300), when our guest went to leave that evening the concierge was not going to give them back their ID stating we didn't pay enough. First, I was infuriated that he would discuss money in front of our guest and make them feel embarrassed. I'm not the type to ask for a manager, but I did let the staff no exactly what I thought of his rude behavior and unprofessional-ism. Second, earlier that day we had no palapa reservation when we went out to the pool. Our butler assured us he had made the reservation but the staff stated there was nothing they could do. The bad part about this was that this request was not just for simply wanting one, but we needed one as one of our guest could not be in the sun. Upside to the complaint, one of the concierge staff, I feel awful for forgetting her name (Mont....something or another) really took my concern to task and was able to get us a palapa and you could tell she was happy to deliver the good news. Other than that day, we had no other request and I feel our butler, Hector tried his best to do for us, but nothing was really needed. The small touches he did do to enhance our vacation was very nice and appreciated.  
2. Housekeeping seems to have difficulty with the towel situation, I couldn't get a hand towel or wash cloth to save my life. Other guest stated the same thing, not sure what that is about. But the bath towels are huge and toiletries are nice.
3. THIS IS A BIGGIE, DO NOT, again do not get a ground floor room as the sewer backs up. Our room smelled so awful three days before we left. It was so bad I was up at night gagging and couldn't sleep. No one offered to change our room. They called maintenance three times to come, but I think it just made it worse. Then they would spray to mask the smell and it just made it smell like flowers and sewage. 
I'm not sure if its the fact that this is a European owned resort or the Mexican management that just does not care about compensation for such inconveniences. I would be embarrassed not to offer some sort of refund or compensation if it were my business.
4. Although, this particular issue did not happen to us, it is well worth mentioning for you reviewers and travelers during winter seasons. Winter storm Stella cancelled many of the resort guest's flights. The hotel was not at all accommodating other than to allow them to stay (because no one was getting in to Cancun either). They charged these guest exorbitant amounts to stay, even tripling their rate, up to $1100 per night. We had made some initial plans to return to the Paradisus with some guest that we had become well acquainted with and after the way the resort handled this situation neither couple plans to return. That seemed to me unreasonable that the hotel would not want to at least match their current rate to keep them as returning guest. It was not as if they didn't have the rooms.

Well traveler, I leave it up to you to decide. My husband and I are currently looking at this and other Melia resorts as well as other label resorts to visit in January/February 2018. We actually were going to re-book while we were guest, but they do not offer any discounts for immediate re-booking. So they may lose out to another resort. There are usually good with bad, and Paradisus has much more good, enough for us to consider a second shot. Besides we would hate to miss Carlos's birthday in January! 

Oh, and although we are platinum cruisers we definitely like the all inclusive resort best! So glad we tried it!

The Schroeders

Taxi to the Airport $28 or currently 350 pesos.

reviews.author: uhlcheezer
reviews.title: Totally rejuvinated!
reviews.text:
Our family of 3 stayed at this resort March 7-14 and had an amazing time.

Check in-This was the first time our 7 year old daughter has been out of the country so we splurged for Family Concierge and I must say, it was awesome. Upon entering the hotel we were swept away to the family private lounge. We immediately had beers in our hands and our daughter was sipping chocolate milk and eating sweet treats.  We got our bracelets, picked our bottle of booze, met our butlers Josue and Alexander and were on our way to the room within 10 minutes. Easy, fast, efficient.

Room- We booked the Family Concierge Suite lagoon view.  The suite consisted of a sitting room with a pull out couch, a bedroom with a king bed, a spacious bathroom and 2 large balconies.  The hotel property is huge and with that being said I’m so happy our room was located on the 6th floor in the main Pyramid 3 so we were close to everything (yes, be prepared to get lost).  We didn’t notice any evening noise, but maybe that’s because we were facing the lagoon which was still very beautiful!

Family Concierge-We enjoyed all the perks of Josue and Alexander and found the phone they gave us handy to contact them at any time.  Our daughter was thrilled when she saw that she got her own robe, slippers, backpack, beach gear and spa kit.  She looked forward to the daily toys, treats, and trinkets.  My husband and I were also spoiled with a bottle of alcohol each evening which always came with various snacks and appetizers.  Our dinner reservations were taken care of with ease. When Josue found out we were doing a daytrip to Isla Mujeres he printed off bus routes, ferry shuttle times and costs.  This is something we could have done on our own but so appreciated not having to lift a finger! Alexander handled our slight mix-up with airport transfer with ease which was very reassuring.

Grounds-The atmosphere was very tranquil and lush-greenery, comfy couches and fountains everywhere.  Gals leave your flat irons at home because yes…it is humid! I found the incense and evening darkness throughout the resort relaxing, not annoying as some have stated.  Wifi signal was strong everywhere even the beach!

Food- We ate at Bana, Market Grill, Blue Agave, Fuego, Mole, Vento and of course Naos-the buffet.  The buffet had a nice variety and was fine for breakfast and lunch, but we enjoyed trying all the restaurants for dinner. Service and food at Mole and Market Grill were top notch and were our favorites.  Vento was our least favorite.  Our daughter was able to eat off a kids menu or the buffet so she was perfectly happy each evening at the restaurants. Dress was resort casual- my husband was fine in a nice t-shirt and shorts.

Pool/ocean-Ocean was beautiful but rough, plenty of seating available.  Pool chairs were hard to come by.  Get there early or rent a bed.  Concierge set us up with a bali bed on our last day which was amazing!  Yes, all the pools are very deep (I’m 5’7” and found it annoying at times) but various floaties are sold poolside so we purchased a few and paid it forward by giving it to new friends when we left.
   
Gym- I tried to go to spinning class one morning and it was cancelled.  I did my own workout on the bike and it was not in good working order.  I did not go in the weight/cardio equipment so I can’t speak for the condition of that equipment.

Entertainment- We loved seeing the shows each night, but as others said, there is not much room to see so get there early or be prepared to stand.

Kids Club- Plenty of fun activities happening throughout the day to get the kids out of the sun.  Cupcake/cookie decorating, pizza making, wax art, pottery and the list goes on.  Our daughter made many new friends through this and even asked to go some days!  When we were alone we were allowed to use the adult only facilities, but we actually preferred the main pool over that side of the resort so didn’t take advantage of those amenities much.

Photos-We scheduled a photo session one morning and I’m so happy we did because the pictures were beautiful.  If only I had the money to purchase them all!
   
Thank you Paradisus staff for making our family vacation peaceful, carefree and without a doubt, memorable!

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Excellent Time
reviews.text: We stayed for 7 nights and enjoyed it very much. The buffet was very good for breakfast and we especially want to mention our waiter we had for breakfast everyday Atilano. He went beyond what is expected from a waiter at a buffet. He was polite and VERY attentive to our needs and wants. We also should mention the night the buffet had lobster tails was excellent except for the Asian women who were VERY pushy and expected the whole tray of lobster tails belonged to them. The other restaurants were also very good and the cocktails were good all day and night. Would highly reccomend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: M. King
reviews.title: It really his the paradise
reviews.text:
It was such a wonderful experience for our first trip of me and my fiance.

I shall describe de pros and cons so that you can have a good idea of the place

First of all, the Royal Service is a must. You really get pampered like you never been before. It is worth every dollars spent. Both of normal and royal service lobbies are amazing.

We got a private transfer from QTS Cancun. They did great with the cadillac escalade and are in the prices. The driver Luis was really nice and gave good service. I was only disappointed with the transfer from the hotel to the airport, since the cadillac had mishap so we had an executive suburban. They did paid back the difference of 30 usd tho that I would have wanted a special price because of that.

Pros: 
1.The check in. When you are in the royal service, you get to check in at the royal service lobby. Everything is calm there, no kids running around. You meet your butler and get a glass of champagne. I give a special mention to Rosanna (Our butler) and Carlos at the royal service lobby, they really made sure everything was perfecto. We had a problem with the door of our bathroom and she upgraded us for free in a deluxe room. If you can get oceanview, the view if amazing. You get premium alchool in your room, which also includes tequila from the hotel reserve. There's also a little snack throughout the day and a chocolate fountain at evening. 

2. The royal service pool with bali beds. You get two days guaranteed of bali bed per stay. The pool is only for royal service and they don't fool around with that. Someone tried to get in there and the security ran at him to get him out of the royal service space. So, no kids here. Really calm and perfect. The pool concierge will make sure you have everything you need. Extra towels, sunscreen, aloes, get the waiter to you. I have to give a special mention to Carlos (one of the pool concierge) and Victor (He was our waiter for two days). They were exceptionnal and we got to share our culture from Quebec with Carlos. 

3. The restaurants. I cannot say how much they were good. It is worth of the 5 stars. We first ate at the Enso, which is asian fusion food. The food is good there and you get to eat near the sea.

On tuesday we ate the Vento, which is mediteranean food. Wow, it was really good. Every small dishes combines perfectly. 

On wednesday we ate at the market grill. Here, it is BBQ food. You have every meat you could dream of. The experience is amazin and the food is great.

On thursday we ate at Fuego. We had our waiter Gama.Special mention to him. I can't say enough of this guy, he gave us the best service for the a la carte restaurant. He was truly amazing. The food here is latin food. Really really good.

On friday we ate at the Bana. If you like sushis, this is the place. My fiance and I are not really into that type of food, but it was good.

Here comes the most amazing restaurant. On saturday we ate at the Tempo. Believe me, it is worth the extra money. It's 65 USD to get the tasting menu, and I strongly suggest you to pair it with the premium wine 100 USD or the normal wine 66 USD. I took the premium wine pairing and my fiance took the normal one. First of all, the service is amazing, you will feel like a prince. Everything is perfect here. When you choose the premium wine pairing, the sommelier explains you every wine with each meal. (You get a 10 services here). I tried differents champagne, red and white wines. Even got a taste of a chardonnay from france which won many prices. If you know how to taste wines and the subtil differences between each wines, the sommelier will love it and you can engage a good conversations about wines with him. You get to meet the Chef too and the restaurant manager. Special mention to all of them, Carlos our waiter, Carlos the Sommelier and Clement the Manager. 

For breakfast we mostly eat at the Palapas (royal service restaurant). You are close to the sea and the food is really good. 

4. The SPA. Best relaxing place ever. 

5. You have a safe in your room with a pin number that you choose. Really convenient.

So, once again, special thanks to Rosanna our butler, Carlos the pool concierge, Carlos at the Royal service lobby, Carlos the Sommelier, Carlos the waiter at the Tempo, Clement at the Tempo, Gama at the Fuego. Don't forget to give them good tips, they work hard 6 days a week. If you give good tips, they will give you all the special attentions. We got 4 days with bali beds at the pool with good tips instead of 2.

Cons:

There's only one. The room cleaning wasn't always good. They forgot coffee cup many days. I put my shoes in the basket to get shined  and they didn't do it. They often forgot towels for the bathroom. Even thought we gave good tips to them, they didn't do the job like they are supposed too. We had to ask to our Butler or Carlos at the royal service lobby many times.

Beside of that, there wasn't a single mistake from the staff.

Truly amazing experience.

reviews.author: Bob H
reviews.title: Very nice vacation
reviews.text: Overall good value. Excellent beach. Nice staff especially breakfast crew (thanks Ignacio). If you're a beer drinker very limited choices. Beach chairs could be a little more comfortable, they're too stiff and only one reclining position. But will go back.

reviews.author: schellmas
reviews.title: Could be so much better!
reviews.text: Average food quality, poor service at dinner & watered down drinks made me very frustrated.  I would have paid extra for a decent glass of wine but only bottles were available.  Rooms are dated and mattress was sunken.  Had to get up early too book dinner reservations if yo want to eat before 9:30.  Also had to save chairs by pool before 8:30.  Coffee shop doesn't open until 10 a.m.  Great yoga teacher but no blocks available for the class. Would not go back.

reviews.author: nicwill4370
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We really loved this place and I highly recommend the Royal Service. This section of the hotel is adults only and you have a separate pool and beach section. Daniel was our butler and he was amazing and always went out of his way to assist and accommodate.  Everyone was extremely helpful and accommodating. The food was pretty good at all the restaurants but our favorites were La Palapa (Royal Service only) for breakfast and lunch; Bana and Vento. I will definitely be back here soon.

reviews.author: rrpastor
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: One of the nicest all-inclusive resorts we stayed at. The facilities, the variety of food at the buffet and the accommodating staff all made for a very enjoyable stay. On the downside, the housekeeping staff could have been more attentive.  Had to ask for wash cloths, toilet paper, only left one glass as examples.  All-in-all, would recommend this place and would return if plans allowed

reviews.author: Donald J
reviews.title: Great time at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Spent March5-12 at Paradisus with husband and another couple. 
Great resort. Hardest working staff we have ever experienced.
Staff run not walk to meet needs of guests.
Entertainment with Rodrigo, Andrea and Brenda was great.

reviews.author: alexiaef
reviews.title: good hotel
reviews.text: when i check in i was very disappointed, not even water was offered and the room they gave us at first was like a cheap motel, when i book the hotel, was lagoon view; when i got my room was like a basement and wall view, they move us to lagoon view next day; and the first day we went to have dinner to the buffet and they did not have even meet, i ask for it and they got me some very very dry from the back i couldn't eat it. We were going to cancel our vacation, but that night we met Daniel the manager from Mole and he was so nice and he invited us to have dinner at Mole, he made us change our mine; also the hostess were very nice Mayely, Alexandra, Katy; the girls from Baby Club and Kids Club, the servers were very polite, house keeping, well every person was very nice. We were not told that the hotel has Baby Club, they told us that they have Kids Club and they only take kids from 5 and older, so we dint take advantage of Baby Club until 3 days before departure we find out.

reviews.author: Brenda J
reviews.title: loved it
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed in the royal service, ocean front, balcony. To me it was the best location on the property.  It is a beautiful room/ living room area (jr suite), gigantic bathroom, very clean.  Royal service lounge/ bar/ food area is a delightful service. Rosanna, our butler, helped us with all our requests, restaurant reservations, massages, keeping any rain away.  The staff at the pool, beach were very helpful, checking in frequently, Cesar, Jorge- who remembers what you like to drink,  Carlos.  We each had massages, read a few books, took endless walks on that long beach, stopping to dance to the music on the beach at the center of the property.  I have not seen a  better beachfront set up than Paradisus on the strip- even with marriot and ritz nearby.  Pool was delightful.  A delicious meal at Tempo (not included),  Enjoyed Mole, MarketGrille food the most, less focused on atmosphere.  Enso has great atmosphere, appetizers good. A windy week, red flags at the ocean every day, so pool swimming was our speed, and the heat made you happy to hop in, and pool area protected enough off the beach for a less windy time.

reviews.author: KellyBurgATX
reviews.title: Nice But Needs Some Work
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time, the service was impeccable and the grounds are nice.  We stayed in a regular room.  Our friends upgraded to the Royal Service.  Their room had been updated and was more modern.  

Pros:
-Lots of restaurants to choose from
-Beautiful beach and view of beach from pool
-Not stingy with pool towels - no keeping up with a towel card!
-Service was top notch
-Pool side entertainment was good
-Pool snack bar had pretty good food for a snack bar
-The service with the poolside cabanas was awesome and came with a better food menu
-The onsite nightclub is fun and kept us from going downtown (saved money!)

Cons:  
-The main pool is too deep - I'm 5'4" and had to stand on my very, very tippy toes to keep my head above water - not ideal for hangin out in the water or standing around drinking in the pool (it is shallower at the pool bar, just too deep in the rest of the pool)
-My room had bugs
-The pool tiles needs some repairs
-The evening entertainment started too early.  They should have 2 showings.  You need to go to dinner pretty early to see the show.  Our dinner reservations were at 8pm each night and we always missed the show
-The check in and out line SUCKED!  Everyone was trying to check in and out at the same time and it was slow and hot and frustrating
-While the menu with the pool cabanas was more expansive, my chicken tenders came out raw - GROSS!
-My favorite meal was lunch in the Taco restaurant.

reviews.author: onthego49joliet
reviews.title: Lots of rest and relaxation
reviews.text: We stayed in the Ocean View Royal Service side. The room was very clean. The room is stocked with full bottles of rum, vodka, tequila,whiskey so don't purchase anything at duty free when you arrive. Also in the refrigerator is beer, soda and snacks. Royal Service assigns you a butler. Ours was Gerardo. He took care of everything for us. All our restaurant reservations and always visited us everyday to make sure everything was going well and if we needed anything. We could also call him if we needed anything. The pool area in this section is just for adults. Carlos took very good care of us. You can ask for as many beach towels as you need, they have suntan lotion aloe vera (so don't bring any) The bali beds in this section is no charge so well worth upgrading because coco loco will charge you 115 a day in peak season. Plus the Royal service side has its own restaurant that offers very good food for breakfast and lunch and food on the beach if you like. The beach is huge!!! and lots of chairs and grass hut umbrellas as well. no matter what time of the day you can find something. The atmosphere at this resort has a lot of plants inside which are very pretty. Market grill was our favorite restaurant. They are a Brazilian menu they just keep the food coming till you tell them to stop. Our last night we ate by the pool. They had pasta and all kinds of other stuff but it was all good. I have stayed at other resorts in Mexico and I would return here. The one thing this resort could use is more entertainment and space for it. Everyone squeezes into the Avenue bar to watch a nightly show.

reviews.author: Julian F
reviews.text:
We just came back from a 6 night stay at this hotel. 
Pros:absolutely amazing property. Rooms are clean and spacious. Upgrade to ocean view. The view is amazing

Con:One of the staff Alex you guys need to be aware of him. First when we checked in he was like meet me tomorrow and we will go over dinner reservations etc. we told him we need help getting a cake for our son's birthday and balloons in the room. He took the information and promise he will help us out. Alex did not help with the cake because we didn't go to the timeshare presentations. We took a cab and went to Walmart. Beware of ALEX, he is a con and a horrible staff. Another weird thing that happens on Saturday march 11th the entire phone system was down in the hotel. However the phones at the front desk and concierge works. Another incident i have is that we miss the dinner reservations at market grill for our sons birthday by 30mins. I explained to the manager and she would not let us eat when the restaurant was empty. The kids club is a big no no. The staff told me that she cannot keep the kids if they cried. The staff is very incompetent and are not well trained. The baby  room for 1-4 years old is lacking, especially if your kids are more developed. We ate at Blue Agave most of the time, the food is amazing. Leah in Blue agave is such a good waitress. Few staff such as Rosa at concierge is helpful. The pool service waiters were nice and helpful.Alejandra in the buffet is such a sweetheart. When i told her about my incident, she went and get a happy birthday ballon for my son. Such a kind gesture. What i realize is if you tip the staff before service they treat you well. If you don't tip the service is horrible. Even though the property is nice, i will not return. The timeshare people are like vultures. Even when you say no they continue to push relentlessly. It is such a turn off. Also bring enough singles to tip. We tip on average $US10 daily.

reviews.author: Erin G
reviews.title: A wonderful vacation, thanks to Paradisus, Cancun!
reviews.text:
We vacationed in Cancun March 8th-13th, 2017 (Wed-Mon).   I think we picked the perfect time of year!  It was beautiful weather (mid 80s) with nothing but blue skies.   I don't know if it is always like this, but the hotel had the perfect amount of people staying while we were there.   Our group of four ranged between ages 39-63, so we were there to have a great time without too many disruptive party-goers or small children.   At no time did it seem like there were too many people there!  We thought the pools would be packed full, but it was just the opposite!  Sometimes we would look around and we were the only people swimming.   There is one large pool that stretches down to one end of the hotel, it was a bit more chilly, but still lots of fun.  There was a swim up bar located in the middle, and we went to that one day and had fun.  The next day we discovered the heated pool on the other side which was smaller and even LESS crowded!  That pool had the most gorgeous, unobstructed views of the ocean.  Our favorite day was lounging from 7:30am-4:00pm looking out into the gorgeous blue water.   
The rooms were nice and clean, there were no complaints, but also nothing too spectacular with them.  We had a larger king suite ocean view that had a sitting area, so it was nice to have some extra room.   The bed was firm, but not uncomfortable.  The mattress was pretty warn, but still comfortable.  There were just a couple of minor things that could have been improved with the room, but nothing that we felt the need to complain about.   We had a room overlooking the pool  and beach on level 0 - so it was a little noisier than some the higher rooms.  That is expected though.  We were fine with it.   My folks had a room on the lagoon side on the top floor (5)  It was an amazing view!  **Side note, the room type is not guaranteed.   You can request a king suite, but that doesn't mean you will get it.  We originally got a room with 2 doubles.  I went down to find out what happened with the king and they told us that it is a just a request.   But, they were able to find us one room left that had a king.  We were very pleased.  There was a mini bar with snacks, beer, pop and water.   They were very good about restocking for us.   Housekeeping was fine, for some reason we kept getting shorted washcloths, not sure why, but we would just request them and they would bring them down.  

The dinners were very good.  We ate at the following restaurants: 

Blue Agave - Simple Mexican choices like tacos and quesadillas.  Very casual

Dinner buffet by the pool - Italian feast.  This was so good!  Some delicious seafood and pasta.  We watched and listened to the waves by moonlight.  It was fantastic! 

Vento - Tapas restaurant.   It was fun to choose several different foods that were basically tiny portions.   We ordered a bottle of wine, but didn't realize that you have to pay for the bottles.  It was fine, we just didn't know it was extra.   

Bana - Japanese.   Definitely the best meal of the weekend.  Sushi, dumplings, noodles, seafood salads.  Everything was so delicious!    This is the restaurant located in the middle of the atrium.  It was my favorite place to be.  Tropical plants and trees everywhere!

Mole - Contemporary Mexican.   It was very good, I just didn't care for my meal in particular.  I had the Poblano Pepper and it was a bit bitter.   However, the sea bass and salmon were wonderful.   Also, the cappuccino soup was AMAZING!  It totally looks like a cup of coffee with foam on top, but it was the yummiest bean soup every!  

Enso - Asian.   This was good food, nothing amazing, but I still really enjoyed it.  Also it was a beautiful location, right in the middle of the pool, overlooking the ocean.  

The buffets were good for breakfast and lunch.   There is a huge variety of food and desserts.   Some very interesting choices, but I think they are trying to cater to many different cultures, which I think is wonderful.    There is a little snack bar at one end of the pool that was not great.   Avoid pizza at all costs in all of the restaurants - pretty awful....but that's ok!  

The waitstaff was absolutely wonderful.  There were a couple of people that stood out to us - David at the Italian dinner the first night was definitely our favorite!  He even remembered us the next day when we were just walking around.   Ulyssis was our waiter by the Coco's beach club pool on Sunday and he was fantastic!  He came around all day and took care of us.  We even felt comfortable leaving all of our belongings in our chairs while we went down to the beach.   The hostesses in the Naos buffett were always so nice when we came down for breakfast.   Also the waiters in there would carry our food back to our table and lay our napkins in our laps when we sat down.  We felt like royalty! 

Definitely the most memorable thing about the hotel was the gorgeous plants and fountains in the atrium.   The main lobby area has thousands of plants and trees and it feels like you are outside.  They have philodendrons hanging from each floor and some of the vines were maybe 50ft long!  It was amazing!   Also, I am ALWAYS cold, everywhere I go.  I always have to have a cardigan with me, especially for restaurants.   The main part of the hotel stays a very comfortable temperature (I assume because of its sheer size and because the tropical plants need the humidity)   If you are naturally warm, you may want to consider this.   I absolutely loved it because we would come in from the pool or beach wet, i didn't freeze to death!   

We had an amazing time at Paradisus.  Thank you to everyone that made it so memorable.  I have already told a few people that are looking to travel to Cancun about this hotel.  We would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Kristine S
reviews.title: Had a great week here!
reviews.text: First, I have to disagree with many of the negative reviews on here. We did experience anything really negative at all, there were a few minor things but nothing at all like some of the posts.  To start off, check in was a bit slow when we arrived but it was because they had to get us set up with the all inclusive package and make copies of our birth certificates, etc.  We had two suites booked and they accommodated us to be on the same floor like 3 rooms apart so that was great. You do have to make dinner reservations every day for the next day, early in the morning so do that right as you wake up. Right as you arrive you can make a reservation for that evening as well as the next night, you can't make them days in advance, only the day/morning before. The first night we were there we ate at Enso, it was average and we didn't dine there again, then we did the buffet the second night, which is great, there is a ton of stuff to choose from. Bana was our favorite we ate their twice. Great sushi and such a great atmosphere..  Fuego was ok not our favorite either. We were unable to eat at Mole because it never had openings which is too bad. I do agree with a post in regards to children being at the swim up bar. Some were sitting on the seats at the bar and some parents propped their kids on the bar. This I thought was not appropriate. They are taking a seat away from someone who is 18 and they for sure should not be sitting on the bar.  As far as pool chairs go, they need more,  you really cannot save chairs for more than 30 minutes, you have to physically be there or leave something personal on the chair, do not only leave towels, the staff will remove them! The service at the pool is awesome, just keep throwing them dollars and pesos, they treat you like royalty. The ocean is rough but it always is in Cancun. I highly recommend renting one of the beds on the beach for the day, it is $150 from 9-5 but it is a day of royalty and so worth it. You get waited on the entire time, they bring you drinks, lunch, towels, and top shelf champagne is included, they have Moet and Chandon or Veuve Clicquot which is what we had. I do have to say my boys 16 and 13 were a bit bored since there is literally only pool and rough ocean all day and no activities for them, but they enjoyed the unlimited food and just being away from home. They ordered breakfast room service every day and loved that, but if you are not 18 and or do not drink, that is what people do all day since it is an all inclusive, so I see why my kids were bored, they aren't big loungers lol. . Sometimes when they clean your room, you do have to continue to ask for waters and towels for your room, but that's Mexico and it's not a big deal, they accommodate right away and then give extras of everything. I recommend this resort for sure. We had a great time.

reviews.author: DeniseD76
reviews.title: Travelling with a toddler/family
reviews.text:
We just got back from Paradisus Cancun and had a really great time.  It was our first time travelling with a child, so thought I'd share some things I would have found helpful before hand.

1. The hotel is clean and well kept. Sure there are some dings in wall, paint chips, etc, but seriously how much are you in the room you care about paint? Bottom line is the room was very clean as were the grounds.  We saw many "supervisors" (we assumed) doing checks with clipboards on rooms being cleaned, the day beds at the pools and the pool itself making sure things were clean and kept.  And if not you saw a worker come by soon after and all was better. 

2. They are quick to address any concerns.  
Odd thing was the smoke detector was smack over our bed and flashed on standby all night and would sometimes just come on full blast like a spotlight-a nuisance at night! I called down and someone came and put tape over the lights - slept just fine. 
We had our daughter with us (20mos), and needed room for the crib, they sent someone up to help us move the beds together to create room.  
A couple times we were in our room for her nap and they couldn't clean, just called down when she woke and they came right up to do it while we headed out again. Same with the person who stocks the fridge.  
We did have 1 day where we did not get any facecloths, I'm sure if I called down it would have been resolved but we lived til the next day.  
Our phone was flashing and didn't stop, I fixed that by unplugging it but they did say they could send someone up.  
Our safe wasn't operational at check in, I called and they sent up a technician immediately and it was fixed and he took time to show me how to operate it. 
Bottom line, if you have a problem you can call down or speak to any of the Guest Services people (desks are throughout hotel) and they get on it.

3. We got a Junior Suite, hoping it would be large enough to accommodate the 3 of us, and the crib- it is a bit larger but they have a lot of furniture in the room and there were 2 Queen beds. As I said we had to move the beds together to create some space.  The crib went by the patio doors at the back of the room.  Many parents say use the bathroom - its too small, you'd never get a crib in there at all.  The patio doors are covered by very thick curtains that cover well and the room is quite dark in the day so ideal for naps. oh and there was a tub in the room, but we had to fill it using the shower head. No big deal.

4. We were put in Building 3, on the 7th floor facing the pool which is essentially the main building - good and bad with a child. Good that everything is right downstairs, all the restaurants, and buffet, etc.  Bad is the center court is used for live entertainments which goes til around 11pm so can be loud in the room - we used a white noise app on our phone and she slept fine, as did we. And the sound of the waves drowns out any noise from the pool, didn't hear a thing inside. It's a bit of a walk to the kiddie pool, but you can easily take a stroller the whole way.

5. In front of Building 1 is a kiddie pool - its shallow and all the lounges have shade. There are even lounges in the pool itself.  Depth is only 2ft max. Get there early though as people save and sometimes that just doesn't count.  The service at this pool is awesome! Manuel and Sofino (sp?) were courteous, quick and made our stay.  Most parents are super chill and all the kids toys end up being communal so great if you don't want to bring any.  There is also a small playground and a covered area near the pool where staff come through the day and do crafts with kids or they put on shows or do activities in the pool and whoever wants to join can.

6. Can't comment on the restaurants as our daughter was a bit of a handful so we stuck to the Buffet - food was fine, we thought it was quite good, the seafood spread night was great!, service is really good there too.

7. We did not use the KidZone or Baby Club (I think located in Building 2) but it had good reviews from parents we chatted with at the pool.  Baby Club says a parent has to attend, but those we spoke with said you can leave your child if they are not upset with you leaving and you just check in.

8. Ocean surf was really rough. We had read that before going but I thought we could at least take our daughter in - nope pretty rough.  Red flags were out each day and lifeguards were keeping you out of the water.  Not sure if this is typical for Cancun, or this time of year? It was my first time here, I've stayed further down the Maya Riviera before in March and the water was much calmer.  

Overall, its a great place to stay.  Staff is really nice and while it's not a "kid" resort, all staff work really hard to make you and your children feel really welcome.  I would recommend it again and possibly go back, would be nice to try a lot of the things we didn't get a chance to.

reviews.author: grahamd556
reviews.title: EXCEEDED ALL EXPECTATIONS!
reviews.text:
My partner and I returned from the Paradisus on 1st March this year having had the most wonderful holiday. Everything was perfect from Virgin Atlantic Premium Economy to the many staff at this wonderful resort.
We had booked an Ocean View Suite with Royal Service benefits. I was not 100% sure what this meant, but arriving tired after flying for 10 hours 15 minutes, to be greeted by our own concierge (unfortunately, i cannot remember her name but she was extremely helpful) and given a Margarita on the rocks,and then to be introduced to our amazing butler, Roseanna,who showed us to our upgraded room, the long journey seem to be immediately forgotten!
As other guests have mentioned, The Royal Section is for adults only and has just over 100 rooms. This was nice as the hotel is large. You also have your own bar area which you can help yourself to, or as I did, opt for Alejandro to make the Margaritas which were amazing.
The Palapa is a Royal Service only restaurant serving breakfast and lunch which we opted for everyday throughout our 10 day stay. Yet again, the crew there are so helpful, and happy at their work which shows. Special thanks to Eddie C, George, Valeria, and Moises(he would bring us a bottle of white wine in an ice bucket at lunchtimes!)
The view from there in the morning over looking a deserted beach, is fantastic while you are enjoying eggs benedict with a bucks fizz!
The evening meals were very good. Our favourite was the Market Garden which we went to twice. Unbelievable how much steak and chicken you can eat there. I thought Enzos was average as other guests have said but its a nice setting. Tempo is also worth a visit, especially the taster menu. Wine can be a expensive though.
One thing to note, if you are in the Royal section, the chap at midday on a Monday by the pool playing the trumpet with a DJ playing dance songs is a bit random! Did make us giggle.
Thanks to everyone for making our stay so enjoyable and I certainly hope to be back next year!! (PS Can we have room 5007 and Roseanna again?!) Thank you!

reviews.author: Jeannie J
reviews.title: Nice resort but not all-inclusive as advertised
reviews.text:
Paradisus is a very nice resort, but not all-inclusive as advertised.  We found as soon as we got there that you had to make a reservation at most all of the restaurants for dinner AND we were told there was nothing available – all week.  When we demanded our money back, they all of a sudden were able to make dinner reservations for us for the entire week.  However, we met many people that had been told the same thing as soon as they arrived, and did not know to be tough and they would probably be able to get reservations.  If you don’t have reservations, you are delegated to the pool buffets or one restaurant that does not require a reservation.  I’m not sure why this hotel advertises all-inclusive and then does not want to get you into their restaurants for the meals you are entitled to.  Also, there are certain restaurants on the resort where you cannot eat at all without paying.  And certain drinks and bottles of wine you cannot have without paying.  So this is NOT all-inclusive and they do not tell you that until you are there.  The pools are beautiful and beach is beautiful, but there again not all-inclusive – meaning you have to pay to sit in certain chairs at both places.  Unfortunately those chairs set up to be paid for, sit empty a lot and they take up room where regular beach and pool chairs could be sitting.  Consequently, if you get to the pool or beach too late, you do not get a chair.  One day I saw a very pregnant woman and her family having to sit on a grassy area because there were no chairs.  The food is ok – best meals are breakfast buffet and various lunch items, either in the same location as the breakfast, or out by the pool.  Dinners left a lot to be desired – none of the dinner food was great – maybe we are just used to different where we live because I’ve experienced this everywhere I’ve ever been to eat in Cancun on various trips – nothing seems to be that good.
The best thing about the resort is the staff.  They are amazing and so kind and helpful.  They truly make the stay at this resort!  
In short, if you are wanting real all-inclusive, you probably need to pick a different place.  We will not return to this one.

reviews.author: TamaraNovakov
reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text:
We spent 10 days at the Paradisus from the 7th to the 18th of February. We were two adults and 2 toddlers. 
Had a lagoon view Junior suite since we weren't going to spend any time in the room... 
The hotel : amazing... Beautiful, clean, spacious with an amazing pool and a stunning beach. 
The restaurants: only been to the buffet and the Bana. Bana is horrible... No comments... The buffet is awesome with so many options that in 10 days we didn't get bored (lobster and all) 
Rooms : good size with big balconies but very old and run down. They really need to do some work there... Mold on the ceiling of the bathroom as well as the sink. Paint peeling off the tub... Beds are old and need replacement... 
The kids club is awesome but a little too basic for kids under 5.
The activities such as painting of ceramics and pool games for kids are awesome.. 
The service was incredible, although sometimes slow at the beach. 
We did a photo shoot on the beach and it was very professional. I was hesitant but now I am so happy we did! 
We had an amazing time and we would go back for sure.

reviews.author: Kruti B
reviews.title: This place is absolutely HORRIBLE!!!  Do NOT stay here, so many better places!
reviews.text: I would never stay at the at the Paradisus Cancun again nor would I ever recommend this hotel to anyone.  I have been to Cancun/Playa De Carmen about 9 times and have stayed in other Melia properties.  This one is the worst one by far.  First of all the hotel itself is outdated and dirty.  It did not seem well maintained or cleaned.  The pictures of the rooms on the website are not accurate.  I can get over that part but the worst part was the service.  This place is very expensive compared to other nice properties on the strip in Cancun, so you would think people were coming here for something, if it is not the rooms maybe it is the service?  Not in my experience.  The tipping culture at this hotel is unbelieveable not like anywhere else I have experienced.  I have traveled to the world and have been to many countries and I have never been treated as unwelcomed and unaccommodating as the staff and management in this hotel.  If you do not tip them generously they will not even look at you!  So I am not against tipping – but this is an all inclusive resort, I paid a lot of money to come here and the whole point is not to walk around with my wallet.  At any other all inclusive or Melia property I have not experienced this only this hotel.  The tipping thing was a challenge all around the cleaning and housekeeping staff would not  clean your room if you did not tip, the bar tenders and waiters would not acknowledge you or take your orders, even the front desk would barely acknowledge you.  We had to repeatedly call to have them clean our room.  I was not going to tip out of principle for the fact that I should be treated with respect regardless of tipping as I paid thousands of dollars to stay in the hotel!  One day our room wasn’t cleaned after 5 follows ups – we ended up seeing the turn down service housekeeping cart and grabbing our own towels and stuff to tidy our room and the maid had the nerve to give us a tipping envelope! I will be letting Melia know about this hotel, it does not meet Melia standards, I know Melia itself has high standards and I would recommend they look into the practices of this hotel.  There is some serious issues and mis management going on!

reviews.author: 835gunjank
reviews.title: Great Vaccation
reviews.text: loved my stay at Paradisus, for 5 nights. Its a great place. Good food choice. I would recommend  the  Japanese restaurant Bano, Nice beach and pool area. great kids care system. we had a ocean front room which was good. One issue I found with the room was the wind noise in the night through the glass door was really loud and to a great degree very annoying. may be it was just our room. other than that is was a great experience over all.

reviews.author: Linda M
reviews.title: Great vacation! (March 4 - 11, 2017)
reviews.text: We were booked at Me Cancun, but with the renovations not finished, we were relocated at Paradissus Cancun.  We really enjoyed this property, more than the Me where we had been twice.  The staff is great, especially Jeorge, Eddie and Veronica (manager).  Property is very clean and the food was very tasty.  If you can't find anything to eat at the buffet, I would say you are very fussy!  The drinks were very good too with a wide variety to chose from.

reviews.author: 930abbyf
reviews.title: Great winter vacation!
reviews.text: I love this hotel! I have traveled many places but the service and quality at Paradisus is amazingly high. Tempo is worth every penny a must do experience! Also, make sure you splurge for a cabana one day by the pool, what great service with a perfect view!

reviews.author: Don M
reviews.title: No night life
reviews.text: Horrible layout for night show . The chairs around the pool are not enough no activtes around the pool .First day there waited for water aerobics at noon no one showed up not the way to start a vacation no communication at all.

reviews.author: Bill K
reviews.title: Nice Getaway
reviews.text: Room was ok. We had requested a king size bed with a higher floor 4 months before we came, and were given twin beds on a middle floor (other option was king size on ground floor). All servers - food and beverage - were wonderful, but check-in / check-out staff didn't have great attitudes. Many good restaurants, and nice pool and beach area, though you have to get up early to put towels on chairs to have a spot. Royal Service may be a better experience - but it costs a lot more.

reviews.author: behrle13
reviews.title: Overall a great stay....
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed here for 5 nights end of Feb.Overall this was a very nice resort and we had a wonderful stay. With that being said, I will list the pros/cons we found at this resort:
Pros:
-ocean view rooms are fantastic, there's nothing like seeing that beautiful turquoise water and hearing the waves. The beach here is beautiful!!
-there is a small coffee bar located on the ground level (I never saw this mentioned in the restaurants/amenities for this resort so I was super excited when I found it!)
-awesome snack bar by the pool to grab snacks for lunch instead of leaving the beach/pool to go sit down in at the buffet.
-beach service at this resort is the best I have experienced at any resort we have stayed at., order a BBC (baileys, banana & cream?) or a mini beer shot at the swim-up! 
-there is a beach bar (Coco's?) that is open until midnight 
- The food here is incredible. We ate at Blue Agave (unlimited guacamole!), Enso, the Market Grill (ate here twice, it was the best) and Bana, which was actually our least favorite out of the restaurants we did eat at. 
-10-15 minute bus ride to the mall

Cons:
-Just like most others have reviewed, check in at this resort could be improved, we waited in line for quite some time but since I had read the other reviews about this, we were prepared for it
-We had booked a king bed ocean view room but at check in were told the only kings they had with ocean view were on ground level or there was a 2 queen bed room on the 8th floor. I wasn't so much mad about having the 2 queens on the 8th floor instead of a king but either these 2 beds weren't queens at all or their queen bed is the equivalent of a double in the U.S. But we dealt with it to have the view we had.
-I only went to the swim up bar here one time the whole trip because the pool here is 6 ft. deep (I'm only 5 foot tall) so if I wanted to be able to stand in the pool, I had to stand at the bar area which was crowded. 
-The cabana/palapa situation here is a little ridiculous. The palapas on the beach are taken by 8 am so if you want one, you better get out there early and reserve it (which you aren't supposed to do, but everyone did it anyway) The cabanas on the beach were $120. Also there is a stretch of sunbeds in the Coco's beach bar area which are apparently reserved for someone, never did figure out who. My husband and I got a drink at the beach bar one night and went over to sit on one of the lounge beds (which were all free because there wasn't another person over there) and we got kicked out. 
-There's no alcohol in the fridge/mini bar, only beer, soda, juice and water. Every all inclusive we've stayed at had mini liquor bottles, but not here. 
-Reservation system for restaurants are a pain when you can only get in a restaurant at 9 or 10 pm. One night we were ready for dinner early (around 5:30-6) pm and Enso didn't look full at all so we just walked up and they gave us a table without having a reservation.
-Biggest complaint of all about this place is the Club Melia sales pitch. They ambush you immediately after check-in to sit through their Club Melia "vacation club" presentation. We sat through the 2 HOUR presentation (which is promised in the beginning it will only be 90 minutes) long story short here, save yourself and DO NOT WASTE your time sitting through this presentation. What they promise you (couples massage for $50 and 3 nights/4 days at one of their properties) just for sitting through it was not worth wasting 2 hours here. It's expensive as hell and they expect you to make a financial decision like that about a resort you've never been to on your first day there. Wish we would have been sitting beach side instead of spending our first two hours of our first full day in that presentation. 
One last thing, on our second to last night there, I woke at 1:30 am to someone knocking on our door...twice! I looked our the peephole and could see someone out there with a flashlight. We were on the 8th floor of the main pyramid and it was very dark. I called the front desk to ask them why someone might be knocking on our door at 1:30 am and they didn't know why and would send someone up to check it out. Never heard anymore about it but if you stay here (or anywhere for that matter) DON'T open your door for anyone you don't know, especially at 1 in the morning! 
All in all we had a great stay and I would recommend this resort to others, especially families. If you are used to staying at an adults only property (as we usually do) you might consider looking elsewhere for a true adults only property.

reviews.author: Jonathan Johnson
reviews.title: Best Resort in Cancun
reviews.text: This resort is amazing! We are very picky about where we stay and this place exceeded our expectations. The entire staff was very friendly and went out of their way to ensure our vacation was perfect. The rooms are very spacious and clean. The resort itself is beautiful, inside and out. I read some negative reviews before I booked here and I can't imagine what anyone could find to complain about here. My 4 year old loved the kiddie pool and the staff was extremely friendly to him making sure he had as much fun as we did. The resort didn't seem crowded and we never had trouble finding chairs by the pool. The resort is very clean as the staff is constantly keeping everything clean and picked up. The food was great at all the restaurants. We especially like the Market Grill. We would like to personally thank Sofonia Castaneda Cabrera. He was our pool waiter and went above and beyond to cater to our every desire. He made us feel at home our entire stay. I would go back to this resort without hesitation. What an amazing place!

reviews.author: poulet78
reviews.title: I strongly recommend Paradisus Cancun.
reviews.text:
I felt like going on a re-honeymoon. This resort is luxurious and The pool bar is awesome.
The swimming pool is so big that our family had much time in the pool. 
The cocktails of pool bar was also excellent.

reviews.author: Bobby T
reviews.title: Service and Nightlife were amazing...however the food and rooms had serious room for improvement...
reviews.text:
Okay First lets talk about what was great.

The Service- We did the all inclusive package and they made sure to take care of each and every one of us! Their service staff and bartenders did an exceptional job at making sure everything we needed was taken care of and in a timely manner. Cindy, Asuncion and Eden are the three names that especially stood out to us. Daily they made sure our needs we met and did so with a smile! All three of those employees are a great asset to that resort. 

Nightlife-  If you're looking for a resort with things to do a night, this is a great place to go! The have a beach bar that is a great atmosphere and offers an amazing view of the beach. The bar is open until 12 pm and has a great selection of drinks, as well as offering hookah and cigars if that's your cup of tea. Great place to hang out with friends or go to meet new people.   

The red lounge is another great place to go at night. It's a club atmosphere that is open until 2 am. Late night , this is the place to be! Fun for all ages 18 and up. The bar staff are terrific and will defintely ensure you have a great time. The DJ is great and places many types of music while also taking requests. Ask for Alexandro and ask him to make his famous JellyFish Shots! 

Now for the bad.....

Food- The food is no where near what I was hoping for or expecting. For the price that we paid for our vacation, I was seriously disappointed with what we were presented with. The buffet was okay...most of the time food was cold and bland. Enso, the asian fusion, was not worth the trip. The menu is very small and doesn't cater to many pallets. 

The best two restaurants hands down were Market Grill and Bana. I would recommend going to those during your stay but I honestly can't recommend any of the other dining options. I was not impressed by them at all. 

Rooms-  The rooms were okay, they are your average hotel room. We did have a great view of the ocean which was something that we were very thankful for. The room wasn't very important to us as we really only slept in there. They major problem was.... I spent a lot of the week being sick and sick to my stomach. We figured the food had something to do with it... but the second to last night we were there we finally got sick of our AC grate on the ceiling leaking and decided to look into it.... 

Not only had this grate leaked all week and soaked my clothes the first night we were there , also ruining medications that I brought with me... but there was mold on the top of the door in the bathroom. We wiped it with a towel MULTIPLE times and the black mold just kept coming.... the people who were with us didn't have this problem and their room was fine but it did happen to us and is part of why I am giving the rating that I am. 

When asked if I would stay there again, it's something that I would really have to think about...

reviews.author: claudiamit
reviews.title: Great resort for everyone!!
reviews.text: Make your dinner reservations as soon possible!  Every time we tried to make a reservation we could only get in at 6 pm or 9 pm.  We stayed in Tower 3 which was perfect!  Shows, most restaurants and most bars are in tower 3.  Also, reserve your beach chairs or pool chairs as early as possible.  Our first day we did not get down to beach/pool area until 10:30 and there were no lounge chairs available,

reviews.author: Bella K
reviews.title: March Getaway
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and location. Great service in all dining areas as well as on the beach.  Excellent Wifi service (even on the beach). Hotel staff friendly and very attentive.  Loved the all-inclusive (food, drinks, mini bar and wifi).

reviews.author: CarolaRN
reviews.title: Amazingly beautiful hotel and beach! Great food! wonderful personable service!  Thank you!!!
reviews.text:
Our family has stayed at the Paradisus 8 times.  We Love the beauty of the hotel and the beach.
The food is amazing.  Hotel is so well kept and clean. Entertainment is great! ( I would like to see the evening entertainment freshened up a bit ( this year, the entertainment was a bit drab, using a lot of techno soundtrack   lip syching and dancing featuring very old songs from the 80's.  Please bring back the MC's and evening games
We would especially like to acknowledge our favorite staff member Nacho Mendez in Naos during breakfast and lunch. We will return in large part because of him, his warmth and service..way above average. My family is so very fond of this wonderful man
We would also like to thank  katarina our morning hostess in Naos who always greeted us with a smil and a hug, Miguel santos (naos in the evening) Mirian and all of the wonderful waiters in the Market grill March 1-8th 2017 and to Flor and Latisha our ocean watresses.  Thank you for a wonderful stay with you! We LOVE you!

reviews.author: Seth A
reviews.title: Consider looking elsewhere
reviews.text:
If you are not a seasoned traveler or are an occasionally vacationer, you may not be bothered by this place.  It’s typical of very large hotels…rules for the sake of rules, and very bureaucratic.  Tremendous difficulty getting resolution to problems. And little attention paid to detail.  Main problems were:
The check in process is a guest’s first exposure….and it’s an abomination!  Perhaps Ricardo Gerente (who will likely provide a useless response to this review) can spend some time aiding front desk staff to speed up the check in process.  It took over 40 minutes, and my room wasn’t ready. Come back for you key when it is, and wait in line another 30 minutes.  Oh, you requested a quiet room…and we have you directly above the pool where the music is playing? Come to the desk, wait in line another 30 minutes, and we will tell you we don’t have another room.  But, you could come back tomorrow, wait in line, and maybe we will have a quiet room.  OK, I’ll play along.  Wait in line, get a key for a new room, and it literally abuts a building that is currently under construction, complete with jack hammers and drilling.  You get the picture.
The music on the beach is a bit much.  Think…thumping bass, techno …or, as the DJ referred to it when we asked him to tone it down, “deep house”.  So, with “deep house” blaring every day, it’s difficult to relax on the beach.  And, of course, everyone is just flocking here to listen to “deep house”.  After all, isn’t that what every guest here is just dying to hear?  One word for you Mr. DJ…”variety”.
As for food, I felt as though I was back in college trying to sneak food out of the cafeteria for a visiting friend.  I’m an adult, and I paid to stay here. If I want to bring a salad down to the beach, please let me do that.  NO Senhor!!!!! You must eat in the dining area!  Food cannot be removed from the buffet area!!!  Seriously…this is just dumb.
OK, I’ll sit at the bar at the taco place and have a beer and a quick taco.  Oh no Senhor, you cannot get food at the bar.  You must move 8 feet away to a table and there you can get all the food you want.  Aahhh…my favorite…. A rule for the sake of having rules.
Restaurant food was just OK.  We travelled with a large group, and dined as a group. Making dinner reservations in advance of our arrival was a project involving dozens of emails and phone calls, a boat load of excuses as to why they can’t do advance reservations, and finally the hotel making reservations in advance.  It was all very unnecessary.
I will say that the bar service and beach service were very good.
I am mystified by all the fabulous reviews of this place.  If you value quality over quantity, this place is probably not for you.  I now know it’s not for me.

reviews.author: Elias L
reviews.title: Great trip with wonderful service!
reviews.text:
Recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun with my wife for 11 days. For the most part the service was amazing. The staff is filled with amazing people who were nothing short of spectacular:
-By the pool Asunción, Jorge and Laura always made sure we had full drinks or a bucket of beer and water.
-For breakfast and lunch in the buffet Christian was our guy. Great service and always happy.
-Entertainment staff Rodrigo and Andrea always friendly and smiling. I never missed volleyball at 11am and 3pm.
-In the Red Lounge Alejandro never forgot what we or our friends were drinking and checked on us regularly.

Now for the pros and cons.
Pros: 
-Beautiful resort and always smelled nice. 
-Room was nice and probably the best stocked mini fridge we've had. (Beer, water, juice, pop, chips, Oreos, fruit bar, M&Ms, granola bar)
