-Many restaurants to choose from and they have something for everyone
-Friendly staff around every corner
-Never had a problem getting a beach chair by the pool and if we couldn't find a spot, one of the pool concierges would find us one.
-Golf course was well kept but don't shank a shot or you could easily hit a car. 
-Everything was very clean and always had staff working to keep it that way.
Cons:
-buffet food was luke warm at best most times-they need steam trays. I suggest going to as many a la carte dinners as possible.
- Massage was overpriced and nothing special- even with 20% off after conversion it was $167 CAD for 50 minute relaxation 
- Bali beds are also overpriced but people still used them. $120/day closer to the water and $85/day closer to the resort
-The area for the shows at night is too small and it's hard to get a decent spot to watch unless you show up early. 
-Also had a bad experience with Aquaworld. I booked 2 days of scuba diving. One day 1 tank feeding sharks and another day 2 tanks for two other dive sites. Cost $221 USD. Was able to do the shark dive but weather caused the other day to be cancelled 3 days in a row so I had to get a refund and they only offered $35. I fought for 2 days just to get back $70 in the end. 

We met a lot of really nice people on this trip and my wife and I really enjoyed it. We would probably come back again.

reviews.author: Virgo3am
reviews.title: Vacation 3/2017
reviews.text:
What a fabulous trip. Went down and met our friends for a 7 day vacation. The resort is fabulous. The main building with koi pond and greenery is amazing. Service was exceptional and we didn't do the royal service. Rent a cabana by pool it's so worth it. You get full VIP treatment and a full bottle of choice of alcohol with juices, ice and limes to make your own cocktails. It's $85 by pool, and $120 beach view and upgrade to premium alcohol. The beds were very comfortable and rooms very accommodating. In room safe and mini bar filled everyday. 
Restaurants fill up fast so book reservations early. We didn't get to eat in any of the extra fee restaurants but we heard they were really good. Naos buffet was good, but food was always room temperature, most of food everywhere was room temperature. Heat lamps didn't keep anything hot, so just be prepared for a different atmosphere when eating. There was a large variety each night with a theme at buffet, some nights better then others. Pool side grill had great guacamole and salsa for snacks. The hamburgers and hot dogs have a different taste then American standard, very different taste a texture. Other food was good, we stuck to the pasta, Mexican food, cheese/salami and bread, salads. Breakfast was the best buffet. 
Pool was great. It's a large pool with ample room for everyone. It's separated by area, with kids area, main pool with swim up bar, second area by market grill had a heated pool and then there was the royal service area for adults only. The beach is spectacular. Waves can be rough but worth a dip if you don't go in to far. When on beach you will get people selling you stuff while laying out. They are not to aggressive as I've seen in the past if you just tell your not interested, they go away. Chairs fill up quickly so head down to pool area early to claim spot. But be aware if gone to long someone will take your spot even if towel is on it. 
Overall a great stay, would stay again here for sure. Service was impeccable. Beautiful amenities and spa service was relaxing. Only draw back was the warm temp food and making reservations for restaurants. It's only 15-20 minutes from airport and 10 minutes on R1 bus to downtown Cancun to local bars and shopping.

reviews.author: Dogbluehorse
reviews.title: Go Rodrigo!
reviews.text: My five friends and I had an absolutely wonderful time here- the food was pretty good and the beachfront was lovely. Our favorite part, though, was the activities manager Rodrigo. He was the highlight of every day and always made the poolside that much more fun. Always remembered who we were and stopped to say hello and invite us to the next activity- really made a difference. Only thing I'd caution is the Bana sushi place as we found the fish wasn't too fresh.

reviews.author: Orbie-2
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text:
We did check in early. They gave us a double room on the 3rd floor. We were supposed to have a king, so we had to go back down and wait in line again. They gave us the option of a lower room (King) or check back in few days because they were 90% full. It was a Sunday. We decided to keep the 3rd floor and they shoved the beds together. It really wasn't a problem we were going to let ruin our trip. We decided to upgrade to an ocean view for the last two days. Darisnel at the front desk was true to his word and we upgraded to one on the 6th floor with a fabulous view. 

Our rooms were clean. The bathroom layout I really liked and the water pressure was great. (usually a problem for us in Cancun). Our mini bar was stocked daily. The maids were terrific, the whole hotel was very clean. The indoor plants hanging down give it a tropical feel. 

The hotel is so big that it takes awhile to figure out where you’re eating and what to do. We mostly ate at Naos because we didn't want to make reservations in advance. The Market Grill was delicious and breakfast usually was at The Blue Agave. Food at this resort is definitely better than the standard all-inclusive. Deserts were delicious. Although all the staff is friendly, Alexandra, Andrea "Andie", Marco and Jesus deserve a special mention. Yes, Jesus was his name!  Alexandra, thank you for the hospitality! She is a wonderful hostess and made our stay memorable. We had room service one night. It was quick, exactly what we ordered and tasty.  Well done!

The free Wi-Fi was fantastic. I even had it on the beach and around pool. It let me share my trip with friends back home. We spent most of our time on the beach.  A special shout-out to Marco our beach waiter who always kept the drinks coming, and once when someone took one of our chairs, personally drug a new one down to me. How kind! He went well above his line of duty. I must say the beach chairs were always completely full and the bali bed that you have to rent are empty. Twice we counted 2 of the 18 beds being used. The chairs around the pool were completely full too so you better get there early. 

This is a beautiful hotel, and we had a wonderful time. We tipped because we appreciated the extra effort and was not disappointed. Would love to go back some day.

reviews.author: Destination799530
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We had the the best vacation ever staying here.We got the Royal Service Junior Ocean Suite for 10 days and we were definitely treated like royalty.Our personal butler Galdino was the best he took the time to make sure our stay was perfect,and it was.The servers at the beach and pool,Cesar,Jorge,Victor,Ricardo,Ramon and Josea were spectacular they made sure we wanted for nothing.Omar the pool concierge was the best we asked for a Bali Bed by the bar and bam..we were there.The food was just as amazing thank you Benito at Enso and Nedal at the Market Grill for taking care of us.All in all this place was amazing and without the staff here it would not have been possible, thank you.😎

reviews.author: busybee2775
reviews.title: A nice break overall
reviews.text:
Well, the place feels and smells like a far-east spa.  You walk into an expansive lobby and immediately feel that you are in a tropical forest/jungle with greens hanging off all eight floors of the main tower.  The insense is burning everywhere with the corresponding pleasant ombre.    So, let's start with the positives.
1) Pretty, immaculately clean with attentive room service that is also very timely (as opposed to many other hotels) and a turn-down service.  
2) wonderful food - great buffet for breakfast and lunch and very good restaurants (the best being Mole and the Mediterranean tapas place - but all are at least solid)
3) good drinks - they will mix you anything - all you have to do is ask.  And there is no watering down
4) very attentive service
5) very pretty beach - can't blame the hotel for rough waters - that is just Cancun.  But the white sand and comfortable chairs are wonderful
6) great music - Coco club spins absolutely the best playlists all day long - was a complete pleasure lounging all day at the beach listening to the music
7) nice life jazzy night entertainment - very very pleasant

Now for the negatives...
1) The most useless, horrific check-in process.  All the spa-dressed people stand around completely uselessly and don't do anything.  We stood in line for almost an hour and had to raise a situation in order for more people to get in there. And after all was said and done - none of the spa-dressed attendees took us anywhere and the room was still not there.  Had to stay in another 40 min line just to get the key. And I can't say that it is any better for the people with the special packages as they also waited forever
2) The whole sitting at the pool - can't sit anywhere decent really, as can't grab ahead of time and most of the nice couches and seats are for VIP packages.  Which is a complete non-sense, as that is NOT the way to make people spend more money.  And the bed shouldn't cost $100/day.  So, instead of me wanting to get the VIP package, I wanted to leave.  In fact, this is the biggest downfall of the resort - the packages for the people to pay extra to have the private cabana or the butler or whatnot..it is absolutely fine if people want to do that, but pressuring people into that by limiting the pool option is not cool
3) only one pool was heated - the one near the restaurant.  The other ones were ice cold
4) rooms are a bit outdated - if this is catered as a modern, hip, chic resort - make the room look appropriate

This is not really a negative but the main tower may get a little loud because it is an open space and you can hear all live entertainment - but really wasn't bothersome.
Finally, after reading multiple reviews and the consequent managerial responses - I would appreciate no response at all, than the useless ones the managers provide on this website.

reviews.author: TERRY H
reviews.title: WONDERFUL VACATION
reviews.text: We own a timeshare here and have been here a quite a few times.  We recently took my twin sister, our son and his wife and our niece to Paradisus Cancun and they loved it.  I was so impressed on how accommodating the hotel staff was. They were all so helpful and friendly. The restaurant food was so so. The beds were wonderful as were the pillows, which so often are not. We ordered room service and they said it would take about 35 minutes.  they delivered our food in 15 minutes.  I could not believe how fast it was.  We went parasailing, took the boats out in the ocean near a reef and snorkeled which was a lot of fun but saw very few fish.  The ocean water was so nice and warm. I can't say enough nice things about this place.  It was top notch all the way. My only complaint is that the cabanas were way to expensive to rent. So they sat empty most of the time.  Wouldn't it be better to  lower the rental fee and fill them all up. You would be making more money that was than letting them sit empty. Just a thought  :)

reviews.author: MissK7012
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Went on family vacation with husband and children including a 2 1/2 year old. Resort is beautiful,clean  and  well kept. Buffet food is  not great, not that much variety
We ate at  Tempo (not part of all inclusive) food was great ,very tasty  but overall pricy especially the wine. We also ate at Market grill ,another non inclusive restaurant. Our waiter Carlos went above and beyond with the service he provided us . Food was good . Do not go to Enzo,food is horrible. Spoke to some other people we met at the resort and everyone hated it. The food at Vento,no extra charge was very good as well as the tacos at blue agave. The 12 hours day care 9am to 9pm is very attractive ,kids seem to love it. My daughter enjoyed it. The service seemed to be good. The one thing that really annoyed us was that you couldn't find any spot at the beach or by the pool. You could   rent a canopy for 50 dollars a day which I think is very expensive.  They just don't have enough "free" or should I say all inclusive spots to accommodate guests and that to me is a big minus and brought their rating low for me

reviews.author: fishinMTL
reviews.title: Best All Inclusive We Have Visited - Royal Service Is A Must!!!!
reviews.text: We just came back from a week long stay in the Royal Service building.  All I can say is the staff and service was amazing and well worth the extra cost.  Hector was our butler and literally made all of our arrangements and checked on us multiples times a day to ensure our vacation was perfect.  The food in the restaurants was above average and private dining in the Royal Service was quite good.

reviews.author: Chester & Monic... M
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is amazing. The food is great, the room is clean and spacious, the staff are most helpful and friendly and the location is perfect. Will definitely stay here again and would recommend it to everyone.

reviews.author: Larry H
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text:
This was our first visit to Cancun, Mexico.  The Paradisus Resort was beyond amazing.  It exceeded all of our expectations. We stayed in Tower 5, Royal Service .  The hospitality of the staff was great from all of them, especially our Room Butler, Hector ( he took care of our dinner reservations, room up keep, and the little details that you don't think of.
The waiters, Octavio and Eddie were always taking care of our needs at the pool and beach. 

Will go back soon!!

reviews.author: Alisbigsis
reviews.title: Totally blown away
reviews.text: Our first time at an inclusive resort and this was a beauty. The facilities were gorgeous. We had an ocean view suite and watched the sun rise over the ocean a few mornings.The service was beyond our expectations and the staff was wonderful. The last day there we reserved a Bali bed by the pool. Wish we'd had another day to enjoy this. The buffet at Naos was never ending and always packed with people. But the breakfast buffet at Blue Agave was a quieter and so more enjoyable. We also enjoyed a romantic dinner on the beach at La Palopa. Our servers, Josue and Javier were discreet but at the ready whenever we needed something. Can't wait to return!

reviews.author: markpK7696XB
reviews.title: Paradisus Stay
reviews.text:
We stayed Royal Service for 6 days/5 nights.

The GOOD...Facilities are well kept and clean, Rooms in Royal Service were very nice and adequate for the amount of time spent in them. We really enjoyed the YHI Spa as well as the Royal Service pool and Beach Area..We enjoyed the food in all the restaurants we tried and found the food and beverage staff to be the ones that made the Paradisus enjoyable for us.
The NOT SO GOOD.. Club Melia vacation club. They WILL contact you and offer to show you all the benefits your entitled to as part of your stay. We found the offers to be less than honest and not worth the time to even spend listening to any of it. I would prefer a resort that didn't try so hard to sell me a vacation for the next 50 years of my life! We also had a billing problem in the one restaurant that is an extra cost to dine at. Our experience eating at Tempo was outstanding with the exception that they presented a bill that wasn't close to what we ordered. Back at home, now still trying to work it out, and of course not holding my breath about it!! 
Our stay would have been 4 stars but for the above mentioned.
We were really impressed with how hard the Staff works for the guests. Management might learn a bit from the staff!

reviews.author: Evie F
reviews.title: My Survey
reviews.text: We had a great time and would come back again, I look forward to booking trips with Melia hotels. The staff was friendly and very accommodating. The only issue was that I would have to wake up early at 7am and go down to the beach to place a towel on a beach chair or else they were all taken by 10am.

reviews.author: Kbeth9670
reviews.title: Always a wonderful stay!
reviews.text: This was our 5th trip to Paradisus Cancun.  Staff is amazing!  Very helpful.  Stayed in the Royal Service area and recommend that for sure.  Our server Ricardo Balam in La palapa was super.  Not only did he remember our names, he remembered our drink orders.  Great way to spend a long weekend

reviews.author: Barry  K
reviews.title: Above and Beyond Experience
reviews.text:
My wife and I have stayed at a number of resorts in Punta Cana and Mexico, the Paradisus Cancun rates as one of the best. The service was first class, staff was very friendly and eager to assist. Our room had an ocean view that was spectacular, room was very nice, bed was very comfortable. Food was amazing, all restaurants had something to great offer. We enjoyed hanging out at the main bar listening to music and looking at the beautiful lobby. Loved the main pool, beautiful beach was only steps away.

I would like to acknowledge Jorge - beach waiter, he provided exceptional service, it's this type of staff experience that will have us coming back.

Hope to see you again soon !!!

Barry

reviews.author: Bob I
reviews.title: Pretty awesome hotel!
reviews.text:
Check in was easy, and then they offered us our first drink - it was awesome!

The hotel has 5 towers with tower 3 being the tall one in the center and tower 5 is the northern most tower which is the "Royal Service" area.  It appears that Royal Service also includes:
- their own pool by tower 5
- their own palapas on the beach
- their own restaurant
Fear not peons!  The rest of the hotel is pretty awesome!
There is a HUGE pool with a swim-up bar that goes from tower 3 to tower 1.  And another pool you can enjoy as well (that is wonderfully warm too!)
I didn't find an outdoor hot tub although there are parts of the big pool that have bubbles.  I'm sure the spa had a hot tub, but we didn't partake.

Speaking of the towers, tower 1 is closest to Fiesta Americana which at the time (mid-Feb) was having MAJOR work done on their northern most building (next to tower 1).  Hopefully that'll be done soon since the workforce was very large and busy.

This hotel will WOW you at how beautiful the public spaces are, especially in tower 3!  LOTS of restaurant choices and making reservations was much easier than other hotels -- just pick up the phone, and ask for your reservation. 
My personal ratings for the reservation restaurants:
Mole - wonderful
Fuego - wonderful
Market Grill - the Brazilian style eatery at night was delicious!  Be VERY hungry the food doesn't stop!
Bana - was "meh"
La Palapa - was "meh"
Vento - I'll be nice and just say, I didn't care for it.

The buffet is Nao and its strengths are the foods prepared in front of you like omelets, grilled fish, etc.  Like any buffet, some food is hit or miss depending on how long it's been sitting there.
Without question though, the pastry chef is absolutely AMAZING!  Zillions of beautifully prepared tastes of a great variety of desserts!  Major applause to the pastry team!
Also, the ice cream here is TO DIE FOR!  Always had 2 servings each day!  Yummm!

The drinks are great!  Not just the availability of top shelf liquor but also their drink mixers are great quality too!  

The staff is extremely well trained and so polite and courteous.  Please tip them!

The only negatives I have are:
1. Our ocean view room needed a "refresh".  The bed closer to the window had a big sag in it, the love seat had a stain in the fabric, etc.
2. The 8:30 entertainment needs to have better lighting and more seating.

Overall, I'd definitely stay there again!

reviews.author: Cameron H
reviews.title: Amazing trip!
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from Paradisus and had the most incredible time there. We initially booked a non-royal service lagoon view room but upgraded on arrival to ocean view with royal service. I would do this again and again. Hector was our butler and made our trip absolutely amazing. He was incredible and ninja like in his ability to get to you quickly. We stayed for 8 days and did not have to eat at the buffet a single time because royal service offers la palapa which gives you amazing freshly prepared food for breakfast and lunch. We either ate lunch at la palapa or blue agave every day. We were able to get reservations to EVERY restaurant and ended up canceling Enso at the end because it had bad reviews and ate at market grill twice instead. 

Restaurants best to worse --we are big foodies--
- Tempo (pay out of pocket but has Michelin star chef) *****
- Market Grill (amazing meats) ****
- Blue agave (best for lunch, dinner if you don't get reservations) ****
- Mole (nicer Mexican dinner) ****
- La palapa (royal service only) ****
- Vento (tapas) ***
- Fuego (poor execution on all dishes) ***
- Bana (sushi was alright, nothing special) **
- Enso (skipped, but seems to be the consensus worse) *
- Buffet--looked ok but at the end of the day its mass produced food that we decided not to waste calories on when we could have freshly prepared meals *

Entertainment is lackluster. They have one nightly event at 8:30 every night but its in a tiny room in pyramid 3 and everybody fights for seats and most end up standing. Entertainment is over by 9:30 at the latest. They have red lounge that has a live DJ at 11 but you are left with nothing from 9:30 to 11 waiting for the beat to drop. 

Overall, Royal service is luxurious, smells better, taste better. I don't think we would return if we had done non-RS but will definitely be back with royal service. Definitely worth ~100 extra per day.

reviews.author: jamesattner
reviews.title: Great place - Great food - Great yoga!
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Cancun.  The restaurants were terrific.  The buffet was good but not great and there were limited food options between 4 and 6 p.m.

The pools and the beach were terrific.  The private patio facing the ocean was the nicest of any all-inclusive resort we had every been.  We made full use of it too.

For activities, we went sailing (in the lagoon across the street only), played tennis a few times (only one court but no issues getting a time) and went to yoga three times.  

Yoga was terrific as the instructor, Petra, was fantastic.  Another guest had requested yoga every day that week so know that you can make requests as otherwise yoga is only scheduled for two or three times a week.  We benefited from the other guests request.  I highly recommend that you go to yoga early in the week so you can be convinced to go again later in the week.  Petra can and will cater to any level of participant.  Thank you for the great classes, Petra!

reviews.author: Patrick F
reviews.title: Fantastic , friendly service
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun and had a wonderful stay. The hotel, located on a beautiful, white sandy beach, offers something for everyone. There are multiple, great restaurants to choose from and there is nightly entertainment.
The staff at the Paradisus Cancun is top notch, especially Eddie C. and Valerie at the LaPalapa restaurant. They were so friendly and attentive and made us feel welcome.

reviews.author: Heide C
reviews.title: Very Nice Surprise!
reviews.text: My husband and I just returned home after spending a week at Paradisus Cancun. We had the best experience of all the different all inclusive reorts we have been to over the years. We arrived in the late afternoon and check in went very smoothly. We had booked a lagoon view room but on arrival we decided to ask for an upgrade to an ocean view. I can't say enough good about Alma and Pedro in reception. Not only did they work hard to get us a deal on an oceanfront but they were able to provide us with most of the Royal Service perks. It turned out to be the best money spent. Once we were settled in our new room (Pyramid 4 Room 4502 - king size bed, awesome rain shower/tub, huge balcony with reclining sun chairs with the best view of the ocean and pools) we headed for the beach. Because we had Royal Service bracelets we had access to a separate part of the Resort and we were definitely treated royally! Don't get me wrong .. we're not 'those' people that insist on being waited on hand and foot but it was definitely a great, new experience. Victor is the hardest working gentleman on the beach - he was literally running everywhere making sure everyone's needs were met before they even asked. A bucket of ice with bottles of water was a really nice touch. The beach and pool lunch menus were remarkable. We were able to secure a cabana beside the adults only heated pool (another nice touch!) and this is were Eddie C really made an impression with us. Again, very attentive and  pleasant and he always remembered our favourite beverages without having to ask. Another stand-out was Omar who looked after the cabanas (another first for my husband and I and a highlight of this vacation). He managed to get us the same cabana 3 days in a row (one day we were on the wait list, the other 2 were reserved for us). Really a nice way to go .. you had a comfortable large cabana as well as two lounge chairs so you could go between shade and sun. Lucky for us we had the best weather so we took full advantage of both. We tried every restaurant and again, the service was above and beyond. Darwin in Bana was a stand-out - very friendly and knowledgeable about the menu. Every restaurant was a culinary treat - freshly prepared and beautifully presented. All in all a wonderful memorable vacation. These people work so hard and always with a smile. My husband and I believe in tipping even though we stay at "all inclusive" resorts, not out of guilt but respect. Hola and mucho gracias to everyone at Pardisus that made our vacation one of our best yet!

reviews.author: Rebecca L
reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun was a wonderful vacation. The staff first and foremost made all the difference. People would stop and ask us where we were from just to have a conversation. The environment, beaches and pool were phenomenal. There were so many opportunities to lay back and relax I definitely felt like I was being pampered (there's a lavender smell throughout that adds to that feeling). The place has such a luxurious feel. We stayed in room 4002 (ocean view on ground floor) and we couldn't have asked for a better room. 

Ok so the cons: the food. It just okay. Like if food is of the utmost priority then I'm sorry...this isn't the place. It's just weird flavoring, and super chewy steak, or bland. I honestly believe it may because I'm from New York so I'm used to a certain caliber of food, I wanna give the benefit of the doubt because everything else was so wonderful. To be fair we only ate at the buffet, Enso and Blue Agave. HOWEVER! We did eat at Tempo. I don't consider Tempo a part of the resort experience because it's a separate charge. Tempo was the single greatest culinary experience of my entire life. It was so wonderful that it made up for the lackluster experience. If you're at this resort go to Tempo...it's not an option it's a necessity. It will change your life. 

The drinks were also pretty watered down. I mean I drank like 5 in one sitting and got barely a buzz. Regardless the service was outstanding and I would still come back and probably just eat at Tempo every night. That's how wonderful the entire experience was.

reviews.author: Kimberly D
reviews.title: The most amazing place on Earth
reviews.text:
My daughters and I went to Paradisus to attend a wedding. I was the photographer and the clients were friends, so this made it an easy "yes" when they asked for me to come. Our trip coordinator, Alin, was outstanding to begin with and helped me with any concerns about traveling internationally with children. 
So upon arrival, you are greeted by different shuttle services and it was very easy to find ours. They had all scheduled and ready to take. 
As we pull up, I could not believe my eyes. Then walking in? Forget it, it was like a dream come true with endless gardens, the sweet scent of a jungle, the concierge came out to get our bags immediately, we were then escorted to the front desk where we were met with amazing smiles and a man quickly asking if I wanted something to drink. I had to refuse since I was not ready but soon found myself enjoying all the perks of an all inclusive resort. 
Everyone was so focused on making sure your stay was as perfect as possible. The room service came 3 times a day. Once to clean, then to stock your mini bar and then to turn down your sheets and leave chocolates. 
There was entertainment every night if you wanted to see a good show. Our room was directly above the entertainment space, so it was a little too loud for me but it was over by 9:15pm and I was soon soothed by the sound of the waves and wind. 
Every morning we went to Naos restaurant where there is an endless buffett. My oldest daughter was in heaven! We befriended a waiter named Alberto Espinosa, who went above and beyond to make sure we had a wonderful time. He out the napkins on our laps, poured our coffee and cream, made sure that our drinks were waiting for us before we even sat down with our plates of food. He was outstanding and this is just one person out of hundreds that had us feeling like princesses in a castle. 
I honesty can not say enough about Paradisus and plan on going again next February vacation. Just pick up the phone or go online and book this place!!!! You will not regret it. If you want a great view, pay the extra for the ocean view. Seriously unreal!
Oh, and one more thing. You can grab a taxi right out front to head to downtown Cancun or walk down the stairs and get on a bus. When you do, GO TO Carlos and Charlies....this is an experience you will never forget. A restaurant with constant entertainment by the staff.

reviews.author: Carol B
reviews.title: Really looked forward to my trip
reviews.text: I looked at Paradisus (previously Grand Mellia) while on a trip to Cancun 5 years ago and have always wanted to plan a trip there because the resort is so beautiful. The resort is beautiful, well maintained and very clean.  I read reviews and most were pretty positive but I did not note that most reviews seem to be from travelers who upgraded to "royal service" .I was not offered this option during my y day stay. I probably would not have upgraded because this was my first stay at resort. It does seem that royal guests have a better chance of securing a seat on the beach but I noted that these special seats were often empty while us common folk struggled for separating daily. I refuse initially to be a "towel saver" but by my last day I had to venture down at u:30 and place my towel to secure a seat at the beautiful pool facing the beautiful beach. I watched people save chairs for hours without sitting on the chair. I watched a couple state they were going to town for lunch and left the towel saver for at least the three hours I was there. Seems trivial to some but I too am paying to enjoy the sun. Mat needs to buy more chairs or enforce 30 minute rule posted on signage. Food was good but buffet was crowded and noisy. I made reservation at Vento and got all dressed up and was impressed by romantic vibe and music playing only to be escorted out the door and seated in the back of the noisy buffet. I had consistent problem with preferred seating i.e. I is asked to sit inside at the buffet and they kept putting me outside or behind a dirty curtain..most staff  we're nice but I can only mention Rosie at the front desk because she helped get my air conditioning fixed. First disappointment was booking a king bed months in advance and being told on arrival I would be getting a full bed or would have to move to poolside floor 0 for king. I was never given option of a move to upper level room with king bed throughout my stay.I did love the eighth floor. Again good food in the buffet and market grill..made my own reservations easily..never saw concierge after initial check in but that's ok.did not want  pressure to join club and I must say no one asked me to join thankfully. Will continue my search for my favorite all inclusive in Cancun. Loved coconut bay in st Lucia and Finnesteria in cabo

reviews.author: JoAnnSteinbach
reviews.title: Great Home Away From Home.
reviews.text: We stayed here February 18-25, 2017.  We have been staying here since 1997 as members of the Melia Vacation Club. This year we were given a 1 bedroom rather than the studio which is what we own. It was so nice to have the extra space and we enjoyed having 2 patios to enjoy as well. We were even treated to a bottle of champagne one night with 3 chocolate covered strawberries. The soaps and lotions always smell so good too! Great Home Away From Home.

reviews.author: Christine H
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus for 6 days and have been to many other all-inclusive places in Mexico but this one is our favorite.  The rooms all have a view of water whether it is the ocean or the lagoon, the beach is beautiful, the food is all good and it is not difficult to get reservations.  But what makes this a great place is the people and the service.  Freddy at the gym does a great work-out, Cindy at the pool is a wonderful guest service provider, Hugo organizes volleyball on the beach twice a day, and painting with Esteban in the children's section is a must (he is an amazing artist!).  Loved it all! The only negative is the depth of the pool.  It is all 5-6 feet deep so it is hard to stand and enjoy a drink and socialize when you are only 5 feet tall.  I heard many others mention this also.

reviews.author: KJCbos
reviews.title: Great hotel with incredible beach!
reviews.text: Hotel is very nice overall.  Staff members are exceptional and their attention to detail goes beyond expectations.  Some rooms need updating but they're in the process of doing so.  Go with the Royal section (adults only) but worth extra money.  Some of the incredible team members are Leslie in Family Concierge; Lazaro of Royal Concierge and Carlos in the Royal pool area.  Great vacation spot!

reviews.author: Stacey S
reviews.title: Amazing trip
reviews.text: We just returned from 6 days in Cancun, and can't express how great of a time we had.  We stayed in the Royal Service area of the resort, and Galdino was our butler.  He booked all of our dinner reservations and spa treatments.  He was fantastic, as was the super modern room.  The food was excellent, great variety.  Drinks were top shelf.  We had perfect weather.  It's easy to leave the resort, and hop on the R1 or R2 bus (10 pesos/person anywhere) to explore the "strip."  We went shopping during a little bought of rain in La Isla, and another day we took surfing lessons.  Both trips out felt totally safe, as Cancun is driven by tourism.  We will definitely be returning to this resort in the future!

reviews.author: DaveBriggs24
reviews.title: Amazing staff!!! ...not too much to do tho
reviews.text:
**Would rate 4.5 stars**

PROS: Literally amazing staff!!! Each and every single staff member that helped us during our week here was 10/10. These are the most hard working and nicest people you will find! Waiting staff in the restaurants were quick and there for your every need. They made efforts to remember what you liked to drink and how they could serve you best. Pool staff was also extremely friendly and hard working. Would rate every one of them 10/10! We hung out at "Pool C" for the majority of our trip. Michael, Belém, Asunción and Jorge were all amazing! We woke up late most days and didn't get to the pool until around 10-11am but they were always helpful to find us chairs and no one is ever left waiting for a drink! Every evening they have a show in the Avenue bar. The performers are all very talented and the shows are entertaining. Bartenders and wait staff are all very nice. 

CONS: There isn't too much to do here in comparison to other resorts. "Pool C" is the most hip pool, but it isn't really that hip.  On Saturdays they have a DJ there for a few hours but the rest of the week there is no music playing. I feel at least 1 pool should always have some music playing, especially the one with the swim-up bar. In the evenings, other than the nightly show, there isn't much (if anything at all) to do. There are no pool tables or activities of any sort. We found ourselves just hanging out in the Avenue bar just having drinks and playing cards. They do have a small lounge that plays music but it's always relatively empty. Also something I noticed that was a bit strange, the main building is really sealed off from the outdoors. Most of the resorts I've been to are really open and have indoor/outdoor spaces. Here you are either outside or inside. 

Final thoughts: All this place needs is some good music at one of the pools every day, a few more evening activities, and to open up some of the windows and let some fresh air inside. It's not far off! With that being said, we still did have a great week here!

reviews.author: Jamie V
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text:
Nice hotel and great location along hotel zone. There are a lot of food options for family. Market grill was the best. Great food service and location (outside). I have to say tho that we started on a bad note with Enzo. And that was our anniversary night dinner. The food was horrible!!! Not even average. Way below. Food came out 5 minutes after we ordered and we felt like they were just microwaved and been sitting in their kitchen forever. Good thing market grill made up for it. Beach was dangerous at this time of the year (feb) and red flags were all over the place. We attended a presentation and were promised two treatments at their spa for $50 dollars. We didn't mind the presentation but we minded that they came with us during our first breakfast which was so awkward because we didn't feel we could eat for as long as we wanted. The spa treatment was so horrible. It wasn't even a massage. It felt like she was just putting lotion on our backs. They told us hydrotherapy thing was included but never offered it and when I asked about it, I was told, "you can go if you want". I mean we aren't high maintenance people but that wasn't acceptable. 

Overall tho this hotel offered the comfort we needed for a nice vacation. Would consider it again but maybe would try another hotel next time.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: This is Paradise!
reviews.text:
We stay from February 1st to February 5th. This was our first time at the Paradisus, which we chose because it’s affiliated with the Me by Melia – a hotel we’ve stayed at now 4 times. Since it was closed for renovations, we decided to try the Paradisus. 

When we first arrived, we were very impressed with the greeting and friendly reception as we came in the door. For such a sprawling complex, the staff quickly and kindly directed us to the check in area where we were offered a cold beverage: agua or cerveca. Of course I chose the latter! We checked in quickly and then Judith went through all our dining options and activities at the resort. She helped us make dinner reservations for the first two nights. Again, for such a massive place, this was extremely helpful. 

Once – partially – oriented to all the options, we moved to our room. The room was in tower 1, overlooking the ocean. However, when I opened the door to the balcony, my dreams were crushed. On the adjacent building, there were at least 25 guys doing heavy construction on a building only a couple hundred feet away. They were hammering, jack hammering, sawing and it was extremely noisy and not the relaxing calm vacation we needed. I know the hotel cannot control what goes in adjacent properties, but I called down the desk and they were able to move us to a room on the second floor of tower #3 – PERFECT. Awesome view, quiet, close to everything. Our vacation went from a 3 to an 11 with that move. 

We checked into our second room and made it to the beach by 2:00. We were delighted to find that the beach (like the Me) had drink service. We met Laura and our week was set! Laura was so nice and was always willing to suggest new drinks based on our preferences and soon learned that we liked our afternoon tequila shots! She was fun, friendly and an excellent server. We felt like we had a friend on the beach every single day. She worked hard, but took a couple minute to get to know us, which went a long way. We hope to see her again sometime soon! 

The first night, most of the restaurants were booked, but we managed to get a late (7:30) reservation for Enso. We had good food (including a massive duck appetizer), but the atmosphere and service blew us away. It was a quiet night and we had a beautiful look at the ocean in the dimly lit restaurant. We took our time ordering drinks, perusing the menu, and eventually ordering food. The service was quick and very professional. We had an appetizer, entrée, some drinks and dessert. As we sipped a desert glass of wine, our servers Carlos and Jorge offered us a special treat: café flameado mexicano (Mexican Flaming Coffee). In something you’d have to see to believe, they cooked down flaming Brandy, toasted our glasses, applied the caramelized Brandy to our glasses and served a delicious coffee, Brandy (and maybe Kalua?) drink for the ultimate desert. Again, we were amazed by the service and unique experience! Perfect start to our vacation. 

On our second night, we went to Fuego. I believe our reservation was at 8:00 and it was quite loud. The restaurant it rather small and there were a couple large groups that had been “out in the sun too long”. Oh, these Americans! (and this is coming from an American!). However, our wait staff was impeccable. Gabriel and Jorge were very attentive and seemingly unfazed by the distractions. And, when I didn’t like the appetizer I had ordered, they made me a custom appetizer that was amazing. I could tell that their true focus was on making us happy and providing a great meal.

On the third night, we went to the Market Grill. Having stayed at the Me before, we had an idea what we were in for. Ifrain greeted at our table and we inquired about a bottle of wine on the table – an Argentinian Cabernet Sauvignon. While it wasn’t included with the all-inclusive plan, we opted to buy it and enjoy a special bottle on a perfect Friday evening. He happily opened the bottle and started an amazing evening of service (along with Morkat). The food was amazing, the service impeccable, and the view spectacular. If you’re a carnivore, you’ll LOVE the Market Grill; the experience cannot be beat. There was a wedding on the beach and at the northernmost pool bar (right in front of the Market Grill), which made for a fun evening. 

On our last night in Paradise, we ate at Bana. We loved that the restaurant was built into the middle of Tower #3 and featured a bar, jungle atmosphere, and waterfall. That night Darwin was our waiter and was not only fun and attentive, but helpful and helped us pick a bottle of wine that I was able to purchase with Melia points. It was a Mexican wine – a first for me – and it complemented the food perfectly. We loved the portions and the unique Japanese fusion menu. 

Overall, the experience was far better than experienced. The resort is huge! There is so much to do and so many dining and drinking options. Food is available nearly 24/7, which was a surprise to us. Hungry after being at the club until 2? Head over to Naos (or Blue Agave which was open one night) for a snack. 

The beach is impeccable and we loved the beach beats vibe, which is similar to the Me. 
The beach isn't crowded with jet skis or activities like most resorts, which made it perfect for quiet days lounging in the sun or swimming in the ocean. The guys that gave out the towels would offer different types of day adventure packages, but were never pushy and always very friendly.

Overall, we were very impressed. Being away from our “home” at the Me, we still had an amazing time. As a couple without kids, we didn’t have any trouble avoiding kids. Generally, if you stay on the beach and make late dinner reservations (not at Naos), your kid interactions will be minimal. Do know that they do have a kids’ club and cater to families, but keep in mind that timing is everything. We went in early February, so more kids are in school (at least in the US). 

We’d definitely stay again. Again, our needs were met: perfect tropical beach, great restaurants and service, good room with well stocked mini bar, nice health club, and relaxing truly paradise like environment. Thank you again to everyone at the resort for a much needed relaxing and truly amazing vacation.

reviews.author: holababa
reviews.title: Huge Average Resort
reviews.text: The most stunning lobby area of all resorts in the hotel zone. Excellent food & drinks. The main pool is a little too deep for anyone under 5 foot 10. Clean basic rooms. Set back from the main road where you catch the bus with quite the staircase to negotiate. Some buildings cater to vacation club members & other sections to Royal Service.

reviews.author: jjmilner667
reviews.title: Family trip in February
reviews.text:
Because it is important to know a little bit about the perspective of who is writing these reviews, here is the quick rundown: we are a family of four, two kids (4 and 1), mostly vegetarian (but we do eat some fish and seafood), and we spent a full week at Paradisus in February. On to the review!

Overall, we had a nice time at the hotel. The staff all work really hard and are extremely friendly. One server (Pablo) was especially great – he learned/remembered our kids’ names on the first day and quickly won over the heart of my daughter. By the end of the trip, she was drawing him pictures as going away gifts!

The food on the whole is good, though there are some hits and misses. One thing that we really appreciated is that the buffet has a huge selection of food for vegetarians, and a lot of healthy options at both breakfast and lunch. The smoothie station was killer and the egg white omelets at the omelet station were fantastic. As for the restaurants, we thought that Mole was definitely the best (esp for veggie options). The dishes were creative and delicious. Bana, the Japanese place, was good as well and we thought that Vento (tapas) was also pretty good. We were not enthralled with Fuego and thought that Enso (Asian fusion) was by far the worst spot. 

We loved getting decent cappuccinos all day long. You can order at the buffet (soy cappuccinos were dope!) and at the ‘coffee bar’. We were crazy caffeinated for the trip!

The Kids Club for our younger kids was a bit disappointing. Basically, they would put on a DVD and the kids would watch TV when they were in there. In the end, we did not end up using this service as much as we expected.

Check-in definitely could have been better. The original room they placed us in was tiny with nowhere for our daughter to sleep. We called to see if they had other options and we were placed in a much larger room with a pull-out sofa. Note: junior suite means basically one regular hotel room (maybe everyone knows that but we thought there would be a separate bedroom!). 

Pool options were nice, but as others have noted the main pool is pretty deep so bringing or buying a floatation device is pretty helpful for relaxing in the pool if you’re under 5’7” or so. The beach area in front of the hotel is gorgeous. Lot of great sand for the kids to play in. For most of the trip the waves were too strong for even adults to swim much in the ocean, but man the color of the water is amazing. 

One unexpected bonus: we did a photo shoot for the whole family and were really happy with the pictures. It is nearly impossible to get decent pictures of all of us, but our photographer Parvi with Outdoor Photo did a great job of capturing great looks from each of the children and the family as a whole. Parvi was especially great at drawing out and getting beautiful smiles from our daughter who started off the shoot sulking and crying.  Within a few minutes our daughter was posing like a supermodel!  Parvi was also great with the baby and flexible with breaks for nursing.  She also edited the pictures to make sure the lighting and everything looked good on the final picture file. The photo shoot was not cheap (listed prices are much more expensive than similar photo shoots we have done in the U.S.) – but we were really happy with the photo set we ended up with. Thanks, Parvi!!! (Note – you should negotiate on price of any picture packages you end up buying.)

One annoyance – we felt like we were bombarded with sound the whole trip. The DJ at the beach, playing mainly to a bunch of empty cabanas, spins ‘boring’ (according to my daughter) house music all day at a ridiculous volume. When I am at the beach, I want to hear the crash of the waves! Even worse, inside the hotel they play club music at a high volume all day AND night. Seriously. We were in Pyramid 2, away from the main pyramid so that our kids would not be kept up by the sounds of the shows at night. Even in those pyramids, they had speakers playing music that would be really loud in our rooms with our supposed-to-be-sleeping kids. 

Overall, though, good times were had by all. Thanks Paradisus!

reviews.author: Nick B
reviews.title: Amazing Place
reviews.text:
My friends and I stayed at Paradisus for 5 nights and it was our first time in Cancun and Mexico and we loved this hotel. The service was beyond amazing and as soon as we entered the hotel we felt at home. We stayed in the Royal Service side which was incredible. Our butler Erik was the best from the start. Erik no matter where at the hotel we were always found us and made sure we had everything we needed. He brought us to dinner and made sure our nights were filled with activities and things to do. He went above and beyond to make sure our trip was amazing.

The La Palapa restaurant was our go to. From the view of the beach to the amazing service by the staff we ate here almost everyday and would go back for sure. The staff, Jorge, Cesar, Josue and Alejandro were the best and always knew what we wanted before we even did.

We will definitely be going back to Paradisus next year.

reviews.author: FJB
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We had a beautiful trip.  The only negative feedback; 
The hotel is family oriented.  Which given we were there to get away from children, we had a bit of a chall7.  The hotel was not busy, and even though we stayed on the deeper end of pool, we found children almost landing on us in the pool,(we were using floats and feet on the edge trying to stay out of traffic).  The one show we really wanted to see, at an 18 and above bar, was filled with children. Who were running around or perched on the shoulders of their parents.  The hotel needs to respect those of us who love kids, but pay equally to be away from kids.  The children were sitting in prime seats for viewing and parents did not encourage them to sit on the floor or their laps.  Needless to say we left along with many couples.

reviews.author: Jason D
reviews.title: Ten days at Paradisus Cancun Feb 2017
reviews.text:
I had occasion to stay at the Paradisus Cancun for ten days in mid-February 2017.  After staying, returning to the real-world, and digesting my experience, I feel that the hotel was a good blend of strengths and weaknesses, and I had a pleasant and relaxing time there.  

The service staff can be beyond four stars.  Some will bend over backwards to make your stay more pleasant.  Small tips resulted in beyond extra special attention each day and each meal.  Housekeeping was extremely efficient, accommodating, and professional.  We had absolutely no issues there and that in and of itself was outstanding.  Sand, unintentionally brought in from the beach was gone after each cleaning, new towels refrigerator, and amenities were restocked and provided without  asking, and they actually cleaned.  

The waitstaff was hit and miss.  Some looked at you with dollar signs in their eyes, swearing off and disappearing if they didn't perceive a tip coming.  That being said, I can't highly enough praise the poolside staff member Nurbi and Naos staff member Pablo.  Superb service throughout our stay.  

Wear and tear can be seen throughout the hotel, so if you're looking for true five-star accommodations, you may be disappointed, as will nit-pickers with insanely high standards, but for those of us who are realistic and enjoy where we're at in life, you'll be happy.  The ocean-facing room was absolutely worth the upcharge.  When booking, I took the bottom of the barrel (an admitted gamble) and was rewarded at check-in with the option to upgrade at a 50% discount.  Unfortunately Royal service was not available to us, however the ocean view was, and in my opinion was worth it.  It was fantastic to be able to wake up and walk out to the ocean.  The balcony lights would have been nic

Downsides, having to make reservations each day over the phone at 0700 for the day after is abysmal.  It was hit and miss with who answered the phone whether they would let you make reservations further in the future, and ultimately we were told to call each day.  While our concierge purported he would do this for us, he was never to be seen again after check-in despite receiving a handsome tip.  (Nacho)  There were some instances of reservations being lost, which was also frustrating.  

I was pleased with the overall offerings at most of the restaurants.  Tempo was over-priced for what was provided, but offered a nice ambiance for special occasions.  (We received a special tasting menu for Valentine's day, which had a special price attached to it).  

Mole had the best quality of food, but the mariachi band was so deafeningly loud, it detracted from our ability to even carry on a conversation unless it was done shouting over them.  

Bana (sushi), Market Grill (Brazilian steakhouse awesomeness), and Vento (Mediterranean tapas) were all great options and I would recommend them.  

Blue Agave (street tacos) was a decent lunch alternative to the buffet, but the buffet (Naos) itself has awesome selections available.  

A word on occupancy of the hotel as related to the restaurants.  If they are approaching 80% capacity, it will feel ridiculously crowded and the service, naturally, will suffer as a result.  If there are conferences being held, you feel it as an isolated guest of the hotel.  

I would recommend skipping Enso. (Asian)  It was not a good option for us due to the food quality and service.  

Fuego was decent, but wasn't for us.  The proximity of the tables led to some raucous groups impinging on our enjoyment.  The first north pool/bar area adjacent the east exit of Pyramid 3 is the same deal.  If you are trying to relax, read, and appreciate the sun/quiet, try the north side of the Enso pool bar.  It can be hit or miss due to its proximity to the kid zone, but we had good luck there.  If a spring break, drunken frat party is more your style, get to the pool bar area early (0700-0800) and you'll be able to secure yourself a lounger with a towel.  

If you're not to the pool area by roughly 10 am, you may have difficulty finding a lounge chair.  All of the palapas are at an additional charge, and the loungers adjacent them are included and reserved for their patrons.   

Poolside is American bar food, dogs, burgers, and nachos, it's pretty much what you would expect, but fits the bill for pool-side fare.  

Onward to other observations, the pools are outstanding, the beach is impeccable, however the lifeguards are pretty much for show only.  Two people drowned during our stay, so don't take it lightly that swimming is at your own risk, the current is incredibly strong about a 100 m out, and the sand bars make it deceptive as to the height at which you can stand relative to the low point of the waves.  It is rough in areas for younger children, parents be ever-watchful as I'm sure you always are!  I loved it for beach-coming and finding some stellar shells!  

The folks dressed in white which sit at tables surrounding the central atrium in pyramid three are relentless in trying to sell you excursions and getting you to attend their informational sessions.  I read many reviews talking about this and didn't succumb to their lures and promotions, but it felt a lot like being harangued by the local market vendors every time you walk to the pool, beach, or restaurants.  Some were helpful, informative, and pleasant, some were pushy sales people.  Obtaining pool towels will net you the same verbal fencing, but a polite, "No thanks", will accomplish your goals of getting on to enjoying your vacation.  

A word on excursions, walk (literally) across the street to Aquaworld for water-related excursions at approaching half the price of what the hotel vendors are offering, as they are ultimately serviced by Aquaworld anyways.  

When arriving at the airport, (seasoned travelers already know this, I'm sure) walk past the gauntlet of vendors and approach the taxi line outside the terminal.  We wasted 45 minutes after our flight in waiting on a shared taxi we were sold in this area which was an absolute debacle of management and execution at the rate of $24.00 US.  A taxi was around $20, and don't be fooled, they are governed by contracted rates!  Ask to see their fare placard.  

Once at the hotel, the local bus (while somewhat dangerous due solely to driving habits) was absolutely the way to go.  It is 10.5 pesos to embark each time, per person so during our trip, roughly 58 cents.  So if you're feeling frisky and adventurous, take the leap and jump on/off.  When something catches your eye, hop off.  

The shopping was the regular haggling awesomeness that is Mexico, so if that's your thing, travel into town and check out the local shopping area.  It is a barrage of shelves and vendors.  They are starving for business with the new mall having been erected closer to the hotel zone, so there are a world of knick-knacks to be looked over and deals to be made.  

All-in-all, I recommend the Paradisus for its location, service, and grounds.  The value is a bit muddy, but if you shop right, you can find good deals throughout the year.  We would stay again.  Like most hotels, it is the staff which elevates this property to its four-star rating.

reviews.author: Macketh
reviews.title: Awarded the coveted fifth star/circle!
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed here a few years ago when this resort was a different name, so we decided to return for her birthday. The Paradisus knew it was her birthday and went above and beyond to make our stay exceptional! I normally save a perfect rating for an exceptional experience, and the Paradisus Cancun delivered!

We stayed here during February 2017. After arriving, we were warmly greeted and quickly checked in. I asked to see if we could have a room with a cool view of the ocean. We were declined a better room because when we got to our original room (which was still amazing), it was decorated for my wife's birthday! What an amazing touch, and I knew my wife felt extra special. Plus it make me look like (even more of) a rock star.

I should also say that we stayed in the nice fifth pyramid with the special Royal service, which was amazing. EVERYONE at the Paradisus was so friendly and helpful. The food was great (we hit three or four of their restaurants). Our pool was quiet and clean and warm and had great service. The beach was clean and warm and had great service, too. Wifi was way faster than what I have at home, and it worked everywhere.

As much as I try to think of something to improve the experience, the only thing I came up with is to have towel hooks on the cabana beds near the pool so we could hang up our wet towels or clothes.

We didn't want to leave and would definitely return to visit our new friends there. Thank you so much for an amazing and relaxing time, Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Cherie D
reviews.title: New widow
reviews.text:
I was widowed after booking this trip with friends and my husband and the place was not very compassionate about the circumstances, didn't even address my questions about any sort of refund and sending a death certificate unlike the airline which quickly refunded the whole cost and sent a letter expressing their sympathy. After making phone calls was told the refund for an all inclusive with one person not going was 50.00 dollars a day, I personally don't think that that is fair  and it was difficult to even get them to do that. Pretty sad, what is there biggest concern? Money?
And there check-in and check-out service was horrible. They really need to re-evaluate how they do it.

reviews.author: Alys B
reviews.title: Couldn't have asked for more
reviews.text:
We spent four nights at the Paradisus Cancun for my bachelorette party- Feb 8-12. It was a great trip and the experience at the hotel was superb. It was very clean, modern, and absolutely beautiful. The staff was all very friendly and accommodating. From check in to check out I have no complaints. We spent a lot of time at the pool as opposed to the beach because the water was rough, but we never had an issue getting lounge chairs by the pool for our group of five. The weekend was more crowded than the weekdays, but still was not an issue. The food was the best I have had at an all inclusive resort. Even the buffet was a step up from other places I have stayed in Mexico and other countries. The food and service at the restaurants was outstanding. Be sure to check out the Market Grill for dinner - Brazilian steakhouse rodizio style. Every night we ended at the Red Lounge where Alejandro always made sure we has a drink our hands. His service along with friendly personality ensured every night was a ton of fun. I am missing the amazing iced coffees from the coffee stand. I can't remember the name of the guy working there but he was such a sweetheart. He knew my order after day 1 and provided excellent service. All of the guys at Avenue bar provided great service, especially Samuel. We also loved the team leading zumba and water aerobics by the pool. We did not see much of the evening entertainment because we usually chose late dinner times, but they seemed to be a lot of fun. The entertainment by the pool on the weekend was excellent. Very original. I would definitely visit here again. It was a great trip with friends, but would also be fun with family and kids. 

I would recommend bringing small bills to tip the staff. All inclusive does not include tips which is how anyone working at a resort makes a living. If someone provides you great service be sure to slip them a couple dollars! =)

reviews.author: Room5602
reviews.title: Excellent vacation at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Had a great time here.  Royal Service was the way to go, no question.  We stayed from Feb. 18 to 25, 2017.  Check in was fast and efficient, and friendly.  The Royal Service "lounge" in building 5 is quite beautiful (you have to see it in person).  Our butler was Rosanna, and she was just wonderful.  She was professional, non-intrusive, and got things done.  We also talked to her about local info and the history of the resort, plus a bit of the history of Cancun.  The lounge also has hor d'oeuvres throughout the day, and fresh fruits! Our room was on the 6th floor and overlooked the lagoon, which was nice.  The room was fair size, although the bathroom was a bit small.  No jacuzzi tub or standing shower, just the rain shower head over a tub.  The fridge was fully stocked every day.  The room service was good, but we only order a tropical fruit plate one night.  The restaurants were great.  We asked Rosanna to reserve all of our restaurants for the rest of our stay, on the day of arrival.  Best restaurants were bana (we went twice and the best waiter there was Alberto!) and Feugo (try the breaded salmon with black sesame seed "bread").  Enzo was the worst and the Market restaurant was mainly meats so we skipped it.  We didn't try the Tempo restaurant, it seemed empty most nights.  The La Palapa was excellent, with Valerie (?) being the best staff there.  The place was open for breakfast and lunch overlooking the ocean!  You get 2 guarantee day Bali beds per stay and the pool was large enough that it didn't feel crowded.  There was sun lotion provided by the pool.  Carlos was great in the pool area.  The beach was great and you can walk an hour either way easy.  The spa was great, including the hydrotherapy.  Gym was decent with some machines not operating.  Night time entertainment was ok, nothing to write home about.  We walked to the local mall there which was a disappointment.  We went to Xplor park for the ziplining one day and that was great!  Overall, the resort was great value for the money and the food was fantastic.  It's the first resort we have been to that we could eat healthy and enjoyed the food too!

reviews.author: Santi1989
reviews.title: Best of cancun
reviews.text: If you are looking for a luxury and top of the line alcohol this place is for you. They have multiple specialty restaurants that offer the best service around. I have been to cancun multiple times and stayed at different resorts around the area and this was the best one we have been so far. Try the tapas restaurant and the tacos bar they are amazing.

reviews.author: Shelly H
reviews.title: Amazing Royal Service
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun February 17-24.   We stayed in the Royal Service pyramid and I can't enough wonderful things about the service.  The staff goes above any level of service I have ever experienced.  You will never be without someone making sure that you have a drink and food even as you lay on the beach.  Jorge, Ricardo, Moises just to name a few were absolutely amazing.  The Royal Service food at La Palapa was better than the restaurants in the building I thought.  Bali beds are a nice touch.  The really nice part about that is that there are also 2 chairs that are next to the bed if you choose to go into the sun.  Rooms were clean and comfortable.  Refrigerator stocked with whatever you want the butler to stock it with.  The Royal Service room with food and drinks all day long was incredible.  Delicious from breakfast to a late night snack.  We were not impressed with the restaurants at all and that would be the ONLY thing that would keep us from going back and the food is a huge part of our vacation.  Royal service was the only thing that kept this trip in what I consider and amazing resort.  The staff deserves so much credit from check in to check out!

reviews.author: Zoe H
reviews.title: Didn't want to leave!
reviews.text:
Such a nice place to stay and relax!  I was visiting with family, which included 3 "tween-aged" boys, and we all had a great time!  
The endless food options were very good.   The breakfast buffet was great,  something for everyone.  The sunset grill had the perfect mid afternoon snack options ( good guacamole! ), and there are many options for dinner.  You just have to reserve for the next day's dinner by 10am. 
The evening shows were very good,  we just felt that they needed a bigger stage to fully show their capabilities.
The hotel itself is very nice.   The plants in the center pyramid are gorgeous, but it is very humid in the interior building as a result.  The elevators are very slow (seem to be used by cleaning staff more than guests), and we often just took the stairs instead of waiting.  
For the most positive side, I cannot thank the staff enough.  Every single employee I came across said Ola with a smile!  The serving staff at breakfast were very nice. I think Pablo was one of them, but they were all great.  And our poolside waiters in the kid's pool area were fantastic!  Victor and Alejandro were so incredibly nice and attentive, they really made us feel welcome.  A huge thanks to them and the entire staff for making our first visit to Paradisus a positive one.  We hope to return again in the future.

reviews.author: Andrea H
reviews.title: Avoid high season
reviews.text: This hotel is a mandatory all inclusive service. They try hard to please everybody but sometimes it seems that they have more guests than they can handle during the high season. The pool is also very crowded.

reviews.author: jimtam
reviews.title: Couples Anniversary trip to Cancun. We traveled with 10 people.
reviews.text: We had 10 people in our group and this hotel would have gotten an excellent but we thought there were a few things they could improve on. 1. responding to e-mails.  I e-mailed them 5 times to see if we could get our rooms together and never did hear from them. 2. When we arrived we were suppose to get a coupon book with discounts for massages etc. and they said they didn't have them, even though I had it on our paperwork. 3. The nightly entertainment venue was horrible, they do not have enough room for guests to watch the shows or for the performers to perform properly. We seen several people get angry about people crowding on top of there beds and in front of them. Not enjoyable even though the entertainment was good...The people that work at this hotel make the hotel all of the ones we were in contact with were very helpful and nice. Several people in our group got massages and they were all good. the best one was the 2 1/2 hour special massage...one of the best I have had. Rooms were nice, we had room 3108 but if I had a choice I would have picked a higher floor and not one that was so close to the restaurants and entertainment...very noisy early and late. Restaurants were all very good, we ate at 3 of the ones you need reservations for Mole, Market Grill and  and they were all excellent. The best drinks we found were at the inside bar by the sushi restaurant. The pool bar was good but the bartender was rude..all of the servers waiting on you around the pool and beach were excellent hard workers...all of us tip and all of these people really deserved it. We did a couple of the excursions that we booked right at the hotel and they were good but we got rained on.. We used the taxi service which was kind of expensive...and we also rode the bus which is good and cheap..There are so many things to say I could go on and on but will stop here.

reviews.author: Stephanie N
reviews.title: Hotel was good, but needs work
reviews.text:
Myself and my husband, along with our 2 kids (11 year old boy and 6 year old girl) stayed at Paradisus for 6 days. There were many things we really enjoyed at the hotel, but a few things that were disappointing. 

Pros
-the staff members were really friendly
-the food was very fresh and there was a really good selection
-great beach and pools
-quick and easy check-in and check-out

Cons
-we paid for an oceanview room, but we didn't get one because there were no chairs on our balcony until the last 2 days after many requests - we only enjoyed the view if we stood outside
-other balconies had 2 chairs and a table
-the family concierge told me that a supervisor would contact me, but that didn't happen
-the t-shirts for the kids were really small (even for our 6 year old)
-a lot of tiles are cracking - definitely needs updating

Overall, our vacation was good but we I think we would try another hotel if we go back.

reviews.author: Anna S
reviews.title: Could've been better
reviews.text: This is our second time to Cancun. The first time we stayed at an adults only resort, Secrets The Vine, which we absolutely loved. We wanted to bring our 15 year old son for his birthday and for Spring Break so we picked Paradisus based on some the reviews. We had a basic ocean view room in tower 3 on floor 5. It was actually perfect, close enough to the restaurants, but far away from the noise. The view was the best, although you had to stand up due to the plant bed. Room was clean and comfortable, AC worked fine. Safe didn't work, but maintenance was able to fix it right away. And we had to call for housekeeping because they didn't clean room for 2 days. The grounds overall was nice, but it was so humid. And there were towels and leaks everywhere. Loved the beach and the huts even though it was a battle every day to get chairs. Laura was the best server! The buffets were not good. Breakfast was ok, but after the 2nd day, it was getting redundant. Enso was ok. But the Market Grill for dinner was the best! We really enjoyed it and they even sang happy birthday to my son. Lunch was fine, we mainly ate the taco bar and sunset grill at the pool. If you do not have kids, I would highly suggest an adults only resort. Entertainment was ok, but short. My teenager was bored. The location was great, we took cabs to the mall and walked across the street to Aquaworld. Overall, we had a good trip, but the resort definitely needs some improvement.

reviews.author: Nick B
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Took my wife for her 60th birthday. ..all inclusive...outstanding....5 star service....4.5 star food....and wonderful clean beautiful rooms.I want to thank Alexander the concierge and Victor Chalet my poolside waiter for an experience that was over the top excellent. Also a gentleman by the  name of Francisco who was the utmost professional and was very attentive to my needs. Thank you. As for a return...most definitely. ..same time next year. I highly recommend the Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: Great Time Great Hotel
reviews.text: went to the Paradisus Cancun from 3/25/16 thru 3/28/16 for a long weekend to celebrate my girl friends birthday, we stayed in Royal Services with a Luxury Junior Suite Ocean View . when we arrived we were taken to a separate area to check in, this is were we met Rossana a lovely lady who took care of us thru our stay, she asked if we were celebrating anything special and I did tell Rossana  my girl friends birthday was Sunday. Rossana took care of all our dinners for our stay no worries about reservations she took care of all when she walked us thru the room. the room was a nice size and very clean and fresh the view was breathtaking . AC and hot water both worked very well. We stayed on property for all days we were there having a nice spot at the Royal Service pool with a cabana and 2 lounge chairs next to it , staff at the pool were also very friendly and fast never leaving long without a cool drink. all places we eat at were good as well. on Sunday after we left the pool to get ready for dinner, Rossana had our room all made up for my girl friends birthday she really liked it very much and was very happy. this was one of the best hotels we have stayed at and thanks to Rossana and her special touch during our stay. we will be back soon

reviews.author: mustafa
reviews.title: Nice hotel and location, disappointing service at times.
reviews.text: The Paradisus Hotel is quite nice with nice pool and beach. The service pool side and in restaurants is nice. The food was generally quite good. The service was not as expected and the beds in the room were uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Beverly H
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
Our family just returned from an awesome vacation at the Paradisus Cancun! 😊We found the staff to be some of the BEST we have ever met. One restaurant that our adult family of six dined in every morning "NAOS" not only had wonderful food but our wait staff gave us exceptional service! Kavil anticipated our every need and always made us feel welcome as did Ignacio and Cristian! 
All in all it was one of the BEST vacations ever !!👍

reviews.author: 296leighc
reviews.title: Don't look up!!
reviews.text: Food was good.   Gluten free options available which was very nice.   Most of the staff was very nice.  The building is old and needs a major renovation.  Everything is cracking and leaking.   Our room had an electrical issue and the power kept going out.   There is no night life at this resort!!  Not a lot of activities during the day either.

reviews.author: Trail624639
reviews.title: March holiday
reviews.text: Really enjoyed our stay here in Paradisus. The staff were so helpful and friendly. The service we received was of an extremely high standard and all staff went to great lengths to ensure we had everything we needed. The hotel room was extremely clean and serviced to a high standard every day!! Choice of restaurants was great and we loved all the many dining experiences. All the staff at la palapa and the Royal service were extremely helpful and friendly. Jorge in la palapa provided us with unbelievable service every day and really added to the fantastic time we had there.

reviews.author: jobarn
reviews.title: first time Wonderful
reviews.text:
This was our first time coming to Cancun and we certainly picked the right resort.  It's just beautiful.  We upgraded to an oceanfront room because our first rooms had a ground floor level view of the parking lot - definitely worth it. We traveled with 3 boys - 13, 11 and 9 and we didn't upgrade to family concierge and I cant say we missed out on a thing.  It seems to me the perks of family concierge are geared to younger children - milk and cookies, mini backpacks, plastic toys so trust me when I say if your children are older you don't need it.
  The only next times or opportunities for improvement i could see would be to not have such strong incense at night AND in the morning it's impossible to get an elevator.  They are constantly cleaning which is great but when they are cleaning elevators at 8am it causes a back log.  Maybe clean them before 7 before most people are up.  Truthfully, I don't understand anyone who wrote a negative review.  It was just wonderful and I would highly recommend.   
And finally kudos to Victor and Alejandro who were the drink servers in the children's Pool area.  Two very attentive, pleasant and hard working gentlemen.  All the employees there are guest first and offer legendary service but these two stood out for us.

reviews.author: Corrie B
reviews.title: Not such a great property for Time Share owners.....
reviews.text: Time share owners are put in their own "tower" of the building.  We were moved more than 3 times because of severe flooding in our room from rain.  Had a difficult time securing reservations in the nicer restaurants.  No dance club.  Other than salad bar (which was very large) very few healthy options available on resort.  Not impressed.....

reviews.author: reneer796
reviews.title: able to have fun or just relax
reviews.text: Wonderful atmosphere and gracious staff make your stay feel pampered and special. The food was better than average and there were many choices/varieties. The Nespresso bar was a hit... usually packed most of the time.

reviews.author: Sara B
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: The Royal Service was worth the upgrade. The Bali beds and poolside service alone made our whole vacation. We were on the 6th floor and loved the experience. Food was great. Drinks were great. We loved loved loved the avenue bar. All the staff was incredibly friendly and professional at all times.

reviews.author: Moses R
reviews.title: Spring break ....taste of paradise
reviews.text:
