Flew from Lax and arrived at 7 am in the resort. The staff accommodated us and allowed to use the amenities until our rooms were available. We got the royal treatment in the royal service building. Sergio our butler, Victor , Rode, Aurelio, Oscar our food servers ,  Samantha and Elena on the concierge were all amazing. Thank you for your commitment to make our stay awesome.
The buffet and fine dining were great. Food was fabulous. Clean room and attentive housekeeping special mention Brendi.
Safety issues excellent- today was a rip tide danger for guests. The resort didn't allow the guests to swim on the beach to prevent any injury. 
For sure we will be back. Best hotel ever in Cancun.
Thank you so much

reviews.author: Rachael D
reviews.title: Wonderful Spring Break trip!
reviews.text:
We were at the property for our spring break week with one other family, and our experience was wonderful!  Both families have experienced other resorts in Cancun and in other Mexican cities, and this was definitely one of our favorite stops.

We had booked through an online service, and when we arrived there was some confusion around our reservation.  The family concierge staff, the type of room we had booked, immediately took care of us and made sure there was no worry in getting checked in.  We loved the family concierge suites.  Spacious with lots of extras for the kids.  The only suggestion I would have is to offer some of the special touches more age specific - we had tweens and teens and many of the things were for younger children.  

Our butler Fernanda was awesome.  She found us every day to make sure we were taken care of with reservations and anything else we need. 

We spent most of our time around the main pool and on the beach.  I can't say enough great things about our servers Jesus, Sofonia and Armando.  They made sure we had everything we needed.  We reserved a cabana each day, which was a great way for the kids to take a break if needed.

The entertainment staff was awesome!  We did Zumba every morning and played all of the games by the pool.  We've been at other resorts where the entertainment staff didn't engage, and this team made such a difference in how much fun the day was.  Chacho, Fernando, Hugo and Rodrigo - great team members!

The restaurants were great.  While the main menus didn't have "kid" offerings, they were always willing to get whatever we wanted from the room service menu.  

The kids are already talking about going again next year.  Thank you for making this so much fun!

reviews.author: 328carlyd
reviews.title: Spring Break 2016
reviews.text: Awesome experience! Beautiful! Good food & drinks. The service was great. Calm hotel, not a lot of noise. Fun atmosphere. The night shows in the lobby area were great! I recommend going and staying at this hotel!

reviews.author: Dean J
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: Such a great family resort! Great food, great beach,Amazing and friendly employees! The only negative thing was the hours for the kids's club . they close very early , so we couldn't have couples dinner.And also they should have music for after  Lobby entertainment show. There wasn't  nothing to do with the kids after the show. Paradisus should invest on a Dj to entertain families after Lobby show.We had the best concierge! He was amazing! Very professional and outstanding service!We couldn't ask for a better concierge!His name is Ramon!

reviews.author: CarlosDelOrbe
reviews.title: Great Vacation for 1st time in Cancun.
reviews.text:
For our 1st time in Cancun we had a wonderful time and our Butler Rode was the best, will recommend 100%. great people, Good Food and beverages, nice and relaxing place. 
the entire Staff of the Hotel was very friendly. Will definitely go back!

reviews.author: Nikita H
reviews.title: Royal Service - Birthday!
reviews.text: I went to Paradisus for my boyfriend's 30th birthday and it was absolutely amazing. The Royal Service is a MUST. There was breakfast, cheeses, apps, and any drink you wanted. The service and our butler were perfect! There were balloons, champagne, and a cake waiting for us on the birthday Friday (Thanks Tony). I want to go back ASAP!

reviews.author: blademaster76th
reviews.title: A Perfect getaway
reviews.text: Me and my wife decided to book a trip to Cancun, Mexico for our Wedding Anniversary, and we picked Paradisus Resort. The hotel was so amazing from the outside pool to the beach. It has  mini-stores for people who love to shop. The hotel  also have plenty of restaurants to choose from. My top choice was Vento , it's a twist of Mediterranean food (so delicious),  Service was excellent, Katia and Rody greeted us like we are family and our server Gerardo, great customer service. My wife's top choice was Bana, a fusion of Asian food. We ordered all the sushi on the menu and it was so fresh. Yair Perez our server did a job well done entertaining us. Cancun is really a perfect getaway and I will definitely recommend staying in Paradisus Resort. It's not only because of the place, it's the nice people working in the resort as well.

reviews.author: Donald C
reviews.title: so worth the trip.
reviews.text: We loved our stay. We had the royal service and I highly recommend it. The staff was very friendly and helpful. They made our stay so relaxing and enjoyable as we never had to worry about a thing. We could just enjoy the stay. The food and drinks were excellent everywhere we went in the resort. We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: SGH918
reviews.title: Our trip to Enzo restaurant (on resort)
reviews.text: Our trip to Enzo was amazing, though there were minor flaws. Claudio was a great server and Gerardo was an amazing assistant waiter. Gerardo was good about coming and clearing our food when we were finished. Jose was a hostess, I believe, and he was very personable and made the effort to make us feel at home. Ana was another good hostess. There were a few places to improve on though. They ran out of menus even though there weren't that many people in the restaurant. Also Their desert selection of the curry brownie was questionable. My dad tried it and was okay with it but he said he would've preferred a plain chocolate brownie and ice cream. Honestly, I would've gotten that too, but the pineapple dessert was delicious as well. Overall, it was a great experience.

reviews.author: Ahmed M
reviews.title: Second Time We Loved It
reviews.text: We come to mexican resorts often, and this was easily the best one. We came a second time and it was amazing. All staff, and I mean all, are very friendly and helpful. The food is unbelievable. The resort is beautiful and the beach is as well. The entertainment staff are the best: Rodrigo, Fernando, Hugo and Carlos are one of the best entertainers we've experienced. We've recommended this resort to lots of people and is suitable for families and couples. We will definetly go back for a 3rd time charm

reviews.author: Rakesh Natverla... P
reviews.title: Very good experiende
reviews.text: Totally would love to come back. 5 star ratings. We made a trip with family and friends and totally would recommend to anyone. Overall experice with service and. Food was the best.  We had fun at the beach, kids enjoyed the pool a lot

reviews.author: Eileen M
reviews.title: Fantastic, friendly staff!
reviews.text:
The service was incredible! From the moment we arrived we were catered to. Concierge was incredibly helpful and accommodating, as was our butler! The wait staff went out of their way to make us feel comfortable. Everyone was friendly and kind - they all had a kind word or something funny to say to the kids. 
And Leticia and Laura, beach servers - thanks for keeping the drinks flowing - and the water bottles on ice!

reviews.author: 934matthewv
reviews.title: Satisfied
reviews.text: Enjoyed stay very much, staff was great, food very good and place very nice. We had a hard time getting towels, coffee, coffee cups and such replaced in the room everyday.  We also have a 20 month old that needs warm bottle in night but couldn't get microwave to warm one, it took any-where from 40 minutes to 1hour 20 to get one from room service

reviews.author: MEinLoveland
reviews.title: Pampered Family Vaction.  Definitely recommend Family Concierge.
reviews.text: We have stayed at several all-inclusive resorts and this was by far my favorite.  We upgraded to the family concierge and couldn't believe the perks!  The check-in process was quick and smooth (another benefit of the family concierge) and the kids were psyched about the backpacks filled with goodies they received upon arrival.  The service was outstanding everywhere we went. I was so surprised by the complimentary bottle (tequila, wine, champagne) and treats (cheeseboard, fruit tray, chocolate covered strawberries) that were left in our room each night.  The food was very good, especially for an all-inclusive where you can easily get tired of the buffet. Our favorite restaurant was the Brazilian Marketplace which the whole family enjoyed!  The best perk was having access to the Kids Program which our 7 and 5 year olds thoroughly enjoyed for a few hours each day.  From soccer and pool activities to painting pottery and decorating cupcakes in the kitchen, the kids had a blast.  And, while they were safe and sound in the kids program, the adults enjoyed quiet time on the beach and some R&R at the spa.  My only complaint was the incense that was used in the evenings in the lobby which felt overpowering, especially to a person who is allergies to perfumes.  If you are looking for a family-friendly resort who will spoil you like crazy, then I highly recommend Paradisus Cancun.  We only stayed 3 days, 4 nights and I really wish we had added a day or two to the trip.  We'll be back.

reviews.author: TVLDtheWRLD
reviews.title: outstanding property.  well maintained daily and long term.
reviews.text:
All-inclusive, even the mini bar.  At check-in we were offered an upgrade.  At first refused but I guess rooms were vacant as they offered a good discount.  Multiple times.  When they explained the difference, it was extra concierge, an extra garden bar and snack bar, separate pool and cabanas and beach.  and the true selling point,, no kids.  It is a very child friendly property with even an activity schedule.  Just like a cruise ship.  But our area was quiet day and night.  Soft musician in the evening at the  open garden area.  Card access.  The property is a pyramid style with no interior rooms.  They have real vines growing multiple stories down from the sky lit cover. 
   We tried 6 restaurants and only one was ok with my wife (the buffet).  The market place grill (Argentinian style) brought the skewers of beef to the table to carve.  Tried all but all tough to chew.  the rest of the restaurants were very great!  great service, but all had a fusion style.  We wanted Mexican style as in homes not cutting edge.  It was excellent food well prepared and presented but I guess too fancy for our taste.  We stuck to the bottled water or restaurant water and tequila mixed drinks.  I tried the hot dogs and hamburgers and bacon and sausage at breakfast and poolside but realized that the spicing done was adjusted for local taste.  Kind of bland as they expect you to add salsa of one or another type.    The bacon was cured not smoked or flavored.  As was the sausage and hot dogs.  Good, but different.  
    I had a massage and it was one of the best I've ever had.  LuLu gave a deep massge better than I had in Istanbul.  Steam room was dense and relaxing.  A bit expensive but so good I had a 2nd the next day.
   We had a deluxe excursion to chicheniza?  on Mar 22nd.  For me it was Monday.  For them it was Solstice.   A 12 hour trip turned into 17 hours.  It is a special day as the sun for only 5 minutes or less around 5 PM creates a shadow snake (religious symbol) up the temple.  That required we stay and fight a crowd of over 50K there to see it.  We did not start back until after 7 PM.  Our guide Jorge was excellent and passionate about his job and country.  A buffet lunch (finally a regular Mexican meal as Golden Corral is to me in America) was included but with the long day they included an extra 2 hours in the city center and a box lunch on the way back to Cancun.  Look for the red shirt tours.
  Free wifi
   With the upgrade we qualified to reserve cabanas by the adult pool.  Spent one whole day.  I had breakfast just off the sand in the open air restaurant and lunch and drinks in the cabana (kobe beef sliders) brought by the stewards.  Pampered.
  The only blips on the stay were they had entertainment each night that was very good but presented in a very very small venue in front of a bar.  Maybe a hundred people could hear it but 50 could see as no seats.  Need a better area.  
  And the front desk closed out my account 2Xs.  Each time I had to go (from our area- a very long walk) to reenter my credit card.  I was polite, but I believe the manager understood my feelings.

reviews.author: Debbie K
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Review
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful.  One of the nicest places we have stayed.  The staff went above and beyond to make us comfortable.  The food was amazing.  Our room overlooked the ocean and the view was amazing.  Everyone was extremely friendly and made our visit very enjoyable.  I would highly recommend this hotel and experience.

reviews.author: crehkem
reviews.title: Relaxing getaway with my daughters
reviews.text:
On spring break with my two daughters, we enjoyed a beautiful all-inclusive resort that tailored to our every need. The building was beautiful and the staff was truly wonderful. Even with some rainy days during our trip we still left with a beautiful tan and a relaxed state of mind. This is our second consecutive year coming here and we will sure to be coming back in the future. 
Some of our favorite staff that were a continuous aid and accompaniment were: Cesar Prado in Naos, Miguel in Naos, Tomas, and Oscar in Naos Pm.

reviews.author: Sonia E
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise!
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun far exceeded our expectations!! My husband and I visited Cacun for the first time ever last week. We were worried about traveling there during the busy spring break season- thinking we would basically forfeit any chance at personalized service. We couldn't be more wrong! From the moment we walked in, the staff at Paradisus made us feel like their most important priority. Every single staff member we encountered for any reason greeted us with a smile and was eager to help  us enjoy our time in Cancun. There are so many hotel options in the area, but I sincerely feel the stellar service is what sets Paradisus apart. The restaurants and food are superb and I cannot say enough good things about the staff. Wilbert, Marco and Fulgencio went above and beyond to make every meal a memorable experience! Their service was so personal and efficient. I also have to mention that we went fishing while in Cancun. My husband caught a MahiMahi which he brought back to the hotel. The chef at Enso prepared it for us in such a beautiful (and delicious!) way, that it was one of the highlights of our trip. We cannot wait to go back!

reviews.author: rickby13
reviews.title: Great service and staff!
reviews.text: It's been a number of years since I last visited the Paradisus Cancun.  The rooms have remained the same without much wear and tear.  But in comparison to the other Paradisus properties that I've visited in the Mayan Riviera and Punta Cana, this one was definitely smaller and older.  The hotel staff with their helpful, friendly and courteous manner is what makes this resort an outstanding one in my books. The variety of restaurants and the quality of the food was excellent. Special thanks to our personal butler Bladimir for looking after our every need!

reviews.author: Barnfield91
reviews.title: Second Stay - brilliant
reviews.text:
For the first time ever, my partner and I decided to revisit a hotel we had a brilliant time at the year before. It did not disappoint.

The reason people get the paradisus wrong is due to the booking they make. If you're a family, request the family pyramid, if you're a couple go Royal service, and if you're a complainer just go outside of spring break or summer holidays.

The hotel, staff, pools, beach and general atmosphere around the hotel is amazing.

Would come back a third time.

reviews.author: steffo65
reviews.title: Pure heaven!
reviews.text: I've never been to Mexico and going to Cancun during Spring Break worried me.   I am also not an all-inclusive-resort fan normally but Paradisus was way above and beyond my expectations. The service, cleanliness, location, amenities, food, comfort level, and all around luxury was *impeccable*. Expect to eat a lot, and well. We were with our almost-12 yr old son and he was sort of too old for the kids activities but with the fabulous pools and gorgeous beach -- and tacos by the pool almost every day-- he was very happy. Lots of other things to do should you choose to leave the resort but in our short stay we decided to soak up luxury and sun only. Would go again in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: glpcle
reviews.title: Great vacation!
reviews.text:
We took a family trip to Cancun and had a lovely week at Paradisus. The grounds are beautiful! The staff was so friendly and accommodating and really made our trip that much more memorable. A special thank you to Marco at the Naos restaurant. He always greeted us with a smile, was extremely friendly and helpful, and even brought our favorite drinks to the table without us having to ask - he knew what we would order! Our last day we were so sad having to say goodbye to him! Christian at Naos was also fantastic. Poolside we loved Laura, she's a gem!!
We tried most of the "reservation" restaurants. Our favorites were Bana (great sashimi), Mole, and Fuego. We also frequented the Nespresso station at least once or twice everyday. Anores makes the best cappuccinos! And always with a smile on his face. He's wonderful!
Great trip - we would definitely return. So why 4 stars instead of 5? The hotel could definitely use some updates. There were several areas with leaks. Our bedroom door was temperamental - sometimes it locked, sometimes it didn't. That being said, whenever we did have an issue and spoke to the front desk, they attended to it promptly.

reviews.author: sherriem54
reviews.title: heaven on earth
reviews.text: I loved this place such beauty,,,great food and great people. If you go definitely make a reservation for Banos,,it had the best sushi i have ever eaten. we also at at Vento a great tapa restaurant. our room was beautiful and the alcohol was top shelf. we had a favorite bartender Gibran Lopez,,he was such a great bartender and good kid. i would definitely go there again. the only downside was having to change our american money for pesos so we could buy anything at the resort. I needed cigarettes and was in my bikini,,i ran to the store to get some. well okay i needed pesos so i went to the front desk to get pesos and i needed my PASSPORT to get pesos,,,really i said do i look like i have someplace to keep my passport. I asked the lady if i wanted to give you this $10 american money as a tip would you accept it she said yes....i was a bit mad about that whole thing...but i got over it quickly..lol...still strange they take american money as tips but not to buy anything in their stores.

reviews.author: nmj39901
reviews.title: Amazibg
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I came in for 3 nights and upgraded to royal service. I would do that again. Our butler, Fernando was incredible. Everything was taken care of, dinner was great. Mole and Fuego are must-eats when staying here. Daniel at the pool, always has the sun screen towels and cabanas for you. Once you sit down, make sure to find Caesar and tip him well, he does a great job making sure your drinks aren't empty. I loved this place, good for kids but it won't allow you to do Royal service. The resort is massive, good entertainment and the service is 2nd to none. We will be back, take our advice and see out the people above. They do great work.

reviews.author: Mark G
reviews.title: 2nd year in a row
reviews.text: 2nd year in a row here at the paradisus for spring break with the kids. Even though I really like this place I don't think I would stay there again because I tend to get bored staying at the same place. Two negatives I can say, 1) the beds are not very comfortable and 2) the wifi sucks !!

reviews.author: rrohan189
reviews.title: A 4.3/5
reviews.text:
Paradisus was occasionally better than "Very Good." Here's the low down - 

What wasn't good
- Very questionable food in Enso (Asian restaurant)
- The whole beach chair system is a tad annoying. You have to wake up at 6am or so to throw a couple of towels on chairs - which, then, make the chairs unusable even if the person only uses it for 30 mins. This system should be a bit fluid. 
- Room service seemed to take its own sweet time and had a somewhat annoying habit of banging on the door till you answer or just entering even after you scream you're in the shower (must be a language problem in all fairness)
- The property had a few issues - the area around our room always seemed to have leaks when it rained and had towels all over the place
- Minor annoyance - the price discrimination (while it makes total business sense) was a bit annoying. "Royal Service" has access to some really comfortable "Balis", then Club Melia members have access to something else and for everyone else, it costs $100 to rent one of them during the day.. even if most lay unused for large parts of the day. Their beach system needs revisiting..

What was good 
- The all inclusive concept is fantastic. It is nice to never worry about food with Naos (buffet restaurant) open nearly all through with good food
- Fuego, Mole and Vento are all fantastic parts of the all inclusive deal 
- Occasionally very good live music at Bana 
- Very nice beach, pools and activities
- Friendly staff 
- Good rooms

reviews.author: cjryan37
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun - extraordinary service!
reviews.text: Recent visit to the Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun for 4 night stay.  A foursome of girlfriends - we enjoyed the excellent butler service of Galdino, pool wait-service by Victor, Alberto and Daniel.  We loved the Bali beds for rest, relaxation and cocktails in between the pool and surf water play!  Andrea was so hospitable and welcoming, excellent leader of quality and hospitality - she even had Simon make us some special flowery "Simon says - Love Apples drink".  Cindy Valeria Josue also was our go-to gal at the breakfast bar - absolutely lovely.  Great staff!

reviews.author: 699daled
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: I enjoyed every minute of my stay here. Great value  and great place over all. The food is great and the atmosphere is amazing. The staff was all friendly and the service was prompt. Great selection of alcohol too (not all wells). I would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Jay G
reviews.title: Winter vacation getaway.
reviews.text:
We are familiar with Pardisius resorts after  couple vacations in the Dominican Republic. That was enjoyable so we decided to try Paradisius Csncun. 
Overall we are very satisfied. The property feels a bit older but the upkeep is generally very good and seems to be an ongoing process. 
The rooms were fantastic and spacious. Housekeeping was exemplary and timely. As bottled water is recommended for hydration, brushing of teeth and coffee making, we did have to request beverage replenishment s couple times. Apparently the person who actually does this was new and thought we weren't "all inclusive " guests? No matter, a phone call brought prompt service.
The pools and beach cabanas and sheltered beds were fantastic. Service for beverages, etc was very pleasant and conscientious. (A tip here and there seems to assure attentiveness. ) we especially wish to mention Sergio and David for their warm and charming personal styles and genuine customer service!
One final shout out to our breakfast and lunch server, Cristan at the Naos Restaurant. Cristian was very helpful, happy and engaging. So much so that the last few days of our trip we specifically requested seating in whatever area he was working. 
If you go to Parsdisius Cancun, you will not be disappointed in Cristian's service in Rest. Naos.

reviews.author: BrianandTrish
reviews.title: Another Week of Pure Paradise
reviews.text:
This was our third year staying at Paradisus in Royal Service and it just keeps getting better and better.  The staff is excellent and it all starts at the top with the Manager Lazaro, who greeted us with a nice welcome when we arrived.  Galdino was our butler(per request as he treated us wonderful on past trips) and he recognized us and was there for any need.  Every morning Galdino would check in with us at the pool to ask about any dinner reservation requests and would personally take iced tea up to our fridge to make me happy.  Galdino, thanks for the nice notes, the baths with rose petals you left for me and your wonderful personality!!  I can't wait to see you again next year.  Best Butler in the place(no offense Rode, you are great too!)

The pool in Royal Service is heated, and there is a nice hot tub pool at the edge of the property.  Omar and Daniel at the Bali Bed stand are there for your every need, checking in frequently after we were in the Bali Bed to make sure everything was perfect.  I thank you both for all you did for us.  Your smiling faces by the pool daily were a highlight of our trip.  

Have breakfast at La Palapa(or lunch too as the menu has changed). The fish and chips are fantastic.  Valeria, thank you so much making sure there were banana's daily.  You great customer service meant so much to us.  I thought of you and your customer service when I had my first banana at home.  :)

Ricardo, Victor, Cesar  and Jason from the pool area, thank you for all you did.  You made sure we always had fresh drinks and work so hard. Victor, you also left a huge impression on us with your smiling face and over the top customer service.  

I know I left out names of the great staff here, my apologies as everyone was wonderful.

The Paradisus is a beautiful resort with many dining options and improvements with the property year after year.  What keeps bringing us back is the staff, there are many hotels in Cancun, but the staff at the Paradisus is top notch.   They are there for your every need and want your vacation to be perfection.

We will see you again next year!

reviews.author: Ankur S
reviews.title: Spring break
reviews.text:
What a place to be for your vacation. If not the best resort in cancun , definitely amongst the best . Top notch service - whether it's house keeping ,  concierge , restaurants , or room service . So many restaurants each offering different types of food , servers on their toes to feed you. 

Overall , a great resort.  Must visit .

Critic : all the private agents selling packages for tours to visit around cancun are overpriced. They all are cheating visitors by charging outrageous prices .. Shop around . Buy packages from down town , negotiate.

reviews.author: Carly R
reviews.title: Outstanding wait staff, underwhelmed by Hotel staff
reviews.text: The wait staff is the reason this hotel gets 3 stars and not 1 or 2. Traveled here with my husband and 2 children last week (March 2016) and was impressed with the hotel and the service the first day. When we checked in, we asked if we could be upgraded to a room with a bedroom and he said they were out until 2 days after we checked. We agreed to move rooms and paid extra for the family concierge. My husband and I are NOT picky people but this was definitely not worth it. The only thing the butler did was make reservations for us 2 nights and messed them up both nights. We requested between 7-8 and he made them for 8:30 and 9:30 each night and then told us they were for 8 and 9 each night! Who eats at 9pm with small children? We were very frustrated only because we felt we paid more for a service that was really underwhelming. Don't eat at ENSO- horrible service and encountered the only rude waiter on the resort. Food wasn't great at this restaurant- just stick with the buffet at NAOS. Blue Agave was great food as well.  Yhoni and Arturo at NAOS were AMAZING! We had them 3-4 days in a row and were nothing but awesome. They work so hard with a smile on there face. Lastly, pool and beach access with loungers was just too stressful. Felt like you had to be out by the pool at 7 am to get a lounger by the pool. Bottom line, OK stay if you get a deal. If we would have not paid extra for the concierge service, I probably would have given this hotel a 3/4 star. Since we paid extra, I felt we got ripped off so only 2 stars for this place:(

reviews.author: amrodri2
reviews.title: Eduardo from the swim up bar made our experience the best!!!
reviews.text:
The overall ambiance of the hotel is beautiful!!!! My best friend and I made a Spring break trip out to the Paradisus and upon arriving they upgraded us into Royal Service. We mainly took advantage of the restaurant La Palapa which had absolutely delicious food and the most beautiful view of the ocean. Jorge here treated us very nicely and made sure we had everything we needed at all times. 
The first day we arrived we got a lot of cloudiness and wind so we were pretty bummed, but we spent the whole day at the swim up bar where Eduardo immediately gave us the best experience. He was extremely helpful in giving us a local's insight on where to tour, etc and made us feel super welcome. He was by far our favorite person of the trip and favorite bartender!! His partner Alipio was also great. Overall, all the staff we came across treated us top notch and we made friends with everyone we came across.
It was slightly difficult to get a reservation in at the restaurants we wanted the night before so I recommend booking that at least 2 nights in advance. The hotel vibe was very family oriented so we didn't get the exact "spring break" trip we had imagined, but we had an amazing time regardless. There is a "club" inside the hotel open until 2am I believe but it seemed to have more older couples than young singles. Would go back!!

reviews.author: Mitchell N
reviews.title: Great Property and Value for the Money
reviews.text: We loved our stay.  Royal Service was a great option.  They knew it was my girlfriend's birthday and had the room decorated, champagne and a cake for our arrival - what a treat!  The staff is so helpful and caring about the experience - people smile and are very accommodating.  While the rooms are older, they are more than nice, very clean and food was really good.  I'd definitely go back.

reviews.author: Mary A
reviews.title: STAY AWAY!!  Go somewhere else...
reviews.text: I have never written a review before but I felt compelled to now because of the horrible experience we had at this hotel.  My family of 5 just returned yesterday from Paradisus.  I wanted to hopefully save someone else from booking here and having the same terrible experience. I chose this hotel based on the good reviews and I am shocked anyone would enjoy this place.  First of all, the min you walk in the hotel they pressure you for the Time Share sales and if you don't want to sign up you basically get treated like a second class citizen.  Secondly, the food was terrible!  There are several restaurants on the property but good luck at getting a reservation.  Ever day we called for a reservation and were told that they were booked.  The only time we could eat was at 10:00 or 10:30pm; unless we wanted to go to the nasty buffets.  Blue Agave is nothing more than a taco bar, Naos is typical buffet food that is terrible, Tapas was the worst I've ever eaten!!  Market Grill was the best out of all but it wasn't great.  The staff was less than helpful; there are LOTS of people around but they all tend to the new arrivals and appear to be focused on getting you to do the time share session.  This was our first all inclusive and what a disappointment.  I highly recommend looking for another resort if you are considering this one.

reviews.author: 54LAP88
reviews.title: "Simply Amazing"
reviews.text:
Just arrived home after an amazing trip at the Royal Service Paradisus Cancun.  If you don’t like to get up at the crack of dawn to claim your chair at the pool or beach, this is the place your you!  

The resort is older but is very clean and well kept (we understand the Royal Service portion of the resort will be renovated this fall).  Royal service offers extras that are well worth the cost.  Butler service will help with just about anything.  Our butler Geraldo was wonderful.  He  made all restaurant & Bali beds reservations, supplied aloe for my daughters sunburn, and sent us champagne and cake to celebrate a birthday.  We were able to eat at all the restaurants that required reservations.  Best dinners were at Vento, Market Grill, and Bana.  We did not eat at Tempo, which is not included in the all inclusive eating options.  Breakfast and lunch at the Royal Service La Palapa outside restaurant was very good.  

Royal Service has small scale evening entertainment at 7:00pm every night where you can enjoy a drinks and appetizers before dinner.  The larger scale entertainment at the main area of the resort is crowded and difficult to watch.  If you are interested, be there before 8:00pm to find seating.  

If you need medication during your stay, there is a 24-Hours pharmacy directly across the street from the Paradisus.  If you need to see a doctor, skip the $125 resort doctor and see the “free” doctor next to the pharmacy between 4:00-7:00pm daily.  This doctor was excellent and spoke very good english.

For those who need to stay connected, Paradisus offers free wifi in rooms and throughout the resort.

Special thanks Omar & Patrick who took care of securing Bali beds at locations we preferred, Caesar beach/pool server who kept us well supplied with food & drinks, and Carlos the  Royal Service resort manager.

reviews.author: kassieobrien
reviews.title: Andrés at Nespresso was the best!
reviews.text: At Nespresso, the Coffee Corner at Paradisus Cancún, my husband and I met the waiter, Andrés, who simply exceeded our expectations. He was extremely friendly, the hardest worker we saw there, and always in positive spirits. Andrés made our stay at the resort go from good to great. We loved spending time with him, and if anyone else visits this resort, you need to make sure to go hang out with him too!

reviews.author: hannahmO5709FJ
reviews.title: Will be going back.
reviews.text: If you get the correct room you paid for (meaning we complained and moved rooms) then you will have great views, super friendly staff, clean comfortable and really have a great time. Food is good, drinks are better and ALWAYS get your mid day snack at the Blue Agave restaurant!! AMAZING!! drinks and food everyday.

reviews.author: Carley B
reviews.title: Fantastic trip!
reviews.text: We had such an amazing trip, my husband and I. We took a 5 day vacation and loved it! The weather was quite windy while we were there but hadn't it been for the wind we would have roasted, so the breeze was much appreciated. The staff I can't say enough about. Karla and Anna were great! They made sure we had our dinner reservations booked every day, helped us get around the hotel without getting lost lol and booked our snorkling excursion for us etc. I even hurt my foot while there and Karla was concerned and made it apparent that a doctor was across the street and it was free to see him. She didnt have to do that considering there is a doc. On site for 100 dollars. We were very please with the service. 😉 Also, we received 3 nights 4 days to go back to a Paradisus for sitting through a time share tour thing. Although it was brutal it was worth it. We were still able to say no and get the trip plus that excursion. I was talking about was free. It was a lot of fun! Highly recommend going to Isla Mujeres.

reviews.author: palominagal
reviews.title: Our favorite resort
reviews.text:
We still recall the first time we entered this hotel...we were staying at another hotel,  but we wanted to try the upscale restaurant located here.  Best meal -- but that was in the 90s!

We now own 2 Platinum memberships here as our home resort...we visit at least once a year -- some years we go twice!

reviews.author: DebbieCrane417
reviews.title: Great time at Paradisus!
reviews.text: I have been to several all inclusive resorts and this is one of the best.  We stayed in the Royal Service area and felt it was well worth the extra money.   The cabanas are amazing, we were able to reserve 2 days by pool and one day on beach.   Service was great, the staff were attentive and very friendly.    Plenty of restaurant choices, our favorites were the sushi restaurant Bana and the poolside restaurant in the Royal Service area.   The liquor was top shelf in both Royal Service and the standard area.   This isn't a crazy place like other resorts, perfect for families.  The large pool does have fun activities but appropriate for all ages.    Another plus was we were never  approached about timeshares, which is something I disliked about other resorts.    We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Melissa N
reviews.title: Better than expected!
reviews.text: I came during my college spring break with my boyfriend, we are 20 and 24.  Everything was great, and the things that weren't great were not bad enough to make a difference! The cons first,  there are only two restaurants that you don't have to make reservations for, which isn't a big deal it just would be easier if you didn't need reservations!  Also,the resort is warm in the buildings, probably in the low to mid 70's.  The air conditioning in our room was not strong and every night I could only sleep with only one thin sheet.  The indoor pyramid and restaurants are also this way.  Other than that, the food was great, I have a very sensitive stomach and get food poisoning almost everywhere I travel, even in the US, and I did not get food poisoning here!  They always give you bottled water, so nothing to worry about there.  The people were the most amazing part.  Darwin at Bana is the friendliest waiter and Irving at Blue Agave also.  The pool bartenders Eden, Edgar and Jose were also nice and made very good drinks.  Miguel brought us drinks at the beach and he even brought us drinks that we didn't ask for but he knew we were needing another and got one he knew we would like!  Someone at the pool brought us drinks (didn't catch his name) but we didn't even order another drink yet and he brought us delicious orange drinks, we thought they weren't for us since we didn't order then and tried to decline but then he said he made them for us!  EVERYONE at the resort was nice and these are only a few of the names I could remember.  They truly go out of their way to make sure you are enjoying yourself.  Pool seats fill up very fast so keep that in mind, but there are always a few beach spots.  The cleaning staff was also very good, did not ever have to worry about our things in the room.  The location is also perfect, right  across from AquaWorld where almost all the excursions are so no need to take a bus you can just walk.  And to go downtown the bus stop is right outside the hotel for $1 a person!  We had an ocean view room and when they say ocean view they actually mean it, it's not like you can only see a little if you look from a certain angle, it was a truly amazing view! The balcony was also very big and there are chairs where you can even layout up there, plenty of sun! I was very impressed with this place and we had both said that if we come back to cancun this is where we would stay!

reviews.author: rdshah
reviews.title: Pretty with very good staff and nice location
reviews.text:
Room was normal hotel room with TV Coffee, refrigerator, King bed and sofa bed. No Microwave! Balcony was nice but since our position was not great. But room 2010 was like right next to beach and kids love that part.
Beach:
Beach was clean but rough seas. We had red flag almost everyday. There is this issue in Cancun where polyps are polluting the beach every where. We had the same problem. But I would expect all hotels to come together and pay for cleaning the beach. I found it little dirtier then Virginia Beach.
Sand:
White sand yes!
Water:
Blue water yes!
All Inclusive Resort experience:
Excellent with Naos restaurant and Market Grill were life savers.
We are vegetarians. There was lot of Mexican food and chefs are well aware of what to arrange for you. So no problems in that front.
Loved Blue Agave restaurant service and food.
Overall service was awesome to tell you the least. I mean these guys have raised the bar very high.
Excursions:
We did 2 things Chechen Itza and Boogie board with Dolphins
Both are good.
Rest just go and have fun. This is some  good experience.

Recommendations:
1. Buy what you want to buy at Chechen Itza. Bargaining is fun and they have better rates then Flea Market. Peso or Dollar doesnt matter what you carry.
2. I would prefer All Inclusive vs not. Restaurant on road are limited unless your reach the marketplace. Hotel Restaurant rates are little pricey. All Inclusive you have not much to worry.
3. Restaurants have nice service in evening. So make sure you make reservations 1 day in advance
4. Renting a car might not be best in Cancun is what I read. Using bus service is very convenient.

reviews.author: Zakato70
reviews.title: All Inclusive should not mean you have to sacrifice the basics
reviews.text:
I try to save writing a review for when I receive outstanding service, or when my experience was below my reasonable expectation.  In the case of the Paradisus Cancun, unfortunately my review will be because of the latter.  I have been to a Paradisus property in the past, and I feel that the quality of this one was below par, and I can not see myself spending the money to stay at this or any Melia resort again.  The bottom line is that for the money, you can get better.  If you're happy with average, and can get a discount, the Paradisus Cancun is for you.  Please note that we've traveled to Mexico many times, we all speak Spanish, and we LOVE Mexican hospitality.  It is second to none in the world.  

I reserved two rooms for my family of 5 as the maximum capacity is 4 people per room.  That's pretty standard, and for all of you who have more than 2 kids, you know the pain of having to get the second room.  We generally don't mind as we can put the kids in one room, and we try very hard for an adjoining room.  

Again, most hotels can not guarantee an adjoining room, but when you are traveling as a family, have 5 people in your group, and your youngest is 10, it would seem assigning  adjoining rooms would be a priority.  

When we arrived, not only did we not get adjoining rooms, but we had rooms that were several doors apart.  I was quite disappointed.  Apparently there is NOTHING you can do to ensure adjoining rooms.  The person checking us in worked extremely hard to find us two rooms that were at least next to one another, and finally succeeded.  We didn't get adjoining rooms, but I really appreciated her trying as hard as she did.  For the benefit of having our kids in the room next door, my wife and I had to sacrifice a king bed for two twins.  Could have been worse, and we made the best of our tiny bed.  Soon after we got ready to go to our room, we passed another family with three little children, all under 10 who were in the same boat as we were, and pleading for the hotel to help them.  I felt terribly for them.  

We opted for the family concierge level room.  After almost four days here, I can't really figure out what advantage this extra cost brings.  We had wine and cheese delivered to the room a few times (again this is an all inclusive property).  We were also assigned a "Mayordomo" or personal concierge whom we could call on a little phone they gave us.  He was helpful in getting us information for excursions, getting us restaurant reservations, and other little things.  He was very nice, but I can't really see needing this service if I were to come again.  A couple of times, we asked him to reserve cabanas for us (extra charge of between 100 and 185 dollars a day), and both times, we had to wait around until people figured out who were were, and why we were there.  I don't know whose fault that was, but it was a bit annoying.  I could have just gone up and picked a place on my own.

The other feature of the family concierge is a special family concierge room that has a few snacks and some candies available throughout the day.  Since this is an all inclusive resort, the fact that there is a bar and more drinks, seems like a benefit for the few.  If you have very small children, there is a romper room and a place for an exhausted mom or dad to let their kids run around, so I can see that being a bonus.  There are also video came consoles there for those kids that don't want to go to the pool, beach, or hang out in their rooms.

We had ocean view rooms, and I must say the views did not disappoint.  Make sure to request higher floors, otherwise, you could be staring at people by the pool, and the tops of trees.  We were on the second floor, and that was barely enough.  The size of the rooms were nice, and they were mostly clean.  I say mostly, because our bedding was gross (stains on the duvet) and many of the fresh towels (they are white) had stains on them as well.  I feel like a good dose of OxyClean or Chlorine would have solved that issue.  The dirty sheets and towel issue was a harbinger of things to come.

The most glaring and unbelievable problem at this resort was the utter lack of clean towels available for the guests at the pools and beach.  When I say a lack, I mean there were hours throughout the day, when there were no clean towels to hand out.  The hotel does not even take the responsibility to have hotel staff stand in the towel hut to tell people there are no towels.  Instead, there is a person from a separate company that sells tours, and uses the same hut, who has to notify all the wet guests looking for towels that there are none available.  I spoke with several staff members, and they confided in me that the hotel is aware of the problem, but they are unable to address the issue quickly enough.  It is plain to see that management is unwilling to purchase more towels.  They may have enough for off-season capacity, but during Spring Break there are literally hundreds of guests who have to wait up to an hour to get a towel to use at the pool or beach.  When the clean towels did show up, they were piled into a large mountain in the back of the hut, and handed to the guests without being folded and moist in many cases.  There was no staff to help.  The lady selling tours would hand out towels.  She tried to fold them in some cases, but there was too much demand so she gave up.  It was so surreal and unnecessary for the Paradisus to show such a lack of class on such a simple issue.  As someone who has worked in a service based industry, I couldn't fathom such a glaring issue.

Food.  Food.  Food.  I'm happy eating at a cheap buffet or France's finest restaurants, but the food at this resort left me longing for anything better.  The daily buffet for breakfast was good, but the dinner at the buffet was below average.  Also, the special restaurants including the Japanese, Brazilian, Asian/Fusion, and the Latin one were simply not that good.  I have  very open mind and an accepting palate, but the dishes were uninspired.  The meats were overcooked, and because of the humid temperature, everything became soggy in a matter of minutes (think seaweed on sushi rolls that chewy).  Even a simple order of nachos showed up at my room without the cheese.  At the Asian restaurant we ordered pork Gyoza and the waiter served us shrimp Gyoza.  We asked about the pork ones we ordered and he tried to insist that no such item existed.  We showed it to him on the menu, and then he explained they were out.  They tried to serve us "Nan" as in Indian bread, and it was just an overcooked pita bread.  I could literally write a book on how average/disappointing the food was.  I can pretty much guarantee that given a choice, most of the staff that works at this resort would rather eat at home or a local restaurant than the foods served here.

Finally, let me talk about the service and the staff.  The service at this hotel is what kept this review from being a two star review.  The employees of this hotel make the best with what they have.  That is simply the truth.  They work so hard to make the experience great.  Almost all of the wait staff was super helpful and respectful.  As I mentioned, we speak some Spanish, and that was appreciated, but almost everyone could speak a little English as well.  The housekeeping staff was terrific, and the people taking care of the resort were awesome.  Everyone greeted us with a smile, and a hand on their chest.  It was a great touch.  I love the spirit of hospitality that I feel every time I visit Mexico.  I was not disappointed by the great staff at the Paradisus Cancun.

Maybe I was expecting more, and I shouldn't have.  Overall, I can't recommend this resort to my friends and family, unless there are some changes in the food, the way the rooms are assigned to families with young children, and unless they can get their act together with their laundry.  I have a feeling that the dirty towels, lack of towels, and dirty linens are all somehow related.

Sorry Paradisus Cancun - thank you for sharing your wonderful staff with us, but management needs to know that short term gains will result in long term losses.

reviews.author: Weeney28
reviews.title: Simply AMAZING
reviews.text:
This was my second time staying at the Paradisus, Cancun with my daughter for a "Mother Daughter" vacation. This all inclusive resort is impeccable! There are four "Pyramids" (buildings that are connected and shaped like pyramids) that are all conveniently located to the restaurants, buffet, bars, pools and beach. I suggest the ocean view or lagoon view. We stayed in a Junior Suite during both of our stays. Two queen beds and a separate seating area with a pull-out sofa. 

As part of the all inclusive feature, you can either dine at the buffet (endless and expansive) or at one of their fine restaurants. We ate at each restaurant to try them out for dinner and all of them were great! The picture depicted in this post is the coi pond that was right next to our table. The buffet features an extensive array of fresh and high quality food. You can eat healthy - or not! Delicious!! I think one of my favorite treats was visiting the gourmet coffee stand each day. Better than Starbucks and included in your all inclusive benefits. The barista, Andres, was an amazing young man. He had the best personality and brightened my day!! I loved visiting him each day and getting to know him. He is a Star!

The resort is the cleanest I have ever stayed at. You can't find a piece of dust if you tried. The staff are always busily cleaning and are very friendly. Customer service is obviously a major focus. We met a nice young man named Mario who was willing to give us some good tips about places to visit outside of the resort like Acumel and Taloon. Don't miss the Mian ruins in Taloon!

Lastly, the beach is breathless. We spent many days just lounging on the beach on the comfortable lawn chairs under our grass umbrella! The staff circulate frequently and we were supplied with endless drinks. Yum!!! We felt like royalty!

With that all said...we will be back next year! You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Ahmed86
reviews.title: I was sad to leave, but I left with good memories
reviews.text:
From the time we arrived at the front door, the treatment was royal, even though we were not royal club guests. Check-in was quick, even with a last minute room change request. We were amazed by the beauty and cleanliness of the resort and its contemporary vibe. We stayed in a lagoon view suite, and with two small children, it was large enough. Our room had an open air hot tub, and it was fantastic to enjoy at the end of the day.
It is an all-inclusive resort, and with my experience with this sort, is that I get tired of the same food after day 3. Not in this resort! I was a little concerned about some reviews about the quality of the food, but we were amazed! I think the resort went great lengths to address those concerns and for the first time in my life, I was content with the variety, quality and taste of the food at the Naos buffet restaurant. They had an amazing selection of seafood (large grilled shrimps to thick salmon fillet grilled to perfection, scallops, white tuna, grouper, mahi-mahi, crab legs... you name it) I am a very picky eater, and my wife is even worse. They were cooked to perfection and never raw or dry. Also, we loved the choices of desert and tropical fruits. The market grill was amazing with their top choice beef steak, lambs and tacos. I loved the festive dinner where staff going table to table with the whole big stake and cutting them straight to plates. 
Exceptional guest service was everywhere and each person in uniform made the experience as if we are right at home. From the servers, to the room service ladies, to the ground crew, all greeted us with smiles. Food served at a lightning speed except Fuego. But it was meant to be that way; a romantic environment to have dinner and long conversations. And when food came, it was worth the 40 minutes wait. it was one of the most delicious sesame crusted salmon I've ever had! Vento, Tempo, Bana all were great restaurants and we enjoyed food very much. 
They had several pools and all were clean. We stuck to the shallow pool where the little one stayed in 2 hour stretches.      
The beach was exceptional with white sand beach and no seaweed at all. It was wonderful at the beach and felt very private and safe.
They had activity booths everywhere. A huge dive center/water-sport sits right across the street from the resort; a short and pleasant walk  takes you right to the boats at the lagoon for snorkeling/scuba diving trips.
The quality of the nightly entertainment was great. But the place is a little cramped and we wished it was held at an open auditorium or in a bigger setting. The elevators are on the small side to fit a dual stroller and needed a little maneuvering. 
Overall, it was above our expectation in terms of experience, food, and service. I highly recommend this place and we would love to come back and stay here again. 
Overall, We were very

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: good value for the money
reviews.text:
overall good, very nice restaurants and the service personnel were amazingly nice.. 
the property was nice kept and the rooms were clean, the only thing was the safe deposit box .
it did not work even after calling the front desk. the tv did not have a remote and after the second day of calling the front desk, we did get a technician that took our cable box and just left the local channels on.

reviews.author: brig_swaz
reviews.title: Honeymoon - March 2016
reviews.text: My husband and I went to this resort for our honeymoon. After reading many reviews for resorts, we decided on Paradisus Cancun...and we were not disappointed! Although we went during a peak season (spring break), the resort did not feel crowded or chaotic. All of the staff we interacted with were absolutely wonderful - going above and beyond to make sure our stay was perfect. We ate dinner at a different restaurant every night, and we thoroughly enjoyed all of the food we had during our stay (including the buffet style dining)! Our room was clean, and comfortable. Our minibar was restocked with drinks and snacks everyday which was nice. The chairs at the pool did fill up fast, but we were always able to find a covered spot on the beach and then we would go up to the swim-up bar at the pool to get drinks (staff members also brought drinks down to the beach for you). Staff members were constantly around cleaning the resort, and were always willing to answer any questions we had. This was our first all-inclusive experience, and we loved it! We did not upgrade to the Royal service, but our stay was great without it - we are happy that we saved some money by not upgrading and we used that money for excursions. We would definitely return to Paradisus Cancun for another vacation!

reviews.author: Cfranco1981
reviews.title: nice relaxing vacation
reviews.text: very nice hotel very friendly staff, Daniel from the royal service pool and Jorge and Cesar from the palapa restaurant give us the best service. food was ok at the restaurants, Mole was the best one for us. we will be back next year. so worth it to pay for royal service.

reviews.author: gloriaj0
reviews.title: Clean and Beautiful!
reviews.text: The decor is unique and well thought out. Cleanliness is excellent in all areas.  Wait staff are wonderful.  Location is excellent as are the pools. Improvement on arrival needs attention. Room numbering system should be explained.

reviews.author: joneses2016
reviews.title: Fabulous Vacations! Treated like VIPs
reviews.text:
Our first trip to Mexico, the week before Christmas 2015, we chose this hotel based on reviews, the beach, and a great deal that we got on a family concierge ocean view room. Unfortunately or fortunately, when we got there they told us the hotel was overbooked and they were going to send us to the beautiful Paradisus Esmeralda, and that they would give us a complimentary future stay and upgrade us to a one bedroom family concierge suite oceanview. We used that complimentary stay this March 10 - 17. They treated us like VIPs. We received a free cabana for our use for the week, which I highly recommend renting one to give yourself a break from the sun. Each night a delightful treat awaited us in our room for us or our girls. Once we were treated to a cheese platter and champagne; another time it's was champagne and chocolate covered strawberries; and another time it was a fabulous bottle of red wine and another cheese platter. The girls were treated to cookies left in the room to water guns to great Mexican toys. 
The hotel itself is beautiful from the restaurants, the bars and the gorgeous indoor atrium, to the room we were upgraded to. It was perfect for our family of four. It had two bathrooms, a king size bed in one room and two twin cots in the other room for the girls. It also had two balconies. A huge one with two loungers on one, overlooking the Royal section pool, and another one off our bedroom overlooking the beach and ocean. We were in heaven!
The resort has a fabulous selection of different dining options. Our favorite was Vento. Although, my youngest daughter would say it was the buffet. It was great, especially if you have a picky eater. There is something for everyone.
The pool choices were great. If you wanted action, then the main pool is for you. Lots of games and little shows to entertain. There is also a quieter pool for those who want it. If you want a snack by the pool, there is the Sunset Grill. It always had fruit, wraps, burger, hotdogs and more.
We want to thank Gabriel from the family concierge for taking awesome care of us. Always checking to see if we needed anything and making our stay the best. We also want to thank Jesus, from the pool concierge, for looking after us at the pool, and keeping our family in good supply of water and mudslides. 
I have to say, this vacation was probably the best we have ever been looked after and treated on any vacation we have ever had, and we have been to Turks and Caicos, Bahamas, Jamaica and St. Lucia. Thank you Paradisus Cancun. We will definitely be back!
The Joneses

reviews.author: Candiebeninga
reviews.text: The hotel was extremely humid. Was uncomfortable when we ate at the restaurants. We mainly ate at the outdoor restaurant to stay cool. The service was wonderful. Ceaser was the best waiter ever!!!!:))

reviews.author: Rick B
reviews.title: Very Nice Resort
reviews.text: The resort is very pretty although it needs some upgrades. The staff is wonderful and really go out of their way to be friendly and helpful. The beach is beautiful and the day beds ( for rent) are a wonderful splurge, especially with the champagne and lobster option! The food is good however the guests at the buffet are aggressive so I suggest dining at the restaurants. A very relaxing vacation. If I ever go back to Cancun I would stay at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Angela B
reviews.title: 2nd Trip to Paradisus and we will be back!!! Nothing but relaxation and fun!! :)
reviews.text:
My husband and I went to this resort last March (2015)  and loved it so much that we had to come back this year!! We stayed in the Royal Service side both times and were not disappointed!! So many things to rave about at this resort!!!
First and foremost, our butler GALDINO. We miss him!!! He went above and beyond to make sure we were always taken care of. We had him last year and were so happy with him that we requested him again this year. HE IS ABSOLUTELY AMAZING. They offer a cell phone to you upon arrival so that you can contact your butler when needed. We declined the cell phone both times as we never needed to find him. He took care of everything and we didn't have to lift a finger or be inconvenienced in any way. From dinner reservations, to tips about the nightlife in town, to a warm bath waiting for us after a day at the beach, to my husbands silly pillow request.....he took care of EVERYTHING!!! This trip was a birthday celebration for me and let me tell you, Galdino made that day so very special!! The room was decorated with streamers and balloons, a big banner on our door, he had the pool crew sing to me, he had the crew at the Market Grill restaurant sing to me and the cakes they gave me were so yummy!!! He even gave me a special card and balloon that was so thoughtful. He was very busy with many guests but never skipped a beat. I really don't know he does it!!! He was a pleasure to spend time with and we were very VERY happy the whole trip thanks to him!!!!
Then we have Daniel by the pool. This kid never stops moving! While my husband and I relaxed in our Bali beds he would always come by and make sure we were taken care of. He met us every morning and would take the time to hear the stories or our adventures the night before. He was a joy to get to know and had a great personality. He was ALWAYS SMILING. I noticed that any guest he was helping also had a smile. He too, added to our amazing experience at Paradisus.
The staff at this resort are so happy. We were always met with smiling faces and never had a bad experience with any of them. We had breakfast every morning at LaPalapa and the service and food were top notch. You never had to waive a waiter down while relaxing at the pool as they are constantly coming around making sure your cup and your belly were full. Eddie remembered us from last year which made us feel special, and he too would always make sure we were getting good service whether he was our waiter or not. We would get a big smile and a high five every time we saw him. 
And last but definitely not least, the crew at the Avenue Bar. SAMUEL!!!! Both this year and last year he was THE BEST. The man knew exactly what we wanted and had it waiting for us. Smiling while putting up with our many requests for rainbow shots or his now famous "LaMangolapa". We would be laughing all night with the bar crew. Rey, Emanuel, and beautiful Fabiola....such great times at Avenue Bar!!!
I am big on reading reviews prior to booking and or staying at a resort. I have never written a review but this place deserves one. I see some bad reviews on here and I have no idea why ANYONE would have anything bad to say about Paradisus, in my opinion they just might be hard to please... From the service to the food (and we are very picky eaters!) to the rooms, the resorts gorgeous atriums, the pool and beach...everything was perfect. We plan on coming back for a 3rd trip!!! THANK YOU PARADISUS!!!!

reviews.author: Mindy V
reviews.title: Excellent Resort!
reviews.text: We had an awesome time at the Paradisus.  Great location, great food and fantastic service!  It is a great place to go as a couple or as a family.  Beautiful beach and pool areas.  My only complaint would be that the wifi is terrible.  The bars are great - Christian especially took great care of us in Bana restaurant.  Very nice and down to earth - represented the Melia brand very well.  The place was spotless and employees were always cleaning.  Would go back in a heartbeat!  Stayed in the main tower in ocean view room 3456 - best location in the hotel!

reviews.author: Rosa E
reviews.title: Lovely Vacation IN MEXICO
reviews.text: Overall my experience at this hotel was awesome ,we stayed at the paradisus daring our vacation celebrating my husband birthday and had a wonderful time, my bottler Cesar did a great job making us feel at home and the other guys at the pool area,dining and buffer area was great,I'm looking forward to seeing these guys again Javier, Gustavo, Alberth Pech, Daniel, Omar, Jessica, Sindy Lopez, Alexander, Cesar, josue Leon and venancio we thank you all a wonderful time can't wait to see all.

reviews.author: 966satisfied
reviews.title: What a fantastic place to spring break
reviews.text: We loved staying at the Paradisus Cancun, the rooms were excellent and the restaurants were outstanding! The staff were so friendly and kind, especially Marcos, Victor and Alberto who waited on us at breakfast every morning.

reviews.author: gregoriyy
reviews.title: very beautiful and relaxing
reviews.text:
Excellent resort and service very clean good food nice staff very relaxing set up lots of problems with room equipment probably do to spring break like tv safe iron door lock 
More sea food like crab legs lobster

reviews.author: laurarob2016
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: We just returned home from our third vacation to the Paradisus Cancun.  We love this hotel, the location, the pools and beach, and more than anything, the staff cannot be beat!  We rented a cabana out by the pool every day that we were there and had the pleasure of having Sofonia and Jesus serving us our food and drinks the entire time we were there.  We travel quite a bit, and by far these two provided the best service of any place we have been.  It is always hard to leave when are vacation comes to an end, and we can only hope when we go back again, Sofonia and Jesus will still be there, as they made this year's trip The Best!

reviews.author: JLCWashingtonState
reviews.title: Fourth Visit
reviews.text: We always enjoy our stays. The all-inclusive really saves. The staff is friendly, efficient and responsive. They really take care of all of your needs in a timely manner. The dining choices are wonderful and we really enjoy the live entertainment they offer daily. We usually stay on a upper level floor and get a ocean view.

reviews.author: elisabetta802016
reviews.title: poor Royal service
reviews.text: Please try another hotel chain. I know now we will. And it was our second time staying here. Royal service was not as efficient as they make it sound they will be. Room service food was always cold!!!

reviews.author: C C
reviews.title: Older Hotel needs face lift
reviews.text:
Overall experience was OK - the hotel looks good in the main areas but the rooms are small and dated needing upgrading badly, Avoid rooms that overlook the center area where restaurants and LOUD shows occur every night till late at night.
The food was ok most seafood was not fresh and most of the restaurants while not full seemt struggle to keep with flow of people. A few exceptions of good service the majority of staff while pleasant was also very slow and often taking way too long to do basic tasks.
the beach was very nice and the people serving the pool and beach area were very good.  Overall must say way overpriced for what you get.
Just a last comment nowadays good wifi is a necessity and I must say the internet service was atrocious.

reviews.author: Monoyan
reviews.title: Awesome spring break
reviews.text:
We just returned from an amazing spring break at Paradisus!  From check in where we were greeted with margaritas to our farewell coffees at Nespresso with Andres - we were continually impressed with excellent service.   Judith was very helpful in getting our dinner reservations set for every night at our desired restaurants.  We ate at Bana, Market Grill, Mole and Vento (listed in order of our faves).  We also enjoyed made to order omelettes at Naos  and our daily tacos at Blue Agave - our waiter Atilano made the experience so amazing that we ate lunch there every day! 

We want to give an extra special thank you to Rey, Manuel and colleagues at the Avenue Bar who provided our nightly entertainment with their fun and fruity drink creations.  They contributed to a very memorable vacation! :)

The beach, pool & swim up bar were enjoyed so much that we were all very sad to leave and look forward to visiting again!

reviews.author: sglong5
reviews.title: Spring Break - Wonderful Vacation!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus during Spring Break and had a wonderful vacation!  We were greeted promptly when we arrived and had no difficulties securing our room overlooking the ocean.  Our room was centrally located and it was easy for us to get to the restaurants, pools, and beach.  We were at the pool the next morning by 8 a.m.  Our concierge, Alexander, was already at the pool area and helped us pick a spot and gave us all the tips for securing a spot at the pool.  Alexander was always extremely polite and accommodating.  We had a spa reservation one morning and Alexander watched our stuff at the pool area while we were at the spa.  Our waiters Sofo and Jesus were very polite and routinely checked in with us to see if we needed any beverages.  They had our routine down!  It was sad to say goodbye to Alexander, Sofo, and Jesus.  The restaurants were great!  I would definitely encourage people to make reservations early to get into the restaurants.  The buffet area is great though if you are unable to get into one of the restaurants that require reservations.  Our view overlooking the water was awesome!  Our room was always cleaned well.  There were a couple of times that we needed more towels and the hospitality staff delivered them promptly.  If there were any concerns on our part they were rectified immediately by staff.  Everywhere you turned there were staff members and they were all extremely polite.  We loved chatting we our Nespresso guy too.  We went to the show at Avenue Bar each night and were even lucky enough to when a spa visit the next morning.  One of the best massages I've ever had!!!  On our last day, we were not leaving for the airport till 4 p.m.  We checked out by noon and the concierge stored our bags.  We reserved a hospitality room and were able to clean up before our departure--this was such a nice amenity.  I can't say enough wonderful things about the Paradisus and the staff.  If I would have to give one criticism, I would say that the wifi was very weak, but it was free.  I love to research for good deals when traveling.  When I return to Cancun I will stay at the Paradisus again.  No need to look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Paige H
reviews.title: Great property. Ask for Sergio Mesero or Asunción for your poolside/cabana/beach server!!!
reviews.text:
Sergio was our poolside and beach server for a few of the days we were there.  During his days off, Asunción was our server. She has been on the property for over 20 years and it's obvious why.  She specializes in Tequila tastings and is very friendly. The rest of the staff was also fantastic but Sergio and Asunción were AWESOME!   Our drinks were never empty and our group is a bunch of trained professionals when it comes to downing poolside cocktails.  We were paying for the all-inclusive thing so all we did is throw tips his way.  Our drinks were never empty and we typically have holes in the bottom of our glasses for some reason :-)
Bit of advice:  Bring LOTS of 1$ bills or LOTS of Pesos in small denominations.  ATMs spit out large bills and getting smaller bills was a slight pain.  Property was beautiful but massive.  Later in the evening only a couple bars in the middle of the property are serving.  Our rooms were in the end pyramids requiring a 10 min walk just to get a drink back to your room.  Room-service wine & hard liquor are not part of the deal so plan ahead.  They will stock your fridge with beer if you ask the service staff.  Awesome dining options (especially the Brazilian steak house) with a very helpful and friendly staff.  
I recommend using the hotel to airport transfer service (about $35 each way for up to 8 people) instead of a local cab for obvious security concerns.  The driver was waiting outside customs with my name on a sign and picked us up in a nice new clean black SUV.  I would definitely go back.

reviews.author: stephenkA3810ZO
reviews.title: Beautiful beaches
reviews.text: Very nice resort. Beautiful beach and pool area. White sand beach with best beachfront/ pool seating compared to nearby hotels/resorts. Great service at the pool and restaurants. Very diverse dining options. Maid service was lacking.

reviews.author: knaak
reviews.title: This is true paradise on earth
reviews.text:
Where to begin?  My family and I have enjoyed the opportunity to travel to many different hotels in many different islands throughout the Caribbean. This is now one of my favourite places to visit.

The hotel is beautiful.  The staff are amazing.  The pool is perfect.  The beach is magical.  The food?  Consistently and hands down the best food I've eaten anywhere.

Market Grill was our favourite breakfast and lunch spot.  They are an outdoor, shaded buffet style (with some a la carte options).  Special recognition of David and Carlos, the waiter dynamic duo that we quickly recognized as providing the very best service.  After the second day, we only sat in their section and they took amazingly good care of us the entire trip.

During the evenings, we tried a different place every night.  From authentic Mexican at Mole, to Argentinian style BBQ back at the Market Grill.  Every night was an experience, and one night we treated ourselves to TEMPO which is their on-site food adventure which I will write a dedicated (5-star) review for.

I *really* loved this place, and it lives up to the Paradisus name.  

I did have some minor criticisms that I would offer as opportunities for improvement.  The evening shows were excellent, but there wasn't enough room to accommodate  both the performers nor the spectators.  I think that the hotel management needs to come up with a better solution for providing more space.

I am a slight Whiskey snob in that I enjoy an occasional whiskey and I can recognize many single malts (at least the style) while consuming it.  I noticed that 8th Avenue had Glenlivet (which is nice) and I ordered it.  I did not receive it though, the first night I received some sort of blend suitable for mixing in a Pisco Sour.  The second time, I tried to order it, I received Johnny Walker Black instead.  I guessed that they liked to have the bottles on the shelf, but perhaps they don't like the cost of serving it.

On a similar note, we are Melia Club Members, and I would have liked to have some of the options to enjoy premium spirits in the evenings (similiar to DR and other SR locations) but this didn't seem to be available.  

On the plus side, they use real Fruit in the cocktails and real Yerba Buena in the Mohitos (best mohitos anywhere, including Cuba).

Anyway, this is getting long... If you are considering going to Paradisus with your family DO IT.  Great hotel.  

Thanks David & Carlos for helping to make the week special for my family.

reviews.author: Mauricio O
reviews.title: Spring break with the family
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus last year (2015) for Spring Break. We are a family of four with children of 18 and 10 years old. 

Paradisus Resort was an excellent choice. The hotel grounds are amazong and very well taken care of. The rooms are great, the food was azing and there are things for the whole family. Entertainment team did an excellent job. There are always differemt activities through the day and night. My family loved it. 

The pool was great and the service was quick and always there. Cancun beach is one of the best beaches. We stayed in Riviera Maya, Cancun and Punta Cana several times but Cancun is still the best. 

We stayed at Hard Rock Cafe and Live Aqua as couples only but this time we choose Paradisus for the family vacations and we don't regret it. It was almost perfect. We will definitely go back. Maybe next time to Paradisus Playa del Carmen. 

Great service, food, drinks and amenities. Everything you need for a perfect vacation!

reviews.author: dcr503
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation with Mom
reviews.text: My mom and I wanted to take a vacation during college spring break and we chose this hotel because of the great reviews. Overall, it was a very relaxing vacation and we would go back again. We stayed for four nights and it was the perfect amount of time to get it 3+ full days of relaxing on the beach or near the pool. The hotel was beautiful with vines hanging from the different floors. This was our first impression of the hotel and it was a great one. The rooms were clean and had a nice view of the beach, even though our room didn't completely face the water. (Our room faced one of the other pyramids) The food and service were the best parts about the hotel. We ate at the buffet, Bana (Asian), Blue Agave (Mexican), Mole (Mexican), and the Market (Brazilian). The tortilla soup from Mole was one of the most amazing meals we have ever had! The food was also very good at the Brazilian restaurant, the waiters came around with different meats and sides, which were all delicious. We had breakfast in the buffet every morning and there were many options. We ate a light lunch at the Blue Agave. We also had dinner one night at Bana where we got some nice rolls. The service in all of the restaurants was superb! We sat on the beach the majority of our stay and staff constantly came over to give us waters and to ask if we wanted drinks. We have a few suggestions. We didn't understand why there were not many people in the pool. When we went in the pool we understood why, the pool was uncomfortably deep. (My mom and I are both 5'5') We also wished there were more signs around the hotel, we ended up getting lost the first two days and had to walk up and down several flights of stairs to find what we were looking for, which was frustrating. Besides these two things, we had a great a vacation. Paradisus Cancun is a perfect hotel if you are looking to relax!

reviews.author: Chris R
reviews.title: Excellent rooms, service, pool and lots of choices for restaurants!
reviews.text: We had two beautiful suites facing the lagoon with connecting doors.  We had a kitchenette, two baths, two bedrooms, two balconies.
