Excellent service cleaning the rooms and restocking the mini bar daily.  Enjoyed room service for breakfast every morning.  The restaurants were awesome.  Loved the Brazillian Steakhouse at the Market Grill.  We especially loved Fuego, Bana and Mole.  The pool bar was a lot of fun and enjoyed visiting with Eden every day, and there were an ample amount of loungers around the pool.  Great drinks!  Only thing I would change is there really wasn't anywhere to get an alcoholic drink other than in a restaurant, pool area or beer in your room.  Would have been nice to have a bar in the hotel you could just go and sit, visit and drink.  The Yhi Spa has excellent massages and strongly recommended.  There are a lot of local restaurants and excursions which you can book right in the hotel and plenty to do in Cancun for everyone.  Bus service right out in front of the hotel will take you anywhere around Cancun.  Definitely some place that our family will likely return.

reviews.author: Melissa D
reviews.title: Wonderful Spring Break experience
reviews.text: We could not have been happier with our stay at the Paridisus.  When we arrived, they had booked us in a room with a king bed instead of two doubles, so they delivered a roll away for the first night and upgraded us to an ocean view for the rest of the stay.  The service in every part of the hotel was excellent.  The waiters in every part of the hotel, from the restaurants, to the pool and on the beach were gracious and accommodated every request with pleasure.  We particularly enjoyed breakfast at the buffet (Naos) and dinners at Blue Agave and Vento.  Our waiter, Roberto, at Blue Agave was amazing--The tacos, guacamole and margaritas here were top notch.  We only wished we had time to eat there more than twice!  The food at Vento was a very nice surprise on our last night as well.  It is a tapas restaurant, and everything we ordered was delicious.  I had read many good reviews about Fuego before we went on the trip, but we liked Vento more...One of our other favorites in the hotel was the Nespresso bar.  Andres was delightful and the coffee was so good, we came home and purchased a Nespresso machine!  We do wish the coffee bar was open a bit earlier in the morning and maybe for after dinner coffee instead of just from 9-5 since that is the hottest part of the day.  Shows at night are fun after dinner activity too.  Different show each night and very entertaining!  We would definitely choose Paridisus again--

reviews.author: myra20162016
reviews.title: we loved the pampering-  especially from our waiter Kauil at Naos
reviews.text:
This is a great place for overall luxury and pampering.  We stayed in the adults only section.  We had a butler which helped on some dinner reservations.  THe staff was very attentive and knew us by name by day 2.  The cabanas were reserved daily which we loved and the ocean was magnificient (most days calm).  

Our waiter, Kauil at Naos each morning was superb.  He greeted us wel

reviews.author: angelapMarch2016
reviews.title: Vacation and wedding venue search
reviews.text:
This resort is absolutely beautiful. Staff and team members were helpful, friendly and accommodating. The pools and beach were perfect. Food was good, our favorites were fuego and bana....food temperature in buffet and other dining establishments could be improved, but was still great for an all inclusive Resort. 

Loved our experience and plan in hosting our wedding here in 2017!

reviews.author: Corey C
reviews.title: Excellent resort, unbelievable service
reviews.text: I don't have one bad thing to say about the resort.  The restaurants were all excellent (especially the market grill) even with it being an all inclusive resort.  Reservations for the restaurants were easy to make and there were no problems the whole time.  What really impressed me was the service.  Every staff member went out of their way to help or see if we needed anything.  One staff member in particular, Alexander the concierge, saw us every day at the pool to greet us and even made reservations for us, we did not have to lift a finger.  The pool was very clean and the bartenders were attentive.  All around excellent hotel that did not seem like your standard all inclusive, this is a step above.

reviews.author: trishwalshe
reviews.title: Awesome place to stay!  Eat at the wonderful Naos restaurant!
reviews.text:
Travel Tales:
Cancun Captivates and Caters to All Family Members, Alike!
(It Is So Much More than a Just a Spring Break Destination!)

Submitted by:  Trisha Walshe

Family Member Names:  Trisha, Owen, and Aiden Walshe and Pat Stenson

 We traveled to Cancun, Mexico.  We went the week of December 12th to 19th, 2015.

We were away for eight days and seven nights.
Grandparents:  Jerry and Ann Schmid, my father and stepmother, accompanied the four of us on the vacation.

We vacationed in Cancun last Spring Break and had a wonderful time.  This time, we stayed at Paradisus/Club Melia and enjoyed amazing accommodations, superb service, and delicious dishes each day and night.  The weather was perfect each day of our stay; it was 85 degrees with brilliant sunshine, low humidity, and a gentle tropical breeze.

Although our resort offered nine restaurants from which to choose, each evening we dined at Naos Restaurant which was so much more than a standard buffet.  Each night, the carnivores ate different Mexican dishes, ranging from fish like sea bass freshly caught that day from the Sea of Cortez to various cuts of succulent beef and chicken, with sauces like habanero and scrumptious side dishes like hearty beans and plantains.  Personally, I was offered unique, delectable  Mexican vegetarian rice and pasta dishes with locally grown asparagus, mushrooms, and peppers.  

Granted, my sons could not resist the aromatic franks and crisp fries at dinner each night, but they did try and found that they liked new vegetables like jicama and chayote and fruits like papaya and guava.  Further, the dessert bar was to-die-for, showcasing an array of exquisitely-created, decadent confections.  Also, we really enjoyed the high-caliber wine that we were offered and savored its exceptional quality.  Additionally, there were some excellent rums to sample and a tasty Xtabentum (a famous Mayan liqueur made from honey and anise) to try.

The restaurant's manager, Juan de Dios, was the consummate host and leader of this top-notch establishment.  He meticulously ensured that all of our culinary and service needs were fulfilled by the head chef (Chef Moses) and his cooking staff and the doting waitstaff, most notably, our servers, Miguel and Eduardo.  Ultimately, Juan went above and beyond his role, and we know consider him a veritable member of our extended family!  (See the attached picture of all of us following dinner our last wondrous evening.)

While the boys swam in the pools and frolicked in the waters of the Sea of Cortez with Jerry and Ann, my mother and I, leisurely, either lounged in the shade of the cushy cabana or basked in the vibrant, omnipresent sunlight, reading a copious number of books (as devoid of electronic devices as possible!).
 
The Mexicans who we met were extremely friendly and gracious.  They patiently taught us any Spanish words or phrases that we did not know.  They embraced us and our stories and shared details of their own families as they got to know ours.

We were able to eat dinner at the table as a family for hours each evening, uninterrupted, engaging in meaningful conversations, a feat nearly impossible, with the hustle-and-bustle of our daily, hectic lives, at home.  In fact, ultimately, this vacation gave us the golden opportunity to spend quality time with each other and bond as a family as we never have done before.  

There were no disappointing parts of our stay.  If pressed, I would only say that the one minor disappointment was dealing with the monsoon-like rain on the Saturday morning that we were leaving for home.  Although it helped ease some of the  bittersweet nature of our departure, the weather did cause poor visibility on the roads, and unceremoniously, doused us, along with our luggage, when we arrived at the airport.  But, obviously, there is no controlling Mother Nature; better inclement conditions at the very end of a vacation than during one!

Based upon our last stay, we would certainly return and plan to do so from April 30th to May 7, 2016.

My recommendations for other travelers would be stay at Paradisus/Club Melia and eat at its Naos Restaurant and prepare to experience a magical, once-in-a-lifetime, unforgettable vacation!

reviews.author: FamilyVaca2016
reviews.title: This is an amazing resort! We Stayed 3/10-3/16,2016.
reviews.text:
When we arrived we were told there was a problem with one of our rooms, but they were going to up-grade our rooms to make up for it. They up-graded one room immediately to an ocean view and the other room we would have to wait until the following day to be moved. They up-graded the second room to a one bedroom suite...it was beautiful!!! and worth the wait! Concierge desk...Leticia and her boss Lazero made this all happen!!!! We had royal service and our butler Juan was fantastic!!! He made us feel very special! He made sure we had our dinner and bali bed reservations through out our stay! He checked in with us every day to make sure all of our needs were being met!!!!
 The pool attendants Daniel and Javier....we loved them, so friendly!!! Our waiter at the pool Moises...he was so much fun and always kept the drinks coming!!!  We will recommend this place to anyone going to Cancun! It was worth the extra money to have the "Royal Service"! Had a wonderful experience at the Mole...Hostess Mirian and waiter Rigo were fabulous! Blue Agave had delicious food and this is one of the restaurants that reservations are not needed! Beach was awesome,very little seaweed and lots of chairs to choose from!
Only bad service was at the Cocoa lounge..Jesus was not very friendly :(, and service and food at the Vento was not very impressive.  

Only have two suggestions... Offer drinks while customers are going through the check-in process!
And more trash cans are needed around the resort.

FYI...Jet Ski rentals just North of Paradisus on the beach (not affiliated), stay away.

reviews.author: Gaetania
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: This was our second year of staying at the Paradisus    We very much enjoyed the first visit   Service was great as well as the staff   Our concierge did a fantastic job!  Even though it was in need of quite a bit of renovations and updating they were working on some of the problems so we assumed all would have been completed by the time we arrived this year.  Big mistake on my part!   It was in worse condition!!   We stayed in room 4305 both times   Nothing was improved upon at all    This could be a really nice room as it is a one bedroom suite with 2 bathrooms   Also has 3 balconies   Unfortunately none had outdoor furniture!   We asked our concierge Gabriel 3 times for that and never got it    We were supposed to have 12 noon room cleaning and 6 pm turn down service    Most days we had to call for the room to be cleaned and very rarely did the whole suite get cleaned   Turn down service happened 3 times   Just a note we stayed almost 2 weeks!!   The first 3 nights we received evening snacks which consisted of champagne & berries,  wine & cheese twice  all tasted like vinegar   So disappointing!!   Constantly had to call for restocking of mini bar and water    Also had to call quite a bit to get dinner reservations that the concierge was also supposed to take care of   When you're paying for concierge services you expect them at the very least to just do their jobs!   The high point of this resort was that the food was really good   Wait staff was excellent   This will be my last trip to Paradisus or any of the Melia resorts even though I am a member!   This vacation was so bad that I've booked a trip to St Martin in a few weeks for a do-over!!

reviews.author: SR2324
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort; food is lacking.
reviews.text:
PROS: 
- Beautiful; the inside is like a giant greenhouse and is very grandiose. 
- Staff is all friendly and helpful. 
- The beach area is spotless. 
- Rooms are nice. Ocean view rooms sometimes come with a jacuzzi on the porch which was amazing. I don't know if this is true of all of them but we did not request it. 
- Significant nightlife for a cancun resort. Always people out. 
- They have shows every night which are if nothing else amusing. 
- The fitness area is gorgeous. They have an entire spin room, yoga classes, coolers of water and iced tea outside. 
- Various actives available throughout the day. They have a photo service that comes around with a monkey and lemur that you can take professional photos with. 
- 24 hour room service 
- Nespresso bar and Nespresso machines in all the rooms. Really nice perk. 

CONS: 
- As many other travelers noted; getting beach and pool chairs is competitive. However my group didn't ever get there before 10 and we always managed to find chairs. 
- The food is not good. I stayed at Riu last year and the food was significantly better. I was expecting that if not more and was disappointed. It all looks good but tastes sub-par and sometimes disgusting. The restaurants are actually the worst food. They are fun for the experience but not worth it for the food. I would only bother on going to Bana the sushi place because the environment is so enjoyable. 
- Sure there were days we had to request water because they didn't refill it in our room, or minor things around the resort that need to be fixed. For an affordable all inclusive I don't know why people get so upset about this. 
- The day beds in front of the main area can be rented for $100. This was not worth it. You are put in front of speakers blasting house music and the service is no better than on the beach. They also told us we were getting a lobster as part of the fee which turned out to be a half a lobster tail. We asked multiple times to turn down the music and it was never done. Don't waste your money...though it is nice to lay on a bed on the beach. 
- Like almost every all inclusive. The drinks are sugary and have almost no alcohol in them. If you want to drink get shots. They also have no "drink menus" anywhere which kind of takes the fun out of ordering tropical drinks unless you know them off the top of your head. 

Royal Service: We didn't have it and didn't notice.

reviews.author: Mark T
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay
reviews.text: We just returned from a six day stay at Paradisus Cancun.  This was our first trip to Cancun and we will definitely return!  Fernando, Daniel, Rode, and Melina all went above and beyond.  Best place ever

reviews.author: Kim B
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Had so much fun at Paradisus. Orlando was our server and was excellent! Great customer service. Would definitely recommend breakfast at the restaurant by the pool. Just wish there were no kids allowed in the bar areas.

reviews.author: Frank100000
reviews.title: Great family resort hotel
reviews.text:
We went with reasonably low expectations for a family break in the sun and had them well surpassed.

The resort is very generously all inclusive and the family concierge service was wonderful. Extra pool access was nice but our concierge really spoilt the kids and the sweets and treats waiting in the room, the little treasure hunt one night and the balloon animals made their trip.

Was lovely to relax on the balcony with a jacuzzi too. Brought the days to a close beautifully. 

The range of food options was also very wide and booking was easy and flexible.

All round great family resort.

reviews.author: Laurie D
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful hotels I have stayed at , great room and even greater view.  There really isn't anything bad I can say about this hotel except that if it's really hot, the lobby is not air conditioned but it was not that bad.

reviews.author: Peggy L
reviews.title: Another wonderful vacation at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from the Paradisus and had another wonderful time. We have been vacationing at this resort for 22 years and we are not Club Melia members. There has been many improvements made to the hotel over the years. The hotel is always spotless. The pool area is beautiful and the beach is breathtaking. All the workers are very friendly and they work very hard. Some of them have been working there for 22 years. When we vacation here we also get to see our friends!
Alexander, the pool concierge, is great. He watches over the pool area and monitors how long towels have been on chairs. If the people don't show up within a certain amount of time, he will remove them so other people can use the chairs. Some people put towels on chairs and don't show up for hours. Alexander will also make dinner reservations for you.
Asuncion, Leticia, Laura, Luis, Ingrid, Flor, Sofonia and Hector are the best waiters and waitress at the pool and on the beach. They are so friendly and work very hard always with a smile. Please tip them well!
The bartenders are also great. Juan Manuel Diaz is a great bartender has been working there for many years. We also enjoyed Emmanuel Argaez at the Lobby bar.

Thank you Paradisus for another great vacation!

reviews.author: Al K
reviews.title: A four day nightmare -- but great staff
reviews.text:
This was a family holiday with our children and grandchildren. We have also been long standing members of their vacation club. The hotel has deteriorated over the years --in its ambiance and the quality of some of its guests -- as it has changed its business model from a classy Gran Melia to an all-inclusive Paradisus. We had booked our rooms and vacation about four months in advance. It was a "guaranteed" booking backed by credit card etc. After the first week we were told that we were going to be moved to a different hotel ( in our best interest apparently) for four nights as the hotel was fully booked for a convention attended by siding and window salesmen from the US !! We refused to move -- with young children ( 4 & 2 years in age) --and six adults. We lived through days of uncertainty not knowing whether our stance was going to work. It did--but we had to change rooms several times--and lived through a nightmare of Donald Trump followers--heavy duty drunks and parties with blaring music and doors banging until the wee hours of the morning.
To make matters worse the dining areas and restaurants were packed to the brim --and had to be expanded over to the atrium is with the fish ponds. As a result, we were squeezed dangerously such that some of the chairs and tables were placed dangerously at the edge of the ponds; resulting in my fall backwards and injury to my skull--six stitches. Not once did any of the hotel management inquire about my wellbeing nor any apology was ever given. I talked to my attorney about it and he said good luck –in Mexico !! They are a money making machine with really no regard for their guests. They rely on the adage "there is always another sucker around the corner". After almost 16 visits to Cancun I will move forward to some other hotel and location. We were not on some cheap package--we spent a lot of money for a family vacation--it was a damn disaster. Too bad they have some wonderful staff --if only their management could learn from the real people who slog during the day – as the management guys stay cool in the air conditioned rooms!! If you are a party animal –do visit the hotel. It is your scene. If you are a family or a couple wanting a classy holiday—save yourself. Don’t go.

reviews.author: NatashaKanji
reviews.title: Incredible staff, but poor management
reviews.text:
If you're planning to go during Christmas break, make sure they don't have any conventions going on at the same time. The management tried to kick us out of the hotel and then when we refused to leave, we spent almost a week of our vacation room hopping to meet the demands of their convention guests. This convention took over the entire hotel (imagine loud heavy techno bass music blaring into your ears through your pillow at 3 am type takeover). 

BUT the staff were AMAZING! Once the convention was gone, it was back to a peaceful, family-friendly environment, and we really valued the care of the staff, especially Anores Contreras at Nespresso wanting to make sure we had the best coffees every morning, Martin Sanchez at the restaurant who took care of us every morning and afternoon for breakfast and lunch, and always made sure we had a wonderful experience, and Juan Jorge Garcia Soto at the pool who made sure we always had our cabana. Thank you all sooooo much!

reviews.author: Vacationgirl315
reviews.title: Amazing Birthday Trip
reviews.text: After reading the reviews I went back and fourth trying to decide between this resort and the Hard Rock. Boy was I glad I chose this one, it was my birthday so we were upgraded to Royal Service one bed room suite for free! Super! When we arrived to the room it was decorated with balloons, streamers, a cake and a personalized note for myself. Our fave spot was around the swim up bar, we rented cabana at CoCos Beach Club every day around the pool and boy was Jesus AMAZING, everyday he saved the same one for me, remembered me by name and knew exactly what I wanted everyday without asking, he is such a sweet hard working guy he made me feel like a queen! The beach and sand were beautiful, little seaweed everyday. We visit Cancun once a year but usually like to try a different resort every time but I will definitely be returning! Thanks Paradisus Cancun you rock!

reviews.author: HollisterRanchGirl
reviews.title: Nice hotel but not 5* service
reviews.text:
We were a family of nine and had 3 rooms at the Club Melia (timeshare) side of the hotel.  The hotel is huge and generally clean, but lacks a certain charm.  Felt very sterile in places and showroom-like.  There are some areas that look like they are unfinished (like maybe they are trying for minimalistic zen garden but felt like a corporate apartment) and others are really beautiful and well-done.

THE STAFF was usually really nice and helpful; some wait staff were superb including all of those we encountered at the breakfast buffet and at lunch at Market Grill.  Ordering drinks from the pool near Club Melia was easy and consistent (tipping helps).  We inquired with guest services about a spa menu and were told that they couldn't provide because they changed the prices and we had to walk to the other end of the hotel to get it (no offer to bring us one); another desk printed it out for us.  

THE FOOD was decent at most places.  The breakfast buffet was standard breakfast buffet.  Lots of options from an omelet bar to churros; nothing tasted amazing but it was all okay.  At busy times the line for made-to-order eggs took 10+ minutes so best to get there early if possible.  Fuego and Vento were fantastic, Market Grill, Enso & Bana were good and I didn't care for Mole.  We noticed that many restaurants didn't give us menus and just brought out a tasting of everything; this may have been because we were a large group of nine.  We were were very diligent on making reservations early so we could sit together (even booking with the hotel for the 1st 2 nights before we arrived).  One night we wanted to go to Blue Agave and they do not take reservations.  We took the extra precaution of calling Guest Services to make sure they could take a group of 9 w/o reservation and they said we would be fine.  We showed up and there was a sign out front that Blue Agave was closed that night and the next.  There were other groups milling about and scrambling to make other arrangements so it appeared to be a surprise to many.  We were never notified of the temporary closure and at the very least we should have been told when we called Guest Services.  After trying to squeeze into a restaurant, we were turned away and ended up having to eat at the buffet which we did NOT want to do.

THE DRINKS were consistently inconsistent.  Sometimes you'd get a fantastic, well-made mojito and sometimes it'd be sickly sweet.   

THE ROOM was clean and spacious.  We stayed in three rooms in the Club Melia, Pyramid 1.  Two of our rooms were the 1-bedroom suites, which was actually a sliding room divider in one large room; our room was a studio.  Strange to have a stovetop and full set of dishes at an all-inclusive resort, but that may be helpful to some.  The refrigerator was very loud and turned on throughout the night.  There was a jacuzzi tub on the patio, which would have been nice except we faced another set of rooms so we would have been in full view of others.  Two of the rooms faced a parking lot so also not a very romantic setting, but that was due to our room price point.  The pull out couch beds are extremely hard.  They offer mattress toppers upon request, which make them decent, but they ran out so my sisters had to sleep on very uncomfortable surfaces for most of the stay until the hotel got more.  We don't think they're made to sleep on without these toppers.  It would be nice if they supplied drying racks for swimsuits as there was nothing (not a pull out line in the shower, either).  We had to drape them over the chairs on the patio and as it was very humid or raining they never really dried.  The room setup was fine, but plugging in electronics was not easy (had to pull out bedside table and unplug lamp).  There was no signal on any of the TV channels, not that we wanted to watch much TV on our vacation, but it would have been nice to turn on the news for a bit.  

HOUSEKEEPING was usually decent although replenishing supplies in the room was very inconsistent.  One day we'd get 1 shampoo/conditioner/soap and another day we'd get 5 of each.  One day we'd get a lotion and for the next 4 days we'd get none.  Some days we'd get 2 towels each and others we'd get 1 and they took our bathmat and didn't replace it for 3 days, and so on.  The toiletries were Thierry Mugler, but honestly didn't seem better than any generic hotel stuff I'd used before.  On one occasion a soiled washcloth was set out as clean on the counter.  I threw it on the floor under the sink and when we got back after the "second cleaning" of the day, that same soiled washcloth was set back on the counter.  On the last day we paid hourly to stay until late afternoon as we had a 9pm flight and I was sick with the flu.  Despite putting out the do not disturb door hanger, housekeeping came in on me, waking me up, which was an annoyance.  

THE GROUNDS were nice and generally clean.  A lot of the air conditioners drip and throughout the trip we all ended sitting somewhere getting dripped on and having to move.  The common area near our rooms had some issue where the ceiling or wall was literally chipping off.  The bar area looks nice in the evening with the lights, but the seats are ripped in many areas and some pieces looked like they had literally fallen off the wall and just leaned there.  There was no jacuzzi at all at the hotel, which would have been really nice to have as the weather was a bit stormy at times.  It was warm out but the pool was really cold.  We rented a bali bed for the duration of the stay.  We didn't realize it, but it was right next to the kids pool so we had to put up with annoying song/dance routines by the staff throughout the day.  We moved down the way and it was fine.  As it was stormy many nights/days, the bali bed was wet on some mornings as they didn't protect it during the night.

WIFI was free and ok most of the time, but it wasn't working in our first room.  There was a known issue and we were told to use "common areas" instead.  We had to put up somewhat of a fight to get our room changed to one that didn't have problems.  It was spotty in the other two rooms, but not much time was spent there so it wasn't a big issue.

ISSUES.  At 1:40am we were awoken to a stranger entering our room.  He quickly saw us and apologized, leaving but not stating who he was/why he was there.  The next morning we reported it to security and after investigating they found it was a staff member that had mistaken our room number.  Mistakes happen, we understand that, but the man should have notified someone so we didn't have to spend our morning dealing with security.  They weren't very apologetic and didn't seem to care much.  Same with when our key card stopped working (happened to my sister also).  We were told we had to go to reception (quite far away) and wait in a line to have it fixed.  They told us it was probably due to us holding it next to a phone.  If this is the case, they should inform people of this at check in.   

Overall a decent hotel, but it's not comparable to other 5*s we've stayed at (Shangri-La, Ritz-Carlton, Four Seasons are far superior in amenities, service and detail).  Lots of kinks to work out and consistency needs to be addressed.  Would recommend, but expect more of a 4* experience.

reviews.author: Bridget C
reviews.title: Nice but could use some updates
reviews.text:
The resort is nice but a few things are showing their age.  The brick pavers around the pools are starting to fall apart. I can't tell you how many times i tripped on them.  
The hotel hair dryer burnt my hair the first night we were there. I couldn't get any help from the manager on that night.  I wanted the hair dryer replaced (it was shooting out sparks) and asked for some conditioning cream for my hair from the salon.  I was told that they would just give me more conditioner that is already there. Not good enough. My hair was still falling out and my scalp was throbbing. Finally had the woman who was in charge of our group to go and get it straightened out. That next afternoon, I finally had a new hair dryer and a small container of conditioning oil.  The manager of the rooms, Abraham came to my room and apologized for the mishap. He said he wanted to make it up to me. I told him I didn't want it to happen to the next person who gets the room. I just wanted to condition my hair so it would stop falling out and help my scalp feel better and not peel. He offered me a free service at the salon, which was very nice but I didn't take him up on it because I wasn't looking for free stuff.  He was very nice and because of Abraham, I would come back. Knowing that someone was concerned for me and my well being, makes me happy. I only wish that the manager who I first spoke to could have been as accommodating. She never did any of the things she said she would do.  Anyway, enough of my story...
The food was pretty good. The service was great everywhere we were. They really hustled at the pools to get you drinks.  We brought a bunch of singles to leave as tips for the servers. The more you tip, the better service you get!  
The beach is beautiful! Water was great, warm and clean.
If you are looking for night life, this may not be the place for you. We found that for the week we were there, everything became very quiet after 9pm. Only one night club in Pyramid 3.

reviews.author: JimRachelle
reviews.title: Paradisus A Touch of Paradise
reviews.text:
The facilities and food are beautiful. Having the al a carte options make for fine dining in the evening. Great location on the beach and a quick bus ride will get you to the mall in no time.

Service was spectacular. Having the ability to book restaurants on arrival made things go smooth. The beach food and service was great. A couple areas of concern would be a shortage of beach chairs and we booked a room through a discount travel agent so the room was not the best but who spends time in the room with the beach, food and spectacular service. Spent the extra for a Valentine's Dinner on the beach. It was wonderful. Great food, private music and of course the location was second to none.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: My wife and I flew down from New York to escape the cold winter and soak up some warm sun. We found the Paradisus Cancun to be a beautiful resort that was both clean and well maintained. But what really made it a great stay were the people who staffed the resort. They were warm and friendly and did everything they could to make sure we enjoyed our stay. A extra thanks to Marco and Alberto at the Market Grill restaurant for going above and beyond! The weather was great also. We would highly recommend and look forward to returning.

reviews.author: Jodiroth33
reviews.title: Vacation we will always remember!
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled with our 5 year old son and 5 month old daughter. Upon arrival we were checked in and in our room within 30 minutes. Our family concierge, Gabriel, was wonderful. He had sweets and drinks waiting every night for us, got us into every restaurant at the time we wanted and made sure my son felt very special.
Ingrid and Sergio, the pool waiters, were very attentive. They always had a smile on their face and were happy to bring any drink we requested.
Edgar and Pamela at Fuego were fabulous. Edgar even remembered my order from a few nights prior which is quite impressive when there are many guests staying there.
Our room, the family concierge ocean suite, was AMAZING! It was very large and the views were fabulous. The balconies were oversized and we loved waking up to the ocean everyday.
The spa was nice although my massage was just ok. The gym was kept very clean and always provided water and towels. 
Our favorite restaurants were, by far, Fuego and Mole. Naos had a great selection for a buffet. 
The kids club was WONDERFUL! My 5 year old son had a very hard time leaving when we had to go home. The counselors were so great with him and he never wanted to see us during the day--the sign he was having a good time. They even gave him and my daughter such nice gifts when they left. I feel terrible I forget the girls names who run it but they were so friendly and good with all of the kids.
Overall, this hotel had it all. I read some reviews before I went and I must say, I don't agree with most of them. The staff was so accommodating, the food was great, the rooms were huge, and the kids club was the best. I am already trying to book our next trip back! Thank you to all of the staff at Paradisus Cancun for giving us a trip we will never forget!!

reviews.author: Beverley S
reviews.title: Great service!!!
reviews.text: We upgraded to the Royal Suites side of the resort, included a butler, Galdino who was absolutely wonderful, accomdating and handled any reservation or request we had. While enjoying our Bally bed, pool service was extraordinary. Both Eddie and VIctor Derez were friendly, fun and always smiling. Drinks never ran empty, food service was excellent and delicious. The employees ALL work very hard, hustling around, always polite and with a smile. They made our stay relaxing, hassle free, never having to leave the comfort and amazing ocean view from our comfy lounge area. Highly recommend the upgrade!

reviews.author: Suzanne J
reviews.title: Perfect getaway...
reviews.text: I wanted to share my thoughts with you on my visit to the Paradisus Cancun. There are many hotels up and down the strip but the Paradisus stood out when I looking to book my holiday. What an amazing hotel, something for everyone! Despite Spring Break it wasn't too loud. The hotel was big enough for everyone to get what they wanted from their holiday.  I was lucky enough to stay in the Royal Suite which is situated in the 5th pyramid. I had a butler assigned to organise me if I needed. Fernando was attentive and always on hand to book dinner reservations, excursions and even offered to do some ironing!! Let me tell you about the restaurants, many to choose from with excellent choices to suit everyone's palate. No rushing out at stupid o'clock to reserve sunbeds always plenty with a pool concierge on hand for towels, water or sunblock if needed. In a nutshell nothing was too much trouble for the staff, service with a smile which is always an asset for hospitality.  This was my first visit to Cancun but definitely not the last. When I book again I'm definitely staying at the Paradisus Cancun. Thank you for a fantastic week!❤

reviews.author: Mauriciobertola
reviews.title: Great mini vacations!
reviews.text:
We flew from colorado just for 3 nights but it was enough to have a great time!!!

Great rooms, huge, hot tub at the balcony, sea view, etc.. f&b is awesome, many restaurantes different themes so you can pick anyone you want..

the best thing that the resort has is the expresso coffee shop near to the main lobby, (included as well in the all inclusive plan), Andres, the coofee guy makes this experience awesome. You can see people passing thru the shop and yell hi to andres, everybody loves that guy.. He knows the names of every single guest to stop by for a coffee.. thats a great service and one of the things because we will be back soon to the Paradisus...... Vento restaurante our favorite so far... Gerardo our server was great, excellent selections of spanish tapas.  Everybody there was so nice and friendly, Katia and Ignacio as well at that restaurante.. great experience!

reviews.author: Matthew O
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We had a timeshare room. However it didn't look like anything in the brochure. We were hoping that it was larger which would include a microwave and TV is not programmed correctly. Overall it was a beautiful place to vacation. Every restaurant and recreational program was right at the place.

reviews.author: IheartSugar
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel. Friendly staff. Too much "selling" though!
reviews.text:
I traveled with my husband and our infant son and overall, we had a great time. I really wanted to give Paradisus 5 stars, but there were a few things we really disliked. 

The Good: The grounds and hotel were immaculately clean and I was completely comfortable letting my son crawl on the floor! The views were spectacular and our room was always attentively serviced. All the waiters and maintenance staff were all exceptional. Everyone doted on our son the entire time (he loved the attention)! One morning we took him to the Baby Club, which had tons of cool toys and soft play structures. It was a neat activity and definitely a great amenity to the resort. The food was excellent - we personally loved Bana the best. Even the buffet was excellent and there was so much to choose from. Honestly, there are so many great things about this resort.

The Bad: Although we saw many families and I do think this resort is kid friendly, I don't think it is very baby friendly. We stayed in Pyramid 2 and the club/lounge/pop music that is played within the corridors is too loud and kept our son up very late. For reference, we live in NYC and are used to loud noises (sirens, trains, cars) but the music was too stimulating for my son and the music played well past 10pm. I wish I would have brought a white noise machine! Also, the kiddie pool is not great for babies. I wish there was a gradual (beach-like) entry into the pool or a splash pad. There is a small play ground but after a rain shower, some of the rust from the swings rubbed off on my son's hands and clothes. Finally, our biggest complaint is the constant "selling" of Club Melia. We couldn't ask a simple question without being pitched about Club Melia. Actually, we couldn't even walk by the Guest Service desk without being approached by 5-6 concierges. And we even got phone calls about it. It was ridiculous and made us feel very uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Want2HittheRd
reviews.title: A great first stay at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus for 4 days in the beginning of March. It is our first time to Cancun, so it was also our first visit to Paradisus Cancun. We found the travel time from the airport to the resort to be pretty quick. We booked our transportation to the resort through USA Transfers. They did a great job. Found them quickly (despite the timeshare shark that tried to misdirect me) and we were on our way.
    At the resort, we were greeted at the front door with a smile and our bags were promptly taken to be moved to our room. We prebooked the Royal Service with a lagoon facing room ($70/day).After a short wait in a reception area we were taken on a short tour while making our way to the 5th tower where the Royal Service guests stay. During check-in our drink order was taken. We were brought the best Margaritas we have had in years. At check-in we were offered a couple different rooms, each with their own attributes (King bed/bad view, good view/2 beds, etc) We were allowed to see each before making a decision. We were happy to be checked in and get this vacation started.
    A bit about about the Royal Service upgrade. After weighing the added cost against the added amenities, I firmly believe it is worth the extra $70 a day or $35 /day each. My wife and I found the exclusive top shelf bar and buffet to be great. The buffet seemed to be some of the choice selections from the other restaurants around the resort. Great coffee there too. Everything is small portions but it was all fresh with plenty of options. We also took advantage of the Royal Services 24 hr room service, mini bar with snacks, beer and cold water. We had access to the only heated pool at the resort. A RS only pool and beach with Palapas. The 2 days of beach and poolside Bali Beds were worth the $$ alone. There was a poolside restaurant & bar to make sure you had no needed while there. One afternoon we returned back to the room and found a bottle of very good tequila and a bottle of wine in our room. After expressing our appreciation, there was a fresh bottle each day. The resort as a whole, but more so the RS area smells very nice because they have aroma machines. At times it was quite strong. So, Keep this in mind if you are sensitive to these types of things.
   The downside:
The food is very hit & miss. The Tacos at Blue Agave were good. The Sushi at Bana was not good. The grand buffet at Naos wasn't very good. La Palpala was ok. You could find some safe bets, but a lot of the dishes weren't very good. Cold, overcooked, under seasoned,etc. I think the food at Vento was the best of our stay. I understand that it's difficult to cook good, fresh food for so many people but they really miss the mark. They try to be fancy, but miss in the execution. Only once or twice was hot food close to hot. They represent a dish as one thing, but serve you something else. For example, I ordered Tandoori Chicken wings. They were unseasoned deep fried wings. Nothing Tandoori about them. Just a cold, battered, fried chicken wing. This is the first All inclusive I've been to. I was told by others that compared to most All Inclusives, the food here was pretty good. It wasn't a deal breaker. If I went back, I now know where to eat and where to avoid.
    The service overall was excellent. Anything you need, just ask. My biggest complaint with service was around making dinner reservations. I would go to make reservation and be told we already made them somewhere else. We showed up one time to eat and were told we had canceled the reservation. Our room wasn't serviced one day. None of these were a big deal. Two thumbs up for the service.
   Our overall impression is that we would stay at Paradisus again. The excellent service, great location and beautiful beach outweigh the meh food.

reviews.author: Dennis S
reviews.title: Hope to visit again
reviews.text:
We just got home from our trip to the Paradisus Cancun resort.  We were more than pleased with the accommodation, the staff and the food options.
The event staff, Fernando, Uziel, Hugo, Carlos, Rodrigo and Freddy were amazing and provided fun activities both at the pool and in the Avenue Bar.  We made sure to see the show every night.
Speaking of the Avenue Bar, I just want to give a special thanks to Karina and Eduardo.  We never had to wait for a drink.  They were extremely attentive to us in helping us to have great seats for every show.
I can't say enough about the endless selection of food available.  There was something for every kind of diet:  Mediterranean, Italian, South American, Vegetarian, Asian, wow!  The serving staff were excellent  Special thanks to Jose, Uriel, Teresa, of the Market Grill.  Also the staff in the Fuego Restaurant.  You are wonderful and made our stay especially good.
Oh, I can't forget the massage therapists at YHI Spa.  Lupita and Yuri have the hands of angels.  We left feeling so relaxed.  We didn't want it to end.
Finally, the ladies of BD Travel.  Our experience wouldn't have been the same without your patience and wonderful guidance on all the amazing excursions available in Cancun.  We are definitely zip line junkies!

reviews.author: lah123
reviews.title: Fun vacation with family!
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled with two kids to Paradisus for spring break. The hotel staff is very accommodating and eager to help out. The common areas- restrooms, restaurants, pool,etc are very clean (I have high standards).We had a lagoon view from on the 8th floor. Because we were at the top of the hotel, we could see the water and not the parking lot (one reviewer complained about the lagoon view). We had a lovely, large terrace that was pleasant to sit on in the evening. The room was comfortable, clean and pretty, but nothing extraordinary. If it was a couples trip I'd probably want a nicer room, but I'm not in Mexico to stay in a hotel room.
The gym was well appointed; it started getting crowded about 7:30am. There were plenty of water bottles and towels available.
We felt it was necessary to save chairs on the beach or pool by about 9:30 to ensure we had a spot.
We enjoyed the shows in the evening in the Avenue Bar. The acrobatic Cirque type show was very good. It's best not to take the shows too seriously and just have fun. Arrive about 45 minutes early to get a seat. 
The restaurants were fair, and almost all require reservations a day in advance. My people enjoyed Mole the best. Naos, the main restaurant that does not require reservations and is buffet style, was actually very good. The selection was incredible. I eat a whole food, plant based diet and I had plenty to chose from. The salad bar was not your average bar- there were all sorts of shredded vegetables, legumes, sometimes heart of palm, olives and always guacamole. The fruit was amazing- I ate my weight in papaya. There was pear, kiwi, grapefruit, apples, figs, melon, etc. There was a great selection of fresh juices and a juice bar for made to order juices with add ins like sesame seeds, chia seeds and flax seeds.
Although I don't eat them, the deserts were beautiful. The pieces were small so those partaking could sample several things. 
The Sunset grill by the pool had good "snacks." For healthy eaters, guacamole and pico de gallo to put on lettuce, fruit cups, sandwiches- and for those who like unhealthy fare- burgers, fries, nachos and chicken nuggets.
You can enjoy an afternoon coffee at the Nespresso bar and receive wonderful service from Andres. He was always excited to see patrons.
The grounds were very pretty and well kept. The beach was well managed and the lifeguards seemed to be on top of it. 
Aquaworld across the street from the resort had lots of fun activities and water sports. All four of us enjoyed the Garra Rufa fish "spa" where the fish kiss your feet and soften them.
All in all, I would certainly recommend Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: colleendoc
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Feb 2016
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun was an amazing resort. The staff was excellent and friendly.The hotel was well maintained..The food at the buffet was amazing and the restaurants were superb...I would love to make a return trip .

reviews.author: mfoley77
reviews.title: Loved
reviews.text: We arrived on the 2nd and departed on the 9th. Three couples and we had a great time. We stayed in adults only and had butler service. We met him once. For us it was a waste of money. We just called and made dinner reso ourselves. Booked Bali beds ourselves. We actually spent first three days in the other section... music was better and more lively. We ate at all the restaurants and have nothing bad to say. Pool side service was amazing... fast. Every morning we ate at beachside restaurant. ..was nice to be outside plus buffet was not the greatest and a bit busy. Would we go back? Most definately. .. with the kids next time. Oh one other thing which bothered us was the fact that our room was not cleaned till mid afternoon... don't like that. Not a deal breaker but after breakfast( 9/10) it's nice to come back to a clean room.

reviews.author: Mark B
reviews.title: Great dinner at Mole!
reviews.text:
Location great!  Hotel nice, food fine.   Great dinner at Mole (Javier Salazar was great waiter.....even had music at our table!).

Recommend this place, drinks were plentiful, but seemed to have no buzz (??).

Easy bus ride downtown for $1.   CocoBongo Club night is a definite as the hotel entertainment is small and poorly placed.

reviews.author: Julie H
reviews.title: Definitely not a 5 star
reviews.text: The resort is very tired and in definite need of a re-fresh.  The front door could not be locked, the bathrooms are needing a total refresh and just does not meet the quality standards we have experienced at other Melia resorts.  On the 2nd floor of the Royal Service tower as an example   (premium priced luxury - highest price class room), guests come out to the floor to see planter boxes full of dirt but no plants or flowers.   In the day we arrived jacuzzis did not work but later were operating but you could see the water level ring mark due to the decade of wear and use and poor maintenance.   Activities schedule was not accurate- wasted time showing up to a published activity we were excited about only to be told that the schedule was inaccurate and staff could not even confirm what was the rescheduled time (perhaps sometime between 6 and 7 pm but "we really can't say....").  Service was generally good to very good but not excellent, not in accordance with our experience at other Paradisus resorts such as La Esmeralda or Le Perla in the Rivera Maya area. I saw many royal service pool guests get up and walk to the bar to retrieve their own drink at the Royal Service pool because there is no swim up bar and there were long lapses between waiters coming around for what should have been an experience in stellar service.  Food quality was best in the Royal service area which was only available for breakfast and lunch but mediocre in the other common areas and for dinner and service was extremely slow (2-3 hours in duration) in restaurants which purposely limit seating with advance reservations required.  While the nightly entertainment was very good the venue is extremely poor - poor visibility, uncomfortable, crowded, forced to cozy up with strangers etc ( not a Royal experience at all).   An actual show theater with individual chair seating should be put in place.  After the show is over at 830 pm there is absolutely zero entertainment -not good if you have teenagers who you would like to engage beyond the drinking experience that 7 or 8 bars have to offer .....Butler service benefit equated to an ability to secure a cabana (which is only guaranteed for 2 days of your stay ) and get restaurant reservations.   On the plus side the Royal Service liquor quality is very high and the view of the Caribbean Sea is absolutely gorgeous but I assume there must be other resorts along the coastline that offer equally great views as well as better overall service, consistent food quality and activities.   I have been a devoted repeat Paradisus customer in the past but may not return to Paradisus resorts and with certain will not return to the Paradisus Cancun resort.

reviews.author: CarolaRN
reviews.title: Beautiful, luxorious, Relaxing   Amazing Staff!  Amazing food.  I highly recommend this place!
reviews.text: My family has been to this hotel 6 times with plans to return.  The hotel and it's beach are breath-takingly beautiful.  The staff is warm and welcoming!  The food is both beautiful,fresh and delicious!!

reviews.author: Mike C
reviews.title: Was not happy at all
reviews.text: First of all it was our first trip to Mexico when we got there they put us into double beds was supposed to have a king bed and took them all night to put us in a different room they finally transferred us to a king bed but  it was on the first floor with no view so I was not happy with that. So we stayed in that room for the 5 nights we didn't want to fight to get a different room it was a nice room with a hot tub on the dack but no view.And the room service was horrible and cold every time we ordered it and they kick me out of the buffet for wearing tank top but as I was there throughout the week I saw a lot of guys in tank tops at the buffet and my room was a long walk to go get a t shirt. They cond us do in a timeshare presentation warning don't do it took over 3 hours and all we got was a discounted jungle tour on 2 person speed boat was fun but the tour guy demanded tips at the end of the tour he gave attitude because we didn't leave a big tip he was asking for $20 and the tour cost 180 $ than they sell u a picture and a beer bottal with your picture on it for 20$ and the tour guys name was Diego.The frist time we want to go do the tour the port was closed so we couldn't do the snorkeling so we had to come back the next day to do the tour the hotel never informed us the port was closed so we had to make 2 trips on the local bus warning they drive crazy.The best part about the trip was the pool bar and they closed that at 6pm.I give it 2.5 3 Stars at the most. Overall was not happy with the stay there.

reviews.author: ecogeek
reviews.title: Great hotel with excellent service
reviews.text: Returned to Cancun to celebrate a 10 year wedding anniversary.  Stayed at a 22 year old property, Paradisus Cancun which is well maintained.  We enjoyed the many restaurants, great service and wonderful jungle like environment.  Were greeted warmly every morning by Alicia at the buffet restaurant who seated us promptly wherever we desired for breakfast.  Carlos Cadena, our waiter, took care of all of our meal-related needs with a smile.  It was so nice to practice our Spanish and Italian with him as he served us our drinks.  Norma Acosta in customer service made some restaurant reservations for us, helped us with excursions and handled all of our questions/needs quickly and professionally.  The service was wonderful.and these individuals do great service to the hotel image.  The different restaurants were great;  all had vegetarian options for us and helped make our stay interesting.  The food was also excellent with huge variety. .  The only drawbacks were the noisy music at the pool area which we could hear from our room which faced the ocean.  We would return here again..

reviews.author: douglas l
reviews.title: Black Cloud Over 50th Birthday Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Resort for 6 nights.  Upon arrival at 9pm, the desk said our travel arrangements setup online with BookIt.com had not yet paid for our rooms. they explained that "this is common and to give us your credit card so they could have reassurance that they will get paid" and "check with us in the morning and Bookit should have paid for it by then".  It was late so I agreed.  I checked back the next morning and still no payment, they told me to call Bookit and maybe they will expedite the payment which I did that afternoon.  Bookit claimed they paid for the room, again the hotel said they had not.  This went on my entire stay with a lot of time on phone calls and at the desk until finally the night before my checkout, the hotel said that Bookit paid for the rooms at 330pm of that day.  Basically, the entire trip I had the sinking feeling that I might have to pay for the room twice!.  My issue with Paradisus is they knew and have been having problems with Bookit.com for sometime. They continued to tell me that "I'm not the only one" and "this has been happening with Bookit a lot".  My response was "why are you allowing Bookit to book your hotel if you know this has been a problem".  It's a shame that they would allow this company to put their guests through this.  I'm extremely disappointed in how they handled our situation and hope this sheds light on others so they do not get "trapped" in this scenario.

reviews.author: George M
reviews.title: Fantastic Journey
reviews.text: I have to say that as a member of the Hard Rock Club ,I wasn't expecting the level of quality that I was used to. Guess what folks, The Paradisus is better as far as I am concerned. The hospitality was great ,the grounds were terrific and the buffet was out of this world. A person doesn't see to many buffets that have Red tuna , White Tuna .Grouper , Red Snapper ,sea bass ,stone crabs , king crab legs and lobster tail all in the same buffet on the same day . The flank steak was as they say ,TO DIE FOR. I wouldn't hesitate to go back to this hotel .And it was at least a thousand cheaper than the Hard Rock . My PA travel agent did herself justice in getting me this hotel. Thanks KIM

reviews.author: Sofia P
reviews.title: The best beach club ever!!!
reviews.text:
Tabata and her staff make us feel just great, not the fist time i visit this place and everytime is just epic!!! Great food, great music, the best staff giving you the best service!! what else are you seeking for this holydays?!  safe, fun, availability, great food and amazing beach area just is coco's beach club, the place to be!!  
Big big thanks to tabata!!! Thanks to make our day, one of the best by been the best with us!!!

reviews.author: Jamiejamie77
reviews.title: My moms birthday trip
reviews.text: I have stayed at several all inclusive resorts in Mexico and the carribean. Riu Palace, Sandals, Barcelo. It was my moms birthday trip. I wanted her to feel spoiled and amazed by a luxury resort. She had never stayed at an all inclusive or even been to Mexico. So I payed the extra money to upgrade to Royal Service and an ocean view room. I called ahead from the US the day before our trip to make sure we would have 2 beds and to request a dinner reservation on the night we arrived at Bana. I knew we could only make reservations once we were there so I didn't want to get stuck eating the buffet our first night. I told them on the phone we were celebrating my moms 60th birthday, I put in our reservation comments I was traveling with my mom for her 60th birthday, I told our butler it was my moms 60th birthday. It was not once recognized...Yay! We're finally here. Ummmm no. We were greeted and told we were Royal Service and escorted into a lounge to wait to be checked in by our butler. After no one acknowledged us for 30 minutes I said please just show us to our room- no it has to be the butler. An hour later and 5 more people to talk to we were shown to our room. The worst possible upgraded room in the hotel. With a king bed. On the 1st floor, right outside the Royal service concierge area. Really? Live music, a bar and buffet right outside our door. Our ocean view suite was clean but not a view to be paying extra for. Could we see the ocean yes. A view from the first floor was not what I had in mind. I was told the hotel was a capacity so we could switch rooms to the zero floor with 2 beds and no ocean view. Not a great option. Our butler was friendly and made us our dinner reservations but we never really saw him after our 1st day. The food at Bana was good, our service there was great. We had the breakfast buffet- lots of fresh choices. Mole was good also with great service. We were lucky to get a Bali bed on Saturday because it rained. Our server out there was nice but kept forgetting our drinks so I had to go to the bar anyways. The ocean is breathtaking. The pool was not heated and there is no jacuzzi on the entire property that is hot. Even in the spa. Very disappointing. Bubbly pools of cold water- hmmmm? We ate at the market grill our last night, really good and great service there as well. The other problem here is the nightly entertainment. The entertainers are amazing and really talented but the venue it awful. They threw a show in a lounge bar on a tiny stage for hundreds of people to watch. Only about 25 could sit down and have a view. I booked this hotel because of the reviews the food, Royal service and entertainment. My mom doesn't drink so I thought she'd love the shows at night. She would have if we didn't have to stand up among all the other guests josteling for position to catch a view of a dancer or singer. I'm turning 40 in January and was using this trip for my moms 60th to check out this property for my upcoming trip with friends and family. We won't be back- I am really disappointed in this hotel. Our servers were all so friendly and nice but the management system needs lots of work. The check in process was infuriating and ridiculous. Not a great first impression. And our room and the cold pools and entertainment situation didn't leave a great last impression either.

reviews.author: LePort963
reviews.title: Wonderful Staff, Great Hotel!!
reviews.text:
Just got back from Cancun and had a wonderful time, mostly because of the staff! These people work so hard to keep you happy and it wouldn't be fair to only mention a few people (but I will) because everyone from start to finish was great! Best way to describe this place is like a fun, beautiful cruise ship. No need to leave property!!
 
PROS:
Check In was easy, friendly staff
If you book your trip through the hotel website they will arrange your ground transportation.
Hotel room was very nice, we upgraded to ocean front which was a good choice.
Pools are clean, but cold. 
Pool service was AMAZING. Our waiter Jorge was the best, every morning he greeted us and was very attentive to our needs, our group drank a lot, but always smiling and friendly. Also every morning Alexander greeted us too checked restaurant reservations for us and he even helped me with transportation off property. I can't say enough about these two gentlemen!
The beach is clean and safe. The lifeguard was on point watching guests in ocean, he (Johnny) even saved a girl when she couldn't get back to shore because of under tow.
The food was all good but had a hard time getting reservations. Tried all week to get into Market Grill and Fuego but no luck. Ate at buffet most of trip.
Entertainment was awesome too. By the large end of pool there is plenty of entertainment from Zumba, water aerobics, games, dancing, performers and music all day or you can choose to sit by the quiet pools instead if you like it peaceful. The guys that are in charge are fantastic (can't remember their names) they kept everyone involved and are very good at their jobs!
Evening entertainment was nice too. Every night in the hotel there was a dance/singing show that was really good. 
Golfing is right out the front door, they guys in our group golfed 1-2 times a day.

CONS:
If I could ask for one thing it would have been a more comfortable bed. Bed was too hard.

OTHER COMMENTS:
Although there is ramps for wheel chairs this resort has a lot of steps, inside and out. If you're handicapped you may want to stay somewhere else, we saw a few wheel chair bound people and it looked like a real hassle to accommodate them. The resort is designed to look like the Mayan Ruins so there are a lot of levels & steps.

Our previous trip we stayed at the Marriott Casa Magna (next door) and we really liked that place but there is nothing going on in evening, but that place would be more accessible than Paradisis.

reviews.author: jmbxoxo
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCUN IS PROPER
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Resort for 5 nights. Upon arriving, we were warmly greeted with fresh aromatic hand towels to clean up after our short bus ride from the airport. We checked-in promptly and were offered a room on the 8th (top) floor in Pyramid 3. We inquired about the Royal Service as we read so many reviews raving about it. They quoted us about $100US per night for this service and decided to decline. 
Room: Our room was facing the lagoon and had a very comfortable king size bed. The mini-bar was stocked daily with all your essentials. The maid came twice per day. Once in the morning and once in the evening for turn down service. Our room was kept very clean. Pyramid 3 is very lively. It’s definitely where you want to be if you want to party and be close to the action. If you are looking for peace & quiet, I would recommend a pyramid further out. There is also 24 hour room service available. We took advantage of this for breakfast!
Service: The service was incredible. The staff were extremely friendly and went out of their way to ensure you enjoyed everything. Although we did not book Royal Service, we definitely felt like we were treated like a King and Queen!
Food/Beverages: Beverages are top shelf. You can get brands such as Hennessy, Grey Goose, Belvedere, Johnny Walker, etc. Lots of selection for wine and rum too. The bartenders are great, especially at Avenue Bar. Great ambiance and place to go for pre/post dinner drinks. The food selection is nice. There are plenty of a la carte restaurants to choose from. (Mexican, Asian, Sushi Bar, Steakhouse, Seafood, Tapas). The buffets are massive and offer a large selection however we preferred dining at the a la carte restaurants. There is also a beach grill that offers beef & vegetarian burgers, fries, nachos, salads, wraps and fruit throughout the day. Around 4pm, Blue Agave opens up. A great place to grab authentic guacamole, tacos and quesadillas! If you are vegetarian, you won’t have any issues finding food to enjoy.
Beach: The beach is beautiful! Crystal clear waters and even without royal service, we had beach bar service brought to our chairs. This was a nice surprise! Everyone here works extremely hard. Coco’s Beach Club had a live band/great DJ spinning great beach music to keep a fun vibe going. The ocean was a bit aggressive during our stay but there is a very long stretch of beach to walk along. Plenty of loungers and beds available but on a busy day it’s always best to go early if you want a good spot! 
Pools: Really big and great for swimming. In excellent condition. Very refreshing and always kept clean! 
Overall, I would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun to friends. I usually don’t like going back to the same place more than once but I would definitely come back here for another vacation. Paradisus Cancun Resort has beautiful grounds, unparalleled service and an exceptional beach with a very fun night life! (Red Lounge on the resort, clubs on the strip) Everything about this resort is really top notch. Thank you Cancun!

reviews.author: DeseoNYC
reviews.title: Fantastic All-Inclusive Cancun Hotel!
reviews.text:
I'm rather upset I did not review this property sooner, but life happens :) Though I was at this property about four months ago, the memory is still vivid. The property itself is magnificent. The hotel staff are very attentive to their guests. The beach area is clean and the lounge chairs very comfortable. I cannot comment about the pool as I was mainly at the beach :) but i did see the pool very active with a swim up bar. Our room was immaculate, housekeeping did such great work upkeeping our room. You do NOT have a shortage of dining options at Paradisus! From your typical Mexican fanfare, argentinian churrasqueria, to sushi to very fine dining...have your pick! Drinks are well made as well! There is a daily evening show (8 pm) which brings in the sing and dance to the guests.
If you want an all inclusive where you can just chill, not worry about leaving the hotel at all - this is the place for you. We did not leave the hotel until it was time to go home. I highly recommend Paradisus and I hope to one day return!

reviews.author: kristaPGHPA
reviews.title: Very romantic hotel
reviews.text: My husband and I took a quick getaway weekend in early March.  We were wowed by the hotel top to bottom. We stayed in the 3rd (main) pyramid on the 5th floor with an ocean view, which was a very worthy upgrade.   No issues with our room, it was upgraded, clean and in good repair.  Our room  location was very quiet and the view was spectacular.  We did not do royal service and we were glad we did not spend the money.  We walked through the RS pyramid and it was very quiet, but not worth the upgrade from what we could tell. We found the hotel lush and serene. The hotel was spotless, the service top notch.  We ate at Market Grille (Brazillian).  It was good if you like served in that manner. The meat was offered off of skewers and pans as the waiters passed the table. We ate at Blue Agave which was super casual tacos and had great atmosphere. Our favorite meal by far was Fuego. It was amazing. We had a seafood soup, salad with goat cheese, beef tenderloin, risotto and coconut cream brulee.  Also note, the wines are better at restaurants if you are into wine.  There are a few great bartenders at the Avenue Bar, I got a pretty good Cosmo and a mojito. At the pool they mix fast drinks and serve a crowd.  I thought a lot about others comments.  I'll address a few.  Beach chairs....were hard to find!  It was my ONLY complaint. They need more chairs!  The buffet food is different than American food.  You won't find great hamburgers and fries, but the tacos/pico/guacamole were amazing.  The buffet had a very wide variety of foods.  the food at buffet was not steaming hot, but I still really enjoyed it.  We did not have trouble making dinner reservations.  In general I would steer couples to this resort, we are upper 40's and it was a perfect fit for us. It is lush, quiet, zen and candlelit at night.  It feels  (and smells) like a spa or a boutique resort.  There are NOT a lot of activities happening at all hours, as on a cruise ship.   It is a chill atmosphere except at the pool by the swim up bar, the party people hang there.

reviews.author: newlyweds44
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: First of all, we would like to give a shout out to Victor and Marco at Enos. Victor and Marco exceeded our expectations for customer service!!! On that note we would like to say we were embarrassed by our fellow American tourists who left their manners at home. TIP the staff!!! They deserved it!!! The staff went above and beyond to make sure we had a wonderful stay and that every need was met. We had a beautiful ocean view room. We were surprised by the turndown service and that the rooms were cleaned twice a day. Our favorite restaurant was The Market but we also enjoyed the buffet. Our only critique is the hard sell on the time share. We are all ready planning a trip back!!!

reviews.author: deuce20007080
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: The facility was great. The staff was a fall over you type atmosphere. Service was great.  The restaurants need to be a little more Americanized.   The. Worker. Who checked us in was Nancy da la Cruz.   Nancy was. Tremendously outgoing.  She really explained everything to the tee.  We knew everywhere to go and do the first day there.  We had no time waisted at all.  Thank you Nancy.   Also. Sergio. At the pool area was the best server.  We ever had.  He was always there.   John and Margaret.  Celentano.

reviews.author: Sylvia B
reviews.title: Best Vacation!
reviews.text:
Amazing staff. Great food & endless options. Great entertainment by the pool throughout the day. Amazing performances every night at the Avenue Bar in the hotel. 

We took advantage of the Expedia office in the hotel to book our tours. 

We also took advantage of PhotoShoot offered. It was a free photoshoot with no obligations to buy the photos.... But in the end we got some amazing pictures that we couldn't help but purchase.

reviews.author: MalikaAG
reviews.title: Rest & Relaxation
reviews.text: Nice view from room. Beach was well maintained. Staff was very attentive. Would like to come back with my entire family of five and share my experience. I would rather choose another month to come because the weather was not as warm as I expected.

reviews.author: daaktur
reviews.title: Avoid Room 3111
reviews.text:
I arrived at the hotel just after dark. It looked beautiful from the outside. Almost surreal. The hotel consists of five interconnected pyramids with the top of the pyramids being transparent. We were met by an upbeat doorman who announced loudly, “Welcome to the best hotel in the world.” Check in was quick and easy. My lagoon view room was large with a separate sitting area, a large balcony and very well lit. I liked that. None of that depressing mood lighting designed to save energy. There was no carpeting, as in many hotels located on the beach. The bell boy brought my bag within ten minutes of entering my room.

The bathroom was large and had a separate area separated by a sliding door for the toilet bowl and bidet. I noticed that there were holes on the wall next to the toilet where there would ordinarily be a phone installed. Didn’t pay much attention to that and fell asleep that evening. In the morning I noticed that at two places in the bathroom and one in the entrance area, there was a steady, but tiny dripping of water. The kind that might come from excessive condensation on an air-conditioning duct.  I also noticed that the wall next to the toilet was moist, as if water had flowed down at night. 

The next morning went down for breakfast at 8 am. Informed the concierge that there was water leaking from the roof. Came up 9 am later to get some money from my safe only to discover that there was a water showering down from the roof of the bathroom and entrance area in what could only be described as a waterfall!!! It was also cascading down from the wall next to the toilet. And my room was FLOODED with over a centimeter of water and water was overflowing into the corridor! There were three persons from housekeeping trying to dry it and another three from maintenance trying to patch the leak. They had been sensible enough to pick my bags, dirty clothes and shoes from the floor and placed them on the table to prevent them from being ruined. 

I left hurriedly as they seemed to be confident of fixing it. Two hours later, the leak had slowed, but water was still dripping. Again they told me that they would fix it. Another two hours later, I realized that there was no way that it was going to get fixed. It seemed to be an old problem. That is why, I suspect, the phone next to the toilet had been removed as the water must have short circuited it previously. 

I then went to the front desk and complained. They didn’t seem to have any idea that this was going on. Or at least they pretended not to know. By now, I was upset as I had to be at a meeting in one hour and needed to change. They had as yet no plans of moving me. They really expected me to stay in the flooded room. It was only when I got upset and demanded to be moved and to be upgraded as compensation, did they even acknowledge that there was a problem. 

Accidents do happen. I get that. But in this case, the room had an old problem that had not been fixed. And they knew that. Or at least should have known that. Their ‘crime’ was that they waited for me to lose it before giving me another room. They really should’ve been all over me apologizing for the inconvenience. After all, they did claim to be the best hotel in the world!

Well they did give me another room. And upgraded me to an ocean view room. Which saved them from a really sucky review, because the ocean view rooms are absolutely spectacular! Watching the turquoise shallow water blend into the deeper aquamarine colour of the ocean is a sight that is worth any amount of money.

In all fairness to the hotel, the décor in the central atrium takes your breath away. The vertical, hanging garden is beautiful. As is the jungle created in the central atrium. My suggestion is to eat in the restaurant located in the central atrium, as it is akin to eating in the middle of a rain forest. True it has a lesser variety of food, but the experience more than makes up for that. Also it does not have the same mad rush the main restaurant does. All the restaurants served good food. We even ate at their fine dining restaurant, an extremely pleasant experience, though pricey. At peak times it could take some time to find a table in their main restaurants.

The hotel grounds are beautiful, as are the swimming pools and beaches.  I found it unusual that though there were red flags on the beach, indicating the beach was closed, there were a number of people swimming along the entire beach. One day a young lady swam out too far and could not get back. Almost immediately, a life guard went in after her, then another, then a third and a fourth. Finally, a fifth life guard on a jet ski from a neighboring hotel got them all out by towing them back. This made me feel safe and realized that the hotel and its neighbors had a good team of life guard professionals. 

The bottom line: By all means stay here. You won’t regret it. And definitely upgrade to a sea view room. This is a fabulous hotel which has one room that floods. At all costs, avoid room 3111!

reviews.author: larry45239
reviews.title: large resort with beautiful beach
reviews.text:
this was the largest resort I've ever stayed at and probably too large for my taste.  I was in the main (center) building and in at night it was very loud in my room from the entertainment in the lobby and restaurant area.

the balcony was private.  I could not see anyone and no one could see me and I liked that a lot.

the building was beautiful as was the beach.  my biggest problem with the resort is that amount of steps going from the building to the beach.  if you have an issue with steps, I would highly recommend staying elsewhere.

to me the gourmet restaurants were a total waste of time and after the second night I just ate at the buffet. 

the best part of my stay was Laura at the pool bar.  she delivered my drinks to my palapa on the beach in a very timely manor.  she always had a smile and polite conversation.  with no bar on the beach she kept me from having to go up and down steps to get a drink.

reviews.author: DenisaCardoso
reviews.title: We've had time of our lives!
reviews.text:
The hotel ambience is amazing! The reception and check in area are luxurious and welcoming. The staff cannot be faulted. The hotel itself has lush tropical plants everywhere, a beautiful sushi restaurant and bar right in the middle with small lakes with fish. 
Both the buffet area and the restaurants are wonderful, food is very tasty and plentiful. The same goes for drinks. Staff are very attentive!
We stayed in the main pyramid no 3, on the 5h floor with a sea view and it was worth every penny! We were travelling with our 4yo, they brough an extra bed for her and we joined this with our two double beds, so much space! Beds were comfortable too.
Lots of pools to choose from. 
The beach was amazing! Clean white sand, clear water with fish swimming around, pelicans diving in - it really was a paradise!
We did not want to leave!

reviews.author: Tris300
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text:
We still have one more day and I'm already giving this place 5 stars!!! We stayed in the royal service tower, the staff is excellent.
