Great experience,    Our butler Rodrigo (was the best) set us up with reservations for dinner at Fuego. Excellent service at Fuego, great food. We had lobster and risotto, Andes mountain salad. Food was the best I've had at a resort. I cleaned my plate.

reviews.author: Ushma P
reviews.title: Great time here
reviews.text: We came here for a family wedding. We had a great time. The staff was great, the rooms were nice. The only thing that could have been better was lighting in the rooms. Food was good but the buffet needs more vegetarian options.

reviews.author: Steve B
reviews.title: Cancun Paradise
reviews.text: This is our 4th visit to a Paradisus Resort; previous visits were to La Perla (twice) in Playa Del Carmen and Paradisus Punta Cana.  We stayed from February 27th thru March 5th.  All of the Paradisus Resorts have a common restaurant set up with some subtle differences.  For breakfast we went to Naos each morning.  This restaurant is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  The quality of the food is generally very good and there is a wide availability of choices.  The service at Naos was excellent, in the morning we had Kauil and Jhani making sue we were 100% satisfied. There are a number of mexican food options at Naos.  One item that was not readily available was tortilla's.  They usually have a wide selection of sea food during lunch and dinner to augment traditional meat choices.  Lot's of fresh fruit available at all 3 meals.  The only less than perfect experience at Naos was on the night we arrived (Saturday Feb 27th).  The place was very busy and and the service suffered a bit.  Also, the buffet area was picked over and not restocked in a timely basis.  For the remaining restaurants we went to Bana twice, Vento, Enso, Mole and Fuego.  These a la carte restaurants require reservations.  Unlike the other Paradisus resorts we visited the restaurant reservations had to be made the prior day of planned visit instead of through your concierge upon arrival.  We made our reservations early each morning and had no problem finding a convenient time.  The service at the a la carte restaurants was pretty good.  The resort does a good job not to overbook these restaurants.  The food is generally pretty good, the only place where we were disappointed was Enso.  This Asia themed restaurant food was disappointing.  We both ordered a veggie tempura starter that was plain awful.  The tempura batter tasted like a glazed donut with the same texture.  I also had a chicken curry dish for an entree that was not very good. We opted to upgrade from the basic room to a one bedroom suite.  The room was very nice and similar to the other Paradisus properties.  The resort is in the middle of the hotel zone and very convient to public transportation was was 11 peso per person.  The hotel is within reasonable walking distance to major shopping venues as well as many major restaurants.  The beach in Cancun is the best I've experience anywhere.  Relatively calm surf and no rocks whatsover.  Another plus is the beach is very close to the resort and our room.

reviews.author: RYZZ653
reviews.title: Nice resort with awesome Baby Club
reviews.text:
We stayed a week in an ocean view suite. The suite was average, but the view was excellent.

All of the staff in every section of the resort were eager to provide excellent service in a friendly manner, which was nice, but the speed of service was often much slower than I would expect from 4 or 5 star resort. I think the service was often slow because the resort is so big so staff are busy doing their best to meet all the guests needs.

The food was good everywhere on the resort, especially at Bana.  

The thing that made the vacation most enjoyable was the Baby Club. We were able to drop off our 2 year old son with the amazing staff Alma and Adriana. After the first visit to Baby Club, our son would reach out to Alma; wanting her to pick him up and play with him. Baby Club requires parents to check-in by phone or in-person after 45 minutes, but we never left our son at Baby Club for more than 45 minutes at a time because we simply wanted a quick break once in a while or wanted our son to have some appropriate play time.

reviews.author: Alex M
reviews.title: Great Beach and Food
reviews.text:
This all inclusive hotel was very large and therefore provided many different areas allowing one to choose from in order to just relax or have fun. The beaches were beautiful and the water was clear blue and warm. Strong winds made ventures into the surf a bit challenging. The pools and pool bars were very nice but the availability of lounge chairs were limited making it difficult to sit back and relax. 

Food choices and the number of different restaurants were extensive and the quality of all food was very good.

My room with an ocean view was clean and lived up to my expectations. I suggest ensuring a room on or above the 3rd floor and with an ocean view. 

There are many options for sight seeing ranging from ancient temples, dolphin encounters all the way to scuba diving. Although this is an all inclusive be prepared to tip for excellent service.

reviews.author: Tenise W
reviews.title: My Daughter's 18th bday trip
reviews.text: The best.....simply....We arrived to a suite filled with balloons and cake for my daughters 18 bday. Then we went to pool area (swim up bar) and we met David....from then out trip took a turn for the even  better....from excellent customer service to great drinks and food...we were wowed....We had lobster and bottle service, and cabana service.. Outta this world.... The Best...he is a world class act. So refreshing to finally find someone that truly takes their job in customer service seriously.....you surely have a gem on your hands.

reviews.author: Emily N
reviews.title: Perfect Vacation with Toddler
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus for 9 nights and had a wonderful experience.  The facility itself is meticulously clean.  When my 10 month old woke up at 6 am, we would go for a walk and you would see herds of staff cleaning and scrubbing through out the hotel.

The rooms are SUPER clean and modern and the food was really really fresh. (With the exception of room service).  The buffet team was super kind, Eder and Christina really made sure we were taken care of and we so kind.  The whole team of servers at the buffet was ridiculously service oriented. 

We did note that the majority of people did not tip the servers at the buffet. I honestly don't get why, as they work so hard to make sure that your needs are met.  We were modest but wanted to show appreciation and tipped 50 pesos each meal.

Finally, the beach is gorgeous.  It's a little annoying to pay for the palapas, so we just found chairs with umbrellas.  There's two pools, one for drinkers with a bar, and one near the buffet that is super quiet and relaxed. We camped out there for the week.

reviews.author: B_C_C_2390
reviews.title: Great all inclusive
reviews.text:
Great location. When I looked at the pictures, I thought the plants inside the building looked cheesy, but the pictures don't do it justice - it is very pretty. The beach is beautiful. They do not have enough seating outside, but that is probably because they don't have a whole lot of beach space since it is smack dab in the middle of the hotel zone. We've stayed at the Paradisus Punta Cana before, and I can truly say that the service is consistently great. The employees are so accommodating and want to please you. We got a shuttle from the airport through Best Day, which cost us $18/pp. Check in is a little lengthy because they try to get you to look at a timeshare, which can eat up a lot of your time. The gym is well equipped. The pool is great. They use the alcohol in their drinks. 

We tried 4 of the restaurants. Our first night we dined at Vento. The food was ok at best. Not really our thing. Most of the entrees were sea food, and  we don't like sea food. Ruben was our waiter and he was absolutely fantastic. We also dined at Fuego. The service was very slow, but I think there was only one waiter working the whole restaurant, which is ridiculous. We spent over 2 hours there for dinner. The food was fantastic. We also dined at Market Grill for dinner, which is a Brazilian churrasceria style restaurant. It seems like they only circle around once with each meat and side, so you have to ask the waiter if you want seconds. The food was good. Our waiters Efrain and Alan were really cool. The last restaurant we tried is Blue Agave. They have tacos and quesadillas. It was really good, and they open up at like 3am for the people getting back from partying.The buffets were also good. Breakfast was better than lunch in my opinion. 

My only complaint was the beds. We had a room with the double beds, which are full sized doubles not queen sized doubles like some hotels. The beds were not comfortable, and you should bring your own pillow. That's my only complaint. Overall, it was a great hotel to stay in.

reviews.author: Nicholas S
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation
reviews.text: This past February, over President's Week, our family of five spent some time at Paradisus.  We had a fantastic time - the beach was tremendous, the food excellent (good choices as well), and the family concierge service very helpful.  The staff was outstanding.  From Joan who checked us in and explained all the great things that came with Family Concierge service, the experience was tremendous.  Our butler, Ramon, made sure we had reservations at all the times we wanted, and that if we needed anything, we were taken care of.  Carlos Fararoni kept our minibar stocked with exactly what we like (the kids pestered him for oreos and he didn't disappoint), and I highly recommend the breakfast at Ibana - Carlos Cadena and Pablo made sure that every morning, we were taken good care of.  The Market Grill, Vento and Mole were all excellent.  A little crowded during this week in general, but we always found quiet spots to relax and the beauty (I highly support the Ocean-view room) was outstanding.  Definitely coming back and recommending to all our friends.

reviews.author: audrey m
reviews.title: A week in Paradise!
reviews.text: Service without match 24/7, beautiful room totally soundproof, fantastic amenities, restaurants on site, spa (got the best pedicure I ever had there). Beach and pools superb. Tours if you want to go. When they say all inclusive they're not kidding. Can't wait to go back again!

reviews.author: Christine H
reviews.title: Stellar Service
reviews.text: My daughter and I spent 5 nights and 6 days here.  Every morning we would eat breakfast at Naos, the buffet.  Orlando waited on us the first day.  His service was the best service I have ever received in a restaurant my entire life!  Please ask for Orlando and tip him well.  He works very hard and deserves it! Thank you so much Orlando.  We will miss you :-)

reviews.author: 750denae
reviews.title: Amazing trip!
reviews.text: This was the best trip I've been on. I have been to many Caribbean desitinations and everything about paradisus cancun was perfect! Royal service is a must, I could see how not opting for it could be more crowded. A big thank you to Jorge and Eddie at the Royal service Bali beds! Excellent service and food everywhere on the resort. Thank you !!!

reviews.author: Joseph E
reviews.title: Great All Inclusive Resort
reviews.text:
In short:   

Nice, clean, comfy room.  EXCELLENT food at restaurants.  (AVERAGE buffet.)  EXCELLENT DRINKS (quality alcohol and not watered down like at some other all-inclusive).  GREAT POOL & SWIM UP BAR.  GREAT BEACH with chairs and umbrellas.  EXCELLENT service (restaurants, room attendants, concierge, pool staff, etc.,)  The best all-inclusive I have been to.

Need more detail??  Read below.

This is a resort that would normally be out of my price range, however, I found a good deal and decided to splurge a little.  This review is coming from that point of view.

My wife and I stayed for 5 Days/4 Nights.  We got a private shuttle from the airport to the resort with USA Transfers (recommend)  $55 total for a roundtrip for 2.  

When we arrived we were greeted with a welcome drink while we checked in.
For some reason they were putting us in to a room with 2 double beds.  I asked for a room with a queen instead.  They were able to put us in a room with a King.  And the room was ready for us, even though we arrived a little early for check in.  Great!
(I should mention that I told him I was a Melia Rewards member and gave him my account #.  This couldn't have hurt getting any upgrade.  You can become a Melia Rewards member by just going to the Paradisus company website (owned by Melia) and signing up for free.)

We were put on the 5th floor in a section of rooms furthest from the lobby.  This was the ONLY downside.  It just meant a 5 minute walk to the lobby.  Not a big deal.

After you check in, you meet with some one that tries to get you to sign up for what is essentially a meeting to learn about their time-shares.  They entice you with $200 credit and a 20% off spa services, and discounts for tours and on and on.  We were tempted but decided against it.  It's kind of an awkward start to the stay and they don't stop the first time you say no to the offer.  But try to make it clear that you're not interested.

The room was clean.  Wall safe.  Hangers.  Hair dryer.  Iron and board.  The usual.  Tub on the balcony.  Nice TV with a lot of English channels.  Comfy bed. 

WiFi is free, but was very spotty in our room and pretty much all through out the hotel as well.  Oddly enough, the best service seemed to be out by the pool and pool bar.

They have about 7 restaurants there.  We tried 4 plus the buffet for breakfast and a sit down place for lunch that had great tacos.  The dinner and lunches at the sit down places were EXCELLENT.  The buffet was hit and miss.  Breakfast not the best, but they did have people making omelets or scrambled eggs with your choice of ingredients, so that was great.  

The grill by the pool was good.  Decent burgers and really good buffalo chicken wings.
Swim up bar was good.  And the alcohol through out the resort was great.  Not watered down.  Quality alcohol.  

There are lots of lounge chairs and umbrellas by the pool and on the beach.

The gym was small but clean and had plenty of treadmills and weight machines and free weights.  There is also an Expedia travel agent in the lobby through which we got a great deal on a Chichen Itza tour.

Didn't get a chance to try the spa.

The entire staff was exceptional.

reviews.author: Bivojak
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: First time in Cancun and we hit jackpot with staing in Paradisus . Perfect hotel clean and all personal was all some . Only WiFi connection can be bether. We can a wait to comeback soon. We recommend this all some place to everyone.

reviews.author: Joe G
reviews.title: Great Getaway
reviews.text:
We've had a great stay here and great service; including Cesar, Manuel and Alfredo at the Market Grill and Fernando has taken care of us as part of the Royal Service. 

Came for a quick trip while leaving the kids at home. Was extremely relaxing, good food and great drinks.

Ended up mostly reading and napping near the pool and the ocean.

reviews.author: Scheegee
reviews.title: Mixed reviews!
reviews.text: I have been to Mexico numerous times.  This beach is one of the best I have stayed at.  The sand is soft and the water is beautiful.  The oversize swimming pool is great but dulls in comparisons. The resort itself is old but they are trying to repair what they can. You will see broken steps, peeling paint, and older pool chairs.  Speaking of steps, yes they have ramps, but if you don't like stairs up or down everywhere you turn, choose an other resort.   We paid the upgrade fee for an ocean view and enjoyed it immensely.  If you do not like the sound of the ocean at bedtime, this may not be your best option.  We always choose all inclusive and was disappointed to discover not everything at the resort was included.  Top shelf liquor is additional or consider tipping more. We were told they charged for Tempo restaurant because it was so upscale.  I would rather have had an other restaurant option than pay more.  There were restaurants included at no additional fee but if you did not have a reservation they would not seat you even if there were only 5 tables taken.  There was always the buffet but again, not at the price we paid.  The hours of operation for all the eating facilities is something I would suggest you memorize.  Several times we spent too long at the pool/ocean and got caught with very limited choices.  Once in the restaurants, we only felt EVENING Market Grill and Bana was 4 star worthy.  Market Grill daytime is better than the buffet in my opinion if you don't want to fight the crowds or fear the children who touch food and put back! First let me say,  I usually do adult only resorts but booked here knowing it was open to families.  Poolside, children were not that noticeable.  Dinner and nightly entertainment, you had no choice to not only see children running every where but to hear them as well. Only one bar was 18 and over.  The rest had children using the bar for a playground as parents drank. The 18 over bar opens at 10 and plays ONLY remix. I can only testify to that statement until midnight.  It is open until 2.  The service gets mixed reviews.  It was either great or none at all.  Everywhere but our room and the "pro shop" was very good. We went without towels several times and had to call.  Our refrigerate was not restocked, we had to call.  Turn down service came at 6pm one evening!  The worse was watching the maid service leave, entering the room, only to discover they had used our restroom, left a strong odor behind AND no towels!  Food room service was quick, professional, and good.  DO NOT RENT GOLF CLUBS HERE WITHOUT A TETANUS SHOT!  They charged $30 for s full set of clubs that any beginning golfer could play with 5 clubs.  The clubs had exposed rusted metal, the grips were peeling off, and the club heads were rusted.  We also got a mix of left and right hand clubs so check carefully!  We should have just rented one bag and shared.  There was no starter.  There were not always flags!  They really should just charge you $5 for a push cart. Way overpriced.  The tennis court was under repair.  We did not use the exercise room.  We love outside activities not group at the pool, and felt the resort had very little to offer.  You will love the convenience of the bus service..  Pay in pesos.  The hotel does offer a fair and easy exchange from dollars to pesos.  Cab fare to the airport is negotiable.  Anywhere from $35 to $50 per cab.   Overall, I enjoyed my stay but feel there are better facilities offered at the same price so I will not return.

reviews.author: danniee2016
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Excellent stay service out of this world going back asap. People where fantastic food was exceptional. Butlers are so friendly if you are looking for a great trip this is the place to go. But do not tell to many people.

reviews.author: Fan H
reviews.title: Good for Family vacation
reviews.text:
my daughter is 5 years old. She enjoys Kids club activities at beach and kid swimming pool a lot .

I am Asian, and I feel Bana restaurant definitely can be improved, e.g. Sushi should use Sushi rice not regular rice, Some restaurants are serving slow during dinner time.

All staffing are super nice, friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: asantini66
reviews.title: 5 Star Service !!
reviews.text:
2nd trip here. Both times upgraded to the Royal Service. Our concierge was Rode,... He was the best ! Took care of everything we needed, and always has a smile. (Loved him !!)
The entire Royal Service staff, inside and out, are the best you will find in any resort, and are the main reason we will be going back for a third time! Here is a list of them, and who ever I missed, I'm very sorry.
Waiters - Javier,Jorge, Albert, Ramon, Valeria, Ricardo, Octavio, Josue, Victor, Alejandro, Gustavo, Ivan, Moises, Venoncio,Rafael, Edier, Sindy, Cesor, Edie, Eduardao Ramo, and all others.... !!!!
Kitchen of La Palapa by pool - Heisler, Ventura, Tomas !!!!
Bar of La Palapa (pool) - Josue, Villa Fona, !!!!
Bally Bed / Towels and pool area Guys - Omar, Cesar !!!!
The staff at Royal Service check in desk.... especially Leticia !!! 
Thank you to you all for giving my wife and I a vacation where we were treated like a king and Queen. Hotel in and out is great, very clean, house keeping was great, all restaurants were very good, Beach was perfect. Plenty to do, or just kick back and relax.

Request to the main management ..... Out by royal Service pool....play some steel drum, salsa, mariachi music,.... I'm in Mexico, and would love to hear music that made me feel like was there.... ! Just change that pool playlist......and I wont have to bring my ipod. 
Still Loved every minute I was there. That's not a complaint, just my suggestion.
 Thx again !!

reviews.author: gisellep790
reviews.title: Spa like environment/ great kids zone
reviews.text: Great hotel for families. Kids really enjoyed the treasure hunt and pirate night included in the kids zone. Got to see the moon AND Jupiter through a telescope. It was amazing. Several restaurant options. The buffet was amazing. A lot of Asian/ Mexiacn influence but I loved it. And a snack bar at the beach with the regular stuff the kids enjoy like burgers. The entertainment was really nice. Never made it to the night club. The beach was beautiful and the life guards I was pleased they really were keeping an eye out especially because we went in February the waves were strong. A lot of little touches in the room that were nice. Authentic Mexican restaurant. Mole was amazing (had it over chicken with white rice) everyone was very cordial that you passed. But they will definitely try hard to sell you on different packages and stuff but so much came included we didn't find it necessary. We booked out stay through JetBlue getaways :)

reviews.author: jchoi104
reviews.title: The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly (Missing/stolen items)
reviews.text:
First the good - The hotel itself is pretty nice. Open layout, big but not too huge that you need transportation to get around. You can pretty much walk from one end to the other in about 7 - 10 min. We had an oceanfront suite, which was not really a suite. Just 2 full sized beds in a smallish room with a balcony. The oceanfront view was really nice though, not a fake oceanfront where you have to peer around a corner to get a glimpse of the ocean. 

The breakfast and lunch buffets had a lot of options. Loved the fresh juices for breakfast - they had green, orange, melon, grapefruit, etc. They also had a smoothie bar. Lots of fresh fruit, an omelette station, smoked salmon, cold cuts, etc. The service was pretty good. Nice waitstaff. 

The kiddie pool was great for our 2 small kids. Hint - a lot of people get up early and reserve pool chairs by putting towels and some personal items on there so if you get there after 10 or 11, no chairs for you. 

Now the bad - The dinner restaurants were mediocre. We ate at the Asian Fusion one on our first night. It was pretty bad. I'd rather eat take out chinese food than what they served us. I guess they took the word fusion and applied it literally. We had dumplings, fried rice, shrimp noodle salad, chicken tikka masala and some crispy naan. It was like they fused all the Asian foods and served them in one meal...weird. The 2nd night we ate at the tapas restaurant which was decent but not anything to write home about. The 3rd night, we ate at the Japanese place which was pretty good. Definitely the best out of all of them. The sushi and sashimi were average but their seafood salad and seared tuna were pretty good. The 4th night, we ate at the Mole, the Mexican restaurant. Again average but their tamarind margarita was really yummy. Definitely something to try. 

Now for the ugly - There are THIEVES in the hotel!!! After getting off the shuttle, the bellhop took our bags to be brought up to our rooms. Now, I guess this is partially my fault for not paying attention, but my husband gave him our backpack with my personal belongings. But we were tired, had 2 cranky kids with us and all we wanted to do was check in and relax. The check in process took really long, about 45 min. After we were done, we got showed to our room but our bags still werent there. We were told it would be up shortly. After it arrived about 10 min later, I looked through my backpack for my phone and couldn't find it anywhere. I was CERTAIN I had put it in there before getting off the plane. Still, I guess there was a miniscule chance that it may have fallen out or something so I didn't complain. I did ask the hotel if they had found a phone with my description but they said they hadn't. I let it go for the remainder of the trip. On our last day, my husband was cleaning out our safe and discovered a $100 bill MISSING. I know it was there because I had seen two $100 bills in there a couple of days before and there was no way either of us used it. So there, now we were missing a phone from my bag and a $100 bill from the safe.  This time, we definitely complained to the concierge upon checking out but all they said was to fill out a form, which we declined to because we were leaving and it would probably do nothing anyway.

So overall, the hotel was nice, very nice service, mediocre food, and thieves in the hotel.

reviews.author: Rachel S
reviews.title: Mother daughter getaway
reviews.text: I usually do not do reviews but feel obligated to share my experience as we made our choice to stay at the Paradisus based on other Trip Advisor reviews.  My daughter and I recently stayed at the Paradisus all inclusive.  We found the rooms to be clean and comfortable.  The meals were very good.  I felt safe staying there with my teenage daughter and the service was excellent.  The beach was beautiful and clean as well.  I would highly recommend the Paradisus for families, couples and friends.  It met all of our needs and we were very satisfied with everything in general and had no big complaints!!  We used USA Transfers to shuttle us to and from the airport and their service was excellent, friendly and reliable!!

reviews.author: eembury
reviews.title: Amazing doesn't even begin to cover it...
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for a 3 night getaway and it was absolutely amazing. The hotel is so beautiful, the rooms are pristine and kept impeccably clean, the beach is perfect, but what really makes the experience is the staff. They were so helpful even before our stay when I had questions via email. The restaurants at the Paradisus Cancun are superb and the servers are just wonderful. Some that were particularly wonderful were Eder, Abram and Pablo at Naos; Josue and Aldo at Fuego; and Yavir at Bana. I've stayed at hotels in various parts of Mexico and the service is always excellent, but the servers at Paradisus are a cut above the rest. We will certainly be looking to book with a Melia resort again and thank you so much to the staff at Paradisus for making our stay so memorable.

reviews.author: 80danam
reviews.title: perfect beach
reviews.text: The trip from Cancun airport to Paradisus Cancun is the easiest I have done anywhere. The resort is perfectly located on the Hotel Zone with a 50 cent bus ride to downtown shopping and restaurants.. Rodrigo and the volleyball games on the beach are awesome. I highly recommend this beautiful resort for it's beauty, location,great food and friendly staff.

reviews.author: alla_vovk
reviews.title: Perfect beach Excellent service
reviews.text: We booked Paradisus Cancun because it was highly recommended to us by our friends... They said best service! And I would have to agree.. We were treated like royalty. We had the best servers Carlos, Jesus and Antonio. They were so pleasant always smiling and inviting. Joking around and always making conversation. I felt like we became good friends with them.. Personally the best service We received was from them. Few days into our stay they knew our drinks knew our names... We defiantly felt special! We loved everything about . The Nespresso Bar was a cherry on top. Such good coffee and the the barista guy was so funny and friendly.👍🏻 Beach was just perfection. Very clean beach and amazing service at the beach. Salvador made best mud slides .Rooms were really good and they cleaned our rooms twice a day. Once in am and the other was in the evening after our dinner we always came back to clean restocked room and our beds turned out making us comfy for the night! Best stay so warm. highly recommend this hotel!!!

reviews.author: Marcroeger1
reviews.title: Decent hotel
reviews.text:
It is a good and large property, the food offered is really good so you should always be able to get something you like

Due to the hotels size it can be difficult to get a spot on the beach unless you're willin to get up around seven 

It's definitely a good hotel, but there are better ones in Cancun

reviews.author: Scott W
reviews.title: Nice Visit
reviews.text:
Very nice hotel.  Went with my wife for a couple's getaway.  Friendly and attentive service everywhere.  We used the Royal Service, which meant we had access to exclusive areas of the resort including a beach.  

The hotel itself is very beautiful, but it's beginning to show its age.  The rooms could use some updating, but are still quite nice overall.  The Royal Service has a nice pool and at least one hot tub, but these too need to be updated.  Did not see very many people using the pool and wondered why until I felt of the water temperature - cold!  Hot tub was cold too.  So, we spent most of the time out by the beach, which was great.  Waiters would periodically come by and bring any food or drink that we ordered.  Tips were always appreciated.

The food was the worst thing about the whole experience, and the one thing that keeps me from giving this a 5 star rating.  It was plentiful with a wide variety of offerings, but overall it was very bland.  It was generally beautifully presented, but one meal tasted just the like previous meal.  Perhaps it's just the way it's done in Mexico, but there were very few spices or flavorings used and it was just very boring overall.  Ventured off property a couple of evenings for dinner and found the food to be a bit better (but not by a tremendous amount).  Alcoholic drinks were plentiful, but very weak.  In order to eat at any of the resorts restaurants for dinner, you must make reservations for each night of your stay, at least 20 hours in advance.  I'm assuming this is for staffing reasons, because I never ate anywhere that did not have plenty of tables at which to sit.

As for activities at the resort, I did not find a lot to do.  There is the beach of course, but the tennis courts were being re-done at the time so they were not useable.  They do have one night club, but its sort of small and does not seem to have a whole lot going on.  If you're mostly interested in relaxing by the pool or beach and not much else, this is a terrific place to be.  There are plenty of folks around the property to sell you excursion tickets for snorkeling, parasailing, scuba diving and the like, but these are extra expenses that are not part of the all-inclusive package.

reviews.author: 4max44
reviews.title: Cancun 2016
reviews.text: In spite of its age the Paradisus in Cancun is in great shape. The staff is very friendly and accommodating to guests. The beach layout with palapas and Bali beds is comfortable. The pools are beautiful.

reviews.author: Julia K
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: Came for a family holiday. Couldn't be better. Family concierge Ramon was the most helpful you could wish for. Our daughter had a brilliant holiday. Antonio, Vicente, Yhoni and Pablo in naos buffet restaurant are great and most friendly. Couldn't get better service. Special mention to Sofonia the waiter in the pool bar. We were never waiting for our drinks. They were coming before we even thought about ordering them. The hotel is beautiful. Very highly recommend!!!! Will be back...

reviews.author: ANNIE E
reviews.title: Annie's Mexico Getaway 2016
reviews.text: Upon arrival we were absolutely amazed - the reality was even better than the photographs we had seen.  The resort is absolutely beautiful and situated steps away from the beautiful white sand and blue blue carribbean waters..Most impressive was the interaction with staff - from housekeeping to wait staff, bartenders, concierge...especially Etter in the dining room. To a person, each and every employee we interacted with were all so welcoming and really willing to go out of their way to ensure our trip was completely to our satisfaction.we indulged in a day at the spa and it is among the most indulgent and beautiful spa experiences I have ever had - LuLu, my masseuse was incredibly polite, respectful and masterfully competent. I would recommend Paradisus to anyone looking for a great Cancun experience.

reviews.author: Sean N
reviews.title: great
reviews.text:
had an excellent time here and will be getting married here in this May!!  the service was awesome as well as the food.  We were hosted by Esther Maria. She was very patient and attended to all our needs. We are expecting at least 80 guests to attend our wedding, 60will be using your hotel Paradisus Cancun. 

Sean Nieto and Krystal Ramirez , wedding May 16, 2015

reviews.author: mrsbankroll
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text:
Just got back from staying at Paradisus Cancun....I'll list the positives and negatives....

 Check in was a hassle. We went with another couple and had requested close rooms and we had both paid for king size ocean view rooms. We were given the run around for almost an hour. They didn't have rooms together, then they didn't have 2 king rooms. It took forever and a manager had to be called. Finally we were given the correct rooms but the biggest downfall was were in building 3. After reading the reviews on here I was leary because of the noise complaints. We were assured we were "On the other side, no noise". That was a complete lie. It is one big circle so if you are in building 3 it IS noisy!!! The god awful singing starts at 6:30, beware. Luckily we were usually out of our room eating dinner around that time. 
 The room itself is beautiful. The ocean view is a MUST!!!! Our balcony however had no furniture which was a huge disappointment. I called the front desk and they sent someone out to the beach to snag some beach chairs. Whatever, works for me. The cleaning staff did a wonderful job keeping our room beautiful every day!!!
 Dining was pretty par from other Mexican and Dominican resorts we stayed at. Restaurants were slightly better than the buffet. We found the sushi bar our fave! Wonderful wait staff everywhere. Beach waiters were a nice touch and as long as you tip well they treat you right! We did not upgrade to the Royal Service. I NEVER felt like we were missing out. 
 Beach is beautiful as to be expected. Ocean was a little choppy while we were there but I heard that is the norm for Cancun. 
 Very easy to take a bus for $1 into Cancun for some shopping. Our number one best perk to the resort was the alcohol!! Top shelf everything at no extra charge!!!! 
 I would in fact recommend this resort but I would be insistent on NOT staying in  building three!!! And, definitely upgrade to an Ocean View room!!!

reviews.author: Kristine S
reviews.title: Beautiful and Relaxing but could use a few tweaks!
reviews.text: Our family joined two other families for a Spring break trip to our favorite beach!  We found The Paradisus to be a lovely large scale hotel.  My family opted for the lagoon side because although we LOVE the ocean and the view, we prefer to be out there ON the beach so that was not an issue.  We stayed in tower 3 (the main tower) on the third floor.  We had two "queen" beds which I imagine to be more of a full size bed.  It worked for us.  I found that the lack of chaise chairs on the balcony a little disappointing.  I'd like to sit outside with someone and relax to watch the sunset or read a book while our kids shower and dress.  There was only ONE chair and NO table. ;(  The hair dryer in our room was broken but with one phone call, they came to replace it quickly.  We found all of the restaurants to have good food and options for everyone...anyone.  If you  wanted something different, all you have to do is ask.  We found everyone working there to be most helpful.  We chose to find a spot on the beach under palapas everyday and were lucky enough to have Sofonia (Sofo) take good care of us.  We really appreciated his enthusiasm and speedy service.  He is an asset to the resort!  We found that everyone who works there, works hard to make your stay enjoyable.  Our families (10 of us) were able to dine together most of the time.  They were accommodating!  The reservation process is a little disappointing and confusing.  Several of the restaurants require reservations made in advance and sometimes it is difficult to plan that.  My family used USA Transfers this time and the two other times we traveled to Cancun and I highly recommend them.  We called the Paradisus prior to our visit to see if they really had a tennis court, as reported on the website because I never saw a picture on the site.  They said they did.  However, when we arrived last week, we were told they were going to be resurfacing/repainting.  We got one day of early morning tennis only.  If you like to play tennis, the courts have been repaired and repainted so ENJOY!  Overall, we had a great time and I would recommend this hotel for sure.  It is a larger hotel and we've stayed at a small, medium and large hotel in Cancun and for a large hotel, they make you feel quite welcome. The Wifi is horribly spotty.  Our room had excellent reception but many others did not.   And let's get to the highlight . . . The BEACH.  What an amazing beach.  Although it is a little more weedy than we prefer, it is still the most beautiful white, soft sand and crystal blue water to gaze at while you enjoy a delicious cocktail and relax in paradise.  We'd definitely return!

reviews.author: Scottsws
reviews.title: Great place!!
reviews.text: You and your family will love it,the staff are great,the hotel is superb and clean,this place is exactly what you'd expect a beach resort to be,food is excellent and the ambience is just plain cool!! I would highly recommend this place to everyone I know,a truly great experience for all!!

reviews.author: Toni P
reviews.title: Fantastic And Beautiful Resort with Genuine People
reviews.text: Everyone was absolutely amazing here ! The entertainment crew were so much fun and so sweet  getting everyone involved with fun activities. The Main DJ, Juarez (Luis) was great and Freddy was wonderful and sweet! So was Arturo! Daniel from Naos restaurant was an exceptionally accommodating server. Benito was fabulous from Market grill restaurant. Very hospitable and sweet. The inside was gorgeous with beautiful vines everywhere.  Friday nights show inside was a Michael Jackson impersonator (extraordinary talent) . Victor was very  helpful also. All in all, Paradisus Cancun was pure paradise and I highly recommend your next vacation be here  in Cancun! ❤️🌴

reviews.author: Deena B
reviews.title: Beautiful but expensive
reviews.text: Upon check in, we asked for a room upgrade...there was no one to show us other rooms so they gave us a key and said we could look at 2 rooms.  We chose the bigger of the 2 because we have 2 kids and they needed their own space.  However, that cost an extra 100 US a night...The poolside activities were few, room service food was always cold and rubbery...you had to make reservations at most restaurants so we stuck to the buffet...tips are included however the staff had a way of making you feel you should be tipping...overall the beach and hotel were beautiful but it was very expensive and I have been on many all inclusive vacations and I don't feel there was much difference for the price...next time I would go for a 3 star and pay less because this was a 5 star price but a 3 star experience.

reviews.author: Kim E
reviews.title: Club Melia Member
reviews.text:
We stayed at paradisus cancun 3/17 -3/24.    They've added bali beds to the members only section of the beach & our server Sofonia was amazing!   He kept the drinks coming & (for an additional charge) served lobster & shrimp dinner to us on the beach.  Could not have asked for a more relaxing vacation.  The food was great & the beach is gorgeous!

One more thing to mention, on our 1st day of vacation,  my husband left his $1500.00 watch on a table at the beach.  Sofonia found the watch & turned it into the front desk so they could put it in the safe.  We were extremely grateful!

reviews.author: aajj53
reviews.title: Amazing experience....Excellent Service, Quality and Location
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned last night from out 2nd stay at the Paradisus.  We stayed in the Royal Service and I have to say it was bar none one of the best and most relaxing vacations we have been on.  The location is convenient as it offers, just a short walk or bus ride to many stores and markets. The grounds offer lush landscape, many statues and water features that appeal to the visual pallet. 
The food was excellent, we basically stayed pool side with the exception of the market grill. It didn't matter which location we ate at, the food was always very good . 
I decided to splurge and ordered a massage from the YHI spa.  PURE HEAVEN!!! They set the room up with lavender- vanilla aroma therapy.  The massage therapist was one of the best that I have ever had!
Once again we stayed in Royal Sevice, and the service was well worth it and offers everything they advertise!  Our personal butler was Rode.  if you are going to do Royal Service, I would request him.  Royal Service offers a cell phone to reach him. WE NEVER ONCE HAD TO USE IT! He took notes of everything we like from food, to wine to turn down time, to aroma therapy in our room. He looked for us each day of our stay on numerous occasions to check in, make dinner reservations etc.  He was very accommodating and really cared about what we liked. Because of his ability to speak numerous languages he was in very high demand; regardless of his client list, he made us feel as though we were the only ones at the resort. He never showed any awkwardness, making every conversation feel like you were talking to an old friend.  He is such an amazing asset to Paradisus! 
The resort is large, but the royal service makes it feel small.  The pools are large and kept extremely clean. You can actually see people in the morning scrubbing the pool walls! Each employee we came across was genuinely sweet, accommodating and very hardworking. 
The beach is everything you could ever imagine it to be.  The staff does an excellent job keeping it clean, welcoming and beautiful.  
If you are looking for the ultimate vacation experience this is the place to go!

reviews.author: Michael U
reviews.title: Enjoyable time.  We will definitely go back
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from a weekend getaway to Paradisus.  We  had a great time and we were very pleased with the hotel.  Service was over the top.  We were hit up several times to sit through a timeshare presentation. With only a weekend trip we definitely were not interested.  Can we get a button or pin or something that says we have declined timeshare presentation? This is the reason for the lower rating. 

IMPORTANT!!!  Do NOT use Supershuttle in Cancun!!!  We purchased an over priced round trip at the airport and Supershuttle refused to pick us  up at hotel.  We had to take a taxi and paid for the return twice. Supershuttle said they had no availability.  To busy picking up more suckers at the airport. This has happened to lots of unsuspecting tourist, if you read the Supershuttle Cancun ratings.

reviews.author: Melissa M
reviews.title: Great stay, got a little weird at the end
reviews.text:
My friend and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun for a week at the end of February. It was exactly what we were looking for- a relaxing, beautiful resort with an amazing beach. Had we been looking for a "spring break" type of experience, this would not have been the place to go. When we were there it was by no means a party hotel, and that was totally okay with us. The food was decent but not extraordinary. Definitely enjoyed margaritas and tacos at Blue Agave and breakfast outside at the buffet. Mole, the Mexican restaurant, was a major disappointment. Most of our days were spent on the beach under a palapa, drink in hand. Our beach experience was further enhanced by the ever-amazing Rodrigo, who went out of his way to take care of us. His enthusiasm and friendliness was absolutely a highlight of our stay. 
The biggest downside of the trip was that towards the end of our stay, two large groups arrived and the climate of the resort changed drastically. Other than that, we had an amazing time and a wonderfully relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Madlee1013
reviews.title: Excellent service!!
reviews.text: We stayed at the paradisus presidents week this year and we enjoyed it very much! The restaurants, shows, bar tenders and spa were great! We rented a pool hit everyday and the service was amazing! Sofonía was one of the pool servers who constantly checked on us, knew what we were drinking and eating and made sure we were always taken care of and having a great time! It was a pleasure to stay there with such great service. Definitely going back and hopefully Sofonía will still be there! Stay in a hut by la perla :)

reviews.author: Nathan Thomas D
reviews.title: Not at all worth the money!!!!!!
reviews.text: The room was not cleaned very well. There was feces on the bathroom wall and in the bidet.  The towels are old and it wouldn't give you extra. You cannot make reservations the same day at any restaurant all they wanted you to do is eat at the cheap buffet. And the Internet is horrible it only works in one spot of the hotel.  No Internet in your room no Internet at the pool. If you do get a signal it gets drop

reviews.author: James F
reviews.title: Six days of pure paradise!
reviews.text: We took our 11 year old daughter to Paradisus/Cancun for her spring break and it was fabulous.  The hotel,  the room (family concierge/oceanview jr. suite) the food quality and selection all exceeded our expectations.  Charly was our butler and Jorge and Abraham C. always made us feel special at the breakfast buffet.  Mother nature is also to be complimented for the superb weather and water.  We all felt the circus performance  and 'The 70s' were top notch entertainment.  We feel it was one of our best trips and have every intention of returning.

reviews.author: oppy06010
reviews.title: Just Fantastic!
reviews.text: Just got back from the Paradisius last night, already looking forward to going back next year! The royal service is the way to go if you want a relaxing vacation with absolutely no problems. When we arrived we were upgraded to suites at no charge. We had the worlds greatest butler in Sergio who made sure we were catered to in every way possible! All our dinner reservations were made for us without issues. Sergio decorated our room to the hilt for our anniversary, including helping us with a very special dinner we asked for. We went fishing in Cancun and asked about having our catch cooked for us, again Sergio rose to the occasion, we had to sign a waver if we got sick according to the hotel, then wanted to know what restaurant we wanted to cook it and how we would like it prepared! They did an unbelievable job exceeding our expectations. We have stayed at better "rated" hotels on trip advisor but we beg to differ! THIS IS THE PLACE TO VACATIONS!

reviews.author: Yaisa0320
reviews.title: My vacation was to be a birthday gateway and it turn out hell
reviews.text: Hotel is beautiful  services by the bartender (joushe)coco bar was   excelente the nao buffet was ok wasn't the best food !!! service by the waiters whatt made you go back very friendly and attentive very disappoited overall our phone was stolen from our suit and to top it off we are meliaclub members they gave me $400 to  replace it we didn't feel safe and was afraid  for any other personal belonging. Being stolen We didn't allow no one clean wifi

reviews.author: Carol A
reviews.title: Carol A
reviews.text: Booked royal service and had a fantastic time. Very relaxing. The staff were all lovely and friendly. Our butler Ivan was the best he was helpful, helped to book our bali beds and resturants an all round nice person.

reviews.author: Christine L
reviews.title: Over rated
reviews.text: Really the biggest negative was the room.  The "queen size beds" are full size and very uncomfortable.  There is no patio furniture on the balcony unless you want to pay extra when you get there.  Really? What kind of resort pulls this. The room had a table with two chairs and one area chair.  No sofa or comfortable amenities.  For the expense of the room it was VERY over priced.  This was a standard room and talking with other guests, their experience was the same. Wifi was slow and spuratic.  The pool was great and the ocean access was fantastic.  The pools were very clear.  Beautiful beach.  We have cruised, been to Maui, Cabo, Oahu, all over the states, Caribbean, by far worst room I've seen.  The food in the restaurants were okay.  The resort was generous with alcohol.  Very commercialized resort.

reviews.author: Michelle N
reviews.title: Beautiful!!
reviews.text: The property and service was outstanding.  We signed up for the Family Conceirge which was amazing.  Our butler "Ramon" was the best.  Truly made this vacation one of the finest.  He was so amazing to our son Carter.  Also, loved Asuncion on the beach.  She was the best waitress and so attentive to our needs.

reviews.author: Brian/Trish
reviews.title: Pure Paradise
reviews.text:
We stayed in the Royal Service section again on our 2nd trip to the wonderful Paradisus.  Galdino, our Butler, assisted with any request and left beautiful notes for us, baths, rose pedals.  He made it a point to find us by the pool early every morning to make sure all our needs were met.  Galdino, if you are reading this, you made our vacation!!!  (Rode, you were also awesome to us)
The wait staff around the pool was there for your every need.  Thanks Edie, Rogelio and so many others.  Enrique, the awesome bartender was so awesome to me making my iced tea just the way I liked it.  Thanks for being so awesome.  
The waiters at the Royal Service bar/mini buffet were awesome.  Thanks Edier!  
A final thanks to Rody at Market Grill who got us in for dinner at the last minute.  

Such a great staff and I know I'm leaving many names out as I can't remember them all, though I wish I could.  The bottom line, we felt so welcomed and pampered.  

Customer Service is everything, The staff at Paradisus goes above and beyond.  

I will see you all again next year, if not sooner.

reviews.author: BeachFamilySND
reviews.title: We will be coming back, service is over the top
reviews.text:
This is our first family trip with children to Cancun so we have no other points of reference in Cancun Mexico (MX) but we can put it in perspective by comparing to our recent trip to Dominican Republic (DR) where we stayed at Barceló Punta Cana All Inclusive. This way you can have 2 in 1 review. 
#1: Travel to Cancun was much easier from the stand point of flight selection and price. Also, DR requires extra visa with charge on arrival and another charge on departure. Finding your ride after you land was also much easier in MX with people greeting you with signs and also offered water during the ride which was important to us. MX wins hands down on transportation to final destination. 
#2. Communication was almost impossible in DR where people who even serve you could not understand simple drink orders and forget asking for anything else. We had no trouble in MX with everyone speaking enough English for any of our needs and people who could not such as repair staff, would tell us that they do not. MX wins here again big time. 
#3. Accommodations: Getting the right room is a deal breaker between good and bad stay. DR had one bedroom options with King in one and doubles in another for the kids and bath in between. That's a big plus for travel with kids. MX had limited options for such configuration so we settled for double beds and a pull out sofa. Also, the mattresses were very hard and uncomfortable with all of us feeling tires and sore every morning. DR had outstanding beds and mattresses with all of us sleeping better than at home. DR wins this and only one contest. 
#4. Service: This was the highlight of the trip. There was nothing that the staff could not solve that we asked for and all we had to do is dial a zero. Our room had a few issues that made us move to another and then some other things did not work in the new room but everything was solved by dedicated staff from security, maintenance, food service, cleaning, etc. - AMAZING! DR service staff was always confused primarily due to not understanding much English and trying to knock on the door late at night uninvited. MX service was unexpected to be over the top. 
#5. Food: This was another unexpected experience for us after DR where there were 4x more food choices but everything had no taste whatsoever with us assuming because it was all grown in DR soil that is volcanic. The food was fantastic and unlimited even in reservation required sit down places. DR had only 1 of each category and that's it. The buffet place was having daily themes so you could eat at the buffet every night and still have so much variety. There was no such a thing in DR, all was the same every night. Quick reference for each restaurant we visited that was with kids allowed is the following: Vento - small tapas with different flavors, sea bass grilled to perfection was the favorite. Market Grill - Brazilian style with meat variety and quality hard to find in a real steakhouse and great sides and salad. This was also our go to place for lunch for grilled to order half chicken. Mole - Mexican theme restaurant with cactus salad and stuffed poblano our favorites. Fuego - we liked the salad with berries and onions, very unusual but awesome. All restaurants had great red wine. You cannot go wrong with trying all reservation required places and if you do not like your meal, then head out to the buffet. DR restaurants were just a different variation of the buffet foods and were just as tasteless with watered down drinks and low quality house wine. We also enjoyed breakfast a lot with lots of choices for kids and excellent fruit. The staff works so hard around the clock to feed and clean the guests. It would certainly help if guests would just go easy on loading the plates with the food they are not going to eat. 
#6: We wanted to see what the entertainment was but every time we went by the area as late at 8:30pm, there were people sitting around but no entertainment. So we did not see any. DR had early entertainment for kids and then later one for adults and it was grand scale. Here in MX we did not get to see any. Also, the music on the beach was only for certain areas and definitely not around kids pool area and even when we moved to swim closer to the bar the DJ would leave too early. However, the music that was played was great since we enjoy dance and electronic music, BPM channel on XM anyone? DR wins in this department but that's not a big deal to us. 
#7: Beach and Ocean. This is the most important for us since we are not coming to resorts to stay in pools full of chemicals. Half of a week long stay the ocean was calm enough to stay in and jump over the waves and the other half the waves were too strong for us to stay in without getting exhausted in a short period of time. The water was 78F in the early morning which is cold to get in but fine to stay in and over 80F later in the day and very comfortable for us to spend all day in the water (we had something to measure the temp ourselves). The water in DR was below 76F and was too cold to stay even for a short period of time. Both DR and MX had a lot of sea weed but it was not an issue for us swimming in MX. We were told that April and May are a lot calmer on the waves and chances are no sea weed. However, this is the only time we could come given kids schedules and we are still pleased with the time we spent in the  ocean although it is far from ideal.

Bottom line, this was a 5 star experience for us first time visiting Cancun and Paradisus and we will be back. We definitely do not recommend DR but it is something we were comparing everything with so here you go.

reviews.author: Kay A
reviews.title: Amazing beyond words
reviews.text:
I arrived at the paradisus and was taken to our pyramid. We booked Royal Service and met our Butler the next day Ivan is amazing and a credit to the hotel. He was so helpful, polite and kind. He is great at his job.

The beach is beautiful the water is Aqua blue clear and warm. Being Royal service means we got to have the Bali Beds and you are served your drinks and food if you want to have it on it. By no means do they hold out on the alcohol which is great.

We was recommended by our butler to try the restaurants that was available in the hotel. The best by far had to be Vento. The manager Jose was amazing. The Hostess Katia was so polite and welcoming and finally our server Emanuel was the best. He went through the whole menu recommend what we should try. The food was delicious. Tapas at it's best. 

Overall this experience and trip has been the best and I want to thank the great staff that has made it possible. The rooms and everything I just can not fault it. Will be back here next year with girls. can't Wait!!!!

reviews.author: Joanne F
reviews.title: Truly relaxing
reviews.text: We've been going to the Paradisus for many years now.   We find it to be a great place to relax for a week, and the all inclusive option is the way to go.   We visited early in March this year (2015) and were a bit under-impressed by the staff and the quality of the food.   With one exception:  Sofonia, who took care of us when we were at the pool, was absolutely amazing.  He was friendly, attentive and actually anticipated our needs.  If it wasn't for him I would have given the resort a much lower this year.

reviews.author: Lisa T
reviews.title: Royal service
reviews.text: Second time to this resort. We upgraded to the Royal Service which was not worth $100 a night! Service around the pool area was extremely slow. Our butler made reservations for dinner and that he couldn't even do correctly! Do not upgrade the rooms and service are the same if not better!

reviews.author: tim h
reviews.title: nice but not great
reviews.text:
stayed for two days, the first day there arrived at 1:30 pm front desk was nice then on to the high pressure timeshare sale. I was not ready for this after paying over $450 a night! The food was just ok they were not able to give us reservations for dinner the first night saying they were booked till 10 pm we called at 2pm after getting to room. Off to the buffet "yeah"
Staff was nice, rooms were clean ocean view balcony not worth it. there is a huge planter in the view of the water plus kinda blocked by walls on all sides pluse dead plants in our planter. well off to the pool not bad,very clean, and big pluse warm with swim up bar again staff was nice. We stayed at a non all inclusive for 2 night before coming here and for the extra 250 per night I would never do that again. there is a bus out front $1 per ride per person will take you to any of the other resuraunts up the rd and the food is always great. The blue iguana is a hiden jem, small lunch or dinner food but great tacos and drinks.looks like a hole but good. some other guest told us about it.

reviews.author: Milan H
reviews.title: Best Spring Brake Of My Life!!!
reviews.text: Great Location!!! We went with bunch of friends for the spring brake and we had a blast!!! All inclusive was full of great food and drinks 24/7!!! Great beach and swimming pool!!! I hope to be back one day!!!

reviews.author: Chris M
reviews.title: Will be Back
reviews.text: Great value.  Great service.  Pay up for the Royal Service and you won't be disappointed.  Be sure to reserve a Bali bed the day you get there.   Our butler was great, he set up golf and scuba diving just how we wanted.  Spoke great English, and really made the trip hassle free. Eddie at the La Palapa was great every day didn't let our drink ever get empty.  And when you told him you wanted a a double, It was a double!!

reviews.author: Tony C
reviews.title: Great Service!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus. We upgraded to the Royal Service and it was worth it. Beachfront room is a must. Great views. Although we never really used the Butler service, the other amenities were nice. The best part for us was the pool with the Bali beds. You have to get a Bali bed. So relaxing. The pool service was top notch. Salvador the bartender is second to none. Food was just average but the drinks were top shelf. Chips, salsa and guac were awesome though. For restaurants, the Blue Agave was great for tacos and tequila plus no reservations needed. Baja was quite good as well. The main buffet was just okay. Nothing special. Overall great service and a very nice stay. Would visit again.

reviews.author: JodsterJ
reviews.title: A Week of Paradise
reviews.text:
We enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus Cancun from start to finish!  Despite visiting during the busy month of March, we never had to wait in any lines and there was always somebody available who was willing to do what s/he could to help make our stay more enjoyable.

Check-in was a breeze!  Somebody offered us a cool drink upon arrival and we had our room key before we knew it.  I suspected that we had been given a ground floor room (based on the room number).  We prefer to stay on the higher floors, if possible, and all it took was a simple request and we were given a room on the 5th floor without hesitation!   This set the tone for the rest of our stay.  

After checking in, a staff member took us aside to explain the various options available regarding the restaurants, bars, activities, and other various amenities.  She provided us with resort maps and advice for getting around town easily.  In closing, she did mention that there was a breakfast available the next day which would explain the benefits of joining the Club Melia, but there was no hard push after we politely declined. 

We went upstairs to see our room and we were greeted by a staff member already dropping off our luggage!  He instantly offered to bring us two lounge chairs for the balcony, which was much appreciated.  I can't imagine having such a spectacular view and not spending time on the balcony enjoying it!  I believe he was also the person responsible for our turndown service, complete with chocolates on the pillow each night.  Later in the week, he spent time decorating the room with some rose petals and provided us with a bottle of Absolut.  My only regret is that I didn't catch his name. 

We were located in the main pyramid #3, in room 3552.  The room size and amenities were quite satisfactory for the two of us.  The rain shower head in the bathroom felt great after a day spent on the beach.  The instructions for using the safe were a little worn and hard to read, but a quick phone call to the front desk and our valuables were locked away safely in no time.  The in-room refrigerator was restocked daily with snacks and beverages and the one time that we asked for ice, it arrived within minutes, followed by a phone call to be sure that we had received it.  We ordered room service one evening and it arrived quickly and was warm and tasty.  We were able to get Wi-Fi in the room and could hear the sound of the waves crashing at night.  To me, there is no better lullaby!

We did not make any reservations at any of the restaurants as we preferred to keep our options open regarding our time schedule.  That being said, there was still plenty of variety to choose from at the other restaurants such as Naos (international buffet available for breakfast, lunch, and dinner), the outdoor Market Grill (a la Carte pizza, pasta & grill), and Blue Agave, which served excellent tacos & tequila!  

We did hop in the pool one day, and we loved its large size!  Aside from the swim up bar area, we practically had the whole pool to ourselves.  The water was a great temperature throughout.  That being said, we preferred to spend our time underneath a tiki hut on the beach itself.  When it got a little too warm, the Caribbean Sea was just steps away for a refreshing dip.   I cannot emphasize how wonderful the staff was in taking our drink orders and offering bottles of water.   We were pleasantly surprised when one of the staff (Katrina or Karina?) remembered our preferences from the day before and brought us our favorite drinks before we even had to ask!  There truly was a "No Worries" vibe going on during this vacation!

The location of the resort was very convenient as well.  It is located directly across from AquaWorld, where you could enjoy free non-motorized watersports (such as pedal boats and kayaks) just by showing them your wristband & providing your room number.  We took out the pedal boats one day and had a nice time.  A bus stop is also located at the end of the long resort drive.  It only cost $1 for a quick ride into town to visit the many bars, shopping centers and restaurants.  Just tell the driver where you would like to go and he'll announce the stop.  Safe & easy!
 
All in all, we couldn't have been more pleased with our stay at the Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: walter p
reviews.title: Great vacation!!
reviews.text:
We loved our stay at the Paradisus! Overall the resort was clean, friendly, and fun.

Unlike all the other reviewers here, we didn't get the royal service, so here's a review for how the common folk get down at the Paradisus.

The things I'll remember most are how friendly and helpful the staff were to us and the beautiful pools and beaches.

Check-in took a little longer than we would have liked. Rooms are ready at 3pm and not a minute earlier, but once we got situated things were much smoother. 

The pools were beautiful, clean, and never overly crowded. The bartenders at the pool bar made some great drinks and it never took more than a few minutes in line. 

There was a diverse crowd of travelers: families with kids, couples, and some groups of students on Spring break. We were looking for a calm relaxing week, and we definitely found it here. 

Dining: there are like 8 restaurants at the resort, and we had the opportunity to try 3 and the buffet. They take reservations for dinner the day prior or day of.
First, the buffet is pretty decent for a quick breakfast and lunch. It's not a gourmet experience, but overall we liked the food, including a nice smoothie bar in the morning.
The restaurant we liked the best was Fuego and we ended up there twice it was so good. They have a delicious menu of steak and seafood, and the service is great.
Bana is a sushi restaurant set in a beautiful location at the center of the resort, but the food was forgettable.
Vento is a tapas restaurant in another beautiful setting with a nice diverse menu that we enjoyed too.

My favorite part of the resort was renting a Bali bed for a day. You get great individualized service and an AMAZING seafood lunch delivered, all for 50 bucks.

If you're looking for a fun resort with its own beautiful pools and beaches, this is the place. All the staff members we interacted with were eager and helpful and made it a special week. I loved it here and would happily go back anytime.

reviews.author: Adele472
reviews.title: restaurant staff are so kind and beach is gorgeous
reviews.text:
So many kind staff members at the Restaurant Naos> Jorge, William, Caeser, Oscar, Barbara and Sonia. Louis at Bana Restaurant was unbelievable. He went out of his way to make sure we had what we needed with food allergies, etc. We hope to visit again!
Only problem was the housekeeping kept forgetting to give us enough towels on a regular basis.

reviews.author: Lisa S
reviews.title: First class from start to finish.....
reviews.text: Staying at the Paradisus is always a luxury for our family.  We have been coming here for almost 20 years and have NEVER had an issue.  The service, the staff, the restaurants are always top notch.  They have increased the number of palapas, now found on the beach and have added umbrellas around the pool area.  Every day they are doing something to upgrade and impress.  Now the outdoor grill should be open and we can't wait to experience this next year.  If you are looking for a great place to stay, with friendly service and great food, the Paradisus is the place to be in Cancun MX.

reviews.author: Matanda28
reviews.title: hmm, hard to sum it up in a few words...
reviews.text:
I stayed here on my second trip to Mexico, the first time staying  in Playa del Carmen, also at an all- inclusive. this time, it was a nice short trip from the airport, around 30 mins, if even.
  My expectations in general were high, based on my previous experience.  Aesthetically, the hotel is lovely- the outside is grand and imposing- looking especially gorgeous at dusk. Once you get inside, it's a wide-open space, filled floor to ceiling with Rapunzel-like long, luscious plants and foliage. Plants hang from each floor into the open atrium.  It makes you feel as if you are in the jungle and it is quite a sight. 
  Check-in was fine, but no one walked us to the room which I thought was odd, given the size of the hotel. Also, they took our bags and said they would send them shortly. We ended up having to call and request, as we really wanted to freshen up and get going.
   The food was OK, a lot of choices, some very good, some very standard...  and always the same thing in the buffet.. although the juice bar at breakfast was a really nice touch. 
  The specialty restaurants weren't bad, again- I was basing my expectations on my previous experience which left me slightly disappointed.
  The weather was sort of crappy for most of the trip, but when we could swim it was great and the hotel is of course beachfront. It was a nice beach, and much less crowded than other hotels we walked past as we strolled. This hotel didn't have the spring break party crowds. Cancun in general, from what I have learned, is very windy on the shore and also the waves are stronger than one would expect. It can be very difficult to get beyond the break.. and then get back out without getting pummeled.  But, its the Caribbean Sea.. I shouldn't complain at all!  
 Because the weather wasn't great, we did spend a decent amount of time within the hotel.. we utilized the gym ( not bad at all), tried the restaurants ( all fine, nothing stood out to me), and room service ( a long wait, but great breakfast!) got a massage ( highly recommended) and wandered around. There was a lot of space, some of which was sadly empty, as there just weren't enough people.
    My only real issue was the salesy-ness of this resort. The first morning after we arrived, we wanted to sleep in, but we got a call at 9am asking us if we liked the room and if we wanted to pay to upgrade. It then happened again the next day, this time just after 10am.  The really wanted us to upgrade, but I think after you ask once and we say no, just let us be... 
other than that, it was close to the market in Cancun and local restaurants ( just take the bus that picks you up at the hotel's entrance). We got lots of souvenirs there and had a lot of fun.
   If you're in Cancun, this is a good fit for couples who want a bit of relaxation at a reasonable cost. but for true luxury, try resorts in Playa del Carmen.

reviews.author: Charlene F
reviews.title: Nice, but wrong time to visit!
reviews.text:
We unfortunately booked during spring break (not realising!) and the hotel, pools, beach and everything was busy.  (We were not offered the Royal Service, so this review is just a on the usual suite and all inclusive service) The Paradisus hotel is quite impressive when you first arrive, and in a good location with a few swimming pools and a nice stretch of beach.  However, we found the rooms surprisingly quite dated which was disappointing for the price we paid.  

The hotel is made up of a number of pyramids (1-5) with all the entertainment and restaurants being in the centre pyramid (3).  We were allocated a room which was most possibly the furthest away you could get.. in pyramid 1 and on the 5th floor, overlooking the lagoon side (which basically is a nice way to say the parking lot).  We are not averse to walking but did find the trek to and fro from the room to anywhere quite a drag in the end.. so definitely try and get a room closer.  Also, the hotel has a number of restaurants available BUT you have to book a place in advance.. you cant just turn up and ask for a table, even though we tried a number of times.. and the places looked empty, they all just give you a number and tell you to go away and call to book.. so definitely book a few days in advance as places go quickly.  (There are a few buffet style restaurants which you can always fall back on, which we did.. and the food was good and changed daily)  All the places we ate were really good.

One thing we found quite unnecessary, they have these 'customer services' desks around the hotel, which we thought were there to help us book restaurants or trips etc.. but we found were basically there to just try and get you to join their club, or sell you timeshare.. for a discounted rate on tours.  While its all done amicably, I really didnt enjoy this, and because the people are so friendly you feel its almost impossible to decline attending.. so end up wasting 3-5hours of your day, which happened to us.. also once the one person couldnt get us to buy into a deal, another then came and tried to offer a differing one.. dont be caught! (Im sure booking any tours in advance will be a lot cheaper than any discount they have to offer).

The Paradisus has some lovely pools, but the seats around these are VERY limited.. we found getting one (and especially one that might offer a bit of shade) quite difficult unless you went very early.. and a seat in the beach was impossible. (unless you wanted to pay for a big bed) Not sure if this was just bad luck due to the time of year with all the families on holiday, but incase not.. I would advise getting a seat early..

The service in the restaurants and throughout the Hotel was very good, everyone was eager to help you when they were available.

(As an afterthought.. there is wifi in the rooms and most general areas, for those always needing to be online)

reviews.author: TigerCanada
reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text:
The only great thing about this resort its a beach... We payid for Royal service, garden view room and ending up in the room with a view of tennis court. Have to rent a cabanas at royal service pool everyday, seriously? The "Coco" beach club is great, service there is really good as well but its not a part of all inc, even tho its part of the hotel, you have to pay for it. Love the japan ice restaurant, went there twice, awesome service, good atmosphere, delicios food. 
DO NOT FOLLOW FOR "FREE GIFT" INVITATION, ITS A TIME SHARE! Wasting two hours of my vacation, and salesmen get frustrating and angry when me and my husbnad decide not to go with the offer lol 
We have a great time tho, weather was perfect, drinks was yummy, wifi really fast, and beach just delightful. 
Would we go back to Paradisus Cancun? No.

reviews.author: Toni0099
reviews.title: Second time around.....
reviews.text:
This was our third time in Mexico, all of which we stayed at Paradisus. This was our second to Cancun. We upgraded to the Royal Service when we checked in and it was worth every dime. Our butler,Hector, took care of everything for us. He had a Bali bed by the pool for us without having to ask.The Royal Service has it's own pyramid at the resort as well as it's own beach and pool. Every morning there is breakfast goods downstairs which had everything you could imagine. Edgar made the best cappuccinos every morning for us. He was so friendly and knew exactly what we wanted as soon as he saw us. Kauil at Naos buffet had a table for us as soon as we went up for lunch. He could not do enough for us.He was very friendly and nice to talk to.We plan to return next year again and will be sure to ask for all of favorite staff.
The resort was clean and everyone who worked there were super nice. Everywhere you walk just smells so good. The food was plentiful and the drinks just keep coming. And its top shelf! The water at the beach is a bit rough, so you have to be careful and this year the beach was overloaded with seaweed. Last year there was not a piece to be seen so I guess mother nature had other plans this year. 
All in all we love this resort and will be returning again next year with friends!! And we WILL be upgrading to the Royal Service!

reviews.author: Mark G
reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.text: We went to the paadisus this year instead of the moon palace and we were very happy we did. The beach at the paradisus is a hundred times better than the moon palace. Everything at the paradisus was first class. The best all inclusive hotel that we have ever stayed at, and we have been to several all over the caribbean.

reviews.author: Louise R
reviews.title: Mayan ruins
reviews.text:
Hotel all inclusive part of Melia chain . 
Nice big rooms .
Lots of pools and of course the beach area. Water lovely temperature.
Choice of numerous restaurants. The ones we tried were good . Mexican one pretty average Six star Michelin resturant with Spanish chef. We were unable to try as it is very popular . Mayan ruins very interesting. Tulum amazing setting . Chechen itza was in in really wonderful condition and is being preserved for future generations .
Lots of vendors but not troublesome.
Cancun town looked pretty ordinary on our way through to the Mayan sights

reviews.author: Wayne W
reviews.title: Choose your Cancun hotel wisely
reviews.text:
Stayed here for a week in March 2015 with my family for Spring Break.
Allow me to score the hotel in segments:
1. Front end - Victor was a super host; the staff performing check in/out were super; the help desk changing currency was great.
2. Mid-section.....the room was a bit small for a junior suite, but the balcony overlooking the pool and beach was nice. The maid service was a bit challenged by not replacing wash cloths, but that sort out after the second day. Room service was super and timely. The resturaunts requiring reservation had world class service and food. The gift shop items were reasonably priced.
3. Back end - the open seating resturaunt had average food, the cooks were friendly, but the staff were exceptionally rude on multiple occaisions and to different members of my family.
