I won't get into the weeds, but Americans are not welcomed in this section. It was appalling each time. The Coco bar staff were super rude to my family members and myself to the point that I reported it to management based upon no service whatsoever unless you handed them your wallet at this "all inclusive" resort. The same with the pool bar and the beach wait staff.
Also, the beach wait staff made remarks during the day to each other abiut Gringos and Americanos that were deragatory and within earshot of the customers, some of which were from Texas and knew what the words meant.

For the negative items, they all came in the first two days, making the trip miserable to the point that I wanted to check out, but did not becuase I prepaid the trip through an online travel agency.

I have fond memories of all my other grips to Mexico...Puerta Vallarta many years ago, Cancun many years ago, Riveria Maya a couple of years ago. My best advice: choose hotels that have'professional stafflike Mariott or Iberostar and not the untrained, unsupervised and burnt out staff at hotels like this one. Read the negative reviews, not the glowing honeymooner reviews before you choose.

reviews.author: wheeler604
reviews.title: LOVED IT!!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I just got back. We LOVED IT!!! I really researched a lot of places and read soooo many reviews. By all means UPGRADE to Royal Service! Totally worth it! You get a private butler (ours was Hector Ibarra and he was awesome!) Everyday he surprised us with something... he made us a rose petal bubble bath, bottle of champagne, chocolates on our pillows daily and you also get an included bottle of booze (we got absolut). With the royal service you also get daily access to this massaging whirlpool in the spa (we didnt find out til the last day...oops). Royal service has its own appetizer area where they always have fresh fruit, good booze, and desserts laid out til 10pm at night.... ALSO royal service gets its OWN heated pool (no children allowed...yay!) with an awesome service staff.... shoutouts to Rojalio (server) and Enrique (bartender) who were soooo attentive and fun! So if you are single or a couple without kids Royal Service is the way to go!!!

The restaurants: BANA sushi... awesome.
mole: skip it
Market Grill: skip it
Noas: open all the time buffet.... quite good
Fuego: AWESOME...get the octopus app.

I am from Chicago so I am automatically spoiled by amazing food in my city but the food at Paradisus was good... not Chicago good but def good enough for my vacation.

All in all my husband and I decided we are FOR SURE coming back next year.

reviews.author: newyearsday
reviews.title: It grows on you
reviews.text:
This was our 10th trip to Cancun (first one with our daughter - age 5) and I leave the resort (after a 5 night stay) with mixed feelings.  Off the bat, will we be going back? No...but most people we spoke with were really happy about the hotel.
Pros: Gorgeous beach, great entertainment/activities for adults and kids, beautiful lobby area, good room service, no problem getting a seat at the pool or beach
Commendations to Guadalupe at the front desk,Tabata and Oscar at Cocos bar, Luis at Market Grill, and Manuel at the gym
Cons: The resort is dated; is is well kept but you can tell it is older and has been renovated a lot, rooms are small (we had 2 full beds and a cot and this filled the room) - we had requested a king, the main pool is too deep, and overall, the food was average.
I almost feel bad we didn't like it more as it has received tons of great reviews but honestly, I'm surprised that Paradisus Cancun is so highly rated.

reviews.author: James M
reviews.title: Got moved from the ME by Melia in Cancun to Paradisus Cancun, no options given
reviews.text:
I have been a long time Melia owner, started with resort on Cozumel then upgraded to Puerto Villarta and then upgraded to a 1 BR Suite at the ME Cancun, then they decided that they didn't want me at the ME Cancun and just moved me to the Paradisus, I went there to stay for a week checked in and was given a room that was not a 1 BR Suite at all and it was facing a parking lot that was full of construction debris.  I complained long and hard to the highest level of management I could find, I was finally moved to another room with a nice ocean view but still not a 1BR suite, I was told there were none available but that was what I had reserved and that is what I bought with options.
I wrote to the owner in Europe no answer, I wrote to other management people and said I wanted out or my contract because they had forced me to make the move.  
I bought the new membership at Melia Puerto Villarta and a manager wrote to me saying I was welcome to come back to PV so I am going to try that.  I will never go back to Paradisus as they all lie and laugh about it behind your back.
I AM A MEMBER AND THEY PUT NON MEMBERS IN THE MEMBER WING AND TAKE THE ROOMS MEMBERS SHOULD HAVE.
I am still not happy with Melia the way they treat the Members.
I would still like to get out of this timeshare but probably will not happen, I threatened to stop paying the monthly payments, of course they said they would take me to court.  I should of tried it any way.

reviews.author: Tommy G
reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here from the 11 to 19 the resort was beautiful the food was amazing we usually go to jamacia or the dominican republic so this was our first trip to cancun it was an amazing trip friendly staff didn't have to lift a finger the entire trip tipping goes a long way if you want to be pampered I was on my anniversary and tipped the maid 20 dollars to make the room pretty for my wife she went above and beyond Christian  and Rogelio at the pool bar were amazing and made us feel at home if you like water activities it's offered right across the street highly recommended we did jungle tour personal submarines and paras ailing all amazing definitely go into downtown as well for shopping we will be back for sure

reviews.author: Melissa M
reviews.title: Little Piece of Paradise
reviews.text:
Absolutely beautiful!  I treated myself to a quick 2-night stay over winter break and can't wait to take my son next time!  I stayed in Royal Service, which was adults only.  I rarely left the adults only area of the resort because I was not there long.  I ate at the adults only restaurant for lunch both days.  Food was very good.  The beach was perfect.  Beautiful breeze.  Waves crashing.  Paradise.  I met a few couples and had great conversations with them while drinking yummy drinks and having tequila shots!  Dinner the first night was at the tapas restaurant.  If you go, order a lot.  They aren't kidding when they say "small" plates.  Not a problem, though.  I just ordered more of my favorites.  I saw some of the Michael Jackson show in the lobby, which was much more entertaining than I would have thought!  

All in all, simply incredible.  The beach alone is worth every penny.  Can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Johnferguson A
reviews.title: Great Property, Great Stay
reviews.text:
My wife and I spent 4 nights at Paradisus.  The property is beautiful and is very well maintained by the staff.  The service is outstanding and all of the employees we met were very helpful, cheerful, and hardworking.  Food and drinks are great, we had no issue with any of it throughout the week!

We stayed in the main pyramid which could get loud at night with the entertainment that they have down on the main floor, but it wasn't terribly loud after 10.

I highly recommend staying at this hotel, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: PAdee
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
I can sum it all up by saying .....incredible.  The hotel is absolutely beautiul and I can't say enough about the staff .  It is amazing that they are so upbeat  and caring all day, everyday. I wish I had more names to mention but there are just to many.  The staff at Naos are AMAZING.  Special thanks to Martin,Darwin,Abraham, Jorge,Fidel, David.  At Vento, Jose, Karla ,Leobunde. I wish I had some names in housekeeping, also great!  Servers  on the beach check on you often, and always with a smile!
Nice beach, gorgeous ocean.

reviews.author: Michelle H
reviews.title: Relaxing Stay!
reviews.text: I felt like we stole the keys to the Royal Palace. Everyone at the hotel was warm and friendly and could not do enough for you. The service and the amenities provided were outstanding! Pool area/ beach area had every thing we wanted and my wife just hung out in the cabanna all day.

reviews.author: Behzad Y
reviews.title: best place in cancun patadisus
reviews.text:
Amazing resort. Extra polite staff. High quality food. Greater value. Very entertaining. Family oriented. Very clean. Luxurious. ....

.XxxXxxxXxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

reviews.author: Doc58NewJersey
reviews.title: Primer for the non-all inclusive traveler
reviews.text: Note that we not the all inclusive crowd, so if you intend on taking that option, some of what follows might not be applicable.  We last visited this hotel the year before last (have been staying here every other year for over ten years); at that time it had just changed over to the Paradisus brand.  Being as Paradisus is marketing itself as a luxury resort, we had hoped the place had grown into the brand by now--not the case, as several things kept this place from being far from the standard of a luxury resort.  Paradisus is obviously catering to the “Disney Cruise” crowd; this has changed the vibe of this place from that of a relatively serine and peaceful getaway to that of a rather noisy, younger family with little kids environment--this is especially evident during meal times so be aware of where they seat you.  From the beginning, check in (we are club members) was laborious; it seemed no one person could complete the process (which took over one hour).  Check in ended with a hard sell attempt to upgrade; we declined since they could not give a simple quote to how much the upgrade would cost--instead they wanted an hour of our time to hard sell something.  After decling the hard sell a final time our “agent” asked me if a had some sort of problem--pretty rude to say the least--I let that one go and attributed it to her lack of English proficiency.  TIP: be prepared to not be able to get a direct answer to even the most simple question--seems that the default response at this place is “no”.  First and foremost, for the non-all inclusive crowd, things are not welcoming.  For example, after two days in, we were informed that the continental breakfast option (which had been available forever) was no longer an option.  So, although we preferred a very light breakfast, we were forced to either not eat or spend $50.00 (for two) for that meal--big rip-off.  And by the way, what happened to the great banana bread?  Seems I got the last piece on Sunday--never to be seen again!  We repeatedly asked to speak to the restaurant manager about the breakfast situation; he was always in a “meeting”, and never once did anybody ask to take our name so he could get back to us--not luxury resort behavior.  Next came room service.  We asked for a couple of bottles of water to be delivered on day two; much to our surprise this included a delivery charge; another rip-off.  TIP: walk across the street to Oxxo and buy supplies there.  We stayed in one night (due to illness) and ordered two margherita pizzas from the room service menu; what arrived were two small frozen pizza crusts with some sort of cheese--no discernable tomato or sauce and no basil.  TIP: don’t order room service if you can at all avoid it.  The room was okay; certainly not luxurious, but we had a beautiful sea view.  We battled with housekeeping all week to get two hand towels and wash cloths; they seemed to not get it--two people, two towels.  We eventually did get two hand towels by week’s end, but never received any wash cloths--certainly not luxury resort behavior.  The room had a ceiling fan--the fan worked but the chain to turn off the light was missing so the fan could not be run while we were sleeping since the light was always on.  The beach.  This is the best selling point of this place--white sands and “Corona commercial” water.  Interesting that the resort was even able to disrupt this by having the most obnoxious techno pop, new age, hip-hop boom boom boom boom blaring at very high volume (most days).  Funny how they can take one of the most beautiful settings on earth and turn it obnoxious.  TIP: get to the beach between around 8:00-8:30 a.m.; that way you can find a tiki umbrella and chairs as far away from the “Coco Beach Club” as possible.  Couple of other things; ATM not functional--I suggest using the one at the Marriot next door. Also, three out of the last four times we have been there have been accompanied by traveler’s diarrhea.  Now, I am not blaming this solely on Melia; instead, I think that some food quality control standards have dropped across the board, so be advised.  TIP: you are quite simply taking a chance eating anything raw in Mexico, so consider that.  Importantly take Cipro with you; at the first sign of any GI problem, take it!  All-in-all we were disappointed--love Cancun, definitely not in love with Melia Paradisus.

reviews.author: Jen M
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Mexico. This place is paradise. We were in the Royal Service part. All of the pool guys and wait staff are excellent. Alexander and Arturo were our pool guys and were so helpful and getting us our bali bed. The wait staff hustles all day and surprises you with drinks. We particularly loved Alberth, Edie, Ricardo, and Rogelio. They are amazing. Plenty of food options throughout the resort. Most you need reservations, but our favorite restaurant was actually one you don't need a reservation for. Blue Agave- it's a hidden gem! The water and beach is beautiful as well.

reviews.author: DonnaLM
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, expansive beach front,  very good restaurants, excellent customer service
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful inside and out. It's very wide and therefore there is a lot of beach front, which is important to us. We noticed other resorts on the strip did not have as much beach front and their beaches were crowded.  

We stayed in the Ocean View rooms, which were nice, great view and beds were comfy.  We were in Pyramid 3 and we did NOT find it too noisy as others had commented, however we were not directly over the center, slightly down the hall.  This resort was immaculately clean, with beautiful common areas, lobby etc.  Pictures don't do it justice.  

The buffet was good, and the restaurants were very good.  We particularly enjoyed the Japanese Restaurant, the Brazilian Market Grill, Feugo and Mole. Drinks were delicious and strong.  The service and staff at this resort are EXCELLENT and this stellar customer service is what makes this resort so great.  The beach was beautiful and the ocean waves were SO much fun, spent hours in the ocean.  The pools were nice, and we found the water temperature fine.  

If I had to find a con, I would say we wished there were more organized sports, games, activities etc, but not a big issue.

So to summarize, excellent expansive beach front, exceptional customer service and a beautiful resort.  Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Christian S
reviews.title: Amazing getaway!!!
reviews.text: Great staff, outstanding service amazing looking place. From the knowledgeable bar staff lead by the shot encyclopedia; Christian who helped us and was very patient serving us drinks by the pool, to the amazing food we had at the buffet, the Blue Agave Taqueria, but most impressive was the food at Vento. The staff there; Katia, Jose and our attentive waiter Leobardo made us feel like royalty. A truly extraordinary experience all around.

reviews.author: Crossking1184
reviews.title: Perfect hotel
reviews.text: Angel and Freddy are awesome people beautiful hotel nice food nice room service it was awesome I can't wait and if u read this tel angel Freddy and ouzy and attury that I said hey they are all good people

reviews.author: Beachpail
reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: the staff,food and service were great. The wait staff on the beach and around the pool were wonderful and always there. the only wonder was why no furniture on the balconies. there are about 4 flights down to the beach.  the pools are deep

reviews.author: Barry C
reviews.title: Not a 4-1/2 star
reviews.text:
Pros: The hotel staff were great, Waiters , Bartenders, Pool Guys. The shows were good, Nice Bars and dance the night away in the red lounge.
Cons: The food in the restaurants was only average Seating for the shows was very limited , it was hard to find a seat with a view
Location: The hotel is on the strip. The bus stops in front of the hotel and takes you to downtown Cancun if you wish for $1.
If you are an Expedia Gold member do not expect any of the stated VIP upgrades , the front desk denied knowing about them. We spent 45 min trying to sort it out . Another couple we spoke to had exactly the same trouble the day before. This Paradisus is not up to the standard of the previous ones we have visited in Playa del Carmen and Punta Cana. The balcony only had one ( broken ) chair and you only get one wash cloth a day. If you want a Pool or Beach Cabana there is a hefty daily surcharge. Despite the above problems we had a great time at this hotel it just did not rate a 4-1/2, more like a 4.

reviews.author: Judith P
reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text: My sister and I have been visiting this resort for 10 years.  The service is fantastic and the rooms are lovely.  We have met many servers over the years who are still there to greet us when we arrive in February.  They are: Asuncion, Sofonia, Luis, Enrique, Marisol, Iran (the fabulous wine steward), and Miguel.  The experiences my sister and I share are made possible by these folks.  We shall continue to see them each year.

reviews.author: Elina B
reviews.title: Loved Royal Service!!!
reviews.text:
This review is a few months overdue but I must share how much I absolutely loved my stay at the Royal Service portion of the hotel (adults only, premium drinks, nespresso machine, free daily cabanas, a butler for your stay, amazing rooms, spa perks, etc.)

It was nice to be part of a bigger hotel and to be able to enter your world of Royal Service for peace and luxury.  The staff was incredible and helpful. Service was on point! 

We stayed as a couple and were greeted upon check-in with really good champagne (not the crappy drinks). They did a great job welcoming us and explaining what we are entitled to as Royal service guests.  Throughout our 7 day, 6 night stay, I did feel like we were always taken care of.

The one bad part was that we went right around thanksgiving and the lines for the restaurants were long (perhaps people were traveling with families). Even as Royal service guests, we were supposed to have the luxury of not making a reservation and just being seated right away.  However, we found ourselves waiting for a while for certain meals, especially around show time.  We brought the issue up to management twice and it was eventually addressed. If you are staying at the non-Royal service portion of the hotel, I recomennd making a reservation (especially for a larger group) before you go to your room to change for dinner. Also, the inside of the hotel is basically a jungle and it got very humid at times (especially for dinner).

The other thing to note is that the place where the shows take place has a very bad set-up when they are indoors... I am assuming that some shows are done on the beach during the warmer months. It was hard for us to see and enjoy the shows.

Other then that, we loved our cabanas, the food was great with a fresh selection of veggies and protein. The drinks were wonderful and staff was very accommodating and well trained. 

I have already recommended this hotel to many of our friends. I do want to mention that we got a great last minute deal and were very happy that we did through orbitz.com (we booked 2.5 weeks before the trip). 

We are going on a different trip next week and I am worried that it will not beat the luxury and experience that we had here.  

Shout out to the bar staff In Royal service... Guys are fantastic!

reviews.author: Arthur Karl B
reviews.title: 10 excellent days at Paradisus
reviews.text: We experienced 10 outstanding days at Paradius. Hotel staff very extremly friendly and helpful. Especially we can recommend the Restaurant Bana. Hostess Jessica and Manager Mario and waiters Pedro and Luis were competent et friendly and made our experience unforgetable.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: giant cock roaches
reviews.text: my wife and I stayed in room 1603 which is located in tower 1 the 6th floor.  Giant cock roaches would visit us in the bathroom every night.  The room service food was delivered cold. The naos restaurant was pretty good accept food was not kept warm.

reviews.author: David R
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation
reviews.text: My family and I had an amazing stay. We enjoyed the pool, beach and pool bar!! Freddie, Angel & Arturo were great activity staff and made Zumba a lot of fun! Pascual & Arturo were excellent waiters and made our dining experience superb!!

reviews.author: Susan P
reviews.title: Execellent service! Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: Excellent service!  Asuncion, Enrique, Alejandro, Simon, Victor were ALL very attentive to our needs and service was outstanding!  We definitely will return!!  We love Simon and Tabitha and Asuncion!  They are definitely assets to your resort - very hard workers and very pleasant - always had a smile on their face and quickly served us with everything we ever asked for.  I felt like a celebrity!

reviews.author: john z
reviews.title: Our stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Overall we had a great week.  The Royal Service made the experience what is was.  We were looking for a relaxing week after the hard Northeast winter and that is exactly what we received.  The pool and beach area was as good as any place we have ever stayed.  They have many restaurants and the food is all well above average maybe 8 to 9 out of 10.  Some of the seasonings were a little different than we normally taste and some of the menu's could have been more extensive.  Best of all was the service.  The staff really treat the guests as royalty.  Hector was our butler and he was great and a shout out to Caesar at the pool.

reviews.author: Canadian0102
reviews.title: Dissatisfied
reviews.text: This resort was good until I was feeling sick and was unable to go down to get food. We ordered room service (tuna sandwich and burger) and it took 2 hours and multiple phone calls before the manager came up with our order, which ended up being wrong. Prior to the manager coming up, I called multiple times. Initially they tried to make it sound like it was our fault that we didn't get the food. The operator said that they had brought the food into our room but no one was there so they just left the food in the room. The whole time after I ordered room service, I was doubled over in bed in pain and there definitely was no food in the room or outside the door. I called back twice after that and she told me the food was on its way. 30 mins later, no food. I offered to repeat the order but the lady said she knew exactly what our order was. When the food finally came, they got the order wrong (probably because they made the food while they were lying about it being on it's way). My friend has an allergy to gluten and we specifically said no buns on the burger but of course they brought the burger with buns. They did not do anything to fix the situation. This is not appropriate for a 4.5 star hotel, especially since they kept lying and tried to blame their mistakes on us.

reviews.author: Dennis S
reviews.title: Why Not!
reviews.text:
Just returned from visit. Having been to this resort a few times over the years, it continues to change. Observations---Beach---spectacular!! This year there is an apparent weed problem, but beach gets cleaned once or twice during the week. Food---it depends--the majority of the food is very good. Certainly someone will find something to have a problem with--but you can count on a good selection and good food. Staff--heard a few complaints--put Do Not Disturb card out on your door if you dont want to be bothered in the evening. Carlos in the Market Grill is great--pleasant, happy, and wants to help. Gabriel--in Naos--young guy who gets it. One person in the greeting area for Naos was unpleasant with an attitude--but that is untypical. Resort--I think they are challenged with how to deal with all generations. Music in the center of the resort can be obnoxious at times. 
Service--Ok people we are in Mexico--so having to ask for towels or washcloths can be somewhat of a problem--but its something we can work through. 
Price--I booked through Apple and found that the price at the time was the same for the Casa Magna next door and All Inclusive Paradisus---pretty much a no-brainer!! 
Enjoy Mexico by all means.

reviews.author: Micki P
reviews.title: Love on the beach
reviews.text:
We celebrated our honeymoon at Paradisus Cancun, it was amazing with the greenery lush focal points and posh design! Love the view to the beach from our room, and pretty much anywhere in the hotel. The room was very cozy, beds comfy, and overall clean, and we got a bonus of staying in the pyramid that was equipped with a hot tub in every room on the balcony!! We opted for the all inclusive package, which included 5 different restaurants, a few bars inside and out, room service and super friendly/helpful staff, especially at the Naos restaurant, our favorite servers Pascual, Arturo and Raul. They were always on point being attentive and making us happy! Also the swim up pool has 2 awesome bartenders Christian and Erick, who always made delicious drinks and kept our drinks full! The service made our whole honeymoon that much better!!!

would have given them a 5 but there were a lot of leaks on the walk way to and from our room to the main area. Also the fragrance in there were extremely strong at times, and for some reason our floors in our room were a little sticky...

reviews.author: World Traveler
reviews.title: Not such a great resort
reviews.text:
I had not very good experience at Paradisus resort in Cancun Mexico.  Most reviewers stayed at this resort paid for the all inclusive price.  I didn't not so my experience is from a non-all-inclusive point of view.

The resort was nice don't get me wrong.  The lobby was nice and the staff tried to great everyone as they come in.  I had to catch a cab from the airport to this resort since the resort  did not offer any free shuttle service.  I was on my own since I wasn't one of the guest who paid all inclusive price.

The AC from the resort couldn't keep up with the humidity and the Cancun hot weather.  There were sand on the floor in my room.  

Checking out was interesting:
1)  I had to leave the resort very early in the morning (like 5:30am) and there was a person at the lobby checking to make sure that I had a ticket which showed I paid the room.  They must have people stayed there and not paid???  This was the first hotel that I had to experience this level of 'trust' as I left the resort.
2)  Since I checked out the hotel so early, the person at the front desk told me that he couldn't print out the receipt showing zero balance and that he will email it to me after I wrote down my email address.  I need the hotel receipt for business trip expense report.  I noticed that the resort added some 'optional fees' to the bill without telling. I found out because I asked them to explain each line item.  I had to ask them to take it out.
3) Once I arrived home, I didn't see any receipt from the resort for a few days.  I had to make several phone calls; wrote several emails and finally received the official resort receipt for my business trip expense report.  The part that I found strange was that the amount listed in Mexico Pesos and not US Dollars.  The other thing I found strange was that for each restaurant I ate, instead of showing the final amount (price + tip) the bill had several lines.  From a business expense report, it looked like I ate at that restaurant multiple times during the same day.  I had to explain that to my company.

BTW, WiFi was terrible.  Try to do a speed test and see what you get from your room (not in the lobby of course)

Overall, it's an expensive resort.  It's not a good resort if you're not paying the all inclusive price.  It's not a good resort for business traveler, in my opinion.  I have been too multiple hotels outside the US and this was the very first place where it wasn't pleasant to do expense report because of the things I mentioned above.

reviews.author: Daniela
reviews.title: Spectacular Experience..
reviews.text: What can I say? I've stayed in multiple all inclusive resorts throughout the Caribbean but this is my first time staying in Cancun. I usually stay with The Secrets chain due to very high level of service. However this time Secrets Cancun did not have high reviews and the price tag seemed a bit too high for its value. After some research including this website me and my girlfriend came across Paradisus Cancun. The reviews were wonderful. So we were here for 5 nights and 6 days and everything was so amazing. We were greeted with a glass of champagne and a cold towel but most importantly was the big smile and courtesy from the staff. I was so blown away that I had my room upgraded to royal service for a fair fee. In royal service one gets their personal butler as well as many other amenities including a pool for royal service guests. Our butler was Juan and he was always so helpful and just really always there. He provided  top notch service. Our experience was also made wonderful by concierge Flavio and pool server Javier. I was so happy that we became Club Meliá members as well as in the works of returning later this year... Thanks so much for a wonderful experience..

reviews.author: HandymanMike
reviews.title: 8 times 8 places and we finally found our favorite
reviews.text: We've traveled to Cancun every year each time staying at a different all-inclusive.  We generally stay middle of the road (Not high end pricey and not low budget).  Paradisus had all the elements we were looking for in a good looking hotel with excellent and responsive service.  Each building is decorated the same with the atrium being really spectacular.  The details: Pool chairs were available but umbrellas and tiki huts needed to be fought for early.  You can splurge for a pool bed for an extra $50usd.  Pool side service is excellent and waiters were responsive.  Food across all 3 meals were plentiful and tasty.  Only issue was the hot buffet was not always hot.  The restaurant selections were pretty good and we ate at most of them.  Service was equally good throughout.  Reservations are needed but cancellations do happen and you can get in without them (rare).  They need to improve that.  The rooms were average sized but comfortable.  Don't look to close or you will see its age.  However, respectably clean.  We called a couple of times during our stay and the front desk/concierge responded quickly.  Night time entertainment was there but the venue was really crappy.  For the hundreds of people in the hotel maybe 15 had a good seat.  They should consider changing the venue to the conference center to accommodate more people.  While we had the all-inclusive package there were several restaurants that were not included.   They were for time-share folks and available for extra $$$.  We did not feel the need to indulge in them.  All in all it was a our favorite hotel in Cancun.  Special Thanks to Ayeli at the concierge desk.

reviews.author: Jub630
reviews.title: First Vacation in 23 Years! Won't go any where else!
reviews.text: What a fantastic trip!  We are dairy farmers and  have been married for 23 years. The opportunity came up for us to travel to Cancun and we took it! We have never been anywhere other than Branson and I would love to make this a yearly trip! Everyone was so polite and friendly.  Paola, our concierge, took complete care of us.  We did not do the Royal Service, but we were there for a week, and we loved every minute of it! Everyone is so friendly and the evening shows, food and beach were all awesome! The bus stops right out front to take you into town for shopping or to catch the ferry to Isla Mujeres. Going to Isla Mujeres is a must! You can rent a golf cart and buzz the island all day along with more shopping! This hotel does have an occupied security gate in front, which I noticed a lot of the other hotels didn't. Loved Loved Loved our stay!

reviews.author: MattGlick
reviews.title: Incredible View, Incredible Service, Incredible Food. Incredible Resort.
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Paradisus for the wedding of two of my best friends. Normally we wouldn't vacation to a beach, let alone an all inclusive resort but we are glad we did. We got an Ocean View room for 3 nights and were blown away by the service. As soon as we got there we were greeted by 5 different people to help with our bags and escort us to check-in. Our bags were then taken directly to our room after we had checked in.

The room was very big and offered plenty of space for the two of us. We had a balcony that had a great view of the ocean and we sat out there every morning. The bathroom was very big and my wife absolutely loved the size of tub. The frig was stocked with food that was all included and had a great TV with a few english stations to watch before we fell asleep.

I have never eaten so much food in my life. We tried everything. Considering it was inclusive my wife and I did our best to try all kinds of different food from all the different restaurants. There was always someone willing to get something for you. We were never in "need" of anything.

Did I mention that this resort is literally on the beach? You walk out the back door and basically step into sand. The wedding was held in their amazing gazebo out back and had an amazing view of the water. Not only is the section of the beach only for resort guests but they have people walking around willing to get you anything that you would need.

Normally I wouldn't have stayed at a resort like this, but it was definitely worth the cost for the service that was provided!

reviews.author: WorldlyTravelers
reviews.title: Its ok, good value and nice location
reviews.text:
I spent 3 nights here before moving to the Secrets property, it was not to bad, its is strangely set out and easy to get confused in here, rooms are a little outdated.

Service and checkin was smooth but would much prefer and all inclusive property as this hotel is quite a distance from general touristy area.

reviews.author: Tim M
reviews.title: Awesome Experience
reviews.text: Very friendly staff and the facilities were first class. We really enjoyed our visit to Cancun.  The pool and beach area were very nice and well maintained and the choice of restaurants was vast.  We plan to return in the future.

reviews.author: nnm151243
reviews.title: Noella and Andre - March 2015
reviews.text: What a wonderful trip.  The Paradisus Cancun is a luxurious resort with wonderful staff that mads our holiday perfect.  Kudos goes to all staff from maid services to bartenders in the Avenue Bar.  A special thank you to Oscar, Jorge and Alex in the Naos Buffet Restaurant who always greeted us with a smile for our morning breakfast and afternoon lunch.  We dined in every restaurant except for the ones that cater only to the Royal Service.  All were great.  The ocean view from our room was exceptional.   We will definitely return.

reviews.author: Sabrina Jean B
reviews.title: Wedding and honeymoon adventure
reviews.text: Had a very fun and relaxing time, with great entertainment and people. The hotel staff were very friendly and attentive to whatever we needed. The bartender's and servers were fantastic and quick with anything we needed. The entertainment (shows) were amazing at night in the hotel!!

reviews.author: nightout
reviews.title: Fun in the sun
reviews.text: Great time in the Royal Service section of the hotel.  Even though the resort was full...had no trouble getting beach chairs. Pool area was great with plenty of beds.  Had a bed reserved just for us every day we wanted one with no trouble. Good entertainment in the RS area.  Food was good...many choices from seafood to steaks to sushi.

reviews.author: Jeffreydouglas M
reviews.title: Great Vacation - Wouldn't Want to Stay Anywhere Else in Cancun
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed for our first vacation together since our honeymoon 6.5 years ago.  The service was excellent, the hotel the most beautiful on the strip, food was great, beach was great.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: William B
reviews.title: Brilliant Antidote to Winter
reviews.text: My wife and I spent a week at Paradisus, escaping the clutches of the brutal New York winter, and it was a fantastic experience from start to finish. The hotel is beautiful and dramatic with its pyramid arrangement and soaring atria. The dining options are varied and excellent. The one must, for adult travelers, is the Royal Service, a recommendation that will make the stay even more enjoyable. A personal butler will make all arrangements for you, including a bali bed at the adults only pool, and you will be in a separate pyramid with additional amenities. A week at the Paradisus turned out to be a very special vacation, and we can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Wayne W
reviews.title: The best
reviews.text:
Excellent service everywhere. Guillermo @ NAOS (AM) along with the rest of crew (Carlos) did a great job !

Bloody Mary's & mimosa's were always ready

Beach staff were always ready with cold drinks and ice.

reviews.author: christyfletcher
reviews.title: Treated like royalty
reviews.text:
I recently got back from a vacation in Cancun (March 7-12). My friends and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun. For the most part, we loved the resort! What especially impressed us was how well we were treated by staff. They were in every area of the resort and were so quick to ask what we needed. (Our favorites were Karina and Samuel from Avenue Bar! So fun and so sweet!) I spilled red wine all over my friend's white dress, and their cleaners were able to get it completely out! The pool and beach area are absolutely gorgeous and kept very clean. It is really fun to get a cabana and spend the whole day going from reading in the cabana to taking dips in the pool (rent a cabana a day ahead of time). RELAXATION to the max! There were fun acts at Avenue Bar in the evenings. 

Something I would have enjoyed would have been some more activities in the evenings for guests to enjoy together, such as a show or a bonfire, or music on the beach! We got a little bored in the evenings. We wanted to be outside at night but there wasn't much to do, other than heading into the expensive bars in town.

The excursion we chose was one were you did 3 ziplines and then got to swim in caves. It was an incredible experience to swim in a cave next to stalactites! Once in a lifetime.

reviews.author: Josette M
reviews.title: Amazing stay!!!
reviews.text: Stayed here during Spring Break 2015!!! Service was Amazing Orlando Bello at Naos/Vento was always greeting us with a smile and exceptional service!!! Angel Samano kept my children and family entertained with great activities!!! Jose was awesome outside in the pool area!!! Lolita and Nancy took care of all my dinner reservations and made sure we had a great stay. Can't wait to come back!!!

reviews.author: chaopescao4
reviews.title: Amazing Royal Service employees
reviews.text: We have been to Paradisus Cancun 7 times now.  We go back because we are in love with no only the resort, but the people. We always take the Royal Service and there are two people in particular that work on the Royal side, outside sometimes and inside sometimes and their names are Rolegio (pardon me if spelling is wrong) and Octovier.  We thought they were great but when we spoke to other people at the resort the last two times, they also were very happy with those two.  Of course the others are good, like Javier and Geraldo but these two men just make the Royal Service what it is.  They know their job, they know the people and people come back just to have their perfection and service.  We are returning again on March 23 and we just got home on March 11.  I can not wait to be served by such upstanding men.  And of course the sun.  lol

reviews.author: DC S
reviews.title: Last minute decision for family of 4- very pleased
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun last month, as a last minute decision to get away from the winter blues. We read a lot of the trip advisor reviews, both good and bad, with a grain of salt. 
Our priority on arrival, was to get to our room and head to the beach, ASAP. We knew ahead of time that we did not want the "Royal Service" and we did not want to waste precious vacation time being pressured to hear a sales pitch about "Club Melia." Glad to say, that once approached about spending time to hear their sales pitch, which we politely declined, we did not feel any further pressure and were free to enjoy our stay.
We stayed in pyramid 2, Room 2019 - great view of the ocean, big patio that allowed us to dry our beachwear. Quiet, despite being near the pool crowd. Wi-fi service was great, even had reception by the beach.
It was a great sized regular room. We were pleased to find 2 double beds and a sofa bed that accommodated 2 teenagers and the parents. If we had a question or issue with the room (toilet leaking or hair dryer not working - both of which was fixable), they promptly attended to our concerns (and we didn't need the butler). 
Finding a hut at the beach was not a problem if you saved a spot by 8am. The service at the beach with ordering drinks was very quick. When we gave up our hut to do some kayaking later in the day, we came back to the full beach, but the server went out of his way to bring us a lounge chair/hut as soon as one opened up. 
We enjoyed the Naos buffet, Blue Agave.
The Market Grill at lunch was average (might as well have the variety that Naos offers); at night - the Grill's Argentinian grill was good (except lamb was raw, which I declined). Vento is a tapas restaurant. Wasn't too keen on the cold tapas dishes (creme brûlée with foie gras...), but the warm tapas dishes: scallops and octopus were tender and delicious. The service at Vento was great, with Victor being very accommodating. 

The only disappointment had to do with the Aquaworld on-site marketing of the excursions. We wanted to snorkel, our kids wanted to do the underwater personal submarine experience. We were convinced that the package we bought would accommodate our needs, and paid over 250.00 for the package, the day prior. On the day of our excursion, we were told that we were not allowed to snorkel - just stay in the boat (cost: 53.00/person), while we watched our kids submerge for a mere 10min. total. We asked for a refund of one person's "snorkeling" excursion - we were given a "credit" back to our credit card,  which to this day we have not seen evidence of. 

Overall, I would highly recommend this place.
Tips: 1. bring about 50 $1 bills to easily use to tip. 
         2. call early for dinner reservations.
         3. skip the excursions if your stay is less than 5 days. The beach is what we came here for and enjoyed every minute of it.

reviews.author: Cindy B
reviews.title: Paradise is right
reviews.text:
My husband and I just got back form 7 days in this resort, had a wonderful time.  Weather excellent, drinks excellent, food 5 star in most restaurants.  The hotel was full and we still had no wait in restaurants, pool side chairs were available every time we needed them. Favorite places were:  Avenue Bar, Mole' Restaurant, Market Grill, Naos buffet.  We would definitely revisit this hotel.
If I had one con it would be if you are not a night owl the disco plays until 2:00, a little loud.

reviews.author: jenpost31
reviews.title: Very pleased!
reviews.text:
Great location.  15 minutes from airport.  Beautiful property.  
Cons:  Front desk!!  They are not so helpful.  We were 2 couples with 2 rooms.  Only 1 room was ready.  They asked us to come back at 6!!!!  Not 3!!  Ok, ok, we went back at 7.  Our room was still not ready & then I lost my temper. Not what you want to do on vacation & traveling since 4:30 am.  All of a sudden our room was ready.  Not much music by the pool at all.  And the pool is pretty deep.  I'm 5'2 & I could stand on my tippy toes.  No balcony furniture.  We had 2 chairs but most people talking did not.  What!!???  A huge terrance with no furniture to enjoy room service or coffee.  We thought maybe it's do to spring break season however we saw NO spring breakers at this hotel.
PROS:  All the other staff in the hotel was amazing!!  So eager to please!  Tabs on the beach along with Gregorio & Miguel were great!  I totally recommend getting the bed on the beach.  $50.00 extra but what you get in CRAZY!!!  DO IT!!!!!!
The food all over the hotel (except TAPAS) was AMAZING!  Even the buffet was great.  You will not be hungry here.  Great location.  Clean.  Oceanview stunning.  Slept with our door open & listened to the ocean all night.  
The only reason I didn't give this 5 stars was because of the front desk help.  Otherwise they hit it out of the park!!

reviews.author: IrishTwin5211
reviews.title: Info for RCI members
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here using points through RCI.  I'm hoping this review helps other RCI members.  We were automatically put in pyramid 1 which is beautiful and for members.  The extras include most perks given to Melia members.  We had no issue making reservations for dinner and there was a concierge assigned to us for any other needs.  The hotel and beach are absolutely beautiful.  We enjoyed all the restaurants...some more than others but that was strictly due to personal taste.  The area around the hotel is very safe and we were easily able to take public bus transportation right outside the hotel.  Some staff who deserve special recognition for consistently going above and beyond to make sure we had a fabulous, perfect vacation:  Victor Perez was our concierge; beach servers, Carlos Cardenas and Sofonia Castaneda; Donovan our waiter in Mole.  Thank you so much to all the staff!!  We highly recommend this resort!!

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Royal Escape
reviews.text:
We took a much needed Spring vacation from February 26 to March 3 at the Paradisus Cancun in the Royal Service pyramid.  Upon our arrival we were warmly greeted at the entrance by Raul and were escorted directly to RS. There was no waiting in the private check-in area where we were offered champagne during check in.  We stayed in a lovely and very comfortable ocean front suite.  Our butler, Sergio, was exceptional.  He took care of all of our special requests including restaurant reservations, Bali beds, and surprised us with festive balloons and treats in our suite.  We also found the RS atrium lobby very inviting with coffee, hors d’oeuvres, a well-stocked bar, and evening entertainment.   

The Paradisus offers a variety of dining options. We ate at their premier restaurant, Tempo, which is not part of the all-inclusive package but well worth it.  We recommend the tasting menu with its many delightful and unique dishes along with the wine pairing. Our waiter, Samuel, hostess Fernanda,  the manager, Feres, sommelier Carlos, and chefs Ismael and Ruben,  gave every guest personal and expert service.  We also ate at the specialty restaurants Mole, Market Grill, Vento, and Fuego.  Each restaurant had a different themed menu and gracious staff.  We want to give special thanks to Captain Rody, Jesus, Leonardo, Jose, Victor, Margalli, Miguel, and of course Donovan (‘Speedy’) for such great dining service.

The Royal Service also has an outdoor restaurant, La Palapa, offering breakfast and lunch overlooking the ocean.  The omelets and French toast were fantastic! 
We were greeted by Max, the resort’s food service manager, on several occasions as he passed through each restaurant to keep things running smoothly.

The beach area was improved since our last visit with additional beach chairs and sun umbrellas.  Even with the hotel at full capacity the beach never felt crowded. We had great food and beverage service on the beach and at the pool by Havier and Octavio. The pristine white sandy beach and big beautiful heated RS pool chased our Chicago chills away. What a treat!!

Overall we rate the Paradisus very highly and recommend the rooms in the Royal Service.  The staff always made us feel very welcome and comfortable.  Mucho Gracias Paradisus!

reviews.author: redjade23
reviews.title: Best Cancun stay ever
reviews.text:
Have stayed at dozens of places in Cancun. Was blown away by the Royal Service at this resort.  Stayed for 3 nights then went to Riu Palace, Mayan Riviera.  Riu Palace had a large shadow cast over the stay after leaving heaven at the Paradisus.

Butler service was incredible, everything from pillow menu to packing our bags for us! Also the private Cabanas by the adults only pool was luxurious. 

As a travel agent, and avid traveler, this was by far my best experience yet.

reviews.author: Angela D
reviews.title: 5 Star view in a 3 star resort
reviews.text: The Check in was long and a bit disorganized. Couldn't tell if there was one, two or three lines - others would just walk up (and this was not the Preferred line either) Also had to wait for our room to be ready and this was after 3pm -  I must admit I Loved the room. View was AWESOME. Ocean front, nice sized balcony. Perfect. The resort itself was however rather large and required a lot of walking from one area to the next.  I took my mother for her 70th birthday and well, although it's a nice resort, great for families, children and young adults - not exactly what I was looking for on this particular trip and could be a lot of walking for the elderly. If you want to eat well, definitely go to the restaurants. The buffet was awful - food cold and bland - even for American standards! It took us a day or two to finally realize you have to call before 9 a.m. the day before to make reservations for a restaurant. We were actually ready to go of the property to eat because the buffet was that bad and we were that hungry!  The beach was beautiful - easy to walk on but the ocean water / current was strong and choppy. Every day was a red flag day. Could not enjoy the ocean at all. I don't know if this is the norm for this area of the beach or not. We were also there during one of their "coldest winters" with the highs being in the low 70"s! The pool with the pool bar is ice cold. The pool between the pool bar and preferred is not as loud and warmer. The warm pool is the preferred club pool and if you're not a member ' oh well to the cold pool you go. Staff were great. Excellent. I did enjoy not being hassled to buy anything. Wifi only worked 60% of the time. The gift shops only accept Pesos or you can charge to the room. Location is good because your on the main strip and can catch the bus. The best part of the trip was the room view and the Joya Cirque Du Soleil show in Riveria Maya - worth every dollar!  Stayed 2/18 -2/22.

reviews.author: Busyjo
reviews.title: Staff exceptionnal
reviews.text:
I stayed in the Royal section and enjoyed every moment of my short stay.
The staff in this section is exceptionnaly good.  They go above and beyond to make sure you have what you need.  And always with a smile.
I have to mention the excellent service and the smile and happiness of 
EDGAR FIGUEROA at the Royal buffet.  Thank you Edgar for your wonderful service and dedication.
Hasta la proxima vez.
Johanne

reviews.author: Jess B
reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service!!!
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our stay at the Paradisus.  The hotel staff was excellent….they really go out of their way to make sure you are taken care off.  Julian, Rafael, and Carlos, at the main pool bar are fabulous.  Great swim up bar…..excellent beach!  We considered doing the Royal Service but passed, and at no time did I feel like I missed out on anything.  Our Ocean view room was large with a great balcony (no furniture on the patio however).  We mainly stayed around the main pool/swim up bar during the day. We saw very few children in this area as there is a children's pool under the bridge and a bit of a swim away.  I would suggest someone in your party get up early and get some chairs as they are limited. Besides that just sit back and relax.  This place was great! You won't be disappointed.  Food was great too and don't miss the Michael Jackson show!

reviews.author: Henry1940
reviews.title: Good but our family all got sick
reviews.text:
My husband and I took our two kids ( ages 10 and 12) I will start with the good, nice big pool so you never feel crowded, very nice beach in front of resort, nice balcony and friendly staff.
The negitive: Not enough activities for kids( older kids), food cold at buffet, resort is almost too big, gift store very expensive ( $30 US for two tablets of Imodium).
Over all it was average but I am mainly writing this to warn you that my family got saminilla from this resort. Comfirmed after we were in ER hooked up to IV's. We only ate at resort! We haven't figured out exactly what it was from, but It could be anything

reviews.author: PAS-1979-100
reviews.title: Great family getaway
reviews.text: Can't say enough good things about this hotel. This was our first family vacation and was nervous bringing my 2 children (both under the age of 3). However, the service was excellent and within hours of being at the hotel we were all very comfortable there. We utilized the kids play zone daily and both kids really took to the staff - Rosario, Janette and Lili in particular were incredible. The pool area was great with lots of activities pool-side (i.e.,crafts, painting) for the kids to enjoy.  Would highly recommend this resort to any family traveling to Cancun.

reviews.author: Darryl N
reviews.title: This may be the only Cancun resort I stay at!
reviews.text: What an amazing property! This was my first time at a resort in Mexico, so now the bar has been set very high! First off, the beach view was amazing! We rented a bali bed one day, and spent the whole day staring at the turquoise water. Aside from the water, the staff were what made this place a gem to stay at. From check-in to departure, every employee we came across was very polite and friendly. Jose and all the boys at the swim up bar were very efficient, friendly and fun to be around, so props to them! Norma answered all of our questions with a smile. Also, the concierge and the door guys were also really helpful. The breakfast buffet was very filling and there were many different things to choose from, all cooked well and all full of flavor. The only regret I have was not spending more time on the beach. The in room WiFi was spotty, at best, and you could tell that the system was taxed because it loaded really slow during the day, but was fast at night. The rooms were really nice and were cleaned to perfection daily. I loved the rainfall shower head too! We had the Lagoon view - don't be fooled, this was a very picturesque view, especially on our private deck every evening while we watched the sunsets! Mai Thai's were really delicious too!

reviews.author: 892shellir
reviews.title: Limited beach chairs
reviews.text:
If u are not royal service you feel it.  This hotel allows guest to save chairs with towels so late risers are left with no place to sit.  We crossed into a roped off area in front of building 1 just to find a lounge chair on the beach.  Luckily the wait staff didn't make us leave and served us as they would any other guest.  They should adopt a no saving chair policy.  I Would never wake early just to save a seat and leave another guest in the sun sitting in the sand while I am running around the resort doing other things.  

Cold buffet food...all the time.  Not just some dishes,  all dishes.  The only hot item was the omelette station which is obviously made fresh in front of you. 

Beautiful beach and fun waves.  This is the best swimming if you like wild waves (we do) it was a blast.  

Plenty of bars to grab drinks.

We don't have issues with stairs but if you do...there are a lot of them on the resort.  Just beware of u are traveling with a bad knee or something. 

Room was clean and nice.  We upgraded to the beach view but honestly I wish we would have saved our money.  Didn't spend much time in the room anyway.

We asked for royal service but were told to ask again the next day. 

If u arent interested in the club everyone is trying to sign up up for,  u are invisible.

Wait staff was really good and attentive.  No complaints at all.

reviews.author: Lee E
reviews.title: Birthday getaway
reviews.text: My wife and I went away for a short weekend for her birthday and stayed in the adults only area which we highly recommend.  When we arrived, I told them it was her birthday.  The Royal Service butler we were assigned had iced champagne, a cake and balloons in our room when we came back from dinner.  The hotel is beautiful and food excellent.  The pay restaurant is expensive but the food and service is 5 star.  Enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Flyer372305
reviews.title: poor service, cold food
reviews.text:
not a friendly staff at all. food was always cold. safe did not work. most of the staff other than front desk and front of hotel staff spoke very little english.
not a great place to go for a person solo. good beach, good pools, but nothing more than average. i would not recommend this to anyone other than those simply going to only party, as when drunk who cares about all the stuff at a hotel.

reviews.author: Shawn M
reviews.title: The Butler Did it...
reviews.text:
First, I would like to preface that I did not choose this hotel. It was chosen for us as we came for a destination wedding.

However, although more expensive than I originally would have liked to spend (there were no "vacation specials" or group discounts), I was surprised by the level of service we received.

This was my first experience with a butler. Essentially, he is your personal concierge and can book everything from dinners and cabanas to give you input to where to visit in town and arrange tours. Our butler was great; very personable, pleasant and helpful. However, if you have never had a butler before, ensure you ask him first what he can and cannot do or else you may miss some services that he could arrange on your behalf (I know other couples were disappointed with their butler).

The food at all the restaurants was amazing. My personal favorite was the Market Grill, however Tempo was a close second (Tempo is the Michelin Star restaurant). If you are a wine lover, the wine list at the resort is impressive, but you have to pay extra for anything above the house wine.

The gym is a good size and has a spin room and a yoga room in addition to the regular area, but it will be busy during peak periods. 

We used the Royal Service, which is adult only, has its own pool and serves all top shelf liquor. 

My only issue? Food and drinks are slow anywhere in the hotel. Room service can take over an hour.

reviews.author: Chel1304
reviews.title: Excellent service & location
reviews.text: Great service, food options & location. There is a definite need for upgrade of bedroom, my aircon wasn't working nor shower or safe .... All did get attended too, but still had to wait & we only had one lounger on the balcony which seemed odd.

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: Another Great Vacation
reviews.text:
This was our 5th stay at Paradisus Cancun and it won't be our last.  While I would never describe our stays without some hiccups what matters most is how quickly our little problems were resolved.  And, one thing we'll never do is allow little issues ruin our fun.

The staff at Paradisus are incredibly friendly and helpful.  Karina, who has helped us with check-in at the Melia Club several times is always warm and hospitable.  This time she outdid herself by sending us chocolate covered strawberries to help us celebrate our wedding anniversary.  There was a card sent along with the strawberries that several of the other staff members at Paradisus signed.  This gesture made our day even nicer.

Since we stayed at Paradisus when it was the Grand Melia and have stayed a few times since it's been interesting to see the incremental changes that have been made.  Additional palapas have been added on the beach as well as Bali beds.  They also added additional beach chairs although finding one may be a challenge later in the day.

The beach itself is always amazing.  I don't think many things make us happier than basking in Cancun's golden sunshine and Paradisus is a great venue to do just that.

One recommendation I have for people wanting more nightlife than they'll find at Paradisus itself is to go downtown at night where all the clubs are.  Bus fare is less than $1.00 and the buses run all night. They're also very safe.

We expect to be back next February and look forward to seeing everyone again.  We're also excited to see any additional improvements are made as they continue to upgrade the resort each year.

reviews.author: Shawnvdp
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise
reviews.text: Had a quick weekend getaway with my hubby and the Paradisus was the perfect fit! This was my 2nd time visiting and we were treated to Royal Service! Our butler Galdino helped with dinner reservations and even confirmed our transfer for our return to the airport for us. The entire staff is wonderful, friendly and super helpful! We saw a really great all-female Cirque act on International Women's Day and listened to the Tres Diablos serenade us with their Tenor voices.  The food, with the exception of Vento (which was not very good), did not disappoint either. We had the most wonderful relaxing getaway, just what we were looking for. Highly recommend! Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Neil H
reviews.title: Absolutely excellent
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun combines the beauty and weather of the Caribbean, with the service and opulence of Dubai... We stayed for 10 nights in the Royal Service 'wing' of this vast hotel, and I cannot really find fault with anything during our stay. 
The Royal Service area is separate to the main hotel, but has all the amenities of a full hotel - rooms, lobby, bar, pool, pool bar, beach... Everything you could want. We didn't venture to the main hotel until our evening meal; having breakfast and lunch on our cabana beds by the pool or beach. 
Evening meals were in the main 'pyramid', at one of the many available restaurants, and all reservations were handled by our butler, Tony. Tony was an absolute superstar - nothing was too much trouble - and upon finding out my wife was pregnant he made a point of getting us a gift before our trip home: an Aztec mask representing protection for a long journey.
This was indicative of the staff here at Paradisus. Everyone was thoughtful, helpful and friendly. Cesar, Roman, Tony, Eddie - everyone we spoke to was awesome and made us feel like we were the most important people in the hotel.
We struggled at times to understand the menus (in many cases, portions were tiny, but the idea is to order lots of things to sample). If I had one gripe, and I'm reaching here, then the food didn't really 'agree' with me, but this isn't a reflection on the hotel as my wife was fine.
I would heartily recommend the Paradisus Cancun if you are looking for sun and relaxation - but I would definitely book the Royal Service option - the main part of the hotel looked busy most of the day and night - it was very nice to be in the quieter area throughout the day!

reviews.author: Daniel G
reviews.title: Paradisus = Great vacation
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Paradisus for 7 nights. Food was awesome - and plenty of it. Order a cappuccino at breakfast - fantastic. The mimosas were good too. While many people got to the pool early to get chairs, it seemed like it wasn't a problem to get them anytime in the day. Pool - awesome. Beach - awesome. everything about this place is great. Rooms were a little on the small side, however, most of our time was spent outside the rooms. I would go back for sure.

reviews.author: Ezzie S
reviews.title: Wow!!!
reviews.text: First time to Cancun and staying here at Paradisus All Inclusive Resort. Our experience was fantastic. We had the royal service and loved it. It's just my husband and I. Sooo it was nice to stay at a pool with no kids. It was very quite. It was great to stay in a cabana as my husband is a redhead. We had great help from Leticia Petlan Rosas in Royal Services,she provided us with a butler "Rode". Both of them made sure we were taken care of. The pool guys "Alex and Omar" made sure we had towels and cabanas and lounge chairs everyday. The staff in the restaurant at the pool were great... Edgar Figueroa was Super Duper. He made sure that we had enough. The bartender Salvador and William will make the Best drinks. (Octovio will keep the drinks coming to you at the pool) can't wait to come back soon.. The staff made sure my Birthday was special. Love the staff and this place. You have to come stay here... Rooms are nice. :) ohhhh and it does help to leave tips to all. They appreciate it and deserve it for all the extra care they do for you. 😃

reviews.author: Barbara T
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: I visited Paradisus from Feb 24 through March 1. The resort is very large and very beautiful. I have been to at least 15 resorts in Cancun and this was one of my favorites.  As others have mentioned, the food is cold on the buffet. They really need to address this problem. Who wants to eat cold pancakes?  The only other negative is that Alberto at the front desk took another Spanish speaking guest in front of us, when we were waiting quite a while. Overall, great resort and average food in most restaurants.

reviews.author: Amy p
reviews.title: Paradisus is paradise!
reviews.text: Wonderful everything!  Not a bad thing to say!  Beach-great!, Pool-great! Food and service-great!  Would love to go back! We didn't get the Royal package and still were treated terrific and relaxed and had fun!

reviews.author: Mark L
reviews.title: What an amazing two months.
reviews.text: I have had 7 programs at this resort since Jan 2, 2015.  So many people to acknowledge.  Sandra Blum Resident Manager is AMAZING.  Ana Garcia Conference Services Director, probably the best in the industry, Abran Front Desk Manager, Lazarro, Royal Service Manager, Reyes, Family Concierges so dedicated.  Thank you all for the most amazing two months serving over 2000 of our attendees.  The food was amazing, the hotel staff incredible and the physical property AWESOME.  I got bumped off my flight the last day (well I volunteered and stayed at the OMNI for one night).  Anyway, NO COMPARISON.  You guys rock.  Looking forward to coming back again this summer.

reviews.author: Staci M
reviews.title: Overall great place with good service
reviews.text: We were there from March 1st - March 5th.  We were on a company incentive trip but had lots of free time.  Service was great, food was good, highly recommend the upgrade to the Royal Service.  Weather was great and lots of beach space with many cabanas and lounge chair with bar and food service.

reviews.author: sam555
reviews.title: Clean, good service, nice beach
reviews.text: When we checked in it was quick and efficient. The hostess was helpful with the questions we had. I was travelling with a vegetarian and the food is limited as they cook alot of what would be veg in animal fat, however the hotel accomodated for us and ensured we had vegetarian dishes available in all of the restaurants as long as we informed them in the morning, and even when we didnt inform them, they went out of their way to ensure everyone had something to their liking. So basically, we never went hungry. The rooms were clean and large enough for 3 to share. The balcony was nice with sea views. The beach is good, if you go towards the right when you face the ocean, their are plenty of loungers available. Overall a good, pleasant stay.

reviews.author: Raf19
reviews.title: Overall good,  room for improvement
reviews.text:
I stayed for a week during presidents week/ carnival in mid February . The hotel was almost 100% full apparently. The general experience was positive, but some details can make a big difference and I do think they failed many times. 
Transfer – I had reserved through their website, but the transfer company refused to take me to the hotel because they just couldn’t find my reservation even I was carrying a confirmation voucher!  So I was standing  at the airport after a very long flight from South America connected in the US, under the sun waiting for them to find it, and after almost 45 minutes the answer was no. I ended up taking a taxi and paying myself (USD 68 for return trip). I reported it to the hotel later, they said they couldn’t do anything. Tough start. It wasn’t only about the money, but the situation.
Check in  - ok.  I upgraded to royal service at this moment for USD100/night. Let me tell you about this: I’d be the first to say Royal service is not worth it if it weren’t, but it actually is. And a lot. Actually for people without kids don’t even consider any other option, just do it. After arriving, try to go directly to people behind a glass wall, Club Melia people will already start to annoy you if you let them. 
Rooms – for Royal service upgrade, there was no availability for ocean view, so I got the last lagoon view unit which was nice, don’t automatically disconsider this type of room. I thought rooms could be bad by the photos, but they were much better. Everything worked well and was very well kept, including fridge, A/C, amenities, cleaness. Royal service Pyramid is quiet, so wherever you stay you’re fine. Room service used to take at least an hour, but good.
Butler service –  nice, but not essential. Our butler made reservations for us and everything, but seem to have a prepared speech  and an excessively standardized approach.  And he took some days off, so we didn’ t see him for a while.
Beach and pools – the beach is just like you would expect, gorgeous. The pools were nice, so here comes RS benefits. RS pool is nice and quieter, and heated (not 100%, should be more heated imo). They should heat all pools, as pools are one of resort’s main attractions.  I don’ t get this. In RS area you don’t have to rush for chairs, there is space for everyone. The awesome Bali beds (RS incuded) require reservation, but they can always find one for you. In this area waiters keep passing all the time, there’s absolutely no need to stand at the bar or restaurant and hope to someone take your order, as other areas.  Pools could be cleaner, threre were too many insects floating, leaves, sand and sunscreen, including the RS one. Main pool was even worse, cold and so many kids yelling I just wanted to be back to the adults area as soon as I could. 
In RS area there is a hot tub but not heated, actually very cold! There was also a spa style pool, with astonishing beachfront view, but guess what, not heated either and with an abandoned feeling. Service by the pool (RS) has nothing to be complained. Waiters also always brought us different drinks, whose names I didn’t know but were pleased to made us try them. Drinks are usually very weak, ask for double alcohol that it gets better.
At the main pool area, I saw many pelicans flying over plates to catch leftovers (and sucessfully landing at them!)  and staff would just return plates normally instead of throwing them away. 
Spa – if you’re RS you have one daily access to it and the “water ritual”. It is nice, but their pool is not heated, was not relaxed with the very cold water massage and plus not all of it were working. Didn’t  care to return.
Restaurants – didn’t meet my expectations, what surprises me ‘cause I’m generally open minded about it. There are up and downs. Sometimes I had that bad feeling that they were just serving buffet Naos food reorganized. Vento (tapas) was aweful, frosted food, tasted like plastic. Didn’ like the Mexican either. Brazilian Market grill doesn’t deserve to be at this resort, so bad I can’t even think of it again. I liked Fuego. Naos was chaotic, 40 minutes standing for an omelet.  Service in general was good though. I really miss an Italian and French place there. What’s the point to have a vulgar brazilian rodizio and not a place to experience classic cuisines? Lapalapa at the beach (only RS) worked for me. I had breakfast there almost everyday, perfect combination of view + fantastic camembert cheese omelet. They serve you efficiently at your Bali bed, good for lunch too. One day I chose to go to Naos, what a regret when I met all that crowd. What saved me is the fantastic royal service buffet at the RS Pyramid. It is just for snacks, but always included remarkable delicatenses like top notch cheeses, caviar, cavas etc.
Alcohol is a mixed bag. House wines are bad, but they had a reasonable offer of cavas  included (catalunian sparkling wine, from the land of the Melia chain), Freixenet an example. Just be specific and ask. Other liquors seem to be of good quality.
Night entertainement -  took place at the main pyramid – Avenue Bar. Shows were good, need to get there early. Neighbor bar Red held the disco scene later, was relatively busy when I visited. 
Club Melia hassle – they didn’t waste my time because I was warned here by other reviewers. Just ignore them, drop invitations for breakfast or to pick up welcome gifts. If you fall for them, you’ll  loose a whole morning.
I did report the hotel the problems I wrote here (dirty cold pools, bad restaurants etc) but they coldly ignored me. During check out they tried to charge me USD400 more, but later realized the mistake. The resort is nice though. But I think if you’re really into all inclusive experience, Punta Cana properties may deliver better value.  I hope the hotel improves related to my points here so I can return.

reviews.author: Timothy Richard R
reviews.title: Don't come here unless you want to get drunk and party
reviews.text: Great location close to the airport.  Well maintained hotel - although the cleaning staff are not that thorough.  Food is ok but you need to reserve early for best restaurants.  If you don't want to be accosted by drunk girls in the rest rooms stay away from the nightclub.  During the day avoid the party pool unless you want to party!!

reviews.author: S S
reviews.title: Great Service - Overall great hotel
reviews.text:
We just got back from a week long stay at Paradisus Cancun. Overall, we had a great vacation and Paradisus exceeded our expectations in many ways. 

We traveled with 2.5 year old and were not sure if this resort would be a good fit. Paradisus accommodates both families and couples very well. They have a great kids zone ages 5+ and baby zone ages 1-4. The kids play area were very clean and i felt comfortable leaving my kid. Although, i did not use it during this trip. They have separate kid pool with 2 feet dept. it was the best for our daughter as we did not have to worry about her getting in the way of adult relaxation. also there is a small pool, i think 1 feet deep for babies.  there were separate adult pools away from the kids area. i love the fact that the proper is stretched long so it does not feel crowded. Also, there are plenty of beach chair available.

There are 5 pyramids, we stayed at pyramid 4 so it was very quiet. Although, others complained about the loud music. i really appreciate that they offered entertainment every night from live music to performances and onsite adult club (everything on pyramid 2 or main entrance building). The music echoed everywhere and it was very loud. i think it was more due to the design of the buildings.
The food options were pretty diverse, we were able to get reservations to the restaurants fairly easy and got a chance to try out the various restaurants. The lunch and dinner buffets were pretty decent. they offered sushi and fresh seafood most of the time. overall, i would rate food 7 out of 10. no matter how good the food is one will get sick of it after few days.

The room was clean so no complains with housekeeping. Although, the beds were old and not comfortable. Also, the sofa bed and drapes in the room stunk so either needs deep cleaning or replacement.

Lastly, the service was great. Everyone was welcoming and always greeted us with a smile. The service at front desk, restaurants, housekeeping and even room service was outstanding. We ordered room service several times and it always arrived accurately and within the time-frame given at the time of placing order.

Also, take advantage of free photo sessions. They have great photographers and it is a great way to capture your memories. 

Some names I want to mention for outstanding service:

Poolside server – Victor, he was prompt and helped us find chairs when we arrived late to the pool area. There are limited chairs along the kid’s pool area but ofcourse you can rent the beds if you plan to stay all day.

Conceige/Front desk – Bruno went above and beyond to locate our taxi for pickup. We had prepaid taxi for pickup with supershuttle and we could not get a hold of anyone to confirm the pickup. A few places he tried did not recognize the reservation number. Anyways, he kept trying until he found the right company. 

Photographer – Jesus was very patient and tried very hard to get some great family shots. Our daughter was super cranky and would not cooperate but he did not give up. At the end we were so surprised how he was able to capture our family in a fun way. In reality it was not a fun shoot at all!

reviews.author: FarAway561094
reviews.title: Great Property and Experience
reviews.text: The Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun is an Excellent value and excellent experience.  I cant imagine a better property to stay at for a couples retreat.  The service is superior.  This was our second trip back and will most likely be returning again.

reviews.author: Pierre V
reviews.title: Had a great time at this hotel
reviews.text: The service was friendly and accommodating.  The service by the pool was exceptional.  Enrique, Josque, Carlos and Rey all made sure everyone was enjoying their stay as much as possible.  I'd definitely stay here again just because the service was so great. Oh and the meal selections were great as well.

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Always An Amazing Time!
reviews.text:
We absolutely love Paradisus Cancun! We come year after year and are never disappointed. The ocean is incredible. The staff is incredibly nice and accommodating. The food is delicious! Everything about this place makes us feel happy and relaxed.
