Blue Agave is our go to restaurant because no reservation is required and the tacos and quesadillas are amazing and authentic, prepared fresh. 
Enrique is our favorite bartender! He always takes great care of us and makes the best drinks! All of the staff at Paradisus have always been wonderful! 
If you just want to escape and relax in Paradise, come here!

reviews.author: Ron J
reviews.title: Paradisus Visit
reviews.text: Great adult family fun.    Great adult family fun.       Great adult family fun.    Great adult family fun.     Great adult family fun.    Great adult family fun.       Great adult family fun.    Great adult family fun.   !!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Katherine D
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus!
reviews.text: My husband and I returned this week from a 5 night getaway to Cancun.  After a very difficult winter in New England we decided we deserved an upgrade to Royal Service and were thrilled that we were able to do that upon our arrival.  We were so happy with our decision since it made this the absolute easiest vacation we have ever been on.  Our personal butler, Juan, took care of all our dinner reservations, our bali bed reservations, our transfer contact, etc. so we could spend our time on the gorgeous beach!!! We have been to other "all-inclusive" resorts and the food at the Paradisus is by far the best! There were only a few minor  "negatives" during our stay.  The first night at dinner there was a miscommunication regarding a wine order and we ended up paying for my glass of wine.  I didn't know that you had to ask for "house wine" for it to be part of the all-inclusive.  Also, we loved the look and feel of the resort, but there is a very strong incense smell which we could have done without.  The pillows were also scented and not as comfortable as ours at home.  Overall we totally enjoyed the incredible hospitality at the resort and the outstanding weather.  We would most definitely consider a return trip!  We would have liked some kind of written guideline outlining tipping, especially to the butler.  In the end, we gave him $100 and hoped that seemed fair considering we felt ourselves to be among the "low maintenance" guests.

reviews.author: scorpioerikaw
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
Paradisus is one of the most beautiful resorts I have ever stayed at. When you inside you don't even feel like you are in Mexico or at the beach. If you are looking for very authentic Mexican decor, I would not recommend this hotel. However the resort is one of the most beautiful from the outside and in.

Service is amazing at this resort. Room service comes everyday and it actually came twice a day sometimes. The only flaw was not much of a welcoming upon arrival. At checkin you are given a list of restaurants and map, that's it. It would have been better if they have gave us a little tour of the main floors and a list of activities. My boyfriend and I were lost on what to do the first two nights. Eventually we spoke with great staff members and they answered all of our questions. Two that stood out were Enrique, the bar tender at Mijo bar in Bana. He was great, friendly and made the best drinks at the resort. Also due to the lack of communication of the activities schedule, we had missed the mixology lesson but the bar was empty so he gave us a quick one anyway which was awesome.

As far as the food goes it was good. I recommend making reservations every night because the food is better when you make reservations at the restaurants.In the main dining hall food was always cold and very random. Service was still great but the Market Grill and Fuego were our favorites. 

The pool and beach were great along with the chicken wings, nachos, hot dogs and burger bar throughout the day. One thing that I would say bothered me is guest out towels down on chairs early in the morning and didn't arrive to beach/pool area until much later making it harder for people who want to use the beach/pool to find seats. 
 
Overall our vacation was wonderful and I would stay again.

reviews.author: Anthony C
reviews.title: All Inclusive to Cancun
reviews.text: Overall our experience at Paradisus Cancun was enjoyable.  A couple of things I would point out.  First, provide folks who prepay their gratuities with a wrist band of some type.  Let's folks know we've prepaid our tips and shouldn't be an expectation every time you blow your nose.  Second, there was no ability to cash $100 bills--anywhere.  The front desk sent me to the waiters/bar tenders--the waiters/bartenders wouldn't cash them because they didn't want the same problem.  There was a heavy push for offsite excursions to high priced companies (e.g. Albatros Catamaran/Snorkeling & Market 28).  My wife and I opted for the Platinum upgrade at Albatros and it was fine, however, the photographer on the boat was WAY overpriced and the crew (even after our $208 investment--expected a tip, go figure).  As for Market 28, we went, spent, and then I asked one of the workers for a trip to a real local national kind of market (e.g. fruits, vegetables, meats, etc.).  A $3 cab ride later we were in Market 23 and had a wonderful time--and most of what we purchased was a third the price of Market 28.  We tipped our butler (Hector) as part of the Royal Service upgrade $100--he found out it was my birthday and decorated our room/pool cabana, and otherwise took absolutely great care of us along the way.  Again, trying to figure out how to upgrade to Royal Service prior to our arrival was simply unachievable--had to wait until we got to the hotel and pay the offered price for "the last available room" which obviously wasn't.   Finally, the 90 minute mandatory "breakfast" to try to sell us $140K/50 year Melia Package last 3 hours and despite the fact my wife had left 90 minutes earlier due to illness finally ended in me saying thanks, but no thanks to chase away the hounds.

reviews.author: Johnjohn G
reviews.title: Best hotel in Cancun!
reviews.text: This page is hands down the best hotel I've ever been to in all of mexico not just Cancun, and I've been there a lot. Great staff, beautiful hotel, clean, great food. We opted for the ocean view room and it was a great choice. Huge balconies, and you can't beat the view! I would go back in a second.

reviews.author: robinp562
reviews.title: Staff are Top Notch Professionals
reviews.text: We took our customers to the beautiful Paradisus, Cancun. An all-inclusive resort. Amazing staff, spectacular views, excellent food. First and foremost, NELLY DIAZ, Sub-gerente de Grupos y Convenciones Conference Services Subdirector, without her soothing calm demeanor and "we'll get it done attitude", it would have been a different stay for our customers. Rafael Rodriguez- Banquet Manager, went above and beyond to care for all of us, Angel Toledo –Banquet Captain, another outstanding person who took great care of us, Abraham Franco- Front desk Manager helping us with all of the changes our customers were requesting. Daniel Amador- J&S Audiovisual, making sure our presentations went smoothly.

reviews.author: ChiJetCity
reviews.title: Excellent Food / Excellent Bartender
reviews.text: We own a Sol Melia Timeshare and visited here for the first time in February 2015. The place is well maintained and possibly some of the best dining we have had in an all inclusive. One specific mention is the bartender, Rey who worked at the main bar where the shows were held and also worked at the Red Lounge. He was absolutely fantastic and made our vacation that much better.

reviews.author: Shawna M
reviews.title: Dirty Underwear!!!
reviews.text: Upon arrival our room was not ready and we paid for a king bed and they tried putting us in a double room. We waited for 2 hours for a room with a king bed and when we arrived in our room there was dirty underwear in the closet. Our room was right above the night club so it was loud until 2 AM. Not good.

reviews.author: Djgill50
reviews.title: Winter getaway
reviews.text: Totally amazing, perfect weather, amazing accommodations, very courteous staff. Very nice beach. Had a great week. Don't now how u could beat Paradisus! Nightly entertainment. Food was excellent , plenty of choices, restaurants or buffet.

reviews.author: Oni J
reviews.title: Just Okay...
reviews.text:
I visited this resort from Jan 18-22 for my boyfriend's 30th Birthday. Not bad, it was clean but not extremely modern. The first day we arrived we offered an upgrade for a certain price but we were able to negotiate a lower price. The first morning I woke up I tried to order room service, after waiting almost two hours I recieved a cold omelet with raw onions and unmelted hard cheese. I called back room service they passed me on to several people only to have me eventually speak to the initial person that transferred the call, when I expressed my disappointment the woman pretended she didn't speak english. I was told I had to wait another hour to have it replaced. After waiting more than 1 hour I was once again given another cold omelet with uncooked ingredients. I didn't bother using room service for the rest of the trip. 

Other pro's and con's 
Pros
The room was clean 
Nice view of the beach 
Not a lot of noise on our wing 
Fridge was always stocked 

Cons 
Extremely old refrigerator 
Not a lot of food options (buffet food always cold)
Drinks were not strong (they reused soft plastic cups in certain locations, and didn't give you a straw)
We were being forced into viewing a time share (I was adamant about not going and I did not appreciate being forced) 
Not enough beach chairs  

One last thing, when I was checking out, the lady at the desk told me she could not change my $100 in US (so that I could pay for the cab to the airport) She offered to give me pesos which was pointless because I was leaving. As a courtesy, she could have changed my money into smaller bills because the hotel was more than happy to accept my payment in US dollars. 

If I came back to Cancun I wouldn't stay here again, simply because I would like to see what other resorts have to offer.

reviews.author: CandiceWinnipeg
reviews.title: Pyramid 4 is the best choice!
reviews.text: We recommend pyramid #4 as the best choice for a beautiful view and more restful, quiet night. We enjoyed the "quiet" pool and had excellent service from Victor! He was an excellent poolside server and even taught us a few words in Spanish!

reviews.author: Doris R
reviews.title: Awesome Vacations
reviews.text:
I stayed there the last weekend of February 2015. 
My experience was really good. The hotel is properly maintained, climatized and Iluminated. 
Its interiors are pretty similar to a cruiseship. Exactly what I saw in the pictures... Not edited. 
The staff is really kind and willing to meet your expectations. 
For the foodies like me, there are plenty of options to try... all of them so tasty (trust me!)
Pros: Location, structure, food, beach
Cons: Midnight menu should improve

reviews.author: Jannis S
reviews.title: Better hotels in the area.
reviews.text: We have stayed at 5 hotels in the cancan hotel district over the past few years. I would rank this hotel 3rd. or maybe 4th. for overall experiences. While the people who work here are nice and pleasant there was never the sense that they were willing to go over the top to accommodate us. When we arrived are group was told we were being upgraded to Royal Service. There was nothing Royal about the area except that there were no kids in one pool. That pool did not have a swim up bar, so us and almost all of the other guest spent our pool time in the regular pool. The pool area is nice, but there are no shallow areas in the pool except for maybe a 1' space on the outer edge. If  the swim up bar area was crowded you have to tread water to stay in the bar area. The best restaurant to eat is the Market Grill. Don't bother making reservation for The Steak House. The steak house was only a Mexican buffet. ( we were told that after we were seated) Our room in the Royal tower was small, I mean really small compared to the other couples in our group. There were no house coats or slippers or washcloths in our room. Room service is slow. There is only one elevator in each tower that is shared by workers and guest, so it is very slow. There are STEPS! A lot of STEPS

reviews.author: marktaylor22
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing.
reviews.text:
I booked my trip for this hotel about a year ago for a trip end of February for my 30th birthday.  We just returned yesterday and I couldn't wait to write about my experience with this hotel.  

Simply Put: It's the best vacation I've ever had in my entire life.

Hotel:

The exterior of the hotel is absolutely gorgeous - rivers flowing - amazing gardening - and really just polished very well.  Once we stepped inside the hotel - it was absolutely stunning.. The amount of detail that the resort staff put into keeping the property in tip top shape is absolutely magnificent.

You must absolutely upgrade or book ROYAL SERVICE.  Royal Service is for adults only, and it literally made our vacation the trip of a lifetime.  With Royal Service your room is assigned in the Royal Service area of the hotel where absolutely no children are allowed - which automatically created a quite environment inside the Royal Service area.  When we checked into the hotel, it was our Royal Service team that handled the entire check in process.  We met our Butler for the hotel (Pedro) and Pedro made our vacation absolute stunning.  When you book Royal Service - you get a butler assigned to you to follow you - and ensure that your vacation is top of the line.  Pedro - you are AWESOME - and you took care of us with such a sincere attitude and you made our vacation absolutely perfect.  Inside the Royal Service pyramid - we experienced a Royal Service lounge which featured beers, an automated cappuccino machine, and also a bar with many popular brands - free and unlimited.  It was great!  In addition there was always cheese, crackers, and various meets and fruits and veggies to choose from.  It was absolutely a joy to relax in the comfort of the hotel - with no children - and be able to experience a true vacation with absolute peace.  The summary?  If you are an adult, or an adult couple - book Royal Service - and ask for Pedro!  

The dining options at the hotel were fantastic.  The physical restaurants inside the hotel are exquisite.  The pool service food is very good, but very basic.  The physical flare of the food at this resort is inside their restaurants - Book All-Inclusive!  One of my favorite stops which we hit up multiple times was Blue Agave which is a Taco restaurant inside the hotel - excellent food to be served here.  Another favorite dining option was Mole.  You can't go wrong with the food choices inside this resort.  You have so many options!

I can't sign enough praise about this resort - it was easily the best vacation of my lifetime - and I will refer and praise this hotel for every day of my life.  Way to go Paradisus - you guys rocked it, and I can't wait to visit again!  

PS - The Free WIFI is SUPERIOR, especially for being such a huge property the Wifi Speeds were tremendous - being on the beaches I was able to have a strong signal.  This is HUGE to me because I am data first, voice last. - I am always connected to social media.   Remember, turn off your Data Roaming, and Cellular so you don't get hit with excessive fees, but the Wifi is top notch.

reviews.author: Buffaloblues14
reviews.title: Paradise maximized by impeccable service and quality.
reviews.text: We just recently got back from our 2nd visit to the Paradisus in Cancun. We treated ourselves to the royal service option again this year, though it's no splurge, the value greatly outweighs the cost to have access to all of the delicious restaurants and the luxury of having 24/7 flawless service. The staff even remembered us from our visit over a year earlier. What an incredible feeling to be welcomed into such a huge resort and treated like royal family. Any time we ordered a drink, sat down for a meal or asked a question, the staff was incredibly friendly and accommodating. All of our needs were anticipated and exceeded. The location is perfect, right ON the white sand that flows into the crystal blue water and just minutes from any extra amenities. The world class entertainment and activities by the pool allow you to spend every night and day sipping top shelf drinks and grazing on a variety of gourmet foods. The Paradisus is constantly adding fun, trendy features to their resort, we cannot wait to see what is new next year! The service is truly unparalled, Galdino, Sergio, Simon, Omar, Wilberth, Edier and Edgar treated us so well and went the extra mile for us every time, we will never forget them and the way they made us feel. We highly recommend this resort to everyone who wants a vacation you will never forget.

reviews.author: Ryan A
reviews.title: Wonderful stay from all aspects!
reviews.text: Had the privilege of spending six nights at Paradisus Cancun this past week and was not disappointed. Spectacular views, wonderful food and exceptional service were certainly some of the highlights of our trip.  Enrique, our poolside server was awesome!  Rosa, Margalli, Angel and all of the other staff were amazing and definitely made our entire stay perfect from start to finish.

reviews.author: shelly e
reviews.title: A wonderful experience
reviews.text: The place is gorgeous, the rooms are very comfortable, the hotel is beautifully designed - every corner has been well thought through. The food was great and the performances each night were absolutely wonderful. We really enjoyed our stay. Thank you.

reviews.author: Lindsay M
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text:
Overall, an amazing hotel resort!!!  The property, pools, beach, food, staff, activities, etc were all amazing!  My boyfriend and I just travelled there for my birthday, since neither of us have been to Cancun, and I'm so glad we chose Paradisus.  The staff is extremely friendly and helpful and will provide you with excellent recommendations of restaurants, bars, activities, etc.  The property was immaculate and extremely gorgeous with live trees, vines and jungle plants everywhere.

We frequented the Avenue Bar within the resort the most due to the incredible bartenders Salvador and Rafael.  The best bartenders I've ever seen, Rafael mainly takes care of the server well, while Salvador serves the bar.  Salvador will ask your name and where you're from your first time there.  He will remember that information for the rest of your stay, and is well known for making the BEST shots, and at an interval of every 15 minutes for those sitting at the bar.  We definitely tipped them more than any one else during our entire trip!

The restaurants are great!  We went to la pearla, bana, Blue Agave, mole, and of course the buffet, which names escapes me at this moment.  We are not buffet people at all, and were not anticipating a great meal, but were pleasantly surprised by the delicious worldly cuisine.  Service there was impeccable and while waiting in line for a smoothie, our waiter asked me what I wanted and told me to go back to my table.  He then brought us 3 smoothies when I only asked for 2.  "Happy Hour!  Buy two, get one free!" he said, even though it was all inclusive. We frequented the buffet for both breakfast and lunch often.  The room service isn't bad either.  The menu list is small, but the cuisine was wonderful.

Overall, an amazing resort that we will be returning to in the future!

reviews.author: Linda B
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: Loved the entire vacation at the Hotel.  All of the staff made you feel welcome and all of the employees were very friendly.    The all inclusive is the best way to go.  Even on the beach the staff makes sure you have everything you need.

reviews.author: Carol C
reviews.title: Wonderful waters! Excellent food and service!
reviews.text:
Visited Paradisus, 2/21-2/28. Great place for a group of friends to gather, and a wide range of excellent dining opportunities - after a long day of sun and fun on the beautiful beach.

Vento, Bana and Fuego were my favorite evening dining experiences. The service was amazing and the food memorable! The chefs are impressive! Waiters: Fabricio and Carlos made the meals delightful! The Naos buffet provided a consistently varied and appealing array of choices.

Room amenities were pleasant, but there was a distinctive lack of facecloths and bath mats, on multiple occasions. Nice to have a refreshing beverage available in the fridge, and room service provided prompt, enjoyable meals/snacks.

reviews.author: Don M
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: The staff was great the resort was beautiful  Orlando Bello was a outstanding  waiter took great care of us and our 2 year  old would definitely  stay agin the beach was perfect the resort was well kept and looked like it was just built the rooms was clean and neat great resort for family and kids

reviews.author: anhtrann
reviews.title: February 7 - 11, 2015
reviews.text: We stayed here for 5 days and 4 nights.  We also travelled with 2 younger kids aged 3 and 4.  The beach was beautiful.  We usually found a place to sit on the beach. If you want a guaranteed seat - you will need to go to the beach much earlier in the day.  We always found a place but we came outside much later. You can reserve/rent one of the huts for $100USD a day. It's worth it if you're going to spend the whole day at the beach.   The food was not bad overall; it's not the best food you'll ever have but there were no complaints. Our favourite was the buffet and Blue Agave for tacos (we had them once a day).

reviews.author: mbrunner_13
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: We visited the weekend of Feb 12-16, 2015 to escape the cold weather and celebrate two birthdays.  We had Royal Service and it was worth every penny!  Our rooms overlooked the gorgeous beach, we had all of the amenities needed for comfort in our room.  Our Butler made all of our dinner reservations as well as made sure the birthdays were celebrated in style.  He, Rode, also made sure we had both sun chairs and Bali beds near the pool or beach every day.  He checked on us throughout the day to ensure we were happy.  We especially enjoyed the Royal Service pool and restaurant where we had our lunch delivered to us at our Bali beds.  The food is delicious, especially the Thai chicken salad and of course the quacamole and chips!  The beach is gorgeous with white sands and many miles to walk.  The water is clear and refreshing.

reviews.author: Kris K
reviews.title: Great Beach, Great Service
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus Cancun on a family vacation from 2/11-2/11, kids 12 and 9. We are beach people and this beach is truly spectacular. Powdery white sand, aqua water, long stretch of beach, drink service to your palapa. We are beach people and that's what we were there for, and it did not disappoint! Service was excellent all around from all staff from the moment we got there, until the moment we left. Resort is spotless, and the food was very good, certainly the best of the 3 all inclusives in Mexico in this price range that we have been to. Our favorite was Bana (sushi) which we went to twice but had very good meals at Vento and Market Grill as well. Room service included was a great perk. As others have pointed out, there is cold food on the buffet, however there is so much to choose from we didn't have much of a problem with it.

While everyone we interacted with was great, we had memorable service from Flor on the beach, Roberto at Bana and Orlando at Naos. You just really had the impression that our experience was important to them. Also, if you go to an all inclusive like this, please tip. These people are working hard and very much deserve it (and if you are there, you can afford it!)

Some things that could have been better were the cold main pool (although there is a smaller, heated one), and the noise from the night club at night. If you are ocean front (worth the upgrade), and in the main pyramid, it is going to be loud so if that is important to you try to take care of it at check in. We were all exhausted after dinner, so it didn't really affect our sleep much and we were right above it. There really should be more chairs at the beach. 2 are out per palapa, everyone goes in the morning and moves them, so you have a third row of palapas with no chairs. We went down about 8:00 am or so to reserve chairs and were first row every day. Also, the nightly show is set up really weird. and good views are just about impossible, but that wasn't too important to us either. We considered these minor opportunities for improvement.

Definitely, if you are looking for an all inclusive that is easy to get to (15 minutes from airport), with an awesome beach, great service and very good food Paradisus hits the mark. It's the first vacation we have ever been on where we left saying that we should just back and repeat for our next vacation.

reviews.author: Sahara18
reviews.title: Different, but good
reviews.text:
This isn't your typical "down south" resort.  From the way the front desk staff is dressed to the incense burning almost everywhere, it almost feels like you are in an Asian-type spa...which is not what a person is typically going for when in Mexico.  

Check in went fine, rooms were clean and service was good.  It can be hard to get chairs on the beach, so it's best to get up early and save them.  We noticed that if you only put a towel to save your chair, the staff would often remove the towels or other guests would take them.  It's best to leave a couple of personal items (ie, sandals, t-shirt).

With the exception of Vento the food was just average.  There wasn't much of a selection at the buffet and the other a-la-cartes left something to be desired.  Vento, which is a tapas bar, is an absolute must! TIP:  If you want french fries or bacon, you must order from your waiter as they are rarely in the buffets.  

Although we were in Mexico, we found some staff struggled with English which was surprising for a 5*.

The pool is nice, but quite deep.  It is also fairly quiet...music was rarely played.  Although this was fine, it is not what we expected of Cancun.

The resort has two pyramids that have Time Shares.  We were approached several times by staff wanting to explain all "benefits", etc.  Try and avoid this people if you can.

We enjoyed our vacation, but would most likely not return to this resort.

reviews.author: Chris R
reviews.title: Great vacation, Better than we expected!
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I stayed at Paradisus for our spring break vacation March 14-20. Upon arrival every aspect of the hotel exceeded our expectations. Unfortunately when we arrived, I realized that I had left a backpack that contained my passport at the airport. The front desk was extremely helpful in calling the airport security and lost and found and thankfully I was able to get everything back quickly! The hotel smells smells great and is very clean throughout. Looking a other guests reviews and pictures, I thought the vines might be a bit much, but they actually made the place look great and added to the relaxing atmosphere.

Our room wasn't quite ready at check-in, but after dealing with my passport situation, the room was ready and our bags were brought to our room. Our room was very clean and exceeded any of the pictures we had seen online. We didn't opt for the royal service and our room was a basic lagoon view in the central tower (3 i think) on the third floor. The room had a comfortable king bed, couch sitting area, and a nice big clean bathroom. The room had a nice view of the lagoon and the sunsets were beautiful. We spent most of our time out of the room so weren't too concerned with the ocean view.

I read reviews saying to get up early to reserve an umbrella/palapa by the beach or pool, and this is absolutely true. Get there by 8:30am and you should have a few choices. I was always there by 8am to enjoy the beautiful mornings and there was always plenty of seating choices available. I would pick up beach towels from the towel hut and place those on the chairs along with some shoes or a magazine, then go eat breakfast. We never had trouble with people taking our stuff or spots. Ask the servers on the beach or by the pool and they're happy to help you out. Huge Thank You to Victor for taking care of us on the beach!! We couldn't have asked for better service!! And big thank you to Enrique the night bartender at the Cocos Bar. Had a great night with him and some people that we met at the bar. Service by the pool was great as well. The bartenders will take car of you if you take care of them! Really worth it!

I read some reviews about people having trouble making dinner reservations? This never once happened to us. I called every evening for the next night and always got the time we were shooting for. We tried Mole, which I think was our favorite. Big thank you to Joel and the staff, as your service was great and dinner amazing. Dinner at Bana was fun because of the atmosphere. The food was delicious and different. Our server Jesus was excellent and very friendly. Thank you! Fuego was good and offered the most romantic atmosphere I'd say. The buffet was always different and always left us satisfied.

A couple random points:
I speak Spanish but all of the staff spoke English and were easy to communicate with.
All the staff we encountered were very nice and willing to go out of there was to help us out.
Tip the staff that helps you out! They work hard and really deserve it.
The beach was large and very clean. Every other day or so a large line of staff would walk the beach in a line at the end of the day and pick up small pieces of trash.
The pool and beach never felt crowded.

reviews.author: Estefani W
reviews.title: Super attentive staff
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at Paradisus Royal Service from March 21-28. We were very impressed with the grounds of the hotel as well as the warm welcome we received by the staff upon arrival. Once we were escorted to the royal area for check-in, we had a minor set back with our room having a view of the tennis court but they did offer for us to move us 4 days later which was when they would have a room with ocean view. We chose to think about it since the weather was so fantastic and we were hardly ever in the room. One of our favorite things about staying at this resort, was that they had very comfortable balli beds which I used daily to get comfortable and enjoy some reading. This area where these beds are, was so wonderful, they had servers that would always come around to see if you wanted anything to eat or drink or even offer us a hookah since they noticed we liked that. Francisco the server by the pool/beach area was one of the most pleasant and attentive servers there although they were all fantastic. We also enjoyed a lot the food and service at the buffet specially by the captain Jesus which we loved for taking always such great care of us as well the server Jesus. I tried all of their restaurants except for blue agave and our favorites were tempo (although you have to pay) and Mole the Mexican restaurant which has 3 mariachi that sing while you dine there and they are very good singers. For everyone that had not yet made up their mind abut coming here, I can tell you that this was our 4th time in Cancun and the resort is by far the best I've ever been to. Their food, service and accommodations are incomparable to the other hotels I've been to in Cancun of which are always at least 4-5 stars. We loved everything and we will be returning soon with our family to this wonderful piece of paradise.

reviews.author: Angela V
reviews.title: March Break
reviews.text:
This is an oustanding resort and the staff is extremely helpful.  There are no complaints about the food - excellent quality.  

The Family Concierge is a must for people travelling with small children and was very helpful to our family with an older disabled child.  The Bally Beds are a must for families.

We requested a handicapped accessible room which was provided however it was above a noisy restaurant.  The hotel however moved us to a nice suite in a much quieter building.  All was amazing after that.

reviews.author: Ashley L
reviews.title: Good overall, but a few issues
reviews.text: My husband and I traveled to Paradisus Cancun in February. The check in was a breeze and we were met by our butler, as we had upgraded to the Royal Service. However, after he had shown us to our room we never saw him again, and even after calling him multiple times for help with restaurant reservations etc.. he never answered and we were assigned a new butler after we brought it up to management. The beach was beautiful but we had to claim lounge chairs on the beach between 5-7am!!! I guess we went on a busy week... We did however have the chance to rent out the beach beds which were very nice. The staff was overall excellent.  The manager for Royal service was also very understanding and well trained clearly. My husband stepped on glass outside our room (clearly was not cleaned up properly) and we needed to get the resort doctor to fish it out. $250 later, you can say we were not pleased but the Manager covered the bill, which was very nice.  The restaurant are overall good. Stay AWAY from Fuego, the food was horrible!! espresso on Tuna Tataki??? ew. And our reservation was bumped back from 7:30 to 8:15...Vento sushi was nice, and Tempo (gourmet with charge$$$) was well worth the money.  The spa is also excellent. Great drinks and beach staff, tip them and they will make sure your drink is full. I would recommend visiting this resort.

reviews.author: Alaina Y
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, excellent service!
reviews.text:
Went to this hotel with my mom for a one week vacation. We were impressed with the hotel right away. We were greeted with cold towels to refresh before being brought into the check-in room. We didn't get an ocean view room but were still very impressed with the room nonetheless. We thought the hotel was beautiful, especially at night when there was extra care taken with lighting and candles all throughout the hotel. 

We really enjoyed the food, lots of options at breakfast at the buffet. We always sat in the same spot and had fantastic service from Jorge. We tried most of the restaurants and really enjoyed the food. My mom is not super adventurous and always managed to find something to eat. Our favourite restaurant was Vento. Great tapas style tasting meal and we had great service from Aurelio. Jesus at Mole was also great. The staff were so obliging to give you anything you needed and were always extremely helpful and efficient. Tipping was always greatly appreciate by the staff. 

We opted out of the Royal Service but were still very impressed with the amenities. There were always chairs on the beach for us and we loved how they had staff coming by every so often with water and to take any drink orders. 

The nightly entertainment was fun although a little short some nights, we maybe would have liked more than one performance. Also the seating area for the entertainment is quite small so you have to get there early. 

At the end of everything we had a fantastic time and any negatives we had were very minor. My mom and I both travel to resorts quite a bit and we both agreed that this was the nicest one we've been to. Would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone and we can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Teresa K
reviews.title: Incredible staff and unbelievable service!!
reviews.text: My daughter and I arrived at Paradisus Cancun on March 23, 2014 for a relaxing week on the beach.  On the advice of our travel agent, we upgraded to Royal Service which was incredible!!!  The resort is beautiful, and the grounds are spotless!!  Royal Service guests are treated to priority check-in with a Concierge and a butler.  Our butler provided us with a cell phone to stay in touch with him 24/7 for dinner reservations or cabana reservations or just to answer any questions we might have. Every one of the staff out by the pool and cabana areas (David, Francisco, Marisio, Rogelio and Omar (as well as all of the other gentlemen) worked so hard every day to set up towels in our cabanas and bring us drinks, food and bottles of water.  The level of attention was impressive!  The buffet and self-serve bar in the Royal Service lounge was well stocked and continually refreshed; and we appreciated the selection of premium wines, champagnes and liqueurs that were provided. While we enjoyed our meals in all of the restaurants, we have to say that Tempo  Restaurant was our hands-down favourite.   Fares, the Manager, our waiter Samuel,  the Chef Ismael-Felipe and especially the sommelier Carlos Duarte served us an incredible meal on Thursday evening. We were given a tour of the wine cellar and tasting room, and we were so impressed that we have made a dinner reservation again for tonight.  Sadly we are leaving tomorrow, but we will absolutely be back again. This was a fabulous vacation and we loved every minute of our vacation. Thanks to all of the staff - you are all awesome!!!

reviews.author: Ross0305
reviews.title: good stay overall but 4* and not 5* hotel
reviews.text:
The positive things:
hotel appearance is good, the location is great and the staff (lobby, bar, restaurants and pool/beach tenders and activity staff very good overall.  Food is plenty and fresh (although if you stay like us for 10 days it gets a bit repetitive)
Te things that could be improved:
the housekeeping staff needs training and managements....there was always something missing each day...towels, soaps, toilet papaer etc although when reported was delivered in a timely manner!

I stayed at this hotel back in 1995 and it was superb......second time around overall still a good stay but the hotel is starting to look somewhat tired and lacks the 5* sparkle that once had!

reviews.author: NxG33k
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text:
Had wonderful service, from Francisco, pool and beach side. This made the vacation very enjoyable. The beach was easily accessible with and shower and bathroom near.

There were multiple places onsite to eat however most require reservations, this can be difficult the first night or two depending on how crowed it is.

We will definitely come here again!

reviews.author: Carly L
reviews.title: The outside beat's all!!
reviews.text:
We went to stay at the Paradisus Cancun this last week and I will for beginners say the outside area was to die for! Between the extremely clean pool and one of the cleanest beaches I have ever stepped foot on, outside was where you want to be. Upon arriving, there was an extremely strong lavender smell that was outright overwhelming. The smell was meant to be relaxing, but in my opinion it was over the top the entire trip. The rooms were very clean and housekeeping did a great job the entire five days we were there. The towels and water wasn't always replenished upon getting back to the room each day, but the service in getting us those items quickly was fantastic! I recommend any building other than building 3. Building 3 overlooks everything in the main area, but the music during dinner and then when the club is open is out of control loud! Very annoying.

Food...the buffet was strong. Plenty of items to choose from each meal...the key to going to the buffet is going when it is during key hours so the food is fresh and warm. Went to three different restaurants and the Mediterranean restaurant was very good! The drinks were served quickly outside and they were good. I did however see the glasses be just hand washed with water while we were sitting at the pool bar and that was a HUGE turnoff! Not very clean!

Outside each day, the little mini tiki huts that sit over the lawn chairs are the most popular place to be. I had to get up at 6am to get one every morning and even then they were mostly claimed. However, they are worth it...the sun is SO POWERFUL we needed shade and they provide both. On that note, bring strong sunscreen...the sunscreen in the gift shop at the hotel was about $40. I repeat $40! Anything in the gift shop as far as the sunscreen, the snacks and little nick nacks were outrageous! Make sure you bring anything extra you need! All inclusive is great, unless you need something you didn't bring!

reviews.author: ZadeSamuels
reviews.title: I would stay there again
reviews.text:
We loved our stay at Paradisus Cancun. The architecture was spectacular and the decorations were dazzling. I loved the poor, the beach, the lounge area, the steakhouse, the Brazilian BBQ, the super friendly staff....etc.

When we go back to Cancun it will be very hard for us to risk trying another hotel since the bar was set so high by Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Iowarefugee
reviews.title: Nice resort- could use some updating
reviews.text: The resort wi-fi was the worst. Plan for it- having said that the rooms were clean and maid service was excellent. Our butler did most of the things we asked in his own time. Juan W's service at the buffet was top notch.

reviews.author: tammy n
reviews.title: Family Concierge Vacation - FANTASTIC
reviews.text: We enjoy our luxury travel and were VERY impressed with Paradisus in Cancun! We opted for the Family Concierge accommodations and were very happy with our choice. Our "Butler" Grace was wonderful. She laid out our towels by the pool daily, which we loved along with the amenities. Our children thought it was amazing- milk and cookies in the room, balloon animals created and waiting for them on their beds, mini fridge full of goodies included. We loved the weather, the location, and our overall experience. We WILL be back!! Our kids are age 5 and 10- it was perfect for them and we look forward to coming back when they are older!

reviews.author: Salvador C
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Excellent Service , experience, value , etc.
Paradisus gave me what Zi was looking for , the opportunity to relax and at same time do business in the same city ,. Paradisus is no doubt the place to be all year round

reviews.author: TOCAN8
reviews.title: Rooms need updating
reviews.text:
Our family spent 7 days at this resort.  I am an avid reader of tripadvisor to determine where we should stay.  We travel annually to Mexico and have stayed in Playa del Carmen, Mayan Riviera and Cancun for the past 12 years.  Each destination has it's pros and cons.  I chose this resort based on the family concierge option.  We had stayed at the old Paradisus in Mayan Riviera and enjoyed the option of a private room and full service and not having to  worry about booking reservations.  The service is excellent, the staff in the family concierge is very attentive and friendly.   The nightly turn down service with milk and cookies were a nice touch. I'm a little surprised with the comments about the food selection and quality on this forum.  I have to say,  we had the best meal  at this resort.  There was a few we didn't enjoy but I thought the restaurant Vento was excellent.  We dined there twice because we enjoyed it so much.  The main restaurant Naos does get busy and depending on where you sit the service is hit or miss.  On the whole, we did experience excellent service.
The reason I only gave this restaurant a 3 rating is that the Spa was so disappointing.  The day I visited the spa, the steam room wasn't working, the indoor spa pool was dirty and cold.  There was someone working in the general lounge area.  Only the main shower head had hot water, the other jet heads had cold water.  I've been to many spas in Mexico resorts, I look forward to spending a relaxing couple of hours but this one was so disappointing I didn't even bother to book anything.  Also, the price is out of line for the premises and service. 
The other reason this resort rated poorly was the rooms that we had been shown and stayed in needed major reno.  It definitely showed it's wear.  The beds were not comfortable, the sheets looked worn, the couches had stains. The first room had two double beds and took up the entire room.  We upgraded to a corner one bedroom suite but the first one was horrendous.  They had a pull out couch for the kids that is reminiscent of going to the cottage and sleeping on a horrible mattress.  The curtains in the bathroom had stains and were held up with wires.  They were too small to close thereby, people walking in the adjacent pyramid could see you in the bathroom at night.  We finally moved to the last room which was in the fourth pyramid on the second floor.  It was a 1 bedroom suite with two full size beds. It was still a little too small for two adults and two kids to sleep comfortably in.
Lastly,  there were no organized activities for kids under 9.  The playstation games were all broken, there was a pool table in the family concierge but the kids got bored quickly.  There were no evening activities for the kids other than watching the shows in a small area of the disco club at 8:30pm with very little seating.   Most resorts have some sort of theatre  but not this one. The kids room in the basement was basically for very young kids, a little too dark and dingy.  I don't mind spending more for service and quality.  I like the All inclusive because it's a no brainer.  If this resort renovates the spa and rooms and updates their programs for kids I would come back.  But in it's current condition, we will be looking elsewhere for our next family vacation.

reviews.author: NicoleGL
reviews.title: Gorgeous beach on one side / Crocs across the street :)
reviews.text:
We read many reviews before leaving.  When we got to the hotel - we were impressed!  The lobby was breathtaking.  BUT... after a long trip, line ups at customs, etc... we got yanked to the side and asked to attend some session. We were told it wasn't a timeshare... instead it was framed as an 'opportunity' to get our opinions and 'recommendations' on the rooms on the Melia side. Well, guess what? It was a timeshare discussion but they now call it 'Club Melia' or something like that.  For attending, we got a discount on some travel adventure... but we were there from 8:30 to 11 a.m. on our first day of vacation (never again).  
 
Our room could have used some updates... but with an ocean view like that... who cares :)  

SERVICE SERVICE SERVICE... what else can I say?  "Most" of the employees at the resort are amazing.  They are the ones that make the stay so much better.  I have to mention Guillermo from Market Grill and Roberto from the Blue Agave... these guys know how to make you feel welcome and treat you like you're special (which is how it should be when you're on holidays). 

We loved the fact that we could get out and walk - take a bus downtown - go to Market 28... there were so many options. One night, we crossed the street and walked along the path.  I couldn't believe it but we saw a huge crocodile at one of the marinas located along the lagoon. I attached a photo - very cool!

We did the Explor tour and the Chichen Itza tour.  They were great.  The Chichen Itza tour was a 3-hour bus ride... but worth it.  

We would recommend this destination... but be sure to look around for a better price (if possible).

TIP: We brought Pesos vs American currency.  They only give you something like 10 pesos for 1 U.S. dollar... but that's less than what you'd get at a currency exchange place.

reviews.author: Anastasiya S
reviews.title: Not Impressed
reviews.text:
My friends and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun from March 1st to March 7th. We purchased the Royal Service Package and the service was not that royal at all. The hotel is huge and is divided into 5 pyramids. We stayed in Pyramid 5. 

The hotel itself is beautiful inside and out. However, the service -- not so much. Room service was slow and almost always unresponsive. The restaurants which we booked when we first moved in had good food but we waited for an hour and a half to get our food in Fuego and the sushi in Bana tasted like rubber. They weren't fresh and tasted horrible. For my friend's birthday we had dinner reservations at Tempo at 8pm, we waited for an hour to get our table and another hour for our food. The buffet food was the same everyday and was not always fresh. 

Having visited many resorts in Cancun, Los Cabos, and the Caribbean' we have witnessed exceptional service in almost all. However, we were disappointed at Paradisus. 

ONE Exception: At Naos buffet, we had one server that we stuck to the whole vacation because his service was EXCEPTIONAL!!! His name is Jesus Arzeta. What a great guy! He is very engaging and entertaining, always made jokes with us and made us laugh. Besides, he is very fast and helpful. Whatever we needed, he brought it within minutes. Really, the best service in the whole resort!!! Such a friendly and well-mannered individual!!! During our last day he even brought us souvenirs from Cancun to say thank you for staying there and wishing us a safe trip. It warms my heart to know there are people who actually love their jobs and wish to make others happy! THANK YOU JESUS! You rock!!!!!

-Anastasiya

reviews.author: Mishutka56
reviews.title: Great hotel! Amazing holidays
reviews.text: We were with friends in February 2014. Everything was just super! Nice and friendly staff, great food , good alcohol and a lot of entertainment programs in the evening. Also highly recommend to visit some cities close to Cancun, i.e. Tulum or playa del Carmen. We spent amazing 2 weeks in Mexico, so we will definitely come back there! P.S. if you are not lazy and like to keep fit even in all inclusive hotel , then you definitely need to go to the gym in hotel. They have a lot of machines and good choices of morning trainings (around 9 am). The instructor Aldo is just great! Very nice, friendly and a real professional in what he is doing! So just go and you will enjoy!

reviews.author: Jennifer A
reviews.title: Blown Away
reviews.text: First all inclusive we stayed at and I must say we were blown away. Servive waa outstanding and the beach and pool area was very clean. Rooms were beautiful and we had a gorgeous ocean view! Will return!

reviews.author: dfarruggio
reviews.title: Not What We Expected
reviews.text:
After spending a week at the Paradisus, my wife and I both agreed that it did not live up to our expectations. 

PROS

Beautiful beach
Nice hotel/rooms

CONS

Subpar food
No activities included
No hot tub on premises
Weird zen music by the pool
No food variation in restaurants
Pool was freezing

reviews.author: Brian/Trish
reviews.title: Great Time
reviews.text:
Just got back from a 5 night stay and I can say we will be back.  We did the Royal Service, it was worth the cost just for the swimming pool.  The pool is very large and quiet, and the Bali beds are great to help you stay out of the sun for part of the day. The guys in charge of the free sunscreen and Bali beds were fantastic and very helpful.  The drinks looked to be the same in non Royal Service but the Royal Service was much more peaceful.  We were hoping for some American beer as we like Miller Lite but non to be found so Tecata Lite was a close 2nd.  If you like liquor they have the good stuff, Captain Morgan, Crown Royal, Jack Daniels, etc.
  We did check out the non Royal Service pools and they were busy and not much room to move around.  The Royal Service has a nice help yourself bar and a small snack area that made it nice to grab a snack and drink after spending the day in the water.  We originally had a small room (think motel 6)  on the lagoon side but after seeing the rooms of some other guest we emailed Natalia(she is awesome) and were moved to a larger room with partial ocean view immediately.   If you like to sleep in late, the lagoon view is nice as the sun rises in from the ocean side and the room can be very bright.   The food was good and we found room service to be quick and also very good.
  Do not go off property as another couple that we met did go to Freds Seafood across the street and the bill was over $600 for 4 people.  Not pesos but dollars!  The bar Coco lounge that sits outside and faces the ocean was fun at night and usually very busy.  Nice play to see the stars and the moon and the cruise ships at night.  There is a 9 hole golf course on site that we never played but we did take a walk around and it is in nice shape, very short holes (90-110 yards) but greens were well taken care of which did surprise me.  It gets hot so play early.  
 If you do not do Royal Service just request to be away from Tower 3, there is a disco lounge that we could hear outside.  We only had a couple issues, 1 was the 1st room which they took care of and the other was a waiter at the pool (Francisco) was very slow and once we complained about his service he completely ignored us. A supervisor even came up to my wife the day after she complained about Francisco and asked if she needed a drink.  She said she ordered one a it would come eventually, he asked to help and she felt very uncomfortable because she didn't want any more issues with Francisco after I had to flag him down to get us a drink. It was very disappointing to be uncomfortable in the pool area over this one waiter.    Give them a few dollars up front and they come quicker.  We tend to tip and the end of the day, and learned that this does not work if you would like good service by the pool.     Overall, we enjoyed the stay and will be back

reviews.author: Toni Efiah R
reviews.title: Birthday trip to Cancun with Family & Friends
reviews.text: We stayed from February 17-21. The weather was great. We had a room that faced the bay in the front of the hotel. Room was clean and comfortable. When we checked in, it did take a while, but not terribly long. The staff was very friendly and explained the amenities. Had the pleasure of meeting Iran who was very gracious and helpful as well as friendly whenever he saw us always asked how we were doing and if there was anything we needed or that he could do for us. The greenery inside of the hotel is nice and refreshing. We did have poor wifi reception inside of the room which was the only issue we had with the hotel. Nothing that ruined the time there though. The breakfast was delicious and had such a nice variety of options. We had a great server named Isaias who took great care of us. I loved the fresh juice bar! When we were laying out on the beach, Miguel attended to us and continued to make sure we had water and whatever other beverages we wanted. We had our favorite meal inside of Fuego where Hector and Carolina had us laughing and eating great food. Hector explained the menu really well and we loved the version of ceviche from Fuego. We had such a great stay and will definitely come back in the future.

reviews.author: leiny
reviews.title: This place is a giant biosphere with no breezes or windows that open!
reviews.text:
Stayed for 3 nights / 4 days -- and was very excited, based on excellent reviewed on TripAdvisor.  Unfortunately, our high expectations were not met.  We've stayed in many All-Inclusives in different Mexico cities, and Dominican, but were not impressed.  We go to Mexico for the beach and we felt like we went to a Biosphere.  None of the windows open in any of the restaurants except the Nano's one which is the main buffet style restaurants -- we like, open dining and the breezes of the sea.  Looks very pretty in the hotel at night, but again, felt muggy and musty inside with no fresh air.  Smelled in incense and candles and strong scents everywhere -- no thanks.  Believe me, we wanted to love it -- but would not return.  Would try a different place on the same beach--- should have stayed at Live Aqua like my friend recommended!  Uh -- so bummed.

PROS:
- Beautiful beach with crystal clear water!
- Nice pools that span the hotel
- Food was good - was easy to get reservations each night

CONS:
- Arrived at 10:30am, but room was not ready until 2:15pm.
- I signed up for Melia Rewards prior to our trip, requested early check-in online, but did not hear back and they did not give me any extra treatment for being a member
- We were immediately assigned a concierge at we stood in line to check in -- she asked us if we wanted a drink -- we ordered a Coke and a water -- she gave the water, and then held up a Diet Coke and said, we don't have a Coke and made no attempt to get one.  I said I'll take a water.
- After waiting in line for 15 mins -- we were told our room was not ready.
- Main dining area closed from 11am - 12:30 while they went to breakfast to lunch, disappointing since no other food to be found
- Reserved a Lagoon View Deluxe Suite and got Room 4014 in far right pyramid off in the middle of no where (near spa) which faced a back service driveway -- no lagoon.
- Bags were delivered within 10 mins after got into room, followed immediately by a welcome dessert.
- We were exhausted and took a nap, 2 hours in to our nap, there a constant noise at the door for 10 mins, went to see what it was, and it was the hotel staff trying to open the door, but the key pad did not work -- I opened the door, he apologized, I shut the door.
- After we came back from dinner that night, our key pad did not work, walked back to get new keys, still did not work, they sent someone to fix -- needed new battery, they fixed, and called to see it was OK
- Day 2 there was an envelope with note inside from hotel saying come to lobby for your Welcome Gift.  We sensed it was a push for a time-share hard sell, and decided to ignore.  
- Later that same day -- received a call in our room, asking if all was good, and if we are coming for our Welcome gift - I said no.  She asked if we already got it, I said, no thanks, don't want it.
- There was another message left on our phone, but we did not listen to it, could not figure out how to retrieve it.
- Felt the staff was very pesty.  We kept our Do Not Disturb sign from Day 2 on.
- Hardy any lounge chairs around pool, and had to put towel out by 7am to get a spot
- Downloaded their app, after seeing signs in the hotel, and it did not have all the most current info on it.  Tried to reserve Tennis courts -- and space was double booked. Asked front desk and they said the app doesn't work for Tennis.  
- Only one set of tennis rackets avail for rent -- and they are crappy rackets
- The fences around tennis court (yes, one court) is super low, easy to lose balls -- and hotel charges if you lose tennis balls

reviews.author: Yvonne G
reviews.title: Snowed in New Jersey!
reviews.text: We were snowed in for months in Hawthorne nj and needed a quick getaway, so we used our time share, and hope a plane.  The weather was fantastic!  The people was so nice.  The hotel is beautiful.  One night my boyfriend wanted to do something special for me.  The hotel worked with him and put rose pedals all over my room.  I was met with champaign and chocolate covered strawberry, it was great.  Thank you paradisus for a wonderful well needed 5 day gateway.  It truly was the best, and would recommend everyone come and buy a timeshare here, you won't regret it.

reviews.author: milance445
reviews.title: Great service, good beach, nice rooms
reviews.text:
The hotel is very large compared to all other nearby resorts. The main lobby is very nice and relaxing. It can be actually too relaxing as the water, scents, music and lighting are all designed to make you sleepy. The hotel rooms are nice and clean. Originally we had an ocean view room but had to downgrade to the front side view due to loud whistling noise caused by poorly insulated balcony doors and the strong ocean winds which made sleeping close to impossible.

The room and turn down service is great and they refresh towels twice a day.

Entertainment is OK. Different program every night but it is only 30minutes in a very small area with limited seating. You have to grab a seat 1hr prior to the show if you don't want to stand the entire time.

The beach and the sand is very nice. There are limited tanning beds so you have to get up early to grab one. A lot of people simply put their towels and leave which is not allowed. There is a 30min rule where you can take someone's spot if they are not there since reservation of the beds is prohibited. My suggestion is to tip a resort employee and they will find a spot for you without any problems.

The buffet service is simply amazing. All of the staff is very friendly and accommodating. 

If you are visiting the resort, ask for Luis from the Naos Restaurant (he works the PM shift). We received amazing service every single night from him as he went out of his way to ensure everything was perfect.

Last but not least, DONT BE CHEAP AND TIP if you like the service.

reviews.author: Kathleen1107
reviews.title: Great Trip and Experience
reviews.text: 3rd Time to Cancun and this was our best choice of hotels by far!  Walked in and greeted by hostess to situate us.  Very pleasant atmosphere, beautiful lush trees and greenery in center of hotel.  The pictures on the internet do not do it justice. Smelled great, peaceful music playing all the time, everyone smiling and saying hello.  Service amazing, couldn't clean up and serve u enough.  Constantly maintaining the property, which is huge!  Pool great, only get there early and pick a spot, as big as it is, it fills up.  We started by pool in day and then went to beach in afternoon to take a break from sun and go under huts which opened up by then.  Water and beach very clean and large.  Went parasailing right on beach and only $56. pp through hotel. Highly recommend it, 1st time and am hooked.!  Met a lot of nice guests all different ages, and found it very relaxing. Entertainment at night was really good. Dancers, mostly in lounge, which was very cool, with places to hang with pillows.  The decor throughout the hotel is like Asian Zen meets Mexico influence.  Very different!  Loved it.  Lanterns lighting the steps, unique statues , so many spots too just admire and sit with a drink or just relax.  We were more satisfied than expected.  Restaurants were different, We liked the Mexican intimate rest. one night, great service.  The buffet was good, many choices.  Steak house one, not so much, could use improving.  We were fine and very satisfied otherwise.  So much to do in Cancun, a must do for everyone of all ages!  Loved it, so sad to leave.  Also went on Club vacation tour, skip it if you are not serious interested, hit the beach instead.  Also went of tour to Tulum ruins and then to Ex Hal to snorkel and zip line and got full buffet lunch and drinks included.  Long day but lots of fun and great to see and do something totally different.  Great picture opportunities on tour.  Can hop on bus goes down strip to La Isla outdoor mall.  Very nice for shopping. Save this for a cloudy day as we did.  After the long winter this was so great to escape too. Wish I could have stayed longer, only 5 nights.

reviews.author: Amanda P
reviews.title: Cancun Vaca
reviews.text: We had a great experience at the Paradisus. Hotel was very clean and the staff was very accommodating. We were upgraded to the Royal Services area and really liked that lunch and drinks were served right to you on the beach.

reviews.author: aajj53
reviews.title: Not what I paid for.
reviews.text: My husband and I purchased the royal service and stayed at the hotel from Feb 25 threw March 5th.  The ambience of the hotel is stunning but the service is extremely slow. We weren't able to use the royal service much due to the lack of response and follow through.  Several of the days the restaurants did not open on time. They would come in at weird times to clean our rooms if they came at all. On our last day there our coffee pot started to smoke and crackle we called down to the front desk and it took maintenance 15 minutes to get to the  room. They said it would take a couple hours for a replacement. We told them that we were packing to leave so that wouldn't work. They said the would send up an pot of coffee for us. That took 45 minutes. At 4 am I wouldn't assume room service is that busy. It is a nice hotel and for the most part everyone was friendly,  however I would not go to  this hotel with high expectations or you will be disappointed .

reviews.author: Solly56
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, good service, BIG hotel
reviews.text:
We just spent two weeks at Paradisus Cancun March 3-17 and had a great time. I was surprised by the enormous size of the hotel and if you're not prepared to walk great distances to get just about everywhere, then this on not the place for you. It's certainly not an intimate hotel, but nevertheless, we had a great time. Here's my thoughts on everything from food to staff, beach, room, weather, room service and more.

STAFF: It's true that great staff make for a great hotel. Our waiter at the beach, Enrique, was wonderful, quick, proactive and polite. If my husband ordered Tequila, Enrique would just keep 'em coming. At the fabulous restaurant Vento, our waiter Leobardo was a doll! Sweet, professional, polite, friendly and helpful and remembered our favourite foods and drinks from one visit to the next. Waiters Guillermo and Gerardo at the Market Grill were also very responsive, polite, friendly and quick. Francisco, our waiter at Bana restaurant was delightful - funny, sweet and attentive. After a few visits to that restaurant, he brought us a special dessert one night. The chef had made cheesecake and written in chocolate on the plate: "Thank you for your visit." 

Luis at the concierge desk was extremely helpful when I asked him if there was a library where guests left their old books. He said no, but then disappeared and reappeared a few minutes later with an armload of books from Housekeeping for me! Jose at the Market Grill at breakfast was lovely and remembered what we liked. And last but not least there were the lifeguards Eduardo and Oscar, who got us beach chairs under palapas every day.

Food & Restaurants:
One of our favourites was Vento, which has mediterranean food in small tapas. The truffle risotto with shrimp, beef medallion with truffle mashed potatoes and sea bass with truffle (do you see a theme here?) were amazing. my husband loved the foie gras creme brûlée but it was too rich for me.

Our next fave was The Market Grill for dinner. it's Brazilian and Argentinian food. Which means meat, meat and more meat. the HUGE skewers of chicken were so moist, tender and delicious I could have eaten them all night. the beef and lamb was excellent too, and you MUST try the chimmichura sauce that goes on everything.

We also loved Bana, the Japanese restaurant. the sushi was very good, esp. the breaded, deep fried sea bass roll. The salmon sashimi was good too.

Naos, the only restaurant that you don't need reservations for, besides Blue Agave (which we didn't try) was just so-so. Nothing to write home about. Surprisingly Mole, the Mexican restaurant was pretty awful.

Room Service: it's free and 24/7 but it is AWFUL!!!! The first time we ordered room service they told us it would be about 35 minutes. After about an hour I called them again and was told it had been delivered already! Clearly it got to the wrong room. When they realized their mistake, they said they'd send up more food right away. All told, it took the, m 1 1/2 hrs. to bring our order! The second time we ordered room service (we only did it cuz my husband was sick) it got there in about 35 mins. but the food was dreadful. STAY away from the room service if you can. The selection sucks, the food is awful and the service is worse.

BEACH: the beach is deep, with white sand and it's gorgeous. However, the waves were so big that I only went in the water once. Unless you're a strong swimmer, you won't want to go in. We only hung out at the pool a couple of times and it was usually noisy cuz of the swim-up bar.

ROOMS:
We were in Pyramid 1 and there are FIVE pyramids. it's a HUGE hotel and I was constantly getting lost. Not every pyramid is connected to every other one, and some are only connected through certain floors but not through others.Very confusing and you practically had to pack a lunch to get from the room to the beach or a restaurant. Be prepared for LOTS of walking.

Our first night there we had a toilet issue. it wouldn't flush properly and it took three calls to the front desk to get it fixed right. The next day when I went to shower, I saw they had one of those huge rainforest shower heads, so I expected a powerful spray. What I got reminded me of an 85 year old man with a prostate problem. They had to fix that too which they did. My advice to you is to get a room in pyramid 1 if you want quiet. If you want action and noise then stay in pyramid 3 where the restaurants, bars, and reception desk are. The ocean view was magnificent.

The staff bug you fairly regularly about coming to their Time Share orientation cuz they want to sell you one. If you politely tell the, no thank you, they back off.

The service in terms of replenishing towels, kleenex, shampoo, etc. on a daily basis was irregular. Some days we got enough of everything, other days we got very little.

HEALTH:
My husband got very sick a few days before we were ready to go -vomitting violently. So I called the Hotel Doctor and he came right up to the room, took a history, put in an IV for fluids and gave him some medicine intravenously. He stayed the whole time the IV was in and was very good and thorough. All for the price of $680 U.S.  Luckily we had travel medical insurance. But don't think that it will be easy to call your insurance company from Mexico, even if there is a 1-800 number. And long distance calls are $9.00 U.S. per MINUTE!

Transfer from airport to hotel:
We had booked a private car through our travel agent before we left - Iberoservice - and they were supposed to be waiting for us when we arrived. there was no sign of them so we asked the Rep. to call the office and check. Long story short, it took the private car 45 minutes to get to the airport and pick us up. We were really pissed. The private car that took us back at the end of the trip was on time tough. I'd stay away from Iberoservice if you can.

I think I've covered just about everything. I'd probably give this hotel a 
7 1/2 out of 10. We're spoiled though, since our last several vacations in Mexico (and elsewhere) have been to Secrets Resorts, which are exceptional in every way. (Secrets Maroma and Secrets Capri were amazing!) Paradisus Cancun is just too big and impersonal to get it all right, but nevertheless it was still a very good vacation.

reviews.author: DCTB1026
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text:
We just returned from a short 4 day 3 night stay.  It was our first tine to Cancun and we had no idea what to expect.  The staff was excellent and always there to offer assistance.  The restaurants were very good.  Although I did not like having to make reservations only a day in advance.  I would have preferred to make them all up front.  The only thing that disappointed us with the food was the desserts as they were not a good as I expected. The service at the Market Grill was outstanding.  the barbeque chicken was excellent.  We did stay on the third floor of tower three.  As other shave noted, it is a little noisy.  But it really did not bother us.  It quieted down about 10.  With the TV on before that you could not really hear anything.  The smoothies at breakfast were fantastic.  I highly recommend the "Energy Drink".

The only detraction that prevents an excellent rating was that the rooms could use an update.  We did have trouble with our room safe on the first day.  It took them about an hour to fix.  Would have been nice to be able to enjoy the beach at sunset on our first day.  Oh well, the rest of the visit made up for it.

One other small annoyance was that none of the pools were open in the evenings. I would recommend at least one of them be open until at least 8 or 9.

We will request the Royal Service on our next visit.  And, there will be a next visit.

reviews.author: wanttobetheir
reviews.title: Nice but not that nice
reviews.text: My friends and I stayed here Feb.15th to the 22nd. We used his time share. To get there we went on a shuttle I had not used before but I will use it all the time now. Canada Transfers was awesome, 3 of us pd when we got to the hotel, had ice cold beers for a buck each and a cold towel. When we arrived we were taken to a lounge and had to wait for a half hour then went to check in. At check in we were told the extra room was more money when they had told us it was included. Not a good start. The rooms were ok. But if your there just for a room and not all incl. stay at the Marriott next door much better rooms. This hotel has a great pool and looks nice inside. But make sure u go down and save a chair really early or u don't get one. The swim up bar gets real busy so the wait is long. They do have good shows at nite but u need to get there 1hr early or no good seats left. If u are not all incl. they treat u pretty bad. We did the all incl. the last 2days so it was a little better. The food was ok. The service at the buffet so so. But the steak resturant was very good and service great. The maid we had was the best, keep the rooms very clean. The weight room and spe were very good. This hotel is ok but I would not want to go back.  Doug (Ut.)

reviews.author: Thava K
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!!!
reviews.text: The total experience on the hotel was just fantastic. All staffs were friendly not to mention the splendid luxuriousness of the hotel. Food was great, Lunch could have been little bit more variety every day but was delicious. Breakfast was out of the world. All fine dining restaurants were top notch. Booking was easy. Internet was great in rooms and free. I was only asked once to buy timeshare and then never bothered. The pool was great and the pool bar was fantastic. No one expected a tip but please do tip. I would highly highly recommend this place to anyone. I did not try the SPA hence can't give my opinion on that.

reviews.author: R W
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: This was our first time here and enjoyed it very much.  Starting at the beginning - we used the hotel shuttle (Tropical Incentives). Good value & they were waiting for us when we walked out of the airport. Check in was a breeze. No waiting. First room they gave us was ground floor, asked to be switched - no problem, they handled it right away. We are vegetarian so normally eating at all-inclusives tends to have mostly meat options and we have to ask for special adjustments. This buffet was great. Food was very fresh. Happy with the options. We only went to 2 restaurants - Vento and Bana. Waiters were great at both restaurants. Told them we were vegetarian and they looked after our meal for us. Wonderful service! Beach was FANTASTIC! Never had a problem getting a palapa and we usually got to the beach around 10am. Sometimes had to look for chairs but it wasn't a big deal. Drink service on the beach but not food service, however, you can go to the poolside snack bar, get your food and bring it to the beach. If you book a room with a pull out sofa, be prepared to ask them for a cot. The mattress on the pullout was very thin & looked extremely uncomfortable. Shuttle to leave was right on time. Have to mention Jesus Arzeta and Jorge Martinez De Naos Auw who work as servers in the buffet. Very friendly and wonderful service. Can't say enough about how great the staff is here. Highly recommend this resort. We would go back! Thank you Paradisus for a great vacation!

reviews.author: tanlee
reviews.title: WOW
reviews.text:
Spent 1 week at this fabulous resort in bldg 2. Great location. Far enough away from the noise, but close to the "action". Rooms are large. Had lagoon view. Why spend extra on ocean view when you can see the ocean while on the beach.
Adults atmosphere. Not a party place. Take bus to town for night life. 20pesos for 2 one way.  Avenue bar host great shows in evening. Michael Jackson show is sensational.The "circle de soleil" inspired show also great. Come early for a seat otherwise you may have obstructed view. Lounge staff are very attentive especially server Karina and bartender Israel. Mole restaurant was delicious. Waiter Jose and hostess Sonia were pleasant and helpful in assisting us with our menu options. 
Beach and pool areas are very clean. Many servers in both areas. Lots of loungers. If towels kept on loungers for a longer time without personal itmes, staff would collect to provide space for other guests. Gym gets busy in the mornings.
Fabulous time.  Enjoy!!

reviews.author: Piddeaux
reviews.title: Highly Recommended
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the hotel. I am not sure if we had a really good deal but I think the amenities provided for the price paid were great. The service was incredible. Very sweet and helpful and hard working people. Great beach and pool, good food, and I loved having so many restaurants to choose from. I would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: frank b
reviews.title: Most Pleasant!
reviews.text:
We have just returned from a great holiday at Paradisus.  Our check-in was done quickly and we were promptly assigned our room. Prior to our arrival, I was advised that we might consider the Royal Service, to ask for top floors, to go to the adult only tower, not to stay in tower three because of the noise  but decided against all the warnings. We found ourselves in tower three where all the activities were held and where the majority of restaurants were housed. The noise level quieted down around ten o'clock and we had a great stay with all the conveniences at hand.   The staff, right across the board, from the room maids, the restaurant and bar people; all were most pleasant and always very polite. Additionally, we were impressed by the presentation and quality of food in all the restaurants.
Although entering the main atrium was very impressive with its restaurants, shops, etc., it would be important to note that the rooms though clean and comfortable would need a bit of refreshing, not that this deterred in any away from our having a great holiday.
The location of the hotel is perfect and safe. Just a short bus ride to shopping centers and perfect for long strolls along the ocean front.
The only thing I disliked over my ten day sojourn was the vying with other patrons for beach or pool chairs. The only way around this was to place towels on chairs at six o'clock in the morning. Might I challenge the hotel to find a solution to this situation,  making it more pleasant for all patrons.
Salutations to Antonio at the buffet, to Diego our waiter, Mario the manager  and Francisco our bartender at Ibana, Rody-Leo at Mole& Tacos.

reviews.author: Geneva B
reviews.title: Wit was just wonderful.
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed there in February and we had a great time.  The staff treated us like royalty.  The hotel is beautiful. The hotel always smelled really good. The food was wonderful. We really enjoyed the all you can eat dinning. I have stayed in other all inclusive hotel but this hotel was the best. The waiter Jesus and concierge women name Bianica was wonderful.  My only concern was the room. JR suite was okay. .

reviews.author: Family trippers
reviews.title: Nice update, quality place
