reviews.text: We spent last week at Paradisus, formerly known as the Gran Melia, in Cancun. I was pleasantly surprised by the transformation. When we had stayed in past I found the service to be below par of other comparable resorts in area where we had stayed before, also found the food/restaurant selection to be severely lacking, but not this time. From the minute you walked in front door you could feel the difference, the way in which they met you at door with warm/damp towels to refresh face, to the easy check in process. And loved the updated number of restaurants and the fact that they added varying live entertainment in the Avenue Bar. Favorite is still Coccoa's bar at end of day, amazing view. Staff and management were great to us, went out of way to help with a few small things we needed help with (thanks again Fred!). Would recommend going back to anyone looking for a nice time, good value, beautiful beach.

reviews.author: A F
reviews.title: Good hotel, if you can get it on sale
reviews.text: The food and service were very good.  The lagoon view is a waterview.  That was nice.  It overlooked a mini golf course and road, but the water was on the other side of the road. We did have to switch rooms twice.  The first problem was a ton of water on the floor of the room.  There was a hole in one of the walls, it was rotting and the dry wall crumbling.  After a heavy rain the floor was soaked.  The second room smelt very musty and I couldn't deal with that for the price we were paying.  The third room was fine...we hoped by this time we might receive compensation of some kind, but no such luck.  The beach was great and we didn't have any trouble finding seats and shade.  The drink service on the beach was good, although sometimes a little slow.

reviews.author: Kimberly Z
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach, Average Resort
reviews.text:
My husband, toddler daughter, and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from March 12-16.  Our flight was delayed and we arrived around 6 pm.  We had no problems with check in and were taken straight to our room.  

The resort – My husband likened the layout of the central “pyramid” to an Embassy Suites.  The doors to the room face inward and there is ivy flowing over the sides of the interior balconies.  Unlike other resorts we’ve been to (both AI and non AI), there are no comfortable lounging areas where guests can hang out, chat, order drinks and snacks from waiters.  There is a tiny bar in the middle of the central atrium.  This area also contains the Japanese restaurant and you have to vacate the tables at 6 pm for diners.  There are timeshare people throughout the resort but they were not aggressive about getting us to sit through a presentation.  There aren’t any green spaces or outdoor lounging spaces, either.  The entire property is taken up by the huge edifice and pool areas.

The room - We reserved a deluxe junior suite with a lagoon view and were given an ocean view room.  However, the room was on the first floor so our view was obstructed by the roof of the restaurant below.  While it was clean, it was dated and didn’t fit with the ‘luxury’ atmosphere that the resort purports to have.  The mini bar was stocked with soft drinks, water, and beer.  At other AI resorts I’ve stayed at in the Cancun/Playa area, hard alcohol was provided in the room.  I understand that this is only provided to those who upgrade to Royal Service.  The beds and pillows were not comfortable.  The water in the shower would not run from the faucet, only the shower heads.  There was a bidet in the area with the toilet which made that area crowded.  Our room overlooked one of the restaurants in the atrium below so it would get pretty loud in the mornings when they staff was setting up for the day.  We were also right off the main lobby and down the hall from the night club so we could hear the music at night.  It never lasted into the wee hours, though.  Housekeeping was cursory in my opinion.  We were never provided with enough towels and I had to call regularly to have more provided.  They failed to come until late afternoon on our last day and I had to decline because my child was napping.  

Dining - Breakfast consists of the buffet.  It was very good and provided many options (although to my husband’s disappointment, there was no bacon).  We liked to sit outside during breakfast and lunch and the service was great.  Lunch consisted of the buffet and you can order from the Market Grill menu if you sit outside.  Dinner options included the buffet or reservations at one of the specialty restaurants.  We dined at Ibana and Fuego.  Ibana was ok and we weren’t able to finish our meal at Fuego through no fault of theirs.

Pool and Beach – The pool area is very large.  There are three sections and one is exclusive to Royal Service.  We spent most of our time at the beach and we never had an issue getting loungers.  The beach was beautiful, one of the best we’ve been to.  I loved that they didn’t use towel cards but depending on who is manning the towels, you may be restricted to how many you can have.  There is drink service on the beach and waiters come through at regular intervals.  

Overall, we had a good vacation.  Everyone we met was kind and provided great service.  However, the amenities that we like in a resort were lacking so we probably will not stay at the Paradisus on our next trip to Cancun.

reviews.author: EV1970294478
reviews.title: A bit dissapointed
reviews.text:
I would have given this resort more stars but...  We were supposed to get a room upgrade for being an EXPEDIA VIP member. At check in they said they didnt have any, etc. Then they said they were going to "Upgrade" me to an ocean view room (which is what I originally paid for).
Tired of arguing, plus a long flight we decided to take the room. Bathroom lights didnt work, one of the hot water faucets didnt work, and mini-firdge not working. So I go back and tell them I dont care about where they move us just give another room. 2 days later they inform me that the general manager was looking for me. He apologizes and says he's got me a Junior suite and will take care of moving all our stuff (This is the upgrade I should have gotten on day one..!)  From here on everything is looking great. Enjoyed the food, the restaurants were nice, the drinks were well made and strong (not watered down), and the staff service great (I must say the staff in general were excellent). So, everything great and would have forgotten the "hiccup at checking".   I checked out the day we left and paid all extra charges we had.  Well..... when I got back home and check my credit card statement there was a $300 dollar charge that I never made. After 2 months of disputing and calling CITIBANK the resort finally acknowledge they "accidentally" ran and charged my card erroneously at one of their restaurants (There is one restaurant that is not ALL Inclusive as well as any bottles of wine you consume at any restaurants).
To this day I m still waiting The whole charge settled with the credit card company.
Dont think I will return.  Too bad because it is a nice resort.

reviews.author: joy m
reviews.title: Luxury,comfort,fun!
reviews.text: We have traveled to Cancun on many occasions to and will always return to the Paradisus. The check in is always seamless, with a heartfelt thank you to Betsy, Lolita, Ivette and all of the staff at check in.  Our concierge , Arturo was quick to introduce himself with a big smile and an offer to help us with dinner reservations, ect.   The pool areas are stunning... well laid out with plenty of space. The beach area is impeccable with a choice for full sun, or covered huts for shade.  If you walk along the beach..the Paradisus stands out as the best maintained property along the hotel zone.  The room was comfortable and the bedding is very nice.  The food here is outstanding.  Bana is just outrageous.  The atmosphere and service, led by Mario and his staff are superb. Mole , the Mexican restaurant was also great. Rody and his staff are also at the top of their game. And the little Blue Agave was outstanding.  Thank you to our "angel" Gabriel! They all took such excellent care of us.  And.... Don't be afraid of the buffet! The choices are outstanding for breakfast, lunch, dinner or that late snack...our morning waiters Jesus and Thomas were also just great.  We dined at Tempo one night and it is not on the all inclusive.  It rivals any of the finest gourmet restaurants of the world.. I enjoyed the tasting menu with wine pairing...just outstanding. Carlos , the wine expert made a fine selection for us. Egnacio and Webster.. The best. I wish that I could recognize all of the servers because they are just that good!  They have a variety of shows in the evening... All were good. The gym is nice, clean and plenty of space. And ...the Yhi Spa... What can I say.. A little slice of heaven on earth.  We recommended and traveled with two couples who were equally impressed with the property. Just one problem....we had to leave and return to  the cold northeast!  We look forward to our next visit to our very favorite ... The Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: JimandPhyllis3636
reviews.title: A Cruise Ship on the Beach
reviews.text:
This wasa last-minute alternative to a Windstar cruise out of Barbados (which we cancelled to avoid the latest mosquito-borne deadly virus invading the eastern Caribbean).  JetBlue's Getway service made expeditious arrangements for this "all inclusive" trip that rivaled any of the best cruise lines. Except for a few glitches at the reservation desk involving room switches (we got keys to a room occupied by another couple, for example), the gracious service, pools and beaches and  variety of restaurants made it a wonderful destintion resort.
The architecture by itself is amazing to behold.  There are five separate buildings, all shaped like Mayan pyramids connected by enclosed links.  I was fascinated by the detailed artwork, sculptured walls and indoor gardens that led me to explore each of the buildings.  Our room in Building One was ample, clean,  overlooking the lagoon from a balcony that had its own private jacuzzi.
We observed that this Melia hotel must cater to a younger crowd and young families, with even a special section and services for kids.  There is also a section for guests who paid for upgrades that is blocked off from us commoners, and another for members of the Melia Club, a sort of time-share which we heard all about first morning, but declined.  The obvious stratification of guest levels  made us a bit uncomfortable, but not enough to kill our enjoyment. 
One diferent feature of the hotel staff occurred each time one would greet you - with a gesture of putting one hand over the heart as they said a courteous hello.  I'd never seen that before and it appeared sincere and resectful, certainly welcome.
Like a cruise ship, eating is featured.  Paradisus has a 23/7 buffet overlooking the beach, and seven other restaurants (one with a surcharge) that are available, with bar service,  in the inclusive package.  Each has a different cuisine, from straight Mexican to Brazilian to sushi to a steak house.  Our experience was that all served excellent dishes with prompt and courteous table service.  Reservations are usually needed, but hostesses may find a spare table for two before or after prime dining hours.  
Several tour services are located in the lobby area, to arrange day trips off-site.  We took several, to Chichen Itza, a center of  Mayan  civilization that we never learned about in school, a catamaran  trip to Las Mujeres, an offshore island, and a snorkeling expedition, disappointing only because the reefs are dying and fish are few.     
Try out the spa on site, a beautiful, peaceful place with exceptional services at reasonable prices.

reviews.author: WD27
reviews.title: Great Service, perfect location!
reviews.text:
If you're staying here and not paying for the Royal Service, well,........ You could always stay elsewhere.

Being that I'm madly in love with Hawaii, I was quite hesitant to be in Mexico and at first felt a little like I was cheating on my life's partner. Well,...... let's just say, taking a sample of a different menu can often be fruitful!

Seriously, this place is nutz!! Sooo beautiful! Soooo welcoming, soo inviting, near perfect.

Where to begin?,.... oh yeah... choosing your stay. The perks of the Royal Service outweigh everything else, so I'm glad that's where I was and can't imagine anything else. If you go to the melia website, you'll note that it states: Unparalleled. All-encompassing, Elevated, Preferential and Private specifically for Royal Service tower. This is no joke and I know because I was there.  

You arrive at this all-inclusive and if it's busy like it was when I arrived than sadly, you have to wait in line to check in. (4 stars because of a few little things.... this is one of them... little things do add up) Okay, so you check in, you get a cute little bracelet (signifying which bldg to which you belong), you get your butler and you're in heaven..... paradise.

Paradisus boasts a bunch of fantastic restaurants for any palate. It has a little store downstairs. A spa is great place to truly forget the bill you'll pay at the end of your stay and for some laughs, there's entertainment... At Christmastime, it was a special dedicated to MJ. Obviously, the music we all know and love and good dancers but the Michael they had..... boy oh boy.. waaaay too short to make you forget that your not looking at Michael (<--- even though he was wearing a prosthetic on his face to become MJ's twin). Anyways, it was an awesome production in a small space and definitely helped you to feel like you didn't need to leave the resort for a thing.

Later on, after dinner (secured by reservations), we even went dancing at one of the bars/clubs.... great music, crap dance floor but when you're at an all-inclusive, you take things as they come.

The room was very clean, there's English TV (watched a marathon on Big Bang when it rained one day).... And then there's the pool.

So, the beach in front of the hotel is incredible but if you can't convince your butler to carry you down there and you don't feel like schlepping your bumbum down there, well,..... there's the pool. First of all, order the Guacamole and Tacos. YUM!!!!!! Bring sunscreen or prepare to be baked and burnt and lastly, go get your chairs by the pool nice and early as much like at most hotel pools, seats will be gone and you'll be out of luck. Here's another tidbit, Royal Service folks have their own pool!!! No kiddies allowed! Sorry!!!

Honest to goodness, until I make it to Bali, Bora Bora, Fiji... I'll continue to do Hawaii every year, but without question, there's always room in a year to take a tiny jaunt to Cancun and should you make it so, Paradisus should be your choice. The room is definitely not the high end of luxury but again, that's not why people go to Mexico.

Happy travels!
WD

reviews.author: ematchey
reviews.title: Meets Expectations
reviews.text:
I felt I got what I paid for with this hotel and had a great time. I would recommend this hotel to others. 

CHECK-IN: we arrived on Tuesday afternoon. there was no wait for check in. it was very pleasant, we were offered cool aromatic hand towels and a cocktail. our room was ready right away. they also offer a time share presentation, if you've done this before you know to stay away. 

ATMOSPHERE: the guests are pretty diverse, i noticed a good mix of americans/europeans, as wells as young and older couples. families with kids are present but hardly any that cause disturbance...probably in part b/c there is a separate kiddie pool. the hotel feels upscale and the staff is very friendly (on average). There were some renovations happening at the hotel during our stay, though they were not a huge distractions: palm trees being planted, coco bar being repaired/renovated. another up side do this hotel in cancun, is that it is one of the larger properties, if you like walking the grounds. 

FOOD/RESTAURANTS: the buffet is so so. neither awful nor great, its really old by day 7. one highlight at breakfast, was teh smoothie counter that offered healthy concocktions or would make you a custom smoothie on request. other buffet options included omelette bar, pasta bar, meat grilled to order, but again food was not anything i would want seconds of. restaurants are better. we found Vento to be the best (offers tapas, which was nice since you can taste a few things). Fuego was okay (filet mignon was really good, fish not so much). Bana is good if you dont eat sushi very often and do not know what quality sushi should taste like. Its not that its bad, i enjoyed it, just doesnt taste like the sushi you would get in NYC/Boston/Northeast restaurants. Blue Agave did was ok, its just tacos. Mole was excellent ... we ordered extra scallop appetizer b/c it was so good. don't remember what else ate for main course but we liked it. we felt this restaurant offered the best dessert, 3 layer vanilla cake (?). We did not get to the Brazilian, La Perla or Tempo (this last one is not included in all inclusive). 

ROOMS: we stayed in jr ocean view suites, rooms 3351 & 3302. both had great views of the beach.  rm 3351 overlooks the buffet roof which is not super ugly but would be distracting to a photographer. if you leave your balcony door open you can wake up to the sound of crashing waves in the morning, very nice :-). sizewise, the rooms are small but big enough for 2 people. pretty good condition, though small signs of aging are showing (water discoloration on the faucet, cracked sink, mold on the curtains). reference the pictures. reviews on the noise levels are accurate, especially in rm 3351... we could hear music from the show very well. if you are light sleepers request rooms further away (e.g. not tower 3).  

BARS: top shelf liquor available by request (belevedere , centenario, don julio ...). cocktail drinks are ok, other resorts make you fresh fruit drinks, not here. no cocktail menu either.  

BEACH/POOLS: beach is beautiful, wide, pretty clean, water is an amazing color. waves get rough here, red flags were up most of our stay. you could still go in but you have to be really careful with the undertow. do NOT recommend this beach or Cancun in general for small children unless you will keep them by the pool or holding them the entire time (and even then...). beach/pool chairs ...yes its true , if you want a decent chair you had better nominate someone in your party to get up at the crack of dawn (not kidding here) to reserve some chairs. talking to the guests it seems like this is norm at Cancun hotels. no complaints on the pools, take note they are pretty deep (5.1-5.97 ft deep)

ENTERTAINMENT/ACTIVITIES: there are activities and nightly shows. the activities are exactly the same day to day (zumba, volleyball, soccer, aerobics, etc.) There are definitely people participating, but the "party" factor is nothing like neighboring close by Oasis (crazy spring break orgy here) or Hard Rock (slightly older and probably more affluent crazy partiers there). nightly shows were different every night and happened at the Avenue bar, the space felt a bit cramped but also had a nice informal feel to it. as to the quality, its what you'd expect from most nightly shows at Caribbean destinations: dance groups performing michael jackson shows, traditional mexican dances, flamenco groups, etc. I personally really enjoy these, but i have heard others criticize the quality.

reviews.author: Gonzalez_Grande
reviews.title: Absolute Paradise. Elite staff treats their guests like royalty.
reviews.text: Each October for the past five years in a row my wife and I have gone on vacation. This was our first visit to Cancun. A close friend told us about the Paradisus all inclusive resort and their royal service. I am sure glad he did. We went this past October and from the moment we arrived we were treated like royalty. They made my wife and I feel like we were their most important guests and they were constantly there to serve us. The service from each and every member of the Paradisus was amazing but Natalia (front desk/assistant manager), Hector (private butler/concierge) and David (pool manager/concierge) really went above and beyond to ensure that our visit was nothing less than perfect. We were so impressed that we immediately booked again and recently returned from our 18 year wedding anniversary which was also Valentines day weekend. As busy business owners and proud parents of young children my wife and I just wanted to be able to relax. The entire facility has aromatherapy sprayers so there is a peaceful fragrance wherever you go. The royal service building and pools are adult only and so relaxing you could hear a pin drop. They have ocean front king size bali beds suspended in cabana huts. All you hear is the ocean splashing on the beach. They have all inclusive top shelf liquor and gourmet food available poolside and our glass was never empty. The 8 restaurants were all incredible as was the 24 hour room service. Guaranteed you will not find a better resort anywhere. We brought a couple with us in February and we have already booked again for this coming October 2014 and another couple will be joining us. The Paradisus will be our home at least twice a year from now on. It is hard to find perfection but we found it here. We can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Anthony M
reviews.title: Great Getaway
reviews.text: I just returned from my stay at Paradisus and I must say it was a great stay. I traveled with my girlfriend for our spring break trip and this resort lived up to all of the hype with a few minor setbacks. Upon arrival we had to wait passed the 3 o'clock check in, which was a little bit disappointing but we were allowed to enjoy the pool during our wait. Once in our ocean front room we found half full water bottles in our fridge and the bathtub plug was not put in correctly. We quickly called the front desk and they were very apologetic and came to fix the issues immediately. After somewhat of a rocky start the day did get much better with fantastic service at the pool bar and delicious sushi within the atrium. Over the next four days we found the staff to be very friendly and helpful and they were always making it their mission to see us satisfied. The food by the pool is great and so is the service of the bartenders especially Simon. The one negative was that everyday their was a board of activities listed but for the most part they did not happen except for zumba and water aerobics. This was a bit of a bummer for us as we were looking forward to doing some fun things in the sun. The restaurants Mole, Vento, and and BlueAgave were very good and making a reservation was quick and easy. One of the waiters even overheard that it was my girlfriends birthday on Saturday and they surprised us with a cake and a birthday song. There were many excursions available i.e. scuba diving, swimming with dolphins, jet skis, but everything was an additional charge. Overall, the staff was fantastic, the property was beautiful, food and drink great, just wish there were more things to do!

reviews.author: Bendana
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: I went to Paradisus for my birthday last year . The place is wonderful. I stayed in the all adult section, while my friends stayed in the main building. We were able to make dinner reservations for the 10 of us through my butler and that was fantastic. I love being able to get breakfast and drinks from downstairs without going through the main hotel. The restaurants were really good especially Tempo. I would definitely return, but might try another location.

reviews.author: marenko
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: MY mom and I were at this resort from November 22nd to the 29th. We were immediately upgraded to the royal service with a butler. We travel at least 3 times a year and alway book at the Melia resorts so as a thank you this is what we got.  We had booked an ocean view . The view was amazing ,as was the room. The resort itself was beautiful and the food was great. The only down fall of this resort is that they have no outdoor patio at night to drink at and no entertainment. . At times I found it boring. The upgrade was nice and had I not gotten it free , I would never pay for it really don't see a difference in service other than they separate you to a difference tower of the hotel and you have a butler. Our butler would leave us  chocolate covered strawberries in our room and little gifts. Thank you Samuel for your laughs and you going out of your way . Overall this hotel is nice .Would I go back? no , Cancun was not for me. Ocean was beautiful but cannot swim in it .  However I would recommend this hotel for anyone that plans to go and needs a place to stay while they venture out into town to party.

reviews.author: PPMJAY09
reviews.title: A nice getaway
reviews.text: We stayed from 2/1-2/5 it was a very nice resort. The resort was clean and the staff was friendly. The restaurants were good if not great (I liked the Brazilian steakhouse, my wife liked the Mexican).  The bar was well stocked and top shelf if you asked for it.  We liked that there were no towel cards.  We had a beautiful beach front room.  The only negative was that the beds were mushy and we could not get a good nights sleep. This made for a nice little getaway to break up the winter. I would return to this resort.

reviews.author: Tim K
reviews.title: GREAT VACATION
reviews.text: Overall this is a great resort. We stayed in the Royal Services area and the word says itself. They treated us like royalty. From the food to the butler service to the shops to the wait staff  everything was awesome. I also wanted to say that the Manager Fred went completely out of his for everyone there. I never seen a resort manager so involved in everything. He is absolutely a true asset to this resort. I will recommend this place to all my friends and family that wants to go to Cancun. Thanks again everyone there you are all AWESOME!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: waleed1976
reviews.title: Amazing Place
reviews.text: This was my first time in Cancun  . Can’t say enough about the Hotel and about the Royal Service we got . What an amazing experience We are going back for sure this year . Fred, Hector, Victor , Alexandro, Moses and everyone at the hotel  THANK YOU FOR A GREAT TIME .

reviews.author: yyt777
reviews.title: Great food, drinks & service
reviews.text:
I just returned from my Cancun vacation at the Paradisus (3/1 - 3/9).  I traveled with a group of 8 adults and everyone was very impressed with the entire experience.   We travel two - three times per year and have stayed at many resorts.  The Paradisus is one of the top rated resort by far. The hotel is very clean, offers a great variety of foods, restaurants with quality liquor.  I've stayed at more pricier hotels for a lot less. The staff is wonderful, extremely hard working and always went out of their way for the customer.  Even the COO was out walking the pool area chatting with customers.  We asked him for a special request and he followed through immediately.  It was also impressive to hear the staff speak very highly of the hotel and the COO-  Which was evident by the service they provided.

I definitely recommend this resort and plan on returning next year.

I want to give praise to Edgar Fabian Perez, Jose, Guillermo, and the COO! 

Keep up the great job!

reviews.author: Jelostaz
reviews.title: WOW !!! What a great place to stay
reviews.text: I have been all over the world , and going to Cancun for the first time was like blah !! But WOW I must admit I am blown away by the city and how clean it is . And the Hotel staff and service was amazing . Bar none one of the best trips I have ever taken and one of the best hotels I have stayed at . From Fred to hector , Moses , Alejandro and a lot more . Thank you for making this trip me memorable .

reviews.author: LL L
reviews.title: great vacation
reviews.text: Overall this is a great resort. There were a few things that were not 100% but nothing that couldn't be overlooked.  Pool bartender Rogelio was great! He made interesting and fun drinks and was quick even when the bar was full. Cocos is an outdoor bar overlooking the beach that looks like a tiki hut and gets lively after the sun goes down. The bartender Enrique was very helpful answering all of our questions about the how the resort works. My only complaints were that the food wasn't great, except Blue Agave. We should have eaten there every night but I wanted to give everything a chance. For some reason every morning and evening around 6:30 the room we stayed in smelled unbelievably horrid. We think this may have been when they were emptying the septic tanks.

reviews.author: Joseph R
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: We were very disappointed with the room we were given at check in. It looked like a garage and the view from the balcony was a wall. We received better accommodations after we expressed our displeasure with the reception desk. It was not the best way to start a relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Janette300
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Just spend four nights at the Paradisus Cancun.  We did the Royal service.  Sigiro was our private butlet who was awesome.  The room was big great patio very large, service was excellent.  We had a phone that we could call our butler which we didn't even use but nice.  We ate at the Market Grill one night.  The hostess was Giovanna who was very nice and our waiter was Mesero-Nataneal, Luis was excellent.  Food was great.  We also ate at Mole and had 3 guys who came in and played at each table and sung which were awesome.  The beach is great and you can have your on Cabanna.  There is a bar and restaurant at the pool which you can eat at your cabanna or at a table.  Beautiful property and great service.  They also have a spa which we went to the hydo-spa which was relaxing.  Great trip very quiet at the adult pool.  There were children but we didn't see much of them.  Would definitely go back.  They also had entertainment every night.  Had a stocked bar and buffet in our section and room service was great.  Also had turn down service at night.

reviews.author: Donna C
reviews.title: What a vacation!
reviews.text: My sister and I had the best time!  The food was great and the service was excellent.  It was so relaxing sitting by the pool watching the amazing views.  I would definately recommend this hotel. There could have been more lounge chairs and shade areas.  Needed two chairs in the room patio which had a beautiful view of the ocean.

reviews.author: barannwi
reviews.title: Loved our week at Paradisus!!
reviews.text:
The view from our (Ocean View Deluxe Junior Suite) was fantastic  We had requested a king bed our room had two queen beds. The room is spacious but I didn't consider it a suite, the balcony is large but has only one lounger needs two. The beach is very clean and beautiful. It needs more lounger. Service on the beach for drinks was good,
The staff was wonderful and our request were taking care of quickly. Room service was timely usually 30 minutes.The food was very good many choices. The entertainment for the most part was for younger people. The atrium area is beautiful. I will say again the staff did a great job and did it with a smile.

reviews.author: Jennifer A
reviews.title: Beautiful stretch of beach that includes a resort.
reviews.text:
Great beach. We stayed in a royal suite. Nothing special. Hyatt quality. Butler service was non existent. I recommend reserving your first nights dinner and first two days of cabana use in advance before your stay. We were unable to take advantage of these "all inclusive" paid for perks. The hotel will try to push time shares and tours so be prepared. We were bothered by phone calls by staff making us aware of the gift they had to offer when we visit the courtesy counter. Being awakened by the call upset the morning... oh and the evening to make sure we had slippers and did we visit the counter yet... and in the afternoon to see if we received our robes. Stop bugging us. Let us relax. We already chose the spot, no need to keep trying to sell it. 
Overall now that I know what over $600 a night all inclusive includes, I would say I would stay again at a reduced rate.

reviews.author: Travellercw
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This resort is outstanding! I have been twice now in the last 2 months. The staff are very friendly and helpful! The open buffet is always great, and they have a great BBQ by the pool side where you can get the best guacamole. I travel for work and I'd say this has been one of the best hotels by far. The rooms are modern and very spacious. Just walking into this resort you would be amazed, a great variety of restaurants and drinking spots. I am asked on the daily about what are the best hotels and this one I would recommend one hundred percent. Thank you for the amazing experience!

reviews.author: Circlo7
reviews.title: Great all inclusive hotel
reviews.text: What a nice place to stay.  The staff was very helpful.  The hotel was very clean, organized and worthy of many stays.  It is minutes away from downtown Cancun and is definitely one of the nicer hotels that I have stayed at.  Great pools, great beach and great restaurants.

reviews.author: gene35
reviews.title: Viva Mexico
reviews.text:
Went with my girlfriend and son and we had a fabulous time. Every thing was wonderful. Would go back tomorrow. The food was fabulous. The beach was beautiful. The drinks 
Were flowing. Told my family and friends to go here if they have a chance. All inclusive is the way to go

reviews.author: Scott M
reviews.title: Underwhelming!
reviews.text: We paid for the Royal Service w/butler. Not worth it! Extremely slow check-in process, smoky room (would not change rooms), stained pillows, broken drawers, poor to no internet service, frig. not stocked daily, clogged drains, etc. Had to call 3 times just to get extra pillows. Woke up at 3 a.m. to a beeping safe, never fixed! The employees were nice, but just told you what you wanted to hear. No follow up, very frustrating. The 2 positives were the beach and pool area are beautiful and the food was good!

reviews.author: Kyla K
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradice
reviews.text: Went to Paradisus with my boyfriend and another couple. Had a lovely experience. Staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. More of a family and couple oriented resort, but you can still find a party. Enrique from Avenue bar and Antonio from the Red Lounge were over the top excellent, best service we have ever received. Lots of fun activities to do very close to the resort, ie. parasailing, sea-dooing, jungle tour, coco bongo, scuba diving and much more! Majority of the rooms have a beautiful view. We requested to have our two rooms close together and close to the beach.. Our rooms were conjoined and it was impossible to be any closer to the beach. Very happy that they listened to our request. SUGGEST getting beach chairs asap in the morning, they go fast. And make reso for the restaurants a day in advance as they go fast as well. All restaurants were delicious, LOVED Vento, a tapas bar. Buffet was great as well, so many selections that changed daily. 24 hour free room service for all inclusive was convenient but not the best. Stay away from the late night nachos and fries. Felt VERY safe here, guards at the front gate 24/7 making sure you were a guest, the pizza delivery guys couldn't even come in! Needless to say that we would come back here in a heartbeat and even consider buying a time share here. Luxury at its finest.

reviews.author: Renita G
reviews.title: Great Resort, Excellent Beach
reviews.text:
When booking our vacation we had three requirements, great pool, nice beach and a pool bar.  Paradisus delivered on all three plus more.  The food, rooms, atmosphere and service were all top notch.  The atrium is beautiful and sets the stage for the entire experience.  

Food - Our travel agent had told us we would be pleased with the food at the resort.  Living in a big city we are accustomed to eating in fine restaurants and Paradisus did not disappoint.  Our favorite restaurant was Vento.  We loved the tapas options and really enjoyed trying many different dishes.  Blue Agave was a great place to get a snack with tacos made to order right in front of you and the margaritas were amazing.    Bento had excellent sushi and we loved the atmosphere with several tables tucked into the beautiful atrium.  Mole offered authentic Mexican dishes.  We had the grouper and it was fresh and tasty. There was some confusion over the time of our reservation and the restaurant manager quickly accommodated us at the time we arrived. The buffet offered great options at each meal.  We ate dinner there our first evening as we arrived at the resort too late to make a reservation at any of the specialty restaurants for that night.  We were more than pleased with each meal we ate there.    We had no problem making reservations.  We always made them one day ahead as the resort allows you to make reservations for the day of and the next day.   

Beach - the sand and water are beautiful.  Paradisus has an amazing amount of beach frontage.  We originally thought we would alternate our days between the beach and the pool but found we loved securing a palapa on the beach each day.  Laticia was our beach server and she was AMAZING!.  She kept our glasses filled and accommodated any request we made.  We brought Tervis tumblers with us and she was happy to take those to the bar to be filled.   We had read on Trip Advisor that you had to secure your beach/pool chairs early and we found this to be true.  We made sure to secure our beach chairs prior to 7 a.m. each day and always got our first choice.  By 8 a.m. most chairs were reserved.

Pool - The pool layout is excellent.  We were told the resort was at full capacity but the pool never felt crowded. Salvadore at the pool bar was excellent!   He was fun, kept the drinks flowing and he makes a great margarita. The liquor was top shelf and there was no shortage of it.  We met lots of fun people and really enjoyed a few afternoons hanging out here.  

Sunrise - we made a point to get up one morning to fully experience the sunrise.  It was amazing. 

Room - We had a junior suite on the first floor of tower 5.  The room was very large with a separate living area and bedroom.  The mini-bar was restocked daily.  Housekeeping came twice a day and kept us in fresh towels.  We were on the lagoon side which offered great sunset views which was our preference.  We honestly were not in the room very much at all.   We did not opt for Royal Service and while I am sure the extras are nice we were just fine on our own.  Due to the time of year there were very few children in the resort.  

We enjoyed the entertainment in The Avenue bar a few evenings.  The atrium has a great atmosphere at night and it was fun to secure one of the many comfortable seating options after dinner.  The service was top notch throughout the resort.  We left a small beach bag at the pool one day and were pleasantly surprised to find it was turned into lost and found.  

We are experienced travelers who have collectively visited many places in Mexico and the Caribbean.  We would absolutely return to Paradisus for another visit!  Thank you for a wonderful vacation.

reviews.author: Sonya M
reviews.title: 3rd year in a row
reviews.text: We love this resort. We go here every year for the superior food and views! However, We did think the service was lacking this year. We weren't able to get the king bed we booked, so we had to sleep on a double bed. Also, we had some issues checking in. We arrived early, so we checked in at 2:30, and our room was supposed to be ready in a half- hour. At 3 (checking time), they said another half hour. That was frustrating. Also, you really need to keep your do not disturb sign on when you are in the room. Otherwise, they will barge right in and weird times! But, Bianca, from guest services really made up for it. She greeted us with cool towels and made all of our restaurant reservations. Also, Raul, the doorman, was so nice. We appreciated their service. The food is perfect and it's a great time. I would just like to see for next year my vacation getting off to a good start at check in with no issues and friendly service. The service from all the other hotel employees was wonderful.

reviews.author: Jenny N
reviews.title: Great hotel, but not for young children
reviews.text:
This hotel is wonderful, the food is great and the beach is beautiful.  If you're choosing an all-inclusive based on the food (which is what I did), this is a great place.  My only complaint is that it is not very kid friendly.  Our kids are 5 and 7 and we did not do the club Melia thing, so I can't speak to that.  However, the pool is very deep (5') except for two small areas, so it was tough for the kids to swim like I thought they would be able to.  The beach is gorgeous, but while we were there the waves were pretty big, so they couldn't just swim in the ocean.  
My other complaint is that you do receive better service if you tip.  I have no problem tipping, however I like All-Inclusives because you don't have to carry money around!  I have been to other all-inclusives where the staff won't take tips, even when offered.  Here, it felt necessary to tip.  
Overall, we had a wonderful vacation, I just wish I had known that the pool was that deep and that it's not super kid friendly.

reviews.author: G A
reviews.title: Incredible vacation
reviews.text:
Cancun is beautiful. When you arrive at the airport. There are vendors trying to sell time shares. 
Go directly outside for your transportation. We did the all inclusive deal. This hotel is beautiful and clean.  The staff is friendly and very helpful. The food was great. Do not be frighten to come to Cancun.  Just like anywhere, be smart and stay in the tourist areas. The beach is amazing. So nice to have the warm temperature and ocean breeze. The Mexican people are so friendly and always give you a smile. And one thing important........no bugs. At least not this time of year. If you get the chance take the Chicken Itza tour, it was get. The Mayan ruins are amazing. The cost for the day trip is 116.00 USD each. This is a 12 hour trip with a buffet included. We went with BD travel....Hugo the tour guide was great. Paradisus I give an A Plus.  Bianca was wonderful!

reviews.author: Laurenmari F
reviews.title: Recommended
reviews.text: Everything from the food, pool, beach, hospitality and atmosphere was excellent. It would've been nice to have somewhere to eat for breakfast and lunch outside of the buffet that was included. My only complaint is the bed was uncomfortable but not horrible. I definitely recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Mrs J
reviews.title: 'Great Holiday Great Staff Great Complex
reviews.text: My wife and I travelled for the christmas and new year period and it was the first time we had travelled through this time without any family so we were both a bit apprehensive. Need not have worried as wi fi and Face Time solved the family issues and the complex and staff did the rest. Firstly may I say that the food in both the buffet and restaurants was fantastic but make sure you book your table early as they can fill pretty quickly. We even had about four days of rain but it did not dampen our visit as the room service was very efficient so we had a couple of meals in the room and then tended to visit the gym or spa and by that time it was dinner time at the restaurant. As an addition for those who are travelling to Cancun for the first time you must go to Coco Bongos. Tickets are available in the reception and go for the more expensive ones if you dont fancy the shoulder to shoulder of a packed nightclub as these tickets take you upstairs and the drinks are all included. Sorry I digressed. I just need to mention some staff members who were particularly attentive and helpful: Jose @ restaurant Fuego and another Jose at the outdoor breakfast buffet who brought us traditional English tea every morning and bloody marys for our friends but always with a smile. Maria at customer service at MVC Grand Melia (the timeshare part of the Paridisus) who helped us plan our holiday and was a lovely helpful lady. Finally Carlos Alberto Nunez Tun who works at the Cocos beach bar and the atrium and was one of the kindest, nicest people you could wish to meet. It was these people who make the resort what it is and made our holiday what it was. A total recommend to anyone who wishes to visit Cabcun.

reviews.author: Bob L
reviews.title: Stolen Items in our room as we checked out
reviews.text:
We had a great stay at this hotel, it was clean, good service and beautiful views.  However, as the week progressed staff were constantly trying to come in our room at very unusual times.  They even caught us in our underwear a couple of times...They would knock once and then just come right in...BIZARRE 

Seems like everyone and their mother had a key to our room.

The last day, as we checked out, my Wife's wedding band,bracelet and BlackBerry were missing OUT OF THE SAFE.

We called them and they did not find it, which means even if we left it (we didn't) they took it, same thing as stealing.

If you decide to stay there Do not bring anything of value. We stayed in tower 1 on the ground floor definitely BEWARE of that location.

Phone aside, It's just crushing to lose such sentimental pieces :(

reviews.author: markmoose1
reviews.title: Great Stay!!!!!!!!
reviews.text:
I will try to give an honest review of this all inclusive.  I have been to Cancun 6 times, Riviera Maya twice, Cabo once and Dominican Republic once.  All the hotels I stayed at were all inclusive and rate about the same.  Some of the hotels were Riu, Iberostar, Grand Riviera, Oasis, Royal Solaris, and Grand Serinis.  I would give the Paradisus the exact rating that is given on trip advisor.  It is not a 5 but slightly better than a 4.  It is difficult to get a five from me since everything must be perfect.  I am 39 and my wife is 31.  We like to relax and don't need a party scene to have fun.  

Food:  I would give this hotel an above average for food.  My wife and I thought the buffet offered great selections and not the same thing everyday.  I liked the sushi option one day at lunch.  We loved the smoothie section at breakfast.  I had many during the trip.  For the other restaurants, we ate at Mole, Market Grill, Blue Agave, and Vento.  My wife liked Mole the best and I liked Vento.  All offered a unique dinner.  We didn't love everything but they don't deserve some of the bad reviews that I read before my trip.  The Market grill was like a Brazilian restaurant that the waiters bring skewers of meat around for you to try many items.  Nice touch.

Room:  We upgraded from an ocean front to a lagoon view in the Royal Service.  We decided the adult only and multiple amenities offered was worth the money and in our opinion it was!  We loved the food offered throughout the day and drinks available from 7am-????   The room was larger than expected with almost enough size to have a bedroom and TV area if you threw a wall up in the middle.  We had two TV's, one in each area.  The bathroom wasn't anything too fancy but adequate.  The rooms decor wasn't fabulous but overall it was very nice and I can't complain about it.  It is an older hotel so some if the fit and finishes aren't there compared to a brand new hotel.  

Royal Service:  We liked the adult only option, the area of the building was very quiet and the pool/beach section was great.  Getting a bali bed was fabulous.  No towel cards is great too!  The service around the pool was perfect!  Fransisco was awesome the first day we were there but all the staff was great.  We didn't go without a drink or being offered a menu for good.  You get lotion and aloe at the towel station.  We took advantage of this every day.  You have a separate section on the beach too.  Getting a chair wasn't a problem since I am an early riser but they may need some more chairs around the pool.  If you don't have a bali bed reserved, there could be a chance you don't get an optimal spot.  The staff however will try their best to get you chairs.  

Our Butler Galdino was very helpful.  He reserved our restaurants and bali beds even without us asking so we could get them reserved and wouldn't miss out.  One night they had chocolate covered strawberries available but the next night they didn't have any.  We asked Galdino about them and he went above and beyond and brought us some freshly made strawberries.  It was great!  Then the next night when we were at dinner he left another plate of them in our room and wished us a nice evening.  Top notch service!!!!!!  We did not elect to get the cell phone to call the butler since we didn't want to risk losing it.  It is a nice option.  The "help yourself" bar was awesome.  No one can complain about weak drinks if you are mixing them yourself whenever you want!!!!!  All the drinks were very good.  Top shelf is available and a good selection.

Beach:  The beach in Cancun is great, one of the best.  The beach at Paradisus is huge and well kept.  If a great beach is a must have for your trip, you won't be disappointed.  

Entertainment:  There is a show every night at the Avenue bar.  It isn't set up to accommodate a large volume of people.  This is the only potential down grade versus some of the other hotels we have stayed at.  Many had outdoor venues but this was a much smaller scale.  The entertainment was decent and we enjoyed the Micheal Jackson night.  

Property:  The location is good, only a short bus ride to restaurants and shopping.  A cab is a little pricey at $12 or 130 pesos.  The grounds are well kept and there are always many people cleaning and making improvements to the landscape.

Overall, you can't go wrong with this hotel.  I would rate it a 4.25-4.5 if I could.  You won't have a problem having a relaxing trip at this hotel.  Don't worry about booking it.

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: A great resort just gets better each year!
reviews.text:
This was our fourth stay at Paradisus/Melia Cancun and our first time writing a review.  We have stayed at 2 other top-rated (and more expensive) resorts in the Hotel Zone but they just don’t have the winning combination of service, amenities, food, and a great beach that we found at Paradisus.  It starts with a staff that is dedicated to making you feel welcome and at home.  They find a way to say “yes” where other resorts are quick to tell you what you can’t do. We met Fred Boutouba, the operations manager, who greeted us during our stay and introduced us to Sergio the head of Guest Services, and told us to let them know if there was anything we needed.  This same attitude was expressed by our Porter Eduardo. He checked us into our room. He later arranged our request for late check-out. He was very informative and welcoming. He presents a very positive first impression of the Paradisus. We were so glad to see a Raul at the concierge desk. He was so helpful in previous visits. 

We stayed in a junior suite with an ocean view and were surprised with a whirlpool tub on the balcony!  The room was very clean and comfortable with a free minibar stocked daily or per request. Housekeeping and room service were excellent. The hotel has five connected pyramids each with a towering atrium, gardens, flowing streams, and hanging vines that give the experience of walking through a quiet rain forest.  There is something to explore in every corner – restaurants, shops, lounges, spa, or just seating areas to rest and enjoy the view.  

The quality and variety of food at the Paradisus is one of the main reasons we come back year after year. The casual dining at Taos offers a variety of Mexican and international cuisine with different offerings each day. They also offer gluten free and vegetarian choices. 

There are 6 specialty restaurants that are part of the all-inclusive package.  These require reservations and we had no difficulty getting a table.  All of them were very good, but our favorite was Mole, which served traditional Mexican dishes in a warm, friendly atmosphere.  Rody, the manager, greeted each guest at the door and, with his entire staff, provided exceptional service. Gabriel and Sonia the hostess at Mole were so welcoming and attentive to our dining experience.

Fuego offers delicious Peruvian and Chilean cuisine. Our server Hector explained the significance of each dish that he presented to us.

Our very favorite restaurant was Tempo. We enjoyed the tasting menu with wine pairing. Last year we celebrated our thirty second wedding anniversary at Tempo and it is a special place for us. Our servers Samuel and Raul make quite a team. They provided outstanding service. Samuel’s expertise with the food and wine pairing made this meal a memorable treat. 

The Paradisus was a great escape from our cold Chicago winter.  Gracias to Mr. Boutouba and the entire staff for making this a restful vacation!

Dr. David and Johanna S.

reviews.author: Jen K
reviews.title: Our trip was fantastic!
reviews.text:
We had a great time at the Paradisus Resort.  We booked the Royal service / All-inclusive too and our butler was Sergio.  He was very attentive and made sure we were taken care of (drinks, dinner reservations, cabanas by the pool etc).  Would definitely go back.  No complaints about the food either as everything was really good.  Our server at Mole (Rody-Leo) was awesome as was Martin at Fuego!  

The waiter at the Royal service Pool was Francisco!  By far the best!  He made sure our drinks were never empty, food was hot and ready, the jewelry we bought on the beach was real silver, etc!  When he went on break he gave us the next best waiter too. 

As always, be sure to bring plenty $1 and $5 bills for tipping.  It goes a long ways.  

We can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Abby V
reviews.title: Simply the best
reviews.text:
From the moment we walked in the hotel and drew our first breath we knew this would the experience we were looking for. The hotel is beautiful, the staff is to notch, very helpful. The rooms are nice with breath talking views. The food and service amazing. The shows in the hotel were very entertaining, and there was a different show every night. 
This hotel is the total package, an experience you don't want to pass up. We would like to thank all the wonderful staff at the hotel, with special thanks to Fred the manager of operations! Bruno and Luis at the front desk! and to Simon at Tempo Restaurant for making our dining experience one we will never forget. We will be back same time next year.
Thank you all, Mirko and Abby

reviews.author: Sofya B
reviews.title: Should go
reviews.text: Believe me it is worth money, time and even 14 hours of flight (we travelled from Moscow). Great design, super-service & very hospitable staff. Food is really good. Sea is stunning, very beautiful. Whoever you are, no matter if you are young couple or a serious man, you should go & feel the atmosphere

reviews.author: gcathy g
reviews.title: Great fun in the sun
reviews.text:
This hotel is beautiful. The inside lobby area looked very tropical with a large atrium and hanging vines. A sushi restaurant is nestled right in the middle of the atrium! I think the rooms were very clean but a little dated. Bathroom was nice and updated with rain shower. The beds were lack luster however and so were the pillows. Little lumpy would be the best I could describe. Nice large balcony, only one lounge chair however. The food was fresh and plenty to satisfy every taste bud!
Be prepared to make reservations for all of the specialty restaurants with the exception of Blue Agave and the Buffet that has market grill located in the same area also. Mojitos were excellent and the staff was friendly. My only complaint is that they do not have enough lounge chairs by the pool areas. Every morning was a struggle to find a chair. One of the pool guys were nice enough to go and find us two. Next morning same thing. People must get up at the crack of dawn and secure their chairs with towels and such. Regardless, there still wasn't enough chairs and I also heard a lot of people complaining about the same thing! Overall this is a very nice stay for the price if you don't mind overlooking a couple of things!

reviews.author: Judy-DC
reviews.title: Wow!!! This has to be the BEST hotel in Cancun!
reviews.text:
My daughter and I had enough of this cold snowy season and booked a 5-day/4-night getaway for the end of January. We chose the Paradisus based on the reviews and we got a good package deal!  Everything about the Paradisus whispers "RELAX" - from the time you enter the lobby, as someone mentioned in an earlier review - the Zen surrounds you from the subtle fragrances in the air to the soft lighting, the greenery hanging and growing, the huge Japanese goldfish swimming in the ponds, sounds of waterfalls and soft music drifting by... Did I mention the waves lapping against the shore and the gentle breeze blowing on your double balcony with the best view you can imagine??  

We booked all-inclusive (well worth it) and as we were checking in Felipe offered us a great price to upgrade to "Royal Service", which comes with so many amenities I may forget to mention some. But, I cannot leave out our most attentive Butler, Jose who brought his own sunshine and great smiles with him whenever we called. The Royal Service allows you premium liquors & a great selection of wines at the bar or in your room, allows (your butler) to reserve a beautiful cabana for you each day on the beach or poolside. The Royal Service pool is adults only and has a bar poolside as well. But who really needs to go to the bar when the waiters are there each time it seems your glass is just about empty! You can also order food without having to leave your cabana or lounger. What can I say, but "Aaaaaaaahhhh!" This is indeed the answer for a warm, tropical, relaxing stay in beautiful Cancun!  Royal Service also includes a therapeutic water experience - that combines full body shower jets, the sauna, steam room and pool exper

reviews.author: Jen L
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise!
reviews.text:
Second year in a row staying at Paradisus. We love everything about it. The view from an ocean side room is breathtaking!

The food is awesome and is endless. The Blue Agave is the best!! We also enjoyed Mole, Naos, Market Grill, and La Perla. AND room service!!! :D

Everyone was very friendly and went out of their way to make our stay pleasant. The staff works so hard.  Raul is so nice!

Our only complaint is that our room wasn't ready until 3:40 and check in is 3:00. But we will definitely be coming back nonetheless. :)

reviews.author: Nohra P
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Beautiful property. Friendly staff. Pool manager, Juan, pleasing every guest. The rooms are comfortable and neat. Quality of food excellent. Service over all fist class.  Location is great across the street is aqua world where you can book tours to other places. Very convenient.

reviews.author: YULVIP
reviews.title: Paradise found El Paraiso encontrado
reviews.text:
After spending long hours online to find the perfect honeymoon retreat, we stumbled upon "Paradisus Cancun Resort". I have traveled extensively to Mexico (i.e. Acapulco, Ixtapa, Mexico City etc.) Sincerely, this hotel and it's staff make you feel like you are part of the family!
Probably the best place all inclusive to stay in Cancun! Clean, contemporary decor, zen vibe and lots of vegetation like a solarium, an oasis of calm for couples, if you chose the "Royal Service", you are provided a personal butler, premium drinks, food by the private beach and adult only pool, reserved cabanas, free tanning oil and protective cream and a LOOOONGGG list of amenities and exclusive perks which I will spare for depicting here...
A really nice incentive is your own personal cell phone where you can reach your "majordomo" or butler instantly!
We had the privilege of being catered and pampered by the charming "Juan", who helped us immensely during our 7 days stays, from restaurants to laundry and grabbing some last minute medication, he was the go-to guy and never failed.

"Aide" who attended us daily with a smile at the lobby, gave us the best options for an outing to "Playa del Carmen" and "Isla Mujeres" if you feel like an escapade.

"Carlos", the other lobby host generously helped me pack and weigh my luggage as I was having some concerns with overweight airline charges. When was the last time you saw that?

The Tower 5 (6th floor) Ocean front view was to die for! my wife did not want to leave...;-)
The staff also enabled us to create a romantic in-room dinner...with a complimentary newly wed bottle of champagne - cava from Spain.

The morning buffet had great variety and the 9 restaurants were top class except "Mole" which we found to "mise en bouche" so the portions were small but tasty.       
Let me finish with the manager "Lazaro", wow! a man with great class, business ethics (provided us with an instant serene solution as we had some issues with our initial booking), professionalism and a sense of "savoir-faire", always making us feel welcome. 

All in all, muchas gracias to the personnel for making this vacation, a life long experience.
Hugzzz del corazón ;-)
M&S from Canada

reviews.author: Melanie N
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 7 day stay and had a great week. The beach was amazing, as was the hotel.
We weren't part of the all inclusive, so we cannot comment on any of the restaurants as we would go out every evening for diner. However, we did order drinks and had breakfast and lunch there daily. The buffet was very delicious a good range of food.
We were at the beach every day and found that the drinks were hard to order. The first day we had Miguel as our waiter and he was fantastic, but for the rest of the week the service wasn't as good, the waiter didn't come by very often. There's no bar directly on the beach like a lot of other resorts we've been to, so you hard to go get your drinks by the pool area. 
Our room had an ocean view with two balconies. They gave us an older room (in tower 2) but it was still nice and very clean. The only thing is the room was extremely humid which left our bed and clothes feeling damp all the time. 
We visited the spa on our last day and have to say, we received one of the best massages we've ever had!!
The service at this resort was impeccable. The staff was very friendly and always went the extra mile for us. 
 We will definitely be returning!

reviews.author: UtahFlower
reviews.title: Beautiful property in great location, terrible food.
reviews.text:
I really was impressed with this hotel when I walked in.  It had a beautiful lobby and common areas.  The room (Junior Suite, Lagoon Room, 5th Floor Room #3511) was very nice and I had no complaints once I moved from #3533.  That room was very loud with the night time shows.  The rooms are inside a pyramid (Think Luxor in Las Vegas) so every room inside that triangle gets the full sounds of everything. Not only was that a problem, it rained torrential one day and our room flooded.  A bunch of our clothes were in the closet by our luggage on the floor and got soaked.  Guest services had them cleaned for us.  The mini bar was stocked daily with coke products, mineral water, juice and beer along with potato chips and oreos which was a nice touch.  

House keeping did a pretty good job at the beginning of the trip with turning down our bed nightly with a chocolate on the pillow, but by the end (last two days of our trip) not only did they skip that service but they didn't replace dirty towels.  I had to hunt down wash clothes and hand towels.  It is told that are tips are included in the all-inclusive price, but we found if we didn't tip EVERYONE than we didn't not get excellent service.

When we arrived we were introduced to our "concierge" who explained how the hotel worked and the different restarants, but their sole purpose is to get you to come to a time share which we refused. He didn't harass us anymore, but was really friendly and helpful and he was the rare few we tipped.

The FOOD was a problem.  I loved the fresh salad, but really what was up with the lettus. We rarely could find basic leaf or romaine.  The breakfast was only good if you ordered an ommlette if you wanted warm or hot food. I never could eat the pancakes, french toast etc because always cold. I wonder why they have a problem with keeping food warm. They should use better heat lights or at the least offer syrup in a heated crock or something.  I always had cereal on the days I didn't have an omelette.  The buffet was good for lunch and even dinner as we found after trying all but one of the restaurants. We always made reservations a day in advance, but the food was not good with the exception of Market Street or Bana (but only if you like Sushi).  Vento was ok, but the food were just appetizers really.  Mole was terrible.  La Perla was basic, but after a while that is what you want when you are tired of the gourmet type food that doesn't taste good.  Almost always the meat/fish under cooked as well.   We ended up almost always going to Market Grill at lunch where they served the best sirloin burger and Cajun chicken and ONLY place to get ice cream. Ask for coconut, it is the bomb!  At night, it was just like Rodizio or Tucanos. Pretty tasty.

The service went downhill the longer we were there.  Many times at restaurants we were ignored due to the fact of the color of our bracelet. Ours were black which means first time guest. Repeat or Royal Service guests get better treatment for sure.

Most things we read about this hotel were true except I read the beds were comfortable but they weren't. They had hard mattresses and the sheets were not high quality. the pillows were all bad too.

The pool was cold, but felt refreshing after a hot day by the pool or out and about. I really wish they had a hot tub at least in the SPA.  The gym was pretty basic. They played loud thumping  techno music and the tv's were set on the same with the exception of soccer.  The classes they offered were held much too late (first at 9:15).  Many people who used the gym regularly were there early and so classes I was told were pretty empty.  I did participate in a pool side Zumba class which was only 30 min long, but a blast.

I had to wake up at 6:30 AM to get a chair every day, but one day someone moved our stuff. Not enough chairs especially in the shade. Luckily not too many kids around when we were there since it was for our anniversary and left ours at home.

I did like the hotel and would probably come again, but I wish a few things were different and then it would be top notch.

reviews.author: GlendowerCalgary
reviews.title: An okay get away for 4 nights
reviews.text:
Nice location closer to the north end of the zone. Easy drive from the Airport. 
I found the resort's pool space was segregated according to room value.  Proportionate pool space per room was greater for higher end rooms.  You can always sit on the beach but need to get up early to get a lounge. 
Book a day or two in advance for the non buffet restaurants. One quickly tires of the same offerings in the buffet however there is lots of selection.
Front desk, and buffet service was fine but housekeeping lacked consistency.
Overall a typical Cancun resort. Looks nice from the outside and nice appointments inside, but when all is said and done... just typical and average.

reviews.author: Bravo2013
reviews.title: Royal Service=Fabulous
reviews.text:
Booked a last minute trip to Cancun and got a great price on a 3 night package.  I have been to Cancun, Playa del Carmen and Akumal many, many times.  Paradisus takes the cake.  The service has been outstanding!  Staff are always smiling and ready to help.  Beach was uncrowded and pristine though as others have pointed out, you have to nab a palapa and chairs by 8 a.m.

Royal service means adults only, which made the pool especially nice.  Loved the lounge in the royal service area--super convenient for getting snacks and drinks.  Totally worth the extra money.  Bana was the best restaurant, which I didn't expect.  Great, fresh sushi and Francisco was a wonderful server.  Also liked Blue Agave for tacos.  Fuego didn't wow me but certainly not bad.

The butler service would be useful if you want help booking excursions but we didn't really need it.  Juan was lovely and the pool staff were outstanding.  I really don't want to stay anywhere else in Cancun after this experience!  Hope everyone tips the staff--they work incredibly hard.

reviews.author: Dorrit O
reviews.title: Extremely beautiful and relaxing place.
reviews.text: Definitely needs a lot of improvements at the pool and beach area. Great dificulty in finding lounge chairs, first day there we had to stand for an hour before getting any kind of seat. Also sometimes long wait at some restaurants.

reviews.author: Emmanuel T
reviews.title: Great Vacation.
reviews.text:
Great hotel,good food,great service.Special thanks to Naos restaurant breakfast waiters Richard,Isaias and Tomas,these guys are great,friendly and efficient.
However,the vacation would have been even greater if the hotel had  some organized activities for teenagers.

Hopefully,they will in the future.

reviews.author: LINDSAY h
reviews.title: Wonderful first family holiday with a 6 month old baby!
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend this hotel highly enough, it surpassed my expectations and standards, which is not easy to do. I always do a lot of research when planning a trip and this was excellent. We had family concierge which was brilliant, this is well worth the money. We had a cabana most days which was essential with a baby and the family concierge pool was lovely. The staff here really make it though, thanks go to Karla and vanessa at the family concierge who nothing was too much trouble and they really made a fuss of my daughter despite her being so young. Unfortunately she couldnt participate in the kids club which was superb but they still tried to involve her where possible.
The food really made our holiday though, i have never experienced an all inclusive like it. It really is exceptional and not good for the waistline! Also all the alcohol is top brands which is very unusual.
We are seriously considering coming back here in the summer.

The Spa was amazing but in my opinion over priced. We got a deal for 2 for 1 on massages which we took and they were very good but i would not have paid full price. I got to spas a lot and we like to treat ourselves on holiday but this was expensive. I am sure it would be busier if the prices were lowered a bit.

reviews.author: Mandy B
reviews.title: Relaxing and enjoyable half term break
reviews.text:
The Hotel facilities were great. We had a lovely room with ocean views. Bedding and towels were regularly changed and mini bar in the room was replenished daily.  With the kids, we appreciated having kids food options as part of  room service which was delivered to the room after they had bathed and it really helped keep things calm for bed time.  
We were however very close to the disco - red lounge, in block A rm 3131,  it was a bit noisy at night, though the swimming and sea breeze during the day helped the children sleep soundly through all the noise at night, including the noise of the water features which although therapeutic during the day and create ambience whilst you enjoy your meals in the different restaurants, are noisy at night. Having said that we still preferred being centrally located close to all the facilities.
For the vegetarians that joined us,the food options were limited mainly to fruit, veg, yogurts,soup,salad and bread. If like us you still enjoy a hot cup of tea even when on holiday, you will be disappointed, the water was nearly always tepid.  Naos restaurant staff started to dread our arrival as we would always request hot milk for all of us and resorted to dipping our tea bags in this for a hot tea latte, which ensured a hot brew we enjoyed but you could tell it was an inconvenience to the serving staff, with the exception of the very lovely Sandra and manager Carlos  who happily accommodated our request whenever they were working.  Thank you very much both of you, wevery much appreciated it.
It wasn't long before you could see a marked change in the attitude of beach bar staff, when not getting tipped. Excuse me, but we paid for the AI service and for 8 of us it wan't cheap so we didn't appreciate the attitude when requesting water and squash for the kids, when they closed the nerest beach bar from which we usually went and helped ourselves.I must add the hotel had an impressive international range of spirits available as part of the AI.

I'm glad to report all other service staff were excellent which is a marked difference compared with other holidays we've been to in Mexico, Dominican and Cuba, where tipping is the order of the day irrespective of AI stays. 
 The kids club was always kept very cold so ensure your littlens have a fleece to hand.  
The snack food counter by the pools was not that great, pizzas weren't particularly tasty and never ready waiting to be eaten and only made on request.  You won't find chips/fries anywhere unless you order them specifically as part of room service or at the market grill,surprising as chips are usually staple snack food for AI resorts.  They  also seemed to be holding back on putting out the crisp packets, replenishing only on request.  Kids drinks were limited to orange squash/water or milk other than at breakfast where apple juice or chocolate milk was also available.  There were smoothies but these were too exotic for the kids.  Ice cream could be had but only on request at the restaurants.
The hotel was lovely, entertainment,especially the circus was great.guests can also use certain unmotorised aquaworld facilities. If you can, definately stay here, you won't regret it, but take on board comments about snack food and kids drinks.

reviews.author: Rochelle M
reviews.title: Wonderful Trip
reviews.text: We just returned from a 6 days/5 nights at Paradisus Cancun Resort and had an excellent time. We were greeted by Bianca who was always willing to help us throughout our stay. She took care of all our dining arrangements and was very friendly. We spent every day on the beach where we met Sofonia. He was the server who stood out from our entire trip. Very warm and friendly person who went above and beyond to take care of us. We would return and recommend this resort.

reviews.author: coolguy007
reviews.title: Nice!!!!
reviews.text:
Great location with oceanfront rooms (be sure to ask for one). Nice restaurants. Convenient location near bus stop. Close to airport. Service with a smile.  

But a few minor cons to watch out for. Tours booked at tour desk were pricey (needed to haggle), tennis courts not well maintained, 'all-inclusive' did not include return transfer to airport or use if tennis courts.  Be aware large group bus tours to Chichinitza spend a lot of time picking up passengers from other hotels; if you want to save time: consider private of semiprivate tours instead. 

Overall, a positive experience. Whole family had a blast; would love to go back sometime.

reviews.author: Mn2Mx
reviews.title: All inclusive, well done.  Royal service
reviews.text:
We went WAY out of our comfort zone by going to an all inclusive, huge hotel...having traveled many places in the world on the local economy, living cheaply as possible...this was an invite and was partially comped...so we went for it.  Significant upgrades were given.  We were in pyramid 5 which is adults only Royal Service, has its own palapa bar and grill (fabulous by the way), beach area, pool, bali beds and servers.  We had our own butler, available at any time via a cell phone we were given to use.  Our room was fabulous, with a bedroom and living room, both with large balconies overlooking the sea from a fifth floor view.  We had one bad eating experience...at the Fuego...we had dinner with another couple, all ordering a different meal...and they all were, virtually, inedible.  Our butler could have been more attentive, although we didn't 'lean' on him often enough, perhaps.  I would have given this place five stars with the exception of the one restaurant...the rest were fabulous...room service was great.  We never needed to use money once we checked in.  Our greatest problem with the place were the ubiquitous water bottles...no fresh drinking water seemed to exist except in plastic.  That is beyond comprehension.  Even in the lowliest of hotels in Mexico we've had 5 gallon water containers on a pivot, or with a pump.  These plastic bottles were not even being recycled, to the best of our knowledge.

Still...all in all, a very elegant time.

reviews.author: Gloria H
reviews.title: A Great vacation Time at Paradisus Cancun Resort
reviews.text:
It was my first time in Cancun and a friend of mine recommended this fantastic Resort . 
Food was Great , Rooms are very Clean and Staff is friendly and helpful . Locations are nice.
I highly recommend this fabulous Resort and please have dinner at Market Grill Luis , Gerardo and Giovanna were soooo Nice . I definitely be back next year :-)

reviews.author: btruitt
reviews.title: a wonderful experience in cancun
reviews.text: I just returned from a 6 day trip to Paradisus in Cancun, Each year 3 of us go to a different resort or cruise for our girls trip. This year we chose Paradisus in Cancun since neither one of us had been to Cancun. It was one of our best vacations as the people at this resort do everything to make it that way.  From our check-in to check-out it was great. We had a suite with our personal butler (Grace) who i can't say enough about, i thought she had a gps on us because she seemed to know where we were and checked on us through-out our stay making sure everything was up to our expectations. She was a delight to talk to and did an outstanding job. Then there was Juan at the pool who was always there to help with our cabana, towels, drinks etc. He would come around every day with cold towels, fruit kabobs, drinks, cold water, anything we needed. He is an asset to this resort in pool area. If you are thinking of a cancun vacation check out the Paradisus you won't be disappointed.   Truitt Family,   Carolyn Parsons, Jean Powell and Betty Truitt

reviews.author: HeyChickie
reviews.title: Go! Loved It.
reviews.text:
Just came back from our trip Feb 23-27th. 
We have been to Mexico 5 times now and have always stayed All-inclusive. This was our first Paradisus trip and our first time staying right in Cancun. 
The hotel location is a short 15 minute ride from the airport and I would never imagine this hotel to be a party hopping, spring-breaker location. The hotel is large but very easy to navigate. 
We stayed in the Royal Service area and were very happy with that choice. There are no guests in Royal Service under 18 which was just what we wanted. You do have your own concierge and front desk services there too which made requests so easy.
