The excerice room also crowded at most common hours. You could not get a treadmill within reasonable time (so I jogged on the boulevard, beautiful). So you see I have good things and bad to say about Paradisus. BUT after all said and done, we WOULD return to Paradisus provided that we would have warmer and less windy weather.

reviews.author: BostonGirl2013
reviews.title: Boston Girls
reviews.text:
Upon arrival we told we booked Royalty Service, no idea what that meant but I guess we were assigned a butler.  He helped us to the room and we didn't hear from him again that day.  Seeing him the next day upon walking through the resort, he did get us a dinner reservation which was nice.  I witnessed a lot of butlers checking in on their guests around the resort and on the beach, not ours.  We never heard from or saw him again after day 2 of a 5 day encounter.  Even upon check out, other butlers were gathering people bags and bringing them to check out, not ours.  I guess maybe you need to ask for what you want.  

Resort overall was amazing, our view was just breathtaking from the balcony.  The room was just the right size although beds seemed a little stiff but overall not bad.  The bathroom was clean and a good size.  Beach was just great as our weather albiet windy was beautiful.  The food was a little different for us Boston folks however, it was okay.   

The restaurant Vento would have to be my favorite, although others complained about the food not being hot, I found it warm enough.  Our waiter, Jonathan was absolutely Amazing!!!  I was very impressed with the service I received, so impressed we ate there a second night!

The Avenue Bar has a great bartender, "Alexander the Great", he keeps the atmosphere lively and fun.

We meet amazing people from the UK, South Carolina, Florida, Minnesota and California.  It was so much fun and very entertaining.  

All in all, I would go back tomorrow!

reviews.author: JerseyGirl163
reviews.title: Family getaway
reviews.text: The views of the ocean from the pool area and the restaurants are spectacular.  The service staff in the restaurants were very good, especially Omar, our waiter at Vento.  We all loved the pork carnitas at Blue Agave.  The central atrium is beautiful.  Our room was always spotless.  The 9 hole golf course in front of the hotel is fun if a little quirky.  The hotel enjoys a central location on the strip.  The beach has been replenished since the last time we visited 4 years ago.

reviews.author: Sarah C
reviews.title: Amazing getaway
reviews.text:
The resort was spectacular, the room was a little small, but we never spent much time in there, just to shower and sleep.  I would recommend getting an ocean view room, the view and the sounds of the waves were just out of this world.  Food at all restaurants were okay, however, the service was spectacular.  Our favorite restaurant was Agave - no reservations needed, very laid back and the service we got from Juan Carlos was better than any 5 plus restaurant anywhere.  He was eager, fast, friendly courteous and would do whatever to please us.  He got us the recipe for a spiced oil, which my husband loved and the recipe for the soup I found to be delicious.  
We travelled with our two kids, 5 and 7 and they loved it, they were sad to come home and insisted on saying goodbye to the ladies at the Kids Zone - wow, worth every minute.  The kids asked to go every day and always came back with crafts and things they worked on.  The evenings they also had the Kids Zone open for kids with a variety of activities (movie night, camping night, talent shows, drumming, etc) This allowed my husband and I to go to dinner and enjoy a quite dinner without the kids.  The ladies (Evelyn, Isa and Mary - so many I couldn't remember them all, so caring and sweet).
The kids always wanted to eat at Naos, the buffet, mostly because of the variety and they marched straight over to the kids area (different choices - nuggest, fries, pastas, breaded fish plain rice etc.) Plus the waiter Baltazar knew our kids drink orders (fanta, milk, my coffee and my husbands water).  How do they remember everyone.  They even remembered the kids names.
Martin  and Andres our Naos waiters at breakfast were always happy, helpful and had given us personal service in a buffet.  
The pool area was beautiful, beach spectacular waters were rough, but still beautiful.  The beach and pool area had waiter service as well, they brought you drinks and food to your sun beds, our waitress Yolanda was fast, and so pleasant, she knew our order by heart and always brough the kids water bottles.
Nothing but good things to say .... highly recommend this resort to families.

reviews.author: CobraGT500
reviews.title: NOT what we were expecting
reviews.text:
For a resort on a beautiful beach and in an area where you can leave the resort to shop/explore, this is the place. However, if you are a vacation club member used to all of the pampering you get as part of the "perks" at other resorts, this is NOT the place for you! We were left to find the club member check in on our own after confusing directions and hand gestures to "help" us find our way through three buildings, then we were greeted with an attitude. The girl at check in was very condescending to the platinum Melia Club member we were traveling with. We have never encountered a rude person on ANY Melia Club properties until this trip. 
The food was unremarkable, usually cold and one note in flavor. Drinks were so slow that we began ordering doubles. Bana, the Asian fusion restaurant, had the best, most flavorful, fresh food. The sushi was excellent and the hot dishes came to the table hot. We were so impressed that we ate there two nights in a row. However, in the Brazilian restaurant, The Market,  I watched the waiter go to the buffet next door and "assemble" our appetizers and desserts-disappointing! I was told that another woman and I were laughing too loud in the Blue Agave bar, so everyone at the bar (17 of us) got up and left. The bartender was left without any customers thanks to the manager.
Our room was always clean, but I had to repeatedly ask to get the fridge restocked with water, then received a phone call telling me I only get one restock per day-that's all I wanted since it was never done to begin with!
Overall, this was an acceptable place to stay, but if you are a club member, the level of quality and service is not at the level that other Melia Club resorts offer. Playa Del Carmen was $6 more per night and 10x better in service, quality and dining.

reviews.author: MIhector
reviews.title: Change to Paradisus, outstanding
reviews.text:
We have been staying at the Melia, now the Paradisus, since 1990, and became members of the vacation club in 1998.  It was one of the better investments we ever made.  Many wonderful moments of watching our children having a great and enjoyable vacation. 
The change to the Paradisus is for the better as the Melia was beginning to show her age.  Rooms have been remodled with new furniture, decorating, air conditioning, and clean, clean, clean.  The entrance to the hote is a scene from a Hollywood production.  People are courteous and hard-working. 
We were not on the all-inclusive plan, but we did dine at a number of restaurants, and the food was very good.  Since we dine out somewhat, here are a few recomendations:  breakfast--La Pasteleria (Mexican and crepes), dinner--DuMexique (French) and La Palapa Belga, and an inexpensive Italian restaurant is Rino's a few doors down from DuMexique on Bonampak Ave
Talked to a number of people who were on the all-inclusive plan and did not hear one complaint.  One family from Ohio since becoming vacation plan members said the change to the Paradius was outstanding. 
Keep up the great work, and we will see you next year.

reviews.author: IrishGuinness1690
reviews.title: Luxury resort
reviews.text:
We were amazed at this resort. We had a corner 1 bedroom apartment so consequently had 2 large balconies with views of the ocean and above the pool area. Twice we got up early to have a coffee on the balcony to watch the sunset and then return there in the evening to have a cocktail watching the sunset. Spectacular!!

We booked through RCI and were awarded Club Melia membership which rather blew us away. We had a private beach with sun loungers which you did not need to book. There is always someone to get you drinks as well so you can feel real pampered.

We found the staff very courteous and friendly throughout the Hotel, especially Carola Jiménez-Castro Espejo, our representative at Club Melia,who was so helpful to us during our stay and solved every problem or enquiry we had.

There was a bus stop at the end of the drive and buses passed every minute so we never had to wait. The cost is $8.50 per person per trip so dirt cheap. No need to take a taxi or rent a car. We never ate at the Hotel because of the choice of restaurants in Cancun.

We have travelled the world and are returning next year to Cancun and to the Paradissus because we were so impressed.

reviews.author: JG1981
reviews.title: Royal service exceptional
reviews.text:
We booked 11 nights in Royal Service for our Honeymoon and weren't disappointed. On arrival we were taken to Royal Service check in. The room was great although a little worn but can't expect it to be immaculate, it was clean. We were offered a mobile so we could contact the butler when we wanted but we chose not to. The Royal Service staff were amazing, they were more than happy to help no matter how small the request, and we had a few. 
The restaurants we ate in were delicious, our favourite being Market Grill which served 6 meats cut straight from the skewer. La Palapa, the Royal Service pool bar/eatery was great as we didn't need to go to the main buffet and could relax next to the pool. The menu could have had a few extra things on it but after a while they offered us other choices not on the menu as we kept to what we liked after trying a few, which made lunch times better. 
They have a few bars but non of them really our scene, Avenue was too loud for us, Toji had 8 seats at the bar and 2 2 seater tables which we liked when you could get a seat, We never drank in Red Lounge as it opened at 2100. The majority of the time we drank in the Royal Service lounge where they had a selection of drinks you could help yourself to but they had servers available until 2300.
We would stay at this hotel again.

reviews.author: Keir D
reviews.title: Lovely luxurious relaxing break!
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful time - stayed 10 nights in which time we completely unwound and had an absolutely amazing holiday!
The hotel was amazing and really clean - all staff were fun and helpful and made our stay all that bit more special!
Special mention to Martin who made us smile every breakfast and lunch in the market grill and buffet area and to Benito and Luis for getting us drunk every night wen we weren't looking and also for making us laugh and of course provide us with the best cocktails in Cancun in the sushi bar!

Grace and Key from Manchester!

reviews.author: Cancunceramist
reviews.title: Excelent Hotel All Inclusive in Cancun
reviews.text: Very well located on a prime spot of Cancun Island. Jsut acroos of Aquaworld Water Sports Center. Try restaurant TEMPO by Martin Berasategui. Its a true gurment esperience highly recommendable. It will cost you a bit extra, but it is wothwhile. The beach is out of this world.

reviews.author: 13sadtobehome
reviews.title: Best week ever
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for spring break, March 1st until the 8th.  Opted for the family concierge package, great choice. Our kids 12 and 9 thought the candy bar at the concierge was the bomb... From the moment we arrived Isaac and Karla and the rest of the team took great care of us.  From the Bali beds to the nightly suggestions for the restaurants and even taking care of all the reservations......just fantastic.  The kids loved the nightly turn downs with cookies and milk and we loved the special touches of aromatic pillows and complimentary red wine upon our return to our room. The pool was great and so was the easy access to the powdery white beach.  Would recommend the hotel, to everyone not just family's.

reviews.author: travelgirl022
reviews.title: An escape from the cold
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed for five days.  The resort is in a good location with a beautiful white sand beach.  The waves are strong here so don't expect to get in without getting IN.  Our room was clean and I enjoyed the large terrace with two lounge chairs.  We ordered room service breakfast one morning and ate outside.

The service was really fantastic, not just prompt, but also friendly and welcoming.  Service with a smile!  The food was overall good, sometimes excellent but randomly so.  Especially loved the buffet at breakfast and the hot cappuccino.

The decor was really cool, you could tell things had just been redone with plenty of lounging spaces both inside and out.  We both had the relaxing massage and wished the hydrotherapy pool at least would be heated as the water was chilly (don't go at night).

Now for my one issue, and it felt more and more significant to me as the stay went on.  We were not aware of the option to upgrade to Royal service.  Our room happened to be right on the edge of the Royal Service area yet our bracelet wasn't the "right" color.  No big deal except that the pool and beach most convenient to our room were not for us.  On two separate occasions, once on the beach and once in a shaded seating area I was told I was in the wrong place.  When reading my book in the shaded area I was told I can sit there but cannot be given anything to eat or drink.  I figured out where my boundaries were but felt the class distinction and would suggest upgrading to Royal service to avoid the situation.

No one was rude about it and I would recommend the property with that one caveat.
It certainly was nice to get out of the Northeast and be warm!

reviews.author: Melissa M
reviews.title: Spectacular location and service, food was OK
reviews.text:
We just got back from a 5 night stay at Paradisus Cancun and had an amazing time.  

The pros: service was spectacular, location right on the beach, jacuzzi tub on our room's balcony facing the ocean, top shelf alcohol, poolside and beach side drink and food service.

The cons: food was very mediocre.  presentation was always great, but the food itself was either overcooked, tasteless, or cold.  the resort is so huge that it feels like a ghost town as you are walking through it, and it is always cold inside.  The building has a corporate feel when you walk rather than warm and laid back luxury.  We used our jacuzzi tub on the balcony every night, but it was basically broken (jets didn't work), and the faucets barely dripped water so it took about 45 minutes to fill.  Lastly, you are constantly being sold to and the beach towel check out for the hotel are actually just sales guys trying to hustle you into purchasing an excursion.

Overall, we enjoyed our experience, but might try staying at another resort the next time we go to cancun.

reviews.author: dianne40
reviews.title: Somethings great somethings not
reviews.text:
Our family just returned from 6 days at the Paradisus.  

Pros:
- Beach is beautiful.  Pools are pretty but too cold to swim.  
- Wait staff are all really friendly and do a great job
- Ocean front rooms are great for sleeping at night to the sound of the waves
- Lobby is really pretty
- Health club is nice and clean

Cons:

- Front desk staff is so so unfriendly.  When we were checking out - I stood at front desk for almost 5 minutes before the front desk clerk would even look at me.  She was busy on her computer.  After checking us out, she never said anything such as " Thank you come back again."  It was almost like we were bothering her.  
- No furniture on our balcony.  Not even one chair.  We had an ocean front room but, could not use the balcony because we never had any chairs.  I called front desk the first day and requested some chairs.  The front desk told me that they took our deck furniture to accomodate a room which had 4 persons.  I explained that we had 3 persons and not even a chair.  She said that she would try to get us furniture.  But, after 6 days, we never got any deck furniture.  We pulled the chairs out from inside the room.  
- hotel room - seemed like it needed some repairs.  - bathroom mirrow had chips and bit stains, some holes in the dry wall in bathrooms around the doors,  opening and closing the in room safe was difficult - it took 3 -4 times before it would work. 
- dinner reservations - when calling for reservations - frequently we were told that nothing was available.  Then we would go by the restaurant at the requested time and they were plenty of available tables.  It didn't make sense to any of the other quests as well.
- restaurant receptionists  - not friendly except at Fuego.  They act like the police.  We showed up for our reservation on time and they said they had no record of our reservation.    We after about 10 minutes they finally found it.  No sorry, nothing.  
- noise - we were in Tower 3.  The disco is very loud and the pounding of the bass was so loud that it was difficult at times to go to sleep.  Sometimes to 1am.
- my daughter got sick and I was bringing her a bowl of soup to the room.  The receptionist told me that I wasn't allowed to take soup to my room.  I told her my daughter was sick and couldn't get out of bed and she said that was the rule.  No soup for my daughter.  
- kids club - not real inviting for kids.  went to the kids club out by the pool and she sad that they weren't going to do activities today since they were not enough kids.  My daughter never went back.

reviews.author: TUPike
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: We spent a full week at this resort in the red level and everything was amazing.  The staff was always very accommodating and respectful (especially Luis Cortez, he was our favorite staff member, so kind and helpful!), the hotel itself was very beautiful and clean.  The views were spectacular and your just a short bus ride away from a mall and all different shops and restaurants.  This place has such a variety of everything, from atmosphere to food, we were never once disappointed.  I strongly recommend upgrading to the red level, it ends up paying for itself and then some once you factor in all the perks (especially the open bar they set up from 4-6!).  My wife and I spent our honeymoon here and when we return to Cancun we will absolutely be staying here again, they staff makes everything easy and the pictures speak for themselves!

reviews.author: Linda W
reviews.title: Royal Service is wonderful!
reviews.text:
We are leaving the Paradisus Cancun tomorrow.  We booked the royal service building, ocean view, and we have been very pleased with our stay here.  Basically the royal service is just that, ROYAL SERVICE!  From our personal butler Juan Jose, and butler Hector, to bartender Benito, server Consuelo, and Sergio at the pool.....everyone was just wonderful.  Our room is beautiful and clean.  

You can use the facilities at the entire hotel, but you also have your own, quiet, adults only area.  I would recommend royal service to staying anywhere else on the property if you can.  

The food on the buffet is not on the top of my list of places we've stayed.  Not that it isn't prepared well, just pretty generic.  The specialty restaurants were somewhat better.  The service in all restaurants was very good.   

The lobby's are very pretty and tropical, and there is a LOT of pool, a big plus.  All in all, a very nice place to stay.

reviews.author: Denise006
reviews.title: What a great resort!
reviews.text:
Just spent 6 lovely days at Paradisus Cancun Gran Melia - what a wonderful resort!  This place is so different from any other island resort I've stayed at.  It almost felt like a health spa - incredibly relaxing and tranquil.  Whether in the main lobby area or in the adults only (Royal Service) section, the whole experience was serene and stress releasing:

Royal Service (adults only) - All I can say to you is GET IT.  It was worth the extra cost when we booked - one on one butler service, your own private lobby with food and drinks offered all day and most of the evening, a separate pool with Cali beds and waiter service (which includes food and drinks), it made you feel very royal and pampered!

Service - All I can say is EXCELLENT.  I know people have bad days, but I sure didn't see it here.  All the workers were friendly and more than willing to help you.  Special recognition goes to Consuela and Sergio at the pool - Consuela (sorry probably spelling her name wrong) was such fun to chat with - playful and so chipper.  Always came to us at the right time to make sure we had everything we needed.  Sergio was also always right there to offer any service we might need - both made us feel very pampered - thank you both!  Our butler Juan Jose was wonderful as well - he and my boyfriend planned a little surprise for me my last night - rose petals in the shape of a heart on the bed and wine and chocolate treats on a rose petal decorated table - so nice!  From restaurant and spa reservations to just a general question, Juan was there to assist - thank you for making our trip extra special!  And for all the other waitstaff, housekeepers and other workers who's names I can't remember, thank you as well - the customer service was just fantastic.

Room -  We paid extra (negotiate for a lower price, they will offer it) and upgraded to the ocean view room (Rm 5518) - WOW - what an amazing view - got up early two mornings just to take sunrise pics and slept with our door open most nights so we could sleep to the sound of the ocean.  Room is a good size, clean and the bed was very comfortable.  There was a little wear and tear here and there, but nothing that detracted from the comfort of the room in any way.  Housekeeping did a great job and loved the turned down service at night (and the chocolate that was on the pillow).  I read comments about loud doors: Doors do bang shut, but it's not people not holding the doorknob, it's that you have to pull to close it and it just bangs.  They're wood doors, so I'm guessing they swell with the humidity and don't close easily. 

Restaurants - We only did two - Mole and Market Grill (which we did twice because we liked it so much).  Both were very good.  The rest of the time we did the buffet.  Seriously, if you can't find something to eat, you have to be an incredibly picky eater.  There is a very good selection at each meal (loved all the fresh fruit choices).  I do agree with previous posts that the food is not overly hot, we're guessing they don't heat lamp it too hot so the food doesn't dry out, but the affect of that is lukewarm food.  The trick around it is to get smaller portions, eat and then go back for more.  It is something they need to work on, but again, nothing that detracts from what is offered.  Be brave and try dishes you're not familiar with - we did a few and went back for seconds on a number of them.

Nightlife - This is NOT a party hotel.  They have a great bar in the main lobby area, where they put on nightly shows, but they're done by 10:00 and you can then move on to the nightclub if you want to dance or listen to loud music.  Otherwise, the bar was pretty quiet, nice with big beds you could lay on and have drinks brought to you.  I think it's part of what made it so relaxing - no loud pumping music everywhere.  If you want to party - go in to town.  The bus system is great - only $1.00 USD each way and cleaner than the buses here in Philly.  We did CocoBongo - insanely fun!  Plus there's lots of other bars on the strip you can go to.  We felt perfectly safe, even at 3 in the morning when we were coming out of CocoBongo.  The strip at Cancun is alot of fun, so go out and explore.  And then come back to a relaxing atmosphere at the hotel.

Pools:  Very clean and very pretty but the water was cold - I really hope the resort works on this: heat at least one of the pools - it was just too cold to go in to.  It also would be nice for one or two of the jacuzzis to be hot - there isn't one warm public jacuzzi in the resort.  The ocean felt great though.  Lots of chairs and places to sit.  

Spa: Very nice!  We had two massages each while there, they rank up there with massages I've had here at home.  They have a great jet pool but again, not heated and it's still cold this early in the season.  I would suggest they heat that up, would have felt great to sit in after our massages had it been warm.  Instead I shivered, ran out and got into a hot shower. Tip on pricing: you may receive resort credits for spa services - first try to negotiate a lower price - you can't use the credits if you do that, but both times our final "discounted" price was less than if we did use the credits.

Overall, this place is great - I know it's human nature to critique, but this place ranks a high 95% in my book.  Other than the buffet food needing to be a little warmer and heating up a pool or two, this place and it's employees are amazing.  We're already talking about coming back again next year!

reviews.author: pyutzey
reviews.title: Vacation at the Paradisus in Cancun
reviews.text: We just returned from a week at the Paradisus in Cancun. The hotel and grounds are beautiful and well kept. The rooms are clean and comfortable. The food is good. There is so much to pick from, it is always hard to decide. The desserts could be better though, all are jello based. But hey, I could have gained another 5 lbs too ! We upgraded to royal service , and they delivered ! The staff and service are simply outstanding ! At the poolside, we were frequently offered drinks, fresh fruit, even cold, wet, scented, rolled up washrags to wipe your face with ! Whatever you ask for , they always greet and deliver with a smile. We frequently roamed all areas of the hotel and found all staff to be professional, courteous, and efficient. We especially had a great time with Consuelo, Erik, and Benito in the royal service area. They work very hard to make sure you get what you came for, a complete vacation experience. Kudos to you Paradisus,for your exceptional staff and level of service ! You should be very proud of them all.  I would not hesitate to return, I just wish it could be sooner !

reviews.author: Danie8899
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, amazing staff, gluten-free friendly!
reviews.text:
Cancun offers so many hotel options but when we heard that there was availability at the newly converted Paradisus Cancun we jumped at the opportunity - and we were not disappointed! The staff was unbelievably friendly and so gracious. They were totally accommodating and the butler service, as part of the royal service option, was amazing. Every need attended to. From the pool director to the concierges to the maître d and waiters at every restaurant, there wasn’t anything more we could have asked for. 

After being recently diagnosed with celiac disease, we were a bit skeptical about traveling out of the country. My mom had some brief email correspondence with Fred, the operations director, before we left and as soon as we arrived, our worries completely vanished! Everyone (and I mean everyone) was made well aware of my diet restrictions and understood what I could and more importantly, could not, eat. Many of the chefs came out and spoke to me about the menu options and we even got a "tour" of the large buffet one day at lunch. I am very grateful that I was able to travel, not have to worry at all about getting sick, and actually enjoyed everything I ate! My parents loved the food too, especially all the variety and restaurant choices. 

Overall, we would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for a great getaway!

reviews.author: spill_beans
reviews.title: Recent improvements are very good.
reviews.text:
We traded a timeshare to go here. As a result were were allowed to buy as few as 3 days of all inclusive. Great price for all inclusive add on. The food was very good especially at Mole Mole the Mexican restaurant. One annoyance was the policy of having to make reservations in advance and then being told that the restaurant was full when it was not full when we walked by.

Our room was very clean and nice and had 2 lounge chairs on our private balcony facing the water. The air conditioning fan is a little loud but I am being picky as I am a light sleeper. Daily maid service on a timeshare exchange is unusual.

Great pool, great beach. Courteous and attentive staff. 

Entertainment is sub par. The resort has 5 towers. Main tower music in the evening is quite loud.

reviews.author: LuckyCat
reviews.title: Awesome balcony. Fell asleep to the waves every night.
reviews.text: My mom (65 years old) and I stayed for a week and had a lovely time. The staff are very friendly and kind lots of eye contact and smiles. The bedrooms were cheery and clean and the ocean view rooms with private balconies are a must! We fell asleep every night to the sound of waves and my mom didn't snore once! This is NOT a party hotel for drunk singles. It's for nice families. Food was great. Lots of variety and healthy choices. I would go back again.

reviews.author: RL H
reviews.title: Paradisus Staff was Excellent!
reviews.text:
Wife,and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from the 12th of Feb to the 28th.Our vacation was made excellent by the staff that took care of us.From the moment we arrived.to the day we left.
Let me start with the Pool Bar staff,Carlos,Rogelio,Samuel,RoMartin,and our server Miguel Thank You! The Avenue Bar staff, Bartenders Juan M. Diaz, Alexander,Gabriel The waitress Coral *****
Denisse ***** Karina,Ingrid, Damaris, Antonio. Juan and his team at Blue Agave,and Mole Thank You! For the guys that had our backs on the beach Lifeguards Oscar,Eduardo,Angel,Grabiel,
Fredy Thank You! Our vacation was great thanks to you all!!
Ray&Lisa Hancock

reviews.author: slikmo22
reviews.title: Fun Activities, Good View, and Great People
reviews.text: A couple friends and I went to Paradisus Cancun in December and had an excellent time. During the day there is a BBQ going on next to the pool and activities like beach volleyball and soccer already set up. The event coordinators Diego and Jossie are the nicest people I have ever met and really made the vacation much more enjoyable. Other events like classes on how to make sushi and give massages were also offered in the resort. The food was amazing, there are many restaurants (I think around 7-8) throughout the resort and each offer their own variety of food. Nightlife is pretty good there as well there is a club/bar area as well as a lounge/bar area which is open through the night and into the morning. Paradisus is also about 5-10mins away from downtown on the bus. This resort is highly recommended by my friends and I. [If you go make sure to try the Sea Bass Soup]

reviews.author: Margaretohara1
reviews.title: Relaxing, pleasant atmosphere.
reviews.text: The staff is very kind and accommodating. Our waitress Sandra at Bana was sweet and so attentive as well as Angel and Max, who introduced us to some onterestimg and different food experiences at Mole. We enjoyed the beautiful turquoise Caribbean water and white sands. Overall was a peaceful,fun experience.

reviews.author: Kelly23
reviews.title: Adequate Cancun "zone" hotel
reviews.text:
Hotel probably had it's heyday years ago.  i agree that rooms are tired and pillows did seem old and deflated.  It doesnt help that I stayed at La Esmeralda last year (new sister resort to this one) which was outstanding and same price.  But let's cut to the chase:

Pros:  Stunning and I mean stunning beach!  Color of the ocean is incredible here!!  Very close to airport so can get settled quickly and not eat up whole day in travel.  Plenty cabanas too.  Nice exercise room (although a bit tucked away). Staff seems to try and some are friendlier than others, dont really expect tips, but we Americans are trained so they benefit!

Cons:  Im sorry, but overall the food was mediocre at best.  Lacked taste and variety/freshness.  Even the guacolmole (which should be a no brainer), had very little seasonings or taste.  No pizza on buffet...really?  Dont you know your customers?  Food on hot buffets was never, ever hot, think lukewarm burger and fries!  And no food prepared at pool, so when your lunch came, it was warm at best, if not cool...so sad for such a stunning location!  Yes, rooms are a bit old but I can live with it.

To me, this is like staying at a chain beachfront hotel and not really a resort.  If you like the "resort" feel, which I prefer, then Playa Del Carmen or Riveria Maya is best and feels so much classier that this gradiose hotel on the strip next to the others.

I would probably not come back but that is because I've experienced more beautiful grounds and food at the true resorts that can be found south of here.

reviews.author: OJR
reviews.title: Decent grounds... Horrible customer service... Suited for Collegiate Spring Breakers, Not Seasoned World Travelers
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancún in February to celebrate the birthday of a friend. Our party consisted of 20 to friends from different parts of the US who all flew in to Mexico for this weekend celebration.

I generally don’t like to write unfavorable reviews about an establishment; I only do so when the experience is so horrible that I would not recommend it for a friend. Unfortunately, this is one of those instances. You may read the details below if you wish, but here’s the executive summary:

1. Check-in took 5 hours.
2. The resort’s “all-inclusive” doesn’t include room service sans pizza, quesadilla, and hamburgers. None of the other 50 items are available.
3. We were given “complimentary” upgrades that we never requested because the resort kept making it customer service mistakes. Once we checked out, we were asked to pay for a room type we never received because the resort gave us perks.
4. We were publicly asked in front of other guests to leave a restaurant in the elite “Royal Service” dining lounge in Tower 5 (where we were staying), because an uninformed server had her facts incorrect and had no training in customer experience.
5.  We were asked to leave one of the lobby bars because we were dressed inappropriately in shorts and tank tops at 2:00pm in the afternoon at beach resort, though we saw other guests in the same bar wearing two-piece bikinis and mesh cover-ups/sarongs while other guests were roaming the lobby shirtless, shoeless, and dripping wet from the pool or ocean.
6. When we asked to speak to the General Manager, the Front Desk personnel BLATANTLY LIED, and gave us the # to an Accounting Manager that they were attempting to pass off as the GM.

CHECK-IN: 
In a nutshell, it took us nearly 5 hours to be checked into our room. Two months in advance, we booked a Deluxe Ocean View King. When we arrived at 2:00 on a Friday, we signed our intake forms, gave them our credit card, and did the normal check-in activities. We were then told by the front desk to “come back in an hour, and we might have a room available.” We returned at 3:00 only to be handed the keys to a Deluxe Ocean View Double Bed Room. Of course, this is not what we requested, so the front desk told us to check back in another 90 minutes. 

Around 4:30, we returned to the front desk. We were given a “wonderful, ocean view room on the 6th floor in Tower One with a Jacuzzi on the terrace.”  BEWARE IF THEY OFFER YOU THIS ROOM. Once we walked in, we immediately turned and walked back out. It is an extremely dated room that looks like it was last redecorated circa “Golden Girls” Season 3. It had none of the appeal of the new rooms, and the jacuzzi was less than inviting. I returned to the front desk, and we were told to check back around 6:00 for another room. At this point, it had been 4 hours, and we still had not been given accommodations.

ROOM SERVICE: 
Finally, around 6:00, we were given a Deluxe Ocean View King on the 5th Floor in the main tower, Tower 3. It was exactly what we were looking for. We settled in and decided to order room service before meeting our friends for dinner. We wanted salads, but were told that salads were not included with the all-inclusive package. Livid, I returned to the front desk. I was told the wrong room service menu was placed in my room, but for my inconvenience, I could order anything I wanted at no cost. (I thought this was the entire point of all-inclusive.)

Minutes later, recognizing that I was nonplussed and completely displeased, the front desk manager offered to move us a one-bedroom suite in the “Royal Service” tower for no additional charge as our first day had been a horrendous affair thus far. This tower has additional amenities and limited access to only guests of this Tower. At the time, only Lagoon View rooms were available, but the following day, we would be free to move to an Ocean View room to have the view that we initially requested.

GROUND-FLOOR “OCEAN” VIEW: 
The following day, we were offered a one-bedroom suite with an ocean-facing view. But, given that the “terrace” was actually below ground, the only thing one could see was grass. This in no way parallels an actual ocean-view from a higher floor. We refused the room and decided to stay in our suite facing the Lagoon on the entrance side of the property. 

But, because the resort proactively recognized that, once again, they had messed up, we were given a “complimentary” couples massage.

CHECK-OUT
Upon checkout, I looked at the bill and asked that our charges be reduced to reflect that we had a Lagoon View and not an Ocean View. The Front Desk Manager argued with me about the fact that my suite did not have an Ocean View. He literally had to send someone down to check.

Well, in the end, the resort refused to lower the charges, citing “we were given a complimentary upgrade to Royal Service, and we were also given complimentary massages.” Come again? We never requested those services.

So, we were taken away from the view and room that we requested to be placed into a room and view that we never requested with the unfulfilled promise that we would have an Ocean View, but we should still pay because we were offered amenities that we actually never requested. Not a good way to do business.

GENERAL MANAGER FIASCO:
As world travelers who have stayed in some of the best hotels across the globe, we are accustomed to the occasional hiccup in customer experience. We always speak directly to a General Manager in these cases, and we are promptly given the service and attention we should have received from the start. We asked to speak to the GM for two days straight to no avail. Upon check-out, we asked THREE times, but the Front Desk refused. Finally, they acquiesced and gave us a phone name and number. Because I knew the GM’s name, I knew that the information they had given me was fake.

We asked them to confirm that this person was indeed the GM repeatedly. Finally, after the 4th or 5th ask, the Front Desk Manager admitted that the person was actually on the Accounting Manager. Flabbergasted at the blatant disrespect and lies, we left the resort having endured the worst weekend getaway we’ve ever experienced.

reviews.author: callmej5
reviews.title: Picture perfect beach; average all-inclusive
reviews.text:
We stayed here prior to going to Paradisus La Perla in Playa, and this place definitely has its advantages and disadvantages.

Pros:
Short distance from the airport in the hotel zone
Courteous and attentive staff
Gorgeous beach with plenty of palapas and loungers
Wait staff serves food/drink on the beach
Both sides of the hotel look over water - either ocean or lagoon

Cons:
Mediocre food
Different sized rise and run on every stair you will climb!
Main tower music in the evening is quite loud if you stay in that tower and are trying to nap after a long day in the sun
Recurring sewage-like smell in the main tower in the evening near the bars/restaurants

I feel like I knew what to expect, and was okay with it.  Had a great time.  If you're a beach lover, great spot!  If you're into amazing food and luxurious accommodations, you may want to try La Perla.

reviews.author: onthebayou1
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed here in 2004 when the hotel was called the Gran Melia.  They recently changed the name to Paradisus.  This trip we came with my wifes sister and brother in law.  This was our first time to do all inclusive and I wasn't sure what to expect. We paid for the Royal Service and upgraded from Lagoon Front to Beach front.

The view from the room was amazing and the room was very clean and compfortable. With the Royal Service Plan, you are in a separate pyramid with maybe 140 rooms.  It has its own private conceirage service with breakfast in the morning, snacks in the afternoon, and dessert in the evening. The staff was very attentive and we were truly treated like royalty.  2 staff members stood out as exceptional.  Consuela and Diana served us both at the concierge level and the pool and they were both wonderful to us.

The pool area was beautiful and with Royal Service we got private cabanas at the pool and next to tbe beach.  Sergio made sure our cabanas were  reserved and set up when we arrived.  He also brought by fruit at just the right times.  We never wanted for food or drink at the pool or on the beach. The Royal Service pool area is separated from the other pools and is a bit more relaxing.  We ventured over the main pool one day and sat at the pool bar. It was louder and the bartenders frequently made a variety of shots for the partrons. They also had organized games in this area.

In addition to the games, they had a nightly show in the Avenue Bar.  We went to 3 of these shows. These shows were very cool.  We especially enjoyed the Paris Circus and the Belly Dancers. They had afternoon activities and I participated in the Tequlla Tasting, The Mixology Class, and the Sushi class. These events were fun, but not as polished as the shows.  They could improve participation in these by a little daily marketing, but they were fun.

For Dining, my favorite by far was Bana.  Wonderful Sushi in a cool setting. We also ate at the Blue Agave and the Market Griill. Both had great service and good food.  Naos is the buffet. I liked it for lunch but for dinner, I am not a buffet fan.

Wireless internet was free and mostly reliable.

We truly had a wonderful time and I expect we  will return.  I do suggest Ocean View and Royal Service, both are worth the price.
